### [272] [Context-dependent agent evaluation with orthogonal equilibrium learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31897)
*Haorui Ma,Zehua Zang,Jiangmeng Li,Yi Li,Fanjing Xu,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NashEval框架，通过将上下文依赖的智能体评估构建为双人零和博弈，利用去偏支付矩阵（DPM）和正交间隙损失从离线选择性反馈中学习上下文相关的纳什均衡，以识别异质偏好下每个上下文的最优智能体集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于分数的智能体评估方法（如Bradley-Terry）假设偏好具有传递性，但当人类判断来自异质群体时，集体偏好往往呈现非传递性，导致评估出现偏差或冲突。此外，上下文依赖的评估面临反馈选择性观测的挑战，朴素插件估计器会因干扰函数误设而产生偏差。

Method: 1）将评估建模为双人零和博弈，由反称支付矩阵刻画，纳什均衡的支撑集定义上下文相关的获胜者集合；2）Stage 1构建去偏支付矩阵（DPM），利用基于高效影响函数（EIF）的伪结果进行去偏，并证明其具有Neyman正交性；3）Stage 2设计正交间隙损失，结合DPM和正则化间隙函数学习上下文到均衡的映射，避免为每个上下文单独求解博弈；4）采用交叉拟合估计干扰函数，使用LightGBM和MLP进行实证实现。

Result: 在模拟数据集（K=5个智能体，不同投票者数量）上，NashEval在N_v≥3时优于所有基线，NashEval-debiased始终接近oracle；在RouterBench（10个LLM，8742个提示）和MO-Highway（5个RL智能体，256个配置）两个真实数据集上，NashEval-debiased取得最低的可利用度（0.380和0.066）和最高的支撑F1分数（0.300和0.708），在头部对决博弈值上优于所有对比方法；理论证明实现了准oracle收敛速率。

Conclusion: NashEval是首个在潜在非传递性集体偏好下进行上下文依赖智能体评估的博弈论框架，其去偏支付矩阵和正交间隙损失设计使框架对干扰函数误设具有鲁棒性，理论保证和实证结果均验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Many applications require to evaluate agents under contextual information (e.g., a prompt, task, or user group). We study how to perform such context-dependent agent evaluation from offline feedback. Existing score-based models for this purpose (e.g., Bradley-Terry) impose a transitive preference ordering, which fails to reflect collective preferences when human judgements are heterogeneous. Inspired by social choice theory, we frame evaluation as a contextual game between two players, each selecting a distribution over agents as the strategy to receive greater collective preference than the other. Then, the support of the Nash equilibrium defines a context-specific set of winners. However, learning context-specific equilibria from offline logs is difficult because each context reveals human feedback on only a subset of agents, and, hence, a naive plug-in estimator can therefore be biased. To address these challenges, we propose NashEval, a general framework for robust contextual equilibrium learning. NashEval first constructs debiased estimates of the contextual payoff matrix that characterizes the game. NashEval then learns the context-to-equilibrium mapping with a tailored orthogonal loss, which avoids the need to solve a separate game for each context. We show theoretically that errors in estimating the nuisance functions underlying the payoff matrix affect the risk of the learned equilibrium (i.e., exploitability) only through higher-order terms. Across various experiments, NashEval improves robustness of equilibrium learning and consistently identifies the set of top-performing agents across contexts.

</details>


### [273] [Choir: An Open Protocol for Distributed Multi-Agent Autoformalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31903)
*Yidi Qi,Melanie Weber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Choir 是一个用于分布式自动形式化的开放协议，通过 GitHub 仓库将形式化项目分解为可由独立贡献者在其自有 LLM 订阅上完成的任务，每个贡献都需通过确定性验证门才能合并，支持 Lean 4、Isabelle 和 Rocq。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大规模自动形式化工作（如 Meta FAIR 形式化教科书、Anthropic 形式化费马大定理）通常由单一团队集中运行所有智能体并承担全部计算成本（如 Meta FAIR 教科书形式化耗资约 10万–43万美元），学术团队难以企及。然而开源数学社区拥有分散在各贡献者自有 LLM 订阅中的巨大智能体算力，若能整合这些资源，大规模形式化将不再依赖单一资金充足的团队。

Method: Choir 围绕 GitHub 仓库组织四种角色：(1) 人类监督者（设定目标、审计策略、裁定新公理）；(2) 编排者智能体（规划项目、撰写定理陈述、以 YAML 记录形式在 issues 中发布任务、审查并合并 PR）；(3) 工作者智能体（贡献者在其自有机器和账户上声明任务、证明并提交 PR，无仓库写权限）；(4) 验证门（GitHub Actions 中的确定性审计）。工作流为：规划→发布任务→声明→证明提交→审查合并→必要时进一步分解。验证门执行四项检查：rebuild（从源码重建编译）、axiom-honesty（拒绝引入新 axiom 的提交）、sorry-delta（阻止遗留占位符，除非声明为分解）、statement-immutability（检查提交的陈述未被修改）。此外引入 golf 任务类型以缩短已有证明。

Result: 作者以 Lean 4 形式化 Yufei Zhao 的讲义《Probabilistic Methods in Combinatorics》作为测试案例（该讲义同时被 Meta FAIR 的 Atlas 收录，便于直接比较）。形式化结果开源在 yidiq7/ProbMethodCombinatorics，Choir 代码以 Apache-2.0 许可证开源在 Weber-GeoML/Choir。系统主要在教科书级别的 Lean 4 任务上验证，参与者使用 Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6 等商业模型。

Conclusion: Choir 通过将项目分解为任务并完全基于 GitHub 协调，使拥有自有 LLM 订阅的独立贡献者能够共同完成大规模形式化。其确定性验证门确保未知贡献者的提交质量，历史可视化器从 git 日志、issues 和 PR 重构证明树的构建过程。作者希望其他项目能在自己的仓库上部署 Choir 或将其与现有工作流结合，使学术小组和爱好者能在有限预算下通过协作完成大规模形式化。局限在于：在 Isabelle 和 Rocq 上 statement-immutability 仅做源码文本比较，可能遗漏改变语义但不改变文本的提交；尚未在 Mathlib 规模上测试编排者对数学结构的追踪能力。

Abstract: AI agents can now formalize entire textbooks and major theorems in proof assistants such as Lean, but current efforts are typically centralized: a single team runs all agents and bears the full computational cost. We introduce Choir, an open protocol for distributed formalization. Choir decomposes a project into tasks that can be completed by independent contributors, each running their own agent with their own LLM subscription, while coordinating entirely through the project's GitHub repository. To support open participation, every contribution is checked by a deterministic gate before merge. Choir supports Lean 4, Isabelle, and Rocq, and is open source and modular, allowing projects to replace individual components or extend the protocol.

</details>


### [274] [EmailBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Enterprise Email and Productivity Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31906)
*Mukul Singh,Mansi Uniyal,Devin Devlin,Wen Xie,Big Thadawasin,Ritam Dutt,Vivian Lai,Hyeonsu B. Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EmailBench 是一个自包含的企业邮件与生产力任务基准测试，包含 206 个跨 16 个任务类别的场景。其核心贡献包括一个类型化的邮件 API 规范、Enron 启发的合成语料库以及结合 258 个静态断言和 211 个 LLM 评分标准的混合评估协议。评估 8 种 LM 配置后，最佳模型仅通过 33.5% 的场景，尽管 99.7% 的工具调用成功完成，揭示了"有效工具执行 ≠ 任务完成"的核心问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准多关注网页导航、桌面交互或通用办公任务，缺乏对以邮件为中心、需跨邮箱、日历、联系人和任务实体进行信息检索、结构化状态变更、时间推理和多步协调的工作流进行评估。EmailBench 旨在填补这一空白，建立任务级工作流完成度（而非仅 API 执行成功率）的评估标准。

Method: 基准包含三大核心组件：(1) EmailBenchAPI 类型化邮件 API 规范，定义 119 个操作方法、36 个类型化接口，采用提供者中立的命名；(2) 基于 Enron 公开主题和人物关系的确定性合成语料库，包含 65 条消息、15 个事件、15 个联系人、10 个待办任务及相关生产力实体，跨实体互联；(3) 206 个场景分布于 16 个任务类别，难度分 D1-D3 三级，通过 4 个批次构建。评估采用混合协议：静态断言（258 条，含回复-包含 47.7%、状态检查 39.1%、存在性检查 12.4%）与 LLM 评分标准（211 条，覆盖正确性、完整性、相关性、格式、安全性、操作执行、无幻觉 7 个维度）等权结合，场景通过需总分≥0.5 且所有关键断言通过。

Result: 8 种 LM 配置（Claude Sonnet 4.5/Opus 4.1、o3、GPT-5 系列 5 个变体）的单次运行结果显示：Claude Sonnet 4.5 通过率最高（33.5%，69/206），Opus 4.1 为 29.6%，GPT-5 变体在 20.9%-28.2% 之间。所有配置的工具调用 API 失败率均低于 8%（最佳仅 0.3%），但场景通过率仍低。类别差异显著：Sonnet 4.5 在文件夹任务达 88.9%，而日历写入仅 16.7%；编排任务仅 17.6%。声明域数量越多，通过率越低（1 域 37.7%→4 域 14.3%）。4 个配置（Sonnet/Opus/GPT-5.4-R/o3）中，117 个场景全部失败（56.8%），仅 24 个场景全部通过。成功完成中，89.9%（Sonnet）至 65.2%（o3）在 5 轮迭代内结束。延迟方面，Sonnet 平均 27 秒（最高准确率），GPT-5 仅 13.6 秒（最低准确率）。

Conclusion: EmailBench 揭示了企业邮件智能体中"有效工具执行"与"任务工作流完成"之间的显著差距。核心结论是：API 级调用成功率不能代表用户请求被满足；成功的调用仍可能针对错误实体、违反时间约束或未完成多步工作流。未来工作方向包括：更广泛的工具暴露、多角色测试、重复运行评估、扩展语料库规模、专家校准和多轮交互评估。该基准为评估企业邮件智能体的工作流完成度提供了自包含、可重现的测试环境，强调应以用户请求的工作流完成为成功标准而非单个操作的执行。

Abstract: Enterprise email agents must combine information retrieval, structured state changes, temporal reasoning, and multi-step coordination. Recent agent benchmarks include productivity tasks, but few center on typed email workflows in a self-contained environment. We introduce EmailBench, a benchmark of 206 email and productivity scenarios across 16 task categories. The benchmark couples a typed email API specification with provider-neutral naming, a deterministic synthetic Enron-inspired corpus, and a scenario suite whose topic selection was informed by aggregate task-intent telemetry from an interactive prototype. Its hybrid evaluation protocol combines 258 executable static assertions with 211 LLM rubrics. We evaluate eight LM configurations on a fixed single-user corpus. The best-performing configuration passes only 33.5% of scenarios despite 99.7% of its tool calls completing without an observed API failure, with pass rates varying substantially across task categories. This gap shows that valid tool execution is not equivalent to task completion. EmailBench provides a self-contained environment for end-to-end email-agent evaluation, with broader tool coverage, multi-persona testing, and repeated-run evaluation as future work areas.

</details>


### [275] [Improving Medical Calculation of LLMs with Embedded Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31908)
*Tianshi Ming,Yingying Zhang,Xian Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MedCode框架,通过训练LLM生成嵌入式可执行代码来提升医学计算的数值精度,并引入加权直接偏好优化(wDPO)对困难样本自适应加权,在多个模型上取得20-30个百分点的绝对精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在医学考试与问答上表现良好,但在需要精确数值的医学计算(如药物剂量、肾功能评估、预后评分)上仍不可靠,即使能正确识别临床变量,也常因多步算术或公式系数错误导致严重临床后果。现有方法要么误差率高,要么需要多轮模型调用,效率与可靠性难以兼顾。

Method: MedCode框架:1)将MedCalc-Bench转换为嵌入式代码数据集进行SFT,使模型单次解码生成完整可执行脚本,由确定性解释器执行算术;2)通过错误驱动的偏好对构造(用不同温度采样SFT模型的错误脚本与参考脚本配对)构建偏好数据;3)提出加权DPO(wDPO),按模型对偏好对的概率间隔自适应赋权,并加入互补的自适应SFT正则项,重点优化难以区分的样本(系数/单位转换等微小错误)。另构建5000+1000条的ICU时序EHR计算数据集。

Result: 在MedCalc-Bench上,LLaMA3-8B和Mistral7B经SFT Code+wDPO后平均精度分别达55.34和59.73,相对零样本提升约40个百分点,优于GPT-4的50.91;在自建ICU数据集上,提取精度从52.39提升至83.20,频次计数精度从75.10提升至98.00;wDPO相比rDPO/ROPO/WPO分别提升4.50/1.09/3.01个百分点。微小错误(系数/变量)由360降至312例。

Conclusion: 嵌入式代码生成能显著提升LLM的医学计算可靠性,wDPO通过难度感知加权进一步改善对细微数值错误的区分能力;但方法依赖预定义计算器,泛化到未覆盖公式和长流程临床工作流仍存局限。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on medical examinations and question-answering benchmarks, but remain unreliable on medical calculation tasks that require exact numerical outputs. These calculations support high-stakes decisions such as medication dosing, organ-function assessment, and prognostic scoring, for which even small errors can have serious clinical consequences. We introduce MedCode, a framework that improves medical calculation by training LLMs to generate embedded executable code. Given a clinical context, the model identifies the relevant calculator, extracts its input variables, and produces a script that delegates arithmetic operations to a deterministic interpreter. Executing the script returns the calculated value together with an explanation and the appropriate unit. We construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference datasets from the MedCalc benchmark and additionally curate a dataset for calculation tasks in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) scenarios. We further propose weighted Direct Preference Optimization (wDPO), which adaptively emphasizes preference pairs that are difficult for the model to distinguish. Experiments with LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B show absolute accuracy gains of 20--30 percentage points, demonstrating the effectiveness of embedded code generation for medical calculation.

</details>


### [276] [BioDyad: Synchronize Biomedical Discovery and Machine Learning Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31939)
*Xingbo Du,Fadli Aulawi Al Ghiffari,Leonard Song,Loka Li,Duzhen Zhang,Zixiao Wang,Xiuying Chen,Le Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BioDyad 是一个用于生物医学机器学习的层级化智能体搜索框架,通过将生物医学发现与机器学习工程在蒙特卡洛图搜索(MCGS)中进行耦合,使用科学层级与工程层级双层结构,在 76 个 BioXArena 任务上以两小时预算和三种 LLM 后端(GPT-5.6-sol、GLM-5.1、DeepSeek-V4)取得最高的惩罚性全任务分数与任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自主生物医学 ML 系统中,生物医学证据获取与可执行程序搜索往往是两条相对独立的研究路线,难以在固定预算下持续协同。具体挑战包括:新证据必须指导候选程序构建、执行结果必须反馈后续发现与复用、验证开销必须适配搜索预算。论文旨在解决生物医学发现与 ML 工程在程序搜索全过程中协调困难的问题。

Method: BioDyad 在共享的蒙特卡洛图搜索(MCGS)骨干上引入两个层级:(1)科学层级——结合先验生物医学指导、节点级发现以及将生物医学计划与执行结果关联的记忆机制(plan-outcome memory),支持迭代式外部知识整合与跨候选复用;(2)工程层级——通过渐进式执行阶段(smoke execution → train/validation evaluation → full-data retraining)提供可行性、预测性与最终提交反馈。每个候选节点状态包括程序、生物医学计划、执行结果与验证分数。检索采用关键字与嵌入排序的倒数秩融合,记忆同时保留成功与失败记录。

Result: 在 BioXArena 76 个任务(覆盖九个生物医学领域)两小时预算下,使用 GPT-5.6-sol、GLM-5.1、DeepSeek-V4 三种 LLM 后端,BioDyad 在每种后端下均获得最高惩罚性全任务平均分(0.738 / 0.705 / 0.701)与任务成功率,优于 MLEvolve、Biomni、BioXArena Harness 及一次性基线。在 18 任务子集的三次重复运行中 BioDyad 平均分 0.711±0.002,稳定性最佳。消融实验(化学生物学与表型-疾病两个领域 16 个任务,GPT-5.4 后端)表明完整框架平均分 0.763 最高,仅添加发现而无记忆或分级评估时性能下降。诊断显示完整框架有效运行占比最高(80.9%),无效运行最少(108 次)。预算扩展分析显示 12 小时搜索可在部分任务(如阿尔茨海默病分期、COVID-19 严重程度)继续提升候选程序分数。

Conclusion: BioDyad 通过协调生物医学发现与 ML 工程,在固定预算下显著优于现有自主 ML 智能体与生物医学智能体,验证了将外部领域知识整合到可执行程序并贯穿搜索过程的价值。消融研究支持同时使用发现、记忆与分级评估三者的必要性。其局限性包括:依赖外部生物医学资源质量与覆盖、先验指导与发现需额外 LLM 调用、评估限于有监督 BioXArena 任务,扩展到湿实验等长周期科学工作流仍待探索。

Abstract: Agentic biomedical machine learning (ML) draws on complementary advances in biomedical evidence acquisition and executable program search. Existing systems connect aspects of these capabilities, but coordinating them throughout program search remains challenging. New evidence must guide candidate construction, execution outcomes must inform subsequent discovery and reuse, and validation demands must fit the search budget. We introduce BioDyad, which couples biomedical discovery and ML engineering through two hierarchies within Monte Carlo graph search. Its scientific hierarchy combines prior biomedical guidance with iterative discovery, then links biomedical plans to execution outcomes in memory for reuse across candidates. Its engineering hierarchy moves candidate programs from smoke execution, through train/validation evaluation, to full-data retraining. We evaluate BioDyad on the 76-task BioXArena benchmark under a two-hour per-task budget with three matched LLM backends. It achieves the highest penalized all-task score and task success rate among four agent methods and a one-shot baseline under each backend. These results support coordinating biomedical discovery and ML engineering to integrate external knowledge into executable programs across heterogeneous biomedical tasks.

</details>


### [277] [Symbolic Guidance for LLM Agents in Distributed Multiagent Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31963)
*Ben Rachmut,Ning Zhang,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik,William Yeoh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出符号引导分类法（SGT），研究不同自主度水平的符号引导对LLM多智能体分布式协调性能的影响，发现中等自主度（基于函数级描述/伪代码的部分引导）表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在分布式协调任务中表现不稳定，尤其是在需要全局一致性的复杂场景中。研究者希望探究如何通过引入源自经典算法的符号引导来调节智能体自主度，从而提升协调可靠性。

Method: 1) 提出符号引导分类法SGT，沿自主度光谱定义五种智能体类型（AgentsNet无引导、函数描述、函数伪代码、主伪代码、完整伪代码）及两个基线（AgentsNet、Code）；2) 基于AgentsNet基准扩展，加入全局变体任务（3-着色、最大匹配、最小顶点覆盖）；3) 采用MIS启发式和分布式DFS两种算法；4) 测试Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B和Gemini-2.5 Flash三种LLM；5) 使用SSE指标在Smallworld、Scalefree、Delaunay三类图拓扑（n=16）上进行评估。

Result: Gemini总体表现最优；在基于MIS的局部和全局变体任务中，函数级（function-description和function-pseudocode）中间自主度引导持续优于无引导AgentsNet基线和完整伪代码约束；Llama对引导较为敏感且普遍受益，Qwen则对引导不敏感；源自复杂全局DFS算法的引导效果有限甚至有害。

Conclusion: LLM多智能体的分布式协调性能与自主度之间的关系并非单调，而取决于符号引导的形式与算法复杂度的匹配程度。源自简单启发式算法的中间级符号引导（函数描述或函数伪代码）效果最佳，平衡了结构化支撑与LLM推理灵活性。SGT为调节LLM智能体自主度提供了系统性设计原则。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in multi-agent systems, yet their ability to reliably execute distributed coordination protocols remains poorly understood. While AgentsNet, a benchmark framework for distributed coordination among LLM agents, enables such coordination, granting full reasoning autonomy often leads to inconsistent or degraded performance in complex domains. We hypothesize that coordination can be improved by regulating agent autonomy through symbolic guidance derived from established algorithms. To investigate this, we introduce the \emph{Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy (SGT)}, which characterizes a spectrum of autonomy ranging from open-ended natural language reasoning to fully prescribed algorithmic execution, with intermediate levels providing partial pseudocode guidance. Our results show that intermediate autonomy levels consistently outperform both unguided agents and fully prescriptive specifications. These findings identify autonomy regulation as a key design principle for LLM-based distributed coordination.

</details>


### [278] [Goal-Persistent Coding Agents as Scientific Performance Engineers: A Fixed-Radius Nearest-Neighbor Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31980)
*Xiangyang Ju*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过一个repository级的案例研究，展示了通用的目标持久型编码代理（Codex和Claude Code）能够自主进行假设驱动的科学性能工程优化，并以固定半径最近邻搜索（FRNN）为具体对象，最终在保持与暴力搜索完全一致结果的前提下实现了显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学GPU软件性能优化通常需要领域知识与软硬件栈理解，由资深性能工程师迭代完成。尽管近期出现了可在多轮工具调用中维持完成契约的目标持久型编码代理，但通用编码代理是否能够执行严肃的科学性能工程仍是未经验证的实证问题。本文旨在回答这一开放性问题。

Method: 采用repository级案例研究方法：以Xue的PyTorch相关CUDA FRNN实现为起点，向现成的Codex与Claude Code代理提供一个包含正确性测试、性能分析需求与验收标准的可执行目标文档，但不规定转换序列。代理通过外层假设循环与内层超参数循环自主迭代，实验结果通过仓库工件持久化。两个独立轨迹分别由Codex+Claude Code主路径和独立的Claude Code重跑组成。

Result: 主轨迹中，代理自主移除PyTorch依赖并生成独立C++/CUDA库libFRNN，其同步NumPy接口相比原始GPU驻留PyTorch接口在RTX 2070 SUPER上实现1.58倍加速（中位数299.6 ms vs 473.0 ms，全部30轮配对均利于新实现，p=1.86×10⁻⁹）；在A100-SXM4上也观察到1.38–1.50倍的加速。最终审计保留了267.8 ms的精确结果，结合了四轴网格、结构化数组布局、舍入安全早期拒绝等多项创新。独立重跑探索了不同假设序列，在目标工作负载上达到207.3 ms，但依赖于该工作负载的密度假设。

Conclusion: 目标持久型编码代理可作为实验性性能工程师发挥作用；可执行的科学契约既可指导也可验证其优化过程。然而本研究仅基于单一主轨迹与一次重跑，预算不等，未能估计重复运行期望或隔离目标持久性、模型选择、探查器访问等因素的独立贡献。未来工作应表征可重复性、扩展到更广泛工作负载与硬件、并将其推广到端到端科学工作流。

Abstract: Coding agents can pursue persistent objectives across many tool-use turns, but evidence that general-purpose agents can conduct rigorous scientific performance engineering remains limited. We present a repository-scale case study in which off-the-shelf Codex and Claude Code agents optimize fixed-radius nearest-neighbor (FRNN) search for particle tracking. Starting from a PyTorch-dependent CUDA implementation, the agents follow an executable goal that specifies exact-correctness tests, profiling requirements, and acceptance criteria without prescribing code transformations. In the primary sequential trajectory, they autonomously remove the PyTorch dependency and conduct hypothesis-driven optimization experiments. The resulting standalone C++/CUDA library exactly reproduces the targeted reference result. Its synchronous NumPy interface achieved 1.6-fold speedup over the original GPU-resident PyTorch interface, despite including host transfers. Similar speedups were observed across different GPU architectures and software stacks. An independent optimization rerun followed a different sequence of hypotheses and reached even better performance on the target workload. These results show that goal-persistent coding agents can act as experimental performance engineers, and that executable scientific contracts are needed both to guide and to validate their optimization.

</details>


### [279] [CSI-Agent: LLM-Assisted Few-Shot Adaptation for Cross-Domain Wi-Fi CSI Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31990)
*Tianya Zhao,Chuan Liu,Xuyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CSI-Agent，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理框架，用于 Wi-Fi 信道状态信息（CSI）跨域感知中的少样本自适应。其核心思想是将跨域 CSI 自适应从传统的固定模型优化重新定义为部署时的决策问题：构建一个受限的"感知动作工具箱"（源分类器、三种互补 CSI 视图、全局原型对齐的岭分类器、支持加权融合），针对每个类别生成结构化的"诊断卡"（support 适配度、激活率、风险标志），由 LLM 规划器为每个类别提议动作，再由确定性验证器和有界执行器把关。在四个公开数据集（CSI-Bench、WiAR、SignFi、WiMANS）共五个跨域划分（设备、用户、环境、组合偏移）上的 1-shot 实验中，CSI-Agent 在所有划分上均取得最佳目标域 Macro-F1，平均较最强基线 FewSense 提升约 16 个百分点（绝对值 0.4890 vs 0.3233），并在 SignFi 等极端跨域场景下提升超过 50 个百分点。同时验证了对 LLM 骨干（Qwen3.5-9B、Llama-3.1-8B、GPT-5.4-mini、Claude Haiku 4.5）的鲁棒性，以及相较"样本级 LLM"推理 8.8×–547× 的延迟降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wi-Fi CSI 感知模型在跨域部署（用户、环境、设备变化）时性能严重退化；现有少样本自适应方法对整个目标域施加同一种适配策略，但实际中：(1) 同一策略在不同目标域甚至同一域的不同类别上效果差异巨大；(2) 源模型置信度在跨域下高度不可靠（>0.9 置信度样本中 49.6%–69.2% 仍错误）；(3) 原始 CSI 序列化后单样本即约 112K tokens，无法直接送入通用 LLM。因此作者主张将跨域 CSI 自适应重新定义为部署时、类别级的"决策问题"，由 LLM 代理基于结构化感知证据进行可审计、可验证的决策。

Method: 四阶段框架：(1) 受限感知动作工具箱 A = {a_src, a_full, a_lowpass, a_qband, a_SW}：源动作直接使用冻结源分类器；三个互补 CSI 视图（全/低通/四分之一子载带）经源特征提取器得到表征后，结合"源原型 + 全局均值漂移 Δ^v"构造移位原型，并以岭回归拟合"support + 移位原型锚定"的视图分类器；a_SW 基于 support 可靠性 Macro-F1 加权融合三视图得分。(2) 类别级诊断卡：包含 support 适配度（正类召回/均值概率/秩、负类误激活率/One-vs-Rest 间隔）、激活适配度（QRate 与均匀参考 1/C 比较）、风险标志、verdict 四字段。(3) LLM 规划与验证：对每个类别 c 输出结构化 {status, failure_mode, action, reason}；验证器检查动作是否与 failure_mode 一致、相对 SW 默认是否有 support 侧改善、无明显误激活/支持侧类分离退化，否则拒绝并回退到默认。(4) 有界执行：z_c(x)=P_SW^c(x)+β·g_c·[P_a_c^c(x)-P_SW^c(x)]，β=0.35，预测取最大似然上值。LLM 仅做类别级规划，不接触原始 CSI 或样本级推理。

Result: 主要结果（1-shot 目标域 Macro-F1）：CSI-Bench Device 0.3464（最强基线 SimCLR 0.3403）、CSI-Bench Compositional 0.3431（最强基线 SimCLR 0.3242）、WiAR Cross-User 0.4006（最强基线 FewSense 0.2885，提升 +0.1121）、SignFi Cross-Env 0.7977（最强基线 PTN 0.2926，提升 +0.5051）、WiMANS Cross-Env 0.5571（最强基线 TOSS 0.4725，提升 +0.0226）；五划分平均 0.4890，较最强基线 FewSense 0.3233 绝对提升 +0.1657（相对约 +51%）。类别级选择优于域级选择：13 个目标域中 12 个领域改进，仅 1 个退化 0.2pp。消融：去 LLM 平均 -2.93pp，去 query 证据平均 -3.25pp（WiMANS -12.55pp），去验证器 WiAR/SignFi 各退化 1.3–2.3pp，去有界执行 CSI-Bench Comp/WiMANS 各退化 1.4–1.8pp。支持样本数从 1 增至 7 时性能单调上升，1→3 增益最大。LLM 骨干鲁棒：1-shot 平均 48.57–48.90%、5-shot 平均 62.65–62.77%，四模型差异极小。开销：CSI-Agent 每域 20.59–91.02 s、4.81K–47.67K 输入 tokens；对比"样本级 LLM"延迟降低 8.8×–547×，tokens 降低 3.3×–661.9×。

Conclusion: CSI-Agent 验证了将 LLM 代理用于 Wi-Fi CSI 跨域自适应的可行性：通过紧凑、感知-grounded 的类别级证据将 LLM 决策与高维非语言 CSI 信号解耦，并以验证器+有界执行保证安全回退，可显著提升少样本跨域感知性能，对不同 LLM 骨干鲁棒，并避免代价高昂的样本级 LLM 推理。作者认为，当 LLM 决策被结构化感知证据约束并由可靠执行机制把关时，LLM 代理可有效支持实际跨域部署。

Abstract: Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) has enabled device-free sensing applications such as human activity recognition. However, CSI sensing models remain brittle in cross-domain deployment, where changes in users or environments can produce incorrect predictions. Existing solutions usually treat this problem as an offline model-design problem, by pretraining a stronger representation or applying one fixed adaptation method to the entire target domain. In practice, labeled target data are scarce and different classes may fail in different ways under the same domain shift. To address this, we propose CSI-Agent, an evidence-seeking LLM agent that reformulates cross-domain CSI adaptation as a deployment-time decision-making problem. Rather than processing raw CSI or making sample-level predictions, CSI-Agent summarizes target-domain behavior into sensing-grounded class-level evidence. It establishes a strong target-adaptive default from complementary CSI views and uses an LLM planner to determine whether each class should retain the default or invoke a specialized action. Deterministic verification and bounded execution further reduce unreliable interventions. We evaluate CSI-Agent on four public datasets using five cross-domain splits covering device, user, environment, and compositional shifts. Under 1-shot adaptation, CSI-Agent achieves the best target-domain performance across all splits and improves the average Macro-F1 by about 16\% compared to the strongest baseline method.

</details>


### [280] [SenseAgent: An LLM Agent for Adaptive Cross-Domain IMU Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32000)
*Tianya Zhao,Chuan Liu,Xuyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SenseAgent 提出了一种基于 LLM 引导的智能体框架，将跨域 IMU 活动识别从静态推理流水线转变为闭环感知过程，通过 LLM 作为运行时规划器协调感知工具、源域经验记忆、在线目标记忆和验证器，在用户、位置和复合分布偏移下实现自适应的 IMU 感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 IMU 跨域方法通常采用固定的预训练表示、数据增强或单一适配策略，但实际部署中目标域是渐进式观察的、标签稀缺，且不同域偏移需要不同的感知动作。同一 OOD 类别下难度差异显著，固定适配规则可能导致负迁移。

Method: SenseAgent 使用 LLM 作为结构化运行时规划器（而非 IMU 分类器），包含四个核心组件：(1) 源经验记忆（冻结骨干网络、原型库、源校准可靠性）；(2) 在线目标记忆（无标签目标窗口的有验证缓存）；(3) 四种感知工具（原始推理、重力感知、原型匹配、风格归一化）；(4) 验证器（检查源支持、目标记忆稳定性和无伤害条件）。LLM 规划器基于诊断报告提出结构化动作（路由、反馈使用、记忆更新），由验证器决定是否执行。支持稀缺用户反馈，无需重新训练骨干网络。

Result: 在 HHAR、TNDA、PAMAP2、Feng 四个数据集上的实验表明，SenseAgent 在零反馈和稀缺反馈设置下均优于基线方法。在 PAMAP2 位置 OOD 上将 macro-F1 从 0.1531 提升至 0.2972，复合 OOD 从 0.1910 提升至 0.4089；在 TNDA 位置 OOD 上从 0.4473 提升至 0.5263。验证器控制的路由选择对避免负迁移至关重要，在 Feng 数据集上验证器覆写了 93.7% 的重力动作。LLM 规划器优于确定性规则路由器，运行时延迟可接受（原始路由 7.82ms/窗口，报告级 1.76s）。

Conclusion: SenseAgent 将跨域 IMU 感知重构为闭环智能感知问题，通过验证器保护的 LLM 引导规划实现安全自适应的域偏移处理。实验证明验证路由选择在放置和复合偏移下显著改善跨域感知，并在有限用户反馈下进一步受益。框架骨干网络和 LLM 均灵活可替换，为实际部署中的鲁棒自适应感知系统提供了基础。

Abstract: Deep learning has improved inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensing for mobile and wearable applications. However, an IMU model trained in one domain often becomes unreliable when it is used with a new user, device, or body position. Existing methods usually treat this problem as a static model-design task: they pretrain a stronger representation, add data augmentation, or select one adaptation method before deployment. In practice, the target domain is only gradually observed, labels are scarce, and different domain shifts require different sensing actions. This paper presents SenseAgent, an LLM-guided sensing agent for cross-domain IMU activity recognition. Instead of asking an LLM to classify raw IMU signals, SenseAgent uses the LLM as a runtime planner over sensing tools, source-domain experience memory, online target memory, and verifiers. The agent builds a label-free diagnosis report from the target stream and uses it to decide whether to keep raw inference or invoke specialized tools, including gravity-aware sensing, prototype transfer, and style normalization. Verifiers check source calibration, target-memory reliability, and no-harm criteria before accepting high-risk tool decisions. SenseAgent also supports scarce feedback without retraining the backbone or replacing the label-free route. This design converts cross-domain IMU sensing from a fixed inference pipeline into a closed-loop sensing process that diagnoses target shifts, selects suitable sensing actions, and rejects unsafe adaptations. We evaluate SenseAgent across multiple IMU datasets and deployment shifts. Results show that its verified route selection improves cross-domain sensing, especially under harder placement and compound shifts, and further benefits from limited user feedback.

</details>


### [281] [What Does the Rank Buy? A Spectral and Distributional Analysis of Low-Rank Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32002)
*Babak Barazandeh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文挑战了LoRA中秩r作为容量控制的传统直觉，证明了在每因子范数预算下，秩限制实际上是"不活跃"的——所有极值泛函都在秩一点上取到。文章将秩r的角色从"容量控制"重新定位为"可达性"与"可负担性"：秩决定了哪些更新可达以及消除预训练权重奇异方向需要多大预算，而不是模型拥有多少容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LoRA的实际应用中，秩r被广泛视为容量控制手段：较小的秩意味着更简单的模型、更好的泛化能力。这一"容量论证"被几乎所有经验研究和自适应秩分配方法所采用，但鲜有研究将其与LoRA训练时实际施加的约束集（权重衰减、范数控制）进行严格对照检验。本文正是要检验这一直觉是否经得起理论分析。

Method: 方法围绕"秩一极值原理"（rank-one extremality）展开。核心工具是：1) 引理1将LoRA可达集𝒜_r精确刻画为秩≤r截断的核范数球；2) 引理2证明在该集合上，线性Rademacher泛函和Frobenius范数均在秩一点取极值。分析围绕三个问题展开：Q1（统计复杂度）使用Rademacher复杂度的精确计算；Q2（谱结构）通过定义谱阈值秩r_spec(ε)并给出匹配的上界和下界；Q3（几何）通过Wasserstein距离刻画可迁移性锥的几何半径，并证明在温和预算条件下存在秩一高斯极值构造。所有结果均辅以高斯实例化（如Example 1）验证对齐假设。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 自由读出LoRA类对所有r≥1作为函数集完全相同（命题1），其精确Rademacher复杂度与r无关；矩阵层复杂度ρ·E‖S‖₂/n同样与r无关（命题2）；最坏情形简化ρX_max√(m/n)被证明与秩无关（引理3(ii)）。(2) 在联合Frobenius预算下，矩阵值复杂度精确形式为ρ·E‖S_r‖_F/n（引理3），仅在数据协方差有效秩条件下算子范数上界可优于秩无关Frobenius分支。(3) 谱阈值秩r_spec(ε)在多项式衰减下为O((1/ε)^{1/(2α)})，几何衰减下为O(log(1/ε))，且上下界在双侧谱衰减条件c₁≍‖ΔΣ‖₂下一致。(4) 散度定义的锥具有环境尺度半径（无穷或在球支撑下半域直径），而推前约束的锥具有秩无关的万能半径上界√(λ_max(Σ_S))·ρ，且该上界在高斯源上由秩一构造达到严格等号（命题6）。两个泛化界：Wasserstein传输界（定理3）和谱消除界（推论1）从两个角度利用谱机制。

Conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：在LoRA的每因子范数预算框架下，秩r并不控制模型容量——这是"秩一极值原理"的直接推论。秩的真正作用在于两方面：统计上，秩仅在联合预算与矩阵值层面的交互中才能恢复有限但有条件的秩敏感性；谱上，秩决定了消除预训练权重W_0前r个奇异方向所需达到的核范数预算门槛，即秩设定了适配的"价格"而非容量。这一重新定位对实践具有直接含义：秩的选择应针对W_0的谱衰减与可接受预算，而非将其作为假设类复杂度的控制手段。同时，一个被本文框架提出但未解决的开放问题是：在每因子权重衰减下，优化动态是否隐式选择低核范数而非低秩解——若是，则核范数本身才是值得调节的量。

Abstract: The rank $r$ in LoRA is widely treated as a capacity control: a smaller rank is assumed to yield a simpler model that generalizes better. We show that, under hard per-factor norm budgets---the idealization of the weight decay and norm control used in practice---this intuition breaks down. The reason is structural: under such budgets, the updates LoRA can reach are exactly the matrices of rank at most $r$ inside a nuclear-norm ball, and every complexity and displacement functional we analyze is maximized over this set by a rank-one update---so the rank cap never binds. The consequences follow directly. The linear-readout model class we study is identical for every $r \ge 1$, its Rademacher complexity carries no dependence on $r$, and the distance the adaptation can move the source distribution obeys a rank-independent upper bound that we show is sharp. If rank does not control capacity, where does it act? We identify two places. Statistically, replacing the per-factor budgets with a joint budget on the product restores a data-dependent, rank-sensitive complexity bound---though the gain appears only for well-spread feature distributions, and the worst case remains rank-free. Spectrally, rank sets the price of adaptation: canceling the leading singular directions of the pretrained weight requires both sufficient rank and sufficient budget. We bound the smallest rank achieving a desired source--target alignment, with upper and lower bounds that match under two-sided spectral decay. Together, these results recast rank as governing which updates are reachable and what cancellation costs---not how much capacity the model has.

</details>


### [282] [Decentralized Master-Mind: Joint Action Refinement through Iterative Intent Denoising in Multi-Agent Pathfinding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32019)
*Valeriy Vyaltsev,Anton Andreychuk,Taisia Zlotnikova,Konstantin Yakovlev,Aleksandr Panov,Alexey Skrynnik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DMM（Decentralized Master-Mind），一种通过迭代意图精化（inspired by diffusion denoising）在多智能体路径规划（MAPF）中实现去中心化联合动作协调的方法，并配合MICPO强化学习算法进行微调，在POGEMA和MovingAI基准测试上取得了优于现有学习方法的成功率与解质量，并能处理超过百万智能体的障碍物密集环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化MAPF中，即使每个智能体的动作分布学习得当，独立采样仍可能将各智能体局部有效的动作组合成不相容的联合动作（即使得碰撞或死锁的joint action）。这一失败源于one-shot采样机制，无法表达agent间的残余依赖关系，尤其在多模态专家分布下（多个valid joint actions共存时）。通信能丰富每个agent的条件信息，但一旦信息固定，独立的最终采样仍会产生乘积分布，无法捕捉agent间的协调。

Method: 1）**去中心化因子分解鸿沟（Decentralized Factorization Gap）的形式化**：将非自回归序列生成中的KL下界（conditional total correlation）从token维度迁移到agent维度，证明了即使有理想学习能力，乘积形式的独立采样执行器与专家联合分布之间存在由TC(A|X)和缺失局部信息造成的不可约误差。2）**DMM（Decentralized Master-Mind）**：将一次性动作采样替换为对"动作意图（action intent）"的离散迭代精化。Agent初始化随机intent（从Dirichlet先验），在K轮通信中通过消息传递与邻居交换intent，每轮采样离散投票并以步长δ累积更新intent，最终以argmax commit。**关键创新**：被精化的中间状态本身是通信信号的一部分，使agents在commitment前就能相互影响stochastic choices。两个架构变体：DMM-3M（保留LC-MAPF的Transformer编解码骨干，3.24M参数）和DMM-0.8M（结构化轻量架构，763K参数，约4.25×小）。3）**模仿学习预训练**：监督每轮的专家动作投票，使用teacher forcing（初始intent偏置β₁和逐轮投票替换βᵣ），并向非零floor退火以维持intent轨迹的expert信号。5）**MICPO（Multi-agent Iterative Commitment Policy Optimization）**：无critic的group-relative RL方法。在每个环境步共享初始intent z⁰采样G个匹配轨迹，分别归一化off-goal和blocked动作两组回报分量，计算组相对优势；执行round-level（per agent, per refinement round）的PPO-clip目标，并加KL正则化锚定模仿预训练参考策略。

Result: 1）**走廊实验**：DMM将valid joint-action frequency从基线的~50%（独立采样均匀分配）提升到94.8%（K_test=4），且99.9%（K_test=12），证明迭代精化将概率集中到两种valid resolutions。零teacher-forcing floor则丢失集中性，回到近均匀分布。2）**POGEMA基准**（Random/Mazes/Warehouse/Cities-Tiles）：DMM-MICPO-3M在最大团队规模下（Warehouse 192 agents: SR 1.000 vs LC-MAPF-3M 0.938；Cities-Tiles 256 agents: SR 0.922 vs 0.805）优于所有学习基线；SoC比率中位数1.006–1.102且四分位距最窄。3）**MovingAI基准**（1,600任务）：DMM-MICPO-3M求解1,598/1,600（最高覆盖），DMM-MICPO-0.8M求解1,593，HMAGAT 1,576，LG-LaCAM 1,569，LaGAT 1,543，MAPF-LNS2 1,411。DMM-MICPO-3M匹配virtual-best SoC于736任务（多对最佳），q₉₅ SoC比率仅107.3%。4）**大规模可扩展性**：在2304×2304迷宫（~29.1%障碍，密度3.48%-27.86%），DMM-MICPO-0.8M成功求解所有测试实例至1,048,576同时智能体（百万级！最大solo attempt），最低episode 16,345步，平均决策时间0.745–3.401 μs/agent/step；GPU-PIBT则在所有运行中未能完成（最终on-goal仅89.15%-98.91%）。5）**消融**：通信intent演进是协调关键（移除intent z或固定z⁰或shuffled均导致性能骤降）；MICPO提高小K_test下的性能；round级TF比initial-intent TF贡献更大。

Conclusion: 1）揭示了去中心化MAPF中独立最终采样的结构性局限：即使正确学习的per-agent分布与完美通信，one-shot采样仍因乘积形式无法表达agent间残余依赖。2）证明round-level intent refinement可有效耦合agents' evolving choices before commitment，提升联合动作协调同时保持去中心化执行（局部同时commit）。3）MICPO作为critic-free group-relative RL方法，能在multi-round refinement下进行稳定的多智能体优化，避免集中化critic的组合爆炸或去中心化critic的信息不足。4）DMM+MICPO在POGEMA上取得竞争性表现，在MovingAI上以学习策略取得最高任务覆盖（1,598/1,600），且是首个完整求解百万智能体障碍密集MAPF实例的学习策略。5）剩余局限：DMM不将可行性作为硬约束执行，不可行的中间选择不被显式排除，仍需外部shielding（如CS-PIBT，本文中使系统中心化）。将显式可行性约束纳入refinement process是自然的下一步工作。

Abstract: Decentralized multi-agent path finding (MAPF) with communication requires agents to reach individual goals without collisions under partial observability. Learnable policies trained on expert data provide an effective approach to this problem. However, when several coordinated joint actions are valid in the same context, independently sampling from per-agent distributions can recombine locally valid choices into incompatible joint actions. This failure can arise from the final sampling mechanism even when the per-agent action distributions are learned correctly. DMM (Decentralized Master-Mind) addresses this by replacing one-shot action sampling with discrete, iterative refinement of action intents across communication rounds, inspired by denoising in diffusion models. Agents initialize random action intents and refine them through local communication, coupling their choices before commitment. DMM is pretrained with imitation learning on expert MAPF solutions and further optimized with MICPO, a critic-free group-relative reinforcement-learning method designed for multi-agent, multi-round action refinement. DMM generally achieves higher success rates and lower solution costs than the evaluated learnable baselines. On 1,600 MovingAI tasks, DMM fine-tuned with MICPO solves 1,598, the highest coverage among the evaluated methods, while achieving solution costs close to those of the strongest baselines. DMM also scales to over one million simultaneously acting agents in obstacle-rich environments. These results show that round-level intent refinement can improve joint-action coordination while preserving decentralized execution.

</details>


### [283] [A Benchmark for LLM's Understanding of Middle School and High School Science Topics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32020)
*Noah L. Schroeder,Yessy Eka Ambarwati,Yuji Zhang,ChengXiang Zhai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对K-12科学教育中缺乏与课程标准对齐的LLM评测基准这一问题，开发了一个符合NGSS（新一代科学教育标准）的综合评测基准，并通过合成数据流水线、多裁判验证和项目级心理测量分析，系统评估了9个开源大模型在中学科学课程中的表现。研究发现较小的本地可部署模型在准确性上表现优异，模型规模并非性能的稳定预测因素；同时指出合成测试项与NGSS标准并未完全对齐，强调人机协同与扩展交互式评测的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM在教育场景的应用日益广泛，但教师缺乏与课程标准对齐的工具来评估其在K-12科学教育中的有效性。现有基准主要测试通用语言能力或高阶科学推理能力，对中等教育课程直接相关内容的覆盖不足，亟需填补这一空白。

Method: 1. 基于NGSS标准开发覆盖中学（初中与高中）科学课程的综合评测基准；2. 采用严格的合成数据流水线生成题目；4. 引入多裁判（multi-judge）验证机制；6. 结合项目层面的心理测量评估；8. 系统评测9个开源权重LLM；12. 邀请人类评审者对合成知识点的权威性进行人机协同验证。

Result: 多个规模较小的本地可部署模型在不同的科学领域与题目类型上均取得了较高的准确率；模型规模与性能之间并未呈现一致的正相关关系；人类评审发现合成生成的测试项与NGSS标准并未完全对齐。

Conclusion: 为教育场景选择LLM时应注重有针对性的选型而非仅凭规模判断；合成数据生成不能完全替代人机协同的项目开发流程；未来需进一步探索学科专业知识与教学法知识的交叉融合，并将基准扩展到交互式、基于证据的教学反馈场景，以全面评估LLM的教育应用价值。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into educational settings, yet educators lack robust, standards-aligned tools to evaluate their effectiveness in K-12 science contexts. Existing benchmarks predominantly assess general language or advanced scientific reasoning, leaving a critical gap in understanding LLMs' performance on content directly relevant to secondary science curricula. To address this gap, we developed a comprehensive NGSS-aligned benchmark for both middle and high school science using a rigorous synthetic data pipeline, multi-judge validation, and item-level psychometric analysis. Nine open-weight LLMs were systematically evaluated using this benchmark, indicating that several smaller, locally deployable models achieved high accuracy across diverse science domains and question types. Our findings indicate that model size did not consistently predict performance, emphasizing the importance of intentional model selection for educational deployment. We then incorporated a human reviewer into the loop, reviewing the items generated by the LLMs for alignment with NGSS standards. The human review indicated that synthetically generated items were not in perfect alignment with the NGSS standards, indicating the benefits of human-in-the-loop item development, the need to explore the intersection of content and pedagogical knowledge, and the need to extend benchmarks to evaluate LLMs' capacity for interactive, evidence-based feedback in educational scenarios.

</details>


### [284] [Reasoning Concentrates Errors, and Self-Consistency Never Notices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32035)
*Asaad Althoubi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文通过Qwen3模型的"同权重推理开关"实验设计，揭示了推理模式会集中模型的错误（而非如自一致性假设那样分散），导致自一致性投票在错误区分上失效，且置信度加权投票无法修复这一缺陷。最终结论是：置信度信号应基于决策而非区分度来评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自一致性（self-consistency）方法假设：模型不确定时会产出不同答案，因此一致性是正确性的证据。但近期多项研究指出该假设存在问题，但未能给出机制解释。本文动机是：(1) 由于推理模型与非推理模型在训练数据、后训练流程等多方面不同，传统对比无法归因于"推理"本身；(2) 需要找到机制解释为何自一致性在推理模型上失败。

Method: 1. 识别策略：使用Qwen3-8B/32B的"同权重开关"——仅通过标志位在thinking和non-thinking模式间切换，保持参数、tokenizer、提示、采样参数完全固定。2. 实验规模：8个模型、5个基准、74,944个样本（每问题k=8次独立采样）。3. 核心指标"碰撞指数（collision index）"：在固定权重内，测量两个独立错误答案重合的概率（类Herfindahl指数）。4. 统计协议：聚类自助法（按问题）、Holm-Bonferroni校正（在整个280组合族上应用一次）、配对符号检验等。5. 比较12个置信度信号与7种加权聚合方法。

Result: 1. 推理集中错误：10/10数据集-规模对比均显示推理模式错误碰撞率更高（精确符号检验p=0.00098）；在匹配子集（双方都出错的问题）上9/9支持推理。2. 在无界答案空间上推理将不同答案数量降至0.43-0.65；在有界空间上（如GPQA 4选项、MMLU-Pro 10选项）两臂持有相同选项集，但推理臂将质量更集中。3. 看似三倍的准确性提升是头部空间差异的假象——两臂实际转换的可用头部空间比例几乎完全相同（约25%）。4. "危险区"（少数样本正确的问题）扩张：推理臂使其缩小2.7倍，恰好抵消错误集中的负面影响。5. 280个组合中无一能在校正后超越简单多数投票；加权投票与多数投票98.5%一致，分歧时仅56.3%正确。6. 信号方向可逆转：在8B权重内，答案对数概率在推理关闭时预测正确、开启时预测错误。7. 学习的六信号组合出域时无任何增益（-0.0003）。

Conclusion: 推理通过双重作用影响投票：(1) 集中错误使投票在"危险区"内更糟；(2) 因模型更准确而缩小危险区2.7倍。二者大致抵消，因此聚合准确性表面上无明显差异。但没有任何下游方法能修复错误集中——所有置信度加权方法均失败。信号的方向是模型的属性而非信号本身的属性。实践建议：报告答案率、使用定长度不变的质重函数、比较置信度AUROC时考虑猜测上限、推理vs非推理比较应固定权重、报告碰撞而非仅报告一致性、按决策而非区分度评估信号、警惕带头部空间项的指标、并预先注册预测。

Abstract: Self-consistency assumes that independent samples disagree when a model is unsure, so agreement is evidence of correctness. Holding weights fixed and toggling only a reasoning mode, over five benchmarks and 74,944 samples, we show that reasoning concentrates a model's errors: the probability that two independently drawn wrong answers coincide rises in all ten dataset-scale comparisons (p = 0.00098), and in nine of nine after restricting both arms to the problems each gets wrong. Where the answer space is unbounded, reasoning cuts the distinct answers produced to 0.43-0.65 of the non-reasoning count; where it is bounded, both arms hold an identical option set and reasoning concentrates mass on it instead, which no positional prior can explain at fixed weights. The aggregate cost is smaller than the mechanism predicts, because reasoning also shrinks the set of problems where answer diversity can decide anything, in ten of ten cells and by 2.7x; normalized for available headroom, both arms convert a quarter of it in domain. Confidence weighting does not recover what is left. Across 280 method-dataset-model combinations on eight models and five benchmarks, not one beats plain majority voting after correction; weighted voting agrees with it on 98.5% of problem-method pairs and is right 56.3% of the time on the rest; and a signal's direction can invert within fixed weights, with answer log-probability predicting correctness when reasoning is off and error when it is on. A learned six-signal combination gains nothing out of domain. Confidence signals should be evaluated on decisions, not on discrimination.

</details>


### [285] [Receiver-Conditioned Latent Communication gives 94% CacheBack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32046)
*Maximillian Rossi,Prajwal Raghunath,Haoqing Xuan,Yusen Zhang,Eugene Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CacheBack提出了一种基于接收方条件化的潜在通信协议，通过让接收方传递查询给发送方来过滤和压缩KV缓存，相比文本通信在准确性和延迟上均有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统通过KV缓存传输进行潜在通信时，全缓存传输会导致接收方上下文随动线性增长，丧失分布式上下文管理的优势，且常超出GPU资源和上下文窗口限制。

Method: 提出接收方条件化通信协议，接收方传递查询描述其信息需求，发送方基于注意力权重选择相关位置；CacheBack是该协议的训练免费实例，通过对均值查询注意力分数进行重加权来纠正"平均稀释问题"，公式为 S_t^CB = Q_t · C_t²。

Result: 在FanOutQA上，CacheBack配合Qwen 3移除75%的状态，准确率提升14.7个百分点，中位延迟降低3.2倍；在LongBench v2上准确率提升9.3-14.7个百分点，速度提升2.5-3.7倍；在16×压缩下移除94%的状态；跨四个模型家族（密集Transformer、Mamba-注意力混合、滑动窗口注意力）均表现一致。

Conclusion: 通信协议应不仅决定消息的表示方式，还应决定消息内容包含什么信息，而内容应取决于接收智能体的需要；即使是简单的训练免费选择器也能在多个模型家族和通信拓扑上推动质量-延迟边界的优化。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems distribute large contexts across agents that communicate to solve a task. Text messages are compact but require decoding and may omit evidence the receiving agent needs. Recent latent communication instead transfers KV caches. This avoids text generation and can improve accuracy and latency. However, a full KV cache grows linearly with both the context an individual agent processes, and the number of agents that coordinate together. This raises memory and context costs, often far exceeding available GPU resources and context window sizes. Our key observation is that agents need only send what the receiving agent requires for its local task -- which we call receiver-conditioned communication. The receiver agent passes the sender a small description of its information needs, which serves to filter and compress the sender agent's KV cache. CacheBack is a simple, robust, training-free instance of receiver conditioning based on the sender's attention weights. On FanOutQA, CacheBack with Qwen 3 removes 75% of the state the agent would otherwise receive, improving accuracy by 14.7 percentage points and reducing median task-completion latency by 3.2x relative to text communication. We show comparable improvements across model families that span dense Transformers, Mamba-attention hybrids, and sliding-window attention.

</details>


### [286] [EngramRAG: Dynamic Usage-Weighted Topology and Synaptic Consolidation for Multi-Hop Agentic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32049)
*Bhavyateja Potineni,Lohit Giri,Anu Jain,Vadim Kutsyy,Rajasekhar Pentakota*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EngramRAG 是一种面向自主 LLM 智能体的自适应分层混合记忆架构，融合互补学习系统 (CLS) 原理，通过低延迟"清醒-状态"检索反射与后台"梦境-状态"巩固周期耦合，解决多跳关联盲目性、支架性遗忘和静态拓扑停滞三大病理问题。在 LoCoMo 基准上以 26.21ms 检索延迟取得 Recall@5 53.21%、MRR 0.4203 的最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统智能体记忆架构存在三大根本缺陷：扁平向量索引无法跨越多跳关系依赖（关联盲目性）、时钟衰减会误删核心身份不变式（支架性遗忘）、静态图拓扑忽略使用动态（拓扑停滞）。作者旨在通过 CLS 启发的双脑架构实现检索-拓扑-保留-突变的闭环自适应生命周期。

Method: 四大核心组件：(1) 动态 Hebbian 边权演化结合语义余弦、共激活历史衰减与关系类型先验；(2) Usage-Modulated Personalized PageRank (U-PPR) 将查询语义种子与访问强度通过 θ 加权融合作为个性化向量，识别 Epistemic Macro-Hubs；(3) Consolidation-Activated Topology Decay (CATD) 基于拓扑承载分数与节点类型缩放保留半衰期，受 N_grace≥4 冷启动保护；(4) 定向 SUPERSEDES DAG 过滤抑制过时事实；三源混合检索（密集向量 + BM25 + U-PPR）通过动态意图路由的 RRF 融合。后台 Dreaming 周期执行 HNSW-DBSCAN 去重 (O(N log N)) 与 Louvain 社区检测。

Result: 在 LoCoMo 全 1,982 个 QA 对（10 个多会话对话）上：Recall@5 53.21%（vs. 密集向量 38.29%，p<0.001，相对提升 +38.9%），MRR 0.4203（vs. 0.2937，提升 +43.1%），显著优于 BM25（48.66%）与静态图基线（8.50%）。时序推理 Recall@5 达 62.33%（+16.67 分）。50 次知识突变测试中，SUPERSEDES DAG 将分裂脑幻觉率从 70.0% 降至 0.0%。90 天连续部署仿真中，CATD 实现 100.0% 支架保留率（基线 60.0%），检索延迟 26.21ms。下游 Qwen2.5-7B 生成上时序 F1 提升 +6.41 个百分点，但 Token F1 因 7B 模型注意力稀释而呈现平台效应。

Conclusion: EngramRAG 在网络科学与流式上下文工程之间建立了闭环自适应记忆生命周期，通过 CLS 启发的计算架构为持久化智能体智能提供了原理性方案。实验验证了动态 Hebbian 可塑性、拓扑感知保留与定向 DAG 突变跟踪的协同价值。未来工作将探索噪声检索下的反馈稳定性、查询条件子图分解与路径受限遍历算法。

Abstract: As autonomous LLM agents are deployed across multi-session environments, conventional memory architectures suffer from Associative Blindness (inability to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies), Scaffolding Amnesia (temporal decay evicting core persona invariants), and Static Topology Stagnation (immutable graphs ignoring usage dynamics). Grounded in Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) principles, we propose EngramRAG, an adaptive memory architecture coupling a low-latency Waking State reflex with an asynchronous background Dreaming State consolidation cycle. EngramRAG introduces: (1) Usage-Modulated Personalized PageRank (U-PPR), where transition probabilities adapt via Hebbian plasticity to promote persistent entities into high-centrality Epistemic Macro-Hubs; (2) Consolidation-Activated Topology Decay (CATD), which scales retention half-life by topological load-bearing weight rather than wall-clock recency, protected by a cold-start grace period (N_grace >= 4); (3) Directed SUPERSEDES DAG filtering to suppress obsolete state during fact mutations; and (4) Triple-source hybrid retrieval fusing dense vectors, BM25, and U-PPR via dynamic Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Evaluating on all 1,982 QA pairs across 10 long-term conversations in the LoCoMo benchmark, EngramRAG achieves +38.9% relative improvement in Recall@5 (53.21% vs. 38.29%, p < 0.001) and +43.1% in MRR (0.4203 vs. 0.2937) over dense vector RAG, significantly outperforming Okapi BM25 (48.66%) and isolated static graph retrieval (8.50%). On temporal reasoning, EngramRAG reaches 62.33% Recall@5 (+16.67 points over dense vectors). In controlled mutation tests, SUPERSEDES suppresses split-brain hallucinations from 70.0% to 0.0%, while 90-day simulations show 100.0% scaffolding retention under a 26.21ms interactive retrieval reflex.

</details>


### [287] [Contract monitoring: governing AI via separation of powers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32061)
*Enric Boix-Adsera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种名为"合同监控"（Contract Monitoring）的AI安全框架，通过引入报告法官（report judge）来定义合同、监控智能体（monitor）来搜寻违规证据，从而将安全规范与安全执行分离，并通过自博弈训练和统计验证获得可量化的安全保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI安全方法（如Constitutional AI和直接监控）存在两类缺陷：Constitutional AI缺乏独立执行机制，worker可能为追求奖励而违反原则；直接监控则面临监控规避（monitor evasion）问题——worker学会绕过监控而非真正安全。本文受法律合同制度启发，借鉴"三权分立"思想，旨在同时解决合同规范的可表达性和执行的可扩展性问题。

Method: 框架包含三个核心组件：（1）报告法官 J(a,r)：作为固定、高效的验证器，给定动作序列a和违规报告r，判断报告是否成立；合同由此隐式定义为"是否存在被法官接受的违规报告"，复杂度对应coNP。（2）监控智能体 M_θ：通过零和自博弈训练，对抗性worker生成违规动作并自报告，监控器尝试独立找到违规证据，类似于GAN训练。（3）统计验证：冻结监控器后，用不同算力预算训练的对抗worker进行红队测试，估算最坏规避概率，从而获得针对有界算力worker的部署安全保证。框架在代码安全（正确代码、评估器完整性、未授权权限、信息泄露、沙箱越界）和逃逸场景中给出具体合同示例。

Result: 作者未报告具体实验结果（论文为框架性工作），但理论贡献包括：（1）形式化定义了由法官定义的合同；（2）提出了基于自博弈的监控器训练算法（Algorithm 1）；（3）给出了基于验证的统计安全保证论证；（4）通过复杂度类比，将该框架定位于coNP（而可验证AI对应NP，AI辩论对应PH），明确了三类方法的证明责任差异；（5）讨论了与Constitutional AI、直接监控、可验证AI和AI辩论的关系，构建了一个"概念演进谱系"。

Conclusion: 合同监控框架通过分离"安全规范"（由固定法官定义）与"安全执行"（由训练的监控器负责），提供了一种可扩展且附带统计安全保证的AI安全方法。其核心优势在于：（a）规避行为可被独立验证（因worker需自报告），提供自动训练信号；（b）可通过缩放定律和红队验证估算部署风险。剩余局限包括合同误规范风险、对AI法官鲁棒性的依赖、训练对抗worker的固有风险，以及如何处理极小概率事件和直接乘积结构等开放问题。该框架与现有方法互补，实践中应组合使用。

Abstract: We propose an AI safety framework that binds worker agents to contracts specifying their permitted actions. We show how these contracts can be enforced and specified by assigning distinct responsibilities to monitor agents and judges, and asymmetric computational resources to monitors and workers. Our framework allows us to empirically measure statistical safety guarantees. The framework applies to a wide range of settings, including code security and escape-the-box scenarios.

</details>


### [288] [Toward Interactive Understanding of Code APIs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32081)
*Dhananjay Ashok,Jesse Thomason,Jonathan May*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了PAU（Python API Understanding）基准，用于评估语言模型通过黑盒交互理解代码API功能的能力。研究发现即使是前沿模型（如Claude-4-Opus）也无法理解超过45%的测试API，主要失败模式为过度自信导致的探索不足和过早终止。作者借鉴非对称Actor-Critic（AAC）范式对模型进行后训练，使Qwen3-8B模型性能达到与GPT-5-mini相当的水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码理解评估多假设模型可读取源代码（如SWE-Bench），但在处理外部或专有API时这一假设不成立。现实中的探索性编程常需通过黑盒交互理解API功能，这对软件测试、API逆向工程等任务至关重要，但当前LM在此类欠规范任务中的能力尚未得到充分研究。

Method: 1. 构建PAU基准：包含3.9K训练实例和741测试实例，每个实例包含匿名化Python方法、金标准描述、两个上下文示例和测试集。2. 多视角评估：采用LM-as-a-judge（Llama3-70B，1-5分制）和描述转代码（Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B）的代码匹配率两种指标。3. 固定编排的交互式ReACT工作流，包括输入概念化、输入生成、假设修订三阶段。4. 借鉴机器人学习中的非对称Actor-Critic（AAC）范式进行RL微调，使用GRPO算法，评论器基于真实描述提供步级奖励信号。

Result: 1. 即使最强模型Claude-4-Opus也无法理解超过45%的测试API。2. 多数模型在交互式模式与上下文模式下表现无显著差异，表明未能有效利用API访问。3. 失败模式分析：推理错误（43.3%）和探索不足（48.7%）占主导，源于模型过度自信（可能与"谄媚性"训练倾向有关）。4. AAC调优的Qwen3-8B达到2.591分，与GPT-5-mini的2.595分相当，代码匹配率提升6.27%。5. 消融实验表明，监督微调、蒸馏、最终态奖励、对称信息评论器均无法达到AAC的效果，证实了特权信息和密集步级奖励的必要性。

Conclusion: PAU基准揭示了LM在黑盒代码API理解任务上的根本性局限：即使经过特定训练范式（包括RLVR），模型仍表现出过度自信和探索不足的失败模式。将机器人学习中的非对称Actor-Critic范式成功迁移到LM的RL微调是本文的重要贡献，AAC通过让评论器利用训练时的特权信息（真实描述）提供密集步级奖励，同时保持智能体自身的探索轨迹，提升了模型的主动探索能力。该方法为其他难以验证奖励的任务（如创意写作、战略决策）提供了新的优化思路。

Abstract: Empowered by advances in Language Model agents, systems have made substantial strides in code generation and understanding. However, these approaches often rely on read access to the relevant code, an assumption which does not hold when dealing with external APIs. In this work, we introduce the PAU (Python API Understanding) benchmark, where we provide models with black-box, API-level access to code snippets. Models must query the API with exploratory inputs and draw insights from the resulting outputs, with the goal of describing the snippet's true functionality. By treating the code snippets as external tools that must be understood via interaction alone, PAU studies the more general problem of unsupervised tool understanding, specifically for tools implemented as Python methods. Despite recent progress in coding agents, even frontier models struggle to achieve high performance on PAU, with the best model (Claude-4-Opus) failing to understand over 45% of the PAU test set. An investigation into the common error modes reveals that models are overconfident; they often overrate the quality of their current hypothesis, leading to insufficient exploration and premature termination. Finally, we take inspiration from the Asymmetric Actor Critic (AAC) paradigm, frequently used in robot learning, to post-train models for interactive code understanding. Models trained with AAC conduct more active exploration of the APIs, with an AAC-tuned Qwen3-8B model matching the performance of GPT-5-mini.

</details>


### [289] [Memory as Middleware for Self-Improving AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32091)
*K. R. Jayaram,Vatche Isahagian,Vinod Muthusamy,Gegi Thomas,Punleuk Oum,Gaodan Fang,Ashwath Vaithinathan Aravindan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"记忆中间件"的概念，将AI代理的记忆管理从应用层抽离为独立的、可插拔的系统中间件层，并通过参考实现 altk-evolve 验证其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM代理本质上是"健忘"的——跨会话无状态，导致重复犯错并丢失宝贵的经验。现有解决方案是"定制化记忆"（bespoke memory），将检索、持久化和学习逻辑硬编码到单个代理中，与特定存储引擎绑定。这种碎片化导致记忆无法交换、共享、隔离或独立推理，类似于数据库出现之前数据访问逻辑被硬编码到应用程序中的历史局面。

Method: 论文提出"中间件视角"，围绕三个设计目标（准确性、成本、控制）和六项系统挑战展开：两侧可插拔性（two-sided pluggability）、宿主原生拦截（host-native interposition）、多租户隔离（multi-tenant isolation）、写路径一致性（write-path consistency）、联邦共享与来源追踪（federated sharing with provenance）、生命周期治理（lifecycle governance）。设计了类型化记忆模型（情景、语义、程序性三类），并通过"经验飞轮"架构（捕获→提取→整合→存储→检索→注入）实现。提出了目的导向摘要（purpose-directed gisting）和分层存储策略。参考实现 altk-evolve 通过MCP工具协议暴露六种逻辑操作（检索、写入、整合、发布、删除、检查），并绑定四个宿主（Claude Code、Codex、Claw Code、IBM Bob）。

Result: 在AppWorld基准测试中，altk-evolve使任务目标完成率从69.6%提升至73.2%，场景目标完成率从50.0%提升至64.3%（提升14.3个百分点）；在困难级别，场景完成率从19.1%翻倍至47.6%。同一记忆层在四个独立开发的编程代理宿主上无需修改即可运行，验证了两侧可插拔性和宿主原生拦截的实用性。

Conclusion: 代理记忆应成为可插拔的中间件基础设施，位于代理与存储之间，统一暴露跨切面关注点（隔离、一致性、共享、来源、用户控制、生命周期治理）。altk-evolve证明该方案的初始子集是实用且能提升代理可靠性的。论文提出了开放的研究议程，包括：学习经验的一致性模型、记忆事务与写入策略、记忆准入与质量加权学习、遗忘与驱逐策略、部署感知打包、目的导向压缩与自适应保真度、隔离与共享策略、来源追踪与可审计性、可移植性基准测试，呼吁系统社区共同推进。

Abstract: AI agents are stateless across sessions by default and therefore operationally amnesic: each session begins with little durable knowledge of prior failures, repairs, preferences, or successful strategies. As a result, agents repeat the same mistakes and discard hard-won experience. The dominant fix is \emph{bespoke memory}---retrieval, persistence, and learning logic hand-wired into one agent and bound to one storage engine. This creates a fragmented landscape where memory cannot be swapped, shared, isolated, or reasoned about independently of the agent that owns it. We argue that this is a middleware problem: agent memory deserves a first-class, pluggable layer, just as data access, messaging, and persistence each became middleware concerns. We develop this vision through six systems challenges: two-sided pluggability, host-native interposition, multi-tenant isolation, write-path consistency, federated sharing with provenance, and lifecycle governance. We present ALTK-Evolve, a reference implementation of memory middleware for self-improving agents, and use it to motivate a broader research agenda for future memory middleware.

</details>


### [290] [GameBoyWorlds: A Testbed for Self-Improvement in Embodied Video Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32093)
*Dhananjay Ashok,Adam Shen,Aslan Huo Feng,Chinmay Khanna,Jun Rui Huang,Raghav Sarmukaddam,Surendira Balaji Natarajan,Xiaotong Cui,Xincan Zhang,Thomson Yen,Hongseok Namkoong,Jonathan May,Jesse Thomason*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GameBoyWorlds是一个针对具身智能体自改进能力的测试平台，由GameBoyWorlds-Execution（5个游戏系列共500个短时任务）和GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough（2个fan-made宝可梦游戏通关）两部分组成。当前的前沿模型在零样本设置下任务完成率低于50%，且现有的自改进方法（世界建模、自主技能发现）反而导致性能下降，只有作者提出的基于好奇心探索生成游戏文档的方法能带来部分提升但不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的强化学习（RL）方法依赖精心设计的人类奖励信号或大量人类示范数据（如MineDojo、π₀等），这限制了其规模化能力。自我改进范式允许智能体仅通过自身与环境交互产生的数据进行学习，但目前缺乏评估该能力在复杂视频游戏环境中的基准测试平台。论文重点在于判断智能体能否在没有任何人工指导、演示或外部奖励的情况下，仅通过自主探索实现能力提升。

Method: GameBoyWorlds基于PyBoy模拟器构建，提供标准化的Gymnasium API。Execution部分使用层次化监督执行框架（supervisor+executor），子目标规划、错误纠正和自我修正机制。Playthrough部分采用双层智能体架构：strategist（拥有目标树、知识树、位置存储和记事本）和supervisor（通过7个动作原语执行短时任务）。自改进方法包括：(1) 世界建模（patch-based CNN自编码器+潜在空间预测）；(2) 自主技能发现（Proposer-Agent-Evaluator框架+LoRA微调）；(3) 基于好奇心的迭代探索（observation novelty+text novelty双重奖励+PPO训练），以及通过VLM从高奖励轨迹中提取洞察构建游戏指南。

Result: 零样本前沿模型（Gemini-GPT-5-Mini、Claude-Haiku）在500个任务中完成率均低于50%（最高约49.3%），主要失败原因是多模态感知不精确和游戏机制理解不足。世界建模方法使平均任务完成率下降3.4%；自主技能发现方法使性能下降44.3%（如宝可梦红从38.8%降至8.2%），原因是过拟合和任务完成自评不准确。基于好奇心探索生成文档的方法平均仅提升2%，最佳情况下提升22%（如BombermanPocket从72%升至88%），但在某些游戏中下降29%（DejaVu1）。Playthrough测试中，复杂的agent在经典宝可梦游戏中能利用预训练知识推进，但在fan-made宝可梦游戏中无法获得第一只宝可梦。污染检查显示模型对经典宝可梦知识接近100%准确，但对ROM hack版本低于30%。

Conclusion: GameBoyWorlds是第一个针对复杂视频游戏中智能体自我改进的基准测试平台。当前前沿模型的执行能力存在显著不足，现有的标准自改进方法（世界建模、自主技能发现）在此环境下完全失败。该平台揭示了自改进研究中的重要空白，需要更强大的方法来支持智能体在缺乏外部信息时实现能力提升，为未来自我改进具身智能体研究提供了明确的评估标准。

Abstract: Powered by expert guidance, agents can operate in interactive environments; however, it is unclear whether they can learn autonomously from their own experience. To evaluate such self-improvement methods, we introduce GameBoyWorlds, a testbed for agentic self-improvement in video games. GameBoyWorlds-Execution evaluates task execution on a collection of 5 distinct game series. Agents are allowed access to dedicated training games but are provided no demonstrations, documentation, or rewards. Agents must ground themselves in the environment through self-directed exploration and by inferring actionable knowledge from their own experience. At test time, agents must complete short-horizon tasks that evaluate their ability to navigate, interact, and engage with game-specific mechanics in unseen games. Out-of-the-box frontier models complete fewer than 50% of the 500 tasks due to failures in multimodal grounding, establishing that self-improvement methods have room to push performance. We demonstrate that contemporary approaches to self-improvement are lacking, with world modelling and autonomous skill discovery failing, and a novel strategy that uses curiosity-based exploration to write guides achieving only partial success. GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough tests end-to-end game completion in two fan-made Pokémon games. We show that while frontier models have been pre-exposed to official releases such as Pokémon Red, they lack essential information on the games in our testbed. Instead of relying on their parametric knowledge to succeed, agents must learn from their own experience and autonomously improve over the course of the playthrough. We show that a sophisticated agentic pipeline with multimodal memory and hierarchical subgoals fails to reach even the first major milestone in both games, establishing GameBoyWorlds as an ambitious target for self-improving agents.

</details>


### [291] [Residual Streams Read, Recurrent States Remember: The Global Workspace in Mamba Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32102)
*Wenlong Wang,Fergal Reid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将 Jacobian 透镜（J-lens）从 Transformer 的残差流扩展到选择性状态空间语言模型（Mamba-1/2/3）的循环状态，发现循环状态是可读概念化的稀疏剩余载体，并在三种递增强度的测试（恢复、持久性、因果可达性）中与残差流互补。作者提出符号保护转向方法（sign-guarded steering），在语言报告任务上显著优于坐标交换，但在关系推理任务上增益不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 中提出的 J-space 假设尚待验证。当工作关注类人脑认知的全局工作空间类比，关注选择性状态空间模型中循环状态作为额外信息载体可能携带可读概念的能力，以及这些概念能否支持下游推理任务。

Method: 1. 在 Mamba-1/2/3 及 Nemotron 混合架构上拟合全路径状态 J-lens 和仅读出控制 J-lens，使用 1000 个 WikiText 提示；2. 在 6 个任务族上评估中间概念恢复率（pass@k AUC）；3. 通过时间追踪和词表实验测试持久性；4. 提出符号保护转向方法（sign-guarded steering G），与原有坐标交换（X）对比，在语言报告、双跳推理、灵活泛化等任务上测试因果可达性。

Result: 1. 状态 J-lens 在 Mamba-2 全部 6 个任务族上优于残差 J-lens、对数基线和调谐基线；联合读出在每个 Mamba 检查点至少 5/6 任务族上改进；2. 时间追踪显示早期内容在状态中保持可读性，残差可见性可能发生变化；3. 符号保护转向在 5 个模型的匹配试验中均提高目标前五成功率（Mamba-2 从 114/335 到 333/335，Nemotron 从 130/621 到 621/621），但双跳推理增益不一致：Mamba-3 状态单独编辑成功 16/90，联合编辑反而为 0/90。

Conclusion: 循环状态作为工作空间内容的稀疏剩余载体，与残差流互补；恢复能力、持久性、语言转向和关系推理成功是分离的不同发现，需要各自单独测量。模型比较未隔离架构效应，因为检查点在训练、规模、分词器、能力上存在差异。

Abstract: Can the global-workspace account of transformer representations extend to state-space language models? We fit Jacobian lenses to the residual streams and recurrent states of Mamba-1, Mamba-2 and Mamba-3, using the original 1000-prompt recipe. Joint residual--state readouts improve recovery of known intermediate concepts over the residual lens on at least five of six task families in every tested Mamba checkpoint. On Mamba-2, state alone exceeds residual and logit lenses on all six families; a normalised joint readout improves on both components on five. Temporal maps and word-list experiments show earlier content remaining state-readable as residual visibility changes. We also propose sign-guarded steering, which improves target top-five success over coordinate exchange on matched verbal-report trials in five models. Recurrent state alone supports this verbal access. These gains do not extend consistently to relational answers: guarded edits often output the edited concept itself, and Mamba-3's joint edits can disrupt successful state-only redirection. Recurrent state thus provides a complementary carrier of workspace content, whose recovery, persistence and causal uses require separate measurements.

</details>


### [292] [Escaping Alignment: A Physical Trap Model of Best-of-N Jailbreaking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32116)
*Marco Biroli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个受物理启发的微观模型来解释 Best-of-N (BoN) 越狱攻击。该模型将每个 prompt 的安全性视为一个高斯分布的"熵瓶颈"基线屏障 α_b，加上每个增强对应的指数分布"鞍点"能量屏障 η_{b,a}，生成过程视为 Arrhenius 热激活逃逸。仅用四个参数 (μ_α, σ_α, μ_β, σ_β) 即可描述整个 (N, M) 攻击面，预测大 N 外推、跨模型标度塌缩以及不同温度下的 ASR，并揭示文献中报道的幂律与指数跨越均为有限数据集或 running exponent 的伪迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 BoN 越狱文献普遍认为攻击成功率遵循固定的 N 幂律，并在 large N 处出现指数跨越。本文质疑这一观点：(1) 缺乏对完整 (N, M) 二维预算攻击面及其温度依赖的物理解释；(2) 不同安全机制（基线对齐 vs. 攻击易感性）被混淆在单一的拟合指数中，无法告知防御者应优化什么。

Method: 受玻璃态物理（trap model, Bouchaud 1992; Derrida 1981）与反应速率理论（Hänggi 1990）启发，假设 LLM 残差流空间中安全/不安全区域由单一超平面分隔，两个稳态盆地间存在熵瓶颈。每个 prompt b 的基线屏障 α_b ∼ N(μ_α, σ_α²)；每个增强 a 选择一个指数分布的鞍点高度 η_{b,a} ∼ Exp[β_b]，其中 log β_b ∼ N(μ_β, σ_β²)。温度 T 下的生成概率为 Arrhenius 形式 p_{b,a} = min(1, exp(-α_b - η_{b,a}/T))。由此推导 ASR@(N,M) 的封闭与半封闭表达式（含 Lambert W 函数），并用 Beta 软壁 + MLE 从实验数据中估计每个 prompt 的 (α_b, β_b)。在 Qwen2.5-3B/7B(-Instruct 与 base)、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Gemma-2-9B-it 五个模型上使用 AdvBench 前 400 提示词进行白盒（嵌入高斯噪声）与黑盒（字符扰动）增强核验证。

Result: (1) 四个参数在五个不同模型上均能拟合整个 (N,M) 表面，MAE=0.031，与 800 参数逐 prompt 拟合（MAE=0.034）相当；(2) 从 N≤100 外推到 N=10⁴ 显著优于纯幂律外推，并在 Qwen-7B 上优于 Feng et al. (2026) 的 Beta 拟合；(3) 五个不同模型在 f_γ(z) 标度函数上塌缩为同一条曲线族；(4) 仅用 T=1 数据预测其他温度下的 ASR，比纯 Arrhenius 误差降低 3.7-7.5 倍；(5) 局部指数 ν_eff 从 N=2 时的 0.1 单调漂移到 N~10³ 时的 2+，不存在平台，幂律假设被证伪；(6) N~10³ 处的指数跨越是有限数据集（400 prompts）造成的有限尺寸伪迹，由最难的单个 prompt 主导存活曲线；(7) 残差流中线性探针验证：安全超平面 AUC=0.89，鞍点 η_{b,a} 可从增强 prompt 的残差预测（R²=0.69）；(8) 不同对齐方案展现不同防御模式——Gemma 以熵防御（α 通道）为主，Llama 以能量防御（β 通道）为主，Qwen 居中。

Conclusion: BoN 越狱不存在固定幂律指数；ASR 由 running exponent 控制，由 log-normal 跨 prompt 屏障分布与高斯跨增强分布共同决定。四个参数构成模型安全性的可解释、可比较、可外推的表征。σ_E 越大（大屏障波动）的模型在小 z 处较弱但在大 z 处更强——这一反直觉结论指导防御者：不应追求紧致的高屏障分布，而应保持宽广的屏障波动以对抗 BoN 的极值过程。计算最优攻击预算 M⋆ 可能大于 1 当 prefill 成本相对较高时（如 Qwen-3B 上 r⋆≈0.05，M⋆≈1.3-9.1）。对齐方案（DPO vs. on-policy RL）映射到不同的 (α,β) 防御模式，但其因果机制有待未来工作。

Abstract: Best-of-$N$ jailbreaking (BoN) bypasses safeguards of aligned models by drawing $N$ independent augmentations of an unsafe prompt and sampling $M$ completions of each. Previous works have shown that the attack success rate (ASR) seems to follow a power-law in $N$, which we challenge. The exponent drifts with $N$, with an exponential crossover which is a finite-size artifact of the adversarial dataset. Little work has been done to explore the entire two-budget ($N, M$) attack surface as well as its dependence on the generation temperature $T$. We introduce a simple barrier model where each prompt has a baseline safety level and each augmentation a random thermally activated barrier. Then four numbers, each backed by an interpretable safety mechanism, determine the entire ($N, M$) attack surface. They extrapolate predictions from $N \leq 100$ to $N = 10^4$, collapse five distinct models on the same scaling function and predict ASR at different temperatures from the one they were fitted at.

</details>


### [293] [READ-Bench: Benchmarking Historical Instance Retrieval for Time-Series Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32123)
*Gerardo Pastrana,Haojun Li,Dhruv Mehta,Anoushka Vyas,Sina Khoshfetrat Pakazad,Henrik Ohlsson,John Paparrizos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: READ-Bench 是一个面向时间序列诊断的历史案例检索基准，覆盖 12 个多变量数据集，提出基于故障类型而非信号形状的相关性定义，并通过"基检索器+重排序"的两阶段范式系统比较经典距离、符号检索、自监督与基础模型嵌入器及语言模型重排序方法。研究发现预训练表示在搜索阶段无显著优势，决定性因素是少量已解析案例监督下的高斯过程重排序器（GPC），由此构建的 CHARM+NR∥DTW-I+GPC 系统在全部 12 个数据集上均优于单一基检索器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列诊断系统很少依赖历史案例检索，且检索质量仅通过下游预测间接评估，缺乏对检索组件本身的系统性比较。诊断相关性与信号形状相似性不等价——同一故障在不同工况下形态可异，不同故障的信号却可能相似——这使得现有以形状匹配为核心的检索评估方法（如 TSRBench）难以覆盖真实诊断需求。

Method: 1. 构建 12 个多变量诊断数据集的查询-语料-相关性标注框架，按故障类型（而非信号形状）定义相关性；2. 基检索器涵盖原始窗口距离（ED、SBD、DTW）、符号检索（SAX/SFA + BM25）和四种冻结基础模型嵌入器（CHARM、Chronos-2、MantisV2、TiRex）；3. 引入 Normal-Residual（NR）评分：从嵌入中减去 k 近邻正常窗口的均值，使相似度反映偏离正常运行的程度；4. 融合策略：RRF、z 分数加权求和、两阶段级联；5. 重排序器：无监督的 PRF、纯度类（Purity/QPurity）、标签感知的 Majority-Vote，以及核心的高斯过程分类器（GPC）；6. 语言模型重排序器（Toto-1.0-QA、ChatTS、Claude、Claude+TSAD）；7. 评估协议：宏平均 NDCG@10、P@K、HR@K；Friedman + Nemenyi 检验；三个正常序列污染等级（0/10/20%）；8. 推荐系统：CHARM+NR ∥ DTW-I → RRF → GPC 重排序。

Result: 1. 标签无关的基检索器（经典距离、符号 BM25、FM 嵌入器）在 NDCG@10 上差异不显著（Friedman 检验），远低于监督参考 MR-Hydra/RDST；2. NR 评分在每个嵌入器上均提升抗污染鲁棒性（退化幅度减半），MantisV2+NR 为最强单一基检索器；3. 融合提供小幅增益（DTW-I 配 RRF 为最优组合），但不足以突破基检索器平台；4. 语言模型重排序对固定池几乎无增益（NDCG@10 提升远小于 GPC），且无检索直接分类的得分接近随机水平；5. GPC 重排序器对每个池均带来显著增益，最佳系统 CHARM+NR∥DTW-I+GPC 在 ρ=0%/10%/20% 污染下 NDCG@10 分别达 0.687/0.640/0.619，相对其搜索阶段提升 +0.11，相对最强单一基检索器提升 +0.16，且增益在污染与全语料下均成立；6. GPC 系统接近监督参考 MR-Hydra（0.776/0.672/0.658）但计算成本极低。

Conclusion: READ-Bench 将时间序列诊断中的历史案例检索确立为独立可测量的能力，并证明：(1) 预训练嵌入在搜索阶段并不优于经典距离和符号基线；(2) 决定性杠杆是重排序阶段少量已解析案例的标签信息，高斯过程分类器通过在嵌入空间传播邻域标签实现最大增益；(3) 语言模型对原始序列的推理在检索设置下几乎无用，检索本身才是其发挥作用的前提；(4) 所提出的 CHARM+NR∥DTW-I+GPC 组合在 12 个数据集、多种污染水平下均稳定领先，验证了"基础嵌入 + 互补形状分支 + 标签感知重排序"的实用路径。未来工作将扩展为多轮诊断问答环境，纳入编码代理、不确定性量化与多轮交互能力。

Abstract: Time-series diagnostic systems rarely rely on retrieving relevant historical cases, and when they do, retrieval is evaluated only indirectly through downstream prediction. We introduce READ-Bench, a benchmark for historical-case retrieval across 12 diagnostic datasets, centered on multivariate time series, that defines relevance by shared fault or event type rather than signal shape, so visually different traces of the same fault count as relevant while similar-looking traces of different faults do not. Treating retrieval as a base retriever followed by a reranker, we evaluate classical distances, symbolic retrievers, self-supervised and foundation-model embedders, and their fusion, plus label-aware and language-model rerankers, under one protocol that varies supervision, pollution, and corpus scale with significance testing. Under a common channel-independent interface, pretrained representations offer no statistically detectable advantage over strong classical and symbolic baselines for search alone. The decisive factor is a small amount of resolved-case supervision at reranking, namely a Gaussian-process reranker that propagates a few neighbor labels in embedding space, which helps far more than more sophisticated representations or language-model reasoning and holds under pollution and at full corpus scale. Guided by these findings, we fuse a normal-residual-scored embedder with a dynamic time warping leg via reciprocal-rank fusion, then rerank with the Gaussian-process reranker, improving NDCG@10 over its own search stage on all 12 datasets, by +0.11 from reranking and +0.16 over the strongest single base retriever.

</details>


### [294] [PastForward: Faster On-Device GUI Agents via Computational Experience Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32166)
*Taehwan Park,Changmin Lee,Hayeon Lee,Taesik Gong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PastForward系统,通过细粒度地复用GUI代理执行过程中积累的计算经验(包括先验token序列、GUI转换和KV状态),在保持任务成功率的前提下,显著降低设备端VLM推理的每步动作延迟。在边缘设备上实现1.63–2.36×的加速,在服务器上实现1.40–1.68×的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在移动设备上本地运行GUI代理可保护隐私,但每个动作步骤的VLM推理开销巨大(在Galaxy S26 Ultra上占动作步骤延迟的77.26%)。现有方法要么在每步进行完整VLM推理,要么复用粗粒度知识(子任务、工作流),需要离线探索或任务特定的微调,难以在动态移动环境中充分利用先验执行记录。

Method: PastForward包含三种机制:(1) Experience-Guided Adaptive Decoding——从解码经验存储(ℳ_dec)检索先验token序列作为多token提议,在单次VLM前向传播中验证并接受匹配部分,提议长度由在线控制器根据接受率和设备延迟自适应选择;(2) Early Inference via Next-Screen Prediction——利用交互经验存储(ℳ_int)预测下一屏幕,在A2O间隔期间提前进行下一步推理,仅在预测屏幕与观察屏幕匹配时保留结果;(3) Cross-Step State Carryover——通过复用连续步骤间共享的KV状态(包括提示前缀和滚动图像,后者利用RoPE位置调整处理图像位置偏移)来减少prefill计算。

Result: 在AndroidWorld基准(20个应用,116个任务)上使用三种VLM backbone和四个平台评估:服务器端实现1.40–1.68×动作步骤加速;边缘设备(Jetson Orin Nano、Galaxy S26 Ultra、Xiaomi 15)实现1.63–2.36×加速,同时保持任务成功率。解码延迟降低60.3–81.6%,内存开销仅增加0.1%(2.4 MiB)。随着计算经验累积,检索率和匹配率持续上升,加速效果进一步增强。

Conclusion: PastForward证明了可以将普通任务执行过程中积累的记录转化为细粒度的计算经验复用,在不修改VLM backbone或代理策略、不需要任务特定离线探索的前提下显著降低设备端GUI代理的延迟,为随着经验增长而更高效的设备端代理提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Running GUI agents on edge devices can keep sensitive screens and interaction histories local, but the computational cost of inference at every action step makes deployment challenging. Existing GUI agent systems either perform full vision-language model (VLM) inference at each action step or reuse coarse-grained knowledge matched to prior tasks. However, dynamic mobile environments and user tasks make it difficult to fully utilize prior task executions without additional fine-tuning or task-specific offline exploration. To address this challenge, we present PastForward, a system that accelerates GUI agents through validated, fine-grained reuse of computational experience accumulated during ordinary task execution. During decoding, PastForward retrieves prior output sequences as device-adaptive multi-token proposals and verifies them in a single VLM forward pass. Across action steps, it uses prior GUI transitions to begin next-step inference while the device executes the current action, retains the early computation only when the predicted screen matches the observed screen, and carries reusable KV states forward. We evaluate PastForward on AndroidWorld workloads derived from real mobile usage patterns using multiple VLM backbones across server and edge platforms. On device, PastForward achieves action-step latency speedups of 1.63-2.36$\times$ while maintaining task success rates.

</details>


### [295] [Noisy Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Code LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32172)
*Xikai Yang,Hieu Trung Nguyen,Dunyuan Xu,Yuzhi Zhao,Jinpeng Li,Wenao Ma,Pheng-Ann Heng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NTRL-Code框架，通过在测试阶段利用无标签噪声数据进行自演化，解决代码大语言模型在面对用户输入噪声时的鲁棒性问题，采用自去噪与AST结构聚合机制生成代理目标，并设计混合奖励驱动GRPO策略优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界中用户的编程指令常常模糊且含噪声（拼写错误、用词不当、语义改写），导致代码大语言模型性能显著下降。现有鲁棒性增强方法依赖大规模配对的干净-噪声样本，标注成本高昂且容易对特定噪声模式过拟合；而熵最小化或自奖励式测试时训练方法（如TTRL、RENT）缺乏针对代码任务的专门设计，无法应对噪声提示下的熵估计失真和代码多数投票失效问题。

Method: 方法核心是解耦代理目标估计与策略优化：(1) 通过保守自去噪（基于长度变化比的回退机制）获得去噪提示，构建更稳定的语义锚点；(2) 在去噪分支上进行双采样，通过Python AST解析、标识符规范化与MD5哈希精确聚类（对无法解析的程序使用归一化Jaccard相似度作为后备），以最大簇的代表性程序作为无标签伪目标；(4) 在原始噪声分支中通过GRPO更新策略，奖励为格式有效性（β=0.25）、代码相似度（Levenshtein距离与Jaccard相似度平均，α=0.5）和去重复信号（基于滑动窗口的重叠率检测）的混合形式。

Result: 在HumanEval、LeetCode-Bench和MBPP三个基准上，针对字符级、词级和段落级三类扰动，NTRL-Code在DeepSeek-Coder-1.3B/6.7B和Qwen2.5-Coder-32B上均取得稳定提升（平均3.0–4.0% Pass@1），显著优于Few-shot去噪、大模型去噪和迭代自去噪三种基线。消融实验验证了自去噪、AST结构聚合和混合奖励三者缺一不可，且框架具备跨数据集/跨扰动类型的泛化能力；在C++/JavaScript等无AST路径的语言中亦有效。

Conclusion: NTRL-Code是首个面向代码生成的测试时噪声鲁棒性强化学习框架，其解耦设计避免了奖励信号对噪声分布的依赖，AST结构聚合解决了代码多数投票的语义失效问题，混合奖励提升了优化稳定性。局限性包括：扰动范围未覆盖需求级噪声、缺乏执行反馈保证、无法直接应用于闭源模型，且存在恶意注入风险。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across various code-related tasks. However, unlike carefully curated datasets that are typically high-quality and error-free, real-world user instructions are often vague and error-prone, posing significant challenges to the robustness of code LLMs. Furthermore, robustness-oriented fine-tuning relies on paired clean-noisy samples, which are costly to curate and require sophisticated noisy simulation techniques. To address these challenges, we propose the Noisy Test-time Reinforcement Learning framework (NTRL-Code), which enables robust self-evolution of code LLMs using only unlabeled noisy data during the testing stage. Specifically, NTRL-Code uses conservative self-denoising to obtain a cleaner semantic anchor for target estimation, and employs an abstract-syntax-tree (AST)-based structural aggregation mechanism to estimate a proxy target from multiple candidate programs. The policy is then optimized on the original noisy prompts with a hybrid reward that combines format validity, code similarity, and anti-repetition signals. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks, each incorporating character-level, word-level, and paragraph-level perturbations, demonstrate that NTRL-Code yields robust and consistent improvements, stabilizing the predictions of various base models. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [296] [AI Harness: Certification under Proposal-Conditioned Information for Foundation-Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32184)
*Hailin Zhong,Shengxin Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究基础模型智能体在"提出-观察-干预"契约下的认证问题,证明覆盖性保持的"状态级折叠"会破坏可证性,并刻画了何时需要保留提案-历史相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型智能体在部署中通常被建模为对观测状态的策略,但运行时仅在模型发出语义提案后才介入——提案既是动作候选又是历史条件过程的决策时观测。将此结构折叠为仅状态级的提案包络虽然保持提案覆盖性,却可能破坏可认证性。论文旨在刻画何时模型-工具边界处的提案-历史相关性对认证是必需的。

Method: 在有限鲁棒接口中形式化提案条件运行时契约,定义提案调节的前驱算子和固定点;用"提案条件公共安全干预存在性"刻画历史折叠的无损准则;给出常数字母表构造使投影可行域完全丢失;用精确有限信念构造信息态博弈,结合标准安全/可达性不动点;进行模型在环控制消融实验(无遥测、限制权限、无效果验证)。

Result: 定理1证明状态折叠可行核包含于历史增强核的物理投影,且在公共安全行动缺失时严格包含;定理2证明观察当前提案可在它分离潜在模式时恢复鲁棒可行性;定理3用精确信念分离"无限运行可行性"与"有限最坏情况已验证进度";1800个契约片段的受控消融实验再现了三种预测的公共行动障碍,全契约下零违规且T_exec≤2L。

Conclusion: 贡献不在于新的不动点演算,而在于刻画了模型-工具边界处提案-历史相关性何时对认证必要;为运行时监管层提出控制论抽象原则——监管层只能对信息接口保留的差异采取行动,只能通过其权限暴露的干预实现行动。基础模型智能体中,提案-历史相关性是认证相关的关键差异之一。

Abstract: Foundation-model agents are often modeled as policies over an observed state. In deployed systems, however, a runtime may intervene only after the model has emitted a semantic proposal, making the proposal both an action candidate and a decision-time observation generated by a history-conditioned process. We show that collapsing this structure into a state-only proposal envelope can preserve proposal coverage while destroying certifiability. In a finite robust interface, the viability kernel of the collapsed model is contained in the physical projection of the history-augmented kernel, and the collapse is lossless exactly when every proposal-conditioned collapsed fiber retains a common robust-safe intervention. This gap can be maximal even with constant-size proposal and history alphabets. The same common-action condition yields a dual result: observing the current proposal can restore robust feasibility when it separates latent modes requiring incompatible interventions. We extend these one-step results over time using exact finite beliefs and standard safety and reachability fixed points, separating indefinite operational viability from finite worst-case verified progress. Controlled model-in-the-loop tests reproduce the predicted obstructions when telemetry or effect verification is removed or intervention authority is restricted. Thus, our contribution is not a new fixed-point calculus, but a characterization of when proposal--history correlation at the model--tool boundary is necessary for certification.

</details>


### [297] [CoMemBench: Benchmarking Collaborative Memory Boundaries across Multi-Agent Workflow Topologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32192)
*Sen Zhao,Ruiqi Kong,Zuyu Zhang,Lifeng Shen,Xinyu He,Ding Zou,Xu Zhang,Qinghua Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CoMemBench是一个执行驱动的基准测试，用于评估多智能体工作流中由拓扑结构决定的任务条件化协作记忆边界，涵盖800个工作流和4个领域，揭示了信息共享与隔离之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆基准主要评估单智能体的保留与检索能力，而多智能体基准侧重端到端协调完成度，缺乏对由工作流拓扑决定的任务依赖性记忆边界的系统评估。该论文提出"协作记忆边界"这一独立系统属性，旨在衡量在多智能体执行中如何根据任务依赖、验证状态和版本选择性共享所需工件并隔离不适用工件。

Method: 从Toolathlon-GYM、SWE-bench Verified、BrowseComp+及三个Lean 4.7项目中恢复源任务依赖图，提取包含链式、分裂-合并、重用、重叠、有界修订五种拓扑模式的可执行子图。每个工作流配对一个隔离挑战（通过兄弟交叉、不兼容负载、未验证结果、误完成、错误实体、陈旧版本六类操作符之一注入单个不适用工件）。评估指标包括终端成功率(SR)、已验证节点完成率(VNCR)、已验证交接成功率(VHS)、隔离挑战成功率(ICS)。

Result: 在10个多智能体系统（涵盖Codex、Hermes、Deep Agents、CrewAI、AutoGen、Peer Review、SMoA、OMAC、ADAS、EvoMAS）和3个骨干模型（Qwen3.8-27B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GPT-6-Luna）上的实验显示：终端完成率极低（最高18.0%），但部分系统可达89.4%的已验证交接成功率；信息共享与隔离呈权衡关系——全上下文机制将状态工具的ICS从97.1%降至72.6%；系统排名随拓扑结构和污染操作符变化；不兼容负载与误完成类隔离挑战几乎从未被成功抵抗。

Conclusion: 协作记忆边界是独立于任务完成度与检索质量的系统属性；选择性、拓扑条件化的工件暴露是高效多智能体记忆管理的核心，最小上下文与最大召回均不足以同时满足共享与隔离需求。

Abstract: Multi-agent workflows require task-relevant information to be shared across agents, while irrelevant, stale, unverified, or incompatible information must remain isolated. We call this task-conditioned scope of information a collaborative memory boundary. Workflow topology determines which intermediate artifacts are applicable to which downstream workers and when they cease to be valid, thereby providing a structural stress dimension for sharing and isolation. Existing memory benchmarks primarily evaluate retention and retrieval, whereas multi-agent benchmarks emphasize coordination and end-to-end completion, leaving topology-conditioned memory boundaries largely unmeasured. We introduce CoMemBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for collaborative memory sharing and isolation across multi-agent workflow topologies. It constructs 800 composite workflows across four domains from source-grounded dependency graphs, with node-local specifications, verifiable artifact handoffs, native evaluators, and matched isolation challenges. CoMemBench measures workflow completion, verified node progress, required-handoff reliability, isolation robustness, and token cost. Experiments reveal a sharing-isolation trade-off: broader context improves information availability but can weaken isolation, while system rankings shift across topologies and artifact violations.

</details>


### [298] [Instruct, Not Answer: Using Instruction Privileges in On-Policy Context Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32201)
*Hantao Yu,Sandy Han,Udaya Ghai,Ferhat Erata,Joe Lilien,Aman Goel,Ali Torkamani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出在On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD)中,使用针对学生常见错误的通用格式化指令作为教师特权,替代仅使用实例编码的黄金答案作为特权,在适当的实验中实现了与黄金特权相近的域内性能,同时显著改善了分布外(OOD)泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在OPCD训练中,现有研究表明使用实例编码的黄金答案或黄金演示作为教师特权会损害训练性能,尤其是在分布外(OOD)场景下。本文探索是否可以通过短小、可复用的通用指令特权来替代实例编码特权,同时保持域内性能并提升跨数据集泛化能力。

Method: 本文以自动形式化(autoformalization)为测试平台,使用ProverQA、ProofWriter、ProntoQA三个逻辑推理数据集,以及Qwen3-Thinking和Olmo3-Thinking系列模型。作者先分析学生模型在训练集上的常见错误(如未解析、∀-遗漏、∀-作用域、核心指代-分裂、异或翻译错误等),然后针对这些错误设计通用的格式化指令(如"将XOR关系翻译为⊕"),将其作为OPCD中的教师特权,与使用黄金转移作为特权的标准方法进行对比。

Result: 在8个实验中的7个中,匹配指令特权在OOD准确率上优于黄金特权4到17个点,同时在域内性能上与黄金特权持平。具体而言:在ProverQA上核心指代-分裂指令表现最佳(优于黄金),在ProofWriter上∀-遗漏指令表现最佳;但在ProntoQA上黄金特权在域内表现最好(因为该数据集最干净,格式化错误少)。在Olmo3模型上的结果验证了指令特权在不同模型架构间的可迁移性。黄金特权虽然能提升域内表现,但会带来显著的OOD退化;需要为教师提供全部能转移给学生的答案可能不如提供可迁移的指令有效。

Conclusion: 本文结论为:在OPCD训练中,使用针对学生常见错误的通用指令作为教师特权,可以比实例编码的黄金特权获得更好的可迁移性,同时不损失域内性能。这表明提供教师全部答案可能不如提供可迁移的针对学生漏洞的指令有效。未来工作可以将此研究扩展到其他领域,并开发一个理解蒸馏中不同特权类型效果及权衡的框架。

Abstract: On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD) has recently emerged as a powerful technique for transferring context to student models and for self-improvement. In OPCD, the teacher is conditioned on privileged information, and the goal is to minimize the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the privileged teacher and the student, evaluated on student-generated tokens. Many existing studies show that using instance-specific gold answers or gold demonstrations as the default privilege can hurt training performance, especially out-of-distribution (OOD). In this work, we instead design general instructions that target common student mistakes observed on the training samples, and show that such simple instructions can outperform gold as the OPCD privilege. In autoformalization tasks, using a matched formatting instruction as the privilege could outperform gold in OOD accuracy by a large margin. In 7 out of 8 experiments using ProverQA, ProofWriter, and ProntoQA as datasets, and Qwen3-Thinking and Olmo3-Thinking families as models, matched instruction privileges outperform gold in OOD by 4 to 17 points, while remaining on par with gold in-domain. Each instruction is only a few sentences (and thus contains much less information compared to all instance-specific gold) and is applied uniformly to every training sample. These results indicate that a general instruction, which applies equally to source and target domain examples, can be substantially more transferable than instance-specific gold in OPCD while maintaining in-domain performance.

</details>


### [299] [Witness: Discovery, Deciphering, and Epiphany in Interactive Puzzle Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32208)
*Guanghan Ning,Ping Liu,Linyi Li,Huangjie Zheng,Arjun Neervannan,Huu Nguyen,Michael Sklar,Deniz Zorlu,Nicolai Ouporov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WITNESS是一个基于2D网格的交互式规则发现谜题环境，包含WitnessGym（RL训练套件）和WitnessBench（评估基准）。研究在18个模型上的评估显示前沿模型仅解决24%的私有测试关卡插槽，规则获取是主要瓶颈，但较小模型即使提供规则后仍存在执行困难。在WitnessGym上的RL训练提升了Qwen3.8-27B的私有测试性能，同时在四个外部发现任务上有显著迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究当前语言模型在交互式规则发现谜题上的局限性，并探究强化学习是否能够提升模型在训练之外的规则上的表现，为自动化科学发现提供基础能力研究。

Method: 提出WITNESS环境（基于ARC-AGI-3 SDK，包含22个训练游戏、8个验证游戏和17个私有测试游戏），使用ASCII观察表示；采用Agentic pipeline（WitnessForge）自动生成和验证游戏；通过共享评估框架控制观察和规则访问以诊断失败原因；使用GRPO算法与基于结果的奖励训练Qwen3.8-27B和Qwen3.5-9B模型；评估指标为相对人类行动效率（RHAE）。

Result: 最佳模型Fable-5在私有测试集上RHAE-L5为36.4，仅解决24%的关卡插槽；提供真实规则使Opus-5的RHAE-L5从59.9提升到97.8，但Qwen3.8-27B仅从8.0提升到10.1；RL训练使Qwen3.8-27B私有测试RHAE-L5从2.1提升到5.4，并在四个外部发现基准（CipherBank、PhysGym、WILT、Failing-to-Falsify）上平均提升4.1个百分点；Qwen3.5-9B在相同训练设置下未观察到改进。

Conclusion: 规则获取是前沿模型（如Opus-5）的主要困难，而较小模型即使在获得规则后仍存在规则执行困难；在隐藏规则谜题上进行的强化学习能够迁移到更广泛的规则和训练之外的真实任务，WitnessGym的训练提升具有泛化性，但效果规模适中且各基准间证据不均。

Abstract: Automated science needs agents that can work out the rules of an unfamiliar environment by interacting with it. Interactive rule-discovery puzzles offer a controlled setting for studying this ability: an agent infers hidden rules through experimentation and uses what it has inferred to reach a stated goal. We ask what limits current language models on these puzzles and whether reinforcement learning (RL) improves performance on rules held out from training. To study both, we introduce WITNESS, a 2D grid-based puzzle environment with ground-truth ASCII observations and controlled access to rules. An agentic pipeline generates games for WitnessGym, the RL training suite, and WitnessBench, comprising public validation and private test games. The validation set separately tests new compositions of trained rule primitives and primitives absent from training. Under a shared harness, the best of 18 frontier proprietary and open-weight models solves only 24\% of private test level slots, with scores sensitive to the observation interface and agent configuration. Providing ground-truth rules raises Opus-5's validation RHAE-L5 (relative human action efficiency over the first five levels) from 59.9 to 97.8, whereas a 27B open-weight model gains only 2.1 points and remains limited even with the rules provided. RL on WitnessGym raises the 27B model's private test RHAE-L5 from 2.1 to 5.4 and yields a mean gain of 4.1 points on four external discovery benchmarks.
