Together, these results point to rule acquisition as a major difficulty for frontier models like Opus-5 while smaller models further struggle on rule-based execution, and indicate that RL on hidden-rule puzzles transfers to broader rules and real-world tasks beyond training. Benchmark is available at: this https URL

</details>


### [300] [Fracast-0: Fractal Weight Sharing for a Time Series Foundation Model with Only 85K Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32209)
*Tianxiang Zhan,Huanyao Zhang,Yuanpeng He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Fracast-0是一个仅85K参数的时间序列基础模型，通过跨尺度权重共享（分形权重共享）实现概率预测。在GIFT-Eval基准的97个配置上，它是28个评估检查点中最小的，且在参数-精度平面上保持非支配地位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型需要在保持多领域覆盖、概率输出和多时间尺度的同时，极大地压缩参数规模。现有模型如TinyCast将参数量压缩到147K，但未确定参数下限。该研究探索能否通过跨尺度重用单一算子（利用时间自相似性）实现更小的通用概率预测器。

Method: 方法核心是分形权重共享：1）预处理阶段使用WindowMinMax归一化、无参数周期检测器（基于Bonferroni校正的归一化周期图）提取显著季节结构；2）编码器沿几何膨胀阶梯（d=1,2,...,512）应用单一共享局部块（DSConv+SwiGLU+RMSNorm），通过FiLM条件化注入尺度信息；3）解码器结合上下文聚合状态和显式季节未来状态，复用第二个共享块沿另一膨胀阶梯，输出9个分位数。训练采用分位数pinball损失加committing项（鼓励模型优于季节性复制基线）。

Result: 在97个GIFT-Eval配置（无逐数据集微调）上，Fracast-0取得MASE 0.808和WQL 0.564，是28个检查点中参数最少的。参数比TinyCast少42.0%，但MASE和WQL分别高4.2%和3.3%。CPU推理延迟降低42.3%（23.9ms vs 41.4ms），内存降低17.4%。在参数-精度平面上保持非支配地位。短horizon表现接近TinyCast（差距仅2.0%），但中长horizon差距扩大至7.4-7.5%。在7个领域中不领先任何领域；频率分析显示秒级和分钟级是主要弱点。

Conclusion: 跨尺度权重复用是压缩时间序列基础模型的可行路径，但并非通用法则。Fracast-0在极低参数量端是一个可用的非支配点，但在中长horizon和亚小时级频率上仍有明显差距。证据局限于单一架构和单一基准，未进行大规模消融实验。未来工作应测试跨尺度权重共享在不同架构、horizon和制度下的适用性，并确定哪些权重应合并、哪些应保持独立。

Abstract: Time series foundation models must preserve multi-domain breadth, probabilistic output, and multiple temporal scales, but parameter count grows when each scale receives a separate representation. We introduce Fracast-0, a probabilistic forecasting foundation model that exploits temporal self-similarity to reuse one operator across scales. A parameter-free detector extracts significant seasonal structure. The encoder applies a shared local block along a geometric dilation ladder with scale conditioning, while the decoder combines context-gathered states with an explicit seasonal future state and reuses a second block along another ladder before emitting nine quantiles. Pretraining across six corpora preserves multi-domain breadth within 85,001 parameters. On 97 GIFT-Eval configurations without per-dataset fine-tuning, Fracast-0 is the smallest of 28 evaluated checkpoints and remains non-dominated in the aggregate parameter-accuracy plane with MASE 0.808 and WQL 0.564. It uses 42.0% fewer parameters than TinyCast, whose MASE and WQL are 4.2% and 3.3% lower. These results support cross-scale weight reuse as a practical route to further time series foundation model compression.

</details>


### [301] [A bilingual AI audiologist built through rubric-guided playbook induction outperforms human audiologists in a blinded evaluation of simulated cases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32220)
*Linkai Li,Changgeng Mo,Hanlin Yu,Congxi Lu,Shangqiguo Wang,Matthew B Fitzgerald,Shan X Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种双语言AI听力学家系统，结合通用大语言模型与规则引导的剧本归纳、多模态听力图解读和检索增强接地，无需微调语言模型。在58个模拟病例上，该AI系统在所有病例（58/58）、20/21评估项和两种语言（中英）中均优于17名执业听力学家（平均配对Δ=+1.35，Cohen's d=1.84，P=4.5×10⁻²⁰），其中剧本归纳组件贡献最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界听力学家病例资料匮乏，而听力诊断需要结构化病史采集、听力图解读和以患者为中心的沟通。现有大语言模型在专业医学领域（尤其是低数据场景）应用受限，且传统微调方法成本高昂，因此需要一种无需微调且能系统化引导的专业咨询代理方案。

Method: 1. 使用21项评估量表和AI患者模拟器，从73个训练病例（43英语+30中文）中归纳出19条咨询策略规则（playbook induction）；2. 集成多模态听力图（audiogram）解读能力；3. 采用检索增强生成（RAG）实现知识接地；4. 不对大语言模型骨干网络进行微调；5. 在58个独立模拟病例（30中文+28英语）上，以预先指定、来源盲法的方式与17名执业听力学家进行对比评估。

Result: AI听力学家在所有58个病例（58/58，100%）上均优于人类听力学家；平均配对差值为+1.35分（5分制综合评分），效应量Cohen's d=1.84（大效应），P=4.5×10⁻²⁰（极具统计学显著性）；在21项评估量表条目中胜出20项；在中英两种语言上均表现优异；消融实验（ablation）显示剧本（playbook）是贡献最大的关键组件。

Conclusion: 该研究证明：通过规则引导的剧本归纳、多模态解读与检索增强接地的组合，可以在不微调大语言模型的前提下，构建出在专业咨询任务中超越人类专家的AI系统，为低数据医学专科领域的专业咨询代理开发提供了一条实用路径。

Abstract: Audiology consultation requires structured history-taking, audiometric interpretation and patient-centred communication, yet real-world case material is scarce. We present a bilingual AI audiologist pairing a general-purpose large language model with rubric-guided playbook induction, multimodal audiogram interpretation and retrieval-augmented grounding, without fine-tuning the language-model backbone. Using a 21-item rubric and an AI patient simulator, we induced a 19-rule consultation policy from 73 training cases (43 English, 30 Chinese) and evaluated the system on 58 independent simulated cases (30 Chinese, 28 English) in a pre-specified, source-blinded comparison with 17 practising audiologists. The AI audiologist outperformed human audiologists on every case (58/58; mean paired $\Delta$ = +1.35 on a 5-point composite, Cohen's d = 1.84, $P = 4.5 \times 10^{-20}$), on 20 of 21 rubric items and in both languages. Component ablation identified the playbook as the largest contributor, offering a practical route to specialist consultation agents in low-data medical domains.

</details>


### [302] [RAO-Nav: Probing Omni-Language Models for Zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32224)
*Qilang Ye,Meng Liu,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RAO-Nav，一种基于单一全模态语言模型(OLM)的零样本语义音视频导航(SAVN)部署流水线，通过"音频目标预测-全局推理-实时动作"的三阶段迭代流程，并结合测试时的潜在导航推理(LNR)模块，在不使用任何任务特定训练数据的情况下，在公开SAVN基准上超越了现有最优基线（包括监督学习方法）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有专门的SAVN模型即使经过大量任务特定训练仍难以实现通用多模态导航，而先前基于多LLM协作的零样本方案（如RILA）虽然可行但系统复杂、难以部署。作者探究OLM能否作为统一"大脑"直接解决零样本SAVN，并解决三个核心挑战：1）OLM缺乏显式声源定位能力；2）OLM（如Qwen-Omni）不适合直接生成离散动作；3）单次决策规划视野短，容易原地打转。

Method: 1. **三阶段RAO-Nav流水线**：(a) AudioGoal Prediction（感知）：OLM基于累积音频-动作历史输出G维类别分数，构造累积信念筛选候选目标；定位阶段采用双通道频谱图+OLM类别分数输入插件式Localization Expert预测K个候选声源位置，并使用时序平滑Π(·)稳定估计；(b) Global Reasoning：QA驱动范式，OLM基于候选航点和历史RGB观测在语义地图上选择路径；(c) Real-time Action：几何控制器将路径编译为"转向-前进"动作序列（基于公式5的离散化），实时监测STOP。
2. **LNR模块**：在文本端插入L个<|latent|>占位符嵌入H，通过冻结OLM反向传播优化以最大化条件对数似然R(H)=log p_θ(𝒢̂_t^k | V, H)（公式7），迭代更新H^(t+1)=H^(t)+η∇_H R(H^(t))，最终MeanPool得到查询q，选择与q最相似的top-K RGB嵌入。
3. **新基准设置**：提出Global Navigation Instruction评测，涵盖闭合/开放音频分类与视觉导航任务。

Result: 在SoundSpaces+MP3D的1000集测试集（unheard-sound设定）：RAO-Nav+LNR+Qwen2.5-Omni-7B达到SR 39.2%、SPL 20.7%、SNA 12.4%、DTG 10.9m、SWS 21.9%，SR超越所有监督基线（K-SAVEN 34.4%）和零样本基线（RILA 35.4%、Qwen3-VL-30B Oracle 14.7%）。消融实验：Random定位3.4% SR、OLM-only定位10.7%、定位专家去类别12.6%、完整定位专家39.2%；RGB only优于+Depth（39.2% vs 28.6%）；LNR优于K-NN（39.2 vs 37.8 SR）。所有实验仅需单卡A100 80GB，无需任务训练数据。

Conclusion: RAO-Nav证明单一OLM可在零样本设置下有效执行SAVN，通过将导航分解为迭代的"感知-推理-动作"过程并结合测试时潜在推理聚焦目标相关观测，在无需任务特定训练的情况下达到甚至超越监督方法的成功率。然而在SPL、DTG等效率指标上仍落后于监督模型，且Global Navigation Instruction评测显示当前OLM在开放音频分类（Baichuan-Omni仅23.84%，远低于闭合65.24%）和视觉-语言指令对齐上仍存在显著瓶颈，真实部署仍具挑战。

Abstract: We explore whether Omni-Language Models (OLMs) can be directly applied to zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation (SAVN). Recent work demonstrates that even state-of-the-art specialized models still struggle to achieve generalist multimodal navigation, despite extensive task-specific training. In this paper, we introduce RAO-Nav, short for Reasoning All-in-One OLM, a deployment pipeline for zero-shot SAVN. By leveraging the rich implicit audio-visual knowledge encoded in OLMs, the embodied agent is enabled to ``hear'', ``see'', ``reason'', and ``act'' in the environment. To further elicit the built-in thinking ability of OLMs, we propose a test-time Latent Navigation Reasoning (LNR) module that can be seamlessly integrated into the decoding space. LNR encourages the model to retrieve more target-relevant observations and make effective navigation decisions. Through comprehensive experiments, we show that our framework surpasses existing state-of-the-art baselines on public SAVN benchmarks without using any training data. Moreover, we introduce a new \emph{Global Navigation Instruction} setting to further evaluate the ability of OLMs to serve as embodied navigation agents. Code: this https URL \_Nav.

</details>


### [303] [Certifying Interventional Agreement Among Observationally Equivalent Causal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32247)
*Sourena Khanzadeh,Daniel Platnick,Marjan Alirezaie,Hossein Rahnama*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ISS（Interventional Separation Selection）方法，通过主动干预查询来区分观测等价的因果模型，并给出在指定成本范围内干预一致性的形式化证书。在MNIST因果抽象任务上验证了该方法的有效性，揭示了观测准确率与因果机制之间的根本性脱节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型在观测数据上表现一致时，可能依赖于完全不同的因果机制（underspecification问题）。观测数据无法区分这些机制，因为干预创造了观测中从未出现的输入。现有方法无法保证模型在干预下的行为一致性。

Method: ISS维护观测兼容的候选因果模型集合（版本空间），反复查询存活候选之间分歧最小的干预，根据真实系统的响应淘汰不一致的候选；当成本范围内无更多分离查询时停止。关键贡献包括：(1)分离成本的数学框架与证书定理；(2)连续变量版本的扩展（通过MILP精确求解）；(3)软证书处理噪声机制；(4)外生接地利用已验证的外生信息以零成本消除假设。

Result: 在布尔MNIST任务中，ISS在R=2时最多6次干预即可认证（达到理论下界⌈log₂C⌉）；在连续三色MNIST任务中，ISS平均用13.6次图像编辑进行认证，1728次运行全部正确。关键发现：训练精度100%的CNN在26%的单数字编辑上与形状标签不符；存在"观测下限"——任何观测学习者在某些网络上必然有≥36-52%的干预风险。bypass网络揭示了证书的脆弱性：97%的白盒证书因路由器绕过被检单元而无效，20次随机验证干预可反驳69%。

Conclusion: ISS将干预购买的是证书而非更好的估计：停止条件保证存活候选在指定半径内与真实系统一致（前提是真实模型在版本空间中）。证书的正确性源于停止条件而非查询策略，且需要完整的版本空间。噪声下变为概率保证；误设情况下需单独的验证阶段来否证类别。该框架为因果可解释性和模型审计提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Observationally equivalent causal models can still disagree about what happens under intervention, because interventions create inputs that never occur in observational data. We introduce Interventional Separation Selection (ISS), which repeatedly queries the true system with an admissible intervention on which the surviving candidate models disagree, discards the candidates the outcome contradicts, and stops once no intervention within a cost bound separates the survivors. If the true system is among the candidates, this stopping condition certifies that every survivor agrees with it on every admissible intervention within the bound, a guarantee that no observational learner can give, however much data it sees. The stopping condition depends only on the survivors, so it can be checked without knowing the truth. For continuous variables the candidates form an infinite version space, and mixed-integer linear programs decide the stopping condition exactly over all of it, with agreement holding up to a tolerance. On a three-digit colored MNIST causal abstraction task in which ink hue tracks digit size, plain convolutional networks trained on examples reach zero held-out error, yet disagree with shape-based labels on 26% of single-digit edits, as often as hue-based labels do. Auditing the causal abstractions of networks observed only on such images, ISS certifies what each network perceives with 13.6 interventions per image on average, and each certificate, checked against every admissible intervention, holds whenever the network's true abstraction is among the candidates. When a network bypasses a unit that every candidate abstraction relies on, certificates covering interventions on that unit can be silently void, and twenty random validation interventions refute 69% of them.

</details>


### [304] [Why Directly Learning Periodic Trajectories Can Fail](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32254)
*Kaixin Zheng,Anita Layton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了直接学习参数化周期轨迹时，两种保守的数据准备方式会导致学习失败：(1)相位不对齐导致IID泛化失败；(2)固定物理时间窗口导致周期超出训练范围时OOD泛化失败。作者通过理论分析证明这两种失败源于共同的"相位累积"机制——频率差异在长时间尺度上累积为快速变化的相位，造成MSE下界。提出解耦表示法（分别学习对齐归一化波形和周期）可避开此下界，并在ODE和PDE系统上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数化周期轨迹的算子学习在科学和工程中普遍存在，但现有方法常默认采用保守的数据准备策略（长瞬态等待+宽物理时间窗口），作者发现这些"安全"选择反而会引入严重的泛化失败。需要系统理解失败原因并设计有效的替代表示。

Method: 1) 通过Goodwin振子和Goldbeter昼夜节律模型两个ODE测试床进行消融实验，识别FM1（相位不对齐）和FM2（固定窗口）两种失败模式；2) 建立统一理论框架：将两种失败目标表达为公共形式F_λ(p)(s)=U(α(s)+λβ(s)ω(p), p)，证明当λ→∞时群体MSE存在由相位方差σ²_phase确定的下界；3) 对FM2推导逐样本OOD下界e_W(p)²/V(p)≥min{z²,1}-o(1)；4) 提出解耦表示——分别学习相位列齐的归一化波形U(s;p)和周期T(p)；5) 在FitzHugh-Nagumo PDE上进行案例验证。

Result: 1) FM1：未对齐的IID验证MSE在Goodwin上达0.997、gold95上达1.328；2) FM2：固定窗口的OOD验证MSE在Goodwin上达0.228、gold95上达0.200，比归一化表示高一个数量级以上；3) 理论预测得到数值验证：随c或W增大，MSE趋向σ²_phase下界；4) 解耦表示成功：IID和OOD下波形和周期预测误差均显著降低（Goodwin IID MSE=3.79×10⁻⁴）；5) PDE案例同样验证了两种失败模式和解耦方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 对于周期系统的算子学习，误差主要由学习目标的选择而非训练过程决定。频率依赖参数加上大时间尺度会将微小频率差放大为快速的相位变化，导致不可约的误差下界。核心原则是：目标应去除、控制或单独表示累积的相位。解耦表示（对齐归一化波形+周期）是该原则的一个实例，并在ODE和PDE系统中验证有效。结果表明周期性基准上的误差部分可能源自数据准备的选择，这些选择应与模型本身受到同等审视。

Abstract: Operator learning of periodic solutions requires deciding how simulation data should be recorded and represented. A natural choice is to integrate long enough for transients to decay and record a window wide enough to contain at least one full period of all trajectories. We find that these conservative choices can make the resulting trajectories difficult to learn, even when the underlying periodic orbits vary regularly with system parameters. Unaligned trajectories generalize poorly even within the training distribution. Phase alignment substantially improves in-distribution generalization, but models trained on a fixed physical-time window still have large errors on trajectories with periods outside the training range. We explain both failures through a common mechanism: frequency differences accumulate over time, so the target phase varies rapidly with the parameters. Predictors that cannot track this variation incur a population MSE floor in both settings; for fixed window prediction, we also derive a per-sample lower bound. We then study one of the simplest representations that escape these floors: learning an aligned, normalized waveform and its period separately. We establish regularity of the decoupled targets under ODE assumptions and show experimentally that this approach avoids both failures in ODE systems and a PDE case study.

</details>


### [305] [Clarify the User or Verify the World? Uncertainty Routing for Proactive Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32255)
*Zhaofeng Li,Xuan Zhang,Xiaokui Xiao,Yang Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PROUR框架，将智能体不确定性分解为用户侧（aleatoric）和世界侧（epistemic）不确定性，并通过路由机制决定采取act、clarify还是verify操作。联合训练模式条件的信息增益奖励驱动的查询生成器，在τ-bench上取得28.17%成功率并减少交互步数，且无需重训即可泛化到更强智能体和τ³-bench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动型LLM智能体在处理不确定性时，往往只能从用户澄清或环境验证中选择一种方式，缺乏对信息源的显式路由机制。作者通过对19,022个step级事件的分析发现，89.1%的不确定性来自世界侧，而仅10.9%来自用户侧，这表明仅依靠用户澄清效率低下。核心问题是：智能体不仅需要判断"是否"获取更多信息，还需判断"从哪里"获取。

Method: PROUR包含两个核心组件：(1) 分解器（Decomposer）通过采样K=5个用户目标解释，计算条件互信息将动作不确定性分解为aleatoric不确定性（AU，跨解释分歧）和epistemic不确定性（EU，每个解释下的残余熵），据此路由到clarify/verify/act；(2) 查询生成器（Query Generator）采用Qwen3-1.7B，基于模式条件信息增益奖励（clarify模式下目标是真实用户目标，verify模式下目标是参考下一动作），使用DAPO算法进行训练。路由器阈值τ_AU=0.25、τ_EU=0.20在240步开发集上通过网格搜索校准。

Result: 在τ-bench的retail和airline域上，PROUR达到28.17%平均成功率（相比最强基线提升4.57%），同时平均交互步数从28.90降至21.33。在τ³-bench上无需重训即达到29.00%平均成功率。在跨智能体泛化测试中，DeepSeek-V4-Flash骨干下达到48.20%成功率。消融实验表明，clarify-only和verify-only均劣于完整方法，验证了双源路由的必要性。分解器调用预算分析显示每步调用实现最佳性能-成本平衡。

Conclusion: PROUR通过将不确定性显式路由到用户侧或世界侧，并使用模式条件的信息增益奖励训练共享查询生成器，证明源对齐的不确定性解析是主动智能体的有效策略。该方法在τ-bench上以更少交互步数取得最优性能，并具备跨智能体和跨基准的强泛化能力，支持源对齐不确定性路由作为智能体主动决策的原理性方法。

Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents must decide not only whether additional information is needed, but also which source can resolve the uncertainty. Existing proactive approaches often specialize in either user clarification or environment verification, without explicitly determining the appropriate information source for each decision. We formulate this problem as uncertainty routing among ACT, CLARIFY, and VERIFY, and propose PROUR, a proactive uncertainty routing framework. PROUR decomposes action uncertainty into disagreement across plausible user-goal interpretations, which signals user-side ambiguity, and the entropy remaining within each interpretation, which signals missing world-side evidence. To acquire information from the routed source, a query generator is trained with a mode-conditioned information-gain reward, targeting user-goal identification under CLARIFY and next-action identification under VERIFY. On $\tau$-bench, PROUR achieves 28.17% average success rate across retail and airline, outperforming the strongest prior method by 4.57% while using 2.17 fewer interaction steps. The learned policy further generalizes to stronger task agents and transactional domains of $\tau^3$-bench without retraining, demonstrating the benefit of source-aligned uncertainty resolution for proactive agents.

</details>


### [306] [LAM: Efficient Lossy Agent Memory Framework With A Retrieval-Score Error Bound](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32256)
*Baixi Sun,Le Chen,Anjir Ahmed Chowdhury,Xiaolong Ma,Chih-Hsuan Yang,Mingze Xia,Syed Zawad,Sheng Di,Rajkumar Kettimuthu,Huihuo Zheng,Rajeev Thakur,Venkatram Vishwanath,Feng Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LAM 是一个面向 LLM Agent 的有损记忆压缩框架,通过"先检测再 prefill"的调度策略与 ℓ₂ 近重复检测规则,在 600 条 SWE-smith 轨迹上以 22.47% 的 token 移除率保留了 99.984% 的 gold-patch 证据,并在固定删除集下预测 71.4×–91.6× 的端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent 执行轨迹(文件读取、命令输出)持续增长,既推高推理成本又终将超出上下文窗口。现有方案(LLM 摘要、SemDeDup、观察掩码)均无法对检索分数损失提供显式上界,且摘要需额外推理开销、缺乏可复现保证。

Method: 三组件设计:(1) 三层去重 L0(行级 xxHash3 精确去重)+ L1(基于带状哈希候选生成与精确 ℓ₂ 验证的 ε-等价规则,合并阈值 cos t = 0.95 即 δ = 0.316)+ L2(cuSZp 字节压缩);(3) 内存管理器在 prefill 前测试,保留已缓存前缀;(4) 基于测量硬件常量的 Amdahl 分解成本模型。核心定理 Theorem 1:δ-替换对任意单位查询保证 max_q·x − max_q·z ≤ δ(由 Cauchy-Schwarz 证明,界紧)。

Result: 在 600 条 SWE-smith 轨迹(27,986 chunks, 9.07M tokens)上,LAM 移除 22.47% 观测 token、保留 99.984% 证据(6,276 行仅丢 1 行);SemDeDup 仅 19.60%,观察掩码无达标配置。在 ECR@τ=0.999 下 LAM 移除最多,SemDeDup 在 τ=0.99/0.95 时移除更多。LHTB 上移除 33.39% 观测 token。端到端加速来自调度而非规则:批大小 1/32 时为 71.4×/91.6×。CPU 压缩与 Qwen2.5-7B 服务在 4 颗 A100 上保持 0.9999× 吞吐。

Conclusion: LAM 通过"先去除再 prefill"调度保留缓存前缀,获得 71.4×–91.6× 端到端加速(任何前缀保留规则都能获此益,含 L0 本身)。ℓ₂ 近重复层成本是 L0 的 2883×,但二者组合在 99.84% 证据保留下移除率高于任一单层。每次删除均可审计。但 LAM 的检索上界仅约束分数扰动而非排名或任务结果;实际任务成功率未被测量。

Abstract: Agent memory grows as agents read inputs, reason, and call tools. Longer histories increase inference cost and eventually exceed the context window. LLM-based summarization reduces this history but adds latency and provides no explicit bound on information loss. We propose LAM, a Lossy Agent Memory system with three components: a deterministic deduplication rule with a substitution bound on retrieval scores - a bound on score perturbation, not a certificate of unchanged ranking; a memory manager that preserves the cached prefix and overlaps compaction with inference; and a performance model that estimates compaction costs before deployment. On 600 agent trajectories, LAM removes 22.47% of observation tokens while retaining 99.984% of the measured gold-patch evidence. At a fixed deletion set, the performance model predicts a 71.4x-91.6x end-to-end speedup from removing records before prefill instead of deleting them from a prefilled context. That benefit comes from the schedule rather than the rule and applies to any prefix-preserving test.

</details>


### [307] [Prefill-Free Cross-Family KV Cache Transfer for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32259)
*Vincent-Daniel Yun,Woosang Lim,Haneul Yoo,Sungjoo Yoo,Sai Praneeth Karimireddy,Murali Annavaram*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HeteroFold是首个支持跨模型家族（不同分词器、不同深度）的免预填充KV缓存传输方法，通过令牌对齐、Recolor映射和输出感知校准，在保持发送方和接收方模型冻结的前提下，实现高效的异构多智能体LLM通信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构多智能体LLM系统中，不同模型的智能体需要交换共享上下文。基于文本的通信要求每个接收方重新预填充已处理过的上下文，造成冗余计算。跨模型家族的KV缓存复用面临三大障碍：分词器不匹配、模型深度不同、KV表征差异。现有预填充自由的缓存传输方法（如Dense Latent、KV Ridge）仅限于同家族模型，未解决跨家族问题。

Method: HeteroFold包含三个核心组件：(1) 令牌对齐（TA）：通过共享字符边界在发送方和接收方分词器之间建立对应关系，无需平均多对一情况下的发送方状态；(2) 层对齐与Recolor映射：采用比例深度对齐，选取每个接收层对应的3个发送层（偏移-4, 0, +4），通过Procrustes对齐匹配接收方特征的均值和协方差，支持跨头映射；(3) 输出感知校准：对K和V分别设计低秩修正（rank=16），K的目标是匹配注意力权重KL散度及键引起的输出误差，V的目标是匹配注意力输出，使用冻结的接收方查询进行优化，训练后将修正折叠回仿射映射，推理时无需额外模块。所有模型保持冻结。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-4B、Ministral-3-14B之间的6个传输方向上，HeteroFold在全部4个长上下文基准（Qasper、HotpotQA、LoCoMo、QuALITY）和大多数短上下文设置中优于Dense Latent和KV Ridge基线。在HiddenBench多智能体通信中达到与TextMas（基于文本通信）相当的群体决策准确率（30.6% vs 29.2%）。延迟方面，32K上下文下Llama-3.1-8B→Ministral-3-14B传输比Native Prefill快10.7倍，比Dense Latent和KV Ridge快1.18-1.47倍。映射参数量（2.01-2.52亿）比KV Ridge少约62%。消融实验表明令牌对齐贡献最大，Recolor优于Ridge回归，键校准对长上下文任务贡献最显著。

Conclusion: HeteroFold证明了跨模型家族边界的KV计算复用无需接收方预填充是可行的，通过解决分词器和模型结构不匹配并校准传输后的缓存以保持接收方行为，为异构语言模型智能体之间的高效缓存共享和更通用的跨模型KV接口迈出了重要一步。

Abstract: Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly combine heterogeneous models for specialized agent roles. However, text-based communication requires each receiver to prefill shared context already processed by the sender. Reusing the sender's key-value (KV) cache avoids this redundancy, but prefill-free transfer across model families must handle differences in tokenization, model depth, and KV representations. To address these issues, we propose \textit{HeteroFold}, a prefill-free cross-family KV cache transfer method that keeps both the sender and receiver frozen. HeteroFold aligns model structures, maps the sender cache into the receiver space, and calibrates it to preserve receiver behavior. Across six transfer directions, HeteroFold achieves the best cache-transfer performance on all four long-context benchmarks and most short-context settings. It also matches text-based communication on the multi-agent benchmark. At 32K context length, Llama-3.1-8B$\rightarrow$Ministral-3-14B transfer is $10.7\times$ faster than Native Prefill and $1.18$--$1.47\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art prefill-free baselines, Dense Latent and KV Ridge. These results show that HeteroFold enables efficient cross-family KV reuse without receiver prefill.

</details>


### [308] [When Does a Skill Add Value? Task-Conditional Gain Prediction for Selective Skill Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32274)
*Anjie Xu,Zhiyu Zhang,Ruiqing Ding,Fengli Xu,Leye Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillDelta框架，通过配对执行历史预测技能对任务的增量增益，从而在执行前决定是否启用技能。该框架基于局部增益预测器，在5个基准和3个代理上的实验表明，相比随机激活可平均提升4.3%的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体技能（skills）有时无法带来收益，甚至会降低性能并增加token成本。因此需要在执行前预测技能是否对当前任务有帮助，而非仅依赖技能辅助后的结果或代理自判断。

Method: SkillDelta框架使用配对执行（同一代理在有/无技能条件下执行同一任务）构建历史数据库。对于新任务，从同族（same-family）支持任务中检索k=6个最近邻，基于余弦相似度加权平均其配对增益，得到预测增益τ̂(t,s)。预测为正则启用技能，否则跳过。理论上通过局部回归分析推导出预测误差界，包含覆盖范围（coverage）、表示残差（representation mismatch）和执行噪声（execution noise）三项。

Result: 在5个基准（ToolQA、MedCalc-Bench、BigCodeBench、LogicBench、SpreadsheetBench）和3个代理（Qwen-Turbo、GLM-5.3-Flash、DeepSeek-V4-Flash）的15组设置中，配对历史在12组中改善了增益排名（AUROC）。在匹配技能使用率下，SkillDelta在全部15组中优于随机激活，平均绝对成功率提升4.3%。增益主要来自跨任务组的分配（3.72%），组内选择贡献较小（0.61%），其中ToolQA的组内选择效果最明显。同时平均节省20.8%的token。

Conclusion: SkillDelta通过配对执行历史有效预测技能增益，在执行前指导技能使用决策。其增益主要源于跨任务组分配技能使用，而非细粒度的组内选择。该方法适用于智能体和技能条件稳定的重复任务部署场景，但部署成本（构建历史库）需考虑复用频率。

Abstract: Agent skills are expected to improve task performance. Yet we find that they often provide no benefit, and can even hurt performance while incurring additional token costs. Can we predict whether a skill will help before the agent acts? We introduce SkillDelta, a framework for predicting task-conditional skill gains from paired executions of the same agent with and without the skill. A local predictor transfers these historical gains to new tasks without retraining the agent. Under explicit transfer assumptions, our analysis links support coverage, representation mismatch, and execution noise to prediction error and decision regret. Across five benchmarks and three target agents, paired history improves observed-gain ranking over skill-assisted outcomes alone in 12 of 15 settings. At matched expected skill-use rates, SkillDelta improves success over random activation in all 15 settings, with an average absolute gain of 4.3%. Most of this advantage comes from allocation across task groups. Evidence for additional within-group selection value is strongest on ToolQA and weaker elsewhere. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [309] [GLIDE: Generalized Layer-wise Intrinsic Distributional Evaluation for Heterogeneous LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32295)
*Wei Zhu,Yiming Wang,Rui Wang,Lixing Yu,Kun Yue,Zhiwen Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GLIDE 提出了一种面向异构 LLM 智能体 MCTS 的轻量级内在评估方法，通过层间残差一致性提取步骤级证据，结合代理级分布校准生成悲观奖励，无需外部验证器即可实现跨代理分支选择与自适应分支。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在多步推理中需要可靠的步骤级评估来比较候选分支，但外部验证器推理成本大，而自评估/置信度在异构代理池中校准不一致、跨代理不可比，存在轻量评估困境。

Method: 1) 层间内在稳定性评估（ISLE）：基于残差流视角，计算每层局部更新与全局残差更新的余弦一致性 Φ_coh，并结合 token 级预测决定性 Φ_dec 得到 S_ISLE；2) 异构代理分布校准：对每个代理维护 S_ISLE 与预测熵的滑动窗口，通过经验秩归一化 S_rank 与原始 S_ISLE 的调和融合构建悲观奖励 R_GLIDE；3) 自适应分支：将 R_GLIDE 作为 MCTS 的转移值，并结合归一化预测不确定性动态调整分支宽度 n(x,a)；4) 理论分析：假设层间更新共享低维子空间且主成分稳定积累，证明 Φ_coh 存在正余弦余量，并证明 S_ISLE 在代理内排序反转概率随潜在效用差指数衰减。

Result: 在 HotpotQA、WebShop、Game of 24 三个异构代理 MCTS 任务上，GLIDE 相比 SYMPHONY-S 在性能与 token 效率上均更优（HotpotQA EM 0.73、WebShop SR 0.57、Game of 24 SR 0.54），并在扩展节点数与 token 消耗远低于 LATS/RAP/ToT；步骤级排序质量（P@1/MRR/NDCG@3）上 GLIDE 优于 Perplexity、Energy、CoE、PRM 系列及随机异构 Judge；消融实验验证了分布校准与自适应分支的必要性；在 MGSM/GPQA/HumanEval 上的跨任务结果可分性表明 S_ISLE 具有稳定的成功/失败区分能力，且内存开销可忽略（8B 模型 +1.06%，70B 模型 +2.39%）。

Conclusion: GLIDE 验证了层间残差一致性可作为步骤级偏好的内在信号，经代理级分布校准后能转换为可靠的跨代理比较信号，实现无外部验证器、无任务监督的 MCTS 价值估计与自适应分支，为异构 LLM 智能体的推理时控制提供了一种轻量高效的方案。

Abstract: LLM agents require reliable step-level evaluation to compare candidate branches and allocate computation effectively. However, lightweight evaluation remains challenging. External verifiers introduce additional inference cost, while agent-produced confidence or self-evaluation scores can be miscalibrated, especially when candidates are generated by heterogeneous agents. We propose \textbf{G}eneralized \textbf{L}ayer-wise \textbf{I}ntrinsic \textbf{D}istributional \textbf{E}valuation (\textbf{GLIDE}) for LLM agents. \textsc{GLIDE} derives intrinsic step evidence from layer-wise residual coherence, which measures whether local residual updates consistently support the global residual change induced by a candidate step. It calibrates this evidence against the recent score distribution of the generating agent and converts it into a pessimistic reward that jointly accounts for absolute residual evidence and agent-relative standing. The reward provides a cross-agent value signal for MCTS branch selection, while normalized predictive uncertainty guides adaptive branching. Experiments on multi-hop reasoning, sequential decision making, and symbolic logic show that \textsc{GLIDE} improves task performance, step-level ranking quality, and computational efficiency without external verifiers or task-specific supervision.

</details>


### [310] [Agentsensus: Consensus-Compressed Shared Memory for Multi-Agent Story Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32297)
*Yu Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Agentsensus提出了一种用于多智能体故事世界的"共识压缩共享记忆"架构，将每个角色的私有记忆流统一为单一存储，通过语义等价合并与关联链接消除见证者冗余，在四个世界（中文古典小说《三国演义》《红楼梦》、莎士比亚《哈姆雷特》及俄乌冲突时间线）上以相同粒度协议对比三种基线方法，写入条目减少22-44%，且是唯一产生共享（14-28%多所有者）和链接（94-99%关联）记忆结构的设计，模拟质量与基线无显著差异，且其记忆图结构能反映故事的社会结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流的多智能体故事世界模拟框架（如Generative Agents及其后续工作）采用每角色私有、仅追加的记忆流设计，这导致三个结构性问题：(1) 见证者倍数冗余——同一共享事件被每个参与者各存储一份，存储与嵌入成本随见证者数而非事件数线性增长；(2) 碎片化、易发散的世界知识——同一事件存在N份措辞独立且逐渐漂移的副本，无法被检索系统关联；(3) 记忆管理依赖智能体主动执行但实证表明智能体在所有后端上对所有自由裁量记忆管理操作的调用次数均为零。因此需要一种无需智能体主动管理、能在存储层面自动消除冗余并建立事件间关联的架构。

Method: Agentsensus的核心架构承诺是：世界记忆为单一存储，共享性由计算得出而非预设。关键技术包括：(1) **原子化与等价合并**——每次remember(agent, text)将文本拆分为自包含语句（受token预算约束），对每条语句进行嵌入并在全存储中以余弦阈值0.70检索top-5候选，由LLM法官判定语义等价，若匹配则两条记录合并，所有者集合取并集、关联集合取并集、保留较短文本；(2) **自动关联**——同一存款拆分出的语句自动互相关联，形成记忆图；(3) **所有者作用域召回与一跳扩展**——召回仅返回智能体拥有的记录，并沿关联边一跳扩展至调用者也拥有的关联兄弟节点。系统采用轮次屏障调度器（每轮所有清醒智能体基于同一世界状态决策，效果在下一轮才显现）、被动环境、信息载体（信件、诏令、剧本）以及全系统检查点实现逐比特恢复。评估采用等粒度协议：所有后端共享同一原子化器、人物卡、场景与向量存储，仅长期存储机制不同；四个世界运行40-80轮，对比Generative-Agents流、G-Memory层级图、Collaborative Memory访问控制列表三种基线。度量包括结构量（条目数、多所有者比例、关联比例、合并深度）与续写质量（基于LLM评判的接地性、轨迹一致性、1-5分叙事评分、目标追求度）。

Result: 在四个世界上，Agentsensus在等粒度条件下写入条目比最近基线少22-44%（例如《三国演义》80轮：Consensus 974条 vs Gen. Agents 1,251、G-Memory 1,434、Collaborative 1,455；俄乌40轮：814 vs 1,268/1,191/1,091），且是唯一产生共享记忆（多所有者比例14-28%，最高合并达10个见证者，如俄乌总统防空指令）与链接记忆（关联比例94-99%）的后端，所有基线在这两项上均为0%——这由构造决定而非调优所致。结构随时间复合而非早饱和：《红楼梦》在10/40/60/80轮的多所有者比例从13%升至24%，俄乌在10/20/40轮从6%升至14%。消融实验证实合并机制本身是关键贡献：关闭合并使存储膨胀3.1倍（6,590→20,669条），共享比例降至精确0%，但链接仍保持94%（因为链接来源于原子化器而非合并）。续写质量方面，16个世界-指标单元中Consensus在4项最优，其余落后幅度在三评之间分散范围内，作者将此报告为"洗牌"而非胜出——压缩既未换来也未损失评判质量。案例研究三层分析（交互图、记忆关联图、共享所有权热图）表明记忆图的分块结构能复现故事中无需读取交互日志即可观察的对话社群。值得注意的是，所有后端、所有模型上智能体对所有自由裁量记忆管理操作的调用次数均为零，因此所有结构机制都被内置于remember与recall操作本身。局限性包括：保留较短文本的规则会丢失命名角色（30%可观测合并中丢失人物，12%丢失下令者），等价判定为单一未经验证的LLM调用（147次可核查合并中有5次混淆不同事件），召回一跳扩展返回行数为语义结果的1.6-8.8倍，合并使写入延迟约翻倍，最大存储为7,025条（向量索引尚不紧张）。

Conclusion: Agentsensus将故事世界的记忆建模为单一共识存储：等价记忆在见证者间合并，分裂记忆链接成图，召回自动遍历该图。在四个世界（跨两种语言、三种体裁、人类与机构行动者）上以等粒度协议实现最小存储占用，是四个后端中唯一产生共享与链接记忆结构的设计，其涌现图结构能镜像故事的社会结构，评判质量在基线噪声范围内。该工作的广义教训是有限的：智能体仅可靠使用remember与recall，因此等待智能体主动策展的设计在此视野、此提示策略下不会产生结构——这是对共识压缩架构必要性的实证支撑而非对其长期优越性的终极证明。

Abstract: A agentic story world is a dynamic system simulating who learned what, when, and from whom -- yet the standard design gives each character a private memory stream. A shared event is therefore stored once per witness, large duplication will be incurred in terms of storage. We present Agentsensus, a story-world simulation framework in which there is an unified long-term memory. Records of the same event merge into one owned by all its witnesses, and semantically relevant memory records are linked. We evaluate on four worlds -- two classical Chinese novels, Hamlet, and a real-world conflict timeline -- run for 40 to 80 rounds against three per-character memory designs under an equal-granularity protocol. Agentsensus writes 22-44% fewer entries than the closest baseline and is the only design whose memory becomes shared (14-28% of records held by more than one character, some by 10) and linked (94-99%), at judged simulation quality indistinguishable or even better than the baselines. An ablation attributes this to the merge itself: disabling it multiplies the store by 3.1x and takes sharing to exactly zero. Sharing also compounds with the horizon rather than saturating early, rising 6% to 9% to 14% as one world is re-run at 10, 20 and 40 rounds.

</details>


### [311] [Train4Merge: A Controlled Single-Teacher Study of RL vs. SFT Teachers for OPD-Based Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32303)
*Jingyuan Huang,Zuming Huang,Yucheng Shi,Zhongzhi Li,Xiaoming Zhai,Wei Chu,Ninghao Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究在基于在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的模型合并流程中，领域专家教师应采用监督微调（SFT）还是强化学习（RL）训练的问题。通过以 Qwen3.5-9B 为共享初始化，在智能体（Agentic）、推理（Reasoning）和感知（Perception）三个领域进行受控的单教师 OPD 对比实验，发现性能相当的 SFT 与 RL 教师中，RL 教师能更有效地指导学生：最佳 RL 引导学生在三个领域分别超出 SFT 引导学生 4.27、1.50 和 0.86 个百分点，且对教师性能增益的恢复率显著更高。机制分析表明，RL 教师在参数空间中距离共享初始化更近，因而更易于 OPD 学生跟随对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于 OPD 的模型合并流程中，各领域教师可由 SFT 或 RL 训练而成，但已有工作很少系统比较这一上游选择。直觉上教师任务性能越强越好，但 OPD 中学生是从教师在自身轨迹上的 token 级监督中学习，因此同等性能的 SFT 与 RL 教师未必具有同等的"可教性"。本文旨在通过受控实验揭示 SFT 与 RL 训练方式对 OPD 教师效果的影响。

Method: 采用受控单教师 OPD 实验设计：以 Qwen3.5-9B 为所有模型的共享初始化，在 Agentic（MobileWorld）、Reasoning（Geo3K）和 Perception（GUI 定位）三个领域分别训练性能匹配的 SFT 教师和 RL 教师（RL 使用 GRPO），再将各自学生从同一基座初始化进行单教师 OPD。通过参数空间位移（τ_T 与 r_t）和 Top-20 token 重叠度（O_K）两个诊断指标，分析教师训练算法影响学生蒸馏效果的原因。

Result: 在三个领域中，最佳 RL 引导学生分别比最佳 SFT 引导学生高 4.27（Agentic）、1.50（Reasoning）和 0.86（Perception）个百分点。Agentic 中，SFT 引导学生仅恢复教师增益的 44.44%，而 RL 引导学生恢复 115.00% 并超越教师；Reasoning 中 RL 学生恢复率 262.96% 对 SFT 的 119.5%；Perception 中为 239.09% 对 169.32%。机制分析显示，RL 教师相对于共享初始化的参数位移仅为 SFT 教师的 0.19–0.37 倍，而 OPD 在早期对两类学生的参数移动相近；Top-20 重叠度上 RL 引导学生在 Agentic 与 Perception 中起点略低但上升更快，在 Reasoning 中起点即已较高。感知领域差距最小，原因在于其 SFT 教师本身位移也较小，符合"教师距初始化越近越易跟随"的假设。

Conclusion: 教师训练算法是 OPD 模型合并中一个被低估的关键设计选择。在共享初始化与教师性能相当的条件下，应优先选择 RL 训练领域教师，因为 RL 教师在参数空间中距共享初始化更近，使得增量更新的 OPD 学生更容易跟随其监督信号，从而获得更强的学生模型与更高的教师增益恢复率。这一效应在 Agentic 任务上最为显著。未来的工作应将该分析拓展到多教师 OPD 与更长视野的智能体基准。

Abstract: Domain experts trained from a shared checkpoint can be merged into one model through on-policy distillation (OPD), where they act as teachers supervising a student on its own trajectories. One upstream choice is rarely examined: whether to build each expert with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (RL). Yet equally strong teachers need not be equally good teachers. We probe this choice through controlled single-teacher OPD, a building block of multi-teacher OPD: in Agentic, Reasoning, and Perception, comparably performing SFT and RL teachers are trained from Qwen3.5-9B, each guiding a student initialized from it. At their best checkpoints, RL-guided students outperform SFT-guided students by 4.27, 1.50, and 0.86 percentage points in Agentic, Reasoning, and Perception, respectively, and recover more of their teachers' performance gains over the base model. The contrast is clearest in Agentic, where the best SFT-guided student recovers only 44.44% of its teacher's gain, whereas the best RL-guided student recovers 115.00%, surpassing its teacher. Our analysis points to an explanation: RL teachers stay much closer to the shared initialization in parameter space than SFT teachers and are therefore easier for their students to follow.

</details>


### [312] [PhiFold: Towards Dynamic Protein Design with Physics-Structured Covariance Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32309)
*Yutian Liu,Mujie Lin,LanqianZhang,Meng Fan,Chang Liu,ZhiweiNie,Siwei Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PhiFold是一个用于蛋白质设计的统一生成框架，能够同时生成蛋白质主链结构及其平衡态动力学（以残基位移协方差表征），而非将动力学作为后处理任务。该方法通过物理结构化的协方差分解实现动力学感知的蛋白质设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质生成模型主要生成静态结构，而构象动力学——对蛋白质功能至关重要——通常通过分子动力学模拟或后处理预测来估计。将MD轨迹作为生成目标也存在过度指定问题。PhiFold旨在将平衡态动力学作为显式设计变量整合到蛋白质生成框架中。

Method: PhiFold采用物理结构化的协方差参数化，将平衡态协方差分解为三个可解释部分：(1) 边际协方差描述局部柔性，(2) 低秩集体运动表示V^raw，(3) 残基级集体参与度α。这三个组件被组装为正定的协方差矩阵Σ_joint = BB^⊤ + Σ_res，保证精确边际一致性。基于FoldFlow架构，通过SE(3)等变流网络共享主链与动力学子网络的中间特征，实现耦合的结构-动力学生成。训练目标包括边际协方差损失、子空间对齐损失、PCA参与正则化、Frobenius损失和局部配对损失。

Result: 在ATLAS数据集（1390条蛋白链，每条3条100ns全原子MD轨迹）上训练后，PhiFold在50个随机选取的可设计蛋白上与独立的两副本GROMACS模拟对比评估。在12项指标中8项领先：局部波动恢复（r=0.739）、边际特征值（r=0.682）、每靶标RMSF（r=0.811）、均方W₂距离（1.386）、弱接触和瞬时接触Jaccard指数最佳。在集体运动子空间重叠（0.428）和长程DCCM（0.204）上具竞争力。消融研究证明物理结构化分解和残基自适应参与度的必要性：直接联合回归产生零有效协方差，固定α_i=0.5系统性地降低耦合恢复。可控生成实验显示：柔性指导使目标区域RMSF增加0.104-0.221 Å，刚性指导使其减少0.025-0.101 Å，区域外变化通常在0.033 Å以内，且设计性变化在5个百分点以内。

Conclusion: PhiFold通过将平衡态动力学作为显式设计变量，超越了后处理动力学估计，将主链生成、集合建模和区域柔性控制整合到统一框架中。其物理结构化表示分离了局部柔性、集体运动和残基级参与度，同时确保具有精确边际一致性的有效协方差。PhiFold为近平衡波动、域尺度集体运动和长程动力学耦合相关的早期阶段设计提供了基础，但不替代序列分辨的原子化建模。未来工作将扩展到联合序列-主链-动力学生成以及多模态时间分辨集合。

Abstract: Protein design is moving beyond structural correctness toward function-aware design, yet existing generative models typically treat dynamics as a downstream property estimated through simulation or prediction after structure generation. Using MD trajectories as a generative target is also undesirable because stochastic, path-dependent trajectories over-specify the underlying equilibrium ensemble. We introduce PhiFold, a framework for jointly generating protein backbones and their second-order dynamics, represented by residue-displacement covariance. Rather than predicting the quadratically sized full covariance, PhiFold decomposes dynamics into three interpretable components: local flexibility, a low-rank collective-motion representation, and residue-wise collective participation. These components are assembled into a positive-definite covariance matrix with exact marginal consistency, yielding a compact and physically constrained representation of equilibrium dynamics. Across generated proteins, PhiFold improves recovery of local fluctuations and long-range residue coupling while remaining competitive on dominant collective-motion subspaces. It further enables bidirectional control of residue flexibility while preserving backbone designability. By unifying structure generation with an explicit representation of equilibrium dynamics, PhiFold lays a foundation for designing proteins not only by how they look, but also by how they move.

</details>


### [313] [Delayed Supervision for Test-Time Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32312)
*Jinha Kim,Taksh Kothari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对测试时语言模型（如LaCT、DeltaNet、RWKV-7）的延迟监督训练方法，通过在事件流中插入经过长时间间隔后提出的基于模拟器状态的问题来训练模型保持与更新事实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的下一标记预测（NTP）目标并不显式要求事实经过多次内存更新后仍可访问，导致在长交互中模型难以保留相关事实或检索最新修订值。核心动机是弥补"继续观察流"与"回答延迟问题"之间的差距。

Method: 方法核心包括：(1) 定义状态基础任务：从TextWorld生成事件轨迹和探针(q, t, y)，区分保留探针和修订探针；(2) 辅助回答目标：在常规NTP损失基础上加入延迟问题的答案损失，使用模型原有语言模型头；(3) 一次性分支机制：每个探针从事件前缀独立分支，答案丢弃，主事件流不受探针答案干扰。结合损失为$\mathcal{L}(\theta)=\alpha\mathcal{L}_{\text{NTP}}+\beta\mathcal{L}_{\text{QA}}$，训练过程中原生测试时更新规则不变。

Result: 在LaCT-760M、DeltaNet-1.3B和RWKV-7上评估：LaCT的BABILong提升5.48个百分点，DeltaNet提升1.32点；单针RULER分别提升1.45和3.27点。RWKV-7对比显示BABILong和RULER分别提升4.60和7点。但方法未隔离延迟本身与通用QA监督的贡献，且仅使用单一训练种子。

Conclusion: 延迟语义监督可作为测试时内存的实用外部训练目标，支持未来语义有用性作为训练信号；保留事件NTP、仅在隔离分支上监督答案、区分保留事实与修订值。但延迟的因果效应、答案+EOS监督中格式化成分、以及向非结构化场景的推广仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Test-time language models adapt a compact memory while processing the input sequence. This perspective encompasses nonlinear fast-weight learning in LaCT, associative delta-rule updates in DeltaNet, and generalized delta-rule state updates in RWKV-7. Training these models to predict the next token does not explicitly require a fact to remain accessible after many subsequent memory updates. We study delayed supervision for this test-time memory: during post-training, ask a simulator-grounded question only after a long interval of unrelated events, and supervise its answer alongside ordinary next-token prediction. Questions are evaluated on disposable branches, so their answers never enter the continuing event stream. The construction distinguishes retention from revision: a retained fact must remain valid throughout the delay, whereas a revised fact must be answered with its latest value. We evaluate this approach on LaCT-760M and plain DeltaNet-1.3B using TextWorld training trajectories and shared BABILong and RULER evaluation panels, and include a separately reported RWKV-7 comparison. Relative to event-only training, delayed QA improves BABILong by 5.48 percentage points for LaCT and 1.32 points for DeltaNet, and single-needle RULER by 1.45 and 3.27 points, respectively. The RWKV-7 comparison reports gains of 4.60 and 7.00 points on its own panels. These results support delayed semantic supervision as a practical outer training objective for usable test-time memory, while leaving open how much of the benefit derives specifically from delay rather than general question-answering and answer-termination supervision.

</details>


### [314] [RLHarness: Co-evolving Procedural Skills with Reinforcement Learning for Long-horizon Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32326)
*Ziqiao Shang,Zian Xu,Ji-Chen Yan,Weiming Wu,Ziyi Jia,Jie Meng,Tao Huang,Shan Huang,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RLHarness提出了一种版本化的Harness（包含技能库、调用协议和示例）与策略学习的协同进化框架，通过两个阶段（Harness I探索-蒸馏初始化，Harness II基于当前策略重建）配合SFT与两段DAPO训练，解决长视野多模态推理中程序冷启动与版本失配问题，在四个任务上显著优于基线和SkillRL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端验证器只判断最终答案正误，不提供程序级指导；固定技能库随策略变化会出现触发器/执行顺序/示例陈旧与不一致的问题，因此需要让外部程序与策略协同进化。

Method: 构建版本化Harness Φ=(I,B,P,E,C)，交替执行：Harness I从原始任务经验初始化B/P/E并生成版本对齐的SFT数据；SFT+DAPO I得到θ¹；Harness II基于θ¹在当前策略的rollout上进行分层对比诊断、修剪低使用率技能、重写协议与示例并原子提交Φ²；DAPO II使策略内化。已提供匹配的消融控制项及K=10配对统计检验。

Result: 在MetroMap-lite/TravelMap-lite上准确率从16.25%/27.50%提升至62.00%/50.00%；在Fee-VL/Cancel-VL上F1从37.13%/45.50%提升至65.81%/65.51%。所有24项主要组件对比经Holm校正后均显著，最佳结果仅在重建与DAPO II之后获得。

Conclusion: 版本化Harness与策略的协同进化是有效的，分阶段重建能持续更新外部程序；学习到的权重仅能有限迁移（偏向同任务族），重建后的Prompt则任务专属性强。仍存在视觉感知、稀疏长视野奖励、Harness-策略版本耦合和迭代次数有限等局限。

Abstract: Multimodal reasoning requires models to preserve visual evidence through long decision chains while selecting appropriate procedures across diverse scenarios and rules. When learning is guided only by terminal verifiers, reinforcement learning (RL) reveals whether a final answer is correct but not how it should be produced. The policy must therefore discover reusable reasoning procedures while learning to execute them, creating a program cold-start problem. Skills can externalize successful procedures, reduce repeated exploration, and provide inspectable guidance. However, a fixed Skill Bank assumes that this guidance remains compatible with an evolving policy, while updating Skills alone can leave their triggers, execution protocols, and demonstrations stale or mutually inconsistent. We introduce RLHARNESS, which organizes Skills, selection and execution protocols, few-shot demonstrations, and task contracts into a unified, versioned Harness and alternates Harness evolution with policy learning. An Exploration-Distillation Harness builds the initial Harness and version-aligned verified traces for SFT and DAPO I. After the first RL block, a Post-RL Reconstruction Harness rebuilds Skills, protocols, and demonstrations from fresh success-failure rollouts, and DAPO II adapts the policy to the reconstructed program. RLHARNESS improves Accuracy from 16.25%/27.50% to 62.00%/50.00% on MetroMap/TravelMap and raises F1 score from 37.13%/45.50% to 65.81%/65.51% on Fee-VL/Cancel-VL. All four tasks achieve their best results only after reconstruction and DAPO II, showing that an evolving Harness complements RL by continually updating the external program that the policy learns to execute.

</details>


### [315] [HyperReCo: Retrieving and Connecting Evidence with Hypergraph Neural Networks for LLM Multi-hop Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32327)
*Zicheng Zhao,Linhao Luo,Junnan Dong,Haoran Luo,Xiaoli Li,Shirui Pan,Chen Gong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HyperReCo提出了一种面向LLM多跳问答的超图检索与证据连接框架，通过查询条件化的超图神经网络(HyperGNN)学习证据间的结构相关性，并利用基于梯度引导的超路径解码(GGHD)将学习到的交互显式地翻译为连接已检索证据的超路径，从而帮助LLM进行多跳推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超图检索器依赖预定义的结构扩展或扩散机制，可能遗漏识别相关证据所需的查询依赖交互；同时这些方法将已检索证据之间的连接隐式化，要求LLM在推理前自行重建连接。作者认为多跳推理不仅需要检索相关证据，还需要显式呈现证据间的连接关系。

Method: 1)将每个文档表示为其抽取实体集合上的超边，通过共享实体连接超边构成超图；2)提出查询条件化的HyperGNN，采用交替的超边-实体消息传递机制，结合文档级和实体级的联合监督学习查询依赖的交互；3)提出梯度引导的超路径解码(GGHD)，通过对训练好的HyperGNN进行梯度归因来解释学到的交互，并基于查询条件化的奖品收集Steiner森林(Q-PCSF)目标将其转化为显式超路径；4)将检索到的文档和解码的超路径一起提供给LLM进行答案生成。

Result: 在六个基准测试上的实验表明，HyperReCo在三个多跳问答数据集(HotpotQA、MuSiQue、2Wiki)上均实现了最佳的检索性能和强劲的下游问答性能。具体而言，在HotpotQA上EM达到60.7、MuSiQue上EM达到39.9、2Wiki上EM达到72.2，均优于所有对比方法。同时在跨域泛化方面，在G-bench的Novel和Medical基准上保持强竞争力，并在Medical上取得最佳QA性能。消融实验证实了查询条件化结构相关性学习的有效性，案例分析展示了超路径对证据组合的引导作用。效率方面，索引构建仅需每10K文档3.3M token（远低于GraphRAG的76M），在线推理延迟为3.55秒/查询。

Conclusion: 成功的多跳推理不仅需要检索相关证据，还需要显式呈现证据之间如何连接。HyperReCo通过结合学习的结构相关性（HyperGNN）和显式的证据连接引导（GGHD超路径），在检索性能和推理性能上均达到最优，且具有跨域泛化能力和较高的效率。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities, with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supporting complex multi-hop reasoning by retrieving evidence distributed across documents. Graph-based approaches exploit connections among evidence, and hypergraph-based retrieval further preserves higher-order entity associations within documents and connects documents through shared entities. However, existing hypergraph retrievers often rely on predefined structural expansion or diffusion, which may miss query-dependent interactions needed to identify relevant evidence. They also leave connections among retrieved evidence implicit, requiring LLMs to reconstruct these connections before reasoning. Therefore, we propose HyperReCo, a framework for retrieving and connecting evidence with a hypergraph neural network (HyperGNN). We represent each document as a hyperedge over its extracted entities, with shared entities connecting the hyperedges. Through hypergraph message passing with joint supervision over documents and entities, the HyperGNN learns query-dependent interactions to retrieve complementary evidence. We further introduce Gradient-Guided Hyper-Path Decoding (GGHD), which uses gradient attribution to interpret the learned interactions and translate them into explicit hyper-paths that help LLMs combine complementary facts for multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on six benchmarks show that HyperReCo achieves the best retrieval performance among the compared methods on all three multi-hop QA datasets, together with strong downstream QA performance. Case studies and further analyses demonstrate the utility of decoded hyper-paths for connecting retrieved evidence.

</details>


### [316] [Enabling Timely Guidance before Skill Retrieval: Retaining Helpful Warm Tips in Agent Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32339)
*Feng Liang,Yupeng Li,Runhao Zeng,Francis C. M. Lau,Xiping Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TipsWarm机制，在LLM智能体对话上下文中维持一个预算受限的"暖提示"池（warm tips），从技能中提炼关键点并按相关性筛选注入每轮对话，使智能体在决定检索完整技能之前就能获得及时指导，在编码和迭代任务执行基准上提高任务成功率并保持时间效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能机制通常仅暴露元数据、按需加载完整内容，导致智能体在决定检索相关技能前因方法无效而耗费精力；而通用记忆方法维护开销大，保留对话上下文中的指导则会反复暴露无关或有害建议。需要在技能检索之前让有用的经验教训可被及时利用，同时控制维护成本。

Method: TipsWarm由三项操作组成：1）过滤（Filtering）：当技能被访问、生成或更新时，用正则提取候选关键点，由LLM判断其对未来相似任务的迁移性，纳入或驱逐出预算受限的提示池；2）注入（Injection）：每个用户消息轮次基于范围关键词匹配和历史效用评分（helpful/harmful/irrelevant计数）做轻量筛选，将部分提示加入上下文；3）归因（Attribution）：任务结束后用LLM基于工具调用事件和任务结果评估每个被注入提示的贡献，更新效用记录。三者将昂贵的LLM评估集中在低频事件（技能事件、任务结束），高频的每轮筛选仅用启发式规则。

Result: 在SkillsBench、AppWorld、AlfWorld三个基准上，TipsWarm均取得最高最终任务成功率：SkillsBench上84.1%（HermesSkill为82.3%），任务完成时间减少30.8%；AppWorld上71.0%，时间约为A-MEM的1/2.8；AlfWorld上略优于HermesSkill。在warmup时间上仅为A-MEM的约1/22、DC的约1/3。消融实验显示范围匹配与效用归因均贡献于早期成功率提升；更强的骨干模型下，TipsWarm仍能进一步扩大性能优势。

Conclusion: 通过将事件触发的LLM评估与廉价的每轮筛选分离，TipsWarm在技能检索之前提供可迁移的决策关键点，同时控制上下文与维护成本。在编码与迭代任务基准上相对底层技能机制和通用记忆基线均取得更优的成功率-时间权衡，并能缩小弱模型与强模型之间的能力差距。

Abstract: Reusable skills help LLM-based agents solve complex tasks, but the agent must receive guidance before it commits to an ineffective approach. Existing skill mechanisms often expose only metadata and load full content on demand, leaving useful guidance unavailable until the agent decides to retrieve it. General memory methods can incur substantial maintenance overhead, while keeping guidance in conversation context risks repeatedly exposing the agent to irrelevant or harmful advice. We propose TipsWarm, a mechanism that complements existing skill mechanisms by maintaining a budgeted pool of skill-derived keypoints, or \textit{warm tips}, for selective injection into the context of every message turn. By separating event-triggered LLM assessment from inexpensive per-turn screening, it makes transferable skill guidance readily available while controlling maintenance costs. In three coding and iterative task-execution benchmarks, TipsWarm achieves the highest task success rate while remaining time-efficient, compared to recent skill and general memory baselines.

</details>


### [317] [ALLOT: Budgeted Hybrid-Memory Routing for Knowledge Updates in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32344)
*Shanfeng Huang,Zhou Fang,Song Xiao,Hai Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ALLOT 提出了一种预算受限的混合记忆路由框架，用于在 LLM 知识更新场景下决定哪些事实值得进行参数化写入（LoRA 适配器），哪些仅靠外部检索即可。该框架通过一个记忆感知的路由器融合冻结文本嵌入、检索置信度与关系元特征生成可重用优先级，并在 CounterFact 上以 Qwen3-4B 达到 0.760 准确率，仅用 20% 参数化写入预算即可恢复 78.4% 的预算匹配 oracle 增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 LLM 接入新事实时，检索与参数化更新各有所长：检索廉价但未必命中，参数化（如 LoRA）准确但代价高昂。若对所有事实同时进行外部存储与参数化写入，会在检索已能回答的事实上浪费大量适配资源。论文核心动机是：在固定参数化写入预算下，回答“哪些事实真正需要额外的参数化写入”，并将其构建为一个受约束的分配问题。

Method: ALLOT 由两部分构成：(1) 监督标签由四种动作（drop/ext/para/both）的探针结果生成，目标函数在准确率基础上减去参数化与外部写入成本（λp=λe=0.5），并证明在该区间内标签稳定。(2) 一个冻结文本编码器提取 D 维特征，与 top-5 检索余弦统计和关系 one-hot 拼接，经 MLP（3D→512→128→4）训练，使用类加权交叉熵平衡 CounterFact 上 53% 的 ext 多数类。路由分数为 para 与 both 两类的预测概率之和。分配算法对所有 N 条事实排序，固定全部外部写入，仅对排名前 B 条做参数化适配（LoRA, query/value, rank=16）。同一排序支持多个预算，无需重训。文中还给出路由精度与 oracle 精度差距的分解式。实验在 zsRE 与 CounterFact（各 500 条）上进行，使用 Qwen3-0.6B/4B 与 FAISS top-5 检索，主协议为三组 80/20 划分下的逐项预算评估。

Result: 在 CounterFact/Qwen3-4B 上，ALLOT（D 配置）在 5/10/15/20/30% 预算下分别取得 0.713/0.730/0.746/0.760/0.788 准确率，20% 预算下相对随机分配恢复 78.4% 的 oracle 增益，相比 uplift 模型（41.3%）和 GBT（35.1%）有显著优势，并比双写策略减少 80% 参数化写入。特征消融显示文本嵌入已提供 72.2% OG，加入检索与关系特征后提升 6.2 pp，且联合特征 D 在 10–30% 预算下均最优。在 Qwen3-0.6B 共享存储下，仅以 6–14.5% 参数化写入即可达到双写水平准确率（zsRE 0.646 vs 0.644；CF 0.585 vs 0.585），存储减少约 8.8–14.9 倍。跨基准迁移（zsRE→CF）保留约 88% 域内增益；时序分配与全池选择差距仅 0.036 pp。100 条标注即可恢复 55–61% oracle 增益。

Conclusion: ALLOT 将 LLM 事实更新问题形式化为混合记忆下的受预算约束分配实验，通过可重用路由评分在统一框架内支持多预算分配与按序写入。实验证明选择性参数化写入能够以极低的适配数量达到接近双写的准确性，文本、检索置信度与关系元特征的联合表征对排序质量至关重要，且路由监督具有跨基准可迁移性。未来方向为更长更新流与更多模型族系。

Abstract: For large language models (LLMs), parametric adaptation is costly when retrieval already suffices. We introduce ALLOT, a hybrid-memory routing framework that separates learned write priority from a hard parametric budget. A memory-aware router combines frozen text representations, retrieval confidence, and relation metadata; a single ranking supports multiple write budgets while preserving all facts in external memory. On CounterFact with Qwen3-4B, ALLOT reaches 0.760 accuracy at a 20% parametric-write budget and recovers 78.4% of the budget-matched oracle gain, with 80% fewer parametric writes than dual-writing every fact. At this budget, jointly adding retrieval and relation features to text improves normalized oracle gain by 6.2 percentage points. Complementary Qwen3-0.6B shared-store results achieve dual-write-level accuracy with 6-14.5% parametric writes, and cross-benchmark transfer retains approximately 88% of in-domain gain. These results support allocating adaptation capacity according to its incremental value rather than treating every factual update as an equally valuable training target.

</details>


### [318] [From Trajectories to Grounded Preferences: Process Preference Synthesis via Interaction Element Graphs for Web PRMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32351)
*Yangzhe Peng,Xiaoyang Wang,Yiyang Zhao,Lijun Wu,Kun He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 surfPRM 框架，通过构建跨轨迹的"交互元素图"(Interaction Element Graph)，沿空间、时间、时空三个混淆轴系统合成环境接地的极小对比负动作，将 Web 过程奖励模型(PRM)偏好数据中"接地极小对比对(GMCP)"的比例从 24.19% 提升至 74.60%，从而消除元素幻觉和动作类型不匹配等浅层捷径，使训练出的比较式 Web PRM 在 step 级偏好判别和下游轨迹搜索中均显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Web 过程奖励模型(PRM)的偏好训练数据通过多策略采样合成，导致严重缺乏"接地极小对比对(GMCP)"——即两个候选动作均针对当前页面真实存在元素且具有相同操作类型的对比对。WebArbiter 基线数据中 GMCP 仅占 24.19%，其余被元素幻觉(BID 不存在于当前观察)和动作类型不匹配(如 click vs. fill)主导，迫使 PRM 在训练中依赖浅层捷径而非真实的上下文决策语义。

Method: 提出 surfPRM 框架：(1) 构建跨轨迹、站点级的持久"交互元素图" G=(V, E_s, E_τ)，节点 V 包含 DOM 元素节点(基于 BID 不变的四元组上下文签名映射)和页面作用域虚拟节点(virt)，边 E_s 记录 AXTree 空间紧含关系(仅连到最近可交互祖先)，E_τ 记录时序交互跳转；(2) 设计六条负动作提案规则，分属三类混淆：空间(结构近邻、文本近但图远)、时间(重做过去、过早执行)、时空(远离目标、形成环路)；(3) 候选负动作严格从 V_grounded(s_t)(能唯一解析到当前 O_t 中 BID 的节点)中抽取，避免元素幻觉；(4) 用教师模型进行 K=5 次一致性验证过滤假阴性，并合成 gold 判断理由与偏好标签；(5) 训练采用"Action-Only"输入协议(剥离候选理由)，目标序列为 (j_t* ∘ y_t*)，用自回归交叉熵损失监督。

Result: 在 50 个网站、854 条成功轨迹、9497 个页面观察上构建交互元素图(116,182 元素节点、1,532 空间边、6,739 时间边)，合成 9,821 对通过 98.21% 教师一致性验证的偏好对。GMCP 比例从 24.19% 提升至 74.60%，非 GMCP 残差 25.4% 完全由虚拟正步骤(16.6%)和功能性保留的动作类型差异(9.1%)两类有意设计造成，假阴性率从 30% 降至 12%。在 WebPRMBench 上，6 个开源基座(3B–9B)上 SURFPRM 训练的 PRM 全面优于 WebArbiter 基线(Qwen2.5-3B: Pairwise +6.45%, BoN +7.76%；Qwen3.5-9B: 86.30%/68.28%)，并比肩 GPT-5/Claude-4.6-Sonnet 等闭源 LLM。在 WebArena-Lite 下游奖励引导轨迹搜索中，引导 GPT-4o 提升 +14.21%，引导 GPT-4o-mini 提升 +12.83%，大幅缓解高分支瓶颈。消融实验证明 GMCP 比例与性能呈正相关、图拓扑贡献显著、三个轴互补必要。

Conclusion: SURFPRM 通过图引导的负动作合成框架，系统性地将 Web PRM 训练数据中的接地极小对比对比例提升三倍以上，有效消除元素幻觉等浅层捷径，使小型开源模型(3B–9B)训练的 PRM 不仅在 step 级偏好判别上超越同规模基线、比肩顶级闭源 LLM，还能作为即插即用验证器为不同策略(GPT-4o/4o-mini)提供显著的下游轨迹搜索增益，证明了跨轨迹拓扑信号与多轴混淆设计对过程奖励建模的关键价值。

Abstract: Comparative Process Reward Models (PRMs) provide critical step-level guidance for autonomous web agents by evaluating state-conditioned preferences between candidate actions. However, existing preference training data synthesized via multi-policy sampling suffers from a severe scarcity of Grounded Minimal Contrastive Pairs (GMCPs)-where competing candidates target genuine on-page elements with identical action types. In representative baselines preference data (namely, WebArbiter), GMCPs account for merely 24.19%, biasing PRMs during training to rely on shallow shortcuts (such as element hallucinations and action type mismatches) rather than acquiring genuine contextual decision semantics. To address these challenges, we propose SURFPRM, a graph-guided process preference synthesis framework for comparative Web PRMs. SURFPRM structures web demonstrations into a persistent Interaction Element Graph that acts as an environment-grounded negative action proposal mechanism, systematically synthesizing contrastive negative actions across spatial, temporal, and spatiotemporal confusion axes. This elevates the GMCP proportion from 24.19% to 74.60%, producing the curated SURFPRM-DATA dataset. Across six open-source backbones (3B to 9B parameters), PRMs trained on SURFPRM-DATA outperform baseline-trained models on average on WEBPRMBENCH and rival leading proprietary LLMs. In downstream reward-guided trajectory search on WEBARENA-LITE, SURFPRM provides step-level guidance for both GPT-4o (+14.21%) and GPT-4o-mini (+12.83%) policies, yielding substantial improvements in complex web task success rates.

</details>


### [319] [AuthorityLens: Rethinking LLM-Based Agent Systems Through the Lens of Authority](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32378)
*Shaojin Chen,Huihao Jing,Wun Yu Chan,Wenbin Hu,Jiaxing Li,Wu Pandy Pui Ching,Kshitij Bhatia,Xinlei He,Haoran Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AuthorityLens 是一个用于测量 LLM 智能体系统"实际授权结构"的框架。它通过分析在所有可接受的执行路径上能实现每个结果所需的最简 Principal（主体）组合，从三个维度评估系统配置：系统授权（可实现结果的比例）、授权分离度（实现结果所需的最少联合参与主体数）、以及主体授权（每个主体独立行使授权的能力）。论文对 Codex、OpenCode 和 Gemini CLI 三种系统的 13 种运行配置在 Agent-599（599 个授权相关结果的组合）上进行了实证评估，发现名义配置与实际授权不一致：Codex Full Access 实质上将授权集中在执行 Assistant 中；OpenCode Build 和 Plan 配置在结果层面完全相同；Gemini Model Review 在不改变系统授权的情况下增加授权分离。论文还区分了"授权复制"（多个主体可独立行使相同授权）与"授权分离"（多主体必须共同参与才能实现结果），并指出控制机制仅当其改变最小充分联盟时才真正影响授权结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体系统正被部署到关键资源和决策场景中，但系统设置（权限模式、沙箱、审查机制）名义上允许的授权与实际实现的授权之间存在显著差距。现有的智能体评估仅衡量任务成功率或抗攻击能力，无法衡量配置如何在主体之间分配授权。随着智能体系统变得更自主、更多智能体，理解这种分配成为设计的关键关注点。经典安全设计原则（职责分离、最小权限）在此情境下需要新的形式化框架。

Method: 论文提出 AuthorityLens 框架，其核心概念包括：(1) Principal（主体），即被授予授权并可归因的实体（人类或 LLM）；(2) authority signature（授权签名），描述主体的操作、资源范围和审批关系；(3) authority portfolio（授权组合），即声明的有限结果集；(4) minimal sufficient coalition（最小充分联盟），即在某个可接受运行时状态下能实现结果且无法移除任何成员的主体集合。基于这些概念定义三个度量：System Authority（系统授权）为可实现结果在组合中的比例；Authority Separation（授权分离度）为平均最小所需参与数；Principal Authority（主体授权）通过 1/d_C(p,x) 的平均值衡量每个主体的"授权承载容量"（d_C(p,x) 为包含该主体的最小联盟规模）。论文证明在合理的类内不变性条件下，这些度量可从有限的状态样本中恢复。实验部分构建了 Agent-599（599 个授权相关结果，覆盖文件、执行环境、主机操作、软件开发、数据系统等 7 大主题 46 个类别），通过对 Codex、OpenCode、Gemini CLI 的 13 种配置进行源代码审计和受控环境测试，测量每个结果是否可实现及其最小主体参与要求。

Result: 实证研究发现名义配置与实际授权不一致：(1) Codex Full Access 相对 Ask/Auto 模式仅将系统授权从 0.997 微增至 1.000，但将 Assistant 单方面可实现的结果比例从 53% 提升到 100%，实质上是集中授权而非扩展授权；(2) OpenCode Build 和 Plan 配置在结果层面完全相同（均实现 537 个结果，m̄=1.000），尽管 Plan 限制原生编辑但保留了 shell 执行和委托执行器；(3) Gemini Model Review 在不改变系统授权（552 个结果）的情况下将 m̄ 从 1.857 增加到 2.837，实现了授权分离的"分层"。研究还发现命令中介机制（Codex 的 rm -f 识别、OpenCode 的外部路径检查）可通过 shell 会话延续或变量编码绕过，而沙箱等资源边界仍然有效。论文区分了"授权复制"（Codex 派生的 Assistant 共享相同授权、OpenCode Explore 子执行器复制根执行器的全部授权）与"授权分离"（Gemini Model Review 引入的审查者成为共同必要主体）。这些发现表明控制系统仅通过改变最小充分联盟来影响授权结构：要么移除到达结果的路径，要么要求更多主体参与。

Conclusion: AuthorityLens 提供了衡量 LLM 智能体系统授权结构的统一框架，将关注点从设置层面转移到结果和联盟层面。论文的核心论点是：权限模式、工作流角色和审查机制描述的是系统的预期运作方式，但实际授权取决于所有可接受路径上仍可达的结果及每个结果所需的参与。这两个维度独立变化：系统可保持结果覆盖率不变但改变联合参与要求；增加智能体可复制授权或分离授权。论文的度量刻画的是可能性而非频率，System Authority 是下界，每个结果所需参与是上界。该视角有助于围绕系统实际实现的授权及其结构性合作要求来设计智能体系统，对多智能体系统的安全设计具有重要指导意义。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed with authority over consequential resources and decisions in real systems. These agents often operate alongside human and LLM-based participants who hold different forms of authority. Yet workflow roles, permission settings, and review mechanisms do not necessarily reflect the authority realized in practice. We introduce AuthorityLens, a framework for measuring a system's authority structure. Starting from an authority portfolio, we evaluate a system along three dimensions: what the system is authorized to do (System Authority), how much joint participation is required to exercise that authority (Authority Separation), and how much authority each participant holds (Principal Authority). We derive these measurements from the minimal combinations of participants sufficient to realize each outcome across admissible runtime states. We apply AuthorityLens to Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI across 13 operating configurations over a common portfolio of agent operations. We find that nominal configurations do not map cleanly onto realized authority. In Codex, Full Access changes System Authority only marginally while substantially concentrating authority in the executing Assistant. OpenCode's Build and Plan configurations have the same System Authority and Authority Separation despite different workflows and root-level permissions. In Gemini CLI, model-based review increases Authority Separation without changing System Authority. Principal Authority further distinguishes authority replication from authority separation: spawned or delegated agents can become alternative holders of the same authority without increasing the required joint participation. Together, these results demonstrate that AuthorityLens provides a unified framework for measuring and comparing realized authority structures across agent systems.

</details>


### [320] [Reward Hacking and Agent Containment Failure: A Monte Carlo Study Based on the 2026 Hugging Face Incident](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32390)
*Murat Ozer,Bulent Erenay,Ibrahim Berber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对2026年7月Hugging Face生产基础设施遭AI智能体入侵事件，构建了一个五阶段概率风险模型（奖励黑客→逃逸→可用访问→持久化→检测失效），通过蒙特卡洛模拟（10万次运行×4种控制配置）量化AI智能体外部网络安全风险，得出分层控制措施效果最优的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着具备网络攻击能力的AI智能体日益强大，单一的奖励黑客问题已升级为外部网络安全事件。传统弱边界隔离已不足以应对，亟需量化的概率风险框架来指导防御资源配置。

Method: 构建五阶段贝叶斯式概率链模型（奖励黑客→容器逃逸→获取可用访问→建立持久化→规避检测），通过蒙特卡洛模拟10万次运行，比较四种控制配置（基线/仅网络隔离/仅监控/分层控制），并进行±25%参数扰动敏感性分析（300次抽样）。

Result: 1) 分层控制显著降低外部事件概率，远优于单独的网络隔离或监控；2) 该结论在参数扰动下稳健成立；3) 智能体能力、监控弱点、授权和凭证控制是风险的最大影响因素；4) 人类的时间折扣和指标博弈为短视优化提供行为类比，但不意味着AI智能体具有人类动机。

Conclusion: 应将具备网络攻击能力的AI智能体评估视为敌对性安全区域：间接外联通道、共享基础设施、凭证及评估产物必须置于智能体的有效权限之外，分层防御是必要架构原则。

Abstract: The July 2026 intrusion into Hugging Face production infrastructure showed how reward hacking can become an external cybersecurity incident when a capable agent encounters weak containment boundaries. This study develops a probabilistic risk model linking five stages: reward hacking, containment escape, usable access, persistence, and failure of detection. A Monte Carlo simulation evaluates 100,000 runs under each of four control configurations. Input distributions represent explicit uncertainty and are used for comparative analysis rather than real-world frequency prediction. Under the stated assumptions, layered controls reduce simulated external-incident probability substantially more than network isolation or monitoring used alone, an ordering that holds under independent plus/minus 25% perturbation of every coefficient in the model across 300 draws. Sensitivity analysis shows that agent capability and weaknesses in monitoring, authorization, and credential control exert the greatest influence on modeled risk. Human temporal discounting and metric gaming provide a behavioral analogy for short-horizon optimization, but the study does not infer that AI agents experience gratification or human motivation. The results support treating cyber-capable agent evaluations as hostile security zones in which indirect egress, shared infrastructure, credentials, and evaluation artifacts must remain outside the agent's effective authority.

</details>


### [321] [SCLATE: a Substrate for Continual-Learning Agent Training and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32391)
*Youngmok Jung,Sirajul Salekin,Henry Tran,Javier Movellan,Zhao Huang,Manjot Bilkhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SCLATE是一个面向持续学习智能体的统一执行底座，通过开放事件调度器、混合模拟时钟和容器内捕获代理，使未修改的智能体harness和记忆系统能在多会话长时跨度上与基准测试事件在同一时间线上协同运行，从而支持评估与训练的一体化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习智能体的评估与训练框架存在三类缺陷：非智能体化基准缺乏时间与会话边界；闭源智能体基准绑定内建助手；智能体无关基准采用封闭调度、拒绝注册会话启停、cron、记忆整合等智能体侧事件，且训练侧rollout引擎继承这些局限，无法在多会话生命周期中以未修改的harness和记忆系统进行控制性对比与端到端训练。

Method: 三大核心机制：(1) 开放事件调度器，通过Benchmark Adapter与Agent Adapter将双方事件注册到统一事件源，由FrontierQueue选择到期事件，Effect Runner执行Deliver、StartAgent、SaveState等正交效果原语；(2) 混合模拟时钟，基于libfaketime让harness和记忆进程看到模拟时间，在智能体忙时按实时流动、在空闲时跳到下一个最早事件，将40日历天的MetaClaw场景压缩至中位数5.9真实小时；(3) 容器内捕获代理作为模型API网关，记录每次调用的token与log probability，并通过API key与系统提示签名做组件级归因，配合Rollout Engine的save/restore抽象支持跨容器状态持久化与外部训练框架（以Slime为例）解耦集成。

Result: 在7个基准（MetaClaw、GAIA-2、AppWorld、LongMemEval、PersonaMem、SWE-Gym、SWE-bench Verified）上对比10款模型×10种harness-记忆配置，得出三个核心结论：(a) 添加外部记忆系统并不稳定优于harness原生记忆（50格中11格更低，多集中于Hermes）；(b) 模型对相同harness与记忆的使用差异显著，Gemini-3.7F以7.6%工具调用占比检索历史会话，无记忆配置即领先；(c) 调度器在GAIA-2上13,050个事件全部按序触发、98.7%按指定延迟触发，与上游结果无显著差异。训练侧：通过未修改的harness与Hindsight对Qwen3.5-4B做on-policy蒸馏，MetaClaw留出天精度最高+11.8pp，记忆事实的目的子句填充率从1.1%升至19.6%，命名程序规则比例从23.6%升至40.6%；SWE-Gym上GRPO训练后SWE-bench Verified Pass@1从9.8%升至26.5%（Claude Code），文件读取减少6.8倍、整文件读取从69.2%降至18.4%、上下文超限从97.6%降至31.0%。

Conclusion: SCLATE通过统一事件语言、共享时间轴与代理级轨迹捕获，使持续学习智能体的模型、harness与记忆三者能够首次以未修改的形式进行横向评估与后训练一体化：评估证明无单一harness或记忆系统对所有模型最优，必须三者联合评估；训练证明模型能够学会适配其原生harness与记忆，写出更结构化的记忆记录并更高效使用上下文，从而将多会话持续学习从基准调度困境推进到可控、可复现的实验科学。

Abstract: Continual-learning agents are systems of models, harnesses, and memory operating over long multi-session horizons. Evaluating and training them requires interleaving tasks with agent-side events such as session stop and start, crons, and memory consolidation. Yet existing benchmarks and training frameworks schedule only the benchmark's own events, leaving each benchmark and agent pair to build a custom scheduling loop. We present SCLATE, an execution substrate where benchmarks and unmodified agents each add their events to one open event scheduler through an adapter. A hybrid simulated clock runs these events on a shared timeline, flowing in real time while the agent works and skipping idle gaps, which compresses a month-long scenario into hours. SCLATE also serves as a rollout engine that runs any agent's harness and memory unmodified, recording the tokens and log probabilities of every model call through an in-container proxy. We port seven benchmarks to SCLATE and compare ten unmodified harness and memory configurations head to head on ten models. The comparison shows that an added memory system does not reliably beat the harness's native memory and that models differ widely in how they use the same harness and memory. We then post-train Qwen3.5-4B through unmodified harnesses and memory systems. The model learns to use both, reading 6.8x fewer file lines with a 16.7-point higher SWE-bench Verified pass rate, and writing richer memory records, while its held-out MetaClaw accuracy rises by up to 11.8 points.

</details>


### [322] [Beyond Scripted Search: Sample-Efficient Reward Discovery via Agentic Black-box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32394)
*Minghao Li,Rui Tan,Ruihang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ARBO框架，用智能体在运行时基于完整评估历史（含观测与信念）自主构建黑盒优化搜索策略，在四个控制领域上以更少样本发现更优的奖励函数，显著优于现有脚本式LLM奖励搜索方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低层RL控制中密集奖励函数设计依赖专家经验；现有基于LLM的迭代奖励搜索采用预定义的选择与提案规则（脚本化搜索），样本效率低，因为在机器人与CPS任务中每个候选需完整RL训练评估，耗时数小时，导致大量失败/低分候选未被后续提示复用，搜索能力受限。

Method: 提出Agentic Reward Black-box Optimization (ARBO)框架，将LLM智能体本身作为提案算子g：1) 历史表示D=H∪B，观测H由评估预言机追加（含分数、每项训练曲线、错误回溯），信念B由智能体维护（含诊断笔记G与候选谱系Λ）；2) 智能体通过bash/文件操作工具查询工作区，在一次自主运行中通过多次工具调用生成下一批候选；3) 外部保留评估预言机与探索-利用调度ψ，在exploit与explore间切换以避免过度利用；4) 类比贝叶斯优化的"信念"机制，将历史视为可修正的解释，而非显式拟合后验或采集函数。

Result: 在四个控制域（Bi-DexHands灵巧操作、Grid2Op Case14电网、Isaac Lab运动控制、RESCO交通信号）上以共享评估预算（运动72样本，其他128样本）对比5种基线（Eureka、REvolve、RF-Agent、R⋆、ShinkaEvolve）：Bi-DexHands十任务平均成功率较基线均值提升29.9%，Case14电网得分提升192.8%；消融显示移除历史观测或信念、禁用调度、弱骨干均导致显著性能下降（消融变体平均损失29.6%增益）。在更稀疏奖励的任务上优势更大，候选质量在搜索过程中持续提升。

Conclusion: ARBO通过让LLM智能体在运行时根据完整评估历史自主决定读什么、生成什么候选，跳出固定选择与提案规则的限制，在机器人与CPS控制任务上以更高样本效率发现更优奖励函数；框架需具备推理能力的强骨干支持，纯文本历史限制了多模态诊断能力，扩展多模态推理留作未来工作。

Abstract: Designing dense reward functions for low-level reinforcement learning (RL) control remains difficult. Recent work uses large language models (LLMs) to iteratively generate and refine reward functions using policy-training feedback within scripted search algorithms. However, evaluating each candidate requires a full RL training run, making sample efficiency a central challenge for reward search on complex control tasks. To address this limitation, we propose an Agentic Reward Black-box Optimization (ARBO) framework, in which an LLM agent builds the search strategy at run time from an evaluation history maintained as its persistent workspace. The evaluation history comprises two components: observations maintained by the evaluation oracle, including candidate scores, per-term training curves, and error tracebacks; and an agent-maintained belief that records diagnoses and intended next steps. The agent queries both with tools and generates the next batch of reward candidates, rather than generating them in a single pass from a fixed prompt. Across four control domains, ARBO achieves gains of 29.9% in manipulation success rate and 192.8% in power-grid score over baseline means under a shared evaluation budget. Ablations examine each component's contribution and sensitivity to backbone choice.

</details>


### [323] [Memory as a cache: Exact context reuse and deletion by construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32395)
*Shengyao Wang,Jiang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SMem（Static Memory）是一种将上下文表征设计为缓存（cache by construction）的Transformer变体架构。其核心是将每个token块通过块局部编码器（block-local encoder）独立映射为记忆行（memory rows），再由读取器（reader）通过跨注意力（cross-attention）读取这些记忆行。这种设计带来三个结构性保证（对所有参数成立）：精确组合（exact composition）、精确删除（O(b)更新的O(b)操作）和路径无关性（path independence）。在4倍训练上下文长度下，SMem仍能检索远距离"针"信息，而各类Transformer变体（RoPE、Block-Attention等）几乎完全失效。同时，SMem在困惑度上与参数匹配的Transformer相当（差距-4.7%到+2.8%），并在服务场景中显著降低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer的KV缓存将每个token的表示与其整个前缀纠缠在一起，导致两个关键限制：（1）精确缓存复用仅限于共享前缀的上下文，在检索、多智能体、重排序文档等场景中命中率极低（生产数据显示仅8%的请求可前缀复用）；（2）删除某段内容必须重算其后所有token的KV状态。这两个问题源于架构选择，而非工程限制。本文从架构层面提出问题：能否将上下文表征设计为天然可组合、可删除的缓存？

Method: SMem架构包含两个组件：(1) 块局部编码器（E层），对每个b-token的块应用块内双向注意力，独立产生b行记忆行μ_j；(2) 读取器（D层），采用块内因果自注意力+跨注意力（至严格更早块的记忆行+学习到的空行）+FFN的pre-LN残差结构。三个结构性命题：(1) 精确组合：μ_{1:2}(C_1∥C_2) = μ_1(C_1) ⊎ μ_2(C_2) 对任意θ成立；(2) 精确编辑：记忆在⊎下构成可消交换幺半群，删除μ_j为精确O(b)更新；(3) 路径无关性：任意编辑序列到达同一块集产生相同记忆。还提出Lemma 1（交叉注意力Jacobian范数界独立于记忆行数）和合成任务PC_k的理论分析（给出R=Ω(k)下界与R=k的显式上界构造）。

Result: 检索能力：在4×训练长度（距离31和63块）下，SMem精确匹配准确率0.14-0.28，而所有Transformer变体（learned-position、RoPE、Block-Attention、YaRN、滑动窗口等）最多0.02。服务性能：完全缓存上下文仅需计算一个块，3.1-6.2 ms（vs. 冷启动prefill随上下文增长）；批量解码存储34-38%更少KV行，带宽受限时吞吐提升1.4-1.7×；删除后生成比后缀重算快8.5×（512块）到452×（4096块）。困惑度：在160M-1.5B参数、FineWeb-Edu数据集上，两种训练配方下，SMem与参数匹配Transformer的差距为-4.7%到+2.8%；SMem+RoPE组合在160M和410M上闭合了29-59%的与RoPE Transformer的差距。零样本评估4/5任务相当，LAMBADA上SMem在所有规模均领先。

Conclusion: SMem证明了一个架构原则：通过移除前缀纠缠（prefix entanglement），将跨块条件化从编码移到读取，可以同时获得（1）与标准Transformer相当的困惑度，（2）精确可组合、可删除、路径无关的记忆管理，（3）超越训练窗口的远距离检索能力，（4）显著降低服务延迟和内存占用。其代价是较小的困惑度差距和训练吞吐量降低15-24%。该架构特别适用于检索增强生成、多智能体系统、长文档处理等需要反复组合/删除上下文片段的场景。关键局限是预训练时选择（而非后改装）、训练实现较慢、且在优化配方下远距离检索信号减弱。

Abstract: The KV cache of a transformer entangles every token's representation with its entire prefix: a passage encoded once cannot be reused under a different prefix or removed without recomputing everything after it, so exact cache reuse is limited to shared prefixes. We present SMem, an architecture whose context representation is a cache by construction. A block-local encoder maps each block to memory rows independently of other blocks, and a reader conditions generation on their union through cross-attention. For every parameter setting, memory composes exactly at fixed block indices, deleting a block is an exact $O(b)$ update for $b$-token blocks, and the memory state is independent of the edit path. At $4\times$ the training context, under the shared recipe, SMem retrieves planted needles beyond any trained-length window (exact match 0.14-0.28 at distances of 31 and 63 blocks), where learned-position, RoPE, and Block-Attention-style transformers all score at most 0.02. A fully cached context is served by computing one block alone at a near-constant 3.1-6.2 ms, whereas cold prefill grows with context; batched decode stores 34-38% fewer KV rows and runs 1.4-1.7$\times$ faster when bandwidth-bound; and deletion beats suffix recomputation by 8.5$\times$ at 512 blocks and 452$\times$ at 4096 blocks (32-256$\times$ the trained length, probing the cost model rather than a served regime). The cost is a perplexity gap of -4.7% to +2.8% (negative favors SMem) against a parameter-matched transformer with the same positional scheme, at 160M-1.5B on FineWeb-Edu across two recipes and a learning-rate search. SMem also composes with RoPE: at 160M and 410M the composite matches or leads the matched transformer and closes 29-59% of SMem's gap to a RoPE transformer. Dropping prefix entanglement thus keeps perplexity comparable while making the cache exactly composable and editable.

</details>


### [324] [Function Over Form: Distributional Orthogonalization in Mixture-of-Experts with Replica Expert Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32398)
*Jinfan He,Yunzhuo Liu,Kai Zhang,Weidong Han,Rayying*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对MoE架构中专家坍塌与表征冗余问题，提出分布正交化损失（DO-loss）从动态路由行为而非静态权重多样性角度进行正则化，并设计副本专家机制（REM）在系统层面恢复负载均衡。两者解耦设计在4.8B/0.5B和30B/3B两种规模MoE模型的下游任务上均优于现有路由算法，且训练效率相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE架构通过稀疏激活实现参数扩展，但其有效性常受两类问题制约：专家坍塌（expert collapse）导致有效参数量减少，表示冗余（representation redundancy）则浪费剩余容量。现有方法——负载均衡损失通过强制均匀分配抑制专业化，参数正交化仅保障参数空间多样性却不保证专家被实际使用——分别解决问题但存在冲突，朴素组合会导致梯度方向矛盾而训练不稳定。本文主张这两类问题应分别由算法层和系统层机制独立解决。

Method: 方法由两部分组成：(1) DO-loss将每个专家的token分配历史编码为高维二值负载签名，通过最小化成对汉明距离的方差来同时抑制专家坍塌（空闲专家获得负梯度被重新激活）和鼓励功能专化（路由重叠的专家对被惩罚）；利用直通估计（STE）实现梯度回传，复杂度仅O(mn²)，并通过跨数据并行组的All-Reduce同步距离矩阵得到Global-DO-loss。(2) REM在系统层面解耦负载均衡：全局批次级控制器基于Benefit Score贪心地将热专家副本放置到欠载rank；微批次内通过轻量级AllGather同步队列深度，实时将token分派至最短队列，且保持原始专家上的优化器状态不变。

Result: 在4.8B/0.5B（100B tokens）和30B/3B（200B tokens）两种Qwen3MoE架构上，Global-DO-loss在AGIEval、MMLU、MMLU-Pro、CEval、GSM8K、TriviaQA六个基准上均优于Local-LBL、Global-LBL、Orth-loss、Auxfree等基线，验证困惑度也最低；CKA分析显示其在深层获得最低均值和最小方差的专家表示。REM在H20和H800 GPU上以EPUB和EPUBEP两种配置均优于EfficientMoE和Pro-Prophet，单副本即可恢复大部分吞吐量损失，双副本使MaxVio趋近于零。最佳DO-loss系数约为5×10⁻⁶至1×10⁻⁵，比典型负载均衡损失系数小约两个数量级。

Conclusion: 本文验证了"路由目标应仅关注功能数据划分，负载均衡应作为基础设施问题由系统级机制处理"的设计原则。DO-loss与REM的解耦使MoE有效性和系统效率在不同抽象层级上分别优化，理论上参数可可靠转化为实际模型容量，同时该设计易于适配其他硬件范式（如晶圆级架构）。

Abstract: The scaling of LLMs increasingly relies on MoE architectures to decouple active computation from total parameter count. However, the efficacy of MoE is often constrained by expert collapse and representation redundancy, both leading to underutilization of model capacity. To address these challenges, this paper proposes Distributional Orthogonalization Loss (DO-loss), an auxiliary regularization that shifts the focus from static weight diversity to dynamic routing behavior. By representing each expert's token assignment history as a high-dimensional binary load signature, DO-loss penalizes signature overlap to prevent expert collapse while encouraging functional specialization. To align this algorithmic design with system efficiency, we further introduce the Replica Expert Mechanism (REM), which improves load balancing through a two-tiered strategy: adjusting replica expert placement at the global-batch level and performing real-time token dispatching at the micro-batch level. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that our method outperforms the evaluated routing algorithms on downstream tasks for both 4.8BA0.5B and 30BA3B MoE models, while maintaining comparable training efficiency.

</details>


### [325] [Opening LLM Judges: Recovering Preference Signals Beyond the Final Verdict](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32407)
*Sourabrata Mukherjee,Sunayana Sitaram*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM评估器（评判模型/judge）的"内部-输出鸿沟"：当评判模型的最终裁决错误时，正确判断所需的信息是确实缺失，还是存在于其内部表征中但未反映在最终输出里？答案是后者——通过对64个开源评估器在14个数据集上的系统性研究，包括对41个评判模型的因果干预，证明人类偏好信号可从冻结的内部激活中恢复。关键发现：在对抗性的LLMBar上，50个评判模型的裁决准确率仅0.456（低于随机），但同一评判模型激活上的小型探针可达0.846，去除表面特征后仍有0.686；这种差距在8个基准和模型族中一致存在，但非普遍——表面混淆分数cf可预测收益大小（ρ=0.90）；对于无表面线索的评分任务，读取内部无优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评判模型广泛用于评估模型输出，但其裁决易受位置、长度等表面特征影响而不可靠。已有研究大多在输出层面修补（去偏、集成、校准），但未追问：当裁决错误时，所需信息是否真的在模型内部缺失，还是存在但被输出阶段丢弃？这是理解评判模型失败机制、决定是否值得从内部恢复信号的基础问题。

Method: 跨64个开源模型（0.36B–405B，21+族）和14个数据集的系统研究，结合两类证据：（1）解码证据：在评判模型冻结激活上训练小型L2-逻辑回归探针，测量人类偏好信号的可恢复性；（2）因果证据：对41个评判模型进行前向传播干预（steering、ablation、patching），定位决策形成层和表面偏差通路。用九维表面特征向量残差化、长度平衡、子集/标签打乱等控制分离内容与表面混淆；用bootstrap、Wilcoxon、FDR-BH、家族聚类等统计方法；提出表面混淆诊断cf（仅用长度特征，无需内部读出器或探针），在拟合探针前即可预测收益。

Result: （1）内部-输出鸿沟稳健存在：50评判×8基准=400格中89%探针优于裁决；去表面特征和家族聚类后7/8基准仍显著；MT-Bench上探针达0.756，超过人-人一致0.646。（2）决策在网络中部即形成：因果决策深度中位0.58，lens解码深度0.91，34/39评判上patching早于可读层生效；82%偏差效应为间接MLP介导，DLA与因果 knockout相关性仅0.31；位置头消融可移除33–54%偏差并迁移到未见数据；长度子空间可线性移除。（3）cf预测收益：ρ=0.90，独立种子ρ=0.95，单元级β=0.53；在低混淆（评分任务、HH-RLHF）上无收益；（4）下游应用：相同标签预算下，探针优于self-consistency/校准prompt，在3,349标签上击败24B全参数微调且无安全回归；探针标签DPO在5/5单元中4个胜出，LLMBar上从0.463提升到0.787，恢复约90%的裁决到金标准差距。

Conclusion: LLM评判模型的最终裁决可能错误，但正确判断所需的人类偏好信号通常仍存在于其内部激活中，可通过小型探针以零梯度更新恢复。这一"内部-输出鸿沟"源于输出阶段暴露的仅是更丰富内部状态的低维投影，决策在网络中部即已因果确立，而直接归因方法（DLA）因仅看直接路径而无法识别主要介导通路。表面混淆诊断cf可在拟合探针前预测何时读取内部值得，使内部读出成为条件性、可证伪的诊断与修复工具，而非通用建议。

Abstract: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate model outputs, but their verdicts can be unreliable: a judge may favor the worse answer for its position, length, or other surface features. When a judge is wrong, is the information needed to judge correctly absent from the model, or present in its internal representations but not reflected in the output? We study this across 64 open-weight evaluators and 14 datasets, including causal interventions on 41 judges (editing activations mid-run to see whether the verdict changes). On LLMBar, built so the superficially better answer is the worse one, the verdicts of 50 judges agree with human labels only 0.456 of the time, even after averaging both answer orders. Yet a small probe on the same judges' activations, with no weight updates, reaches 0.846, and 0.686 once surface features such as length and position are residualized out (0.507 with shuffled labels). The gap holds across eight benchmarks and model families, but is not universal: a score of how well surface features alone predict the human label, computed before any probe is trained, predicts the size of the gain (Spearman rho = 0.90). On rubric tasks that score one answer at a time, leaving no surface cue to exploit, reading the internals gives no advantage. The interventions also show that editing activations mid-network already changes the verdict, before it can be read off directly, and locate the pathways carrying position and length bias. At the same label budget, the recovered signal lets a judge flag cases where it is likely wrong and yields better labels for preference learning. A wrong verdict, then, does not mean the judge lacks the information, and a simple diagnostic shows when it is worth recovering.

</details>


### [326] [Carnator: Fast Text-to-Video Generation with Generation-Native Compatibility-Guided Cross-Request Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32420)
*Xingkun Yin,Xuebin Tang,Mingkun Xu,Hongyang Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Carnator 是一个面向文本到视频扩散模型的跨请求加速框架，通过从模型内部扩散状态中提取"生成原生兼容性证据"（Early Signature），结合风险感知兼容性决策与联合潜在-注意力复用，在三个 T2V 骨干网络上实现了最高 2.17× 的端到端加速，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 因迭代去噪而产生高推理延迟，限制了交互式和大规模服务。现有加速方法主要针对单个请求内部冗余，而现有跨请求复用方法仅基于粗粒度语义相似度判断可复用性，可能接受不兼容的历史计算（激进复用）或错失大量加速机会（保守复用）。

Method: 1) 复用有效性：通过轻量级早期探测（Early Probe）从模型内部交叉/自注意力状态构建 Early Signature（物体为中心的时空支撑与外观描述符），并在风险感知兼容性阈值下过滤候选历史缓存；2) 复用范围：对接受的缓存，通过 Region-Guided Latent Reuse（在 Evidence/Active/Context 三层区域中差异化更新）与 Historical Sparse-Connectivity Reuse（复用历史稀疏注意力块结构）实现联合潜在-注意力复用，仅在中间 Transformer 层进行区域受限更新。

Result: 在 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 和 LTX-Video-13B 三个骨干网络上，Carnator 在缓存命中率更低的情况下（72.67% vs 基线 80.67%），仍取得最高的端到端加速（最高 2.17× E2E speedup on Wan2.1），质量指标 VBench-Q 与 CLIP-T 与密集生成及其他基线相当或仅有轻微下降；消融实验表明 Early Signature 提升文本-视频对齐，联合潜在-注意力复用提供互补加速（1.71× speedup）。

Conclusion: Carnator 证明了跨请求冗余可作为视频生成加速的互补维度，通过生成原生兼容性证据统一解决复用有效性与复用范围问题。严格的复用筛选非但不会降低加速收益，反而使每个被接受的复用更具价值（每接受的次缓存命中率带来 0.50× speedup vs 基线 0.30×）。

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers produce high-quality videos, yet iterative denoising incurs substantial inference latency, limiting interactive and large-scale serving. Most existing acceleration methods focus on individual requests, thereby restricting efficiency gains to redundancy within a single generation trajectory. Recent cross-request reuse offers an additional source of savings, but existing approaches often infer reusability from coarse semantic similarity. This conflates semantic relatedness with generation-level computational compatibility, so aggressive reuse may accept incompatible historical computation while conservative reuse leaves substantial acceleration unrealized. We present \emph{Carnator}, a cross-request acceleration framework that addresses this challenge by extracting and using generation-native compatibility evidence directly from the model's evolving internal states. Specifically, \emph{Carnator} performs a lightweight early probe to construct an Early Signature from internal diffusion states, assessing reuse validity through risk-aware compatibility decisions. The same evidence characterizes reuse scope by localizing target-specific computation and guiding joint reuse of historical latent trajectories and sparse attention connectivity. Across three text-to-video backbones, Carnator consistently achieves higher cache-hit end-to-end acceleration than the evaluated cross-request baselines despite more selective cache acceptance, reaching up to 2.17$\times$ speedup while maintaining competitive generation quality.

</details>


### [327] [MergeHEIR: Mitigating Multimodal Hallucinations as the Tax of Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32422)
*Jinyu Li,Hao Fang,Zhiming Zhang,Jiawei Kong,Bin Chen,Shu-Tao Xia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现多模态大语言模型(MLLM)在模型合并后会系统性产生更多幻觉(称为"合并税"),并提出MergeHEIR框架,通过对合并后模型在专家任务激活的零空间中周期性投影累积参数更新,在缓解幻觉的同时保留继承的专家能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型合并能将多个任务专精模型整合为单一部署模型,但作者发现合并后的多模态大模型会产生系统性的幻觉增加现象(合并税),且现有的幻觉缓解方法在合并后模型上应用时会破坏继承的专家能力,产生幻觉缓解与能力保留之间的矛盾。

Method: 1. 问题形式化:将合并后适应定义为在专家能力保留约束下最小化幻觉损失的双目标优化问题;2. 幻觉导向偏好优化:结合mDPO、图像扰动项(OPA-DPO风格)和锚定项构建复合偏好损失;3. 专家任务零空间投影:利用小规模校准集在合并模型上收集任务激活,通过SVD构建分层零空间投影矩阵,周期性将累积参数更新投影到零空间;4. 理论分析:证明最小失真、最大维度、阈值控制的适应-保留权衡以及向校准外数据的推广保证。

Result: 在3种MLLM配置(Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B、InternVL3.5-8B)和8种模型合并方法上进行24组配对比较,MergeHEIR在所有对比中一致降低AMBER HalRate、CHAIR等幻觉指标,同时Expert Avg几乎不变(Qwen2.5-VL-7B仅降0.28,InternVL3.5-8B仅降0.31);消融实验显示,去除零空间投影会使Expert Avg分别下降1.64和1.34点,而幻觉缓解效果相当;阈值α分析表明α=5×10⁻⁴为平衡两者的最佳默认值;该框架还能作为插件式模块兼容RLAIF-V和OPA-DPO等替代偏好优化方法。

Conclusion: MergeHEIR通过将激活导出的零空间投影与幻觉导向偏好优化相结合,有效缓解了多模态模型合并引入的系统性幻觉税,同时在理论上和实验上证明了其能够在最小化更新失真的前提下保留继承的专家能力,为可靠的模型合并后适应提供了兼顾幻觉缓解与能力保留的更优解决方案。

Abstract: Model merging consolidates task-specialized experts into a single deployable model. However, we show that such capability consolidation incurs a merging tax of increased hallucination: across 8 model-merging methods, every merged checkpoint exhibits a higher hallucination rate than the average of its constituent experts. An intuitive approach is to adapt existing hallucination-mitigation methods to the post-merge model, yet this unconstrained adaptation disrupts inherited capabilities, creating a tension between hallucination mitigation and expertise retention. To tackle this challenge, we introduce MergeHEIR, a post-merge adaptation framework designed to reduce this merging tax while preserving expertise inherited from initial experts. Using small expert-task calibration sets, MergeHEIR constructs layer-wise null-space projectors via SVD from task-specific activations collected from the merged checkpoint, and periodically projects the accumulated post-merge displacement onto the resulting null spaces to preserve inherited expertise.
