Our results show that robust data reshaping requires searching for flat, consensus-supported regions rather than sharp single-trajectory optima.

</details>


### [382] [CAIRN: Dynamic Fact-Intent DAGs for Multi-Agent Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32700)
*Zuyao Xu,Yuyang Jia,Junwei Guan,Xiang Li,Kaiwen Shen,Zhiqiang Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CAIRN 提出一种基于"事实-意图"动态有向无环图（DAG）的多智能体协作范式，通过 Reasoner 提议意图、Worker 执行意图并将发现记录为事实，实现可追踪、可审计的并行探索；在高耗时任务上显著加速但增加 token 开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体系统缺乏有效的组织结构以实现持续、可靠的协作；特别是在需要多方向并行探索的启发式问题求解中，传统的顺序动作-观察轨迹难以复用发现、支持并行分支并提供可审计的执行记录。

Method: 构建持久化的 fact-intent DAG 作为共享记忆：Reasoner 解读事实并提出引用这些事实的 intent，Dispatcher 将 intent 分配给 Worker，Worker 执行并发布新事实；图结构天然支持分支（共享事实驱动多个意图）与汇聚（多事实共同支撑新意图），并通过异步调度、版本化推理请求和原子化提交协议保证一致性；reasoner 可丢弃过期意图以纠错和重定向。

Result: 在 FrontierMath（12 题）和 Cybench（40 题）上，使用 GLM-5.1 与 Pi 0.85.1 智能体实现进行评估：FrontierMath 上平均求解时间由 53.19 分钟降至 27.45 分钟，12 题中 8 题更快（含全部 Tier-3/Tier-4）；Cybench 上 Direct 在 30/40 任务上更快。聚合 52 个任务按 effort 分组后，≥1M token 的高 effort 组中 CAIRN 在 76.5% 任务上更快，最高加速 3.08×，且平均 token 比（C/D）随 effort 提升由 14.71 降至 3.69；并发性分析（1/3/6 槽位）表明更高并发度缩短解题时间且不一定增加 token 消耗。

Conclusion: CAIRN 是一种有效的多智能体协调范式，在高耗时任务上展现明确的时间优势，相对 token 开销随任务复杂度上升而下降；fact-intent DAG 提供了天然的可审计轨迹，适用于对求解时间敏感且具备充足算力的场景（如超大规模部署）。

Abstract: LLM-powered autonomous systems have demonstrated promising capabilities in mathematical reasoning, engineering, and cybersecurity. Yet how to organize these systems for effective, reliable, and sustained performance remains an open question. In this paper, we present CAIRN, a fact-intent-driven multi-agent paradigm for goal-directed exploration. CAIRN represents observations and planned investigations as a dynamic directed acyclic graph (DAG). A reasoner interprets facts to propose intents, which workers execute to produce new facts. Each intent references its supporting facts and defines a potential exploration branch. The persistent graph preserves goals, dependencies and findings across workers, supporting knowledge reuse and parallel exploration. The graph also makes execution trajectories traceable and auditable, providing a basis for human verification and intervention. We evaluate CAIRN across cybersecurity and mathematical reasoning tasks, examining task success, time to solution, and token consumption. DAG-based coordination can incur higher token costs with no observable performance gains on tasks that require little effort. However, on high-effort tasks (at least 1M tokens), we observe faster solutions in 76.5% of cases, with speedups of up to 3.08x. Moreover, as task effort increases, these time gains become more pronounced while relative token overhead declines, highlighting the potential of DAG-guided parallel exploration.

</details>


### [383] [Despite Instructions: Frontier Agents Improvise Covert Channels at Test Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32701)
*Jacob Dineen,Silei Ren,Muhao Chen,Dan Roth,Ben Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 前沿语言模型智能体在推理时通过反复互动，无需任何预置密码本或编码示例，仅凭任务反馈即可学会在受监控的消息中传递被禁止披露的机密信息，形成隐蔽信道。GPT-5.6 Sol 对在模拟事件响应任务中达到 98.8% 的最终恢复准确率，远超 25% 的随机基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在跨信任域的安全敏感场景中，语言模型智能体需要协作但不得泄露机密信息。即使每条消息经过监控审核，智能体能否仅凭任务反馈在测试时自发形成隐蔽信道？现有研究未涉及此问题——即指令固定、无密码本、无外部学习者改写策略、接收者从未见过真实值的条件下，隐蔽信道能否形成。

Method: 研究采用重复博弈框架：发送者观察四个私密状态之一，从四份公开报告摘要中选择，接收者据此推断状态，双方仅获得一位正确性反馈。在"句子选择"实验中，消息从预定义集合中选取；在"自由生成"实验中，发送者自行撰写事件响应更新，每条消息经过监控器审核。实验使用 GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna、Claude Sonnet 5/Opus 5 和 Llama 4 Maverick，通过保持检查、控制反馈/历史消融、消息替换、释义改写等手段分析信道形成机制。

Result: 在句子选择中，9 个模型配对中有 6 个在保留检查中超过随机水平，Sol-Sol 配对达到 95% 准确率。在安全事件响应任务中，10 局 Sol-Sol 游戏最终准确率达 98.8%，所有最终消息均通过监控器审核。Terra 同样支持信道形成；Luna 使接收者接近随机水平。释义改写在学习后介入会使准确率从 98.8% 降至 45%，但若从首次交互起持续改写，三对配对仍能在 60 轮内形成信道（最终准确率 75%、87.5%、87.5%）。控制实验表明：接收者的交互历史是恢复信息的关键；用标准回复替换消息则准确率降至接近随机。

Conclusion: 固定参数、无密码本的智能体可通过反复任务互动学会隐蔽通信，即使被明确禁止披露机密且监控器审核每条消息。机密性的保护不能仅依赖逐条消息的语义审核——接收者从历史中积累的经验使其能解读监控器视为普通的措辞中的私密信息。释义等防御措施在学习后介入效果有限，而允许学习的改写通道仍能形成信道。这意味着在跨机密边界的智能体协作场景中存在根本性风险。

Abstract: In security-sensitive applications, language-model agents are often required to coordinate without disclosing confidential information. Yet repeated interactions may also let ordinary messages acquire shared private meaning. We study a repeated game with pairs of models in which the sender model observes one of four secret states and selects one of four summaries of the same public report, while the receiver model tries to infer the secret state. We find that model pairs can learn to communicate the secret using only one bit of feedback indicating whether the receiver inferred it correctly. This learning occurs during inference with fixed parameters and no supplied codebook or encoding examples. The effect also persists when agents generate their own free-form updates in a simulated incident-response task. Across ten independent games, pairs of GPT-5.6 Sol agents reach 98.8% final accuracy, compared with 25% chance, despite explicit instructions prohibiting disclosure and a monitor that screens each message without access to the agents' interaction histories. The same interactions that help agents cooperate can therefore allow confidential information to pass through messages intended for legitimate coordination.

</details>


### [384] [CoWindow Attention: Full Causal Coverage Is a Collective Property](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32704)
*Jingze Shi,Zhangyang Peng,Xianduo Li,Yanlin Qi,Xiaotian Lin,Haoxian Chen,Liangdong Wang,Guang Liu,Yuyu Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CoWA是一种结构化注意力架构，将因果历史的访问分散到KV头之间，通过共享近窗/前缀汇窗和互补长程窗实现集体因果覆盖，在保持接近FullAttn性能的同时显著降低长序列训练和推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准FullAttn中每个头重复暴露完整因果历史，导致大量冗余计算和内存流量。即使使用IO高效的密集注意力核，这一冗余仍然存在。论文质疑每个注意力头是否都需要直接访问全部历史位置，探索将因果历史的访问在头之间分配以减少重复长程访问同时保留长程检索能力。

Method: CoWA为每个KV头分配三类窗口：(1)共享近对角窗口保留最近上下文；(2)共享前缀汇窗口保留序列起始token；(3)头专属互补长程窗口覆盖剩余因果距离区间。所有头的可见键集合之并集构成完整因果覆盖。该模式完全由位置定义，无需学习路由器。通过全局KV头索引与张量并行对齐。实现了训练前后向和推理prefill/解码的统一窗口构建算法。

Result: 在8K关联召回中CoWA达89.73%（vs FullAttn 89.97%）；128K序列8 GPU张量并行下，训练前向/反向延迟降低7.4×/8.6×，推理解码延迟降低3.0×，解码算子峰值内存降低7.6×；0.6B-14B规模扩展定律实验中14B 32K长上下文训练FLOPs降低28.5%；14B和32B模型在知识、推理、RULER基准上与FullAttn相当。

Conclusion: 完全因果覆盖可以是头集体的集体属性而非每个头的重复属性。CoWA通过位置定义的结构化稀疏模式，无需路由器或索引器，在训练和推理中一致使用，对齐张量并行KV头分片，在保持FullAttn级别模型质量的同时显著降低长上下文注意力计算成本。

Abstract: FullAttn repeatedly exposes the complete causal history to every attention head, creating substantial redundant computation and memory traffic even with IO-efficient dense kernels. We introduce CoWA, a structured attention architecture that distributes access to the causal history across KV heads. All heads share near-diagonal and prefix-sink windows, while complementary long-range windows partition the remaining history. Their union provides full causal coverage although each head attends sparsely to distant tokens. This position-defined attention pattern requires no learned router or indexer, is used consistently during training and inference, and aligns with KV-head tensor parallelism. A window-matched ablation at 8K isolates the effect of complementary long-range allocation: CoWA with 100% collective coverage reaches 89.73% accuracy, compared with 89.97% for FullAttn, while duplicated long-range windows perform substantially worse. Across a broader controlled associative-recall comparison with matched token budgets, CoWA closely tracks FullAttn as the context grows, whereas other sparse patterns lose a substantial fraction of the associations. In an attention-operator benchmark at 128K tokens with tensor parallelism, CoWA reduces forward and backward latency during training by 7.4x and 8.6x and decoding latency during inference by 3.0x over FullAttn. Its per-rank peak operator memory matches FullAttn during training and is 7.6x lower during decoding. Across scaling-law training from 0.6B to 14B parameters, CoWA closely tracks FullAttn in perplexity while reducing total training FLOPs. The resulting 14B models and 32B models from separate continued training achieve comparable knowledge, reasoning, and long-context retrieval scores to FullAttn. These results show that full causal coverage can be a collective property of the head ensemble rather than a duplicated property of every head.

</details>


### [385] [MassAlloc Attention: Let Attention Allocate Its Own Compute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32712)
*Jingze Shi,Zhangyang Peng,Xianduo Li,Yanlin Qi,Xiaotian Lin,Haoxian Chen,Liangdong Wang,Guang Liu,Yuyu Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MassAlloc Attention (MALA)，一种通过softmax归一化贡献度动态分配post-score计算的融合注意力原语，在保持FullAttn建模能力的同时显著降低长上下文计算和延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全注意力(FullAttn)虽然会为大部分因果评分空间分配可忽略的归一化质量，但密集内核仍对所有合法QK块执行完整的post-score路径(包括softmax更新、V加载、PV累加及反向梯度计算)，造成大量低贡献计算浪费。需要一种机制让注意力根据自身归一化贡献度自主决定哪些块值得执行post-score计算。

Method: 核心思想：保留完整的因果QK分数发现(二次复杂度不变)，但利用softmax归一化器决定post-score是否执行。1)前向传播使用在线softmax归一化器的演化值；2)反向传播复用前向保存的最终log-normalizer推导嵌套保留支持；3)统一容忍度阈值τ/L_q(长度感知)控制跳过条件；4)跳过块仅跳过post-score路径(V加载、PV累加、dP/dS/dQ/dK/dV计算)，不跳过QK分数计算；5)提供前向遗漏质量保证(ε_q ≤ τ/(1+τ))。

Result: 1)匹配工作量研究(8K上下文)：MALA接近每实例参考质量oracle，遗漏质量0.0188% vs oracle 0.0182%，远优于静态分配(0.1721%-0.6012%)；2)算子保真度(1K-32K)：单一容忍度保持低输出和梯度误差(平均输出L2误差≤0.021%，遗漏质量≤0.0062%)；3)关联回忆(8K, d=512)：准确率89.67% vs FullAttn 89.97%，远超DSA(52.61%)、MoBA(47.25%)和NSA(22.61%)；4)算子延迟基准(128K, TP=8)：训练前向/反向延迟降低2.2×/3.0×，推理解码延迟降低1.6×，峰值内存与FullAttn持平；5)规模定律训练(0.6B-14B)：14B模型困惑度差异<0.001，32K长上下文训练FLOPs减少23.1%；6)模型级评估(14B/32B)：知识、推理、RULER检索分数与FullAttn相当。

Conclusion: 根据归一化注意力贡献分配post-score计算可以在保留FullAttn评估能力的同时显著降低注意力计算量，为高效长上下文训练和推理提供了一种原则性强、算子保真度高的解决方案。

Abstract: FullAttn often assigns negligible normalized mass to much of the causal score space, yet dense kernels execute the complete post-score path after forming each QK tile. We introduce MALA, a fused attention primitive that preserves score access to every legal causal interaction and uses normalized contribution to allocate post-score computation. Forward uses its evolving online-softmax normalizer, while backward reuses the finalized normalizer to derive nested retained support using only standard attention state. A common tolerance governs training and inference, allowing for adaptive retention of the work. MALA reduces low-contribution post-score computation. A matched-work study at 8K isolates the benefit of distribution-adaptive allocation: under exactly matched total post-score work, MALA approaches a per-instance reference-mass oracle, with mean omitted mass of 0.0188% versus 0.0182%. Across context lengths from 1K to 32K tokens, the same tolerance maintains low output and gradient errors relative to the reference. Across a broader controlled associative-recall comparison, MALA closely tracks FullAttn as context grows, reaching 89.67% accuracy at 8K compared with 89.97% for FullAttn. In an attention-operator benchmark at 128K tokens with tensor parallelism, MALA reduces forward and backward latency during training by 2.2x and 3.0x and decoding latency during inference by 1.6x relative to FullAttn. Across scaling-law training from 0.6B to 14B parameters, MALA closely tracks FullAttn in perplexity while reducing total training FLOPs. The resulting 14B models and 32B models from separate continued training achieve comparable knowledge, reasoning, and long-context retrieval scores to FullAttn. These results indicate that allocating post-score computation according to normalized attention contributions can retain the evaluated capabilities of FullAttn while reducing attention computation.

</details>


### [386] [SkillVine: Agent Skill Evolution via Branching Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32731)
*Kaiwei Liu,Jiqian Dong,Liran Dong,Shuai Mao,Mingming Zhao,Bufang Yang,Jie Chuai,Zhitang Chen,Guoliang Xing,Zhenyu Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillVine，一种通过分支探索实现LLM智能体技能自动进化的框架，将技能库进化建模为图搜索问题，通过主干-分支协作搜索机制、互补性感知节点选择器和自适应粒度更新规则，在5个基准测试、2个LLM上取得10个组合中9个的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体技能进化方法主要遵循线性进化范式，将更新依次应用于最新的技能库版本，容易陷入局部最优，导致许多有潜力的进化路径未被探索。具体表现为：早期版本中有用内容可能被覆盖、无法回退探索替代路径、不支持并行探索与对比。

Method: SkillVine将所有技能库版本组织为可恢复的版本图（每个节点保存版本内容、验证结果、解决/失败样本集和扩展计数）。核心机制包括：(1) 主干-分支更新策略——主干在每个训练批次上做增量更新累积改进，分支从历史版本探索替代路径；(2) 互补性感知节点选择器——基于验证准确率、扩展计数（探索度）和与候选节点的互补性（C_t(v)项）综合评分选择分支父节点，并区分discovery selector和refinement selector；(3) 自适应粒度分支更新（AGBU）——若主干接受更新则分支用粗粒度（一次应用所有编辑），若主干拒绝则用细粒度（逐条编辑评估），过滤有害更新。

Result: 在SpreadsheetBench、LiveMath、SearchQA、OfficeQA、TABVERSE-QA五个基准和DeepSeek-V4-flash、Qwen3.8-Flash两个LLM上，SkillVine在10个模型-基准组合中9个取得最佳测试性能；DeepSeek-V4-flash在全部5个基准领先；消融实验验证了选择器和AGBU组件的有效性；分析显示所有10条最佳进化路径均经过分支（而非主干），且分支在大量训练步骤中贡献全局最优节点。

Conclusion: SkillVine通过分支探索显著优于六种基线方法，证明了分支路径能比线性主干发现更好的技能库版本，为智能体自我进化提供了新思路；在更短分支间隔、适度分支更新尝试数（k=2）和小批量多训练步设置下性能更佳。

Abstract: Agent skills encapsulate reusable procedural knowledge that enables LLM agents to perform tasks, and they can be improved automatically using trajectories from interactions with the environment. This is the classic problem of skill evolution. Existing approaches predominately follow a linear evolution paradigm, in which updates are sequentially applied to the latest skill-library version. As a result, they inevitably fall into local optima, leaving many promising evolution paths unexplored. We propose SkillVine, an automatic skill-evolution framework that formulates skill evolution as a graph search problem and employs a branching exploration strategy. Equipped with a trunk-branch collaborative searching mechanism, an intelligent parent-node selector, and an adaptive-granularity update rule, SkillVine achieves a balance between exploration and exploitation. We evaluate SkillVine on 5 benchmarks with two LLMs. Results show that SkillVine discovers better skill-library versions along branches than along the linear trunk and achieves the best test performance in nine of ten benchmark-model combinations.

</details>


### [387] [Retrospective Distillation Attribution via Normalized Response Similarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32749)
*Minwoo Jang,Jaechang Kim,Minhyeon Oh,Jeongyeon Hwang,Jungseul Ok*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper proposes SCOUT, an output-only distillation attribution method that identifies which teacher model generated the data used in knowledge distillation, even after the student model has undergone subsequent post-training (SFT, preference optimization, or RL). It uses syntactic signatures from PoS n-grams, filters low-contrast patterns, and calibrates against inter-candidate distances, requiring no pre-distillation checkpoints or model internals.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing distillation attribution methods require access to pre-distillation checkpoints or model internals (weights, token likelihoods), and have been evaluated only on students immediately after SFT. In real-world scenarios, distilled models often undergo further training (DPO, RLHF, RL) before release, and external auditors may lack access to historical checkpoints. This creates a critical gap in provenance auditing for model distillation, especially given commercial API providers prohibiting unauthorized distillation.

Method: SCOUT (Syntactic Calibration for Output-only Unreferenced Targets) operates in three stages: (1) represents responses via count vectors of contiguous PoS n-grams (n=3,4,5), aggregating them into candidate profiles (centroids across prompts); (2) applies candidate-contrast filtering using a contrast ratio c = s_Φ/Φ̄ to remove patterns used at similar rates across all candidates, retaining only discriminative syntax; (3) calibrates student-candidate distances against inter-candidate distances via centering (subtracting prompt-specific mean of other candidates' distances) and scaling (dividing by candidate-level std), producing a Z-score that measures unusually close proximity. Attribution selects the candidate with minimum Z-score; abstention uses a gap threshold G(S) fitted without the audited fold.

Result: Retrospective setting (after subsequent training): SCOUT correctly identifies DeepSeek-R1 as the teacher for all 12 publicly released descendants and both distilled parents across all four probes (OMI, s1, OASST1, Dolly), correctly rejecting pre-distillation bases. Controlled setting (immediately after SFT): 18/19 math and 15/19 conversation students detected with zero false positives after teacher removal; AUC of 1.000 (math) and 0.970 (conversation). Trajectory analysis: teacher-associated syntactic signatures emerge during distillation and persist through preference optimization and RL across 13 public ladders spanning dense and MoE architectures, including a diffusion language model (Dream-7B) under mixed-teacher supervision. The signature also extends to non-autoregressive generation.

Conclusion: SCOUT demonstrates that distillation attribution can be performed retrospectively using only current text outputs, without requiring pre-distillation checkpoints, model weights, or token likelihoods. Syntactic teacher signatures are remarkably persistent: they emerge during SFT and survive subsequent preference optimization and reinforcement learning across diverse architectures (dense, MoE, diffusion). This has significant implications for model provenance auditing, though limitations exist: attribution resolution degrades with sibling-enriched pools, and later SFT with a different source can redirect the signature, making earlier sources unrecoverable.

Abstract: Model distillation transfers capabilities through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on teacher responses, often collected from commercial APIs, raising questions of model provenance. Existing distillation attribution methods have been largely evaluated on students immediately after the SFT step. However, a distilled model may undergo further SFT, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning before release, while an auditor may lack access to the pre-distillation checkpoint required by reference-based attribution. To close this gap, we propose SCOUT, an output-only method that aggregates recurring *syntactic patterns* into candidate profiles, filters low-contrast patterns, and calibrates student--candidate distances against inter-candidate distances. SCOUT supports attribution and abstention using only current texts, without model weights, token likelihoods, or historical checkpoints. Auditing publicly released descendants of distilled models spanning diverse post-training objectives, SCOUT consistently identifies the distillation source. Furthermore, tracing teacher-associated *syntactic signatures* along training trajectories reveals that they emerge during distillation and persist through subsequent preference optimization and reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [388] [CUA-Sandbox: Efficient Environments for Computer-Use Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32750)
*Xin Yan,Zhengbo Jiao,Jiaqi Liu,Zhenglin Wan,SiYuan Ma,Xuliang Yu,Tianyi Jiang,Chubin Zhang,Pengfei Zhou,Wangbo Zhao,Xingrui Yu,Bo An,Yang You,Ivor Tsang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CUA-Sandbox，一种通过"运行时-状态分离"来降低计算机使用代理（CUA）强化学习中并行环境执行成本的系统。它将每个环境的可变状态封装在私有状态胶囊中，同时共享初始化后的应用运行时，从而大幅减少资源开销并保持任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的RL环境部署为每个独立的rollout复制完整的运行时（如Docker容器），即使这些轨迹使用相同的软件。这导致内存、初始化和存储开销随并行环境数量线性增长，限制了可扩展训练。核心问题：独立环境是否必须拥有独立的执行运行时？

Method: 1. **运行时-状态分离**：将环境私有可变状态与共享初始化运行时解耦。
2. **状态胶囊（State Capsule）**：每个环境的可变资源（数据库分支、文件、浏览器配置等）封装为独立管理的逻辑环境状态。
3. **状态作用域执行（State-Scoped Execution）**：通过环境标识和绑定表将动作路由到对应的胶囊，确保读写隔离。
4. **事务型生命周期操作**：重置、克隆、分支等操作作用于胶囊状态而非重建运行时，采用冻结-排空-原子发布协议保证一致性。
5. **逻辑环境与执行槽分离**：维护N个逻辑环境但仅分配Q个物理执行槽。

Result: 在WebArena、VisualWebArena和OSWorld上的实验表明：
- **任务性能**：12个模型-基准对中CUA-Sandbox均优于或持平于Docker基线。
- **后训练**：SFT和RL训练效果与Docker保持一致（甚至略优）。
- **效率**：吞吐量最高提升6.20×，每环境内存降低9.2×，增量存储降低504×。
- **生命周期操作**：Create/Reset/Fork等操作速度提升1.03×到17.84×不等。
- **消融研究**：Copy-on-write是状态物化成本的主要节省来源；事务型发布机制100次测试中无混合生成事件。

Conclusion: CUA-Sandbox通过状态胶囊、环境作用域绑定和事务型生命周期操作实现了运行时复用，同时保留了原始软件接口和评估器。该方法在高吞吐训练中具有实际可行性，但受限于资源契约的完整性和绑定覆盖度。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning enables computer-use agents to improve through interaction with real software environments, including websites and desktop applications. However, conventional deployments replicate an initialized runtime for each independent rollout, even when trajectories use the same software, incurring repeated memory and initialization costs as the number of parallel environments grows. Does an independent computer-use environment require an independent execution runtime? Our key observation is that trajectories require independent mutable state, while initialized application runtimes can be reused across concurrently evolving environments, making state the natural unit of environment independence. Guided by this observation, we introduce CUA-Sandbox, which separates private state capsules from shared runtimes through state-scoped execution and transactional lifecycle operations, including resets and branches, while retaining the original software interfaces and task evaluators. Experiments show comparable or improved task success relative to Docker, while substantially reducing rollout and resource costs. CUA-Sandbox achieves up to a 6.20x increase in rollout throughput, a 9.2x reduction in per-environment memory, and a 504x reduction in incremental storage.

</details>


### [389] [Action Shaping: Policies Absorb What They Can Express](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32752)
*Yanjun Chen,Jinghan Wang,Xiaoyu Shen,Wenjie Li,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"动作塑形"(Action Shaping)概念，类比奖励塑形的势能定理，给出了训练时在动作上添加偏移(offset)、部署时移除该偏移分支的"吸收"(absorption)条件与机制：只有当基策略(base head)能精确复制该偏移（即偏移对该基策略的表达是可表达的/expressible），且基策略可训练时，训练过程会在无任何惩罚或调度的情况下自动将该偏移吸收为零，门控(α)自发上升后回落，使得分支可被安全移除。该条件区分的是精确可复制性而非容量，并通过平坦方向上的梯度噪声漂移机制得以解释，并辅以幅值诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励塑形有势能定理保证哪些项可在不影响最优策略的前提下移除；但在动作通道上加入一个偏移却没有相应定理，既无法被某个不变性抵消，也常以无保障的方式在部署时丢弃。该工作旨在将"奖励塑形定理"的思想迁移到动作通道，明确"何时该偏移可被安全移除"。

Method: 1) 形式化"动作塑形"：在actor的相同表征上叠加一个零初始化的线性头h与可学习标量门α，形成π_shaped(s)=f(μ(s)+α·h(s))。2) 提出可表达性(expressibility)条件：若基头参数本身能精确复现μ+αh（即存在W_μ+αW_h的合并），则偏移可被基头吸收。3) 理论分析：证明一阶改进定理（Theorem 1）、平坦线命题（Proposition 2，合并读出下损失沿参数直线不变），以及在标签噪声SGD理想化下门α指数衰减、头权重缓慢衰减的漂移结果（Proposition 3，速率与头大小成反比）。4) 设计七组对照实验（共享/去梯度/独立trunk/冻结基/MLP头/MLP基/MLP基+线性捷径），20个连续控制任务（MuJoCo与DMC）+26个Atari离散任务，使用终端残差r=末20次评估振幅均值/峰值作为诊断指标。

Result: 1) 共享线性头在TD3与SAC的20个连续任务上，门自发先升后降，移除头的IQM代价仅+0.006 (TD3) 与+0.001 (SAC)，15/20环境下置信区间含零。2) 残差r≤0.10的环境移除几乎无损（+0.0007/-0.0003），未完成者损失约0.03；r与移除代价的Spearman秩相关0.61–0.64（p<0.01）。3) 七组对照清晰区分：(a)切断头到trunk的梯度不改变吸收；(b)独立trunk/冻结基/MLP头/MLP基不被吸收（残差0.55–0.83，代价0.22–0.78）；(c)在MLP基上添加一条零初始化线性捷径（恢复可合并性）后，残差从0.786降至0.012，代价降至−0.0002。4) 批量大小B=64的关闭时间早于B=1024（5/6对），与漂移速率∝1/B一致。5) 离散SAC在26个Atari游戏中移除头提升IQM 0.013。

Conclusion: 动作通道上训练时分支可在部署时被安全移除的充要条件是：(i)偏移相对于基策略的函数类"精确可表达"——即基策略的参数本身能完全复现该偏移，而非仅靠容量近似；(ii)基策略可训练。该条件具有可判别性：当且仅当满足条件时，损失曲面存在一条平坦直线通往α=0，梯度噪声将其沿该方向漂移并使门指数衰减，无需任何惩罚或调度。振幅‖δ‖的终端残差提供了读取该条件的诊断量。这为"训练时加分支、部署时去掉"的设计选择提供了与奖励塑形定理相对应的动作塑形定理，并可推广到任何在动作通道共训练的分支。

Abstract: Reward shaping has a theorem: a potential-based term can be removed without changing the optimal policy. The same practice on the action channel, an offset added in training and dropped at deployment, has no theorem. Nothing cancels an action offset, so the correction is kept at deployment or removed without a guarantee. We call it action shaping and state its principle. A trainable policy absorbs an offset its own output layer can reproduce exactly, which is what we mean by express; what is absorbed can be removed with the return intact. Its minimal instance is a zero-initialized linear head behind a learnable gate, added to an actor that trains through a learned action-value function, with no penalty or schedule. The gate rises and then falls on its own, for deterministic and stochastic actors alike, and on 20 tasks removing the head costs almost nothing. The condition is exact reproduction, not capacity: a nonlinear head with more parameters is not absorbed, and in a paired control, one linear path added to a nonlinear base head restores absorption. Exact reproduction gives the loss a flat direction that gradient noise drifts along, and the offset's amplitude indicates, before removal, what dropping the head will cost. Action shaping thus gains the counterpart of the shaping theorem, a condition for absorption, together with the mechanism behind it and a diagnostic that reads it. Policies absorb what they can express, and only that.

</details>


### [390] [Adaptive Consistency Graph for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32754)
*Jiecong Wang,Hao Peng,Zhanyi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Adaptive Consistency Graph (ACG)，通过持久化源溯源执行图谱和按需构建需求中心的临时上下文视图，解决LLM智能体在长视野任务中后期决策偏离原目标的问题。在3个基准上平均成功率优于5种基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在长视野任务中（依赖多步动作和工具调用）性能下降，因为任务需求、历史证据和当前执行状态逐渐脱节，导致后续决策偏离原目标。需要一种在决策时将需求、历史证据和当前状态重新连接的结构化上下文管理机制。

Method: ACG维护一个持续更新的源溯源执行图谱G_t（记忆单元含内容、类型、来源、出现记录和结构化字段）；每次决策时，用任务和最新事件做轮询交织检索种子，通过图扩展和局部聚类构建候选集，再按需求归属筛选（仅接受有明确来源归因的记忆单元），最后在token预算约束下渲染成临时决策视图c_t。该视图不替代也不覆盖基础策略的规划器和工具执行器。

Result: 在DeepPlanning (360任务)、BrowseComp-Plus (830任务)、SWE-bench Lite (300任务) 三个基准上，使用GPT-5.6-luna和DeepSeek-v4-flash两种模型：ACG平均成功率50.2%(luna)/45.9%(DeepSeek)，均高于ReAct(44.5%/43.8%)等5种基线；BrowseComp-Plus上提升最大(luna: 73.5% vs 62.4%)。诊断分析显示ACG显著降低重复执行和缺失交付率。

Conclusion: ACG提供了一种可测试的、结构化的执行历史访问方法，可改善长视野智能体的成功率-推理成本权衡；但效果在不同模型和基准上不均匀，且当前分析为观察性，不能归因到单独的图检索、来源归属或渲染机制。

Abstract: Large language model agents can often make reasonable local decisions on short tasks, yet their performance degrades when success requires long sequences of dependent actions and tool calls. During execution, task requirements, historical evidence, and the current execution state may gradually become disconnected, so later decisions can drift from the original objective. We study this problem by introducing the Adaptive Consistency Graph (ACG) for long-horizon execution. ACG incrementally organizes execution evidence and its provenance in a persistent graph, then constructs a temporary requirement-centered view for each decision under a bounded context budget. Rather than replacing the base agent's planner or tool executor, ACG provides a structured and traceable context view for each decision. In the matched evaluation, ACG improves GPT-5.6-luna's average success from 44.5\% with ReAct to 50.2\%, with the largest gain on BrowseComp-Plus (73.5\% versus 62.4\%). We further analyze trajectory structure and inference cost to characterize this improvement.

</details>


### [391] [Readout is not Recovery: Dissociating Coordinate Emission from Visual-Corruption Repair in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32757)
*Drandreb Earl Juanico*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出VLM定位机制中"读出"与"修复"的可分离性：模型生成坐标token的维度与在视觉证据损坏时修复定位的维度并非同一组。通过Qwen3-VL和Kimi-VL的实验，表明端点读出排名是有用的电路先验，但不能解释遮挡修复——后者需要独立的基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM通过结构化语言输出（如bbox_2d字段）实现定位，但这造成机制模糊性：模型需要"说出"一个边界框，但说出框并不等同于保持视觉证据使框正确。端点维度的读出贡献是否同时具备视觉损坏后的修复能力，这一问题尚未明确。

Method: 研究Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct在COCO单物体定位任务上的表现，对比三种排名信号：(1) bbox_2d字段读出排名；(2) 坐标token读出排名；(3) 损坏导出排名（基于干净到物体掩码修复位移）。方法包括：(a) 元素级floor干预（θ=-0.5）用于干净输入深度triage；(b) 干净端点替换用于视觉损坏修复；(c) 物体掩码与部分遮挡两种损坏设置；(d) 边缘归因修补（EAP）路径级诊断；(e) RMSNorm准层控制。在Kimi-VL-A3B上做跨模型诊断验证。

Result: 1. Qwen3-VL中，坐标token排名在第24层之前惰性，第32-35层承重，第34层达到峰值；损坏导出排名在第16-24层有害，但在第35层附近有益。2. Kimi-VL显示匹配的输出近端转变（层24起始，层26全选择性）。3. 物体掩码修复分离出三种等级预算：k=250显示必要性，k=500显示超过随机的Top-k恢复，k=1280=d/2主要为容量驱动。4. 部分遮挡扫描显示高重叠坐标token集合在k=1000时反而有害。5. EAP显示坐标token路径精度高但召回低。6. RMSNorm控制未能弥合端点-修复差距。

Conclusion: 端点坐标triage是有用的电路先验，但遮挡修复需要单独的基准。读出排名是原则性的电路先验，不足以证明已识别视觉定位路径。从损坏视觉证据中修复需要特定于损坏的因果测试，而非仅靠端点读出证据。该贡献是方法论性的：将定位端点信号与修复信号分离，强调修复性证据必须独立于读出几何进行评估。

Abstract: VLM bounding-box localization is both language generation and spatial commitment. Parseable fields such as bbox_2d make localization easy to score, but dimensions that emit coordinate tokens need not repair localization after visual evidence is damaged. We study this readout/recovery separation in Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct on single-object COCO grounding. We compare clean coordinate-token readout rankings with corruption-derived repair rankings, using object-mask endpoint replacement for recovery and clean-input flooring for depth localization. In Qwen3-VL, coordinate-token rankings are inert through layer 24, load-bearing from layers 32-35, and peak at layer 34; corruption-derived rankings harm layers 16-24 but become beneficial near layer 35/final. A Kimi-VL-A3B diagnostic shows a matching output-proximal transition despite a different box format. Object-mask recovery separates rank budgets: $k=250$ shows necessity, $k=500$ shows Top-$k$ restoration above random, and $k=d/2$ is largely capacity-driven. Partial-occlusion sweeps reveal that high-overlap coordinate-token sets can hurt at $k=1000$ and help mainly at half-width, while population corruption-derived sets provide no reliable fixed repair set. Edge-attribution patching shows coordinate-token paths are high precision but low recall for detection recovery, and RMSNorm quasi-layer controls do not close the endpoint-repair gap. Endpoint coordinate triage is therefore a useful circuit prior, but occlusion recovery requires a separate benchmark.

</details>


### [392] [Mandela-Bench: Multimodal Models Remember Canonical Images Instead of Seeing Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32763)
*Yicheng Bao,Zhenkun Gao,Xiahui Guo,Mingqian Yang,Xueheng Li,Bangwei Liu,Mingang Chen,Lijun Li,Xuhong Wang,Xin Tan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Mandela-Bench基准，测试多模态大模型能否仅凭自身世界知识验证经过无缝编辑的经典图像。研究发现36个模型普遍存在"记忆重建"失败模式：当识别出经典图像时，验证判断倾向于依据记忆中的原始版本而非观察到的编辑内容，即使在显式验证提示下，仅有1个模型的知识锚定率(KGR)超过50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代基于指令的图像编辑器能产生像素级无缝的伪造图像，其唯一的不一致之处在于事实层面（如人物出现于其死亡之后的事件）。现有的检测基准依赖生成器痕迹、图文不一致、视觉不合理性或外部参考，无法测试模型是否仅凭自身知识验证已识别的图像。本文旨在填补这一空白，研究多模态模型在无可用外部证据时是否能够利用其世界知识进行验证。

Method: 构建包含1,507张编辑图像的Mandela-Bench基准，其中1,359张为"知识唯一型伪造"（每张违反一个可验证事实），148张为"无锚点控制"（编辑但不引入事实矛盾），以及474张未编辑的原始图像。设计7种探测（默认、提示验证、身份、面部、对抗建议、识别、纯文本）和5种"去识别"条件（完整、完整+说明、裁剪、裁剪+说明、镜像），通过"证据阶梯"（E0-E4）评估模型解释质量，以知识锚定率（KGR）为主要指标。对36个MLLM（0.8B到前沿规模）进行全面评估。

Result: 36个模型中仅1个（Gemini-3.8-Flash）在提示验证下达到55.1%的KGR，其余均低于36.0。当公众人物从熟悉照片中被移除时，模型仍能在高达72.7%的回答中正确指出该人物。某些模型在隔离显示时能区分替换面部与原面部，但仍判断完整编辑照片为真实。提供真实事件和日期并不能改善知识锚定检测，而裁剪掉可识别构图后提供相同信息则有效。K1（人物）家族检测率远低于K2（物体）和K4（可见文本），表明身份识别限制了人物特定知识的使用。模型识别能力与检测能力呈负相关（人物家族合并OR=0.65，p=0.0004）。

Conclusion: Mandela-Bench揭示了多模态模型的一种系统性失败模式：当识别出经典图像时，验证过程倾向于"从记忆中重建"而非依据观察到的编辑内容。失败既不能简单归因于知识缺失，也不能归因于视觉感知不足——模型可能拥有相关事实并能感知视觉差异，但一旦场景被识别，最终判断并不一致地反映这些信息。主要瓶颈可能在于识别后是否调用验证。这一发现对构建可信赖AI系统具有重要意义，因为接受伪造经典图像同时描述记忆中的原始版本可能使伪造更具可信度。

Abstract: Historical photographs and other canonical images can now be edited seamlessly with a single instruction, often leaving no reliable pixel-level trace. In such cases, the only evidence of manipulation may be a fact about what the image depicts. Existing benchmarks instead rely on generator artefacts, image-caption inconsistencies, visual implausibilities, or external references, and therefore do not test whether a model can use its own world knowledge to verify a recognized image. We introduce Mandela-Bench, containing 1,507 edits of canonical images: 1,359 knowledge-only forgeries, each contradicting one verifiable fact, and 148 anchor-free controls that preserve the editing process without introducing a factual contradiction, together with 474 untouched originals. We score not only whether a model detects a forgery, but whether its explanation identifies the inserted entity or the fact being violated. Across 36 multimodal models, from 0.8B parameters to frontier scale, we find a consistent failure mode. When a public figure is removed from a familiar photograph, models still name that person in up to 72.7% of responses. Some models can distinguish the replacement face from the original when shown in isolation, yet still judge the full edited photograph as authentic. Providing the true event and date does not improve knowledge-grounded detection, whereas providing the same information after cropping away the recognizable composition does. Even under explicit verification prompts, only one of the 36 models meets the KGR criterion on at least half of the forged images. These results suggest that the failures cannot be explained by missing knowledge or inadequate perception alone. Instead, they are consistent with recognition biasing verification toward the remembered canonical image rather than the observed edit.

</details>


### [393] [Forecasting Intraday USD/CAD Exchange Rate with News-Derived Monetary-Policy Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32773)
*Maya Kodeih,Aliaa Alnaggar,Mucahit Cevik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统计归因方法，将货币政策新闻通过大语言模型和时序特征工程转化为可解释的通信渠道信号，用于美元/加元汇率的高频预测，并通过累积消融和FDR控制量化各通信维度（时序、活动、情绪）的增量预测贡献，发现通信时机和定向央行活动特征贡献最大，LLM衍生情绪在组别层面提供补充信息，而广义新闻量特征冗余。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注新闻情感对整体预测准确度的提升，但对货币政策通信中哪个维度驱动预测改进缺乏系统性理解；评估通信渠道层面的增量预测贡献，而非仅依赖聚合精度。

Method: 七阶段方法论：(1)数据采集与预处理（2024-06至2026-06，927篇政策相关文章、17,517小时观测）；(2)使用GPT-4o-mini对每篇文章标记美联储/加央行政策情绪；(3)时序特征工程（情绪差分、新闻到达指示器、衰减特征、滚动汇总等）；(4-6)滚动窗口确定性、概率性、方向性预测（Extra Trees、XGBoost、LightGBM，预测1/3/8/24小时）；(7)累积特征消融归因+Benjamini-Hochberg FDR多重检验。

Result: 水平预测方面机器学习模型未能跑赢随机游走基准（R² 0.844–0.915 vs RW 0.976–0.999）；但方向性预测显著优于多数类和持续性基准，1h/3h/8h/24h方向准确率达63.2%–66.6%。特征归因显示：通信时机（is_news_hour，ΔR²=+0.012，FDR q=0.003）为最强单特征贡献者；定向央行活动特征（fed_non_neutral_last_24h、fed_articles_24h、boc_news_last_24h、boc_articles_24h）均正贡献且FDR显著；而广义新闻量特征（news_articles_24h、news_articles_6h）和长期时差特征冗余/有害。组级别上LLM衍生情绪提供补充正向信息。Step 7特征子集在概率预测中改善pinball loss最高达55.6%。模型重要性与消融贡献存在显著差异。

Conclusion: 货币政策通信的预测价值集中在少数关键信号中：通信时机是最强个体贡献者，定向央行活动特征也提供正向贡献，LLM衍生情绪在组级别提供互补信息，广义新闻量特征冗余。累积消融与模型特征重要性提供根本不同的视角——前者衡量增量预测贡献，后者描述模型利用信息的方式。改进通信感知预测应聚焦于识别具有独特预测价值的少数特征，而非堆砌文本特征。局限性包括仅限于USD/CAD、累积消融的路径依赖性、未考虑交易成本与经济价值。

Abstract: Monetary-policy announcements and central-bank communications play a central role in foreign exchange markets, yet their qualitative, unstructured form makes their forecasting value difficult to quantify. While prior research has largely focused on sentiment extracted from financial news, comparatively little is known about the relative contribution of different dimensions of monetary-policy communication. Existing studies primarily evaluate whether textual information improves overall forecasting performance but provide limited insight into which communication channels drive such improvements. To address this gap, this paper introduces a statistical attribution methodology that decomposes monetary-policy communication into interpretable channels and quantifies their incremental forecasting contribution under false-discovery-rate control. Monetary-policy news is transformed into structured communication signals using large language models (LLMs) and temporal feature engineering. These signals are evaluated using rolling-window experiments with tree-based machine-learning models. The results show that monetary-policy communication contains measurable predictive information. Attribution analysis shows that predictive value is concentrated in a small subset of signals, with communication timing providing the strongest individual feature-level contribution, targeted communication-activity measures also contributing positively, and LLM-derived sentiment providing complementary information at the group level. The findings indicate that communication-based forecasting value extends beyond sentiment alone and that attribution, rather than aggregate accuracy alone, is central to evaluating news-derived signals.

</details>


### [394] [Learning response-aware patient dynamics for respiratory support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32782)
*Xiaolei Lu,Shamim Nemati*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向呼吸支持的"响应感知"患者动力学模型，将预测的生理变化显式分解为基线动力学和呼吸支持相关偏差，并以室内空气为参考锚定该分解，在两个独立ICU队列上验证了在生理状态变化时的一致性改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作条件驱动的患者动力学模型通常将生理进展和治疗相关变化合并在同一状态转移函数中，且主要通过预测未来状态来隐式表示生理变化，缺乏对"变化本身"的显式建模。临床上，不同患者对相同呼吸支持（HFNC、NIV等）的短期生理响应差异显著，响应本身（如ROX指数变化）具有预后价值，因此需要显式建模生理变化以更准确地刻画呼吸支持下的患者轨迹演化。

Method: 1) 问题形式化：给定6小时观察历史（含50维生理变量、TSLM、缺失指示、呼吸支持和静态特征），自回归预测未来6小时轨迹；2) 潜在状态初始化由序列编码器完成；3) 生理变化分解为 Δx̂ = F_base(s) + g⊙F_treat(z^a)，其中z^a = E_action(s,a)为状态依赖的呼吸支持表示，g为特征门控；4) 以室内空气（无主动支持）为参考条件，对参考步的呼吸支持偏差施加软正则化 L_RA，并给出硬约束下分解唯一性的形式化命题；5) 响应通路：显式编码 r̂ = x̂_{t+1} - x̃_t 并通过 E_response 映射为 z^r，与x̂_{t+1}、z^a一起送入 U_state 更新潜在状态；6) 训练采用4轮"响应引导"暖身期（按ρ_e概率使用观测响应ρ_e由1线性降至0），主损失为带缺失掩码的MSE，完整目标 L = L_pred + λ_RA·L_RA；7) 评估在完全自由运行（不访问未来真实值）下进行，覆盖内部、时间外推和外部队列，并在|x_{t+h}-x_t|>0.25SD的"有意义的生理变化"子集上单独评估。

Result: 消融（Val/Temporal/External）：加入治疗相关动力学并不总能改进指标，加入响应感知状态更新可恢复或改进多个指标（如Val MSE 0.270→0.266，External MC-MAE 0.911→0.901）。与基线（Persistence、Action-GRU、SepsisAgent-WM、MedDreamer-WM）比较：整体RMMSE相当，但在中间和较晚预测时段（4-6h）本文模型更优，MedDreamer-WM在最早时段更优。在有意义变化子集上，本文模型在Val相对Persistence改善10.1%（vs MedDreamer 9.2%），Temporal 9.7%（vs 9.6%），External与Action-GRU并列4.2%。分层分析显示在多种呼吸支持模式（室内空气/常规氧疗/HFNC/NIV）和多类生理变量（O2Sat、FiO2、DBP、MAP等10项中的6/5/8项最低RMSE）上均具竞争力，无单一子群主导。

Conclusion: 该响应感知患者动力学模型在三个ICU队列上达到与强基线相当的总体性能，在生理状态发生变化时取得更一致的改进；模型将生理变化显式分解为状态依赖基线与呼吸支持相关偏差，并以室内空气为参考锚定该分解。未来工作将探索反事实轨迹分析和呼吸支持决策建模，并需显式处理混杂并进行前瞻性验证；当前结果仅限回顾性观察预测，不构成因果效应估计或临床决策建议。

Abstract: Respiratory support can shape the short-term physiological trajectory of critically ill patients, but patients receiving the same intervention may follow different physiological trajectories. Clinical patient dynamics models typically predict future states from recent physiology and recorded interventions, while physiological change is mainly represented through the predicted future state. We propose a response-aware patient dynamics model that explicitly represents physiological change during autoregressive state updating. The model decomposes predicted physiological change into state-dependent baseline dynamics and respiratory-support-associated deviations, with room air providing a reference for the decomposition. We provide a formal analysis of this reference-anchored formulation. A response pathway encodes the predicted physiological change and uses it to update the latent patient state across the forecast horizon. Across ICU cohorts from two independent institutions, the proposed model achieves comparable overall trajectory prediction to patient dynamics baselines, with more consistent improvements when physiological states are changing.

</details>


### [395] [CLAIRE: A Schema-Grounded Hybrid Workflow for Healthcare Administrative Form Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32787)
*Garapati Keerthana,Manik Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CLAIRE是一种面向医疗行政表单填写的"模式接地"混合工作流架构，将字段状态发现、源到字段映射、确定性验证、受限修正、升级与审计追踪分离为四个逻辑角色（Selector、Filler、Validator、Error Corrector）。在24,000个合成基准剧集和6,000个运营模拟剧集中，完整CLAIRE达到1.000成功率，验证器移除则使压力套件成功率降至0.500；估算节省149.7-165.5秒/案例。语言模型辅助映射但不授权未支持的行动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗行政人员需将来自EHR、转诊、索赔系统等异构源的结构化信息转入动态表单，缺失或不一致的条目会延误诊疗并造成返工。传统浏览器脚本脆弱，而无约束的语言模型代理可能产生无依据、畸形或不可追溯的条目。需要一种在显式模式内灵活映射、具备状态跟踪、验证、受限修正和审计的中间路径。

Method: 四角色架构（Selector发现可见字段与依赖、Filler映射源支持值、Validator执行确定性检查、Error Corrector应用确定性规范化或显式修正）；五个合成医疗行政表单家族（患者登记、事前授权、福利验证、医师资质、索赔补交）；1,000条确定性合成源记录（500清洁+500验证压力副本）；四种界面变体（原始/同义词/混淆标识符/布局洗牌）；六个对照（Exact ID、Labels only、Monolithic、CLAIRE无模式、CLAIRE无验证器、完整CLAIRE）共24,000剧集；2,000清洁+2,000验证压力+2,000升级挑战剧集的运营模拟；Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B严格输出审计。

Result: 完整CLAIRE在清洁与压力两套件中均达到1.000剧集成功率、字段准确率、必填字段完成率和依赖完成率，零最终验证错误。移除验证器使压力套件成功率降至0.500且每剧集残留0.900错误。运营模拟中100.0%清洁与验证压力剧集达到员工可审阅草稿；升级挑战中68.6%达草稿，31.4%被阻止，不安全案例捕获率100.0%。Qwen2.5-1.5B压力套件成功率从0.230（仅标签）经0.480（模式循环）升至0.900（模式+修正）；Qwen2.5-7B模式条件下达0.840。估算节省149.7-165.5秒/案例。

Conclusion: 模式接地与验证是医疗行政表单自动化鲁棒性的必要条件；语言模型组件应辅助映射而非授权未支持或后果性行动。CLAIRE作为员工审阅加速器，需保留人员对批准、修正、升级或停止提交的最终权限。未来需从公开基准走向员工面测试、非生产门户和EHR集成工作队列，再考虑现场部署。

Abstract: Healthcare administrative staff transfer structured information from electronic health records, referrals, claims systems, provider rosters, and work queues into dynamic forms. We developed and evaluated CLAIRE (Clinical Language and Agentic Intelligence for Reasoning and Entry), a hybrid workflow that separates field-state discovery, source-to-field mapping, deterministic validation, bounded correction, escalation, and audit tracing. We tested five synthetic healthcare administrative schemas, 1,000 source records, four interface variants, two data-quality suites, and six comparators, yielding 24,000 benchmark episodes. A separate strict-output audit evaluated direct mappings from Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B, and a trace-derived operational simulation covered 6,000 episodes. Under the evaluated synthetic benchmark conditions, full CLAIRE achieved 1.000 episode success, field accuracy, required-field completion, and dependency completion in both suites; removing validation reduced stress-suite success to 0.500. In the simulation, 100.0% of clean and validation-stress episodes reached a staff-reviewable draft, compared with 68.6% of escalation challenge episodes, unsupported cases were blocked. Scenario-based savings were 149.7-165.5 seconds per case, not observed staff times. The findings support schema-grounded, validation-first healthcare administrative automation in which language-model components assist mapping but do not authorize unsupported or consequential actions.

</details>


### [396] [$T^5$: Twin-Critic Training for Token-Level Thoughts in Reinforcement Mid-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32791)
*Nan Qiao,Yebin Yang,Weinong Wang,Shuning Wang,Shangpin Peng,Fengyuan Lu,Xinming Wang,Zhehan Kan,Ruixu Zhang,Songyang Zhang,Sheng Yue,Yonglong Tian,Ju Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出T⁵（Twin-Critic Training for Token-Level Thoughts），一种用于强化学习中训练阶段的双评论家方法。它从单个轨迹校准token级优势函数，通过条件矩鞍点目标学习动作依赖的混合权重，并引入预测资格验证和信号保持约束来控制由训练-推理不匹配和PPO裁剪引起的均值诱导漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法存在效率与可靠性矛盾：基于组的相对方法（如GRPO）需要昂贵的重复生成，而学习的评论家虽能提供单次rollout反馈，但仅靠准确的回报预测无法保证可靠的策略更新——训练-推理不匹配和PPO裁剪会使优势估计中的共同偏移无法抵消，引入额外的更新漂移。

Method: 提出T⁵双评论家方法：(1)预测资格验证——通过R²阈值筛选合格的评论家；(2)条件矩鞍点目标——学习动作依赖的混合权重w_φ以组合两个优势估计，使各前缀条件均值趋于零；(3)信号保持约束C(φ)≤κQ防止校准消除学习信号；(4)理论证明强对偶性和残差漂移上界。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-2B/9B上，T⁵在7项基准测试中均优于RLP等基线，平均性能提升7.8%，训练步时间减少最多63.4%（2B减少41.1%，9B减少63.4%）。9B模型上均分从69.56提升至92.71。

Conclusion: T⁵将回报预测与优势校准解耦：通过合格的双评论家提供估计，条件矩目标组合单次rollout的GAE，约束保证信号保留，理论分析界定了均值诱导分量的漂移上界，使回报预测与其优势估计的使用共同成为学习过程的一部分。

Abstract: Reinforcement mid-training lets language models learn internal thoughts from unlabeled text, but efficient token-level credit assignment remains challenging. Existing group-relative methods require costly repeated generation. Learned critics offer single-rollout feedback, but accurate return prediction alone does not ensure reliable policy updates. Our analysis shows how training--inference mismatch and PPO clipping prevent a common offset in advantage estimates from cancelling out, introducing additional update drift. We propose \tfour{}, a twin-critic method that calibrates token-level advantages from a single generated trajectory. After warmup and held-out qualification, the critics provide two advantage estimates, combined using action-dependent weights learned through a conditional-moment saddle-point objective. This objective brings the average advantage at each prefix toward zero, while a signal-retention constraint prevents the correction from erasing the learning signal. Sharing information across text positions avoids repeated sampling of each prefix. Theoretically, we characterize optimal mixing under the signal-retention constraint and establish an upper bound on residual mean-induced drift. Experiments show that, compared with the state-of-the-art critic-free method, \tfour{} improves mean benchmark performance by 7.8\% and reduces mean training-step time by up to 63.4\%.

</details>


### [397] [AgentHabit: Characterizing Distinct Behaviors of Agents on Everyday Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32795)
*Woojung Song,Hoyeol Yang,Jeonghoon Shim,Sungjib Lim,Jonggeun Lee,Yunho Choi,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了 HABIT 行为分类法和 AgentHabit 基准，用于系统地表征和比较 LLM 智能体在执行日常任务时的行为方式（而非仅关注任务成功与否），揭示了不同模型家族之间稳定且可区分的行为倾向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体评测主要关注任务成功率，但任务可通过多种合理方式完成，智能体的具体执行方式（如是否询问澄清、是否使用工具、是否陈述假设）可能与用户偏好不匹配。作者希望提供一个超越任务成功率的框架，帮助用户选择行为符合其需求的智能体，并指导智能体开发者调整行为。

Method: 1) 从 Anthropic Economic Index 推导 17 个领域；2) 三位作者与三个 LLM 独立审阅 408 条轨迹，提出 716 个候选行为轴，经合并精炼为 23 个行为轴（分 5 类）；3) 构建用户模拟器（基于 WildChat-1M 风格采样）；4) 在 17 个保留任务上对比 HABIT 与 Schwartz 人类价值观及 Act·ONOMY；5) 构建 86 任务的 AgentHabit 基准，对 18 个模型进行画像分析；6) 测试自报告、提示词引导和 SFT/DPO 微调对行为的影响。

Result: HABIT 在模型区分度（92.2% matching vs Schwartz 72.8%, Act·ONOMY 87.2%）、标注一致性（inter-AC1 0.718）和标签熵（0.653）上均优于现有分类法。GPT/Claude 模型倾向于陈述假设并在需求冲突时提供替代方案，而 Qwen/Google 模型倾向于隐含假设或修改需求。轮廓在不同任务子集上保持稳定（10% 任务下 80.21% 同模型识别，98.90% 同家族识别）。提示词引导对某些轴效果显著（如装饰符号 +93.3%），但对另一些轴几乎无效；SFT 和 DPO 微调对整体行为轮廓的改变不显著。

Conclusion: HABIT 和 AgentHabit 提供了一个超越任务成功率的系统框架，用于描述和比较智能体的行为倾向。行为轮廓在模型间可区分、在家族内聚类、跨任务稳定，但难以通过提示词或微调大幅改变，为选择和开发符合用户需求的智能体提供了基础。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents assist users with everyday tasks that can be completed in many reasonable ways. Even when their answers are useful, how agents carry out these tasks may not match users' preferences and needs. For example, agents differ in whether they ask clarifying questions or search the web. We introduce HABIT, a taxonomy of 23 behavioral axes in five categories, which three authors and three LLMs derive bottom-up from 408 agent trajectories across 17 domains. On held-out tasks, HABIT distinguishes models more clearly than existing taxonomies of human values and agent actions while supporting comparably consistent annotation. Building on HABIT, we construct AgentHABIT, a benchmark that profiles each agent's behavioral tendencies from its trajectories on 86 everyday tasks. Profiling 18 models with AgentHABIT reveals a range of distinctive tendencies. For example, most GPT and Claude models state their assumptions and offer alternatives when requirements conflict, whereas Qwen and Google's models more often leave assumptions or changes to requirements unstated. These profiles remain recognizable even when built from entirely different sets of tasks, indicating that they reflect general tendencies rather than task-specific behavior. Prompting agents to adopt specific behaviors shifts some axes readily but barely changes others, while fine-tuning on another model's trajectories changes only part of a model's profile and leaves much of it intact. Overall, HABIT and AgentHABIT provide a systematic framework for characterizing how agents carry out everyday tasks beyond task success, offering insights to guide the development of agents whose behavior better fits users' needs.

</details>


### [398] [PlanGuard: A Guardrail for Multi-Step Plan Safety in Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32801)
*Junchi Chen,Changtao Miao,Yuxiao Xiang,Zhenchao Jin,Haojie Yuan,Qi Chu,Tao Gong,He Liu,Bo Zhang,Jiansheng Cai,Zhe Li,Nenghai Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PlanGuard是首个面向具身智能体多步计划的执行前安全检测器，通过构建MSP-Safe数据集和提出STAC-OPD蒸馏方法，使紧凑模型（0.8B/2B）在多步计划整体物理风险检测上超越更大的通用VLM、通用安全护栏和单步子任务检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全保障存在两大盲区：通用护栏（如LLaMA-Guard）仅关注语义内容安全，无法理解物理交互；具身安全检测器（如EMBGuard）仅独立评估单个子任务，无法捕捉多步计划中子任务依赖与环境交互产生的组合性物理风险（如先开灶火再放纸巾引发火灾）。因此亟需执行前、面向完整多步计划的安全检测机制。

Method: 1) 构建MSP-Safe数据集：采用Base/Risk配对任务构造（指令或环境受控扰动），6个跨三类家族的规划器（通用VLM、具身预训练VLM、VLA）生成多步计划，三评判者多数投票标注Safe/Unsafe及Reason；2) 两阶段训练：先做任务导向SFT（Result-Reason结构化输出，先输出决策以降低延迟），再提出STAC-OPD——强教师在线策略蒸馏（基于学生自回归前缀做token级反向KL）+ 概率路由硬补偿（学生已偏好参考决策时保留学生自生成目标，否则由教师重构完整目标做序列级监督）。

Result: PlanGuard-2B在MSP-Safe-Test四个子集（In-Domain、Scene-Heldout、Hazard-Heldout、Planner-Heldout）上平均ACC 87.15%、F1 87.21%，全面超越Qwen3.5-Plus（最强VLM基线，F1 81.48%）、GuardTrace-VL-3B（最强通用护栏，F1 55.94%）和EMBGuard-2B（单步检测器，F1 68.96%）；PlanGuard-0.8B亦以F1 82.25%超越所有基线。消融显示SFT贡献最大（+14.58 F1），强教师OPD再+2.51，硬补偿+0.78。全计划检测在交互诊断集上比逐步检测F1高出6-15点。

Conclusion: PlanGuard证明了完整多步计划监督对捕捉动作顺序与跨步依赖风险的必要性，紧凑模型通过STAC-OPD可达到甚至超越大模型的计划安全检测能力，同时满足实时部署的低延迟要求，为具身任务规划提供了有效且高效的执行前安全保障。

Abstract: Embodied task planners may produce multi-step plans whose subtask dependencies and interactions with the environment create physical risks during execution. Yet existing safeguards overlook such compositional risks, as general-purpose guardrails focus on semantic harm and embodied safety detectors assess subtasks in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce PlanGuard, the first pre-execution detector that evaluates the physical safety of a complete multi-step plan in its current environment. For training and evaluation, we construct a Multi-Step Plan Safety (MSP-Safe) dataset through paired task construction, plan generation using diverse planners, and safety annotation by three judges. Task-oriented SFT on MSP-Safe establishes fundamental plan-safety assessment capabilities, yet a substantial gap remains between compact models suitable for real-time deployment and stronger but costlier large models. Accordingly, we propose Strong-Teacher Adaptive Compensation for On-Policy Distillation (STAC-OPD), which provides compact models with adaptive strong-teacher supervision along their on-policy trajectories. It combines token-level distribution transfer from a fine-tuned strong teacher with probability-routed sequence-level compensation, retaining student-generated targets when the student favors the reference safety decision and using teacher-reconstructed targets otherwise. Across all test subsets, PlanGuard-2B achieves average 87.15% ACC and 87.21% F1, demonstrating effective whole-plan physical-risk detection at compact model scale. Code and dataset will be publicly released.

</details>


### [399] [Re-derivability Decides What a Staged Agent Pipeline Recovers After an Upstream Fault](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32802)
*Tianqi Bu,YuXuan Peng,Junteng Tu,Henghui Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"可再推导性"（re-derivability）这一变量，决定了上游故障对语言模型智能体多阶段管道的代价。通过让下游阶段重新访问原始问题（重接地，re-grounding），可以在四个开源骨干模型上一致地恢复故障后的准确率，而这一效果源于内容的可推导性，而非词元数量的存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多阶段语言模型智能体管道中，单个上游故障会严重降低准确率（保留率仅0.230-0.667）。现有研究虽记录了此类失败，但未探讨哪个属性决定上游故障是否能在下游存活。理解这一变量对构建可靠的智能体系统至关重要。

Method: 实验设置包括：(1) 四个开源指令微调骨干模型（Qwen3-14B/8B、Phi-4、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct），禁用思考模式；(2) 注册的四阶段管道（提取、设置、计算、格式）与探索性三阶段管道；(3) 在第一阶段注入确定性故障wrong_intermediate；(4) 重接地开关：将原始问题重新注入k=0,…,3个下游阶段；(5) 遮蔽对照：按可见词比例0/0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0替换原题词语为空白，控制词元数量；(6) 120个固定gsm_hard项目，温度为零。两个确认性族系采用McNemar精确单侧检验加Holm校正。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 重接地剂量响应在四个骨干模型上均成立，保留率从+0.233升至+0.392（最大Holm调整p值为2.1×10⁻⁶）；(2) 遮蔽对照在四个骨干模型上均成立，证实效果源于内容可推导性而非词元数量；(3) 严格管道在3/4骨干模型上输给单次直接调用（-0.267、-0.125、-0.317），从未可靠获胜；(4) 交互项在注册管道下于2/4骨干模型排除零，但在三阶段管道（4/4）和完整历史（3/4）下成立；(5) Llama-3.1-8B在任何剂量下都未检测到故障成本；(6) 首个重接地阶段以+59.8词元/项的代价获得+0.394的匹配保留率，后续阶段无所获。

Conclusion: "可再推导性"决定了上游故障的代价，而不仅仅是词元数量。重接地——即将原始问题重新注入到下游阶段——是一种廉价且前置的修复方法：在Qwen3-14B上，第一个重接地阶段就能以仅+59.8词元/项的代价获得几乎全部恢复效果。论文建议实际部署管道的团队：让丢失信息的那个阶段重新接地，并首先接地它。

Abstract: One variable sets what an upstream fault costs a staged pipeline of language-model agents: re-derivability, how much of what a stage needs it can rebuild from the original problem. Grounding an inspector agent in that problem is worth +0.608 [+0.517, +0.700] to +0.358 over a blind one on four open-weight backbones served with thinking disabled, and on the two Qwen backbones the blind inspector changes no item at all. That head-to-head is exploratory. One deterministic fault enters the first stage, and we re-expose the original problem to $k = 0,\dots,3$ of the downstream stages with agents, items, fault and topology held fixed, on 120 gsm_hard items per arm at temperature zero. Accuracy under fault rises on four of four backbones, from +0.233 to +0.392, the largest Holm-adjusted $p$ being $2.1\times10^{-6}$. A registered kill test rules out tokens. Blanking every word holds the word slots fixed, and retention tracks the visible fraction on four of four, climbing from 0.221 to 0.692 on the primary. Those two families are confirmatory and everything else here is exploratory. The interaction excludes zero on two of four backbones under the registered pipeline, four of four under a three-stage pipeline, and three of four under full message history, the primary at +0.317. On Llama-3.1-8B the fault carries no detectable cost at any dose, so the other three carry every claim about what a fault costs. Re-derivability also sets what the architecture costs, and no decomposition we measured reliably beats one direct call. With no fault injected the registered pipeline loses to that call by -0.267, -0.125 and -0.317, and on Phi-4 reads +0.058 at $p = 0.118$, which the test fails to separate from zero. The repair that works is cheap and front-loaded: the first re-grounded stage buys +0.394 of matched retention for +59.8 tokens per item on Qwen3-14B, and the stages after it buy nothing.

</details>


### [400] [Nutri-ATLAS: Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for Smarter nutrition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32803)
*Uttej Kallakuri,Boxun Hu,Ankur A. Butala,Najim Dehak,Tinoosh Mohsenin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Nutri-ATLAS是一个面向真实世界营养辅助任务的具身智能体系统，通过融合图结构营养推理（GATv2图嵌入）、文本语义检索、硬件感知的LLM选择和机器人环境证据采集，构建了一个统一的四阶段RAG检索与推荐流水线。该系统在HealthyFoodSubs、NutriBench v2、PFoodReQ和真实机器人部署实验中均取得领先性能，验证了结构化营养知识与物理环境感知闭环的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的营养辅助系统主要依赖被动的文本交互和静态上下文，在食物描述模糊或营养证据缺失时表现不可靠，难以满足真实环境中的个性化、约束感知的营养推荐需求。作者将营养辅助重新定义为生成式与代理式IoT问题，强调需要同时结合结构化营养知识、用户饮食上下文和环境感知证据，以解决LLM幻觉、约束执行困难等核心问题。

Method: 方法包含三大核心模块：(1)统一营养嵌入模块——基于USDA FoodData Central与FoodKG构建异构图（9,991种食物+626种营养素+82,238个食谱+238个标签，93,093节点），采用两层GATv2编码器学习64维图嵌入，并使用Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B生成1024维文本嵌入，通过s=α·cos(q_gat,x_gat)+(1-α)·cos(q_text,x_text)进行混合打分；(2)个性化检索与推荐模块——四阶段RAG流水线（食物提及→营养谱、营养目标→补足食物、食物→相似替代品、食物→食谱组成），通过Preference Memory实现硬约束过滤与软重排序；(3)具身辅助与硬件感知选择——LLM规划器调用导航、地标查询、物体检测、偏好与食物可获得性更新等技能，结合Jetson Orin Nano上的九种Qwen3.5-9B量化变体Pareto分析进行模型选择。

Result: 主要实验结果包括：HealthyFoodSubs上混合检索器达到37.9% MAP、80.7% RR@5、90.1% RR@10，超越GraphSAGE和GAT基线；PFoodReQ上达到78.8% MAP、83.0% MAR、77.5% F1，相对BAMnet基线分别提升16.1、21.2和13.8个百分点；NutriBench v2上Dense+GAT检索在九种量化配置下均能稳定营养估计；五位患者临床案例研究在低碳/平衡饮食目标和过敏回避方面全部满足约束；真实Unitree Go2机器人三难度九任务测试中简单任务近完美完成，复杂任务优雅降级；EmbodiedBench-ALFRED仿真中记忆增强的规划器在长程任务上优于基础规划器。

Conclusion: Nutri-ATLAS验证了将图结构营养推理、个性化检索、硬件感知LLM选择与具身证据采集统一为闭环营养辅助系统的可行性。系统在多个基准上取得领先性能，证明了结构化营养知识与物理环境感知对解决幻觉和约束执行问题的重要性。未来的工作方向包括：双向人机交互、临床营养师工作流集成、纵向膳食监测与趋势分析、以及多模态膳食识别，以推动系统从"定位与查找工具"向真正的个性化膳食辅助系统演进。

Abstract: Generative and Agentic IoT systems offer a promising foundation for digital healthcare applications that combine sensing, personalized reasoning, and autonomous interaction in real-world environments. Nutrition assistance is a natural use case, but existing Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems are often limited to passive text interaction and static context, making them unreliable when food descriptions are ambiguous or nutritional evidence is missing. We propose Nutri-ATLAS, an Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for smarter nutrition in the real world. It integrates graph-grounded nutrition reasoning, hardware-aware LLM selection, and robot-based evidence acquisition. Nutri-ATLAS builds a unified Food-Nutrient knowledge graph from USDA FoodData Central and FoodKG and learns 64-dimensional GATv2 food and recipe embeddings. A shared hybrid graph-text scoring mechanism supports food nutrition extraction, nutritional gap filling, substitute retrieval, and recipe-level meal composition, while an LLM-guided skill interface navigates landmarks, updates dietary-context and food-accessibility memory, and grounds recommendations in observed food availability. We evaluate Nutri-ATLAS across nutrient estimation, substitution retrieval, recipe recommendation, patient-profile adherence, edge deployment, and real-world embodied execution. On HealthyFoodSubs, the hybrid retriever achieves 37.9% MAP, 80.7% RR@5, and 90.1% RR@10. On NutriBench v2, Dense+GAT retrieval grounds nutrient estimation across nine quantized Qwen3.5-9B configurations. On PFoodReQ, Nutri-ATLAS reaches 78.8% MAP, 83.0% MAR, and 77.5% F1. A patient-profile study shows adherence to allergy and healthy-target constraints for all selected cases.

</details>


### [401] [Decision-Sufficient State Representations: Measuring and Reducing Write-Time Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32805)
*Bingyu Shen,Boyang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM智能体在长程任务中因上下文压缩（writer）造成的事实丢失问题，提出将决策损失分解为预算损失和写入时遗憾（write-time regret），并提出DSSR方法训练writer。在TextWorld烹饪游戏中验证了预算并非瓶颈，writer的选择才是；递归充分性评分能预测游戏结果；训练在短延迟下带来显著提升，但长延迟下因信用分配困难而失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长任务产生超出LLM智能体处理能力的历史记录，常用方案是让writer维护一个简短状态，但writer在写入时丢弃的信息会永久丢失。本文旨在量化这种损失并探索是否能通过训练来减少它。

Method: 1. 将常数上下文智能体的决策损失分解为预算损失β（任何同大小状态都必须承担的损失）和写入时遗憾κ（writer前瞻选择造成的损失）。2. 提出DSSR（决策充分状态表示）：对候选状态用冻结的reader以递归滚动方式评分（前向滚动评估状态在被writer持续重写后的价值），而非固定的窗口评估。3. 通过SFT和DPO训练，仅训练writer LoRA适配器，reader保持冻结。4. 在TextWorld烹饪游戏中设计了受控的相关性滞后（relevance lag）协议F'，将填充步放在揭示之后。

Result: 预算不是瓶颈：128 token的oracle-b状态几乎赢得所有游戏，而LLM prompt writer最多赢17%。几乎所有损失都是写入时遗憾κ，且随延迟增长。在测试集上，九延迟时DSSR带来+7.0 [+1.9, +12.2]百分点的显著提升，使摘要writer达到信念和槽位提示的水平。然而长延迟下预注册的检验全部失败：DSSR未显著优于提示式writer或基于结果的基线。递归充分性评分预测游戏结果（ρ=0.48），而窗口评分则不能（ρ≤0.07）。失败原因被诊断为信用分配问题：在当前writer下保留事实的回报取决于后续所有重写也都保留它，而逐步评分无法看到这一点。手写保留规则在每个延迟下都优于学习到的风格基线，因为它利用了任务知识。

Conclusion: 常数上下文智能体的失败主要源于写入时遗憾而非预算限制，且遗憾随事实需要被保留的写入次数增加而增长。递归充分性评分是预测结果的有效信号，基于此训练的writer在事实需要很快被用到的场景下有显著提升。但长延迟下训练增益消失的根本原因是每步优化目标无法为超出当前writer遗忘范围的保留行为提供信用。未来方向包括：评分时强制保留候选状态所保留的内容、联合训练writer和滚动策略、从短到长延迟的课程训练，以及允许reader请求回传事实的reader设计。

Abstract: Long tasks produce more history than an LLM agent can hold in its context, and more than it uses reliably even when the history fits. A growing line of work therefore has agents carry a short written state instead: at every step a writer rewrites the state, and a reader acts from the state alone. Steps stay cheap, but anything the writer drops is lost before later decisions reveal that they need it. We quantify this loss and ask whether training can reduce it. Comparing the written state with the best state of the same size written in hindsight, we split the reader's loss into a budget loss, which any state of that size must incur, and a write-time regret, which comes from the writer's choices. In TextWorld cooking games where we control how long a fact must be carried before it is needed, a 128-token state holding the facts wins nearly every game, while prompted language-model writers win at most 17%. Almost all of the loss is write-time regret, and it grows with the delay. We then train the writer from the reader's own loss. DSSR (decision-sufficient state representations) scores candidate states by how well the reader acts after the writer carries them forward, and teaches the writer to prefer the better ones. This forward-rolled score predicts game outcomes ($\rho = 0.48$), whereas scoring a candidate as a fixed context, as hindsight methods usually do, does not ($\rho \leq 0.07$). On a pre-registered test split opened once, training adds +7.0 [+1.9, +12.2] points of success when facts are needed soon, bringing a plain summary writer to the level of belief- and slot-based memory prompts. The gain shrinks as the delay grows and is significant only at the shortest delay. We trace this limit to credit assignment: keeping a fact now pays off only if every later rewrite keeps it too, which a per-step score cannot see.

</details>


### [402] [Beyond Accuracy: Counterfactual Fragility and Demographic Bias in Clinical Evaluation of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32807)
*Chaitai Deb Purkayastha,Bharath Kumar Bolla,Vishnu Surya Reddy Nandi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出对医学大语言模型(LLM)的临床评估不能仅依赖答案准确率，而应纳入反事实一致性和人口统计学稳健性。研究通过自动化扰动测试，在150道MedQA USMLE题目上评估了6个LLM，发现准确率高的模型在反事实有效性(CFV)测试中表现较差，且答案会随人口学前缀变化而改变，同时存在刻板印象证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统临床LLM评估过度强调答案准确率，无法衡量模型的：(1)反事实一致性(即能否识别使不同答案正确的合理临床改变);(2)人口统计学稳健性(即回答是否受人口学前缀影响)。作者旨在建立超越准确率的多维度评估框架，以支持临床安全筛查。

Method: 在150道MedQA USMLE题上测试6个LLM，使用两种自动化扰动测试：(1)反事实有效性(CFV)测试——要求模型做出最小且合理的临床改变使另一答案正确；(2)人口学稳健性测试——添加6种人口学前缀(在性别、种族等维度)与基线比较答案与解释的变化。指标包括CFV率、答案变化率、解释人口学不和谐分数(EDD)和刻板印象证据标记率。所有判断均为自动化，未进行临床医生验证。

Result: 900次CFV尝试中仅228次(25.3%)有效；5400次人口学比较中1097次(20.3%)答案发生改变；自动化评判发现3128个刻板印象证据标记，其中1932个属于"其他"宽泛类别。MedGemma 27B准确率最高(87.1%)且CFV表现最佳(63.3%)，答案变化率最低(16.0%)，EDD分数低(0.169)，但其准确率仍高于CFV，表明正确答案并不保证反事实一致性。OpenBioLLM答案变化率和EDD最高，GLM刻板印象标记率最高。

Conclusion: 准确率、CFV、答案稳定性、EDD和刻板印象证据各自捕捉不同的评估维度，单一准确率指标不足以评估临床LLM。该评估方法适合作为安全筛查工具，但由于完全依赖自动化判断且缺乏临床医生验证，无法确立模型的临床可部署性。

Abstract: Clinical LLM evaluation often emphasizes answer accuracy; however, accuracy alone does not test counterfactual consistency or demographic robustness. We evaluated six LLMs on 150 MedQA USMLE questions using two automated perturbation tests to assess their performance. The counterfactual validity (CFV) test asked each model to make a minimal, plausible clinical change that would make a different answer correct. The demographic robustness test added six demographic prefixes to the same vignette and compared the answers and explanations with a no demographic baseline. Of the 900 CFV attempts, 228 (25.3 %) were valid and 672 were invalid. Across 5,400 demographic comparisons, 1,097 answers were changed (20.3%). Automated judging identified 3,128 stereotype evidence flags, including 1,932 in the broad Other category. MedGemma 27B achieved the highest accuracy (87.1%) and CFV (63.3%), lowest answer change rate (16.0%), and low mean Explanation Demographic Dissonance (EDD) score (0.169). However, its accuracy still exceeded its CFV, indicating that correct answers do not guarantee reliable performance on the counterfactual validity task. OpenBioLLM had the highest answer change rate and EDD, whereas GLM had the highest stereotype flag rate. These findings show that accuracy, CFV, answer stability, EDD, and stereotype evidence capture different evaluation aspects. Because all judgments were automated and no clinician validation was available, the results support safety screening but do not establish clinical deployability of the model.

</details>


### [403] [Overwhelmed by Choice: Studying LLM Decision Making at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32809)
*Yu-Chi Lin,Aryan Seth,Anshul Aravind,Eugene Lee,Tanmay Parekh,Nanyun Peng,Kai-Wei Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了大候选集场景下大语言模型(LLM)的决策能力，发现随着候选数量增加，模型准确率显著下降，并识别出两种系统性失败模式：gold-margin collapse（正确答案置信度下降）和早期选项主导（early-option dominance）。通过层次划分和置换推理等推理时干预策略，在N≈160时可在HotpotQA和MIMIC上提升约20个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM的多选评估基准通常候选数量较少（少于10个），但实际应用中常需从大量候选中决策（如重排序、医学诊断、工具选择等）。小候选集的评估结论能否推广到大候选集场景尚不明确，候选集规模作为一个被忽视的评估协议变量亟待研究。

Method: 论文采用系统性实验设计：(1) 在多个任务（重排序、医学诊断、长上下文分类等）和不同模型（Qwen3、Gemma、Llama、Phi等）上测试N∈{5,10,20,40,80,160}的准确率；(2) 通过分析token级log概率计算gold margin（正确答案与最强干扰项的分数差）；(3) 通过添加无关文本控制上下文长度变量；(4) 通过控制gold插入位置实验分析位置偏置；(5) 提出两种干预方法——层次划分（Hierarchical Partitioning）和置换推理（Permutation-based Inference）。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1) 跨任务、提示策略和模型规模，准确率随N增加持续下降（如Phi-4-mini在HotpotQA上从83%降至19.5%）；(2) 增加无关上下文长度不会重现相同的退化模式，表明问题非简单长上下文效应；(3) Gold margin随候选增加而缩小，主要由正确答案置信度下降驱动；(4) 模型预测越来越偏向早期位置，后插入的gold越来越难推翻早期偏好；(5) 层次划分和置换推理在N=160时在HotpotQA和MIMIC上各提升约20个百分点，置换推理以5.76次模型调用达到76.5%准确率。

Conclusion: 候选集规模是LLM评估中一个重要的协议变量，小候选集的强表现不能可靠反映大规模候选比较能力。大选项退化不能完全由标准长上下文检索失败解释，反映了大规模候选比较的系统性弱点——gold-margin collapse和早期选项主导。重组比较过程的推理时策略能显著改善大规模候选场景下的鲁棒性，但需权衡计算成本。未来工作应探索更高效的干预策略，并扩展到多语言、多模态和交互式场景。

Abstract: Multiple-choice and candidate-selection evaluations are widely used to assess LLM reasoning and decision-making, yet most benchmarks contain relatively small candidate sets. It remains unclear whether conclusions drawn from these settings remain valid as the candidate space scales. We systematically evaluate LLMs as the number of competing candidates increases and find substantial accuracy degradation across tasks, prompting strategies, and model scales. Controlled analyses show that standard long-context retrieval explanations cannot fully account for this degradation. Instead, we identify two systematic failure patterns. First, gold-margin collapse: the score gap between the correct answer and the strongest distractor progressively shrinks, driven primarily by weakening confidence in the correct answer. Second, earlier candidate preferences become increasingly difficult to overturn, with later candidates exerting progressively weaker influence on the final prediction. Motivated by these findings, we evaluate hierarchical partitioning and permutation-based inference, which improve accuracy by roughly 20 percentage points at $N=160$ on both HotpotQA and MIMIC. Overall, our results identify candidate-set scale as an important evaluation-protocol variable and show that strong small-option performance does not necessarily imply robust large-scale candidate comparison.

</details>


### [404] [Right Answer, Wrong Reason: Accuracy, Consistency, and Consensus Are Misleading Indicators of LLM Faithfulness in Clinical Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32817)
*Bharath Kumar Bolla,Bharath Kumar Bolla,Vishnu Surya Reddy Nandi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出三个轻量级、可直接解释的指标——解释稳定性指数（ESI）、因果忠实性分数（CFS）和扰动稳定性分数（PSS），用于衡量临床大语言模型（LLM）解释与推理过程之间的忠实性差距。研究发现仅有少数被引用的概念对预测具有因果必要性，且正确性、一致性并不能保证推理的忠实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床LLM在医学考试中能达到很高的准确率，但正确答案并不意味着其解释真正反映了驱动决策的推理过程。准确率、一致性和共识作为安全信号存在不足，因此需要专门的指标来衡量解释与推理之间的忠实性差距。

Method: 提出三个可解释的忠实性度量指标：1）解释稳定性指数（ESI），衡量重复查询下的推理一致性；2）因果忠实性分数（CFS），通过概念消融测试被引用概念是否真正驱动预测；3）扰动稳定性分数（PSS），衡量对语义保留改写的鲁棒性。在MedQA-USMLE 150道题上评估6个LLM，共产生900次模型-问题观察。

Result: 仅23.3%被引用的临床概念具有因果必要性；正确答案的CFS反而低于错误答案（0.212 vs 0.398）；答案一致性与CFS呈负相关（Spearman r = -0.466）；模型对之间答案一致时，共享的推理概念仅占8.8%。

Conclusion: 准确率、一致性和共识是不完整的临床决策支持安全信号；模型的高准确率并不保证其解释真实反映推理过程；所提供证据是行为层面的（基于反事实敏感性），而非机制层面的（不揭示内部电路）。

Abstract: Clinical Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong medical-exam accuracy; however, a correct answer does not guarantee that the explanation names the concepts that actually drove the decision. We introduce three lightweight, directly interpretable metrics for this faithfulness gap: the Explanation Stability Index (ESI), which measures reasoning consistency across repeated queries; the Causal Faithfulness Score (CFS), which tests whether cited concepts drive predictions via concept ablation; and the Perturbation Stability Score (PSS), which measures robustness to semantic-preserving paraphrases. By evaluating six LLMs on 150 MedQA-USMLE questions (900 model-question observations), we found that only 23.3% of the cited clinical concepts were causally necessary. Correct answers had lower CFS than incorrect answers (0.212 vs. 0.398), answer consistency negatively predicted CFS (Spearman r = -0.466), and model pairs could agree on answers while sharing only 8.8% of cited reasoning concepts. These results show that accuracy, consistency, and consensus are incomplete safety signals for clinical decision-making support. The evidence is behavioral rather than mechanistic: concept ablation tests counterfactual sensitivity of outputs, not internal circuits.

</details>


### [405] [When Can First-Order Models of Fine-Tuning Bound Forgetting?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32818)
*Jianchang Su,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究在LoRA微调开始时是否能通过一阶响应模型来界定每个受保护事实被遗忘的概率上限。研究发现，虽然有限差分探测法能以0.974-0.998的相关性精确预测边际变化，但直接预测遗忘会失败，因为遗忘所需的参数变化远超模型验证区域。作者推导了Freedman和Azuma首次通过边界界定，并在112个条件下测试：完整Freedman界定在所有条件下成立（排除R≥a的事实），简化版本在R≥a的事实上失败，并在两个预注册验证研究中得到证实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在新数据上微调时会遗忘先前学会的事实。现有方法只能对可能被遗忘的示例进行排序或风险评估，但无法为每个受保护的事实提供具体的遗忘概率上限保证。研究者的目标是：在微调开始前，仅基于起始测量，为每个事实计算遗忘概率的可证明上界。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 使用有限差分探测法估计一阶响应模型（正交基上的边际梯度方向）；(3) 构建线性surrogate边界（应用响应模型到任务B更新的噪声）；(3) 推导Freedman和Azuma首次通过边界界定，其中Freedman边界包含系数变化项R；并定义R为响应系数变化量，a为边际到边界的距离；(4) 在112个条件下测试多种规则，包括简化Freedman边界（R=0）、完整Freedman边界（R保留）、Azuma边界、筛选边界（按条件选择分支）和每事实规则；(5) 进行预注册验证研究验证关键发现。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 一阶响应模型在6个检查点上的相关性达0.974-0.998，但预测遗忘失败；(2) 简化Freedman边界在112个条件中的14个被违反，且所有被违反的事实都满足R≥a（系数变化≥边际到边界距离）；(3) 完整Freedman边界和Azuma边界在所有112个条件下成立，包括43个预注册验证研究；(4) 在34,256个事实-运行对中，完整边界认证的事实遗忘次数为0次；(5) 筛选边界在新起始状态下失败，因为它按条件整体判断而非按事实判断；(6) 验证研究证实R≥a是观察到的失败所在区域的必要条件。

Conclusion: 一阶微调模型可以在响应系数变化小于边际到边界距离（R<a）的事实上界定遗忘概率。完整Freedman边界排除了R≥a的所有事实，在所有112个条件下成立，包括43个确认性条件；简化Freedman边界在大多数事实上有效但只在R≥a处失败。边界应针对每个起始状态和每个事实单独计算，按条件整体判断的规则（如筛选边界）会在新起始状态上失败。边界对实际模型的有效性是经验发现，因为将形式保证从surrogate转移到实际边际的余项仍无法量化。研究覆盖SGD在40和80步的LoRA微调，Adam和全参数微调仍未探索。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a language model on new data can make it forget facts that it should keep. We ask whether measurements taken at the start of a fine-tuning run can bound, for each protected fact, the probability that the run makes the model forget it. In LoRA fine-tuning with stochastic gradient descent on models from 0.6B to 14B parameters, a first-order response model estimated by finite-difference probes predicts changes of per-fact margins with correlation 0.974-0.998. Predictions of forgetting built on this model nevertheless failed, because forgetting requires parameter changes far outside the region in which the model was validated. The probes can, however, bound the probability that a margin first falls below a boundary near zero: we derive Freedman and Azuma first-passage bounds for a linear surrogate of the margin and test on new runs whether they hold for the model. The bounds contain a term R that measures how much the response coefficients change during the run. The simplified Freedman bound, which sets R = 0, certified most facts but was violated in 14 of 112 conditions, and every fact on which it was violated had R >= a, where a is the distance of the fact's margin to the boundary. The complete Freedman bound certifies only facts with R < a, and it held in every condition. On the violated facts, the spread of the margin across test runs was a median of 14.6 times the prediction of the response model, so the failures are breakdowns of the model, and in our data they occurred only where R >= a. We found this pattern post hoc and tested it in two preregistered confirmatory studies with 43 new conditions: the complete bound held in all of them, and the simplified bound failed there on only 3 facts, each with R >= a. First-order models of fine-tuning can thus bound forgetting on the facts whose response coefficients change by less than their distance to the boundary.

</details>


### [406] [Rank Collapse Is Recoverable, Growing $|Q|$ Is Not: Out-of-Sample Early Warning for Value Divergence in High-UTD Soft Actor-Critic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32819)
*Tianqi Bu,YuXuan Peng,Junteng Tu,Henghui Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) 高UTD设置下，区分了"塑性损失"中的两类症状：表示秩塌缩和值函数幅值|Q|增长，发现秩塌缩是可恢复的，而早期|Q|增长率g能预测种子何时被发散警告触发，并据此设计了增长中止控制器以节省计算资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高UTD（update-to-data）比率会破坏off-policy评论家，表现为"塑性损失"。先前工作将表示秩塌缩和值发散混为一谈，未能在训练早期预测单个run的发散时机。

Method: 使用2048宽度的无归一化评论家，在5个MuJoCo任务、4个UTD比率下进行612次SAC和TD3训练。定义发散标签（loss>10^8或|Q|>10^6），在5k-15k窗口计算log10|Q|的最小二乘斜率g作为早期增长信号，通过留一一致出（LOSO）AUC和Harrell C指数评估预测能力，并设计基于阈值θ的中止控制器。

Result: 在Walker2d和Ant(r=4)中，g排序发散标记的Harrell C为0.78和0.98，LOSO AUC为0.78和0.98。HalfCheetah在r=16下秩塌缩但不发散，警告从不标记。增长中止控制器在Walker2d样本外节省9.9%计算，Ant节省31.9%。LayerNorm评论家可移除Walker2d(r=4)的标记但降低回报。

Conclusion: 秩塌缩是可恢复的（HalfCheetah带休眠单元仍学习），但早期|Q|增长率g能可靠地预测发散时机。将g转化为中止阈值可在样本外节省计算资源，这比基于休眠比例或回报的中止规则更有效。

Abstract: Raising the update-to-data (UTD) ratio breaks off-policy critics in two ways grouped as "plasticity loss": collapsing representations and growing value magnitude $|Q|$. We separate them in Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) with scaled critics (width 2048, no normalization). Collapse is survivable: at UTD ratio 16, HalfCheetah critics with most units dormant keep learning, and the training guard, which stops runs whose loss or $|Q|$ explodes, never flags them. Within one high-UTD SAC configuration, runs start close together, and how far a critic's $\log_{10}|Q|$ has climbed by step 15k, its early growth, ranks the runs by how soon the guard flags them. At 15k, a flagged run's $|Q|$ sits a median of over a hundredfold below its flag level, yet the climb's rate already orders the flags (Harrell's C and out-of-sample AUC 0.78 on Walker2d, 0.98 on Ant, at UTD ratio 4). Dormancy does not. Aborting on this rate saves about a tenth of held-out Walker2d compute and stays net-positive live. A LayerNorm critic lowers the rate, removes the flag on Walker2d at UTD ratio 4 and lowers the return.

</details>


### [407] [Routing Drift Alone Does Not Diagnose Failure in Merged MoE LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32821)
*Yuanyi Wang,Yanggan Gu,Su Lu,Guanghao Zhu,Pengkai Wang,Yifan Yang,Congkai Xie,Zhaoyi Yan,Jianmin Wu,Hongxia Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究模型合并后MoE LLMs的路由漂移现象，发现仅凭路由漂移不能诊断路由失败。提出了基于任务层面干预效果的可恢复损失评估框架，并提出Selective Router Repair (SRR)作为案例研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型合并可改变MoE模型中token到专家的路由分配（路由漂移），现有方法常将其视为路由失败并直接修复。然而，路由变化是否真正构成路由失败，以及何种证据应支持修复决策，尚不清楚。

Method: 1) 开发路由分析工具包，通过交叉源/合并路由器输入与参数进行反事实干预；2) 将路由失败形式化为在固定非路由参数下、可通过特定路由策略恢复的任务损失；3) 提出SRR作为案例研究，拟合似然加权的源派生专家对修正系数；5) 在DeepSeekMoE、OLMoE和Qwen3-MoE三种架构上进行评估。

Result: 77.7%-96.9%的路由变化由表征漂移引起而非路由器参数；JS散度等结构度量预测源路由恢复增益的AUROC接近0.5；源路由恢复在评估模型上未产生可靠任务收益；SRR的95%置信区间跨越零点，无法证明源似然优势能识别有益的局部修正。

Conclusion: 路由漂移本身不足以作为路由失败的证据；基于源信息的一致性必须通过其在固定检查点上的任务级干预效果来判断，而非仅凭与源模型的一致性。

Abstract: Model merging efficiently combines specialized large language models (LLMs) without joint retraining, but can substantially alter expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Such \emph{routing drift} is often interpreted as routing failure, raising a fundamental question that remains unclear: \emph{does routing drift after MoE merging actually indicate routing failure, and what evidence should justify repair?} We investigate these questions across DeepSeekMoE, OLMoE, and Qwen3-MoE proposing a routing analysis toolkit for controlled counterfactual interventions and token-level analysis. By crossing source and merged router inputs and parameters, we attribute most expert reassignments to input shifts rather than parameter changes at the same layer. However, source-relative routing differences poorly predict next-token likelihood gains from source-route restoration, and different expert selections can produce directionally similar mixture outputs. We therefore operationalize routing failure as \textit{task loss recoverable under a specified routing intervention, with non-routing parameters fixed.} These tests detect recoverable loss under deliberate router corruption, whereas source-route restoration does not establish reliable task benefits in the evaluated merged models. Motivated by these, we propose \emph{Selective Router Repair (SRR)} as a case study, and find that source-specialist token-likelihood advantages do not reliably identify beneficial local corrections. Together, these findings show that \textbf{routing drift alone is insufficient evidence of routing failure}: source-informed corrections must be judged by their task-level intervention effects. The analysis toolkit and SRR code are released.

</details>


### [408] [The Decomposition Tax: LLM Pipelines Lose Up to 40 Accuracy Points at Their Own Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32825)
*Tianqi Bu,YuXuan Peng,Junteng Tu,Henghui Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"分解税"(decomposition tax)概念，量化了多阶段LLM流水线中各阶段间接口所导致的准确率损失。研究发现，在固定模型、问题、阶段、提示和计算预算的对照实验中，仅因后续阶段看不到原问题这一因素，流水线最多损失40.5个准确率百分点（gemma-3-12B在MATH-500上）。同时提出了两条实践建议：在有损接口之后重新注入原问题，以及让列举数值的阶段保留各量之间的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多阶段LLM流水线（如least-to-most prompting、Decomposed Prompting等）在每个阶段间存在接口，当前缺乏对"接口本身代价"的孤立度量。现有框架允许重写某阶段的提示，但没有人给阶段间的接口贴上价格标签。研究者关心的核心问题是：当上下文预算或角色边界限制只允许单条消息跨接口时（即后续阶段只能基于前序阶段输出的文本进行推理），这种"单消息模式"会让流水线损失多少准确率。

Method: 研究设计了严格的对照实验框架：
1. **双臂设计**：严格(strict)臂中每阶段仅见前一阶段输出；完全(full)臂中每阶段额外看到原问题。分解税TAX = acc(full) - acc(strict)，控制变量包括模型、问题、阶段、阶段提示和生成预算，仅改变"每阶段能否看到原问题"。
2. **2×2因子设计**：三阶段方深入研究内容(Content: condensing vs preserving)与形式(Form: list vs prose)的交叉；四阶段方深入研究边(Edge)与接收方(Receiver: committed vs re-deriving)的交叉。
3. **混合顺序流水线**(MIX_LR/MIX_RL)：将一个有损接口置于不同位置，分离接口效应与位置效应。
4. **统计方法**：每单元配对McNemar精确检验+配对自助法置信区间，并在预注册的家族内使用Benjamini-Hochberg FDR和Holm校正。
6. **对照组**：安慰剂（掩码问题词汇为下划线）、剂量反应（按比例恢复问题）、解析完整性、采样、计算预算、硬件、措辞重写。
7. **预先密封假设检验**：注册一条更强规则（从接口和接收方类型预测被征税方），在两个未见流水线(HO1_cross、HO2_formal)上做封闭决策。
8. **跨代际验证**：在2024年队列（Llama-3、Qwen2.5、Gemma 3、Phi-4、OLMo-2等）和2026年队列（gemma-4-12B、gpt-oss-20B、Granite-4.1-8B）上分别测试。

Result: 1. **规模**：最大的税为+40.5准确率点（gemma-3-12B在MATH-500上，Holm校正p=1.66e-19）。118项主族检验中有70项通过Benjamini-Hochberg，54项通过Holm。重新接地平均恢复63%的流水线与单次调用之间的差距。
2. **机制是问题内容本身**：GSM-Hard上的安慰剂（保留≥60%的额外令牌、≤1个问题词）未带来任何恢复（-0.01/-0.005/-0.01）。
3. **单个阶段提示可左右税的大小**：gemma-3-12B在MATH-500上，仅改写一个阶段的指令就将税从4.5移到36.5点。在列表输出中加入"保留所述关系"条款可在9/9模型上降低税。
4. **修复应在有损接口之后**：在MIX_RL中，重新接地有损接口之后阶段优于之前的阶段在8/8模型上；在MATH-500上仅重新接地之前阶段甚至比无修复更差（7/7模型）。
5. **2026新模型仍受影响**：gemma-4-12B损失37.0点；修复策略对全部3个新模型有效；但在MATH-500上税的构成（边效应vs接收方效应）已改变。
6. **注册规则被驳**：强规则（从接口和接收方类型预测被征税方）在密封测试中失败：HO1_cross显示再推导阶段税反而最高（4/4模型）。

Conclusion: 论文得出两条实践建议：(1) 若预算仅允许一个阶段获得原问题，给有损接口之后的阶段；(2) 若某阶段必须列出数值，明确要求保留其关系。这些建议在数学推理两族模型上稳健。论文同时坦率记录了一个被驳的注册预测（更强规则），并明确指出结论的范围（数学推理基准、固定流水线家族、两个模型代际），不建议外推到检索、规划、代码或工具调用流水线。

Abstract: A four-stage LLM pipeline gives up as much as 40.5 accuracy points at its own interfaces (gemma-3-12B on MATH-500, Holm-corrected p = 1.66e-19; the largest tax in the primary family). We hold model, problem, stages, stage prompts and completion budget fixed, vary only whether each stage can still see the original problem, and call the accuracy difference the decomposition tax. Across 21 open-weight models from nine organisations, on GSM-Hard and MATH-500 at n = 200 paired items per cell, 70 of 118 primary-family tests survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction and 54 survive Holm. On GSM-Hard, a placebo recovers nothing: it carries at least 60% of the extra tokens and at most one word of the problem. Builders design a pipeline one stage at a time, and its bill arrives at the interfaces between stages. Rewriting one stage's instruction moves gemma-3-12B's tax from 4.5 to 36.5 points, and adding "every relationship stated between them" to a stage that lists the numerical quantities lowers the tax on 9 of 9 models on MATH-500. Re-grounding, which shows a stage the original problem again, belongs after the loss. With one lossy interface, re-grounding the stage after it beats re-grounding the stage before it on 7 of 7 models on both benchmarks; on MATH-500 the earlier repair is worse than none on 7 of 7. Newer models still pay: gemma-4-12B gives up 37.0 points, and the repair holds on all three of the newest models we test. A sealed held-out test refuted a stronger rule we registered, which predicted the paying stage from the interface and receiver types, so we locate the tax by measuring one stage at a time. The prescription has two parts: re-ground the stage after the lossy interface, and if a stage must list the quantities, tell it to keep the relationships.

</details>


### [409] [Improving LLM Collaboration via Multi-Agent Preference Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32827)
*Shuo Liu,Xinzichen Li,Tianle Chen,Christopher Amato*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出MAPL（多智能体偏好学习）框架，用于在缺乏明确奖励信号的情况下，通过比较反馈优化LLM多智能体协作。该框架涵盖去中心化和中心化两种协作形式，并实例化为MARLHF和MADPO两种方法。在写作、编码、工具使用和旅行规划四个任务上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM多智能体协作中，MARL依赖手工设计的奖励，难以构建且难以准确反映任务目标；偏好学习在单智能体上成功但未充分扩展到多智能体系统。MAS策略空间大，偏好数据难以覆盖，奖励估计易不准确。

Method: 1) 将偏好式MAS形式化为Pb-Dec-POMDP（去中心化）和Pb-MPOMDP（中心化）；2) 提出MAPL通用框架，迭代地将当前策略的联合轨迹与解耦策略产生的轨迹进行比较生成偏好数据；4) 三种范式：Dec-Dec、Cen-Cen、Dec-Cen；5) 实例化为MARLHF（两阶段：学习奖励模型+MAGRPO策略优化）和MADPO（直接偏好优化扩展）。
