Result: 在四个领域的实验显示，MAPL最接近使用固定明确奖励的MARL性能，在CoopHE和Travel上的pass rate分别达65.8%和76.4%。Cen-Cen通常最优，Dec-Dec也表现强劲；Dec-Cen因信息和可实现性差距表现较差。MARLHF在多数领域优于MADPO，但对数据覆盖、代理与比较器模型以及底层MARL算法较敏感；actor-critic方法不如MAGRPO稳定。

Conclusion: MAPL是首个系统性研究LLM多智能体协作的偏好学习框架，通过偏好反馈有效提升去中心化与中心化协作质量，接近oracle奖励MARL的水平。验证了在线偏好收集、λ衰减回放缓冲以及MAGRPO优于actor-critic等设计选择。未来需扩展到更大规模MAS、解决Dec-Cen差距、降低计算成本。

Abstract: Several works have explored multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) in LLM collaboration. However, constructing reliable rewards is difficult in practice, as complete and accurate metrics are often unavailable and hard to aggregate. Preference learning provides an alternative by learning from comparative human or AI feedback. Yet, its extension to multi-agent systems remains underexplored. To address this gap, we formulate preference-based multi-agent systems (MAS) from decentralized and centralized collaboration perspectives. We also introduce a general multi-agent preference learning framework (MAPL) to solve these problems. MAPL allows iterative updates by comparing the current solution with decentralized or centralized solutions generated by various agents. We instantiate MAPL using MARL from human feedback (MARLHF) with a learned reward model and multi-agent direct preference optimization (MADPO). Experiments on collaborative writing, coding, tool use, and travel planning show that MAPL can improve collaboration quality and efficiency while approaching the performance of MARL with fixed, well-defined rewards. Within MAPL, MARLHF generally outperforms MADPO on most tasks but remains sensitive to data coverage, agent and comparator models, and the underlying MARL algorithms.

</details>


### [410] [FinancialAuditBench: Benchmark Construction under Differential Privacy Using Real-World Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32835)
*Jerry Huang,Sarvesh Babu,Matt Van Buren,Alexander Wang,Pranav Pillai,Arush Jain,James P. Burton,Julia Hockenmaier*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍FinancialAuditBench基准测试及其基于差分隐私的合成审计任务生成框架，用于评估AI代理在财务报表审计任务中的表现。结果显示，前沿模型能完成部分初级审计工作，但在可靠性和准确性上仍不足，需要专业监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理在金融领域的应用日益广泛，但现有评估受限于数据隐私，难以构建真实、复杂的金融审计任务基准。本研究旨在解决隐私敏感领域基准构建的挑战。

Method: 提出一个四阶段的合成审计任务生成框架：(1)变量选择；(2)利用差分隐私机制从历史审计中提取先验统计；(4)利用排行榜审计员反馈修订。生成包含90个任务、覆盖6个合成审计项目的FinancialAuditBench基准，采用基于差分隐私的聚合统计（(3.65, 10⁻⁵)-DP）和计算图来保证数据内部一致性。评估11个前沿模型在完成和复核任务中的能力。

Result: 最佳模型Claude Opus 5.5的Pass@1为69.17%，pass^8降至44.44%，表明可靠性不足。识别出四类常见错误：未考虑变更影响、检索不充分、证据评估不充分、不愿留待处理。代理运行时间（7-12分钟）远低于审计员手工完成时间（2-12小时）。复核任务中，所有模型表现均有提升。计算机使用场景下表现接近bash工具设置。

Conclusion: 前沿模型尚不能在没有专业审查的情况下独立完成审计工作，应作为审计员的辅助工具（co-pilot）。所提出的框架为隐私敏感领域的合成任务生成提供了可推广的方法。

Abstract: As AI agents are becoming widely adopted in the financial services industry, careful measurement is essential to understand where they can be reliably deployed and where oversight and professional review remain necessary. Such measurement, however, is constrained by limited access to proprietary or privacy-sensitive data. Existing benchmarks therefore often rely on publicly available data, human- and/or LLM-authored tasks, or simplified settings. We introduce FinancialAuditBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on financial statement audit tasks, along with a framework for systematically generating synthetic engagements. Our task generation framework leverages differentially private aggregate statistics from historical audits along with audit expertise contributed through over 1,100 hours of benchmark development and review. FinancialAuditBench consists of 90 tasks spanning workpaper completion and review across six synthetic audit engagements, each containing an average of 179 files. Evaluation on eleven frontier models shows that while agents complete substantial portions of staff-level audit tasks well, they sometimes perform inappropriate procedures or produce incorrect documentation. Beyond financial auditing, our framework offers an approach for systematically generating synthetic tasks for model evaluation and training in privacy-sensitive domains.

</details>


### [411] [Counterfactual Self-Evolving Agents for Evidence-Grounded Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32870)
*Xing Han,Yuxin Wang,Chen Chen,Wei Dai,Gautham Krishna Gudur,Shijun Li,Hsing-Huan Chung,Gregory D. Hager,Joydeep Ghosh,Paul Pu Liang,Suchi Saria*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CF-Evolve框架，通过Proposer-Verifier-Solver架构，利用反事实自演化机制在冻结Solver的前提下提升基于证据的推理能力。仅训练Proposer生成有针对性的证据编辑及其因果解释作为Solver的上下文，并通过记忆库累积已验证的反事实实现持续改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自博弈方法在证据可识别任务中难以生成可独立验证的合理案例，且简单的决策翻转目标无法区分有益的纠错与有害的逆转。需要一种机制既能测试决策对证据的依赖性，又不更新底层模型。

Method: 1. Proposer-Verifier-Solver架构：仅训练Proposer，Solver和Verifier保持冻结；2. 基于结构因果模型定义Observe、Explain、Intervene三类反事实测试；3. 人工设计的反事实指令微调数据集教授Proposer区分纠错与保持；4. 集成Solver正确性/不确定性与Verifier合理性的反馈奖励（GRPO）；5. 通过翻转保证门控（flip-warrant gate）选择性注入反事实，并累积至记忆库供冻结Solver使用。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV（IHM/LOS）、DiagnosisArena、HoVer和MMMU Business等任务上，CF-Evolve在Qwen2.5-7B、Llama3-8B和MedGemma-4B上均优于零样本、RAG和GSEM基线。例如用约3000个反事实示例训练的Proposer可使冻结Solver的IHM性能接近使用41886个示例直接微调Solver的效果（约1/14的数据量），且诊断推理准确率从34.8%提升至66.7%。较难患者和较难任务的获益更显著。

Conclusion: CF-Evolve证明了通过学习生成高质量反事实上下文来引导冻结Solver是可行的样本高效替代方案。记忆库规模增长带来的收益主要体现在困难案例上，且记忆质量比数量更重要。未来工作包括估计条件纠错与有害概率以指导反事实选择，以及学习结构因果模型以约束编辑。

Abstract: Self-play proposer--solver methods improve reasoning by generating tasks and learning from verified solutions. However, for evidence-identifiable tasks, where case-specific evidence and domain knowledge determine a checkable answer, self-play requires generating plausible cases whose answers can be independently verified. We introduce counterfactual self-evolution, which generates counterfactual context for reconsidering the original case. A trainable Proposer constructs targeted evidence edits and describes potential outcome changes with causal explanations. We handcraft an expert-verified counterfactual instruction-tuning dataset to teach the Proposer to generate high-quality counterfactuals across a broad range of action--outcome scenarios. Each counterfactual instruction-tuning example specifies an edit within a defined category and explains its hypothesized causal effect on the decision, teaching the Proposer to reason systematically about what changes and why. We instruction-tune the Proposer on these examples, then formulate a fine-tuning reward that integrates feedback from the Solver and Verifier. Across diverse counterfactual scenarios, this reward favors high-quality counterfactuals and warranted revisions, while penalizing changes that overturn correct decisions. The counterfactual context aims to correct errors and strengthen confidence in correct decisions. Accepted counterfactuals accumulate in memory that supplies in-context evidence to the frozen Solver; the Solver adapts through evolving context rather than weight updates. We apply the framework to clinical reasoning, fact verification, and business reasoning. Our evaluation tracks performance over successive rounds as counterfactual memory grows, including transfer to harder cases. Our method achieves superior results across diverse frontier models.

</details>


### [412] [Can LLMs Predict the Future? A Brier Score Analysis of Prediction Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32885)
*Yuanbo Li,Zekun Li,Xiaoyan cong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构建了包含3000个已结算二元预测市场问题的RMF基准，评估了6个LLM变体（Claude Sonnet 4.5/4.6、Claude Opus 4.1/4.6、Qwen2.5 7B/32B）在零样本、仅问题输入条件下的概率预测能力，使用Brier分数、Murphy分解和配对差异分析。核心发现：前沿LLM仅勉强优于经验基率预测器（优势0.024-0.033），模型版本/规模升级不能持续提升预测精度，事件类别对预测误差的影响远大于模型容量差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地被研究用作概率预测器，如何评估其概率估计质量成为关键问题。论文关注两个核心问题：(1) LLM是否真的能预测未来；(2) 模型升级（版本迭代、规模扩大）是否带来更准确的概率估计。论文强调预测分数应结合简单概率基线和问题组成来解读，因为仅报告绝对分数无法反映模型是否真正提取了超越边际事件频率的额外信息。

Method: 方法包含三个核心要素：(1) RMF基准数据集——从Polymarket公开记录中分层抽取3000个已结算二元问题，涵盖9个领域（加密货币、娱乐、金融、地缘政治、政治、科技、体育、天气、其他）；(2) 评估协议——零样本、无检索、仅问题文本输入，各模型输出[0,1]概率；(3) 评估指标——Brier分数（配对样本t检验的bootstrap 95%置信区间）、Murphy分解（可靠性、分辨率、不确定性）、配对Brier差异（固定问题集比较两模型），并使用经验基率预测器作为基线。训练截止日期分层设计：预截止日期（≤2024-12-31）与后截止日期（≥2025-06-30）之间设置6个月缓冲带。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 在后截止日期层级上，四个Claude模型的Brier分数为0.183-0.192，比基率参考预测器提升0.024-0.033；Qwen 32B未显著优于基率；Qwen 7B显著差于基率。(2) 配对对比中仅Qwen 7B→32B显著改善（Δ=-0.024），而Claude版本/层级升级均无显著改善，Opus 4.1→4.6反而显著负向（Δ=+0.009）。(3) 同模型在不同事件类别间的Brier差异远大于Claude变体间的差异。(4) 预/后截止日期Brier差距很小（<0.03），无明显记忆悬崖。(5) 显著事件（高交易量）在前截止日期更容易预测，在后截止日期更难预测，呈现记忆效应。(6) 后截止日期跨模型一致性显著上升（0.42→0.62），前段模型在新事件上趋同于相同的保守对冲预测。

Conclusion: 该研究得出三个关键结论：前沿LLM仅勉强超越经验基率预测器；容量扩展仅在低于前沿时有效，一旦达到Claude收敛带（~0.19）便停止作用；事件类别比模型容量对后截止日期Brier变异的驱动作用更大。研究强调更优的推理基准测试不能转化为更好的前沿预测器，提示在金融和政策等高风险部署场景中需要谨慎对待LLM输出的校准数值。论文将发布RMF数据（CC-BY 4.0）和评估代码（MIT许可），主要局限包括：仅以基率为基准（未对比人类专家/市场价格）、零样本无检索协议、未分解不同截止时间长度的预测表现。

Abstract: We study whether model upgrades improve probability estimates for prediction-market questions. Our Resolved Market Forecasting (RMF) benchmark contains 3,000 resolved binary questions across nine domains, on which we evaluate six Claude and Qwen model variants using a question-only, zero-shot protocol. We assess Brier scores relative to an empirical base-rate predictor, examine their Murphy decomposition, and compare models through paired differences, with results stratified by event category and timing relative to training cutoffs. In the reported post-cutoff stratum, the four Claude models achieve Brier scores of 0.183-0.192, improving on the base-rate reference by 0.024-0.033. Qwen 32B does not significantly outperform that reference, although its paired Brier is 0.024 lower than that of the 7B checkpoint. The evaluated Claude version and tier upgrades yield no significant improvement. Within-model differences across event categories exceed the observed differences among Claude variants. These results show why forecasting scores should be interpreted alongside simple probability baselines and question composition: under this protocol, newer versions or higher model tiers do not consistently produce more accurate probabilities.

</details>


### [413] [StraTune: Adaptive Selection of Revision Operators for Self-Evolving LLM Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32886)
*Zeping Liu,Yan Li,Ni Lao,Gil Wolff,Gengchen Mai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: StraTune（StraTune）是一种用于LLM自演化文本技能（self-evolving textual skills）的方法。它通过让冻结的优化器LLM在每一轮从优化状态中自适应选择"修订算子"（搜索策略+修订形式），解决了现有方法固定单一修订算子、难以持续提升技能性能的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM技能学习方法（如TextGrad、GEPA、SkillOpt、Trace2Skill、Iter-CoT等）每种方法都固定使用一种"修订算子"（搜索策略与修订形式的组合）。然而实证表明，没有一种修订算子能在所有任务上一致地表现最佳；持续使用不适合的算子会限制进一步的性能提升。因此，亟需一种能够动态选择修订策略的方法。

Method: StraTune将搜索策略（直接修订I1、迭代优化I2、并行采样I3）与修订形式（条件规则F1、示例F2、推理程序F3、全文改写F4）解耦，构建一个候选算子菜单。每一轮中，冻结的优化器LLM读取优化状态Ω_t=(s_t, E_t, H_t, p_t)（当前技能、执行反馈、评估历史、迭代进度），自适应选择算子o_t并生成候选技能。所有候选技能通过统一的"候选评估"（包括小样本筛选+大样本验证），检查收益与回归（使用Wilson置信下界），决策结果写回评估历史H_t。最终技能选择从已保存候选技能中挑选最佳。训练预算按目标LLM执行次数计算（6|D_train|），保证公平对比。

Result: 在DocVQA、LiveMath、Mind2Web、SpreadsheetBench四个基准上，使用Haiku/Sonnet与Opus两种模型配置，StraTune在8项中的6项中排名第一：LiveMath得分从最强基线的45.02提升至65.88（Haiku），从78.20提升至81.52（Opus）；SpreadsheetBench提升约4分。消融实验表明：固定I1/I2/I3、随机、轮询、Once、Replay策略均表现较差；三类bandit规则（ε-greedy、UCB1、Thompson）全面低于优化器LLM选择；移除历史信息后LiveMath暴跌至34.12；仅用全文改写（F4）也损失显著。优化器选择开销仅占目标LLM执行token的0.13%–1.45%。用Haiku学到的技能迁移到Opus可恢复Opus自身学习增益的60%–98%。

Conclusion: 将"如何学习"的选择——即搜索策略与修订形式的组合——纳入优化过程，由冻结的优化器LLM基于完整优化状态在每一轮动态决策，是持续提升LLM技能的关键。StraTune在大多数基准-模型配置上达到最优，且自适应选择贡献了主要增益，而非候选评估或最终选择。低成本目标LLM学得的技能可迁移到更强LLM，降低优化成本。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can learn reusable textual skills from execution feedback without updating their parameters, but effectively deciding how to revise these skills remains a key challenge. Existing methods typically rely on a fixed revision operator, a search strategy and the revision forms applied under it. However, we observe that no single revision operator consistently performs best across tasks, and repeatedly applying an unsuitable operator can limit further improvement. We propose StraTune (strategy-guided skill tuning), which lets a frozen optimizer LLM choose the revision operator at every round from the optimization state, which is defined as the current execution feedback together with the recorded outcomes of earlier strategies and forms. Candidate skills from every revision operator pass one candidate evaluation, which screens for gains and regressions on a small sample set and validates them on a larger one, and every outcome is written back to the optimization state for later choices. Across four benchmarks and two LLM settings, StraTune outperforms all five baselines in most settings. Ablations attribute the gains to the adaptive choice of the revision operator, since fixed, random, scheduled, and bandit strategy choices all score lower, and skills learned with a small target LLM also improve a stronger one. Code and learned skills are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [414] [Constraints Are Graphs, Not Chains: Exact Decoding for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32900)
*Jianchang Su,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FactorDLM 是一个无需训练的解码器，将扩散语言模型的约束表示为因子图而非顺序自动机。它通过在每个去噪步骤中利用变量消除法精确调节模型的平均场预测，从而将解码复杂度从自动机状态数转移到约束图的诱导宽度上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 dLLM 受限解码器将约束编码为顺序语言（正则表达式、上下文无关文法、有限自动机），对于关系型约束，状态空间会指数级爆炸；而因子图是同一关系的紧凑表示（大小为 O(k)），因此应当用因子图替代链式状态机进行约束解码。

Method: 将有限域关系表示为因子图（factor graph），在每个去噪步骤通过变量消除（variable elimination）精确约束 dLLM 的平均场预测。设计统一的编译器，将语法约束（链形因子图）和非局部关系约束统一表示，整体解码成本随约束图的诱导宽度（induced width）指数增长。

Result: 在九个关系基准和三个骨干模型上，所有输出均满足声明约束，投影开销 0.4–6.9%；无约束解码的有效率仅为 0–79%。编译后投影的查询速度比八核并行 CP-SAT 快 13.6 倍。在含交叉字段引用的 JSON 记录中，纯语法自动机会让引用悬空，纯关系因子会产生畸形 JSON，而组合方案两者皆满足。

Conclusion: 对于关系型约束，因子图比链式自动机更紧凑、更高效；顺序状态与直接因子表示之间的选择取决于约束本身，且可在解码前计算。新基准（含精确随机下界和固定模板下界）证明：在精确约束样本间选取优于贪心投影。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) predict masked positions in arbitrary order, but their exact constrained decoders still encode constraints as sequential languages, whose state must track every unresolved dependency between positions. For relational constraints this encoding grows exponentially: for same-order copy, every finite automaton needs $4^k$ states, deterministic or nondeterministic, and every context-free grammar has size $2^{\Omega(k)}$, while the factor graph of the same relation has size $O(k)$ and a 16-entry peak table. We introduce FactorDLM, a training-free decoder that represents finite-domain relations as a factor graph and, at each denoising step, conditions the model's mean-field prediction on that graph exactly by variable elimination. Decoding cost then grows exponentially with the induced width of the constraint graph, which replaces automaton size as the governing parameter. Because a finite automaton is a chain-shaped factor graph, one compiler enforces syntax and nonlocal relations together: on JSON records with cross-field references, a schema automaton alone leaves references dangling, relational factors alone produce malformed JSON, and the combined plan is valid on both counts, including on records of variable length. Across nine relational benchmarks and three backbones, every output satisfies every declared constraint at 0.4-6.9% projection overhead, where unconstrained decoding is 0-79% valid, and compiled projection answers repeated queries 13.6x faster than CP-SAT with eight parallel workers. Because model-free rules solve three of five standard benchmarks, we construct benchmarks with exact chance and fixed-template floors, on which selecting among exact constrained samples beats greedy projection. Which encoding is cheaper, sequential state or direct factors, depends on the constraint and is computable before decoding begins.

</details>


### [415] [Logical subspace in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32907)
*Hope Kean,Enric Boix-Adsera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出最小可行子空间（MVS）方法，在Gemma和Qwen模型中发现低秩激活子空间可支持逻辑推理，且该子空间与模型的事实知识、工作记忆、认知控制和算术能力呈现功能性分离，类似于人脑中专门的抽象形式推理网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 借鉴神经科学中关于人脑存在专门的抽象形式推理网络的发现，探究大语言模型内部是否也存在功能上可定位的、专门支持逻辑推理的紧凑机制，而非仅依赖广泛共享的计算资源或高维分布式表征。

Method: 提出最小可行子空间（MVS）方法：通过学习残差流激活中的低秩正交子空间U（围绕中性语料均值μ投影），最小化修改后与原始模型的KL散度，以保留目标任务的性能。系统在多个层和不同秩（1-64）下进行优化，并对比保留子空间与消融子空间两种干预方式，在Qwen3-8B和Gemma-4-12B上评估逻辑推理任务以及多项控制任务（语言建模、工作记忆、事实知识、认知控制、算术等）。

Result: 在中间层（如Qwen第22层秩2，Gemma第21层秩1），保留逻辑子空间可使逻辑推理准确率接近完整模型（~0.99→0.96），同时显著损害控制任务；消融该子空间则使逻辑推理降至随机水平（~0.5），而几乎不影响控制任务和语言建模能力。子空间具有跨词汇内容和模板的泛化能力（含非词条件），且激活在该子空间内呈现与论证形式对应的聚类结构。

Conclusion: 研究证明LLM中逻辑推理能力依赖于紧凑的功能专门化表征，与人脑中的逻辑网络相似，为通用Transformer内部认知功能的可分离性提供了因果证据。MVS方法可推广至其他任务的能力制图分析。

Abstract: Recent work has identified a human brain network specialized for abstract formal reasoning (Kean et al., 2025). Does the same hold true in language models? To answer this question, we introduce the minimal viable subspace (MVS) method, which searches for the lowest-rank activation subspace at a layer that preserves task performance when everything outside that subspace is ablated. Using MVS, we demonstrate low-rank subspaces supporting logical inference on Gemma and Qwen models. Furthermore, these subspaces exhibit a clear dissociation from model capacities on other tasks, such that retaining these late logic subspaces preserves inference while impairing factual knowledge, working memory, cognitive control, and arithmetic. Conversely, ablating them reduces logical inference accuracy to chance while largely sparing these other capacities. Our results suggest a functionally localizable core machinery for logic akin to that in the human brain.

</details>


### [416] [Planner-as-Router: Joint Plan-Time Model Routing for Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32917)
*Vivek Kumar Singh,Preeti Priyam,Gautam Bhowmick*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Planner-as-Router (PaR)，一种训练免费的路由模式，将模型层级选择融入规划阶段，在依赖 DAG 上联合为每个子任务分配 small/mid/frontier 层级，以实现多智能体工作流中的成本-准确率帕累托优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产中 LLM 智能体工作流链式调用多次，前沿模型（如 Claude Opus）单 token 成本可达小模型（如 Haiku）的 25 倍，全用前沿模型成本过高。现有路由方法（FrugalGPT 级联、RouteLLM/Hybrid-LLM 查询级路由、MasRouter 智能体级路由）均为单次调用决策，无法利用工作流依赖结构，可能导致上游小模型的错误沿 DAG 传播放大。需要一种能感知完整计划结构、无需训练数据即可联合分配层级的路由方法。

Method: 架构核心：(1) 规划器（固定使用 Claude Haiku 4.5）通过强制结构化输出的 produce_plan 工具，一次性产出包含 id、specialist、tier、depends_on、cost_rationale 的完整计划 DAG；(2) 复杂度分类器（Haiku，max_tokens=10）对查询标记 simple/complex，simple 直接短路为单 small-tier 子任务跳过完整规划；(3) 调度器按拓扑序执行，统一重试策略（同层重试 3 次→升一层重试 1 次→null 传播），节点失败用 null 传播而非重复计费。目标函数为成本感知效用 U=A/C^α。基准为 EntBench（54 任务，7 类，4 能力类 + 3 组合类），采用执行式评分（SQL/MongoDB 跑真实数据库、提取 F1、工具序列匹配等），对比 8 种路由策略（含 AllFrontier、AllSmall、SinkFrontier、SourceFrontier、FrugalGPT 级联、PaR-Lite 简化版及无 cost_rationale 的消融），3 随机种子共 1157 次评估。

Result: 排除 SQL-Compose 类（所有路由器均 0%，属专家质量瓶颈非路由问题）后，PaR 准确率 26.1%，与 AllFrontier(29.0%)、SinkFrontier(25.4%) 在 ±6pp 置信区间内不可分离，但成本仅 0.0101 USD，较 AllFrontier 降 44%（Δ −0.0074 USD，CI 不含 0），较 SourceFrontier 降 45%（CI 不含 0），与 SinkFrontier 成本相当但准确率稍高（+0.7pp），较忠实 FrugalGPT 级联在更低成本下达更高准确率（+2.9pp）。在 α∈{0.5,1,1.5,2} 的所有成本权重下 PaR 效用排名第一，每美元准确率约为 AllFrontier 的 1.6 倍、SinkFrontier 的 1.3 倍。规划器实际层级分布：45% small/46% mid/8% frontier，平均 1.8 子任务/计划；能力类几乎全 small，组合类升至 mid/frontier，验证了基于结构的层级推理。消融：去除 cost_rationale 字段使 Cross-Recon 类准确率归零且成本翻 4 倍以上；PaR-Lite 仅匹配最便宜路由器准确率(24.6%)却维持 PaR 级成本，说明收益来自整体规划推理而非分类器。组合误差初步观察：21 任务试点显示 PaR 复合因子 ρ=3.33（高于独立假设预测），AllFrontier ρ=1.27，提示廉价层级在组合工作流中可能存在隐藏的级联惩罚（仅假设，未验证）。

Conclusion: PaR 提供了一种训练免费的替代方案：通过将层级选择融入规划阶段、利用完整 DAG 依赖信息，无需训练路由器或标注数据即可达到成本-准确率前沿位置；它不是学习型路由器的对比优胜者，而是更轻量的可比替代，可作为提示变更+调度器直接集成进基于图的多智能体框架。但存在多项局限：基准仅 54 任务导致置信区间较宽，绝对准确率较低（22-29%，反映执行式评分对组合任务难度）；复合误差为 21 任务试点而非验证结果；规划器与层级绑定同一供应商，未测跨供应商设置；未与 RouteLLM/MasRouter 等训练型路由器直接对比；相对 AllSmall 无成本优势（成本显著更高、精度持平）。未来工作包括扩充至 300 任务、完成 18 种专家-层级组合的全量复合测量、引入不确定性感知层级分配以及跨供应商层级分配研究。

Abstract: Running large language model (LLM) agents in production gets expensive fast. A frontier model (the largest, most capable tier) is accurate but can cost 25 times what a small model costs per token, and the gap compounds once a workflow chains several calls together. Planner-as-Router (PaR) attacks this from a different angle. Instead of leaving model-tier selection to some component downstream, it folds the choice into planning itself. As the planner breaks a query into subtasks, it also assigns each one a model size tier (small, mid, or frontier, ordered by capability and price), so the dependencies between subtasks are visible before any specialist runs. Unlike per-call routers such as cascade routing, which look at one node at a time, PaR sees the whole workflow up front and needs no separate router model or training data. We evaluate PaR with EntBench, a benchmark of 54 enterprise agentic tasks across seven classes, graded by actually running the generated Structured Query Language (SQL) and MongoDB queries against live databases. Over 1,157 evaluations spanning eight routers and three seeds, PaR stays on the observed cost-accuracy frontier. It matches a sink-frontier heuristic (frontier model on terminal nodes only) in accuracy at comparable cost and a faithful FrugalGPT cascade at lower cost, and cuts cost 44% against all-frontier routing while giving up 2.9 points of accuracy. Several accuracy gaps fall inside the plus-or-minus six-point confidence interval of a 54-task study, so we frame PaR's advantage as frontier position rather than a clean accuracy win. We also report a preliminary observation, not a validated result: a small pilot hints that cheap routing may carry a hidden compounding penalty on compositional workflows, which we frame as a hypothesis for future measurement. PaR, EntBench, and all evaluation code are open source.

</details>


### [417] [Precision As You Need: Stochastic Computing Is a Dense Adaptive Quantizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32922)
*Haoran Jin,Kangqi Zhang,Jirong Yang,Barry Lyu,Qiuyi Ding,Ruijie Gao,Nathan Bleier*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将随机计算(SC)重新定位为一种"密集自适应量化器",提出基于流长度L的精度控制可替代传统INT4/INT8等固定位宽格式,并通过GPU模拟库和逐行混合精度策略,在图像分类、检测分割、图像生成和视觉世界模型规划等任务上验证了SC在视觉Transformer推理中的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代Transformer视觉模型的推理成本主要由矩阵乘法主导,而现有的训练后量化(PTQ)和混合精度推理受限于硬件支持的固定位宽格式(INT4/INT8/BF16/FP16),这种"稀疏、硬件定义的精度阶梯"限制了混合精度推理的粒度。需要一种能暴露密集精度空间的算术范式。

Method: 1) 基于C-BSG(条件比特流生成)的GPU模拟库:Triton融合内核实现比特流生成、AND/XNOR乘法、计数器解码,流长度L作为一等公民内核参数;2) SC矩阵乘法:用XNOR门替代多比特整数乘法器,精度由流长度L控制,支持任意正整数L(非2的幂次);3) 敏感性分析:对ViT-L/14的6类算子×24个块进行单算子SC替换,定位高敏感(算子,块)单元;4) 逐行混合精度策略:离线校准阶段记录每行查询/激活/注意力峰值等轻量指标与L的关系,通过预算约束的拉格朗日分配拟合阈值,推理时按阈值分配每行流长度;5) 残差补偿:借鉴QwT的闭式拟合,在SC数据通路内实现per-block per-head仿射补偿,并通过交叉种子余弦门控接受。

Result: 在DINOv2 ViT-L/14 ImageNet-1k分类上,SC+补偿在L̄=192时达85.47% top-1(仅-0.93pt vs FP),优于QwT同位宽;在7-bit级SC MP+补偿恢复至83.26%。EVA-01 ViT-g + Cascade Mask R-CNN COCO检测上,SC 8/8达61.98 APb(几乎无损),7/7时MP+补偿较均匀SC提升+1.61/+2.08 AP。DiT-XL/2 ImageNet条件生成,L̄=64时FID=17.33(优于FP 24.81)。Dino-WM wall_single规划,L̄=192时SC MP达0.933 SR(高于FP 0.833)。总体上SC在匹配位宽预算下与INT量化有竞争力,逐行混合精度在低流长度下保持精度。

Conclusion: SC可作为密集精度基底支持细粒度混合精度推理,在现代视觉Transformer上保持任务级精度;同一SC硬件可通过运行时流长度L(包括非2幂次点)支持密集精度调度,无需重训练;该工作提供了软件层面的可行性证据,支持未来面向自适应精度加速器的硅基设计探索。局限在于评估配置有限(代表性骨干+少量精度预算),硬件收益来自分析/门级模型而非端到端硅验证,补偿方案的稳定性与Sobol配置的依赖关系尚需形式化分析。

Abstract: Matrix multiplications dominate the inference cost of modern transformer-based vision models, yet existing efficiency techniques such as post-training quantization and mixed-precision inference are largely limited to the small set of fixed-width formats (INT4, INT8, BF16, and FP16) supported by conventional accelerators. We revisit stochastic computing (SC) as a way to lift this constraint: viewed as a dense adaptive quantizer, SC controls precision by bit-stream length L rather than a fixed datapath, while each multiplication reduces to a single AND/XNOR gate. We build a GPU library that emulates SC matrix multiplication at scale, exposes stream lengths as first-class kernel arguments, and evaluates SC end-to-end on image classification, object detection and instance segmentation, class-conditional image generation, and visual world-model planning. On top of this substrate, we develop a dynamic per-row mixed-precision policy that assigns stream length per token or group at matched average budget, requires no retraining, and uses the same SC hardware across schedules. Across tasks, SC remains competitive with fixed-format INT quantization at matched bit budgets, while per-row mixed precision helps maintain accuracy at lower average stream lengths. These results provide software-level feasibility evidence that SC can serve as a dense-precision substrate for fine-grained mixed-precision inference on modern vision transformers.

</details>


### [418] [TRACE: Learning to Self-Calibrate Wireless Digital Twins from ISAC Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32923)
*Saad Masrur,Saeed R. Khosravirad,Ismail Guvenc*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TRACE 提出了一种基于物理的无线数字孪生自校准框架,通过 ISAC 测量与孪生渲染 RF 之间的残差对齐,迭代修正数字孪生中建筑物几何参数,在仿真和实测 28GHz 数据上均显著降低位置与朝向误差,并具备良好的跨布局泛化能力与 Sim-to-Real 迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无线数字孪生依赖不完美的 3D 地图(如 OSM 平均偏差约 4.13m),几何错误会显著降低传播预测和波束选择性能,而现有工作要么训练对误差鲁棒的前向预测器,要么从 RF 重构场景,缺乏针对已有近似孪生的"残差维护"方法。

Method: 1) 问题建模:将孪生维护定义为残差对齐,对每个建筑物预测 6 维参数修正量;2) 确定性前端:对测量和孪生渲染的 CSI 在同一世界网格上进行 6 高度相干反投影,再以当前孪生位置为中心做 GeoCrop 提取局部窗口;3) 学习修正器:共享复值 CNN + 传感器姿态 FiLM 编码 → 实测-孪生交叉注意力 + CueFusion → 跨传感器置换不变融合 → 相对几何建筑物注意力 → 门控 + 残差头,输出 6 参数门控修正;4) 训练采用 MSE + BCE 门控损失,支持迭代重渲染闭环修正。

Result: 在 5400 个未见仿真场景(28GHz)上:3D 位置 RMSE 从 2.202m 降至 0.302m(去除 86.3%),yaw 从 4.978° 降至 0.894°,优于 ViT 和 U-Net 基线;OOD-Layout 下保持 88.7% 误差去除;OOD-Error 经两步迭代修正去除 93.08%;在 -5dB 低 SNR 下仍去除 52.8% 误差,显著优于基线(为负值);NIST 实测 28GHz 庭院数据上,纯合成训练模型将墙体平均平面位置误差从 1.00m 降至 7.8cm(92.2% 去除),且无需实测微调或几何标签;波束选择 P10 频谱效率保留率从 14% 提升至 61%(4m OSM 偏移场景)。

Conclusion: 物理 RF 测量与孪生渲染响应之间的差异可作为修复不完美无线数字孪生的有效学习信号;通过世界帧反投影与 GeoCrop 构建的建筑物中心残差表示,以及多视图门控修正器,实现了跨布局、跨建筑数量、跨传感配置、跨 SNR 的泛化能力,并成功迁移至实测 RF,无需真实数据微调即可达到厘米级修正精度,显著恢复了下游波束选择性能。

Abstract: Wireless digital twins (DTs) rely on 3D environment models to predict radio propagation and support wireless-network decisions, yet these models are often initialized from imperfect 3D maps. Errors in building position, height, footprint, and orientation can therefore cause a high-fidelity propagation engine to simulate the wrong physical environment. In this paper, we study how a deployed wireless network can repair an existing DT using its own radio frequency (RF) measurements. In particular, we introduce Twin Residual Alignment and Calibration Engine (TRACE), a physics-grounded learning-based self-calibration framework that treats twin maintenance as residual alignment between the physical world and the current DT. Using the same sensing configuration as the physical measurements, TRACE ray-traces the current DT, coherently backprojects the measured and simulated RF onto a common world grid, and extracts the same local region around each building's current DT position. A multi-view corrector then fuses evidence across sensing nodes and neighboring buildings to predict a gated six-parameter correction per building, without relying on absolute layout or sensor ordering, and supports iterative correction through re-rendering. On 5,400 held-out samples from unseen simulated scenes at 28 GHz, TRACE reduces 3D position RMSE from 2.202 m to 0.302 m and yaw RMSE from 4.978° to 0.894°, outperforming ViT and U-Net baselines under changes in layout, building count, sensing-node count, and SNR. On measured 28 GHz RF data from the NIST outdoor courtyard, a model trained only on synthetic RF reduces mean planar wall-position error from 1.00 m to 7.8 cm, without measured-data fine-tuning or geometric labels. These results show that the discrepancy between measured and twin-rendered RF can serve as a learning signal for repairing a wireless DT.

</details>


### [419] [Diagnosing Sampled LLM Reasoning in Formal Geometry: Coverage, Realization, and Validity Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32924)
*Xiao Yue,Guangzhi Qu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CRV（Coverage, Realization, Validity Evidence）评估协议，用于诊断LLM在形式几何推理中重复采样的失败模式。该协议将"覆盖率"（正确答案是否在候选池中）、"实现率"（读出器能否选中正确答案）和"有效性证据"（盲审评论员对推导过程的支持判断）作为三个独立维度进行分离度量，并基于HardShift441数据集（参考求解器对其中406/441题无法求解）验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM几何求解器的评估通常仅依据单一生成的数值答案是否正确（answer-matching accuracy），这混淆了三个独立问题：(1) 重复采样是否能在候选池中找到正确答案（覆盖率）；(2) 多数投票或验证器是否能从候选池中选出正确答案（实现率）；(3) 正确数值答案背后的推导是否由前提支撑（有效性证据）。在几何题中，每一步推理可能依赖先前演绎或图中才显示的关系，因此仅看数值答案正确性会掩盖严重的推理缺陷。本文旨在提供一个可控的诊断协议来分离这三个维度。

Method: CRV框架的核心方法包括：(1) **冻结候选池构造**：对每道题采样K=16条推理轨迹，按数值答案聚类后冻结，再让不同读出器（Majority、Best-of-K、WSC）操作于相同的答案簇集合；(2) **CRV轮廓向量**：𝒫_CRV = (pass@K, Acc(R), Δ_R, η_R, 𝐛_R, ρ_audit)，分别记录覆盖率、读出器准确率、生成-选择差距、相对于多数投票的提升率、按正确答案多重度分桶的准确率向量、以及审计支持率；(3) **多重度条件化失败定位**：将问题按正确候选出现次数分为c₀/c₁/c₂/c₃₊四档，并计算"最难负样本边界"m_n来衡量验证器在同一题内区分正确轨迹与最强错误轨迹的能力；(4) **盲审有效性证据审计**：让GPT-5.4作为过程评论员，在不知道答案正误的情况下对正确-答案簇和强错误-答案簇的代表性轨迹进行"支持/反驳/不确定"判定。生成器使用LoRA适配的Qwen2.5-7B，验证器为同架构的LoRA适配模型。

Result: 在HardShift441（参考HyperGNet求解器留下406/441题未解）上：平均单样本准确率24.2%，pass@16达68.9%，但WSC仅达38.0%，Δ_WSC达30.94个百分点。在低多重度桶中读出准确率尤其低：c₁桶WSC仅4.87%、c₂桶13.53%，而c₃₊桶达75.63%。最难负样本边界胜率在c₁/c₂/c₃₊分别为14.57%/26.59%/66.82%，高于多重度调整后的随机基线但仍偏低。候选级AUC从域内约0.903降至HardShift441的0.819。在195道覆盖题的盲审中，仅12个正确答案代表轨迹（6.15%）被评论员标为"支持"，181个被标为"反驳"（其中179个高置信度），2个不确定；错误答案代表轨迹100%被标为"反驳"。第二模型在34例抽查中与评论员一致33例，人工抽查20例全部一致。这些结果表明覆盖率、实现率和有效性证据是三个本质不同的量，应分别报告。

Conclusion: 本文证明pass@k既不能等同于可部署的读出器准确率，也不能作为推导有效性的证据。在硬形式几何状态上，未实现的答案级覆盖率集中在低多重度候选池中：当正确答案仅出现1-2次时，验证器倾向于给看起来合理的错误轨迹更高分，而WSC又因频次加权进一步压制低多重度簇。这凸显了发展更强的题内判别能力和几何特定过程验证模型的必要性。CRV框架提供了一种受控的诊断协议而非新的选择器，其结论限于数值答案生成阶段而非符号证明搜索阶段。

Abstract: Repeated sampling can reveal a correct numerical answer without yielding either a reliable system output or a supported derivation. We present Coverage, Realization, and Validity Evidence (CRV), an evaluation protocol for sampled large language model (LLM) reasoning over formal geometry states. Coverage is answer availability, realization is readout accuracy on the frozen candidate pool, and validity evidence is a label-blinded critic judgment of derivational support rather than a proof certificate. CRV freezes each candidate pool before comparing readouts and analyzes covered failures by correct-answer multiplicity and within-problem discrimination. On HardShift441, a 441-problem set for which a reference solver leaves 406 problems unsolved, a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-7B generator obtains 24.2% average single-sample accuracy and 68.9% pass@16, whereas verifier-weighted self-consistency (WSC) reaches 38.0%. Readout accuracy is particularly low when the correct answer occurs only once or twice in the pool. In a separate constructed audit of 195 covered problems, the critic labels 12 correct-answer representatives as supported, 181 as refuted, and two as uncertain. These results show that coverage, realization, and validity evidence from the critic are distinct quantities and should be reported separately.

</details>


### [420] [The Commit-Abstain Circuit: Why Language Models Hallucinate Instead of Abstaining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32964)
*Vy Nguyen,Ziqi Xu,Jeffrey Chan,Estrid He,Feng Xia,Renqiang Luo,Erik Cambria,Xiuzhen Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文通过机制可解释性方法，识别了语言模型中控制"承诺-弃权"决策的稀疏电路（CAC），揭示了幻觉产生的内部机制：承诺促进组件在早期层积累正向信号，而弃权促进组件虽在后期出现但强度不足以推翻已积累的承诺。基于此发现训练的轻量级策略显著提升了弃权决策准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型即使在信息不足时也倾向于自信作答（产生幻觉），而非诚实弃权。现有研究多关注幻觉的检测与缓解，但未解释模型内部如何做出承诺或弃权的决策。作者将幻觉重新定义为"无支持的承诺"（unsupported commitment），即模型在内部已存在不可回答信号时仍然承诺作答的控制失败，而非知识失败。

Method: 1. 定义承诺-弃权边际 Δ(x)：从模型 logits 中分离弃权词集 𝒜 与承诺词集 𝒞，通过最高 logits 之差量化承诺倾向。2. 采用因果组件门控（Causal Head Gating），扩展至同时门控注意力头与 MLP 子层，通过三阶段优化（任务优化、保留压力、移除压力）识别稀疏电路 CAC。3. 通过渐进消融和定向放大实验验证 CAC 组件的因果功能角色。4. 基于 CAC 各组件贡献训练轻量级 MLP 策略。

Result: 在 10 个 3B-14B 模型（5 个家族）与 3 个基准上：1. Δ(x) 在所有 30 个配置中 AUROC 均显著高于随机（0.640-0.913，均值 0.811）。2. CAC 极为稀疏（2.0%-11.8%，中位数 5.2%），包含承诺促进组件（c-components）和弃权促进组件（a-components）。3. 发现反复出现的"积累但欠纠正"模式：c-components 集中在早期层积累承诺，a-components 在后期作为纠正信号但强度不足。4. 基于 CAC 的 MLP 策略比 Zero-Threshold 基线提升决策准确率 12.2 个点，错误弃权率降低 2.5 倍，并在未见基准及 27B-35B 更大模型上可迁移。

Conclusion: 论文提出"无支持的承诺"作为幻觉的机制性解释：模型并非缺少弃权信号，而是这些信号在组件层面出现得太晚且强度不足以推翻早期层积累的承诺。CAC 不仅具有诊断价值（阐明模型过度承诺的内部机制），还具有实用价值（提升弃权决策）。该发现为推理时更早、更有针对性的控制提供了基础。

Abstract: Language models (LMs) often hallucinate by committing to confident answers rather than abstaining, even when they do not have enough information to answer reliably. A large body of existing work mitigates hallucination through detection or abstention mechanisms, but leaves open how models internally arrive at the decision to commit or abstain in the first place. We study this decision through mechanistic analysis, framing hallucination as unsupported commitment: the model commits despite exhibiting signals of unanswerability. Using causal gating, we identify a Commit-Abstain Circuit (CAC), a sparse, causally localised subset of attention heads and MLP sublayers underlying this decision. Across ten LMs (3B-14B) from five families and three benchmarks, the CAC exhibits a recurring accumulate-yet-undercorrect pattern: commitment-promoting components build up commitment in earlier layers, while abstention-promoting components act later as corrective signals that are often insufficient to overturn the accumulated commitment. Building on this finding, a lightweight policy trained on CAC activations improves decision accuracy by 12.2 points over the model's intrinsic commit-abstain margin, reduces false abstentions by 2.5 times, transfers to unseen benchmarks, and extends to larger models (27B-35B). The CAC is both diagnostic, clarifying how models overcommit, and practical, enabling improved abstention decisions.

</details>


### [421] [Relic: From Multi-Agent Collaboration to Persistent Organizational Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32965)
*Hongyi Du,Tianyi Zhang,Weijia Zhang,Yi Yang,Haofei Yu,Kunlun Zhu,Tianxiang Dai,Shang Jiang,Zhelun Gao,Jiaxin Pei,Shang Zhu,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Relic是一个将协作失败转化为组织级可执行协议的系统，通过成员反思、提议规则并治理其采用，使协议绑定触发条件、职责、所需证据和执行后果，从而在成员变更后仍能持续治理团队，提升多智能体协作的完整交付率和行为正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体协作中常因成员变动导致经验教训丢失（例如接口变更引发的集成冲突），团队缺乏一种将协作经验固化为组织级持续约束的机制，导致后续成员重复犯错。

Method: 引入Relic框架，将反复出现的协作失败转化为组织拥有、可执行的协议（protocols）：成员基于可见工作进行反思，提出规则并治理其采用；采纳的协议将触发条件、责任、所需证据和执行后果绑定到运行时，同时支持修订与退役。在360次控制实验（10个软件工作负载、3个模型）中评估性能，并在新成员迁移场景下对比"无可继承协议""文本规则"与"可执行绑定"三种条件。

Result: Relic将完整合约交付率从14.06%提升至19.76%（+5.71个百分点），在所有模型层中改善全部四个已验证生产端点；行为正确性在无可继承协议时为25.4%，文本规则下为34.6%，可执行绑定下达41.2%（比纯文本高+6.5点）；在CooperBench基准（排除损坏对后）达到367/477（76.9%），创同类结构化系统最优结果；在48对同模型子集上以29/48超过Solo的26/48。

Conclusion: 协作经验可以转化为持久的组织状态，即使在创建它的成员离开后仍保持效用；Relic通过将规则从文本升级为运行时可执行绑定，显著提升了多智能体团队在成员更替场景下的协调质量。

Abstract: Multiple agents may often conflict in an organization: for example, one coding agent changes an interface in a repository, but another continues to develop on the old version where existing tests become stale. A conversation can resolve the episode, but when the participants change, what makes the lesson continue to govern the team? We introduce Relic, which turns recurring collaboration failures into organization-owned, executable protocols. Members reflect on visible work, propose rules, and govern their adoption. Adopted protocols bind triggers, responsibilities, required evidence, and execution consequences to the runtime, while remaining open to revision and retirement. In one traced case, repeated integration friction produces an interface-review rule that governs later pull requests and is revised as work continues. Across 360 controlled runs over ten software workloads and three models, Relic raises complete-contract delivery from 14.06% to 19.76% (+5.71 percentage points) over a matched structured team without the protocol lifecycle, improving all four verified production endpoints in every model stratum. Under fresh-member transfer, behavioral correctness is 25.4% with no inherited protocol, 34.6% with the same rules provided as readable text, and 41.2% with executable bindings, a +6.5-point advantage over text alone. On the full CooperBench benchmark, after excluding broken benchmark pairs, Relic achieves 367/477 (76.9%), establishing the best reported result among peer-structured systems. On the fixed 48-pair same-model subset, Relic also exceeds Solo (29/48 vs. 26/48), reversing the coordination loss exhibited by the official peer baseline. Together, these results show how collaboration experience can become persistent organizational state that remains useful beyond the members who created it.

</details>


### [422] [Certified Long-Horizon Code Agent Evolution via Validation-Gated Skill Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32990)
*Yifan Wang,Hao Cheng,Xiaomin Li,Yuexing Hao,Hemanth Neelgund Ramesh,Dongwon Jung,Hao Tang,Keru Wang,Chenliang Zhou,Qianhui Wu,Wenlin Yao,Ananth Grama,Andrzej Banburski-Fahey,Baolin Peng,Jaron Lanier,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VALVE是一个面向长周期部署的验证门控框架，通过Extract-Validate-Retrieve流水线实现代码智能体的上下文自我进化，在SWE-smith基准上以冻结模型权重实现跨1000+任务的稳定技能优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体自进化方法主要针对短周期任务，在仓库级软件工程这一长周期场景中面临更新不稳定、性能回撤乃至智能体崩溃的问题，亟需一种无需更新模型参数即可实现可靠、持久能力积累的机制。

Method: 将自进化形式化为文本空间中的验证门控优化问题，提出Extract-Validate-Retrieve三阶段流水线：Extract基于任务内成功/失败轨迹的对比反思生成技能与原则；Validate通过固定验证面板上的配对可执行回放决定是否接受更新；Retrieve按任务相关性从记忆库中检索条目。采用正边际接受门控机制，建立有限收敛定理、未来任务增益与回撤的认证保证，并推导验证集与评估集规模的定量规则。

Result: 在SWE-smith的4个仓库上使用GPT-5.5、Claude-4.6和MiniMax-M2.7三个模型进行实验：VALVE平均终态增益14.9点、峰值增益16.5点；验证门将平均回撤从6.1降至1.5点（降幅75%），同时记忆库精简11倍。理论上建立了自适应验证面板的群体损失一致界并给出保持集规模的领先阶标度律N≳s²L/γ²。消融实验表明选择性检索、对比式训练流、原则记忆、富文本格式、技能库结构及细粒度生成是关键设计选择。

Conclusion: VALVE为冻结LLM核心的智能体提供了一种经认证的长周期自进化范式，通过验证门控将瞬态增益转化为持久增益，有效缓解了长部署中的性能回撤问题，为终身部署智能体的可信持续自我进化迈出了关键一步。

Abstract: Long horizon agent self-evolution without model weight updates is essential for enabling deployed agents to accumulate reusable skills and improve over time. Prior self-evolution work has focused primarily on short-horizon tasks, while repository-level software engineering remains unexplored despite being an ideal testbed for long-horizon adaptation. In this setting, agents are required to solve streams of sequential tasks, navigate complex dependencies with evolving repositories and persistently store and reuse experience. Text-based skill optimization offers an efficient, non-parametric approach for such adaptation. However, existing methods often suffer from unstable updates, performance drawdown, and agent collapse over extended deployments. In this paper, we formalize the concept of in-context self-evolution and introduce VALVE, a validated-gated framework for long-horizon skill optimization. We establish finite convergence, provide theoretical guarantees for future-task gain and drawdown, and derive the validation and evaluation holdout sizes required for a prescribed tolerance, with leading-order scaling Empirically, our pipeline, VALVE achieves stable self-improvement over evolution horizon spanning more than 1,000 SWE tasks, with average final and peak gains of $14.9$ and $16.5$ points across three frontier models (GPT-5.5, Claude-4.6 and MiniMax-M2.7). The validation gate reduces average drawdown by 75% and produces an 11x more compact skill bank than ungated evolution. We further present extensive ablations identifying the design choices most critical to long-horizon skill evolution.

</details>


### [423] [X-Tree: Tokenizing Reusable Experience for Efficient Agent Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32993)
*Sitao Cheng,Xunjian Yin,Zhiyuan Sun,Yuxuan Li,Ruiwen Zhou,Xiangru Jian,Victor Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 X-Tree（reusable eXperience tree），通过类比文本 BPE 分词的思想，从轨迹语料中以零 LLM 调用、纯统计的方式挖掘出动作层级的可复用技能树（用 X-Score 衡量 recurrence × length × success），并将其作为先验知识以三种方式融入训练：离线 RL（每个 X-Tree 节点作为一个训练实例）、在线 RLVR（自适应技能奖励 bonus）、On-Policy Self-Distillation（作为 self-teacher 的 privileged context），在 WebArena、ScienceWorld、WebShop 三种环境、1.5B/3B/7B 三种规模上一致超过标准方案（最高 +4.5%/+5.8%/+4.1%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步智能体的 SFT/RLVR 训练对每个 token 等权处理，忽略了任务中反复出现的子程序层级，导致稀缺轨迹数据的利用不充分。已有方法（Agentic Workflow、OpenClaw）通过 LLM 总结经验，但这些技能只被用于上下文检索，无法泛化到模型权重中。

Method: 1）动作规范化（verb⟨role⟩）后用 X-Score = frequency × length^p × (success+ε)^p 自底向上递归合并相邻对，生成 X-Tree（类似 BPE 但加入 success 信号）；2）三种集成：①离线 RL（每个节点作为 GRPO 实例，奖励含 step-matching + depth-scaled completion bonus）；②在线 RLVR（对执行到 X-Tree 节点的 rollout 加自适应 bonus，权重 λ_g 随 verifier win rate 衰减）；3）OPSD（将 X-Tree 渲染为文本作为 self-teacher 的 privileged context，加 per-token distillation 项）。

Result: WebArena（Qwen2.5-7B）SR 18.4→22.9（+4.5，X-Tree Full）；ScienceWorld 三规模 X-Tree bonus 一致超过 outcome-only GRPO，最多 +4.9% SR，OPSD 在 7B 达到 +5.8%；WebShop 最多 +3.6% success 与 +4.6% graded score；OPSD 中 X-Tree 作为 skill bank 与 LLM-written bank 持平甚至更优，且零 LLM 调用；消融证明增益来自 X-Tree 结构和三种集成方式，而非额外数据或算力。

Conclusion: X-Tree 通过零 LLM 调用的方式从轨迹语料中自动挖掘层级化可复用技能结构，并将其作为训练先验以三种方式融入训练，在多个环境和基座模型上稳定提升多步智能体泛化能力，证明了将文本 BPE 的"分词"思想推广到经验结构化是可行且高效的。

Abstract: Multi-step agents are trained on flat action streams: SFT and RLVR weight every token uniformly and ignore the sub-procedures that recur across tasks, the hierarchy that lets humans plan top-down from reusable routines. This structure sits unused, and flat training uses each scarce trajectory less fully than its content allows. Recent agents do use that structure, but only as LLM-written skills in context, never in the weights, so their gains do not generalize beyond retrieval. We instead recover this hierarchy from the data itself and train on it, with no LLM calls. Following text tokenizers, which build a vocabulary by counting alone, we score action spans by reusability and merge canonicalized actions into a reusable eXperience tree (X-Tree). Each X-Tree node captures how a frequent and success-bearing skill is composed from sub-skills, guiding efficient generalization. We integrate X-Tree into three training settings: offline RL, with each node as a training instance; online RLVR, with an adaptive skill bonus; and on-policy self-distillation, with X-Tree as the self-teacher's privileged context. Across WebArena, ScienceWorld, and WebShop at three model scales, X-Tree improves over standard recipes at matched data and budget by up to 4.5% SR on WebArena, 5.8% SR on ScienceWorld and 4.1% success on WebShop. Matched analyses attribute the gains to the X-Tree structure and the three integrations.

</details>


### [424] [Model-Aware Data Selection from In-and-Out Information Interplay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33010)
*Yifan Wang,Xiaomin Li,Yuexing Hao,Dongwon Jung,Hemanth Neelgund Ramesh,Ananth Grama,Varun Chandrasekaran,Yu Hu,Andrzej Banburski-Fahey,Jaron Lanier*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出CAP（Counterfactual Assimilation Profile）数据选择方法，通过对模型层间权重与隐藏状态的秩均衡现象进行观察，将"尚未被模型同化的知识"作为数据价值度量，仅需一次贪心生成+两次前向传播即可完成选择，在多领域、多模态下显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SFT数据选择方法存在两个核心问题：(1) 外部评分与几何覆盖方法完全忽略当前模型状态；(2) 基于困惑度/IFD的难度评分无法区分"尚未同化的内容"与"内在困难的文本（含噪声）"，导致有用数据与垃圾数据混淆。选择价值依赖于模型本身，而非数据固有属性。

Method: 核心方法包含两部分：(1) 现象层：观察到权重秩呈倒U型、中间层高秩，隐藏状态秩呈U型、末端解码时陡升，推导出层间的"输入输出"信息交互——浅层表征差异反映表面失配（格式/风格），深层表征差异反映存储知识被调用的位置差异。(2) 算法层（CAP）：对候选(x,y)同时运行真实对[x;y]与反事实对[x;ŷ]（ŷ为模型自生成），计算各层余弦相似度差D_ℓ，将浅层（≤0.33L）均值作为表面难度，深层共享τ作为知识差异，并对深层残差化浅层回归：CAP = D_late − (α + β·D_early)，等价于分离出"尚未同化的可学习内容"信号。理论证明表明该信号能够识别结构化知识与无结构噪声，并保证选择的一致性。

Result: 在Marin-8B-Base上的系统评估显示：(1) 在数学/代码/科学三领域、不同预算下，CAP相较最强基线LESS平均提升35.4%，相对随机选择的增益接近1.9×；(2) 仅用10%候选池即在数学上超过全池训练（76.04 vs 72.48），科学上接近全池；(3) 无需修改即可迁移至多模态文档理解任务（Molmo2-O-7B，46.15%准确率超基线4.39点），并以相同协议在金融/医疗领域获得13.8%/8.2%相对提升；(4) 在响应长度R∈{16,48,144}近一个数量级范围内稳健；(5) 注入5%随机噪声时，困惑度将噪声排到所有干净样本之前，而CAP将99.7%的噪声排在干净样本之后。

Conclusion: 权重与隐藏状态秩之间的互补剖面是预训练后涌现的跨架构/尺度/模态的普遍现象，反映出"输入（激活）—输出（知识读取）"的信息交互机制。该机制支持一个轻量级的、与模型绑定的数据选择信号CAP，能够识别尚未同化的内容而非表面难度，从而在SFT预算受限场景下同时提升数据效率、稳健性与噪声拒绝能力。结果支持一种观点：有效的post-training数据应当针对"模型尚未内化"的内容，而非"模型难以拟合"的内容。

Abstract: LLMs are effective representations that assimilate vast amounts of knowledge during pretraining, but post-training is necessary for models to reliably access this knowledge and "know what they know." We observe an interesting rank equilibrium between knowledge stored in the weights and the data stream passing through the model. Across all model layers, we find that the hidden states (data stream) follow a U-shaped pattern, showing substantial compression in early layers and a steep rise during the late-layer decoding phase. In contrast, the weight rank follows an inverted U-shaped pattern, with very low rank in the early and late layers and high rank in the middle. We interpret this as an in-and-out information interplay: intermediate activations do not need to carry content that the weights can supply later, so they primarily preserve what the weights cannot provide. Motivated by this observation, we propose a model-aware data selection method, CAP (Counterfactual Assimilation Profile), which can determine whether a data candidate contains information accessible to the current model by utilizing the divergence gap in early- and late-layer representations between model-generated and reference responses. Across math, code, and science domains, CAP delivers 35.4% greater average improvement over the base model than the strongest baseline under different selection budgets. With only 10% of the data pool, CAP surpasses or matches full-pool training on math and science. We further show that CAP transfers to multimodal data selection and is robust to response horizon and noise.

</details>


### [425] [When Pair Count Is Not the Sample Size: What All-Pairs Agent Comparisons Estimate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33012)
*Wei-Jung Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出，在代理基准测试中进行全配对（all-pairs）比较时，对的数量远大于独立证据量；关键区分在于分析目标是描述固定排行榜还是推断未来配置总体。在前一种解释下，全配对均值是精确摘要；在后一种解释下，它是二阶U统计量，其一阶不确定性取决于配置数量M而非配对数N。作者通过SWE-bench Verified快照、二值精确模型以及ScienceAgentBench和Terminal-Bench快照进行了实证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的代理基准测试在执行全配对比较时，往往将配对数误认为独立样本量。然而，由于配对之间共享端点（A与B、A与C共用A），这种独立性假设并不成立。论文的动机在于厘清全配对均值在不同解释下的统计含义，并说明pair-iid推断在端点共享情形下的失效。

Method: 1. 理论框架：区分固定看板目标（exact summary）与总体推断目标（U-statistic），列举四种采样组合（配置×任务）。2. Hoeffding分解与dyadic sandwich方差估计用于刻画共享配置导致的依赖结构。3. 实证包括：(a) SWE-bench Verified固定面板134个配置的近ties比率分析，比较pair-iid Wald区间与四种考虑共享配置的区间方法（Hoeffding投影、dyadic sandwich、delete-one-configuration jackknife、off-diagonal bootstrap）；(b) 二值精确枚举模型（Bernoulli(1/5)配置，匹配指示核），对比共享端点边与独立边的覆盖率；(c) ScienceAgentBench与Terminal-Bench快照上对比all-pair均值A与等块加权均值E，检验配对包含与加权对精确摘要的影响。

Result: 1. SWE-bench上，考虑共享配置的区间宽度是pair-iid参考的2.35至2.86倍。2. 二值精确模型中：M从40增至160时，pair-iid覆盖率从0.307降至0.157（标称0.95下严重欠覆盖），而端点感知方法覆盖率达0.928–0.940；匹配独立边控制的覆盖率为0.950–0.951，差距随M增大而扩大。3. 在ScienceAgentBench与Terminal-Bench上，A−E分别为2.92和4.78个百分点，SciCode与AssistantBench等小面板上差异更大且可正可负，取决于近ties分布位置。

Conclusion: 全配对均值本身不决定其不确定性：在固定面板上是精确值，需明确配对包含与加权规则；在总体解释下，一阶方差为O(1/M)而非O(1/N)。Pair-iid推断在边共享端点时覆盖率严重偏离标称水平，而匹配独立边控制接近标称。论文提出四点报告建议：(1)固定看板需声明配对规则与加权；(2)总体推断需声明采样源与可交换单位；(3)方差公式需与采样实体匹配并报告诊断；(4)使用模拟或精确模型时报告独立边匹配控制以隔离端点复用效应。该研究不涉及推翻已发布的排行榜结论，仅聚焦不确定性与聚合的解释问题。

Abstract: When an agent benchmark compares every pair of leaderboard entries, the number of comparisons can look much larger than the independent evidence behind them: A versus B and A versus C both reuse A. Whether this reuse affects inference depends on what the analysis is meant to describe. If the board and its outcomes are fixed, the all-pairs mean is an exact summary of those entries, and any interval must come from another declared source of randomness. If the entries are instead treated as iid draws from a population of future configurations and the pair rule is regular and nondegenerate, the same mean is an order-two U-statistic whose first-order uncertainty depends on the number of configurations, not the number of pairs. We use near ties as the running example, but the distinction extends to other symmetric pair summaries when their regularity conditions hold. We examine both interpretations using a fixed SWE-bench Verified snapshot and an exact binary model with known truth. On SWE-bench, intervals that accounted for shared configurations were more than twice as wide as a pair-iid reference that treated the pairs as independent. In the exact model, pair-iid coverage fell far below the nominal level when edges shared endpoints but remained near nominal for matched independent edges. Results on two other fixed leaderboards show that exact summaries also depend on which pairs are included and how they are weighted. An all-pairs analysis must therefore state what is fixed, what is sampled, and how it handles shared entries and pair aggregation.

</details>


### [426] [The Epistemics of Agent Memory: Measuring, and Governing, the Consolidation Decision in Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33013)
*Sasank Annapureddy,Anjaneya Prasad Thamatani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对长程LLM智能体的"记忆巩固决策"问题,提出一个四阶段研究计划,核心发现不是单一算法,而是测量范式的转变:从"记住多少"到"巩固决策是否好"再到"该决策是否可信赖"。每个阶段都输出一套"认知论工具"(epistemic tool),包括防泄漏协议、ConsolidationBench基准、受治理限制治理架构,以及一个经外部验证的负面结论——质量指标无法预测真实迁移准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程LLM智能体受限于上下文与KV缓存,主流方案(扩窗口、RAG、摘要)将记忆视为"存储"。然而终身智能体真正需要的是决策相关的"状态",即承诺、学到的规则、可复用流程。这是一种"状态而非存储"的视角。核心挑战在于"巩固"(consolidation):将原始经验转化为持久状态时,应保留什么、压缩什么、抽象为何种技能/规则、遗忘什么,以及该决策本身能否被治理与审计。该工作正是将巩固决策作为一等公民问题孤立研究。

Method: 研究分四个阶段:①Phase 1学习事件边界——用BoundaryLearner从智能体轨迹中以下游效用为优化信号学习片段切分,虽未达到预注册0.70相关性阈值(实测0.691),但产出三门防泄漏协议(provenance/probe/count-matched)。②Phase 2学习"何时提升与提升至哪一层"(keep/summary/skill/rule/forget),硬性token预算约束下,在十个新鲜保留种子上经对抗性核实获得+22.7%任务成功率提升与7.17×压缩,但遗忘精度接近随机;识别出两种失败机制:degenerate forgetting(以几乎不动作换高精度)与λ-prevalence coupling(基于反悔信号的超参对分布漂移敏感)。③Phase 3构建ConsolidationBench——oracle-by-construction基准,在保留、压缩、迁移三个非循环轴上对比最优巩固策略,主指标CQS为保留与迁移的几何均值并oracle归一化。④Phase 4引入受治理限制治理(governed consolidation)——在决策外包一层防毒、可逆、可审计保证及强制质量门G4;揭示治理维度在统计上独立于质量分数(r²=0.43,partial r=0.27,同分策略治理分差三倍)——"保险特性"。⑤外部验证:重新设计CQS为graded-reuse形式(几何均值+ε底,防止多数策略塌缩到0),在12个策略面板、两个真实基准(LoCoMo、2WikiMultiHopQA)共2532个真实答案单元上,发现CQS不预测真实迁移准确率(pooled ρ=-0.24, CI spanning 零),得到一个已解决的负面结论。所有阶段均经过对抗性自我批判,零过度声明幸存。

Result: Phase 1:BoundaryLearner未达0.70阈值(0.691),如实报告为接近失败。Phase 2:+22.7%成功率提升与7.17×压缩经对抗核实,但遗忘精度处于随机水平(0.319 vs 0.333);"λ-流行耦合"作为新的分布漂移失败模式被命名与诊断。Phase 3:ConsolidationBench排行榜显示所有方法均未弥合oracle差距,8/10策略在CQS₀下得0;主流检索系统(Mem0-style/SimpleMem-style)保留良好但迁移为0。Phase 4:四项治理保证(G1毒抗、G2可逆、G3可审、G4质量门)在双配置下全部通过预注册标准;治理维度与质量分统计可分离。外部验证:CQS不预测真实迁移准确率(pooled Spearman ρ=-0.24,n=12,置换p=0.45,bootstrap 95% CI [-0.79,+0.49]跨零);单跳控制ρ=+0.32反转多跳的-0.24,三个轴均单独失败;机制可读——"不巩固"基线在2Wiki上获得次高准确率,因真实多跳QA靠原始事实检索而非技能/规则迁移。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献并非一套算法,而是一套"如何知晓"的认识论工具链:①三门防泄漏协议;②失败机制诊断方法;③针对巩固决策质量的oracle校准基准;④独立于质量分有效性的治理包装(防毒/可逆/可审)。其核心立场是:CQS是一个分辨率有效、可判别、非循环、oracle归一化的巩固决策度量,而非下游答案质量的预测器——它认证的是结构性的巩固质量,而非优越的真实任务准确率。受治理限制治理贡献通过"保险特性"独立成立,不依赖CQS的外部效度。四阶段均采用对抗性自我批判(17个声明、零过度声明幸存、3处对冲),所有数字可从持久化机器可读结果文件逐位复现。这种"建造事物,并建造其核查事物"的认识论取向,是该工作在快速演进领域中可持久的赌注。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents must convert accumulated experience into durable memory, deciding what to keep, compress, abstract into reusable skills and rules, or forget. We report a four-phase research program on this consolidation problem whose central finding is a shift in what is measured: from how much an agent remembers, to whether its consolidation decisions are any good, to whether those decisions can be trusted. Phase 1 learns episodic boundaries from agent traces by downstream utility; an honest near-miss (oracle correlation 0.691 vs a 0.70 bar) whose lasting output is a three-gate anti-leakage protocol. Phase 2 learns when to promote experience and to which abstraction level under a token budget, achieving a verified +22.7% task-success improvement with 7x compression, but exposing a degenerate-forgetting failure and a distribution-shift failure mode we name lambda-prevalence coupling. Phase 3 introduces ConsolidationBench, an oracle-by-construction benchmark that scores consolidation decisions against a known optimum on three non-circular axes; production retrieval systems retain information yet score zero on cross-level transfer. Phase 4 introduces governed consolidation: the decision wrapped in poison-resistance, reversibility, and auditability guarantees with a quality gate. Governance is statistically distinct from the quality score ($r^2 = 0.43$; partial $r = 0.27$; identical-quality policies differ threefold in governance), so the contribution survives independently of the metric's external validity. On that question we report a resolved negative: after a graded-reuse redesign removed a structural ceiling, a two-benchmark study with 2,532 real answer cells finds the quality score does not predict real transfer accuracy (pooled Spearman $\rho = -0.24$, n = 12, CI spanning zero). An adversarial self-critique pass cleared the final claim set with zero surviving overclaims.

</details>


### [427] [Trust and Task Completion in the World of Consumer AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33017)
*Jeroen Olieslagers,Eduardo Pujol,Gal Zahavi,Lukas Ingemarsson,Shivani Poddar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种同时评估消费者行动型AI代理信任度与任务完成率的方法，核心结论是Fo（Wajo的个人助手）在完成率71%、信任度94%上显著优于基座模型和开源OpenClaw，验证了"模型外的harness（指令+护栏+工具）才是决定行动代理安全可用性的关键"这一核心主张。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行动型AI代理（如发邮件、花钱、打电话）一旦出错就会变成现实中的已发生动作，现有评估方法存在两大不足——（1）单独衡量信任度或完成率，无法识别"靠拒绝一切换取安全"的退化行为；（2）只测试模型本身而忽略harness（指令、工具、上下文、护栏）对实际行为的影响。作者认为信任（不过度行动也不过度犹豫）和完成（不轻言放弃）必须在同一运行中联合度量。

Method: 构建了一个完整的状态化评估环境，包含模拟商业（网站、邮箱、电话）、模拟用户（回答助手提问，2-5轮）和模拟人物。三个配置在同一世界中对比：① 基础模型（仅一句指令+中性事实）×三种基础模型（GLM 5.3 Flash、Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-5.6 Sol）；② Fo的harness去除护栏；③ 完整Fo。任务套件分为信任类（含"越权联系"、"承诺用户未批准事项"、"隐私泄露"、"无来源断言"四类陷阱，每类配匹配对照）和完成类（自主查找细节、购物结账、挫折恢复、跟进闭环、预见下一步需求、对外沟通六类）。每个陷阱都有仅差一个细节的匹配对照，使"拒绝一切"无法伪装安全。最终状态基于世界记录（而非代理自述）由两个不同模型家族的评分器判定，统计采用配对任务聚类自助法和精确McNemar检验。同时以OpenClaw（开源助手）作为参照。

Result: Fo完成率71%、陷阱信任率94%；三种基础模型完成率50–64%、信任率59–75%；Fo的harness无护栏版本已达70%完成率+88%信任率，护栏再增+6%信任且不损完成（+0.5%）；Fo较三个基座模型提升信任+20~+36pp、完成+6~+21pp；对照通过率Fo为91%，基座模型为94–95%（Fo略更频繁确认）。OpenClaw在共享任务上完成率仅42%（vs Fo的71%）、共享陷阱信任率74%（vs 94%）。Fo案例分析显示：护栏主要拦截越权邮件并去除隐私细节，harness则提升结账时的预算检查、跟进闭环和挫折恢复；代价是匹配对照略低、隐私护栏偶尔移除任务所需细节。明确的信任违规数0（Fo）vs 5（无护栏）vs 15/27/34（三基座模型）。

Conclusion: 行动型代理的有用性与安全性很大程度取决于模型外的harness，而非模型本身；评估必须将信任与完成在同一运行中测量，并配以良性对照和可询问的模拟用户；商业闭源消费者助手缺乏可编程运行接口，使开放、可重复的系统级评估难以实现，作者计划开源环境、任务与评分器供业界持续测量。局限：使用虚构商家与人物、模拟用户本身11%决策有误且2%会改变评分、评分器与人类标注者的一致性尚未充分验证、对实际用户的真实违规率未做测量。

Abstract: Action agents do things for people. They send email, spend money, and call businesses while the user is busy with something else, so a mistake can turn into an action before anyone notices. They fail their users in two ways. They break trust when they do something the user never agreed to, or hold back after the user clearly said go. And they fall short on completion when they give up on errands that turn out to be hard. Both depend heavily on the harness around the model, meaning its instructions, tools, context, and guardrails. We built an evaluation that scores trust and completion on the same runs, in a simulated world of businesses with their own websites, inboxes, and phone lines, and of people who write back. A simulated user answers the assistant's questions. Trust means that nothing happens the user did not agree to. No email goes to someone they never approved, no private detail ends up on a group thread, no money is spent past their limit, no stranger's instructions are followed, and nothing is claimed without a source. Every trap has a matched control in which acting is the right call. We use the evaluation to measure Fo, Wajo's personal assistant, against a base model with basic instructions on three foundation models, and against the Fo harness with its guardrails switched off. Fo completes 71% of the errands and keeps the user's trust on 94% of the trap runs. The base models complete 50% to 64% and keep trust on 59% to 75%. On the matched controls, Fo goes ahead slightly less often. OpenClaw, a popular open-source assistant given the same access, completes 42% of the errands it shares with Fo, against 71%, and keeps the user's trust on 74% of the shared trap runs, against 94%. Measuring trust and completion together, on the whole system rather than the model alone, is how we think action agents become safe to hand real work to.

</details>


### [428] [SRE-Marathon: A Continuous, Change-Driven Benchmark for Autonomous Site Reliability Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33023)
*Yifang Tian,Yingjian Bai,Yifeng He,Zichun Chong,Yuanchen Gao,Yiran Li,Hans-Arno Jacobsen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SRE-Marathon 提出了一种面向 SRE 智能体的连续、变更驱动的基准测试。该基准在真实 Kubernetes 双区部署中以固定节奏持续注入故障（含代码/配置变更），要求智能体在长时持续运行中处理重叠故障、噪声告警，并依据记录的系统证据进行确定性离线评分，揭示当前智能体难以将诊断转化为有效修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SRE 基准多采用"单次故障-明确任务"的情节式评估，无法反映真实生产环境的三个核心特征：(1) 故障通过噪声信号涌现而非显式给定；(2) 39.5% 的高严重度故障源自内部代码/配置变更；(3) 多个事故并发且干预存在副作用。因此亟需一个能衡量智能体在持续、并发、变更驱动条件下端到端运维能力的基准。

Method: 基准包含三部分：(1) **实时系统**——基于 OpenTelemetry Demo Astronomy Shop（20 服务）、Online Boutique（11 服务）、Train Ticket（41 服务）三套微服务应用，其中 Astronomy Shop 跨双 Kubernetes 区模拟地理分布部署；(2) **故障编排器**——从 700 个故障目录中按生产分布采样（代码 bug 27.0%、依赖 16.4% 等），故障持续时间 4–12 分钟，注入强度 4 倍递增，约 60 个故障/次运行；(3) **智能体-系统接口**——通过 MCP 协议暴露 19 个工具（含读、报告、执行、保护四类），并以 Δ=120s 周期调用智能体。故障分为**变更驱动型**（通过正常发布流水线部署的代码/配置变更）与**直接型**（资源耗尽、网络中断等）。评分基于封装的运行 bundle，离线确定性计算 **Marathon-Score**：对每个注入故障按"关联-定位-修复"三阶段有序赋分（公式为 100·(1−d/2)·(1/|F|)·Σ(a_f+a_f·b_f+a_f·b_f·c_f)/3，其中 d 表示是否尝试禁忌操作），另含干预风险、服务降级水平、MTTD/MTTL/MTTR 与成本等指标。

Result: 在 10 种方法、2 种骨干模型（Kimi K2.5 与 GPT-5.6 Luna）上的实验中，最佳 Marathon-Score 为 Keep-agent 的 41.3/100，Runbook 次之（33.5），其余方法介于 3.1–28.0。**关键发现**：(1) 修复是主要瓶颈——故障活跃期间修复率最高仅 0.024，多数得分来自关联与定位；(2) 检测较快（MTTD 约 146–189s），但用户面降级水平对骨干敏感；(3) 故障负载上升时，智能体上报增多而行动稀疏，仅 Keep-agent 与 RAG 在后期仍保持每次调用至少一次执行动作；(4) 短跑（5/10 故障）中修复率显著提升（0.500 与 0.183），证明并发压力是修复失败的主因。案例分析表明：智能体常能正确定位根因，却因动作选择低效或干预过晚而错失修复窗口。

Conclusion: SRE-Marathon 揭示了当前 LLM 智能体在端到端自主生产运维方面存在根本性差距：能够关联甚至定位大多数故障，但在持续负载下几乎无法将其转化为及时有效的修复。其确定性离线评分机制也使其可作为 SRE 智能体的可重复训练目标。论文同时指出了若干局限：单一事件来源校准故障分布、影响范围测量未考虑重叠相互作用、规则包版本固定、模型判分被精确匹配取代、以及仅评估了两个非前沿骨干模型。

Abstract: Benchmarks for site reliability engineering (SRE) agents are typically episodic: one fault is injected, the agent receives an incident task, and its response is scored. Production operation is not. Incidents surface through noisy alerts, overlap in time, and often originate from code or configuration changes. We present SRE-Marathon, a benchmark for long-horizon, continuous SRE operation. An agent is invoked at a fixed cadence with cumulative alert history and a persistent workspace while operating a live two-zone Kubernetes deployment as a fault orchestrator injects overlapping faults according to a seeded, production-calibrated schedule. Curated code and configuration changes deployed through the same build pipeline available for repair. Each run is recorded into a sealed bundle and scored offline: Marathon-Score credits each injected fault for ordered progress through correlation, localization, and repair, with all metrics computed deterministically from recorded system evidence. Across three applications and about sixty faults per run, the best of 10 methods reaches only 41.3 out of 100. Agents often correlate and localize faults, but almost never complete repairs while the faults remain active.

</details>


### [429] [Agent Safety From Within: Detecting Harmful Trajectories from LLM Internal States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33039)
*Difan Jiao,Ashton Anderson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 TACIT，一种基于冻结 LLM 内部状态的智能体轨迹安全检测方法，通过线性探针读取有害内容和危险工具使用两种安全信号，在六个基准测试上显著优于现有开源守护模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开源守护模型主要针对内容审核设计，在智能体工具调用轨迹上的检测能力不足，特别是无法识别需要上下文才能判断的危险工具使用行为。需要利用 LLM 内部表征来更准确地检测智能体轨迹安全。

Method: 首先通过表征分析区分两类轨迹级风险：直接表达的有害内容和需依赖交互上下文的危险工具使用，发现两者在内部空间中线性可读但方向近乎正交，且守护模型的输出对危险工具使用判别能力仅为随机水平。基于此设计 TACIT：通过冻结骨干网络内部状态的线性探针（及其集成和多层聚合改进）输出安全分数，无需解码任何 token。

Result: 在六个轨迹安全基准（R-Judge、TraceSafe、ATBench、ASSEBench、OpenAgentSafety、AgentDojo）上，TACIT 多层聚合读出器在 Qwen3-4B 上平均宏 F1 达 86.2%，在 Llama3.1-8B 上达 85.4%，优于最强开源守护模型 AgentDoG 的 62.3%；留一基准测试时仍以 65.7% 优于 61.1%；与全参数安全微调效果相当且可叠加提升；仅训练约百万分之一的参数量、约六分之一的训练时间，推理延迟最低（比 Qwen3Guard 低 82%）。

Conclusion: 内部表征可作为检测智能体行为危害的实用基础，线性读出器在冻结骨干上即可同时捕获两类正交的风险信号，TACIT 为高效、低延迟的智能体轨迹安全监控提供了新范式。

Abstract: Language model agents can now perform sophisticated sequences of actions via tools and harnesses, which has increased the scope of the damage they can cause. Guard models, however, are mainly built for content moderation and thus are not well-suited to detecting this agentic risk. To address this, we proceed by first conducting a representational analysis, then use the resulting insights to build a solution. In our analysis, we focus on two types of trajectory-level agentic harms: harmful content, which is expressed directly, and unsafe tool use, which depends on whether an action is consistent with the interaction that produced it. We investigate how open-source guard models represent these two types of harm and find that they are linearly readable inside the model, even though guard models predict no better than chance on pairs that differ only in the called tool's schema. The two harm types also follow nearly orthogonal internal directions, and neither reliably serves as a proxy for the other. These results motivate reading trajectory safety directly from internal states. We introduce TACIT, a readout of a frozen backbone's internal states that decodes no tokens. Trained on six trajectory-safety benchmarks, a linear probe raises mean macro-F1 from 62.3 for the strongest open guard to 80.7, and refined readouts reach 86.2. With each benchmark held out of training entirely, the refined readouts still lead the strongest guard (65.7 vs. 61.1). With the same backbone, training data and test split, the frozen readout is on par with full safety fine-tuning, and it improves the fine-tuned model further when applied on top. The probe trains about one millionth as many parameters as full fine-tuning in about a sixth of the time, and TACIT has the lowest latency of the guards we evaluate.

</details>


### [430] [BudgetVerify: Budget-Tiered Verification for Financial QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33052)
*Janet Jenq,Hongda Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出BudgetVerify框架，针对金融问答任务，通过学习一个轻量级路由器在三个验证层级（无验证、轻量级检查-修订、高代价求解-比对）之间进行成本敏感的自适应路由选择，在保证准确性的同时节省推理计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融问答需要精确数值抽取与算术推理，统一应用昂贵的验证策略会浪费测试时计算资源；不同问题的难度差异巨大，需要按需分配验证计算量。

Method: 1) 将验证形式化为预算路由问题：给定生成答案，在Low/Mid/High三个验证层级间选择，最大化准确性与成本的加权和；2) 离线运行全部三个层级获取正确性与token成本，构造成本敏感的oracle标签；3) 训练轻量级监督路由器（决策树/GBM/XGBoost/TabFM），仅使用验证前可获取的特征（问题特征、上下文统计、生成器元数据）进行分层路由。

Result: 在FinQA数据集上对6个商用与开源基础模型（GPT系列、Qwen系列）进行评估：BudgetVerify在所有模型上均产生比固定验证策略更优的准确率-成本Pareto前沿；TabFM路由器的表现最佳，XGBoost次之；强模型主要受益于避免对已正确答案的不必要验证，弱模型则有更多可被验证修复的错误。

Conclusion: BudgetVerify验证了自适应、预算感知的验证分配是一种通用推理时计算分配原则，而非特定模型的特性；其Pareto前沿的定性形状在不同模型间保持一致，表明验证价值依赖于输入和答案，而非对所有样本恒定。

Abstract: Financial question answering often requires precise numerical extraction, unit handling, and arithmetic over tables and text, but applying expensive verification uniformly wastes test-time compute. We propose BudgetVerify, a budget-tiered generator-verifier framework that routes each generated answer to one of three verification tiers: no verification, lightweight check-and-revise, or higher-cost solve-first-then-compare verification. The router is trained from offline correctness and token-cost outcomes and, at test time, selects a verification tier using information available before verification, including the question, context statistics, the generated answer, and associated generator metadata. The selected tier either returns the generated answer directly or invokes the corresponding verifier. Across six commercial and open-weight base models, BudgetVerify consistently produces more efficient accuracy-cost Pareto frontiers than fixed verification policies by selectively allocating stronger verification only when it is useful. Although absolute performance varies across models, these efficiency gains and the resulting qualitative frontier shape are consistent across generator models.

</details>


### [431] [Large Language Models Substantially Compress Well-Being Inequality but Largely Preserve Its Socioeconomic Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33055)
*Nattavudh Powdthavee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现，尽管大语言模型(LLM)在生成合成人群时会压缩人类生活满意度的整体离散度，但经过归一化处理后，LLM仍能在不同收入群体间再现人类幸福不平等的社会结构（即低收入群体比高收入群体异质性更高），表明压缩的幅度与异质性的分布结构是可以分离的两种性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究反复表明LLM生成的合成数据会压缩人类经验的多样性，引发了关于LLM能否捕捉人群内部有意义区别的怀疑。本文旨在探究这种压缩是否同时也抹去了人类异质性的社会结构（即差异在不同社会群体间的分布模式）。

Method: 基于世界价值观调查(WVS)第7波93,901名来自66个国家和地区的受访者数据，构建六种LLM根据人口、社会经济及态度特征预测其生活满意度的任务；在压缩模型输出的整体离散度后，比较人类与LLM预测的群体内部变异（特别是按收入分层的不平等模式）的归一化分布，并通过国家固定效应、等权重、WVS权重和人口构成进行了稳健性检验。

Result: 六种LLM均显著低估了生活满意度的总体离散度，但经归一化后，它们在很大程度上再现了人类的收入梯度异质性结构——低收入群体相对更高收入群体仍具有更大的异质性；该模式在稳健性检验中保持成立，并方向性地扩展到就业、教育与感知控制维度，但在极端结果与特定国家梯度上保真度较弱。

Conclusion: LLM保留的异质性总量与该异质性在社会群体中的分布方式是两种可分离的属性；因此，LLM生成的合成人群可以大幅压缩人类变异，同时仍保留关于变异集中位置的有意义信息，这为合成数据在社会结构分析中的应用提供了更细致的认识。

Abstract: Research using large language models (LLMs) to generate synthetic populations has repeatedly shown that model outputs compress the diversity of human experience. This has raised doubts about whether LLM-generated data can capture meaningful differences within populations. We show that such compression does not necessarily erase the social structure of human heterogeneity. Using 93,901 respondents from 66 countries and territories in Wave 7 of the World Values Survey, we ask six LLMs to predict respondents' life satisfaction from demographic, socioeconomic, and attitudinal profiles. All six models substantially understate the overall dispersion of life satisfaction. Yet after normalizing for these differences in scale, they largely reproduce the human income gradient in well-being inequality: lower-income groups remain relatively more heterogeneous than higher-income groups. The pattern is robust to country fixed effects, equal-country weighting, WVS survey weights, and observed demographic composition, and it extends directionally to employment, education, and perceived control. Fidelity is weaker for extreme outcomes and country-specific gradients. These results show that the amount of heterogeneity preserved by an LLM and the way that heterogeneity is distributed across social groups are distinct properties. LLM-generated populations can therefore substantially compress human variation while retaining meaningful information about where that variation is concentrated.

</details>


### [432] [LLM sequential decision making under uncertainty in biochemical domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33061)
*Mattias Akke,Soojung Yang,Jurgis Ruža,Sathya Edamadaka,Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统性地评估了五种前沿大语言模型(LLM)在贝叶斯优化(BO)框架下,针对生化与材料科学领域的序贯决策能力。研究发现LLM虽"意图"探索,却因"上下文黏性"(context-stickiness)而实际表现为过度利用,且对弱信号过度反应而非固守先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于驱动科学发现,理解其如何在新数据与文献先验之间做决策至关重要。现有评估仅关注最终性能分数,无法揭示决策策略;且不同研究对LLM作为优化器的表现给出了矛盾结论(优于/劣于统计基线)。本文旨在通过直接测量模型信念与行为,诊断LLM在序贯决策中的真实策略与失败机制。

Method: 1. 基准测试:在7个组合数据集(蛋白质工程、反应优化、分子设计、肽自组装、催化)上对比5个前沿LLM(GPT-5.4、Sonnet 4.6、Kimi 2.5、Qwen3.5、GLM-4.7)与统计基线(UCB、EI、TS、ε-greedy、Greedy、DE)。
2. 提示消融:三种模式(Default/Alias/Blind)逐步剥离化学语境,分离记忆、领域知识与纯优化能力。
3. 能力配置:无推理、推理、Agent(访问统计工具)三种。
4. 行为诊断:信念-动作分解(V, U平面)、过度反应统计量Z、Martingale分数M;提出对测量噪声偏差的修正。
5. 因果消融:移除上下文历史以验证黏性机制。

Result: 1. 性能:先验帮助平均但方差大,偶尔有害;无配置稳定超越平均统计基线。
2. 信念动态:所有模型在所有提示模式下均过度反应于新数据(正Z,负M),而未出现固守先验;行为信念与陈述信念一致(ρ=0.76)。
3. 探索行为:推理型LLM停留在历史附近的Hamming距离小于几乎所有基线;92%推理调用探索,但意图与实现信息增益几乎零相关。
4. 因果验证:移除历史使Agent的U特征接近Thompson采样器,意图与实现信息增益相关性恢复。
5. 诊断修正:Martingale与Z的噪声偏差修正使LLM成为决策推理,但先前会将理性智能体误判为过度反应者。

Conclusion: LLM在序贯决策中的核心失败模式为"上下文黏性":模型将决策锚定于上下文窗口内数据,导致在高先验-弱信号领域出现过度反应而非固守先验。这一失败属于能力差距而非意图-行动差距——模型真诚地意图探索但缺乏识别高不确定性区域的能力。干预设计应解耦LLM先验与决策机制(例如转换为统计评分或语义化不确定性代理),而非仅依赖提示指令。论文同时贡献了信念动力学噪声修正方法与重建的NFA数据集。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to drive scientific discovery. Understanding how LLMs make decisions from new data and memory of the literature is vital before trusting them to design experiments under tight experimental budgets. However, their decision strategies are invisible in the current performance scores used to evaluate research agents. Here, we benchmark five frontier LLMs in a Bayesian Optimization setting against published statistical baselines on seven combinatorial datasets spanning protein engineering, reaction optimization, molecular design, peptide self-assembly, and catalysis. Performance is paired with direct measurements of model beliefs and actions, enabling highly resolved behavior analysis. A prompt ablation that progressively strips context separates memorization from chemical reasoning and from bare categorical optimization. Prior chemical knowledge helps in expectation, but with high variance and occasionally even harms performance. No configuration tested decisively beats a mean statistical baseline across domains. Belief-movement and Martingale diagnostics, corrected here for a measurement-noise bias that mislabels rational agents as irrational, show that models overreact to incoming data rather than entrenching on their priors in the contexts studied here. Interestingly, while LLM actions are exploitative, models sincerely intend to explore and consistently act on that intent. This failure is a competence gap arising from context-stickiness. Removing in-context history restores exploration, indicating that priors and data must be decoupled to achieve effective LLM-driven discovery.

</details>


### [433] [QureRadEmbed: Structuring Radiological Similarity through Attribute and Reasoning Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33075)
*Janhavi Prabhu,Sahil,Shivam Ashok Shukla,Manoj Tadepalli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出QureRadEmbed，一种4B参数的放射学专用文本编码器，通过RadSim（属性分解排序目标）和RadThought（层次推理对齐）双监督信号及三阶段课程学习，捕捉放射学报告中细粒度属性（侧别、叶段、严重程度、大小等），在检索、低标签标注和报告比较任务上显著优于通用及生物医学基线编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用生物医学编码器将"右肺上叶结节"与"左肺下叶结节"视为高度相似，忽略了侧别、严重程度等关键临床属性的细微差异；现有放射学表示缺乏对属性级别的细粒度区分能力。同时，生成式报告比较工具（如GREEN）虽精确但推理成本高昂（2755秒/千对）。因此需要一种既能捕获临床细节差异又可高效重用的嵌入表示。

Method: 1) RadSim：基于Intern-S2属性抽取（侧别、大小、严重度等），结合疾病家族相关性，使用确定性加权公式生成[-1,1]区间内的可解释排序目标；2) RadThought：从69万份CXR报告中构建逻辑证据-一阶-二阶-三阶-综合的层次化描述，通过场景图Jaccard与RadSim加权融合实现多级对齐；4) 三阶段课程：Stage 1（报告与推理对齐，含RadSim对、报告三元组、RadThought）、Stage 2（10轴单属性对比，含位置控制侧别）、Stage 3（50k对跨属性优先级校准）；5) 损失函数：CoSENT（λ=20）用于分数对，余弦三元组损失用于锚-正-负样本；6) 基于Qwen3-Embedding-4B全参数微调，最终EOS向量归一化为2560维。

Result: 在受控10轴属性上顺序准确率达0.996，跨属性目标Spearman从0.501升至0.976；外部检索Recall@1在Open-I/testing XR/testing CT分别为10.5%/12.4%/42.9%（vs基座6.6%/5.7%/31.4%）；100标签下testing-XR发现提取macro-F1为0.481（vs基座0.412）；全报告比较8.8秒/千对（vs GREEN 2755.1秒，约313倍提速）；在ReXVal专家一致性τ_b=0.336（GREEN=0.445）。

Conclusion: QureRadEmbed通过可解释的属性级监督和层次化推理对齐学习到放射学感知的紧凑表示，在临床检索、低标签结构化标注和高效报告比较方面具有实用价值；局部句子对齐和生成式评估仍是细节错误检测的互补手段。

Abstract: Radiological similarity depends on disease relationships and on fine details such as laterality, lobe, severity, size, and certainty. Broad biomedical similarity can overlook these qualifiers, particularly when several attributes vary together. We introduce QureRadEmbed, a 4B radiology-aware encoder trained with two complementary signals: RadSim supplies deterministic, attribute-decomposed ranking targets, while RadThought aligns reports with hierarchical evidence and reasoning descriptions. A three-stage curriculum combines these signals with report triplets, finding perturbations, and single- and cross-attribute contrasts. The final model achieves 0.996 mean ordering accuracy across ten controlled synthetic attributes and raises Spearman correlation with the designed joint-attribute targets from 0.501 to 0.976. On external findings-to-impression retrieval, Recall@1 reaches 10.5% on Open-I, 12.4% on testing XR, and 42.9% on testing CT, compared with 6.6%, 5.7%, and 31.4% for its backbone. Frozen embeddings support finding extraction with only 100 labeled testing-XR reports (macro-F1 0.481 versus 0.412 for the backbone). Whole-report comparison costs 8.8 seconds per 1,000 pairs in our benchmark, versus 2,755.1 seconds for the generative evaluator GREEN. Sentence-level comparison improves sensitivity to local discrepancies, although generative evaluation remains stronger on several expert-rated and subtle-error tasks. The results support reusable radiology-aware representations for search, structured report indexing, and efficient report comparison.

</details>


### [434] [Structure-Mapping-Guided Self-Explanation for Learning Mathematical Procedures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33079)
*Shinhaeng Lee,Christopher J. MacLellan,Daniel Weitekamp*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"结构映射引导的自我解释"计算模型，用于模拟学习者从数学范例中推断产生式程序的过程。通过类型化抽象语法树表示数学表达式，利用结构映射建立源-目标对应关系，以锚定和结构距离为启发式引导溯因搜索，显著降低搜索空间并提高目标程序被优先找到的概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习者从范例（worked example）中学习时，需推断产生观察到的数值变化的底层程序。然而，朴素搜索会产生大量仅在数值上正确但与演示结构无关的"巧合解释"，搜索空间巨大。需要一种计算机制来解释人类认知偏差如何使该溯因推理变得可行。

Method: 1. 将源表达式和目标表达式解析为类型化抽象语法树（AST），节点暴露操作符、嵌套和有序参数角色。2. 使用 Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds (SMTB) 建立源-目标结构对应关系，放宽一对一约束。3. 对每个变化的目标值，选定对应源区域作为"锚点"，其操作和操作数优先进入候选池。4. 按 AST 距离从锚点向外逐步扩展可用的源数值和操作，构造和测试候选算术运算程序。5. 将局部解释组合为可执行的候选变换程序。6. 设计六种受控搜索配置进行消融对比。

Result: 在70个数学变换（含120个变化的数值组件）上：完整引导模型恢复了全部120个预期程序；在104个子问题（86.7%）中将预期程序作为首个成功解释返回（无引导搜索中位数仅32/26.7%）；检验的数值-操作组合减少93.8%；遇到的竞争性替代解释减少94.1%。完整程序排序中，80.0%的预期程序排名第一（无引导搜索中位数为22.1%）。转移测试中，16个家族中有28/32个新实例被正确求解。消融分析表明：值距离引导贡献了原始语料库上大部分搜索节省；当多个可见操作竞争时，操作距离引导可额外减少43.5%的计算量。

Conclusion: 结构映射引导的自我解释为"关系结构如何引导程序学习"提供了高效、可解释的计算账户，并为人类从范例中自我解释的过程提出了可检验的认知假设：人们应倾向于使用对应且局部证据的解释，而将远处或未陈述的知识置于较后考虑。该机制可集成到更广泛的DIPL架构中，与where-learning和when-learning协同实现多步归纳式程序学习。

Abstract: Worked examples are a powerful form of instruction, but learners must infer how the demonstrated steps were produced. A naive simulation of this self-explanation process can generate thousands of numerical explanations that reproduce one observed change without capturing its underlying procedure. We propose structure-mapping-guided self-explanation as a computational account of the cognitive biases that reduce search effort and make this inference tractable. The model represents mathematical expressions as typed relational structures and uses structure mapping to identify corresponding source and target regions. For each changed target value, the corresponding source region serves as an anchor: it guides abductive search toward structurally relevant values and operations before broader alternatives, yielding ordered, executable candidate procedures with inspectable source evidence. Across 70 mathematical transformations containing 120 changed numeric components, the model recovered every intended procedure. It returned the intended procedure before any other computation producing the same target value in 104 subproblems (86.7%), compared with a median of 32 (26.7%) across 100 unguided runs that tested candidate calculations in random order. Our proposed model also tested 93.8% fewer combinations of values and operations than unguided search before reaching the intended procedures. These results provide an efficient, interpretable account of how relational structure can guide procedural learning and a testable hypothesis about human self-explanation from worked examples.

</details>


### [435] [The Model Knows Another Way: Strategy Switching for Effective RLVR Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33085)
*Jin Cui,Xinyue Long,Boran Zhao,Pengju Ren,Hao Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PSRA方法，针对RLVR中有限预算采样导致的"策略选择失败"问题，通过贝叶斯分配在问题-策略臂上动态分配rollout预算，并将成功轨迹迁移到无引导策略同时保留策略可达性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR在困难问题上常因rollout组全错而缺乏训练信号。作者认为这类失败并非源于能力缺失，而是有限采样集中于问题特定的"主导推理策略"，忽略了模型本已支持的替代策略；同时这些策略的可达性在RL过程中会动态变化（内化或丧失可引导性），现有引导式RL方法未能同时解决"往哪里探索"和"如何保持探索方向可用"的问题。

Method: 1) **策略发现**：用Dirichlet过程混合模型(DPMM)对基础模型rollout的隐状态聚类，经行为认证筛选出5种语义推理策略（逐步分解、方程建立、公式应用、逆向推理、反事实推理），用自然语言指令作为轻量控制接口。2) **问题条件化探索分析**：证明有限自主采样高度集中在单一主导策略；引入预生成覆盖预测器g评估问题级别的策略机会Ω(q,z;O)；定义纵向可达性指标区分"内化"ι_t和"可达性丧失"L_t。3) **PSRA框架**：将无引导和各策略条件化提示视为竞争臂，先对每个(q,z)进行小规模probe采样，用层次贝叶斯先验（结合问题难度、全局臂效应、剩余机会）构建后验；通过贪心边际增益分配额外budget最大化非饱和组期望数。4) **学习目标**：使用臂内优势计算、序列级行为校正w(y)和token级PPO比率ρ^φθ将引导轨迹迁移到无引导策略（转移损失L_tr），并附加on-context保留损失L_pres维持策略可达性。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B模型及DAPO-Math-17K与DeepScaleR-40K两个训练集上，PSRA一致提升分布内推理性能（7B上较GRPO提升2.3分，较最佳基线提升1.2分），并改善分布外迁移（OOD平均提升3.3-4.7分）。PSRA恢复26%的初始未解问题（GRPO仅17%），降低死饱和率并维持更高策略熵；在更大推理预算k下优势持续扩大，表明保留了更广泛的策略覆盖。消融实验证实贝叶斯分配、策略保留项及3-4个策略的紧凑基底的必要性。

Conclusion: RLVR的探索失败可归因于有限预算的策略选择而非能力缺失。PSRA通过自适应地在问题-策略臂上分配rollout、同时保留有用的策略条件并将成功引导行为迁移到无引导策略，提升推理性能、降低饱和并维持更广泛的探索，验证了预训练策略库作为RLVR探索有效接口的价值。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is often limited by insufficient exploration: difficult problems can yield uniformly incorrect rollout groups and therefore little learning signal. We show that such failures need not reflect missing capability. Instead, finite sampling often concentrates on a problem-specific dominant reasoning strategy while leaving alternative strategies already supported by the model unexplored. Moreover, the accessibility of these strategies evolves during RL: some are internalized into autonomous behavior, while others become difficult to elicit before being absorbed. Motivated by these observations, we introduce Problem--Strategy Rollout Allocation (PSRA), which treats unguided and strategy-conditioned prompts as competing exploration arms and uses Bayesian sequential allocation to direct a fixed rollout budget toward arms most likely to yield informative, non-saturated groups. A preservation objective keeps useful strategy-conditioned routes accessible while successful guided behaviors are transferred to the unguided policy. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B and two RL training corpora, PSRA consistently improves reasoning performance, reduces dead saturation, strengthens out-of-distribution transfer, and maintains larger gains under increased inference budgets.

</details>


### [436] [Modular Discovery of General Game-Playing Algorithms with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33115)
*Zun Li,John Schultz,Marc Lanctot,Daniel Hennes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多智能体大语言模型元学习系统，通过模块化协同进化的方式在 C++ 中自动发现通用的博弈搜索算法与领域启发式，并在大规模、多类型的博弈环境中验证其泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用博弈博弈（General Game Playing, GGP）要求算法在不进行人工调优的前提下，在规则差异显著的多种博弈类（完美信息、随机、不完美信息）上同时具备竞争力。现有手工设计的 MCTS 变体往往针对特定领域，难以跨域迁移；因此探索利用 LLM 自动发现具有普适性的搜索机制具有重要研究价值。

Method: 将搜索过程分解为两个协同进化的组件：① 游戏无关的“过程式搜索机制五元组”（M = ⟨TreePolicy, ValueBackup, RootActionSelector, FinalActionSelector, VirtualLoss⟩），采用 C++ 实现；② 针对每个具体博弈演化的领域知识三元组 κ = ⟨PriorPolicy, ValueEstimator, ResampleHistory⟩。基于 AlphaEvolve 框架，利用 Gemini 3.5 Flash 对过程式机制提出结构性代码修改，以头部房间归一化的“放大率（Amplification）”与“改进率（Improvement）”作为多目标适应度，引入三阶梯对手验证与随机课程进度以保障评估稳定性。在 50 个 OpenSpiel 训练博弈、19 个保留博弈、360 个自动从自然语言规则合成的博弈以及 17 个由 PPO 训练的神经网络先验博弈上，通过 AlphaRank 静态分布与 Soft Condorcet Optimization（SCO）跨博弈综合排名进行评估，并在 10 个经典博弈中与专用引擎对比。

Result: 系统跨 5 个独立进化路线均稳定产生排名首位的机制。代表性案例 Bifv-Mcts 在 50 ms 搜索预算下，于训练博弈（509.34±0.39）、保留博弈（509.36±0.48）、合成博弈（508.99±0.20）和神经 PPO 博弈（508.91±0.67）四个层级均位列 SCO 排名第一，在双变量博弈 95% 置信区间内击败所有 15 个调优 MCTS 基线（如 UCT、PUCT、MCTS Solver、Gumbel AlphaZero 等），其中对参考 PUCT 胜率分别为 65.2%、62.2%、70.4%、52.9%。在 1,000 次模拟预算（IsoSim）下也保持排名首位。该机制在 Kuhn、Leduc 扑克与 Liar’s Dice 上使 PUCT 的可利用性（Exploitability）分别降低 10–20 倍模拟成本。机制内部生成出多种非标准数学组件（如基于效用跨度 ΔU 的对数调度、兄弟访问加权期望初始化、完全有理化探索调度等），但仍受到求解器、可利用性优化以及在线元自适应等方面的限制。

Conclusion: 通过 LLM 驱动的协同进化，可自动发现能够跨 400 多个博弈（包括人工设计、程序化合成以及冻结神经网络表示）通用的过程式搜索机制，验证了算法发现的 LLM 元学习范式在通用博弈领域的可行性与有效性。同时明确其作为策略提升算子的本质边界：无法替代完备残局表与大规模预训练评估网络。

Abstract: General Game Playing across arbitrary games from rules alone remains challenging due to differing algorithmic requirements across game classes and strict decision-time constraints.
