Rather than hand-designing search heuristics for specific domains, can we leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to discover general game-playing algorithms? Because language models can propose and refactor structured code, they provide an expressive proposal engine for exploring the space of algorithmic designs. We introduce a multi-agent LLM meta-learning system to co-evolve game-agnostic procedural search mechanisms in C++ alongside domain heuristics synthesized directly from game rules. Controlling the compute budget, we benchmark the discovered mechanisms across more than 400 diverse environments, including OpenSpiel training and held-out games, procedural simulation engines, and games with deep neural policy-value representations trained via PPO. Evaluated via AlphaRank stationary distributions and Soft Condorcet Optimization (SCO) against 15 established MCTS baselines, the discovered search mechanisms consistently achieve top-tier ratings and pairwise ballot majorities over most baselines across independent evolutionary runs, generalizing to unseen human-designed and procedurally synthesized games and remaining competitive with baselines on frozen neural network representations.

</details>


### [437] [Compositional Safety Failures in Harness Evolution: Identification and Runtime Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33123)
*Zhixiang Zhang,Zesen Liu,Wai Ip Lai,Hongxu chen,Dongdong She*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究自演化智能体框架（harness evolution）中跨组件更新的组合安全失败问题，提出基于类型化超图的运行时监控方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自演化LLM智能体的harness会持续更新记忆、提示、技能和工具等组件。现有安全验证方法仅检查单个更新或整体harness是否安全，忽略了不同组件更新之间可能产生的组合安全风险——即单独安全且保持效用的更新在共同激活时可能产生不安全行为。这是harness evolution固有的安全风险。

Method: 1. 在三个安全基准（AgentDojo、Agent-SafetyBench、Agent Security Bench）上实证识别组合安全失败，包括两两组合失败和不可约的三元组合失败。2. 提出类型化超图表示：以组件状态为节点、安全相关的高阶交互为超边，通过局部邻域（h-hop）和LLM语义过滤进行增量构建，避免枚举全局组合空间。3. 基于超图的运行时监控机制：仅检查当前执行中激活的交互邻域，在动作执行前进行组合安全检查。

Result: 在三个基准上识别出43个两两组合失败和18个不可约三元组合失败。运行时监控将残馀CFR降低至最多1.27%，同时保持任务效用，运行检查率仅为候选动作的20.1-33.6%，时间开销从穷举检查的80.5-139.5秒/任务降至19.8-32.5秒/任务。实验揭示了不同安全机制间的安全性-效用-成本权衡。

Conclusion: 独立更新的安全验证不能保证组合安全性，跨harness组件的组合安全失败是harness evolution的内在风险。增量超图与运行时监控是解决组合安全检查组合爆炸问题的有效方法，在安全性、效用和成本之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: Self-evolving agent harnesses continually update persistent components such as memory, prompts, skills, and tools. We call this process harness evolution. However, such evolution could introduce unexpected safety risks. Existing work studies harness misevolution and validates candidate harnesses or attributed individual component updates, leaving safety analysis of cross-component update interactions largely unexamined. To address this gap, we study compositional safety failures in harness evolution, where interactions among individually safe and utility-preserving component updates can produce undesirable or unsafe agent behavior, revealing a safety risk intrinsic to harness evolution. Across three safety-related benchmarks, we identify 43 pairwise and 18 irreducible 3-way compositional safety failures. Conventional solution incurs combinatorial complexity in validating cross-component interactions, leaving the safety checking impractical as the harness evolves. To solve this, we introduced a typed hypergraph that represents component states as nodes and safety-relevant higher-order interactions as hyperedges. When the harness changes, the hypergraph updates only the interaction neighborhood of the changed states rather than reconstructing the global composition space. Building on that, we develop a hypergraph-guided runtime monitoring mechanism. Experiments show that our method effectively mitigates compositional safety risks while preserving task utility and reducing interaction-checking costs, and further reveal an empirical safety-utility-cost trade-off across different safety mechanisms.

</details>


### [438] [Ceiling of a Task: When Can a Transformer Succeed Without Its Chain of Thought?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33134)
*Jiashu He,Jinxuan Fan,Xiao Xiao,Radu Marculescu,Alejandro Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper develops a theoretical framework that quantifies exactly when a transformer needs its chain of thought (CoT). By modeling transformers as shallow circuits (constant-depth TC⁰), it defines the "ceiling" of a task—the best accuracy achievable without serial computation—and proves three theorems (Necessity, Depth, Locality) that hold universally. Experiments on finite group word problems and math benchmarks (MATH-500, AIME) confirm that erasing the chain collapses accuracy to the predicted ceiling, while the content carried by the chain determines accuracy above the ceiling.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Recent work shows filler/pause tokens can partially reproduce CoT gains (Pfau et al., 2024; Goyal et al., 2024), and chains often fail to state true reasons (Turpin et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2025), making it unclear whether CoT performs real computation or is decorative. Prior erase/truncate/shuffle experiments (Lanham et al., 2023) are hard to interpret because drops could reflect the model reading the chain rather than the chain itself. The paper seeks quantitative bounds on what any transformer can do without the content of its chain, regardless of training method.

Method: The paper uses circuit complexity theory: (1) Models one forward pass as a TC⁰ circuit of constant depth L (Fact 2.1, from Merrill & Sabharwal, 2023). (2) Defines "shallow circuit" pipelines (Lemma 2.3): any constant number of forward passes is still shallow. (3) Defines the "ceiling" of a task as the best accuracy of any shallow circuit. (4) Proves three theorems—Necessity (Theorem 3.1): erasing intervention caps accuracy at ceiling; Depth (Theorem 4.1): chains lifting accuracy above ceiling cannot be written shallowly; Locality (Theorem 5.2): answer head is one shallow pass, so serial work must be in the chain. (5) Extends worst-case seriality (Li et al., 2024) to average-case and maximally serial. (6) Experiments: trains small transformers on finite group word problems (A₅, S₅, Z₆₀, A₄×Z₅) with/without CoT and with/without RL (GRPO/RLOO/PPO); tests open-weight reasoning models (DeepSeek-R1-Distill, Qwen3) on word problems and MATH-500/AIME via six interventions (filler, random tokens, template, truncation, sentence shuffle, token shuffle).

Result: Small transformers on word problems (L=2,4,8): chain-trained models achieve 1.000 on A₅ at all lengths up to n=128; erasing drops them to 0.0148–0.0188 vs. baseline 1/60≈0.0167 (exactly matching ceiling). Chainless models collapse to ceiling as n grows—tracking prefix t* plateaus at ~8 (L=2), ~30 (L=4), ~110 (L=8). RL (GRPO/RLOO/PPO) does not change this: models with chain reach 0.709–0.804, under erasing 0.014–0.019. Only T=n chain steps reach 1.000; T<n stays at baseline. Open Qwen3 models on A₅: with full chain reach 0.62 at n=4, 0.29 at n=8; with filler or no chain, every model scores ≤0.030. On MATH-500/AIME: erasing costs 0.52–0.82 accuracy; sentence shuffle is harmless (≤0.045 change); token shuffle drops to erasing level even though answer string remains in 33–45% of shuffled chains. Checkpoints trained with random reward (GRPO) show the same pattern. Surviving accuracy after erasing is the "shortcut" the model can compute in one pass.

Conclusion: The ceiling of a task answers when a transformer needs its CoT. Three universal theorems establish: (1) Necessity—everything above the ceiling rests on chain content; (2) Depth—the chain cannot be written shallowly; (3) Locality—serial work happens in the chain, not the answer head. The framework applies to all transformer variants (one-pass models, latent reasoners, diffusion decoders, process reward models) and explains observed phenomena (filler tokens don't help on serial tasks; sentence shuffle vs. token shuffle; limits of chain compression). This provides a task-level, training-independent criterion for when CoT is necessary versus when a single forward pass suffices.

Abstract: Reasoning models generate long chains of thought before they answer, yet it is debated whether the content of these chains does real computational work or is largely decorative. We study this question by viewing a transformer as a shallow circuit. One forward pass through a fixed number of layers has constant depth, so any procedure that runs the model a constant number of times is a shallow circuit. We call the best accuracy that a shallow circuit can reach on a task the ceiling of the task, and a task is serial if its ceiling lies below one. We prove three results on serial tasks that hold for every transformer, no matter how it was trained. Necessity: replacing the chain by anything that does not depend on its content, such as filler tokens or a restatement of the question, drives the accuracy down to the ceiling, and on a maximally serial task down to chance. Depth: no shallow computation can write the chain of a model whose accuracy exceeds the ceiling, not even approximately. Locality: the answer is one shallow pass away from the finished chain, so all of the serial reasoning happens in the chain. On word problems of finite groups, whose ceilings are known, small transformers trained from scratch, with or without reinforcement learning, attain the predicted numbers: chain-trained models solve every input length and fall to chance when the chain is erased, chainless models collapse to the ceiling as the input length grows, and open-weight reasoning models given the same problem in words return to the baseline without their chain. On MATH-500 and AIME, erasing the chain costs open reasoning models 0.52 to 0.82 accuracy, a sentence shuffle is harmless, and a token shuffle is as harmful as erasing; the same holds for checkpoints trained by GRPO with a correct or a random reward. The ceiling of a task therefore answers when a transformer can succeed without its chain of thought.

</details>


### [439] [On Device Agentic Operation Caches -- Classifier-Centric NL-to-Action Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33141)
*Moghis Fereidouni,Anthony Arnold,Sumit Gulwani,Mark Marron,A.B. Siddique*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种"设备端操作缓存"机制，将NL-to-Action任务从生成式重新定义为分类式，通过在本地设备运行小型模型处理高频操作，降低延迟、提升隐私、降低成本。在Excel公式生成任务上，推理成本降低56%，缓存命中时延迟降低5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前智能体AI依赖云端100B+参数大模型进行NL-to-Action转换，带来网络延迟、隐私泄露和高昂运营成本问题。需要一种方法在本地处理高频常见操作。

Method: 1. 对公式进行α-重命名抽象，提取参数化操作惯用语（idiom）；2. 对NL查询进行聚类，构建惯用语簇；3. 基于高频惯用语微调小型设备端模型（Gemma 3 1B），采用"learned refusal"训练将非目标查询映射为MISS；4. 推理时采用refusal gate + 置信度门控（基于长度归一化对数似然的置信度评分）决定路由；6. 提供自动化的缓存构建与持续更新机制，支持团队/组织特化。

Result: 在NL2Formula基准（70,799查询，21,670表格）上：缓存命中率55%，缓存命中正确率97%，缓存未命中正确率83%；总推理成本从$1.54降至$0.67（降低56%）；缓存命中延迟从1.6s降至0.31s（5倍加速）；整体系统正确率91% vs 云端单独使用GPT-5的85%；置信度门控在阈值>0.99时保持95%正确率且命中率达50.2%；在30%键盘噪声扰动下仍保持96%正确率（命中率降至38.6%）。

Conclusion: 该方法将生成式问题转化为分类问题，通过设备端语义缓存有效处理高频操作，显著降低延迟、成本并增强隐私，同时意外地提升了整体准确率。缓存可从系统行为观察中自动构建，支持团队特化，是一种实用且高效的智能体系统优化方案。

Abstract: Agentic AI is increasingly being embedded in software applications to provide natural language interfaces to features and functionality. In most cases these agents are powered by enterprise (100+ billion parameter) or frontier class large language models that require substantial computational resources run and depend on cloud hosted inference to handle the task of transforming natural language inputs into actionable software operations. This reliance on cloud-hosted inference introduces substantial network latency on top of LLM inference times, creates data privacy concerns, and, given the costs of running these models, can rapidly escalate expenses associated with supporting agentic features. This paper introduces a novel means of converting the NL-to-Action problem from a generative one into a classification-centric formulation via on-device operation caches. These caches allow an agentic system to handle frequently occurring classes of actions completely on-device -- reducing latency, enhancing privacy, and lowering operational costs. We show that for a classic NL-to-Formula task, generating Excel Formula in response to user requests, this approach reduces total inference cost by 56% when compared to cloud-only model-routing based inference and, on cache hits, reduces the latency to response latency by 5x.

</details>


### [440] [LiteEvo: Automated, Cost-Efficient Harness Evolution for Generalization to Unseen Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33146)
*Euntae Choi,Sumin Song,Sungjoo Yoo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LiteEvo是一种轻量级harness进化算法,通过四个无工具的元智能体从失败导向的轨迹采样中挖掘可复用组件,组成版本化库并构建每轮harness,从同一个中性harness开始,不告知基准名称,在五个智能体基准上以13.0×更低的API成本达到与HarnessX相当或更高的pass@2,且能泛化到未见测试任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有harness进化方法(如HarnessX)存在三个问题:(1)需要为每个基准手工设计种子harness,引入了人类先验知识;(2)API成本高昂,每个基准需1亿至1.75亿个元智能体token;(3)仅报告在进化任务上的性能,未验证对未见任务的泛化能力。

Method: LiteEvo采用四个无工具元智能体(分析师、编辑、馆员、作曲家),通过失败导向的分组采样(failure-oriented group sampling)从冻结Qwen3.5-9B智能体的轨迹中挖掘失败模式并提出候选组件,馆员管理版本化组件库,作曲家从中组装候选harness,然后通过pass@2门控机制基于验证任务决定接受、保持或回退。所有基准从同一788字符中性harness启动,元智能体不知晓基准名称。

Result: 在五个基准(ALFWorld、WebShop、AppWorld、GAIA、SWE-bench Verified)上,冻结Qwen3.5-9B的平均pass@2达到71.0%,优于HarnessX复现的67.3%,而API成本低13.0倍($8.24–24.30 vs $118.47–190.32)。归纳设置下泛化未见过测试任务,AppWorld上提升pass@2达65.5pp,在Claude Code+Sonnet 4.6上也提升1.2至71.4pp。Qwen3.5-4B同样获得6.7至49.8pp提升。

Conclusion: LiteEvo证明了从基准无关的中性起点,通过廉价的自动化harness进化循环即可产生在未见任务上保持增益的harness,标志着向完全自动化、跨基准泛化的harness设计迈进一步。局限包括每个基准需独立进化库、跨基准库迁移未成功、GAIA上可能通过答案副本泄漏,未来工作包括指令优化、与微调/RL结合等。

Abstract: An LLM agent is defined by two things: the weights inside its model and the harness of components assembled around it. Harnesses are still handcrafted, and HarnessX, which evolves them automatically, starts each benchmark from a handcrafted harness, reports gains on the tasks it evolved on, and budgets 100 to 175 million meta-agent tokens per benchmark. We propose LiteEvo, a lightweight harness-evolution algorithm whose tool-free meta-agents mine agent trajectories for reusable components, curate them into a versioned library, and compose each round's harness from it, starting every benchmark from the same neutral harness and never naming the benchmark. Evolving on the graded tasks of five agentic benchmarks with a frozen Qwen3.5-9B, LiteEvo lifts pass@2 by 10.5 to 67.7pp and reaches comparable or higher pass@2 than a reproduction of HarnessX (71.0 against 67.3 on average) at 13.0 lower mean API cost. Harnesses evolved on train tasks keep their gains on unseen test tasks of four benchmarks, and LiteEvo also lifts Claude Code with Sonnet 4.6 by 1.2 to 71.4pp.

</details>


### [441] [Not Too Hard, Not Too Easy: Learning from Intermediate States for LLM Structured Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33149)
*Hongbo Chen,Guohua Lu,Ting Dang,Hong Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FOCUS方法，通过选择训练难度适中的中间状态来提升预训练大语言模型的结构化推理能力。在Sudoku-Extreme和Maze-Hard任务上取得了显著效果，并展现出零样本迁移到数学推理和代码执行任务的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受人类学习中"难度适中"原则的启发，作者探究在结构化推理任务中，如何选择最适合当前模型能力的训练样本。现有方法多关注初始状态或人为损坏状态，缺乏对模型自身轨迹中哪些中间状态最有训练价值的深入研究。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：1) 语言模型条件化的循环更新器，将预训练LLM与共享参数的循环更新器结合，反复修订显式解答状态；2) FOCUS基于"修复前沿"的选择策略，通过测量当前模型在固定步数内对候选状态的能量缩减比例来选择训练状态；3) 完整的循环状态重放，同时恢复答案和记忆，并引入缺陷惩罚以正则化局部修复进度。

Result: 使用Qwen3-1.7B骨干，FOCUS在Sudoku-Extreme上达到64.4%精确求解率，在Maze-Hard上达到91.1%，相比仅用最终状态监督的循环基线分别提升57.2和5.1个百分点。在1.7B到8B参数的五个Qwen和Llama骨干上均观察到一致提升。此外，禁用循环更新器后，训练过的LLM在MATH-Hard（72.36%→72.96%）和CruxEval-O（50.75%→55.38%）等下游任务上展现零样本性能提升。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将语言模型与共享循环更新器结合能够有效提升结构化推理任务的求解能力。FOCUS通过选择模型自身轨迹中处于"修复前沿"的训练状态，显著优于随机采样、能量困难和固定混合等基线策略。同时，结构化修复训练可使语言模型获得可迁移的推理能力，为利用任务特定训练塑造可重用表征提供了新思路。

Abstract: A common principle of effective learning is to practice material that is neither already mastered nor too difficult to permit progress. We ask how to apply this principle to structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and maze solving. In these tasks, a model can repeatedly revise an incomplete or incorrect candidate solution until it satisfies the problem's constraints. The intermediate candidate solutions along this trajectory provide natural training examples: some are already solved, some cannot yet be repaired by the model, and others lie at its current frontier of achievable progress. We therefore investigate whether pretrained language models can learn to revise such states and whether training on states at this frontier improves reasoning more broadly. To achieve this, we couple a pretrained language-model backbone with a recurrent updater that repeatedly revises an explicit solution state, using the same parameters at every update step. We further introduce Frontier-Oriented Curation Using Self-trajectories (FOCUS), which selects training states from trajectories generated by the current model. FOCUS measures how much the model improves each state within a fixed number of recurrent updates and prioritizes states from which it can make substantial progress. With Qwen3-1.7B, FOCUS achieves 64.4% exact solve accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme and 91.1% on Maze-Hard, with similar gains observed across five Qwen and Llama backbones spanning 1.7B to 8B parameters. We further observe zero-shot transfer in the adapted LLM to mathematical reasoning and code execution, even when the recurrent updater is disabled and no downstream fine-tuning is performed.

</details>


### [442] [SeOPD: Self-Evolving LLMs via Online Policy Distillation from Self-Generated Chain-of-Thought](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33181)
*Xiaoshu Chen,Xiangyu Wong,Sihang Zhou,Ke Liang,Xinwang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SeOPD框架，利用LLM自身的思维链（CoT）作为内部特权信息实现自进化，无需外部标注或环境反馈。通过深度思考模式生成推理过程，非思考模式生成响应，再以CoT为监督信号进行在线策略蒸馏，同时改进两种模式的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）方法依赖外部特权信息（如人工标注、环境反馈），成本昂贵且难以扩展。已有无外部PI的自改进方法增益有限。作者观察到同一LLM支持深度思考与非思考两种模式，且深度思考能生成额外推理信息，可作为内部PI来源。

Method: SeOPD包含三个阶段：（1）用深度思考模式生成CoT作为自生成特权信息；（2）用非思考模式生成响应作为学生轨迹；（3）将CoT作为条件输入思考策略，对非思考响应进行token级监督，采用对称KL散度作为蒸馏损失。此外引入CoT正则化项约束思考策略相对于冻结参考模型的偏差，防止CoT坍缩。总损失为蒸馏损失与CoT正则化损失加权和。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen3-8B上的科学问答（化学、物理、生物、材料）、工具使用（ToolAlpaca）和代码生成（LCBv6）任务中，SeOPD一致改进两种模式的性能。在仅训练LCBv6后，holdout任务（IFEval、MATH-500）仅有微小变化，说明无灾难性遗忘。CoT信息增益与性能提升呈正相关（r=0.39）。SeOPD优于基于自一致性的U-OPSD，与部分外部PI方法（系统提示、技能）相比也有竞争力。固定参考模型CoT时SeOPD仍优于参考模型，且生成CoT在参考模型下的困惑度随训练上升，表明确实内化了新知识。

Conclusion: SeOPD证明了LLM自身的推理过程（CoT）可作为有效的内部特权信息用于自进化，无需任何外部监督。深度思考与非思考模式可相互促进：思考模式为非思考模式提供监督，参数更新又反过来强化思考能力。这为LLM自改进提供了一条可扩展的路径。

Abstract: Recent advances in online policy self-distillation (OPSD) have demonstrated that large language models (LLMs) can improve their capabilities by leveraging external privileged information (PI), such as manual annotations or feedback from external environments. However, obtaining accurate annotations and constructing sophisticated environments often require substantial human effort and computation, limiting the scalability of OPSD. While a few recent studies have explored self-improvement without external PI, the resulting gains remain limited. In this work, we explore whether LLMs can achieve comparable self-improvement without external PI. Our key observation is that a single LLM can support multiple reasoning modes, such as deep-thinking and non-thinking modes, with deep thinking generating additional information during reasoning. Based on this observation, we propose Self-Evolving Online Policy Distillation (SeOPD), which enables LLMs to distill and internalize information generated by their own chain of thought (CoT). Specifically, it (1) generates CoT with the deep-thinking mode, (2) produces responses with the non-thinking mode, and (3) uses the generated CoT as PI to provide token-level supervision for the non-thinking response, allowing new information inferred during reasoning to guide the non-thinking mode and be internalized into the shared model parameters, thereby improving both non-thinking and deep-thinking capabilities. Extensive experiments across LLMs and tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of SeOPD.

</details>


### [443] [Unlocking Latent Personalization in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33182)
*Wei Chen,Guanghui Zhu,Zhongliang Cai,Yihua Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LatentPersonal框架，将LLM个性化重新定义为在共享潜在适配空间中的导航问题，仅需少量用户交互即可实现有效的个性化适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM个性化方法依赖有限的user-specific数据从零学习用户对齐行为，但预训练LLM本身可能已具备个性化相关行为的潜在能力，因此本文探索如何以极少样本激活这些已有能力。

Method: 1) 将个性化形式化为共享低维潜在偏好空间中的导航问题；2) 通过偏好编码器从少量用户交互推断紧凑潜在表示z_u；3) 以变分信息瓶颈正则化鼓励紧凑的偏好表示；4) 核心创新在于LoRA实例化：在共享低秩因子B和A之间插入diag(z_u)，仅需推理z_u即可生成用户专属适配，无需更新LoRA参数；5) 训练目标结合适配保持损失和KL压缩损失。

Result: 在HiCUPID、PRISM、PersonaMem和PIR四个个性化基准测试中，LatentPersonal在低样本（尤其是one-shot）场景下显著优于ICL、LoRA、PPlug和Profile-to-PEFT等基线方法，同时将测试时个性化开销降至最低（1-shot时仅0.0219秒）。消融实验证实了潜在表示、潜在导航和信息瓶颈三个组件的互补贡献。

Conclusion: LatentPersonal验证了将个性化视为在共享潜在适配空间中导航的有效性，证明从极少交互推断的紧凑潜在表示即可实现对未见用户的有效个性化，且该框架可自然扩展到Adapter和Prompt Tuning等其他PEFT架构，为高效少样本LLM个性化提供了有前景的新视角。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to adapt to individual users, yet effective personalization remains challenging when only limited user-specific samples are available. In this work, we take an alternative perspective: pretrained LLMs may already possess latent capacity for personalization, and a few user samples may therefore suffice to guide the model toward user-aligned behavior with minimal user-specific adaptation. From this perspective, we propose LatentPersonal, a framework that formulates personalization as navigation in a shared latent adaptation space. LatentPersonal infers a compact latent representation from a few user samples to guide user-specific model adaptation, regularized with a variational information bottleneck to encourage compact preference representations. We instantiate LatentPersonal with LoRA, leveraging its low-rank parameterization as a natural low-dimensional adaptation space for personalization. By simply inserting a user-specific guidance vector between the shared low-rank factors, the model can navigate toward personalized adaptations through lightweight inference of this compact representation, without updating the shared LoRA parameters. Experiments across multiple personalization datasets demonstrate that LatentPersonal substantially reduces user-specific adaptation overhead while achieving effective personalization from only a few user-specific interactions, with particularly strong performance in the one-shot regime.

</details>


### [444] [Are Benchmarks Reliable? Toward Structural Diagnosis via Sample-Level Capability Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33196)
*Haiquan Hu,Yuzhu Liang,Weicheng Tang,Yanzeng Li,Yao Shi,Tian Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了BSDProbe框架，通过沿有序模型轴进行重复响应采样，从样本层面估计能力边界，诊断基准测试的结构可靠性，而非仅依赖聚合分数。实验表明基准可靠性是轴依赖且异质的，且所选高价值子集的模型区分能力最高可达完整基准的8.58倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型评估主要依赖基准测试的聚合分数和排行榜排名，但聚合指标可能掩盖基准样本是否真正支持模型对比，即基准的结构可靠性问题。数据污染、样本难度分布不均等问题使得相同分数差距可能具有完全不同的测量含义，因此需要从样本层面诊断基准的内部测量结构。

Method: 提出BSDProbe（基准结构诊断有序模型探测）框架：1）对每个样本沿能力有序模型轴进行T=20次重复响应采样，构建经验响应分布；2）提取归一化熵轨迹Eq和正确性质量轨迹Cq；3）通过等渗回归估计边界位置xq（50%正确性增益点）、边界宽度wq（25%-75%增益区间）、边界信号有效性vq（结合后验置信度和高能力区域正确性与稳定性）、顺序一致性oq；4）将样本分为valid-boundary、order-anomalous和weak-boundary三类，聚合为基准级结构画像。引入Normalized Discrimination Ratio (NDR)衡量子集的模型区分能力。

Result: 在6个基准（MMLU、GPQA、GSM8K、MATH、PopQA、TriviaQA）上的实验表明：GSM8K和MATH测量结构最稳定（有效边界约71-77%）；MMLU和TriviaQA相对稳定但异质（约65%有效边界）；GPQA存在显著顺序异常风险（约43%异常率，仅17%有效边界）；PopQA以弱边界为主（约75%弱边界）。这些模式在Qwen3、Qwen2.5及跨模型轴上保持一致。BSDProbe选择的100样本子集的NDR在GPQA上最高达8.58倍完整基准的区分能力，且在所有基准上均优于随机采样、TinyBenchmarks、Anchor Points、Bayesian和PSN-IRT基线。阈值敏感性分析证实结构诊断具有稳健性。

Conclusion: 基准可靠性不应被视为二元属性，而是取决于在评估的能力范围内是否提供清晰、有效且顺序一致的样本边界。BSDProbe将基准可靠性从单一分数假设转化为可观测的结构属性，为基准诊断、模型对比和基准设计提供了可复现的工具。核心贡献在于将基准可靠性重新定义为轴依赖的结构诊断问题，以样本能力边界作为基本分析单元。

Abstract: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) relies heavily on benchmark scores, yet aggregate metrics can obscure whether benchmark samples reliably support model comparison. We introduce \textbf{BSDProbe}, a sample-level framework for \emph{benchmark structural diagnosis} that estimates capability boundaries from repeated-response trajectories along ordered model axes. BSDProbe summarizes samples by boundary position, boundary width, boundary-signal validity, and order consistency, then aggregates them into benchmark-level structural profiles. Experiments on six benchmarks show that benchmark reliability is axis-conditioned and heterogeneous: GSM8K and MATH exhibit the most stable measurement structures, MMLU and TriviaQA are relatively stable but heterogeneous, while GPQA and PopQA show stronger axis-conditioned risks. These profiles remain consistent across Qwen3, Qwen2.5, and cross-model axes. BSDProbe further selects compact high-value subsets whose model discriminability reaches up to $8.58\times$ that of the full benchmark. These results suggest that reliable benchmark use requires examining sample-level capability boundaries beyond leaderboard scores.

</details>


### [445] [WorldAgent: Verification-Guided Agentic Physical World Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33208)
*Caoliwen Wang,Mengdi Wang,Yige Chen,Zejia Wu,Bowen Huang,Siyuan Chen,Guanxiong Chen,Lifu Wei,Heng Zhang,Qinghai Zhang,Yin Yang,Guandao Yang,Shiying Xiong,Peng Wang,Chenfanfu Jiang,Peter Yichen Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出WorldAgent框架,通过验证引导的智能体方法从单条自然语言提示自主构建可编辑、可模拟的复杂物理世界(包含3D场景与数值仿真),并在新建的AgenticSimBench基准上取得领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言驱动的3D场景生成系统在处理复杂物理世界时面临两大瓶颈:(1)自然语言提示中大量物理约束隐式缺失,需用户多轮调试;(2)单纯依靠仿真执行无法保证物理一致性与任务达成,需显式验证循环引导修正。游戏、影视及科学模拟场景亟需减少建模与仿真配置负担。

Method: 框架分两层:(1)世界构建层将提示扩展为结构化世界规范(世界故事、实体契约、场景图、镜头规划四组件JSON清单),结合地形派生场(优先级淹没、D8路由等)与六类物理仿真技能(流体、气体、刚体、弹性体、布料、粒子及流固耦合),执行场景构建与数值仿真;(2)验证层在每步后执行八项检查(尺度一致性、穿插、支撑有效性、可导航性、因果、类别、数值、接触),失败则触发规范修订与受影响的步骤重执行,采用短探测→全量烘焙策略,保持原始提示不变。

Result: 在13条长提示的AgenticSimBench上,WorldAgent在基于GPT-5.6 Sol的智能体基线方法中,五项指标(穿插、因果完整性、场景组成完整性、镜头规划、文本对齐等)最优,最大归一化穿透深度较最强基线降低46.6%,因果节拍完成度提升26.6%;26人用户研究在物理合理性、镜头规划、内容对齐、美学四项准则均获最高均分,分别超最优基线1.14/0.48/0.52/0.92;消融实验验证了八项检查的必要性,且在三种LLM骨干下均稳定优于直接提示。

Conclusion: 验证引导的结构化构建流程能够从单条提示可靠地生成物理一致、可编辑、可复检的复杂世界;当前局限在于Blender求解器能力、物理参数推断精度与全轨迹严格验证成本,未来方向包括跨后端扩展规范与验证,并从接受/失败的仿真中持续学习。

Abstract: Constructing complex physical worlds from language requires coordinating extensive 3D environments, detailed structures and objects at different spatial scales, and interacting physical processes under both stated goals and implicit physical constraints. We present WorldAgent, an agentic framework for verification-guided physical world construction from a single natural-language prompt, without iterative user debugging. A world construction layer expands the prompt into a structured world specification and uses physical knowledge to build scenes and run numerical simulations. After every step, a verification layer inspects scene geometry and simulation states alongside rendered views. Failed checks guide automatic revisions to the specification and re-execution of the affected steps. Accepted worlds pass the required checks and remain editable for further inspection and resimulation. We introduce AgenticSimBench, on which WorldAgent achieves the best scores among the evaluated agent-based methods on five of seven metrics. In a 26-participant user study, it receives the highest mean ratings across all four criteria.

</details>


### [446] [CodeSkill: Latent Skill Abstraction for Long-Horizon Code Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33243)
*Song-Li Wu,Jingyi Wang,Zhaocheng Du,Weinan Gan,Weiwen Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CodeSkill 框架,将层级潜在技能建模引入代码智能体领域,通过教师模型蒸馏多层级文本技能抽象,结合时序变分推断与强化学习,将离散语义映射到连续潜在变量,并以执行反馈驱动的自适应边界机制动态门控技能切换,作为冻结 LLM 的潜在语义前缀注入,使 RL 从 token 级优化转向经验级推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对代码智能体的 RL 方法主要在 token 级进行优化,与高层行为推理之间存在错配,导致稀疏奖励下的探索效率低下与信用分配困难;此外,大规模智能体轨迹中重复出现的多步行为模式被噪声性的 token 级表征所掩盖,难以有效复用。缺乏显式的行为抽象是长周期代码智能体 RL 不稳定的关键原因。

Method: 1) 使用与基座相同的教师模型(零样本结构化提示),将成功与失败轨迹蒸馏为三层文本技能:高层全局意图、中层执行技能、低层 token 控制;失败轨迹提取反事实技能(错误决策、执行证据与修正方案)。2) Skill Weaver:利用冻结 LLM 的文本嵌入 + 两层 MLP 将文本技能映射为语义高斯先验的均值/方差,得到连续潜在变量 z^H、z^L;中层 z^M 由执行门控边界变量 b_t∈{0,1} 控制(b_t=1 时重采样,b_t=0 时保持上一时刻),后验用双向编码器 + Gumbel-Softmax 离散 b_t。3) 将潜在技能转为软前缀 P_t 与历史拼接,冻结基座 LLM、对注意力层做 LoRA,以 PPO 优化策略;失败轨迹的反事实技能引导负优势。最终损失为 L_ELBO + λ·L_RL。

Result: 基于 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct,在通用代码(EvalPlus、BigCodeBench、FullStackBench 等)、工业代码(芯片设计 VeriScope/RealBench/VeriRepair/ArchXBench、GPU 优化 KernelBench/TritonBench、3D 建模 CAD-Coder 等)、智能体编码(Terminal-Bench、SWE-bench)与通用工具使用(Mind2Web、BFCL V3、τ²-bench)四类基准上,在 32B 规模下取得与显著更大模型相当乃至领先的开源权重性能。消融实验验证:三层层级结构(尤其中层 z^M)、随机 VAE 后验、执行触发的自适应边界、文本技能→连续潜在变量的桥接、以及成功+失败轨迹混合训练均为必需;相对无技能基线平均交互步数从 12.3 降至 6.8(-45%),15 步限制内任务成功率从 62% 提升至 94%。

Conclusion: CodeSkill 通过将 RL 从 token 级探索迁移到经验级推理,有效提升了长周期代码智能体的优化效率与行为一致性;显式的层级行为抽象为可扩展、鲁棒的代码智能体提供了有前景的基础,且所学技能具备良好的跨领域迁移能力。

Abstract: Code agents require long-horizon decision-making over complex interaction trajectories. However, existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches typically optimize behavior at the token level, creating a mismatch between low-level generation and high-level behavioral reasoning. This limitation leads to inefficient exploration and weak credit assignment under sparse rewards. Moreover, while large-scale agent trajectories often contain recurring multi-step behavioral patterns, their noisy token-level representations hinder effective experience reuse. To address these challenges, we propose CodeSkill, a framework that adapts hierarchical latent skill modeling to the code agent domain. CodeSkill first leverages a teacher model to distill both successful and failed trajectories into multi-level textual abstractions. It then integrates temporal variational inference with reinforcement learning to map these discrete semantics into continuous latent variables, while an adaptive boundary mechanism dynamically gates skill transitions based on execution feedback. The learned skills are injected into a frozen LLM policy as latent semantic prefixes, enabling optimization in a compact semantic space rather than over raw token sequences. By shifting RL from token-level exploration to experience-level reasoning, CodeSkill improves optimization efficiency and long-horizon behavioral coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CodeSkill achieves highly competitive performance against strong open-weight baselines across diverse general and industrial coding benchmarks. Furthermore, the learned skills exhibit strong transferability and robust cross-domain generalization, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit behavioral abstraction for scalable agentic code generation.

</details>


### [447] [ActiveMem: Dynamic Latent Memory Trees for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33244)
*Song-Li Wu,Jingyi Wang,Zhaocheng Du,Weinan Gan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ActiveMem 提出了一种分层潜在记忆树（HLMT）框架，通过递归组织智能体经验为依赖感知的执行树，并利用强化学习（GRPO）联合优化记忆的扩展、检索与剪枝策略，从而缓解长时程 LLM 智能体中扁平记忆导致的上下文碎片化和跨任务干扰问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆系统将历史轨迹或摘要作为独立片段进行扁平检索，忽略了多步执行中固有的过程依赖关系。随着记忆规模增长，这种方式会引发上下文碎片化与跨任务干扰（例如在机票预订任务中错误引入酒店预订流程），导致结构不一致的推理轨迹并降低长时程决策的稳定性。

Method: ActiveMem 构建分层潜在记忆树（HLMT），其中节点编码可复用的子任务级抽象，边保留执行依赖关系；通过由轻量级控制器驱动的递归贪婪遍历进行路径检索。控制器具有双头结构：(1) 潜在注入头生成连续的软提示前缀 m_t，引导冻结的 LLM 推理；(2) 树动作头采样离散拓扑操作（插入/更新/合并/删除），实现即时执行与基于 EMA 利用率的延迟维护。训练采用 GRPO 结合可验证过程监督的层级优势函数（全局组归一化 + 局部父子比较），在 LLM 冻结的条件下端到端优化控制器参数。理论分析证明了路径检索通过 d-分离消除跨任务干扰、记忆树规模 O(1) 有界以及相比 token 级 RL 的二次方差缩减。

Result: 在 9 个跨领域基准（ALFWorld、TriviaQA、PopQA、KodCode、BigCodeBench、GPQA、GSM8K、MATH）上，ActiveMem 在 SmolLM3-3B 和 Qwen3-8B 上均一致优于 12 种基线方法（SFT、GRPO、REINFORCE、MemoryBank、ExpeL、AWM、SoftCoT、Co-processor、MemGen 等），其中 Qwen3-8B 的 GRPO 变体在 ALFWorld 达到 95.57%，GSM8K 达到 94.81%，MATH 达到 92.76%。消融实验验证了 HLMT、潜在注入、层级优势和树拓扑编辑均为不可或缺的核心组件。在多目标 QA 任务（2/8/16 目标）上，ActiveMem 保持近似恒定的峰值 token 使用量（~600-1100），在 16 目标设置下仅使用 Qwen2.5-14B 27.1% 的峰值 token 即超越其性能。在 WebShop 上达到 76.24 平均奖励，优于 GPT-4o 及 13B AgentLM。在基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的搜索智能体设置中，BrowseComp 达 43.6、BrowseComp-ZH 达 56.1、GAIA 达 72.8，超越 DeepSeek-V3.1-671B 并匹配 OpenAI-o3。跨域泛化与持续学习实验进一步证实了框架的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: ActiveMem 通过分层依赖感知的记忆组织、RL 优化的拓扑演化与潜在推理调制，有效解决了长时程 LLM 智能体中的上下文碎片化和跨任务干扰问题，在大幅降低 token 开销的同时实现了跨规模 SOTA 性能，证明了结构化拓扑记忆相对于扁平记忆缓冲区的根本优势。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory to support long-horizon reasoning and decision making. Existing memory systems typically retrieve historical trajectories or summaries as independent context fragments, overlooking the procedural dependencies underlying multi-step execution. As memory scales, such flat retrieval introduces context fragmentation and cross-task interference, leading to structurally inconsistent reasoning trajectories. We propose ActiveMem, a hierarchical memory framework that recursively organizes agent experiences into dependency-aware latent execution trees. ActiveMem abstracts trajectories into reusable subtask nodes while explicitly preserving execution transitions, enabling coherent reasoning-path retrieval conditioned on the current execution state. To support continual adaptation, ActiveMem further learns dynamic memory expansion, retrieval, and pruning policies through reinforcement learning. Experiments across various agent benchmarks demonstrate that ActiveMem consistently improves task completion, reasoning stability, and memory efficiency over existing memory-based agents. Moreover, ActiveMem enables compact open-weight models to achieve competitive performance with substantially larger proprietary systems.

</details>


### [448] [CORTEX: A Verified Experience Layer for Generalist Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33260)
*Garapati Keerthana,Manik Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CORTEX 框架,这是一个用于通用智能体的"经验层",通过外部存储的已验证经验(episode/pattern/strategy)与元控制器(replay/adapt/synthesize/escalate)实现累积式任务能力,无需修改模型权重。核心贡献包括形式化的精确重放契约、版本分离保证、新家族迁移测试(1,000 案例跨 8 个临床和政策家族),证明了过程性策略可在保持证据新鲜性的前提下跨家族复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Agent 系统虽具备工具推理、角色协调、自我反思能力,但其"记忆"机制只能存储答案或计划,无法记录使该结论成立的前提条件。当规则、工具版本或事实发生变化时,表面相似的检索结果可能变成"自信的错误"。因此需要一种原则性方法,决定先前解法何时仍有效、何时需要调整、何时应丢弃。

Method: 1. **任务契约**:将任务形式化为 z=(g,x,c,t,q),输出为带推导证明 ρ、不确定条件 u 和处置 a 的类型化包 F。
2. **三层经验**:episode(完整任务记录)、pattern(去除偶然细节的谓词模式)、strategy(可跨家族复用的程序)。
3. **架构组件**:源代理、解释器、规划器、推理器、验证器、经验管理;外加源/环境注册表(带摘要、有效期、作用域)和经验图。
4. **元控制器**:四模式决策——Replay(精确可接受匹配)、Adapt(带转换见证的检查后调整)、Synthesize(新推导)、Escalate(升级)。
5. **形式化契约**:基于强 Kleene 三值逻辑({Y,N,U})、版本化规则 r=(f,v,ι,p,o,I,π)、delta 分类器 Δ(B,C)∈{add,retire,modify,same,inapp,unk.},证明了 Sound Exact Replay、Version Separation 和 Reuse Saves Work 三个命题。
6. **发展循环**:解决→验证→抽象→挑战→更新能力,显式搜索边界案例。
7. **评估协议**:精确重放(1,000 合成案例,临床+政策双域)、完整家族留出测试(100 新家族案例)、跨域压力测试(8 个家族 1,000 案例)、输入不变性扰动(字段插入顺序反转+添加不相关字段)。

Result: **表 2(内部控制保真度)**:体验核与完整评估器在两个域均 500/500 完全匹配场景预言;仅看当前版本的快照基线仅 251/500 和 249/500;无版本谱系降至 364/500 和 382/500。**热复用效率**:93.6% 临床案例、100% 政策案例触发重放;规则节点评估从 33.88 降至 12.688(临床)、52.072 降至 15.836(政策)。**表 3(新家族迁移)**:100/100 完成、0 不支持主张、全新证据基础。**表 4(跨域压力)**:8 个家族 1,000 案例全部验证通过、新鲜证据基础 1,000/1,000、输入不变性 1,000/1,000。**表 5(模型角色试点)**:直连、类型化角色、带经验三种条件下 4/4 均通过验证。

Conclusion: 通用智能可在 Agent 系统中以"可信赖的任务能力累积"为研究对象。CORTEX 提出具体机制:窄智能体求解并检查任务,外部层保留推理有效的前提条件,元控制器学习何时重放、调整、综合或求助。精确重放与版本分离具有条件保证;完整家族留出与跨域留出表明,共享过程可在保持证据当前性的同时将任务求解组织带入新家族。这是通过已验证经验、过程抽象与发展迁移迈向通用智能的初步工程路径。**局限**:依赖形式化编码的正确性与注册表的完整性;验证器与推理器可能共享解释错误;两个初始域为高后果领域,输出应标注为决策支持而非决策本身;研究未涵盖完整发展架构、自主策略归纳或向未见任务语言的迁移。

Abstract: An agent can solve a task today and face the same task under new facts, tools, or governing knowledge tomorrow. Most agent systems can retrieve relevant text or recall prior conversations, but they lack a principled way to decide when a previous solution is still valid, when it must be adapted, and when it should be discarded. We introduce CORTEX (Contextual Orchestration and Reuse of Task EXperience), a general AI systems framework that connects specialized agents through an external layer of verified experience. Each episode records its task conditions, source and tool state, decisive predicates, proof trace, verifier, and outcome. A meta-controller chooses exact replay, checked adaptation, fresh synthesis, or escalation. Accepted episodes can become task patterns and procedural strategies through a challenge-driven development loop. This gives the system an implicit competence layer that can grow without changing model weights. We formalize system contracts for exact replay and source-version separation, and derive when reuse saves computation. A controlled two-domain implementation tests the exact-replay core on 1,000 synthetic cases. Complete-family holdouts test procedural transfer on 1,000 new-family cases across eight clinical and policy splits, with complete fresh-evidence grounding and perfect invariance to irrelevant-field and insertion-order perturbations. The transfer trace exposes the work required for verified strategy execution. These results establish an initial path toward general intelligence through reusable procedures, typed experience, and developmental transfer.

</details>


### [449] [LSTMem: Hierarchical Long Short-Term Online Memory for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33268)
*Xianglong Shi,Ruijie Yang,Sirui Zhao,Shukang Yin,Zihao Bian,Tinghao Yi,Enhong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LSTMem是一种受LSTM启发的层级化在线记忆模块，将其附加到冻结的LLM每一层中，通过两个矩阵状态（积累历史的cell state C和控制读出的hidden state D）实现记忆积累与记忆表达的解耦，并通过跨层hidden state传播和块级反馈机制来构建层级记忆结构。在MemoryAgentBench、LoCoMo和HotpotQA等多个长程记忆基准上，该方法在Qwen3-4B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B和SmolLM3-3B三个骨干模型上一致优于基线及其在线记忆对照方法δ-Mem。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有紧凑型在线记忆通常使用单一持久状态同时承担"积累历史"和"提供读出"两种角色，导致记忆的存储与暴露耦合在一起：保留下来供后续使用的内容即使与当前计算无关也始终被暴露，而下层已持有的有用信息又因状态容量有限而必须重复存储。这种耦合限制了长程助手和代理场景下的记忆效率。

Method: 1) 在冻结Transformer每一层附加两个矩阵状态：cell state C（积累历史）和hidden state D（提供读出）；2) 通过输入门、遗忘门控制C的写入与保留，通过输出门单独控制D对当前计算的暴露；3) 引入depth gate g使下层hidden memory参与当前层D的形成，并通过前向hidden state传播连接相邻层；4) 在历史块边界引入block-end feedback：利用更高层的重建损失梯度修正低层cell state，再由浅至深重建hidden state；5) 记忆读出产生对注意力query和output的低秩修正Δq、Δo，作用于冻结骨干的注意力机制。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct上，LSTMem相比原始骨干在MemoryAgentBench上提升15.54分（平均45.08），LoCoMo F1提升12.81分（53.60），HotpotQA F1提升12.12分（68.12），同时IFEval仅下降0.19分、GPQA-Diamond上升3.03分；在Qwen3-8B和SmolLM3-3B上同样取得最佳记忆基准成绩。消融实验表明：移除跨层hidden memory传播使MemoryAgentBench下降1.77–1.92分（测试时学习任务下降6.21–8.00分）；LSTM式记忆形式优于联想记忆对照；36层全连接记忆优于任何稀疏子集布局；block-end feedback贡献2.82分单跳问答增益。效率方面，LSTMem保留δ-Mem平均92.10%的单步解码速度，端到端开销仅5.9%–6.5%。

Conclusion: 将记忆积累与记忆表达分离、并沿模型深度组织层级化的在线记忆结构，对于长程LLM助手和代理任务具有显著优势。LSTMem在不修改骨干模型参数的前提下，通过每层双状态矩阵+跨层传播+块级反馈的组合，在多个长程记忆基准上一致超越现有在线记忆方法，并保持与基线相当的推理效率，验证了"在线记忆既是时间过程也是深度层级"这一设计原则的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly serve as long-horizon assistants and agents, where they must both accumulate information across interactions and make the relevant parts available when later requests depend on them. Existing compact online memories typically use a single persistent state both to accumulate history and to serve readout, so what the memory stores cannot be controlled separately from what it exposes to the current computation. We propose LSTMem, an LSTM-inspired online memory that instead equips each layer of a frozen LLM with two matrix-valued states: a cell state that accumulates history and a hidden state whose readouts correct the backbone's attention. Input and forget gates control what the cell stores, while an output gate separately controls what the cell exposes through the hidden state. LSTMem further connects memory across depth through forward hidden-state propagation and block-end feedback, and uses higher-layer reconstruction gradients to refine lower-layer cell states before rebuilding hidden states from shallow to deep layers. Across memory benchmarks on Qwen3-4B-Instruct, LSTMem consistently improves MemoryAgentBench, LoCoMo, and HotpotQA over the plain backbone. Comparisons further show that the LSTM-based memory formulation outperforms an associative-memory counterpart, while removing cross-layer hidden-memory propagation degrades performance. These results demonstrate the benefits of separating memory accumulation from memory expression and organizing memory hierarchically across model depth. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [450] [Structured Sparse Memory for Recurrent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33270)
*Zixuan Zhao,Samuel Wheeler,Neil Getty,Xiaotian Duan,Rick Stevens,Fangfang Xia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CHARM系统，通过引入结构化稀疏记忆（CoSE）显著提升了ARC-AGI推理任务的参数效率，在仅使用1/15任务记忆参数的情况下，将ARC-AGI-1的pass@2提升至84%，ARC-AGI-2提升至46.7%，并验证了该设计在元胞自动机推理、语言建模等领域的通用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ARC系统中，任务条件化记忆表（task embedding table）的参数量是循环骨干网络的30倍以上，但常被忽视。研究者质疑：能否利用ARC增强的组合结构（puzzle identity、dihedral transform、color permutation）在不损失性能的前提下大幅压缩任务记忆参数？同时探究循环推理深度与学习horizon之间的权衡关系。

Method: 核心方法CoSE（Compositional Sparse Embedding）由两个分支组成：(1) 组合分支——将puzzle embedding通过FiLM算子与dihedral和color permutation的组合嵌入进行调制；(2) 低秩残差分支——保留每实例rank-32的查找表（原始宽度的1/16），通过sigmoid门控与组合分支融合。此外，作者还构建了Re-ARC2合成数据集扩展至ARC-AGI-2的1000个任务，并研究了循环骨干中推理深度R与学习horizon H的平衡。

Result: 在ARC-AGI-1上达到84% pass@2（使用29.6M任务记忆参数 vs 原始448.9M），在ARC-AGI-2上达到46.7% pass@2。任务记忆参数减少94%，同时pass@2提升。组合分支与残差分支单独使用均弱于完整表，但组合使用超越完整表基线。在CAR基准上，三因子CoSE将未见规则-horizon组合的pass@2从0%提升至3.69%；在nanochat语言建模中，CoSE在所有记忆容量下均降低验证bpb。持续学习实验显示，仅用每个谜题512个参数即可适应未见谜题。

Conclusion: CHARM证明结构化稀疏记忆能有效替代ARC系统中被忽视的大规模任务表，同时提升准确性和参数效率。组合结构利用先验知识降低冗余，低秩残差保留必要的实例特异性。该方法在CAR（支持组合泛化）和语言建模（一致改进n-gram记忆）中具有跨领域适用性，但在数据充裕时优势收窄，表明组合记忆在数据稀缺、键结构丰富的场景下价值最大。

Abstract: Recurrent models trained from scratch have recently become competitive on ARC-style reasoning tasks, but the usual framing around small recurrent backbones overlooks two important parts of the system: task-conditioned memory and synthetic augmentation data. We study this regime through CHARM, a compact hybrid ARC model that combines recurrent reasoning with structured task memory, synthetic data, and inference-time aggregation. In existing approaches, task-conditioned memory supplies a large hidden source of capacity, reaching more than 30x the size of the recurrent backbone. We introduce a compositional sparse embedding (CoSE) for task conditioning that reduces learned task-memory parameters by over 90% while improving pass@2 in controlled ARC ablations. For the recurrent backbone, recurrent depth helps only when balanced with learning horizon. Combining these ingredients, our system reaches 84% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 and 46.7% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-2 public evaluation. The benefits of structured memory also generalize to unseen puzzles and other domains. Our code, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [451] [Next Thoughts Are Distributions: Generative Autoregressive Reasoning in the Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33271)
*Yang Li,Yi Wang,Shiyuan Huang,Yang Liu,Hao Wang,Chengzhi Mao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ATF提出将下一思维建模为多模态分布，结合因果自回归骨干与轻量扩散头，实现连续推理中的多样性思维采样，在数学推理基准上显著提升准确率与解覆盖度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续推理方法通常将下一思维预测为点估计或单峰高斯分布，导致推理路径坍缩为单一轨迹，无法捕捉同一问题下的多种合理思路；而扩散式推理又往往牺牲自回归结构。需要在保留因果自回归骨干的同时，对"下一个连续思维"进行多模态分布建模。

Method: 提出Autoregressive Thought Flow (ATF)：因果Transformer产生上下文条件h_t，轻量条件流头（基于Rectified Flow）从该条件生成下一连续思维的多模态分布，采样后反馈回模型。训练联合优化离散token交叉熵与流匹配损失；通过Causal-Register VAE (CR-VAE)离线生成有序连续思维目标。采用组相对优化对潜在轨迹与文本回答进行双层优势估计的强化学习微调；推理时支持classifier-free guidance控制探索-利用权衡。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B/4B及LLaMA-3.1-8B上的GSM8K、MATH-500、OlympiadBench、AMC 12等数学基准上，ATF以4-8步紧凑潜在推理超越MSE回归与短预算CoT；Pass@100在MATH-500达83.2%、GSM8K达97.6%、OlympiadBench达52.4%，较此前最强基线在OlympiadBench提升34.6点；推理速度较文本CoT提升3.5-6.4倍；强化学习与CFG进一步改善准确率-覆盖度权衡。

Conclusion: 对"下一个连续思维"建模为多模态分布而非单一预测，是提升连续推理效果的关键因素；ATF通过自回归接口与扩散头的结合，在保持预训练因果结构的同时释放了潜在推理的多样性，多样本评测与可视化均证实了多模态思维分布对解覆盖度的实质贡献。

Abstract: Reasoning problems often admit multiple valid ways to proceed. Continuous reasoning promises to move computation beyond language tokens into a more compact latent space, but representing several plausible ways to think next remains difficult. We introduce Autoregressive Thought Flow (ATF), which models the next continuous thought as a multimodal distribution. A causal autoregressive model performs the reasoning computation, while a lightweight diffusion head generates a plausible next thought from the resulting condition. The sampled thought is fed back into the model, allowing continuous reasoning to unfold for a variable number of steps while preserving the pretrained backbone. Across mathematical reasoning tasks, ATF improves accuracy with compact latent traces and benefits from reinforcement learning and additional test-time thinking. Multi-sample evaluation shows broader solution coverage, indicating that its multimodal predictions capture useful diversity among reasoning paths. Our results suggest that continuous reasoning is more effective when multiple possible next thoughts remain available rather than being collapsed into a single prediction.

</details>


### [452] [ChronoFlow: Hierarchical Flow Matching for Irregular Time Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33276)
*Changhun Kim,Sunguk Jang,Jeongjun Lee,Juhwan Choi,Sangchul Hahn,Grigorios Chrysos,Eunho Yang,Juho Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ChronoFlow提出了一种基于流匹配的分层框架，按"统计粒度"由粗到细（全局观测统计→采样模式→测量值）生成原生非规则时间序列，在五个基准上取得了最优的生成保真度，并配套了一套评估完整非规则样本的综合指标体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列生成方法要么假设规则时间网格，要么只关注给定采样结构下的特征动态，无法以原生形式生成非规则时间序列——即同时建模"有多少观测、何时发生、哪些特征被共同观测"这一异质联合问题。

Method: 将非规则样本表示为S=(τ, B, x)，通过分层因式分解p(M,r)p(τ,B|M,r)p(x|τ,B)将其拆为三个流匹配子模型：(1) IntensityFlow（MLP）生成全局观测统计M和特征频率r；(3) PatternFlow（Transformer+槽位令牌+一维最优传输耦合）联合生成观测时刻与特征共现面板；(3) ValueFlow（Set Transformer+事件令牌+置换等变）条件化生成测量值。配套六项互补评估指标（Set-Discr、CoOb、Pattern-MMD²、Trans-MMD²、Value-W1、Set-Corr），并通过受控扰动实验验证其敏感性。

Result: 在eICU、P12、MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV和Activity五个基准的30项数据集-指标对比中，ChronoFlow在21项上取得最低均值；eICU上Set-Discr从0.3629降至0.0995，Value-W1降低53.4%。消融实验验证分层顺序和最优传输耦合的贡献；Oracle干预表明IntensityFlow误差是主要改进瓶颈，ValueFlow对上游扰动相对稳健。

Conclusion: 按统计粒度组织的分层生成可将异质联合问题分解为结构对齐的子问题并保持依赖关系，ChronoFlow在所测基准与设置下取得了当前最优的完整非规则时间序列生成保真度。

Abstract: Recent advances in generative modeling have substantially improved time series generation, yet most existing methods either assume a regular temporal grid or focus on feature dynamics under a given sampling structure. This makes them illsuited for generating irregular time series in their native form, where a model must capture not only feature values, but also how many observations occur, when they occur, and which features are observed together. To address this heterogeneous generation problem, we propose ChronoFlow, a unified hierarchical flow matching framework organized by statistical granularity. Following a coarse-to-fine hierarchy, ChronoFlow first generates observation counts and feature-wise frequencies, then jointly generates observation times and feature co-observation patterns, and finally generates values conditioned on the realized pattern. This turns a complex joint generation problem into structurally aligned subproblems while preserving their dependencies. To evaluate complete irregular time series generation, we introduce complementary metrics spanning sample realism, sampling structure, value fidelity, and temporal and cross-feature dependencies, and validate them through controlled corruptions. Across five benchmarks, ChronoFlow achieves strong improvements in generation fidelity over existing baselines, while factorization studies support the proposed hierarchy. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [453] [Multi-Dimensional Comparative Scale Construction for Efficient Personalized Subjective Judgment in High-Traffic Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33282)
*Xianglong Shi,Shifeng Liu,Sirui Zhao,Shengming Yuan,Enhong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于成对比较的多维尺度构建框架（SubJudge），用于高效个性化的主观判断。该框架通过稀疏Elo比较与多法官投票机制将离线构建复杂度从O(N²)降至O(NK)，并通过Batchwise Preference Optimization（BPO）训练一个"系统一"模型，使在线推理仅需一次前向传播即可输出连续分数，复杂度为O(1)。9B模型在PluriHarms和iNews基准上匹配或超越多个前沿大模型，在H100 GPU上实现1.29×至261×的推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主观判断在情感建模、内容安全和个性化推荐等高流量应用中至关重要，但面临两大核心挑战：（1）主观强度难以量化，绝对评分在不同语境和个体间解释不一致；（2）主观判断存在显著的个体差异，这种差异不应被视为噪声，而反映了有意义的个人经验、偏好和价值观差异。例如在PluriHarms数据中，同一请求的危害性评分在不同标注者间横跨0-100的完整范围。现有框架难以同时捕捉"感知有多强烈"和"个体感知如何变化"，且需要满足高吞吐实际部署的计算效率要求。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：（1）多维尺度构建：将每个对象定义为"案例-人物"对（z=(x,p)），通过两个互补轴的稀疏比较——同一人物不同案例（捕捉强度差异）和同一案例不同人物（捕捉个体差异）——结合多法官投票聚合与Elo评分更新，将比较复杂度从O(N²)降至O(NK)，其中K为每个对象的对手预算；（2）两阶段后训练（SubJudge模型）：第一阶段采用基于数字的监督微调（Digit SFT），将Elo排序映射至[0,9]并监督第一个响应位置的数字token；第二阶段提出Batchwise Preference Optimization（BPO），利用Bradley-Terry比较在批次内构建偏好矩阵，通过数字token概率的期望读取连续分数，使推理复杂度降至O(1)；（3）连续读出：训练与推理时使用相同公式，对10个数字token的logits做softmax后计算期望值，无需采样或argmax。

Result: 在PluriHarms数据集上，SubJudge（9B Qwen3.5-9B基座）取得Individual MAE 0.1659、Aggregated MAE 0.2278，优于评估的前沿模型（包括Kimi-K3开启思维的0.168、GPT-5.4的0.176等），零拒绝率、100%完成率，且较同基座K-Shot基线Individual MAE降低18.3%。在iNews数据集（Arousal/Dominance/Valence三个维度）上，T+P输入的MAE分别为0.7530、0.6960、0.9361，Arousal MAE较最佳基线GPT-5.6-sol降低15.7%，Arousal精确匹配率达42.31%、±1准确率达85.84%。法官面板消融显示判官组合变化仅导致Individual MAE在0.1659-0.1682间小幅波动，框架具有较好的法官模型无关性。推理效率方面，在H100 GPU上SubJudge平均延迟0.503秒，较Qwen3.5-9B（关闭思维）实现1.29×加速，较256-token思维配置实现17.53×加速，较4096-token思维配置实现261×加速；批次64时吞吐量达4.095 req/s，峰值显存67.36 GiB（比思维配置节省约10.2%）。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了一个统一的成对比较框架，能够同时捕捉细粒度主观强度和跨个体的系统性差异，通过稀疏Elo-多法官投票机制实现高效的离线尺度构建，并利用BPO蒸馏使SubJudge在线推理仅需O(1)前向传播。9B模型在两个互补基准（个性化伤害判断PluriHarms和多模态新闻情感反应iNews）上匹配或超越前沿大模型，验证了比较监督作为高流量应用中个性化主观评估实用基础的有效性。该方法的优势在于将昂贵的比较计算与快速在线评分解耦，通过多法官投票缓解单一LLM法官的系统性偏见，为高吞吐部署提供了兼具准确性、个性化和效率的解决方案。

Abstract: Subjective judgments are central to many high-traffic applications, but subjective intensity is difficult to quantify and perceptions vary substantially across individuals. To address these challenges, we propose a pairwise comparative framework for multi-dimensional scale construction. By comparing case-person pairs along case and profile dimensions, the framework constructs relative scales that capture both fine-grained intensity and individual variation. To support practical high-traffic deployment, we optimize both offline scale construction and online inference. For scale construction, we combine sparse Elo comparisons with multi-judge voting, cutting the comparison cost from $O(N^2)$ to $O(NK)$ for $N$ objects and a budget of $K$ opponents per object, while limiting reliance on any single judge. For inference, we propose SubJudge, a System One model for personalized scoring with Batchwise Preference Optimization (BPO). Using Bradley-Terry comparisons, BPO trains the model to learn relative orderings, and SubJudge reads a continuous score from digit-token probabilities at the first response position, requiring only one forward pass per criterion and reducing the inference complexity to $O(1)$. Experiments on PluriHarms and iNews show that our 9B models match or surpass the evaluated frontier LLMs on multiple metrics. On the H100 GPU, SubJudge achieves an approximately $1.29\times$ to $261\times$ speedup in mean inference latency over Qwen3.5-9B with different thinking budgets. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [454] [RINI: Seeing the Prior Is Not Enough](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33284)
*Hongyi Du,Tianyi Zhang,Heng Wang,Zhelun Gao,Yimei Liu,Ambrose Luo,Annie Hao,Jiayan Ni,Jiawei Han,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 RINI 方法，用于审计和修正科研提案中对既有工作的贡献归属错误。研究发现，仅向模型提供相关已有文献不足以纠正"虚假新颖性"声明；而 RINI 通过证据链接的贡献审计、检查剩余区别并进行局部修订，将修正成功率从 39.1% 提升至 72.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型生成的科研提案常出现"unsupported novelty"（无支撑的新颖性）问题：正确描述了既有方法却声称是其创新。直观上认为提供相关已有文献即可解决，但作者发现仅"看到"先验文献并不足以纠正贡献归属错误，因此需要系统化的贡献审计与修正方法。

Method: 研究分三部分：(1) 构造匹配实验，对比提供决定性先验文献（E）与同主题非覆盖文献（H）对生成提案的影响；(2) 人工诊断 175 对暴露提案，分析识别（recognition）、正确归属（correct attribution）、目标收缩（contraction）、有效迁移（valid relocation）等行为；(3) 提出 RINI 方法，通过贡献审计、剩余区别检查和有界局部替换（最多 4 处）修正提案，并与 Self-Revision 和 Retrieve-and-Revise 在 240 个共同缺陷提案上进行对比评估。

Result: 提供决定性先验文献并未在聚合层面显著降低无支撑新颖性（联合估计 −0.17，95% CI [−0.51, 0.15]）。在 175 个可解释的暴露提案中，137 个识别了文献相关性，但仅 61 个正确归属了既有贡献；71 个提出的"剩余区别"中有 37 个已被同一先验覆盖。在 240 个共同缺陷提案上，修正成功率：Self-Revision 11.7%、Retrieve-and-Revise 39.1%、RINI 72.2%，RINI 较 RR 提升 33.0 个百分点（95% CI [24.5, 41.4]）。RINI 还保持了对研究问题和技术方法的保留，且未引入新的贡献错误（0/360）。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了"接触先验文献"与"正确进行科学归属"之间的鸿沟：模型常识别相关文献却仍错误声称既有方法为创新。RINI 通过显式的证据链接贡献审计和局部修正，有效纠正贡献归属同时保留研究内容。这些发现强调在基于文献生成和修订科研提案时需进行显式的贡献归属，而不能依赖隐式的文献暴露。

Abstract: A research proposal can describe an established mechanism correctly while claiming to introduce it. We study whether providing the earlier paper corrects such contribution claims. Three controlled experiments compare proposals generated with a contribution-bearing prior and a same-topic control. Providing the prior yields no clear aggregate reduction in unsupported novelty. Human analysis of 175 interpretable exposed proposals finds that 137 recognize the prior's relevance, but 61 correctly attribute the established contribution. Of 71 proposed remaining distinctions, 37 are covered by the same prior. We introduce Research Idea Novelty Inspection (RINI), which audits contribution claims against evidence, checks the remaining distinction, and applies local revisions. Five human annotators evaluate 1,080 original-revision pairs across three methods. On the same 240 originals judged to require correction, successful repair is 11.7% for Self-Revision, 39.1% for Retrieve-and-Revise, and 72.2% for RINI, with research tasks weighted equally. The improvement over same-evidence direct revision is 33.0 percentage points. The revised proposals retain their research questions and technical methods. These results motivate explicit contribution attribution when using literature to generate and revise research proposals.

</details>


### [455] [Feedback Makes Perfect: A Closed-Loop Framework for NL-to-STL Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33287)
*Bowen Ye,Xiang Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将自然语言到信号时序逻辑（STL）的翻译重构为闭环反馈过程，通过反向翻译（STL→NL）让用户验证并修正，避免直接阅读形式化语法。实验表明该方法在500个专家需求和7个大模型上显著提升准确性，闭环精炼可使强模型准确率从约89%提升至98-99.2%，弱模型提升超30个百分点，反馈增益源于语义而非重复尝试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一次性、开环的NL到STL翻译存在固有局限：自然语言具有歧义性，且用户所写未必完全反映其真实意图，导致目标规约无法仅从输入文本中完全推导。大语言模型单纯的翻译能力提升已接近准确率上限，任务框架转向。

Method: 将NL到STL翻译重新构建为闭环反馈过程：(1) 前向路径——LLM将自然语言需求翻译为STL公式；(2) 反馈路径——将STL公式反向翻译为自然语言解释；(3) 用户基于解释进行验证或给出修正意见；(4) 根据反馈迭代修订STL公式直至用户接受。该方法借鉴反馈控制理论中前向通道不精确但反馈通道精确可实现精确闭环行为的原理，前向通道（语言→逻辑）难以精确，反向通道（STL→语言）可高度精确。

Result: 在500个专家编写需求和7个LLM上的实验结果：(1) 反向翻译解释与专家判断一致率达99.5%；(2) 闭环精炼使强模型准确率从约89%（开环）提升至98.0–99.2%；(3) 弱模型获得超30个百分点的增益（如17.6%→48.0%）；(4) 消融实验表明增益源于反馈的语义内容而非重复尝试；(5) 专家审计和280次会话的用户研究证实反馈环路可靠性；(6) 识别出反馈不再起作用的模型能力门槛。

Conclusion: 通过将NL-to-STL翻译重构为闭环反馈过程，利用精确的反向翻译通道弥补前向翻译的不精确性，可显著突破单纯依赖更强翻译器的准确率天花板。该框架使用户无需阅读或编写形式化语法，适用于能力不同的各类LLM，并存在反馈失效的能力门槛。

Abstract: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) enables rigorous verification and control of cyber-physical systems, but writing correct specifications requires expertise that most requirement holders lack. Large language models can translate natural-language (NL) requirements into STL, yet stronger translators alone approach an accuracy ceiling. We argue that this ceiling stems from how the task is posed: one-shot, open-loop translation is somewhat ill-defined. Natural language is ambiguous, and, more fundamentally, what a person writes may not always be what they intend, so the target specification is not fully contained in the input text. We therefore reformulate NL-to-STL translation as a closed-loop feedback process. Each generated formula is translated back into natural language for the user to check, and natural-language corrections drive revision until the user accepts the specification. Users never read or write formal syntax. This framework rests on an asymmetry familiar from feedback control theory. The forward path, from ambiguous language to formal logic, is hard and error-prone. The feedback path, from structured STL back to language, can be made highly precise, and a precise feedback path lets an imprecise forward path achieve precise closed-loop behavior. Experiments on 500 expert-authored requirements and seven LLMs support this view. Back-translated explanations agree with expert judgments in 99.5\% of cases. Closed-loop refinement raises strong models from about 89\% open-loop accuracy to 98.0--99.2\%, and yields gains of over 30 percentage points for weaker models (e.g., 17.6\%$\rightarrow$48.0\%). Ablations show these gains come from the semantic content of the feedback rather than from repeated attempts. An expert audit and a 280-session user study further confirm the reliability of the loop. We also identify a capability threshold above which feedback no longer helps.

</details>


### [456] [Learning to Sell: Reinforcement Learning for Strategic Large Language Model Agents in Multi-Product Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33289)
*Shuze Daniel Liu,Claire Chen,Jiuqi Wang,Thorsten Joachims*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对多产品市场中自主LLM智能体作为卖方的多产品议价问题，提出将并发多产品议价建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），通过四段式结构化消息协议（Thought/Target/Talk/Action）将自然语言映射到可验证的决策空间，并使用基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）对Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507进行后训练。训练后的30B智能体在销售者剩余提取和买家-产品匹配质量上匹配或超越万亿参数前沿模型，并在未见市场结构、相关估值分布和价格范围上具有鲁棒泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用大语言模型在多产品并发议价场景中存在系统性的战略短视，倾向于追求早期成交和高交易量而非投资组合层面的利润最大化。在信息不对称和通信预算受限的情况下，过早接受低利润交易会同时移除买家和商品，妨碍更高价值的匹配。研究动机在于通过任务特定的后训练，使智能体能够学习协调信息收集、谈判和分配决策，以最大化整体卖方剩余。

Method: （1）将多产品卖方议价形式化为有限时域POMDP，采用四段式XML消息协议（Thought/Target/Talk/Action）将自然语言映射到可解析、受规则约束的决策空间；（2）奖励函数基于销售者剩余提取比率（清单价减去成本），违规时奖励为-1；（3）采用基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）配合CISPO目标函数，对Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507进行单轮训练；（4）构建包含6,500个来自13个亚马逊类目的可替代产品数据集；（5）设计六维评估指标，包括指令违规率、销售者剩余提取比率、顶端买家成交率和最优配对报价覆盖率；（6）构建6个分布外测试环境，包括规模扩展、结构失衡、相关估值和未见价格范围。

Result: 在分布内测试中，训练的30B智能体获得+0.407的奖励和+0.425的销售者剩余提取比率，优于所有万亿参数前沿模型（包括Kimi-K2.6-thinking的+0.379、DeepSeek-V4-Pro-thinking的+0.369），最优配对报价覆盖率达0.844，顶端买家成交率达0.687，指令违规率仅1.3%（未训练基线为43.3%）。在所有6个分布外环境中均超越最佳基线，奖励优势从+0.089（高商品量环境）到+0.135（未见类目和相关商品估值环境）不等。训练过程显示指令违规率在前15步内迅速下降至接近零，奖励稳步上升，呈现出未受显式监督而自发涌现的买家-商品匹配和资源分配行为。

Conclusion: 研究表明，针对特定任务的RLVR后训练可以使紧凑型30B语言智能体在多产品并发议价中匹配或超越万亿参数前沿模型，实现策略性谈判和买家-商品匹配。智能体学习到的策略能够泛化到未见市场结构、相关估值分布和价格范围，验证了可验证奖励训练在长视野、多智能体、部分可观测战略决策中的有效性。结果揭示了通用语言模型中对话友好性与显式经济优化之间的张力，并展示了任务特定后训练在发展自主战略智能体方面的潜力。

Abstract: Autonomous large language model (LLM) agents operating in multi-product markets must make sequential decisions under information asymmetry and resource constraints. We develop a machine learning approach for training such agents to act effectively as sellers in a multi-item bargaining environment, where a seller concurrently negotiates a catalog of substitutable assets across a pool of independent buyers. Buyers hold private, heterogeneous valuations across products, and each can purchase at most one item. Facing limits on total communication turns, the seller must dynamically match buyers with the most profitable products considering their private valuations, while strategically allocating its limited interaction budget toward combinations of greater potential value. We formalize this problem as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process using a structured, four-part message protocol that maps natural language into a parsable and regulated decision space. Using this formalization, we design a post-training method using Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). To evaluate this framework, we construct a multidimensional metric suite that quantifies constraint adherence, seller surplus extraction, and allocation quality. Our trained seller agent learns to match limited inventory to buyers more effectively, matching or outperforming trillion-parameter frontier models in both seller surplus extraction and buyer-product allocation quality. Finally, these learned strategies generalize robustly to unseen market structures, correlated valuation distributions, and price ranges not encountered during training.

</details>


### [457] [TraceDance: An Automated System for Building Agent Behavior Benchmarks from Real-World Agent Deployment Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33295)
*Dehai Min,Daoan Zhang,Yiming Zeng,Huayi Zhang,Ziyi Chen,Yan Zhang,Qinbo Bai,Mengyuan Chao,Jing Ning,Qiyue Hua,Huiyi Chen,Hanrong Zhang,Henry Peng Zou,Jie Yang,Wei Xu,Philip S. Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TraceDance是一个自动化系统，利用真实部署轨迹构建针对用户指定不良行为的智能体基准测试，采用"决策点续接"评估方法而无需环境重放，并揭示当前LLM在关键决策点的严重行为弱点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准测试主要评估任务完成结果，但智能体可能在执行过程中表现出不良行为（如泄露凭证、未检查错误日志就重试）。固定的测试集无法覆盖部署中新出现的行为问题，需要一种方法将真实部署轨迹转化为可定制的行为基准测试。

Method: 核心方法包括：(1) 决策点续接（decision-point continuation）——在源LLM表现出不良行为的临界点截取上下文，让被评估LLM生成下一轮响应并按行为特定评分细则打分，无需环境重放或参考回答；(2) Anchor-and-Confirm两阶段检索框架——可编程锚点在CPU上扫描结构化轨迹，Flash LLM仅对候选进行行为确认；(3) Anchor Synthesis Loop——为预定义目录外的自定义行为自动生成、验证并修订行为规范（含可执行锚点、确认标准、帧特定切点合约和评分细则）。支持action、failure、claim三种帧类型，并使用三模型评委小组（GPT-5.6-Sol、Gemini-3.5-Flash、Claude Opus 4.8）进行评分。

Result: 基于252,557个会话（Claude Code编码场景和OpenClaw通用工具场景），构建了107个基准测试共4,125个实例，完成了95.3%的构建请求；人类标注者确认84%的实例确实呈现了请求测试的行为，评分细则质量评分为4.5/5（90%达到4分以上），评委小组与人类标注者的一致性（Cohen's κ=0.40）优于标注者之间的一致性（κ=0.31）。九个前沿LLM的平均通过率仅26.7%（22.9%-34.1%），在"执行前需检查"（Check first）类行为上平均通过率仅8.1%（最低Failure-log inspection仅0.6%）；以TodoWrite作为首动作的响应通过率仅4.6%（其他动作为30.8%）。整体排名可能掩盖行为特异性弱点，例如Kimi-K3在Error-guided correction上以57.8%大幅领先Opus 4.8（27.8%）。

Conclusion: TraceDance成功将用户指定的部署问题转化为可复用的决策点续接基准测试，作为递归自我改进（RSI）循环中的关键评估组件；其揭示了当前LLM在关键决策点上的严重行为弱点（如检查错误日志、提交前审计等），这些是任务完成度评估难以发现的；未来工作是在RSI循环中实际部署该系统以指导模型改进并检验回归。

Abstract: An agent can complete a task while exhibiting undesirable behavior during execution. Developers need tests for the specific behaviors encountered in deployment, beyond fixed benchmark suites. We present TraceDance, an agent system that constructs targeted benchmarks from deployment traces for user-specified undesirable behaviors. For efficient construction, Anchor-and-Confirm combines programmable retrieval with candidate-level confirmation by a Flash large language model (LLM), while the Anchor Synthesis Loop generates and revises specifications for custom behaviors. The benchmarks use decision-point continuation to evaluate an LLM's next turn at a recorded decision point with a behavior-specific rubric, without a reference answer or environment replay. Experiments in coding and general tool use draw on 252,557 sessions and produce 107 benchmarks with 4,125 instances, fulfilling 95.3% of build-target requests. Both human annotators confirm the requested behavior in 84% of sampled instances, and the automated grader's agreement with human pass/fail judgments is comparable to that between the annotators. Nine frontier LLMs achieve a mean pass rate of only 26.7%, showing that they still struggle to respond appropriately at the evaluated decision points. Analysis across behavior-specific benchmarks further reveals weaknesses in how current LLMs behave as agents. By turning deployment problems into targeted benchmarks, TraceDance could serve as a key component of the recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop.

</details>


### [458] [The Error You See Is Not the Error You Made: Progression-aware Reasoning Origin for Reasoning Error Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33297)
*Yiguo Wang,Ziyuan Yang,Yi Zou,Dan Lin,Rongsheng Li,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需训练、面向"首个错误步骤定位"（first-error localization）的验证框架 PRO（Progression-aware Reasoning Origin）。核心观点是：在多步推理中，错误可能具有局部合理性，并仅在后续步骤中显式表现出来，因此"第一个被拒的步骤"未必是错误的真正起源。PRO 通过联合建模前向上下文支持（incoming）与后向结构兼容性（outgoing），在信号不一致处触发细粒度细化，并结合干预式重写与重排序，将早期推断错误溯源至其最可能的起源位置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法分为整体式（holistic）和顺序分解式（sequential）。前者缺乏位置证据，后者通常仅基于前向局部检查，将第一个被拒的步骤视为错误源。但在错误传播下，最早被拒绝的位置可能只是错误被暴露的下游节点，真正引入错误的早期步骤可能仍具局部合理性。因此，需要将"错误暴露"与"错误起源"区分开来，引入后向/进展感知证据以更可靠地完成 first-error localization。

Method: PRO 是三阶段、训练自由（training-free）的流水线：（1）进展感知证据建模：对每个块同时计算 incoming 可接受性与 outgoing 与下一块的兼容性，按 (R, A, M) 三态划分；（2）不匹配触发的粒度细化：仅在 M 集合上对局部窗口进行更细粒度重检，以排除粗粒度分解伪影，得到 refined detector index τ_det；（3）起源导向的候选归因：以 τ_det 为锚，构建包含 detector 位置在内的 top-k 候选短名单；对每个候选执行"局部重写 + 重新验证"的干预式证据，最后通过重排序区分真正起源与其下游传播表现。此外，作者形式化证明了结构暴露指数 τ★ ≤ τ_seq（严格可能更早），以及仅靠 incoming 信号无法普遍恢复 τ★。

Result: 在 ProcessBench（GSM8K 子集）的开放域推理、MedReason 竞赛级医疗推理（450 条迹）以及 Number Triangle Summation 的结构化算术推理上进行了评估。基线包括 Holistic Verification、GoV（仅前向分解式）和 PARC（图结构）。结果显示：PRO 在 F1 与 Error Accuracy 上取得一致改进，且跨骨干（Qwen2.5-32B/72B-Instruct、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama3.3-70B-Instruct）保持优势；推理深度越大、错误暴露与起源距离越远，PRO 优势越明显。消融实验表明 Backward Outgoing、Refinement、Top-k Rerank 三组件均必要，其中重排序影响最大。附录给出了 1 型糖尿病案例：GoV 将错误定位到 Step 5，而 PRO 通过候选重写与重排序正确识别 Step 2 为错误起源。

Conclusion: 在错误传播下，"看到的错误"不等同于"犯的错误"。PRO 将检验证据沿轨迹的进展纳入考量，把错误暴露与错误起源解耦，借助下游后果作为回顾性证据，提高了 first-error localization 的忠实度。理论与实验共同支持"可靠的推理检验应建模错误传播而非仅依赖局部逐步判断"这一设计原则。

Abstract: Verifying multi-step LLM reasoning requires more than determining whether a trace is correct: a useful verifier should identify where the reasoning first goes wrong. However, existing holistic methods provide little positional evidence, while forward sequential verification often treats the first rejected step as the error source. Under error propagation, this assumption can fail, since an earlier mistake may remain locally plausible and become observable only through its downstream consequences. We therefore rethink reasoning verification as a progression-aware error-source localization problem: rather than asking only where a reasoning trace first appears inconsistent, we ask which earlier step best explains how that inconsistency emerges along the trajectory. Based on this view, we propose Progression-aware Reasoning Origin (PRO), a training-free framework for first-error localization. PRO jointly models incoming support from the preceding context and outgoing compatibility with subsequent reasoning, selectively refines regions where these signals disagree, and finally performs detector-conditioned source attribution with intervention-based evidence to distinguish the true error origin from its propagated manifestations. We further formalize the gap between forward rejection and structural exposure, showing why incoming-side evidence alone is insufficient for reliable localization under error propagation. Experiments across open-form, medical, and structured reasoning tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong verification baselines, supporting progression-aware source attribution as a more faithful formulation of reasoning verification.

</details>


### [459] [PhysAlign: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Role Alignment in Multimodal Physics Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33319)
*Kecheng Liang,Haoyang Liu,Zexin Chen,Zirong Liu,Weixing Chen,Qiufeng Wang,Yang Liu,Liang Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PhysAlign 是一个针对多模态物理推理的基准测试，旨在通过局部探针和配对控制，将视觉识别与物理角色对齐（即识别到的内容与正确物理实体/角色的对应关系）分离开来，揭示了当前多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉识别正确的情况下仍频繁出现物理角色分配错误的"对齐瓶颈"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态物理推理基准主要评估最终答案或整体推理阶段，无法区分模型错误源于视觉识别失败、视觉信息到物理角色的对应错误，还是后续推理错误。这种耦合导致难以诊断和定位具体的失败模式。

Method: 构建了包含 3,341 个人工验证探针（来自 986 个物理题）的基准 PhysAlign，引入三类探针（T02-single、T03-image、T03-text），并提出五个互补指标（CAcc、GAcc、JAcc 等）。同时设计了配对 Base/+GT 输入控制，通过在保留问题、证据锚点、候选不变的前提下注入正确的局部读取内容，测量角色对齐对正确识别内容的依赖程度。所有评分基于确定性规则，无 LLM 评判。

Result: 在六个主流多模态大模型上测试发现：即使局部内容被正确识别，条件性角色对齐错误率仍达 13.8%（GPT-6 Astra）至 50.6%（InternVL3.5-8B）。配对 +GT 控制带来 1.3–8.1 个百分点的净增益，但项目层面同时存在"修复"与"损害"。最终答案正确并不能保证局部角色对齐正确，反之亦然，两者并非等价测量。

Conclusion: PhysAlign 揭示了 MLLM 中独立于视觉识别的物理角色对齐瓶颈：强大的感知能力并不必然带来可靠的物理解释。这表明未来模型需要通过查询条件化的局部检查以及包含保留内容但交换实体或角色的困难负样本来训练，从而更好地将识别到的视觉证据与其物理含义对齐。

Abstract: A key challenge in physics diagram understanding is correctly associating visual information with the physical entities, relations, and conditions it describes. Even when a value, symbol, or other local element is accurately recognized, assigning it to the wrong entity or scope can distort the underlying physical premise and lead to incorrect reasoning. To systematically study this challenge, we introduce \textbf{PhysAlign}, a benchmark designed to assess whether multimodal models correctly associate information recognized from physics diagrams with its intended physical role. By disentangling visual recognition from physical-role assignment through localized probes and controlled variants, PhysAlign isolates correspondence errors from recognition failures. It contains 3,341 human-validated probes spanning 986 physics problems, enabling systematic evaluation of visual recognition and physical-role correspondence at scale. We further introduce five complementary evaluation metrics, including CAcc, GAcc, and JAcc, which provide a comprehensive assessment of models' ability to recognize diagram content, establish correct physical correspondences, and solve the underlying physics problem. Across our evaluated multimodal models, PhysAlign reveals a consistent gap between local visual recognition and physical-role grounding. Even when the queried content is correctly recognized, the conditional correspondence error rate remains 13.8\% for GPT-6-Astra and rises to about 50.6\% for InternVL3.5-8B. These findings indicate that strong perception alone does not ensure reliable physical interpretation, exposing a distinct grounding bottleneck that is largely hidden by answer-level accuracy and highlighting the need for future models to better align recognized visual evidence with its physical meaning.

</details>


### [460] [Agentic Multi-Turn Reasoning: A Fairness Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33323)
*Thanh-Dat Truong,Sankalp Pandey,Hugh Churchill,Jackson Cothren,Marios Savvides,Khoa Luu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization (Fair-MPO/Φ-MPO)，一种用于智能体多轮推理学习的偏好优化框架。该方法通过多层级偏好学习和公平加权机制，同时解决长程信用分配和数据分布不平衡两大核心难题，在多个智能体推理基准测试中取得了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体系统通过多轮规划、工具使用、验证和记忆更新解决复杂任务，但学习面临两大挑战：(1) 长程信用分配——监督信号仅在最终结果可用，难以归因中间步骤；(2) 数据分布不平衡——主导数据模式偏置优化，削弱对稀有但信息丰富的推理行为的适应性。现有RL方法（PPO/GRPO/Flow-GRPO）存在高方差和价值估计不稳定问题，而标准DPO为单输出设计，无法建模智能体轨迹的序列结构。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) Multi-Level Preference Optimization (MPO)——将轨迹级偏好分解为多个对齐的状态级比较，通过动态规划构建对齐集A来配对语义相关的中间状态；(2) Rollout评分机制——基于正确性、工具调用数和推理步数计算综合评分S(τ)以构建on-the-fly偏好对；(3) Fair Multi-Level Objective (Φ-MPO)——引入focal加权因子(1-p_ij)^γ，抑制简单偏好对的梯度贡献，强调困难对。理论证明：(a) DPO与K-GRPO在仅相差正加权时具有等价的成对优化方向；(b) focal加权以(γ+1)阶速率ε^(γ+1)抑制简单多数对的优化影响。最终损失为L_DPO和L_Φ-MPO的加权组合。

Result: 在Search-R1+DeepMath数据集上训练，使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct作为Action Planner。在四个基准测试类别共10个数据集上取得SOTA：(1) 知识密集搜索：Bamboogle 81.6%, 2Wiki 81.5%, HotpotQA 69.0%, Musique 35.0%；(2) 智能体推理GAIA：41.7%；(3) 数学推理：AIME24 50.0%, AMC23 72.5%, GameOf24 65.0%；(4) 科学推理：GPQA 59.0%, MedQA 86.0%。7B模型在所有搜索基准上超越GPT-4o，Qwen3.5-9B版本进一步提升至85.6%/85.0%/77.0%/40.0%/49.6%。消融实验验证了多层级监督和focal加权（最优γ=2.0）的有效性，且λ_Φ-MPO比λ_DPO权重更关键。增大推理轮数T从3到10可持续提升性能。

Conclusion: Φ-MPO作为一种新颖的智能体学习框架，有效解决了长程推理和数据不平衡的双重挑战。理论分析证明了DPO与GRPO的成对等价性以及focal加权对简单多数支配的抑制作用。大量实验表明该方法在多个智能体推理基准上达到SOTA，且在跨模型规模（3B/7B/9B）和不同骨干网络（Qwen2.5/Qwen3.5）下均具有良好可扩展性。局限性在于对focal参数γ、rollout多样性和奖励可靠性的敏感性。

Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems capable of solving complex tasks through multi-turn planning, tool use, verification, and memory updates. However, learning agentic systems remains difficult due to two fundamental challenges, i.e., (1) long-horizon credit assignment, where supervision is available only at the final outcome, and (2) imbalanced data distributions, where dominant data patterns bias optimization and weaken adaptation to rare but informative reasoning behaviors. In this paper, we propose Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization (Fair-MPO or $\Phi$-MPO), a new preference optimization framework for agentic learning. We first show that Multi-Level Preference Optimization provides a principled and more computationally efficient framework for long-horizon reasoning. Then, we introduce a Fair Multi-Level Objective that addresses imbalance in agentic learning. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis demonstrating that our approach addresses both long-horizon reasoning and data imbalance. Our experiments on agentic reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves State-of-the-Art (SOTA) performance.

</details>


### [461] [ANTMAN: Adaptive Need Tracking for Multi-Agent Navigation in Large Information Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33326)
*Jerry Wang,Haibo Jin,Xiaopeng Yuan,Peng Kuang,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ANTMAN是一种多智能体信息检索协调框架，将演化中的信息需求作为协调的基本单元而非静态空间划分，从而在大幅扩展的信息空间中保持恒定的协调开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体长上下文系统（如LongAgent、CoA）采用静态分区策略，将输入划分为固定大小的块并分配给各工作智能体，导致协调开销随信息空间线性增长，与查询实际需求严重脱节。此外，传统的信息检索缺乏对"未解决需求"的显式可修订表示，难以适应搜索过程中不断变化的信息需求。

Method: ANTMAN框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 静态基底映射——将信息空间确定性划分为M个领域(territories)，每个领域关联一个轻量级的WorkerCard描述其内容范围；(2) 可修订需求图(Need Graph)——作为运行时控制状态，显式追踪每个未解决需求的解决状态、累积证据、历史尝试和进度信号，支持需求的解决、重构、再路由和回退等动态更新；(3) 需求驱动的协调机制——基于当前需求图选择未解决需求，路由到对应领域的工作智能体进行有界本地信息检索，当进度停滞时触发任务级恢复。该框架通过公式|A(q)| ≤ min{M, ρH(q)}形式化证明了协调开销与查询需求而非空间大小相关。

Result: 在三个评估场景中均表现优异：(1) 标准多文档QA上ANTMAN在HotpotQA/2Wiki/MuSiQue上平均EM/F1达0.711/0.814，超越所有基线；(2) 控制性空间扩展测试中，当信息空间增长16倍时，ANTMAN的活跃协调仅增长1.23倍（LongAgent和CoA超过15倍），且F1提升+0.065；(3) 现实结构化导航中，ANTMAN在RepoProbe、SWE-QA-Pro和GAIA上分别超越最强基线15.3%、18.4%和27.9%。使用Qwen3-8B小型工作模型时仍保留89.2%-98.3%的性能。位置鲁棒性测试显示ANTMAN中间位置差距仅+0.015，而全上下文推理为-0.181。消融实验验证了需求修订、适应性重路由和恢复机制的互补贡献。

Conclusion: ANTMAN证明了协调开销无需与信息空间大小绑定。通过将演化中的未解决信息需求作为运行时控制状态，可以同时实现空间可扩展性和强答案质量。该框架为多智能体信息检索提供了一种新的设计范式：协调应随查询需求而非信息可用量增长。未来工作将聚焦于更丰富的信息基底、可迁移的需求表示以及更精细的修订和路由策略。

Abstract: Information-seeking agents increasingly operate over information spaces that are too large to process exhaustively. Yet many multi-agent systems organize computation around static partitions of the available space, causing coordination to grow with how information is segmented rather than with what the query still requires. We introduce ANTMAN, an adaptive coordination framework that treats evolving unresolved information needs as the unit of runtime coordination. ANTMAN maintains a revisable Need Graph that tracks unresolved requirements, accumulated evidence, prior attempts, and search progress, and uses this state to control worker selection, routing, and task-local recovery as new evidence is discovered. By separating the coordination policy from substrate-specific search interfaces, the same need-conditioned mechanism can operate across different information spaces. Experiments across multi-document question answering, controlled long-context scaling, and realistic structured navigation show that ANTMAN remains effective across settings, including when execution is delegated to substantially smaller worker models. Under a 16x increase in searchable context, ANTMAN increases active coordination by only 1.23x, compared with more than 15x for partition-driven baselines, while preserving strong answer quality.

</details>


### [462] [Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching for Sign Language Production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33339)
*Jiayi He,Shengeng Tang,Sisi You,Yanbin Hao,Lechao Cheng,Richang Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SignNMFlow框架，将手语生成(SLP)从流匹配视角重新建模为流形上的传输问题，通过在单位四元数乘积流形上构造自然度引导的条件路径（耦合闭式测地线与可学习偏差），解决了现有基于条件流匹配(CFM)的SLP方法因欧氏空间线性插值而偏离关节旋转流形的几何失配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于条件流匹配(CFM)的手语生成方法（如SignFlow、SignSparK）通过欧氏空间的线性插值构造条件路径，但人体关节旋转构成SO(3)^J流形，线性插值会产生违反正交性约束的中间状态（Property 1），且忽略了手语运动的分布特性，导致生成的运动偏离流形且与运动分布不一致。

Method: 1) 使用单位四元数乘积流形 M=(S³)^J 表示手语运动；2) 通过K-means聚类提取K个原型运动，定义基于核加权散度矩阵的运动自然度测度 G(x)=m(x)(S(x)+ρI)^{-1}，将其从点提升为路径上的动能度量；3) 通过最小化自然度测度下的动能，学习自然度引导插值 x_t=Exp_{x0}(t·Log_{x0}(x1) + t(1-t)·ε_θ)，耦合闭式测地线（几何项）与可学习偏差（自然度项）；4) 采用目标预测参数化（而非速度预测）训练生成网络φ，沿冻结的修正网络ε_θ定义的路径进行推理。

Result: 在Phoenix-2014T、CSL-Daily和How2Sign三个数据集上，手部DTW-PA-JPE分别达到1.07、1.30、2.07，BLEU-4分别达到16.15、15.14、16.88，均超越现有SOTA方法；用户研究中81.11%的偏好率显著优于SOKE(7.78%)和SignFlow(11.11%)；推理效率上以233.20M参数和0.0103秒/动作的延迟实现了相比SignFlow 8.3倍、SOKE 26.1倍的加速；消融实验验证了运动表示(MR)、几何效率(GE)和自然度引导(NG)三个模块各自的有效性。

Conclusion: SignNMFlow通过在运动流形上直接构造同时兼顾几何效率和运动分布的条件路径，显著提升了手语生成的质量与保真度，为基于流匹配的SLP提供了新的流形传输视角。

Abstract: Sign Language Production (SLP) aims to generate sign motions from text. Conditional Flow Matching methods have achieved strong performance in SLP by constructing conditional paths that transform a source distribution into a target distribution. However, existing methods construct these paths via linear interpolation, whereas the rotational geometry of human joints confines valid joint rotations to a manifold embedded in Euclidean space. Consequently, linear interpolation between two sign motions leaves this manifold and ignores the motion distribution on it. In this paper, we revisit SLP from the perspective of manifold transport and propose a Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching framework, termed \textbf{SignNMFlow}, which constructs conditional paths directly on the motion manifold by jointly considering geometric efficiency and the motion distribution. Specifically, we exploit the intrinsic geometry of the manifold and introduce a motion naturalness measure to characterize the motion distribution. By minimizing the kinetic energy under this measure, we learn a naturalness-guided interpolation that couples a closed-form geodesic, which provides geometrically efficient transport, with a learnable deviation that incorporates the motion distribution, thereby significantly improving the fidelity of generated sign motions. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of this work.

</details>


### [463] [QuPID: Quantum Parameter-Efficient Input-Dependent Retrieval Adaptation for Medical RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33351)
*Hyojun Ahn,Emily Jimin Roh,Soohyun Park,Walid Saad,Hyung-Chul Lee,Joongheon Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QuPID 提出了一种用于医学 RAG 检索的量子参数高效输入依赖适配方法,仅用 60 个共享参数即可在 ChestX-ray14 和 MURA 上实现比 5.25M 参数的 Adapter 和 LoRA 更高的 P@5;其核心是通过数据重上传和测量读出替代基于状态保真度的相似度比较,以规避共享酉变换下的训练退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像检索中,病理信息常被池化后的通用解剖特征淹没,导致相似病例在冻结特征空间中近似共线,引发诊断不一致的检索证据和 RAG 幻觉;且数据保护法规限制了数据外流,本地可用适配样本有限。因此需要一种参数极少、无需专家标注的检索几何适配方法。

Method: 方法包含三项关键设计:(1) 通过 Proposition 1 证明,冻结特征经过振幅编码后,共享输入无关酉变换下的保真度排序对参数不可训练,故该方法采用数据重上传使电路输入依赖;(2) 相似度不再比较量子态,而是比较局部 Pauli 期望读出向量 z ∈ R^40 的余弦;(3) 用 SimCLR 式对比损失进行无标签训练,理论分析给出读出的频谱上界(Proposition 2)和参数计数泛化界(Proposition 3)。电路仅 60 个共享参数(10 量子比特、3 层、4n_q 个观测)。

Result: 在 ChestX-ray14 和 MURA 上,QuPID 的 60 参数取得比最高 5.25M 参数 Adapter/LoRA 更高的 P@5;在 ChestX-ray14 上较冻结编码器提升 +0.116 P@5,512 适配样本时较重调 Adapter 优势最大(+0.040);在 IU X-Ray 和 MIMIC-CXR 的报告生成中,QuPID 的检索上下文使 CheXbert-F1 和 RadGraph-F1 优于 Adapter。在 MVTec AD 和 CUB-200 上同样观察到该模式。噪声模拟和有限采样读出表明排序质量在 10^4 shots 时与精确期望仅相差 0.002 P@5。

Conclusion: QuPID 验证了电路定义的测量特征是参数高效检索适配的可行路径,在仅 60 参数下达到或超过百万级参数 Adapter/LoRA 的检索质量;但其优势仅在经典 GPU 模拟下成立,不声称量子计算优势;在 512 适配样本下对等参数对照(rotation-plane head)的 95% 置信区间包含零。该方法适用于本地、低数据、参数极受限的检索适配场景。

Abstract: Fidelity-based quantum retrieval ranks candidates by the fidelity between query and archive states. Applying a shared input-independent unitary after fixed state encoding leaves that fidelity unchanged, so training the circuit cannot alter the ranking. Quantum parameter-efficient input-dependent retrieval adaptation (QuPID) repairs this by making the circuit input-dependent through data re-uploading and by comparing measurement readouts, vectors of local Pauli expectations, rather than states. The result is a small readout for adapting frozen image features to a local archive with limited data: training simulates the circuit classically, and inference runs on a GPU with fixed learned parameters. We characterize the class as a structured factorization of input-modulated quadratic feature maps, bound the frequency support of its re-uploading channel, and give a parameter-count generalization bound that motivates its small budget.
