Conclusion: 发布的 Laya 检查点系统性欠自信，与模型卡的过自信框架相反；继承的温度覆盖配置方向错误（软化而非锐化）。一个不相交拟合的标量温度可消除大部分误校准，但冻结的 NLL 选择规则偏好表达力强的等渗回归，无法泛化。确认阈值在两条独立轨道上都未达到其误差目标。可重用的教训是：对校准器和阈值采用交叉拟合（split-half）或选择 τ 时使用上置信界。部署建议：本地可审计的紧凑类型化评分器加上一个拟合温度可在约 2/3 覆盖度下作为有用的分诊阶段，但接受集必须审计，阈值必须本地验证，且该检查点不应部署于分布外场景（E10 探针显示无零样本迁移，准确率从分布内 0.858 降至 OOD 0.617）。

Abstract: The shipped Laya Typed-Decisions checkpoint, a 421M-parameter ModernBERT-large assessor that answers typed choice/noul/score questions over workflow state, is uniformly under-confident. The signed confidence-accuracy gap is $-0.214$, every occupied reliability bin's accuracy exceeds its confidence, and that sign uniformity collapses every binned ECE variant to the same value, $0.214$. The card frames the risk as over-confidence; the measured direction is the opposite, and the direction decides which way a confidence-gated cascade fails. A single disjointly fitted temperature ($T=0.469$, sharpening) removes most of the miscalibration (held-out ECE $0.204$ to $0.037$) and outperforms the shipped per-option-count table. The frozen selection rule instead chose isotonic regression, which overfit and failed its held-out NLL contrast on both tracks, so hypothesis H2 is not supported. Re-running the released checkpoint on its full official test split reproduces the card's headline accuracy ($0.767$ vs. $0.766$). The retrospective E1 reproduction preceded the analysis freeze; E2-E8 were prospectively preregistered, and 20 of 22 executed confirmatory tests reject under Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at $q=0.05$ (two descoped). The frozen gate beats random escalation but misses its 10% accepted-set error target on both tracks, an exploratory out-of-distribution probe finds no zero-shot transfer (accuracy $0.617$), and every score measures agreement with a synthetic teacher whose self-agreement ceiling ($0.735$) the specialist exceeds. Per-decision predictions, run manifests, and the frozen preregistration are in the ancillary files. The author has no affiliation with the model's publisher, the dataset's publisher, or TypeSafe.

</details>


### [518] [How code helps different tasks? A decompositional lens on LLM post-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33845)
*Zheng Yu,Yiwei Li,Yishen Chen,Xiang Li,Jiale Han,Benyou Wang,Jingbang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种"分解式视角"（decompositional lens），将可执行验证的Python代码语料按其解决方案的主导计算模式（如动态规划、哈希计数、字符串解析等）分解为10个可解释类别。通过在6个指令微调模型和11个评测配置上进行受控微调实验，研究代码数据的类别特定迁移效应及其在联合训练中的组合效果。研究发现：(1) 平衡混合训练一致提升QA任务平均表现，但代码与数学任务的提升因模型而异；(2) 最佳类别同时依赖于起始模型和目标任务；(3) 在特定模型-任务对上，紧凑的2-3类别混合（仅使用全语料的10-15%）能同时超越其最佳单类别成分和全语料训练，展现出"少即是多"的模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常将代码数据视为单一语料，模糊了不同类型代码示例对不同模型和下游任务的差异化贡献。有效的数据选择需要理解单个类别的效益以及这些效益在类别组合后是否保留。同时，关于代码数据的研究发现（如代码暴露、表示、结构复杂度）并未明确指定哪些计算类别对特定模型有益，或这些效益在联合训练时如何变化。

Method: 方法包含三个核心步骤：(1) 将KodCode语料（35,974个Python示例）按解决方案的主导计算模式分解为10个类别（数学/数论、动态规划、图/状态、贪心/搜索、实现/工具、哈希/集合、范围/矩阵、序列变换、排序/有序处理、字符串/解析），采用AI标注+AI审查的两阶段分类流程；(2) 在6个指令微调模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B、Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen1.5-7B）上使用LoRA（rank 16，alpha 32）进行单类别微调（1,706样本，107步）和平衡混合微调，比较11个评测配置（HumanEval/MBPP/MBPP+、GSM8K/MATH-M/MATH-H、ARC-C/FinQA/LegalBench/MedCalc/ScienceQA）；(3) 基于单类别结果构建紧凑的2-3类别混合（Personalized Top2/Top3、Shared Top3），与平衡对照、比例采样对照和全语料微调（35,974样本，2,249步）进行对比。报告三种子均值，使用百分比点变化（Δ=S_trained-S_Base）衡量迁移效应。

Result: RQ1：平衡混合在所有6个模型上提升5任务QA均值（+0.6至+2.9 pp），其中26/30的模型-任务分数提升；但代码与数学任务表现因模型而异（如Qwen3在数学上+1.4 pp但代码上-6.5 pp，Gemma-2则相反）。所有60个单类别配置均提升QA均值，仅24个提升代码+数学合并均值。RQ2：类别排名可随任务或模型反转。例如，Llama-3.1上Imp在MATH-M上提升+7.6 pp而DP下降-2.9 pp，但在MATH-H上两者关系反转；同样在MATH-M上，Imp对Llama-3.1有利但对Llama-3.2不利。每个模型的Overall均值都有一个单类别配置优于示例匹配的平衡混合（+0.5至+1.2 pp）。RQ3：在精选的模型-任务对上，2-3类别混合（5,118样本，320步）在17对模型-任务中同时超越最佳单类别成分和全语料训练，使用仅10-15%的数据。严格筛选下，3类别有18/132次通过、2类别有9/66次通过，覆盖16个不同的模型-任务对。Imp在所有6个模型的ARC-Challenge和ScienceQA上一致提升QA均值，审计显示可能与更好地应用题目陈述的条件和变量关系有关。

Conclusion: 该论文确立了分解式视角作为研究代码数据在LLM后训练中作用的可行方法，揭示了：(1) 代码数据的价值高度依赖于模型和任务的特定组合，"更广泛覆盖"不等于"更好性能"；(2) 单类别层面的效益不一定在联合训练中保留，但当成分类别都各自改善目标时，紧凑混合可以优于全语料训练，呈现"少即是多"的模式；(3) QA提升具有跨类别一致性，而数学和代码任务的迁移表现出模型依赖性。研究强调了代码数据选择应同时考虑类别组成和目标任务的增益分布，需要基于具体模型和任务进行定制化的数据组合策略。然而，研究也存在局限：仅限Python语言，类别间存在计算模式重叠，筛选过程具有探索性（选方与评测使用相同测试套件），且训练预算（样本数/token数）在单类别、混合和全语料间未匹配，无法完全分离类别协同效应与训练量效应。未来工作需要独立的选方目标和冻结配方进行验证。

Abstract: Evaluating code data as a single corpus can obscure which types of code data benefit which models and downstream tasks. Effective data selection requires understanding both the benefits of individual categories and whether these benefits persist when categories are combined. We introduce a decompositional lens for studying these effects in LLM post-training. We first decompose an execution-verified code corpus into interpretable categories based on the computational patterns of its solutions. Through controlled fine-tuning experiments, we compare individual categories with a balanced mixture across instruction-tuned models on question answering, mathematics, and code generation. The resulting response maps reveal recurring gains in average question-answering performance, while the same category can improve one model or task and degrade another. The best-performing category also varies with the starting model and target task. We then compose compact mixtures guided by these results and examine whether benefits observed in individual categories persist under joint training. On selected model--task pairs, mixtures whose constituents each improve the target task outperform both their best constituent and full-corpus training while using roughly 10--15\% of the full corpus. These exploratory findings illustrate a \emph{less is more} pattern and highlight how the value of code data in post training depends on which categories are combined for which model and task.

</details>


### [519] [R$^2$ Flow: Recursive Self-Improvement via Recursive Skill Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33867)
*Mingda Zhang,Qiang Huang,Yanjin Li,Zijia Wang,Qika Lin,Xiaoying Tang,Tiesunlong Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: R²Flow 提出了一种基于共享状态编排图的递归自改进框架，通过流网络训练（递归残差轨迹平衡 R²TB）实现可验证门控的技能库演化，在十二个跨域数据集上显著优于启发式编排、强化学习和技能进化基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体的递归自改进面临三大障碍：树状历史结构导致策略坍缩（同一过程的不同顺序排列无法共享证据）、非负的流式信用将频繁调用等同于收益、以及库编辑依赖于策略所优化的任务奖励（评估者被优化器利用）。

Method: 提出 R²Flow 框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 共享状态编排图 σ(H)=(E,≺,∂,V,Ω)，通过 Mazurkiewicz 迹等价合并仅独立步骤顺序不同的历史，使反向策略在合并状态上有真实选择；(2) R²TB（递归残差轨迹平衡）目标，在子轨迹平衡基础上加入领域偏置 b_d 和推理文本条件的前向策略，并分离"流份额"Ψ⁰(u)（参考流三元组下的不变量）和"有符号效用"Ã_e（衡量技能是否有帮助）；(3) 验证器门控的技能库更新，使用分层 Beta 后验的可信区间（LCB/UCB）而非点估计，由参考边缘流 φ⁰(e) 分配验证预算，通过残差方差平稳期触发阶段切换，编辑须经配对非劣性验证方可提交。

Result: 在 12 个数据集（QA、数学推理、交互决策、代码生成）上，R²Flow 在分布内（IID）平均 EM 提升 41.6 点、准确率提升 26.9 点，分布外（OOD）EM 提升 54.6 点、准确率提升 28.8 点，均显著优于 AFlow、FlowSteer、Trace2Skill、SkillOpt 等基线（p<10⁻³）；阶段间 OOD 分数从 71.2 升至 81.02，37 次编辑中 33 次提升保留验证分数（精度 0.89）；签署效用使 12 个注入有害技能中被剪除 11 个；组件消融显示共享状态贡献最大（IID -7.31、OOD -5.99 点）。

Conclusion: R²Flow 通过共享状态编排图解决策略坍缩、分离流份额与有符号效用解决无差别信用、通过验证器证据独立于任务奖励进行库编辑，实现了可靠的递归技能进化，在跨任务和跨执行器场景中均表现出显著且一致的改进。

Abstract: LLM-based agents can improve themselves across tasks by reusing and revising the skills they orchestrate into executable procedures. Flow-based training fits this loop: it samples procedures in proportion to reward, and the flow through each skill credits it for the next library revision. Three obstacles stand in the way of making this self-improvement reliable: flow training suffers strategy collapse over tree-structured histories; nonnegative flow-based credit rewards frequent use as if it were benefit; and library edits rest on the task reward the policy optimizes. We introduce R$^2$ Flow, a recursive self-improvement framework that alternates policy learning, independent verification, and versioned skill-library updates on a shared-state orchestration graph. The graph merges histories that differ only in the order of independent steps, allowing flow training to pool evidence across equivalent executions. A flow-share readout of the trained flow, invariant to the backward policy, and a separate signed utility rank which skills to change, verifier evidence decides whether an edit is warranted, and a residual-variance plateau sets when to update. Committed edits reshape the graph the next policy learns on, realizing recursive skill evolution. Across question answering, mathematical reasoning, interactive decision making, and code generation, R$^2$ Flow improves task accuracy and library-edit precision over heuristic orchestration, reinforcement learning, and skill-evolution baselines, and transfers across executors. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [520] [When Successful Strategies Fail: Adaptation to Environmental Novelty in Terminal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33870)
*Janvijay Singh,Vaishnavi Shrivastava,Dilek Hakkani-Tur,Ece Kamar,Asli Celikyilmaz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究了LLM智能体在环境发生变化时（环境新颖性）的适应能力，提出了AGNI自动化流水线用于生成可控的环境新颖性，并在三个终端基准上评估了多个LLM，发现存在显著的适应差距，且通过新颖性增强的后训练和元动作推理可以缩小这一差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在长视野任务中依赖隐式环境假设，但当这些假设失效时，智能体需要检测变化并调整策略。论文旨在研究这种适应能力，并将环境新颖性定义为在保持任务目标不变的前提下，使原本成功的策略所依赖的假设失效的环境变化。

Method: 论文引入了AGNI（假设引导的新颖性注入）流水线，包含求解器、策略分析器、新颖性生成器、实现器和行为观察器等模块。AGNI从验证成功的轨迹中提取环境假设，注入针对性的环境变化，并验证新颖任务仍然可解。论文还提出了新颖性增强训练和元动作推理（明确推理每个动作的战略意图，如检查、诊断、修改、验证）作为提升适应能力的方法。

Result: 在三个终端基准（ET-eval、TB-Lite、TB-2）上评估了七个LLM，发现环境新颖性使pass@1平均下降16-31个百分点，且基础任务表现强的模型不一定具有更好的适应能力。轨迹分析表明，智能体常常遇到变化的证据但未能诊断原因并修改策略。新颖性增强训练将ET-eval适应差距从45.8缩小到28.6个百分点，元动作推理进一步将pass@1从29.5%提升到37.9%，且过程奖励对适应能力的提升有限。

Conclusion: 论文揭示了任务能力与适应能力之间的差距，强调应将环境变化作为智能体训练和评估的核心维度。研究表明，将环境新颖性纳入训练数据和引入显式的元动作推理可以有效提升智能体在变化环境中的适应能力。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks by autonomously interacting with their environment. In doing so, their strategies rely on assumptions about that environment: which resources and tools exist, where they are located, and how they behave. When these assumptions no longer hold, reliable agents must detect the change and adapt while pursuing the same goal. We study this adaptation capability through environmental novelty: a change that keeps the task objective fixed while invalidating an assumption underlying an otherwise successful trajectory. We introduce AGNI, an automated pipeline that extracts trajectory-relevant assumptions, injects targeted environmental changes, and validates that the resulting novel tasks remain solvable. Across three terminal benchmarks, AGNI produces diverse novelties spanning resources, interfaces, constraints, and execution semantics. Evaluating multiple LLM agents reveals a substantial adaptation gap between base and novel tasks. Trajectory analysis suggests that agents often encounter evidence of the change but fail to diagnose its cause and revise their strategy. Finally, post-training for environmental novelty improves adaptation to held-out novel tasks while also improving performance on base tasks. Our results highlight a gap between task competence and adaptive capability and motivate environmental variation as a core dimension of agent training and evaluation.

</details>


### [521] [Curating Merchant-Matching Training Data with Two Confidence-Gated Local LLM Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33878)
*Donghao Huang,Jinling Pei,Zhaoxia Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究商户匹配任务中伪标签数据清洗问题，提出基于两个本地LLM法官置信度门控的分阈值一致性策略。核心发现：高选择阈值提升正标签纯度但增加漏配，高弃权阈值降低负标签纯度；为正负标签设置独立有序阈值可避免矛盾标签。(0.86, 0.80)操作点在81.7%覆盖率下实现96.88%总纯度，但46个错误弃权即使零阈值下仍存在，且更高推理投入未带来F0.5提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商户匹配需将噪声支付描述符解析为检索到的商户实体，或返回无匹配。训练标签整理的关键挑战是区分教师弃权与证据性无匹配：错误的负标签污染伪标签数据，保守标签则降低覆盖率。需探究双法官一致性是否提升伪标签可靠性。

Method: 形式化分门控一致性策略：选择阈值τ_sel控制正标签集P，弃权阈值τ_abs控制负标签集N，需满足τ_abs≤τ_sel以保证P∩N=∅。使用Muse Glimmer 30B（zero-shot, low, v1）与Gemma 4 31B（k=20, off, v2）配对，在2000条专家标注查询上进行回放。在0.60-0.98阈值网格上扫描，测量纯度与覆盖率，并通过200次分层随机对半拆分（400次保留评估）量化阈值选择乐观性。

Result: 在(τ_sel, τ_abs)=(0.86, 0.80)下，配对策略标注1633条查询（81.7%覆盖率），总纯度96.88%，正纯度99.47%，负纯度93.38%；比单模型高2+百分点，但覆盖率更低。46个错误弃权在零阈值下仍存在，对称阈值0.86额外增加40个错误无匹配。5项配对推理努力比较中，所有F0.5区间包含零，但延迟增加1.8-5.0倍。阈值选择乐观性仅0.14百分点。

Conclusion: 分门控一致性可显著提升商户匹配伪标签纯度，正负标签的不对称误差行为要求独立阈值设置与审计；较高推理努力在此评估条件下无明确F0.5收益；研究建立的是标签纯度而非学生效用，新数据整理与学生微调仍是必要的下游验证。

Abstract: Merchant matching resolves a noisy payment descriptor to a retrieved merchant entity or returns no match. A key challenge in curating training labels is distinguishing teacher abstention from evidence that no acceptable entity exists: false no-match labels contaminate pseudo-labeled data, while conservative labeling reduces coverage. We investigate whether agreement between two local large language model judges improves pseudo-label reliability. A label is retained only when the judges agree, with separate ordered thresholds for selections and abstentions that guarantee disjoint positive and negative label sets. Retrospective replay on 2,000 expert-annotated queries shows that higher selection thresholds can improve positive-label purity, whereas higher abstention thresholds increase false no-match labels. At thresholds (0.86, 0.80), Muse Glimmer 30B and Gemma 4 31B jointly label 1,633 queries (81.7% coverage) at 96.88% purity; positive and negative purities are 99.47% and 93.38%. This exceeds either constituent model at the same thresholds by more than two percentage points, with lower coverage. A split-half check finds only 0.14 percentage points of threshold-selection optimism. A symmetric threshold of 0.86 adds 40 erroneous no-match labels, while 46 false abstentions persist even with no confidence threshold. Across five matched within-model comparisons, higher reasoning effort yields no clear F0.5 gain and increases median latency by 1.8-5.0 times. These results motivate separate thresholding and auditing for positive and negative pseudo-labels. The study establishes label purity, not student utility; fresh-data curation and student fine-tuning remain necessary to demonstrate downstream value.

</details>


### [522] [When Consent Outlives Context: Residual Authority Replay in Long-Lived Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33910)
*Zhihao Zhang,Chao Wang,Rujia Li,Qingze Wang,Xiaoyan Sun,Jun Dai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示并形式化了长生命周期LLM智能体中一种新型安全漏洞——"残留权限重放"（Residual Authority Replay）：用户授权一旦跨越任务/会话边界被持久化，原授权所依赖的上下文已改变，但该权限仍可在新上下文中被恶意复用而无需重新获得同意。论文通过对八个生产级编码智能体进行源码级授权语义分析、508个AgentDojo攻击案例（覆盖六大模型家族）以及55个Terminal-Bench真实智能体（Codex/Gemini CLI/Goose）现场实验，证明残留权限可使提示注入与上下文重绑定攻击成功率提升最高35.1个百分点（平均24.9个百分点），并指出更细粒度的匹配仅能降低而无法消除这一时序性授权缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长生命周期LLM智能体（long-lived agents）日趋保留跨任务/会话的状态以减少重复授权开销，但用户授权（consent）天然具有上下文依赖性，而持久化授权机制将同意"有损编译"为可复用的谓词，仅保留了原始操作的部分属性。一旦后续执行上下文（路径、可执行文件、依赖、内容等）发生重绑定，先前合法的授权可能被静默用于安全含义已完全改变的操作。真实事件（如Gemini CLI、Meta Muse、Codex中的跨项目/账户权限泄露）已印证该风险。论文的核心问题是：攻击者能否主动通过良性交互"积累"残留权限，并在随后的对抗性上下文中重放以放大提示注入与上下文重绑定攻击的成功率。

Method: 1) **授权画像（Authorization Profiling）**：对Codex、Gemini CLI、Goose、OpenCode、Cline、Continue、OpenHands、Aider八款生产级智能体进行源码逆向与字段级污点传播，提取每个系统的授权源、授权检查点、授权范围Σ_i、存储表示F_i、匹配谓词M_i与生命周期L_i，并通过对单属性重放与跨边界回放进行原生验证。2) **残留权限回放攻击构造（四阶段）**：① 从目标有害动作反推所需授权状态A_req；② 良性任务映射（backchaining）将所需授权映射到合法任务；③ 良性权限获取（benign authority farming）通过原生审批流获取并保留目标授权集合R；④ 在相同对抗上下文c*下对比"全新状态G_0"与"残留状态G_h"的执行结果，定义成功重放为S_replay=W(1−Q_2)H_2=1。3) **受控实验**：将上述授权语义实例化为AgentDojo工具调用的确定性授权层，评估h∈{0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64}八个历史长度与三种粒度策略（tool-level/scope-level/exact-resource），并与Progent（任务感知最小权限）、PAuth（任务作用域）以及no-replay对照。4) **现场实验**：在55个Terminal-Bench上下文漂移案例（涵盖可执行文件劫持、内容替换、依赖劫持、配置投毒、项目/CWD重定向五类）上对Codex/Gemini CLI/Goose进行原生授权接口下的Fresh vs Farmed对比。

Result: 1) 八个生产智能体中，Codex、Gemini CLI、Goose、OpenCode的授权可跨任务与跨会话复用，Cline/Continue仅复用可配置能力，OpenHands仅会话内有效，Aider无allow规则复用。2) AgentDojo上：随良性历史从h=0增长到h=64，"尝试率P(attempt)"基本平稳或下降，但"静默执行率P(silent execution | attempt)"从0单调上升至0.982–1.000，ASR在四个受影响模型家族上达到0.114–0.351；Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite在h=64时ΔASR=35.1 pp（95% CI [30.6, 39.5]），GPT-4.1为27.9 pp，Qwen3-14B为23.5 pp，DeepSeek-V4-Pro为11.4 pp；Claude-Sonnet-5与Llama-3.3-70B因极少产生有害尝试而ASR接近零。3) 粒度实验中，tool-level→scope-level→exact-resource使ASR从0.114–0.351降至0.016–0.116再降至0.012–0.039；Progent进一步降至≤0.009，PAuth降至0，但两者均以牺牲跨任务复用为代价。4) 现场55个Terminal-Bench案例上，三款生产智能体的平均ΔASR=24.9 pp；其中Goose工具级权限放大了四类攻击，Gemini CLI三类，Codex因argv前缀匹配较窄仅获有限增益；可执行文件/依赖劫持ASR提升最高0.46，内容替换在Goose上提升高达0.90。5) 即使exact-resource匹配下ASR仍非零，表明权限的"动作身份"虽被保留，但决定其安全含义的上下文已改变，揭示consent与execution之间存在根本性的时序分离。

Conclusion: 本文形式化了"残留权限"（residual authority）——一种由持久化授权与上下文漂移共同造成的纵向授权失效模式，并提出"残留权限重放"（residual-authority replay）作为可被主动利用的对抗性原语。实验证明，通过合法交互积累的权限可在后续对抗性上下文中显著放大提示注入与上下文重绑定攻击（最高+35.1 pp，现场平均+24.9 pp），且仅靠更细粒度的动作/资源匹配不足以消除该风险，因为匹配谓词并不保留原授权的安全相关上下文绑定。任务作用域方案（PAuth/Progent/no-replay）可彻底阻断此类放大，但需以放弃跨任务权限复用为代价。论文最终呼吁设计"context-bound authorization"：在复用授权时应保留并重新验证关键的安全相关执行绑定（如路径、可执行身份、依赖、内容），若这些绑定发生改变则应触发重新审批，从而弥合持续授权与上下文性同意之间的根本错配。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on user approval to authorize security-sensitive actions at runtime. Such approvals are granted within a specific task and execution context. In long-lived agents, authorization decisions may need to persist across tasks or sessions. We find that this continuity can outlive the context that originally justified the approval, creating residual authority reusable without renewed consent. We expose this failure mode through a longitudinal attack that starts from a target security-sensitive action, identifies the authority required to execute it, induces benign interactions that legitimately obtain that authority, and later replays the residual authority during adversarial execution. Across controlled and live settings, we demonstrate that residual-authority replay arises in practice and substantially increases the success of prompt-injection and context-rebinding attacks. We evaluate 508 AgentDojo attack cases across six LLM families using production-derived authorization semantics. With residual authority, attack success rate (ASR) increases by up to 35.1 percentage points compared with a fresh authorization state. In live context-rebinding attacks on 55 Terminal-Bench cases across three real-world production coding agents, residual-authority replay increases ASR by 24.9 percentage points on average. These findings expose a fundamental mismatch between persistent authorization and the contextual nature of user consent in long-lived LLM agents.

</details>


### [523] [HyperMCTS: Hypergraph-Augmented MCTS for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33920)
*Tingsong Xiao,Nithish Balachandar Moudhgalya,Chandrayee Basu,Lichao Wang,Luyang Kong,Benjamin Z. Yao,Zhe Jiang,Jie Hao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HyperMCTS 是一种免训练的方法，通过在标准 MCTS 树基础上增加跨轨迹超图，在长程任务中复用决策组的反馈，从而提升搜索效率与规划精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程 LLM 智能体任务中，标准 MCTS 仅维护前缀特定的统计信息，无法有效复用跨轨迹、跨前缀出现的重复决策组的反馈，导致搜索成本高、效率受限。

Method: 在有序 MCTS 树基础上构建跨轨迹超图，节点代表规范化的决策，超边代表带标签的决策组并累积当前任务中的观测回报；提出 HyperUCT 选择规则，将树局部 UCT 值与超边聚合先验结合。

Result: 在 DeepPlanning 上，三种骨干模型的平均规划精度提升 2.3–7.3 个百分点；Qwen3.6-27B 在购物规划上以更少 LLM 调用和输出 token 超越 Claude Opus 4.6 (max)；在 SealQA 任务上也取得了提升。

Conclusion: HyperMCTS 通过超图在保留执行历史的同时共享决策组级别的证据，是一种即插即用的高效测试时扩展方法，适用于可重放或可模拟的环境，未来可结合世界模型扩展到不可逆动作的任务。

Abstract: Long-horizon tasks require large language model (LLM) agents to coordinate decisions under constraints that span an entire solution. Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) offers a promising approach to test-time scaling by exploring alternative action trajectories, but model computation and environment interaction make search costly. Efficient search therefore requires effective reuse of trajectory feedback. Standard MCTS maintains prefix-specific statistics, without explicitly accumulating outcomes for decision groups that recur across different paths. To fill this gap, we propose HyperMCTS, a training-free method that augments an ordered MCTS tree with a cross-trajectory hypergraph. Hyperedges represent groups of canonical decisions and accumulate their observed returns within the current task. Our hypergraph-guided HyperUCT selection rule aggregates evidence from overlapping hyperedges into an action prior, allowing outcomes collected under one prefix to inform selection under another while preserving execution histories in the tree. On DeepPlanning, HyperMCTS improves average planning accuracy by 2.3--7.3 percentage points over the strongest baseline for each of three backbone models. It enables Qwen3.6-27B to outperform Claude Opus 4.6 (max) on Shopping Planning, while achieving higher accuracy with fewer LLM calls and output tokens than the evaluated MCTS-based baselines. SealQA experiments further demonstrate improvements in question answering.

</details>


### [524] [Designing Reliable LLM-as-a-Judge Measurement Systems for Multi-Turn Business Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33955)
*Kaiwen Luo,Ming Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对多轮商业智能体评估这一难题，提出了一套将LLM评判与人类审计深度耦合的端到端"测量系统"方法论，涵盖评估规范、模块化LLM裁判、意图保持的用户模拟器及人机协同治理循环，并在生产环境中通过观测性研究验证了其描述层面的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM-as-a-judge方法多用于对单轮固定输出打分，但生产环境中的多轮商业智能体面临业务专属事实、按商户流程操作、跨轮次状态缺陷以及失败归因（模型能力缺失 vs 业务知识缺失）等独有挑战，单一的裁判提示词或通用基准已无法满足可维护、可操作的测量需求，亟需一套完整的测量系统工程方法。

Method: 提出四大组件耦合的方法论：(1) 评估规范层定义对话级端状态、互斥的失败归属（模型能力缺口/业务知识缺口）及L1–L5分层诊断树；(2) 模块化LLM裁判架构采用独立原子裁判+版本化共享上下文存储+显式聚合图，引入Net Detection Rate (NDR = TPR−FPR) 作为系统级保真度指标；(3) 意图保持型LLM用户模拟器，对话条件/指令条件双模式，强制从版本化用户档案取信息，发布前需通过意图一致性、人设一致性、可理解性、稳定性四项审计；(4) 人机协同治理循环，采用独立盲审+升级裁决+分层黄金集更新+分歧路由（标签修正/规范修订/裁判改进）。

Result: 在两年半的生产观测中：(1) 系统级NDR从初始-0.022（模型能力）和0.299（知识覆盖）经多轮审计提升至0.550和0.686，最终人类协同审计时分别达0.611和0.553；(2) 在两个Agent的任务完成评估中，人机协同流程的描述性表现均优于纯人工或纯裁判（Agent-A准确率82.1% vs 75.6%/67.9%）；(3) 138天滚动窗口内裁判和人工在四个评估维度上NDR同步上升，差距收窄；(4) 双向反馈通道同样改进了人类评审（70余次重新分配，L1失败召回率从0.58恢复至0.80）。但这些为观测性研究，缺乏置信区间与显著性检验，且图示区间之后双方进入平台期甚至小幅回撤。

Conclusion: 可靠的多轮商业智能体评估不能仅依赖裁判提示词，需将对话级规范、业务接地的事实层、显式聚合图、意图保持的用户模拟与独立审计的人工反馈环作为整体测量系统工程化。生产证据支持该方法论的操作价值，但并未确立因果或普适优越性；评估应被视为随智能体、证据与流量持续演进而需不断验证保真度的"测量系统"而非一次性工具。

Abstract: Many LLM-as-a-judge evaluations score fixed outputs under a fixed task definition. Production multi-turn business agents instead require a maintained measurement system: correctness depends on business-specific facts and procedures, outcomes emerge across turns, and failures must be attributed to either agent capability or missing business knowledge before they are actionable. We present an integrated methodology spanning evaluation specification, modular LLM judges, intent-preserving user simulation, and human-in-the-loop governance. The specification defines conversation-level end states and actionable failure ownership. Atomic judges share versioned evidence and feed an explicit aggregation graph. The simulator is released only after task-preservation and stability checks. Independent human audits estimate measurement fidelity, renew tiered reference sets, and route disagreements to label correction, guideline revision, or judge improvement. Production studies show that system-level fidelity improved across repeated audits, that human reviewers and automated judges improved together under the shared feedback loop, and that their combined workflow had the strongest descriptive performance in both reported task-completion settings. Because the studies are observational and the human reference itself required revision, these findings demonstrate operational usefulness rather than causal or universal superiority. The contribution is a practical framework for making multi-turn agent measurement reliable, actionable, and maintainable as the evaluated system and its evidence evolve.

</details>


### [525] [EHRAdapt: Adapting Pretrained Language Models to Electronic Health Records with Semantic Priors for Rare Clinical Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34007)
*Andre R Goncalves,Vincent Liu,Priyadip Ray*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 EHRAdapt，一种轻量级适配器，通过将结构化 EHR 事件直接映射到冻结大语言模型的嵌入空间，实现对罕见临床事件的有效建模。其核心创新在于将每个事件向量表示为"语义先验 + 证据残差"的组合，利用 BioLORD 医学知识为罕见事件提供语义支撑，利用低秩残差让常见事件从数据中学习适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子健康记录(EHR)以(时间,模态,代码)元组形式编码临床历史，与预训练语言模型期望的文本 token 不匹配。现有方法将事件转为文本会膨胀序列长度，且临床事件呈高度长尾分布（最常见事件出现 8760 万次，中位数仅约 20 次），导致罕见事件难以学到可靠表示；而平均化的评估指标又掩盖了对罕见事件的影响。

Method: EHRAdapt 是一个冻结 LLM 适配器，仅训练 0.1–0.6% 参数：(1) 模态用学习嵌入表示；(2) 时间间隔通过 16 桶的分层注意力偏置注入；(3) 事件向量 = 语义先验 + 低秩残差。语义先验来自冻结的 BioLORD 编码（基于 UMLS 临床本体），经共享可学习投影映射到 LLM 输入空间；残差为低秩分解（rank=64）的可学习修正。输出头与输入嵌入共享权重，并加入事件偏置和可学习 logit 尺度。在约 400 万患者的 KPNC 数据集上对 OLMo2-1B/7B、Llama3.2-1B 三种冻结骨干进行下一事件预测的持续预训练，并按事件频率分 10 个十分位评估。

Result: 完整模型在三个骨干上的全局测试交叉熵均最低（OLMo2-1B: 2.847, Llama3.2-1B: 2.806, OLMo2-7B: 2.799）。移除语义通路对罕见事件损害超过常见事件的 10 倍以上（D1 与 D10 相差 2.4 nats vs 0.04 nats）；移除残差虽提升最罕见事件的预测（D1–D3），但整体性能下降。下游生物监测任务（14 类传染病和 4 类综合征分类）上，EHRAdapt 在所有视图均优于文本化 LLM 和计数型随机森林基线，Rare-6 AUPRC 达 0.233–0.247（RF 基线仅 0.190），4 类综合征宏 AUPRC 达 0.791–0.798。两条通路对罕见疾病判别均带来提升，呈现互补角色。

Conclusion: EHRAdapt 证明语义先验（外部临床知识）与证据残差（数据驱动修正）在不同事件频率上互补：语义通路主要帮助罕见事件，残差通路主要帮助常见事件，但两者均对罕见疾病的下游分类有益。该研究强调需按频率分层评估，而非仅看平均指标。局限在于未使用实验室数值、生命体征值和人口学信息，且评估仅限单一医疗系统。

Abstract: Electronic health records (EHRs) encode clinical histories as (time, modality, code) tuples, whereas pretrained language models expect text tokens. Serializing them as text inflates sequence length and redundantly encodes structure. We introduce EHRAdapt, an adapter that maps tuples directly into a frozen language model's embedding space. Modality receives a learned embedding, time gaps enter through learned attention biases, and event codes receive dedicated vectors. Learning event vectors is the central challenge: clinical vocabularies are long-tailed, leaving rare events too few observations for reliable estimates. EHRAdapt therefore represents each event vector as the sum of a semantic prior and an evidence residual. The prior is a frozen embedding of the event's clinical description from a biomedical language model trained on clinical ontologies, mapped into the model's input space by a shared learned projection, so it supplies clinical meaning even when observations are scarce. The residual, a learned low-rank event-specific correction, refines it as evidence accumulates. We run continued pretraining on about 4 million patients' records with three frozen LLM backbones (OLMo2 1B, Llama3.2 1B, and OLMo2 7B), training only the adapter (0.1--0.6% of all parameters). The full adapter outperforms all ablations in held-out next-event prediction on every backbone. Removing the semantic pathway hurts rare events over ten times more than the most frequent ones, whereas removing the residual hurts overall prediction but improves it for the rarest events. On reportable infectious-disease and syndromic downstream classification tasks, EHRAdapt outperforms text-based LLM and count-based baselines, and both pathways improve rare-disease discrimination. The two pathways therefore play complementary roles, visible only when results are broken down by event frequency rather than averaged.

</details>


### [526] [A Computer Vision Approach to Visual Fraud Detection in Phishing Websites Using YOLOv8](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34015)
*Basil Sajid Shaikh,Hajar Homayouni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视觉图像的钓鱼网站检测方法，使用YOLOv8卷积神经网络对完整网页截图进行分类，依据布局、logo位置、配色和登录表单结构等视觉特征判断网站真伪，测试集准确率达92%，单次推理约100ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统钓鱼检测依赖URL、HTML或域名注册等信号，易被攻击者轮换或混淆，且无法反映真正诱导受害者输入凭据的页面外观特征。论文旨在借鉴人类视觉判断方式，从页面"看起来像什么"的角度进行检测。

Method: 构建包含钓鱼与合法网站截图的数据集；采用针对光照、压缩和缩放变化的数据增强策略；使用YOLOv8卷积神经网络对完整页面截图进行二分类（钓鱼/合法），训练模型基于布局、logo放置、配色方案和登录表单结构等视觉特征进行识别。

Result: 在留出测试集上达到92%分类准确率；单张截图处理时间约100毫秒；经过针对性数据增强后，假阳性率相对增强前基线下降11%。

Conclusion: 视觉型钓鱼检测器可作为URL与内容型防御的补充手段，与现有检测方式协同使用，而非替代；论文详细介绍了数据集构建、增强策略、模型架构与训练过程，并讨论了视觉检测器的适用场景。

Abstract: Phishing remains one of the most common vectors for financial and identity fraud, and most detection systems still rely on inspecting a page's URL, HTML markup, or domain registration history. These signals are easy for an attacker to rotate or obfuscate, and they say very little about what actually convinces a victim to hand over a password or a card number: the way the page looks. This paper describes a visual, image-based approach to phishing detection that treats a rendered webpage the same way a human eye would, as a picture that either matches a trusted brand or doesn't. A YOLOv8 convolutional neural network was trained to classify full-page website screenshots as phishing or legitimate based on layout, logo placement, color scheme, and login-form structure, rather than on text extracted from the page. The system reached 92% classification accuracy on a held-out test set, processed a single screenshot in roughly 100 milliseconds, and, after a round of data augmentation aimed specifically at lighting, compression, and scaling variation, cut the false-positive rate by 11% relative to the pre-augmentation baseline. The paper walks through the dataset construction, the augmentation strategy, the model architecture and training setup, and the resulting performance, and closes with a discussion of where this kind of visual detector fits alongside, rather than instead of, existing URL- and content-based defenses.

</details>


### [527] [Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation. Preliminary Results](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34024)
*Alfredo Madrid-García,Beatriz Merino-Barbancho*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究首次系统评估了Jev（一种非生成式"系统一"AI模型）在四个医学基准测试上的表现。结果显示，Jev在研究摘要类问题上与前沿LLM（GPT-6 Sol）准确率相当（PubMedQA: 78.4% vs 78.2%），但在考试题和复杂诊断案例上明显落后（MetaMedQA差7.9个百分点，诊断案例差20-23个百分点）。其概率校准在考试题上优于GPT-6 Sol，但选择性预测无优势，且极少选择"我不知道"选项。Jev速度快（中位延迟0.27-0.31秒）、成本极低（2,823项仅0.08美元），但临床应用前需针对具体任务进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev作为新型非生成式"系统一"模型，声称具有抗幻觉、速度快、成本低、校准概率等优势，但其在医学任务上的准确性和校准性尚未得到系统验证。由于医学临床推理的错误可能造成严重后果，且临床病例通常需要多步推理（开发者列出的模型弱点），因此有必要在医学基准上评估Jev的实际表现，以判断其是否具备支持临床决策的潜力。

Method: 研究在四个医学基准上评估Jev 1.13：MetaMedQA（1,373道考试题，含277道无正确答案题）、PubMedQA（500道研究问题）、DiagnosisArena-MCQ（915个复杂病例）和NEJM Case Challenges（34个病例）。以GPT-6 Sol（含/不含中等推理）为参照。主要结局为Top-1准确率；次要结局包括校准（ECE）、选择性预测（AURC）和不可回答问题识别能力。每个模型和条件运行一次，共8,469个请求。采用McNemar检验和2,000次bootstrap重采样进行配对比较，Holm法校正P值。

Result: Jev在PubMedQA上与GPT-6 Sol准确率相当（78.4% vs 78.2%，差异0.2pp），但在MetaMedQA（74.8% vs 82.7%，差-7.9pp）、DiagnosisArena-MCQ（59.8% vs 82.4%，差-22.6pp）和NEJM病例（61.8% vs 82.4%，差-20.6pp）上显著落后。在MetaMedQA上，Jev的校准优于GPT-6 Sol（ECE 0.063 vs 0.146），概率≥0.9时准确率93.4%，但在相同覆盖率下GPT-6 Sol准确率相当或更高（AURC 0.087 vs 0.070，Jev更差）。在DiagnosisArena-MCQ上，Jev概率判别能力差（AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768），最自信答案仍有约25%错误率。在162道正确答案为"我不知道"的题目中，Jev仅选择该选项10.5%（GPT-6 Sol为8.6%）。中位延迟0.27-0.31秒，全部2,823项仅花费0.08美元。

Conclusion: Jev速度快、成本低，在研究摘要类简单任务上与前沿LLM相当，但在需要临床整合和复杂诊断推理的任务上表现明显较差。其概率校准在考试题上更好，但未转化为选择性预测优势，且很少选择"我不知道"选项。Jev可作为高速、低成本的文本分类组件用于系统评价筛选、试验资格检查等场景，不确定答案可转交临床医生，但不能作为独立诊断工具。临床使用前必须针对具体任务验证准确性和校准性，并按需重新校准概率。

Abstract: Jev is a non-generative "System One" model that assigns probabilities to predefined answer options and cannot answer outside them. Its accuracy and calibration on medical question-answering and case-based diagnostic-reasoning tasks are unknown. We evaluated Jev 1.13 on four medical benchmarks: MetaMedQA, PubMedQA, DiagnosisArena-MCQ and the NEJM Case Challenges. GPT-6 Sol, with (medium) and without reasoning, was the reference. The primary outcome was top-1 accuracy; key secondary outcomes were calibration, selective prediction and recognition of unanswerable questions. All 8,469 requests returned a valid answer. Jev's accuracy was similar to that of GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning on PubMedQA (78.4% vs 78.2%;), lower on MetaMedQA (74.8% vs 82.7%) and much lower on DiagnosisArena-MCQ (59.8% vs 82.4%;) and the NEJM cases (61.8% vs 82.4%). On MetaMedQA, Jev's probabilities were the best calibrated (expected calibration error 0.063 vs 0.146), and its answers with a probability of at least 0.9 (52.9% of questions) were 93.4% accurate, but GPT-6 Sol was as accurate when it accepted a similar proportion of questions. On DiagnosisArena-MCQ, Jev's probabilities discriminated poorly (AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768). Of the 162 questions whose correct answer was "I don't know or cannot answer", Jev chose that option for 10.5% (GPT-6 Sol, 8.6%). Median latency was 0.27-0.31 s; all 2,823 items cost USD 0.08. Jev was fast and inexpensive, and its accuracy was similar to that of a frontier LLM on research abstracts but lower on examination questions and much lower on complex diagnostic cases. Task-specific validation is required before clinical use.

</details>


### [528] [Large Language Models for Structured Clinical Data Analysis: Dual-Agent Grounding and Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34039)
*Erfan D. Dehkalani,Seetha Shankaran,Abbot R. Laptook,C. Michael Cotten,P. Ellen Grant,Yangming Ou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了CLEAR-Med框架，一个用于结构化临床数据分析的双智能体系统。该框架通过调用智能体将自然语言问题翻译为SQL并执行，独立验证智能体进行确定性检查与跨模型验证，支持一次有界修复或显式弃权，实现可溯源的数值分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM可在无数据库访问的情况下生成看似合理但缺乏溯源的临床数值答案，难以满足受监管结构化临床表分析对队列定义、分母保真和可审计性的要求。

Method: 采用双智能体架构：Invocation Agent基于schema-guided text-to-SQL生成并执行查询，生成草稿及证据记录；Clinical Validation Agent执行确定性检查（只读SQL、溯源完整性、队列保真、分母、算术等），并由跨提供方LLM独立做出accept/repair/abstain决策。系统被形式化为有界选择性流水线，证明在编码属性上的有效性保证。

Result: 在532名婴儿记录、约1300变量的HIE数据库上，CLEAR-Med完成全部六项可扩展性配置（含500×1300），25个开发查询×5次重复中，Invocation Agent正确83/125（66.4%，95% CI 48.0–83.2%），显著优于无基础ChatGPT基线的15/125（12.0%），配对提升54.4个百分点。

Conclusion: CLEAR-Med提供了可溯源结构化临床数据分析的通用架构，数值声明与已执行SQL保持关联，未解情况可安全弃权；完整流水线的验证与弃权阶段的前瞻性评估是后续工作。

Abstract: Objective: To develop and characterize CLEAR-Med, a dual-agent framework for natural-language analysis of structured clinical data that separates SQL-based invocation from independent validation. Methods: CLEAR-Med uses one agent to translate a question into executable Structured Query Language (SQL), retain the executed query and database result, and produce a draft. Deterministic checks and a separately invoked cross-provider Validation Agent then accept the draft, request one bounded repair, or abstain. We formalized the system as a bounded selective pipeline and evaluated CLEAR-Med's configuration and scalability, and the Invocation Agent's accuracy and consistency on a 25-query development benchmark, using a harmonized 21-site neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy table containing 532 de-identified infant records and approximately 1,300 variables. Results: CLEAR-Med completed all six nominal scalability configurations, including 500x1300. Across 25 development-benchmark queries repeated five times, the Invocation Agent answered 83 of 125 responses correctly (66.4%; query-cluster bootstrap 95% CI, 48.0-83.2%), compared with 15 of 125 (12.0%; 95% CI, 3.2-22.4%) for the ungrounded ChatGPT baseline, a paired improvement of 54.4 percentage points (95% CI, 36.8-72.0%). Conclusion: CLEAR-Med provides a general architecture for traceable analysis of structured clinical data: numerical claims remain linked to executed SQL, and unresolved cases can fail closed. The reported experiments characterize CLEAR-Med's configuration and scalability and the Invocation Agent's accuracy, while the formal analysis establishes the encoded-property guarantee of the complete control flow; a prospective full-pipeline evaluation of the validation and abstention stages is the next stage of this work.

</details>


### [529] [Thinking Outside the Box: Retention and Transmission of Information in Sliding-Window KV Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34049)
*Timothy DeLise,Seth Cromelin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了滑动窗口KV推理（Sliding-Window KV Inference），即在推理时仅保留固定大小的KV缓存来处理长序列。通过三个实验，作者发现某些预训练Transformer模型能够在信息源token被驱逐出缓存后，仍能通过保留的隐层状态恢复相关信息，其中Mistral 7B和Muse Glimmer表现出最强的"潜在信息中继"（latent information relay）能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer推理的内存随上下文长度线性增长，而循环架构（如状态空间模型Mamba）虽有定长状态但需要重新训练。本文探索一种折中方案：在推理时对预训练因果Transformer施加滚动KV缓存，验证信息是否可通过残差流激活的逐层传递，从已驱逐的源token传播到当前窗口内，从而实现无需额外训练的有界内存长上下文推理。

Method: 1. 理论分析：利用残差流作为信息通信通道的框架，推导出在L层、窗口宽度W下，最大感受野为L(W−1)个token位置。2. Rolling-KV推理算法：处理前W个token初始化缓存，之后每步处理新token、保留新KV状态、驱逐最旧位置。3. 三个实验比较Rolling-KV、Last Window（仅重算最后W个token）和Full Prompt（完整处理）三种推理条件：(a) 秘密代码检索（Experiment 1），(b) 扩展秘密代码检索（Experiment 2），(c) 定义-载体距离分离测试（Experiment 3）。4. 评估模型：Qwen2.5-0.5B/3B、Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Muse-Glimmer-30B，使用RTX 3090 GPU，窗口W=512，四选一迫选任务。

Result: 1. 实验1：偏移+1时所有模型Rolling-KV达100%准确率，而Last Window仅24.4%；偏移+2时，Glimmer 100%、Mistral 97%、Llama 82%、Qwen 3B 47%、Qwen 0.5B 32%。2. 实验2（更长定义）：偏移+10时Glimmer仍达96%、Mistral 89%、Llama 56%、Qwen接近随机水平。3. 实验3：在定义-载体间隔≥512 token且代码已被驱逐的最难条件下，Glimmer仍达62.9%，Mistral达39.9%，其他模型接近随机。4. 总体而言，Qwen模型衰减最快，Llama在中等距离有效但远距离衰减；Mistral 7B和Muse Glimmer在整个测量范围内保持高准确率。

Conclusion: 本文证明：预训练Transformer在滚动KV推理下确实能够通过保留的KV状态中继来自已驱逐token的可用信息，表现出类似有界循环记忆的行为。这一现象在所有测试模型中均存在，但程度差异显著——采用滑动窗口注意力训练的Mistral 7B和Muse Glimmer表现出最强的"潜在信息中继"能力。研究识别出三种信息保留模式：上下文化表征作为载体、潜在信息中继和长程传输。然而，研究存在局限性：仅评估行为层面的检索，未追踪信息在缓存中的具体表示路径，且模型间差异无法隔离单一变量。未来工作建议训练匹配架构的模型并对KV状态进行干预以揭示内部机制。

Abstract: Sliding-window KV inference refers to processing a sequence incrementally while retaining only a fixed-size cache of recent key and value states. It can be applied to pretrained causal transformers at inference time without additional training, while its KV-cache memory remains fixed as more tokens are processed. Because cached states are computed in the context of earlier tokens, they may carry information from beyond the current window and transmit it to later states. This study presents a series of experiments using five open-weight models spanning Qwen, Llama, Mistral, and Muse Glimmer. We investigate whether information originating outside the immediate context window can persist through a rolling KV cache and remain useful for retrieval. Initial results show that retaining previously computed states improves retrieval across the models tested compared with recomputing the final fixed window from raw tokens. We then measure how far this effect extends and find that Muse Glimmer and Mistral 7B show the strongest \emph{latent information relay}: they can recover information even after the relevant source tokens have left the cache. Both models incorporate sliding-window attention in their published architectures, an association that motivates testing whether training with sliding windows promotes more reliable information retention.

</details>


### [530] [Towards Certificate-Driven Software Porting: A Self-Improving Agentic Harness for Scientific Program Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34069)
*Piyush Jha,Aishik Ghosh,Vijay Ganesh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出证书驱动进化搜索（CDES）方法，将进化搜索与失败候选派生的可执行约束相结合，并将其应用于Geant4工具包中两个粒子模拟函数（Compton和Fermi）的CPU到GPU转换。生成的CUDA实现分别实现了13.78倍和23.54倍的函数级加速，其中Compton函数的GPU吞吐量比专家实现的Celeritas高出14.9%，混合时达到16.1%。消融实验表明，证书反馈使通过正确性检查的候选比例从55%提高到90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型科学代码库（如Geant4粒子模拟工具包）的升级和重写面临重大挑战，特别是向新硬件加速范式（如GPU）的迁移。虽然基于LLM的进化搜索可以移植和加速遗留代码，但仅依靠提示中的修复反馈无法防止后续候选重复相同错误，亟需一种能够强制执行约束的机制来可靠地移植科学代码。

Method: CDES（证书驱动进化搜索）扩展了AlphaEvolve风格的进化搜索，通过证书数据库记录失败候选的假设、检查器证据和合理约束。控制逻辑通过拒绝、回溯和定向修复强制执行这些约束，同时保留兼容编辑。具体包括：（1）冲突检查器与分析器使用存储的证书和依赖关系的符号检查审查未完成候选；（2）借鉴CDCL SAT求解器的思想进行回溯、重启和修复；（3）评估工具包结合形式化检查（Lean验证GPU任务分配、CBMC检查数组边界）、数值比较、物理守恒律检查、GPU安全测试（Compute Sanitizer）和统计分析（Nsight Compute）。

Result: 在NVIDIA H100 GPU上使用约25万个输入进行基准测试：（1）性能方面，CDES生成的GPU代码相比CPU版本在Compton函数上实现13.78倍加速，在Fermi函数上实现23.54倍加速；（2）在共享Compton基准测试中，GPU吞吐量比Celeritas专家实现高14.9%，执行时间低约3.0%；（3）将Celeritas的粒子能量选择代码与生成的方向计算代码混合，GPU吞吐量比Celeritas提高16.1%；（4）消融实验中，证书反馈使通过正确性检查的候选比例从55%提升至90%，吞吐量提升超过10%的比例从50%提升至80%。

Conclusion: 本文展示了向可靠且可扩展地移植大型遗留科学代码库迈进的初步方法，通过在两个Geant4函数上证明CDES的有效性。生成的代码展现出优于专家手写实现的优化模式，与Celeritas组件结合证明了人机协作的互补优势。CDES将冲突检测、证书验证和强制搜索控制连接起来，适用于科学优化场景。未来工作将测试证书的成本和正确性收益如何随函数和优化难度变化，将评估扩展到更大规模的Geant4代码，并整合Celeritas等项目所需的需求。

Abstract: The upgrade and rewriting of large scientific codebases has traditionally been a major challenge. While evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can port and accelerate legacy code, repair feedback in prompts alone does not prevent subsequent candidates from repeating the same errors. We introduce Certificate-Driven Evolutionary Search (CDES), which extends evolutionary search with enforceable restrictions derived from failed candidates, recorded as certificates of assumptions, checker evidence, and justified restrictions. Its control logic enforces these restrictions through rejection, backtracking, and targeted repair while preserving compatible edits. We apply CDES to CPU-to-GPU translation of two particle-simulation functions from the Geant4 toolkit, evaluated with a harness that goes beyond unit tests to combine formal checks, numerical comparisons, physics checks, and GPU safety tests. Generated implementations achieve 13.78x and 23.54x function-level speedups over CPU code, including data conversion and transfers; for one function, GPU throughput exceeds an expert implementation by 14.9%, reaching 16.1% when complementary components are combined. In an ablation over execution settings, certificate feedback increases the fraction of candidates passing required correctness checks from 55% to 90%.

</details>


### [531] [PhysFieldBench: Can Multimodal Models Understand Physical Fields?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34072)
*Yuezhou Ma,Huikun Weng,Jialong Wu,Chenyi Zhao,Hang Zhou,Haonan Shangguan,Jianmin Wang,Mingsheng Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PhysFieldBench是一个评估多模态大语言模型理解物理场能力的基准，包含24个任务和1160个评估样例，涵盖控制方程场、模拟物理场和观测物理场三类。研究发现当前MLLM在零样本物理场推理上表现极差（最佳模型仅29.3分），但任务特定的监督ViT能达到70.4分，表明视觉输入中包含可学习的物理信号。后训练（如答案监督SFT、CoT监督和RL）能提升任务表现但跨任务泛化仍然困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的物理基准主要评估教科书式问题求解或直观物理推理，无法评估MLLM从连续物理场观测中推断物理意义的能力，而这正是科学与工程智能体的核心需求。论文旨在填补这一评估空白。

Method: 1) 构建PhysFieldBench基准：24个任务、1160个样例，沿三个推理轴（机制、控制、结果）和三个场域（控制方程场、模拟场、观测场）组织；2) 零样本评估多种开源/闭源MLLM；3) 训练任务特定的ViT作为监督参考基线；4) 使用Gemini 3 Flash进行结构化自我解释分析以诊断错误来源；5) 比较三种后训练策略：答案监督SFT、CoT监督SFT和GRPO强化学习。

Result: 零样本MLLM表现很差：GPT-5.5最佳仅29.3分（机会归一化），多个开源模型接近随机水平。监督ViT达到70.4分。错误分析显示主要失败原因为视觉模式遗漏和视觉到物理的映射错误（物理映射错误占主错误的53%）。后训练中：答案监督SFT在训练任务上从-8.1提升至58.2，但泛化差（保留任务仅16.2）；CoT+RL在保留任务上从22.3提升至33.3，泛化最佳。Pass@8覆盖率显示模型采样时潜在能力更高（训练任务85.9%，保留任务87.8%）。

Conclusion: 当前MLLM远未实现可靠的物理场推理，核心瓶颈在于视觉到物理的接地（visual-to-physical grounding）能力不足以及跨任务泛化困难。需要在视觉证据识别、物理意义解释和多任务泛化方面取得突破，才能使MLLM在科学与工程工作流中可靠地解释物理场。后训练能提升已见任务表现但需关注跨任务迁移问题。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly envisioned as core components of scientific and engineering agents, yet their ability to interpret physical fields remains poorly understood. Existing physics benchmarks largely emphasize textbook problem solving or intuitive physical reasoning, leaving open whether MLLMs can infer physically meaningful information from continuous field observations. We introduce PhysFieldBench, a benchmark comprising 24 tasks and 1,160 evaluation examples across controlled equation fields, simulated physical fields, and observed physical fields. The tasks assess three forms of inference: identifying physical mechanisms, comparing latent control variables, and predicting outcome properties. Across representative open-source and proprietary MLLMs, zero-shot performance is low: the best model achieves a chance-normalized score of 29.3, while several open-source models remain near chance. In contrast, a task-specific supervised vision transformer performs substantially better, demonstrating that the inputs contain learnable physical information. To diagnose these failures, a structured self-explanation analysis attributes most errors to missed visual patterns and incorrect visual-to-physical mappings. Further, to explore whether post-training can improve physical inference and generalize to unseen tasks, we compare supervised fine-tuning with final answers or chain-of-thought supervision and reinforcement learning. Final-answer supervision performs best overall but transfers less effectively, whereas reinforcement learning after chain-of-thought supervision achieves the best generalization. Together, these findings highlight the need to improve visual-to-physical grounding and cross-task generalization for MLLMs to reliably interpret physical fields in scientific and engineering workflows.

</details>


### [532] [GenoMorph: Pathway-Grounded Genomic Disease Reasoning via Adaptive Latent Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34079)
*Tanmoy Kanti Halder,Akash Ghosh,Arijit Roy,Sriparna Saha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GenoMorph提出了一种多模态基因组推理框架,将疾病预测从记忆性的基因-疾病关联转向基于通路的机理推理,通过问题条件跨注意力融合、自适应潜在推理、层次最优传输正则化以及拒绝采样微调,在KEGG基准上显著优于BioReason,并在基因名匿名化条件下保持优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的基因组疾病推理主要依赖记忆的基因-疾病关联(捷径学习),而非理解生物通路机制;当分子标识符缺失或匿名时,此类方法鲁棒性和泛化能力严重下降,亟需转向通路层面的机理推理。

Method: 四阶段训练框架:(1)有监督微调,引入问题条件CrossAttentionFusion(替代静态线性投影)、LatentSp课程式潜在推理、ThinkingResidualGate实现基因组证据按需重注入;(2)离线层次最优传输(HiRef-OT)计算基因组表示与疾病答案流形间的几何监督信号;(3)GRPO多目标强化学习(8项奖励,含正确性、格式、潜在效率、OT一致性等);(4)拒绝采样微调(RSFT)将自适应潜在策略内化至参数,推理时无需在线熵估计。构建全局一致的基因名匿名化KEGG基准以消除记忆捷径。

Result: 在原始KEGG基准上,加权F1从BioReason的0.7863提升至0.9412(GRPO)及0.9725(RSFT),推理时延减少近60%(从23.74s降至9.75s);在匿名化基准上仍达0.9465加权F1,准确率保持率97.2%,显著优于所有基线;消融实验证实CrossAttn、LatentSp、自适应门控、HiRef-OT奖励、RSFT各自均有贡献;定性分析显示多数剩余错误源于疾病命名粒度差异而非推理错误。

Conclusion: GenoMorph证明了基于通路机理的基因组推理优于记忆式基因-疾病关联,且自适应潜在推理能同时提升准确率与推理效率,为面向新基因、匿名数据及多组学场景的可扩展基因组基础模型提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in biological reasoning; however, genomic disease inference remains largely dependent on memorized gene-disease associations rather than understanding biological pathways. This shortcut learning undermines robustness and generalization, and breaks down when molecular identifiers are unavailable. We present GenoMorph, a multimodal genomic reasoning framework that shifts disease prediction from associative gene-disease mapping toward pathway-grounded reasoning. GenoMorph couples a frozen DNA foundation model with question-conditioned cross-attention fusion, self-adaptive latent reasoning (LatentSp), a residual reasoning gate for iterative genomic evidence reinjection, and rejection sampling fine-tuning regularized by hierarchical optimal transport (OT). Rather than learning direct gene-disease mappings, GenoMorph aligns genomic sequence representations with latent pathway dynamics, enabling reasoning trajectories that follow molecular interactions before producing disease predictions. LatentSp dynamically allocates computation according to reasoning confidence, reducing unnecessary reasoning steps and improving inference efficiency. We further construct an anonymized benchmark from the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), replacing every gene and molecular identifier with anonymous symbols while preserving sequences and pathway topology, thereby removing memorization shortcuts. GenoMorph raises the weighted F1 from 0.7863 (BioReason) to 0.9412, and rejection sampling fine-tuning with self-adaptive latent reasoning pushes it to 0.9725 while cutting latency nearly 60%. On the anonymized benchmark it reaches 0.9465 F1, substantially outperforming prior systems and confirming that accurate disease prediction can arise from pathway reasoning rather than memorized gene-disease associations.

</details>


### [533] [K-OPSD: Verifiable On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Vision-Language Models on AEC Drawings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34082)
*Yunfei Bai,Enrico Chionna,Akash Amol,Kawaljit Singh KC,Joern Tinnemeyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出K-OPSD，一种基于可验证监督的on-policy自蒸馏方法，用于在AEC（建筑、工程与施工）图纸理解任务上对视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行后训练。该方法通过过程级验证器筛选模型自身的best-of-N生成样本，利用hint-conditioned rescue机制处理失败样本，并以交叉熵损失替代传统的有界token级广义JSD损失，在Qwen3-VL模型上取得了与开源基线竞争的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态大语言模型在解读AEC图纸时存在困难，因为图纸包含密集的符号约定、精确几何和隐含的工程语义。传统的监督微调（SFT）存在exposure-bias问题，强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）缺乏per-token目标信号，而现有的on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）使用的有界token级广义JSD内损失在高置信度错误token上会出现梯度饱和，且依赖的不均衡教师会产生"正确答案、错误推理"的trace。因此需要一种新的方法来克服这些限制。

Method: K-OPSD方法包括六个步骤：(1)从当前学生策略采样N个completion；(2)使用过程级验证器V对completion进行验证筛选；(3)对失败的prompt使用hint-conditioned rescue进行重采样；(4)对rescued trace进行重新验证和hint剥离；(5)在冻结的SFT基础上拟合新的LoRA适配器，使用验证后的teacher token序列上的交叉熵内损失；(6)在held-out评估集上对比更新前后的策略。关键创新包括：使用模型自身的verified best-of-N生成构建自教师；过程级验证器覆盖感知、推理和最终答案；使用交叉熵损失替代有界token级广义JSD损失。

Result: 在AECV-Bench数据集上，使用K-OPSD微调的FT-Qwen3-VL-4B获得了最高的平均judge score（0.819）和顶级的combined accuracy（0.738），与Llama4-Maverick-17B和Gemma-3-27B持平。在out-of-domain的ArchCAD数据集上，FT-Qwen3-VL-8B以0.693的judge score领先所有模型。消融研究证实：验证门控的自蒸馏可以匹配或超越外部教师（Claude Fable 5）的OPD；交叉熵内损失在大多数情况下优于有界token级广义JSD损失。

Conclusion: K-OPSD提供了一种有效的verifier-guided on-policy自蒸馏方法，用于AEC领域的VLM后训练。实验结果表明，小型领域专用模型（4B-8B参数）可以通过验证性自蒸馏达到与大型开源模型竞争的性能。该方法具备样本效率高、可迁移到out-of-domain数据集等优点。未来工作将扩大训练数据量、深入研究梯度饱和机制、探索负面学习信号以及进行质量与成本的定量分析。

Abstract: Interpreting architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) drawings is hard for general Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce K-OPSD, a VLM post-training methodology for improving AEC drawing understanding. Building on On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) with verifiable supervision, we construct a teacher from the model's own best-of-N generations, certified by a process-level verifier, and rescue failed prompts by resampling under a hint that exposes the verified answer. We then perform an on-policy model update by training on verified completions with a cross-entropy inner-loss, outperforming the bounded token-wise generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) used by on-policy distillation. Using K-OPSD, we fine-tune Qwen3-VL models on the AECV-Bench dataset. The resulting models attain the top average judge score (0.819) and combined accuracy (0.738), achieving competitive results against open-source baseline models. The recipe transfers to the out-of-domain ArchCAD dataset, where the 8B model gains most. We present the verifier suite and the continual learning and self-improving pipeline, our results provide preliminary evidence that verifier-guided self-distillation is a promising route toward more reliable machine reading of architecture drawings.

</details>


### [534] [A Differentiable Optimization Framework for Registering Sequential Bounding Boxes with Point Cloud Stream](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34103)
*Xuesong Li,Jinguang Tong,Jie Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的可微分优化框架，将时间平滑约束嵌入LiDAR点云序列的3D包围盒配准目标函数中，通过L-BFGS联合求解所有帧位姿。在多视角观测条件下，联合优化在低粗糙度预算内显著优于卡尔曼和Savitzky-Golay后处理平滑方法，但在单侧、含距离噪声和自车运动的射线投射仿真下优势消失甚至逆转。定位了联合方法适用的观测边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶LiDAR自动标注流程通常采用"逐帧配准+事后平滑"的两阶段策略（如Kalman RTS或Savitzky-Golay），但事后平滑会将包围盒从几何最优解处移开且不再重新优化，存在精度-平滑度权衡问题。作者主张应将时间平滑约束嵌入配准目标内部联合求解，并探究该联合设计何时真正带来收益。

Method: 构建一个由四项可微损失组成的目标函数：(1) 接近度项——最小化点到可见面的平方距离；(2) 包络项——用L1距离惩罚落在包围盒外的点（默认权重最大）；(3) 平滑项——惩罚位姿轨迹的二阶差分（加速度）；(4) 对齐项——约束包围盒朝向与运动方向一致（因耦合速度估计而脆弱，默认关闭）。固定包围盒尺寸，将序列所有6-DOF位姿作为优化变量，用PyTorch实现自动微分，以L-BFGS（强Wolfe线搜索）在CPU上联合求解至收敛。提出一种无需真值的自适应规则：根据帧级配准的粗糙度自动选择时间权重ε，确保所有轨迹落入低粗糙度预算。

Result: 在理想多面可见条件下：联合方法在低粗糙度预算(R̄≤0.1)内相对Savitzky-Golay提升+0.032 IoU、相对Kalman RTS提升+0.059 IoU（p<10⁻⁴，每条轨迹均胜出），并在IoU无显著差异下将粗糙度降低5.8倍。消融显示包络项是精度核心（移除损失0.125 IoU），平滑项专司粗糙度控制。但优势随可见性单调衰减：单侧观测下优势消失；射线投射仿真（含距离相关密度与自车运动）下紧预算时解耦流程反超0.016 IoU。问题定位于对齐项——它将偏航耦合至受噪声污染的速度估计。自适应ε规则在72条保留轨迹上实现100%预算达标，优于固定ε（理想94%、射线83%）。

Conclusion: 联合优化框架的有效性高度依赖于观测条件：当传感器能观测到目标大部分表面时优势显著，但在真实LiDAR常见的单侧、稀疏、含自车运动的观测下优势消失甚至逆转。文章的核心贡献在于明确划定了联合方法的适用边界，并解释了同一框架在不同仿真器下出现矛盾结果的原因——对齐项的脆弱性。自适应时间尺度规则可实现无真值的预算保证。局限在于评估基于合成仿真，初始化仅模拟单帧检测器扰动，且假设包围盒尺寸已知恒定。未来需在真实LiDAR（如KITTI跟踪）上验证。

Abstract: Refining a sequence of coarse 3D bounding boxes against a LiDAR point-cloud stream demands tracks that are geometrically accurate (high IoU) and temporally coherent (low roughness), preferably without training data. The usual recipe keeps the two concerns apart: register each frame independently, then smooth the trajectory afterwards with a Kalman~RTS or Savitzky--Golay filter. Smoothing displaces boxes from a geometric optimum and never re-optimises, so it trades accuracy for smoothness. We instead fold the temporal smoothness constraint into a training-free registration objective and solve for all poses jointly with L-BFGS. The payoff depends on how well the object is seen. On well-observed tracks it is large: within the low-roughness budget, the joint objective beats both post-hoc smoothers on paired multi-seed statistics and cuts roughness several-fold relative to frame-wise registration at matched accuracy. Treating visibility as an experimental variable exposes the limit. The advantage decays monotonically as views become one-sided, until it is indistinguishable from zero for near-edge-on objects and slightly negative under a ray-cast simulator with range-dependent density and ego motion, where the decoupled pipeline is in fact ahead at tight roughness budgets. We locate that boundary and trace it to one term: orientation alignment ties yaw to the estimated velocity and fails once that estimate is noisy. A ground-truth-free rule can choose the temporal scale and keep every track inside the roughness budget.

</details>


### [535] [SpecRegMatch: Robust Semi-Supervised Regression for Vehicle Interior Noise Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34111)
*Sejin Sim,Jinsoo Bae,Seoung Bum Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为SpecRegMatch的新型半监督回归(SSR)方法,用于解决车辆内部噪声预测中标注数据成本高的问题。该方法通过使用单一模型,结合一致性正则化和信息最大化,在减少计算开销的同时实现了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI在汽车行业预测车辆内部噪声水平方面的应用增多,但标注数据收集成本高昂。虽然现有的半监督回归方法通过利用未标注数据减少了对标注数据的依赖,但通常因训练多个模型和数据采样而带来较高的计算成本。

Method: SpecRegMatch是一种新颖的SSR方法,其核心特点是:1)仅使用单一模型训练,无需多次数据采样;2)结合一致性正则化(consistency regularization)和信息最大化(information maximization);3)通过对嵌入向量(embedding vectors)和预测值(predicted values)应用多种数据增强来实现鲁棒训练。

Result: 实验结果表明,SpecRegMatch在各种场景下均达到了最先进的性能水平,即使仅使用单一模型也表现优异。在标注数据稀缺的情况下,该方法获得了R²分数为0.434的显著性能,展现了其在少样本场景下的强大能力。

Conclusion: SpecRegMatch成功解决了半监督回归中训练多个模型所带来的计算成本问题,通过单一模型结合一致性正则化和信息最大化,在车辆内部噪声预测任务上实现了SOTA性能,特别适用于标注数据稀缺的场景,为工业应用中降低标注成本提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has observed increased application in predicting vehicle interior noise levels within the automotive industry. However, the collection of labeled data for training models in this context involves significant costs. Previous studies in semi-supervised regression (SSR) have effectively mitigated the reliance on labeled data by incorporating unlabeled data. Nonetheless, these approaches often introduce a high computational cost due to the training of multiple models and data sampling. This study introduces SpecRegMatch, a novel SSR method aimed at addressing the computational cost associated with training by leveraging a single model, thus eliminating the need for multiple data samplings. SpecRegMatch integrates consistency regularization and information maximization to robustly train the model, achieved through various augmentations applied to both the embedding vectors and predicted values. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecRegMatch achieves state-of-the-art performance across various scenarios, even when using a single model. It attains a remarkable performance, as indicated by an R^2 score of 0.434. This is especially noteworthy in scenarios where labeled data is scarce. You can access the code for our proposed method at this https URL .

</details>


### [536] [GUITAR: Structured Failure Diagnosis of GUI Agents via State Transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34113)
*Shaoqing Zhang,Kehai Chen,Xuefeng Bai,Zhuosheng Zhang,Pengfei Zhang,Yang Xiang,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GUITAR 是一个面向 GUI 智能体的、以状态为中心的结构化故障诊断框架，通过构建状态转移图（STG）将视觉多样的屏幕映射到共享的功能状态，从而在状态和转移两个层面进行多层级失败分析，揭示瓶颈状态并指导智能体改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 GUI 智能体评估主要依赖逐步成功率（step accuracy），该指标将每个屏幕视为独立观察，忽略了 GUI 环境的底层结构，导致两个关键盲点：（1）功能等价的屏幕被独立评估，掩盖了跨共享屏幕的系统性失败模式；（2）长尾分布使得稀有但关键屏幕上的失败在标准指标下不可见。

Method: GUITAR 通过五阶段全自动 VLM 流水线构建状态转移图（STG）：(1) 屏幕语义描述提取；(2) 轨迹状态抽象；(3) 全局 STG 构建；(4) 状态链重构以保证语义一致性；(5) 细粒度屏幕到状态分配。状态由功能角色而非视觉外观定义，通过行为等价性映射。诊断涵盖两个层级：状态级成功率 C(s) 定位瓶颈区域，转移级成功率 T(s_i, s_j) 精确归因到具体决策点。瓶颈引导推理通过检索高错误率状态的相似状态，生成子目标来指导智能体决策。

Result: 在 8 个智能体、6 个 AndroidControl 与 Mind2Web 任务上的实验表明：(1) 60.4% 的失败集中在 20% 的瓶颈状态（Gini 系数 0.584）；(2) 瓶颈引导将 SR 提升 +2.8%，瓶颈状态自身成功率平均提升 +18.1%；(3) 三折轨迹留出评估下全自动 STG 仍保持 +1.88% 平均增益；(4) 9 个任务 57 对组合上达 +3.09% 平均增益；(5) 人工标注一致性 Gwet's AC1 = 0.848；(6) 相比 PageAgent，VLM 调用减少 20.1%，状态数减少 82.6%。

Conclusion: GUITAR 证明了结构感知诊断对 GUI 智能体评估具有诊断价值和可操作性，将屏幕抽象为功能状态并建模状态转移可有效揭示标准逐步评估无法捕捉的集中失败模式，并直接指导智能体优化。主要局限包括依赖 STG 构建质量、离线静态构建、评估范围有限，以及引导推理仍属概念验证。

Abstract: Understanding where and why Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents fail is essential for building more reliable systems, yet current evaluation relies on step accuracy, a metric that treats each screen independently and overlooks the underlying structure of GUI environments. This leads to two critical blind spots: (1) functionally equivalent screens are evaluated in isolation, obscuring systematic failure patterns across shared screens; and (2) the long-tailed GUI distribution renders failures on rare but critical screens invisible under standard metrics. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{GUITAR}, a state-centric diagnostic framework that performs structured failure analysis over both states and transitions, using a State Transition Graph (STG) by mapping visually diverse screens to shared functional states. Across 8 agents and 6 tasks from AndroidControl and Mind2Web, GUITAR reveals that 60.4\% of failures occur in 20\% of states, localizing errors to a small set of bottlenecks. Bottleneck-targeted guidance improves SR by 2.8\% and retains a 1.88\% average gain across 7 agents under three-fold trajectory-held-out evaluation with fully automatic STGs. These findings demonstrate the diagnostic and actionable value of structure-aware evaluation within the evaluated mobile and web tasks. Code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [537] [From Attack Success to Attack Severity: Counterfactual Memory Attacks on LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34132)
*Mingxi Zou,Langzhang Liang,Zhuo Wang,Yiyang Zhao,Lizhen Qu,Zenglin Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MemHarm，一种针对LLM智能体持久记忆的严重度导向反事实攻击方法，将攻击设计目标从传统的二元攻击成功转向下游任务损失的严重程度，并通过形式化的反事实记忆遗憾（CMR）度量进行自适应搜索与认证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持久记忆攻击仅以二元成功（攻击是否生效）为评估目标，但两个同样"成功"的攻击可能在下游任务中造成截然不同的损失程度；这种严重度差异是可被利用的攻击设计维度，却被现有工作系统性忽视。论文用固定候选空间内的反事实消融实验证明：成功导向选择在ASR上提升17.8个百分点，却仅使编辑态与干净态的下游损失差距增加0.013；严重度导向选择使该差距增加0.100，同时保持高ASR。

Method: MemHarm在接收任何结果反馈之前，先冻结一个由类型化语义因子（如授权范围、收件人、附件、日期等）替换构成的有限可接受反事实写集；通过智能体标准记忆接口对候选进行实现，利用离线配对损失反馈（同一初始状态下干净写与候选编辑写的配对运行）估计反事实记忆遗憾CMR（编辑损失减干净损失的期望），并采用基于可预测混合经验Bernstein置信序列的自适应分配，将选择问题建模为固定置信度最佳臂识别；对最终选择给出类条件(η,δ)-近最优性证书；理论部分还给出CMR的机制分解（任务后果κ、编辑实现偏差、干净实现偏差）和可实现严重度下界，并证明被动观测下归因歧义的下界。

Result: 在AgentDojo与τ³-bench两个基准、GPT-4o/Llama-3.1-70B两种骨干、六种记忆契约（向量情景、滚动摘要、用户档案、反思、图、混合）上，MemHarm在所有主要基准–骨干设置下获得最大CMR点估计，且在适用支持上的ASR保持第一或第二；通用攻击同支持CMR中MemHarm以0.334–0.568大幅领先最强基线0.011–0.216；91.4%的运行获得最优性证书；因子移除消融将CMR降低-0.34（匹配无关因子仅-0.02），证实所选语义因子的因果贡献；在OpenClaw与Hermis本地代理部署中通过GPT-OSS-120B验证了"写入-持久-检索"攻击路径的原生可行性。

Conclusion: MemHarm将持久记忆攻击设计从二元成功推进到下游严重度，通过CMR形式化、可冻结候选类的固定置信度搜索和类条件认证，在多个基准与记忆契约上一致识别出更具危害性的持久状态，同时保持强ASR；认证范围限于声明的有限编辑类，构建过程需要可重置隔离副本与配对损失反馈，部署仅需一次正常接口写操作。

Abstract: As LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent memory for long-horizon and personalized behavior, they can retain and reuse information across interactions, but this also creates a lasting channel through which malicious memory writes can influence future behavior. Persistent-memory attacks are typically evaluated by whether they succeed, yet successful attacks can leave persistent states with substantially different downstream consequences. We study this severity as a distinct attack-design objective and formalize it with counterfactual memory regret (CMR), the paired increase in expected downstream loss relative to clean memory. We introduce MemHarm, which predeclares a finite class of sparse, grounded semantic edits, evaluates candidates through the normal agent memory interface using offline paired-loss feedback, and certifies resolved selections within that class. Compared with attack-success optimization, CMR-guided selection produces substantially larger downstream loss while retaining most of the success-rate gain. Across two agent benchmarks and diverse memory designs, MemHarm attains the highest CMR point estimates among the evaluated general attacks on identical support. Factor-removal interventions link this harm to the selected semantic factor, and native-agent deployments verify the write-to-fresh-process attack path.

</details>


### [538] [StateGuard: Analytical-State Management with Validity-Aware Intervention for Long-Horizon Data Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34134)
*Wenle Liao,Zhao Wang,Jingchao Zhang,Jiajie Jin,Yimeng Xu,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: StateGuard 是一个外部运行时管理层，将长程数据分析的演进过程外化为可执行、可验证、可追溯的分析状态图，通过证据驱动的验证与分层修复机制，结合面向管理者的反事实监督与有效性引导的策略优化，显著提升数据智能体在多阶段分析中的可靠性并降低依赖性错误的级联传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程数据分析中，约束、变量、中间结论等分析产物隐式嵌于交互历史中，智能体难以追踪其在依赖变化下的有效性，导致陈旧产物被静默继承并向下游传播，引发级联失败。现有方法主要关注任务分解、流程验证或通用记忆，未显式维护派生产物在依赖演进中的有效性。

Method: StateGuard 将分析进度外化为结构化状态图（含约束、版本化变量、中间结论、跨状态关系），通过 Open→Update→Verify→{Finalize→Commit 或 Repair→Update} 的生命周期进行证据驱动的有效性验证与分层（轻量/重型）修复；训练采用两阶段：(1) 关系图任务合成 + 反事实运行时合成构建 3K 面向管理者的轨迹进行 SFT；(2) 基于协议正确性、状态接地与干预质量的多粒度运行时有效性奖励，使用 DAPO 进行策略优化。管理基于 Qwen3-8B，通过受限提示接口与底层数据智能体解耦。

Result: 在 LongDS-Bench、DAComp-DE、DABstep 三个长程数据分析基准上，StateGuard 对 GPT-5.5、Claude Sonnet 5、Kimi-K2.6、DeepSeek-V4-Pro 等专有智能体以及 Qwen3 系列开放权重智能体均带来一致性能提升（如 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在 LongDS 平均准确率由 44.53 提升至 54.05），同时显著降低依赖污染率（DCR），减少下游错误级联传播；消融实验验证 SFT 对获取结构化状态协议至关重要、RL 进一步稳定验证与干预，且显式状态有效性管理优于自由格式记忆和无状态观察。

Conclusion: 显式分析状态管理与有效性感知干预是提升长程数据智能体可靠性的有效途径；StateGuard 通过将分析状态视为可执行、可验证、依赖可追溯的对象并施加证据驱动验证与分层修复，在多个基准上持续提升任务性能并抑制依赖性错误传播，验证了显式状态管理范式对可靠长程数据分析的价值。未来方向包括将状态管理内化至智能体自身、采用轻量自适应管理机制以及引入更强的形式化有效性保障。

Abstract: LLM-based agents have shown strong capabilities in automated data analysis and are increasingly moving toward long-horizon, multi-stage analytical workflows. However, as the analytical process evolves, constraints, variables, and conclusions remain implicitly embedded in interaction histories, making it difficult for agents to track which analytical artifacts remain valid over increasingly long horizons and changing dependencies. Consequently, stale artifacts may be silently inherited, propagating errors to downstream stages. To address this challenge, we propose StateGuard, an analytical-state validity management framework for long-horizon data agents. StateGuard externalizes evolving analytical progress into a state graph containing constraints, versioned variables, intermediate conclusions, and cross-state relations, treating each state as an executable, verifiable, and traceable object rather than textual memory alone. StateGuard maintains state validity through evidence-grounded verification and hierarchical intervention. To equip StateGuard with these capabilities, we first introduce Manager-Oriented Counterfactual Supervision, which constructs 3K state-centric trajectories through counterfactual runtime synthesis to fine-tune StateGuard for state maintenance, verification, and repair. We then apply Validity-Guided Policy Optimization, using runtime validity evidence to provide fine-grained learning signals for protocol correctness, state grounding, and intervention quality. Experiments on three diverse long-horizon data-analysis benchmarks show that StateGuard consistently improves data-agent performance while reducing dependency-induced downstream error propagation, demonstrating the advantages of explicit analytical-state management for reliable long-horizon data analysis.

</details>


### [539] [Evo2Team: When Do Evolved Skills Transfer? From Selection to Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34135)
*Renxiang Wang,Jiaming Cui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体系统（MAS）中进化出的技能库在不同团队规模或模型层级间迁移的可行性。提出Evo2Team框架，通过选择、适配和确认三个阶段将源团队进化出的路由与通信技能迁移到目标团队。在Count-Frequency和AgentsNet两个任务族、4–32智能体规模、GPT和Qwen模型层级上进行28个迁移方向的实验。结果显示20/28方向实现正向迁移，探索成本低于从头进化新技能库；但选择不同的技能集不一定改变执行行为，且固定图确认无法保证在新实例上的成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作表明可复用技能和技能库能帮助多智能体系统，但当技能库迁移到不同模型层级或团队规模的新MAS时，其规则并不保证能改善新团队的决策。本文旨在系统研究技能迁移何时有效、如何评估其效果，以及确认机制是否可靠。

Method: 提出Evo2Team框架，包含三个阶段：(I) 选择-执行边界——比较六种冻结选择器（Direct、KNN、KMM、CORAL、Options、SF-GPI）和Evo2Team在相同执行器下的选择差异；(II) 执行-收益边界——通过离散编辑（添加/移除/替换技能、调整路由边界、通信参数）进行适配，考虑任务组级别的recipe选择；(III) 确认-测试边界——三次固定图确认后在新实例上测试。使用Count-Frequency层次聚合任务和AgentsNet去中心化协调任务，团队规模4/8/16/32，GPT和Qwen模型层级，28个迁移方向。

Result: 源进化在16个设置中14个达到联合质量、成本、模型层级和确认目标；28个迁移方向中20个满足正向迁移标准（含3个被保存的诊断测试）。Evo2Team探索成本在所有方向上低于从头进化目标技能库（CF: 9.0–91.6%，AgentsNet: 49.7–71.9%）。但发现：(1) 不同选择器可能产生相同执行（G4→G8和Q4→Q8中KNN和CORAL选择不同但执行相同）；(2) 质量改善不一定广泛覆盖所有任务；(3) 固定图确认无法保证新图成功——5个接受方向中22条任务记录全部通过三次确认，但有4条在新图执行中失败。

Conclusion: 技能迁移的有效性必须通过智能体的实际执行行为、受影响的任务数量、以及最终部署的质量与成本来综合评估。源进化表现不能预测迁移效果；选择不同的技能集不一定改变执行；固定图确认无法保证在新实例上的泛化。Evo2Team提供了一种系统化且成本更低的迁移路径，但技能迁移的评估需要超越聚合分数，关注执行记录和任务级结果。

Abstract: A skill bank that helps one multi-agent system may leave another's behavior unchanged. A transferred rule helps only when target agents act on it successfully. We study this path for routing and communication skills in Count-Frequency and AgentsNet, using teams of 4--32 agents and GPT and Qwen model ladders. Source evolution meets a joint quality, cost, model-tier, and confirmation goal in 14 of 16 settings. We then evaluate Evo2Team, which selects, adapts, and confirms source skills for the target team, alongside six frozen selectors across 28 transfer directions. Evo2Team's target-side exploration cost is below that of evolving a new target bank in every direction, even when reused reference evaluations are charged once. Twenty of 28 held-out outcomes meet the positive-transfer criterion, including three saved diagnostic tests. Selection alone does not explain these outcomes: KNN and CORAL choose different banks in two AgentsNet directions but produce identical recorded executions. When Evo2Team changes execution, gains can reach many tasks, as in a Count-Frequency direction that improves 28 of 32 tasks over KNN. Seven positive AgentsNet outcomes save 6.1--14.6\% in deployment cost while using transferred skills on only three to six of fifteen tasks. In five earlier accepted directions, all 22 task records using transferred skills pass three fixed-graph confirmations, but four fail in recorded executions on new graphs. Graphs and model responses change together in this comparison. These results show that skill transfer must be assessed through the actions agents take, the tasks those actions reach, and the quality and cost of the final deployment.

</details>


### [540] [Waggle: Learning One Anonymous Local Law for Self-Organizing LLM Swarms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34136)
*Mingxi Zou,Wei Zhu,Zhuo Wang,Langzhang Liang,Zhiwen Tang,Yinghui Xu,Zenglin Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Waggle框架，将LLM多智能体组织学习从显式组织结构（角色、层级、路由策略、通信拓扑）转向学习一种可复用的匿名局部律（anonymous local law），通过Swarm-Consistent Distillation（SCD）训练该律在变化群体规模与交互条件下生成、维持并重组协作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统通常学习或适应显式的角色、层级、路由策略或通信拓扑，将"组织"本身作为学习对象。这种范式在群体规模变化或交互条件变化时需要重新设计全局组织结构，缺乏灵活性。受群体智能（swarm intelligence）启发，作者将学习目标从显式组织转向生成组织的可复用局部律，以支持在线涌现和自适应协调。

Method: Waggle是一种共享匿名策略，运行在有界局部视图上，联合选择任务动作、语义通信和局部承诺更新。同一律在可互换智能体间共享，重复执行即可在线形成、维持并重组协作，无需显式角色或全局拓扑。训练方法Swarm-Consistent Distillation（SCD）包含两个关键组件：(1)匿名轨道一致性（anonymous-orbit consistency）——对等效匿名视图（通过置换源记录和不透明引用的双射变换）施加一致性约束，确保决策在不同标识符和邻居顺序下保持语义一致；(2)滚动条件下一场预测（rollout-grounded next-field prediction）——预测局部协调场如何从一个更新演化到下一个，使控制器表征捕捉协调动态。SCD训练头仅在训练时使用，部署时丢弃，不增加推理时组件。理论上证明了条件局部到全局的重标记等变性（Proposition 1）和事件驱动扩展（Proposition 2）。

Result: 在SwarmBench（空间协调）和Silo-Bench（分布式语言协调）两个子基质上，以N∈{16,32,64}的群体规模评估：(1)同一学到的律在N=128时仍保持N=64成功率的82.9%，且通信有界；(2)保持子基质特定oracle质量的96.8%（SwarmBench）和97.6%（Silo-Bench），仅使用一个adapter和一半标注数据；(3)在AgentsNet-RP冻结迁移上（不更新参数），五个任务中四个领先，使用的消息少于所有通信对比方法；(4)SCD因子分析显示，轨道监督将部署匿名视图一致性提高22.3个百分点，场监督将冻结探针损失降低34.3%；(5)反证据后的重组能力从80.0%提升至88.5%；(6)使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct作为第二学生骨干验证了结论的可复现性；(7)Silo-Bench N=64下58.2%成功率，远超瞬态交换和固定规则基线约15%的水平。

Conclusion: LLM智能体组织可以通过反复执行学到的局部律来涌现和适应，而非被显式指定为系统级结构。Waggle表明，在适当的有界规范接口和固定运行时下，适应性LLM智能体组织可以学习为可复用的匿名局部律。该方法在测试的子基质和规模上，重复的局部反应可形成、维持和修正协调，SCD改善了匿名稳定性和反证据后的重组。贡献包括：概念上将学习目标从显式组织结构转向生成组织的局部律；方法论上开发了SCD训练目标；实证上验证了一个律在跨子基质、群体规模和反证据重组场景下的有效性。局限包括：固定接口假设、确定性适配器、训练覆盖受限于训练子基质局部情境、未评估开放域持续适应和对抗场景。

Abstract: As LLM agents increasingly collaborate on complex tasks, how to organize their interactions becomes a central design question. Existing multi-agent systems typically learn or adapt explicit roles, hierarchies, routing policies, or communication topologies. We shift the learning target to a reusable local law that can be shared across interchangeable agents and adapt coordination as populations or interaction conditions change, without redefining a global organization. We introduce Waggle, a shared anonymous policy over bounded local views that jointly selects task actions, semantic communication, and local commitment updates. Repeated execution of the same law allows coordination to form, persist, and reorganize online without explicit roles or global topology. To learn this law across interchangeable agents and evolving coordination, we develop Swarm-Consistent Distillation (SCD), combining anonymous-orbit consistency with rollout-grounded prediction of the next local coordination field, with no added inference-time components. Across diverse coordination settings, the same learned law remains effective as populations and interaction budgets change, retains over 96% of substrate-specific oracle quality, and transfers without retraining; SCD further improves reorganization after counterevidence. Together, these results show that LLM-agent organization can emerge and adapt through repeated execution of a learned local law.

</details>


### [541] [You Can't Have It Both Ways: Concept Entanglement Limits Diffusion Model Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34137)
*Yian Wang,Ali Ebrahimpour-Boroojeny,Hari Sundaram,Varun Chandrasekaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文从表征几何的角度揭示了文本到图像扩散模型中概念遗忘（concept unlearning）的根本性限制：目标概念与相邻概念在激活空间中的重叠度（用纠缠系数 κ 度量）构成了任何鲁棒擦除方法对相邻概念造成附带损害的下界，由此得出不存在同时实现完美擦除和完美保留的算法，并将遗忘问题重构为帕累托前沿上的权衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念遗忘方法面临两种失败模式：在间接提示下泄露（concept leakage）或损害相邻概念（collateral forgetting）。论文认为这些不是算法缺陷，而是概念表示几何结构的必然结果，需要从理论层面加以刻画。

Method: 1）将概念形式化为交叉注意力激活空间中的区域，定义纠缠系数 κ 为目标区域与其他概念区域重叠体积的占比；2）证明关键定理（Theorem 4.6）：在 Lipschitz 连续性和最小位移假设下，ε-鲁棒擦除必然导致非目标提示上的平均位移 ≥ κ(1−ε)/L，即概念保留误差 γ ≥ κ(1−ε)/L；3）推导出不可能结果（Corollary 4.8）：当 κ>0 时，无法同时实现 ε=0 和 γ=0；4）在 Stable Diffusion v1.4 上对 13 种遗忘方法进行实证验证，引入 NP（Neighbor Preservation）指标度量相邻概念保留程度，并通过 SDXL 和 FLUX 验证跨架构一致性。

Result: 在 13 种方法中无一同时实现强擦除（UA>90）和强相邻保留（NP>80）。STEREO 实现近完全擦除（UA=99.8）但 NP 降至 18.0；稀疏推理时方法保留邻居但泄露（IRR=24.5）。损伤程度随 κ 单调递增（STEREO 的 Spearman 相关性 r_s=−1.0），κ-缩放在 SDXL 上重现，FLUX 上观察到邻居选择性损伤。仅最低 κ 目标（castle 和 snake）上存在满足 UA>90 且 NP>80 的方法对。STEREO 的 Lipschitz 常数跨概念仅变化 7.8%，与定理预测一致。

Conclusion: 对于纠缠概念，完美遗忘是错误的目标；方法应基于论文建立的帕累托前沿进行评估。κ 可作为部署前诊断指标，仅从基模型激活即可预测哪些目标可干净擦除，哪些必须接受附带损害。基准测试应联合报告擦除和保留，方法设计应具有 κ 感知能力，将位移限制在擦除所需方向上。

Abstract: Concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models aims to suppress a target concept (e.g., \texttt{horse}) while preserving related but distinct content (e.g., \texttt{donkey}), yet existing methods either leak under indirect prompts or visibly degrade other concepts. We show that these failure modes stem from the geometry of concept representations rather than from any particular algorithm. Formalizing concepts as activation-space regions, we prove that the overlap between a target and other concepts lower-bounds the damage any robust erasure must inflict on them, with the trade-off scaling linearly in the degree of overlap. Across thirteen unlearning methods, including methods designed to preserve non-target concepts, no method achieves both strong erasure and strong neighbor preservation: STEREO nearly eliminates indirect leakage but cuts neighbor generation by more than 75\%, while sparse inference-time methods preserve neighbors but leak. Damage increases with our overlap measure, monotonically so for STEREO; the $\kappa$-scaling reproduces on SDXL, and neighbor-selective damage recurs on FLUX. Perfect unlearning is the wrong target for entangled concepts; methods should be evaluated on the Pareto frontier our theorem establishes.

</details>


### [542] [Same Tasks, Different Apps: Why Mobile GUI Agents Fail to Generalize?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34139)
*Tien Tran,Namho Koh,Daiki E. Matsunaga,Ayush Jain,Kee Eung Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AnyAppBench是一个在线Android基准测试，专门评估移动GUI智能体在保持用户目标不变的情况下跨不同应用程序的泛化能力。通过10个功能类别、100个任务模板和520个任务-应用对测试13个智能体，发现应用场景的变化会导致显著的性能下降，子目标分解只能提供有限的帮助。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的移动GUI智能体基准测试通常将每个任务绑定到单一应用程序，无法区分智能体是否真正理解了任务还是只是记住了特定应用的操作方式。这导致在某个应用上取得高分并不代表智能体掌握了任务本质，难以评估真实部署中的跨应用泛化能力。

Method: 构建AnyAppBench基准：1）在AndroidWorld基础上设计100个应用无关的任务模板，覆盖10个功能类别；2）为每个模板配对1个AndroidWorld原始应用和多个新应用，形成520个任务-应用对；3）使用确定性程序化验证器评估成功；4）设置两种评估轨道（直接执行C1和应用无关子目标增强执行C2）；5）使用VLM judge对失败轨迹进行六类失败模式归因；6）通过人工标注评估judge的可靠性；7）评估13个不同家族的智能体模型。

Result: 1）11个仅指令型智能体在原始AndroidWorld应用上平均成功率为38.7%，但在同类新应用上仅27.3%，下降11.4个百分点；2）13个智能体（含混合系统）在原始应用上平均43.6%，新应用上31.4%；3）表现越好的模型损失越大（如Gemini-3.1-Pro损失29.0点）；4）子目标增强在SMS等5类别上提升+3.2点，但在Tasks等5类别上降低-3.5点，均无法弥合跨应用差距；5）失败类型组成随目标应用变化，新应用上execution/tooling和grounding类失败比例上升。

Conclusion: AnyAppBench揭示了移动GUI智能体在跨应用泛化方面的重大缺陷：在某个应用上取得高分不能可靠预测其在功能等价的替代应用上的表现。应用无关的子目标分解只能带来小幅度、类别相关的变化，无法弥合性能差距，且失败模式组成因目标应用不同而变化。该基准为移动GUI智能体的实际部署提供了重要的评估工具，并强调未来需要在任务分解、UI定位和UI变化下的恢复能力方面取得突破。

Abstract: Mobile GUI agents deployed in real settings must work across different applications that support the same functionality. Most existing benchmarks test each task in only one app, so a high score can mean the agent understands the task, or only that it knows that particular app. We introduce AnyAppBench, a category-controlled live Android benchmark that evaluates cross-application generalization while keeping the user goal fixed. It spans 10 functional categories, 100 task templates, and 520 task--application pairs over 52 applications. Agents run from raw instructions and with app-independent sub-goals, and a VLM judge labels every failed run under a fixed failure taxonomy whose reliability is measured by human annotation. We find that, across 13 agents, success on the original application does not transfer reliably to new applications with the same goal. Furthermore, providing high-level sub-goal decomposition produces only small, category-dependent changes that do not close the gap, and the mix of failure types changes with the target interface. Based on those insights, we believe the AnyAppBench benchmark provides an important stepping stone toward robust real-world deployment of mobile GUI agents. Our code, data and the leaderboard can be found at the project website this https URL .

</details>


### [543] [Self-Evolving Agents via Likelihood-Guided Tool-Space Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34151)
*Xuanqi Zhang,Ruinan Jin,Running Yang,Yuxuan Zhang,Minghui Chen,Wenlong Deng,Xiaoxiao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LOTS（基于似然的工具评分），通过冻结模型回答并测量移除工具观测后答案似然的变化，从执行经验中为每个重复任务构建持久且精简的任务级工具空间，无需修改模型参数，无需正确性标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当工具库扩大时，全量工具暴露会引入大量无关上下文并损害工具选择决策；现有方法存在输出无感知、跨请求无状态、推理代价高三方面局限。

Method: 请求级留一法干预：在冻结生成输出的前提下，移除工具s的观测/调用，重新计分同一输出的对数似然，差值即为工具s的贡献；跨请求聚合后取Top-K剪枝形成任务专属工具空间；支持EMA更新与跨任务累积，并具备跨模型可迁移性。

Result: 在TGB、BFCL多轮、GTA-Atomic ReAct三类基准上，于8/5/7个模型中一致优于Keep all与BM25/Dense/Tool2Vec/LLM路由/TTO/Beam Search等基线；服务上下文减少33–46%；18/20跨模型配对实现配置迁移；任务专属空间随新批次请求持续改进。

Conclusion: 可执行工具空间本身可作为智能体的持久自适应状态：通过输出感知的似然评分将执行经验转化为可复用、可更新、跨模型迁移的任务级配置。

Abstract: Self-evolving agents can continually improve their behavior, while tools define the executable action space through which they interact with the environment. However, exposing the full tool library to model introduces substantial irrelevant context and can impair tool-use decisions. We study tool-space self-evolution, where each recurring task type maintains a persistent tool space which is constructed from accumulated output experience. We identify three limitations of existing methods: (1) output-unaware selection: they rely primarily on tool descriptions or model priors rather than observed tool outputs; (2) statelessness across request: they select tools independently for each request without consolidating prior output experience into persistent task-specific state; (3) inference cost: they repeatedly search, rank, or reason over candidate tools for subsequent requests of the same task. We address these limitations through output-aware tool scoring, persistent task-specific tool spaces, amortized tool selection, and reusable configurations across models. We introduce LOTS (Likelihood-Only Tool Scoring), which evolves an agent's tool space from accumulated output experience while keeping model parameters fixed. After each request, LOTS holds the model's generated answer and estimates each tool's contribution by measuring how much the answer likelihood changes when its observed output is removed. These contributions are aggregated within each recurring task to rank tools and update its persistent space. Across three benchmarks, LOTS improves task performance while substantially reducing tool context. More importantly, sequential experiments demonstrate that task-specific spaces persist and continue to improve over time, while cross-model experiments show that learned configurations transfer across different models.

</details>


### [544] [TableSeek: Structure-Preserving Agentic Evidence Seeking over Heterogeneous Table Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34157)
*Jiaming Tian,Liyao Li,Wentao Ye,Haobo Wang,Lihua Yu,Zujie Ren,Gang Chen,Junbo Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TableSeek是一个面向异构表格语料库的结构保留型智能体检索框架，将开放域表格检索重新定义为迭代证据搜寻过程，而非一次性排序。该方法通过LLM智能体生成grep模式、检查表预览、识别模式和值层面的不匹配，并基于累积证据迭代优化搜索策略，在无需检索器训练或预计算语义索引的情况下实现与强检索-重排序流水线相当的端到端性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放域表格检索面临的核心问题是语义相关性与证据充分性之间的鸿沟：主题相关的表格可能缺乏回答所需的事实，而证据往往局限于少数几个依赖模式和表上下文的单元格。现有的一次性排序方法（稀疏检索、密集检索、重排序）难以应对异构模式、值格式和序列化带来的表示不匹配问题。

Method: TableSeek采用三阶段框架：(1) 基于grep的表格检索——LLM生成覆盖实体、属性、值和模式概念的搜索模式集合，对完整表格计算匹配得分进行排序；(2) 智能体检索精化——LLM智能体检查保留结构的小表格预览或大表格的序列化头部与匹配行，通过select或regenerate操作迭代优化搜索模式（形成P_t→R_t→P_{t+1}的循环）；(3) 可回答性检查——QA模型尝试回答，若证据不足则执行fallback回退到下一候选。核心设计原则是以单元格和模式作为搜索锚点，同时保留完整表格作为证据单元，实现细粒度定位与结构上下文的平衡。

Result: 在TCR-Bench（Mixed格式）上，TableSeek（10步）以Qwen3-30B为骨干达到R@all=0.507、F1=0.361，优于最强重排序基线Rerank(top-5)的0.421/0.317。在TARGET-TabFact-test-1k上达到最高Acc=0.764和Acc-Sup=0.589。TableSeek展现出更高的判别分数（DS@all=0.803 vs 0.540），表明其更注重证据充分性而非语义相关性。格式鲁棒性方面，TableSeek的FRS达95.1%，优于重排序方法的87.6%。消融实验证实refine机制贡献最大，结构保留设计对QA性能至关重要。但统计显著性测试显示，在Qwen3-30B上与重排序基线的差异未达到p<0.05水平，而使用更强的Qwen3.6-27B时差异显著（p<0.001）。

Conclusion: TableSeek证明了主动的、保留结构的证据搜寻是开放域表格检索的有效范式，能够在无需检索器训练、密集索引或重排序模型的情况下实现与强基线相当的性能。其优势在异构表格场景中尤为突出，且效果随底层LLM推理能力的增强而提升。框架的局限性在于其有效性紧密耦合于骨干模型的推理能力，且尚未探索智能体训练、轨迹优化或检索特定的微调技术。

Abstract: Open-domain table retrieval seeks tables that contain sufficient evidence for answering a question or verifying a claim. Yet semantic relevance is often misleading: topically similar tables may lack the required facts, while answer-bearing evidence is often confined to a few cells whose meaning depends on surrounding schema and table context. Heterogeneous schemas, value formats, and serializations further weaken one-shot matching. We present TableSeek, a structure-preserving agentic search framework for heterogeneous table corpora. Instead of ranking tables once, an LLM agent iteratively follows sparse clues, inspects schema-preserving previews, identifies schema- and value-level mismatches, and refines its investigation. TableSeek uses cells and schemas as evidence anchors while retaining complete tables as evidence units, enabling fine-grained localization without losing the context required for interpretation and answerability checking.
