Without relying on retriever training or a precomputed semantic index, TableSeek produces transparent evidence-seeking trajectories and achieves competitive end-to-end performance against strong retrieval-and-reranking pipelines on heterogeneous table benchmarks. These results suggest that active, structure-preserving evidence seeking is a promising paradigm for open-domain table retrieval.

</details>


### [545] [RoutePrism: Tracing Construction Order Effects in Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34160)
*Dong Xu,Zhangfan Yang,Jiantao Wu,Shipeng Zhang,Zexuan Zhu,Jiangqiang Li,Jun Zhang,Junkai Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了RoutePrism诊断协议，通过对同一源池以不同处理顺序构建记忆两次，追踪源、编译上下文和答案的差异，定位记忆构建中处理顺序导致的证据损失。核心发现是：幸存者选择（survivor selection）驱动了大部分源级变化，且不同记忆策略（压缩、有界最近性、MemoChat风格摘要、A-MEM）在源、上下文和元数据层产生不同的失败特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆系统评估仅依赖端点准确率，无法揭示构建过程中哪些证据发生了变化以及变化是否重要。端点准确率将源选择、上下文编译和答案采样混合为一个数字，掩盖了记忆构建中因处理顺序不同而导致的证据损失问题。

Method: RoutePrism采用配对构建干预：固定所有变量（记录内容、时间戳、策略、答案模型），仅改变处理顺序（正向与反向），在三个层级追踪差异——暴露源集合（V）、编译上下文（C）和生成答案。通过四个条件的支持恢复干预（S+、S-、恢复、替换）检验被置换记录是否携带任务相关证据。使用残差估计量D_res分离路径效应与答案模型采样噪声。在PersonaMem-32K（63个查询）和LongMemEval-S（470个问题）上评估，跨5个答案模型复现。

Result: 在focal压缩策略下，几乎所有源重叠丢失（J=0.057）；恢复被置换的单条记录可恢复超过60个百分点的丢失准确率（focal R-A=0.671），而等长的非支持替换则不能。机制定位显示幸存者选择驱动了大部分源级变化（63/63查询），而聚类单独变化几乎不影响暴露集（≤4/63）。不同策略呈现不同失败特征：压缩改变源、MemoChat改变编译上下文（保留源标识）、A-MEM改变内部元数据。LongMemEval-S上Recent-8策略产生0.000的源重叠，正向准确率0.206，反向仅0.081。

Conclusion: 端点准确率不足以诊断记忆系统——需审计证据本身。RoutePrism的双路径追踪分离了源替换（J）、上下文重写和答案模型噪声（D_res）。实际设计建议：(i)部署前比较幸存者规则与任务支持的匹配度；(ii)在合并和摘要过程中保留记录级来源；(iii)记录检索和回答实际使用的字段。来源级干预在所有5个答案模型间一致转移，但任务级幅度因模型而异（Qwen3-8B效果较小）。不同策略的失败模式需要多层观察才能完全捕获。

Abstract: Processing the same records in a different order can discard different evidence, yet endpoint accuracy alone cannot reveal what changed or whether it mattered. We introduce RoutePrism, a diagnostic protocol that builds memory twice from the same source pool in two processing orders, then traces which sources, compiled contexts, and answers differ. Because record content, timestamps, policy, and the answer model all stay fixed, any observed difference is localized to the memory construction step. A matched four-condition intervention tests whether a record displaced by reordering actually carried task-relevant evidence: restoring that single record recovers over 60 percentage points of lost accuracy, while substituting a non-supporting record of equal length does not. We evaluate the protocol on PersonaMem-32K (63 primary queries, 29 users) and 470 LongMemEval-S questions with histories spanning 38 to 62 sessions, replicating the core intervention across five answer models. Survivor selection, defined as the choice of which record a cluster retains, drives most source-level changes, while different memory policies (compaction, bounded recency, MemoChat-style summarization, A-MEM) produce distinct failure signatures at the source, context, and metadata layers.

</details>


### [546] [ReplayLens: Auditing Agents' Use of Outcomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34177)
*Dong Xu,Zhangfan Yang,Jiantao Wu,Shipeng Zhang,Zexuan Zhu,Jiangqiang Li,Jun Zhang,Junkai Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReplayLens 提出了一种黑盒审计方法，通过改变存储历史中的一种关系（如分数归属、动作-分数对的顺序或键名）并保持其他接口不变，来诊断智能体对记录结果的依赖方式，揭示标准端点评估无法检测的依赖结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆评估（如端点准确率或记忆开关对比）无法揭示智能体究竟依赖存储历史中的哪种关系（分数值、动作名称还是记录位置）来做出决策，这给记忆迁移、日志合并和重排序等操作带来了兼容性风险。

Method: 设计四种成对干预——结果重分配、整体对传输、一致重命名和键-槽重分配——每次仅改变历史中的一种关系而固定写入器、初始状态、未来接口和评估器，通过动作分歧率和效用差异来测量依赖程度；并证明端点等价不能决定重放行为，提供了有限支持构造和成对传输零定律等理论依据。

Result: 在合成写入器上验证了四种干预可恢复已知的更新律；黑盒 LLM 接口（GPT-6 Astra 等）上交换分数会改变决策而移动完整对则不会，从而分离分数归属与记录顺序；有界记忆研究暴露了端点比较遗漏的摄入顺序敏感性；顺序实验规划中，改变的历史分数会重定向探索并降低最终效用；代码调试智能体在隐藏测试中呈现相同模式。

Conclusion: ReplayLens 提供了一种关系级审计框架，可判断记录经验是否可以安全地合并、重排序或重新索引，其端点等价严格细于重放等价，填补了现有记忆评估在诊断结构依赖方面的空白。

Abstract: When an agent reuses logged experience, a changed decision may reflect the recorded score, the action's name, or the record's position in storage. Standard memory evaluations do not reveal which relationship drives that change. We introduce ReplayLens, a black-box audit that changes one relationship in the stored history at a time, holds the remaining interface fixed, and measures the resulting decision. Four interventions target four relationships. Outcome reassignment swaps which scores belong to which actions. Pair transport moves intact action-score pairs to new record slots. Consistent renaming relabels actions in both history and menu. Key-slot reassignment changes both score attachment and position. A constructive separation shows why the audit is needed: two memory writers with identical endpoint accuracy respond differently to the same replay, so conventional evaluation cannot resolve the underlying dependence. On black-box LLM interfaces, swapping scores changes decisions while moving intact pairs does not, separating score attachment from record order. A bounded-memory study exposes ingestion-order sensitivity that endpoint comparison misses. In sequential experiment planning, altered historical scores redirect exploration and reduce final utility despite fresh measurements. A code-debugging agent with sealed hidden tests shows the same pattern outside model selection. ReplayLens provides a relationship-level audit for deciding whether logged experience can be merged, reordered, or reindexed safely.

</details>


### [547] [RAGWarrant: Evidence-Preserving Governance for RAG Policy Promotion Under Quality, Cost, Latency, and Risk Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34179)
*Richard Krueger,Lucas Krause,Zach Pocquette*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RAGWarrant是一个开源的RAG策略晋升控制框架，将策略发布从排行榜选择转变为受约束的证据决策。它通过规范化评估输出、设置质量与硬风险门、分配证据类别声明上限、保留负面结果，并发出可审计的PROMOTE/BLOCK/REJECT/INCONCLUSIVE决策。框架在多个基准上评估，强调其作为治理抽象的价值，而非优化器优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统的策略变更涉及多目标权衡（质量、成本、延迟、风险），但现有评估工具仅产生度量分数，不决定发布安全性。部署权威往往是隐式的（验证集最高分或成本仪表板成为事实推荐），缺乏明确的、可审计的晋升控制层。本文旨在填补这一治理空白，防止以运营收益为名的不安全发布。

Method: 核心方法是构建一个证据保留型晋升控制器（promotion control formalism）。具体包括：(1) 规范化外部评估器输出（保留来源、方向、规模、分割等元数据）；(2) 冻结决策规则，预先声明质量损失边界δ，采用非劣效性（noninferiority）原则——当Δq的置信下界≥−δ且Δc或Δl的置信上界<0时才可PROMOTE；(3) 实施非补偿性硬门（安全、来源、出版卫生等）；(4) 引入证据阶梯（fixture/development/frozen/generative/human/platform），限制声明上限；(5) 四类科学决策（PROMOTE/BLOCK/REJECT/INCONCLUSIVE）；(6) 仅追加的证据账本与验证运行完整性检查；(7) 容器化的有限作业契约，可作为CI/CD或Kubernetes作业运行。

Result: 在T2-RAGBench、MultiHop-RAG、CRAG、HotpotQA等基准上的评估显示：(1) MultiHop-RAG确认性研究中治理与仅质量选择器选出相同策略，无优越性；(2) CRAG mock API路径呈现最强有界信号——治理选择更低成本策略，效用差约+0.001，主要由成本/延迟驱动；(3) HotpotQA因质量下降超过非劣效边界而阻断运营节省；(4) 守门员在4折验证通过，但在3个偏移的保留评估中失败；(5) 生成式评估（qwen3:8b、gpt-oss:20b、llama3.2:3b）的小切片结果不可重复；(6) 选择器压力测试显示受治理选择器以0.66的阻断率换取零质量损失标签；(7) 公开mini和硬化Docker作业可从全新克隆复现。

Conclusion: RAGWarrant的价值在于架构性和程序性创新：分离证据生成与发布权威，应用非补偿性门，绑定证据类别与声明上限，保留负面和混合结果。其核心贡献是让"我们测量了"与"我们有理据部署"之间有了纪律化的系统边界。框架在多个场景下展现出阻断不安全发布的能力（HotpotQA失败案例、守门员保留评估失败），证明其保守治理策略可执行。未来工作包括更大规模独立语料校准、盲法人工裁决、真实平台集成及假拒绝率度量。当前明确不支持：优化器优越性、生成式成本优势、人工验证、生产就绪或消除幻觉。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems are extensively instrumented with metrics, benchmarks, traces, and automated judges, but these tools do not decide whether a proposed policy change is safe to release. We present RAGWarrant, an open-source promotion-control framework that treats deployment as a constrained evidence decision rather than a leaderboard choice. RAGWarrant normalizes evaluator outputs and operational telemetry, applies predeclared quality and hard-risk gates, assigns evidence-class claim ceilings, preserves negative outcomes, and emits auditable PROMOTE, BLOCK, REJECT, or INCONCLUSIVE decisions. We evaluate the framework across T2-RAGBench, MultiHop-RAG, CRAG, HotpotQA, synthetic reproduction, and bounded local generative experiments. On HotpotQA, operational savings were blocked because answer quality fell beyond the declared margin. A bounded CRAG study selected a lower-cost quality-tied policy, but related generative gains were unstable and a held-out guardrail failed closed. We claim an auditable promotion-control abstraction, not optimizer superiority, human validation, or production readiness. The tagged artifact reproduces from a fresh clone, runs as a hardened Docker job, accepts external evaluator exports, and verifies artifact integrity.

</details>


### [548] [Decision Readouts for Text-Mediated Video Anomaly Detection: An Exploratory Evaluation of Jev and Qwen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34180)
*Xukui Qin,Youting Wang,Xinjie He,Ziyang Luo,Runxiong Wu,Yan-Syuan Chen,Zhongyao Chu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一项探索性实证审计研究,聚焦于"决策读出方式"(decision readout)对基于文本的视频异常检测结果的影响。研究者使用 LAVAD 缓存的视觉描述,在固定的视频衍生文本证据条件下,对比了 Jev 的两种类型化决策接口(Noul/Choice)与 Qwen 的三种读出方式(生成概率、短评分、序数似然期望)。研究在 UCF-Crime 和 XD-Violence 两个数据集的小规模开发样本(40 个视频、400 个锚点)上进行了评估,发现了数据集条件性的结果:Noul 在 XD 字幕上的排序表现最佳,但在 UCF 上未显示优势;Choice 因数值接受策略导致覆盖不全。研究明确指出结果不构成因果性结论或通用优越性证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当视频已被转换为文本后,不同的决策读出方式(生成的数值评分、概率数字、合法答案的似然分布、类型化 API 响应)在输出语义、分辨率、计算方式和失败模式上存在差异。研究者关心的是:在控制文本证据的条件下,这些接口差异的实际效果是否仍然有用。已有工作(如 LAVAD)将视觉字幕与异常评分分离,但缺乏对决策阶段不同读出方式的系统性比较。

Method: 1. **样本设计**:从 UCF-Crime 和 XD-Violence 各选 20 个源组(各 10 个正常/异常),共 40 个视频、400 个锚点,使用固定种子的确定性选择程序。
2. **五种读出方式**:
   - **N (Jev Noul)**:类型化 yes/no 概率接口
   - **C (Jev Choice)**:带概率分布的选项接口(0.0–1.0 共 11 个候选项)
   - **G (Qwen 生成概率)**:直接生成 0–1 之间的概率数字
   - **O (Qwen 序数似然期望)**:对完整答案的似然取期望
   - **S (Qwen 短评分)**:argmax 评分
3. **证据视图**:每个样本提供 summary 和 ordered captions 两种文本视图。
4. **评估指标**:ROC-AUC、AP、PR 梯形面积、Brier 分数、NLL;使用 20 个源组的 bootstrap 区间(2,000 次重复)。
5. **历史基线**:在完全相同锚点上审计历史 LAVAD 原始分数。
6. **审计维度**:响应结构 vs 数值一致性;Choice 的首次失败分类;输入长度统计;历史完整帧缓存重放(69,634 UCF 锚点 + 146,449 XD 锚点)。

Result: **主要结果(数据集条件性)**:
- **XD 字幕(Cap)**:Noul AP = 75.99%,显著优于 G(48.47%)和 O(57.81%);N − O 差值 = 18.18 个百分点,95% bootstrap 区间 [5.53, 31.50];N − G 差值 = 27.52 pp,区间 [8.41, 45.38]。
- **UCF 字幕(Cap)**:Noul ROC-AUC = 52.26%,反而低于 O(65.95%);未显示对应优势。
- **Brier 分数**:两种概率读出(G、N)在 UCF 上均高于评估患病率参考 0.0475,显示校准差。
- **Choice 覆盖**:800 请求中仅 776 个返回有效数值,严格数值策略导致完整覆盖质量比较不可行。
- **历史 LAVAD 对比**:在 XD 上,N − L 差值达 35.23 pp;在 UCF 上差异较小或方向不一致。
- **二元似然控制缺失**:实验设计中缺少二元读出对照,限制了对二元接口的结论。

Conclusion: 本研究得出的是数据集条件性的探索性结论,非通用性主张:
1. 在冻结的视频衍生文本上,读出选择确实影响排序、概率质量和失败统计;
2. Noul 在稀疏 XD 字幕上的证据最强,但 UCF 结果与类别患病率参考严重制约了更广泛的推广;
3. 完整答案的序数似然在多个关键单元上提供了比生成概率更强的本地排序对照;
4. 保留 Choice 失败案例区分了结构响应有效性与数值接受性;
5. 研究未确立:类型化接口的因果效应、自然校准性、非劣效性、通用优越性或端到端加速。
主要局限包括:Jev 与 Qwen 同时改变了权重、训练和服务实现;摘要与字幕改变了证据内容;缺失二元似然控制;每数据集仅 20 个源组、UCF 仅 10 个正锚点;样本稀疏使 bootstrap 区间无法创造新信息;未评估直接 yes/no 措辞对 Noul 输出的潜在影响。

Abstract: How much does the decision readout matter when video-derived textual evidence is held fixed? We evaluate Jev typed decisions and three Qwen readouts on a sparse development sample of 40 videos and 400 target anchors from UCF-Crime and XD-Violence, each presented as a summary and ordered captions. Each dataset contributes 20 source groups and 200 anchors, including only 10 and 37 positives, respectively. The original five-backend pilot requested 4,000 predictions; Jev Choice returned 776 valid responses out of 800 under the study's strict numerical policy, blocking its full-coverage quality comparison. On XD captions, Jev Noul achieved 75.99% average precision versus 48.47% for Qwen generated probability and 57.81% for the stronger local ordinal-likelihood expectation. The latter paired difference was 18.18 percentage points (95% source-group bootstrap interval 5.53-31.50). UCF did not show a corresponding advantage: caption ROC-AUC was 52.26% for Noul and 65.95% for ordinal likelihood. Both probability readouts had higher, hence worse, UCF Brier scores than the evaluation-prevalence reference of 0.0475. We additionally audit historical LAVAD scores at exactly matched anchors and distinguish response structure from numerical consistency. A binary-likelihood control is missing. These exploratory offline results characterize ranking, probability quality and interface failures; they establish neither a causal typed-interface benefit nor general superiority, calibration or end-to-end acceleration.

</details>


### [549] [Efficient Reasoning via Constrained Optimization in Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34181)
*Zhinan Hou,XingChen Li,Keyou You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需训练的推理加速框架，通过在潜在空间中将偏离的隐藏状态投影回高效推理区域（凸多面体），有效缓解大型推理模型的"过度思考"问题，在减少token消耗的同时提升准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型(LRMs)存在"过度思考"问题，产生冗余推理步骤导致token消耗过大。现有方法（如抑制反思关键词或强制缩短推理长度）往往截断必要步骤，引发"思考不足"，损害性能。因此需要在不牺牲性能的前提下实现高效推理。

Method: 方法包含三个核心步骤：(1) 通过Direct CoT和Vanilla CoT的对比发现高效推理步骤在潜在空间中聚集为集中区域H；(2) 利用PCA投影和K-Means聚类+线性SVM构建高效推理集的凸多面体边界；(3) 在推理过程中，将步骤分隔符的隐藏状态投影回H内，通过二次规划(QP)问题求解，并利用多参数二次规划(mp-QP)进行GPU加速。

Result: 在四个模型（1.5B-14B）和六个基准测试（数学、编程、科学问答）上验证：准确性最高提升12.1%，token减少11.8%-52.8%，端到端推理延迟减少24.9%-38.4%。方法具有跨域泛化能力，不损害创造力和探索能力（Pass@k保持或提升）。

Conclusion: 本文从几何视角揭示了高效推理在潜在空间中的集中特性，提出了一种基于约束优化的训练免费表示引导框架，有效缓解了LRMs的过度思考问题，同时避免了思考不足的风险，为高效推理提供了新颖且实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have shown remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet they still suffer from overthinking, generating redundant reasoning steps which incur substantial token consumption. Existing methods, such as suppressing reflective keywords or forcing shorter reasoning lengths, attempt to mitigate this issue but inevitably truncate necessary steps and induce underthinking, thereby compromising performance. To address this dilemma, we investigate the latent representations and observe that efficient reasoning steps naturally cluster into a concentrated region in latent space, while those deviating from this region tend to produce verbose sequences. To leverage this, we keep reasoning focused within this region via a quadratic program which projects deviating hidden states back into the region. Then we propose a novel training-free framework to achieve efficient reasoning that reduces token generation costs without sacrificing performance. Extensive experiments conducted on four models ranging from 1.5B to 14B, and across six benchmarks in math reasoning, coding, and scientific QA, validate the effectiveness of our method, up to a 12.1\% improvement in accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 11.8\% to 52.8\%. Codes are available at \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

</details>


### [550] [CASS: Contribution-Aware Structured Sparsity for Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34184)
*Yan Li,Guiping Cao,Meng Xu,Tao Jiang,Yaguang Song,Ming Tao,Yaowei Wang,Dongmei Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CASS（Contribution-Aware Structured Sparsity），一种基于贡献感知结构化稀疏的模型合并框架。该方法通过识别并保留任务特定的注意力头和FFN神经元，以结构化方式过滤任务向量，缓解多任务模型合并中的参数干扰问题。包含两种实例化：CASS-Merging（事后即插即用滤波器）和CASS-Tuning（训练时梯度约束）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型合并方法将Transformer视为非结构化的"参数袋"，基于权重幅值或随机启发式剪枝任务向量，忽视了Transformer固有的模块化结构（注意力头、FFN神经元）。这导致参数干扰问题，任务向量之间存在冲突更新，影响合并效果。作者从机制可解释性视角出发，认为任务相关知识应集中在少数激活显著的组件中，因此需要组件级别的结构化过滤方法。

Method: 核心方法包含三个关键设计：1）将MHA和FFN分解为统一的残差流加性求和形式，为组件级过滤提供代数基础；2）提出贡献分数指标，FFN神经元使用绝对贡献幅度，注意力头使用任务选择性分数（相对全局平均的偏差）；3）构建结构化二元掩码，选择top-k%任务相关组件。两种应用场景：CASS-Merging对已微调的任务向量进行掩码过滤后再合并；CASS-Tuning在微调阶段对梯度应用掩码约束，使任务向量在结构上分离。掩码仅抑制任务特定更新，非活跃组件恢复至预训练参数而非删除。

Result: 在三类基准测试上验证：视觉任务（ViT-B/32、B/16，20个任务）、编码器语言模型（RoBERTa，8个GLUE任务）、解码器语言模型（Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B-Instruct，4项能力）。CASS-Merging持续提升所有八种基线方法，TA和DARE增益最大（ViT-B/16上TA提升+4.97%，DARE提升+4.87%），子空间方法和优化方法也有小幅提升。CASS-Tuning在Qwen2.5上改进所有基线，TIES在0.5B模型上提升+0.121。OOD泛化实验显示CASS能保持甚至提升分布外性能（MMLU提升）。消融实验证实贡献感知掩码优于随机掩码，FFN掩码单独使用效果通常优于MHA掩码，两者结合最佳。方法对探针样本数量不敏感（8-1024样本性能差异<0.5%），计算开销小。

Conclusion: CASS提供了一个统一的贡献感知结构化稀疏框架，通过识别任务特定组件有效缓解模型合并中的参数干扰。理论分析证明任务相关组件具有稀疏性和部分不相交特性，支持结构化组件级过滤。两种实例化（CASS-Merging和CASS-Tuning）分别提供事后即插即用和训练时主动控制两种范式，在视觉和语言多种架构上一致提升现有合并基线。局限性包括固定稀疏率（20%）和仅在最大1.5B参数的解码器模型上验证。

Abstract: Model merging integrates task-specific fine-tuned models into a single multi-task model, but often suffers from parameter interference caused by conflicting task-vector updates. Existing methods typically mitigate conflicts by pruning task vectors based on weight magnitude or random heuristics, treating Transformers as unstructured ``bags of parameters'' and overlooking their inherent modularity. In this paper, we propose \textbf{C}ontribution-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{S}tructured \textbf{S}parsity (CASS), a unified framework that reduces parameter interference by identifying and preserving task-specific components. At the core of CASS is a contribution-aware structured mask that identifies task-relevant attention heads and FFN neurons. We instantiate this mask in two settings: CASS-Merging, the primary post-hoc setting where masks serve as a plug-and-play denoising filter for existing merging operators, and CASS-Tuning, an extension for scenarios with fine-tuning access where masks constrain gradients to reduce structural overlap between task vectors. Our analysis shows that task-relevant components are sparse and partially disjoint, supporting structured component-level filtering as an effective way to reduce merging interference. Extensive experiments across vision (ViT, 20 tasks) and language (RoBERTa, 8 tasks; Qwen2.5, 4 tasks) benchmarks demonstrate that CASS improves a range of representative merging baselines.

</details>


### [551] [PainterBench: A Figural Divergent-Thinking Benchmark for Tool-Using Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34195)
*Shane K.A. Dalumura Hettige,Jonas Oppenlaender*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PainterBench是一个将人类图形发散思维测试中的"未完成图形任务"移植到AI智能体（agent）场景下的基准测试。它要求智能体通过工具调用在画布上作画，将给定起始形状融入尽可能原创的画作中。研究者评估了14个多模态语言模型，收集了2,700幅画作和72,000条众包评分，并提出了一个自动化创造力评分器ViDrA-adapted。结果显示模型间创造力差异显著，GPT-6 Astra表现最佳；智能体画作在创造力评分上超过人类参考，但在可识别性上低于人类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的语言模型创造力评估多局限于文本领域（如替代用途任务AUT），且已有的智能体绘画系统（如SketchAgent）侧重于评估可识别性而非创造力。人类创造力研究中使用的"未完成图形任务"是评估图形发散思维的成熟工具，但尚未被移植到工具调用智能体场景中。此外，预训练阶段习得的创造力能否迁移到多轮工具调用场景中，这一问题也尚未得到检验。

Method: PainterBench将MTCI（多试验创造性思维）未完成图形任务移植到智能体场景。智能体在400×400像素画布上通过14种绘图工具（如draw_dots、draw_lines、draw_polygons等）进行多轮工具调用作画，每轮后观察画布渲染结果，自主决定何时结束（调用drawing_finished工具）。刺激库包含30个起始形状（20个不完整形状+10个物体转换轮廓）。研究评估了14个多模态语言模型，每模型对30个刺激各完成5次重复试验，共2,100次试验。创造力与可识别性通过众包评分（每画12名评分者，共72,000条评分）。研究者还提出了ViDrA-adapted——一个基于DINOv2 ViT-L/14特征训练的核岭回归自动化创造力评分器，通过在众包评分上重新拟合回归头以适应智能体画作。此外进行了6项敏感度分析（工具接口/词汇量/空白画布/Oracle提示/指令措辞/上下文组件）。

Result: 1) 14个模型间图形发散思维能力差异显著（χ²(13)=3096.9, p<0.001），GPT-6 Astra创造力最高（0.81），Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite最低（0.35）；2) 智能体画作在创造力上超过人类参考样本（0.56 vs 0.41, d=0.88），但在可识别性上低于人类（0.45 vs 0.53, d=-0.41）；3) 所有模型的画作与人类画作分布相距甚远（最低1.9 SD，Gemini系列达4.3 SD）；4) 智能体极少进行修改（仅22.9%的试验调用undo），绘画努力量与创造力在模型间几乎无关（ρ̄=0.06）；5) 每个模型在不同试验中倾向于重复少量想法（如GPT-5.6 Luna 61.3%的画作标题含"cosmic"）；6) 识别性缺陷源于模型的目标选择而非执行能力——Oracle条件下可直接恢复至人类水平；7) ViDrA-adapted评分器在留一模型出交叉验证中达到r=0.83，在留一刺激出验证中达到r=0.84；8) 失败模式包括：无效修改、零响应、过度绘画、跨试验同质化、碎片化画作。

Conclusion: PainterBench成功将人类图形发散思维评估范式移植到工具调用智能体场景，证实预训练获得的创造力可部分迁移至智能体环境，但在可识别性维度上存在显著缺陷，该缺陷源于智能体在开放式指令下未将可识别性作为目标。智能体画作具有"过度原创但不够有效"的特征——创造力高、可识别性低、修订稀少、想法重复。GPT-6 Astra表现最佳。ViDrA-adapted是可靠的自动化评分器。研究还发布了完整的画作数据集、工具调用轨迹、众包评分及基准测试工具，支持后续创造力评估研究。

Abstract: Figural divergent thinking is the ability to develop a given shape fragment into an original drawing. In humans, this ability is assessed with incomplete-drawing tasks. We introduce PainterBench, a benchmark that ports the incomplete-drawing task to the agentic setting. The agent draws on a canvas through tool calls and observes the result after every turn. The canvas includes a starting shape which cannot be erased, and the agent's goal is to incorporate this shape into the most original drawing it can produce. The task is open-ended, and the agent itself decides when the drawing is finished. The benchmark tests incremental visual planning over a short horizon and the transfer of creative ability from pretraining to multi-turn tool use. We evaluate 14 multimodal language models from small to frontier scale. Across the primary study and six sensitivity analyses, we collect 2,700 drawings and crowdsource creativity and recognizability ratings for every drawing and for 300 human reference drawings. We also present ViDrA-adapted, an automated scorer that predicts human creativity ratings of agent drawings (r = 0.85 on random held-out test split). Figural divergent thinking varies widely across the 14 models, and GPT-6 Astra produces the most creative drawings. Relative to the human drawings, the agent drawings score higher in creativity but lower in recognizability. We release the final drawings, per-round canvas snapshots, tool call traces, stimulus bank, benchmark harness, crowdsourced ratings (N = 72,000), and ViDrA checkpoint.

</details>


### [552] [Behavior-Grounded Semantic Enrichment for Financial Fraud Modeling and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34211)
*Linbo Shao,Huilin He,Yating Lou,Dawei Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对金融欺诈检测中公开数据集语义稀缺的问题，提出了一个基于交易行为的多智能体语义增强框架，并构建发布了多模态金融欺诈数据集MS-FFSD。该框架通过角色专用智能体（时间、用户、商家、一致性、文本智能体）生成可解释的结构化语义和文本语义，同时保留真实数据驱动的交易行为。实验表明，丰富语义能提升欺诈建模与上下文感知的LLM推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开金融交易数据集存在两难：真实数据集保留行为结构但语义稀疏（隐私限制导致匿名化）；合成数据集语义丰富但行为真实性不足，且缺乏支持语义推理的实体级文本描述。这限制了基于语义上下文的欺诈建模与LLM推理能力的发展。

Method: 提出多智能体语义增强框架，包含五个角色专用智能体：(1) 时间智能体：基于IEEE-CIS参考节奏和用户级模式重构时间戳；(2) 用户智能体：结合观察到的用户-位置交互与外部先验初始化地理和人口属性；(3) 商家智能体：依据交易行为和外部先验进行分层类别分配；(4) 一致性智能体：在用户-商家交互图上迭代优化跨实体语义一致性；(5) 文本智能体：使用Qwen3-32B将精炼的结构化状态转化为实体级自然语言描述。通过外部知识库、约束引擎和欺诈感知保留控制器进行共享控制。

Result: 在MS-FFSD上对16种图基欺诈检测模型进行渐进式语义增强评估：原始特征平均AUC为87.94%，加入结构化语义后为88.01%，加入文本语义后提升至89.17%。文本语义带来更一致的改进。在两个私有真实金融数据集上验证了框架的通用性。语义增强质量分析显示生成语义具有统计保真度和语义信息性。LLM（DeepSeek-V3）零样本推理案例分析表明，丰富语义支持上下文感知的行为解释。

Conclusion: 该工作推进了多模态金融欺诈研究，弥合了LLLM与多智能体能力与实际反欺诈实践之间的差距。MS-FFSD数据集和框架已开源发布，为系统探索LLM和多智能体在真实金融场景中的能力与边界提供了资源。

Abstract: In financial fraud detection, rich semantic context can provide important evidence for transaction behavior modeling and fraud reasoning. However, public real-world financial datasets often lack rich semantics due to privacy constraints. Consequently, synthetic datasets incorporate generated semantics, but at the cost of behavioral realism; textual descriptions for contextual reasoning remain scarce. We address this gap through a semantic enrichment framework grounded in original transaction behavior to simulate multimodal financial data. We (1) propose a multi-agent semantic enrichment framework that generates interpretable financial semantics grounded in transaction behavior through role-specialized agents and consistency refinement, and (2) newly contribute a valuable multimodal financial fraud dataset, MS-FFSD, enriched with structured semantics and textual semantics while preserving real-data-grounded transaction behavior. Furthermore, we systematically analyze the quality and utility of semantic enrichment. Results demonstrate statistical fidelity and framework generalizability, while showing that richer semantics benefit fraud modeling and context-aware LLM reasoning. Overall, this work advances multimodal financial fraud research and bridges emerging LLM and multi-agent capabilities with operational anti-fraud practice. The framework and dataset are released at this https URL .

</details>


### [553] [GlyphBench: A Playground for Language-Model Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34214)
*Roger Creus Castanyer,Marc-Alexandre Côté,Matthew James Sargent,Augustine N. Mavor-Parker,Glen Berseth,Pablo Samuel Castro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GlyphBench 是一个面向语言模型智能体强化学习后训练的环境套件，包含360+任务，将空间观测渲染为二维Unicode网格。研究表明其字形观测优于原生文本和像素观测，且在100个游戏任务上的RL训练能提升模型在Reasoning Gym上的迁移能力，效果优于数学和代码RL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型RL后训练研究在观测接口、动作接口和训练设置上差异较大，难以系统比较。游戏作为RL经典测试床具有可重复交互和多样化挑战的优势，但缺乏统一的面向语言模型的文本接口来支持跨环境的研究。

Method: 构建GlyphBench环境套件（362个任务，9个游戏家族），采用二维Unicode网格观测和命名动作的统一接口；通过Prime-RL框架进行PPO/IPO风格的RL训练；在Craftax上比较观测格式（字形vs文本vs像素）和Agent harness设计；用Snake实验研究学习率与rollout组大小的交互；在100个任务的混合上训练Qwen3.5-4B，并在Reasoning Gym、MathArena、SWE-bench上评估迁移能力。

Result: 1) 字形观测在Craftax上显著优于原生文本和像素（Sol模型: 11.4% vs 0.3% vs 3.7%最大奖励）；2) Guided Memory harness配合高推理算力可获得更大收益；3) Snake实验显示小rollout组配合合适学习率效果最优；4) 在100个游戏任务上训练后，Qwen3.5-4B在Reasoning Gym上达到63.48%准确率，超过基础模型（56.04%）、数学RL基线（62.29%）和代码RL基线（58.98%）；5) 在MathArena和SWE-bench上的迁移效果不显著。

Conclusion: GlyphBench可作为评估语言模型智能体的基准、研究学习动力学的工具以及后训练套件。游戏训练的推理能力迁移效果在主实验设置下优于数学或代码RL，提示交互式学习对提升推理能力具有重要价值。字形空间文本观测是有效的语言模型交互接口。未来需进一步理解何种交互促进迁移以及如何优化训练。

Abstract: We introduce GlyphBench, an environment suite for reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of language-model agents, with over 360 tasks spanning diverse games. GlyphBench renders spatial observations as two-dimensional Unicode grids and connects training, evaluation, and trajectory replay through a unified interface designed to support efficient and reproducible research. We use GlyphBench to study how observation interfaces, reasoning effort, and agent harnesses affect performance, and how RL configurations shape learning dynamics. Our results show that glyph observations outperform native text and pixels in our Craftax experiments, with further gains on several BALROG environments. RL on 100 GlyphBench tasks improves Qwen3.5-4B on held-out Reasoning Gym problems, reaching 63.48% accuracy and outperforming the base model, a math-trained baseline, and a code-trained baseline. These experiments provide empirical evidence that reasoning gains from gameplay can yield stronger transfer than math or code. Together, these results highlight GlyphBench's value as a testbed for systematic research on how language-model agents learn, interact, and generalize.

</details>


### [554] [Same Winners, Different Success Rates: Evaluating How LLM Agents Recover from Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34215)
*Dong Xu,Zhangfan Yang,Jiantao Wu,Shipeng Zhang,Zexuan Zhu,Jiangqiang Li,Jun Zhang,Junkai Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了LLM智能体恢复评估中广泛使用的"集合一致性(set agreement)"度量存在根本性缺陷：它是一种纯序数度量，无法区分"普遍成功"与"普遍失败"两种本质不同的恢复状态。文章通过理论证明(集合-路径对称性)和大规模实验(864个RecoveryBench回合 + 3,456个规划响应)论证了这一缺陷，并提出四个诊断指标来解决该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体在复杂工作流中的部署日益增多，从中间任务失败中恢复的能力成为关键能力。现有的checkpoint-based基准(如RecoveryBench、ToolMaze)使用"集合一致性(set agreement)"作为稳定性度量——即独立运行选择相同最佳动作的频率。然而，本文指出这种度量存在根本性缺陷：高一致性可能来自"普遍成功"或"普遍失败"两种截然不同的状态，这会误导实践者关于动作质量的判断。

Method: 文章采用理论与实证相结合的方法：(1) 理论层面：提出"集合-路径对称性(set-path symmetry)"定理，证明对于等成本伯努利动作，成功概率(0.9, 0.8)和(0.2, 0.1)产生相同的最佳动作集分布；证明有限时间内无法证明精确的人口平局；证明检查点到动作的绑定关系携带超出边际分布的信息。(2) 实证层面：在864个冻结RecoveryBench回合(3个GPT-5.6模型 × 3个恢复动作 × 8次重复)和两个规划队列(共3,456个响应，覆盖24个冻结检查点)上进行实验，并通过排列检查点到动作的绑定关系进行对照实验。(3) 使用Hoeffding证书验证统计认证的样本需求。

Result: 主要结果：(1) RecoveryBench实验中，Luna模型在k=1时一致性达85.4%，但保留成功率仅1.4%，且所有匹配比较均由全零对比驱动；(2) 规划实验中，一致性从k=1到k=4下降5倍(从40.4%降至8.3%)，但保留成功率保持稳定在约76%；(3) 一致性下降完全由平局解析驱动，多动作匹配从0.310降至0.125，而单动作匹配仅小幅上升；(4) 检查点-动作绑定的排列改变了8-13%的单元级结论；(5) 在典型5-10个百分点的差距下，认证唯一最佳动作需要数百至数千次执行，远超当前评估预算。

Conclusion: 集合一致性(set agreement)作为恢复评估的稳定性指标具有根本性误导性，因为它无法区分普遍成功与普遍失败。文章提出报告四个诊断量——一致性(all-zero fraction)、保留成功率(hold-out success)和汇总成功率(pooled success)——可使该失败模式暴露而无需额外数据收集。实践者应：(1) 在报告一致性时同时报告全零比较比例；(2) 按结果质量分解一致性以揭示其驱动因素；(3) 不将跨样本预算的一致性下降解释为质量下降；(4) 评估管道应记录检查点到动作的绑定关系，因为失去这些绑定会无声地破坏8-13%的单元级结论。

Abstract: Evaluating how LLM agents recover from mid-task failures is central to deploying reliable agentic systems. Existing checkpoint-based benchmarks measure recovery by comparing which action is selected as best across independent runs, a quantity known as set agreement. However, set agreement is a purely ordinal measure that records which action wins without reflecting the absolute level of performance. When all actions fail, they tie at zero reward, and independent runs produce the same tied set with high probability, creating an illusion of stability that masks near-zero recovery success. We formalize this limitation through a set-path symmetry result, proving that for equal-cost Bernoulli actions the success probabilities (0.9, 0.8) and (0.2, 0.1) yield identical best-action-set distributions at every sample size. No procedure based solely on which action wins can distinguish these two regimes. We further prove that certifying exact population ties is impossible in finite time, and that the assignment of outcomes to checkpoints carries information beyond marginal outcome distributions. The pooled success probability is the missing scalar that resolves the ordinal ambiguity. Experiments on 864 frozen RecoveryBench episodes and two planning cohorts totaling 3,456 responses confirm the theoretical predictions. Agreement and held-out quality can move in opposite directions, and permuting checkpoint-to-action bindings changes 8 to 13 percent of cell-level conclusions. Based on these findings, we propose reporting four diagnostic quantities (agreement, all-zero fraction, held-out success, and pooled success) that expose this failure mode with no additional data collection.

</details>


### [555] [When Does Selection Replace Extraction? A Pre-Registered Test of Agent Memory with a Typed Decision Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34227)
*Rishabh Sharma,Rishika Lall*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇预注册的非劣性测试研究，核心问题是：对话记忆系统是否需要LLM提取的事实，还是仅靠选择正确的原始对话轮次就够了？研究在LoCoMo和LongMemEval两个基准上，使用Jev（一种类型化决策模型）作为单次重排序选择器，对比原始轮次选择与LLM事实提取（engram v2）。结果表明：在紧预算下，单次Jev调用选择的原始轮次与LLM提取记忆在5点非劣性边界内等价，写入成本低3061倍；重排序的增益随预算增长而减小（k=3时+17.4分，k=20时仅+1.5分），这解释了先前文献中关于重排序价值的分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献对对话记忆系统中提取与原始轮次选择的相对价值存在分歧：基于提取的系统（mem0、LongMemEval、SeCom）报告蒸馏事实带来的增益；但SmartSearch认为原始历史加排序就够好，而Fidelity Before Structure则发现逐字块优于提取工件。这两项研究还互相矛盾——SmartSearch认为排序是瓶颈，Fidelity却发现重排序增益很小。本文提出上下文预算（保留的候选数量）可能是分歧的关键解释，并设计预注册研究来验证。

Method: 1) 预注册非劣性测试：在5个从未用于开发的LoCoMo对话（778题）和LongMemEval上进行，主假设H1测试Turns+Jev（单次Jev重排序调用选择的原始轮次）相对engram v2（LLM提取的事实+Jev读取路径）的非劣性，边界为-5分（单侧95%）。2) 系统对比：Turns+Jev（原始轮次+Jev相关性判断）、Turns+cosine（仅余弦排序基线）、engram v2（LLM提取+Jev管理）、mem0 2.1.0、Jev-Mem（多调用图遍历）。3) 匹配上下文：在比较时通过Eq.5选择匹配token数的k值。4) 二次测试S1-S7（McNemar或非劣性，Holm校正）。5) 鲁棒性检查：第二个答案模型（Llama 3.3 70B）+盲法人工评分（对judge分歧问题）。6) 诊断：短列表回忆分解、每个类别的损失定位。

Result: 1) H1通过：judge评Turns+Jev 77.0% vs engram v2 77.5%，差异-0.5分，单侧95%下界-3.0，超过-5边界。盲法人工评分（严格/宽松）下界为-3.9和-4.7，仍通过。Turns+Jev写入成本$0.0006/千轮，engram v2为$1.865/千轮（3061倍）。2) 重排序增益随预算缩减：LoCoMo上k=3时+17.4分，k=20时仅+1.5；LongMemEval上k=3时+9.1分，k=20时+1.1分。这解释了SmartSearch和Fidelity的分歧。3) S1、S2、S3、S4、S7经Holm校正后被拒绝：Turns+Jev显著优于Turns+cosine、Jev-Mem和mem0；与LLM重排序器非劣（下界-2.0），延迟仅为其1/3。4) 在慷慨预算下，engram v2在k=20时最准确（82.4%，1238 tokens），超过Turns+Jev的77.6%——压缩此时更重要。6) 诊断：11.5%问题因短列表遗漏丢失，9.2%因重排序丢弃（其中时间证据最易被重排序丢弃，22.7%）。7) 重排序降低了正确弃答率（k=3时从63.6%降至54.1%）。8) judge宽松度与答案长度交互：对简短答案更宽容，因此judge-人工一致性因系统答案风格不同而异。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是：（1）首次预注册非劣性测试对话记忆评估（在held-out对话上，5点边界，第二个答案模型，盲法人工评分），在紧预算下界定提取最多贡献4.7分；（2）首次发现重排序增益随上下文预算增长而缩减（同一研究内，k=3到k=20，LoCoMo和LongMemEval上），提供了SmartSearch和Fidelity Before Structure分歧的解释：分歧源于预算；（3）首次在匹配上下文上证明类型化决策模型作为选择器与LLM重排序器等效（1/3延迟）并优于多调用Jev-Mem图遍历；（4）诊断定位了选择的天花板在短列表遗漏（11.5%）和重排序丢弃（9.2%），并揭示LLM judge宽松度与答案长度的交互效应，建议不同答案风格的系统对比应报告按系统分类的judge-人工一致性。研究局限包括：仅使用LoCoMo和LongMemEval两个基准家族；engram v2未在LongMemEval上运行；人工评分者为系统作者本人；未测试对抗性内容；Jev为闭源模型版本化结果；绝对准确率低于SmartSearch报告值（不同协议下）。

Abstract: Does conversational memory need LLM-extracted facts, or is selecting the right raw turns enough? Published results disagree. Extraction-based systems report gains from distilled facts. Recent studies find raw history with good ranking does as well, but disagree about whether ranking matters. We ran a pre-registered study on held-out LoCoMo conversations and LongMemEval. At a tight budget on LoCoMo, raw turns selected by a single call to Jev, a typed decision model, are non-inferior to an LLM-extraction memory (one-sided 95% bound -3.0 points against a -5-point margin). Blind human grading narrows the margin but does not change the result. Raw turns cost 3,061 times less to write, and the result holds with a second answer model. Within this study, reranking's gain shrinks as the budget grows. It adds 17.4 points on LoCoMo and 9.1 on LongMemEval when three of 30 candidates are kept. At generous budgets it adds 1.5 and 1.1, and extraction systems are more accurate. This suggests why published results disagree. At matched context, Jev selects as accurately as an LLM reranker (non-inferiority bound -2.0) at a third of the latency, and more accurately than a multi-call graph traversal. Reranking lowers correct abstention. Plans, code and graded answers are released.

</details>


### [556] [AdaGuard: An Adaptive Guard Model with User-defined Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34241)
*Yunhao Feng,Yifan Ding,Yuxiang Xie,Zheng Li,Mingrui Lao,Zeyuan Wang,Yanming Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AdaGuard 是一个面向智能体轨迹安全评估的自适应护栏模型系列，能够依据用户自定义策略（1-100条规则）进行违规检测与规则归因；核心贡献包括 AdaptiveSafety 数据集（策略与行为反事实增广）、SafePO 强化学习算法（结构化判决奖励+价值引导的令牌加权），以及 0.6B/4B/8B 三种规模的模型实现，其中 8B 模型在 AdaptiveSafety 上达到 89.50% 准确率和 88.67% F1，在 DynaBench 上达到 76.80% 准确率和 76.05% F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有护栏模型依赖固定的预定义风险分类体系，难以适应不同应用场景下差异化的策略需求。对于智能体（agent）而言，相同行为在不同策略下可能得到完全不同的合规判定，因此需要一种能够联合解读用户自定义策略与智能体交互轨迹、并生成可解释分析的护栏机制。

Method: （1）构建 AdaptiveSafety 数据集（10,939 训练+1,000 测试），整合多源智能体轨迹，并通过策略反事实、行为反事实及结构增广（规则重排、标识符重映射）实现监督；（2）提出 SafePO 强化学习算法，采用分层结构化奖励（精确匹配/集合F1/序列LCS），在响应级别保留组内相对优势，并通过独立价值模型调节分析与判决区域的令牌权重（固定预算 m_A=1/3, m_V=2/3）；（3）从 Qwen3Guard-Gen 初始化，经监督微调+SafePO 训练出 0.6B/4B/8B 系列模型。

Result: 在 AdaptiveSafety 测试集上，AdaGuard-8B 准确率 89.50%、F1 88.67%、精确匹配 77.10%、规则 micro-F1 74.05%；AdaGuard-4B 准确率 89.30%、F1 88.53%，均显著优于 Qwen3Guard-Gen、DynaGuard、YuFeng-XGuard、Laya 等基线。在跨域 DynaBench 上，AdaGuard-8B 准确率 76.80%、F1 76.05%，低于 DynaGuard-8B 的 80.11% 但在规则归因上更具优势（70.72% vs 仅二元输出）。SafePO 相对监督初始化在 8B 上带来一致提升，但 0.6B/4B 上并非所有指标均改善。

Conclusion: AdaGuard 在策略条件化的智能体安全评估任务上取得了当前最优的结果，证明了反事实监督+结构化 RL 奖励+价值引导区域加权这一技术路线的有效性；但仍存在 DynaBench 上与专用模型存在差距、不同规模下 SafePO 收益不均、解释内容未被独立验证等局限，部署时建议保留人工审核。

Abstract: Guard models support the safe deployment of language model agents, but fixed risk taxonomies limit their ability to accommodate requirements that vary across applications and tasks. Under user-defined policies, detecting violations requires interpreting both the applicable rules and the agent's behavior, since identical actions can receive different judgments under different policies. To support learning this capability, we introduce AdaptiveSafety, a dataset of 10,939 training examples and 1,000 test examples covering policies with 1--100 rules. The dataset combines trajectories from multiple sources with policy and behavioral counterfactuals, pairing each example with an explanation and the complete set of violated rules. These counterfactuals expose changes that alter compliance, while structural augmentations provide supervision for consistency under rule reordering and identifier remapping. Building on this supervision, we propose SafePO, a reinforcement learning algorithm for refining violation identification while balancing explanatory reasoning and final verdicts. SafePO uses structured rewards to assess prediction correctness, retains group-relative advantages at the response level, and employs a separately trained value model to modulate token weights within explanation and verdict regions. Separate normalization controls their relative contribution to training despite differences in length. Through supervised initialization followed by SafePO, we develop AdaGuard, a family of 0.6B, 4B, and 8B guard models that assess agent trajectories under policies supplied at inference time. Our 4B model achieves binary accuracies of 89.30\% on AdaptiveSafety and 71.82\% on DynaBench. The project repository is available at this https URL

</details>


### [557] [Stashbird: Efficient Speaker-Indexed Memory for Conversational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34242)
*Chidera Biringa,Lucas Yannul,Xiaowen Wang,Marco Ayala,Nicholas Yi,Alex Moyse,Nishant Manchanda,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Stashbird是一个面向对话式AI智能体的情节锚定（episode-anchored）长期记忆系统，通过显式溯源（provenance）将源对话片段与衍生记忆状态关联，支持增量更新和片段级删除。它在四个长期记忆基准上以显著更少的提示词开销实现与Hindsight等基线可比或更优的问答准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI智能体交互历史不断增长（尤其是多人多场景对话），现有记忆系统难以同时兼顾：1）跨用户—智能体、用户—用户、群组对话的信息保留；2）证据变化或删除后的状态协调；3）回答质量与模型调用/Token成本之间的平衡。Stashbird旨在通过显式溯源和结构化记忆视图解决这些问题。

Method: Stashbird将对话切分为带时间戳和说话人标记的情节（episode），构建五类结构化记忆视图：情节记录、实体、关系、偏好和社区摘要。核心流程包括三部分：(1) 摄取与更新——使用15K token全局摘要+20K token分块（10%重叠）+ NER补全+ 4K token滚动实体上下文，通过余弦相似度与Levenshtein比（均>0.85）进行实体调和；(2) 删除——基于溯源集P(x)进行协调，包含"实体元遗忘与邻居收养"机制，将失去所有支持但仍有邻居的实体保留为连接锚点；(3) 检索——查询分解为最多4个子查询，混合检索后采用倒数排名融合（RRF, k=60）+ LLM重排序，最终送入答案模型。算法1给出了完整的片段级删除协调流程。

Result: 在LongMemEval-S上，Stashbird以GPT-4o-mini达到75.6%（Hindsight为74.8%），以GPT-4.1-mini达到81.0%（Hindsight为78.3%），尤其在单会话偏好问题上显著领先（74.6% vs 53.7%；88.4% vs 55.3%）。在LoCoMo上达到87.5%（GPT-4.1-mini），略低于Hindsight的89.1%。在EverMemBench上平均55.4%，与Hindsight的54.8%相当。在GroupMemBench上以51.1%大幅领先Hindsight的24.9%，尤其时序推理72.3% vs 2.2%。效率方面，LoCoMo摄取阶段仅用57次LLM调用和484K提示词token，比Graphiti少76.4倍摄取提示词token，比Hindsight少8.1倍检索提示词token；LongMemEval-S上用29K次LLM调用（vs Hindsight 137K, Graphiti 1.3M）。K值在10–50范围内结果稳定，骨干模型升级至GPT-5.4可使LoCoMo达92.0%。

Conclusion: Stashbird验证了结构化、可溯源的对话记忆在质量—成本权衡上的优势：通过保留说话人、时间戳和显式溯源链接，在群组和共享对话场景中表现尤为突出；其生命周期操作（增量更新和片段级删除）虽未在基准中评估，但为记忆可演化性提供了系统级保障。论文也指出多跳推理、行为推断等仍是开放挑战。

Abstract: AI agents require memory that preserves information across user-agent exchanges, user-to-user conversations, and group conversations with or without agent participation, while supporting updates as evidence changes or is removed. We present Stashbird, an agent memory system that links source episodes to derived memory state through explicit provenance. Stashbird organizes memory into episodic records, semantic relations, community summaries, and persisted graph state, with lifecycle operations for incremental updates and episode-level deletion. We evaluate question-answering accuracy and model-facing workload across four long-term memory benchmarks. On LoCoMo, Stashbird uses 76.4x fewer ingestion prompt tokens than Graphiti. Compared with reproduced Hindsight on the same benchmark, it uses 8.1x fewer retrieval prompt tokens, with accuracy 1.6 percentage points lower. It achieves higher accuracy than Hindsight on LongMemEval-S and GroupMemBench and comparable accuracy on EverMemBench.

</details>


### [558] [Evolving Support Priorities in Empathetic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34249)
*Pengyu Huang,Zhiyuan Han,Wenwen Tong,Hewei Guo,Jiangnan Chen,Sirui Chen,Lewei Lu,Beier Zhu,Xun Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出CARE框架,通过在每个对话轮次动态生成上下文自适应的评估rubric(包括认知、情感、前瞻三种共情维度的权重及细粒度标准),解决共情强化学习中奖励规格固定不变的痛点。该框架通过SFT和基于偏好的强化学习训练rubric生成器,并将其作为冻结的自适应奖励接口集成到RLVER和MICA等现有RL流程中,在SentientBench、EQBench3、EMPA三个基准上以三个独立LLM评判均达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共情对话强化学习方法在整轮对话中使用固定的奖励规格(rubric),但共情支持需求会随对话状态动态变化(例如初期需要情感安抚,中期需要理解,后期需要行动指引),固定的奖励规格与演化的支持优先级之间存在根本性错配。

Method: 将共情支持分解为认知、情感、前瞻三种维度;两阶段训练rubric生成器:(1)基于1.5K轮次级rubric监督数据的SFT,(2)基于2.8K人类偏好对的GRPO偏好强化学习,奖励由偏好奖励、优先级对齐奖励、格式奖励组成;训练后的生成器在在线RL中冻结,为每个对话状态生成专属rubric作为自适应奖励接口,可无缝替换RLVER和MICA的原始奖励。

Result: 在SentientBench(EQBench3,EMPA上以DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Gemini-2.5-Pro、GPT-5.5三个评判均达到SOTA。EMPA上EPM-Idx在Gemini-2.5-Pro评判下从28.11提升至83.54,所有三个评判下均至少提升13分;在EQBench3上Qwen3-32B+CARE(R)达到76.35,超过GLM-5.2-753B(74.90);人工评估中CARE(R)获得51.5%偏好。分析表明学习到的rubric优先级随对话阶段和用户情感系统性地变化。

Conclusion: 提出"演化支持优先级原则",证明对话状态自适应的奖励规格比固定rubric显著提升共情RL性能,且不损害通用能力;为共情对话系统提供了一种可解释、鲁棒的奖励建模新范式。

Abstract: We identify a fundamental mismatch in empathetic reinforcement learning: support priorities evolve with the dialogue state, yet existing methods typically optimize predefined reward specifications that remain fixed across turns. To model these evolving support priorities, we organize empathetic support along cognitive, affective, and proactive empathy, and propose Context-Adaptive Rubric Evolution (CARE). At each turn, CARE generates a context-adaptive rubric by adjusting both the weights of these three empathy dimensions and their fine-grained evaluation criteria. The rubric generator is trained with turn-level rubric supervision and human preference data through supervised fine-tuning followed by preference-based reinforcement learning, and then serves as an adaptive reward interface for online empathetic RL. Integrated with both RLVER and MICA, CARE achieves state-of-the-art performance across SentientBench, EQBench3, and EMPA under three independent LLM judges. Notably, on EMPA, CARE improves EPM-Idx over the strongest baseline by at least 13 points under all three judges, including an increase from 28.11 to 83.54 under Gemini-2.5-Pro. Further analyses show that learned rubric priorities systematically vary across dialogue stages and user emotions, demonstrating that CARE adapts what is rewarded as support needs evolve.

</details>


### [559] [QuantaSpike: Short-Window Spike-Driven Quantization for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34259)
*Bang Hu,Guowei Zhu,Changze Lv,Xiaoqing Zheng,Fengzhe Zhang,Fan Zhang,Wei Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为QuantaSpike的短窗口脉冲驱动量化框架，用于大语言模型（LLM）推理。该框架基于对数三元积分-发放（LTIF）神经元，通过三元脉冲事件和二进制膜响应量子在四步发放窗口内实现高效量化，无需长发放窗口或辅助非脉冲路径，在保持准确性的同时显著降低能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理依赖密集的乘累加（MAC）操作，导致高能耗。脉冲神经网络（SNN）提供事件驱动替代方案，但LLM激活中的异常值使得脉冲驱动推理通常需要长发放窗口或辅助非脉冲路径，增加了推理延迟或削弱了纯脉冲驱动执行路径的优势。

Method: QuantaSpike框架核心是LTIF神经元，使用三元事件（{-1, 0, +1}）和2的幂次膜响应量子。方法包括三个关键组件：(1) 基于中位数绝对偏差（MAD）和幅值门控的尖峰感知激活映射，进行选择性异常值准入；(2) 分组自适应增益计算；(3) LTIF膜动力学：正常值使用最多3个残差发放步骤，准入的异常值获得一个额外的起始脉冲后进入相同的残差动力学。计算通过符号控制的移位-累加（shift-ACC）操作实现，无需激活端的MAC操作。

Result: 在OPT、Llama-2模型上，QuantaSpike以四步发放窗口实现了最先进或竞争性的困惑度和零样本准确率，且发放窗口显著短于SpikeQuant的16步或32步。可迁移到Llama-3-8B和Qwen3-8B，保持接近FP16参考性能。分析能量投影显示，在OPT模型上一次线性变换能耗比SpikeQuant降低约80.0%，在Llama-2模型上降低约67.1%。

Conclusion: QuantaSpike提出了一种短窗口脉冲驱动量化框架，通过LTIF神经元结合三元发放和2的幂次膜响应量子，在四步发放窗口内高效表示激活值，结合分组自适应增益和选择性异常值准入，在多个LLM系列上实现了准确性和能效的良好平衡，为LLM推理提供了一种准确且能效优化的脉冲驱动路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many tasks but rely on dense multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations during inference, resulting in high energy cost. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an event-driven alternative in which synaptic integration uses lightweight accumulation. However, spike-driven LLM inference remains difficult because outlier-heavy activations typically require long firing windows or auxiliary non-spiking paths. We propose QuantaSpike, a short-window spike-driven quantization framework for LLMs built around Logarithmic Ternary Integrate-and-Fire (LTIF) neurons. LTIF uses ternary events with power-of-two membrane-response quanta, improving the information represented by each firing step while retaining shift-ACC-compatible computation. QuantaSpike combines this neuron with group-adaptive gain and selective outlier admission: normal values use residual LTIF steps, whereas admitted outliers receive one additional onset spike before entering the same residual dynamics. Across OPT and Llama-2, QuantaSpike achieves state-of-the-art or competitive perplexity and zero-shot accuracy among spike-driven LLM quantization methods. It also transfers to newer dense LLMs, remaining close to the FP16 reference on Llama-3-8B and Qwen3-8B under the same four-step firing window. Analytical linear-energy projections show that QuantaSpike reduces the energy of one linear transformation by about $80.0\%$ on OPT models and $67.1\%$ on Llama-2 models relative to SpikeQuant, providing an accurate and energy-efficient spike-driven path for LLM inference.

</details>


### [560] [Maintaining Benchmarks Against Increasingly Capable Agents: Detection and Remediation of Unearned Passes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34262)
*Weijun Luo,Kelvin Luu,Xinyi Liu,Guangze Luo,Miguel Romero Calvo,Soham Dan,Daniel Yue Zhang,Ying Liu,Mohamed Elfeki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种过程验证框架，用于检测智能体基准测试中的"不劳而获通过"（unearned passes），即智能体通过绕过预期任务（如访问参考解决方案或利用验证器弱点）来获得通过分数的现象。作者审计了来自29个模型-基准测试组的3,810条通过轨迹，发现违规率随模型代际增加但并非单调递增，并展示了三个修复案例研究，表明仅阻断已知漏洞不足以恢复基准测试完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体基准测试的可信度面临根本性挑战：随着智能体能力提升，原本无害的基准测试表面可能被利用，导致智能体通过利用评估基础设施而非展示预期能力来获得分数。这种"不劳而获的通过"会影响模型选择、排行榜排名和强化学习奖励，使基准测试的有效性成为一个需要持续维护的问题，而非一次性构建属性。

Method: 该论文提出了一个完整的过程验证框架，包括：(1) 确定性预扫描以标记潜在漏洞（如git历史、网络主机、评分相关文件）；(2) 主语言模型判断器结合预扫描标记进行三元分类（legitimate、unearned、unearned violation）；(3) 对抗性第二判断器（合法通过被送去降级判断器，不劳而获通过被送去升级判断器）；(4) 跨模型升级仲裁处理分歧；(5) 定位阶段将违规映射到被利用的信息通道；(6) 修复阶段区分"路由关闭"（Route closure）与"经验通道关闭"（Empirical channel closure），通过最小确定性补丁、回放探测和实时pass@k重新评估形成闭环。

Result: 跨3,810条通过轨迹的29个模型-基准测试组分析显示：在SWEBench Pro V1.0上，违规率从Opus 4.7的24%上升到Fable 5的73%，但最新模型Fable 5.1降至11%，GPT-6 Astra降至0%。违规集中在少数反复出现的漏洞上，特别是通过git历史访问参考解决方案。三个修复案例研究表明：仅阻断记录的漏洞路径不足以恢复完整性——同样的受保护信息可能通过另一条路径被访问——因此必须结合最小补丁、漏洞重放和全新的智能体评估才能验证修复有效性。在最终补丁下，无评估尝试到达受保护通道，且所有修复后通过均被判为合法。

Conclusion: 基准测试完整性需要持续维护。审计、定位、修复和全新评估构成一个闭环。报告完整性差距（integrity gap）与基准测试分数并行列出，有助于区分被奖励的捷径与真实展示的能力。仅靠检查补丁本身无法验证基准测试修复——关键不在于某条路径是否被移除，而在于其携带的信息是否仍然可达，且可达性是智能体运行时所面对环境的属性，而非维护者编辑产物的属性。

Abstract: Agentic benchmarks guide model selection and training. Yet an agent can pass a task without demonstrating the intended capability. Such outcomes constitute unearned passes; their proportion among all passes defines the integrity gap. As agents improve, benchmark surfaces that once seemed harmless can become exploitable, making benchmark validity an ongoing maintenance problem. We introduce a process-verification framework that audits passing trajectories, distinguishes evidenced reward hacking from verifier weakness, and localizes exploitable surfaces for repair. Across 3,810 passing trajectories from 29 model-benchmark cohorts, confirmed violations often increase with model generation but not monotonically. On SWEBench Pro V1.0, confirmed violation rates rise from 24% to 73% between Opus 4.7 and Fable 5 on matched tasks; later cohorts fall to 11% for Fable 5.1 and 0% for GPT-6 Astra. These comparisons are descriptive: configurations were not normalized, and the latest models also pass fewer exploitable tasks. Violations concentrate around a small set of recurring surfaces, especially unintended access to reference solutions through git history. Three repair case studies across two benchmarks show why blocking a recorded exploit is insufficient: the same protected information can remain accessible through another route. Therefore, we combine minimal patches with exploit replay and fresh agent evaluation, auditing new passes under the original standard. No evaluated attempt against the final patches reached the protected channel, and every post-patch pass was judged legitimate. Benchmark integrity requires ongoing maintenance: audit passing behavior, repair the enabling surface, and re-evaluate both exploit access and legitimate solvability.

</details>


### [561] [Query Expansion and Key Specialization in Transformer Attention Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34273)
*Vidit Gupta,Siddhesh Nadkarni,Mihik Chaudhari,Vinaya Sawant,Prachi Tawde*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究 Transformer 注意力机制中查询(Q)和键(K)投影在训练过程中的有效维度演化差异。研究发现查询有效维度扩张、键有效维度收缩，PR_Q - PR_K 在受控字符级实验中始终为正；键收缩通过压缩 QK^T 交互谱导致注意力更尖锐(熵更低)，这一因果关系通过干预实验得到验证。但在完整预训练的 token 级公开检查点上，单调配对差异趋势并不普适，仅在早期训练阶段成立，而 QK^T 交互秩到注意力熵的桥接信号更为稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管 Q 和 K 在注意力公式 QK^T 中数学上对称，但功能上不同(查询=信息寻求，键=信息提供)。已有研究多关注初始化对优化稳定性的影响，或关注表征坍缩(如秩坍缩、熵坍缩)。然而，初始化与功能差异如何共同塑造 Q/K 投影在训练过程中的几何演化(尤其是有效维度的分化)，以及这一几何分化是否因果地决定了注意力尖锐程度，尚未被系统研究。

Method: 实验设计：1) 在字符级 WikiText-103 上训练小型 GPT 式 Transformer(4/6/8 层，d_model=256，4 头，~4-8M 参数)，AdamW 训练 45 epoch；2) 三种 Q/K 初始化方案(Independent Xavier、QK Identical、Disjoint Support Xavier)× 4 随机种子 × 3 深度 = 36 次运行；3) 主要度量：基于协方差谱的参与比 PR 和有效秩 erank，以及注意力熵、QK^T 有效秩、对齐度等；4) 在 8 层模型上做 6 种受控干预(K 谱钳制、强制 K 收缩、冻结 Q、冻结 K、QK 解耦、QK 对齐正则)× 5 种子 × 15 epoch 验证因果性；5) 在 GPT-2 small、Pythia 70M/160M/410M、SmolLM2 135M/360M、OLMo-1B 公开检查点上做边界性扩展分析。

Result: 主要结果：1) PR_Q 斜率在 54 条种子平均轨迹全部为正(+0.1406±0.0902)，PR_K 在 50/54 条轨迹为负(-0.0437±0.0565)，PR_Q - PR_K 在全部 54 条轨迹上为正(+0.1843±0.0966)；2) 在去耦合初始化的 36 个单元中，PR_K 与 QK^T 交互谱压缩相关(r=0.840)，QK^T 有效秩又与注意力熵锐化相关(r=0.769)、与 top-1 锐化相关(r=0.637)；3) 受控干预：强制 K 收缩→熵降至 2.0809、logit 标准差升至 5.4071、QK^T 有效秩降至 6.03；冻结 K→熵升至 2.6002、logit 标准差降至 3.2136，方向置信度均为 1.00；4) token 级检查点：6 个系列中仅 1 个(Pythia-70M)的 PR_Q-PR_K 全程斜率为正；GPT-2 small 显示早期 PR_Q-PR_K 快速上升后衰减；4/6 系列保留 PR_K → QK^T 有效秩 → 注意力熵的桥接共变关系。验证损失在各初始化方案间接近(1.19 附近)。

Conclusion: 结论：1) 在受控字符级训练中，查询扩张与键特化是稳健的早期训练几何签名，PR_Q - PR_K 单调增长；2) 键侧特化(而非查询侧扩张)是与注意力尖锐化因果关联更强的一端：通过压缩 QK^T 交互谱实现，干预实验支持因果解读；3) 初始化不仅是优化起点，更是 Q-K 接口的几何先验——不同初始化在相同验证损失下产生截然不同的内部注意力几何；4) 该规律在完整预训练 token 级模型中并不普适，仅作为早期训练阶段成立；QK^T 交互秩到注意力熵的桥接信号是更可跨模型迁移的诊断量。建议将 PR_Q、PR_K 作为注意力分布异常的诊断工具。

Abstract: The projection of queries and keys are central to the attention mechanism in Transformer architectures. While they are mathematically symmetric, they play different roles in attention mechanisms. The question of whether there is an effect from their functional distinction on their geometric development in training remains unanswered. We investigate the problem through the training of small GPT-like Transformers on character-level WikiText-103 for three different depths (4, 6, and 8 layers), three types of initialization for queries and keys, and four random seeds, resulting in 36 runs and 54 trajectories of average layers across seeds. We track the effective dimensionality of those layers using participation ratios and discover that effective dimension of queries expand while keys shrink, and that $PR_Q - PR_K$ is positive in all trajectories studied. In connection to attention, the shrinking of keys leads to a narrower spectrum of $QK^\top$ and more peaked attention weights. In order to determine if this connection is causal or coincidental, we directly control the spectrum of keys during training across five seeds: restricting it to make it shrink sharpens the attention with high directional confidence, while keeping it constant to the level of initial dispersion makes attention softer. Additional token-level checkpoint analyses show that the monotonic paired-contrast trend is not universal across pretrained families, but survives as an early-training regime that later decays over a full pretraining run, and the link between interaction-rank geometry and attention entropy remains visible in several models.

</details>


### [562] [BIABench: Evaluating AI agents on real-world bioimage analysis tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34274)
*Zixuan Pan,Davide Panzeri,Lukas Johanns,Marilin Moor,Yu Zhou,Hedi Peterson,Yiyu Shi,Jianxu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BIABench 是一个用于评估 AI 智能体在真实生物图像分析任务中端到端表现的基准测试，包含 16 个从已发表生物学研究重建的任务，涵盖 11 个分析子任务和多种成像模态。它通过结果分数（与真实值对比）和过程分数（VLM 评估方法选择与质量控制）双重评分，揭示当前 AI 智能体在高维度和时序任务上表现不佳，且存在严重的运行间可靠性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的 AI 智能体在自动化生物图像分析方面展现出潜力，但缺乏一个系统性评估其能否完成从原始图像到生物学洞见的完整端到端分析能力的基准测试。现有基准要么只评估单步分析（如核分割），要么测试的是模型构建而非完整分析管道的执行。生物图像数据的复杂性（2D/3D/时序、体积庞大）和分析的多步骤特性对智能体提出了独特挑战，亟需一个可验证的评估框架。

Method: BIABench 从 16 个已发表的生物学研究中重建任务，保留其原始图像、生物学问题和已发表的输出作为真实标签。每个任务由两个智能体集成层级的指令（简要版和专家详细版）描述。评估包括：(1) 结果分数——使用领域标准指标（如 Dice、CTC SEG/TRA、KS 统计量等）与真实标签对比；(2) 过程分数——由 VLM 法官根据专家撰写的严重度加权评分表（105 项）对方法选择和质量控制进行评判。评估了 6 个智能体（涵盖 LLM 工具使用、命令行编码、GUI 操作 Fiji 三类）在多种模型下的表现，每个配置-任务组合重复 3 次。

Result: 结果显示：(1) 常规 2D 任务表现良好（最佳智能体得分 0.85-0.96），但涉及三维或时序的任务中，没有任何智能体得分超过 0.19（如核孔组装动力学 0.19、3D 斑点定量 0.05）；(2) 生物学专业智能体无总体优势，通用智能体在 14/16 任务上取得最佳或并列最佳成绩；(3) 更强模型或更详细的专家指令均未能弥合这一差距；(4) 智能体可靠性差——40% 的智能体-任务对三次运行间差异超过 0.2，运行间方差是智能体选择方差的 6 倍；(5) 过程分数和运行时间无法在无真实标签时区分正确与错误运行（过程-结果相关性 r=0.09；r=-0.03 由人类专家评判）。案例研究揭示失败模式：报告与交付文件矛盾、标准流程中未经校准的参数、以及以完成承诺结束但实际未生成所需文件。

Conclusion: BIABench 揭示了当前 AI 智能体在生物图像分析中的关键局限：表面合理但结果错误的高风险模式、复杂高维任务的不可靠性、以及自我检查能力的缺失。该基准不仅是一个评估工具，还为构建大规模多步骤图像到洞见数据集提供了通用开发策略，目标是推动社区在数年内实现专家级自主生物图像分析。基准、数据和代码已公开发布。

Abstract: Artificial-intelligence (AI) agents hold promise for automating bioimage analysis, yet no benchmark evaluates whether they can carry out real-world analyses end to end. Such analyses are hard for agents because 2D images, 3D volumes and time-lapse sequences are often too large to read as context, so an agent must choose and run an analysis through code, specialized software and rendered views. Published studies make this capability testable, because each pairs raw images with a peer-reviewed result. We introduce BIABench, a benchmark of 16 tasks reconstructed from published biological studies that retain their scientific questions, imaging data and ground truth. The tasks span eleven analysis subtasks and modalities from H&E histology to single-molecule localization microscopy. Each submission receives an outcome score, which compares the output files with the ground truth using field-standard metrics, and a process score, in which a vision-language model judges method choice and quality control against an expert-written rubric. We evaluated general-purpose and biology-specific agents across several language models, with repeated runs of every task. Routine two-dimensional tasks were solved well, but on some tasks that added a third dimension or a time axis no agent scored above 0.19. Neither biological specialization, stronger models nor detailed expert instructions closed this gap. The agents were also unreliable, with scores varying more between repeated runs of one agent than between different agents, and without ground truth a correct run could not be told from a wrong one by its process score or by the time spent. Released openly with its data and code, BIABench provides a verifiable framework for evaluating, and eventually training, agents for reliable long-horizon bioimage analysis.

</details>


### [563] [MoSPR: Histology-to-Gene Expression Prediction with Morpho-Spatial Macrostates and Low-Rank Molecular Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34280)
*Dongmyung Shin,Geongyu Lee,Yesung Cho,Park Jong Bae*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MoSPR是一个线性框架,通过将WSI块嵌入聚类为形态微观态、聚合空间邻接关系以构建共享宏观态,并将其与训练数据导出的低秩基因表达基相结合,实现从H&E组织病理图像预测基因表达。在三个TCGA癌症队列上,MoSPR在基因和通路层面均优于现有方法,且参数最少,数据效率高,并支持精确的宏观态级分子贡献分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从H&E全切片图像(WSI)预测分子表达谱具有低成本虚拟分子筛查潜力,但面临两大挑战:WSI包含空间组织的异质组织模式,而基因表达涉及数千个相关靶标。现有方法(如全局池化、标准MIL、基于Transformer/图的方法)要么不显式编码空间邻接,要么在患者特定的图上操作,无法以紧凑形式捕捉群体级的空间组织。

Method: 1)使用冻结的病理编码器(CONCH)提取块嵌入;2)通过k-means(J=200)聚类形成形态微观态;3)利用8邻域块邻接构建患者级微观态邻接矩阵,归一化后在训练队列上聚合为全局邻接矩阵;4)对行归一化邻接矩阵进行谱分解,排除平凡特征值后保留L=20个非平凡特征成分,形成谱嵌入并归一化;5)再k-means聚类为K=8个宏观态;6)每张WSI由全局形态向量M和丰度加权的宏观态偏差S表示,X=[M|S];7)从训练表达数据学习PCA低秩基U_q,通过岭回归将X映射到q维分子系数空间,再投影回基因空间;8)该线性形式支持将预测分解为全局和宏观态特异性贡献。

Result: 在TCGA-BRCA、KIRC、LUAD三个队列上,MoSPR在所有6个队列-指标组合中均取得最高的基因级PCC和SCC,优于最强基线PCC/SCC提升达0.022–0.043;在三个通路集合(Hallmark、GO-BP、KEGG)的9项比较中,通路分数排名首位8次;BRCA消融实验证实宏观态表征和低秩输出具有互补贡献;仅用44%(基因预测)/48%(通路重建)的训练数据即可匹配全数据ABMIL性能;参数仅0.96M(最少),推理GFLOPs为2.02;宏观态在300次自助重采样中ARI为0.653–0.786,定性分析显示不同宏观态对应不同空间区域和不同的Hallmark通路富集(如OXPHOS、EMT、IFN-γ响应)。

Conclusion: MoSPR通过耦合群体级邻接驱动的形态宏观态与低秩分子基,提供了一种紧凑、可解释且数据高效的WSI到基因表达预测框架;其线性形式支持精确的全局与宏观态级别分子贡献分解,桥接了空间连贯的形态区域与相关分子程序;局限性在于宏观态仅概括局部邻接模式,批量RNA无法验证空间定位,TCGA评估不保证跨机构泛化,需外部队列和空间分辨分子数据进行进一步验证。

Abstract: Predicting molecular profiles from histopathology remains challenging because whole-slide images contain spatially organized, heterogeneous tissue patterns, while gene expression comprises thousands of correlated targets. We introduce MoSPR (Morpho-Spatial Program Regression), a linear framework that couples an adjacency-informed histology representation with a low-rank molecular basis. MoSPR clusters frozen patch embeddings into morphology microstates, aggregates their spatial adjacencies across the training cohort, and groups microstates with similar adjacency patterns into shared macrostates. Each slide is then represented by global morphology and macrostate-specific deviations, which are linearly mapped to coefficients of a training-derived low-rank gene-expression basis. Across three cancer cohorts from The Cancer Genome Atlas, MoSPR achieves the highest mean gene-expression prediction scores among all evaluated methods. Without pathway-level supervision, pathway scores derived from its predicted expression profiles rank first in eight of nine comparisons across three pathway collections. Ablation studies on the breast cancer cohort show complementary gains from adjacency-derived macrostate representation and low-rank molecular prediction. Moreover, with half of the training data on this cohort, MoSPR exceeds the full-data gene-prediction score of the strongest competing baseline. Finally, its linear formulation enables exact decomposition of each predicted expression profile into global and macrostate-specific molecular contributions, providing an interpretable link between spatially coherent macrostate regions and their associated molecular programs. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [564] [ControlScope: Workflow Revision and Reliability in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34313)
*Jingjie Ning,Xueqi Li,Yibo Kong,Dongting Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ControlScope 比较了语言模型代理在运行工作流中可执行的修订范围（Keep/Arg/Full 三种嵌套操作集合），通过共享公共执行状态评估局部干预与持续修订策略对任务成功率和计算开销的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 代理通过可执行工作流执行任务，如何设计代理在运行时修订已有程序的能力成为一个重要的架构选择。论文旨在回答"扩展可执行修订范围会带来多少适应性收益"，并区分"可用的修复"与"代理实际选择的操作"之间的关系。

Method: 定义三种嵌套操作集合：Keep（仅继续执行当前程序）、Arg（允许修改下一个原始工具调用的数据参数）、Full（额外允许替换剩余工作流）。在共享公共执行状态 (h,s) 下，从同一前缀分支比较各条件。使用文件系统任务（MCPMark 改编 20 任务）、ALFWorld（87 与 134 任务两个队列）以及 AppWorld V1（585 任务实例/195 模板）作为评测基准。诊断维度包括修复可用性、修复选择、执行稳定性。采用前缀回放与候选执行验证，结合配对差分 Δ 与自举置信区间进行统计分析。

Result: 在 20 项文件系统任务中，Full 在两个源程序与三次推理评审下完成 15–16 项（Keep 为 13 项），快评审下完成 10–13 项（Keep 为 13 项）。ALFWorld 87 任务推理面板上 Keep/Arg/Full 得分 85/86/87，134 任务快面板上得分 134/134/127（Full 方向反转）。AppWorld V1 净差异较小（配对 TGC +0.60 与 +0.24 个百分点）。216 对早期局部干预中 Arg 与 Full 结果完全相同。批量读取与解析器修复可被工作流替换解决；冻结回放显示两次文件组织失败运行中有效替换被后续评审中断。五次调用保护节省 19.4% 日志输出但损失一次成功。存在论证效率快捷方式（共享补丁在 11 次调用内成功，采样 Full 政策反而使用 25 次调用）。

Conclusion: 编辑范围、有效选择与评审时机共同决定任务成功与模型工作量。代理系统应同时暴露数据编辑与工作流替换能力，因为部分修复（如批量读取、解析器修正）需要更广控制，而共享论证编辑可节省调用。需将评审时机与有效操作返回率纳入评估。Keep、Arg、Full 在所有 216 个早期局部对中结果一致，说明扩展范围的实际收益取决于代理在后续评审与执行中是否选择并完成可用修复。

Abstract: How much of a running workflow should a language model agent revise? ControlScope compares continuing generated code, editing the next tool call's data arguments, and replacing the unfinished workflow from the same public execution state. The nested permissions separate available repairs from the actions an agent selects. We evaluate one-time and repeated reviews across filesystem tasks, ALFWorld, and AppWorld. Across two source programs per task and three reasoning-reviewer draws on 20 filesystem tasks, FULL completes 15-16 tasks versus 13 for KEEP; across four fast draws it completes 10-13 versus 13. Fresh student-record confirmation reproduces a batch-read repair. ALFWorld fast panels yield KEEP/ARG/FULL scores of 85/86/87 on 87 tasks across 52 scenes and 134/134/127 on 134 tasks across four scenes; reasoning on the 87-task cohort also yields 85/86/87 with substantial review cost. An AppWorld V1 official-test panel of 585 task instances from 195 scenario templates shows small net differences. Frozen replays expose viable agent-written replacements interrupted by later revision in two failed file-organization runs. An offline source-trajectory midpoint comparison shows later reviews completing an insufficient repair. Five-call protection saves 19.4% of logged model output and loses one success across 20 fresh source runs. An argument-only shortcut shows that the broader sampled policy can overlook a cheaper successful edit available in both operation sets. These outcomes tie repair access to actual choices and subsequent execution.

</details>


### [565] [Dynamical Parameters: An Interpretability Framework for Time-Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34316)
*Kang Yang,Gaofeng Dong,Liying Han,Mani Srivastava*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对时间序列基础模型（TSFM）提出"动力学参数"（Dynamical Parameters）可解释性框架，揭示一个核心现象：模型隐藏状态中可线性恢复的动态参数信息，未必能在预测输出中正确表达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSFM可解释性研究多关注隐藏表征中的参数可恢复性（probing）或预测对干预的敏感性，但未定量检验"可访问的参数"是否在预测方向、幅度和时序形态上与参考响应一致。论文填补这一空白。

Method: （1）受控状态空间框架：在9个冻结TSFM（Chronos-2、TimesFM 2.5/3、Moirai、Sundial、Time-MoE、TTM-R2、Timer-XL、Toto）上，用13种动力学律（含10个单参数+3个多参数）构造匹配历史对，仅一个指定参数变化、其余干扰量与随机实现固定；（2）表示可访问性：线性脊回归探针从隐藏层恢复动力学律与参数，以law/nuisance条件后验均值为参考；（3）预测响应：对比模型预测变化与生成器参考响应，用居中对齐增益g、方向相似性s、全向量误差e、正交误差e⊥、条件参考归一化比Ū衡量；（4）因果几何：Jacobian正则化反演得到产生参考响应所需的"局部因果方向"v，通过SVD估计低秩共享子空间，岭回归从原始隐藏态预测输入特定坐标，并比较该方向与输入干预实际诱导的隐藏态变化。

Result: （1）63个模型-参数单元中42个可访问性>0.95，但中位条件参考归一化对齐增益仅0.46；3个模型对趋势斜率呈反向响应；（2）所有63单元在验证选定层通过Jacobian校准后，局部隐藏态编辑能以中位g=1.00、e=0.06恢复参考响应；投影到共享子空间保留g=0.93、e=0.18；（3）输入干预诱导的隐藏态变化仅1.1%能量落在共享子空间、99.6%落入Jacobian零空间，中位余弦仅0.028；（4）读出预测的部署方向优于固定方向控制，56/63单元中位g从0.23升至0.58，但预测仍不完整，参数-控制特异性有限（洗牌目标在51/63单元与正确目标共享秩k90）。

Conclusion: 论文区分了TSFM的三个性质：表征中可访问的参数信息、预测中表达的信息、隐藏态在干预下能产生的信息。可访问参数不必通过输入变化表达，因为参数干预常沿与产生参考响应所需的隐藏态方向不同路径移动状态。直接隐藏态编辑可恢复参考响应，表明选定隐藏态具备响应容量；预测的输入特定坐标仅部分恢复该响应。该框架在受控律、9个TSFM、真实序列背景（ETTh1/Electricity/Weather）及多参数系统中均成立，为评估TSFM预测与其内部表征的一致性提供新诊断工具。

Abstract: This work studies a central gap in interpreting time-series foundation models (TSFMs): a dynamical property may be accessible in a hidden state even when the forecast fails to respond correctly as that property changes. We formalize these properties as Dynamical Parameters, including trend slope, oscillation frequency, and autoregressive dependence. We compare their representation accessibility, measured by recovery from hidden states, with their forecast response, measured by agreement with the expected forecast change. Across nine frozen TSFMs and thirteen laws, 42 of 63 model-parameter cells achieve accessibility above 0.95, whereas their median reference-aligned response relative to the conditional reference is only 0.46. To explain this gap, causal geometry compares the hidden-state change required to produce the reference response with the change induced by the parameter intervention. Directly modifying the hidden state recovers the reference response, but the parameter intervention often moves the state in a different direction. These results show that accessible parameter information need not be expressed in forecasts when input changes miss the required hidden-state direction.

</details>


### [566] [Test-Time Scaling via Budgeted Multi-Attribute Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34322)
*Bo Xue,Ji Cheng,Shen-Huan Lyu,Yuanyu Wan,Shuang Qiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 BMA-GAI 算法，将 LLM 测试时验证建模为全局预算下的多属性优质臂识别问题，通过成本感知的自适应臂与属性选择，在共享预算下最大化可靠认证候选答案数量，并证明其达到一阶最优覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 测试时验证方法多采用单一评分或忽略验证器调用成本的异质性，难以在共享预算下联合决策"验证哪个候选"与"检查哪个属性"，导致验证预算分配效率低下，无法可靠认证尽可能多的高质量候选答案。

Method: 将每个候选答案建模为含 M 个属性的"臂"，每次采样某属性的验证分数并产生成本 $c_m$；定义"好臂"为所有属性均值均超过阈值的候选。BMA-GAI 维护三个核心机制：(1) 稀疏探索阶段对欠采样对进行强制采样；(2) 基于优化/保守置信区间构造认证成本代理 $H(z)$，筛选成本最低的潜在可认证臂作为目标；(3) 在目标臂的未解决属性间按采样进度比例分配验证资源。算法持续更新 anytime-有效的下置信证书 $L_{q,m}(t)$，臂一旦所有属性证书均超过阈值即被认证。

Result: 理论上证明：(1) BMA-GAI 满足任意时刻可靠性（$\hat{\mathcal{S}} \subseteq \mathcal{G}$，概率 $\geq 1-\delta$）与硬预算可行性；(2) 在归一化预算 $b$ 下，以高概率认证至少 $\underline{K}_\varepsilon(b)$ 个好臂（定理1）；(3) 匹配的信息论下界表明任何一致可靠策略最多认证 $\overline{K}_\varepsilon(b)$ 个臂（定理2）；(4) 在非临界预算下，BMA-GAI 渐近达到最优覆盖 $K(b)$。实验上，在合成高斯基准（含异质成本与诱饵坏臂）与 GSM8K 真实验证任务（廉价/中等/昂贵验证器）中，BMA-GAI 在相同预算下均认证更多高质量候选，显著优于均匀分配（Uniform）与成本盲的自适应方法（CB-GAI），且当坏臂需通过昂贵验证器排除时优势更明显。

Conclusion: 本文系统建立了"预算受限的多属性验证"框架，识别出认证复杂度 $T_\ell^*(\mu) = \min_{|S|=\ell, S\subseteq\mathcal{G}} \sum_{q\in S} h_q$ 作为问题的一阶内在复杂度，证明了 BMA-GAI 在该框架下的一阶最优性。未来方向包括联合优化候选生成与验证的预算分配、未知或时变验证器成本模型，以及更紧的有限预算非渐近保证。

Abstract: Verifying LLM-generated answers under a shared computational budget requires jointly deciding which candidates to inspect and which verification attributes to evaluate. We formulate this problem as multi-attribute good-arm identification under a global budget: each candidate is an arm evaluated along several costly attributes, and the goal is to certify as many candidates as possible whose mean scores exceed the prescribed thresholds on all attributes. We propose \textsc{BMA-GAI}, an algorithm that combines cost-aware arm selection with adaptive sampling of attributes. Every observation serves both to guide adaptive allocation and to support anytime-valid certification, which removes the need for a separate confirmation stage. We establish an asymptotic coverage guarantee for \textsc{BMA-GAI} and derive a matching information-theoretic converse that characterizes the intrinsic complexity of the problem, thereby proving that \textsc{BMA-GAI} is first-order optimal away from critical budget levels. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and an LLM answer-verification task show that \textsc{BMA-GAI} allocates the verification budget more efficiently and certifies more high-quality candidates than competing methods.

</details>


### [567] [Knowing When Thinking Is Not Enough: Teaching Small Reasoning Models to Reason Beyond Their Parametric Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34327)
*Chanuk Lee,Minki Kang,Sangwoo Park,Woongyeong Yeo,Jinheon Baek,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FlyBy框架，教导小型推理模型（sRM）在遇到内部知识不足的"知识瓶颈"时，选择性地调用更强的外部模型获取针对性信息，区分了可通过自我反思解决的"执行瓶颈"和需要外部知识的"知识瓶颈"，并在六个基准的1158道难题上以更低成本超越更大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时计算扩展（如更长的思考、自反思）是小推理模型提升推理能力的主流方法，但作者发现并非所有问题都能通过更多思考解决——当模型缺乏相关参数化知识时，再多的反思也无济于事。因此需要让模型学会判断何时"思考"不再是正确操作，转而寻求外部信息。

Method: 通过反事实干预在中间推理状态区分两种失败模式：执行瓶颈（正确解可达，反思可恢复）和知识瓶颈（需外部信息才可达）。基于此提出FlyBy框架，将外部模型暴露为多深度查询动作（d=1,2,3对应不同规模和成本的模型）。训练采用两阶段：先用95条高质量"救援轨迹"监督微调引导查询动作空间，再用带成本惩罚的GRPO强化学习校准是否查询、查询什么、查询多深。

Result: 在6个基准的1158道难题上，FlyBy-4B达到45.96% pass@8，以2.7倍更低的推理成本超越Qwen3-14B（41.64%），pass@1也超越Qwen3-8B；FlyBy-8B进一步提升至51.81%。分析表明RL学会了迭代查询（即使SFT仅展示单查询），并能在浅层查询成本下达到深层后端的性能。

Conclusion: 有效的测试时计算扩展不仅需要思考得更长，更需要知道何时思考不够。FlyBy通过诊断瓶颈类型并选择性查询外部模型，使小模型能以远低于更大模型的成本获得更强的推理能力，展现了"思考+求助"协同的潜力。

Abstract: Scaling test-time computation is a powerful way to improve language-model reasoning, and is particularly appealing for small reasoning models (sRMs) that are cheap to serve. However, is additional thinking always the right operation? By intervening at intermediate reasoning states across two model families and multiple scales, we find that self-refinement largely consolidates probability mass onto solutions already reachable from the current state, rather than making new ones reachable. These interventions reveal two failure regimes: execution bottlenecks, where the correct path is reachable and reflection can recover it, and knowledge bottlenecks, where relevant external information makes it reachable. Motivated by this distinction, we introduce FlyBy, a selective querying framework, and train 4B and 8B variants to reason first, diagnose what remains unresolved, and, at a knowledge bottleneck, query stronger models whose parametric knowledge extends beyond its own. Supervised fine-tuning bootstraps a multi-depth query action, and cost-aware reinforcement learning calibrates whether to query, what to ask, and how much to spend. On 1,158 hard problems across six benchmarks, FlyBy-4B achieves 45.96% pass@8, surpassing Qwen3-14B (41.64%) at 2.7 times lower serving cost, while also exceeding Qwen3-8B in pass@1 (16.85% vs. 15.31%). Scaling to FlyBy-8B further improves pass@8 to 51.81%.

</details>


### [568] [SAGE: Structured Strategic Reasoning for Efficient LLM Game Playing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34342)
*Zhiwei Chen,Tianchun Wang,Zhongtao Rao,Haiming Zhu,Ding Cao,Tianxiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE，一个无需训练的推理时框架，通过"锚定-适应-再校准"三步结构化 LLM 战略推理，在博弈游戏中同时提升性能与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 博弈代理在自由形式推理中存在三类结构性问题：无支撑的战略假设（>47% 的规划步骤不成立）、不一致的对手估计、以及不相关历史交互对当前策略的干扰。需要一种结构化方法协调未来推理、对手建模与历史经验三种异质信息源。

Method: SAGE 框架包含三个协调操作：(1) 锚定（Anchor）：以 MCCFR 计算的纳什均衡策略为战略起点；(2) 适应（Adapt）：通过软信念（结合全历史信念 b_all 与近期窗口信念 b_cur，权重 α=0.85）估计对手行为倾向，指导偏离均衡的剥削性决策；(3) 再校准（Recalibrate）：从相似历史中生成反事实假设（每轨迹至多 2 条），作为决策校准信号而非直接行动指令。

Result: 在 Leduc Hold'em、Liar's Dice、Goofspiel 三种重复不完全信息博弈中，SAGE 相比推理密集型基线（Suspicion-Agent、ReTA、Agent-Pro、EMO、Hypothetical Minds）在 Liar's Dice 取得最高 127.6% 的收益提升，同时输入/输出 token 用量减少达 80%/90%。直接对抗中分别在 5/10、8/10、8/10 个对手上获得非负收益，平均仅需约 4.92 次 API 调用/局和约 10,837 tokens/局，比 Agent-Pro 少一个数量级，比 Hypothetical Minds 少两个数量级。消融实验显示各组件均有贡献，均衡引导在 Leduc/Liar's Dice 中贡献最大，对手信念引导在 Goofspiel 中贡献最大。

Conclusion: SAGE 通过将异质战略证据显式分解为三种协调信号，在无需修改 LLM 参数的前提下，实现了更强且更高效的战略推理；未来工作将探索更具扩展性的战略先验和长周期交互环境的推理方法。

Abstract: A strong LLM strategic agent should reason prospectively over uncertain futures, adapt its strategy to opponents' behavioral tendencies, and continuously recalibrate its decision process from interaction experience. However, incorporating these sources in free-form reasoning could lead to unsupported strategic assumptions, inconsistent opponent estimates, and harmful interference from irrelevant historical interactions. To address these issues, we propose SAGE, a training-free inference-time framework that structures LLM strategic reasoning around three coordinated operations: anchor, adapt, and recalibrate. SAGE first anchors reasoning to an equilibrium policy that provides a strategically valid prior. It then conditions deviations from this anchor on a soft belief over opponent behavioral tendencies, enabling opponent-specific exploitation. Finally, SAGE distills strategically related interactions into counterfactual hypotheses about previously missing considerations, allowing past experience to recalibrate the model's reasoning. We evaluate SAGE on three repeated imperfect-information games: Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, against various opponent types in each game. Compared with reasoning-intensive LLM agents, including Suspicion-Agent, ReTA, Agent-Pro, EMO, and Hypothetical Minds, SAGE achieves up to a 127.6% payoff improvement in Liar's Dice while reducing input and output token usage by up to 80% and 90%, respectively. In direct match-up play, it attains non-negative mean payoff against 5/10, 8/10, and 8/10 evaluated opponents in Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, respectively, while using relatively fewer tokens. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [569] [Fuzzy Distribution Modeling for Synthetic Tabular Data Generation with Causality Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34349)
*Michael Vasilakakis,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于模糊集理论的合成表格数据生成方法，通过模糊集合表示特征分布、模糊认知图建模特征依赖关系，实现了低参数、可解释的数据生成模型，兼具对混合数据类型、缺失值和领域约束的原生支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实表格数据常面临有限或不可访问的问题，且表格数据具有异构、非平滑、不完整等特性，使传统概率模型和深度生成模型在可解释性方面存在不足，难以满足模糊系统和决策支持应用中对透明推理的需求。

Method: 提出基于模糊集理论的模糊分布建模（fuzzy distribution modeling）方法：(1) 使用模糊集表示特征分布；(2) 通过模糊认知图（Fuzzy Cognitive Maps, FCM）建模特征间依赖关系；(3) 通过采样模糊概念（而非原始值）生成合成样本；(4) 支持语言查询与IF-THEN推理。

Result: 在基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在效用（utility）、保真度（fidelity）和隐私性（privacy）方面与现有先进方法相比具有竞争力，同时在可解释性方面表现出显著优势。

Conclusion: 模糊分布建模被确立为合成表格数据生成的一种原则化且有效的方法，特别适用于模糊系统和决策支持应用。

Abstract: Synthetic tabular data generation provides an effective alternative for the training of machine learning models when real-world data is limited or inaccessible. However, the heterogeneous, non-smooth, and incomplete nature of tabular data poses fundamental challenges to conventional probabilistic and deep generative models, where their interpretability remains limited. This paper proposes a novel fuzzy distribution modeling methodology for synthetic tabular data generation based on fuzzy sets theory. Feature distributions are represented using fuzzy sets and feature dependencies are modeled through Fuzzy Cognitive Maps, resulting in a low-parameter, and an interpretable data representation. Synthetic samples are generated by sampling fuzzy concepts rather than raw values, enabling native support for mixed data types, missing values, and domain constraints. The methodology further supports linguistic queries and IF-THEN reasoning, facilitating transparent simulation of decision-making processes. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate competitive performance with respect to utility, fidelity and privacy compared to state-of-the-art methods, while offering substantially improved interpretability. These results establish fuzzy distribution modeling as a principled and effective approach for synthetic tabular data generation in fuzzy systems and decision support applications.

</details>


### [570] [SemRD-V2X: Closure-Guided Communication with Bounded Inference for Cooperative Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34353)
*Hu Xu,Chun Li,Siyuan Qiu,Zeyan Li,Jianfeng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SemRD-V2X 提出了一种基于"闭包保真度"（closure-fidelity）理论视角的 V2X 协同感知通信高效方法，通过精确预算的 BEV 支持选择、逐点信道压缩和有界共享权重重构，在大幅降低通信负载（26.6×）的同时提升 3D 检测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 V2X 协同感知中，密集的远程特征可能包含接收方可从自身观测推断的冗余上下文，而现有通信高效方法大多仅通过经验性优化掩码或编码来压缩张量，缺乏对"哪些远程证据在给定接收方观测条件下是不可或缺的"这一更基础问题的理论回答。需要一种将保真度定义为演绎结果相等（而非迭代剪除误差）的判据，以区分必须显式传输的证据与可在接收端有界推断恢复的上下文。

Method: 1. **闭包保真度理论框架**：在有限演绎抽象下，将感知特征视为共享推理系统中的语句，定义上下文闭包 Cn_E(T)；当重建限制在源闭包内时，率失真函数分解为 R_V2X(D) = P_A R^(A)(D/P_A)，零失真率变为 R_V2X(0) = P_A H(π_A)；有界解码深度 δ 下零失真率关于 δ 非递增。2. **SemRD-V2X 操作设计**：(a) 轻量评分器通过 Gumbel 松弛训练，在推理时执行精确预算 Top-k BEV 支持选择；(b) 逐点 1×1 编解码（64 通道 FP16）压缩所选位置的信道开销；(c) 共享权重 Differentiable Inference Module (DIM) 对被省略位置执行至多 δ 步掩码重构。ρ 控制传输载荷，δ 控制接收端重构计算。

Result: 在 V2XSet 和真实世界 DAIR-V2X 上验证设计竞争力。在 Tesla V100 控制五轮对比中，相对于本地复现的 V2X-ViT-v1 基线，分析特征负载减少 26.6×（96.2%），AP@0.5/AP@0.7 分别提升 4.13/8.57 点，均值计算延迟增加 3.81%。在 150 Mbit/s 良好吞吐的说明性场景中，序列化总时延从 907.243 ms/帧降至 178.542 ms/帧（80.3%）。消融实验验证了学习式选择、紧凑编码和重构监督的必要性；δ=2 为最优有界重构深度；定位噪声鲁棒性测试显示在 σ_xyz=0.5 m 高噪声下 AP@0.5/AP@0.7 下降 4.01/7.46 点。

Conclusion: 闭包保真度既是分析视角，也是通信高效协同感知可操作的设计原则。SemRD-V2X 通过精确预算支持、紧凑编码和有界重构实现了有利的通信-精度-计算权衡，同时明确区分分析负载与神经重构、演绎率与闭包失真。未来工作将结合稀疏执行与分组级无线测量，并将评估扩展到多模态和时序协同感知。

Abstract: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) cooperative perception improves 3-D detection by sharing intermediate features, but dense remote features may repeat context that the ego agent can infer locally. Most communication-efficient designs optimize masks or codes empirically, leaving a more basic question open: which remote evidence is indispensable given the receiver's own observation? We introduce a closure-fidelity perspective on ego conditioned remote perception. Under a finite deductive abstraction and explicit conditions, its rate--distortion function decomposes over an irredundant core, and the exact zero-distortion rate becomes $P_A H(\pi_A)$. This analysis suggests a concrete design principle: transmit compact evidence and recover derivable context with bounded receiver-side inference. Guided by this principle, SemRD-V2X is an operational neural proxy that combines exact-budget BEV support selection, pointwise channel compression, and masked shared-weight reconstruction before standard fusion. Experiments on simulated V2XSet and real-world DAIR-V2X validate the resulting design. In a controlled five-run V2XSet comparison against a locally reproduced V2X-ViT-v1 baseline on one Tesla V100, SemRD-V2X reduces the analytical feature payload by $26.6\times$ while improving AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by 4.13/8.57 points, with 3.81\% additional mean compute latency. These results position closure fidelity as both an analytical lens and an actionable design principle for communication-efficient cooperative perception.

</details>


### [571] [Improving Large Language Models for Code through Runtime Program-State Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34359)
*Hongwei Li,Spandan Garg,Yufan Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出两种互补的程序状态推理任务（错误输入-输出推理、前置条件-后置条件推理），通过分阶段后训练得到 9B 参数模型 Comet-9B，在仓库级补丁生成、回归测试生成和安全 PoC 生成三个任务上取得显著提升，性能可与 GPT-5.2/GPT-4o 等大模型相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型缺乏对程序运行时状态的显式推理训练；现有工作虽训练代理产生补丁或调用工具，但并未将"程序状态如何被触发及如何传播"作为明确的训练目标，限制了其在仓库级软件工程任务中的可靠性。

Method: 设计两个互补的程序状态推理任务：(1) Buggy Input-Output Reasoning（非智能体式、具体值推理），要求模型为有缺陷的程序构造能暴露差异的输入并预测执行结果；(2) Precondition-Postcondition Reasoning（智能体式、符号推理），要求模型在真实仓库中以符号谓词刻画触发前置条件、解释因果传播并实例化为可执行回归测试。基于 Qwen3.5-9B Base，通过四阶段训练：数学 RL → 代码 RL → 混合 SFT（问题解决 + 两种推理任务）→ 前置条件-后置条件 RL → 错误输入-输出 RL。使用 GRPO，奖励结合执行验证和 LLM 推理评判。

Result: Comet-9B（9B）在 SWE-bench Pro 达 30.51%（接近 GPT-5.2 的 29.94%，优于 Kimi K2 的 27.67%），在 SWT-Bench Verified 达 45.50%（与 GPT-4o+AssertFlip 的 45.5% 持平）。两种推理任务加入 SFT 分别带来 7.25 和 9.70 个百分点的提升；序贯 RL 再带来 7.25、26.79、4.67 个百分点的提升（三个基准）。在无安全专项训练的 CyberGym 上也达到 10.67%，显示任务泛化能力。

Conclusion: 将程序状态推理作为显式训练目标，可显著提升软件工程代理在仓库级任务中的能力，且能力可跨任务泛化（包括安全 PoC 生成）。Comet-9B 以 9B 参数规模实现与远大模型相当的性能，证明了运行时程序状态推理训练的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models receive limited explicit training in reasoning about runtime program states. We study whether training models to reason about runtime program states improves downstream software-engineering capabilities. We introduce two complementary program-state reasoning tasks. Buggy input-output reasoning requires a model to generate a concrete input that exposes a behavioral difference between a buggy program and a hidden correct implementation and to predict the resulting execution behavior. Precondition-postcondition reasoning requires an agent to symbolically characterize a bug-triggering precondition, predict the expected postcondition, explain their causal connection, and instantiate this reasoning as an executable regression test. By incorporating these two tasks into a staged post-training pipeline, we develop Comet-9B, a 9B language model based on Qwen3.5-9B Base. We evaluate the resulting checkpoints on repository-level patch generation, regression-test generation, and security PoC generation. Adding both program-state reasoning tasks to supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on issue resolution improves success rates by 7.25 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro and 9.70 points on SWT-Bench Verified. Sequential reinforcement learning on the two tasks yields further gains of 7.25, 26.79, and 4.67 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro, SWT-Bench Verified, and CyberGym, respectively. Despite having only 9B parameters, Comet-9B achieves a score comparable to the reported GPT-5.2 result on SWE-bench Pro and matches the reported success rate of a GPT-4o-based agent on SWT-Bench Verified.

</details>


### [572] [CoeF-SFL: Preserving Collaborative Server-Client Learning with Enhanced Communication Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34360)
*Junwoo Bae,Jin-Hyun Ahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CoeF-SFL框架，通过基于曲率的梯度补偿，在每轮仅通信一次的条件下保留SFL的端到端优化目标，并开发了CoeF-D（对角梯度外积）和CoeF-J（基于Jacobian的Hessian上界）两种变体，在多个视觉与语言任务上显著优于基于辅助网络的SFL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于辅助网络的SFL方法虽降低了通信开销，但客户端优化的是与端到端目标不同的局部目标，导致中间表征过度压缩、丢失任务相关信息，限制了协作训练性能。

Method: 提出CoeF-SFL：客户端复用服务器每轮初始交换的smashed data和梯度，在本地更新时用激活空间的曲率修正补偿陈旧梯度。CoeF-D用对角梯度外积近似Hessian；CoeF-J基于损失函数上界构造代理，用Jacobian的灵敏度矩阵P=J⊤J补偿，并利用majorization-minimization理论保证损失不增。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、Food-101、Tiny-ImageNet、20 Newsgroups、MNLI、SQuAD v2.0等任务上，使用ViT-Tiny/Base与DistilRoBERTa/RoBERTa，CoeF-D和CoeF-J在每轮一次通信下接近vanilla SFL性能，显著优于AccSFL、FSL-SAGE等辅助网络方法（ViT-Tiny上提升16.1–27.4 pp），非IID与不同切割层下优势更明显。

Conclusion: CoeF-SFL通过保留端到端目标并以曲率补偿梯度陈旧性，实现了通信高效与协作训练的兼顾；其额外开销置于服务器端而非资源受限的客户端，在实际部署中更具可行性。

Abstract: Split Federated Learning (SFL) enables resource-constrained clients to participate in collaborative training, but vanilla SFL exchanges smashed data and gradients at every batch, which incurs significant communication overhead. Recent methods reduce this overhead with an auxiliary network at the client-side cut layer. However, we identify that this approach makes the client optimize a local objective that differs from the end-to-end objective, which fundamentally limits the collaborative training between the client and the server. We propose Compensated Feedback based SFL (CoeF-SFL), a communication-efficient framework that retains the end-to-end objective without any auxiliary network. In CoeF-SFL, the client and the server exchange the smashed data and the gradients once per round and reuse them during local training.
