Since this reuse makes the gradients stale on the client side, we compensate them with a curvature-based correction in the activation space and develop two variants. CoeF-D approximates the Hessian with a diagonal gradient outer product, while CoeF-J exploits the tractable Jacobian-based Hessian of a surrogate loss that upper-bounds the true loss. We provide the theoretical background of each method, characterizing its compensation. Across vision and language tasks, model capacities, cut layers, and data distributions, CoeF-SFL significantly outperforms auxiliary-network-based methods under the same communication frequency, and the improvement is most substantial on vision tasks. Code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [573] [PersMem: Internalizing Personality into Dual-Pathway Memory for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34372)
*Hanzhong Zhang,Ziwei Xiang,Weicheng Xie,Shizhe Liu,Siyang Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PersMem（Personality-Integrated Memory）是一种将预定义人格向量统一整合到LLM智能体记忆处理流水线的新型自传体记忆架构，通过情感评估、记忆保留、被动情感驱动检索和主动目标驱动检索（含人格条件重定向门）四个与人格相关的步骤，使记忆处理在回复生成前即可被人格一致地控制且可被检查。该架构在依恋与Big Five人格设定下产生了可区分的人格相关记忆处理模式，并在CoSER角色扮演基准上取得了66.13的平均分（角色保真度69.33、情节质量84.33）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有角色扮演智能体在系统提示中定义人格，但其记忆处理流水线（存储优先级与检索）独立于该人格。这种分离常导致记忆处理与预定义人格不一致，并且难以验证智能体行为是否遵循该人格。当交互上下文变长或后续指令与系统提示冲突时，仅靠系统提示维持的人格一致性会减弱，甚至出现身份漂移。因此需要一种让预定义人格直接控制记忆处理并使其效应在回复生成前即可被检查的架构。

Method: 提出PersMem，将预定义人格表示为固定低维向量（依恋：π=(π_anx,π_avo)；Big Five：π_BF=(O,C,E,A,N)），并映射为操作特定参数控制四个与人格相关的步骤：(i) 情感评估——将用户输入通过LLM或词典转换为VAD（效价-唤醒度-支配度）原始向量，再按人格向量调整（如高依恋焦虑强化负效价、高神经质强化负效价等），并更新智能体当前情感状态；(ii) 记忆保留——按ret(m,t;π)=exp(-(t-t_m)r(m;π))计算保留值，衰减率r(m;π)由记忆唤醒度与负记忆的人格依赖项控制；(iii) 被动情感驱动检索——评分S_pas=α·sem+β_π·R+γ·ret，结合语义相似度、人格调制的关系分R（含功能性回避过度概括记忆项）和保留值，按温度τ采样top-K候选；(iv) 主动目标驱动检索——当有显式召回目标时，由人格条件重定向门I_t=σ(λ_I[S_pas-θ]+ν·a_t)决定是否用被动候选重定向下一步搜索，其中人格条件阈值θ_π=θ_0-η·π_anx（依恋）或θ_BF=θ_0-η·N（Big Five）。主动检索器与回复模型均不接收人格向量或显式人格指令。特性到增益的映射g_φ通过高斯进化策略拟合预设的PCB、OGM、SDR校准目标。

Result: 实验1（依恋）：在保留集测试中，完整PersMem对四类依恋人格分类准确率达48.1%，远超25%随机基线（p=0.0002）；中性门降至40%，关闭门降至25%，仅文本嵌入分类器为25%，线性人格感知重排器为30%；完整轨迹诊断（最近质心）达75.0%。被动检索贡献最大（+0.130），其次是重定向门（+0.085）。回避型和恐惧型在痛苦状态下检索更多过度概括记忆（OGM分别0.37和0.73，恐惧型中性条件下0.47）。焦虑型在主动检索中对负记忆的重定向比例最高（0.63 vs 安全型0.59、回避型0.51）。回复级分类达53.3%（随机33.3%）。实验2（Big Five，50个OpenPsychometrics画像）：神经质与检索效价负相关（r=-0.703），外向性（r=+0.776）与宜人性（r=+0.607）正相关，责任心与OGM负相关（r=-0.710）；无性状控制下这些相关消失或减弱。盲评对话对比中，完整系统准确率67.5%，随机记忆控制60.8%，无记忆控制53.3%，无性状控制54.2%。实验3（CoSER）：平均分66.13（情节一致性59.83、人性化51.00、角色保真度69.33、情节质量84.33）。附加实验：校准误差0.084（固定增益参考0.482）；对抗性正向框架下，PersMem保留89%神经质相关检索差异，提示人设基线仅58%；LoCoMo上PersMem相对生成式智能体式评分F1提升0.0169（95%CI [0.0027,0.0310]）。

Conclusion: PersMem提供了一种在回复生成前直接将预定义人格整合进记忆处理并使其效应可被检查的方法。依恋与Big Five实验表明其产生了可区分的人格依赖记忆处理模式，部分差异在生成对话中仍可见；CoSER评估表明其在角色保真与叙事质量上具有竞争力（平均66.13）。论文也明确指出，PersMem中实现的人格依赖映射为设计选择而非经过验证的人格计算模型；未来工作需通过人类判断验证记忆与对话行为、考察更长交互，并在更广泛的人格与记忆设定下评估。附录A进一步从哲学与文学批评视角（Stanislavski体系、Merleau-Ponty风格观）讨论了人格作为风格"稳定器"与"中介者"的双重功能，并提出"characteristic voice"作为设计概念。

Abstract: The profile of a role-playing agent usually depends on the pre-defined personality in a system prompt, whereas its memory processing pipeline, including prioritisation of stored memories and subsequent retrieval, remains independent of this personality. This separation causes the agent's memory processing to be inconsistent with the pre-defined personality, and makes it difficult to validate whether agent behaviours follow this personality. In this paper, we propose Personality-Integrated Memory (PersMem), which integrates personality into the agent's memory processing pipeline, making it consistently personality-dependent. PersMem processes memory using four steps, where the personality is mapped to operation-specific parameters controlling: (i) affective appraisal annotating emotion states of the user input; (ii) retention of previously stored memories along with the current input; (iii) passive affect-driven memory retrieval exploring memories similar to user input in semantics and personality-guided emotions; and (iv) active goal-driven memory retrieval that refines and selects passively retrieved memories for the reply. Consequently, consistency with the pre-defined personality can be examined by inspecting memory-processing traces during human-agent interactions. We evaluate these personality-dependent differences in attachment and Big Five settings. PersMem exceeds the chance baseline for four-way attachment classification by 23.1 percentage points. In Big Five dialogue comparisons, PersMem achieves 67.5% accuracy, 6.7 percentage points above a baseline using uniformly sampled memories. On CoSER, PersMem achieves an average score of 66.13, with scores of 69.33 for Character Fidelity and 84.33 for Storyline Quality. Together, these results show that PersMem produces distinguishable personality-related memory-processing patterns.

</details>


### [574] [Org-Agent: Beyond Personal Assistants Towards Organizational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34392)
*Luyao Zhuang,Yujing Zhang,Zijin Hong,Yilin Xiao,Xiao Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了 Org-Agent，一个面向组织场景（多用户协作）的统一约束驱动推理框架，通过任务依赖图（TDG）、依赖感知调度和约束感知执行，在 MUSES-Bench 和 GroupMemBench 上显著优于现有检索与记忆基线及原生智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体主要面向单用户设计，难以在组织环境中协调多用户请求并利用分散在多次交互中的知识。组织任务受到三类约束的制约（用户身份与权限、信息归属与时效、冲突解决与完成要求），简单拼接或独立处理各用户请求均无法显式建模和执行这些约束。

Method: Org-Agent 采用三阶段约束驱动框架：(1) 任务分解与图构建，将任务分解为原子子任务（询问/决策/响应节点），构建有向无环任务依赖图（TDG）并在新用户输入到达时动态更新；(2) 依赖感知调度，通过拓扑排序确定执行顺序，支持层级并行执行；(3) 约束感知节点执行，使用 LLM 依据节点目标和约束规则进行动作决策，并配备证据获取工具（相似度打分、条件下过滤、关系遍历）和记忆管理工具（Read/Write 操作维护执行记忆）。

Result: 在 GroupMemBench（745 题，6 类查询）上以 GPT-4o-mini 取得 44.03% 平均准确率，超过 BM25（37.72%）和最强记忆系统 Hindsight（38.79%），且 LLM token 消耗仅 5.5M（远低于 Hindsight 的 117.5M）；换用 Qwen3-8B 仍达 40.40%，保持优势。在 MUSES-Bench 上，使用 GPT-4o-mini、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash、Qwen3-32B 三种骨干平均提升 8.27/4.24/5.29 个百分点，Meeting 任务最大提升 23.15 个百分点（37.04%→60.19%）。消融实验证实去除依赖建模或工具均导致性能下降（GroupMemBench 降至 41.61%/40.40%，MUSES-Bench 降至 71.10%/67.10%）。用户规模扩展实验显示 Org-Agent 性能下降更慢（Queue 每增 1 用户仅降 0.35 分，对比原生 1.75 分）。超参数敏感性分析表明混合检索权重 α=0.5（兼顾 BM25 与密集语义）效果最优。案例分析展示 Org-Agent 通过作者过滤与依赖排序正确处理用户身份归因和先决确认问题。

Conclusion: Org-Agent 通过将组织约束显式编码进任务依赖图与节点级执行机制，将单用户智能体扩展为组织智能体，在跨用户交互决策与跨用户记忆知识利用两种互补能力上均取得显著提升，且框架模型无关、随用户规模扩大鲁棒性更强，为 LLM 智能体从个人助理迈向组织助理提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Language model agents serving organizations must coordinate requests from multiple users while using knowledge distributed across their interactions. We identify two complementary capabilities for this setting, namely cross-user interaction and decision-making, as well as cross-user memory and knowledge use. Both capabilities are governed by organizational constraints across three aspects: user identity, authority, and access permissions; the attribution and temporal validity of information; and rules for resolving conflicting requirements across users and completion requirements for joint decisions. These constraints shape what information or decisions must be obtained before an action can proceed and what conditions must be satisfied during its execution. Motivated by this, we introduce Org-Agent, a unified constraint-centric reasoning framework that organizes task execution in three stages. Specifically, Org-Agent decomposes a task into atomic subtasks and constructs a task dependency graph whose edges encode the dependencies among them. Building on this graph, it schedules the subtasks in dependency order through topological sorting. It then executes each subtask while accounting for the task's constraints, supported by evidence-acquisition and memory-management tools. Experiments on MUSES-Bench and GroupMemBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Org-Agent on both capabilities, and ablations further support the contributions of dependency modeling and tool use.

</details>


### [575] [SkillFocus: Evolving Agent Skills via Capability Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34397)
*Ning Wang,Zhiren Gong,Bingdong Li,Peng Yang,Aimin Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillFocus 提出了一种基于能力分解的智能体技能演化框架，通过在执行前从任务规范中提炼出固定的"能力空间"（capability space），将任务反复需要的程序性需求与当前技能的行为分离开来，从而在每一轮演化中指导"改什么"和"用哪部分证据改"。在四个异构基准上全面超越现有方法，平均提升5.7个百分点，且比最强迭代基线平均少用24%的演化token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能演化方法主要基于执行轨迹或反馈进行修订，导致两个问题：（1）跨任务反复出现的程序性需求（procedural requirements）被隐式处理，无法显式指导修订；（2）修订过程与当前技能的行为紧密耦合，技能变化后修订依据也随之变化。核心问题在于：能否在执行前从任务规范中提取反复出现的需求，形成一个固定的"能力空间"，使其在技能演化过程中保持稳定，从而同时指导修订目标和证据选择。

Method: SkillFocus 包含三个核心模块：（1）能力空间构建：在执行前从任务规范、输入结构和环境契约中提取反复出现的程序性需求，通过多视角提案（需求/干预/边界）形成共识能力集合 C 和任务-能力矩阵 Q，并在演化过程中冻结不变；（2）能力引导的修订：每轮计算每个能力的"未解决任务质量" m_d = π_d(1-q_d^t)，选择最高者作为当前轮修订目标，并仅使用该能力相关任务的执行证据进行诊断和编辑；（3）整体技能验证：候选技能必须在选择集和训练集上都呈现正配对变化才被接受，确保整体改进而非局部过拟合。能力选择使用"支持率 × (1-当前得分)"的乘积作为优先级度量，兼顾覆盖广度和当前不足程度。

Result: 在 SearchQA、SpreadsheetBench、LiveMath 和 IFBench 四个异构基准上，SkillFocus 的测试准确率分别达到 80.1%、77.1%、43.6% 和 82.0%，均超越所有基线（包括 Trace2Skill、GEPA、SkillOpt 等），平均比最强竞争对手高 5.7 个点，同时比最近的迭代基线 SkillOpt 平均少用 24% 的演化 token。控制实验表明：（1）基于需求的能力优于任务语义分组（低8.2-18.8点）和执行派生分组（低6.6-12.9点）；（2）随机化任务-能力分配会降低11.1-20.2点的最终准确率；（3）在固定修订状态下，证据与所选能力匹配可使候选增益提升4.4点；（4）独立提案间的任务-能力分配一致性高（ARI 0.883-0.973，NMI 0.953-0.989）。

Conclusion: SkillFocus 通过将技能演化建立在固定的能力空间之上，成功分离了"任务反复需要什么"与"当前技能如何行为"，使反复出现的需求在技能变化时保持稳定，而当前的执行证据仅用于决定改进哪个需求以及读取哪些证据。在异构任务上，SkillFocus 不仅产出了更强的最终技能，还降低了演化成本。控制研究证实了能力分解的来源和证据匹配都至关重要。核心启示是：技能演化可以将任务需求与技能行为解耦，保持前者固定、利用后者驱动改进决策和证据选择。

Abstract: Agent skill evolution seeks to improve reusable procedural guidance for large language model (LLM) agents through iterative revision. Existing methods base each revision mainly on execution trajectories or feedback, leaving recurring behavioral requirements across tasks implicit and tying revision to the behavior of the current skill. We introduce SkillFocus, which decomposes recurring task requirements into a capability space that remains fixed as the skill evolves, separating what tasks require from how the current skill behaves. SkillFocus maps current task outcomes to this space to identify the capability that leaves the most tasks unresolved, then uses that capability to determine what to revise and which evidence to use. Across four benchmarks spanning heterogeneous tasks, SkillFocus achieves the best held-out accuracy on all four, outperforming the strongest competing result by 5.7 points on average while using 24\% fewer evolution tokens on average than the closest iterative baseline. Controlled studies further show that capabilities derived from recurring task requirements outperform task-semantic and execution-derived alternatives, while randomizing task--capability assignments reduces final accuracy by up to 20.2 points. Matching evidence to the selected capability increases candidate gain by 4.4 points under prioritized revision.

</details>


### [576] [Mathematics for and by human cognition: A resource-rational search for bottlenecks in problem-solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34410)
*Sneha Aenugu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"资源理性瓶颈搜索"理论，将人类认知局限视为数学抽象化突破的驱动力而非障碍，主张工作记忆限制、厌倦和挫败感等认知瓶颈促使数学家重构知识表征，催生新形式化方法（如对数、群论、傅里叶级数、特征向量等），并建议将类似机制引入AI系统以促进能效驱动的数学发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点将人类认知限制（如有限工作记忆、易疲劳、挫败感）视为数学问题求解的障碍。本文挑战这一观点，认为AI在数学领域的崛起引发了对人类数学家角色的反思，需要重新审视认知约束在数学进步中的真正作用，探讨人类特有的认知瓶颈是否实际上推动了而非阻碍了数学抽象的发展。

Method: 基于"资源理性"（resource rationality）框架，本文提出数学抽象化的计算模型：(1) 将认知瓶颈形式化为三类——tedium（重复操作的疲劳）、frustration（持续失败的挫败）、planning failure（规划超限）；(2) 提出表征变化的不等式判据——当发现新抽象的期望成本加上新表征下的求解成本小于在当前表征下继续求解的期望成本时，资源理性驱动的表征变更发生；(3) 通过数学史案例（对数、群论、傅里叶级数、特征向量、笛卡尔几何等）进行历史叙事分析；(4) 讨论该理论对LLM数学发现的启示，建议引入类似人类认知瓶颈的信号机制。

Result: 本文从数学史中识别出反复出现的模式："代价高昂的搜索 → 瓶颈 → 表征搜索 → 低成本计算"。通过对数、群论、傅里叶级数、特征向量、解析几何、复数、非欧几何、零和位置计数法等案例，展示了认知约束如何驱动抽象创新：(1) 工作记忆限制促进层次化抽象，将搜索复杂度从O(N)降至O(C·log_C(N))；(2) 厌倦情绪（如Napier发展对数时的抱怨）推动了计算压缩；(3) 挫败感促使放弃徒劳搜索（如对五次方程根式解的放弃催生了群论）；(4) 记忆检索脆弱性促进了可重用、跨域可迁移的抽象发展。在AI层面，文章指出LLM虽然继承了人类数学的表征，但缺乏人类认知瓶颈可能导致计算资源低效分配（过度思考、代码冗余），建议引入类似厌倦/挫败的信号机制来引导AI进行表征级搜索。

Conclusion: 认知约束是人类数学进步的核心特征而非缺陷。瓶颈信号（厌倦、挫败、规划失败）在问题求解过程中积累，触发元决策——停止在现有概念组合中搜索，转而搜索知识空间的新重组方式。该理论对机器数学发现具有重要启示：能效驱动的计算需要类似人类瓶颈的信号来防止低效搜索，鼓励发现可压缩、可重用、可理解的抽象解。人类数学家的核心价值在于创造对人类友好的、高效且可重用的抽象化方法，这一目标无法仅靠算力扩展实现。文章承认对于新抽象的发现机制本身仍属未解问题，呼吁未来研究关注能感知瓶颈的机器问题求解系统。

Abstract: Human cognitive constraints are generally viewed as limiting factors in problem-solving. We argue that these constraints can instead play a critical role in driving advances in mathematics and beyond. We propose a theory of mathematical abstraction as a resource-rational search for bottlenecks in problem-solving. Bottlenecks arising from cognitive constraints create pressure to restructure existing knowledge, potentially giving rise to novel formalisms with applications beyond the problems that originally motivated them. Drawing on episodes from the history of mathematics, we illustrate how such bottlenecks can drive the development of novel abstractions and examine how cognitive constraints and affective responses shape this process. Finally, we discuss the implications of this account for machine mathematical discovery and argue that incorporating human-like constraints may facilitate the discovery of useful mathematical abstractions.

</details>


### [577] [OSPD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Persona-Consistent Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34418)
*Rui Xu,Yikai Zhang,Aili Chen,Zicheng Zhao,Xu Yinghui,Libo Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出OSPD（On-Policy Self-Distillation），一种用于角色扮演对话的在线自蒸馏框架。同一模型在信息不对称条件下同时充当教师和学生——教师接收完整角色档案，学生仅接收简短摘要。基于教师置信度的双峰结构设计角色感知散度切换机制，并通过渐进式特征掩码课程将角色知识内化到模型参数中，无需外部教师或奖励模型即可显著提升角色一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色扮演语言模型在多轮对话中存在"角色漂移"问题：随着对话进行，模型逐渐偏离预设人物转向通用行为。现有方法存在根本局限：离策略蒸馏因分布失配导致误差随对话轮次累积（二次增长），强化学习在主观的角色保真度上存在奖励模糊性，对比学习难以处理细粒度的角色特征差异。论文动机是利用角色扮演对话中"完整档案"与"简明摘要"之间的内在信息不对称，构建无需外部教师或奖励模型的在线自蒸馏信号。

Method: OSPD框架包含三个核心组件：(1) **特权信息在线自蒸馏**：学生从自身策略生成轨迹，教师（学生参数的EMA副本）基于完整档案$c_{\text{full}}$（~2000 token）提供逐token监督，学生仅看到简明摘要$c_{\text{brief}}$（~100 token）；(2) **角色感知散度切换**：发现教师置信度呈双峰分布——在角色关键token处峰值尖锐，在通用语句处弥散，据此设计门控机制，低熵位置使用反向KL（精确模仿），高熵位置使用前向KL（保持多样性）；(3) **渐进式特征掩码课程**：将角色档案分解为五个语义维度（身份、性格、知识、风格、历史），训练分两阶段——Stage 1接收压缩全维度，Stage 2仅保留身份和性格，掩码知识/风格/历史，迫使模型将深层角色知识内化到参数中。另加入SFT正则项防止模式坍缩，PCV过滤器筛选严重偏离角色的轨迹。总损失为$\mathcal{L} = \mathcal{L}_{\text{OSPD}} + \lambda \cdot \mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}}$。

Result: 在CharacterBench、CharacterEval和SocialBench三个基准上的实验表明，OSPD在角色一致性上显著优于SFT（CharacterBench +0.51）以及多轮RL基线，无需外部教师或奖励模型。多轮鲁棒性分析显示，OSPD在60轮对话中仅下降5.2点（SFT下降22.0点），漂移速率显著更慢。内部化比率（IR）达到0.86，显著缩小了$c_{\text{brief}}$与$c_{\text{full}}$条件之间的性能差距。消融实验验证了在线生成（最大贡献，-0.22）、散度切换、特征掩码课程和SFT正则项的必要性。表征探针分析显示OSPD在深层表征中编码了更丰富的角色知识（知识维度+20.1 vs SFT）。人类评估中OSPD以62.8%胜率优于SFT，以43.2% vs 28.4%优于多轮RL。跨模型验证（LLaMA-3-8B）和跨规模验证（Qwen2.5-14B）均验证了方法的可推广性。

Conclusion: OSPD通过利用同一模型在完整档案与简明摘要之间的信息不对称实现有效的在线自蒸馏，无需外部教师或奖励模型。角色感知散度切换匹配了角色扮演对话的内在双峰置信度结构，渐进式特征掩码课程成功将深层角色知识内化到模型参数中。实验证明该方法在角色一致性、多轮鲁棒性和内部化能力上均达到最优，跨模型和跨规模均可推广。该工作为解决角色扮演中的暴露偏差问题提供了新范式，并为理解角色扮演对话的内在结构提供了实证依据。

Abstract: Maintaining persona consistency across multi-turn dialogues remains a core challenge for role-playing language models. Off-policy distillation from external teachers incurs distribution mismatch that compounds across dialogue turns, while reinforcement learning struggles with reward ambiguity inherent in subjective persona fidelity. We propose OSPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework where the same model serves as both teacher and student under asymmetric information: the teacher receives a complete character profile while the student sees only a brief summary, and the student generates trajectories from its own policy. We find that teacher confidence in role-playing dialogue exhibits a bimodal structure---sharply peaked at character-critical tokens yet diffuse at generic utterances---and introduce role-aware divergence switching to match this structure. A progressive trait masking curriculum further forces staged internalization of character knowledge along semantic dimensions. Experiments on CharacterBench, CharacterEval, and SocialBench show that OSPD substantially improves persona consistency over supervised fine-tuning and multi-turn RL baselines, without requiring any external teacher or reward model.

</details>


### [578] [Beyond End-to-End Black Box Mapping: An Intentional Agent Framework for Cognitive-driven Facial Reaction Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34419)
*Hanzhong Zhang,Jindong Wang,Siyang Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"意向性智能体"(Intentional Agent)框架，将面部反应生成(FRG)从端到端的黑箱映射重构为由显式内部状态介导的生成过程。该框架通过内部动力学模型整合情感驱动与迭代式"内在思维流"(ITF)，在无外部输入时仍可自主更新状态，并通过基于VAD(效价-唤醒-优势度)的启发式映射与扩散Transformer(DiT)将抽象内部状态映射为面部表情。在REACT 2025数据集上取得最低的FRDist和最高的FRDiv/FRVar，盲评中Full模型与真实反应无显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FRG方法多为端到端的刺激-反应直接映射（类似行为主义），缺乏对听者内部认知状态的显式建模，未能捕捉真实交互中由内部评估、思维演化驱动的面部表达生成机制，尤其是在长时间社交静默期难以维持行为连贯性。

Method: 1) 内部动力学模型：候选状态更新公式 S̃_{t+1}=f_i(S_t)+f_e(S_t,N_{t+1})，其中 f_i 实现无外部输入时的内生演化，f_e 处理外部感知调制；2) 预测编码循环（预测-比较-纠错）；3) 基于预测误差的VAD情感动态更新；4) 意向性智能体：以Qwen3-8B为基座LLM，维护显式命名的内部状态组件（思维T、情感E、动作A、记忆M），通过ITF在静默期由心跳信号驱动状态更新；5) 面部生成：VAD→AU启发式映射提供低频先验 + DiT学习高频残差；6) 提出RQS（反应质量评分器）作为辅助自动指标并通过盲人评估验证。

Result: 在REACT 2025数据集上：FRDist=72.39（最低）、FRDiv=0.5057（最高）、FRVar=0.0883（最高）、FRSyn=47.59；96个反应的盲人评估（8位评分者，ICC>0.96）：Full平均分5.527 vs GT 5.195（p_Holm=0.076，无显著差异），显著优于Event-Triggered(3.059)和Heuristic-Only(1.445)（均p_Holm<0.001）；RQS与人类评分高度相关（Pearson r=0.855，Spearman ρ=0.821）；跨基准Seamless Interaction适应中AU-MAE从0.19081降至0.13973；30分钟静默测试中62.08%的事实锚点保留率（vs 仅思维4.17%）。

Conclusion: 将FRG重构为内部状态介导的生成过程是可行的且具有显著潜力，内生动力学（endogenous dynamics）在构建高度自主、类人智能体方面具有巨大潜力。显式命名的内部状态组件（而非单一不透明隐表示）能在长时间静默中维持语义连贯性。RQS可作为经人类判断验证的辅助自动指标。但仍存在实时性挑战（单次更新4.37秒），未来需探索轻量化算法。

Abstract: Automatic human-like facial reaction generation (FRG) is essential for building intelligent systems that can engage in human-computer interaction (HCI). While diverse and context-appropriate facial reactions can reflect latent appraisal and affective processes in human interaction, most existing FRG methods rely on end-to-end architectures that directly map speaker behaviours to listener expressions without an explicit intermediate internal state. We reformulate FRG as generation mediated by a structured internal-state process and propose the \textbf{Intentional Agent}, which shifts FRG from direct stimulus-response mapping to stimulus-grounded generation through explicit intermediate states. To represent temporal internal-state evolution, we propose an internal dynamics model that integrates emotional drives with an iterative Inner Thought Flow (ITF) within a structured intermediate state used for subsequent generation. This state can continue to update during conversational silences. Furthermore, to bridge abstract internal states with physiological actions, we formulate FRG as a downstream affective mapping from this latent thought flow to facial expressions. Experiments on the REACT 2025 dataset show an FRDist of 72.39 and an FRDiv of 0.5057; perceptual plausibility is evaluated separately through blinded human ratings. A blinded human evaluation of 96 reactions found no significant difference in mean score between Full and ground truth ($5.527$ vs.\ $5.195$, $p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=.076$), while Full significantly outperformed Event-Triggered and Heuristic-Only (both $p_{\mathrm{Holm}}<.001$). The Reaction Quality Scorer (RQS) correlated strongly with human judgements (Pearson $r=.855$; Spearman $\rho=.821$, both $p<.05$), supporting its use as an automatic metric. These results underscore the immense potential of endogenous dynamics in building highly autonomous, human-like agents.

</details>


### [579] [Social Circuits behind Multi-agent Echo Chambers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34444)
*Chuiyang Meng,Wenlu Yu,Ming Tang,Cheng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Social Circuits框架，通过追踪接收方内部激活变化来理解多智能体系统中的信息茧房效应，并基于此设计Circuit-Guided Deliberation (CGD)方法以选择有效消息提升任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多智能体大模型系统中，智能体之间的消息交换既能纠错也会形成"回音壁"（强化共享错误）。仅看整体任务性能无法揭示单条消息如何改变接收方的内部激活和决策，因此需要一种机制层面的分析框架来理解消息效应，并利用该理解来选择有用消息。

Method: 1) Social Circuits框架：通过"匹配重运行"（改变消息）和"激活重置"（在参考输入下用原始消息对应的激活替换选中层的激活向量）来量化消息对答案分数和任务性能的影响，并定义消息效应恢复率ρ。2) Circuit-Guided Deliberation (CGD)：利用发送方激活摘要和接收方激活变化（r_A - r_∅）的逐元素乘积构建评分函数，通过增益加权pairwise logistic loss训练以选择最优消息组合。3) 理论分析：证明激活重置在err<gap条件下保留接收方答案，并界定CGD与最优消息组合之间期望任务效用的差距上界。

Result: 在3个模型（Gemma-3-4B, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B）和4个数据集（2WikiMultiHopQA, GSM8K, MATH-500, TruthfulQA）上的实验表明：(1) 接收方激活变化能有效追踪消息效应，2Wiki上激活重置恢复了96.73%-97.81%的答案变化；(2) CGD在所有9个二选一设置中排名第一，GSM8K自由生成中排名第一或并列第一；(3) CGD生成的token数少于所有多智能体基线；(4) 在相同token预算下，2Wiki自由生成准确率超过最强基线11.25%-30.69%。

Conclusion: Social Circuits框架成功通过接收方内部激活变化追踪消息效应（包括纠错和强化共享错误），CGD利用这些激活变化学习选择有用消息，在准确性和生成成本两方面均优于现有基线。理论分析为激活重置保留决策提供了充分条件，并界定了CGD与最优选择之间的差距。

Abstract: Language-model agents exchange messages to combine evidence, but their communication can also create echo chambers that reinforce shared errors. However, overall task performance does not explain how a message changes the receiving agent's internal activations and affects its decision. In this work, we introduce Social Circuits, a framework for tracing message effects through receiver activations. We compare the receiver's answers before and after changing a message. Then, we restore selected activations recorded under the original message to determine how much of the message effect these activations reproduce. Based on Social Circuits, we propose Circuit-Guided Deliberation (CGD), which learns to select useful messages using receiver activation changes. We establish when activation replacement preserves receiver decisions and bound the gap between CGD's task performance and the best achievable through message selection. Experiments show that receiver activation changes explain the message effects and guide message selection that improves the task performance. Across three models and four datasets, CGD achieves the highest or joint-highest average accuracy in our main comparisons while generating fewer tokens than multi-agent baselines.

</details>


### [580] [CORTEX: Learning to Share and Specialize in Dense Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34449)
*Chuiyang Meng,Ming Tang,Vincent W.S. Wong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CORTEX提出了一种在稠密语言模型内部学习模块化（共享模块+多个专门化模块）的框架，通过域条件梯度将参数组分配到共享或专门模块，无需引入显式专家或路由机制，在合成与真实领域混合数据上取得了优于MoE、MoM等基线的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在异构数据混合上训练，不同知识领域既需要共享知识也需要专门化能力。现有模块化方法（如MoE）依赖显式专家和路由机制，或在训练后通过可解释性分析发现模块，缺乏在训练过程中在稠密参数空间内部形成模块化结构的方法。核心问题是：能否通过塑造学习动力学在稠密LLM内部形成模块化？

Method: 1. 将每个可训练权重矩阵划分为参数组（FFN按中间通道分块，注意力按头分块）；2. 使用softmax重参数化学习每个参数组在共享模块和各专门模块上的软分配权重；3. 定义域条件组梯度，计算效用分数——跨域梯度余弦相似度高者分配至共享模块，梯度幅值集中且与其他域对齐低者分配至专门模块；4. 同时更新模块分配参数和骨干参数；5. 提出选择性损伤分数（SLS）和模块-域互信息（I^mod）两个可解释性指标度量模块功能特化程度。

Result: 在160M合成基准上，CORTEX在六个域的精确匹配率均最优；在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-32B真实域混合上，CORTEX在大多数域取得最佳或具有竞争力的NLL，并实现最大的平均困惑度降低。下游评估中12个骨干-域组合中有9个优于最佳基线。模块化分析显示对角SLS为正，分配权重集中度高，模块与域对齐良好。训练步时间比MoE和MoM更低。

Conclusion: CORTEX在保持稠密架构的前提下，通过域条件梯度和效用分数学习参数组的共享/专门模块分配，形成可识别的功能模块。理论分析表明模块分配权重控制分配偏差与更新幅值之间的收敛权衡。该框架为稠密LLM提供了一种训练时可解释的模块化方法，兼顾共享知识与域特化能力。

Abstract: Large language models are trained on heterogeneous data mixtures, where different knowledge domains require both shared knowledge and specialization. Existing modular approaches typically impose explicit components or discover modules through interpretability analysis after training. In this work, we propose CORTEX, a learning dynamics-inspired framework that learns internal modularization within dense language models. CORTEX partitions trainable matrices into parameter groups and learns module assignments from domain-conditioned gradient and cross-domain gradient similarity. We introduce the selective lesion score and module-domain mutual information to characterize the target-domain lesion effects and alignment, and analyze how module assignment affects the trade-off between assignment bias and update magnitude. Experiments with 160M, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-32B backbone models show that CORTEX achieves the highest synthetic-domain exact match and largest average perplexity reduction, while remaining competitive on real-domain evaluations and forming identifiable modules.

</details>


### [581] [Escaping Local Views: Discovering Latent Concepts for Interpretable Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34459)
*Yijie Sun,Sanquan Sun,Yanda Zhu,Yuanyang Zhu,Yaohua Hu,Chunlin Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为ELV（Escaping Local Views）的可解释多智能体强化学习框架，通过引入语义结构化的潜在概念来解决部分可观测性下的合作决策透明度问题。该框架利用概念瓶颈、变分自编码器构建的全局语义桥、双路径注意力机制以及概念预测驱动的内在奖励，在多个基准测试中实现了具有竞争力的性能并提供了清晰的决策解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在合作型多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，深度神经网络策略的不透明性阻碍了其在高风险应用中的部署。同时，由于部分可观测性，每个智能体仅能获取局部观察，导致CTDE范式下局部表征与全局协调之间存在矛盾。现有可解释性方法主要分为事后解释和内在可解释策略两类，但前者存在近似性和可靠性问题，后者通常仅基于观察级别的激活提供解释，缺乏直观的语义层次。因此，需要一种能够在部分可观测条件下发现并共享概念级抽象，同时支持CTDE训练范式的可解释框架。

Method: ELV框架包含三大核心组件：(1) **概念瓶颈网络**：每个智能体从局部动作-观察历史中提取K个低维语义概念，通过软门控机制（存在概率p_i）在活跃与非活跃嵌入之间插值；(2) **变分语义桥（VAE）**：将所有智能体的概念聚合并编码为全局上下文潜在变量z，通过重建全局状态实现跨智能体的语义对齐；(3) **双路径注意力机制**：一阶注意力计算单个概念相对于全局上下文的显著性，二阶注意力通过概念对的拼接建模高阶合作模式，两者相加作为最终概念重要性权重。此外，引入观察重建损失以防止表征坍缩，以及基于下一个概念预测误差的内在奖励以促进语义层面的探索。整体目标联合优化TD损失和表示学习损失。

Result: 在LBF、SMAC和SMACv2三个基准上的实验表明，ELV达到了与强基线（VDN、QMIX、QPLEX、QTRAN、CDS、NA²Q、ReBorn、MA²E、SHAQ）相当或更优的竞争性能。消融实验验证了内在奖励、概念交互模块和重建正则化各自的关键作用。ELV学习到的概念具有清晰的语义结构：t-SNE可视化显示概念形成紧凑分离的聚类且智能体不变；基于梯度的归因分析将概念分配给具体的语义角色（如特定敌人追踪、自身状态等）；测试时的概念干预显著影响策略性能。案例研究还展示了ELV能够通过依赖强度矩阵揭示合作动态（如根据队友血量动态调整依赖关系）。在受限观察半径的LBF实验中，ELV在最小观察半径下仍保持稳定性能。

Conclusion: ELV通过将局部观察和历史分解为语义结构化的潜在概念，并通过变分语义桥进行对齐，有效缓解了部分可观测性问题并改善了全局协调。双路径注意力捕获了上下文相关的显著性和高阶概念交互，重建基础的正则化和概念动态驱动的内在奖励进一步规范了表征并促进了探索。该框架通过将价值估计与显式语义结构相结合，推进了复杂领域中透明、数据高效的多智能体系统的发展。附录中还提供了理论分析支撑：双路径注意力对应于函数ANOVA分解的二阶截断，重建损失等价于最大化观察-概念互信息的变分下界，VAE重建则通过数据处理不等式保证全局状态的充分性。

Abstract: Efficient cooperation is challenging due to the usual partial observability of each agent in multi-agent reinforcement learning. Recurrent networks encode local interaction histories, but their hidden representations provide limited insight into the information underlying individual decisions. To address these challenges, we propose a novel interpretable framework, called escaping local views (ELV), which introduces semantically structured latent concepts to render policy decisions transparent. Specifically, each agent extracts low-dimensional semantic concepts from its local observation and action-observation trajectory. These concepts are jointly encoded into a contextual latent variable via a variational autoencoder (VAE), which builds a bridge between local views and global semantics. To explicitly model the decision of each agent, we employ a dual-path attention mechanism in which one module estimates the salience of individual concepts relative to the global context, while the other captures higher-order cooperative patterns with pairwise concept interactions. Furthermore, we incorporate a concept prediction module that derives an intrinsic reward from next-concept prediction errors, which incentivizes agents to explore regions of semantic novelty. Experiments in multiple environments verify that ELV not only achieves competitive performance but also explicitly provides how agents reason about their decisions.

</details>


### [582] [When Does Structured Knowledge Help Neural Theorem Proving?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34460)
*Sareh Nabi,Roland Vogl,Marzieh Nabi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍MathAgent, 它构建了数学知识图谱MathKG, 通过9,434条语义边连接364个Mathlib定理, 并将其作为上下文增强LLM定理证明器。在五个模型和四个增强模式上的消融实验表明, 专业化训练比上下文增强更重要, 且增强效果因模型能力和问题而异, 自适应选择增强模式可显著提升证明成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Lean形式化数学库（如Mathlib）虽有28.5万+已验证定理及其句法依赖关系, 但数学家赖以发现新定理的语义层（类比、推广、跨领域桥梁）仍是隐式的。本文旨在构建这层语义知识, 探究结构化数学知识是否能帮助LLM证明Lean 4定理, 以及该效果如何随模型能力和问题难度变化。

Method: 方法核心是MathAgent构建的MathKG知识图谱:
1. 知识图谱构建：以Mathlib中已验证的声明为锚点, 通过基于LLM的关系抽取推断9,434条类型化语义边, 覆盖369个Mathlib定理和定义。
2. 控制消融实验设计：设置四种增强模式（无上下文、知识图谱上下文、Mathlib检索、两者结合）, 在五个模型上测试, 分别为Qwen3-8B/32B及其Lean专用变体Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B, 以及Claude Sonnet 4.6。
3. 评测基准：miniF2F, 以及仅Sonnet评测的PutnamBench和MathOlympiadBench。
4. 分析维度：模型专业化vs通用化的对比, 知识图谱对不同规模模型的效果差异, 以及不同增强模式解决问题的互补性（含oracle选择分析）。

Result: 实验得出三项主要发现:
(i) 专业化主导于增强效果：Lean微调在所有模式下均带来33-38个百分点的求解率提升；专用8B模型比其4倍大的通用基模型高出29-35个百分点, 而任何增强模式带来的提升均不超过3个百分点。
(ii) 增强效果取决于模型能力：知识图谱上下文对小型模型有帮助, 但对大型模型有害；专用模型相比其通用基础模型在所有规模下都获得了更大增益。
(iii) 互补性效应显著：oracle按问题选择最佳增强模式时, 比未增强证明器多解决6%至58%的问题, 在PutnamBench（更难问题）上增幅达32%。这表明不同增强模式擅长解决不同问题, 自适应策略具有显著潜力。

Conclusion: 结论指出, 结构化数学知识对LLM证明器的帮助并非普适, 而是高度依赖于模型能力和问题特性：模型专业化（Lean微调）的收益远超任何静态上下文增强, 知识图谱增强对弱模型有益但对强模型有害, 不同增强模式之间存在显著的互补性。这些结果直接推动了"按模型能力和问题自适应选择增强策略"的研究方向, 为未来构建更智能的神经-符号混合定理证明系统提供了实证依据。

Abstract: Does structured mathematical knowledge help LLMs prove theorems in Lean 4? If so, for which models, and does the answer vary by problem? Formal libraries such as Mathlib encode 285,000+ verified theorems with syntactic dependencies, but the semantic layer mathematicians rely on for discovery (analogies, generalizations, cross-domain bridges) remains implicit. We introduce MathAgent, which builds this layer as a knowledge graph, MathKG, and uses it to augment LLM theorem provers. MathKG connects 364 Mathlib theorems and definitions by 9,434 typed semantic edges inferred via LLM-based relation extraction anchored to verified Mathlib declarations. We run a controlled ablation across four augmentation modes (no context, knowledge-graph context, Mathlib retrieval, both) and five models: Qwen3-8B/32B, their Lean-specialized derivatives Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, on miniF2F, plus PutnamBench and MathOlympiadBench for Sonnet. Three findings emerge. (i) Specialization dominates augmentation: Lean fine-tuning adds 33-38 percentage points of solve rate in every mode, and a specialized 8B model beats a $4\times$ larger general one by 29-35 points, while no augmentation mode improves solve rate by more than 3 points. (ii) Augmentation is capability-conditioned: knowledge-graph context helps small models but hurts large ones, with the specialized model gaining more relative to its general base at every scale. (iii) Yet the augmentation modes solve different problems: an oracle selecting the best mode per problem solves 6% to 58% more than the unaugmented prover, a complementarity effect that strengthens on harder problems (32% more on PutnamBench). These results motivate adaptive strategies that select augmentation by model capability and problem. Code, data, and artifacts are available at this https URL

</details>


### [583] [PowerBench: A Benchmark for Agentic Retrieval and Reasoning in Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34492)
*Xijing Wang,Yinsheng Yao,Jinru Ding,Yidong Jiang,Ziwen Xu,Yiwen Jiang,Jie Xu,Dawei Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PowerBench是一个针对电力系统场景的大语言模型智能体评估基准，包含生成框架、合成的异构互联数据集（761台设备、100种设备类型、1335万条遥测记录、24939份运行文档）以及300个跨越三类任务族的智能体问题，用于评估LLM智能体在受限工具调用和时间预算下的自主证据检索与推理能力。实验表明，即使最佳模型GPT-5.6-Sol也仅达到74.2%的Macro联合准确率，多设备比较任务（CoRR）尤其困难（最佳JA仅48.7%），且失败模式在证据发现、内容检索、工具使用和推理阶段各异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实工业场景（以电力系统为例）的运营数据受保密性限制难以获取，且现有公开基准无法充分捕捉跨异构数据源的链式依赖关系，导致难以严格评估LLM智能体在工业分析中的检索与推理能力。电力系统由于天然具有多变量时间序列与非结构化文本记录（运行日志、维护文档）的高度异构性，且需要沿隐式依赖链进行多源证据检索与多步逻辑推理，成为评估智能体能力的有前景的测试平台。

Method: PowerBench采用LLM辅助的生成框架，围绕设备实例构建四类异构数据（设备元数据Md、可执行规则集Rd、小时级遥测Td、运行文档Dd），通过显式依赖链Md→Rd→(Md,Rd)→Td→(Md,Rd,Td)→Dd实现跨模态互联。设备类型通过四层分类法和原型-维度-实例三阶段流程扩展；规则采用布尔DSL绑定到设备配置；遥测通过AR(1)均值回归路径生成"干净"背景并注入真实事件与近失误（near-miss）；文档以程序化方式从事实表中渲染。基准包含300道问题，分属三类任务族：(1) 时序检索与推理（TRR，60题）——将巡检文本观察转化为遥测分析；(2) 上下文检索与推理（CRR，90题）——基于故障叙事重新评估规则；(3) 比较检索与推理（CoRR，150题）——跨多设备独立分析并比较。评估在统一工具栈（list_corpus、search_corpus、read_file、read_timeseries、python）和50次工具调用/300秒预算下进行，测量Macro-JA、FA、RER、AER、TR、TE等指标并保留完整执行轨迹用于失败归因。

Result: 九个前沿LLM（GPT-5.6-Sol、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Qwen3.8-Max、Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3、MiniMax-M3、Llama-4-Maverick、Doubao-Seed-Evolving、Gemini-3.6-Flash）评估显示：最佳模型GPT-5.6-Sol的Macro-JA仅74.2%，DeepSeek-V4-Pro与Gemini-3.6-Flash置信区间重叠（约46%）。TRR与CRR单设备任务表现较好（如Doubao-Seed-Evolving TRR达86.7% JA、GLM-5.3 CRR达96.7% JA），但CoRR多设备任务极度困难——GPT-5.6-Sol仅48.7% JA，多数模型接近0%；FA与JA差距巨大（如Kimi-K3：30.4% FA vs 2.7% JA）。轨迹分析揭示不同失败模式：Llama-4-Maverick几乎不调用工具；Qwen3.8-Max与MiniMax-M3工具错误率高（TER>50%）；Kimi-K3与DeepSeek-V4-Pro工具可靠但跨设备推理失败；CoRR中RER普遍降至50–70%。随CoRR目标设备数从3增至5，GPT-5.6-Sol的JA从60%降至40%，TBR从4%升至48%。

Conclusion: PowerBench揭示了当前LLM智能体在电力系统异构数据上执行多设备分析的能力瓶颈：单设备任务相对可解，但跨设备证据聚合与比较仍不可靠。完整执行轨迹使基准能够将失败定位于证据发现、检索、工具调用、推理和答案提交各阶段，为智能体规划、检索和推理改进提供可重现的诊断平台。研究团队将公开生成框架、数据集与基准任务，并计划扩展数据生成、研究多实例推理的智能体设计，并覆盖更多工业分析场景。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents offer new opportunities for automated analysis in industry. However, rigorous evaluation of such agents-for example, within power system scenarios-remains hindered: real operational data are confidential, and existing public resources fail to fully capture the chained dependencies and heterogeneous evidence. To address this gap, we propose PowerBench, comprising (1) a generation framework that derives interconnected heterogeneous operational data through a common dependency chain, and (2) a synthetic dataset generated by this framework. The dataset covers 761 devices across 100 device types, with 13.35 million hourly telemetry records spanning two years and 24,939 operational documents. Building on this dataset, we construct 300 questions across three task families that evaluate frontier LLMs' ability to complete analysis tasks that require autonomous evidence retrieval and reasoning across interconnected and heterogeneous data under restricted tool calls and time budgets. Results demonstrate that the evaluated frontier LLMs remain challenged on these tasks: the best model reaches only 74.2% joint accuracy. Our trace analysis further reveals that model performance varies across evidence discovery, content retrieval, tool use, reasoning over evidence, and answer submission. These findings provide detailed insights for evaluating LLM agents and guiding their reliable deployment in industry. The framework, dataset, and benchmark tasks are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [584] [Does Model Uncertainty Track Human Ambiguity? Evidence from Multi-Annotator Vision Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34506)
*Manya Singh,Arjun Pakrashi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究模型不确定性（单模型softmax置信度、预测熵，以及预测多重性指标：模型间投票熵、JSD散度等）是否能可靠地反映人类标注者之间的分歧（人类歧义）。在FER+和CIFAR-10H两个多标注者视觉数据集上，使用8个预训练模型（ResNet、EfficientNet、MobileNetV3）进行实验，发现模型不确定性与人类分歧之间仅存在弱到中等的相关性（ρ=0.24–0.55），且在离散标签层面，大量人类标注者存在分歧的图像被8个模型一致分类，揭示了模型不确定性作为高风险决策信号的可靠性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在主动学习、选择性分类、临床决策支持等高风险AI辅助决策场景中，模型不确定性被广泛用作决策信号，但其隐含假设——"模型不确定的样本也是人类认为困难的样本"——从未在现代视觉模型上进行系统验证。大多数评估仅将模型预测与单一ground-truth标签对比，忽视了人类标注本身存在分歧这一真实的歧义信号。

Method: 在FER+（8类面部表情，10名标注者/图）和CIFAR-10H（10类物体，51名标注者/图）两个数据集上，对8个预训练模型（ResNet18/34/50、EfficientNet B0/B1/B2、MobileNetV3 Small/Large）进行微调。从两个层面进行分析：（1）离散标签层面：定义四种"分歧画像"（MC、MoD、HoD、MD），统计人类与模型一致性/分歧的交叉分布；（2）连续分数层面：计算人类标注熵与模型softmax置信度、预测熵，以及预测多重性指标（模型间投票熵、JSD散度、族内/族间分歧、不一致比）的Spearman秩相关系数。

Result: 核心发现：模型不确定性与人类分歧的对齐在两个层面均较弱。（1）离散层面：CIFAR-10H中50.4%、FER+中33.5%的图像被人类标注者认为存在分歧，但8个模型一致给出唯一分类（HoD画像）。这些恰恰是人类会请求专家审核、而模型却自信决策的实例。总体人类-模型对齐率仅47.01%（CIFAR-10H）和61.34%（FER+）。（2）连续层面：单模型不确定性与人类分歧的相关性ρ=0.24–0.55（CIFAR-10H弱，FER+中等）；预测多重性指标仅带来有限改善。在置信度阈值>0.95时，模型间分歧几乎消除，但人类分歧仍然显著，表明高置信度并不能可靠地排除人类认为歧义的实例。（3）FER+上的对齐优于CIFAR-10H，可能因为前者的微调标签来自多标注者多数投票，而CIFAR-10H使用单一标签。

Conclusion: 广泛使用的不确定性量化方法不能可靠地识别人类认为歧义的实例。在高风险场景中，模型不确定性不应被默认视为可信赖的决策信号。实践建议：在依赖这些信号前应使用多标注者评估集验证其与人类分歧的对齐；基准测试套件应纳入多标注者数据，以便针对人类分歧而非单一标签准确率来评估不确定性。

Abstract: Human-model alignment is critical for trustworthy AI-assisted decision-making systems. Yet, most work evaluates model predictions against single ground-truth labels, overlooking that humans themselves often disagree on labels, a signal of genuine ambiguity. We investigate whether models struggle on the same instances that humans find difficult. We measure this on two vision datasets (FER+ and CIFAR-10H) where multiple human annotations per image capture human disagreement patterns. We evaluate eight pretrained models across three architectures (ResNet, EfficientNet, MobileNetV3) in two parts: first, whether model uncertainty (softmax confidence, entropy) correlates with human disagreement, and second, whether predictive multiplicity measures (inter-model disagreement, Jensen-Shannon divergence) do. We find that it does not: alignment is weak in both dimensions. At the discrete label level, 50.4% of CIFAR-10H images and 33.5% of FER+ images receive multiple valid classifications from humans, while the models converge on only one. These instances represent a critical failure case where humans perceive ambiguity and would request expert review, yet models decide confidently. At the continuous score level, single-model uncertainty correlates weakly with human disagreement ($\rho = 0.24--0.55$), and predictive multiplicity provides only modest improvement. Widely-used uncertainty quantification methods do not reliably identify instances humans find ambiguous. Model uncertainty should not be treated as a trustworthy signal by default for decision-making in high-stakes scenarios.

</details>


### [585] [Can AI Make Money in Crypto? Measuring the Gap from Backtests to Real Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34510)
*Xingtong Yu,Jiarun Zhou,Guanlin Ding,Wenkang Wei,Jiarui Liu,Chang Zhou,Fangzhou Ge,Chenyi Xu,Xikun Zhang,Renqiang Luo,Jie Zhang,Hong Cheng,Xinming Zhang,Hui Zhang,Yuan Fang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对AI加密货币交易方法提出统一基准，通过历史回测、交易所模拟盘、真实资金实盘三阶段递进式评估，量化"回测到实盘"的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI交易评估主要依赖历史回测，无法证明方法能否泛化到未来市场或在真实交易摩擦（延迟、滑点、流动性、市场冲击）下保持表现。现有基准要么局限于单一方法家族（RL或LLM），要么未涵盖从离线模拟到实盘的完整协议。

Method: 1) 评估32个AI交易方法，涵盖ML、RL、LLM和交易代理四类，附加比特币买入持有基线；2) 三阶段协议：2025年历史回测（OKX数据，10种大市值加密货币）、2026-06至09交易所模拟盘、2026-08至09实盘；3) 五个评估指标：累计收益、Alpha、Sharpe、最大回撤、波动率；4) 测量执行差异：延迟、价格偏差、订单价值偏差；5) 采用OKX执行环境，做市费率0.10%/0.05%；6) 公开代码与持续更新的公共平台。

Result: 1) 历史回测中：23/24 ML方法盈利（最高GATs 71.70%），但RL/LLM/代理方法全部亏损；2) 模拟盘中出现明显反转：仅2/8 ML方法盈利，所有6个非ML方法转为正收益；3) 同期对比显示回测与模拟盘差距高达26.42个百分点（Qwen），且10/14方法在模拟盘表现更佳；4) 执行差异：ML平均延迟18.6秒、LLM 186.9秒、代理522.9秒，但执行差异与性能差距相关性低；5) 实盘中4个方法仅1个盈利，所有方法Alpha为负，无一跑赢买入持有；7) 模拟盘比回测更接近实盘，Alpha和Sharpe差距缩小约52%和51%，但价格偏差从0.31‰增至1.86‰（约6倍），订单价值偏差翻倍。

Conclusion: 历史回测无法可靠预测前瞻性交易表现；模拟盘是必要但非充分的中间环节；当前AI交易方法在实盘中均无法持续击败市场。未来研究应超越单一历史回测优化，转向关注跨市场条件与执行环境的稳健性、一致性以及持续超额收益。

Abstract: AI-based trading methods have rapidly evolved from machine learning and reinforcement learning to large language models (LLMs) and trading agents, yet their performance is still predominantly assessed through historical backtesting. Such evaluations provide limited evidence of whether a method can generalize to unseen future markets or whether its backtested performance can be sustained in realistic trading frictions (e.g., latency, slippage, liquidity constraints, and market impact). We present a unified benchmark that evaluates representative machine learning, reinforcement learning, LLM-based, and agent-based trading methods in cryptocurrency markets through three progressively more realistic stages: historical backtesting, prospective exchange-based paper trading, and real-money live trading. These stages jointly increase temporal realism by moving from historical to unseen future markets, and execution realism by moving from offline simulation toward live trading. This protocol enables us to quantify the backtest-to-realization gap, identify when performance begins to deteriorate, and compare how this gap differs across major classes of AI trading methods. We further provide a unified open-source system supporting all three evaluation stages, together with a public platform that continuously updates benchmark results. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [586] [EOPSA: Efficient On-Policy Self-Distilled Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34519)
*Qirui Liu,Yichen Sun,Yan Wang,Yu Mi,Wei Cao,Yue Shen,Zhixuan Chu,Kui Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EOPSA提出了一种高效的安全对齐框架，通过自适应 rollout 调度和选择性 token 蒸馏，仅对可靠监督下的安全关键 token 进行梯度更新，在减少约50% rollout 计算和仅反向传播约2% token 的同时，在安全性和推理能力保留方面均优于全 token 蒸馏基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) 在大型推理模型的安全对齐中虽具前景，但存在两个关键瓶颈：(1) 监督坍缩——随学生 rollout 前缀延长，教师监督可靠性急剧下降，注入噪声梯度；(2) 梯度稀释——特权提示引发的风格差异主导了蒸馏目标，掩盖真实安全信号并损害推理能力。这导致训练效率低下且引发"对齐税"。

Method: EOPSA 包含两个协同机制：(1) 自适应 rollout 调度（ARS）——基于新提出的 Teacher Rescue Rate (TRR) 指标动态约束生成长度，使其严格处于可靠监督范围内；(2) 选择性蒸馏——通过基于语义规则集的分类器将 token 划分为 Pivot/Intent/Risk（安全关键）与 Function/Consistent/Other（安全中性），仅在前者上反向传播 KL 梯度。语义规则集通过离线 LLM 抽取流程针对模型族自动构建。

Result: 在 Qwen3（1.7B/4B/14B/32B）和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B 上的实验显示，EOPSA 将平均防御成功率提升 2-20 个百分点，rollout 计算减少约50%，反向传播 token 数降至约2%（每样本 3-12 个 token），且在多数情况下保持或超越基础模型的推理水平。在 PAIR/GCG/TAP 越狱攻击下也表现出更强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 有效安全对齐的关键在于语义精度而非优化体量；将计算与梯度预算集中于可靠监督下的稀疏安全关键 token，可同时实现高效安全对齐与对通用推理能力的近乎无损保留。

Abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for safety alignment, delivering dense, token-level supervision by distilling from a teacher conditioned on refusal-oriented privileged prompts. However, we reveal that this paradigm suffers from critical inefficiencies that degrade both training efficiency and general reasoning capabilities. Specifically, we diagnose two fundamental bottlenecks: (1) supervisory collapse over extended rollouts, where the teacher's corrective efficacy degrades precipitously as the student's generation prefix lengthens, injecting noisy gradients into late-stage tokens; and (2) gradient dilution from stylistic shifts, where the distillation objective is dominated by safety-irrelevant stylistic discrepancies induced by privileged prompting, washing out genuine safety signals and impairing base reasoning. To resolve these issues, we propose Efficient On-Policy Self-Distilled Safety Alignment (EOPSA), which concentrates computational and gradient budgets exclusively on reliably supervised, safety-critical tokens. EOPSA incorporates two coordinated mechanisms: (i) Adaptive Rollout Scheduling, which dynamically bounds the generation horizon guided by a novel Teacher Rescue Rate (TRR) metric to operate strictly within reliable supervision regimes; and (ii) Selective Distillation, which filters out safety-neutral tokens to restrict gradient updates exclusively to safety-pivotal transitions. Extensive evaluations across reasoning models up to 32B parameters demonstrate that EOPSA slashes rollout computation by $\sim$50% and backpropagates through merely $\sim$2% of tokens, consistently outperforming full-token distillation baselines in both safety compliance and reasoning retention.

</details>


### [587] [PairPref: When Should Memory Guide the Answer? A Benchmark for Contextual Preference Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34526)
*Mingfei Lu,Mengjia Wu,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了 PairPref 基准,包含 1,227 个情境对(覆盖 45 个偏好和 8 种情境类别),用于评估 LLM 在不同情境下判断"何时应应用用户偏好"的能力。设置选择题和自由生成两条评测轨道,发现模型虽能在选择题中区分适用情境(选择性 Δ 51-65 分),但在自由生成中 71-92% 的情况下仍会在两种情境中都应用偏好,表现出显著的"过度个性化"倾向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆与个性化基准主要测试偏好的存储与检索,而忽视了一个关键问题:即使偏好仍然有效,情境变化时是否应该应用它可能完全不同。检索相似度高并不等于适用性高。论文旨在填补"判断偏好何时应指导回答"这一未被充分评估的能力空白。

Method: 构建配对情境:每个对中偏好和请求保持固定,只改变情境,使偏好在一个情境下应被应用(C+),在另一个情境下应被搁置(C-)。候选回复分为 r_M(应用偏好)、r_sup(明确搁置)、r_obl(隐式搁置)、r_irr(无关任务)。两条评测轨道:选择题(从 4 个候选中选)和自由生成。包含三轮验证(规则检查、语义验证、无上下文筛选)。评估 8 个主流 LLM,并进行多组控制实验(移除情境、缩减记忆池、更改记忆呈现方式、改写 prompt)。

Result: 选择题中,7 个模型达到 51.3-64.9 的选择性 Δ;但自由生成中,两个回答都合适的 pair 成功率仅 3.6-18.3%。71-92% 的生成对中模型在两种情境下都应用了偏好。控制实验显示:移除情境后选择性降至近零;缩小记忆池、更改呈现方式或使用更严格的 prompt 都不能消除这种过度应用倾向。表明模型在判断"偏好何时适用"上存在持续困难,选择合适候选的能力无法迁移到实际生成中。

Conclusion: 可靠的个性化不仅需要检索相关偏好,更需要判断偏好何时适用,并将该判断贯彻到实际回答中。PairPref 通过配对设计和双轨道评测,揭示了模型在选择行为与生成行为之间的显著差距,为改进情境化偏好判断提供了测试平台。

Abstract: Memory-augmented assistants use retrieved preferences to guide their responses. A small change in the situation can change whether a preference is appropriate while barely affecting its retrieval similarity. Memory benchmarks typically test whether systems store and retrieve preferences, with less attention to when those preferences should apply. We introduce PairPref, a benchmark of contextual preference use. Each pair changes only the situation, keeping the preference, request, and four candidate replies fixed. The preference remains valid in both situations. In the selection track, models must choose the reply that applies the preference only where appropriate. In the free-generation track, they must decide when to apply it without seeing candidate replies. Both tracks use the same 1,227 pairs across 45 preferences and eight situation categories. We evaluate eight models, most of which achieve selection scores ($\Delta$) of 51 to 65 points. In free generation, however, both responses are appropriate for their respective situations in only 3.6\% to 18.3\% of pairs. Models continue to apply the preference in both situations even with fewer retrieved memories, alternative presentation formats, and a stricter prompt. These results show that models still struggle to judge when user preferences apply and respond accordingly.

</details>


### [588] [The Marathon of Scientific Reasoning: Robustness of Scientific Agents to Perturbations in Multi-Turn Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34537)
*Xiaoting Lyu,Xinbo Ma,Yufei Han,Hangwei Qian,Ziyang Lin,Bin Wang,Bin Wang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了SciARP基准，用于评估基于LLM的科学智能体在多轮科学问题求解中对科学合理扰动的鲁棒性，发现当前智能体在高无扰任务表现与抗扰鲁棒性之间存在显著差距，且扰动失败往往潜伏、传播且难以恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的科学智能体正被广泛用于多步骤科学工作流，但其可靠性评估多聚焦于最终答案正确性或对抗性攻击，而对真实多轮交互中自然出现的科学合理扰动（如歧义术语、错误前提、错误推理路径等）的鲁棒性缺乏系统研究。这类扰动可能潜伏并在下游推理中传播，导致科学可靠性与任务推进解耦。

Method: 构建SciARP基准：将620道经核验的科学问题（来自GPQA、SciBench、OlympiadBench、BixBench）转化为3–13轮相互依赖的多轮任务；定义13类科学合理扰动，按问题理解、证据处理、推理、结论形成四个阶段分类；clean与perturbed版本独立实时执行，产出配对轨迹；从任务准确率（TACC）、信息正确性（IC）、任务推进（TP）、推理有效性（RV）四个维度评估8个LLM，并通过LLM+人工双重评判。进一步分析扰动的位置（早/中/晚）和频率（n=1,2,3）影响。

Result: 三大核心发现：（1）不同阶段扰动呈现不同鲁棒性画像，证据扰动使TACC下降21.73%但TP仅下降1.23%，揭示"静默失败"——智能体在科学可靠性下降时仍继续推进任务；（2）clean任务表现更强的模型不一定更鲁棒，GPT-5.6在无效前提扰动下clean准确率更高但退化更大（31.06% vs Claude Opus 5的16.91%）；（3）扰动效应具有强时间动态性，74%的E2和58%的E3失败在两轮后才显现，且82.9%的失败会持续到最终轮而非恢复。推理扰动平均退化最大（TACC 50.69%），结论扰动对IC和RV影响最大（22.35%和31.69%）。位置分析显示晚插入扰动退化更大；频率分析显示多次重复显著放大失败。

Conclusion: SciARP揭示了当前LLM科学智能体在面对科学合理扰动时存在显著鲁棒性缺陷，能力与鲁棒性之间存在鸿沟，失败具有潜伏性、传播性和难恢复性。研究强调需超越最终答案准确率，从多轮过程层面评估科学智能体的可靠性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based scientific agents are increasingly used for scientific problem solving, yet their robustness to imperfections arising during multi-turn interactions remains poorly understood. We introduce \textsc{SciARP} (\textbf{Sci}entific \textbf{A}gent \textbf{R}obustness to \textbf{P}erturbations), a benchmark for evaluating scientific agents under scientifically plausible perturbations throughout multi-turn problem solving. \textsc{SciARP} transforms 620 scientific problems into interdependent tasks of 3--13 turns and defines 13 perturbation types spanning problem understanding, evidence processing, reasoning, and conclusion formation. Clean and perturbed versions of each task are independently executed under matched settings, producing paired live trajectories for evaluating both task success and process reliability. Experiments across eight LLMs from four model families reveal three key robustness characteristics. First, different classes of scientific perturbations exhibit distinct robustness profiles and can decouple task progression from scientific reliability: agents may continue advancing through the task even after their information or reasoning has become unreliable. Second, stronger clean-task performance does not necessarily translate into stronger robustness, as models with higher clean-task accuracy can exhibit larger degradation under perturbation. Third, perturbation effects exhibit strong temporal dynamics: they may remain latent for multiple turns before emerging and subsequently propagate through downstream dependencies. Together, these findings show that current scientific agents remain insufficiently robust to scientifically plausible perturbations, with failures often remaining undetected, propagating, and resisting recovery.

</details>


### [589] [APOLO: Automatic Prompt Optimization for Ontology Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34540)
*Huu Tan Mai,Roman Kochnev,Cuong Xuan Chu,Lukas Lange,Heiko Paulheim,Daria Stepanova*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: APOLO将本体学习(OL)形式化为LLM模块上的显式提示优化问题，通过多智能体系统从专家策划的本体生成文本-本体对训练数据，提出贪心学习器和自回归(AR)学习器两种架构，并使用基于DSPy构建的GEPA进化提示优化器进行优化。在DOID和PO两个领域本体上的实验表明，提示优化在几乎所有模型和模式组合上都带来了一致的改进，其中AR学习器获益最大，超越了所有现成的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本体构建成本高昂且需要专业知识，而现有的LLM-based本体学习方法面临两个主要障碍：(1) 文本-本体标注对的训练数据极其稀缺；(2) 手动搜索高性能提示耗时费力，微调每个子任务的LLM成本高昂。论文旨在探索自动提示优化作为一种轻量级替代方案，避免权重更新的同时提升LLM在OL任务上的表现。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 多智能体数据生成系统（Planner、Verifier、Writer、Critic）从12个公开本体生成文本-本体对训练数据；(2) 两种单模块学习器架构——贪心学习器（独立处理每个文本块后拼接）和自回归学习器（以前序块的预测公理为条件生成新块，训练时使用teacher forcing）；(3) 使用GEPA（基于DSPy的贪心进化提示优化器）优化提示π，评估指标μ结合实体F-β分数(δ=0.2权重)和公理F-β分数(β=3)，并提供包含错误诊断的可操作反馈供反射LLM迭代改进提示。

Result: 在DOID（生物医学）和PO（植物）两个领域本体上，使用Qwen3.5-27B和Devstral-Small-2-24B两个开源LLM进行评估。关键结果：(i) 几乎所有模型/模式组合在GEPA优化后都获得了一致的改进；(ii) AR学习器获益最大，Qwen3.5-27B AR在DOID上AxP从0.569提升至0.838（+47%），并在大多数公理级指标上超越了所有现成基线；(iii) 优化后提示变得非常冗长（如Qwen3.5-27B AR从14词扩展到1474词）；(iv) 优化过程仅需3-4小时且无需GPU显存用于权重更新。然而，评估指标未能惩罚冗余公理，且领域本体可能在LLM预训练中被见过，存在数据泄漏风险。

Conclusion: 论文证明提示优化是微调的可行且轻量级的替代方案，能为OL带来稳定改进；自回归公式比贪心方法更好地捕捉本体结构。将自动数据生成与提示优化相结合是迈向更好本体学习器的有前景的路径，该方法可自然扩展到多智能体架构和任意本体领域。未来工作将探索合成本体生成以减少数据泄漏，并设计更鲁棒的复杂OWL 2构造评估指标。

Abstract: Ontology Learning (OL) from text has advanced with the emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs), but it remains challenging due to the limited availability of annotated training data and the difficulty of adapting LLMs to perform OL effectively. We address this via APOLO - Automatic Prompt Optimization for Ontology Learning, by casting OL as an explicit prompt optimization problem over LLM modules. To obtain training data, we employ a multi-agent system that generates text-ontology pairs from existing expert-curated ontologies. We then propose two ontology learner architectures: a greedy and an autoregressive learner, and optimize both using GEPA, a greedy evolutionary prompt optimizer built on DSPy. Experiments on two ontologies - a biomedical (DOID) and a plant ontology (PO) show consistent improvements after optimization across nearly all model and mode combinations, with autoregressive learners achieving the largest gains. Our results demonstrate that prompt optimization is a viable and lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for OL, and that the autoregressive formulation better captures ontological structure than the greedy approach.

</details>


### [590] [Remember Before You're Asked: MemDream for Self-Probing Memory Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34545)
*Mingfei Lu,Mengjia Wu,Runsong Jia,Zhe Luo,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MemDream提出了一种主动式（self-probing）记忆演化框架，通过离线"梦境周期"中的Dreamer、Analyst、Consolidator三智能体协同，在真实查询到达前探测、诊断并修复记忆图谱中的潜在失效，在LoCoMo和MemoryAgentBench上显著优于现有反应式记忆基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统采用反应式范式：仅在真实查询暴露失败后才进行修复，每个检索失效都已造成真实交互代价。需要一种能够在失败发生前主动发现并修复记忆缺陷的机制。

Method: MemDream采用三层层次化记忆存储（STIM/MTEM/LTSM），通过多智能体梦境周期实现自我探测：Dreamer基于节点弱点评分（连通性、冗余度、时效性）生成前瞻性探测查询并配对桥接伙伴；Analyst沿"节点内/跨节点"与"召回/精度"两轴将失效分类为buried/scattered/redundant/noisy四类；Consolidator执行extract/merge/synthesize/prune四种修复操作，其中prune采用软衰减（γ=0.2）实现可逆遗忘。三个智能体共享Llama-3.1-8B骨干，通过LoRA适配器实现角色分工，采用GRPO（组大小N=4）分别优化各自的复合奖励函数，经SFT预训练、独立GRPO、联合微调三阶段训练，Dreamer生成查询配对从源记忆原文复制的期望答案以保证grounded。

Result: 在LoCoMo上MemDream以GPT-4.1为读者取得55.14平均F1（提升3.98），时序类F1提升8.57；在MemoryAgentBench上整体得分54.2（GPT-4.1）和37.1（Llama-8B），分别超过最强基线9.1和11.5分。消融实验显示软衰减贡献最大（移除后F1下降14.10），Dreamer、Analyst、GRPO分别贡献3.05/1.71/2.16的F1增益。多轮稳定性测试证实即使运行20轮（远超实际2-3轮）图谱也不会崩溃，幻觉率不累积。统计检验显示与Mem0、MemR3的对话级显著性p<0.001。

Conclusion: MemDream将自我探测（self-probing）作为记忆系统主动维护的范式，通过Dream Cycle将不可观察的未来查询分布转化为可训练信号，用GRPO学习修复策略，用软衰减实现可逆遗忘，为长程交互中智能体记忆的预维护提供了一个可扩展的基线方法。

Abstract: Memory is essential for enabling LLM-based agents to maintain coherent, personalized behavior over long-horizon interactions. However, existing memory systems share a fundamental limitation: they never proactively test their own memory, repairing it only after real queries expose weaknesses. This reactive paradigm means every retrieval failure corresponds to a real interaction in which the cost has already been paid. We propose MemDream, a framework that enables self-probing memory evolution for LLM agents. Our framework periodically enters offline dream cycles where three specialized agents (Dreamer, Analyst, Consolidator) collaboratively probe, diagnose, and repair the memory graph before failures occur. A policy trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization learns which repair operations produce durable retrieval improvements, while a soft decay mechanism provides reversible forgetting driven by the same anticipatory signal. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemoryAgentBench demonstrate that MemDream improves answer F1 by 4.5 points on LoCoMo and achieves a 9.1-point higher overall score on MAB over the strongest reactive-evolution baselines.

</details>


### [591] [SGG-ReflAct: Sub-Goal Guided ReflAct with Structured Planning for Reliable Long-Horizon Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34548)
*Jaeho Jung,Sung Hoon Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SGG-ReflAct（Sub-Goal Guided ReflAct）是一种LLM智能体推理骨干，通过将任务分解为子目标并将每步反思锚定到当前活跃子目标（而非最终目标），解决了ReflAct在长horizon任务中因状态远离最终目标导致反思指导性弱的问题。作者还提出BeamSGG-ReflAct，用束搜索LLM规划器替代单路径规划器。在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和Jericho三个交互式文本基准上，使用GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct三个模型进行评估，SGG-ReflAct在几乎所有设置下均优于ReAct、Plan-and-Act和ReflAct基线。使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct时，ALFWorld成功率提升14.9个百分点，ScienceWorld提升8.0个百分点。该方法主要通过减少幻觉动作（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上将无效动作率从43.3%降至29.9%）来提升性能，程序化任务受益最大。研究还表明，规划质量是骨干性能的关键决定因素，仅靠搜索无法弥补计划内容缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体推理骨干（包括ReflAct）在长horizon任务中存在关键缺陷：随着推理horizon增长，不一致的内部信念导致中间错误，使智能体偏离目标。ReflAct虽然每步针对最终目标进行反思，但在长horizon任务初期，当前状态距最终目标尚远，反思提供的可操作指导有限，导致早期误判累积为无根据动作。

Method: 提出SGG-ReflAct，两阶段框架：(1) 规划阶段：单次LLM调用将任务分解为N=4个有序子目标序列；(2) 反思与行动阶段：每步先识别当前活跃子目标，再针对该子目标进行反思，然后选择动作，两个阶段共享同一次LLM调用。扩展版本BeamSGG-ReflAct采用自评估引导的束搜索规划器（K=2, S=3），无需环境交互即可探索多个子目标序列。规划器作为模块化组件，可独立替换。

Result: SGG-ReflAct在三个基准（ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、Jericho）和三个模型上几乎全面超越基线。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上：ALFWorld成功率从ReflAct的35.8%提升至50.7%（+14.9pp），ScienceWorld从25.6%提升至33.6%（+8.0pp）。无效动作率从43.3%降至29.9%，且剧增态势得到缓解。程序化任务（如Boil从0%升至55.6%、Paint/Mix从5.6%升至61.1%）收益最大。消融实验表明，性能提升主要来自将反思锚定到活跃子目标（+6.1pp），而非仅在上下文中加入计划（+1.9pp）。然而，束搜索规划器在多数设置下未优于单路径规划器，因为计划内容质量（是否包含所需操作）才是关键决定因素。仅靠搜索无法弥补计划缺失必要操作的缺陷；显式提示规划器包含所需操作可恢复性能增益。

Conclusion: 研究得出长horizon智能体的双重设计原则：(1) 强化推理骨干需要改进其反思目标——锚定到子目标比锚定到最终目标更有效；(2) 优化规划器需要优先考虑子目标内容才能实现有效搜索。SGG-ReflAct提供了一个实用且高效的推理骨干，通过子目标引导的反思使LLM智能体在复杂长horizon任务中实现可靠性能，并易于集成。局限性包括：固定计划无法在episode中途动态生成新子目标；Jericho等基准样本量小；固定N=4不适用于所有任务；束搜索规划器最多需42次额外LLM调用。

Abstract: Recent advances in reasoning backbones have empowered large language model (LLM)agentstotackle complex, multi-step tasks. However, as reasoning horizons grow, inconsistent internal beliefs induce intermediate errors that cause agents to drift from their goals. This limitation also persists in REFLACT, which reflects only on the end-goal at each step without explicitly considering intermediate sub goals. To address this problem, we propose SGG-ReflAct (Sub-Goal Guided Re flAct), a reasoning backbone that integrates sub-goals generated through a single path LLM planner into the reflection process. We further extend this framework to BeamSGG-ReflAct, which replaces the single-path planner with a beam search based LLM planner for structured plan exploration. We run experiments on ALF World, ScienceWorld, and Jericho with multiple LLM models. SGG-ReflAct out performs REFLACT in nearly all settings, achieving best success rate gains of 14.9 percentage points on ALFWorld and 8.0 percentage points on ScienceWorld with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Our experimental analysis shows that SGG-ReflAct re duces hallucinated actions and achieves its largest gains on procedurally ordered tasks. Furthermore, experimental results with BeamSGG-ReflAct show that the backbone's effectiveness depends on plan quality: explicitly specifying the re quired operations recovers gains that plan searching alone cannot achieve. These results demonstrate that SGG-ReflAct offers a practical and highly effective rea soning backbone, enabling LLM agents to achieve reliable performance in com plex, long-horizon tasks through easy integration.

</details>


### [592] [SkillRubric: Co-Evolving Actor Guidance and Evaluator Rubrics for Multimodal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34557)
*Bingqing Jiang,Guoxi Zhang,Jasper Wang,Auric Wang,Bingning Wang,Tianyi Lin,Zichao Yu,Yujin Han,Ziye Ma,Difan Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillRubric框架，将多模态智能体中的可复用技能同时表示为面向执行者的"指导"和面向评估者的"评分标准"，并通过交替协同演化机制让两者随策略学习共同进化，从而将稀疏结果奖励转变为基于证据的轮级过程监督信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能增强多模态智能体训练主要依赖稀疏的结果奖励，对中间决策缺乏监督；而基于评分标准的奖励虽能提供细粒度信号，但难以大规模构建且与执行者实际执行过程脱节。论文观察到结构良好的技能天然同时规定"如何行动"和"如何评判成功执行"，从而可作为评分标准的可靠来源。

Method: 方法分三阶段：(1) 从多教师轨迹中通过"教师内聚合-跨教师整合-双视图重构-跨任务聚合"的两层层次化机制构建双视图技能库(描述d、面向执行者的指导g、面向评估者的评分标准C)；(2) 技能条件化的策略优化——按任务描述与技能适用描述的余弦相似度检索top-1技能，指导g用于调节策略rollout，评分标准C通过粗到细的两阶段多模态验证器(基于截图和工具输出)产生轮级过程优势，与分组结果优势合并用于GRPO更新；(3) 交替协同演化——冻结策略下用配对rollout验证指导更新，用离线重新标注验证评分标准更新，固定结果评估器作为锚点，每H=10步交替进行。

Result: 在8个多模态智能体基准(含4个IID和4个OOD)上，Qwen3-VL-8B平均成功率从最强基线SkillRL的13.12%提升至17.88%(提升4.76个百分点)，Qwen3.5-9B从25.24%提升至28.79%(提升3.55个百分点)，9B模型甚至接近122B-A10B参考模型水平(28.81%)；消融实验显示结果奖励、评分标准奖励和协同演化三者贡献递增；交互轮次从9.5轮降至4.55轮(9B)；协同演化产生的技能库版本可在不同模型家族间迁移并持续提升性能。

Conclusion: SkillRubric通过将共享的过程性知识同时用于执行引导和过程监督，使评分标准与执行过程天然对齐；交替协同演化在保持因果可分辨性的同时让两个组件随策略共同进化，在效果、迁移性和效率方面均取得一致提升，证明了共享过程表征可同时改进智能体行为和过程监督。

Abstract: Recent work incorporates reusable skills distilled from past interactions into multimodal agent training, providing procedural guidance for long-horizon planning and tool use. However, policy optimization in these methods remains driven primarily by sparse outcome rewards, providing little supervision for intermediate decisions. Rubric-based rewards address this limitation through explicit intermediate criteria, but reliable rubrics are difficult to construct at scale and often disconnected from the procedure followed by the actor. We observe that a well-structured skill naturally specifies both how to act and what successful execution should achieve. Based on this insight, we introduce SkillRubric, which represents each skill through aligned actor-facing guidance and an evaluator-facing rubric. A multimodal verifier evaluates skill-defined goals using screenshots and tool outputs, assigning completion and progress rewards to the responsible turns. We further introduce an alternating co-evolution scheme that validates guidance revisions through paired rollouts under a frozen policy and rubric revisions offline under fixed guidance. Experiments across diverse multimodal agent benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance gains, while controlled paired rollouts further show that evolved skills provide more effective guidance for planning and tool use than their preceding versions.

</details>


### [593] [FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34565)
*Minghao Li,Bangyan Li,Zifan Wang,Yulong Li,Hu Xu,Gan Zhang,Jingtong Wu,Wenqiang Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FlowState提出将执行状态本身作为长周期LLM智能体的统一记忆表征，通过持续保留的语义类型化状态节点、增量状态更新（ISU）与渐进式状态访问（PSA）两个机制，将持久保留与按需访问解耦，从而在长周期、多会话任务中同时提升性能与token效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长周期任务中，保留完整历史会大幅增加上下文开销并模糊相关信息，而压缩历史又可能丢失后续决策所需的关键细节；历史信息的相关性往往只在推理进行中才显现出来。已有方法要么聚焦于紧凑的状态追踪（如ZipAct），要么聚焦于外部长期记忆与检索（如ReasoningBank、BM25、Mem0），但鲜有工作将"当前执行状态"与"跨请求可复用记忆"统一在同一表征中，并实现按需渐进披露。

Method: FlowState构建三层结构：(1) Persistent State Repository（运行时维护、包含语义类型化节点、节点间关系及对原始工具观测的引用，但不放入模型上下文）；(2) Historical State Index（轻量级，仅含状态标识符与摘要，纳入当前请求的上下文）；(3) Active State（当前请求的决策工作区）。状态分为五类：preferences、knowledge、attributes、judgements、artifacts。在单次执行循环中包含两个互补操作：Incremental State Update（ISU）通过Add/Update/Remove操作增量维护当前请求状态；Progressive State Access（PSA）通过索引或已披露状态中的关系，按需追溯历史状态及相关证据。模型在每次调用时同时输出状态增量、历史访问请求和执行决策三个组件，验证后合并得到下一时刻的Active State；请求结束后新生成的状态与引用到的原始观测被持久化到仓库中供后续请求复用。

Result: 在MemoryArena（Web Shopping、Group Travel Planning、Formal Reasoning: Math/Physics）与τ³-Bench（Airline、Retail）上，使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash：相比Full Context基线，MemoryArena平均成功率提升4.55个百分点、τ³-Bench平均通过率提升13.95个百分点，同时token消耗分别降低43.2%与40.6%。消融实验表明ISU与PSA互补——移除ISU导致成功率降为0，移除PSA虽在个别指标略高但token消耗显著上升。跨基模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GPT-5.6-terra、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B）实验显示PS与SR全面提升、相对token消耗降低28.3%–56.3%；在子任务深度分析中，FlowState在长尾深度的子任务上保持最高的相对性能保持率（nAUC），验证了PSA按需追溯历史信息的设计优势。

Conclusion: FlowState通过将执行状态升格为可跨请求复用的记忆单元，统一了当前决策与历史信息访问，在长周期、相互依赖的多会话任务中同时提升了任务成功率和token效率，验证了"以执行状态本身作为长程记忆统一表征"这一思路的有效性。

Abstract: Long-horizon tasks require LLM agents to continually draw on information from earlier interactions. However, retaining the full history increases context costs, while compressing it risks losing details needed later, and the relevance of historical information often becomes apparent as the task progresses. To address these challenges, we propose FlowState, which treats execution state as memory that can be retained and revisited across requests, unifying current decision-making with the reuse of historical information. FlowState preserves semantically typed state nodes, their relations, and references to raw tool observations, separating persistent retention from on-demand access. Within a single execution loop, Incremental State Update (ISU) maintains the current state based on new inputs and feedback, while Progressive State Access (PSA) progressively reveals historical states and supporting evidence as needed during reasoning. Together, these mechanisms enable agents to reassess prior decisions in light of new information and guide subsequent actions. Compared with a full-context baseline using the same DeepSeek-V4-Flash model, FlowState improves the average success rate on MemoryArena and the average pass rate on $\tau^3$-Bench by 4.55 and 13.95 percentage points, respectively, while reducing total token consumption by 43.2% and 40.6%. These results demonstrate the performance and efficiency advantages of FlowState on long-horizon tasks.

</details>


### [594] [PersonaManifold: Revealing and Exploiting Curved Geometry in LLM Persona Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34571)
*Rui Xu,Yinghui Xu,Libo Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PersonaManifold框架,将LLM人格表征建模为激活空间中一个弯曲的低维黎曼子流形,通过估计局部度量张量、测地线距离和Ollivier-Ricci曲率来刻画其内蕴几何,并提出沿测地线插值的"测地线引导"方法。同时提出了基于行为反应的人格相似度基准BST。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时激活引导方法隐含"线性各向同性"假设(欧氏距离和直线插值足以描述人格相似度与组合),但实践报告三类系统性失败:维度非正交、天花板/抗性效应不对称、多特质组合显著偏离。表明人格表征空间可能具有弯曲、各向异性的几何结构,欧氏运算无法准确刻画其距离、方向与组合性质。

Method: 1) 从约2K多样化人格(来自PersonaHub与CoSER)的残差流激活中提取人格表征(中性基线减去的均值激活),经PCA降维;2) 估计流形内蕴几何:用Marchenko-Pastur与Levina-Bickel MLE估计内蕴维数d*,构造局部协方差矩阵并取其逆作为局部度量张量,在k-NN图上以度量加权Dijkstra最短路计算测地距离,用Ollivier-Ricci曲率量化局部曲率异质性,并进行密度-曲率解耦分析以排除采样伪影;3) 测地线引导:在k-NN图上取最短路径,沿局部切空间三次样条平滑后等弧长采样,反投影回原激活空间注入残差流;4) BST基准:基于Moral Foundations、DOSPERT、人际环、决策风格、Schwartz价值观、沟通者风格六大心理学构念生成150道情境题,通过行为反应(选择一致性+嵌入余弦)定义人格相似度三元组。

Result: 在三个开源LLM(Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B)上的实验显示:1) 人格激活形成内蕴维数d*∈[15,23]的弯曲流形,远超Big Five假设的5维,且曲率异质(职业人格正曲率、虚构角色负曲率),密度解耦后差异仍显著(p<0.001);2) 测地距离在BST上预测行为相似度优于所有欧氏基线,TCR提升+5.1–6.1个百分点,因子分离分析证实各向异性与曲率各自独立贡献;3) 测地线引导在高偏差对(d_g/d_E>1.2)上生成更连贯的中间人格(IC/TS/MA均优),在外部基准(PersonaGym、BFI-44、TES)及人工自然度评分(3.82 vs 3.41)上一致验证;4) 优势集中在高曲率区域(虚构人格、曲率最大的人格对),在近平坦区域与线性方法相当。

Conclusion: 尊重LLM内部表征的内蕴几何是人格控制的一项实用归纳偏置。弯曲结构是普遍存在的几何性质(三种架构一致),测地线距离比欧氏距离更好地预测行为相似度,测地线引导比线性插值产生更连贯的中间人格。实用指南:当d_g/d_E>1.2时使用测地线引导(覆盖约60%随机人格对)。局限:实验限于7-8B模型;几何估计需O(N²)计算;当前以单一均值激活向量表征,坍缩了跨情境的个体内变异。

Abstract: Controlling persona in large language models (LLMs) at inference time is important for role-playing, personalized dialogue, and social simulation. Recent methods extract persona vectors from the model's activation space and apply Euclidean operations---addition, scaling, and linear interpolation---under the linear representation hypothesis. However, these methods themselves report systematic failures: non-orthogonal trait dimensions, asymmetric ceiling and resistance effects, and significant deviations in multi-trait composition, suggesting that the linear isotropic assumption does not hold. We propose PersonaManifold, a framework that models persona representations as points on a curved, low-dimensional Riemannian submanifold in activation space. We estimate the manifold's intrinsic geometry---local metric tensors, geodesic distances, and Ollivier-Ricci curvature---and introduce geodesic steering, which interpolates between personas along manifold geodesics rather than Euclidean straight lines. We also propose the Behavioral Similarity Triplet (BST) benchmark, which automatically generates situational questions grounded in six established psychological constructs and defines persona similarity through behavioral responses rather than self-report questionnaires. Experiments on three open-source LLMs show that persona activations form a manifold with heterogeneous curvature, geodesic distance predicts behavioral similarity more accurately than Euclidean alternatives with independent contributions from anisotropy and curvature, and geodesic steering produces more coherent intermediate personas on both our BST benchmark and external evaluations, with the advantage concentrated in high-deviation regions where the manifold deviates most from flatness.

</details>


### [595] [Nudgeability: Reasoning Models Follow Confidence Signals Without Tracking Their Own Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34572)
*Rohit Saxena,Utkarsh Upadhyay*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"Nudgeability"框架，通过在推理轨迹的固定边界注入单个表示自信或怀疑的第一人称句子，测量推理语言模型在"自行回答"与"调用工具"之间的委托决策变化。研究发现模型对该信号高度敏感（开源模型中位数摆动20.6个百分点，提供商模型达53-70个百分点），但行为变化仅弱相关于模型实际能力（仅比随机基线高+2个百分点），表明当前模型能感知置信信号却未能据此做出能力匹配的选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理语言模型在具备工具调用能力时，需要决定何时自行回答、何时委托给工具。现有自我反思机制研究混杂了"信号来源、信号表征、行为效应"三个独立问题，且缺乏对推理模型在推理轨迹内部进行委托决策的因果评估方法。本文旨在分离这三个维度，专门测量信号对后续行为的影响。

Method: 方法核心是配对反事实干预：在模型已生成的推理轨迹（r_i）的固定边界处（紧邻think-close标记之前）插入一个第一人称句子（"I feel confident in my answer." 或 "I do not feel confident in my answer."），然后重新生成续篇。两个对照臂共享完全相同的问题、系统提示、工具描述和推理前缀，唯一的差异是被插入句子的情感极性。定义两个维度：(1) 敏感性S = 怀疑条件下委托率 - 自信条件下委托率；(2) 定向性WT = 引导的行为翻转中与无辅助能力一致的比例，L = WT - WT_rand（随机选择基线）。实验涵盖9个开源推理模型（Qwen3、Gemma4、GLM-Z1）和2个通过API供应商模型（DeepSeek-V4-Pro、MiniMax-M3），在MuSiQue和StrategyQA两个多跳问答任务上进行评估。

Result: 主要结果：1) 所有22个模型-任务实验中，怀疑一致增加委托、自信一致减少委托，开源模型中位数摆动为20.6个百分点，提供商模型为53-70个百分点；2) 定向性差：中位数仅42%的诱导翻转与无辅助能力一致，相对随机基线的提升仅为+2个百分点；3) 定向性与敏感性之间几乎无相关（Spearman ρ=0.13），表明模型对信号敏感但未能将反应定位于需要帮助的问题；4) 行为画像分布：Gemma4-E4B和供应商模型属"顺从型"（高S但L≈0），Qwen3在MuSiQue上表现出"选择性"特征（L=+5.2至+18.8个百分点）；5) 控制实验：无句子拼接几乎无影响（中位|∅-B|=0.3 pp），第一人称归因与专家归因效果相当（16/18实验中前者至少不弱）。

Conclusion: 结论指出当前推理模型具备可靠的"被置信语言引导"能力，但缺乏将引导与自身能力匹配使用的机制。Nudgeability作为一个无需后训练的诊断属性，为未来内生自我反思系统的开发提供了评估敏感性（S）和定向性（L）的统一框架。实践意义在于：评估委托机制时应同时报告这两个维度，因为仅靠工具调用率变化无法判断系统是否在需要时寻求帮助；模型即使具有高残余自依赖和条件性过度自信，也不应成为更强工具的唯一把关者。

Abstract: Reasoning language models that can call tools must decide during inference whether to answer unaided or delegate. Any self-reflection mechanism for this must answer three questions: where the reflective signal comes from (verbal reports, output distributions, hidden states, a separate predictor), how it is presented to the model (numerical prediction, confidence token, prompt injection), and whether it changes the model's subsequent action. We isolate the third question. At a fixed point in otherwise identical reasoning trajectories, we insert a single first-person sentence expressing either confidence or doubt; the model then continues reasoning and chooses whether to answer directly or call a tool. Comparing these counterfactual continuations measures the causal effect of the reflective signal on delegation. We call this behavioral response Nudgeability and measure it along two dimensions: sensitivity, how strongly confidence and doubt change delegation rates, and targeting, whether delegation increases for problems the model cannot solve unaided and decreases for those it can. Across nine small-to-medium open-weight reasoning models from three families (Qwen, Gemma, and GLM) and two tasks, models are consistently sensitive: doubt increases delegation and confidence decreases it, with a median confidence-to-doubt swing of 20.6 percentage points, and 53 to 70 points for the larger provider-served models. This responsiveness is poorly targeted: a median 42% of induced flips are well-targeted, only a +2 percentage-point lift over a random-selection baseline. Confidence language is thus a strong control surface for delegation, but current models use it only weakly in accordance with their actual competence. Nudgeability offers a simple, post-training-free way to evaluate both sensitivity and targeting as endogenous self-reflection mechanisms mature.

</details>


### [596] [Diffusion Subgoal Planning for Long-Horizon Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34575)
*Hengrui Zhang,Yuhu Cheng,C. L. Philip Chen,Xuesong Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DSP（Diffusion Subgoal Planning），一种基于扩散模型的离线目标条件强化学习高层子目标规划框架，通过无分类器引导替代基于价值函数的高层子目标选择，在长视野导航与操作任务上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习在长视野任务中因稀疏奖励和折扣导致价值估计不稳定；分层方法（如HIQL）虽缓解此问题，但高层子目标仍依赖噪声敏感的价值比较，在复杂环境中易产生不稳定行为。

Method: 将高层子目标生成建模为引导式生成推理，学习无条件与条件速度场（通过条件dropout实现），推理时采用无分类器引导（CFG）引入目标导向偏置；证明CFG采样等价于隐式相对优势加权子目标提取；低层策略沿用HIQL的IQL式价值学习与AWR执行。

Result: 在OGBench基准的locomotion和manipulation任务上，DSP在多步子目标规划（尤其是maze环境）中显著优于HIQL、OTA、Pi-HIQL等基线，并在D4RL AntMaze上超越HDMI、DTAMP、HD等扩散式分层方法；定性可视化显示DSP生成的子目标轨迹更平滑且符合拓扑结构。

Conclusion: 引导式生成建模是长视野离线GCRL高层规划中替代显式价值引导的有效方案，但过度引导会牺牲子目标可达性，且性能仍依赖离线数据覆盖。

Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) learns goal-directed policies from reward-free data, but in long-horizon tasks, goal-conditioned value functions often provide unstable guidance due to sparse rewards and discounting. Hierarchical methods partially mitigate this issue via subgoal decomposition; however, high-level decision-making still relies on noise-sensitive value estimates, leading to unstable behavior in complex environments. We address this limitation by proposing \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{S}ubgoal \textbf{P}lanning (\textbf{DSP}), a diffusion-based framework for high-level subgoal generation. DSP casts high-level planning as guided generative inference over goal-conditioned subgoals and learns both conditional and unconditional flows, enabling classifier-free guidance to introduce a goal-directed bias at inference time. By removing explicit value-based guidance from high-level planning, DSP generates reachable and goal-directed subgoals through a generative model while retaining hierarchical execution. Experiments on offline GCRL benchmarks demonstrate that DSP outperforms prior methods on a range of navigation and manipulation tasks, with particularly strong performance in maze environments that require multi-step subgoal planning.

</details>


### [597] [Calibrated Uncertainty for Informative Path Planning in Aquatic Environmental Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34577)
*Samuel Yanes Luis,Alejandro Casado Pérez,Alejandro Mendoza Barrionuevo,Dame Seck Diop,Sergio Toral Marín,Saniel Gutiérrez Reina*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对水面自主艇(ASV)在水生环境(如油污泄漏)监测中的标量场重建任务，研究将高斯过程(GP)替换为经过良好校准的深度集成模型(Deep Ensemble)对信息路径规划(IPP)性能的影响，并比较了五种规划策略（ε-Greedy、Value Greedy、Uncertainty Greedy、MCTS、Receding Horizon Orienteering）在共享同一Deep Ensemble骨干下的表现。结果表明：Deep Ensemble使归一化RMSE相对GP基线降低83%，且良好的不确定性校准会"放大"规划策略选择的重要性——多步前瞻规划器比贪心策略在重建误差上最高提升32%，IoU超过0.85；最终推荐MCTS，因其在重建质量上接近Orienteering但计算开销低一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于高斯过程(GP)的信息路径规划依赖其闭式后验方差作为不确定性信号，但GP的平稳各向同性核(如RBF)对油污泄漏等非平稳现象建模不当——单全局尺度无法捕捉污染边界的陡峭梯度与背景区域的平滑性共存的结构——导致不确定性系统性失准，进而降低主动感知策略的有效性。论文旨在探究：(1)用良好校准的深度学习替代GP能否提升路径规划结果；(2)不确定性质量与规划算法选择之间是否存在交互作用。

Method: 1) 不确定性模型：采用M个U-Net成员构成的Deep Ensemble，每个成员基于观测掩码M和值矩阵V的拼接输入，经编码器(4块卷积+BN+ReLU+最大池化，通道32→512，瓶颈1024)与对称解码器(转置卷积+跳跃连接)，由1×1卷积输出均值估计与对数方差(偶然不确定性)。各成员以异方差负对数似然独立训练。推理时，集合均值作预测，认知不确定性由成员间方差得到，偶然不确定性由各成员预测方差均值得到。GP基线采用RBF+白噪声复合核，L-BFGS优化超参数。2) 规划算法：所有规划器在滚动时域框架内运行，每步仅执行候选轨迹首动作。包含三种贪心策略（ε-Greedy以衰减探索率随机游走；Value Greedy选预测最大场值点；Uncertainty Greedy选最大认知不确定性点）；MCTS采用UCT选择、扩展、不确定性贪心启发式回溯，并设计认知不确定性自适应分支半径r(x)∝1/σ_epi(x)，将搜索预算聚焦于高不确定性区域；Receding Horizon Orienteering在子网格采样候选航点，将边穿越像素的认知不确定性之和作为奖励、欧氏距离作为成本，以多启动贪心构造+爬山局部搜索的两阶段元启发式求解。3) 仿真：100×100网格，基于物理的粒子油污模拟，含随机风与潮汐；传感器加性高斯噪声N(0,0.1²)。评价指标为归一化RMSE(相对第一步)与阈值τ下的IoU。

Result: 1) 模型维度：Deep Ensemble归一化RMSE均值0.1568±0.2856，相对GP(0.9350±0.5623)降低83%，相对Myopic(0.6243±0.2300)降低75%；且GP高方差证实其平稳各向同性核对此类场根本性失配。2) 策略-模型交互：失准模型下各策略性能差异极小(规划器选择无关紧要)；Deep Ensemble下策略差异显著放大，揭示清晰性能层级。3) 策略比较(Deep Ensemble下)：Receding Horizon Orienteering最低RMSE 0.1434±0.1385，MCTS次之0.1561±0.1473，二者比Uncertainty Greedy(0.2097±0.1823)分别降低32%与26%；定位精度上MCTS IoU最高0.8563±0.1099，略高于Orienteering的0.8491±0.1122，均显著高于Uncertainty Greedy的0.8085±0.1315；Value Greedy居中(RMSE 0.2794，IoU 0.7594)；ε-Greedy最差(RMSE 0.6774，IoU 0.5053)。4) 定性分析：多步规划器产生对污染边界结构化覆盖，MCTS呈现系统栅格状扫描，Orienteering生成紧凑子路径；ε-Greedy分散于无信息背景区域，Value Greedy聚集于峰值但忽视边界。5) 计算效率：Orienteering每规划调用成本比MCTS高一个数量级；MCTS通过树复用与认知不确定性自适应分支摊销2000次模拟开销。

Conclusion: 模型质量是路径规划性能的主导因素：将平稳GP替换为良好校准的Deep Ensemble使归一化RMSE降低83%，并使规划策略选择的重要性被"放大"——良好校准的不确定性地图将不确定性转化为可靠的规划梯度，从而区分有效与无效的探索策略。多步前瞻规划器在可靠不确定性信号下持续优于一步贪心选择，验证了贪心子模最大化(1-1/e)近似保证虽非平凡但仍有提升空间。实际部署中MCTS为推荐方案：以远低于Orienteering的计算成本取得接近最优的重建质量与略优的定位精度，契合资源受限ASV的实时重规划需求。未来工作包括引入证据深度学习以降低推理延迟，以及将框架扩展至多智能体协调感知场景。

Abstract: Informative Path Planning for scalar field reconstruction uses predictive uncertainty to direct sensing vehicles toward maximally informative locations. Gaussian Processes provide this signal but their stationary isotropic kernels are misspecified for non-homogeneous phenomena such as oil spills, producing miscalibrated estimates that degrade planning. We investigate whether replacing the Gaussian Process with a well-calibrated Deep Ensemble improves path planning outcomes, and whether uncertainty quality interacts with the choice of planning algorithm. Five strategies ($\epsilon$-Greedy, Value Greedy, Uncertainty Greedy, Monte Carlo Tree Search, and Receding Horizon Orienteering) share a common Deep Ensemble backbone trained on physics-based oil spill simulations. On held-out stochastic spill scenarios, the Deep Ensemble reduces normalised reconstruction error by $83\%$ relative to the Gaussian Process baseline. Crucially, well-calibrated uncertainty amplifies the importance of the planning strategy: the performance gap between algorithms is negligible under miscalibrated models but becomes substantial under the ensemble, where multi-step lookahead planners outperform greedy selection by up to $32\%$ in reconstruction error and achieve IoU above $0.85$. Monte Carlo Tree Search is the recommended planner, matching Orienteering in reconstruction quality at an order-of-magnitude lower computational cost.

</details>


### [598] [SpeechCritic: Learning a Diagnostic Speech Judge from Limited Human Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34582)
*Mingyue Huo,Shivam Mehta,Bhavin Jawade,Yinghong Lan,Haoqi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SpeechCritic框架，仅用约300条人类偏好对比，训练出一个诊断式语音评判模型（diagnostic speech judge），在参考条件下的跨语言语音比较任务中输出多维度判决（说话人、情感、节奏、发音/口音、音频伪影）及可听证据支撑的推理依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动语音质量评估方法多将语音简化为单一自然度分数，无法反映人类听觉的多维度感知（情感、说话人特征等）；而让现有音频-语言模型零样本充当评判器则存在大量错误与指令遵循不稳定问题。专业人工标注成本极高，因此需要一种从有限人类偏好出发构建可扩展诊断式语音评判器的方法。

Method: 采用"select–calibrate–scale"三阶段流程：(1) Select——基于约300条人类标注开发集，对候选声学测量（说话人相似度、唤醒度偏差、时长偏差+DWT包络、字符错误率等）进行分组交叉验证筛选，保留对每个维度有提升的指标；(2) Calibrate——用L2正则化多项logistic回归将每个保留指标的有符号差距映射为A/Tie/B的概率分布；(3) Scale——冻结上述映射，以"非绑定提示"形式连同原始音频交给机器标注器（Gemini 3.1 Pro），生成超过10,000条带判决与推理依据的监督数据，用于训练7B评判器。学生模型基于Qwen2.5-Omni-7B，比较SFT、OPD（在策略蒸馏）与RL（DAPO/GRPO）三种训练信号；RL仅奖励解析后的判决正确性，不直接奖励文本依据。任务在英语-日语与英语-西班牙语两种语言对上实例化。

Result: 加入校准提示后，相比无提示直接标注，维度级macro-F1提升6.3点（95% CI [3.0, 9.4]），Tie率MAE下降10.4点（CI [7.4, 13.4]），Overall准确率变化不显著（-1.5点）。SFT使Zero-shot Qwen2.5-Omni-7B的Overall准确率从13.10%提升至69.54%；特权OPD（Qwen3-Omni-30B教师）进一步达73.79%，但继承教师弱维度；门控RL在SFT基础上再加约2.3点，且增益集中在高一致性样本。RL虽未直接奖励依据文本，但人类评估者在28例同判决比较中以11:1偏好SFT+RL的依据（p=0.006）。跨语言上单语与联合训练均可迁移，无明显损失。外部VOX-DUB评测中英语-西语模型达38.7 mean macro-F1，接近Gemini 3.1 Pro的40.0。

Conclusion: SpeechCritic证明可从有限人类偏好构建兼具多维度判决与声学可验证推理依据的诊断式语音评判器；SFT建立任务能力、OPD传递教师判决画像、RL锐化被奖励的判决行为，三者构成互补而非线性阶梯。提示而非替代机器标注、冻结的概率映射、判决级奖励等设计可显著改善维度一致性、合理化Tie选择并促进依据的声学定位。但研究也警示：流畅且有说服力的依据仍可能伴随错误判决，应分开评估判决正确性与依据的声学可验证性。

Abstract: Human speech conveys rich perceptual information, such as emotion and speaker identity, yet most automatic speech quality judges reduce it to a single naturalness score. We study diagnostic speech judges: given two candidates, a diagnostic judge decides which is better, along which perceptual dimensions (e.g., timbre, emotion, timing) they differ, and which audible cues support its decision. Learning such judges is challenging: expert annotation is costly, and simply prompting a frontier audio-language model to produce labels is unreliable: our probing reveals substantial errors and unstable instruction following. We introduce SpeechCritic, which learns a diagnostic judge in a reference-conditioned cross-lingual setting from only about 300 human-labeled comparisons. Rather than replacing the frontier model, SpeechCritic calibrates it with these labels: for each dimension, it selects the acoustic measurements that agree with human judgments, maps them to A/Tie/B probabilities, and passes these to the model as non-binding hints alongside the audio. Compared with the same model labeling without hints, this raises dimension-level agreement with humans by 6.3 points and cuts the mismatch with human Tie rates by 10.4 points. We then train a 7B judge on this supervision and find that different training signals shape different judge behaviors: SFT establishes the task, OPD transfers the teacher's dimension-level strengths and weaknesses, and RL helps most on clear-cut comparisons where human raters agree. Notably, human listeners also find that RL makes rationales cite more specific, localized acoustic cues, although it never directly rewards rationale text. Finally, we show that the pipeline is language-pair agnostic by instantiating it on both English-Japanese and English-Spanish. Together, these results demonstrate a path from limited human preferences to a diagnostic speech judge.

</details>


### [599] [TULIP: Targeted LLM Unlearning at Layers Identified Per-Input](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34591)
*Yejin Kim,William F. Shen,Seokwon Jung,Daeun Park,Seong Joon Oh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 TULIP：一种逐输入识别层的 LLM 表征级遗忘方法，通过 logit lens 定位"形成-读取"边界，并在该层去除隐藏状态与遗忘目标的对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表征级遗忘方法（RMU、Adaptive RMU、LUNAR）对整个遗忘集使用单一固定干预层，但 LLM 知识分布在不同层，不同输入的目标"形成"完成层差异很大，固定层不足以覆盖所有样本。

Method: 1) 通过"劫持实验"（将目标模型中间隐藏状态嫁接到仅在保留集训练的 oracle 中）证明目标在中间层即已形成，后续层仅做读取；2) 用 logit lens 逐输入估计形成-读取边界层；3) 在该层施加正交化损失，使隐藏状态与遗忘目标的 unembedding 向量正交，同时保留所有层上的 retain 重建损失。

Result: 在 TOFU（Llama-1B/3B/8B）、PISTOL（Llama2-7B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-4B）和 WMDP（Zephyr-7B）上 consistently 优于 GradDiff/NPO/SimNPO/RMU/LUNAR 等基线，FQ 与 MU 同时更优；对释义攻击和 8-bit 量化稳健；逐输入层选择可作为即插即用模块进一步提升现有方法（如 RMU、GradDiff、NPO、SimNPO）的 MU 至接近 oracle 水平。

Conclusion: 表征级遗忘应针对目标在中间层的"形成"而非"读取"，且干预层应逐输入选取；TULIP 通过 logit lens 估计该边界并施加正交化损失，是该方向的有效基础，未来可探索更精确的边界估计器及对 4-bit 量化更强的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Representation-level unlearning intervenes on the intermediate hidden states of LLMs. Although knowledge is distributed across layers, existing methods operate at a single fixed layer for the entire forget set.
