We ask whether such a fixed layer is sufficient. To answer this, we design a hijacking experiment that grafts hidden states of the target model into an oracle trained only on the retain set. The oracle cannot produce the forget answer on its own, yet it produces the answer from the grafted state. Thus, the answer is formed at an intermediate layer and merely read out afterward, so unlearning should focus on formation, not readout. Moreover, the layer where formation ends varies widely across inputs. Motivated by these findings, we propose Targeted Unlearning at Layers Identified Per-input (TULIP). For each input, TULIP uses the logit lens to locate the formation-readout boundary and removes the hidden state's alignment with the forget answer's unembedding vector there. TULIP consistently outperforms output- and representation-level baselines on TOFU, PISTOL, and WMDP across Llama, Qwen, and Zephyr models. It also remains robust to paraphrase and quantization attacks. Beyond standalone use, its per-input layer selection serves as a plug-and-play component that further improves existing methods.

</details>


### [600] [After the Fix: How Corrected Agent Histories Transfer to Related Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34603)
*Yanfei Zhang,Xu Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究智能体（agent）在完成一次失败任务并接受修复后，其修正后的经验是否在新任务中具有更高的复用价值。通过将同一失败源任务在修复前（U）和修复后（C）分别传递给固定的目标任务B，并在ThinkingBox、APEX-state和APEX-text三个环境、共计3,300次实验运行中，区分"修正增益"（C-U）和"独立执行增益"（C-B-only），研究得出核心观点：修复经验的价值与复用经验的价值是不同的，二者不可混淆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在智能体记忆系统中，常默认将接受修复的失败经验替换为"更好的记忆"。然而修复改善的是源任务本身，而非该经验在新任务中的复用价值。本文旨在回答：同一失败任务在修复前后，其经验对新任务的传递价值有何差异？修复增益是否仅源于更差的未修正版本？修正能否带来超越独立执行的真正增益？

Method: 设计固定目标B的同源对照实验：每个源任务A有U（仅初次失败）和C（继续反馈并接受修复）两个分支；每个分支通过None/Full/Skill/Hybrid/Summary/Execution六种表征以及B-only共11种条件传递给B。三种环境设置：ThinkingBox（100对，文本状态通道）、APEX-state（100对，含649个文件系统项的源状态继承）和APEX-text（100对，仅文本通道，与APEX-state共享相同配对）。采用精确双侧McNemar检验、Holm族校正（9个H1a、9个H1b、6个H2共24个全局检验）、15/16组聚类自举和穷尽组符号翻转检验。分解C–U为八种B-only/U/C结果模式（000–111）。

Result: ThinkingBox中Full/Skill/Hybrid的修正增益分别为44/29/32个百分点，修正后性能较独立执行高出25/22/18个百分点；但Full较Skill多出的15个百分点的修正差距中，有12个点来自更差的未修正表现（U-Full 23% vs U-Skill 35%），而非更好的修正记忆（67% vs 64%）。46个Full向上转移中有22个是恢复已观察到的基线成功（101模式），仅有24个超越两个参考点。APEX两种环境下均未确立可比的整体修正增益。APEX-text的Execution比Summary高12个百分点（52% vs 40%），但不优于独立执行（47%）。较小的交接包减少输入token但增加模型调用。行为证据区分了可复用的工作流义务（思考箱的工单生命周期）与源局部选择（APEX的全年贴现惯例与B要求的中期惯例冲突）。

Conclusion: 修复经验的价值与再利用经验的价值是截然不同的成就。较大的修正增益可能源于较差的未修正记忆，修正后的目标结果可能只是恢复无需记忆即可获得的性能。ThinkingBox在两个参考点之外都取得了成功，而两种APEX环境均未确立可比的整体修正增益。记忆更新应同时对照前序版本（前版本参考）和全新起点（独立执行参考）进行评估，并应保留建议适用的条件。修复重要，但仅源接受度本身并不能说明其经验何时应被复用。

Abstract: Does repairing an episode make its experience a better memory for the next task? We transfer the same failed source before and after accepted repair to a fixed target, alongside independent execution. Our 3,300 runs cover 100 ThinkingBox pairs and the same 100 APEX pairs with and without source-state inheritance, under eleven conditions. ThinkingBox's Full/Skill/Hybrid correction gains are 44/29/32 percentage points, with corrected performance 25/22/18 points above independence; inference weakens at the task-family level. Yet 12 of Full's 15-point larger correction gap over Skill come from worse uncorrected performance, not better corrected memory. Moreover, 22 of Full's 46 upward transitions restore observed baseline success. Neither APEX regime establishes comparable aggregate correction benefits. Action evidence connects workflow gains with reusable obligations and convention conflicts with source-local choices. Text APEX's accepted execution reaches 52% versus its summary's 40%, without robust global/group-level superiority or an estab- lished advantage over independence. Smaller handoffs reduce input but increase calls. The value of repairing experience is therefore distinct from the value of reusing it: memory updates require both a previous-version reference and a fresh-start reference.

</details>


### [601] [LLMs for Executable Multi-Agent System Specification Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34619)
*Andreas Kouvaras,Periklis Mantenoglou,Alexander Artikis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为genRTEC的方法，利用预训练大语言模型（LLMs）从自然语言描述生成多智能体系统（MAS）的可执行规范，其目标语言为运行时事件演算（RTEC）。该方法以零样本方式工作，支持层次和循环依赖，并在电子商务、投票和论证等多个领域进行了广泛的定性和定量评估，证明生成的规范具有高预测准确性且不牺牲推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统（MAS）的规范需要表示智能体行为的时间效应及规范性状态（如权限、义务等），且规范需可执行以支持运行时监控。然而，构建此类规范面临两大难题：一是需要形式语言专业知识，二是传统机器学习方法依赖大规模标注数据，而这些数据在实践中往往不可得。因此，作者旨在利用LLM的自然语言理解与代码生成能力，弥合非形式化描述与可执行时间规范之间的鸿沟。

Method: genRTEC是一种基于提示工程（prompting）的零样本方法，通过精心设计的提示序列引导LLM将自然语言翻译为RTEC规则。提示流程包括：（1）使用Prompt R介绍RTEC核心谓词；（2）使用Prompt S展示简单FVP（initiatedAt/terminatedAt）和静态确定FVP（holdsFor）规则的语法及示例；（3）针对每个MAS，使用Prompt E描述智能体动作，Prompt B描述背景知识，Prompt G逐组件生成规则。方法的关键优化包括：明确告知LLM后续将定义某些构件以处理循环依赖；显式列举定义的多面性（如"第一、第二…"）；鼓励复用已生成的"输出流"以构建层次化知识库。实验使用GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro和Claude Sonnet-4三种LLM，评估指标包括f1分数（预测准确性）、句法相似度（人工修正工作量估计）以及推理时间（效率）。

Result: 在七个应用领域（NET谈判协议、VP投票协议、ARG论证协议、MSA海事态势感知、CTM城市交通管理、ACR活动识别、CG临床指南）的实验表明：（1）至少一个LLM在大多数应用中达到接近完美的f1分数，例如Claude在NET、VP、CTM、ACR中达到完美f1分数，GPT在ARG中达到完美f1分数；（2）生成的规范与手工规范的推理时间相当，未牺牲效率换取准确性；（3）循环依赖未对性能产生显著负面影响。定性分析识别出四类主要错误：逻辑连接词误用（将自然语言中的"或"误译为逻辑"与"）、遗漏规则、流元数（arity）错误、生成冗余规则或条件。其中流元数错误对f1分数和推理效率影响最大。

Conclusion: genRTEC证明预训练LLM能够以零样本方式从简短的自然语言描述生成高质量、可执行的MAS规范，涵盖复杂的层次和循环依赖结构。生成的规范在保持高预测准确性的同时不增加推理开销。未来的研究将探索自修订技术（如利用RTEC编译器提供反馈）和针对特定错误的LLM微调，以进一步减少人工修正工作量。

Abstract: MAS specifications express the effects of the actions of the agents and their environment, as well as other temporal phenomena, such as the intervals during which an agent may perform an action. The specification of a MAS should also be executable in order to allow for run-time monitoring. Constructing the specification of a MAS requires formal language expertise, while machine learning techniques depend on labelled data which are rarely available. To address these issues, we propose `genRTEC', a method that leverages pre-trained Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate executable MAS specifications, in the language of the `Run-Time Event Calculus' (RTEC), from natural language descriptions. genRTEC constructs MAS specifications with complex hierarchical and cyclic dependencies based only on short natural language descriptions of the concepts involved. We present an extensive empirical evaluation of genRTEC, spanning various MAS specifications, including both a qualitative and a quantitative assessment. Our results demonstrate that genRTEC constructs executable MAS specifications of high predictive accuracy without compromising reasoning efficiency.

</details>


### [602] [A Persistent State for Auditable Mixture-of-Experts Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34634)
*Abdurrahman Javat,Allan Kazakov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SA-MoE（Scratchpad-Augmented Mixture-of-Experts），一种为MoE路由器配备低维持久状态的新型架构。该状态仅路由器可见，专家不可访问；每层通过学习到的写入头更新状态，其后更新的实际变化可精确分解为对后续路由边际的贡献，形成"路由账本"。在两个模型族（SmolLM2和Gemma）三种训练种子上的实验表明，该通路增加了不到1%的前向计算开销，但被训练好的路由器广泛使用（局部抑制分别改变87.6%和69.9%的Top-2专家选择），持久累积相比仅保留最新写入的控制组将长程路由可访问性提升19.4和12.2个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的MoE模型虽然在不同层反复将token路由到稀疏的专家子集，但无法提供路由特有的、跨层影响如何累积的记录。这使得理解为何后续路由器偏好某个专家需要推理跨深度累积的影响，但缺乏专门针对路由的计算历史记录机制。虽然其他架构（如RMoE）引入了路由器间的显式记忆，但并未将写入级路由溯源作为前向计算的一等对象。

Method: SA-MoE为每个路由器提供一个低维（128维）持久状态s_ℓ，该状态不提供给专家。路由器logits由z_ℓ = W_x^ℓ x_ℓ + W_s^ℓ s_ℓ + b_ℓ计算。写入头使用tanh激活产生写入提议u_ℓ，持久状态按s_{ℓ+1} = clip(s_ℓ + u_ℓ, -5, 5)累积更新。关键定义是"实现写入"Δs_ℓ = s_{ℓ+1} - s_ℓ。由于s_L = Σ Δs_ℓ，任意后续路由边际可写为m_{s,L}^{a,b} = Σ (W_{s,a}^L - W_{s,b}^L)ᵀ Δs_ℓ，这就是精确的"路由账本"。对照组包括：移除状态通路的普通MoE，以及保持相同状态宽度但采用替换而非累积的"仅最新写入"控制。

Result: 在基于SmolLM2-135M和Gemma-270M稀疏上循环的两个模型族（每族三种独立训练种子42/43/44）上：(1) 架构开销：增加不到1%的活跃参数和分析前向FLOPs；(2) 状态使用：局部抑制状态贡献时，SmolLM2的87.6%和Gemma的69.9%路由决策中Top-2专家集发生变化；(3) 持久性效益：相比仅最新写入控制，长程（4-8层）未来路由可访问性提升19.4pp（SmolLM2）和12.2pp（Gemma），所有种子均为正向；(4) 分布式历史：超过90%的绝对账本贡献来自非最近写入，有效源支持分别为9.49和5.82个写入；(5) 干预效果：账本选定的写入抑制会改变后续路由和输出分布；(6) 排名比较：账本分数与干预效应的Spearman相关性（0.369/0.823）强于最大写入范数，但梯度×写入更强（0.769/0.890）。

Conclusion: SA-MoE提供了一个补充性的设计点：将路由特有的溯源直接表示为模型计算中的一个紧凑状态、明确的源事件序列，以及用于追溯查询和干预的原生对象。路由账本是精确的前向溯源对象，而非路由的完整因果解释。梯度感知方法可以更好地预测完整前向干预效果，且后置方法（Li等2026）可在无需架构修改的情况下恢复相关的跨层归因。实验覆盖两个模型族和三个种子，复制了主要效应，但更大规模MoE的行为仍待验证。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models repeatedly route tokens to sparse subsets of experts, but conventional routers expose no routing-specific record of how cross-layer influences accumulate. We introduce Scratchpad-Augmented Mixture-of-Experts (SA-MoE), which gives each router access to a low-dimensional persistent state that is not provided to the experts. Learned layerwise writes update this state, and their realized post-update changes exactly decompose the state-mediated contribution to any later routing margin, forming a routing ledger. Across sparsely upcycled SmolLM2- and Gemma-based models and three independent training seeds per architecture, this pathway adds less than 1% analytical forward compute and is strongly used by trained routers: local removal of its router contribution changes the selected Top-2 expert set in 87.6% and 69.9% of decisions, respectively. Relative to a matched latest-write-only control, persistent accumulation increases long-horizon future-routing accessibility by 19.4 and 12.2 percentage points, with positive effects in every seed. More than 90% of absolute ledger contribution comes from non-recent writes in both families, and full-forward suppression of ledger-selected writes changes later routing and output distributions. The ledger is an exact provenance object for the persistent-state pathway, not a complete causal explanation of routing. Sensitivity-aware scores better predict full-forward intervention effects, and post-hoc methods recover related cross-layer attribution without architectural modification. SA-MoE instead makes one routing-specific computational history explicit and directly inspectable within the model's natural forward computation.

</details>


### [603] [MechReasoner: A Simulator and Benchmark for Mechanistic Reasoning in Qualitative Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34636)
*Danilo Gusicuma,André Freitas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MechReasoner是一个基于合流定性物理学的机制推理基准测试，包含1,120道确定性生成的任务，覆盖18种机制和6类任务族，用于评估大语言模型是否能基于底层结构和因果约束进行可靠的机制推理。GPT-5.5的准确率随机制复杂性增加而显著下降，从B1桶的76.1%降至B4桶的38.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的大语言模型虽然能生成流畅的机制描述，但这些描述往往不能可靠地从底层的结构和因果约束中推导出来。现有基准很少评分"机制"与"声明"之间的对应关系，无法区分可能结论与必要结论，也未保留转换和推导证据。因此需要一种可审计、可执行的定性模拟器作为语义参考，构建一个评估机制推理能力的基准。

Method: 1) 基于合流（confluence）的定性物理学构建机制表示，包含组件实例、拓扑、局部约束、状态依赖域限制和转换声明；2) 使用内状态求解器计算每个复合状态的合法解释集，使用独立的模拟会话构建情节图（episode graph）；3) 设计6类任务族——状态一致性、情节路径合理性、必要性、情节图转换、功能恢复和轨迹忠实性；4) 对9个模型端点（包括GPT-5.5、o3、DeepSeek-R1等）进行直接推理评估，按机制复杂性分桶（B1-B4）；5) 使用OpenModelica进行独立的定量-定性一致性验证（341个观察场景）。

Result: GPT-5.5获得最高端到端准确率60.9%，o3为32.2%，DeepSeek-R1为16.9%。所有模型在高复杂性桶（B4）的表现均低于低复杂性桶（B1）；GPT-5.5从76.1%降至38.0%，九个模型池化后从23.7%降至8.7%。调整提示词和答案长度控制后，负相关仍然成立（每桶比值比0.619，95%区间[0.547, 0.701]）。组件级部分得分明显高于精确准确率，表明结构化答案常包含正确组件但未能形成一致的最终判断。提示文本符号基线通过重构任务类型并执行公共定性语义实现100%准确率。OpenModelica定量检查显示341个场景中339个直接一致、2个边界兼容、0个矛盾。

Conclusion: 定性模拟器能够为NLP基准提供可审计的机制推理测试基础。机制推理需要基于合法解释集和可达情节路径来评判声明，复杂性增加显著降低LLM表现，部分结构恢复常无法产生连贯的整体判断。基准证明了可执行机制模型作为评估参考的可行性，为未来构建更具挑战性的机制推理评估提供了方向。

Abstract: This work introduces MechReasoner, a mechanistic qualitative simulator grounded in confluence-based qualitative physics, together with a benchmark for mechanistic inference. Current large language models (LLMs) generate fluent mechanistic descriptions that do not reliably follow from underlying structural and causal constraints. The benchmark tests whether answers preserve simulator-licensed ambiguity, quantified claims, episode-graph transition evidence, repairs, and trace-support judgments. Its 1,120 items are generated deterministically from admissible interpretation sets, component states, scenario restrictions, confluence constraints, and derivation steps across 18 catalog mechanisms and six task families. Each mechanism undergoes converter checks of structure and topology and behavioral checks against quantitative simulations. GPT-5.5 accuracy decreases as family-specific mechanistic complexity increases, from 76.1% in the lowest-complexity bucket (B1) to 38.0% in the highest-complexity bucket (B4). The negative association remains after controls for rendered-prompt and expected-answer length. These results show that qualitative simulators can support auditable NLP benchmarks for mechanistic inference.

</details>


### [604] [Beyond Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Context Management Policies for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34649)
*Weiyuan Li,Jinghan Xu,Aili Chen,Xintao Wang,Shuang Liang,Jiaqing Liang,Deqing Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ContextEvo框架，针对长时程任务中将"上下文管理"作为可演化策略的harness进化方法，通过重构轨迹证据、归因诊断和约束性策略更新，在三个长时程基准上达到与主流agent harness相当或更优的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的harness进化方法（基于经验或技能）在长时程任务中效果有限，因为长交互产生的冗余或过时上下文会埋没关键证据，使得"上下文管理"本身成为性能瓶颈。固定或局部调整的上下文策略难以适应不同任务环境的信息压力。

Method: ContextEvo将上下文策略形式化为三维度（Input Assembly输入组装、History Maintenance历史维护、Context Orchestration上下文编排），通过三阶段进化循环运作：（1）轨迹证据重构——扫描信息流并分页回溯关键决策点的模型可见上下文；（2）失败归因与目标识别——基于跨案例对比和反事实重放，识别失败类型（missing/degraded/buried/polluted）和策略维度；（3）约束性策略更新——基于八个干预点（observation projector、compaction planner、summary writer、memory writer、memory retriever、context assembler、child context builder、child result reducer）修改、组合或引入新实现。进化在固定基座模型下进行，使用held-in/held-out任务划分。

Result: 在LHTB-46、DeepSWE-113、BrowseComp-Plus hard174三个基准上，基于Pi-agent起点，使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash和GPT-5.6-Luna两种基座模型，ContextEvo在多数设置下取得最佳或次佳全基准分（如LHTB全分45.3%，DeepSWE 71.7%，BrowseComp-Plus 88.5%），优于Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw等主流harness。两轮迭代可获得持续增益。相比纯技能进化（reward 0.370，9.61M tokens），ContextEvo以更少token（7.52M）达到更高reward（0.448）。消融实验表明分页轨迹回溯最关键（去除后下降12.15pp）。策略在不同环境产生差异化机制（LHTB侧重选择性观察渲染与状态保护，DeepSWE侧重规约与验证连续性，BrowseComp-Plus侧重可恢复证据组织），并可在同环境跨模型迁移但不可跨环境可靠迁移。跨harness验证显示ContextEvo在OpenCode和OpenClaw上同样有效。

Conclusion: ContextEvo将harness进化从规则/技能层面拓展到全生命周期上下文策略层面，通过基于证据的诊断与约束性更新，能够针对不同长时程任务环境自适应调整上下文管理方式，在多个基准上达到与主流agent harness相当或更优的性能，同时显著降低token消耗。其局限在于：跨案例证据支持归因假设，反事实重放仅测量决策级局部敏感性，不构成任务级因果奖励贡献。

Abstract: Harness evolution improves LLM agents by learning from execution trajectories, but existing experience- and skill-based methods are less effective on long-horizon tasks. As interactions grow, useful evidence can be buried by redundant or outdated context, making context management itself a key bottleneck. We introduce ContextEvo, a framework that learns a context policy from long-horizon trajectories. ContextEvo reconstructs the model-visible context at key decision points, identifies context-related failures, and applies targeted policy updates. Starting from the open-source Pi-agent harness, ContextEvo improves performance across three long-horizon task benchmarks, achieving results comparable to or better than several prominent agent harnesses, including Codex, OpenCode, and OpenClaw. Additional analyses show that fixed or locally evolved context strategies can fall short under long-horizon information pressure, while our methods adapt to the information demands of each environment.

</details>


### [605] [OmniTide: Co-Designing Algorithms and Systems for Efficient On-Device Omni-LLM Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34653)
*Zongshang Shen,Wangsong Yin,Daliang Xu,Mengwei Xu,Xuanzhe Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OmniTide是首个面向端侧流式全模态推理的算法-系统协同设计框架，通过OmniPick（基于单元结构的逻辑令牌选择）和OmniPage（基于保留状态的物理KV分页与选择性迁移）两个组件，解决多模态流式推理中KV缓存单调增长导致的内存与计算瓶颈问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧部署全模态LLM（如实时语音/视频助手）可保护隐私并消除API费用，但面临关键瓶颈：连续多模态输入导致KV缓存单调增长。以MiniCPM-o-4.5在Apple M2 Pro上为例，仅6.25分钟输入即产生近80K tokens、消耗约23 GiB内存（超出消费级设备典型16 GiB容量），per-chunk prefill延迟劣化2.5×（28s→69s），注意力核计算时间激增19.5×。现有稀疏注意力方法要么在线估计开销过高（H₂O占注意力时间33.02%），要么破坏跨模态交错上下文（位置式方法如StreamingLLM在StreamingBench上掉点高达17.1个百分点），且均未解决物理内存碎片化问题（动态压缩开销可达流循环59.6%）。

Method: 核心抽象是"单元"（unit）——单个时间块内交错的图像、音频、文本令牌及其结构标记。基于此：(1) 算法层OmniPick：由三项观察驱动——单元与模态局部sink（注意力在单元起始与模态边界处汇聚）、近期上下文集中（查询倾向于关注邻近令牌）、模态不对称注意力（音频等信息密度更高的模态需更高保留优先级）。当历史超过高水位线时，OmniPick确定性保留完整近期单元+受保护的系统前缀+从旧单元中按模态重要性分配的sink跨度，并更新相对位置编码（RoTE调整）。(2) 系统层OmniPage：基于保留似然对KV进行类感知分页（tile-aligned paging），将must-keep、selected-history、recent-context三类条目分页存放以减少碎片化；超过高水位线后执行选择性迁移（仅在计划能减少活跃page/subblock数量或缩短物理跨度时执行），避免全量压缩开销。实现基于llama.cpp-omni（约9.6K行新增），支持Qwen2.5-Omni-3B/7B和MiniCPM-o-4.5，部署于CUDA（RTX 4090）和Metal（Apple M2 Pro）。

Result: 在3个模型、3个流式基准（StreamingBench、SVBench、LiveSports-3K-CC）上的评估：(1) 速度——注意力核最高12.72×加速，流循环延迟最高2.40×降低（Qwen-7B CUDA session从51.71s降至21.52s）；(2) 质量——StreamingBench上比滑窗基线最高提升18.0个百分点（vs H₂O/Token-basic），OmniPick与全上下文基线精度差异在±0.3–+2.1之间（保持或略超）；(3) 物理存储——OmniPage相对原生逻辑淘汰额外缩短26.7%（Qwen）/10.0%（MiniCPM）的物理KV跨度，注意力GPU时间降低26.1%（prefill）/22.5%（decode），达到全量压缩oracle收益的82–88%；(4) 极端案例——在4 GiB预算下，Qwen-7B处理220K tokens的241秒流仅用0.164 GiB物理KV（vs 全上下文67秒即膨胀至3.5 GiB），最高64K窗口下生成速率达109.9 tokens/s。

Conclusion: OmniTide通过算法-系统协同设计，在不重训练的前提下有效解决了端侧流式全模态推理的KV缓存增长瓶颈：OmniPick的单元感知结构化保留策略在有界历史预算下最大化任务精度，OmniPage的保留似然驱动分页与选择性迁移将逻辑淘汰转化为实际的注意力计算节省。系统解锁了消费级设备上实时、无限上下文流式全模态推理的可行性，为隐私敏感的实时交互场景（如语音/视频助手）提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: On-device streaming omni-modal inference safeguards user privacy and eliminates prohibitive per-token API costs, but faces a critical bottleneck: the continuous influx of multimodal data rapidly exhausts constrained memory and compute budgets via monotonic KV cache growth. Existing sparse attention methods fall short, either incurring prohibitive online estimation latency or destroying interleaved cross-modal context, while failing to resolve physical memory fragmentation. We present OmniTide, the first algorithm-system co-design tailored for efficient on-device streaming omni-modal inference. Driven by the observation of modality-aware structural sparsity, OmniTide adopts a unit-based abstraction with two components: (1) At the algorithm level, OmniPick logically retains critical multimodal context based on unit boundaries and modality importance to preserve task accuracy; (2) At the system level, OmniPage physically partitions the cache by retention likelihood and dynamically compacts surviving sparse tokens, minimizing both memory fragmentation and data-movement overhead. Extensive evaluations across three streaming benchmarks and two consumer-device architectures show that OmniTide achieves up to $12.72\times$ kernel speedups and $2.40\times$ lower stream-loop latency. On StreamingBench, it improves accuracy by up to 18.0 percentage points over sliding-window baselines at comparable session cost. OmniPage further reduces the physical KV span by up to 26.7% relative to native logical eviction, unlocking real-time, infinite-context streaming on edge devices.

</details>


### [606] [A General Harness for Protein Foundation Model Fitness Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34654)
*Yang Tan,Qijia Tian,Gangyu Sun,Bozitao Zhong,Mingchen Li,Yuanxi Yu,Nanqing Dong,Liang Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出VenusREM-Harness（VRH），一个通用的、模型无关的、免训练的检索增强突变预测框架，用于蛋白质基础模型的适应性预测。该框架通过自适应MSA融合、相干门控校准和结构调节三个组件，将冻结的模型分数与进化和结构证据相结合。在1,211个实验和310万个变体上验证，71种配置在三个基准上均提升Spearman相关性，基于此构建的VenusREM2在ProteinGym上达到0.556的SOTA成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质适应性预测对蛋白质工程至关重要。现有蛋白质基础模型（PFM）存在两个关键局限：(1) 模型的氨基酸偏好紧密反映其训练语料库的组成，存在系统性偏差；(2) 不可靠的输入会扭曲预测结果。虽然同源序列进化证据和结构上下文可以提供互补约束，但现有方法（如Tranception和VenusREM）使用固定权重，忽略了家族-语料库偏好不匹配的问题。

Method: VRH是一个免训练的检索增强突变预测框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 自适应MSA融合——根据模型不确定性、野生型支持和模型-MSA一致性，导出蛋白质特定的尺度感知混合权重α；(2) 相干门控校准——通过门控机制κ(R)校正共享的模型背景偏差，同时保留家族证据；(3) 结构调节——基于相对溶剂暴露（RSA）和结构置信度（pLDDT）对位点分数进行收缩。框架定义了统一的分数场接口R∈ℝ^(L×20)，支持masked、wild-type和teacher forcing三种评分接口。

Result: 在1,211个实验（ProteinGym 217个、VenusMutHub 905个、新策划的VenusViroHub 89个）和约310万测量变体上，71种配置在所有三个基准上均提升Spearman相关性，平均提升0.073。基于6个ProSST变体（K∈{20,128,512,1024,2048,4096}）的集成模型VenusREM2在ProteinGym官方评估中达到Average Spearman 0.556，超过此前最佳基线（AIDO Protein-RAG）0.038，在所有17个功能、物种、MSA深度和突变深度层级中均排名第一。计算效率方面，变异查找速度提升20.7倍，MSA构建速度提升62.3倍。

Conclusion: VRH是一个通用、高效的推理层，通过整合进化证据和结构上下文来减轻模型偏差并解释不确定性，可在不重新训练的情况下提升任何冻结PFM的预测能力。基于VRH构建的VenusREM2在蛋白质适应性预测基准上创造了新的最先进水平。VenusViroHub作为一个新策划的病毒蛋白突变效应预测基准，扩展了对免疫逃逸等病毒特异性表型的评估能力。未来的工作可以探索可训练的MSA表示和融合，以及整合蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用和蛋白质-小分子输入。

Abstract: Accurate fitness prediction is central to protein engineering and understanding sequence-function relationships. With advances in deep learning, protein foundation models (PFMs) have become widely used for this task. Recent analyses, however, show that these models share preferences reflecting their training corpora, while unreliable inputs can further distort fitness predictions. Family-specific evolutionary evidence and structural context can help address these limitations by providing complementary constraints on model scores, motivating VenusREM-Harness (VRH), a general, model-agnostic, training-free Retrieval-Enhanced Mutation harness. It fuses frozen model scores with multiple sequence alignment (MSA) evidence according to model uncertainty, then applies gated background correction and score shrinkage based on structural confidence and solvent exposure. Across 1,211 assays and 3.1 million measured variants from ProteinGym, VenusMutHub, and the newly curated viral benchmark VenusViroHub, all 71 configurations improve Spearman correlation on all 3 benchmarks by 0.073 on average, with broad gains across 5 metrics. Extended analyses relate retrieval gains to model-MSA preference differences, assess domain-level gains and immune-escape cases, and quantify computational speedups. Built with VRH, VenusREM2 is the first to rank highest in all function, taxon, MSA-depth, and mutation-depth categories, with a ProteinGym Average Spearman of 0.556, 0.038 above the prior best.

</details>


### [607] [Jailbreak Context Lingers: Divergent Safety Routing and Its Cross-Task Predictability in Tool Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34686)
*Xi Wang,Songlei Jian,Yiming Zhang,Bin Ji,Zhaoye Li,Ma Jun,Baosheng Wang,Jie Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型作为工具调用智能体时，越狱上下文对后续安全反馈行为的影响。作者提出配对延续框架，在192个任务上系统评估8个智能体，发现安全反馈并非统一保护，而是产生三种发散路由：救援、持续不安全、附带损失。通过层级激活修补发现安全决策集中在最终层的"晚期提交模式"，并证明这些关键层表征可预测未见过任务的路由结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 越狱上下文在多轮交互中可能持续影响智能体行为，而安全反馈作为运行时防护机制的有效性尚不清楚。现有研究主要关注攻击迁移性和静态护栏，对越狱上下文如何调控智能体对安全反馈的响应缺乏系统性理解。

Method: 1) 配对延续框架：在192个父任务（42个领域）上构建匹配的风险混合（R）和良性（B）变体，在两个预动作检查点冻结状态，交叉保留（J⁺）和中和（J⁰）越狱上下文与中性提醒（N）/安全反馈（S），共生成12,288对延续轨迹；2) 层级激活修补：将S→N替换隐藏状态，测量各层干预效果；3) 在8个智能体上评估三种发散结果：救援、持续不安全、附带损失；4) 留一父任务交叉验证（LOPO）预测路由结果。

Result: 1) 8个智能体表现出显著模型依赖的发散路由，Qwen3-14B持续不安全率高达85.7%而Qwen3.6-27B仅1.0%；2) 发现跨模型"晚期提交模式"，干预效果集中在相对深度0.958-0.984的最终层，峰值效应差异达30倍；3) 关键层修补对下一步工具动作具有因果调控效力，在大多数智能体中显著优于半深度和随机控制；4) LOPO预测峰值ROC AUC分别达0.675（救援）、0.777（附带损失）、0.702（持续不安全），验证关键层作为预测基线的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文建立了系统性的安全反馈路由分析框架，揭示越狱上下文使安全反馈从统一保护转变为不可预测的路由操作器，产生安全缓解与任务效用之间的复杂权衡。通过机制分析确认最终层的因果决策承诺作用，并提供基于局部干预特征的预测基线，为自主智能体安全部署中的安全-效用权衡预判奠定基础。

Abstract: As large language models increasingly operate as tool-using agents, post-jailbreak safety feedback is often assumed to serve as a reliable safeguard; however, how lingering jailbreak context shapes subsequent agent behavior remains largely unexplored. To systematically examine this dynamic, we introduce a paired continuation framework across 192 parent tasks spanning 42 domains, evaluating 12,148 analyzed continuation pairs (curated from a 12,288-pair initially design) across eight diverse agents. We find that identical safety feedback induces sharply model-dependent behavioral routing rather than uniform protection: redirecting unsafe trajectories toward legitimate completion (\emph{rescue}), sustaining unauthorized execution (\emph{persistent unsafe}), or triggering over-refusal on benign tasks (\emph{collateral loss}). Through layer-wise activation patching, we discover a shared \emph{late-commit pattern} where causal intervention effects surge sharply near the final layers (relative depths of 0.958--0.984) despite an over 30-fold variation in peak magnitude across architectures. Crucially, critical-layer representations correlate with macroscopic routing outcomes, and intervening at these layers causally alters concrete next-step tool actions. Building on this causal foundation, we test whether localized intervention-derived features can serve as predictive proxies for full-trajectory routing outcomes on unseen parent tasks under leave-one-parent-task-out evaluation, finding that they provide viable predictive signals in responsive agents with peak ROC AUCs reaching 0.675 for \emph{rescue}, 0.777 for \emph{collateral loss}, and 0.702 for \emph{persistent unsafe}. These findings establish a mechanistic lens and a predictive baseline for anticipating the safety and utility trade-offs of post-jailbreak feedback in autonomous agents.

</details>


### [608] [VCN-Bench: A Video-Contextualized Navigation Benchmark for Spatial Reasoning over Prior Visual Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34687)
*Siqi Zhang,Meng Wei,Chenyang Wan,Shaohao Zhu,Shufan Shen,Xihui Liu,Zhihua Wei,Tai Wang,Jiangmiao Pang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VCN-Bench是一个基于Matterport3D的视频上下文导航基准，专门用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在闭环空间推理上的能力。给定覆盖起点和目标位置的先验视频，智能体需推理指令指定的目标并进行导航。基准包含五种指令类型、10万训练集和1250个评估集。作者还提出MV-DualVLN基线方法，联合利用先验视频和episode内观测进行规划。实验揭示了有限的导航性能、显著的目标解析到导航的差距，以及即使正确识别目标后仍频繁出现导航失败的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间推理基准通常以离线预测结束，而导航基准将空间推理与指令跟随和探索混合评估，难以表征空间知识如何被推断并用于指导后续导航。需要一个能评估MLLMs能否将先验视觉经验中的空间理解转化为有效闭环导航决策的基准。

Method: VCN-Bench基于Matterport3D构建，包含五种指令类型（Instance、Count、Order、Distance、Orientation），分为Object Goal和Room-to-Object (R2O) Goal两类。评估采用双协议：以导航为主任务，以目标识别（goal identification）为诊断任务，区分目标解析错误与导航失败。基线方法MV-DualVLN基于DualVLN的System 2架构，输入包括指令、下采样至50帧的先验视频、导航历史、初始位置多视角观测和当前多视角观测，通过特征池化处理长输入，并在像素空间中预测导航路径点。

Result: 所有评估方法均面临显著挑战，最佳MV-DualVLN仅达到27.6% SR（成功率）。诊断目标识别揭示即使去除闭环交互，模型仍远低于人类表现（Gemini-3-Flash-Thinking平均Rid-SR为45.0%，人类为89.6%）。MV-DualVLN平均Rid-SR为43.1%但RSR仅31.7%，存在11.4个百分点的目标解析-导航差距。正确识别目标后，P(N|G)=37.8%，仍有62.2%的episode即使目标正确也导航失败。视频帧数与Qwen3-VL性能呈负相关，但Gemini-3对视频长度较鲁棒。消融实验证明先验视频和导航历史均不可或缺，反事实关系干预和视频打乱均导致性能显著下降。

Conclusion: VCN-Bench揭示了当前MLLMs在闭环空间推理方面的局限性——目标解析和导航执行均存在瓶颈，且即使目标正确识别，导航仍频繁失败。这为未来研究指明了方向，包括处理环境变化、扩展评估场景覆盖、探索替代视觉表征（文本场景描述、结构化场景图）以增强记忆压缩和空间理解。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to embodied agents, yet it remains unclear whether spatial understanding can be carried forward to guide sequential interactions. Existing spatial-reasoning benchmarks typically terminate at offline predictions, while navigation benchmarks evaluate spatial reasoning as part of instruction following and exploration. We introduce VCN-Bench, a \textbf{V}ideo-\textbf{C}ontextualized \textbf{N}avigation benchmark for probing closed-loop spatial reasoning over prior visual experience in MLLMs. Given a prior video covering both the initial location and destination, the agent is tasked with reasoning out the instruction-specified target and navigating toward it with the inferred spatial context. Built on Matterport3D, VCN-Bench contains five instruction types, 100k training episodes, and 1,250 evaluation episodes. Navigation serves as the primary evaluation, while diagnostic goal identification helps distinguish destination-resolution errors from subsequent navigation failures. We further propose MV-DualVLN, a planning-oriented baseline that jointly leverages prior video and in-episode observations. Experiments reveal limited navigation performance, a substantial destination-resolution-to-navigation gap, and frequent navigation failures even after correct destination identification.

</details>


### [609] [ResonAct: Streaming Metrics for Runtime Diagnosis and Self-Healing in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34701)
*Tarun Chintada,Neelamadhav Gantayat,Ishaan Romil,Renuka Sindhgatta,Soujanya Soni,Sameep Mehta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ResonAct 是一个面向基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）的运行时自愈框架，通过流式操作指标实现执行期间的持续监控、故障检测、根因定位和策略驱动修复，作为外部控制平面运行而无需修改智能体或编排逻辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统在自动化企业工作流时面临多种执行时故障（工具退化、上下文传播错误、协调中断、循环重复等），现有可观测性工具主要在执行后进行诊断和修复，导致长运行任务中异常行为造成大量不必要的计算开销，且缺乏通用运行时干预机制。

Method: ResonAct 通过 Langfuse 捕获智能体交互、工具调用和执行轨迹事件，经 Kafka 流式传输，构建包含查询级、代理级和工具级三个层次的运行时指标体系（基于计数、嵌入和 LLM-as-judge 三种机制）。采用结构化失败模型（Common/Silent/Critical 三类）将特定指标与检测规则映射；通过连续 r 个评估周期的稳定性过滤抑制瞬态误报；由 LLM 进行反思诊断后，由修复决策引擎选择 LLM 策略或确定性策略，在智能体调用边界注入修正指导。

Result: 在 Sales MAS 和 AppWorld MAS 两个场景下，使用 Granite-8B 和 Qwen3-8B 两种 8B 模型评估：检测精度 70.59%-82.91%，召回率 63.09%-100%；任务完成率提升 4.76-10.00 个百分点，恢复率 10.48%-46.67%；运行时开销 -0.25% 至 14.12%，CPU 和内存变化均较温和；Granite-8B Sales 场景中重试成功率高达 97.7%。已作为技术预览集成至 IBM watsonx Orchestrate。

Conclusion: ResonAct 通过可解释的流式指标实现无需模型训练或逐步 LLM 判断的运行时检测与修复，在所有评估配置中均提升任务完成率，验证了外部控制平面架构的有效性；发现存在检测质量、恢复难度与运行时成本的权衡，工作负载感知的检测器校准与选择性干预策略是未来重要方向。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly used to automate enterprise workflows involving multiple specialized agents, external tools, and long-running task execution. Failures may arise from tool degradation, context propagation errors, coordination breakdowns, or repeated agent interactions that prevent task completion. While existing observability frameworks provide traces and logs, diagnosis and remediation are largely performed after execution completes, limiting opportunities for recovery during runtime. We present ResonAct, a runtime self-healing framework that enables continuous monitoring, diagnosis, and remediation of multi-agent systems through streaming operational metrics. ResonAct ingests execution traces, agent interactions, and tool invocations into a streaming analytics layer that continuously derives task progress, context health, and tool reliability metrics. These metrics serve as runtime control signals for detecting anomalous execution patterns and localizing root causes using a structured failure model. Based on the diagnosed failure, ResonAct dynamically selects remediation policies and performs actions. The framework operates as an external control plane, enabling intervention without modifying application agents or orchestration logic. We evaluate ResonAct across enterprise workflow scenarios and AppWorld benchmarks. The results show that the streaming metric-based analysis identifies execution degradations and localizes faults. Furthermore, policy-driven remediation improves task completion rates by up to 10.00 percentage points, with detection precision ranging from 70.59% to 82.91%, recall from 63.09% to 100%, recovery rates from 10.48% to 46.67%, and runtime overhead ranging from $-0.25%$ to 14.12% across the evaluated configurations.

</details>


### [610] [FromPitch2Board: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Long-Horizon Football Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34710)
*Peiyu Zang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FromPitch2Board 是一个确定性的足球管理智能体基准测试，通过在单一模拟器上控制五个可配置因素（基础模型、Agent 框架/脚手架、责任范围、比赛控制粒度、任务跨度），使用配对种子和冻结校准进行受控对比，旨在揭示长周期智能体表现的来源归因问题，而非仅仅报告单一终点分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长周期智能体基准（如 WebArena、SWE-bench、τ-bench、FM-Bench、Vending-Bench 等）通常只报告端点进度分数，无法将性能差异归因于基础模型、Agent 脚手架、责任范围、比赛控制粒度或时间跨度中的某个具体因素。论文指出功能性组合（functional composition）和时间持续性（temporal persistence）是长周期智能体的两个独立但未被现有基准在同一受控环境中联合测试的问题。

Method: 基于开源足球管理模拟器 Openfoot Manager 构建确定性环境（通过键控随机流实现按种子可重放）。五个可配置因素：(1) 责任范围（Coach→Recruiter→Manager 三级阶梯）；(2) 比赛控制粒度（赛前决策 vs 含第30/45/60/75分钟检查点的赛中干预）；(3) 任务跨度（1/3/10 赛季）；(4) 基础模型（DS Flash、DS Pro、Opus 5、GPT-5.6）；(5) Agent 脚手架（自有 stateless、Pi、Claude Code、Codex）。四个预算/阵容场景（crisis、moneyball、rebuild、title）。配对种子评估+100种子冻结贪婪参考校准的 Z 分数归一化。共 640 集主排行榜评估（4场景×8种子×2责任范围×10配置）。诊断指标：Composition Gap、责任阶梯、跳过决策率、出价接受率、10赛季轨迹等。

Result: （1）模型轨道：Coach Z 分数跨度仅 0.19，Manager Z 跨度 0.68，GPT-5.6 责任扩展后从 Recruiter 58.1 分跌至 Manager 46.8 分，跳过决策率从 1.1% 升至 57.9%，行为签名是被动性而非无效动作；（2）脚手架效应：在 Flash–Pro 模型对上，脚手架选择使 Manager Z 分数变化最高达 0.48，而 Pro–Flash 模型差仅 −0.08 至 +0.09 Z；（3）时间持续性：3 年队列在第1年和第3年均排名出现方向反转；Claude Code+Pro 的 10 年轨迹在第 3 年达峰（85.4 分）后回落，第 6 年降至 47.1 分；（4）成本：DS Pro 在 Manager 范围上优于 Opus 5 和 GPT-5.6，成本却低 18–22 倍。

Conclusion: 功能性组合不是单调的（GPT-5.6 从 Coach 到 Recruiter 改善，但在完整管理责任下失去该收益，行为变得明显被动）；3 年结果显示出平均排名的方向反转，10 年轨迹早期达峰后持续低于该峰值。模型–脚手架交叉允许将某些效应定位到被测试的因素，而不是将每个智能体结果视为模型的固有属性。智能体结果应作为配置级而非仅模型级的属性来报告。

Abstract: Long-horizon agent benchmarks typically report how far an agent progresses, but do not identify whether its performance comes from the foundation model, scaffold, responsibility scope, match-control granularity, or horizon. We introduce FromPitch2Board, a deterministic football-management benchmark that studies five configurable factors through controlled comparisons on a single simulator, using paired seeds and a frozen calibration. We evaluate four foundation models and four agent scaffolds. In the Model Track, Coach points Z-scores span 0.19, while Manager points Z-scores span 0.68, with GPT-5.6 showing a sharp rise in passivity under responsibility expansion. Its responsibility ladder rises from 46.1 to 58.1 points with recruitment, then falls to 46.8 under full management, localizing the regression to the final responsibility boundary. Across that boundary, its skipped-decision rate rises from 1.1% to 57.9%. Within the Flash-Pro pair crossed across every scaffold, scaffold choice changes Manager points Z-scores by up to 0.48 relative to the fixed stateless scaffold. The 3Y cohort shows a directional reversal in mean ranking between years one and three, while a selected Claude Code+Pro configuration peaks in year three and remains below that peak, showing that responsibility scope and horizon expose behavior changes that a single headline score conceals.

</details>


### [611] [RSI-Router: Evolving Subtask-Level LLM Routing and Skills for Cost-Efficient Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34712)
*Hao Li,Hangfan Zhang,Zhiyao Cui,Chunjiang Mu,Yiqun Zhang,Bo Zhang,Danyang Jia,Shuyue Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RSI-router是一种用于LLM代理任务(subtask级别)的大-小模型协作路由框架，通过递归自我改进同时优化模型分配和模型特定执行技能，在五个智能体基准上以约一半推理成本超越纯大模型基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视野智能体任务中，不同阶段对模型能力需求不同；任务级路由无法利用小模型处理部分阶段的能力，步级路由则面临探索成本高、信用分配困难的问题。需要一种能在子任务级别协作大-小模型、并通过执行反馈持续优化路由和执行技能的框架。

Method: 四阶段递归进化循环：(1) Subtask Mining——从训练轨迹中挖掘可复用的子任务定义与识别规则；(2) Routing Strategy Evolution——在子任务级别并行探索多种模型分配方案；(3) Model-Specific Skill Evolution——对比路由后轨迹与纯大模型轨迹，诊断失败模式并生成模型特定的可复用执行技能；(4) Pareto-Optimal Router Selection——基于验证集性能与成本维护非支配Pareto前沿，保留被支配路由器作为后续进化负例。推理阶段由小模型预测子任务、选取模型并附加对应执行技能。

Result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop、SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0五个基准上，RSI-router平均降低推理成本51.7%（8.1%–82.2%），同时匹配或超越DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash纯大模型基线；在ALFWorld成功率从90.62%提升至98.44%且成本降低75.3%，Terminal-Bench 2.0从40.00%提升至46.67%且成本降低18.0%；Pareto前沿优于9种路由基线（HybridLLM、FrugalGPT、RouteLLM、GraphRouter、Avengers-Pro、Router-R1、MTRouter等）。消融实验验证了子任务识别与执行技能设计的有效性。

Conclusion: 递归自我改进范式可有效构造成本感知的子任务级路由策略；通过可复用子任务和模型特定执行技能，小模型能够贡献于其无法独立完成的任务，从而在性能-成本权衡上同时实现提升；累积执行经验的复用支撑了跨迭代的成本持续下降。

Abstract: Practical deployment of large language model (LLM) agents requires strong task performance at affordable inference cost. For long-horizon agentic tasks, this performance-cost trade-off can be improved through within-task large-small model collaboration, as smaller models can handle some stages even when they cannot solve the full task. In this paper, we introduce RSI-router, a routing framework that constructs subtask-level model assignments and model-specific skills through recursive self-improvement over accumulated experience. Each iteration consists of four stages: Subtask Mining derives subtask definitions and identification rules from training trajectories; Routing Strategy Evolution proposes and evaluates diverse model assignments; Model-Specific Skill Evolution compares routed and large-model-only trajectories to diagnose failures and develop reusable execution skills; and Pareto-Optimal Router Selection updates the Pareto population using historical and newly generated routers while retaining dominated routers as experience for subsequent evolution. Routing between DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.5-9B, RSI-router consistently surpasses the DeepSeek-only baseline at roughly half the inference cost (48.3%) across five agentic benchmarks. In particular, on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, it cuts inference cost by 74.7-82.2% while simultaneously improving performance; on Terminal-Bench 2.0, it achieves a 16.7% relative performance gain at 18.0% lower cost. Moreover, RSI-router establishes a stronger performance--cost Pareto frontier than 9 routing methods.

</details>


### [612] [PDE-JEPA: Predictive Representation Learning of Latent Dynamics Modeling for Parametric PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34715)
*Zhentao Tan,Jianrong Zhang,Ruijie Quan,Yi Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出PDE-JEPA框架，针对参数化偏微分方程的潜空间动力学建模，采用预测性表征学习替代传统的基于重建的学习范式，通过物理对齐的潜空间几何和物理结构化的潜空间预测器，在九个PDE基准测试上实现了分布内平均33.4%、分布外平均51.4%的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的参数化PDE潜空间动力学建模主要依赖基于重建的学习目标，强调恢复观测到的物理场，但重建保真度并不能保证所学潜空间适合精确的时间演化，特别是在控制条件发生变化时。因此，核心问题是如何构建适合参数化PDE动力学精确预测和外推的潜空间表征。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于JEPA的预测性预训练，采用掩码潜空间预测目标捕捉PDE动力学规律；(2) 物理对齐的潜空间几何(PAG)模块，引入轻量级残差几何投影器，通过多滞后方向相似度对齐将潜空间轨迹几何与物理场演化几何匹配，并使用锚点损失保留预训练信息；(3) 物理结构化的潜空间预测器(PSP)，将动力学分解为参数无关的演化分量和参数相关的响应分量，采用RK4 ODE求解器进行连续时间传播，并针对不同PDE的结构特点实例化相应的参数化向量场。

Result: 在九个参数化PDE基准（涵盖对流、扩散、波传播、反应扩散和流体动力学）上的实验表明：PDE-JEPA在九个基准中的八个上取得了最低的相对L2分布内滚动误差，平均比现有最优方法提升33.4%；在五个分布外评估基准上均取得最优性能，平均提升51.4%，特别是在Combined(77.9%)、Wave-2D(74.2%)和GS(59.7%)上提升显著；消融实验证实PAG通过将潜空间轨迹几何对齐到物理演化（Vorticity上角度MAE降低78%）来改善长时演化，而PSP通过结构化参数响应（改善方向一致性和幅度一致性）增强对未见控制参数的外推能力。

Conclusion: 参数化PDE动力学的泛化物理预测不仅取决于演化模型，还取决于学习适合演化和外推的状态空间几何结构。预测性JEPA预训练产生具有物理信息的表征，但仅凭信息丰富性不足以确保精确的滚动预测；通过显式对齐潜空间轨迹几何并注入物理结构化的参数响应归纳偏置，可以构建既支持精确长时演化又能泛化到未见控制条件的可演化状态空间。

Abstract: Physical trajectories contain more than snapshots of a system: they also reveal how its states evolve under governing conditions. However, representation learning for parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) has largely relied on reconstruction-based objectives that emphasize recovering observed physical fields. In this paper, we investigate predictive representation pretraining as an alternative to reconstruction-based learning. We find that predictive representations preserve rich physical information, yet this advantage alone does not ensure accurate field evolution. Based on these observations, we introduce PDE-JEPA for parametric PDE dynamics. Specifically, we first train an encoder using a masked-latent prediction to capture the underlying regularities of PDE dynamics. To explicitly adapt the pretrained representation toward a more dynamics-aligned state space, we then introduce a geometry projector that aligns latent trajectory geometry with the evolution geometry of physical fields. Finally, building on this geometry-aligned latent space, we further develop a physics-structured latent predictor that decomposes the dynamics into parameter-independent evolution and parameter-dependent response components. Extensive experiments on nine widely used PDE benchmarks demonstrate that our framework outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods by an average of 33.4\% in-distribution, while achieving an average improvement of 51.4\% when extrapolating to unseen governing parameters. The project page is available \href{ this https URL }{here}.

</details>


### [613] [From Human Narrative to Harmonic Structure: A Human-Centered Investigation of Algorithmic Music Generation through the Chord Wheel Diagram](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34735)
*Josef Pavlíček,Petra Pavlíčková,Irena Štrausová*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过对比人工作曲与AI生成的编曲，研究AI是否能再现特定歌曲的原创和声选择。研究选取了Bob Dylan、Johnny Cash和Ritchie Valens的六首叙事性流行歌曲，采用可解释的计算和声系统，基于旋律生成编曲，并使用Chord Wheel Diagrams和BPMN表示法进行多维度分析。结果发现，旋律与和弦的高兼容性并不必然意味着对原创和声决策模式的保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI音乐生成虽能满足和声与音乐连贯性的形式要求，但音乐表达是否能仅用数学性质描述仍是根本性问题。人类作曲家的个人与文化语境会深刻影响和声选择以及对既定模式的有意偏离。现有生成系统多关注和声正确性，而忽略了结构性身份、语境与人类创作意图。

Method: 1) 选取六首叙事驱动的流行歌曲（Bob Dylan、Johnny Cash、Ritchie Valens）。2) 使用可解释的计算和声系统（explainable computational harmonizer）在仅给定旋律（无原始和弦进程）的条件下生成编曲。3) 从五个维度对比人工作曲与AI生成的和声：和声词汇、功能持续性、重复模式、非调性事件、张力-解决模式。4) 使用Chord Wheel Diagrams和基于BPMN（业务流程建模表示法）的可视化表示进行分析。

Result: 结果显示，旋律-和弦的高兼容性并不必然意味着对原创人工作曲和声决策模式的保留。部分生成的编曲保留了参考作品的经济性结构，其他则改变了和声多样性或抑制了具有区分度的事件，尽管其与旋律依然兼容。AI在保持和声合理性时，可能会抹平原作中由叙事意图驱动的独特和声选择。

Conclusion: 本研究提出"叙事条件约束的和声结构"（narrative-conditioned harmonic structure）作为计算音乐分析的补充视角。研究表明，生成系统应不仅建模和声正确性，还应建模结构性身份、语境与人类创作意图。本研究并非要量化艺术质量，而是强调和声身份与文化语境在计算音乐分析中的不可还原性。

Abstract: Contemporary AI-based music generation can produce compositions that satisfy formal requirements of tonality and musical coherence. However, whether musical expression can be described by mathematical properties alone remains a fundamental question. Human composers operate within personal and cultural contexts that influence harmonic decisions and deliberate departures from established patterns. This study investigates six narrative-driven popular songs by Bob Dylan, Johnny Cash, and Ritchie Valens. Original human harmonies are compared with outputs of an explainable computational harmonizer operating on the same melodies without access to the original chord progressions. We examine harmonic vocabulary, functional persistence, repetition, non-diatonic events, and tension-resolution patterns using Chord Wheel Diagrams and BPMN-based representations. Results show that high melody-chord compatibility does not necessarily imply preservation of the original human harmonic decision pattern. Some generated harmonizations retain the economical structure of the reference, while others alter harmonic diversity or suppress distinctive events while remaining compatible with the melody. Rather than quantifying artistic quality, the study introduces narrative-conditioned harmonic structure as a complementary perspective for computational music analysis. The findings suggest that generative systems may benefit from modeling not only harmonic correctness, but also structural identity, context, and human compositional intention.

</details>


### [614] [SeLMRoute: Probabilistic Semantic Evidence for Large Language Model Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34736)
*Vasilis Perifanis,Nikolaos Pavlidis,Symeon Symeonidis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SeLMRoute提出了一种LLM路由框架，将候选无关的语义证据提取、候选性能学习与部署目标三个阶段解耦。核心是用一个决策模型评估16个可解释的语义探针（如推理类型、知识需求、精确性等），保留每个判断的概率分布（40维概率向量），再由轻量监督路由器映射到各候选模型的预测性能。语义表示与候选模型池独立，因此同一表征可复用于不同模型池和路由目标。在LLMRouterBench上（15数据集、20轻量模型、11481查询），分组五折OOF评估达72.64% AvgAcc，优于最强固定候选（69.23%），并在13模型性能-成本场景中平均PerfGain达2.66%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM路由器大多直接从查询嵌入、模型表示或偏好数据学习路由决策，但路由所用的表示很少明确说明查询"实际需要什么"。密集嵌入虽能捕捉语义相似性，却与任务需求不同：两个Python查询可能需要截然不同的能力。此外，硬化语义判断会丢弃不确定性信息。LLMRouterBench显示多个领先路由器的性能集中在狭窄区间，部分增益可能仅来源于粗粒度的领域结构。因此核心问题是：能否用更细粒度、可解释的查询描述来路由，同时保持紧凑？

Method: 框架分解为三阶段：(1) 语义证据提取S：决策模型（主要使用JEV）对16个语义探针（含8个二元Noul问题+8个四级Score问题）作答，保留原始概率分布形成40维向量s_PM(x)；(2) 性能学习F_θ：基于语义状态用监督模型（默认CatBoost多输出回归）预测各候选模型的得分向量ŷ(x)；(3) 路由目标R_ω：按部署偏好选择模型（如纯质量最大化argmax ŷ，或质量-成本效用U_m = (1-λ)ỹ_m − λc̃_m）。还对比了Full（88维，含熵/期望等衍生量）和Hard（16维离散化）表征、GTE-Qwen2密集嵌入、TF-IDF、DomainOnly基线，以及JEV-Direct直接路由消融。评估采用分组（去重）70/30五随机种子划分和分组五折OOF协议，含Dataset-OOD和Domain-OOD两种分布偏移测试、12探针嵌套缩减实验、leave-one-probe-out分析、性能学习器敏感性分析、选择性路由（基于语义熵）和13模型旗舰池的性能-成本评估。

Result: 在LLMRouterBench性能导向设置上：ProbabilityMass获72.08%±0.45 AvgAcc、Gain@B 5.72%、Gap@O 22.00%，优于Full（71.30%）、Hard（71.20%）、GTE-Qwen2（71.16%）、DomainOnly（71.08%）、TF-IDF（70.87%），且在均值上为所有评估表征中最高；分组五折OOF达72.64%，最强固定候选Qwen3-8B为69.23%。与已发表路由器（RouterDC 61.33、GraphRouter 70.29、EmbedLLM 71.24、Model-SAT 71.88、Avengers 71.94）相比具竞争力。JEV-Direct仅68.78%，SeLMRoute高出3.79pp（95% CI [2.69, 4.95]）。开权重的Laya后端仍达70.53%，显著高于Best Single（p=0.00035）。Lite-12嵌套缩减后达72.49%（vs 72.64%），减少约34%输入token和18% p95延迟。Leave-one-probe-out显示constraint_density、context_integration、current_information贡献最大。语义熵AURC 0.0901优于路由margin的0.0974，但熵阈值在Domain-OOD下未能跨域转移。在13模型性能-成本场景中，5个分组划分全部获得正PerfGain（均值+2.66%±1.85%），但严格CostSave在所有划分中均未达标。JEV提取开销约350ms平均延迟、$0.0675/千查询。

Conclusion: SeLMRoute验证了显式概率语义状态可作为LLM路由的有效中间表征，其40维概率向量在均值上优于密集嵌入、词法与领域级表示，并与领先路由器具竞争力。将语义证据、性能学习与路由目标解耦，使同一语义状态可支持不同候选池与部署偏好，且语义提取器可替换。概率保留相对硬化的边际效益在统计上不显著但方向一致。然而仍存在开放问题：(1) Domain-OOD泛化困难，语义描述无法替代对未见域的候选性能经验；(2) 语义提取引入不可忽略的延迟；(3) 性能提升未必转化为货币节省；(4) 新候选模型需要特定校准。未来工作包括微调开源决策模型、概率校准、联合语义与路由不确定性建模、自适应探针选择、候选冷启动策略以及综合考虑质量/成本/提取开销/延迟的路由目标。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to select the most suitable model for each incoming query. Most existing routers learn this decision directly from query embeddings, model representations, preference data, or clusters of similar examples. Such approaches can be effective, yet the representation used for routing rarely states what a query actually requires. We introduce SeLMRoute, a routing framework that separates the extraction of candidate-independent semantic evidence from the learning of candidate performance and the application of deployment objectives. A decision model first evaluates a set of interpretable questions about the query, such as its reasoning requirements and use of external knowledge, with each judgment retained as a probability distribution. The resulting probabilistic semantic state is used by a lightweight supervised router to estimate candidate model performance. Routing objectives are applied after performance estimation, which allows the same semantic state to support performance-oriented and cost-aware decisions. On the LLMRouterBench (15 datasets, 20 candidate models, 11,481 queries), SeLMRoute achieves an average accuracy of $72.08\% \pm 0.45$, while grouped five-fold out-of-fold evaluation reaches $72.64\%$, compared with $69.23\%$ for the strongest fixed candidate. The representation achieves the highest mean performance among the evaluated semantic, dense, lexical, and domain-level representations. In a separate 13-model performance-cost setting, SeLMRoute improves performance in all five grouped splits, with a mean PerfGain of $2.66\%$. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [615] [Privacy-Preserving Full-Body Meshing from mmWave Radar via Mesh Foundation Model Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34768)
*Shuxing Zhang,Yongquan Ni,Zhenyu Ding,Yawen Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向商用毫米波雷达(单芯片TI IWR6843,每帧仅~6.5点、约28%空帧)的跨模态师生框架,实现隐私保护的全身逐帧度量3D网格重建,并输出逐关节不确定性。核心是利用冻结的网格基础模型SAM 3D Body作为零训练教师生成伪标签,经五阶段质量门控后监督雷达学生网络StudentPoseFormer(含CVAE多假设头),部署阶段仅雷达运行。在MM-Fi基准上达7.45 cm MPJPE,自建数据集21.47 cm,并通过缩放定律揭示"样本多样性而非数量"才是性能瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有mmWave雷达人体感知受限于商用传感器点云极度稀疏(均6.5点/帧、28%空帧),传统方法只能做关键点检测或离散动作分类,无法提供下游应用真正所需的连续度量级全身3D网格及逐关节置信度;同时摄像头方案存在卧室、浴室等隐私敏感环境的固有问题,亟需一种"部署时零视觉输入"的隐私原生方案。

Method: 1)跨模态教师-学生框架:训练时TI IWR6843雷达与ORBBEC Femto Bolt RGB-D相机硬时间戳同步(中位抖动~11ms),用Umeyama+RANSAC刚体配准将教师输出映射至雷达坐标系;2)冻结SAM 3D Body零样本从RGB生成70关节、18439顶点的MHR全身网格作为伪GT,经置信度门控、深度验证、One-Euro时序平滑、骨长一致性、坏帧剔除五阶段质量控制;3)StudentPoseFormer学生网络:集合编码+掩码注意力池化处理变长稀疏点云,4层8头时序Transformer融合T=5帧,核心创新为CVAE多假设头——训练时编码器q_φ(z|GT,c)配KL退火(β 0→1,前20%),推理时从N(0,I)采样K=20次,逐关节均值作为位姿估计、方差作为不确定性;4)损失函数L=L_pos+0.1·L_bone+0.05·L_vel+β·L_KL,Adam 3e-4→1e-5余弦退火;5)部署阶段仅雷达FIFO缓冲+前向推理,通过trackData.tid分路支持多人。

Result: MM-Fi跨主体基准(TI IWR6843,S01-S07训/S08-S10测,27动作):最优配置G4达7.45 cm 12关节MPJPE、PA-MPJPE、track_r=0.651;G系列单变量消融证实因果收益——点云累积k=3贡献-0.34 cm(wrist -1 cm)、Doppler通道贡献-0.85 cm(wrist -2 cm、快动作A10 -1.7 cm)、速度损失贡献-0.27 cm;k=5时运动涂抹反而损害快动作。自建同步数据集(6 session、1主体、块级留出):端到端21.47 cm,逐关节误差从hip 4.8 cm单调增至wrist 34.7 cm,符合物理照射律;缩放定律拟合err=53.8·n^(-0.124)(b≈0.12,需~30k同分布样本才能达15 cm),而MM-Fi 6860多样本锚点隐含b≈0.65,斜率差>100×,证明多样性而非数量为性能约束。

Conclusion: 本文首次在商用固定参数稀疏mmWave点云上实现端到端全身度量网格重建,证明:①网格基础模型可零训练替代昂贵MoCap/多相机标注;②CVAE多假设头不仅处理一对多模糊更提供诚实感知边界(髋部4.8 cm高置信 vs 手腕34.7 cm低置信);③Doppler与时序累积是雷达端真实信息维度而非冗余通道;④隐私保护由部署时物理缺失摄像头而非访问控制策略实现;⑤关键实践启示——数据采集预算应购买"主体×姿态×位置"多样性,而非堆叠同分布样本。局限:单主体块级划分不足以证明跨主体泛化,global_rot MSE=0.908为朝向估计瓶颈,不确定性尚未做后验校准曲线。

Abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving human perception, but the extreme sparsity of point clouds from commercial single-chip sensors (mean ~6.5 points/frame; ~28% empty frames) has confined prior art to body-part keypoints or discrete action classification. We present a cross-modal teacher-student framework that lifts commercial radar to full-body, per-frame, metric 3D mesh reconstruction with per-joint uncertainty. Three innovations: (1) a mesh-foundation-model teacher - SAM 3D Body produces whole-body MHR ground truth (70 joints, 18,439 mesh vertices) from a single RGB frame with zero training, slashing annotation cost by orders of magnitude; (2) StudentPoseFormer - set encoding with masked attention pooling, a temporal Transformer, and a CVAE multi-hypothesis head that outputs both the pose mean and per-joint variance, honestly reporting where the radar cannot see; and (3) a multi-stage ground-truth quality pipeline (confidence gating, depth validation, temporal smoothing, bone-length consistency, bad-frame rejection) plus systematic information-lever ablations. On the public MM-Fi benchmark (same TI IWR6843 sensor, cross-subject), our full configuration reaches 7.45 cm 12-joint MPJPE, with ablations proving the causal value of point accumulation (k = 3, -0.34 cm), Doppler (-0.85 cm; -2 cm at the wrist on fast actions), and velocity loss (-0.27 cm). On our own synchronized radar + RGB-D corpus with block-level held-out splits, the pipeline achieves 21.47 cm end-to-end (per-joint hierarchy from 4.8 cm at the hip to 34.7 cm at the wrist - matching physical information limits), could be improved to 15 cm with ~30k diverse samples, and a scaling law shows sample diversity, not volume, is the binding constraint. Deployment inference is radar-only - no camera, no image.

</details>


### [616] [When Do Model Internals Help? Exploring the Role of Representation Engineering in LLM Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34771)
*Tianyi Guan,Jianhui Chen,Liangming Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过匹配实验，系统比较了表示工程（表征引导与表征探针）与行为安全方法（DPO行为对齐与文本监控器）在LLM安全控制与监控两类任务上的相对优势与适用条件。研究表明表示工程并非行为安全的通用替代品，但在特定场景（低数据控制、原生高效监控、监控-控制互补）下具有实用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全防护中，行为对齐方法（如DPO）与表示工程方法（如激活引导、表征探针）通常在独立设置下分别评估，缺乏统一、可控的对比，导致无法明确二者的相对角色与适用边界。此外，DPO等方法在良性微调后安全性易退化，而表示工程能否弥补这一缺陷尚不清晰。

Method: 采用匹配评估框架，分三条主线：(1) 安全控制——将DPO与CAA、探针引导、基于流的引导（Flow）三种表征引导方法对比，评估维度包括鲁棒性（jailbreak与良性微调后）、实用性（能力保留、过拒、数据效率）和粒度（跨安全域迁移）；(2) 安全监控——将四种表征探针（mean、last、rolling、attention）与微调文本监控器及Qwen3Guard对比，评估全响应检测、流式早期检测与计算开销；(3) 监控-控制集成——研究探针引导的阻断、改写再生与增强引导三种干预策略恢复DPO良性微调后安全性的能力。模型涵盖Qwen2.5-1.5B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B与Qwen2.5-32B，数据使用PKU-SafeRLHF、StrongREJECT、HarmBench、XSTest等。

Result: 安全控制：DPO总体最强且随数据量稳定扩展，但良性微调后安全性严重退化（如AIM攻击ASR从0.027升至0.436）；Flow在低数据+高质量对比数据场景下具竞争力，但过拒较高；CAA和探针引导效果有限。安全监控：Qwen3Guard全响应检测AUROC最高（0.996），流式召回最优（0.948）；rolling探针在探针中综合最优（流式召回0.913，序列FPR仅0.017），边际FLOPs约为Qwen3Guard的1/7.6×10⁵。集成：探针引导的阻断将14B DPO良性微调后平均ASR从0.500降至0.042，过拒仅小幅增加（0.108→0.124）。

Conclusion: 表示工程并非行为安全的通用替代品。其价值体现在三个特定场景：(1) 高质量安全数据有限时的控制（Flow）；(2) 原生激活可复用时的低成本高效监控；(3) 通过监控信号恢复行为对齐方法因良性微调而丧失的安全性。建议将表示工程视为既定安全防护的补充手段，根据数据与部署条件选择方法，而非将其视为行为安全的全面替代。

Abstract: Reliable AI safeguards require both control mechanisms that reduce unsafe behavior and monitoring mechanisms that detect safety risks during model interactions. Established behavioral safeguards include alignment methods that optimize model outputs and text monitors that assess interaction text. Representation engineering instead reads or modifies internal model states, but the relative strengths of these approaches remain unclear because they are often evaluated under different settings. We present a matched evaluation across two tracks. For safety control, we compare DPO, a behavioral alignment method, with three representation steering methods across robustness, practicality, and granularity. DPO provides the strongest overall control and generally improves with increasing training data, although its safety can degrade after subsequent benign fine-tuning. Representation steering remains competitive primarily in low-data settings, particularly with high-quality contrastive data. For safety monitoring, we compare representation probes with fine-tuned and open-weight text monitors across full-response detection, early detection, and computational cost. Specialized text monitors achieve the strongest overall detection accuracy, while representation probes remain competitive at substantially lower marginal cost. Finally, monitor-guided interventions recover much of the safety lost by DPO after benign fine-tuning, with little additional over-refusal. Overall, representation engineering does not generally replace behavioral safeguards, but offers practical advantages under specific conditions and can provide complementary safety benefits.

</details>


### [617] [Before the Token Commits: Trajectory-Level Benchmarking of Visual Hallucinations in Diffusion VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34772)
*Yadong Wang,Siping Yue,Yu Tian,Chuanxing Geng,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DynaHall，一种针对多模态扩散语言模型(diffusion VLMs)的轨迹级视觉幻觉基准，揭示视觉幻觉在答案提交前就已定型，并基于此诊断提出PGS干预方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉幻觉基准针对自回归模型设计，仅评估最终输出，无法揭示扩散VLM中无依据视觉断言是在何时、何步形成的。扩散VLM通过迭代去掩码生成响应，答案需经历多步轨迹，因此需要轨迹级诊断工具。

Method: 1) 构建DynaHall基准：包含8,000条带标注的二元视觉命题(物体存在、计数、属性、关系)，配以按先验强度分级的困难负样本；2) 提出承诺感知(commitment-aware)评估协议：在每个去掩码步骤记录中间答案倾向与最终提交状态；3) 评测5个扩散VLM(覆盖3个架构家族)；4) 提出PGS(Pre-commitment Gradient Steering)：在答案位置仍被掩码时，通过梯度方向编辑注意力头激活来减少假阳性。

Result: 1) 假阳性中77%–97%的无支持"是"倾向在答案位置80%掩码时已占优，去掩码后期很少反转；2) 跨解码调度、答案格式、开放式生成均稳健；4) 计数与关系任务存在普遍崩溃；5) 属性错误方向随子类型变化(形状偏向过度肯定，材质偏向保守否定)；6) PGS将假阳性从42.7%降至28.5%，肯定率趋于平衡，且可迁移至另一架构而不损害通用能力。

Conclusion: 视觉幻觉应在扩散VLM的生成轨迹上进行测量与缓解，而非仅看最终答案；DynaHall提供了轨迹级诊断框架，PGS证明了提交前窗口的可干预性。

Abstract: Multimodal diffusion language models generate responses by iteratively unmasking tokens, making each answer the endpoint of a multi-step trajectory rather than an immediate commitment. Hallucination benchmarks built for autoregressive models evaluate only the final output, and therefore cannot determine whether an unsupported claim in diffusion VLMs appears late or has already stabilized before any answer token is revealed. We introduce DynaHall, a trajectory-level benchmark of annotation-backed binary visual propositions covering object existence, counting, attributes, and relations, with controlled hard negatives graded by visual prior. DynaHall is paired with a commitment-aware protocol that records the intermediate answer tendency at every unmasking step alongside the committed output. Across five diffusion VLMs from three architecture families, visual hallucination is settled before commitment: an unsupported answer is already the preferred state while the answer position is still masked, and later unmasking steps rarely reverse it, so the failure is not introduced at the write step. This holds across decoding schedules, answer formats, and open-ended generation. DynaHall also exposes failures hidden by final-output metrics, including counting and relation collapse, prior-driven false positives, and attribute errors whose direction changes by type. Guided by this diagnosis, PGS (Pre-commitment Gradient Steering) edits still-masked answer states to reduce false positives, bringing the affirmation rate close to balance, and transfers to another architecture without degrading general ability. DynaHall and PGS suggest that hallucination should be measured and mitigated along the generation trajectory of diffusion VLMs, not only at the final answer.

</details>


### [618] [Page-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for EvalLLM 2026: A Five-Variant Study on French PDFs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34776)
*Abdelhak kelious*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究针对法语PDF文档的页面级问答任务，系统性地比较了五种RAG系统变体。实验表明，单纯密集检索或简单混合融合均不如BM25基线，但加入重排序和查询分解后，完整系统在595个挑战问题上的MRR@10达到0.4450，Recall@10达到0.4010，相比BM25基线分别提升30%和34%。然而，页面选择和推理成本控制仍是未来改进的重点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在EvalLLM 2026竞赛中，PDF问答不仅需要生成正确答案，还需引用正确的支持页面。PDF提取噪声、长文档、专有名词和日期的精确匹配需求使得页面级证据检索成为一项艰巨任务。本研究旨在通过渐进式消融实验，系统评估密集检索、混合融合、重排序和查询分解等技术在法语PDF场景下对检索质量和答案生成的影响。

Method: 研究采用页面保留的索引管道（PyMuPDF逐页提取，220词分块并保留40词重叠），比较五种系统变体：(A) BM25基线；(B) 密集检索（intfloat/multilingual-e5-large）；(C) BM25+密集检索的RRF融合；(D) 在C基础上使用BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3重排序25个候选；(E) 在D基础上增加查询分解。生成器使用gpt-5.4-mini（温度0.1），接收最多8个候选页面进行答案生成和引用。评估基于595个挑战问题，使用七个官方指标（LLMaaJ、MRR@10、Recall@10、Top1、nDCG@10、QBERT、QPARA Albert）。

Result: 完整系统E在所有七个指标上均优于其他变体：MRR@10从0.3430（A）提升至0.4450（+29.7%），Recall@10从0.2994提升至0.4013（+34.0%）。然而，B和C均不如A（如C的MRR@10仅0.2168）。相比匿名总体均值，E在LLMaaJ和QBERT上略高，但在四项页面检索指标上仍落后。相比最佳系统，差距达0.29 MRR在页面排名方面。E的运行时为101.1分钟（较A的70.3分钟增加43.8%），且出现了更多意外脚本字符（21例）和对话残留（92例）。

Conclusion: 研究结论指出：(1) BM25在该任务中是强基线，密集检索单独使用效果较弱；(2) 简单融合会退化基线性能，但重排序和查询分解能恢复并提升表现；(3) 完整系统虽达到最佳，但仍存在显著的页面选择和引用准确性提升空间；(4) 未来工作应聚焦于页面特定排序、引用控制、透明的推理成本核算，并发布完整的提示工程、分解程序和评分定义以促进可重复性。

Abstract: We study retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for questions about French PDF documents when both the answer and its supporting document pages are evaluated. Five system variants add dense retrieval, rank fusion, reranking, and query decomposition to a BM25 baseline. On 595 challenge questions, the complete system scores 0.4450 MRR@10 and 0.4013 Recall@10, compared with 0.3430 and 0.2994 for BM25. Dense retrieval alone and a simple lexical--dense fusion both underperform BM25. Reranking improves the hybrid system, whereas adding query decomposition produces the largest further gain, with higher latency and more detected output artifacts. The complete system slightly exceeds the reported anonymous overall mean on two answer metrics but falls below it on most page-retrieval metrics. These results identify accurate page selection, rather than semantic retrieval in isolation, as the main opportunity for improvement in this setting.

</details>


### [619] [Applying Language Models in medical Medicine: Recent Trends and Perspectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34780)
*Erik Aerts*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于大语言模型（LLMs）在医学领域应用的综述性文章，总结了近年来的研究趋势、机遇与挑战，并指出了未来发展方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLMs在医疗领域的应用日益广泛，其可靠性、准确性、透明度和安全性引发关注。作者旨在通过总结近期文献和演讲，探讨LLMs在医学研究和临床实践中的潜力与局限，为当前及新兴的角色提供视角。

Method: 文章采用文献综述与会议演讲总结相结合的方法，涵盖了LLMs在医学中的多个关键方面：(1) 传统深度学习在医学中的应用；(2) 医学LLMs的基准测试与评估；(3) 医学数据语料库的处理；(4) 资源限制与基础设施挑战；(5) 工具调用能力；(6) 多轮交互能力。通过分析代表性工作如BioMedLM、MedPaLM、PediatricsGPT、Foresight、FEDMEKI、SERSAL等，讨论了各方向的进展与不足。

Result: 1. **基准测试**：现有医学LLMs与其基础模型相比无显著优势，且USMLE等考试基准不足以衡量实际医学能力。新基准（如PretexEval、MediConfusion、MedCalcBench、MedSafetyBench等）开始关注推理、工具使用、安全性等更实际的能力。2. **偏见与安全**：LLMs在医学决策中可能延续社会偏见（如性别、种族），且在面对有害医疗请求时仍可能遵从。3. **数据处理**：医学自由文本是重要信息源，但需要NER等技术（如MedCAT）进行提取和标准化，数据分散和匿名化是关键挑战。4. **资源限制**：由于数据敏感性，本地部署至关重要，FEDMEKI、LoRKD、SERSAL等框架通过联邦学习、知识蒸馏、协同学习等方式解决这一问题。5. **工具调用**：通用工具调用研究（如CRAFT、ToolEVO、Tool-Planner）有潜力但需考虑医学特殊性，多轮交互中LLMs从工具中获益更多。6. **现状评估**：LLMs尚未准备好作为独立医疗助手部署，医学调优的实际效果有限。

Conclusion: LLMs在医学领域展现出潜力但尚未成熟。当前研究已从单纯的医学知识测试转向更全面的能力评估（推理、工具使用、安全性等），但仍缺乏与具体临床场景的紧密结合。未来需要在以下方面取得突破：(1) 开发更具领域特异性的高质量基准；(2) 解决医学数据稀缺、分散和标准化问题；(3) 在资源受限环境下实现高效训练与部署；(4) 提升工具调用的医学适用性和多轮交互能力；(5) 确保安全性和公平性。文章认为LLMs短期内更适合作为辅助工具帮助临床医生处理大量医学信息，而非独立承担诊疗责任。

Abstract: The use and applicability of artificial intelligence (AI) in medical research and clinical practice has received increasing attention in the literature over recent years. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has expanded discussions in regards to applications of AI within healthcare. While traditional deep learning based AI applications in medicine have often focused on specific and defined tasks, LLMs offer broader capabilities and flexibility in working with available data,. At the same time of writing, the integration of LLMs into medical settings raises important questions regarding their reliability, accuracy, transparency, safety, and appropriate role in a medical setting. This text presents and discusses recent talks and articles concerning the application of LLMs in medicine, with particular emphasis on their potential utility in research and clinical practice. It considers both the opportunities offered by these technologies and the challenges associated with their implementation, aiming to provide a perspective on the current and emerging role of LLMs within the medical field.

</details>


### [620] [BEHAVE: Functional Behavior Modeling Enables Self-Improving Agents for Hardware Design and Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34785)
*Yuheng Wu,Berk Gokmen,Sujeeth Jinesh,Lauren McLane,Aarav Wattal,Qi Yang Huang,Zhaozhuo Xu,Thierry Tambe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BEHAVE是一个用于硬件设计与验证的智能体框架，通过功能行为建模解耦时序约束，支持多轮联合开发、PPA探索与可验证的强化学习自改进，使27B模型在60种子任务上自提升后达到与540任务全量RL相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统硬件验证通过周期级输出对比进行正确性检查，会拒绝那些满足规范但时序/微架构不同的合法RTL实现，无法支持PPA探索。需要一种不强制绑定特定实现时序的可执行监督信号。

Method: 引入Behavior IR（带类型的Python子集）描述功能行为模型作为可执行参考；BEHAVE-Sim评估器使用Z3求解器进行目标导向的刺激生成，独立评估RTL设计与行为模型；RL通过GRPO以两制品得分的均值作为奖励；自改进中Analyst-Builder-Implementer-Reviewer多角色基于滚动反馈识别能力缺口并构建新的(S, B*)对。

Result: Qwen3.8-27B在BEHAVE-Eval上的RTL pass@1从55.0%通过60种子任务的自提升升至75.0%，与使用540任务的固定数据集RL（73.3%）相当；GPT-5.6 Terra等前沿模型在该基准达到85.0% RTL pass@1；MXFP4/NVFP4案例展示了面积-时序Pareto前沿探索；Behavior IR相比HLS获得更高成功率与更低成本。

Conclusion: 功能行为建模为硬件设计验证提供了时序灵活的可执行监督，使LLM智能体能在不需要参考RTL的情况下进行可验证RL和持续自改进；将高级实现转化为(S, B*)对为算法和负载演化过程中的持续自我提升提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Developing agents for hardware design and verification requires reliable correctness feedback. As a hardware specification may permit correct implementations with different latencies, matching design and reference outputs cycle by cycle can reject valid designs. To address this, we introduce BEHAVE, an agentic framework for multi-turn joint hardware design and verification through functional behavior modeling. We define Behavior IR to express task functionality as executable behavior models without prescribing implementation timing beyond the specification. The agent iteratively develops a register-transfer-level (RTL) design and a behavior model as the design's verification reference. Our evaluator, BEHAVE-Sim, checks both artifacts separately against a hidden golden behavior model using input stimuli generated by random sampling and solver-guided search. BEHAVE thus supports power, performance, and area (PPA) exploration across task-permitted latencies and microarchitectures. During training, the same evaluator provides verifiable reinforcement learning (RL) rewards from specification-behavior pairs without reference RTL. For self-improvement, the agent continually searches for high-level implementations relevant to its capability gaps, constructs and checks specification-behavior pairs, and trains on the expanded task pool. We release BEHAVE-Train and BEHAVE-Eval with 600 human-reviewed specification-behavior pairs for realistic hardware workloads. Starting from 60 seed tasks and acquiring 100 new tasks, self-improvement raises Qwen3.8-27B's RTL pass@1 on BEHAVE-Eval from 55.0% to 75.0%, reaching performance comparable to RL using a 540-task pool.

</details>


### [621] [STRIDE: Automated Evaluation of Text-to-Trajectory Alignment across Diverse Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34799)
*Wanchun Ni,Tao Qi,Leonel Aguilar,Jiugeng Sun,Marlene Wagner,Verena Zimmermann,Mennatallah El-Assady*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: STRIDE是首个用于评估文本到行人轨迹生成中上下文对齐的自动化框架，通过基于社会学理论的行为分解和确定性测量工具进行结构化验证，无需依赖真实人类轨迹数据即可对多样化场景进行可扩展、可复现的评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的行人轨迹评估方法依赖真实人类轨迹数据，无法扩展到多样化的文本到轨迹生成场景；且行人行为具有异质性和上下文依赖性，单一指标无法作为正确答案，使得文本条件轨迹生成的可靠评估面临挑战。

Method: 1) 设计VRDST五轴评估协议（速度Velocity、真实感Realism、方向Direction、空间Spatial、时间Temporal），源自McPhail和Wohlstein的群体行为社会学理论；2) 将高层上下文场景分解为场景自适应的行为问题；3) 构建确定性测量工具库（DMT），包含20个直接对轨迹坐标进行计算的函数，将LLM生成的语义期望转换为数值答案范围进行可复现验证。框架实例化为STRIDE-Bench，包含936个场景、6633个行为问题和11696个测量，覆盖30个真实世界地图和11种人群类别。

Result: 1) STRIDE-Bench在真实人类轨迹（Fête des Lumières）上获得0.94的高分；2) 人类标注者与基准答案的一致性达80%，Cohen's κ=0.730；3) 跨四个SOTA LLM的鲁棒性验证均处于人类留一法范围内；4) 评估的文本到轨迹模型中，Text-Crowd表现最佳但总分仅0.645，远低于人类水平，揭示当前模型在细粒度上下文对齐方面存在显著不足。

Conclusion: STRIDE是文本到行人轨迹对齐评估的首个原则性框架，其分层验证机制实现了无需真实轨迹数据的自动化、可复现、可扩展评估。验证表明STRIDE-Bench与人类判断高度一致，但当前文本条件轨迹生成模型的上下文对齐能力仍有限，尤其在细粒度空间推理和复杂行为条件方面存在持续挑战。

Abstract: Language-conditioned trajectory generation is here, but its evaluation has not kept pace. Existing pedestrian trajectory metrics compare trajectories with real-world human data. This does not scale to text-to-trajectory generation across diverse contexts, as collecting human trajectories for every scenario is costly and infeasible. Moreover, pedestrian behavior is heterogeneous and context-dependent, with no single metric as the correct answer, and current evaluation frameworks are not transferable to this domain. These challenges make scalable, reliable evaluation difficult. We introduce STRIDE, the first framework for evaluating context alignment between scenario descriptions and pedestrian trajectories. STRIDE addresses these challenges through three design choices. First, we derive our VRDST evaluation protocol from sociological theories to define a complete evaluation space. Second, it decomposes high-level context into scenario-adaptive behavioral questions. Third, every question is resolved against a deterministic measurement tool library that yields reproducible answers. Together, STRIDE enables complete, verifiable, automated, and scalable evaluation across diverse contexts without requiring human trajectory data. We instantiate STRIDE in the crowd domain as STRIDE-Bench, comprising 1K scenarios, 6K behavioral questions, and 11K measurements with calibrated expected answers across 30 real-world maps. Comprehensive human validations show that STRIDE-Bench is consistent with human behavior and judgment, achieving 80% human agreement. We further evaluate several text-to-trajectory models, finding limited context-alignment capability and persistent challenges in fine-grained context conditioning. We believe that the STRIDE framework provides a first step toward principled evaluation of context-aligned pedestrian trajectory generation.

</details>


### [622] [SIPO: Selective-Inference Policy Optimization for Tree-Structured Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34805)
*Zenghuang Fu,Ningqi Chen,Mingda Jia,Xiaofeng Han,Zhaoyang Li,Qiuyuan Ai,Zelong Zheng,Haoyu Wu,Tianyu Fu,Chenxu Zhao,Minghui Wu,Guannan He,Changwei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SIPO提出了一种选择性推理策略优化方法，用于树结构智能体强化学习。它解决了自适应扩展中"在位者"与"新生成兄弟分支"之间的统计不对称问题，通过三个核心机制：分数校准的分支标准、可交换分支生成和顺序统计修正，在保持叶子预算和宿主策略优化目标的同时，提高了基于树的信用估计质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在树结构搜索智能体的强化学习中，自适应扩展造成了统计不对称：在位者因其自身的生成统计量被选中扩展，而新兄弟分支在该选择之后才被采样。当该统计量与回报相关时，即使共享父节点，分支价值也会反映选择历史而非真实的延续质量。这种不对称性影响了分支价值比较和信用分配。

Method: SIPO方法由三个协同组件构成：(1) 无标度分支标准(SFC)：对生成分数进行标准化后再施加兄弟惩罚，使相对标度随策略变化保持一致；(2) 可交换分支(EXB)：从每个选中的父节点生成多个新延续，保持叶子预算不变（通过调整K和B），提供对称的对比参考；(3) 顺序统计修正(OSC)：利用Blom近似估计选择排名对应的期望正态顺序统计量，根据分数-结果关联调整保留的在位者价值，再通过子节点softmax权重传播到内部节点。

Result: 在7个QA基准（多跳：HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、Musique、Bamboogle；单跳：NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA）上，使用Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B三个骨干模型，SIPO在所有三个骨干上都取得了最高的报告多跳和单跳平均值。在Qwen3-8B上，多跳和单跳平均相比AT²PO分别提升1.31和1.07个百分点，在7个基准中6个排名第一。组件消融实验表明三个组件各自均有效，组合后效果更佳。早期训练的配对诊断显示存在显著的选择-新生成价值差距（约-0.0756），而新-新对比接近于零（-0.0008），验证了选择历史的影响。

Conclusion: SIPO通过将选择历史纳入基于树的信用估计，在保持叶子预算和宿主策略优化目标的同时，提高了搜索智能体的训练效果。三个组件（分数校准、新兄弟生成和顺序统计修正）相互协同，组件消融和分支诊断实验均支持在构建和评估搜索智能体rollout时考虑选择历史的重要性。代码已开源。

Abstract: Tree-structured reinforcement learning trains search agents by comparing alternative continuations and propagating terminal rewards to intermediate decisions. Adaptive expansion, however, creates a statistical asymmetry: an incumbent is selected using its own generation statistic, whereas fresh siblings are sampled after selection. When that statistic is associated with return, branch values can reflect selection history as well as continuation quality, even for a shared parent. We propose Selective-Inference Policy Optimization (\SIPO{}), which incorporates this distinction into tree-based credit estimation. Its scale-free branch criterion keeps generation scores and sibling penalties on a consistent relative scale; exchangeable branching supplies multiple fresh continuations from each selected parent; and order-statistic correction adjusts retained incumbent values using selection rank and the estimated score--outcome association. These mechanisms preserve the leaf budget and the host policy optimisation objective. Across seven QA benchmarks using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, \SIPO{} achieves the highest reported multi-hop and single-hop averages among the compared methods. On Qwen3-8B, it improves these averages over AT\textsuperscript{2}PO by $1.31$ and $1.07$ percentage points, respectively, and ranks first on six of seven benchmarks. Component ablations evaluate the individual and combined changes, while early-training paired diagnostics show a selected--fresh value gap alongside a near-zero fresh--fresh reference. Together, these results support accounting for selection history when constructing and evaluating search-agent rollouts. Our code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [623] [UniOPSD: Unifying Outcome and Hindsight Feedback for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34810)
*Zenghuang Fu,Zhaoyang Li,Qiuyuan Ai,Xiaofeng Han,Zelong Zheng,Haoyu Wu,Tianyu Fu,Chenxu Zhao,Minghui Wu,Guannan He,Changwei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: UniOPSD提出一种统一的智能体强化学习方法，通过自适应局部信用仲裁机制融合环境回报反馈与同组成功同伴的回顾反馈，在共享交互锚点上动态分配两者的影响力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在智能体强化学习中，稀疏延迟的环境回报难以对长交互序列提供有效信用分配。现有的策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）方法利用特权训练上下文提供补充监督，但其诊断显示环境回报与回顾反馈在平均层面一致的同时，在局部决策层面存在显著分歧。因此需要解决"在两者不一致时应信任哪个信号、信任多少"的核心问题。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 可比局部信用估计——在匹配锚点构造GiGPO的环境回报分支与回顾分支（基于冻结行为策略的log概率差距），并进行中心化和尺度匹配；(2) 基于历史与局部证据的仲裁——corr规则利用历史相关性设定全局混合水平，再以当前信号可用性和相对精度在单个决策上调整权重，并通过凸融合形成F_k；(3) 有界token调制——在PPO之前用sign(F_k)·δ_k,t的有界指数权重精炼融合的步信用，同时保留episode级环境贡献。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA三个领域，使用Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct进行评估：ALFWorld成功率82.8%/83.6%，WebShop成功率75.0%/82.0%（3B模型较SDAR提升7.0个百分点），Search-QA聚合准确率45.3%/49.8%。消融实验显示，UniOPSD在所有六个模型-基准设置中均优于逆方差融合和固定相关性融合变体；诊断显示局部信号分歧率高达37.8%而平均相关性仅为0.315。

Conclusion: UniOPSD通过自适应局部信用仲裁有效统一了环境回报与回顾反馈，实验验证了在多个智能体任务上的竞争力，证明了同时基于历史一致性和当前证据可用性来调节回顾反馈影响力的必要性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become an effective approach to training language model agents, but sparse and delayed outcome rewards provide limited guidance for credit assignment across long interaction sequences. Recent work on on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers complementary supervision by evaluating a policy's sampled responses under privileged training-time context. However, our diagnostics show that positive average agreement between outcome and hindsight feedback coexists with substantial local disagreement, raising the question of how to allocate influence between them at each decision. We introduce UniOPSD (Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation), which unifies these feedback sources through adaptive local credit arbitration. UniOPSD constructs comparable credit estimates from environmental returns and successful-peer hindsight at shared interaction anchors. Historical agreement determines the global mixing level, while current signal availability and relative precision adjust each source's influence at individual decisions. The episode-level outcome contribution is retained, and bounded token modulation refines the fused step credit for policy optimization. With Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, UniOPSD achieves ALFWorld success rates of $82.8\%$ and $83.6\%$, WebShop success rates of $75.0\%$ and $82.0\%$, and Search-QA aggregate accuracies of $45.3\%$ and $49.8\%$, respectively. On 3B WebShop, UniOPSD improves over SDAR by $7.0$ percentage points. Our code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [624] [Simulating Respondents, Not Single Questions: Coherent Survey Generation with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34828)
*Ji Huang,Mengfei Li,Shuai Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FullRespondent-LLM (FR-LLM)，一种通过两个专门微调的LLM（一个用于学习单题边际分布，一个用于学习问卷内跨题自回归依赖关系）并结合边际约束联合投影（MCJP）来生成连贯问卷响应的社会调查模拟框架，在多题准确性、跨人群泛化及下游商业决策中均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM调查模拟方法在单题层面表现良好，但无法保证同一模拟受访者在整份问卷中给出连贯一致的答案（如同时报告高生活满意度和幸福感），这导致基于多题聚合的可靠性（Cronbach's α）、效度（AVE）以及下游决策产生误导。

Method: FR-LLM框架包含三个阶段：(1) Stage 1 对单题-背景数据进行LoRA微调，学习每个题项的边际分布；(2) Stage 2 在真实完整问卷上以随机化题目顺序进行自回归微调，学习跨题联合依赖结构；(3) Stage 3 通过MCJP（一种I-投影操作），将Stage 2的自回归提议分布投影到满足Stage 1边际约束的最近分布，使用反向KL散度，并通过IPF和系统重抽样生成最终完整问卷。

Result: 在ESS11和TALIS 2018两个大型社会调查（含三种迁移设置：未见构念M1、未见国家M2、两者皆未见M3）以及Qwen3.5-9B和Ministral-3-8B两种骨干模型上，FR-LLM在全部12个设置中获得最低的Cronbach's α MAE、AVE MAE和Construct JSD，且Item JSD具有竞争力；相对零样本基线在可靠性、效度和构念级JSD上分别缩小了86%、81%和83%的人类重采样差距。在小型商业调查的定价-库存决策模拟中，FR-LLM实现了最高利润且未过度囤货。

Conclusion: 通过将边际学习和依赖学习分离并通过MCJP融合，FR-LLM在多题结构准确性上显著提升而不牺牲单题准确性，为连贯虚拟受访者模拟提供了一个可衡量的框架；但与人类重采样误差仍有差距，且有限候选支撑、α/AVE的非线性等因素限制了理论保证的适用范围。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate response distributions in social surveys. Prior work has achieved accurate population-level simulation for individual questions. Real questionnaires, however, ask each respondent a sequence of related questions. A simulated respondent should show coherent preferences across the whole questionnaire, not merely accurate distributions for isolated items. Existing single-item methods cannot accurately reproduce how the same person answers a complete survey. We propose FullRespondent-LLM (FR-LLM), which fine-tunes two specialized LLMs: a marginal model for each item's response distribution and a respondent-level autoregressive model for dependencies across answers. Marginal-Constrained Joint Projection (MCJP) then projects the autoregressive joint distribution onto the set satisfying the item-level marginals learned by the first model. This yields complete questionnaires with realistic cross-item relationships while retaining strong item-level accuracy. On two real-world social survey datasets, FR-LLM more accurately reproduces multi-question response patterns, maintains competitive single-item accuracy, and generalizes better to unseen populations and questions. In a small commercial-survey dataset, we use simulated responses to make pricing and stocking decisions; FR-LLM achieves the highest realized profit.

</details>


### [625] [BV Loss: Block Verification-Aware Loss for Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34832)
*Suyoung Kim,Jahyun Koo,Hyeonjin Kim,Inhyeok Bang,Seunghyun Lee,Hyunjae Oh,Baeseong Park,Dongsoo Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出BV loss，一种直接源于块验证（block verification）接受规则的序列级训练目标，用于训练并行块扩散草稿器。它最大化期望被接受的草稿长度，在不改变推理流程的情况下，相较交叉熵损失提升平均接受长度13.0–21.0%，并优于TV/LK等逐token接受目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推测解码中草稿器训练目标（多以token级CE/TV/LK为主）与推理时采用的序列级块验证机制之间存在错配，导致优化方向与实际验证标准不一致，限制了推测解码的加速效果。

Method: 从块验证接受规则出发，推导出目标生成路径上的期望接受长度估计；引入log形式的BV目标及前缀退火聚合机制（β从0到1线性升温）；支持在target-generated轨迹上训练，无需对草稿采样求导；当B=1时退化为TV loss。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B上以DFlash与DSpark为草稿器，在GSM8K、MATH-500、AIME25、HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench、MT-Bench七个基准上，块验证下τ相对CE提升13.0–21.0%；同样优于TV与LK；增益可泛化至token验证与贪心解码；token精度高并不等于块接受长度长。

Conclusion: 对齐块验证的训练目标比逐token独立优化更能提升并行扩散草稿器的序列级接受长度；BV loss在多种草稿器、验证规则与解码设置下均取得一致增益，验证了“验证感知、块感知”训练范式的有效性。

Abstract: Diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by proposing multiple tokens in parallel. Despite recent advances in speculative decoding through sequence-level drafting and verification, existing training objectives remain largely designed around token-level verification. To address this mismatch, we introduce Block Verification-aware loss (BV loss), a training objective designed to maximize the expected acceptance length of a drafted sequence. BV loss is directly derived from the block verification acceptance rule, providing a principled connection between the drafter training objective and the inference-time verification mechanism at the sequence level. Across math, code, and chat benchmarks, BV loss increases the mean number of tokens accepted per verification call under block verification by 13.0--21.0\% over cross-entropy loss training for DFlash and DSpark with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B without changing the inference procedure. BV loss also outperforms tokenwise acceptance objectives such as TV loss and LK loss, and its gains extend to token verification and greedy decoding. These results demonstrate the benefit of training block diffusion drafters with an objective aligned with sequence-level verification, rather than optimizing each token independently.

</details>


### [626] [Nociception as a Control Primitive: Afferent Channels and Nociceptive Memory for Agents Deployed in One Body](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34840)
*Wolfgang Maass*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究"单次部署"（epoch-one）场景下的智能体设计：在固定权重策略、无法在生命周期内更新参数、身体磨损率未知且不可通过安全探索获取的条件下，痛觉通道（伤害感受性信号）与疼痛记忆是保护身体、延长职业寿命的控制原语。理论证明：(1) 感觉信号配合记忆将资源分配推向"已尝试且报酬最高"的活动，而非"最温和"的活动；(2) 缺乏记忆时痛感约束永远不生效；(3) 该通道仅在威胁具有个体不可预测性、规避廉价、忽视代价高昂时才有价值。在2,000个模拟地板工膝盖上，感觉+保留+替代将工作寿命从55.2岁延长至59.6岁，职业产出从33.7增至36.1，69.3%的身体获益且无一受损。条件(1)(b)——记忆——承担了大部分收益。种群训练的智能体在同一通道上仅获+0.65年，-0.54产出，差距源于物种先验已捕捉的部分。命题1（时间表混淆恒等式）将消融均值与个体价值联系起来；命题3（支付机制）给出事前可检验的三条件；定理1刻画急性场景下保护策略成立的充要条件。实验涵盖四种世界：地板工膝盖（慢性磨损）、护理机器人（认证寿命延长6倍）、漫游车（威胁确定，通道收益微薄）、潜在缺陷车队（隐藏缺陷，信号+记忆将报废率从0.55降至0.15）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度优化需大量样本，但单次部署的智能体（如工人、机器人、假肢）只有一次生命。每一次用于识别自身磨损率的试验都会损耗本应保护的身体。安全强化学习假设约束可被学习或给定，此处该假设失效。本文追问：在一个无法在生命周期内学习其身体的世界里，固定权重智能体必须携带什么才能保持能力？这对承载它的身体价值几何？临床对标为夏尔科关节病（Charcot arthropathy）：失感觉患者重新加载受损关节，感觉正常者保护数十年。

Method: 建立三类模型：(1) 单生命形式化——隐藏身体参数θ（磨损抗性κ等）+环境e构成的POMDP族，磨损动力学M_{t+1}=M_t-d/κ；(2) 输入层α（载荷门控、显著性门控、校准的伤害感受图），将组织状态转译为公共尺度的感觉信号s_t；(3) 决策层求解max Σa_j ŷ_j s.t. Σa_j ĉ_j ≤ τ，其中ĉ由工作记忆写入、遗忘率v衰减。理论层面证明：引理1（无保留时约束永不生效）、命题2（识别磨损率需消耗完整性）、命题3（通道有价值的充要三条件）、定理1（急性场景下保护策略成立的充要条件：感知、持久、尾部敏感）、命题4（慢性场景的类似结果）、命题11/12（时间表混淆恒等式与记忆的系统发育）。实验层面在四种世界（地板工膝盖、护理机器人、漫游车、潜在缺陷车队）共5,000+身体上进行配对试验（同一身体有/无通道），PPO训练对照臂（带感觉s、记忆h、损伤权重w及其消融）。基准锚定于已发表职业医学与生物力学数据。

Result: 主要数值结果：地板工膝盖（2,000身体，Δθ=18°）：感觉+保留+替代将职业寿命从55.2→59.6岁（+4.4年，95%CI [+4.23,+4.53]），产出33.7→36.1（+2.4），69.3%身体获益无一受损；感觉单独+0.5至+1.0年，记忆承担+3.4至+3.9年；种群训练臂仅+0.65年/-0.54产出；χ=1.40，时间表混淆使消融设计低估约7倍。护理机器人（500生命）：认证寿命51.5→323.3月（6倍），产出36.9→150.8，但记忆反损34.2月（因代价可从电机信号直接读出）。漫游车：警告已覆盖97%增益。潜在缺陷车队（5,000单位）：全栈报废率0.55→0.15，J从0.49→0.79（Mann-Whitney p=1.4×10⁻⁵）。敏感性分析：16/18参数格获益；当条件(ii)失效（最低替代工资+最高产出底线）时保护代价十年。头数值在σ_κ 0.20-0.80范围内始终为正（+3.06至+5.63年），无一身体受损。

Conclusion: 感觉、保留与内禀损伤代价的结合体在威胁不可预测、可规避、不可原谅的世界中保护身体。在一个膝盖上它延长工作寿命+4.4年、增加产出+2.4，且几乎全部来自记忆。三点结论超越本文本身：(1) 在不能学习自身身体的一次性部署智能体是机器人/假肢/工人的一般情形，"epoch one"是其设计场景；(2) 命题3三条件可事前检验，学习者在满足条件的世界中获得结合体（车队为证）；(3) 命题1恒等式适用于一切以消融对比群体训练智能体评估的部件，配对运行可补全消融遗漏。开放问题：慢环路本身（记忆需要何种系统发育）、超越单一行业与单一关节的世界。失败模式（附录D）说明：错置底线使机器世界产生可信负面结果；水平截断使保护臂被审查、效应低估约10倍；职业生涯未进入目标函数则每项消融击败完整栈。该工作同时指出保护实验的设计边界：若工作规则限定暴露上限，则体感通道不可被需要。

Abstract: An agent deployed in a single body cannot learn how fast that body wears, because every trial that would reveal its wear resistance wears the body it would protect. We study this \emph{epoch-one} setting, in which the parameters of a fixed-weight policy are set before the body is drawn and never updated in life. The agent carries a load-gated nociceptive channel and a memory that retains what was felt. We prove that felt cost moves the allocation to the best-\emph{paid} work not yet felt rather than the gentlest, that an agent without retention never sees the felt-cost constraint bind, and that the channel pays only where the threat is individually unpredictable, cheap to avoid and expensive to ignore. We measure per body, setting the agent with channel and memory against the same individual without them, where neither carries a schedule learned across lives. On $2{,}000$ simulated floor-layer knees, with wear anchored to published loss rates, feeling, retaining and substituting extends the working life from age $55.2$ to $59.6$ and raises career output from $33.7$ to $36.1$. $69.3\%$ of bodies gain and \textbf{none lose}.
