<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AEO/GEO/LLM SEO从业者推崇FAQ模块、结构化数据、Core Web Vitals等页面级干预措施以提升LLM引用频率，但这些建议多源自SEO经验的简单迁移，缺乏在生产系统上经过混杂控制的大规模实证检验。此前尚无公开研究在生产LLM上以大规模、多引擎方式测试这些处方。

Method: 研究采用观测性设计：(1) 数据来源为Discovered Labs AEO基准平台六个月间从四个商用LLM收集的≈210万条⟨prompt, engine, URL, position⟩引用元组，与10,042个被引网页的60+结构/对齐/时效/基础设施特征相连；(2) 因变量为log₂(1+n_c)的URL级引用计数；(3) 九方法共识框架包括带域名固定效应的混合效应回归（OLS+HC1）、Benjamini-Hochberg FDR校正（q<0.05）、稳定性选择Lasso（B=200自助法，Π*=1.0）、双重机器学习（DML，正交化偏效应）、探索性因子分析（速度指标promax旋转）、广义可加模型（GAM）、梯度提升树的SHAP特征重要性、敏感性分析（五个子集）、留一域复制（LODO，八个最大域名）、以及按引用日期划分的时间保持复制；(4) 共识协议要求预测因子同时满足q<0.05、Π̂≥0.60、DML后非零、GAM单调/单峰、5个敏感性子集中至少4个保持符号稳定；(5) 品牌控制分析限于自有品牌与竞争品牌子集（N=4,015, D=297），第三方分析使用完整127万条真实第三方引用记录。

Result: 四项发现通过全部检验：(1) 提示-内容对齐（页面token与工作区完整prompt语料库的Jaccard重叠，含非引用prompt以避免循环）是主导页面级预测因子，β̂=+0.37，95% CI [+0.33, +0.41]，q≈10⁻⁷³，等价于引用计数约30%增长；200/200自助法选择、DML θ̂=+0.35（p<10⁻⁵⁰）、GAM单调递增、时间保持复制β̂_hold=+0.34（CI严格为正）、八次留一域拟合均稳定（范围+0.475至+0.550），自有品牌子集效应更大（+0.77）而竞争品牌子集较小（+0.31）。(2) AEO清单中FAQ块（β=+0.07）、TLDR/BLUF（β=+0.05）、作者简介（β=+0.02，深度控制后不显著）、Core Web Vitals（控制域名后不显著）、合成Lighthouse分数等在合并数据中显示正效应，但引入域名固定效应后反向或坍缩至零——辛普森悖论：大型在位品牌引用多且页面系统性较慢，合并估计产生速度与引用间的伪负相关。(3) 引擎间异质性显著：引用中位年龄从Claude的5.1个月到ChatGPT的8.0个月；品牌控制URL占比从Gemini的13.8%到ChatGPT的39.3%（位置加权后53%对24%）；Claude引用定价页中位年龄3.3个月而ChatGPT为14.0个月；Google AI Overviews贡献23,908条第三方LinkedIn引用中的96.6%而Gemini为零。(4) SHAP分析显示域名权威（目标编码的域名平均log引用）的平均绝对SHAP值为0.381，而最强非对齐页面级特征仅0.060——前者为后者的约6倍；域名层面R²=0.320，全特征集R²=0.450，ΔR²=0.130为页面级优化的上界。最佳匹配段落深度中位数为0.36（页面顶部三分之一），Wilcoxon检验p<10⁻²⁰。页面类型残差效应：定价页β=+0.39（q<10⁻³），榜单评论页β=−0.12（q<0.05）。前十第三方域名合计引用占比<20%，约1,000个域名才能覆盖80%引用量，YouTube/Reddit/LinkedIn合计仅≈7%。

Conclusion: 提示-内容对齐是唯一具有实质性域内效应的页面级调控杆（β=+0.37），其实质为基于买家语言（VOC）的内容定位而非页面级技术优化；从业者广泛推荐的FAQ块、结构化数据、页面速度等AEO清单效应主要由域名权威混杂驱动，合并估计存在辛普森悖论，"挑战者品牌"不应期望从结构化数据部署获得与在位品牌相当的引用收益。域名权威在SHAP重要性上超出最强非对齐页面级特征约6倍，但域名权威本身是持续内容策略与AI可见性工作的存量而非外生禀赋，故R²分解不构成对页面级干预的反证。四个商用LLM引擎在引用时效、品牌占比、平台分布上存在数量级差异，"为AI优化"非单一目标问题。研究方法学贡献为九方法共识协议（含域名固定效应、双重机器学习、时间保持复制），为生产LLM行为的观测研究提供可复用的严谨模板，可推广至B2B SaaS以外的领域；但因果识别仍需未来通过受控prompt操纵、自然实验或纵向滚动窗口验证实现。研究局限：观测设计无法排除未测量混杂（内容质量、编辑投入）；B2B SaaS单一基准平台；四个引擎不含Perplexity、Bing Chat；六个月连续窗口不能涵盖引擎管道季度级变更；语义相似度指标仍以引用prompt计算，存在残余循环成分。

Abstract: Production large language models retrieve and cite web pages alongside generated answers, yet the page-level features that predict citation frequency remain poorly characterised. We present an observational study of approximately 2 million LLM citations from four commercial engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Gemini) over six months, joined to 10,000 crawled pages from nineteen B2B SaaS workspaces. Sixty-plus features are tested using a nine-method consensus framework combining mixed-effects regression with domain fixed effects, FDR correction, stability-selection Lasso, double machine learning, generalised additive models, and temporal hold-out replication. Four findings survive all checks. First, prompt-content alignment (Jaccard overlap between page tokens and the full workspace prompt corpus, including non-citing prompts) is the dominant page-level predictor (beta = +0.37, 95% CI [+0.33, +0.41], q ~ 10^-73). Second, the standard AEO checklist (FAQ blocks, structured data, Core Web Vitals) shows positive effects in pooled data that reverse or collapse to zero once domain fixed effects are applied: Simpson's paradox with practical consequences for the AEO literature. Third, domain-level AI authority exceeds the strongest non-alignment page-level feature by a factor of six in mean absolute SHAP value. We release the analytic pipeline as a methodological contribution.

</details>


### [655] [When Valid Tool Calls Change Meaning: Formation-Consistent Dispatch for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35088)
*Geonwoo Kim,Brent ByungHoon Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FCD（formation-consistent dispatch），解决LLM智能体工具调用中的"schema-epoch drift"问题：在调用形成与执行分离的架构下，schema合法且未变更的调用可能被路由到语义不同的解释器，产生不同的安全效果。FCD将三个决策绑定到执行前：效果兼容性、调用授权、生命周期资格，并在大规模实际部署中验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在MCP（Model Context Protocol）架构中，模型通过model-visible接口（descriptor）形成tool call，但host在后续才选择具体实现（handler）。这一分离导致descriptor-handler关系未被纳入标准dispatch流程。攻击者或常规运维操作（如rollout、reconnect、delayed approval）可使一个schema有效且未变更的调用被路由到不同语义的handler，产生不同的安全效果（例如private→public），而模型和参数策略无法察觉。本文将这类failure定义为schema-epoch drift，并通过实际部署复现证明其普遍性。

Method: FCD的核心设计包含三个分离的决策：（1）效果兼容性（effect compatibility）——通过reviewed effect profile对官方源码进行静态分析，生成provenance-bound over-approximation的效果摘要；（2）调用授权（invocation authority）——formation时verifier用具体参数和认证上下文评估successor效果是否满足合同C_i，仅当Effects(e_S,i)⊆C_i时才捕获一个successor；（3）生命周期资格（lifecycle eligibility）——通过原子准入（atomic admission）和final-hop identity fence将决策保持到effect，exact source保留优先权，captured successor仅在source安全retire后才可执行。注册阶段绑定artifact、configuration、依赖、provenance；执行阶段通过catalog snapshot、authenticated credential、lease marker、最终身份校验共同实现formation authority的持久化。支持四种语言前端（Python AST、JS bundle、Go source、C# source）。

Result: 在32个官方release上验证4个profiles：29个release无需release-specific变更即可自动处理，3个DBHub release因源码结构变化升级需人工审查。frozen 16-release expansion与独立oracle完全匹配。在预注册的策略对比中（GitHub MCP v1.4→v1.3场景）：call A（显式private:true）保持private，call B（省略private）在v1.3下变public。FCD在3次重复中完成所有A调用（3/3）并阻止所有B调用（0/3）；exact pinning和release-wide deny策略阻止全部6次调用；release-wide allow完成全部6次但产生3个public effect（违反安全合同）。生命周期实验证明formation时捕获的certificate可在source retire后生效（3/3），而事后安装的相同certificate不能扩展旧调用的authority（0/3）。跨框架（LangGraph、LangChain MCP、PydanticAI）、跨replica、跨VM部署均保持formation authority。性能上本地绑定增加约0.030ms，final fence增加约0.4ms，replicated registry在concurrency 64下达256 req/s。

Conclusion: FCD通过将效果兼容性、调用授权、生命周期资格三个决策绑定到formation时刻，并在closed-target approval policy下保持决策的单调收缩性，有效防止schema-epoch drift。FCD不是替代现有agent defenses（如ETDI、Tool Forge、Semantic differencing），而是通过引入source-derived effect bound和formation-scoped successor authority填补了pending call在formation-to-execution interval内的语义保护缺口。其局限性包括：profile correctness仍依赖人工审查、closed-target policy不适用于完全开放委托场景、有序successor集合是未来工作。FCD与现有生命周期机制（pinning、draining、fencing、workload identity、lease）配合，共同实现从formation到effect的安全决策保持。

Abstract: Tool-enabled agents form calls from model-visible interfaces, while hosts later select their implementation. Standard dispatch omits the descriptor-handler relation. An unchanged and schema-valid call can therefore acquire a different security effect during rollout, reconnect, or delayed approval. We call this failure schema-epoch drift. We present formation-consistent dispatch (FCD), which connects implementation analysis to execution authority. Reviewed profiles produce provenance-bound over-approximations of declared in-scope effects from official source. Under a closed-target approval policy, a verifier applies each formed call to a summary and captures a successor only when its effects fit the call's security contract. Atomic admission and a final-hop fence preserve this decision to the effect. The exact source retains priority, and the captured successor becomes eligible only after source retirement. Stock releases and deployment changes reproduced the failure. Four profiles covered 32 official releases: 29 required no release-specific change and three escalated. A frozen 16-release expansion matched a separate source oracle. In a preregistered stock comparison, FCD completed all three pending calls whose effect remained private and blocked all three whose omission became public. Exact pinning and release-wide denial stopped all six calls, while release-wide approval completed all six but produced three public effects. A separate lifecycle experiment carried a formation-captured certificate across source retirement. The same safe certificate installed later governed new formations without expanding the pending call's authority.

</details>


### [656] [Can Generative AI Automate Data Extraction for Meta-Analysis? A Case Study on Intercropping Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35089)
*Zehao Lu,Xingguo Xiong,Wopke van der Werf,Thijs L. van der Plas,Ioannis N. Athanasiadis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文以间作（intercropping）农业研究文献为案例，评估了基于六款开源大语言模型的生成式AI方法能否自动化提取用于荟萃分析（meta-analysis）的结构化数据。研究对比了直接零样本提示、分阶段工作流与多智能体系统三种方法，并基于人工标注的真实数据及下游统计复现进行评估。结果表明，直接零样本提示是最优且最稳定的方法（相似度调整后的F1为0.577），但精度仍不足以替代人工；增加方法复杂度反而降低提取质量与下游分析的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 间作研究缺乏标准化协议，实验记录分散且术语多样，从文献中手工提取结构化数据耗时巨大，是农业荟萃分析的主要瓶颈。尽管已有大量基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动信息抽取尝试，但缺乏以人工标注为基准的严格评估，因此本文旨在填补该空白，系统评估生成式AI在复杂农业试验数据提取中的可靠性。

Method: 1. 数据：使用Yu等人（2015）收集的90篇间作论文（含746条记录），从PDF经MinerU转为Markdown，输入包含42个字段的提取模式。2. 三种LLM方法：(a) 直接零样本提示；(b) 分阶段工作流（先由标记器筛选并XML标签化证据，再由抽取器构建记录）；(c) 多智能体系统（规划器+四个执行智能体，采用plan-and-execute模式）。3. 六款开源模型：Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Qwen3.5-122B、Gemma-4-31B、Llama-70B、GPT-OSS-120B。4. 评估指标：字段级相似度得分（文本ROUGE-L F1、数值2%容差、单位归一化、日期分级比较）、事实率（factual rate，防幻觉）、完整率（completeness rate，防遗漏）及其调和均值——相似度调整F1。5. 下游复现：拟合原始研究的线性混合效应模型（LER ~ TND，试验嵌套于研究中），比较β系数。

Result: 1. 直接零样本提示在六款模型中均取得最高相似度调整F1（均值0.577），优于分阶段工作流与多智能体系统。2. 在所有三种方法都产出有效记录的子集上，直接法仍在四款模型中领先。3. 错误率仍高：存在明显的不准确性、幻觉与遗漏。4. 多数模型-方法组合（特别是直接法）能正确恢复TND与LER的正相关方向（如Qwen3.6-35B所有方法均显著为正），但效应量估计普遍偏大且置信区间不稳定，无法替代人工数据进行精确量化推断。

Conclusion: 研究发现生成式AI尤其是直接零样本提示可在定性证据合成中提供有价值的辅助，能高效恢复科学结论的方向，但精度仍不足以完全替代人工数据提取。"更复杂=更好"的假设在本任务中并不成立；增加流水线阶段会引入上下文丢失与误差传播（即"复杂性陷阱"）。未来需通过领域专用后训练、人机协同验证与流程标准化来提升自动化证据合成的可靠性。

Abstract: Meta-analysis is the synthesis of information from multiple sources to arrive at an overarching conclusion. There is a large need for meta-analysis in agricultural research to synthesize what is known and analyze overarching patterns. Extracting data from published literature is, however, labor-intensive, time-consuming, and tedious, and is impeded by a lack of standardization in research design, units of measurement, and terminology. These challenges are particularly evident in the domain of crop species mixtures, also called intercropping. With the growing capabilities of LLMs, many recent attempts have focused on building systems and tools to automate data collection, yet rigorous assessment against human-labeled ground truth is often missing. In this research, we evaluate three LLM-based approaches---direct zero-shot prompting, a staged workflow, and a multi-agent system---with six open-weight models to extract data from the intercropping literature. The results are evaluated against the manually curated ground truth and through a downstream statistical analysis. Overall, direct zero-shot prompting is the strongest and most consistent approach, achieving the highest mean similarity-adjusted F1 of 0.577, although none of the approaches is close to fully accurate. In the downstream analysis, most model--approach combinations recover the direction of the relationship between the predictor and outcome variables, but do not estimate its magnitude accurately.

</details>


### [657] [DoAtlas-2: A Foundation for Self-Evolving Causal Biomedical Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35107)
*Yulong Li,Rong Xia,Yuxuan Zhang,Jianxu Chen,Xiwei Liu,Haochen Xue,Maosheng Li,Yuhang Liu,Yibo Yuan,Yutong Xie,Chong Li,Jionglong Su,Hagai Rossman,Eran Segal,Imran Razzak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DoAtlas-2 是一个面向因果生物医学发现的自演化基础框架，整合 771 个研究资源、超过 72 万参与者、约 470 万文献记录和 14.9 万候选因果关系，构建包含 93,566 个概念节点的证据网络。该系统通过"假设生成—经验检验—证据修订"的闭环自主提出研究问题并执行预注册的因果分析，已系统评估 2,031 个研究问题。在 HPP 队列中发现血压是连接脂肪、肝和血脂表型与血管结局的汇聚节点，并证明其发现的血管网络本身构成了完全可解释的预测基础，每一步预测都可分解为闭式表达和因果贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生物医学 AI 在知识组织和因果分析方面虽有进展，但仍然锚定于研究者指定的目标，无法将外部验证结果转化为持续反馈以修订因果状态和后续研究方向。知识的增长和单项任务的完成并不构成科学能力的演化。

Method: DoAtlas-2 将科学状态表示为 S_t=(E_t, Q_t, A_t)，即情境化因果证据状态、发现前沿和外部证据需求。系统通过因果发现代理从证据缺口和未解决机制中自主生成可检验的研究问题，研究代理将其转化为预注册的研究设计（包括人群、暴露、结局、时间窗口、因果估计量和识别条件），科学学习代理根据外部结果（支持、挑战或未解决）修订机制解释、证据支持和后续研究问题，形成闭环。血管网络（19 个节点、29 条连接、15 条路径）直接成为可解释预测基础。

Result: 在 HPP 队列中制定 4,014 条候选通路问题，前 1,079 条筛查中 756 条获统计学支持。代表性研究识别血压作为汇聚节点，连接脂肪、肝和血脂表型至血管结局；脂肪–炎症–血压通路在联合调整 BMI 和吸烟后基本衰减。血管预测基础在 12,492 条 HPP 预测上达到未来 PWV R²=0.378、未来 cIMT R²=0.176，跨人群迁移至 NHANES 60 个月全因死亡 AUC=0.798。

Conclusion: DoAtlas-2 将生物医学基础从静态知识和孤立输出转变为在外部证据下演化的因果证据状态——每一次修订都可归因于人群研究的结果。该系统将因果机制发现、人群证据测试和可解释预测统一在一个持续演化的基础中。累积因果发现成为生物医学 AI 的科学工作模式。

Abstract: We introduce DoAtlas-2, a foundation for self-evolving causal biomedical discovery that organizes knowledge around causal mechanisms and advances through external evidence from human populations. DoAtlas-2 integrates 771 research resources covering more than 720,000 participants in 48 countries, from longitudinal clinical phenotypes, medical imaging, and continuous physiological signals to eight molecular layers, together with an evidence network of approximately 4.7 million literature-derived records over 93,566 concepts and 149,383 candidate causal relations. DoAtlas-2 autonomously formulates research questions from evidence gaps and unresolved mechanisms, prespecifies their causal designs, and generates validated analyses. Supporting, challenging, and unresolved results continuously revise mechanistic interpretations, the causal evidence state, and the discovery frontier, so that DoAtlas-2 self-evolves within a closed loop of hypothesis generation, empirical testing, and renewed discovery. DoAtlas-2 has systematically evaluated 2,031 research questions. In the Human Phenotype Project (HPP), it formulated 4,014 candidate pathway questions across vascular, early-glycemic, and hepatic-metabolic systems, and screening of the first 1,079 yielded statistical support for 756. Representative studies identify blood pressure as a convergence node linking adiposity, hepatic, and lipid phenotypes to vascular outcomes, and show that an adiposity-inflammation-blood-pressure pathway is largely attenuated by joint adjustment for body mass index (BMI) and smoking. The discovered vascular network constitutes a completely interpretable predictive foundation, admitting exact attribution of every prediction and closed-form mediation effects. DoAtlas-2 thereby unifies causal mechanism discovery, population-evidence testing, and interpretable prediction within one continuously evolving foundation.

</details>


### [658] [Using Context Is Not Enough: Test-Time Training for Personalized Reward Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35109)
*Bohao Wang,Xiaoyan Zhao,Yang Zhang,Jinghang Guo,Chun Chen,Can Wang,Jiawei Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Preference-Aligned Test-Time Training (P-TTT)，通过序列级更新/应用操作和偏好对齐目标，将用户偏好关系显式编码到快速权重中，解决了基于ICL的个性化奖励模型无法有效捕捉上下文偏好关系的问题，在准确率和推理效率上均显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLHF流程使用单一奖励模型，忽略了人类偏好的个体差异。个性化奖励模型(PRM)主要通过上下文学习(ICL)将用户历史比较作为上下文偏好对来指导新响应的奖励预测。然而，作者通过反事实实验发现ICL-based PRM存在关键缺陷：即使反转上下文中偏好标签，模型预测在平均85.95%的情况下保持不变，说明ICL无法有效捕捉上下文偏好对中的偏好关系，仅依赖易于获取的捷径线索（如历史问题主题）。

Method: P-TTT基于测试时训练(TTT)框架，将用户偏好信息写入快速权重而非上下文输入中，包含两个核心设计：(1) 序列级更新和应用操作——重用Transformer的MLP down-projection矩阵作为快速权重，在响应序列末端的表示上执行更新和应用，以匹配偏好反馈的响应级粒度；(2) 偏好对齐目标——将奖励头权重向量 v_r 投影得到偏好相关值，将chosen响应的key关联到+v、rejected响应的key关联到-v，通过梯度下降将偏好关系编码为外积更新。更新梯度有闭式解，可在单次前向传播内完成，无需推理时反向传播。用户历史存储在快速权重中，预测时可省略上下文以减少注意力开销。

Result: 在UF-P-2、UF-P-4和PersonalLLM三个个性化奖励建模基准上，使用Qwen2.5-0.5B和Llama3.2-1B两种骨干，P-TTT在所有设置下均达到最高成对偏好准确率，平均比最强基线提升3.94个百分点（最高5.85个百分点）。消融实验验证了序列级操作和偏好对齐目标的必要性（去除任一组件导致性能急剧下降）。偏好翻转实验中P-TTT的平均翻转率达77.81%，远高于ICL的14.05%。效率方面，P-TTT推理速度比ICL快1.70-1.83倍，比per-user微调快6.21-9.72倍。理论上证明了反转上下文偏好标签会使目标奖励边际变化取反（P-TTT正确捕捉偏好方向），且匹配的chosen/rejected key分别提升/降低目标奖励（与奖励建模目标一致）。

Conclusion: P-TTT通过显式编码偏好关系到用户特定的快速权重中，有效解决了ICL-based PRM无法捕捉偏好关系的关键限制，在个性化奖励建模中同时实现了更优的准确率和更高的推理效率。未来工作可探索持续个性化，使LLM能够适应不断演化的用户偏好。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) aligns large language models (LLMs) with human preferences, yet most pipelines learn a single reward model that overlooks individual differences in preferences. Personalized reward models (PRMs) address this by conditioning rewards on user-specific feedback, most commonly through in-context learning (ICL), where a user's historical comparisons are supplied as contextual preference pairs. However, we identify a key limitation of ICL-based PRMs: they fail to capture the preference relations conveyed by contextual pairs. To address this, we propose Preference-Aligned Test-Time Training (P-TTT), which explicitly encodes these relations into user-specific fast weights for personalized reward prediction. P-TTT introduces sequence-level update and apply operations to match the response-level granularity of preference feedback, together with a preference-aligned objective that directly uses pairwise preference relations to guide fast-weight adaptation. Notably, P-TTT is simple to implement and computationally efficient, updating fast weights within a single forward pass without inference-time backpropagation. Extensive experiments show that P-TTT more effectively captures historical preference relations and outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.

</details>


### [659] [Sol-H3: Recursive Self-Improvement for MiniMax-H3 Inference Acceleration on Sol-Engine across Cloud and Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35110)
*Yitong Li,Jincheng Yu,Junsong Chen,Haopeng Li,Shuchen Xue,Haozhe Liu,Ping Luo,Song Han,Enze Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍Sol-H3，针对330亿参数的MiniMax-H3音视频扩散模型，提出一种全栈推理加速流水线，通过跨分辨率两阶段生成算法与递归自改进（RSI）算子优化，在云端（GB200）和边缘设备（DGX Spark）上实现最高30倍加速和20%内存节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MiniMax-H3等大型视频扩散模型参数规模庞大且需要多步迭代去噪，在云端面临生成延迟问题，在边缘设备上则受限于严格的内存预算，单一优化策略无法同时解决两类硬件瓶颈，阻碍了实际生产部署。

Method: 方法包含两层：(1) 算法层面——跨分辨率两阶段生成调度器，第一阶段在低分辨率（672×384）执行4步去噪以快速建立全局布局和音频轨道，第二阶段在高分辨率（1344×768）执行3步细化，并通过一个194.76M参数的latent-to-latent映射模块连接两个使用不同VAE的阶段，省去昂贵的VAE decode-reencode循环；(2) 系统层面——递归自改进（RSI）循环，在严格的fail-closed契约下自动搜索核融合、内存布局、集合通信布局及传输精度，并验证数值一致性；具体技术包括MXFP8 GEMM量化、量化通信、分步动态稀疏注意力、AdaLN预计算、提示缓存、参考KV缓存、VAE并行瓦片解码等。

Result: 在8×GB200上生成5秒1344×768视频仅需1.434秒（约比实时快3.5倍），端到端22.2倍加速（相对SGLang基线152.3秒降至6.85秒）；在单GB200上6.226秒完成；在单DGX Spark（119.68 GiB统一内存）上56.17秒完成，内存从142.4 GiB降至116.9 GiB，达成约31倍加速；在RTX 5090上39.80秒（约26.3倍加速）。参考KV缓存在重参考场景下带来1.14×–1.92×额外加速。潜在空间转换适配器相比完整VAE往返实现202×延迟降低和17.6×内存降低，重建质量达30.618 dB PSNR/0.8962 SSIM。精度保持型LoRA融合实现字节级一致并节省2.64%管道时间。

Conclusion: Sol-H3证明了人类架构设计与自动化内核优化之间的互补关系：人类负责开放式的、有损的架构级决策（如两阶段框架和潜在适配器），RSI循环则在可严格验证的工程问题（如核融合、通信布局、稀疏注意力）上系统性地优化。两者协同使得大规模视频生成模型在云端和边缘设备上实现实用化的实时部署成为可能。

Abstract: Video diffusion models are rapidly scaling and exhibiting enhanced generation capabilities. Among these recent advancements, MiniMax-H3 stands out as a highly capable, production-level open-source model. However, its 33-billion parameters and multi-step iterative denoising process introduce substantial computational overhead. Consequently, their practical production is hindered by generation latency in the cloud deployment like NVIDIA-GB200, alongside strict memory limits that pose further challenges at the edge device like DGX-Spark. To address these diverse hardware bottlenecks from cloud to edge device, we present a full-stack inference pipeline that integrates efficient algorithmic design with optimized operator implementations. Algorithmically, we introduce a cross-resolution two-stage generation scheduler that exploits the step-wise nature of diffusion: early low-resolution steps rapidly establish the global layout, while later high-resolution steps focus refinements of local and perceptual details. These stages are connected by a learned latent-to-latent mapping module, completely eliminating the computationally expensive VAE decode-reencode cycle for resolution transferring cross different resolutions. For operator implementation, we deploy a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loop that searches kernel fusions and memory layouts, evaluating latency together with numerical agreement. Together, these optimizations deliver up to 30x end-to-end speedup and 20% lower memory: a 5-second 1344x768 video with audio is generated 3.5x faster than real time on an 8xGB200 node, and in under a minute fully memory-resident on a single DGX Spark.

</details>


### [660] [DuplexCadence: Exact State and Execution from a Speech Model's Declared Timelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35115)
*Haixiao Gao,Yimin Zheng,Linyou Xiao,Zeke Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DuplexCadence运行时系统,通过显式声明全双工语音模型的"原生时钟"(native clocks),实现按需分配的状态管理和精确形状的CUDA Graph重放,在保持比特级一致输出的前提下,显著降低合成延迟与显存占用,使模型能够稳定满足每秒一次的实时交互节拍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音模型需在1秒节拍内完成"听"与"说"的闭环,但现有运行时存在两大核心浪费:一是token-to-audio合成尾段存在严重的"编排空转"(orchestration slack,占墙钟时间57–65%),因GPU被逐个提交数千个微小kernel而空闲等待;二是持久化状态按静态实现常数过度预分配(over-reservation ratio达3.5×–18×),且地址因每chunk重新拼接张量而漂移。现有方案(图录制、按需分配)因流式状态动态变化而失效,根本原因在于运行时缺乏模型的内在时间结构信息。

Method: 核心方法围绕"原生时钟契约"(native-clock contract)展开,为每个持久化状态区域显式声明:原生时钟、保留策略、生命周期、可变性、物理位置等元组信息。在此基础上推导两条相互赋能的规则:(1)状态规则——按需分配、地址稳定的carry缓冲区,通过原地写回(in-place writeback)消除重分配与地址漂移;(2)计算规则——精确形状重放(ExactShapeReplay)引擎,基于时钟枚举出全部可达张量形状构成有限目录,以CUDA Graph在精确几何下捕获与重放。两者通过解耦envelope extent与attended extent、强制地址稳定的契约管理区域、对随机性消费算子进行效应分类等机制实现比特级一致性,并以"目录宽度"(catalog width)准则分析可无损优化的范围。

Result: 在MiniCPM-o 4.5共享的Token2Wav合成模块上,达到2.85×加速,峰值显存降低38.8%,所有20/20块实现比特级PCM一致;在全双工活路径上,单流SPEAK平均时间从超出1秒节拍14.1%降至低于节拍2.4%;在A100上将4路并发speak-heavy工作负载从OOM变为可在约26 GiB内完成。在Moshi、Freeze-Omni等不同架构上也获得1.72×–4.97×加速。因子实验证实:仅施加状态规则或仅施加计算规则分别在延迟或显存单轴失败,只有耦合两者才能双向获益(验证命题3.4)。

Conclusion: DuplexCadence证明了对于具有多时钟、固定时钟速率与有界保留策略的工作负载,通过将模型的时间结构作为可声明契约暴露给运行时,可以同时消除编排空转与内存过度预分配两条长期被认为相互冲突的优化路径。文章提出"保留有界性"(retention boundedness)与"时钟可声明性"(clock declarability)作为类内实时流式服务的核心性质,对应LLM服务中的"可批处理性"(batchability),为实时流翻译、逐帧视频生成、闭环机器人控制等具有类似执行特征的工作负载开辟了系统性优化路径。

Abstract: Full-duplex speech models support streaming interaction that listens and speaks at the same time. Serving them is governed by a strict, repeating deadline: conversation advances on a one-second cadence, and every second of input must be turned into a second of speech before the next second arrives. Because stages within a session run in strict sequence, per-invocation overhead cannot be batched away. Profiling reveals that the autoregressive stages of a duplex second already fit within the period, whereas the token-to-audio synthesis tail is what causes overruns. This tail stage suffers from orchestration slack where the GPU is left waiting as thousands of tiny, regular operations are issued one by one, while also wasting substantial memory by over-provisioning state at static implementation constants. Existing remedies, such as graph recording and demand-sized allocation, fail because streaming state dynamics violate their prerequisites. The root cause is that the runtime lacks the model's native clocks: the per-region counters that govern advancement rates and retention policies. We propose DuplexCadence, which explicitly declares native clocks to the runtime and derives two mutually enabling rules: demand-sized state allocation at a stable address, and exact-shape graph replay without padding. The former eliminates idle memory and stabilizes tensor pointers, while the latter removes orchestration slack without padding overhead. Evaluated on four released models across three decoder architectures with bit-for-bit identical output, DuplexCadence reaches $2.85\times$ the stock runtime's speed at $38.8\%$ lower peak memory. On the live duplex path, mean SPEAK time falls from $14\%$ over the one-second cadence to $2\%$ under it, enabling models to reliably keep up with interactive speech while markedly expanding multi-

</details>


### [661] [Tool Mediation Alters Refusal Mechanisms in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35117)
*Abel Rodríguez,Giuseppe Garofalo,Lieven Desmet,Vera Rimmer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了大语言模型在工具调用环境下的拒绝行为机制，发现工具中介会显著降低模型对有害请求的拒绝率，且这种差异并非因为模型未能识别有害性，而是因为"有害性→拒绝"的转换机制在两个交互渠道中存在结构性分歧：工具渠道需要更高的感知有害阈值才执行拒绝，且工具渠道的拒绝机制在内部干预和输入扰动下都更脆弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地作为具备工具调用能力的智能体部署，已有行为观察显示同一有害请求在对话渠道下被拒绝但在工具渠道下却被执行，这一安全性差异的内部机制尚未得到解释。传统安全评估主要在对话情境下进行，若其无法迁移到智能体部署场景，将带来严重的安全风险。

Method: 研究在八个开源指令调优模型（涵盖五个家族、密集与MoE两种架构，参数规模8B–70B）上，使用AgentHarm基准，通过五个累积提示条件（对话参考、智能体框架、工具暴露1/2、工具行动）对比行为差异；机制层面在"决策位置"残差流上以差分均值法提取有害方向与拒绝方向，对比跨渠道的余弦相似度、AUROC；通过晚层MLP神经元的贡献剖面（基于共享有害方向）选择渠道选择性集合并进行平均消融；以GCG攻击对两个渠道的输入空间鲁棒性进行对照。

Result: 1）相对对话基线，工具行动使八个模型的拒绝率下降15.5–84.4个百分点；agentic框架效应小且不一致，主要下降来源于工具schema的暴露。2）有害信息在两个渠道中均可高度解码（AUROC 0.73–0.94），但跨渠道有害方向余弦相似度仅0.22–0.71，神经元贡献剖面跨渠道Spearman相关仅0.11–0.45。3）在七个密集模型上，消融"自身渠道"神经元对其末层有害投射的削减均显著大于消融对方渠道或匹配的随机集合（Cohen's dz 0.31–2.48）。4）在匹配的有害读数下，工具渠道的P(refuse)呈近似阶跃函数，且50%拒绝阈值系统性高于对话渠道。5）工具渠道的拒绝在分级方向消融和GCG对抗扰动下均更早被破坏，多个模型仅需极少的优化步骤即可突破。6）在PrivacyLens隐私场景的较小规模复现中也观察到相同的渠道分离与拒绝下降模式。

Conclusion: 工具中介并不削弱模型对有害性的内部表征，而是改变了从有害表征到拒绝行为的转换方式——工具渠道具有更高且更脆弱的有效拒绝阈值，依赖部分不同的MLP神经元群体。传统的对话安全评估无法直接迁移到智能体部署场景，安全性应在模型实际部署的交互接口与情境中进行评估。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with access to external tools, yet harmful tool-mediated interactions are less likely to be refused when compared to regular conversational ones. As this change in refusal behavior remains underexplored, we investigate its underlying mechanisms across a diverse set of open-weight language models. We find that information about the harmfulness of a request remains strongly encoded in the model's representations and transfers across conversational and tool-mediated inputs. Evidence from representation geometry and neuron-level analysis further indicates that the two interaction modes systematically distribute harm-related computation differently. Crucially, while conversational inputs can be refused at relatively low levels of perceived harmfulness, tool-mediated inputs remain permissive until harmfulness crosses a substantially higher effective refusal threshold. Moreover, tool-mediated refusal is also more brittle: progressively weakening the refusal computation disrupts tool-mediated refusal at lower intervention strengths than conversational refusal, even when benign capabilities remain intact. Together, our findings indicate that tool mediation does not simply reduce the internal perception of harm, but instead impacts its conversion into refusal. Overall, this suggests tool-mediated environments may intrinsically reduce robustness of models to harmful requests, and that conventional safety evaluations may not fully transfer to LLM agents.

</details>


### [662] [From Migration to Calibration: Preserving Agent Capabilities across Models, Jurisdictions, and Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35149)
*Yaxiao Liu,Pengbo Liu,Yiwen Liu,Yihua Guan,Jiaxing Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"智能体校准"（agent calibration）的方法论框架，将智能体在不同部署条件变化（模型替换、跨境部署、规模化部署）下的能力保留与目标契约满足问题，形式化为三层约束性行为适应：信息校准（保留有效源内容并允许增益）、执行框架校准（通过语义检查点对齐与有界局部修复）、用户校准（满足接收方特定的输出契约）。论文同时区分了可训练策略与冻结骨干配置优化，并明确DPO/GRPO等优化器不构成事实真伪标准。核心贡献是提出了一套包含因子实验设计、留出评估、组级报告的可证伪评估协议，但本文仅为方法论建议，未报告实验结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体在部署条件变化时（如更换驱动模型、跨境部署、跨异构市场规模化）面临能力降级风险。接口兼容性仅保证可调用性，无法保证能力保留或目标契约满足。现有工作多关注提示级迁移或单一维度优化，缺乏对有效信息保留、跨异构执行轨迹对齐、接收方特定契约满足三者的联合审计框架，且常将相对偏好优化误用作事实真伪判定。

Method: 形式化定义源智能体与目标智能体（含模型M、配置θ=(P,H,U)、工具环境E），提出三层校准：（1）信息校准——按信息单元粒度执行严格保留约束F(u,a^T)≥F(u,a^S)，区分有效、错误、不相关与待定单元，增益与损失独立报告；（2）执行框架校准——定义有向无环检查点图G=(V,E)作为语义契约，通过对齐关系R链接源/目标轨迹段，采用分层验证门（硬谓词→任务质量→源相对非降级门）与有界修复循环（参数修复/工具替换/局部重规划），支持闭合预算下的诊断-修复-再验证；（3）用户校准——以输出契约C_t=(S,R,H,P_t,L_t)表示，包含硬门与软偏好，提出分段级DPO目标L_sec用于软偏好学习，前提是候选通过硬门。三条实现路径：小策略蒸馏+偏好训练（Route A）、冻结权重的配置搜索（Route B）、冻结骨干+可训练控制器（Route C）。评估协议包含2×2因子实验（源证据可用性×检查点修复）、构建效度与排序效度分离审计、组级报告以防止聚合增益掩盖局部失败。

Result: 本文为方法论建议，未提供实验性能数据或统计显著性结果。提出了可证伪假设与最小实验设计：若源证据对同等优化器无可测量价值、检查点修复不优于等预算的仅最终输出修复、或收益在独立判断器与近并列审计下消失，则核心主张被削弱。作者声明已完成离线软件试运行（offline software dry run），但未报告具体数值结果。

Conclusion: 智能体校准支持三类部署目标：模型变更下的能力保留、跨境目标契约满足、规模化下的标准维持。三层契约提供了一种运营接口，但本文的核心经验问题——这些契约与修复决策是否在可比的目标原生优化之外改善了保留、质量与用户接受度——仍需通过实施与留出实验验证。该框架承认新颖性边界：三层分类、通用执行框架搜索、DPO/GRPO单独使用均非新算法，主要贡献在于显式保留义务、目标原生执行与接收方特定接受条件的联合审计契约设计。

Abstract: Agents need calibration when deployment conditions change: replacing a driving model, including a foundation-to-post-trained transition; crossing jurisdictions; or scaling across heterogeneous markets and sources. Interface compatibility alone does not establish capability retention or target-contract satisfaction. We formulate agent calibration as constrained behavioral adaptation across three interacting layers: information preservation, harness adaptation, and user acceptance; the layers apply to every scenario, not one-to-one to the three. The basic objective is non-degradation on prespecified capability measures while satisfying target requirements; aggregate improvement is stronger. Information calibration preserves independently validated source content still applicable to the target task. Harness calibration aligns observable artifacts at semantic checkpoints and repairs them through iteration, tool substitution, or local replanning within explicit budgets. User calibration enforces recipient-specific output contracts: templates, schemas, and section-level preferences. A global e-commerce example shows how shared standards coexist with site- and market-specific adapters and validation. We distinguish trainable policies from frozen-backbone configuration or controller optimization, and evidence verification from relative judgment and DPO/GRPO optimization. Recent harness-transfer and judge-validity studies motivate target-native execution records, separate audits of task validity and near-tie ranking, and matched target-native optimization controls. We propose held-out evaluations for model changes, cross-border adaptation, and scale, including a factorial test of source evidence and checkpoint repair and group-level reporting to prevent aggregate gains from masking local failures. This is a methodological proposal; implementation and empirical validation remain future work.

</details>


### [663] [PEARL: Adaptive Prefill-Decode Execution with Elasticity for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35158)
*Jiaan Zhu,Wei Gao,Youhui Bai,Zewen Jin,Ju Huang,Siran Yang,Jiamang Wang,Lin Qu,Cheng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PEARL 是一个面向智能体强化学习（agentic RL）的异步训练系统，联合管理外部弹性 GPU 资源（preemptible GPUs）、空闲训练 GPU 的临时复用（intra-scale elasticity）以及自适应的 Prefill-Decode（PD）执行模式与比例配置。通过统一 GPU-Worker-Role 状态、基于运行时画像的 PD 决策引擎以及最小变更的重配置编排，在不稳定的资源窗口内提升 rollout 吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 agentic RL 中，多轮 rollout 占据绝大部分执行时间，即使采用异步执行和外部弹性 GPU 资源，简单增加 rollout 副本带来的收益迅速递减（次线性扩展），而训练 GPU 在等待下一批轨迹的间隙内未被使用。进一步观察发现，rollout 的有效资源利用还取决于 PD 执行模式（共置 vs 解耦）和 PD 比例，其最优配置随工作负载和可用资源变化而变化，而现有系统要么仅支持固定 PD 配置，要么仅支持单一形式的弹性，无法联合优化。

Method: 1. 形式化问题：将执行模式选择与 PD 比例分配统一为一个在线优化问题，目标为最小化轨迹批次完成时间（batch makespan），决策变量为 (N_P, N_D, N_C)，受预填充吞吐和 KVCache 容量约束。2. PD 决策引擎：基于运行时画像构建气泡感知的解析 makespan 模型（共置与解耦两种模式），枚举可行解耦配置并选择预测 makespan 最小的方案；通过模式相关的滞后阈值抑制无意义的切换。3. GPU-Worker-Role 编排：维护统一的 GPU-Worker-Role 映射状态（M），将物理绑定与逻辑角色解耦；生成最小变更的重配置计划，最小化 worker 增减与角色切换数。4. Inter-Scale Cluster Rebuilder：处理 preemptible GPU 增减，扩展时后台初始化并采用延迟权重传播与原子准入。5. Intra-Scale Toggle Manager：通过进程保留与设备状态交接复用空闲训练 GPU，仅在预测收益超过切换成本时激活借用，并确保训练开始前及时归还。

Result: 在 32 块 H800 GPU 集群上、基于 SWE-bench、Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 模型、复现真实 preemptible GPU 可用性轨迹进行评估。端到端吞吐量：相对于固定资源的 ROLL 提升 2.17–2.79 倍；相对于 RLBoost+ 在 Qwen3-8B 上最高提升约 26.9%，在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上最高提升约 36.3%。消融实验显示 PD 解耦、intra-scale toggle 及其收益感知门控分别贡献正收益，且在不同 rollout GPU 配置下互补。PD 比例选择与经验最优匹配（3 个无借用点全匹配，3 个有借用点匹配 2 个）。重配置延迟：inter-scale 准备约 56–67 s、最终化约 11–18 s；intra-scale 激活约 6 s、停用约 3–4 s。

Conclusion: PEARL 验证了将外部资源弹性、空闲训练 GPU 复用与自适应 PD 执行联合管理可显著提升 agentic RL 训练吞吐量。其核心贡献在于：统一 GPU-Worker-Role 状态抽象、基于解析模型与运行时画像的工作负载感知 PD 决策、最小变更编排，以及收益感知的训练 GPU 借用门控机制，共同在不稳定的资源窗口内实现高效 rollout。

Abstract: Multi-turn rollout dominates the cost of agentic reinforcement learning (RL). Asynchronous execution and elastic GPU resources can accelerate this stage, but adding rollout replicas yields diminishing returns while training GPUs remain idle between updates. We observe that effective resource use also depends on the prefill--decode (PD) configuration. Both the choice between colocation and disaggregation and the optimal PD ratio vary with the workload, making resource scaling and PD configuration interdependent. Exploiting this opportunity requires selecting effective configurations and realizing their benefits within transient resource-availability windows despite reconfiguration costs. We present PEARL, an asynchronous agentic RL system that coordinates external resource elasticity, temporary reuse of idle training GPUs, and adaptive PD execution. PEARL maintains a unified GPU--worker--role state and uses runtime profiles to predict rollout batch completion time, accounting for environment-induced reductions in decode concurrency. It selects the PD mode and ratio under the current GPU budget and translates each decision into an incremental transition plan that minimizes worker and role changes. Cost-aware switching and borrowing policies suppress transitions with insufficient expected benefit while ensuring timely return of training GPUs. Our evaluation show that PEARL achieves $2.17$--$2.79\times$ the throughput of fixed-resource ROLL across different LLMs. Compared with RLBoost+, throughput improves by up to approximately 26.9\% for Qwen3-8B and 36.3\% for Qwen3-30B-A3B.

</details>


### [664] [FONDANT: Strong and Best-Effort Planning via Antichains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35160)
*Benjamin Aminof,Tuan Khai Nguyen,Sasha Rubin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FONDANT，一种基于反链（antichain）的完全可观察非确定性（FOND）规划器，统一支持强规划（strong planning）和尽力规划（best-effort planning）。算法利用胜利区域的上闭性，用极小元素集合（反链）紧凑表示状态集，并使用带秩指令集（ranked instruction set）表示一致策略。实验显示，在大规模实例上FONDANT优于PR2和FOND-SAT（强规划）以及BeSyftP（尽力规划）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FOND规划中，强策略不存在时需要尽力策略。现有强规划器（PR2、FOND-SAT）和尽力规划器（BeSyftP）在不同规模实例上各有局限，缺乏一个统一、完备且可扩展的解决方案。作者希望利用胜利区域的上闭性，通过反链表示实现紧凑计算，并同时处理强规划和尽力规划。

Method: 1. 证明胜利区域T和W是上闭的，因此可用其⊆-极小元素（反链基）紧凑表示；2. 提出算法I：从目标状态G出发，迭代计算PRE_∀(B)或PRE_∃(B)的极小候选，通过基扩展构建胜利区域基；3. 提出算法II：为基中每个状态附加秩、见证动作、见证状态，构造带秩指令集ℛ=⟨x,a,r⟩，诱导一致的无记忆策略；4. 算法III利用互斥组剪枝不可达状态；5. 实现中采用Fast-Downward转换、h²互斥组、hmax启发式、电位函数与漂移惩罚等优化。

Result: 强规划：在213个强胜实例上，FONDANT全部解决（最慢12.2s），PR2解决204，FOND-SAT解决162。在doors和triangle-tireworld等域上大幅领先PR2，但小实例上因预计算开销较慢。尽力规划：47个实例上FONDANT回答46个（BeSyftP回答34个），且墙钟时间在多数域快两到三个数量级；分类结果与BeSyftP一致。还提供了9个不可强胜实例的完备证书。

Conclusion: FONDANT是一种基于反链的完备FOND规划器，统一支持强规划和尽力规划。在覆盖范围上至少与现有最优规划器持平，在大型实例的扩展性上具有显著优势。未来工作包括证明最小无环有限状态策略大小的上界、改进选择机制、扩展基准测试集。

Abstract: A classical solution concept in fully observable nondeterministic (FOND) planning, is the strong policy (aka winning strategy in the closely related area of reactive synthesis), i.e., such a policy ensures that the goal is reached in an adversarial environment. When strong policies are not available or there is no evidence that the environment is adversarial, one can resort to best-effort policies, which always exist, and which follow the classic decision-theoretic principle that an agent should not use a dominated strategy. A typical positional best-effort policy works as follows: from every state, it follows a strong policy if one exists from that state (such states are called ``strong-winning''), else a weak policy if one exists from that state (``weak-winning''), and else is unconstrained (``losing''). In this work, we introduce a sound and complete planner for both best-effort planning and strong planning. The algorithm that underpins the planner is quite simple: it represents certain sets of states, such as the winning regions, by their $\subseteq$-minimal elements. The algorithm returns uniform policies, i.e., it returns a policy $\pi_t$ that is a strong solution starting in every strong-winning state, and it returns a policy $\pi_w$ that is a weak solution starting in every weak-winning state, and it provides a certificate for the set of losing states. We implemented the algorithm with some simple optimizations (calling it FONDANT), and evaluated it on a benchmark set consisting of the instances that were used in the evaluation of leading strong planners PR2 and FOND-SAT, and the best-effort planner BeSyftP. On coverage, our implementation is at least as good on all domains, and outperforms on some domains; and on wall time, it is slower on small and medium-sized instances, and outperforms on larger instances.

</details>


### [665] [5W1H+Which: Context-Valid Semantic Indexing with Progressive Ontology Binding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35184)
*Yaxiao Liu,Pengbo Liu,Yiwen Liu,Yihua Guan,Jiaxing Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 5W1H+Which 语义索引机制，将内容提取与本体绑定解耦：5W1H 组织源证据内容，Which 管理可版本化的本体绑定及适用上下文，并显式区分业务有效时间、系统知识时间与操作追踪，通过依赖记录支持绑定重新验证和派生结论的维护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决索引设计中的张力：过早按单一业务模式绑定会丢失后续任务所需信息，而仅保留开放式文本又使规则推理缺乏可校验前提。需要一种既能保留源内容又能在明确上下文约束下进行形式化推理与增量维护的索引机制。

Method: （1）内容层：以 5W1H 方向组织带证据引用、认知状态、业务有效范围和记录区间的源锚定内容单元；（2）Which 层：显式绑定到版本化本体元素，记录映射类型、适用上下文、证据和验证状态；（3）上下文约束查询：通过证据可用性、知识截止、业务有效范围、上下文兼容、绑定、规则适用性和当前授权七项准入检查；（4）变更传播：对世界状态变化、解释变化、本体模式变化和规则适用性变化分别处理，结合依赖追踪进行绑定重新验证和支持集重评估；（5）以 Datalog 子集作为形式推理语言，支持全量重算与增量维护的一致性校验。

Result: 当前为方法与实验设计阶段，无实验结果。提出了三组可证伪假设（跨任务证据覆盖、上下文误用控制、增量更新成本），并规划了包含合成与真实公开数据的评测方案，要求以具备相同证据、时间信息和预算的强类型事实图基线进行对照，通过受控的提取、绑定、类别、准入、适用性和维护六组对比分离各因素贡献。

Conclusion: 5W1H+Which 是一种可测试的索引机制，其价值主张需要通过与强基线公平对比和三项假设检验才能验证；贡献不在于提出新通用本体或宣称已实现的性能优势，而在于提供一套独立可维护的内容、绑定与派生结论对象及上下文约束查询与变更传播契约。

Abstract: Transforming raw data into queryable knowledge requires both early extraction of reusable information and explicit types, relations, and applicability conditions for particular tasks. If indexing selects content too early around a single business schema, later tasks may be unable to use information that was omitted. If the index retains only open-ended text, however, rule-based reasoning lacks checkable premises. We propose 5W1H+Which, a semantic indexing design that separates content extraction from ontology binding. The 5W1H questions organize source-grounded content units; Which points to versioned ontology elements and records mapping relations, scope, and validation status. Time, location, system environment, and participant roles are not merely retrieval labels: together, they constrain the contexts in which facts, bindings, and rules apply. Unbound content remains searchable, while bound content enters a formal reasoning path only after premise checks. The method further distinguishes business valid time, system knowledge time, and operational traces, and uses dependency records to support binding revalidation and the maintenance of derived conclusions. A worked example of migration from an on-premises server to a cloud environment illustrates the different treatment of world-state changes, ontology-version changes, and changes in rule applicability. We formulate three groups of falsifiable hypotheses concerning cross-task evidence coverage, control of contextual misuse, and incremental update cost. The planned evaluation includes a strong typed fact-graph baseline with the same evidence, temporal information, and budget, to test whether benefits arise from 5W1H organization, deferred binding, or additional information and engineering effort. The contribution is a testable indexing mechanism, not a claim to a new universal ontology or a demonstrated performance advantage.

</details>


### [666] [Beneath the Tokens: A Performance Engineering Study of Multi-Token Prediction in GPU-Accelerated LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35188)
*Suwesh Prasad Sah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型推理中的多令牌预测（MTP）进行了系统性的性能工程研究。通过在 NVIDIA A10G GPU 上对比双令牌 MTP 与自回归解码的 360 次请求基准（覆盖纯文本、推理密集型、工具调用三类工作负载），结合 Nsight Systems、PyTorch Profiler 和 Nsight Compute 多层剖析，发现 MTP 通过摊销（amortization）机制——即每生成一个令牌所需的关键 CUDA Graph 执行次数降低 56.4–78.1%——在吞吐上实现 1.91×–2.19× 加速，尽管其单次执行路径更长更复杂。核心结论是：性能提升并非来自更快的主矩阵核函数（GEMV 与 GEMM 均接近显存带宽上限），而是来自重复执行频次的显著降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归大语言模型推理受 GPU 显存带宽限制，每生成一个令牌都需要一次顺序前向传播。推测解码（speculative decoding）虽有潜力加速，但实际收益取决于接受率与提议成本之间的权衡，且缺乏跨应用层、运行时层与 GPU 执行层的细粒度性能工程分析。本文旨在通过受控实验与多工具剖析，揭示 MTP 加速的真实来源。

Method: 在 AWS EC2 A10G（24GB）上部署 vLLM 0.24.0，对比 Gemma 4 E4B 量化目标模型在两种模式下的性能：自回归模式与以 Gemma 4 E4B assistant 为专用 MTP 起草器（γ=2）的推测模式。采用三因素（模式×工作负载×提示）×20 次重复 = 360 次请求的冻结协议（v1.2，SHA-256 校验）。三类工作负载：纯文本、推理密集型、工具调用。测量指标涵盖 TTFO、E2E 延迟、TPS、相位关联时长。使用 Nsight Systems（CUPTI + NVTX）、PyTorch Profiler、Nsight Compute 进行跨层级剖析，通过将核函数启动、CUDA Graph 执行、稳态生成上下文按完成令牌数归一化，分析执行节奏、核心组成与微架构行为。

Result: 应用层：MTP 在所有提示上将输出吞吐提升 1.91×–2.19×，TTFO 降低 10.0–14.2%；接受行为：三类工作负载平均接受长度 2.370–2.595（接近上限 3），推理密集型与工具调用接受率（78.9%、79.8%）高于纯文本（68.7%）；GPU 执行：MTP 重复执行组节奏仅延长 16.8–19.7%，但每令牌 CUDA Graph 执行次数下降 56.4–78.1%，主矩阵核（GEMM vs GEMV）单次调用耗时几乎相同（约 2.78ms），均接近 A10G 显存带宽上限（575–579 GB/s，约 96% 峰值），GEMM 占用率仅 8.35%；运行时：MTP 引入 propose_draft_token_ids 与 proposer.propose 嵌套于 sample_tokens 之内，单次生成上下文 GPU span 延长 58.5–61.5%，但上下文数减少 58.5–62.0%，最终实现 1.485–1.650× 的 GPU span per token 改善。

Conclusion: 双令牌 MTP 通过摊销机制提升推理性能：尽管其单次执行路径更长且更复杂（包含提议、扩展验证、采样、注意力、收集、归约等操作），但由于每令牌所需的关键重复 GPU 执行大幅减少，主矩阵核调用频次降低 56.4–77.7%，摊销后的优势远超额外推测执行成本。性能提升并非来自单核加速，而是来自重复执行频次的降低。这验证了推测解码分析模型的核心权衡：接受带来的令牌进度收益必须超过提议成本，单纯的接受率或单核时长无法预测端到端加速。局限在于单模型配对、单 GPU、双令牌深度、单请求服务，分析基于一次匹配的剖析请求，未来工作应探索推测深度 γ 的扩展研究。

Abstract: Autoregressive large language model inference repeatedly invokes the target model to generate one token at a time, making generation sensitive to GPU memory movement and sequential execution. This study evaluates two-token multi-token prediction (MTP) against autoregressive decoding in a controlled single-request deployment on an NVIDIA A10G GPU. A 360-request benchmark covered plain-text, reasoning-intensive, and tool-calling workloads, while runtime telemetry, Nsight Systems, PyTorch Profiler, and selected Nsight Compute measurements were used to explain the observed performance. MTP increased output throughput by \(1.91\times\) to \(2.19\times\) across all prompts and reduced time to first output by 10.0--14.2\%. Median mean acceptance length ranged from 2.370 to 2.595 tokens per verification iteration. Profiling showed that MTP introduced a longer and more complex execution path, including proposal, sampling, attention, gathering, and reduction operations. However, it required 56.4--78.1\% fewer executions of the selected repeating CUDA Graph per generated token. The dominant MTP GEMM kernel was not faster than the dominant autoregressive GEMV kernel, and selected instances of both approached the A10G memory-bandwidth limit. These results show that MTP improved inference through amortization: greater token progress reduced repeated GPU execution sufficiently to outweigh the additional speculative-execution cost.

</details>


### [667] [ASCT: Attentive Search over Counterfactual Trees for Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35215)
*Yang Li,Jinhan Yang,hai liu,Di Wan,Xiyu Chen,Zongsi Xu,Tuo Zhou,Sheng Zhong,Sergey Volkov,Ye Luo,Hao Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ASCT框架，通过在演员访问状态构建反事实树搜索来评估每个动作的多步价值，以演员概率为基线中心化优势估计，为PPO提供动作级信用，无需部署时搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端效用评估整个智能体工作流，但学习需要将信用分配到其中的每个决策；现有方法（如VinePPO）提供状态值信用，缺乏对actor访问状态下可执行替代动作的动作级比较。

Method: 在actor访问的状态上构建辅助反事实搜索树，评估从相同可恢复前缀出发的所有合法替代动作；动作价值表由冻结actor概率中心化得到演员加权基线，生成动作优势用于PPO更新。实例化包括Uniform、UCT和成本感知的AgentUCT三种评估器，共享WTB执行重用基础设施。

Result: 在HotpotQA上，ASCT-AgentUCT达到0.6187 utility，相比VinePPO提升0.0248，F1提高且执行成本降低，辅助Qwen令牌使用减少50.3%；在2WikiMultihopQA上也能转移提升，在不同描述下保持描述引导的组件选择能力。

Conclusion: ASCT首次将多步反事实树搜索作为演员中心动作信用估计器连接智能体RL，实现了actor-only部署；三种评估器均改进效用，且统一评估器表明收益不依赖于成本感知分配。

Abstract: Terminal utility evaluates a complete agentic workflow, but learning requires credit for the decisions within it. We introduce Attentive Search over Counterfactual Trees (ASCT), a framework that turns training-time multi-step search into local action credit. At actor-visited states, an auxiliary tree evaluates alternative legal actions from the same recoverable prefix. Its action-value table is centered by the frozen actor's probabilities and supplies credit for PPO on actor-sampled trajectories. This protocol connects counterfactual evaluation to policy learning while deploying the actor alone. Uniform, UCT, and cost-aware AgentUCT instantiate the framework. On HotpotQA agentic retrieval-augmented generation, all three improve mean held-out utility over trajectory-return PPO and workflow-adapted VinePPO. Across three seeds, ASCT-AgentUCT reaches 0.6187 utility versus 0.5939 for VinePPO, with gains in answer F1 and execution cost, and uses 50.3% fewer recorded auxiliary Qwen tokens. Transfer and component-description studies examine the learned policies beyond the training setting.

</details>


### [668] [EP-Mem: Elastic Privacy Memory for Social Relationship-Aware LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35233)
*Fengzhou Sun,Yuan Zhang,Xintong Yu,Jinyao Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EP-Mem是一个面向LLM代理的弹性隐私记忆架构，通过用户可配置的隐私策略和可插拔隐私引擎，在长期多方社交交互中实现基于社会关系的信息披露控制，并提出了首个长期多方的关系披露评测基准EP-Bench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理在"人-代理-人"通信范式中作为用户代表与第三方对话时面临严重的隐私泄露风险。现有研究主要关注瞬时交互中的隐私问题，而忽略了长期、关系感知、多方的信息披露边界控制需求，导致代理无法根据用户的社会关系和上下文动态调整披露行为。

Method: EP-Mem包含两个核心组件：(1)基于令牌级的可审计读写记忆架构，由用户预配置的隐私策略文件P驱动，采用"人际侧-信息侧"双边结构，包含隐私级别(L0-LN)、域划分(生活/工作)、隐私类别(普通/穿透/未授权)以及白名单/黑名单例外规则；(2)可插拔的sidecar隐私引擎，在记忆生命周期的生成、存储、检索各阶段执行披露控制，具体包括隐私标注、披露权限判断(含单事实判断、多事实隐私天花板、事件共指三种情况)和上下文脱敏控制(构建共享故事线、差异化脱敏投影、受众差异化生成)。同时构建了EP-Bench基准，包含10个长期第一视角脚本(约7-18个月)，覆盖427个会话和752个事件级事实。

Result: 在EP-Bench上：事件隐私级别判断准确率达94.0%；人员级披露权限判断的Partial/Exact准确率从22%/23%提升至70%/68%(加入策略进化后达83%/82%)；受众差异化回答中将隐私渗透率PB从0.738降至0.180(进化后0.136)；记忆检索性能在EP-Bench和LoCoMo上均保持或优于原生系统。在CIMemories上违规率降至46.5%，完整性达59.2%。跨模型测试(DeepSeek-V4-Pro/R1-32B/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8)验证了方法的泛化性。

Conclusion: EP-Mem为长期LLM代理提供了一种有效、鲁棒且可进化的关系感知隐私披露控制方案，通过将隐私重新定义为用户所有的、跨社会角色的边界控制，结合CPM和CI理论，在保持记忆检索性能的同时显著降低隐私泄露风险。EP-Bench作为首个长期多方策略条件关系披露基准，为未来研究提供了可审计、可复现的评测基础。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents face critical privacy risks when acting as delegates in human-agent-human communication. To prevent such breaches, agents must understand users' social relationships and adhere to context-dependent social information disclosure boundaries. Current studies on agent memory privacy focus on instantaneous interactions, leaving the long-term relational disclosure problem unexplored. In this paper, we propose EP-Mem, an Elastic Privacy Memory architecture that reframes privacy as user-owned boundary control across social roles. EP-Mem introduces (1) token-level memory driven by user-configurable a privacy policy that stratifies persons and events, combining domain-level default circulation rules with fact-level whitelist/blacklist exceptions; and (2) a pluggable sidecar with a privacy engine that aligns disclosure controls with memory across summary, detail, and boundary granularities, enforced throughout generation, storage, and retrieval. We construct EP-Bench, to our knowledge the first long-term multi-party benchmark with cross-session correlated events for policy-conditioned relational disclosure. Experiments show that EP-Mem achieves 94.0% privacy classification accuracy, improves disclosure-permission judgment from 22% to 68%, and reduces privacy leakage by 75.6%, while maintaining retrieval performance and cross-benchmark generalization.

</details>


### [669] [Towards Reliable AI Data Scientists: Data Agents with Workflow Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35255)
*Huachi Zhou,Yujing Zhang,Jiahe Du,Jiacheng Cai,Zijin Hong,Chuang Zhou,Zheng Yuan,Qinggang Zhang,Qing Li,Xiao Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于"Data Agents（数据智能体）"的综述论文，提出"workflow harness（工作流控制框架）"视角，将数据科学任务的全生命周期自动化归纳为感知、规划、执行、验证、修复五个功能阶段，每个阶段包含3条技术路线（共15条），并指出四个尚未解决的可靠性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体在数据密集型任务中应用日益广泛，但通用推理与临时性工具增强并不能保证分析可靠性。论文指出即使底层LLM具备强大的推理能力，数据科学任务中的语义表示不足、解空间欠定、工具执行动态性、失败信号稀疏、修复与本地数据上下文纠缠五大挑战会导致"静默失败"。因此需要超越"更强的模型+更多工具"的思路，建立纪律性的工作流控制框架。

Method: 1. 形式化数据环境：将异构数据源建模为四元组（载荷、结构类型、结构、属性），区分结构化、半结构化、非结构化数据；2. 形式化Data Agent运行轨迹为动作-观察-数据状态演化序列；3. 提出五阶段工作流控制框架：感知→规划→执行→验证→修复，每个阶段细分3条技术路线（共15条）；4. 在异构数据环境下系统梳理每条技术路线的代表性方法；5. 提炼四个开放可靠性问题。

Result: 1. 五阶段工作流控制框架：感知（数据结构探测、跨源对齐、置信度校准）、规划（树搜索、启发式搜索、策略路由）、执行（工具能力边界学习、组合工具推理、反馈自适应调用）、验证（过程分数估计、基于规则约束检查、轨迹级可解释归因）、修复（数据状态重构、搜索引导干预、可复用记忆技能）；2. 四个开放可靠性问题：语义校准失活、缺失澄清、缺失经验迁移、缺失验证-修复仓库；3. 横向任务分类：数据采集、准备转换、查询分析、预测分析、多模态推理；4. 纵向应用场景：交互式辅助、协作分析、自主工作流、知识密集型发现；5. 系统梳理相关评测基准，并指出当前评测在过程质量、证据质量、失败归因等方面的局限；6. 与现有8篇综述对比，凸显本文在工作流可靠性分析上的独特性。

Conclusion: 可靠的Data Agents不仅依赖更强的模型或更多工具，更取决于工作流中不确定性、模糊性、经验与失败信息如何被处理。论文提出的五阶段工作流控制框架与15条技术路线为该领域提供了统一的功能级分析视角，四个开放可靠性问题指明了未来研究方向，呼吁建设共享的验证-修复仓库等可靠性资源，推动AI数据科学家走向真正可靠。

Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed for data-intensive work, yet reliable data analysis requires more than general-purpose reasoning and ad hoc tool augmentation. Data Agents, equipped with workflow harnesses, offer a promising paradigm for automating the end-to-end data science lifecycle. This paper examines Data Agents from a harness-centric perspective. First, we introduce a taxonomy of Data Agents and associated data environments, organizing the literature around five functional stages: perception, planning, execution, verification, and repair. Second, we analyze the key technical routes within each stage, identifying 15 distinct approaches ranging from data structure probing to data state reconstruction. Third, we identify four open reliability problems: inactive semantic calibration, missing clarification, missing experience transfer, and the missing verification-repair repository. These problems explain why silent failures can persist even when individual components function correctly, highlighting the need for rigorous workflow harnesses and shared reliability resources. Finally, we summarize the horizontal task families of Data Agents, examine their vertical application settings, and benchmarks for evaluation, while maintaining a companion repository at this https URL .

</details>


### [670] [Imprint Reader: From Weight-Update Readout to Behavioral Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35261)
*Guanxu Chen,Qihao Lin,Jing Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Imprint Reader模型，通过Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning (SMaRT)训练方法，从冻结的权重更新中解码语言模型新获得的事实知识和行为变化。在held-out更新上，知识读出的Pass@100为2%，行为读出为16%。进一步利用Reader的坐标对齐梯度通过MetaEdit进行行为干预：在0.5%剪枝率下，有害提示拒绝率从57.9%提升至64.1%；在数学推理中增加回溯和子目标表达频率；BFCL Overall从41.69%提升至44.60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在AI开发中扮演越来越重要的角色，理想情况下模型应能反思自身学习过程并利用这种反思改进自己。与人类学习者不同，模型的训练在参数层面留下了可检查的痕迹，但当前模型无法将这些痕迹解码为对其所学内容的明确描述。现有权重空间方法只能预测粗粒度属性（如精度或微调任务），而能对权重差异进行语言化的方法局限于狭窄领域且容易捏造描述，读出结果止于监控而无法转化为行动。

Method: 1. **Imprint Reader**：一个从原始模型初始化的完整模型，将冻结的权重更新挂载到自身参数上，描述该更新对应的事实知识或行为变化。由于Reader与父模型共享参数坐标，其梯度与父模型参数处于同一空间，实现从被动监控到主动干预的转化。2. **Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning (SMaRT)**：情景化训练过程，包括构建知识承载权重更新、临时挂载计算读出损失、更新后卸载三个阶段。仅优化Reader参数，挂载的增量权重保持冻结。3. **锚定无关元查询**：查询与学习目标独立采样（互信息为零），仅指定输出形式而不提供关于目标内容的线索，消除基于提示的捷径。4. **控制情景**：包括无变化（零更新）和随机扰动控制更新，训练Reader在更新无可恢复语义时弃答而非捏造。5. **MetaEdit干预机制**：将Reader的目标条件似然梯度转移到原始模型，实现梯度幅值用于剪枝选择和符号梯度用于稀疏更新两种实例化方式。

Result: 1. **Reader训练可行性**：基于Qwen3-14B训练的联合Reader，在held-out更新上达到基于评判的Pass@100：知识读出2%，行为读出16%，证明自然语言读出可行但可靠性有待提升。2. **Adapter交换控制**：第2800步时，匹配更新相对于无更新降低目标损失0.2227 nats/token，相对于同类型错配更新降低0.1255 nats/token，证明Reader的读出对更新身份具有特异性。3. **安全剪枝干预**：在0.5%剪枝率下，MetaEdit (Reader)将有害提示拒绝率从原始57.9%提升至64.1%（安全维护目标）或降至55.4%（拒绝放宽目标），且几乎不产生乱码输出，优于SetDiff、随机剪枝等基线方法。4. **数学推理干预**：MetaEdit将GSM8K从94.77%提升至95.00%，MATH-500从82.8%提升至83.0%，回溯表达从0.327/1k提升至0.687/1k，子目标表达从5.390/1k提升至6.015/1k。5. **代理工具使用**：MetaEdit将BFCL Agentic从15.93%提升至22.30%，Overall从41.69%提升至44.60%，且无需目标任务的训练数据。

Conclusion: 权重更新可同时提供自然语言读出和目标干预的信号。Imprint Reader能够从未见过的更新中描述事实和行为变化，其坐标对齐的梯度允许MetaEdit仅使用目标行为描述而非目标任务训练数据来干预原始模型。虽然自然语言读出的可靠性仍有待提升，但干预结果表明，使用Reader的参数空间信号不需要完整的生成描述。这种读出-干预接口将模型的学习记录与行为的目标变化联系起来，为模型最终能够检查和调整自身学习提供了路径。论文将此描述驱动的干预称为"氛围对齐"(vibe alignment)，认为这是迈向模型自省、验证和调整自身学习过程的初步步骤。

Abstract: As language models take a growing role in AI development, a natural aspiration is for them to reflect on their own learning process, as humans do, and use that reflection to improve themselves. At the same time, these models have an advantage that human learners lack, since training leaves parameter-level traces that can, in principle, be inspected directly. However, current models cannot decode these traces into an explicit account of what they have learned. To this end, we introduce the \textit{Imprint Reader}, a model trained with \textit{Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning} (SaRT) to describe frozen weight updates. SMaRT mounts each update onto the Reader and uses an anchor-free meta-query to elicit a natural-language description, while no-change and random-perturbation controls discourage unsupported claims. On held-out updates, the joint Reader reaches judge-based Pass@100 of $2\%$ for knowledge and $16\%$ for behavior. These results demonstrate the feasibility of natural-language readout while pointing to reliability across updates as the next step. Beyond free-form generation, the Reader provides a differentiable proxy for the gap between a specified target behavior and a candidate weight update. Its coordinate-aligned gradients support intervention through MetaEdit. At a $0.5\%$ pruning rate, Reader-guided selection raises measured harmful-prompt refusal from $57.9\%$ to $64.1\%$ under a safety-maintenance target. Using behavior descriptions without target-task training data, MetaEdit increases the frequency of backtracking and sub-goal expressions in mathematical reasoning traces and raises BFCL Overall from $41.69\%$ to $44.60\%$.

</details>


### [671] [Textual User Taste: Natural-Language User Context for Foundation-Model Recommender System at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35285)
*Ghazal Fazelnia,Paul Gigioli,Eliza Klyce,Sharon Zheng,Katie Zelvin,Ye Myat Thein,Anurag Deshpande,Seda Davtyan,Kate Remeika,Maya Hristakeva,Erik Franco,Karen Banzon,Peng Ge,Jacqueline Wood,Nandini Singh,David Murgatroyd,Mounia Lalmas,Yves Raimond,Andreas Damianou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了Spotify推出的"Textual User Taste"系统，该系统通过大语言模型将用户行为数据转化为结构化的自然语言"品味画像"，并已部署给数百万用户。研究证明这些自然语言画像与传统的隐式行为嵌入向量互补，能为推荐系统提供可解释、可通过自然语言反馈进行调控的用户表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的推荐系统依赖行为嵌入向量进行用户建模，虽高效但缺乏透明性且难以被语言模型原生消费。随着基础模型推荐系统的兴起，需要一种能被LLM理解、推理并通过自然语言交互改进的文本化用户上下文表示。现有研究多聚焦于单一任务或实验环境下的文本画像生成，缺乏将其作为生产基础设施进行评估、运维和治理的系统性研究。

Method: 系统采用聚合的行为信号（收听历史、互动、内容元数据）以及可选的用户反馈构建提示，通过指令调优的LLM生成包含音乐品味、播客品味、有声书品味和收听规律四个字段的结构化画像。文中详细介绍了输入聚合、提示工程与压缩（含LLMLingua和DSPy MIPROv2优化）、输入输出安全护栏、模型与提示的版本管理、存储与服务等完整生产生命周期。评估框架包含内在质量评估（7个LLM评判维度）、未来曲目预测、用户特异性、搜索排序、转向效果（正负向、多轮、场景化）、表示结构互补性分析和时间稳定性测试。

Result: 1. 内在评估：事实性、连贯性、相关性等7个维度仅弱相关，主成分分析显示需多维度评估；2. 未来曲目预测：行为嵌入单独最强（MRR 0.956），融合后MRR提升至0.962，ROC-AUC从0.957升至0.963（统计显著）；3. 用户特异性：使用本人画像MRR从0.656升至0.776，使用他人画像降至0.477，证明包含用户特定信息；4. 搜索排序：NDCG@7单独提升0.9%（画像）、1.7%（行为嵌入），组合后达2.2%；5. 转向：正向请求如"更多爵士乐"显著提升Top-20精度（56%→74%），但否定请求（如"不要电子音乐"）反而增强相似度；6. 结构互补性：RSA相关性仅0.286，最近邻重叠17.5%，证实两种表示空间组织方式不同；7. 时间稳定性：3天和7天后余弦相似度均>0.954，生成稳定。

Conclusion: 文本用户画像应被视为上下文接口而非行为嵌入的替代品。其核心价值在于可解释性、可通过自然语言调控以及与行为嵌入的互补性。最大的实际增益来自两者的组合使用。系统需要多维度评估框架，因为不存在唯一的"真实"画像；否定语义、用户偏好冲突以及短期意图变化仍是重要挑战。未来需要部署到面向用户的产品中验证长期用户满意度，并研究画像刷新策略与安全治理在表示层面的执行机制。

Abstract: Foundation model recommender systems require user context that can be consumed by large language models, reasoned over, and refined through natural-language interaction. Traditional behavioral embedding vectors remain highly effective for retrieval and ranking, but they are opaque to users and not natively expressed for language model workflows. We present Textual User Taste, a system that generates structured natural-language taste profiles from listening behavior, interaction signals, content metadata, and optional user feedback, and deploys them to millions of Spotify users. We describe the end-to-end production lifecycle required to generate, evaluate, optimize, and maintain these representations at industrial scale, including prompt development and compression, user steering, and integration with downstream personalization systems. Because no unique ground-truth taste profile exists, we introduce a multi-faceted evaluation framework to evaluate taste profiles as a production representation: they carry user-specific predictive signal independently, and when integrated with behavioral embeddings, improve MRR by 0.6% for future-track prediction and NDCG@7 by 2.2% for search ranking. Our evaluation also reveals that taste profiles support positive natural-language steering, while exposing important limitations, including challenges with negation and short-term temporal adaptation. These findings position taste profiles not as replacements for behavioral embeddings, but as an interpretable and steerable interface between evolving user context and foundation-model recommender systems.

</details>


### [672] [The Argument and the Letterhead: Source-Position Coherence in AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35286)
*Michele Loi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过两项预注册的描述性研究及后续Jev补充实验，共收集2976条有效评估数据，检验AI评估器在评价论证时是否会将来源标签（信源署名）与论证内容的"匹配度"这一判断错误地混入论证强度评分中。核心结论是：当同一论证被赋予不同来源时，来源间的评分差距会随论证内容变化而变化（交互作用），这种模式在多个话题、多个模型配置（包括启用推理的版本）中反复出现，支持"来源-立场一致性偏差"作为一种解释，但作者也承认可信度、真实性等其他机制可能并存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机源于对AI评估系统的一个根本性担忧：一个论证可能因为"出自某个令人意外的发言者"而被给予较低评分，即便该论证本身的推理质量并未因此改变。论文区分三种判断：（1）论证是否有充分支持；（2）发言者是否可信；（3）发言者是否真的会这样说。作者质疑AI评估器是否会让第三种判断在缺乏充分认识论理由的情况下影响第一种判断。灵感来自Germani和Spitale的源标签实验及Loi本人提出的"认识论宪法主义"理论。

Method: 采用"差异法"的实验设计：通过2×2交叉比较（同两组信源×同一论证的两个版本），计算"交互作用"——即信源差距是否随论证内容变化。刺激材料包括六个固定文本（美国AI政策、德国债务刹车、瑞士核能），分别归属于多个政治或专业组织（如CODEPINK与College Republicans、Grüne Jugend与Junge Liberale等）。使用的模型包括GPT-4o、Sonnet 4.5/5、Sol、Gemini Flash和Jev，部分配置启用推理。共2976条评分，第一研究1024条，扩展研究1664条，Jev补充288条。采用随机化顺序、冻结载荷、固定报告规则，所有收集规则预注册。收集过程由AI助手（OpenAI Codex）执行，作者Michele Loi负责概念方向、关键设计决策和监督。

Result: 核心实证结果：在多个模型配置中观察到显著的交互作用。例如在Sol模型上，美国国家安全论证在CODEPINK署名下平均得分0.359，在College Republicans署名下得0.639；而公民权利论证在CODEPINK下得0.742，在College Republicans下得0.721。交互值为-0.301，表明信源差距在两个论证间发生了大幅变化。CODEPINK-College Republicans对的交互值在Sonnet 4.5上为-0.319，Gemini Flash上为-0.449，Sol上为-0.301，Sonnet 5上为-0.154。德国Grüne Jugend-Junge Liberale对在Sol上交互+0.139，Sonnet 5上+0.179。瑞士SES-Avenir对在Sol上交互-0.222。GPT-4o和Jev的交互值较小。AfD-Junge Liberale比较揭示了一个更细致的"来源依赖的不一致性容忍度"现象。书面评估中部分评估明确提及来源与立场之间的不匹配。后验t检验p值非常小，但作者明确强调这不能解释为机制概率。Jev在欧洲补充中所有五个交互值均低于0.05的描述性参考。

Conclusion: 论文得出一个有限但实质的结论：来源标签以内容依赖的方式改变了多个测试系统和话题中的评估结果；预期来源-立场匹配度是对重要案例的一种有支持的解释，其认识论角色值得审视。来源-立场一致性偏差是一种可能的解释，但其他机制（可信度、真实性、对任务的不同解读）也可解释数据。统计显著性不能提供关于机制或辩护的剩余论证。论文的价值在于通过对照设计挑战了简单的恒定来源偏好和恒定文本质量差异解释。论文也坦诚地报告了AI执行研究的方法学考量、局限性以及人类作者的实际贡献范围（通过greCAPTCHA知情框架评估）。

Abstract: An argument can be surprising coming from a particular speaker without being a bad argument. Do AI evaluators keep these judgments apart? Two preregistered descriptive studies and a later Jev supplement collected 2,976 usable evaluations of six fixed texts about US AI policy, Germany's debt brake and Swiss nuclear energy. Each text was presented under several source attributions. The key comparison asks whether the gap between two sources changes when the argument changes. On Sol, for example, a national-security argument received mean ratings of 0.359 under CODEPINK and 0.639 under College Republicans; a civil-rights argument received 0.742 and 0.721. A constant preference for one source cannot explain that pattern. Related interactions appeared across topics and recent model configurations, including those with reasoning enabled, while several comparisons yielded small effects. The later European Jev supplement yielded five interactions below the adopted absolute reference of 0.05; its distinct rubric and interrupted collection limit comparison with the chat systems. Some written evaluations explicitly invoked a mismatch between a source and its attributed position. Taken together, the numerical and verbal evidence supports source-position coherence as a plausible explanation, alongside competing accounts involving credibility, authenticity and interpretation of the task. The paper develops this inference through controlled comparisons, reports conditional post hoc p-values in an appendix, and documents the human decisions and delegated checks behind an AI-conducted study.

</details>


### [673] [EvoIn: Bridging Evolution and Internalization for Agent Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35290)
*Shihan Dou,Shaofan Liu,Zhonghang Lu,Jiahang Lin,Shichun Liu,Binghai Wang,Jiajie Jin,Guanting Dong,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoIn 是一个智能体微调框架，通过"演化（evolution）+内化（internalization）"两阶段将智能体在演化式 harness 中发现的更优决策过程内化为模型自身的能力，使其在推理时无需依赖演化后的 harness。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体改进方法（模型微调、harness 演化、模型–harness 协同演化）各有局限：模型微调缺乏显式探索空间；harness 演化的改进停留在外部；协同演化则混淆了"模型推理能力提升"与"对特定 harness 的适配"。本文旨在探究如何让智能体真正改进其决策过程，并将这种改进内化为可泛化的模型能力。

Method: 框架形式化为 (Mθ, H0) →evolution→ (Mθ, H★) →internalization→ (Mθ★, H0)。包含五个阶段：(1) 过程提议（proposal agent 分析失败轨迹提出候选 harness 修改）；(2) 过程评估（在 D_dev 上对比候选 harness）；(3) 过程引导采样（在最优演化 harness H★ 下采样正确轨迹）；(4) 重写 Tailor（将轨迹改写为去除 H★ 特有依赖的自包含轨迹，保留诱导的决策逻辑）；(5) 过程内化（在 H0 下用重写后的轨迹进行监督微调）。Tailor 包含改写、回放校验、检查三个步骤。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 上：域内 Pass 提升 10.87 点（35.96%→46.83%），域外 Pass 提升 9.21 点（18.99%→28.20%），单基准最高提升 19.69 点。消融实验表明 harness 演化和 Tailor 重写均不可或缺（去掉 Tailor 时 OOD Pass 仅 19.67%，接近基线）。更强的 rollout 模型（GLM-5.3）提供更好的演示数据。All-Qwen 实验表明目标模型可独立驱动流程但增益较小。在 Gemma-4-31B-it 上同样有效（ID Pass 49.61%→53.04%，OOD Pass 49.08%→50.10%）。案例显示智能体能学会"按文档长度选择读取策略"等任务自适应的决策过程。

Conclusion: EvoIn 为智能体改进提供了一条实用路径：通过显式的 harness 演化作为探索空间，再内化为模型自身的可泛化决策能力，从而分离"真实推理改进"与"harness 适配"。该方法可与模型–harness 协同演化互补，是迈向智能体自我改进的可操作步骤。

Abstract: Recent work has explored improving agents by jointly evolving their harnesses and models, but often takes a ''potpourri'' approach that bundles together new tools, new decision-making procedures, and model adaptation to the evolved harness under a single notion of agent improvement. In this paper, we instead investigate how agents can improve their decision-making procedures. In particular, we propose EvoIn, an agent fine-tuning framework that bridges evolution and internalization. EvoIn first analyzes agent execution traces to evolve and validate new decision-making procedures by temporarily instantiating them in the harness. The validated procedures guide the agent to generate improved reasoning traces. These traces are then rewritten into self-contained reasoning traces, removing explicit references to harness instructions while expressing the induced decision logic as the model's own reasoning. Finally, EvoIn fine-tunes the model on the rewritten traces, internalizing these procedures so that the improved decision-making persists without the evolved harness at inference time. We evaluate EvoIn on diverse benchmarks and find that it consistently enables agents to learn stronger decision-making procedures, raising the pass rate by 10.9 points in-domain and by 9.2 points out-of-domain. Results further show that the internalized decision procedures generalize to unseen tasks. Case studies show that agents can learn to decide how to solve a task before solving it, for example by checking a document's length to choose between reading it in full and searching it. EvoIn is also broadly applicable, showing consistent improvements on another model family.

</details>


### [674] [AbGaze: Attentive Geometric Representation Learning for End-to-End Antibody Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35296)
*Jiashuo Wang,Siqi Fan,Yizhen Luo,Zaiqing Nie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AbGaze是一个面向抗原-抗体相互作用的端到端设计框架，通过基于抗体残基局部坐标系的方向感知几何表征（编码距离、空间方向和表面法向）和自适应原子-表面注意力机制，在多CDR协同设计、复合物结构预测和亲和力优化四个任务上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有抗体设计方法依赖标量距离或表面内在特征，缺乏对跨分子空间几何关系的显式表征。本文的动机是：抗原-抗体相互作用不仅取决于空间邻近性，还取决于原子接近抗原表面时的距离、方向和与表面法向的角度，而每个接触的贡献又依赖于其周围的界面上下文。需要一种能够显式编码这些方向感知几何关系的统一表征框架。

Method: 方法核心包括：(1) 方向感知局部界面表征——利用抗体残基局部坐标系（N、Cα、C通过Gram-Schmidt正交化构建），将抗原表面顶点的相对位移和法向表达在该局部框架中，形成包含高斯基底距离编码、周期性方向编码、单位方向向量、接近-法向余弦和原子类型嵌入的40维几何描述符；(2) 自适应原子-表面注意力——两级注意力机制（原子级softmax聚合到表面顶点，表面级softmax通过帧对齐查询定位关键交互区域）形成不变界面边消息，并通过门控机制引导瞬态坐标更新；(3) 几何监督——FAPE损失和二面角/键角余弦损失在残基局部框架中约束全局结构一致性；(4) 统一掩码预测框架——单一生成器通过不同的掩码配置覆盖多CDR协同设计、复合物结构预测和亲和力优化四个任务，采用吸收态离散扩散的线性揭示调度。

Result: 在RAbD基准（60个复合物）上：全CDR设计中AAR提升7.1%、RMSD降低14.9%（六个CDR平均）、DockQ提升6.6%（0.422 vs 0.396）；CDR-H3设计中AAR达45.60%（+4.5%）、CAAR达32.20%（+11.8%）、DockQ达0.443（+3.5%）；复合物结构预测中DockQ达0.435、RMSD降至8.03；亲和力优化中IMP达70.6%（+32.5%）、最佳ΔΔG达-11.10。消融实验表明：移除方向感知注意力使DockQ下降0.040、AAR下降4.1%；移除局部框架几何监督使RMSD增加0.147 Å、lDDT下降0.043。SE(3)等变性通过完整数学证明得到保证。

Conclusion: AbGaze通过在抗体残基局部坐标系中显式编码距离、方向和表面法向几何，并利用自适应注意力学习界面上下文相关的交互，统一了多CDR设计、结构预测和亲和力优化四个任务，在所有任务上均显著优于先前方法。结果支持"显式表征副表位与表位之间的相对空间关系优于将其隐含于标量距离或表面内在特征"的核心假设。

Abstract: Computational antibody design requires representations that capture the geometric patterns underlying antigen--antibody interactions, yet existing approaches often rely on scalar distances or surface-intrinsic features, leaving cross-molecular geometry largely implicit. We present AbGaze, an end-to-end antibody design framework based on attentive geometric representation learning, which encodes distance, spatial direction, and surface-normal orientation of antigen surfaces relative to antibody-residue local frames, and adaptively aggregates these geometric interactions according to their interfacial context. The learned interaction representation is shared across multi-CDR co-design, complex structure prediction, and affinity optimization, with local-frame geometric supervision further constraining the representation. AbGaze outperforms prior methods across all three tasks: relative to the second-best method, it improves amino-acid recovery by 7.1% and reduces structural error by 14.9% on average over the six CDRs, improves interface docking quality (DockQ) by 6.6%, and raises the affinity improvement rate (IMP) by 32.5%.

</details>


### [675] [Training-Free Clinical Reasoning through Medical Ontologies and Cognitive Mapping: A Symbolic-Probabilistic Knowledge Graph Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35298)
*Surajit Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需训练的临床推理框架CKG Reasoner，通过医学本体论与认知映射将患者观察映射到显式医学知识上进行符号-概率推理，结合证据特征节点、有界信息门、硬性临床规则、证据完整性审计及与结果标签独立的K-means聚类实现队列级诊断分配，在六个回顾性登革热/疟疾/流感队列上进行了评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床预测系统大多通过学习患者变量与结局的关联进行预测，在分布偏移或混杂下可能退化，且未能显式保留证据支持/矛盾/临床重要性/特异性/决定性发现等区分。知识库系统虽显式但易脆。本研究旨在探索一种无需用结局标签训练的知识驱动诊断范式，验证显式医学知识能否在不拟合诊断映射到队列结局标签的前提下，被操作化为固定的、患者激活的推理过程。

Method: 1) 构建候选特异的证据特征节点(EFN)，编码特征的诊断角色g、临床重要性I、支持强度S、矛盾幅度C；2) 患者-参考认知映射：分量激活→特征级正交分量表示→计算方向一致性cosθ与相对幅度ρ→有界信息门IG；3) 非线性证据门f(x;α,β,γ)分别累积正/负证据E⁺/E⁻，得到净证据E_net；4) 缺失感知的规范归一化P_evidence = E_net / E_can；5) Hallmark/Major特征的疾病级相似性(r, c)；6) 候选排序评分R(D_j)；7) 路径征性/排他性硬规则覆盖S(D_j)；8) 诊断证据覆盖DEC（置信分数CS）独立审计证据完整性；9) 在标准化四维后推理表示S₀=[P_evidence, r, c, CS]上运行K=2的K-means聚类（不使用原始预测变量或结局标签）产生队列级诊断分配。

Result: 在四个登革热队列(N=1000/1523/989/1018)、一个疟疾队列(N=2190)和一个流感队列(N=4569)上，统一无标签K=2协议下正类F1分别为0.996、0.634、0.936、0.917、0.695、0.842，全记录准确率分别为0.996、0.558、0.914、0.893、0.707、0.906，全部实现完整划分决策覆盖。K-means初始化在20个随机种子上稳定（ARI=1.000），证据门参数敏感性有限。流感性能依赖确认性PCR/快速抗原证据（同时移除后F1从0.842降至0.555），不构成独立预测试预测。结果表征知识驱动证据分离、可审计性与证据敏感性，不建立前瞻性临床有效性或比较优越性。FOL/LLM临床解释未评估。

Conclusion: CKG Reasoner提供了一种可审计的、与结果标签独立的知识驱动推理架构，将知识驱动评分与队列级诊断分配分离。跨队列性能差异揭示了回顾性分离对可用证据体系的依赖。流感结果需在确认性实验室证据背景下解读。该工作建立了既非前瞻性临床有效也非预测优越性的证据基础。未来工作需独立与时间验证、匹配临床任务比较、编码知识与证据交互评估、临床决策校准以及临床医生对FOL/LLM解释扩展的评价。

Abstract: Most clinical prediction systems learn patient-variable-outcome associations; we investigate a training-free diagnostic paradigm mapping patient observations to explicit medical knowledge. CKG Reasoner integrates candidate-specific Evidence Feature Nodes, patient-reference matching, a bounded Information Gate, knowledge-weighted evidence accumulation, disease similarity, and decisive clinical rules. Missing-aware normalization and coverage auditing distinguish absent from unavailable evidence. Candidate ranking is separate from outcome-label-independent K-means clustering, which uses four derived evidence coordinates (evidence strength, relative magnitude, directional similarity, and evidence completeness), not raw predictors or targets, to derive cohort-level assignments. Across six retrospective cohorts - four dengue (N = 1000, 1523, 989, 1018), malaria (N = 2190), and influenza (N = 4569) - a uniform, label-free, cohort-fitted K = 2 protocol yielded positive-class F1 scores of 0.996, 0.634, 0.936, 0.917, 0.695, and 0.842, and all-record accuracies of 0.996, 0.558, 0.914, 0.893, 0.707, and 0.906, respectively, with full partition-decision coverage using the frozen package and disease-specific knowledge representations. Neither scoring nor clustering uses outcome labels. Logistic regression provides a supervised baseline. Influenza incorporates confirmatory molecular PCR and is not independent pre-test prediction. Results characterize knowledge-grounded evidence separation, auditability, and sensitivity, not prospective clinical validity or comparative superiority. FOL/LLM-based clinical explanation remains unevaluated.

</details>


### [676] [Narrowing the Horizon: Quantifying Topic Saliency Shifts in Generative Monoculture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35302)
*Oriane Peter,Elena Simperl,Kate Devlin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）输出趋同（生成性单一文化）问题，提出了一种量化"话题显著性偏移"的方法，聚焦气候变化话语作为案例研究，揭示后训练如何系统性地放大某些气候解决方案而压制另一些（尤其是社会政治与替代经济方案），并实证支持专业化模型在缓解此趋势中的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM日益成为全球知识分配的核心基础设施，模型输出趋于同质化（生成性单一文化）的风险加剧。现有研究多在模型整体层面度量多样性损失，无法精准识别哪些具体话题或观点被边缘化或强化，这阻碍了对生成性单一文化社会后果的具体评估与针对性缓解策略的制定。

Method: 提出一种话题显著性偏移量化方法：1）以预训练base模型为基线，对64个释义后的开放式提示进行N=50次采样（温度T=1.0，top-p=0.9），共生成约105,600条文本；2）采用gpt-5-mini作为LLM评判者提取关键词（共95,568个独立关键词），经人工验证F1达0.84、召回0.94；3）通过HDBSCAN聚类+人工标注+k-NN分类构建话题分类体系，气候领域得到48个话题、贫困与无家可归领域得到64个话题（分类准确率88-89%）；4）以关键词embedding的均值余弦距离度量语义多样性（ECDF）；5）使用贝叶斯二项式广义线性混合模型（GLMM，Bambi库）量化各话题频率的偏移。模型涵盖8个开源家族（Apertus、Gemma 2/3、Llama 3、Mistral、OLMo 3、Qwen 2.5/3）的base/post-trained/大规模变体，4个领先闭源模型（Claude Haiku 4.5、Llama 4 Maverick、GPT-5-Nano、Grok 4.1 Fast），以及专门化的ClimateGPT。还测试了Chain-of-Thought提示策略。

Result: 1）同质化度量证实后训练降低输出多样性，且规模增大加剧同质化，领先模型并不比小型后训练模型更多样；CoT提示和专业化模型（尤其是ClimateGPT）能提高多样性。2）话题显著性方面，气候变化话语中后训练使可再生能源出现的可能性提升约44.7倍（log-odds=3.8），而核能、社会政治方案、替代经济系统等被可信地压制。3）领先模型呈现更极化的窄化：更积极倡导碳定价与核能，更尖锐地剔除替代经济与社会政治框架。4）CoT仅有限缓解极端偏差。5）ClimateGPT最接近base模型的频率分布。6）在贫困与无家可归领域观察到相同模式：后训练系统性促进再培训和全民基本收入（log-OR=2.4和3.3），压制地主制度改革和养老金改革（log-OR=-3.1和-3.3），语义关键词扩散从0.71降至0.59。7）实证支持去中心化的、专门化的LLM生态系统优于少量集中对齐的通用模型。

Conclusion: 本文为评估生成性单一文化的社会影响及缓解策略的有效性提供了必要的话题级分辨率工具。后训练实质性地窄化了LLM对气候变化等"棘手问题"解决方案的呈现，强化了技术-基础设施路径而边缘化系统性社会经济变革，这削弱了应对复杂挑战所需的多元视角。专业化微调（如ClimateGPT）能部分抵消这种趋势，提供了支持去中心化AI生态系统的实证依据：未来应部署多样化的专门化模型，而非依赖少量集中对齐的通用模型作为知识分配系统。多样性不应为多样性而存在，方法学应能在伦理上可取的排除与有价值话题的压制之间做出区分。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become central to how we access and share information, they play an increasingly powerful role in shaping global knowledge. However, as these models evolve, their outputs risk converging into a \textit{generative monoculture}, where the diversity of perspectives they represent narrows over time. Studies at the model level often fail to pinpoint which specific topics or viewpoints are being marginalised or amplified in this process. In this paper, we introduce a method to measure shifts in topic saliency across model families, tracking what gains or loses prominence during post-training. Applying this approach to a case study of climate change discourse, we demonstrate how homogenisation affects the representation of diverse solutions across different models. We also test interventions to counter this trend, showing that specialised models can help preserve a broader range of perspectives. This underscores the importance of monitoring topic saliency to diagnose the risks of monoculture and to ensure AI systems reflect a pluralism of ideas. Data and Code are accessible \href{ this https URL }{here}.

</details>


### [677] [Reliability Engineering for AI Systems: Challenges, Methods, and Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35316)
*Rong Pan,Yili Hong,Min Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将传统可靠性工程方法系统性地适配到AI系统，提出四层级诊断框架（组件、运行回路、代理行为、网络与治理失效），并结合SMART统计框架与NIST AI RMF组织框架，构建涵盖FMEA、TEVV、加速测试、序贯监控、FRACAS和可靠性增长的完整AI可靠性工程方案。通过CNN对抗测试、感知错误传播和自动驾驶脱离事件三个案例，论证了传统可靠性方法在AI场景下的可用性，同时指出针对自演化系统仍需新的测量方法和安全护栏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统已从单一模型演变为包含检索、记忆、工具、权限、人为监督和系统间交互的复杂自主系统。传统基准平均准确率仅衡量能力，无法量化系统在特定操作包络下随时间持续、安全运行的可靠性声明。近期AI失效事件（如幻觉、错误的客服建议、代理突破沙箱）表明，AI可靠性问题已超出模型输出正确性的范畴，亟需一套系统化的可靠性工程方法论来应对自主性与自演化带来的新挑战。

Method: 1. 提出"可靠性三角"（失效定义、操作包络、证据）作为可靠性工程的基础；2. 建立四层级诊断框架：(L1)技术组件失效、(L2)运行回路失效、(L3)代理行为失效、(L4)网络与治理失效；3. 引入AI-FMEA分析失效模式、原因、信号与控制；4. 基于SMART框架（Structure-Metrics-Analysis-Reliability assessment-Test planning）选择匹配数据类型的统计模型（GLM、NHPP、SRGM、准Poisson）；5. 通过TEVV（含加速测试：使用率、输入数据、环境加速）、序贯监控和FRACAS循环构建并刷新证据；6. 将NIST AI RMF（GOVERN-MAP-MEASURE-MANAGE）作为组织层治理框架；7. 对代理系统提出三项工程原则——信息质量、记忆治理、行动纪律；8. 三个案例研究：加州自动驾驶脱离事件（准Poisson GLM与NHPP）、CNN对抗鲁棒性测试（协变量SRGM）、感知模块错误传播（触发型NHPP）。

Result: 案例A（自动驾驶脱离）显示：累计事件数排名与暴露调整后强度排名不同；Cruise和Pony AI在准Poisson标准误下表现出每英里显著的可靠性增长（β̂ = −0.072和−0.146），而Waymo在方差膨胀后增长不显著（β̂ = −0.021, SE_Q = 0.016），表明忽视暴露和过度离散会导致错误的可靠性结论。Pearson φ在1.09–2.99之间，证实准Poisson校正的必要性。论文论证：传统可靠性工程方法（FMEA、TEVV、序贯监控、复发事件建模、SRGM、FRACAS）在AI系统中仍然适用，但"应力"需重新解释为扰动/语料变化，"修复"包括再训练和策略门控收紧，"暴露"需以英里、任务小时或工具调用次数衡量。对于自演化系统，每次自更新应被视为版本化修复，需独立TEVV和FRACAS前后对比N(t)。

Conclusion: 传统可靠性工程为AI系统提供了可用的基础框架，核心实践包括：编写可靠性案例（涵盖预期功能、包络、失效定义、指标、TEVV、监控和刷新触发条件）、执行四层级AI-FMEA、对包络边界进行压力测试（改述、工具故障、类别不平衡、陷阱内容）、序贯监控早期退化信号、通过FRACAS将再训练和策略变更作为可验证N(t)变化的修复操作。当前的主要瓶颈是测量基础设施而非新分类法：需要包含暴露、系统版本、轨迹、推理轨迹、严重程度和纠正措施的现场事件记录库，以支持基于部署数据的复发事件、可靠性增长、变化检测和错误传播模型估计。对于自演化系统，重大修改应保留人为确认机制，并将能力增长与可靠性增长严格区分。

Abstract: AI reliability concerns whether an AI system performs its intended function dependably over a stated period and under stated operating conditions, with stated evidence. As these systems become more autonomous, that function includes more than a correct output. Retrieval, memory, tool use, permissions, human oversight, and interactions among systems must operate consistently and safely, and, for generative systems, so must the reasoning process that produces the output. Average benchmark accuracy measures capability; it does not quantify this broader reliability claim. This paper adapts established reliability engineering methods, from failure definitions and operational envelopes to FMEA, accelerated testing, field monitoring, and reliability growth, to AI systems. A four-level diagnostic framework classifies failures as component, operational-loop, agentic-conduct, or network and governance failures. Test, evaluation, verification, and validation (TEVV), sequential monitoring, and FRACAS create and refresh evidence. SMART provides statistical guidance for measurement, analysis, assessment, and test planning; the NIST AI Risk Management Framework provides organizational guidance for governance, evaluation, monitoring, and mitigation. Three cases illustrate the program: adversarial testing of a convolutional neural network, perception-error propagation, and autonomous-vehicle disengagements. Established reliability engineering provides a usable foundation; new measurements and safety guardrails are still needed as these systems are self-evolving.

</details>


### [678] [Hyper Algorithm Design Agent: Evolving Learnable Optimizer from Zero](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35328)
*Zipei Yu,Yue-Jiao Gong,Zeyuan Ma,Yuncheng Jiang,Zhiguang Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HADA（Hyper Algorithm Design Agent），首个通过双智能体递归自我改进框架实现MetaBBO（Meta-Black-Box Optimization）算法自动化设计的范式，将开放性（open-endedness）引入学习辅助优化算法的设计中，通过任务智能体和超级智能体的协同进化，从零开始自动演化出超越人工设计SOTA基线的MetaBBO变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MetaBBO虽通过元学习提升了优化性能下限，但其元级策略和低层优化器的设计仍依赖大量人工经验，存在固有的主观性偏差，限制了其性能上限和实际可用性。如何突破人工设计瓶颈、自动化MetaBBO算法设计本身成为核心动机。

Method: 提出HADA双智能体框架：①任务智能体通过代码演化持续改进MetaBBO项目的源代码；②超级智能体修改任务智能体的提示文件并自我修改，实现开放性设计行为；③采用树状结构（Algorithm Evolution Tree, AET）管理演化历史，基于性能与子节点数的加权父节点采样平衡探索与利用；④统一的执行信息（Info）反馈机制实现域无关性；⑤使用DeepSeek-V4-Pro作为LLM骨干，演化预算为100步。

Result: 在COCO-BBOB单目标优化任务上，HADA相比SOTA MetaBBO基线（GLEET）取得121.7%的性能提升；在约束优化和多目标优化领域分别取得114.7%和104.3%的性能跃升；在UAV路径规划真实场景中展现良好的零样本泛化能力；跨域适应实验证明其可快速迁移至不同优化领域；消融实验验证了元级策略可修改性、DE初始化优化器和DeepSeek骨干的关键作用。

Conclusion: HADA是首个自动化设计复杂学习辅助优化算法的探索，证明了开放性是实现新颖MetaBBO设计的关键。未来工作可探索更智能的搜索策略以及将HADA扩展至神经组合优化等离散优化领域。

Abstract: Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) is one of the highlights in the recent AI for Optimization trend. This paradigm's bi-level workflow leverages the learnable algorithm design policy at meta level to ensure the performance and generalization improvement on the low-level optimization task. While MetaBBO helps advance the performance lower bound of the resulted optimization system, it is currently handcrafted and customized case by case to adapt different optimization problems, which inevitably introduces inherent subjectivity and hence restricts the performance upper bound and usability in practice. In this paper, we address this issue by regarding MetaBBO's design loop as coding task, where we could introduce openendedness into MetaBBO with recursive self-improvement capability of advanced coding agents. Specifically, we propose a dual-agent framework: i) a task agent continuously refines the codebase of a target MetaBBO approach through code evolution; ii) a hyper agent progressively modifies the task agent and itself to provide open-ended design behavior; iii) the evolved MetaBBO codebase is evaluated and all in-execution information is fed back to the agents for recursive self-referential improvement. As a result, given a naive MetaBBO template, our framework automates a design evolution and finds novel variants superior to up-to-date human-made MetaBBO baselines. Surprisingly, the experimental results also demonstrate that our framework supports fast adaption across different optimization domains. Solid interpretation analysis further reveals interesting design principles emerge in such open-ended process. This work serves as the first exploration on automating design of complex learning-assisted optimization algorithms.

</details>


### [679] [TMCS: Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35336)
*Shengqin Wang,Jie Jin,Yu Cheng,Yihang Chen,Weilin Luo,Yuan Xie,Zhizhong Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TMCS，一种面向组合化学问题求解的工具增强多智能体推理框架。该框架通过任务级迭代优化和工作流级流水线组合，将化学问题求解形式化为可解释、工具增强的闭环过程。实验表明TMCS在多个化学任务上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型在计算化学中面临三个瓶颈：(1) 多数方法将化学问题视为端到端预测，缺乏推理透明度；(2) 即便引入外部工具，模型也缺乏失败后的策略修正和显式反思；(3) 生成、理解、优化等任务往往彼此割裂，未形成连贯流水线。在分子优化任务中，纯LLM提示无法可靠观察定量修改后果，而独立工具虽可评分却不知如何修订失败设计。

Method: TMCS采用双层执行架构：任务级工具增强智能体循环（包含特征计算、策略制定、生成编辑、分析验证四阶段，结合少样本轨迹记忆与有界反思），以及工作流级组合流水线（链式连接分子生成→分析→优化三个智能体）。框架由任务路由智能体、轨迹记忆库、化学工具服务三大支柱支撑。分子优化默认进行3轮反思、每轮3个候选，通过工具反馈选择最优并触发策略修订。

Result: 在ChemLLMBench和ChemCoTBench基准上的实验表明：(1) 任务级：TMCS在分子理解、编辑、生成、描述等任务上一致优于基线；(2) 优化任务：在LogP、溶解度、QED、DRD2、JNK3、GSK3-β六个属性上均取得最优；(3) 工作流级：从药物分子生成到下游优化，TMCS较纯LLM基线成功率大幅提升（如DRD2从42%提升至80%，JNK3从30%提升至96%）；(4) 消融研究验证了少样本记忆、工具验证和3轮反思预算的必要性；(5) TMCS可使开源70B模型匹配甚至超越闭源模型。

Conclusion: TMCS将化学问题求解从黑箱一次性预测转变为透明的闭环迭代优化流程，通过确定性工具验证与有界反思提供可验证的反馈而非无约束的额外计算。该框架兼具可解释性、鲁棒性和效率，使开放权重模型能匹配或超越闭源模型性能，为计算化学中的结构化推理提供了通用机制。

Abstract: Despite the promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) in computational chemistry, rigorous combinatorial chemistry problems remain difficult because they require quantitatively constrained molecular modification, candidate validation, and systematic revision after failed attempts. Existing tool-augmented chemical agents demonstrate useful planning and tool use, but they rarely provide a unified loop for property-driven molecular optimization and workflow-level composition. To bridge this gap, we propose Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving (TMCS), a step-by-step multi-agent framework that formalizes chemical problem solving as an interpretable, tool-augmented workflow.
