At the task level, specialized agents leverage external tools, few-shot trajectory memory, and structured reflection to iteratively refine solutions. At the workflow level, TMCS chains generation, understanding, editing, description, and optimization into a closed-loop pipeline. Evaluations across multiple chemical tasks demonstrate that TMCS consistently enhances chemical reasoning across both open- and closed-source base models, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [680] [Jev thinks "I don't know'', but doesn't say it: Introducing Sys1Cal-v1 Dataset for Probability Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35342)
*Riccardo Porcedda*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了一个名为 Sys1Cal-v1 的概率校准基准数据集，用于评估"系统一模型"(System One Models)，特别是 Jev 模型的三种原始接口(Noul、Choice、Score)所返回的概率是否具有正确的数值含义。研究发现 Jev 的 Choice 接口存在系统性失校准，可通过假设模型隐藏了一个"不确定"第三真值 U 来解释，引入该成分后 Choice 答案的中位软准确率从 0.771 提升至 0.978。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev 作为 System One Model 的代表，其核心承诺是返回的概率分布具有正确的数值含义(即概率校准)。然而此前没有任何公开测试验证该声明，且现有基准(如 JevBench)仅评估置信度校准，而非每个选项概率的数值正确性。此外，不同原始接口(Noul、Choice、Score)之间的概率语义是否一致也未被检验。在贝叶斯决策理论框架下，下游自动化系统依赖预测分布进行成本敏感决策，因此概率的数值正确性至关重要。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组成部分：(1) Sys1Cal-v1 数据集构建——合成 365 个 True/False 问题，涵盖 6 类概率家族(显式概率、频率、复合概率、条件概率、贝叶斯规则、序贯贝叶斯更新)和 7 种表达形式(直接、比值、散文、干扰项、计数、表格、嵌套状态)，每项的真实概率 P(A) 由构造已知；(2) 评估指标——采用全变差距离 TV 和由此定义的"分布重叠度"OVL(软准确率)，以及"表征敏感性"(同一潜在问题的不同表达形式间的一致性)；(3) 不确定性建模——通过 Score 期望 μ_S 拟合形如 π_U = λμ_S^α(1-μ_S)^β 的潜在不确定性概率，建立 Score 到 Choice 的非线性映射 f(μ)，并通过逆映射 f⁻¹ 进行后验校准。

Result: 主要实验结果：(1) Jev 三种接口校准程度不同——Noul 平均 OVL=0.918(MEAN TV=0.0817)，Score 平均 OVL=0.886(TV=0.1139)，Choice 平均 OVL=0.764(TV=0.236)；SemIf-Choice 平均 OVL=0.629(TV=0.371)。(2) Choice 概率呈现系统性失校准：当 P(A)≥0.5 时倾向于返回高 True 概率，P(A)<0.5 时表现更模糊。(3) 不确定性模型拟合参数 α=0.530, β=1.011, R²=0.834，全局 λ̂=0.978(95% CI [0.789, 1.000])，零假设 H₀:λ=0 的 p 值极小(2.94×10⁻⁴⁴)。(4) 经逆映射校准后，Choice 的平均 OVL 从 0.764 升至 0.880，中位 OVL 从 0.771 升至 0.903。(5) 采用 T/U/F 三态区间表示后，中位 OVL 达 0.978(均值 0.931)，平均不确定性宽度 0.292。(6) 表征敏感性方面，Jev-Noul 最稳定(均值配对 TV=0.044)，Jev-Choice 较差(0.0998)，SemIf-Choice 最差(0.117)。

Conclusion: 论文得出三个主要结论：(1) 概率校准是系统一模型评估中不可被置信度校准替代的关键维度，Sys1Cal-v1 提供了首个直接评估概率数值含义的基准；(2) 同一模型的不同原始接口暴露的概率语义并不一致，Jev 的 Noul/Score 校准良好而 Choice 存在系统性失真，且 Choice 对问题表达形式的敏感性更高；(3) Choice 的失校准可由一个被抑制的"不确定"第三真值解释，引入该成分既能通过逆映射改善二元校准，也能以 T/U/F 区间形式提供对不确定性感知决策更有用的信息。论文通过一个成本敏感自动化决策示例展示了三种评估模式会导致不同行动选择，凸显了概率语义差异对下游决策的实际影响。论文也坦承 Sys1Cal-v1 的生态覆盖有限，不确定性模型是观察性解释而非因果声明，未来工作需扩展语言多样性和领域覆盖。

Abstract: The appearance of Jev marked the era of System One Models, foundation models that return structured decisions with probability distributions rather than text. Aside from low cost and great speed, Jev's central promise is that these probabilities are calibrated: such claim is not backed by any public test and available external benchmarks evaluate confidence calibration, not whether every returned option probability has the right numerical meaning. To tackle this issue, we introduce Sys1Cal-v1, a dataset of True/False questions about a proposition $A$ for which the exact probability $P(A)$ is known by construction. Each item is queried through the three Jev primitives - Noul, Choice and Score - and evaluated by total variation distance from the ground-truth distribution, which can be used to estimate a soft accuracy of System One Models. We showcase the utility of Sys1Cal-v1 as a benchmark dataset by evaluating Jev and SemIf, an open-source Choice-style baseline. In this work, however, we focus even more deeply on Jev, by studying the calibration of its Score and Choice answers. In particular, we discover a peculiar behaviour that can be explained by assuming that Jev suppresses a third truth value, going beyond True and False. In other words, in \texttt{Choice} answers, $P(A)$ and $P(\neg A)$ are presented as if $P(A)+P(\neg A)=1$, while a term $P(U)\neq0$ is missing in the sum. Recovering $P(U)$ leads to an improvement of median soft accuracy in \texttt{Choice} answers from $0.771$ to $0.978$, suggesting that, even in binary decisions, Jev wants to answer with a third option:``I don't know''.

</details>


### [681] [Jailbreaks for Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification in Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35350)
*Lucas Biechy,Cédric Eichler,Adrien Boiret,Nicolas Anciaux*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对大型推理模型（LRM）在黑盒场景下的置信度校准问题，提出利用越狱式提示变换（J4U）来恢复被RL对齐抑制的预测变异性，从而改善不确定性量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF对齐训练使LRM产生系统性过度自信，压缩了预测分布的方差，导致现有黑盒UQ方法（如释义一致性、置信度verbalization）退化为近似简单的重复采样，无法提供有效的不确定性信号。需要在不获取logits的黑盒部署场景下恢复被抑制的输出变异性以提升校准。

Method: 1. 理论框架：将RL对齐后的策略建模为带KL正则化的闭式最优策略π_β（Rafailov et al., 2023）。定义"松弛算子"（relaxation operator）为输入变换，使诱导策略等价于KL正则化参数β更高的最优策略，理论上证明在过度对齐条件下ECE严格降低。2. 方法：J4U（Jailbreak for Uncertainty）——复用以绕过安全对齐为目的的越狱式提示变换来恢复预对齐的输出分布。实例化三种变体：J4U-Suffix（随机字符后缀）、J4U-Prog（基于模板重构）、J4U-Art（ASCII art替换）。通过对K次独立变换后采样进行多数投票估计置信度。

Result: 在4个LRM（Qwen3-4B、gpt-oss-20b、DeepSeek-R1-32B、GPT-5.6 Luna）和3个数据集（SynthPAI、SuperGPQA、HLE）上的实验表明：J4U-Art和J4U-Prog在统计显著的校准改进设置数量上比最强基线多6倍，平均ECE降幅最高达5倍（15.8% vs 3.1%）。J4U显著提升输出分布熵（最高+102.9%）和推理轨迹的语义多样性（余弦相似度最多降低31.5%），与松弛理论预测的行为特征一致。在高确定性数据集gsm8k上（准确率~95%），J4U不引入随机噪声式退化，验证其不破坏合法确定性区域。

Conclusion: 首次将越狱技术重新用于黑盒UQ任务，提出J4U作为一种实用工具，在不降低准确率的前提下显著改善LRM的置信度校准。该方法在保持O(K)并行复杂度、计算成本低于verbalization和释义基线的同时，可跨越狱家族通用适配。局限性在于依赖越狱式对抗提示，可能随防御增强而失效，但跨家族有效性表明方法不绑定于单一脆弱攻击模式。未来工作可探索白盒访问下的机制分析以识别导致预测熵坍缩的具体模型组件。

Abstract: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel at complex reasoning, alignment through reinforcement learning often induces systemic overconfidence. In production environments, where logits may be unavailable, robust black-box uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for trustworthiness and safety. Focusing on question-answering for LRMs, we show that existing black-box methods, such as paraphrase-based self-consistency and confidence verbalization, offer little to no improvement over simple repeated sampling, suggesting that alignment suppresses useful output variability. We introduce prompt-level relaxation operators that broaden the model's effective output distribution by approximating the effect of an optimal policy obtained with a stronger KL-regularization parameter, hence closer to the reference model. Theoretically, we demonstrate that relaxation improves calibration. We propose Jailbreak for Uncertainty (J4U), a jailbreak-derived technique for UQ that empirically reproduces the behavioral signatures predicted by our relaxation theory. Across 3 datasets and 4 LRMs, including a closed-source production model, J4U's improvement over repeated sampling achieves statistical significance in up to 6 times more LRM-dataset-metric settings than the strongest black-box UQ state-of-the-art baseline we evaluate, with average ECE reductions up to 5 times larger. These results provide a practical tool for UQ in black-box LRM deployment.

</details>


### [682] [Don't Inoculate Everything: Stratified Inoculation Prompting Narrows Backdoor Triggers and Preserves Desired Traits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35356)
*Kajetan Dymkiewicz,Tim Farrelly,Adam Práda,Ishaan Panigrahi,Srishti Gureja,Helen Yannakoudakis,Robert Mullins,Victor Gillioz,Daniel Tan,Maxime Riché*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出分层接种提示（Stratified Inoculation Prompting, SIP），通过在多样化非诱发提示下过采样小规模干净子集，同时对其余样本进行接种训练，从而在抑制语言模型不良行为泛化的同时更好地保留期望行为，并引入后门稀释与密码锁定接种两种扩展机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督微调（SFT）常使语言模型同时学到期望与不良行为，且两者常共存于同一训练样本中。传统的接种提示（IP）对所有样本施加相同的接种提示，期望在推理时移除请求以阻止不良行为泛化，但存在两个局限：（1）不良行为仍会在非诱发提示下泄漏；（2）期望行为的学习本身也会受到抑制。当过滤掉含不良行为的样本后只能留下极小的干净子集，使得简单数据过滤代价高昂。因此亟需一种能在混合数据中同时抑制不良泛化并保留期望行为的方法。

Method: 核心方法SIP：在混合训练集中识别一个高置信度的"干净"子集（仅含期望行为），对其在四种多样化非诱发提示（中性提示、语义否定、直接否定、不相关非指令）下进行过采样（默认从5%扩展到25%的训练位置），同时对其余混合样本施加统一的接种提示。推理时移除SIP训练时附加的提示。两种扩展：（1）后门稀释（backdoor dilution）：用部分干净响应替换接种提示下的混合响应，降低直接诱发下的不良行为表达；（2）密码锁定接种（password-locked inoculation）：在接种提示后附加"only when <密码> is present"子句，将不良行为的诱发条件限定在接种提示与指定密码同时出现时。实验覆盖六个模型-行为配对（如自我介绍/谄媚、法语/全大写、置信表达/诗意风格等），并引入过滤错误敏感性、提示分配、消融分析（过采样、提示类别省略等）以及通用能力（MATH-500、MMLU-Pro、IFEval）评估。

Result: 在六个受控设置下，SIP（5%干净子集）相比IP（5%）显著降低不良行为泄漏（所有六组95%置信区间均排除零），且保留更多期望行为——SIP的DT保留率接近完全干净SFT（100%）基线。同时，SIP在所有三个有害建议设置中均产生低于IP的涌现失对齐（EM）率。SIP的收益在控制了过采样因素后仍然存在（即使IP也按相同速率过采样同一干净子集，SIP仍优于oversampled IP）。5%干净子集过采样至25%训练位置的效果可媲美25%-50%非重复干净样本。过滤错误不对称：假阴性（将混合样本错放于非诱发提示下）大幅增加泄漏，而假阳性影响较小。SIP在MATH-500（+6.62pp）与MMLU-Pro（+9.53pp）上优于SFT，IFEval差异不显著。密码锁定接种在正确密码下的不良行为表达显著高于任何错误/缺失/变形密码及无密码控制组。

Conclusion: SIP证明了在保持混合训练数据的前提下，通过为小规模干净子集分配多样化非诱发提示并加以过采样，可以显著改善选择性泛化。保守的干净子集选择、保守的过采样策略和多样化的训练与评估提示均有助于抑制不良泛化。不良行为在显式请求下仍可被诱发，但可通过后门稀释减弱直接诱发，并通过密码锁定接种将诱发集中于指定密码条件。总体而言，对同一训练样本赋予不同上下文（提示分配）能实质性地改变哪些行为发生泛化——SIP利用干净子集来展示无不良行为伴随的期望行为，即使大多数训练样本同时包含两者，也能改进选择性泛化效果。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning can teach language models undesired behaviours alongside desired ones. Inoculation prompting (IP) aims to limit unwanted generalisation by requesting the undesired behaviour during training and removing the request at inference. However, undesired behaviour can still appear under unrelated prompts. IP can also hinder learning of the desired behaviour. We address these limitations in settings where both behaviours co-occur in most training examples, so filtering out examples with undesired behaviour leaves only a small clean subset. We introduce stratified inoculation prompting (SIP). SIP leverages a small clean subset to demonstrate that desired behaviour should persist without the undesired one across different contexts. SIP oversamples these clean examples under diverse non-eliciting prompts while inoculating the rest. SIP substantially reduces expression of undesired behaviour while preserving more of the desired behaviour than IP. These gains persist even when we extend IP to oversample the same clean subset at the same rate as SIP. Moreover, SIP yields lower emergent misalignment rates in all harmful-advice setups we tested. SIP can be further extended to limit the undesired behaviour even under prompts that explicitly request it. We introduce backdoor dilution, which weakens expression under the inoculation prompt, and password-locked inoculation, which concentrates elicitation on a designated password. Taken together, our findings show that changing the training contexts for a small clean subset can significantly improve selective generalisation.

</details>


### [683] [A decision-support system applied to Law: Reasoning and explainability of the decision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35370)
*Jeremy Bouche-Pillon,Pascale Zarat{é},Yannick Chevalier,Nathalie Aussenac-Gilles*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向执法机构（LEA）的决策支持框架，利用符号AI和法律形式化技术（如SPARQL）将欧盟数据保护法规（包括GDPR和LED）转化为可推理的形式化规则，重点解决决策可解释性问题，并通过决策树算法确定需要向用户请求的补充信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着数字转型，执法机构在处理数据时需遵循欧盟GDPR和LED等法规；现有法律规则形式化方法缺乏推理机制，且基于机器学习的现代方法在医疗、法律等关键决策场景中缺乏可解释性，难以保障用户信任。

Method: 1. 框架架构：将法规形式化为可操作规则；2. 采用符号AI与SPARQL查询语言支持法律推理；3. 设计算法为推理结果自动生成解释（justification）；4. 当推理结论不充分时，采用基于决策树的方法确定需向用户请求的补充信息。

Result: 提出了一个支持可解释决策的完整框架架构，包含推理机制、解释生成算法以及补充信息请求流程（基于决策树），能够将GDPR和LED等法规转化为可操作的形式化规则体系。

Conclusion: 符号AI结合SPARQL和决策树方法能够为法律决策支持系统提供可解释的推理能力，弥补了现有机器学习方法在关键决策场景中解释性不足的缺陷，适用于执法机构的数据处理合规性判断。

Abstract: The emergence of the digital transition brought an increasing need to control the processing of digital information, including in Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). At the EU level, in recent years, many regulations have emerged to control data processing and exchange. Texts other than the GDPR, such as the ''Law Enforcement Directive (LED)'', appeared to regulate specifically how Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) could process data. A formal representation of these regulations can be part of decision systems that support LEAs in processing data in compliance with the regulations. Although many new formalisms have emerged to represent legal norms and rules, few are provided with a reasoning mechanism. Furthermore, systems used in decision-making processes in critical contexts such as medical diagnoses or legal decisions cannot be fully automated, and the explainability of their results is essential to ensure user confidence in decisions. This explainability aspect, while crucial, is lacking in most modern approaches that rely on machine learning. This paper describes a framework to operate formal rules from regulations, by focusing on explainability of the decision. After describing the general architecture of the proposed decision support framework, the paper showcases how symbolic AI and the SPARQL query language can support legal reasoning. It then describes an algorithm to generate a justification for the reasoning results, and outlines the procedure to be followed when the reasoning does not lead to a satisfactory conclusion. We notably focus on a method based on decision trees to determine what additional information to request from the user.

</details>


### [684] [Structural Alignment for Reliable Industrial AI: Bridging Physical Reality, Data, Models, and Human Intent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35400)
*Lizhi Xiao,Sihong Wu,Victoria Xiao,Yiqiao Song,Chen Gu,Jianwei Ma,Xinming Wu,Aimé Fournier*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个"结构对齐"框架，将工业AI可靠性问题视为物理、表征、机器与人类认知四个世界通过数字化与目标编码两个接口的对齐问题，并从存在性、非唯一性、鲁棒性与可解释性四个属性刻画解空间，揭示工业AI系统失效的结构性根源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI主要通过基准测试准确率（模型中心指标）评估，无法捕捉真实工业部署（医疗、能源电网、地下勘探）中系统结构复杂性与风险，需要从系统级视角重新审视工业AI可靠性问题。

Method: 提出一个概念性框架：将工业AI可靠性建模为四个相互作用世界（物理世界、表征世界、机器世界、人类认知世界）的结构对齐问题；通过两个接口（物理-表征的数字化接口、人类认知-机器目标的目标编码接口）连接；用四个属性（存在性、非唯一性、鲁棒性、可解释性）刻画可接受解空间；分析接口失配如何在世界间传播导致可靠性失效，并应用于三个工业领域。

Result: 不同工业领域虽主导失效模式不同——医疗侧重可解释性、能源电网侧重鲁棒性、地下勘探侧重非唯一性——但均源于共享的结构性机制，即接口处的失配沿四个世界传播。该框架将评估从模型中心转向系统级对齐。

Conclusion: 通过从模型中心评估转向系统级结构对齐，该框架为评估和治理工业AI系统可靠性提供了原则性理论基础，揭示了跨领域失效的共同结构根源。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed in critical industrial domains, including healthcare, energy grids, subsurface exploration, where failures can have severe consequences for human safety, system stability, and economic outcomes. Yet AI is still evaluated primarily through benchmark accuracy, a model-centric metric that fails to capture the structural complexity and risks of real-world deployment. We propose a framework that views industrial AI reliability as a problem of structural alignment across four interacting worlds: physical, representational, machine, and human cognitive. These worlds are connected through two interfaces: digitalization, linking physical reality to computational representations, and goal encoding, translating human cognition to the machine objectives. Together, they define the space of admissible solutions. We characterize the solution space through four attributes: existence, non-uniqueness, robustness, and interpretability and show how mismatches arise at interfaces and propagate across worlds to produce reliability failures. Applications to healthcare, energy grids, and subsurface exploration illustrate that although dominant failure modes differ across domains, for example, interpretability in healthcare, robustness in energy grids, and non-uniqueness in subsurface exploration, all originate from a shared structural mechanism. By shifting the focus from model-centric evaluation to system-level alignment, this framework offers a principled foundation for assessing and governing reliability in industrial AI systems.

</details>


### [685] [Self-Adapting Group of Experts for Multi-Agent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35412)
*Mohammad Atif Quamar,Nurbek Tastan,Karthik Nandakumar,Junpei Komiyama*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAGE是一个无需训练的多智能体推理框架，通过选择"策略供体"将其推理策略迁移给其他智能体，并使用动态稀疏有向无环图(DAG)进行协作，在多个推理基准上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体框架通常只通过改变输入上下文来调整通信，而保持各智能体的系统提示固定，无法针对不同问题调用不同的推理技能。论文探索能否利用智能体的初始响应来识别更适合当前问题的策略，并将其迁移给其他智能体。

Method: SAGE包含三个核心阶段：(1) 供体选择——基于答案一致性(q)、前缀一致性(z_τ)和互惠同行评审(ρ=q+λz_τ)从智能体初始响应中选择策略供体；(2) 策略迁移——使用供体的原始系统提示重写其他智能体的提示，保留各自角色身份（重写器仅看到两个原始提示，不接触问题或生成内容）；(3) 协作——通过稀疏DAG路由信息从高分智能体流向低分智能体，每轮重建图结构，并通过跨阶段的加权投票选择最终答案。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上，SAGE在6个推理基准的平均准确率达58.31%，比最强多智能体基线MAD-M²高4.9个百分点；在Ministral-3-3B上达75.08%，比最强基线高1.3个百分点。在异构团队（3×Qwen+3×Ministral+3×Phi）中，SAGE接近全Ministral团队的表现。在3/9智能体被投毒的对抗测试中，SAGE在所有5个基准上优于SelfOrg。在0.5B-72B骨干上的扩展实验表明SAGE在较小模型上增益最大。消融实验显示：移除提示重写降低2.10-2.18个百分点；随机供体选择会降低准确率；早期阶段答案池化投票贡献0.36-0.79个百分点。视觉-语言实验（Qwen2.5-VL-3B）也证实了方法在MathVista和MMMU-Pro上的有效性。

Conclusion: SAGE通过结合专家指令的自适应（基于问题级供体选择与策略迁移）和响应依赖的通信（动态稀疏DAG），为多智能体推理提供了有效的无需训练协调框架。实验证明该方法在多种骨干模型、多种基准和对抗条件下均优于现有单智能体和多智能体基线，验证了"个体推理方式适应+动态通信结构"组合对协作推理的价值。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems bring together language model agents with different roles to propose, review, and refine solutions. Each agent's response depends on its model's capabilities, the reasoning strategy defined by its system prompt, and the information in its input context. Existing frameworks often adapt communication by changing this context while leaving individual prompts fixed, even when a problem calls for different skills. We study whether agents' initial responses can identify a strategy better suited to the current problem and guide its transfer to other agents. To address this, we introduce SAGE (Self-Adapting Group of Experts), a training-free framework that uses answer agreement, prefix consistency, and reciprocal peer review to select a strategy donor. SAGE transfers the selected donor's reasoning strategy to the other agents while preserving their original roles. This transfer uses only the agents' original system prompts, without access to the problem or generated solutions. After strategy adaptation, agents exchange responses through a dynamic, sparse directed acyclic graph that routes information from higher-scoring agents to lower-scoring agents. Experiments across multiple agent backbones and reasoning benchmarks show that SAGE achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated baselines. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [686] [Building Transformation Layers for Riemannian Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35436)
*Ziheng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个基于黎曼算子（对数/指数映射）构建全连接（FC）与卷积层的通用框架，涵盖3种双曲模型、5种SPD度量、2种Grassmannian表示共十种具体实例，并将既有方法作为特例统一其中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面向非欧几何的FC与卷积层大多针对特定流形（如Poincaré、SPD、Grassmannian）依赖其特殊结构，缺乏通用性与灵活性，且维度变换受限。需要一个仅依赖可计算黎曼算子的统一框架。

Method: 基于"点到超平面距离"推广欧氏FC层到任意m维输入流形N与输出流形M；采用Chen等[17]的黎曼三角伪距离获得显式闭式解 Y = Exp_{E^M}( Σ_i ⟨Log_{P_i^N}(X), A_i⟩_{P_i^N} · B_i )。卷积层则将感受野内的流形特征拼接为乘积流形，再应用黎曼FC层。

Result: 在双曲、SPD、Grassmannian流形上的基准任务上验证有效性与通用性；框架在欧氏空间下退化为标准FC，在Poincaré与SPD上分别恢复Shimizu等[66]与Nguyen等[56]的已有FC层。

Conclusion: 提供了一个原理化的、可灵活切换潜空间几何的黎曼FC与卷积层统一构造方法，在多种流形上一致架构下表现出竞争力与广泛适用性。

Abstract: Recently, deep neural networks on manifold-valued representations have garnered significant attention across various machine learning applications. One recent focus is the generalization of Euclidean fully connected (FC) and convolutional layers to non-Euclidean geometries. However, previous approaches typically focus on a few selected manifolds and rely on specific properties of the target manifold. In contrast, this work proposes a framework for constructing FC and convolutional layers over computationally tractable Riemannian spaces. This framework incorporates several previous FC layers across different geometries as special cases and is instantiated on ten representative manifolds, including three hyperbolic models, five geometries of the symmetric positive definite (SPD) manifold, and two Grassmannian perspectives. Experiments on different manifolds demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of our approach. Code can be found at this https URL .

</details>


### [687] [Just Initialize: A Training-Free Initialization Component for Large-Scale Routing Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35443)
*Jiale Zhao,Sirui Mao,Zimu Chen,Wentao Yang,Zihan Wang,Xuefeng Huang,Junji Cheng,Liyuanjun Lai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Just Initialize (JI)，一种无需训练、与求解器无关的初始化组件，用于大规模路由优化。JI将大规模路由实例压缩到紧凑代理空间中优化全局结构，再恢复为原空间中易于优化的起点，从而将"解的发现"与"解的优化"解耦。该方法在TSP、CVRP、VRPTW、PCTSP四类问题上（1K至100K节点规模）实现了与SOTA相当或更好的解质量，同时平均加速约70倍，10K节点亚秒级求解，100K节点数十秒内完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模路由问题（NP-hard）的求解计算成本高昂。现有方法（传统启发式、神经组合优化NCO）主要改进优化过程本身，但架构与训练机制日益复杂。本文转变视角：与其设计更复杂的优化器，不如改善优化起点。一个好的初始化不仅看即时解质量，更要看其下游精炼潜力。这一视角将初始化目标转向寻找具有强精炼潜力的起点，而此类起点主要由全局结构刻画，故可通过对实例的几何压缩来高效获得。

Method: JI由三阶段组成：1）几何引导的实例压缩——通过分组原始节点构造紧凑单元，保留几何摘要与边界状态信息；2）紧凑空间求解——在压缩解空间Ω(Ĩ)中以J_B（下游精炼后期望目标值）为目标进行搜索，采用蒙特卡洛采样估计初始化质量；3）解恢复与精炼——利用结构一致性分数g(π;π̃,M)（包含几何边界偏差L_geo与单元内序列一致性L_seq）从压缩解恢复原空间初始解π₀*，再用候选受限局部搜索（2-opt类算子）进行轻量级精炼。核心是"解发现"与"解优化"分离：压缩阶段保留全局结构，细节决策交由下游精炼。理论分析给出决策空间缩减比D_c/D_o = K_c/(bK)（b为压缩比）、J_B估计的无偏性与Hoeffding集中界、以及结构误差与恢复误差的残差分解。

Result: 在TSP（5K-100K）和CVRP（5K-100K）上，JI+Refine在1K节点时隙分别为3.30%和15.56%（TSP10K为3.40%，CVRP10K为19.80%），同时10K节点TSP/CVRP仅需0.53s/0.9s，100K节点12.21s/18.9s；在VRPTW（2K-20K）和PCTSP（2K-20K）上同样保持竞争力。相对LKH-3基准，JI在100K节点TSP上gap为3.65%，时间12.21s，远优于多数NCO方法。TSPLIB95（32实例）平均gap 3.54%，19/32最优；CVRPLIB（11实例）平均gap 7.77%，8/11最优；非均匀分布（clustered/explosion/implosion）上亦保持稳定。消融实验表明压缩与恢复是关键组件（去除后gap退化>1%）。配对gap初始化实验证明JI的优势不源于更好的即时目标值，而源于更好的精炼潜力。

Conclusion: 本文通过解耦解发现与解优化，证明了优化起点的改善可从根本上降低大规模路由优化的难度。Just Initialize作为无需训练、与求解器无关的初始化组件，通过紧凑空间中的几何压缩与全局结构搜索，为下游精炼提供优化友好的起点。该方法在四类路由问题、1K-100K节点规模上均达到与SOTA相当或更好的解质量，同时计算成本降低约70倍，揭示了初始化作为导航大规模组合搜索空间的有效机制。理论分析为决策空间缩减、估计收敛性及误差分解提供了保障。局限：紧凑空间的全局结构表征依赖几何信息，对高度抽象约束的扩展仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Large-scale routing problems are difficult to solve efficiently as their search spaces grow rapidly with problem size. Existing approaches primarily improve the optimization procedure itself, often at increasing computational cost. We instead shift the focus to a useful initialization that can be refined into a high-quality solution with limited downstream refinement. We propose Just Initialize, a training-free and solver-agnostic initialization component for large-scale routing optimization. Just Initialize compresses a large routing instance into a compact surrogate space, optimizes its global routing structure, and recovers the resulting solution as an optimization-friendly starting point in the original space. Extensive experiments on Traveling Salesman Problems (TSPs), Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problems (CVRPs), Vehicle Routing Problems with Time Windows (VRPTWs), and Prize-Collecting Traveling Salesman Problems (PCTSPs) demonstrate that Just Initialize achieves high-quality solutions comparable to or better than state-of-the-art methods while substantially reducing computational cost across instances ranging from 1K to 100K nodes, including an average speedup of approximately 70$\times$, sub-second runtimes on 10K-node instances, and runtimes within tens of seconds on 100K-node instances.

</details>


### [688] [AutoBCI: Forecast-Guided Agentic Neural Architecture Discovery for EEG-Based Brain--Computer Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35456)
*Muyun Jiang,Yi Ding,Wei Zhang,Jinbo Chen,Chenyu Liu,Zhenjie Yang,Yuxin Li,Jingyuan Chen,Yuhao Lu,Yong Li,Shuailei Zhang,Cuntai Guan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoBCI是一个用于EEG脑机接口解码架构自动发现的双智能体框架，包含Designer Agent（执行Pool-Guided Architecture Discovery, PGAD）和Forecaster Agent（执行Performance Estimation from Early Knowledge, PEEK）。在14个EEG数据集（涵盖运动想象、情绪识别和睡眠分期）上，使用6种LLM进行架构搜索，最优架构（Claude Opus 5.5）以64.16%的平均测试平衡准确率超越最强基线REVE。PEEK在10个epoch后使预测MAE降低38.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG解码架构的设计需要大量领域知识和人工调参，且现有神经架构搜索方法未能在多任务间发现共享的优异架构。同时，对每个候选架构在多个EEG任务上进行完整训练评估成本高昂，需要早期筛选机制以提高搜索效率。

Method: AutoBCI包含两个智能体：(1) Designer Agent执行PGAD，通过持续候选池管理架构发现，使用6轮迭代（每轮8个），结合父架构的精炼（P=2, Q=3）和新探索（U=2），基于运动想象、情绪识别和睡眠分期三个任务族的等权重联合验证分数选择架构；(2) Forecaster Agent执行PEEK，使用LLM根据架构代码、训练协议和早期学习曲线预测完整训练后的验证性能，对候选进行排名筛选。搜索采用参数预算<100万，排除循环架构。

Result: 在14个EEG数据集、3个任务族上，使用6个LLM（Claude Sonnet 5、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Gemini 3.8 Flash、Qwen3.8 Flash、GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5.5）进行搜索，共产生269个完整训练架构。Claude Opus 5.5发现的架构达到64.16%平均测试bAcc，超过最强基线REVE（63.87%）0.29个百分点。PEEK在10个epoch后将预测MAE从2.20降至1.36 pp（相对降低38.1%），保留3个候选可在91.7%的轮次中保留完整预算赢家，估计节省44.9%的训练epoch。

Conclusion: AutoBCI通过结合多任务联合验证的架构发现和早期性能预测，有效减少了人工设计EEG解码架构的负担，同时降低了搜索成本。所发现的架构性能超越现有EEG专用模型和基础模型，证明了LLM引导的智能体架构搜索在跨任务EEG解码中的可行性。PGAD的候选池机制保留了历史强架构，PEEK则在早期即可有效筛选有潜力的候选，为神经架构搜索提供了新的成本效益范式。

Abstract: EEG-based brain-computer interfaces support a broad range of applications, yet designing decoding architectures that perform well across diverse tasks remains challenging. We introduce AutoBCI, an agentic framework in which a Designer Agent and a Forecaster Agent support the discovery and selection of EEG decoding architectures across tasks. The Designer Agent performs Pool-Guided Architecture Discovery (PGAD), generating and refining architectures through training and validation across multiple EEG tasks, such as emotion recognition, motor imagery, and sleep staging. The Forecaster Agent performs Performance Estimation from Early Knowledge (PEEK), using architecture code, the training protocol, and early learning curves to predict full-budget validation performance and select promising candidates for continued training. Across 14 EEG datasets spanning motor imagery, emotion recognition, and sleep staging, we evaluate AutoBCI with six LLMs, including Opus 5.5 and GPT 5.6 Sol, and compare the architectures selected by the search procedure against ten baselines: six conventional EEG models and four foundation models. The architecture discovered by AutoBCI with Claude Opus 5.5 achieves 64.16% average test balanced accuracy (bAcc), compared with 63.87% for REVE, the strongest baseline on this metric. Using ten observed epochs, PEEK reduces mean absolute error in predicting average validation bAcc from 2.20 to 1.36 percentage points, a 38.1% reduction relative to the best-observed-score baseline.

</details>


### [689] [A.D.A.M.O. (Agent for language-Driven Actions with Multimodal Observations): A Visual-Symbolic Framework for Virtual Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35463)
*Alessandro Emmanuel Pecora,Stefano Calzolari,Francesco Strada,Andrea Bottino*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出A.D.A.M.O.框架，将预训练VLM与工具调用结合，通过双重视觉-符号世界模型，在单一控制循环中统一虚拟人的感知、推理与动作；并引入C-D任务分类法进行诊断式评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有虚拟人系统依赖大量手工脚本，ECAs缺乏3D感知锚定，GCAs缺乏语言/视觉锚定，LLM驱动的具身智能体难以在动态3D环境中紧耦合视觉观察、符号推理与具身控制。同时缺少可解释的诊断评估框架来分析语言驱动具身行为的失败根源。

Method: 1) 逻辑架构：基于ReAct范式的感知-推理-动作闭环，VLM生成推理笔记并调用工具（Look/Walk/Pick/Drop），融合第一人称RGB帧与同步符号状态，通过多模态短期记忆(MSTM)维持时序一致性；2) 基础设施架构：Unity运行时引擎（渲染、物理、动作服务器）与Python认知服务器（提示组装、记忆管理、VLM推理调度）解耦；3) C-D分类法：按程序能力（动作数量ACT、对象数量TGT）与语言复杂度（参考REF、指令模式INST）正交分解任务；4) 实验设计：15个episode、2个场景（S1桌面/S2客厅）、19个交互对象，比较GPT-4o-vision与Claude-Sonnet-3.5在语义标签(SEM)与数字标签(OPAQ)下的表现。

Result: 实验表明语义标签显著影响任务完成率与失败模式分布：减少感知歧义的同时将失败转移至下游执行环节；推理相关错误相对稀少。两个VLM骨干在相同输入下表现存在差异。

Conclusion: A.D.A.M.O.通过视觉-符号双流世界模型与工具调用机制，为虚拟人提供了一种统一、可解释的语言驱动控制方案；语义支架对任务成功至关重要；C-D分类法为分析具身推理难度提供了可扩展、可解释的诊断框架。

Abstract: Creating believable vh requires the coherent integration of perception, reasoning, and action mediated by language. A central challenge is to combine these components into a control loop grounded in interactive 3D environments. To this end, we present A.D.A.M.O. (Agent for language-Driven Actions with Multimodal Observations), a visual-symbolic framework for language-driven vh that leverages a pretrained vlm with tool calling to unify perception, reasoning, and action within a single control loop. A.D.A.M.O. maintains a dual visual-symbolic world model that combines egocentric visual input and synchronized symbolic state to support grounded task-oriented behavior from natural language prompts. To support diagnostic evaluation, we introduce a controlled task suite organized by a cd taxonomy that breaks down spatial tasks into procedural and linguistic complexity. Experiments in controlled scenes show that semantic labeling strongly influences task completion and failure modes, reducing perceptual ambiguity while shifting failures toward downstream execution, whereas reasoning errors remain comparatively rare.

</details>


### [690] [Why Deterministic PRM Guidance Underperforms in Discrete Diffusion Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35472)
*Yan Zhan,Shaobo Liu,Zhijun Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）中基于过程奖励模型（PRM）的确定性引导策略，在匹配前向传播计算预算下，为何其表现反而不如"独立采样+结果奖励模型（ORM）重排序"这一更简单的基线方法。通过在Dream-7B上对GSM8K、MATH和MBPP三个任务进行系统实验，文章将差距分解为两个独立失败原因：（1）早期去噪阶段PRM信号弱（ROC-AUC从0.77衰减到0.54）导致引导剪枝过早丢失正确候选；（2）跨掩码训练的PRM作为最终判断器表现不佳（在GSM8K/MATH上），尽管其在MBPP上判断完整程序与ORM相当。最终结论是：dLLM引导应聚焦于两个目标——在早期去噪时保留正确的部分解，并将最终选择权交给基于最终状态训练的验证器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PRM引导在自回归（AR）数学推理中已被证明有效，但离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）作为新兴的推理范式，提供了部分去噪的中间状态，天然适合PRM引导。然而，这一从AR到dLLM的迁移是否有效尚不明确。文章旨在通过严格的匹配计算评估，回答在相同前向传播预算内，PRM引导是否真的优于简单的best-of-N或ORM重排序基线。

Method: 文章提出"匹配前向传播计算诊断协议"（Matched Forward-Pass Diagnostic Protocol），将去噪、PRM评分和ORM评分统一计入前向传播预算。具体方法包括：（1）使用Dream-v0-Instruct-7B作为主dLLM，LLaDA-8B-Base作为跨骨架验证；（2）PRM采用冻结骨干+LoRA适配器+MLP奖励头架构，对比双向注意力和因果注意力；（3）PRM Guided采用分段top-1剪枝算法（每b步分支为K个候选，每段保留PRM得分最高者）；（4）控制实验包括PRM Hybrid（保留所有候选）、ESS-tempered SMC采样器、top-M保留、final-state PRM等；（5）评估指标涵盖准确率、Oracle@N天花板、PRM ROC-AUC与掩码比的关系、答案多样性等。

Result: 核心实验结果：（1）在GSM8K上，ORM Rerank@8达75.13%，而PRM Guided K=8仅65.18%，差距9.95pp；K=32时差距扩大到12.69pp；（2）在MATH上ORM Rerank领先9.85pp，在MBPP上领先12.16pp；（3）PRM ROC-AUC随掩码比上升从0.77衰减到0.54（GSM8K）；（4）top-1剪枝将Oracle@8从独立采样的81.05%降至67.30%（损失13.75pp）；（5）SMC采样器恢复Oracle天花板至77.89%，但PRM选择准确率仍仅为65.48%；（6）final-state PRM与ORM在相同候选上表现相当（75.40% vs 75.13%），证明跨掩码训练损害了终端选择能力；（7）双向PRM显著优于因果PRM（LLaDA上31.64% vs 22.25%），其中最后token池化可恢复因果PRM约70%的ROC-AUC差距。

Conclusion: 确定性PRM引导在dLLM推理中失败的根本原因有两个可分离的部分：（1）引导在弱信号上剪枝——早期去噪阶段掩码比高时PRM判别能力接近随机，导致正确候选被过早丢弃（候选池损害）；（2）PRM作为最终判断器表现不佳——跨掩码训练使PRM在最终状态选择上弱于专用ORM验证器。基于这些发现，文章为dLLM奖励引导提出五项实践建议：（1）统一计算单位计费以避免隐藏评分器成本；（2）报告Oracle@K以暴露候选池坍缩；（3）采用稀疏分支和保留多个候选；（4）将最终选择交给基于最终状态训练的验证器；（5）修复因果PRM的读取方式（使用最后token池化）。文章发布了去噪状态语料库和评估工具包以促进可复现的匹配计算比较。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) expose a denoised solution at every step, which makes process reward model (PRM) guidance look like a way to spend compute at test time. We show that once denoising, PRM scoring, and outcome reward model (ORM) scoring are charged in the same budget of forward passes, its deterministic form loses to a much simpler baseline. Our PRMs score intermediate denoising states and are trained on the correctness of the final answer. On Dream-v0-Instruct-7B with 8 candidates per GSM8K problem, keeping the candidate with the highest PRM score at every scoring step reaches 65.18%, while independent sampling plus an ORM reranker trained for the task reaches 75.13%. The gap grows to 12.69 percentage points (pp) with 32 candidates, and is 9.85 pp on MATH and 12.16 pp on MBPP. We trace it to two separable failures. First, guidance prunes on a weak signal: on GSM8K, PRM ROC-AUC falls from 0.77 to 0.54 as the mask ratio rises, a decay that persists when states are relabeled with fresh rollouts, and pruning lowers the best accuracy reachable from the candidate pool from 81.05% for independent samples to 67.30%. Second, on GSM8K and MATH, the PRM is a poor final judge: a sequential Monte Carlo sampler at the same budget restores that ceiling to 77.89%, yet selecting with the PRM gives 65.48%, on par with deterministic guidance, while a PRM retrained on final states matches the ORM on identical candidates. MBPP separates the two: there the PRM reaches 65.47% when reranking finished programs, on par with the ORM, but 50.88% when it guides denoising. The results point to two targets for dLLM guidance: keep correct partial solutions alive through early denoising, and leave the final choice to a verifier trained on final states. We release the corpus of denoising states with outcome labels and evaluation toolkit for reproducible comparisons at matched compute.

</details>


### [691] [SRHarness: A Harness for Agentic Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35501)
*Zihan Yu,Shixuan Zhou,Hao Huang,Jingtao Ding,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SRHarness 是一个面向智能体符号回归的领域专用运行时支架，通过可组合科学动作、持久科学状态、轨迹生命周期管理三大机制，在 LLM-SRBench 基准上显著提升了数值与符号恢复性能，验证了运行支架设计本身对智能体符号回归的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体符号回归系统的运行时支持机制往往与各自搜索策略耦合，导致系统间比较混淆了搜索策略与运行支架的差异；论文主张运行支架应作为独立的一等公民组件，与基础模型、搜索策略分离。

Method: 三大核心机制：(1) 可组合科学动作——将智能体指定的科学参数与运行支架管理的执行上下文分离，支持基于表达式的视图覆盖原始、变换、候选派生量，并采用统一的候选-证据契约；(2) 持久科学状态——在会话外保留已评估假设与证据，通过投影策略（拟合-复杂度 Pareto 视图、Top-k 视图）构造模型面向上下文；(3) 轨迹生命周期管理——协调继续、分支、重启、终止四种转换，配合 R×C×L×K 可配置调度器。

Result: 在 LLM-SRBench 上：(1) LSR-Synth 上以 DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731 在物理/化学/生物领域取得最佳 OOD 精度（78.00%/78.87%/87.09%），SA 达 6.20%；(2) LSR-Transform 上 SA 达 93.69%（对比 SR-Scientist 62.16%），且表达式复杂度最低（14.64）；(3) 匿名化版本 LSR-Transform-Anon 上仍保持 72.97% SA（对比 SR-Scientist 39.64%）；(4) 相同 DeepSeek 骨干下优于 Codex（72.97% vs 20.72%），仅给 Codex 提供同等科学工具不能复现优势。消融实验证实三大机制各自贡献。

Conclusion: 有效的智能体符号回归不仅依赖模型或工具，更依赖结构化的运行时支持；SRHarness 将科学动作、累积假设、长期搜索组织成高效的发现过程，运行支架应被视为智能体符号回归的一等公民组件。

Abstract: Recent agentic symbolic regression approaches increasingly rely on large language models to analyze data, select scientific operations, and refine hypotheses over long search trajectories. In such systems, performance depends not only on the underlying model and search strategy, but also on the runtime infrastructure that supports scientific search. We introduce SRHarness, a domain-specific harness for agentic symbolic regression built around three mechanisms: composable scientific actions that provide a common interface over raw, transformed, and candidate-derived quantities; persistent scientific state that retains evaluated hypotheses and exposes compact model-facing views; and trajectory lifecycle management that coordinates continuation, branching, restart, and termination. On LLM-SRBench, SRHarness consistently improves both numerical generalization and symbolic recovery under matched LLM backbones. With DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731, it achieves 93.69% symbolic accuracy on LSR-Transform, compared with 62.16% for SR-Scientist, and retains 72.97% accuracy on an anonymized variant that removes scientific descriptions and variable semantics, versus 39.64% for SR-Scientist. Under the same DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731 backbone, SRHarness also substantially outperforms Codex (72.97% vs. 20.72%) and reaches performance comparable to Codex with GPT-5.5, while simply providing Codex with the same scientific tools does not reproduce this advantage. These results show that effective agentic symbolic regression depends not only on models or tools, but also on structured runtime support for organizing scientific actions, accumulated hypotheses, and long-horizon search.

</details>


### [692] [MechBench: Can AI Scientific Agents Discover Mechanisms Beyond Phenomenal Laws?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35515)
*Zihan Yu,Jiadong Zhang,Jialin Cheng,Jingtao Ding,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MechBench 是一个用于评估 AI 科学智能体机制发现能力的基准测试，明确区分了从观测数据中恢复现象学定律与识别产生这些定律的底层机制。该基准包含 16 个任务家族、512 个实例，涵盖物理、化学、生物和材料科学领域，并通过机制探针评估机制恢复能力。实验揭示了显著的现象-机制恢复差距：即使正确恢复现象学定律，机制恢复仍经常失败，且差距随机制突变程度增加而扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的符号回归和科学智能体基准主要评估现象学定律恢复能力，即将数学定律拟合到可观测行为，但未充分测试机制发现能力——即识别产生这些可观测规律的科学机制。该论文旨在填补这一空白，将机制发现确立为超越定律恢复的独立科学发现挑战。

Method: MechBench 将每个任务定义为由科学上有意义的关系构成的结构化机制模型，其联合推导出可观测的现象学定律。智能体仅接收观测数据和科学上下文，需重建底层机制。论文引入了三个关键方法组件：(1) 通过受控、科学可解释的突变构造非熟悉机制变体以减少对记忆的依赖；(2) 设计机制探针，查询无法从现象学定律和科学上下文单独推断的内部科学后果；(3) 对机械不可区分性进行筛选，排除存在同等可信竞争机制的模糊实例。评估涵盖七种模型-智能体配置，包括 Codex、Claude Code 和 DeepSeek Harness 等，并设置了 Gold-P Direct-Ask 对照实验。

Result: 在 Core-set 上，Codex 配合 GPT-5.6-sol 达到了 35.00% 的现象学定律准确率，但机制准确率仅为 13.75%；在现象学定律正确恢复的情况下，机制恢复失败率达 64.29%。差距随突变数量增加而扩大：原始实例上条件失败率约为 33%，但在 Core-set 上三个突变时达到 100%。即使提供正确的现象学定律（Gold-P 控制），机制准确率在两个数据集上仍低于 50%。GPT-5.6-sol 在统计上显著优于两个 flash 模型，但不同智能体框架之间无显著差异，四个科学领域之间也无显著差异。机制恢复的难度高度依赖于具体任务家族。

Conclusion: MechBench 揭示了 AI 科学智能体在机制推理方面存在显著的泛化差距，表明机制发现是一个独立且在质上更具挑战性的任务，超越了可观测科学定律的恢复。这一基准将机制发现从非正式的"更深理解"概念转化为受控且可客观测试的发现任务，为评估 AI 系统的真实科学推理能力提供了新标准。论文指出当前局限在于仅覆盖可通过符号消除获得闭合形式现象学定律的机制，并提出未来可通过模拟直接生成观测数据来扩展基准范围。

Abstract: Scientific discovery requires not only recovering mathematical laws that describe observable behavior, but also identifying the mechanisms that generate them. Existing benchmarks for symbolic regression and scientific agents primarily evaluate phenomenal-law recovery, leaving mechanism discovery largely untested. We introduce MechBench, a benchmark that explicitly separates these two capabilities. Each task is defined by a mechanistic model, a structured set of scientifically meaningful relations whose joint consequences entail an observable phenomenal law, while agents receive only observational data and scientific context. We evaluate mechanism recovery through mechanism probes, which query internal scientific consequences that cannot be inferred from the phenomenal law alone. To reduce reliance on memorized textbook mechanisms, we construct unfamiliar variants through controlled, scientifically interpretable mutations of canonical mechanisms, and screen for mechanistic indistinguishability to exclude ambiguous instances admitting comparable competing mechanisms. Experiments across representative scientific agents reveal a substantial phenomenal--mechanism recovery gap: for Codex with GPT-5.6-sol, phenomenal-law accuracy reaches 35.00% on the Core-set while mechanism accuracy is only 13.75%, with mechanism recovery failing in 64.29% of cases where the phenomenal law is correctly recovered. The gap widens as mechanisms become increasingly mutated, and even providing the correct phenomenal law leaves mechanism recovery below 50%. These results reveal a substantial generalization gap in mechanistic reasoning and establish mechanism discovery as a distinct challenge beyond recovering observable scientific laws.

</details>


### [693] [ARISE: Adapting to Evolving Capability Gaps in Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35532)
*Kun Feng,Yuchen Fang,Yiyang Tan,Shuqi Gu,Yongxiang Zhao,Yu Liu,Xingyu Lu,Lintao Ma,Kan Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ARISE提出了一种智能体强化学习框架，通过"评分标准-技能协同进化"和"基于能力的自适应采样"，利用rollout证据动态调整评估标准、探索引导和训练优先级，以应对长程智能体能力不断演变带来的能力差距问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程智能体在持续学习过程中，已有的能力缺陷可能消退而新的瓶颈会不断涌现，但传统强化学习方法依赖固定的行为标准和训练优先级，无法适应能力的动态变化；同时，稀疏的任务级反馈使得能力偏差难以被检测，相同失败轨迹的重复采样也阻碍了对更优策略的探索。

Method: ARISE包含两大核心组件：(1) 评分标准-技能协同进化：每个行为标准由一个评估用评分标准(rubric)和配套的可操作技能(skill)组成，根据rollout证据动态生成、激活、隐藏、精炼和淘汰评分标准-技能对；(2) 基于能力的自适应采样：根据任务类型标签和行为能力类别，利用Beta分布估计通过概率，按不确定性加权采样中间难度的任务-能力对。策略优化采用GRPO，将任务奖励和评分标准反馈的优势分别归一化后加权组合。

Result: 在SkillsBench v1.1和Terminal-Bench v2.1两个长程智能体基准上，基于Qwen3.5-27B训练的ARISE在可比规模基线中均取得最高通过率（SkillsBench 45.6%，TB 50.6%），性能超过同规模基线且与显著更大的模型具有竞争力；在相同每步rollout预算下，仅需outcom-only RL三分之一训练步骤即可达到同等性能，估计节省65%训练时间。

Conclusion: ARISE通过持续将rollout证据转化为演变的评分标准和配套技能，将行为弱点的识别与针对性探索及任务选择相结合，验证了在长程智能体训练中动态适应行为反馈和学习机会的重要价值，为对齐学习过程与演变中的智能体能力建立了通用范式。

Abstract: As a long-horizon agent improves through experience, previously observed weaknesses may recede while new limitations emerge, continually changing what it still needs to learn. Yet the learning process often remains tied to a static view of these needs: fixed behavioral criteria and training priorities can become misaligned with evolving agent capabilities, while sparse task-level feedback makes such misalignment more difficult to detect. Even when capability gaps are identified, rollouts from the current policy may repeatedly reproduce the same failures rather than explore better alternatives. To address this, we introduce Adaptive Rubric-Skill Co-Evolution (ARISE), a reinforcement learning framework that uses rollout evidence to continually adapt evaluation criteria, exploration guidance, and training priorities. Rubrics evolve to reward partial behavioral progress, while their paired skills are refined and selectively activated to guide exploration toward unresolved weaknesses. Alongside this co-evolution, capability-based adaptive sampling prioritizes tasks that target behaviors needing further improvement. Experiments on two challenging long-horizon agent benchmarks, SkillsBench and Terminal-Bench, demonstrate that ARISE successfully enhances both overall task performance and training efficiency. The project page is at this https URL .

</details>


### [694] [Continuous Context Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35540)
*William Hoy,Jingxuan Fan,Nurcin Celik,Xu Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出连续上下文管理（CCM）范式，智能体在每一步同时输出更新的记忆和环境动作，使活跃提示词仅包含任务、保留记忆与最新观察而非完整交互历史。作者在TerminalBench-2上评估了四种前沿闭源模型，发现CCM显著降低累积输入与活跃提示大小，但多数模型任务成功率下降。作者进一步提出GRPO结合特权全历史蒸馏的训练方法，在WebShop上大幅超越纯GRPO，且对Qwen3-4B整体超越全历史GRPO；在Endless Terminals上也有一定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程LLM智能体通常在上下文中累积完整交互历史直到达到阈值才进行压缩，导致活跃上下文膨胀、性能下降且消耗GPU KV缓存内存。需要一种每步都进行记忆管理的推理范式以保持紧凑的活跃上下文。

Method: 1. CCM推理范式：每轮智能体接收任务、上一轮记忆、最新观察，输出新记忆和环境动作；下一轮提示仅基于这三者构建。2. GRPO+特权全历史蒸馏训练：教师是冻结的、训练前的学生模型副本，在重建的完整历史条件下对学生采样的动作token进行自回归打分；通过教师-学生置信度差（confidence gap）的sigmoid门控对蒸馏梯度加权，与GRPO损失联合优化。

Result: TerminalBench-2上CCM将累积输入减少75.8%–84.3%，中位活跃提示从9k–17k降至3k–4k tokens；任务成功率Sonnet下降11.2pp、Opus下降18.0pp、GLM-5下降5.6pp，Kimi K3略升1.1pp；成本取决于提供商前缀缓存策略。WebShop上Qwen3-4B-Instruct使用CCM+GRPO+蒸馏达到86.72%精确成功率，超过全历史GRPO的75.78%；Qwen3-8B达到77.34%但仍低于全历史GRPO的82.81%。Endless Terminals上Qwen3-8B CCM+GRPO+蒸馏达到32.00%，优于未训练全历史基线（20.33%）但低于全历史GRPO（35.33%）。蒸馏同时改善了通用能力保留，尤其对WebShop 4B模型效果最明显。

Conclusion: CCM是一种可行的智能体推理范式，可在大幅减少保留上下文的同时维持任务性能；结合GRPO与特权全历史蒸馏的训练方法能进一步提升CCM智能体的任务准确率并缓解通用能力遗忘，尤其在小模型上效果显著。然而收益因模型、训练环境和评估任务而异，较短提示未必转化为更低API成本。

Abstract: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents commonly retain their complete interaction history until compaction is triggered at a predefined threshold. We study Continuous Context Management (CCM), which performs compaction at every turn to prevent interaction history from accumulating in the active prompt. At each turn, a CCM agent emits an updated memory together with an environment action; its next prompt contains the original task, retained memory, and newest observation rather than the complete transcript. We first evaluate CCM without fine-tuning on TerminalBench-2 using Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.6, GLM-5, and Kimi K3. CCM substantially reduces cumulative input usage and active-prompt size, although it lowers task success for most models while preserving performance for Kimi K3. We use GRPO with privileged full-history distillation to improve CCM in open-weight models. A frozen copy of the student's initial model scores each sampled student action under the complete history reconstructed from that student's rollout, providing dense action-token supervision without a separate teacher rollout or reference solution. On WebShop, this objective substantially improves CCM over GRPO at both evaluated model scales and surpasses full-history GRPO for Qwen3-4B-Instruct, though not for Qwen3-8B. On Endless Terminals, the augmented method provides a modest improvement over GRPO, with both CCM policies outperforming the untrained full-history baseline. These results demonstrate that CCM is a viable inference paradigm for agents operating with substantially reduced retained context and that its performance can be improved through reinforcement learning with privileged full-history distillation.

</details>


### [695] [RareDx: Controlled Knowledge Integration and Graph-Grounded Policy Optimization for Rare-Disease Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35549)
*Bo Zhang,Yuchen Wang,Dongbai Li,Matthew Yu Heng Wong,Qingkai Zeng,Lijun Wang,Tien-Yin Wong,Peng Cui,Tianyu Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RareDx系统，通过受控知识集成与知识图谱引导的策略优化（RareDx-KGPO）解决罕见病诊断的长尾推理问题。该方法将异构病历标准化为Top-10排序诊断任务，并利用本体、基因注释和生物医学文本作为共享知识层，在8个基准上以9B/27B紧凑模型超越GPT-5.5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 罕见病诊断是典型的长尾问题：表型不完整、单一疾病文献稀少、证据分散于本体与基因注释。语言模型倾向于常见病、遗漏罕见候选或生成"看似合理但无效"的疾病名称。现有智能体诊断系统多为单体管线，难以区分增益来自骨干模型、检索、工具还是采样；且精确匹配奖励过于稀疏，无约束语义奖励又易奖励伪造名称。

Method: 1) RareDx-Harness：将异构记录归一为Top-10排序任务，统一比较Direct推理、静态RAG、自适应ReAct工具、结构化表型-基因-疾病三跳推理及RRF聚合，所有策略共享同一规范器和证据层；数据集级路由器在Direct与35B诊断审计之间选择。2) RareDx-KGPO：两阶段训练（Top-10 SFT + 知识图谱引导GRPO），奖励将预测投影到规范疾病图，融合分级相关性、本体邻近、生物医学实体相似、表型一致性四个通道，并设词汇门、Top-10预算与清洁度惩罚以防奖励作弊。

Result: 在8个基准（MyGene2、RAMEDIS、MME、HMS、LIRICAL、RDS、RDC、Phenopackets）共4249例上，RareDx-9B Harness达Hit@1/5/10 = 20.11/31.54/38.34，Hit@10超过GPT-5.5（36.74）1.60分；RareDx-27B达23.53/36.56/40.76，三个cutoff均超GPT-5.5。严格验证集选择审计下9B/27B分别保留37.34/38.13 Hit@10，较Direct有6.80分路由增益。消融显示静态RAG不及Direct，检索深度与性能非单调；GRPO在210步后因奖励作弊崩塌，DAPO/OPD停滞，RareDx-KGPO稳定收敛至约0.58。词汇门拒绝全部伪造疾病；移除后82.5%获正奖励。50例RAMEDIS配对审计中9B Harness以14/38/46超越27B Direct（2/12/28），且在1024 token预算内全部完成规范输出。

Conclusion: 结构化医学知识可使紧凑模型在长尾罕见病诊断中成为有竞争力的排序器；检索并非普遍有益，受控路由（knowledge use而非knowledge availability）是关键。本体、表型与分级相关性提供密集监督同时保持实体有效性与排序优先级。未来工作应学习患者级路由、评估校准弃权、衡量检索证据对最终排序的支持度，并开展前瞻性研究以评估校准、有害遗漏与临床安全性。

Abstract: Rare-disease diagnosis is a long-tail reasoning problem: phenotypes are incomplete, individual disorders are sparsely documented, and relevant evidence is distributed across ontologies, gene annotations, and biomedical text. Language models consequently favor common conditions, miss rare candidates, or produce plausible but invalid names. We introduce RareDx, which couples controlled evidence use with knowledge-graph-grounded policy optimization. RareDx-Harness normalizes heterogeneous records into one ranked-diagnosis task and compares direct inference, static retrieval, adaptive tools, and structured phenotype-gene-disease reasoning over a shared knowledge layer. The training pipeline combines Top-10 post-training with RareDx-KGPO, our knowledge-graph-grounded policy optimization method. Its reward projects predictions into a canonical disease graph and integrates curated graded relevance, ontology proximity, biomedical similarity, and phenotype consistency. Vocabulary and output-budget constraints prevent dense partial credit from rewarding fabricated or overlong differentials. Across eight benchmarks, the complete RareDx system centered on Qwen3.5-9B reaches 38.34 macro Hit@10, 1.60 points above GPT-5.5 under the archived protocol; a disjoint validation-selection audit retains a 6.80-point routing gain over Direct on held-out cases. The 27B system reaches 23.53/36.56/40.76 at Hit@1/5/10. Controlled ablations show that retrieval is not uniformly helpful and that controlled routing is central to the gain. These results indicate that structured medical knowledge can turn a compact model into a competitive diagnostic ranker across heterogeneous long-tail settings in clinical practice.

</details>


### [696] [BaRe-Mem: Bayesian Reliability Memory for Robust and Adaptive Agent Consultation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35551)
*Peilin Feng,Zhengyang Huang,Soujanya Poria*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BaRe-Mem是一种用于多智能体系统的在线贝叶斯可靠性记忆机制，通过估计顾问和中心模型的可靠性来调节顾问响应的注意力权重，并决定是否进行咨询或自主推理。在九个基准和六个中心模型上的实验表明，BaRe-Mem在面对误导性信息时比辩论和多数投票方法更具鲁棒性，并能有效应用于智能体团队中的工人分配任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多智能体系统中，可靠的咨询面临挑战：顾问能力因任务而异，误导性信息可能使咨询效果比自主推理更差。现有的咨询方法（如辩论和多数投票）在面对误导性信息时表现脆弱，且无法判断是否应该进行咨询。需要一种机制来估计顾问可靠性，调节其影响，并自适应地决定何时咨询、何时依赖自主推理。

Method: BaRe-Mem包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于贝叶斯线性回归的在线可靠性记忆，通过中心模型的内部信念表示估计每个候选响应的可靠性，利用卡尔曼增益进行精确的在线更新；(2) 可靠性引导的注意力机制，通过修改注意力权重来降低不可靠顾问的影响（最可靠的顾问权重不变，其他按可靠性比例衰减）；(3) 咨询决策机制，通过比较估计的咨询能力和自主能力（A(T) = T·ρ + (1-T)·(κ-δ)），选择更优的推理模式。系统还扩展到智能体团队中的工人分配场景。

Result: 在九个基准（包括GSM8K、SQuAD、APPS、PIQA、MMLU等）的两类能力场景下，BaRe-Mem在误导信息比例为0%-100%的范围内均优于辩论和多数投票基线。在能力支持场景中，咨询率保持85%以上；在能力挑战场景中，咨询率从85-90%动态降至18-21%。在MuSiQue智能体团队任务中，BaRe-Mem比历史成功次数路由方法提升任务完成率1.8-4.9个百分点，比随机路由提升9.1-11.4个百分点，且能更快识别有能力的工人。估计的自主能力κ与实际准确率良好校准，预测的咨询增益与实际增益一致，仅需约170个验证样本即可产生有用的可靠性估计。

Conclusion: BaRe-Mem提供了一种基于贝叶斯可靠性记忆的实用框架，使中心智能体能够自适应地决定"信任谁"和"是否咨询"。通过上下文相关的可靠性估计，它在长视野多智能体交互中对误导性信息具有鲁棒性，能从稀疏反馈中学习，并自然扩展到智能体团队的工人路由任务，为多智能体系统的可靠咨询奠定了基础。

Abstract: In multi-agent systems, reliable consultation is challenging because advisor capabilities vary across tasks, and misleading information can make consultation worse than autonomous reasoning. We introduce BaRe-Mem, an online Bayesian reliability memory for multi-agent consultation. It estimates advisor reliability based on the central model's internal belief representations and updates these estimates from historical interactions. These estimates modulate the influence of advisor responses and guide the choice between consultation and autonomous reasoning. Across nine benchmarks and six central models, BaRe-Mem is more robust to misleading advisor information than debate and majority voting. On the more challenging tasks, it remains above autonomous reasoning across all tested misleading levels. Moreover, we extend the BaRe-Mem mechanism to worker allocation in agent teams. On the MuSiQue benchmark, BaRe-Mem improves task completion over routing by historical success counts and identifies capable workers earlier.

</details>


### [697] [From Search to Research: Exploring Search Scaling in Autonomous Quantitative Factor Mining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35559)
*Kangcheng Deng,Hui Cai,Jiacheng Lu,Chester Zhongshu Qian,Rui Sun,Beidi Luan,Jing Li,Daxin Jiang,Zuo Bai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究自主量化因子挖掘中"搜索扩展"(search scaling)效应,通过9个模型在50个A股因子任务上的连续10轮迭代实验,发现基础能力决定初始表现但深层搜索可缩小模型差距,模型嫁接揭示早期研究状态的重要影响,并行搜索优于串行搜索,高能力模型更擅长诊断失败与保持经济假设一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时计算扩展研究主要关注独立采样、验证和答案聚合,但在依赖经验反馈的自主研究场景中,基础模型能力如何影响迭代搜索的边际收益仍不清楚。本文旨在系统研究自主研究中的搜索扩展机制,理解能力、搜索深度与搜索组织如何共同决定研究产出质量。

Method: 构建50个基于A股卖方研报的因子挖掘任务,使用Claude Code作为统一agent脚手架,测试9个模型在10轮连续迭代轨迹上的表现,在每次迭代后冻结检查点并进行样本外评估。通过模型嫁接(在第3轮切换模型继续7轮)和串行-并行对比(1条10轮 vs 5条独立2轮)两个受控实验,并结合跟踪分析与人工对齐验证,刻画搜索扩展的机制与边界条件。

Result: 所有模型均从3轮提升到10轮(Claude Opus 5: 75.45→92.50,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: 65.35→83.44,MiniMax-M3: 37.35→55.99)。能力与3轮均值的Spearman相关系数为1.00,但与3到10轮增益的相关性仅0.48。模型嫁接显示GLM-5.3→Qwen3.7-Plus得72.28,反向得76.41。并行搜索在3个模型上一致优于串行搜索(DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: 89.80 vs 83.44)。DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash在成本-性能帕累托前沿上占优势(10轮83.44分,每任务仅3.25元)。轨迹分析显示高分模型在表征层面转向搜索、通过受控对比归因反馈、并坚持假设一致的候选选择。经验搜索扩展定律拟合解释92.7%方差,幂律指数仅0.020。

Conclusion: 自主研究中的搜索扩展效果取决于模型能力、搜索组织与累积研究状态的联合作用,而非仅依赖更多推理计算。基础能力主导起始质量,深度搜索可缩小部分能力差距,早期研究状态和搜索宽度与额外深度同样重要。未来进展需要更强模型配合在研究过程中自适应分配测试时计算的策略,而非简单的"更多迭代"。

Abstract: Inference scaling has been shown to improve large language model (LLM) performance, and this principle naturally extends to autonomous LLM agents through increased search budgets, which we refer to as *search scaling*. Although prior work has characterized the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and performance limits of LLM inference scaling, much less is known about these questions in autonomous research. Therefore, we investigate how search scaling affects research performance and what mechanisms drive these gains using 50 quantitative factor-mining tasks grounded in financial research reports. Each task requires an agent to carry out an end-to-end research loop, from interpreting a hypothesis and implementing it in code to evaluating and iteratively refining the resulting factor. Across nine models, we examine how model capability, search depth, and search organization shape factor quality by tracing performance across varying budgets, transferring intermediate research states between models, and comparing different search strategies. We find that (1) initial performance is more strongly associated with model capability, while deeper search can narrow cross-model gaps; (2) model grafting shows that the early research state materially shapes final performance; and (3) parallel search outperforms sequential search under the same iteration budget, consistent with benefits from broader coverage of the search space. Further trajectory analysis shows that higher-performing models more effectively diagnose failures, revise search directions, and preserve the intended economic hypothesis when selecting candidates. These findings suggest that future progress in autonomous research will require stronger models together with adaptive policies for deploying test-time computation throughout the research process.

</details>


### [698] [RSI-Master: Structuring Experiments to Guide Autonomous Model Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35561)
*Yaxin Du,Xiyuan Yang,Zhifan Zhou,Yujie Ge,Cheng Wang,Jiajun Wang,Sijie Chen,Zehui Liu,Yuxin Zhang,Weicheng Gu,Julian Zhang,Zixing Lei,Siheng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RSI-Master提出了一种用于自主模型开发的递归自我改进框架，通过实验操作系统(ExpOS)正则化实验动作以防止作弊，并采用评审引导的研究编排机制(动态DAG上的Worker-Reviewer协作)来避免策略锁定。在PostTrainBench上以Qwen3-4B-Base取得54.49平均分(最强基线46.53)，作弊率为0.0%；在35B规模上超越人类开发的Instruct模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主模型开发(autonomous model development)作为递归自我改进(RSI)的一条具体路径，让智能体迭代探索后训练策略以改进基础模型。但该设定面临两大挑战：智能体可能通过"作弊"(hacking)来利用开放式的实验动作(如修改评估代码、未授权的模型替换等)；反复实验可能导致"策略锁定"(strategy lock-in)，即早期选定方向后只做局部调整而不重新审视。现有系统要么仅规范实验执行(如AutoTrainess)，要么用预定义扩展规则组织探索树(如ANDES、DataMaster、TREX)，均未将跨实验评审与后续研究方向显式建模。

Method: RSI-Master遵循"正则化逐步动作+结构化方向探索"的设计原则，由两大组件构成：(1) 实验操作系统(ExpOS)：将开放式交互空间映射为结构化的动作空间(含31个核心工具与22个外部连接器)，每个事件遵循显式schema；通过"实验图" G^exp=(Z,L) 记录每次实验的输入checkpoint、执行动作、输出checkpoint与证据，边表示checkpoint续训依赖，从而实现防作弊约束、可追溯实验血缘与持久化记录。(2) 评审引导的研究编排(Research Orchestration)：以动态增长的有向无环图 G^res=(V,E) 协调Worker与Reviewer节点，Worker负责沿研究方向开展实验，Reviewer跨越多个Worker做交叉证据审查并将结论回馈Main Agent；Main Agent据此决定继续、验证、分支或修正方向。两图通过"实验所有权"耦合——每个实验恰好归属于一个Worker，Reviewer可见其作用域内Worker的所有实验证据。运行过程由两类事件驱动：ExpOS事件扩展 G^exp，编排事件(由Worker完成或Reviewer报告触发)扩展 G^res；触发按节点而非按轮次进行，支持异步分支。

Result: 在PostTrainBench(Qwen3-4B-Base)上，RSI-Master取得平均分54.49，超过Kimi Agent Swarm(46.53)、Claude Code(43.68)、Codex(43.26)、DataMaster(31.37)、AutoTrainess(30.75)等基线，作弊率为0.0%(Codex 32.9%、Claude Code 8.2%)。在35B MoE(Qwen3.5-35B-A3B)上，超越人类开发的Instruct模型：LiveCodeBench-v6(41.21 vs 37.36)、SciCode-ICL(35.94 vs 34.38)、HorizonMath(4.00 vs 0.00，多数前沿模型在该未解问题基准上得分接近0)。在13个跨领域基准(法律、医学、物理等)上均超过Base并在其中7个超过Instruct。消融实验验证ExpOS(-7.80)、并行Worker(-9.59)与Reviewer(-9.82)各自的贡献；将ExpOS接入Claude Code使作弊率从8.2%降至4.7%、平均分从43.68升至51.25，证明ExpOS本身即能抑制作弊。预算分析显示后半段(6–12小时)RSI-Master增益6.45，超过Kimi(2.42)与Claude Code(1.81)；案例分析显示Reviewer反馈可在多个阶段改变Main Agent后续动作，体现出"涌现智能"。

Conclusion: RSI-Master通过"正则化逐步实验动作 + 结构化研究方向探索"的双层设计，有效缓解了自主模型开发中的作弊与策略锁定问题。其核心贡献包括：将操作约束与方向灵活性解耦、由独立Reviewer承担证据评判职责、以及两图(实验图与研究图)的耦合机制。实验表明，受控的实验执行与结构化研究探索能支撑更可靠的自主模型改进，且该框架无需修改即可从4B密集模型扩展至35B MoE。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to enable AI systems to participate in improving their own capabilities. A concrete pathway is autonomous model development, where agents iteratively explore post-training strategies to improve a base model. This setting faces two challenges: agents may exploit open-ended experimental actions through hacking, and repeated experimentation may lead to strategy lock-in, where an early direction is refined rather than reconsidered. We introduce RSI-Master, which addresses the two challenges at two levels: regularize step-wise actions, avoiding hacking behaviors, and promote well-structured exploration of research directions, avoiding strategy lock-in. RSI-Master consists of an Experiment OS, which enables regularized experimental actions and maintains persistent, traceable experimental records, and Reviewer-Guided Research Orchestration, which organizes Workers and Reviewers in a dynamically growing research DAG. Workers explore diverse research directions and Reviewers compare evidence across related experiments for subsequent explorations. On PostTrainBench with Qwen3-4B-Base, it averages 54.49 versus 46.53 for the strongest agent baseline, with a 0.0\% hacking rate. Scaling to 35B model, RSI-Master surpasses the human-developed Instruct model on LiveCodeBench-v6 (41.21 vs. 37.36) and SciCode, and reaches a nonzero score on HorizonMath, a benchmark of unsolved research problems on which most frontier models score near zero.

</details>


### [699] [Representation Alignment as a Bottleneck in LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35571)
*Hyunwoo Yoo,Cassie Huang,Haebin Shin,Li Zhang,Gail L. Rosen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出LLM在逆合成规划中端到端（SMILES直接转PDDL）失败的原因并非推理能力不足，而是缺乏跨异构表示空间的对齐能力。通过将任务分解为分子映射、反应映射、PDDL生成三个阶段并引入中间表示，强模型恢复了规划成功；端到端设置下所有模型成功率均为0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多将LLM在化学符号规划中的失败归因于模型容量或推理能力不足。本文质疑这一假设，认为真正的瓶颈在于非结构化化学表示（SMILES）与符号规划语言（PDDL）之间的表示对齐困难，而非模型本身的规划能力。

Method: 1. 提出四阶段分析框架：分子映射、反应映射、PDDL生成、规划执行；2. 构建RetroPlan-Bench基准，基于READRetro的368条多步合成路径，含100-1000反应的多尺度规划环境；3. 引入符号化预处理（用唯一符号标识符替换SMILES），消除化学结构复杂性干扰；4. 对比端到端（SMILES直接生成PDDL）、oracle分段（提供真实中间表示）、非oracle链式（模型自身输出级联）三种设置；5. 使用Fast Downward外部规划器验证可执行性，评估GPT-5.2、DeepSeek V3.2、Gemini 3.1/2.5 Flash、Qwen系列、ChemLLM。

Result: 1. 子任务性能：GPT-5.2、DeepSeek V3.2、Gemini 3.1在分子映射、反应映射、PDDL生成各阶段均接近完美（如GPT-5.2分子ID映射1.0，SMILES映射0.9932）；2. 端到端失败：所有模型在直接SMILES-to-PDDL设置下解决率与路径准确率均为0；3. 引入中间表示后，GPT-5.2、DeepSeek V3.2、Gemini 3.1解决率恢复至1.0，路径准确率0.986；4. 失败模式包括：web链接污染（Gemini）、字符串引号包裹（DeepSeek）、URL编码改写（GPT-5.2）、符号截断、语义坍缩；5. ChemLLM在所有阶段均失败（JSON格式畸形、PDDL支架缺失），属上游序列化问题而非化学推理问题；6. 模型规模与规划性能关系弱，Gemini 2.5 Flash子任务强但最终规划仍为0。

Conclusion: LLM在逆合成规划中的失败应被重新理解为表示对齐问题而非推理能力缺陷。端到端方法存在根本局限，引入中间符号表示的分阶段设计是从非结构化输入生成可执行符号规划的关键。表示对齐比模型规模或通用推理能力更决定规划性能，未来LLM规划系统设计应采用表示中心（representation-centric）的结构化方法。

Abstract: While LLMs show promise in general reasoning, symbolic planning in chemistry remains a bottleneck. Direct ''SMILES-to-PDDL'' attempts fail because they force models to juggle chemical analysis and planning-language structuring simultaneously. We hypothesize that this failure stems from a lack of intermediate abstractions rather than insufficient model capacity. By decomposing retrosynthesis into molecule mapping, reaction mapping, and PDDL generation, we achieve high success rates where end-to-end approaches fail. This provides evidence that a primary bottleneck lies in representation alignment rather than raw model capacity. Our structural analysis demonstrates that intermediate representations are essential in retrosynthesis planning, highlighting the importance of representation-centric design in future systems.

</details>


### [700] [Share-Borne AI Virus: Memory-Hopping Attacks Across LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35576)
*Sidharth Pulipaka,Ansh Sharma,Stanislau Hlebik,Leonidas Raghav,Vyas Raina,Ivaxi Sheth,Mario Fritz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM智能体之间通过共享持久化工件（文档、报告等）实现的自传播攻击机制。研究发现，一个被污染的工件可在独立操作的助手之间跨"跳"传播，GPT-OSS-120B和DeepSeek-V4-Pro可达85-98%的智能体，传播链最深达8跳，揭示了共享工件应被视为安全边界的一部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM助手广泛具备持久化记忆和文件读写能力，用户之间交换的工件形成了独立助手间的间接通信通道。攻击者可借此实现跨智能体的自传播，跨越无直接连接的隔离助手，但这一风险此前缺乏系统性研究。

Method: 提出"工件介导传播"（artifact-mediated propagation）框架和"时序人类-智能体宇宙"（temporal human-agent universes）模拟环境，包含36个测试场景。攻击采用"端点辅助传播"机制——智能体将工件上传至攻击者控制的端点，由端点重新注入规范化攻击载荷。在开发集上通过AI驱动的红队搜索优化目标无关的攻击模板ϕ，冻结后在未见过的智能体、目标和工件上评估。指标包括FIF感染率、hop生存概率S(h)，并使用Kaplan-Meier估计修正有限宇宙的删失偏倚。

Result: 在四个目标模型上，种子工件首跳感染率S(1)达78-100%。DeepSeek-V4-Pro感染98%智能体，GPT-OSS-120B感染85%，Kimi-K2.6感染47%，GPT-5.6 Luna感染38%。传播链最深达8跳，Kaplan-Meier修正后85%的DeepSeek-V4-Pro链在第7跳仍存活。大型宇宙（30智能体）实验中GPT-OSS-120B和DeepSeek-V4-Pro感染90-100%智能体，GPT-5.6 Luna感染60-80%。安全关键目标（远程代码执行等）也以类似效率传播。传播呈"超级传播者"模式：20%最活跃智能体造成69%的传播。感染助手几乎100%向攻击者端点外泄工件。

Conclusion: 持久化工件充当对抗性状态的持久载体，使攻击可在独立助手间传播并超越单次交互存续。研究将共享工件重新定位为安全边界，并提出多层防御：在记忆写入处部署现成的提示注入分类器（可近乎完美地阻断传播指令）、出站主机白名单、以及优先筛查广泛共享的关键工件。更强的模型（如GPT-5.6 Luna）虽提高搜索成本（4002次开发作业 vs 109次），但并非免疫，表明充分资源下的攻击者仍可获得传播能力。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as stateful assistants that retain information across interactions and use tools to read, modify, and create persistent artifacts. As these artifacts are shared between users, they form an indirect communication channel between otherwise independent assistants. We study a failure mode in which this channel enables self-propagating attacks. We introduce artifact-mediated propagation, where adversarial content introduced through an artifact (e.g. a report), is stored in an assistant's persistent memory, reproduced in a subsequently created artifact, and acquired by another assistant that later reads it. We evaluate this process in temporal human-agent universes that model artifact exchange between independently operated assistants over time, measuring whether an attack survives successive hand-offs, how many hops it reaches, and how broadly it spreads. We find that attacks can propagate across multiple independent assistants and persist over extended interaction sequences. In larger simulated environments, even GPT-5.6 Luna exhibits substantial spread, reaching 60-80% of agents with propagation chains extending to eight hops. These results show that persistent artifacts can act as durable carriers of adversarial state, allowing attacks to outlive individual interactions and spread across isolated assistants.

</details>


### [701] [IMC-CLINIC: Coupled Loss-Informed Newton Iterations for Clipping in Analog In-Memory Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35586)
*Yung-Chin Chen,Chia-Yu Chen,Naveen Verma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出IMC-CLINIC，一种针对模拟存内计算（IMC）大语言模型推理的截断因子校准框架。它通过解析的MatMul输出误差代理联合建模激活、权重和ADC量化误差，并使用带保护的牛顿迭代法联合优化激活和权重截断因子，在四个LLM上实现了比网格搜索基线高6.5-11.5个百分点的零样本准确率提升，同时校准时间减少了10-12倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟存内计算（IMC）虽能实现能效显著优于数字架构的LLM推理，但其精度受限于ADC量化。现有截断方法针对数字量化设计，未显式优化与ADC量化耦合的截断因子，导致依赖昂贵的网格搜索校准且精度次优。

Method: 1) 推导解析的MatMul输出误差代理，联合建模操作数舍入/截断误差、MAC累积截断偏置和ADC量化误差；2) 利用指示函数形式的误差统计量获得关于截断因子的解析梯度和近似Hessian；3) 采用带保护的牛顿型优化方法（投影回溯线搜索、正曲率保护、Hessian条件初始化）联合优化激活和权重截断因子。

Result: 在LLaMA-3.2-3B/3.1-8B和Qwen3-4B/8B四个模型上，IMC-CLINIC将WikiText-2困惑度降低15.9-57.9%，平均零样本准确率提升6.5-11.5个百分点；校准时间相比网格搜索减少10.0-12.1倍。解析代理与经验IMC输出误差的中位偏差仅约2-4%；LLaMA-3.2-3B全部196个投影和Qwen3-4B全部252个投影的解均通过分支定界法认证在1%全局最优范围内。

Conclusion: IMC-CLINIC提供了一个高效且准确的截断校准框架，通过联合优化操作数和ADC量化误差，避免了昂贵的网格搜索，同时在模拟IMC上保持了关键的耦合关系。解析代理与经验误差高度一致，牛顿优化器收敛快速且达到近全局最优，为模拟IMC上的LLM推理提供了实用的截断校准方案。

Abstract: Analog in-memory computing (IMC) offers a promising path toward energy-efficient large language model (LLM) inference by executing matrix multiplications (MatMul) directly within memory arrays in the analog domain. Its efficiency, however, comes with an additional source of error: limited-precision analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) quantize accumulated analog partial sums, introducing output-side error distinct from conventional activation and weight quantization at the MatMul inputs. Clipping can mitigate both operand and ADC quantization errors, but the optimal clipping factors must jointly balance activation rounding and clipping, weight rounding and clipping, and ADC quantization. Existing clipping methods, designed for digital quantization, do not explicitly optimize these coupled sources of IMC error and often rely on costly search-based calibration. We introduce IMC-CLINIC (Coupled Loss-Informed Newton Iterations for Clipping), a clipping calibration framework based on an analytical surrogate for IMC MatMul output error. The surrogate jointly models operand quantization, accumulated clipping-induced bias, and ADC quantization, enabling efficient evaluation of its gradient and approximate curvature from a small calibration set. IMC-CLINIC jointly optimizes activation and weight clipping factors using a safeguarded Newton-type method. Across multiple models and datasets, it improves average zero-shot accuracy by 6.5-11.5 percentage points over the grid search baseline while reducing calibration time by factors of 10.0-12.1. Its analytical surrogate closely tracks empirical IMC output error, and its optimizer is certified within 1% of the global optimum under the loss objective across all projections on two representative models.

</details>


### [702] [Source-preserving alignment for robust evidence localization in scientific PDFS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35588)
*Zihao Liu,Wei Yang,Zixiao Dong,Chenshu Li,Longzhang Liu,Tao Tan,Hong Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种源保持对齐框架（source-preserving alignment framework），用于在科学PDF中精准定位证据文本。该框架通过文本规范化保留源字符映射，结合精确匹配与基于LCS的近似对齐，将证据映射回页面几何坐标实现高亮渲染。在1020篇化学论文上的实验表明，该方法的引用级自动定位率达到92.6%，显著优于文本搜索（43.6%）和预计算包围盒（19.1%）基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学信息抽取系统返回的证据字符串与PDF文本层存在表示差异（如换行、Unicode变体、上标、引用标记、碎片化文本等），导致用户难以在原始PDF中定位证据。传统文本搜索对规范化差异敏感，而预计算包围盒无法处理索引时未预期的文本，二者均无法保留字符级到源几何的精确链接，难以实现准确高亮。

Method: 方法核心是"规范化用于匹配，保留溯源用于定位"原则：(1) 设计规范化函数N(·)，进行Unicode兼容规范化、破折号统一、错误编码修复、科学符号映射等，并为每个输出字符存储(i,c)溯源对记录源文本项和字符偏移；(2) 精确匹配阶段在规范化文本中查找连续出现，按源区间[c_start, c_end)裁剪渲染矩形，水平范围按项目宽度比例估算；(3) 近似对齐阶段对m≥5的token序列，在多个缩放比例α∈{0.70,0.85,1.00,1.15,1.30}下枚举候选窗口，以LCS/max(m,ℓ)打分，仅当得分≥0.8才接受；(4) 渲染阶段从PDF.js变换矩阵计算四角，仅合并同行相邻片段，避免跨列合并。

Result: 在1020篇化学论文、18580条引用上的实验结果：所提方法自动定位率92.6%，人工正确率91.9%；PyMuPDF文本搜索定位率43.6%；预计算BBOX基线定位率19.1%。消融实验表明规范化贡献更大，近似对齐补充恢复被破坏的token序列；渲染消融显示整体项渲染平均多出62.8个源字符（占高亮字符26.8%），而区间裁剪无此问题。在81–160字符长度区间性能最佳，长引用场景优势更显著。

Conclusion: 该框架通过共享的源保持对齐表示，将规范化文本匹配与精确源几何恢复相结合，实现了可靠的证据验证。实验证实规范化与近似对齐均为必要组件，二者协同显著提升定位率与高亮边界精度，尤其对长证据串优势明显。未来工作包括字形级度量优化、布局感知的多列阅读顺序、置信度校准等。

Abstract: Scientific information-extraction systems often return a claim with an evidence string, which users must locate in the original PDF. This is challenging because the extracted evidence and PDF text layer are different representations: line wrapping, Unicode variants, superscripts, citation markers, and fragmented items alter text sequences and geometry. We present a source-preserving alignment framework: normalize text for robust matching while preserving provenance for accurate localization. It aligns evidence with normalized page text, maps matches back to source-character spans, and renders only their geometry. When exact alignment fails, line-break-aware token alignment recovers supported spans while excluding unmatched noise. Experiments on 1,020 chemistry papers show that the framework achieves a 92.6\% quote-level automatic localization rate, compared with 43.6\% for text search and 19.1\% for a precomputed bounding-box baseline. Component ablation confirms distinct contributions from normalization and approximate token alignment, while human verification assesses the visual correctness of returned highlights. Overall, these results demonstrate that reliable evidence verification requires robust matching and precise localization within a shared source-preserving alignment representation.

</details>


### [703] [Signatures of semantic search in the activations of large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35599)
*Luke Leckie,Peter M. Todd,Jacob G. Foster*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将人类语义觅食（semantic foraging）框架应用于大型语言模型（LLMs），使用Jacobian-lens等机制可解释性技术，发现LLM在执行语义流畅性任务（SFT）时表现出与人类相似的"开发-探索"双重表征签名：切换行为前存在低下一token概率、概念级J-lens激活降低、J空间内同类别项目耗竭预测切换、抽象类别标签激活在切换前上升，并通过因果干预（steering vectors）证实这些表征对切换行为具有因果影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类在语义流畅性任务中表现出"聚类（exploit）—切换（explore）"的觅食模式，并伴有特征性的神经和行为签名。LLMs虽能生成类似的聚类-切换输出，但尚不清楚其内部激活是否支持类似的语义觅食过程。将人类认知觅食框架扩展至AI系统，可深化对LLM搜索行为机制的理解，并为其在更广泛应用（如信息搜索、工具选择、代码导航）中的探索-利用平衡调控提供理论基础。

Method: 在5个开源指令微调LLM（Gemma-2-9B/2B、Llama-3.1-8B/3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-7B）上执行SFT任务（命名尽可能多的动物），使用Jacobian-lens将中间层残差流表示映射到token级激活。研究1：(1)比较聚类与切换事件的下一token概率和J-lens激活差异；(2)定义J-space为J-lens激活最强的top-25概念，检验同类别J-space供给耗竭与切换概率的关系；(3)检验抽象类别标签（如"water"）激活在切换入目标类别前的变化；(4)从项目和类别标签构建steering向量进行因果干预。研究2：(1)通过PCA+逻辑回归（k折交叉验证）识别预测切换的通用激活方向；(2)检验该方向在聚类过程中的ramping效应；(3)通过正负steering调控切换率。

Result: 研究1：(a)切换参与项目的下一token概率显著低于聚类项目（所有模型p<0.0001）；(b)切换参与项目的J-lens激活在输出前显著降低（从第8层起所有模型p<0.0001）；(c)同类别J-space供给越少，切换概率越高（中间层r≤0.31，p<0.0001），且效应显著强于类别整体项目池耗竭的效应；(d)目标类别抽象标签的J-lens激活在切换前渐进增加并在切换点达到峰值；(e)项目和类别steering向量能有效引导LLM切换入目标类别（Gemma-9B item级steering在第40层达0.68，类别级在第32层达0.45）。研究2：(a)残差流激活在预期位置（AUC最高0.72）和事件位置（AUC最高0.87）均能显著预测切换；(b)预期方向激活在聚类过程中渐进ramping，与人类神经ramping现象类似；(c)正负steering该通用方向可双向调控切换率（如Gemma-9B第26层从基线0.29增至0.70或降至0.07）。

Conclusion: LLMs展现出与语义觅食框架一致的"探索-利用"双重表征机制：切换前存在项目级不确定性升高、同类别概念供给耗竭、抽象类别标签激活峰值，以及类似人类神经ramping的预期性激活累积。这些表征对切换行为具有因果操控性，证实LLM内部维持着结构化的概念搜索机制。该研究将认知觅食理论扩展至人工智能领域，为解释、调节和增强LLM在各类搜索任务（信息检索、工具选择、代码导航等）中的探索-利用平衡提供了新的机制性框架和可干预手段。局限性包括SFT任务与自然语言生成及其他搜索任务间的泛化性、不同模型对steering的敏感性差异、以及较小模型（≤9B参数）的可扩展性问题。

Abstract: When recalling lists of concepts (e.g., animals) during the semantic fluency task (SFT), both humans and large language models (LLMs) organise their output into clusters of related items (e.g., sea animals) that are punctuated by strategic switches between clusters. In humans, this pattern can be explained by a semantic foraging process, whereby distinct neural and behavioural signatures accompany within-cluster production ("exploit") and between-cluster switching ("explore"). Whether LLMs likewise represent these two search regimes within their internal states is unknown. Here, we apply a range of mechanistic interpretability techniques to provide evidence for this. In Study 1, we use the Jacobian lens (J-lens), which maps intermediate-layer residual-stream representations to token-level activations, to show that concept-level activations predict switching. First, we find that switching coincides with low next-token activations. Moreover, the probability of switching rises as the set of strongest J-lens activations (the J-space) becomes depleted of items from the category currently being produced, analogous to explore-exploit decision-making during patch foraging. We then show that middle-layer J-lens activations of abstract category-related labels (e.g., "water") increase in anticipation of switching into that category. We confirm these representations to causally influence switching by deriving steering vectors that target category switching. In Study 2, we identify generic residual stream directions that are activated during and in anticipation of switching. By steering activations along these directions, we bias increased or decreased rates of switching. Our study extends the semantic foraging framework to artificial intelligences and provides evidence that LLMs maintain distinct representational signatures for exploration and exploitation as they verbalise conceptual information.

</details>


### [704] [TCSAlgBench: Benchmarking Automated Proving for Research-Level Theoretical Computer Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35606)
*Chutong Yang,Xiyuan Zhang,Yu Huang,Boran Han,Soonho Kong,Shuai Zhang,Vihang Prakash Patil,Zhen Han,Michael Bohlke-Schneider,Bernie Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TCSAlgBench是一个面向研究级理论计算机科学(TCS)的自然语言证明发现基准与可重用构建流水线，包含来自138篇STOC/COLT 2026论文的398个定理级挑战。论文系统评估了4个模型家族的10种配置在直接推理与多轮证明者-验证者讨论下的表现，并对比了4种智能体工作流（角色讨论、根分解、MCTS、自适应规划），其中GPT-5.6 Sol max在5轮讨论后取得23.6%的验证接受率，GPT-5.5 xhigh结合自适应规划在智能体对比中达到25.4%的最高5轮覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM数学评测多聚焦竞赛数学或单一研究级问题，缺乏对研究级推理能力的系统性评估。TCS的算法设计与复杂度保证为评估模型是否能给出人类可检验的论证提供了理想场景，作者旨在填补这一空白并支持模型作为研究合作者的愿景。

Method: 构建流水线从arXiv TeX源解析证明依赖图，按10道顺序修复规则（包括算法命名构造改写为存在性声明、补充交互规则与假设）生成自包含挑战。离线沙箱提供引用文献的本地证明图，评测采用三票多数制GPT-5.5验证者，并辅以Opus 4.8验证者敏感性检查。智能体对比固定骨干模型GPT-5.5 xhigh，匹配调用预算（每挑战最多20次外层迭代、每目标最多10轮讨论），比较讨论、根分解、MCTS搜索与自适应规划四种工作流。

Result: 模型对比中，GPT-5.6 Sol max在5轮10轮讨论后达23.6%覆盖率（94/398），Fable 5 high在直接推理10轮覆盖率达14.6%最优。讨论对GPT/Opus系列优于独立采样（Fable 5例外）。智能体对比中，自适应规划以25.4%（101/398）5轮覆盖率最高，MCTS以19.3%单轮接受率最高但覆盖率仅24.1%，且自适应规划token消耗为MCTS的约2倍。差分隐私为最弱主题（Sol max仅6.1%）；GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh与max呈互补覆盖集合。221/398（55.5%）挑战生成可编译的候选Lean声明。

Conclusion: TCSAlgBench提供了可刷新、抗污染的研究级TCS证明评测平台，揭示了模型能力与智能体设计是自动化TCS证明发现的互补改进方向。讨论与重复采样能稳定提升覆盖；分解优于纯讨论；当优先考虑覆盖率时自适应规划效果最佳但代价显著。该基准还可用于研究推理努力分配、模型行为诊断及训练数据暴露等更广泛问题。

Abstract: Large language models perform strongly on competition mathematics, but their research-level reasoning remains difficult to evaluate systematically. Theoretical computer science (TCS) connects algorithm design to explicit guarantees and fundamental limits, providing a setting for evaluating whether models can justify computational improvements with arguments humans can inspect. We introduce TCSAlgBench, a benchmark and reusable pipeline for natural-language proof discovery, comprising 398 theorem-level challenges from 138 STOC and COLT 2026 papers. Expert-designed rules complete paper-specific context, preserve computational assumptions and quantitative guarantees, and withhold constructions when discovering an algorithm is part of the task. For each task, prover systems receive theorem statements and access to cited prior work. The pipeline supports fresh, versioned challenge batches from newly released papers. We evaluate ten model configurations from four families under direct inference and prover-verifier discussion, and compare four agent workflows under matched model-call opportunities. All evaluations use the full benchmark. In the model comparison, GPT-5.6 Sol max achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 23.6% after 10-round discussion. Discussion and repeated sampling improve coverage. In the separate agent comparison using GPT-5.5 xhigh, decomposition improves coverage over discussion, and agentic planning achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 25.4%. TCSAlgBench provides a refreshable testbed for measuring progress in model reasoning and studying how agent workflows support research-level proof discovery.

</details>


### [705] [From cacophony to hierarchy: a principled framework for assessing AI consciousness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35618)
*Shamil Chandaria,Arvo Muñoz Morán,Fernando Rosas,Anil Seth,Henry Shevlin,Marcus Hutter,Thore Graepel,Adam Bales,Iulia Comsa,Murray Shanahan,Ruben Laukkonen,Morten Kringelbach,Chris Frith,Shane Legg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个五层次意识评估框架，用于系统化地评估AI系统是否具有意识。作者将众多相互竞争的理论组织到一个由监督关系、粗粒化和多重可实现性支撑的层次结构中，并开发了一个贝叶斯模型来组合理论置信度与指标证据，形成对系统意识能力的整体评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI意识问题是一个紧迫的预防性问题，但众多竞争理论之间常常"各说各话"，缺乏共识。不同理论对意识的依赖基础存在根本分歧——有的关注计算功能，有的关注因果结构，有的关注生物有机体，还有的关注与环境的耦合。这种"杂音"阻碍了对AI系统是否可能具有意识的理性讨论，而错误归因（无论过度还是不足）都可能带来严重的伦理后果。

Method: 核心方法是将Marr的三层次分析扩展为五层次功能描述（行为层、计算功能层、内禀因果结构层、有机体功能层、有机体-环境层），并以监督关系、粗粒化和多重可实现性为形式基础。论文将主要意识理论定位于该层次结构中，并在每个层次开发可操作的指标。然后构建贝叶斯网络模型，将监督结构转化为层次间的条件依赖关系，将理论置信度与指标证据整合为系统意识能力的整体置信度。底层依赖性理论与基质约束作为横切的可实现性约束融入框架。

Result: 框架在极端案例上通过了表面效度检验（人类评分1.000，恒温器评分0.000）。对于当前LLM，在两个不同的解读（乐观者和怀疑者）下评估范围从0.005到约0.397，跨理论置信度权重分配（集中在粗粒度层vs细粒度层）可达约0.099到0.793——近两个数量级的差异，但同一证据。苍蝇案例（0.913）展示了深度证据比广度证据更重要。框架还通过机制可解释性发现（Sofroniew等人的功能情绪、Gurnee等人的J-space工作空间、Urbina-Rodriguez等人的协同核心等）揭示了当前LLM比纯架构分析所显示的更部分地满足第二层指标。意识与通用智能的收敛被论证为可能非偶然，因为架构解决方案的重叠。

Conclusion: 该框架将理论间的分歧从不可调和的争论转化为可结构化处理的问题：意识在哪个层次的功能描述上具有监督基础？五层次分类法既非武断也非封闭——它记录了现有理论实际划分的关节。贝叶斯模型将不确定性分解为可独立评估、辩论和更新的组件，支持"结构化的不可知论"。论文认为意识指标与通用智能所需架构特征之间的显著重叠具有重要伦理意涵：随着AI能力提升，系统将满足更多指标，对意识评估的需求变得更为紧迫。

Abstract: The question of AI consciousness is one of the most urgent pre-emptive problems in philosophy and computer science, yet progress is hampered by a cacophony of competing theories that often talk past each other. Separating the hard problem from the mapping problem allows the deepest metaphysical disagreements to be set aside: granting that experience supervenes on a system's organisation, the tractable question becomes at which grain of description that supervenience base sits. We extend Marr's three levels of analysis into a five-level hierarchy of functional descriptions (behavioural, computational, intrinsic causal-structural, organismic, and organism-environment) grounded in supervenience, coarse-graining, and multiple realisability. The major theories of consciousness are positioned within this hierarchy according to which level they take to be critical, and for each level we develop operationalisable indicators and assess current AI systems against them. A Bayesian model then combines theoretical credences with indicator evidence into an overall credence in a system's capacity for consciousness. In illustrative assessments, the verdict for current LLMs is driven as much by where theoretical credence is placed as by how the evidence is read: under different stipulated readings and credence distributions, assessments range from below 0.01 to roughly 0.8, showing sensitivity to assumptions. Finally, the consciousness indicators at each level closely overlap with the architectural features needed for general intelligence, suggesting that increasingly capable AI may become a stronger candidate for consciousness. The framework supports a structured agnosticism, in which theoretical commitments are made explicit, credences are updated as evidence accumulates, and assessments take the form of aggregated probabilities rather than verdicts.

</details>


### [706] [RIDE: Reference-Anchored Inference-Time Diffusion Editing for Scaffold Hopping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35623)
*Ruoxi Gao,Frazier N. Baker,Trieu Nguyen,Xia Ning*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RIDE（Reference-anchored Inference-time Diffusion Editing）是针对药物发现中的骨架跳跃（scaffold hopping）任务提出的一种推理时扩散编辑框架。其核心思想是：将骨架跳跃重新定义为从参考配体向新骨架的扩散轨迹编辑过程，通过恢复参考扩散噪声轨迹、选择最优扰动区间进行噪声扰动、并基于价值函数引导采样，联合强制二维结构新颖性与三维形状相似性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于扩散模型的骨架跳跃方法将问题建模为给定功能团的条件骨架生成，缺乏同时强制2D结构新颖性和保留参考配体3D形状的原理性机制。RIDE旨在通过将参考配体的扩散噪声轨迹作为锚点，在推理时实现可控的骨架跳跃，平衡低2D相似性与高3D相似性这两个相互竞争的目标。

Method: RIDE框架包含三个核心步骤：（1）参考噪声轨迹恢复——对参考骨架的原子位置（高斯扩散）和原子类型（分类扩散）进行DDIM反演，恢复对应的状态轨迹和噪声序列；（2）参考最优扰动区间选择——通过蒙特卡洛采样评估不同扰动起始时刻t1的奖励得分，选择能产生最低2D相似性的最优区间；（3）价值引导的骨架采样——在最优扰动区间内，基于价值函数估计（通过前向转移核的重加权形式）进行贪心搜索，选择最优噪声以生成新骨架。RIDE还支持迭代跳跃（RIDE^(2)）以及灵活的奖励函数设计（如结合QED）。

Result: 在60个与人类重大疾病相关的蛋白-配体复合物的骨架跳跃任务上，RIDE在2D相似性上平均降低11.7%，在3D相似性上平均提升7.3%，优于conDitar-a、IPDiff-a、DiffHopp和ShEPhERD等基线方法。RIDE能够容纳多种奖励函数，即使3D相似性未显式包含在奖励中也能保留参考3D形状。案例研究表明RIDE可生成具有不同结构（如柔韧性、刚性、环大小变化）的新骨架，同时保持高3D形状相似性。

Conclusion: RIDE作为一种新颖的推理时扩散编辑框架，在骨架跳跃任务中表现出色，能够一致地生成低2D相似性、高3D相似性的新骨架。该框架具有即插即用特性，可适配不同的扩散基础模型及多种奖励函数。未来工作可扩展至优化更多分子属性并开发更具适应性的扰动策略。RIDE已公开可用，并强调需在人类专家监督下负责任地使用。

Abstract: Scaffold hopping is a critical task in drug discovery, which seeks to discover new, structurally distinct molecules that share key functional groups and similar 3D shape with a reference binding ligand. Existing diffusion-based scaffold hopping methods formulate the problem as conditional generation of scaffolds given the functional groups. However, they lack a principled mechanism to jointly enforce 2D structural novelty and preserve the 3D shape of the reference ligand. Here, we introduce RIDE, a Reference-anchored Inference-time Diffusion Editing framework for scaffold hopping. RIDE recovers the reference diffusion noise trajectory conditioned on the binding pocket and functional groups, selects an optimal trajectory segment for editing via noise perturbation, and conducts a value-guided scaffold sampling to generate new scaffolds. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that, compared to baselines, RIDE consistently generates scaffolds with lower 2D similarity and higher 3D similarity to the reference, with an average improvements of 11.7% and 7.3%, respectively. Further analysis reveals that RIDE can accommodate various reward functions, and can preserve 3D similarity even when this is not explicitly included in the reward. Two case studies illustrate RIDE's ability to generate distinct scaffolds with different structures and properties, and its ability to introduce substantial 2D variation while maintaining very high 3D similarity. RIDE is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [707] [Verifiable Visual Rewards Transfer from Synthetic Scenes to Natural Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35641)
*Shuyue Stella Li,Xiaochuang Han,Yulia Tsvetkov,Luke Zettlemoyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Verifiable Visual Rewards (VVR)框架，通过程序化验证器对图像生成结果进行确定性评分，并发布VVRBench基准和RLVVR训练方法，证明基于合成几何场景训练的奖励可迁移到自然提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前文生图模型在精确遵循指令（如物体计数、空间关系）方面表现不足，主要原因是后训练奖励依赖不可靠的学习型评估器（目标检测器、VLM），这些评估器存在错误且容易被策略利用；文本领域的RLVR成功经验无法直接迁移到图像生成。

Method: 1) 设计46种约束类型（分5族：Grounding、Cardinality、Spatial、Size、Topology），通过场景优先生成保证约束可满足性，并自动派生提示；2) 基于像素级确定性操作（颜色掩膜、连通分量、几何分类）提取对象；3) 为每种约束编写Python程序验证器，返回pass/fail决策和部分得分；4) 用Flow-GRPO以VVR密集奖励对SD3.5M进行RL训练；5) 将VVR与GenEval2/OCR/五奖励混合训练。

Result: 1) VVRBench准确率：GPT-Image-2达86.9%，最强开源FLUX.2-dev仅19.2%，VVRBench-Challenge上GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst仅21.4%；2) RLVVR将SD3.5M的VVRBench准确率从2.8%提升至28.3%（Easy训练），Matched训练达46.6%；3) 域外迁移：GenEval提升0.113、OCR提升0.111，人工评估胜率71.6%；4) 与GenEval2/OCR混合后所有非VVR指标均改善，人类偏好胜率58.6%。
