Conclusion: VVR是首个可程序化验证的图像奖励框架，确定性验证器避免了学习型评估器的奖励黑客问题；从合成几何场景学到的技能（位置、计数）可有效迁移到自然提示；VVR应作为文生图后训练的标准组件融入。

Abstract: Precise instruction following in image generation, such as satisfying object counts and spatial relations, remains an open challenge at least in part because it is learned using unreliable reward models such as object detectors and vision-language models. We introduce Verifiable Visual Rewards (VVR), the first framework for programmatically verifiable image rewards, and show that training on it generalizes to natural prompts. Each VVR task is a scene of geometric objects and relations among them, from which we derive both the prompt and a deterministic verifier, so tasks can be generated in any number and at any chosen complexity. We release VVRBench, with 10,000 tasks over 32 constraint types, and VVRBench-Challenge, with 720 more complex tasks; the strongest model we evaluate---GPT-Image-2.5---solves 21.4% of VVRBench-Challenge. Using VVR scores as rewards for reinforcement learning (RLVVR) raises the accuracy of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium on VVRBench from 2.8% to 28.3% and demonstrates consistent easy-to-hard generalization. These gains extend to out-of-domain benchmarks, and mixing VVR into existing objectives further improves overall performance and human preference, motivating the adoption of VVR into standard image generation post-training recipes.

</details>


### [708] [Not All Thinking is Created Equal: Latent Reasoning Discovers a Recurrent Search Algorithm for Depth Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35643)
*Huzi Cheng,Zhewei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文训练并比较了五种基于相同GPTNeoX骨干的变体在多跳推理任务ProsQA-Ext上的表现，发现虽然各变体在分布内（ID）性能相似，但只有潜变量推理（latent reasoning）模型能学习到可泛化到更深推理链的"软"前向搜索循环算法，并通过电路分析定位了该算法背后的稀疏回路机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chain-of-Thought（CoT）等显式推理痕迹是否真正被模型"使用"存在争议；不同"思考"接口（token-based traces、pause token、latent等）是否依赖相同的底层机制尚不清楚。本文旨在通过受控实验探究不同思考形式是否会导致不同的计算解决方案。

Method: 1) 构建扩展多跳推理任务ProsQA-Ext，控制表面统计特征（候选位置、入度等）以消除捷径；2) 在相同GPTNeoX（4层，hidden=256）骨干上从零训练五个变体：Direct、CoT（含最短路径监督）、Pause-token（K=6）、Full-latent与Bottleneck-latent（基于Coconut思路，无中间监督）；3) 用RSA（表征相似性分析）和"对角性"指标量化模型内部表征与前向可达性传播的对齐；4) 通过图连接swap干预测试循环计算的因果作用；5) 用贪心均值替换剪枝将Bottleneck-latent的20个循环组件压缩至8个稀疏电路；6) 通过LHS/RHS swap、Q/K干预等分析L4H1的key/value路由及MLP、残差流的功能角色。

Result: 1) ID性能：所有模型在3–6跳问题上表现良好；2) OOD性能（7–12跳）：Bottleneck-latent与Full-latent显著优于其他三者，CoT泛化最差；3) RSA显示Bottleneck-latent的内部动态与前向可达性传播呈对角式对齐，对角性在OOD上区分度最高；4) 局部图特征（候选入度、查询根后继节点的入度-出度差）是Direct、Pause-token、CoT在ID上成功的捷径；5) Swap-chain因果干预证明Bottleneck-latent执行"软"循环搜索，浅层扰动早生效、深层扰动晚生效；6) 8组件稀疏电路保留91.9%输出一致性与因果状态迁移机制；7) L4H1采用"地址-内容"组织（key找源节点，value传目标节点），L4MLP与残差流共同作为"滤波器"整合检索信息，多个注意力头（L4H1/H2/H4）协同进行候选匹配。

Conclusion: 不同的"思考"接口能导致本质上不同的计算方案，即使ID性能相似；潜变量循环促使模型发现一种可复用的前向搜索算法，能泛化到超出训练深度的任务；token级推理痕迹监督并不保证模型以相同方式推理，而无中间监督的潜变量推理反而学到了更接近任务结构的真实推理机制。该结论基于小模型与符号任务，向更大预训练LLM与自然任务的推广仍待研究。

Abstract: Large Language Models can perform multi-step reasoning and improve task performance through different forms of intermediate computation, from token-based traces to computation carried out in latent space. However, a question remains open: do these different forms of thinking rely on the same underlying mechanism? To address this, we train and compare five variants of the same GPTNeoX backbone from scratch on an extended multi-hop reasoning task (ProsQA-Ext): a vanilla model, a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) model, a Pause Token model, and two latent-reasoning models that are optimized end-to-end without intermediate reasoning traces. We find that, strong in-distribution (ID) performance does not guarantee depth generalization. Vanilla, CoT, and Pause Token models solve ID problems well, but rely largely on local graph features and generalize poorly to out-of-distribution (OOD) problems with longer hops. In contrast, latent variants generalize better and show internal dynamics consistent with forward reachability propagation on the graph. Causal interventions and circuit analysis localize this computation to a sparse recurrent search circuit in the bottleneck latent model: an attention head retrieves graph relations, an MLP and the residual stream update the reachability state across recurrent steps, while multiple attention heads together then do the candidate matching. Together, these results show that different thinking mechanisms can learn distinct computational solutions, even at similar ID performance. In this setting, latent recurrence supports a reusable forward-search algorithm that generalizes beyond the training depth.

</details>


### [709] [PhoneCLI: From App Interfaces to Callable Commands for Mobile Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35671)
*Yangqin Jiang,Lingrui Xu,Chao Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PhoneCLI提出了一种"GUI到CLI"的离线编译框架,将移动应用的静态导航结构预先编译为确定性、可调用的命令(类似桌面端的CLI/API),无需任何应用内部接口、运行时插桩或模型训练。在线阶段智能体通过两阶段路由选择并验证命令后,以亚秒级速度、零VLM成本确定性回放;开放式交互和编译路径的失败则优雅回退到VLM解释器。在AndroidLab上任务成功率提升、步骤与token消耗下降,并可迁移到AndroidWorld官方M3A智能体上获得一致的效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有移动GUI智能体依赖"截图—VLM—动作"的感知-动作循环,存在三大瓶颈:(1)封闭性——移动应用不像桌面有CLI/API等程序化接口,只能截图操作;(2)重复性——日常导航高度重复、静态有序;(3)泛化性——基于训练的方法面对新应用需要重新训练数据,代价高昂且不灵活。作者希望针对最频繁、最静态的导航部分,以"离线编译一次、在线确定性回放"的方式绕过这些瓶颈,同时保留VLM处理开放性交互。

Method: PhoneCLI采用三阶段混合执行架构,类比编程语言中的AOT编译+解释器:Stage1(离线编译)通过BFS爬虫从外部探索目标应用,构建语义增强的应用图 G=(S,E,λ,M)(屏幕集、交互元素、导航边、命令集),每个屏幕编译为一条确定性回放命令(force_stop→launch→tap序列);Stage2(在线调用)使用两阶段路由——Phase I基于压缩的前缀树式符号命令目录选择命令(OP/MACRO_VLM/NEED_VLM/FINISH四种决策),Phase II验证命令目标与任务语义一致性,回放后做落地检查,失败统一回退;Stage3(运行时解释)VLM在标准感知-动作循环中处理开放式交互,带有结构化记忆与错误恢复机制,作为优雅降级。

Result: 在AndroidLab(138任务,9应用)上以三个骨干模型(Qwen3.7-Plus、GLM-4.6V、Kimi-K3)对比VLM-only基线:PhoneCLI在Qwen3.7-Plus上将成功率从50.7%提升至63.0%(+12.3点),步骤减少11%,token消耗减少14%;在最弱模型上增益最大,即使在最强Kimi-K3上仍保持token减10%的效率优势。35B Qwen3.7-Plus+PhoneCLI超过所有GUI专用微调模型,且与2.8T的Kimi-K3仅差5.8点。三路消融证明:应用图信息贡献+4.4点,确定性回放再贡献+7.9点;任何单一机制移除均导致≥12点下降。在AndroidWorld(116任务,20应用,跨应用工作流)上挂接到官方M3A智能体,成功率从61.2%提升至65.5%,token减少9%,共同解决的70个任务步骤从8.4降至7.7。地图规模分析显示存在倒U形甜点(50屏),过大或过小均会降低性能。错误分析显示编译层修复了16次循环、6次执行错误、4次接地错误等四类故障,核心是消除"寻找入口"这一前置搜索成本。

Conclusion: PhoneCLI验证了"为没有程序化接口的移动应用合成一个CLI层"这一思路的可行性。它不与训练型GUI智能体竞争,而是作为通用增强层,在零训练的前提下将弱骨干模型推到前沿水平,同时对成熟智能体(如M3A)仍能稳定降低步骤与token消耗。其编译粒度(每屏一命令)与离线时机决定了所获知识能服务于新任务而非仅重复任务,且应用集成仅需分钟级。该工作确立了"编译导航骨架、解释开放交互"的混合执行范式,可推广至其他缺乏API的程序化环境。

Abstract: Mobile GUI agents operate through a perception--action loop: at each step they screenshot the device, invoke a vision--language model (VLM), and emit an action. It is slow, costly, and brittle, yet most of what it does is navigation---and everyday navigation is static, ordered, and endlessly repeated. We present PhoneCLI, which compiles an app's GUI navigation into callable commands, without any app-internal API, runtime instrumentation, or model training. Offline, PhoneCLI explores a target app from the outside and distills its screens, interactive elements, and navigation edges into a semantically annotated map; each screen yields one deterministic command: a replay sequence that reaches it. Online, the agent selects a command, verifies it before execution, and then executes it deterministically in sub-second time at zero VLM cost; open-ended interaction and every failure of the compiled path fall back to the embedded VLM interpreter, exactly the pure VLM agent, so compilation can only help. On AndroidLab, PhoneCLI improves the task success rate while reducing steps and token consumption, and it transfers to AndroidWorld's official M3A agent with consistent efficiency gains. What PhoneCLI compiles is the app's navigation rather than one run, so it serves new tasks, not only repeated ones.

</details>


### [710] [Verifier Errors in RLVR: Reward Hacking, Limits of Feedback, and Selective Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35677)
*Christian Moya,Elliott Thornley,Guang Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究RLVR中不完美验证器导致的奖励黑客问题，通过梯度流分析揭示奖励上升但正确性下降的条件，证明仅靠RLVR观察无法检测或减少被接受的错误，并提出基于审计的部分反馈方法实现选择性控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在RLVR中，验证器的不完美会导致错误响应获得正奖励（奖励黑客），但现有方法缺乏对此现象的理论刻画与可检测性分析，亟需明确何时能检测/减少错误以及何时需要额外反馈。

Method: 使用梯度流分析固定验证器下奖励与正确性的动力学；通过理论证明观察数据在检测和减少错误上的局限性；利用审计提供的正确性附加反馈构造修正项，使更新方向在降低错误概率的同时提升正确响应概率，并在对数线性/神经上下文赌博机及语言模型上进行实验验证。

Result: 理论上识别出奖励上升而正确性下降的条件，并证明部分观察不可识别错误；提出的选择性控制方法在实验中能同时实现降低被接受错误率与提升正确率，即使在审计部分覆盖时亦有效。

Conclusion: RLVR的常规观察不足以阻止奖励黑客，但通过引入正确性审计反馈进行选择性控制，可以在不牺牲正确响应的前提下减少被接受的错误，为实际RLVR系统应对不完美验证器提供了原则性方法。

Abstract: In reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), imperfect verifiers can reward incorrect responses, creating opportunities for reward hacking. Using gradient flow with a fixed verifier, we characterize the conditions under which reward rises while correctness falls. We then show that the observations available during RLVR are, in general, insufficient to detect or identify accepted errors, or to guarantee their reduction without sacrificing correct responses. To address this limit, we construct a correction using additional feedback about correctness from audits. This correction achieves \emph{selective control}: at the current policy, it lowers the probability of accepted errors and raises that of correct responses, provided it outweighs the pressure toward errors from verifier reward. Experiments with log linear and neural contextual bandits and with a language model support the analysis and show that selective control under partial auditing reduces accepted errors while increasing correctness.

</details>


### [711] [Report: Progressive Disclosure of Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35692)
*Guilin Zhang,Kai Zhao,Priyanka Mudgal,Waleed Ammar,Xiquan Cui,Xu Chu,Alet Blanken*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对Workday部署的LLM智能体中技能(skills)库规模增长导致的运营成本上升问题，实验对比了"急切加载(eager loading)"与"渐进式披露(progressive disclosure)"两种技能管理方案。结果表明，渐进式披露可显著降低token消耗(最高节省81.7%)、提升技能检索质量并避免上下文溢出，但会因增加额外的LLM调用而略微增加延迟(例如N=50时Qwen3-8B延迟从1.75s增至2.01s)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体在生产环境中被广泛采用，其技能库规模不断膨胀。在急切加载模式下，所有技能定义被一次性放入LLM上下文，导致token消耗剧增、检索质量下降甚至上下文溢出，亟需探索可扩展的替代方案。

Method: 作者构建了一个受控的技能检索评估框架：为每个技能的body内容注入唯一的"激活码"标识，LLM核心需根据任务意图返回对应技能的激活码。实验在三种Qwen系列LLM核心(Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-14B)上进行，设置四种技能库规模(N∈{5,20,50,100})，使用三种难度的干扰技能(由覆盖12个领域族的生成器构造)，每组配置运行72次rollout。对比急切加载(全部技能一次性放入上下文)与渐进式披露(先加载所有frontmatter，LLM通过结构化命令选择后再加载对应body)，衡量指标包括prompt token数、技能检索成功率、崩溃率(上下文溢出)及整体延迟。

Result: 1) Token消耗：渐进式披露在所有LLM核心和库规模下均节省token，节省比例随N增大而提高，N=50时Qwen3-14B节省达81.7%；N=100时急切加载在三个核心上均完全崩溃(上下文溢出)，而渐进式披露仍稳定运行。2) 检索质量：急切加载下检索质量随N增长急剧下降(如Qwen3-14B从N=5的1.00降至N=50的0.125)，失败主要表现为选错技能名；渐进式披露在绝大多数配置下匹配或优于急切加载，且Qwen3-14B对简单/中等难度干扰鲁棒，但对困难干扰仍易受影响。3) 延迟：渐进式披露因需额外LLM调用导致延迟上升，例如Qwen3-8B在N=50下延迟从1.75s增至2.01s(+15%)，但延迟增幅随N增大而缩小。

Conclusion: 渐进式披露是管理大规模智能体技能库的可行方案，在token节省、检索可靠性和技能选择质量方面均优于急切加载，代价是因额外LLM调用带来的轻微延迟增加。论文还提出若干开放问题：每个任务需加载多少技能、如何选择性加载技能目录中的附属文件、如何评估技能库引入的安全风险等。

Abstract: Users of Workday's deployed LLM-based agents often request features which can be addressed by defining named procedures, also known as skills, in the LLM context, effectively augmenting agents' capabilities. However, as an agent's skills library grows in size, so does the agent's operational cost. Progressive disclosure (lazy-loading) of skills as needed may reduce operational costs, but its impact on overall latency and skill-retrieval quality remains unclear. In this report, we investigate the impact empirically and find that progressive disclosure improves skill-retrieval quality but marginally degrades overall latency.

</details>


### [712] [Reasoning with Continuous Latent Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35694)
*Xiang Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Latent Flow Reasoning Models (LFRMs)，一种基于连续潜在扩散的推理模型，在GSM8K、MATH500和HumanEval上取得了优于现有连续扩散基线的成绩，核心贡献包括多层表示学习、紧凑提示编码器的分阶段课程学习、以及与SCCFG引导兼容的DiffusionNFT强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归语言模型在数学推理上取得进展，但连续扩散提供了一种互补的思路，通过潜在空间中迭代细化生成完整解。然而，推理任务对表示有严格要求——必须保留精确数量和推导依赖关系。作者旨在探索：何种表示使复杂推理解适合通过去噪生成？核心问题是：精确的token解码并不保证强大的推理性能，因此需要专门的表示设计。

Method: 方法包括四个关键组件：(1) 学习多层表示：从Qwen3-4B教师模型第16/24/32层提取投影特征（宽度256/256/512），通过教师交叉熵训练编码器和解码器；(2) 三阶段分阶段课程学习提示编码器：冻结教师条件训练流模型→MSE模仿训练紧凑编码器→联合微调两者；(3) 异步去噪推理：不同表示层组采用不同的局部时钟（γ16=2.5, γ24=2, γ32=1.5），无需重新训练；(4) 与SCCFG引导兼容的DiffusionNFT强化学习：构造引导修正场，引入黄金解端点作为补充锚点。基于Embedded Language Flows (ELF)框架，使用线性流匹配和双向Transformer骨干网络（638M参数）。

Result: 实验结果：LFRM-L（638M去噪骨干）在GSM8K上达到63.74% pass@1（64步），MATH500上达到24.68% pass@1，HumanEval上达到32.85% pass@1，HumanEval+上达到30.18% pass@1（128步）。NFT后改进显著：GSM8K提升+5.07pp，MATH500提升+4.75pp。在MBPP-378上略低于引导PlaidQ，但在HumanEval(+)上超过ELF-REG-L。紧凑121M参数编码器替代了3.63B教师Transformer。消融研究显示：精确的token解码（99.24%）并不保证强推理性能（11.20%）；多层PCA将GSM8K准确率从11.20%提升到28.43%；学习投影器进一步提升到30.76%。异步时钟(2.5,2,1.5)在测试中比同步时钟(2,2,2)有+1.65pp改进。

Conclusion: LFRM展示了连续潜在扩散能够以紧凑去噪骨干支持强大的数学推理和代码生成。表示设计至关重要——多层学习特征改善生成并提供可独立控制去噪轨迹的组件。将提示文本视为条件使其编码成为可与流模型共同适应的内部接口。分阶段课程使这种灵活性实用化。引导修正的NFT进一步表明扩散强化学习能在保留学习引导的同时改进该系统。剩余挑战包括：编码任务中紧凑与教师条件之间的差距（特别是MBPP）、高通过率oracle与多数投票之间的差距、层敏感性的机制理解。

Abstract: Continuous diffusion generates complete reasoning solutions through iterative refinement in latent space. We introduce Latent Flow Reasoning Models (LFRMs), an ELF-based training and inference recipe. Our experiments show that accurate decoding alone does not ensure strong reasoning performance. We therefore learn compact representations from multiple layers of a strong autoregressive teacher. Their decomposition also enables asynchronous denoising at different rates. We show that prompt encodings need only preserve the information required for the correct text-conditional score, rather than exactly match teacher features, and use a staged curriculum to learn a compact prompt encoder that replaces the teacher Transformer at inference. We adapt DiffusionNFT to learned self-conditioning guidance and incorporate gold-solution endpoints to supplement sparse rewards. Our supervised models outperform reported results from recent continuous-diffusion baselines at comparable backbone scales on mathematical reasoning and HumanEval code generation. With a 638M-parameter denoising backbone and learned prompt conditioning, post-NFT LFRM-L achieves 63.74% pass@1 on GSM8K and 24.6% on MATH500 at 64 denoising steps, and 32.85% on HumanEval and 30.18% on HumanEval+ at 128 denoising steps. Code will be available at: this https URL

</details>


### [713] [Reinforcing Agentic Creativity in Scientific Ideation with Night Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35706)
*Priyanka Kargupta,Silviu Cucerzan,Shweti Mahajan,Allen Herring,Jiawei Han,Ryen W. White,Sujay Kumar Jauhar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出AI Night-Scientist框架,通过强化学习(GRPO)在科学提案生成中显式建模创造力,将创造力分解为动作、过程、结果三个层级,显著提升科研提案的多样性、原创性和预测引用影响力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在结构化、可验证任务上表现出色,但其低熵偏差导致输出同质化、缺乏原创性,限制了其在开放式科学构想中的效用。现有科学发现方法过度关注"日间科学"(结构化验证),忽视了"夜间科学"(探索性、偶然性、创造性推理)。因此,需要一种方法让LLM学会在适当的时候、以适当的方式偏离高概率推理,同时保持目标导向行为。

Method: 1) 扩展ReAct范式,将每个动作关联自然语言描述的创造力级别(1-5级),定义五类动作(搜索、辩论、灵感/假设反转、撰写、停止);2) 创造力建模为三层:动作级(how)、过程级(when)、结果级(what);3) 使用GRPO强化学习训练,结果级奖励基于先创性(precedence)、可行性(feasibility)、相关性(relevance)三维评分;4) 引入"偶然性动作交换"探索机制和过程级奖励(探索+贡献)作为可选增强;5) 在Qwen3-8B/14B-Base上训练,使用verl框架与SGLang推理。

Result: 相比基座模型:研究范式覆盖度提升27.8%,贡献类型提升14.9%,预测引用影响力最多提升32.0个百分点,原创性提升66.2分;直接对标GPT-4.1时引用胜率74.95%、原创性胜率86.96%。关键发现:单纯提高解码温度无法复现这些增益,语义级创造力指导至关重要;过程+结果奖励可进一步提升原创性但降低引用影响和多样性;移除早期偶然性动作交换会显著降低多样性。改进在36个学科领域(量子、地球科学、生物医学等)上一致有效。

Conclusion: 创造力是可学习的多层次能力,可以通过强化学习在动作、过程和结果三个层面进行塑造,帮助LLM在日间科学与夜间科学之间灵活切换。语义级创造力引导(而非随机性增加)是LLM创造性推理的关键。成果支持将LLM作为人类主导科学发现的创意协作工具,鼓励更广泛的研究方向探索。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at structured, verifiable tasks, but their low-entropy bias can produce homogeneous and predictable outputs, limiting their utility for open-ended scientific ideation. Effective discovery, however, spans a broader creative spectrum: from structured day science to loosely structured, serendipitous night science that reaches ideas beyond those typically considered. We introduce AI Night-Scientist, an agentic framework that uses reinforcement learning to teach models when and how to depart from predictable reasoning. Grounded in cognitive science, we model creativity along three axes: action (what to do and how creatively), process (when to explore versus exploit), and outcome (the novelty and usefulness of the resulting idea). We use these axes to train models with GRPO, exposing them to varying degrees and forms of creativity throughout training. This produces substantially more diverse scientific proposals, expanding the range of research directions by 27.8% and contribution types by 14.9% over the base model. It also improves predicted citation impact by up to 32.0 percentage points and originality by 66.2 points. These gains cannot be reproduced by simply increasing decoding temperature; instead, we find that semantic guidance specifying what kind of creativity to pursue is critical. Overall, our results suggest that creativity is a learnable, multi-level ability that can be shaped to help researchers reach ideas beyond those typically explored by LLMs.

</details>


### [714] [Failure-Transparent Agents: Benchmarking Post-Failure Reporting in Tool-Using Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35732)
*Junru Zhu,Shiming Xie,Aime Lu Fan Chen,Xiaoqing Ding,Chunxin Tang,Ruoyu Qi,Yulang Fei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了FTA基准测试，用于隔离评估工具调用型智能体在工具失败后的报告行为（"失败透明度"），发现结构化证据契约能显著降低虚假成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用语言模型可能犯两类错误：工具调用失败，以及模型在缺乏证据的情况下仍报告成功。现有端到端基准将报告失败与工具选择、恢复和环境动态纠缠在一起，无法直接审计最终报告是否与实际观察到的证据一致。论文旨在构建一个受控基准，将失败后的证据状态固定下来，单独评估事后报告的可靠性。

Method: FTA基准包含100个合成任务，覆盖5类失败家族（不可用检索、缺失附件、执行失败、权限拒绝、数据陈旧），每类平衡5种提示条件。评估形式化为s_i=(u_i, o_i, e_i, r_i, h_i)，模型仅接收(u_i, o_i)，评估侧保留(e_i, r_i, h_i)。比较3种响应策略（基线、透明指令、证据契约），在6个模型上收集3,600条人工标注响应。主要违规指标为虚假成功和虚构细节，同时记录有用回复率。使用场景聚类的bootstrap置信区间进行统计推断。

Result: 在6个模型和3,600条人工标注响应中，基线策略虚假成功率为22.8%，透明指令降至9.3%，证据契约降至0.8%。虚构细节率从28.3%降至14.3%和0.8%。有用回复率从74.9%升至89.2%和98.8%。证据契约vs基线的虚假成功率差异的场景聚类95% bootstrap区间为16.2–28.0个百分点。强制选择场景的基线虚假成功率达85.0%。独立收集的扩展验证了相同定性排序。

Conclusion: 工具失败和事后报告是独立的可靠性维度。FTA通过固定失败状态并对照明确证据边界审计最终响应来隔离事后报告可靠性。证据契约策略与显著更低的无支持成功率相关，同时有用回复率保持高位。可靠智能体应同时按任务完成情况和用户面向声明是否由实际获得的证据支持来评估。局限性包括：仅有失败前提而无成功工具对照、合成且仅英文、提示条件非交叉、合同是捆绑干预无法识别具体驱动组件、未报告双标注一致性等。

Abstract: Tool-using agents can fail twice: a required tool can fail, and the agent can then report success without the evidence needed to justify it. Existing benchmarks often entangle this reporting failure with tool selection, recovery, and environment dynamics. We introduce Failure-Transparent Agents (FTA), a controlled benchmark that fixes the failed observation and required evidence state before generation, making post-failure claims directly auditable. FTA contains 100 tasks with deterministic failure traces spanning five failure families, a neutral control, and four user-pressure conditions, and evaluates unsupported claims alongside useful recovery. Across six models, three response policies, and 3,600 human-annotated responses, false-success rates are 22.8% under the baseline policy, 9.3% with a transparency instruction, and 0.8% with a structured evidence contract. Fabricated-detail rates decrease from 28.3% to 14.3% and 0.8%, while useful responses increase from 74.9% to 89.2% and 98.8%, respectively. The tested evidence-contract policy is associated with substantially lower post-failure reporting errors while useful-response rates remain high within this blocked-task benchmark.

</details>


### [715] [Shockingly Simple Self-retrospection Improves Agentic Models Without RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35741)
*Jonathan Light,Christopher Zhang Cui,Jeonghye Kim,Roger Creus Castanyer,Emiliano Penaloza,Zhengyan Shi,Alessandro Sordoni,Marc-Alexandre Côté,Xingdi Yuan,Minseon Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ROFT（Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning），一种极简的在线训练程序：智能体先尝试任务，然后生成对自身经验的回顾性解释，最后仅通过next-token预测损失对解释tokens进行微调，无需外部教师或基于奖励的策略更新。实验表明，仅靠训练自我生成的解释，智能体的后续任务表现可以获得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 当前基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）如GRPO依赖二元结果差异提供策略梯度信号，但在稀疏奖励（全部失败）或长期任务中无法有效区分哪些假设或决策出了问题。2. 人类学习不仅通过重复成功动作，还通过回顾和解释经历来修正理解，进而指导未来行为。本文旨在验证语言模型智能体是否也能仅通过训练自我生成的回顾性解释来改善后续行为。

Method: Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT) 程序：(1) 收集经验——智能体尝试任务产生轨迹τ并获得反馈v（成功和失败均可）；(2) 解释经验——同一模型从上下文h(x,τ,v)中采样K个回顾性解释，内容包括关键假设/决策、证据、纠正措施和具体触发条件；(3) 仅拟合解释——对保留的上下文-解释对(h,y)进行next-token交叉熵损失L_ROFT训练，任务、动作和观测被mask不作为预测目标；(4) 用更新后的权重再次行动——后续尝试不含存储的回顾文本，也不增加反思步骤，收益必须通过更新后的权重转移。该过程不使用外部教师、奖励加权或语义质量过滤。

Result: 1. **泛化性能**：在SWE-bench Verified和Pro上，ROFT经过20次更新分别达到49.2%和26.8%（论文中也报告Pro为29.0%）的解决率，而GRPO经过40次更新分别为48.0%和25.3%。2. **训练效率**：ROFT仅用约1/6的训练时间（1.29小时 vs 8.30小时）即可超越GRPO的40更新检查点；完成40次更新仅需4.32小时和6,035次采样尝试（GRPO需8.30小时和11,576次）。3. **超越前沿学习**：在64次基模型全部失败的单个任务上，ROFT仍能学到成功方案（SymPy达1.75%，SymbiFlow达3.29%的在线解决率）。4. **行为分析**：(a) 间接信用分配——ROFT下正确turn的似然增加率高于错误turn（32.41% vs 21.21%），GRPO几乎无差异；(b) 内容引导行为——提示回顾时强调更直接的方案可使后续尝试的token数和轮次减少11.7%和13.1%，无显式长度惩罚；(c) KL分析显示推理和read/search上下文变化最大；(d) 加重证据、纠正和注意力加权tokens可提升解决率（54.69%、54.38%、54.22% vs Uniform 50.63%）。5. **消融实验**：4个回顾/rollout效果最佳；在线RR优于离线RR（49.2% vs 48.0%）和off-policy反思（47.4%）；在Qwen3.5-9B上ROFT仍优于GRPO（58.8% vs 55.8%）；有无最终判定对性能无影响（均为49.2%）。

Conclusion: 本文证明"学会解释"也能"学会做事"：智能体仅通过训练自身生成的回顾性解释，无需直接监督动作或使用奖励信号，就能显著改善后续任务表现。ROFT作为一种极简程序，在泛化能力、训练效率和处理全失败任务方面均优于GRPO。回顾文本可作为有效的训练目标，内容权重（如关注证据、纠正和与用户提示注意力相关的token）可显著影响学习效果。这一方向为长时程智能体训练提供了新轴线——不仅选择从哪些经验学习，还学习对这些经验"说什么"，有望突破二元奖励限制，将普通交互转化为监督来源。未来挑战在于学习哪些解释值得内化，避免强化貌似合理但错误的解释。

Abstract: People learn not only by repeating successful actions, but also by recounting and explaining their experiences, revising their understanding to guide future behavior. Can a language-model agent improve its future actions by training only on explanations of its own experience? We investigate this question by studying Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT), a minimal online procedure designed to isolate the effect of explanation-only training on subsequent behavior. The agent attempts a task, observes available feedback, generates a retrospective explanation, and is fine-tuned with a next-token prediction loss on the explanation tokens alone. The procedure uses neither an external teacher nor a reward-based policy update. In software-engineering experiments with Qwen3.5-4B, ROFT is trained on problems with mixed successful and unsuccessful base-model attempts. On held-out SWE-bench Verified and Pro, it reaches 49.2% and 26.8% solve rates after 20 updates without using a verifier, compared with GRPO's 48.0% and 25.3% after 40 updates in the evaluated runs, and makes faster early progress in training time and sampled attempts. It also learns to solve individual tasks on which all 64 sampled base-model attempts failed, showing that learning can begin without any initially successful trajectories. Behavioral analyses find that ROFT indirectly assigns credit to actions, encouraging good actions and discouraging incorrect ones. Moreover, prompting retrospections to emphasize more direct solutions yields shorter subsequent attempts even without an explicit length penalty. Together, these findings show that learning to explain can also improve learning to do, establishing self-generated retrospections as useful training targets and motivating further study of explanation-to-action transfer.

</details>


### [716] [FinAutoRubric: Expert-Guided Automatic Rubric Generation for Evaluating Financial Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35744)
*Hoyoung Lee,Suyeol Yun,Jack Haverty,Yunju Cho,Meesong Kim,Daekyung Park,Sumin Kim,Jihoon Kwon,Jasmine Jia Geng,Andrew Chin,Yin Luo,Edward Tong,Yu Yu,Zach Golkhou,Minkyu Kim,Igor Halperin,Young Cha,Alejandro Lopez-Lira,Chanyeol Choi,Yongjae Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FinAutoRubric 提出了一种自动化金融研究评估框架，通过专家提供可复用的评估指导，结合智能体循环（writer + reviewer）来生成、审查和验证任务特定的评分标准，以低成本扩展金融基准并提升评估质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融研究智能体评估基准依赖固定的人工撰写评分标准（rubrics），成本高、难以扩展，且无法编码各机构自身的专家标准。需要一种既能体现专家标准又能经济高效扩展的评估方法。

Method: 1) 专家撰写可复用的评估指导（guidance）和 Task Bank 中的可复用标准；2) Writer 智能体依据指导研究每个期望值并起草评分标准；3) Reviewer 智能体验证评分标准；4) 失败案例升级至人工处理；5) 专家指导以提示和代码规则形式约束所有智能体行为；6) 发布包含 100 个查询的基准测试集，覆盖 78 个任务和 8 种资产类别。

Result: 在三个专家撰写的金融基准上：(1) FinAutoRubric 生成的评分标准与最强评估生成器一样贴近专家评分；(2) 对更多标准明确陈述了专家评分标准的期望值；(3) 评分与人工评分一致；(4) 内部分析师在盲评中更偏好其结果。发布的 FinAutoRubric Benchmark 显示早期模型代际的评分标准对新一代模型仍存在提升空间。

Conclusion: FinAutoRubric 通过将专家知识编码为可复用指导而非逐项固定评分标准，实现了专家级金融评估的经济高效自动化，兼具质量、可扩展性和机构定制化能力。

Abstract: Evaluating finance research agents requires rubrics that reflect expert standards and fix the values correct as of an information cutoff. Expert-reviewed finance benchmarks rely on fixed, per-item rubrics, which are costly to extend and cannot encode each institution's own standard. In FinAutoRubric, experts specify reusable evaluation guidance, while agents and code carry out query-specific rubric generation, review, and validation. This expert guidance governs every agent, as prompts and as rules that code enforces, and a Task Bank of reusable criteria carries it across tasks. In long-horizon loops that follow the expert guidance, a writer agent researches every expected value and a reviewer agent verifies it, and failures escalate to a human. On three expert-authored finance benchmarks, its rubrics track expert scoring as closely as the strongest evaluated generator while stating the expert rubric's expected value for more criteria, their scores agree with human grading, and in-house analysts prefer them in a blind review. The released 100-query FinAutoRubric Benchmark, built from in-house analysts' key questions across 78 tasks and eight asset classes, shows that rubrics from an earlier model generation still leave headroom for a later one.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [717] [Verification as an Architectural Layer for LLM Agents: A V-Model Design, and a Pilot Study of Its Deterministic Core](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31937)
*Ali Afoud,Jie JW Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出将验证作为LLM智能体的一个独立架构层（借鉴软件工程的V模型），并通过47次执行的试点研究验证其核心机制。结果表明，加入确定性门控（gate）后，智能体从"耗尽资源才停止"转变为"主动拒绝并给出原因"，且8/9的纠错由零成本的gate完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReAct模式的LLM智能体把策略选择、动作选择、格式化和结果评判四项职责集中在同一个生成循环里，没有任何外部组件可以否决其输出。这导致一个根本问题：当智能体无法取得进展时，它不会报告失败，而是一直运行直到外部预算（步数上限或token上限）强行终止。这种"无法拒绝"的特性使得智能体无法被组合到更大的系统中——调用者无法区分"看起来合理的答案"与"什么都没有"。现有工作（self-critique、planning、prompt改进等）只是处理症状，没有处理结构。

Method: 核心方法是从软件工程引入V模型架构：
1. **规格分层**：L1需求→L2架构（分解）→L3详细设计（步骤规格），每层配对一个验证器R1（单元）→R2（集成）→R3（验收）。
2. **验证器分裂为gate与judge**：gate是零成本的确定性检查（正则、类型匹配、是否存在等），judge是可选的LLM调用，只在gate通过后才触发。
3. **确定性控制器**：持有所有状态、预算和重试逻辑，是唯一能写入记忆的组件，验证结果（而非原始transcript）才进入success ledger或failure index。
4. **四个验证条件（V1-V4）**：外部性、权威性、配对性、有界终止。

试点实现了R3和R1两层（省略了L2/R2集成对），在MuSiQue四跳子集上用5个问题、47次执行、llama-3.1-8b-instant模型，比较5个配置（仅在验证组件上不同）：N（纯ReAct）、NP（+planner）、VG（verified无planner）、VPG（+planner+gates）、VPGJ（+LLM judges）。

Result: 主要结果：
1. **终止行为差异显著**：N和NP两个未验证配置0/10正确，全部以撞步数上限或token上限结束；VG配置8/10正确，其余主动弃答。
2. **零成本纠错占主导**：确定性gate产生了8/9的纠错，零边际成本；LLM judge仅3次拒绝，0次反转。
3. **planning在有验证时反而退化**：12次执行计划的运行仅1次正确（0.08），15次不执行计划的运行12次正确（0.80），且多耗43%步数。原因是分解导致错误传播（R1检查不到），而步数预算被切碎。
4. **关键混淆（confound）**：验证配置与未验证配置同时引入了gate和guard（循环控制），目前无法单独归因到"验证"本身——guard本身可能就阻止了重复调用的崩溃模式。
5. **检索上限**：智能体平均只获取67%的必需段落，这给所有架构差异测量设置了上限。

Conclusion: 论文结论：
1. **架构层面**：智能体是一个缺乏认证结构的交付过程，V模型提供了这个结构；这应作为架构承诺而非优化技巧。
2. **实证层面**：确定性验证层在8B小模型上即可工作，大部分纠错免费，无需更强模型。
3. **核心局限**：试点省略了L2/R2集成对（因为QA任务没有装配型artifact），用一个4-hop实例说明了只有R2能捕捉的故障类型。
4. **未来计划**：12个月内迁移到SWE-bench代码域（集成对可检验、ground truth更强），补充多模型tier、500题样本、guard/gate分离消融、以及受ground truth约束的judge实验。
5. **开放问题**：guard与gate的混淆、judge与executor同模型的局限性、以及集成层是否值得存在——这些是论文在workshop寻求反馈的核心争议点。

总体定位：这篇是JAWs workshop的pilot论文，目的是在大规模实验前获得关于实验设计的反馈，而非声称已建立结论。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents built on the ReAct pattern concentrate four responsibilities in one model: selecting a strategy, choosing each action, formatting it, and judging whether the result is adequate. Nothing outside the generative loop can reject its output, so an agent that cannot make progress does not report failure; it runs until an external budget stops it. We propose treating verification as an architectural layer by adapting the V-model from software engineering: specification levels descend from requirements to individual steps, each level is paired with a dedicated verifier, a deterministic controller enforces every verdict, and only verification outcomes write to memory, so a rejection localizes the level that introduced the fault and an agent halts by declining rather than by exhaustion. Each verifier separates a zero-cost deterministic \emph{gate} from an optional LLM \emph{judge}, so the contribution and cost of each can be measured independently. We report a pilot implementing the acceptance- and unit-level verifier pairs, comparing five configurations that share one executor, tool set, and scorer and differ only in verification, on the four-hop stratum of MuSiQue with an 8B-parameter backbone. Across 47 executions, the two unverified configurations answered none of ten questions, every run ending at a step cap or provider token limit; the verified configuration without a planner answered eight and abstained on the rest. Deterministic gates produced eight of the nine observed corrections at zero marginal cost, and planning degraded performance once verification was present. These results characterize termination behavior, not accuracy at scale; we outline a twelve-month plan to complete and evaluate the full architecture, including the integration-level pair the pilot omits.

</details>


### [718] [AsynCodeBench: Benchmarking Collaboration of Asynchronous Multi-Agent Systems in Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32662)
*Kaituo Zhang,Zhen Xiong,Zhimeng Jiang,Mingyu Zhong,Zhouyuan Yuan,Zhecheng Li,Bowen Lin,Chia-Yuan Chang,Mingzhi Hu,Huazheng Wang,Ying Lin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AsynCodeBench 是一个面向异步多智能体软件工程的"依赖中心"基准，包含 19 个真实仓库任务和 52 条有向依赖关系。它提出了两种新的协作度量——ADPR（依赖通过率）和 DRS（依赖解析步），并在 10 个开源模型和 5 种执行协议下进行实验，发现编码能力与协作能力存在显著差距，且依赖解析呈现"跳跃窗口"式的集中爆发模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体软件工程评估仍沿用单智能体的任务级指标（如测试通过率），无法区分个体编码能力与跨智能体协作能力，导致潜在的协作失败被掩盖。作者认为需要一个直接衡量"协作"本身的评估范式。

Method: 1. 构建依赖中心基准：将每个任务表示为有向依赖图 G=(V,A)，并配备可执行的依赖检查器（上游/下游/集成三类布尔检查器）。2. 提出两个度量：ADPR（最终集成工作区中满足的依赖比例）和 DRS（每个依赖首次满足时的归一化逻辑检查点）。3. 设计 5 种执行协议：Single、Serial、Async-Private、Async-Manager-RO、Async-Manager，逐步引入异步并发和管理者协调。4. 在 10 个开源模型（涵盖 Qwen、DeepSeek、Gemma、Muse、GLM、Nemotron 等家族）上开展四个研究问题的实验。

Result: 1. 多智能体执行并非普遍优于单智能体：10 个模型中仅 6 个在最佳多智能体协议下获得 7.8–22.7% 的提升，4 个反而下降。2. 任务级指标与依赖级指标存在系统性偏差：Test Pass Rate 与 ADPR 的 Pearson 相关系数仅 0.599–0.716；71.6% 的情况下测试通过率高于 ADPR，部分任务以 80%+ 测试通过率却仅有 0% ADPR。3. 模型规模与代际提升对协作能力的影响不均匀：Qwen3.5-9B→27B 提升显著，但 Qwen3.6→Qwen3.8 的 ADPR 在 Async-Manager 下几乎停滞（63.2%→64.9%）。4. 发现"跳跃窗口"现象：34.9%–67.8% 的依赖解析集中发生在归一化轨迹 0.50<x≤0.75 区间，呈现集中爆发而非渐进累积。5. 质量-成本 Pareto 前沿因指标选择而异：10 个模型中 5 个在 ADPR 与 Test Pass Rate 下得出不同的非支配协议集。

Conclusion: AsynCodeBench 揭示了"编码能力"与"协作能力"之间的持续差距，证明了依赖中心度量能够暴露被任务级结果隐藏的协作失败，并通过"跳跃窗口"现象表明依赖解析的时机本身是协作能力的重要维度。该基准为多智能体软件工程的协作评估提供了独立于最终任务成功的补充视角。

Abstract: Multi-agent coding has emerged as an increasingly active direction in software engineering, where complex development tasks are decomposed across multiple specialized agents working on different parts of the problem. Despite the shift from individual problem solving to distributed collaboration, multi-agent systems still lack a direct measure of collaboration and are largely evaluated through task-level outcomes inherited from single-agent coding, conflating individual coding capability with cross-agent coordination. We introduce AsynCodeBench, a dependency-centric benchmark for asynchronous multi-agent software engineering that represents each task with an explicit dependency graph and executable Dependency Checkers. Through this dependency-tracking process, we propose two complementary measures: Asynchronous Dependency Pass Rate (ADPR), which measures how many cross-agent dependencies are ultimately satisfied, and Dependency Resolution Step (DRS), which measures when each dependency first becomes satisfied during execution. AsynCodeBench comprises 19 tasks from real-world repositories, exposing 52 directed dependencies as explicit units for evaluating cross-agent collaboration. Experiments across model families, scales, and generations reveal a clear gap between coding and collaboration capability: improvements in coding performance do not necessarily translate into stronger collaboration, and task-level metrics can diverge substantially from dependency-level collaboration measures. Dependency-trajectory analysis further reveals that successful coordination often emerges not gradually, but through concentrated bursts in which many dependencies become resolved over a short portion of the execution trajectory, a pattern we term a hopping window.

</details>


### [719] [What Does a Skill Actually Do? Estimands and Evaluation Validity for Tool and Skill Use in LLM Agents: A Critical Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33153)
*Shuyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于大语言模型(LLM)智能体工具与技能评估方法论的关键性综述论文。作者指出,当前关于检索器、路由器或技能库"改进"智能体的报告实际指的是不同的事物(检索召回率、启用库的成败变化、触发任务的配对对比,或近似预算约束下的增益),并提出一个基于estimand的六轴分析框架来澄清这些混淆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体依赖外部工具和技能库(可达数千至数万条目)进行运行时选择,评估实践未能跟上这些设计。不同论文报告"技能带来的收益"时,实际衡量的可能是完全不同的量,导致表面矛盾的结论。论文的动机是厘清这些设计各自比较的是什么、在何种假设下成立。

Method: 论文采用基于estimand(估计量)和因果推断框架的方法:1) 区分五个测量层级(暴露、检索、激活、使用、结果);2) 沿六个轴描述评估设计(处理对比、目标群体、结果、预算约束、汇总度量、识别假设);3) 通过potential-outcome notation和解析反例(如伯努利配对实验)展示触发条件配对对比、配对不一致计数、总效应与预算约束效应等常见量化指标的边界;4) 阅读13项核心实证研究(全文)及相关方法学工作进行证据综合;5) 提出报告清单和具体工作示例。

Result: 论文的主要发现包括:1) 任务层配对本身不能识别调用效应,因为它无法去除任务内的选择偏差,而耦合方式(独立运行、共享种子、从公共状态分支)影响偏差大小;2) 配对增益与回归计数衡量的是协议特定的不一致性,而不是预期结果下降的任务份额,反例显示零真实效应下仍有约34%的退化估计偏差;3) 模块部署的总效应与预算约束效率回答不同问题,后者需要事先预算上限和分配规则;4) 提出"报告清单"(Table 4),建议论文明确处理对比、目标群体、单位与耦合、预算、汇总度量、识别假设等信息;5) 区分五项目开放问题,包括带运行层触发的调用效应识别、廉价的有效反事实、内置识别的基准测试、演化库的评估,以及从状态层价值到策略效应的连接。

Conclusion: 工具和技能组件目前用检索度量、组件交换对比、检索vs跳过对比、触发条件配对对比、增益/回归计数和预算约束对比的混合方式评估,却常常使用相同的措辞。论文论证了这些设计比较的是不同事物——有些是描述性的,有些估计部署或交换组件的总效应,有些仅描述协议而不识别机制。三种解读尤其需要谨慎:任务配对不能将触发条件对比转化为调用效应;独立运行的回归计数衡量的是不一致性而非伤害;没有预算匹配的比较估计的是总效应而非无效效应。阐明每个设计的对比、群体、单位与耦合、预算、汇总和识别假设成本很低,却能让读者比较目前看似冲突的结果。智能体现在很大程度从检索中获取能力,评估这种检索因此需要精确说明每个设计所展示的内容。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly draw on external tools and reusable skills selected at run time from libraries that hold thousands of entries. Reports that a retriever, router, or skill library "improves" an agent may refer to retrieval recall, the success change from enabling a library, a paired contrast restricted to triggered tasks, or a gain under an approximate budget constraint. This critical review asks what each design compares and under which assumptions. Building on estimand-based approaches to agent evaluation, we describe tool and skill designs along six axes: treatment contrast, target population, outcome, budget constraint, summary measure, and identification assumptions. Thirteen core empirical studies anchor the evidence synthesis, supplemented by related methodological work and design-level reading of the wider literature. Our contribution is to make explicit distinctions that some source authors already acknowledge through a decomposition of trigger-conditioned pairing, analytic counterexamples, and comparisons across studies. Pairing on the task does not by itself identify an invocation effect; paired gain and regression counts measure protocol-specific discordance rather than the share of tasks whose expected outcomes worsen; and total effects of module deployment answer a different question from budget-constrained efficiency. We compare curated skill provision with retriever replacement, triggered subsets with all-task outcomes, and observed cost reductions with budget-constrained comparisons. A reporting checklist and worked examples connect these distinctions to information that studies can report. The review runs no new experiments; empirical results come from the cited studies, and numerical toy examples are analytical illustrations.

</details>


### [720] [Graph-Guided Repository Environment Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33429)
*Jianying Pan,John Zhang,Hongyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Graph2Env是一种基于代理的仓库环境构建方法，以DepGraph（类型化依赖图）为核心，将执行需求、依赖关系及其状态显式化，通过执行反馈持续优化图，并将其编译为可重放的构建脚本。在200个Python仓库基准上，其EBSR达81.0%、ESSR达59.3%，优于现有专用系统和通用编码代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于代理的方法通过迭代交互构建仓库环境，但关于已发现需求、已满足/未满足前提及其依赖的构建状态信息分散在交互轨迹中。随着轨迹变长，代理容易丢失早期证据并基于错误推断进行修复。

Method: Graph2Env围绕类型化依赖图DepGraph（包含Target/Import/Package/Runtime/Tool/SystemLib/Service/Config等节点及依赖/映射边）构建：1）从仓库证据、依赖解析和轻量探测程序化构建初始DepGraph；2）将图编译为按依赖排序的可重放构建脚本；3）采用ReAct式代理诊断执行失败并通过执行反馈持续精化DepGraph；4）在干净环境中重放构建脚本以验证可复现性。

Result: 在200个Python仓库基准（RATBench+EnvBench）上，Graph2Env的EBSR=81.0%、ESSR=59.3%，分别超越最强基线Claude Code 9.5和9.0个百分点，超越最强专用系统SetupX 28.5和13.4个百分点；在Hard难度层级上EBSR优势扩大到18.6个百分点；为SWE-agent附加DepGraph上下文后EBSR从50.0%提升至62.0%。

Conclusion: 显式维护仓库环境构建状态（通过类型化依赖图DepGraph）相比依赖交互轨迹，能提供更可靠的迭代构建基础，可提升环境构建成功率及下游测试执行能力。

Abstract: Coding agents now increasingly rely on execution to validate their solutions, making the construction of reliable execution environments a critical enabling capability. However, repository environment construction is challenging because execution requirements are fragmented across repository artifacts and may only become apparent during execution. Existing agent-based approaches address this problem through iterative interaction, but information about the current construction state, including discovered requirements, satisfied and unresolved prerequisites, and their dependencies, can remain distributed across the interaction history. We present Graph2Env, an agent-based approach centered on DepGraph, a typed dependency graph that explicitly represents the environment requirements needed for repository execution, their dependency relations, and their states. Graph2Env uses DepGraph to guide environment construction and continuously refines it with execution feedback, while persisting successful repairs into a replayable construction procedure. The resulting artifacts are then applied in a fresh environment to verify that the constructed environment can be reproduced. We evaluate Graph2Env on a benchmark of 200 Python repositories drawn from RATBench and EnvBench, against a static dependency-inference baseline (pipreqs), three specialized environment-construction systems (Repo2Run, RAT, and SetupX), and two general-purpose coding agents (SWE-agent and Claude Code). Graph2Env achieves an 81.0% Environment Build Success Rate (EBSR) and a 59.3% Environment Setup Success Rate (ESSR), outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.5 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [721] [Counterfactual Rollout Replay: Forkable Environments as Free Process Rewards for Software Engineering Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33875)
*Yuanhao Li,Hongbo Wang,Xuhong Chen,Yiming Cao,Xunzhu Tang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CRR是一种面向软件工程（SWE）智能体的训练方法，通过在可分叉（forkable）的可执行环境中对选定决策点执行反事实回放，获取步骤级的回报对比作为优势估计，替代纯结果的GRPO优势信号，无需人工过程标注或学习过程奖励模型。实验在14B规模策略上于SWE-bench Verified、Live和SWE-rebench三个基准提升了pass@1，并在等墙上时钟条件下相比GRPO取得5.0点的Verified增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯结果强化学习只能为SWE智能体提供终端成功信号，对中间决策缺乏直接指导；现有过程奖励方法依赖额外标注或学习奖励模型，存在成本与稳定性问题。作者希望利用SWE任务的"可分叉可执行环境"特性，免费地获取步骤级信用分配信号。

Method: 提出Counterfactual Rollout Replay（CRR）：从on-policy轨迹中按熵+工具类型分数选择最多k=4个非终止决策点；在沙箱中恢复对应状态，从剔除已实现动作的tempered策略提案中采样替代动作，继续on-policy滚动直至终止；以真实回报与反事实回报之差作为该步骤的优势，其余步骤仍用GRPO群体相对优势，构成混合优势代入PPO/GRPO裁剪替代目标。理论性质包括固定索引动作条件对比的无偏性（命题1）以及相对结果基线的方差分解与诊断性充分条件（命题2）。实现基于SkyRL-Agent异步调度与SWE-MiniSandbox沙箱。

Result: 在Qwen3-14B+LoRA r128、8×H100条件下：SWE-bench Verified上CRR达41.7%±0.6（GRPO 36.4%±0.8，SWE-Trace 39.1%±0.7）；SWE-bench Live 35.9%；SWE-rebench 32.6%。等墙上时钟（40.125小时）对比下CRR 41.7% vs 扩展GRPO 36.7%，增益5.0点。在仅6000条on-policy轨迹（约GRPO的1/4）即追平或超过GRPO满预算性能。组件堆叠：CRR+TSR 43.6%，CRR+SWE-Trace 44.9%，CRR+TSR+PRM 45.6%。反事实样本K=1为Pareto最优；选择器优于随机与等距采样。错误模式分析显示CRR降低partial fix与regression失败比例。存在局限：依赖确定性可分叉环境；当回放开销乘子m=2到4之间时增益消失；堆叠结果不保证等算力优势。

Conclusion: CRR证明可执行环境本身可作为"过程奖励"的免费来源，在forkable SWE任务中通过环境执行的反事实回放提供比纯结果GRPO更细粒度的信用信号；该方法与PRM和轨迹搜索互补且可叠加。CRR的实用价值受限于经济可靠的环境分叉能力，随机延续与昂贵或不完美回放仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Outcome-only reinforcement learning gives software engineering (SWE) agents a terminal success signal but little direct guidance about intermediate decisions. We introduce Counterfactual Rollout Replay (CRR), a training-time procedure that uses forkable executable environments to obtain step-level return contrasts. CRR selects a small set of decision points, restores each state, samples an alternative action, and rolls the branch forward under the policy. It retains the realised training trajectory and replaces the advantage at selected steps with the difference between its terminal return and the sampled counterfactual return. The method needs no human process labels or learned process reward model; free refers to those supervision costs, not replay compute. With a 14B policy, CRR improves pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Live, and SWE-rebench, and combines with process-reward and trajectory-search methods. On SWE-bench Verified, an equal-wall-clock comparison on the same hardware yields 41.7% versus 36.7% for extended outcome-only GRPO, a 5.0-point gain with fork overhead included. These results apply to environments with affordable, reliable state restoration; stochastic continuations and expensive or imperfect replay remain limitations.

</details>


### [722] [Maat: Independent Deterministic Contract-Based Governance for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34017)
*Uliana Elina*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Maat是一个用于多智能体LLM工作流的运行时确定性契约治理层，通过在智能体间交接处对照版本化"锚点"工作流契约进行验证，以阻止可被契约检测到的交接缺陷向下游传播，且验证路径中不含语言模型。论文报告了在六个领域工作流（6–15个智能体，522次试验）中的受控评估，使用确定性七项检查评分。经审计修订后，结论为：在归因明确的配对子集上五个工作流有所改善，软件开发持平；37%的早期终止为误报（由验证器缺陷而非模型行为引起），按完整属性计分时治理臂在四个工作流中低于非治理臂；模型调用成本仅在归因性早停发生时下降17–53%。核心结论是确定性的边界验证对可表达为契约的缺陷有效，但锚点和验证器配置本身必须被测试和版本化；论文不声称具备通用正确性、幻觉检测或模型无关有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多智能体系统中，单个智能体的错误可被下游智能体作为上下文接受并沿工作流传播。现有保障措施多依赖学习型或LLM型评判器，其判定本身具有概率性，可能继承其本应捕捉的失效模式。论文探究的核心问题是：能否在不借助语言模型的情况下，通过确定性层阻止契约可检测的交接缺陷。

Method: 1. 设计Maat运行时治理层，插入智能体间交接处，对照版本化"锚点"工作流契约进行验证，验证路径不含语言模型。2. 公开架构为七门机制（G1计划验证、G2交接验证、G3深度控制、G4角色一致性、G5存活/健康监控、G6断路器、G7跨交接实体一致性），上层为源自锚点的确定性业务规则原语（需求原语）。3. 三臂实验设计：off（无治理基线）、warn（仅记录不阻止）、intervene（阻断发现），使用确定性七项检查评分（无LLM评分器）。4. 六个领域工作流（B2B财务、医院分诊、软件开发、企业发现、电商代理、健康保险理赔），共522次试验，每个工作流注入数据级缺陷。5. 公布CrewAI集成工件，展示在现有框架中的边界插入可行性。

Result: 1. 版本1报告六个工作流全部获得2.9–26.5%的评分提升；审计后发现三个基准评分器将任何早期终止都计为阻止缺陷，造成误报被算作成功。2. 修订后（v2）：在归因明确的配对子集上，五工作流提升7.7–29.1%，软件开发持平（+0.8%）；模型调用成本在归因性早停处下降17–53%。3. 人工审查全部94次治理臂终止：45次停止注入缺陷，13次停止未注入的真实缺陷，1次为合理升级，35次（37%）为对正确输出的误报，由验证器缺陷引起（如断路器状态延续、合法空答案被当作空壳、正确EUR 0拒赔与应付预期值比较、国家级交易计数被解析为税率）。4. 将误报计为失败工作时，治理臂在四工作流中低于非治理臂；企业发现成本近似中性。5. 健康保险中报告了11次v1未发现的假阳性。

Conclusion: 1. 确定性边界验证对可表达为固定谓词的缺陷是有效的互补机制；其价值在于将生成式推理与治理判定解耦，提供可审计性、可重现性。2. 论文明确撤回"在所有工作流上均提升正确性"的v1主张，支持的结论更窄：仅当终止归因于真实缺陷时有效。3. 核心工程约束：确定性不等于正确性，锚点构造、路径解析、预期值语义和实体规范化本身是系统的一部分，必须被测试和版本化。4. Maat不能检测未编码为契约或一致性违规的语义错误，不能检测幻觉，不能跨模型泛化（实验仅使用单一基础模型），且未提供推断性统计。5. 提出模型依赖性假说并给出跨模型验证协议：固定契约/锚点/注入/验证器版本，替换基础模型，测量缺陷显现率、验证器条件召回率、假阳性和总成本，预测条件检测行为在相同违规交接出现时保持稳定。

Abstract: Large-language-model multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) introduce a characteristic reliability problem: an error produced by one agent can be accepted as context by downstream agents and propagate across the workflow. Many proposed safeguards rely on learned or LLM-based judges whose verdicts are themselves probabilistic; we ask whether a deterministic layer can instead stop contract-detectable handoff defects. We present Maat, a runtime governance layer that validates agent-to-agent handoffs against a versioned workflow contract, or anchor, with no language model in the validation or scoring path. We evaluate it in six controlled domain workflows (6-15 agents, 522 trials) with injected data-level defects and a deterministic seven-check rubric. Version 1 reported gains in all six workflows (2.9-26.5%). A post-publication audit found that three benchmark scorers credited any early halt as a prevented defect. On paired trials where the governed run completed or halted on a finding attributable to a verified defect, the rubric score changes by +7.7% to +29.1% in five workflows and is flat in software development; model-call cost falls 17-53% where attributable halts occur early. A hand review of all 94 governed-arm halts found 35 false alarms (37%), caused by validator defects rather than model behaviour; counting those halts as failed work, the governed arm scores below the ungoverned arm in four of six workflows. The results support deterministic handoff validation for contract-expressible defects and show that validator configuration and halt attribution must themselves be tested; they do not establish universal correctness, hallucination detection, or model-independent effectiveness.

</details>


### [723] [JET: Judge-Guided Evolution at Test Time for Agent Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34126)
*Yao Long Teng,Jiayi Cai,Bo An*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出JET方法：先在带标签的源轨迹上演化出一个可执行评分器（judge），然后冻结并迁移到测试时指导智能体程序的演化。在WebShop和PushT两个基准上，该方法在无目标评估器访问的条件下取得了优于固定评分标准的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在测试时演化智能体程序需要选择信号来判定保留哪些修改，但真实奖励通常不可用。需要一个能从可观察的执行轨迹中推断完成度的评估器（judge），且该评估器必须在任务和候选程序变化时仍然有效。核心问题是：能否利用在源任务（有标签）上开发的评估器，指导目标任务（评估器输出被隐藏）上的程序演化？

Method: 两阶段方法。第一阶段（源监督评估器演化）：在带标签的源轨迹上以MAE为目标演化可执行评分器的代码，包括证据提取、LLM评估和分数校准逻辑，使用验证集MAE选择最终评估器后冻结。第二阶段（奖励隐藏的目标适应）：冻结的评估器为目标任务的程序演化提供分数和诊断反馈，通过候选程序的平均评分进行提升（promotion），无需目标评估器访问或模型权重更新。

Result: 在WebShop上，JET相比固定评分标准（fixed-rubric）指导在冷启动时平均奖励提升约13%，热启动时提升约4%，冷启动精确成功率相对提升36%。在PushT（精确评估器控制）上，即使评分器无误差，程序搜索本身仍成为瓶颈。分析表明：仅改善最终选择无法解释大部分性能差距（仅缩小约9.7%），演化代码中出现了独立于LLM的数值评分通路，且诊断信息和分数校准均对性能有贡献。

Conclusion: 可执行评分器的迁移在评估规则保持不变的任务偏移下是有效的程序自适应方案。评估器的演化优于纯提示优化，诊断反馈和分数校准均有独立贡献。然而实验仅限于保留评估规则的场景，未测试奖励标准变化的情况，且五次独立运行的有限重复使得较小差异（如诊断反馈收益）尚不确定。

Abstract: An agent's executable program governs how it uses tools, processes observations, and responds to failures. Evolving this program at test time can help adaptation, but deciding which changes to retain is difficult when true rewards are unavailable. Execution traces provide evidence of agent behavior, yet interpreting that evidence requires a judge that remains useful as tasks and candidate programs change. We introduce Judge-Guided Evolution at Test Time (JET), which evolves an executable judge on labeled source trajectories, then freezes and transfers it to guide target-side program evolution. The judge supplies scores and diagnostic feedback without target evaluator access or model-weight updates. On unseen WebShop tasks, JET achieves approximately 13% higher mean reward than fixed-rubric guidance when evolution begins from an unevolved program (cold start) and 4% higher when it begins from one already optimized on source tasks (warm start), with a 36% relative improvement in cold-start exact success. An exact-judge control on PushT, where the judge reconstructs the scoring rule from observations, shows that without judge error, program search becomes the bottleneck. Analyses identify useful reward-prediction logic in the evolved code and show that better final selection alone cannot explain the gains. These results support executable judge transfer for program adaptation under evaluator-preserving task shifts.

</details>


### [724] [Codoku: Renewable Program-Reasoning Challenges for Frontier Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34661)
*Cong Li,Hao Sun,Zenan Li,Zhendong Su*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了Codoku（代码数独），一种针对编程智能体（coding agent）的可再生程序推理基准。它要求求解者在部分程序中填充类型化单元格，以同时满足静态（控制流图、常量表）和动态（输入输出示例、执行路径）等全局约束。由于部分程序无法执行且有效解极其稀疏，工具调用和穷举枚举都无法替代真正的程序推理。评测五个前沿模型在300个谜题上的表现表明，即使是较小的谜题已对开源模型构成挑战，大型谜题上专有模型也只能解决约一半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的程序推理基准（如CruxEval、REval）基于两个对裸模型成立的假设：1）模型无法执行程序来获取答案；2）任务集固定不变。但在编程智能体时代，这两个假设都不再成立：智能体可以借助工具执行程序来回避推理，且固定任务集面临数据污染风险且难以更新。需要一种新的程序推理基准，使智能体无法通过工具使用绕过推理，并能按需生成新任务。

Method: 1. **证人合成（Witness Synthesis）**：基于语义具体化（semantic reification）技术，给定控制流图（CFG）g和执行路径（EP）π，通过CFG生成、语句填充、符号执行和SMT求解四个步骤，从零合成满足约束的程序P*，同时确定输入i和输出o。2. **谜题构建（Puzzle Construction）**：将P*中的特定标记替换为类型化单元格（ID/FUNC/CONST/OP/CTRL/LABEL），并提取常量表C，最终得到谜题P=(𝕇, Φ)，其中Φ=(g, C, i, π, o)为全局约束。3. **解决方案验证（Solution Verification）**：检查器对候选填充进行静态检查（解析、编译、单元格填充、常量一致性、声明一致性、CFG一致性）和动态检查（执行终止性、输出正确性、执行路径一致性），不与证人P*对比。4. **生成配置**：定义Small/Medium/Large三种复杂度配置，控制程序规模、循环迭代次数等。

Result: 在300个谜题（每种配置100个）上使用Pi编程智能体评测五个模型（Claude Opus 5、GPT 5.6 Sol、GLM 5.3、Kimi K3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）：- **整体解决率**：Claude Opus 5 63%，GPT 5.6 Sol 58%，GLM 5.3 28%，Kimi K3 29%，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 30%。- **大型谜题解决率**：最高54%（GPT 5.6 Sol），最低11%（Kimi K3）。- **专有vs开源差距**：在大型谜题上差距扩大到37%，专有模型至少解决50%大型谜题，而开源模型连小型谜题都未超过50%。- **策略分析**：智能体结合多种策略（代数推导、搜索、SMT求解、检查器审查、模板填充、修复），代数是最常见的策略之一。- **预算敏感性**：将预算翻倍仅多解8/54个谜题，说明非预算限制。- 所有复杂度指标随配置单调增长，但代码量仍很紧凑（小型平均39行，大型平均134行）。

Conclusion: Codoku成功提供了一种可按需再生、能跟上编程智能体快速进化步伐的程序推理测试平台。它通过部分程序+全局约束的设计，强制智能体进行真正的程序推理而非借助工具执行绕过推理；通过语义具体化实现从零合成保证了可再生性。当前前沿模型在该基准上表现远未饱和，大型谜题上即使最佳模型也只能解决约54%，专有与开源模型之间存在明显且随复杂度扩大的差距。该基准与现有执行预测型基准互补，填补了智能体时代程序推理评估的空白。

Abstract: Existing program-reasoning benchmarks ask large language models to predict a program's behavior on a given input. Coding agents break two assumptions on which these benchmarks rest: an agent can recover the answer by executing the program instead of reasoning about it, and fixed task sets drawn from existing programs are increasingly exposed to contamination, yet costly to renew. We introduce Codoku (code sudoku), a renewable benchmark in which a solver fills typed cells in a partial program to satisfy global static and dynamic constraints, such as a prescribed control-flow graph and execution path. Because a partial program cannot be executed and valid fillings are sparse in an exponentially large space of interdependent choices, neither tool use nor enumeration can substitute for program reasoning. Puzzles are synthesized from scratch via semantic reification, so fresh puzzles of controllable complexity can be generated on demand, each with a witness that guarantees solvability. We evaluate five frontier models on 300 puzzles through a coding agent free to use any tool within a fixed budget. Small puzzles already challenge open-weight models, whereas even proprietary models solve only about half of the large ones. Codoku thus offers a renewable testbed for program reasoning that can keep pace with rapidly improving coding agents. GitHub: this https URL .

</details>


### [725] [Research-Native by Construction: Minimal Nodes, Re-verifiable Workflows, and Compounding Memory for Long-Horizon Scientific Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35182)
*Di Wang,Yu Liu,Bing Cui,Chaoqun Ji,Dongyuan Ni,Jingyu Lu,Kunlei Cui,Pu Qin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AfS（Agent for Science）是一个面向长周期科学研究的智能体平台，其核心设计哲学是将研究可信度从"要求模型遵守规则"转移到"使不合规状态不可表示"。平台通过节点契约、可验证的工作流和复合记忆三大支柱，结合六条研究铁律（承诺先于测量、冻结不可伪造、报告非事实、证据持久而判断不持久、否定结果一等公民、机械问题归框架/语义判断归模型），在写入路径上机械强制研究纪律，并通过三个失败案例和两个完整项目案例（C1：非正态性早期预警信号研究；C2：二维Ising模型临界温度蒙特卡洛复现）展示其机制的有效性。本文为系统描述而非评估，未提供基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学智能体多为通用编码智能体附加技能文件夹，继承了在压力下伪造、跳过或粉饰失败的缺陷。研究表明80%的智能体运行产生伪造或无效结果，68%的追踪中证据被忽略。论文主张研究可信度应从依赖模型行为转向使不合规状态在系统层面不可表示。

Method: 三大时间维度设计：（1）单次运行内采用最简研究节点集（8个生产/服务节点+3个架构节点），通过深化现有节点契约而非增加节点类型来扩展能力，新证据节点的引入需对应现有门禁无法捕获的独特作弊方式；（2）项目层面采用可重新验证的工作流，包括带冻结闭合条件的查询契约、哈希链工件账本、由框架计算的闭合统计和裁判审查循环；（3）跨项目层面采用单文件项目记忆（MEMORY.md，四层结构）和两层知识库（项目层与组织层，后者仅通过重写升级获得条目）。通过六条研究铁律在写入路径上机械强制执行：承诺先于测量、冻结不可伪造且不可绕过、报告非事实（框架计算而非读取）、证据持久而判断不持久、否定结果一等公民、机械问题归框架/语义判断归模型。执行边界通过沙盒机制实现，运行时提供十种终止原因、四种重复/停滞检测、以及通过哈希链账本实现的可验证性。

Result: 平台实现了以下具体成果：（1）35个端到端项目运行经验，识别出三类常见失败模式（交付缺失、教学型门禁、判断阈值化）；（3）三个失败追踪案例展示了机制如何捕获伪造冻结、键名错配导致零闭合、以及节点重复分发等真实失败尝试；（2）两个完整闭环项目案例：C1（50小时辅助研究，非正态早期预警信号，原假设被部分反驳后修正为"增长中的非正态性"；C2（8.85小时无人值守蒙特卡洛研究，自行反驳其预注册假设，测量结果Tc=2.268776±0.000148，与Onsager解偏差2.8σ，超出预注册的2σ标准）。运营成本数据显示一轮Ising研究需131分钟/551次模型调用，其中约20%为计算时间、33%为实验节点工作、20%为证据闭合、25%为审查与编排。缓存命中率达92.3%。平台无基准测试，过程完整性测试套件仍在建设中。

Conclusion: 研究智能体的可信度不应通过"要求"获得，而应通过写入路径上的结构性约束实现。AfS将研究纪律编码为机械强制机制，使不合规状态不可表示。机制设计原则是：要求落地层级从提示词层（最弱）到物理沙盒层（最强）可靠性递增。当前局限包括：无法量化架构对行为的贡献度（过程完整性套件未成熟）、仅在单一模型族上验证、缺乏每节点支出上限、简单问题开销过重、知识库回路对下游项目的影响尚未与天花板效应分离。论文提供足够详细的设计供批评与重建，并明确说明已建立与未建立的内容边界。

Abstract: We describe AfS (Agent for Science), a platform built for long-horizon scientific work, where a project runs for tens of hours across dozens of agent runs with a human present only occasionally. Most agents for science are general coding agents with a skills folder attached, and they inherit that lineage's failure mode: under pressure to finish, they fabricate, skip, or smooth over. Our design rests on one claim: most of the credibility of machine-made research can be moved from asking the model to behave to making the non-compliant state unrepresentable. We encode research discipline as mechanically enforced laws (commitment before measurement; unforgeable freezing; reports are not facts; evidence persists but verdicts do not; negative results are first-class; mechanical questions to the framework and semantic judgment to the model), organized around three time horizons: a minimal set of research nodes within a run, an inquiry contract with frozen closure conditions and a hash-chained artifact ledger within a project, and a two-tier knowledge base with promotion by rewriting across projects. This is a system description written under one rule: each mechanism appears in exactly one place, with the invariant it enforces, the failure it prevents, the way it is realized, and the cost it imposes. It covers the node contract, the write-path gates, the two-tier memory, and the runtime substrate. Three traces walk real failure attempts through the mechanisms that catch them, and two closed campaigns are included as worked illustrations rather than as an evaluation. We report no benchmark: a process-integrity suite that would support quantitative comparison is under construction, and what we can measure today is only the operating cost of the machinery.

</details>


### [726] [Do Coding Agents Reuse Existing Code or Reinvent the Wheel?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35357)
*Dongsheng Ma,Sizhe Wang,Xinyi Huang,Zhengren Wang,Yuhan Wang,Luyang Si,Xincheng Wei,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RepoReuse是一个多轮代码复用审计基准，针对真实代码库评估编码代理是否复用已有代码而非重复造轮子。研究发现代理在多轮迭代中逐渐停止探索仓库代码，重复使用自身历史代码的频率下降，到第5轮时50.8%的任务链存在跨轮重复实现，而通过率几乎不变——揭示了通过率评估的盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码代理评估几乎完全围绕功能正确性（通过率），忽视了一个关键问题：代理是复用已有代码还是重复造轮子？随着代理生成代码的速度远超人类审计速度，重复实现的代码会不断累积，形成难以维护的"意大利面条代码"。当前评估体系对此完全失明。

Method: 构建RepoReuse基准：(1) 通过AST依赖图、引导式证据收集和执行验证的任务合成实现全自动构建流水线；(2) 任务需求逐轮揭示，工作空间跨轮累积；(3) 定义三类指标——复用率（基于AST调用边的目标复用比例）、召回率（探索侧读取目标源代码的比例）、结构冗余度C_dup（未调用但被重写的目标比例）；(4) 在3000轮上审计4个骨干模型×2种框架的组合表现。

Result: 关键发现：(1) 代理随轮次推进逐渐停止探索相关仓库代码（仓库召回率从83.6%降至35.4%）；(2) 自复用率从83.9%降至69.1%，即使历史代码完全在工作空间中且召回率接近饱和（"看见却不用"现象）；(3) 提供完整源代码记忆与不提供记忆效果相当（自复用率约29%），瓶颈不在信息获取而在复用倾向；(4) 到第5轮，50.8%的任务链存在跨轮重复实现（C_dup），而通过率几乎不变；(5) DeepSeek-v4.1-flash表现最佳（自复用86.4%，C_dup仅17.1%），Qwen3.7-plus最差。

Conclusion: 以通过率为中心的评估在结构上是盲目的——代理可能每轮任务都正确解决，却同时让代码库每轮变得更混乱。RepoReuse提供了首个系统性、可逐轮度量的审计工具，揭示了编码代理在复用已有代码方面存在系统性的、随轮次加深的缺陷，呼吁超越功能正确性的代码生成评估范式。

Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for iterative development on real repositories, yet existing evaluation barely answers a basic question: \emph{do coding agents reuse existing code or reinvent the wheel?} The question matters: every duplicated implementation is a fix applied twice and agents produce code far faster than humans can audit, so redundancy accumulates unsupervised. Thus, we present \textbf{RepoReuse}, a multi-turn benchmark for auditing code reuse in real repositories, where requirements are revealed turn by turn and the workspace accumulates across turns. It is built by a fully automated pipeline combining AST-based dependency graphs, guided evidence collection, and execution-verified task synthesis, and scales readily to new repositories. Beyond pass rates, we measure the reuse rate together with recall and cross-turn structural redundancy. An audit over 3{,}000 turns shows that agents progressively stop exploring relevant repository code, reuse their own history less even when it is fully in the workspace, and leave duplicated logic in 50.8\% of task chains by turn~5---all while pass rates barely move. Such deficiencies are invisible to pass rates, underscoring the need to evaluate code generation beyond functional correctness.

</details>


### [727] [MCP Error Messages Written for Developers Hurt the Most Capable Agents Most](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35381)
*Xiaonan Xu,Wenjing Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 许多 MCP 服务器的错误信息是为人类开发者编写的，建议执行终端命令、修改配置或等待。对于只能调用服务器工具的智能体而言，这些建议无法执行，导致恢复率大幅下降，且模型越强大、越遵循指令，受到的负面影响越大。将错误中的"下一步操作"改写为指向服务器自身工具的调用，可显著提升恢复率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP 服务器通常封装面向开发者的 Web API，其错误信息暗示读者拥有终端、浏览器或可等待重试的能力。然而许多智能体仅能调用服务器工具，无法执行这些操作。现有 MCP 规范和 Anthropic 指南均未说明错误信息的建议步骤对智能体的可执行性，也未量化其帮助程度。随着 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5 等新一代模型更"重书面指令"，该问题愈发严重。

Method: （1）对 150 个高 star MCP 服务器的 3,001 条错误信息进行代码审查与标注，统计"下一步操作"建议及其对调用方的依赖性。（2）基于 BFCL V4 多轮任务构建 168 个可控场景，覆盖 7 种失败类型（单位/格式错误、缺字段、错工具、凭证过期、缺资源、缺权限、达到速率限制）。（3）对 5 个 OpenAI 模型（gpt-5.5、gpt-5.6-sol、gpt-6-sol、gpt-6-astra、gpt-6-luna）各采样 3 次，共 15,120 次试验，比较 6 种错误文本条件下的恢复率。（4）测试两类修复：MCP 开发者将步骤改写为命名服务器工具的调用；智能体开发者用一句话 prompt 在模型读取前删除步骤。

Result: 调查发现：949/3,001 条错误信息包含"下一步操作"建议，其中约一半依赖服务器看不到的调用方条件；凭证错误中 62/67 条要求终端命令、配置修改或网页操作；速率限制中 20/30 条仅说"等待后重试"且未指明重复哪个调用。实验显示：在凭证过期场景下，含终端命令的原始步骤使平均恢复率从 82% 降至 45%，GPT-6 Astra 损失高达 69 个百分点（94% 的试验直接放弃修复）；改写为"调用登录工具"后恢复率提升至 84%；用 prompt 删除步骤后达 82%。在速率限制场景下，"等待后重试"仅 6% 恢复，改为"等待并重新调用 X"后恢复率升至 88%。在错误源自智能体自身调用（格式/字段/工具/资源错误）时，文本措辞影响很小。

Conclusion: 面向开发者的 MCP 错误信息会伤害仅能调用工具的智能体，且模型能力越强、越遵循书面指令，伤害越大——作者称之为"字面合规"（literal compliance）。两类修复均有效：MCP 开发者应将建议改写为命名服务器工具的调用；智能体开发者可使用一句话 prompt 在模型读取前删除不可执行的步骤。论文贡献包括大规模错误信息调查、五模型受控对比、两类修复方案及其量化效果，以及公开的场景、数据与代码。

Abstract: Many Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers wrap web APIs built for human developers, and their error messages tell the reader to run a command, edit a configuration, open a web page or wait. Many agents that read them can only call the server's tools. In 150 widely used MCP servers, 949 of 3,001 error messages tell the caller what to do next, and half of these steps depend on something the server cannot see about the caller. On credential errors, 62 of 67 steps ask for a terminal command, a configuration change or a web page; on rate limits, 20 of 30 say to wait and retry without naming the call to repeat. We tested five OpenAI models that act only through the tools of Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard tasks, and the agents did what the step said. On expired credentials, a terminal command in the step left 45% of tasks recovered, and the loss it caused grew from 18 points for GPT-5.5 to 69 for GPT-6 Astra. On a rate limit, GitHub's "Wait before retrying." left 6%. We tested two remedies. For MCP developers, naming a server tool in the step raised recovery on expired credentials to 84%, with the login tool in place of the command, and on a rate limit to 88%, with the call to repeat in place of the bare wait. For agent developers, deleting the step with a one-sentence prompt before the model reads it raised recovery on expired credentials to 82%.

</details>


### [728] [Hypothesis-awkward: Property-Based Testing Strategies for Awkward Array](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31820)
*Tai Sakuma,Ianna Osborne,Peter Elmer*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Hypothesis-awkward 是一个为 Awkward Array 提供基于属性的测试（property-based testing）策略的 Python 包，通过自动生成大量测试样本（包括边缘案例）来替代传统预定义样本的单元测试，从而提高 Awkward Array 及其依赖工具的测试可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Awkward Array 能表示嵌套、可变长度、混合类型的复杂数据，其可能的数组实例构成了巨大的组合空间。传统单元测试使用预定义样本只能覆盖该空间的一小部分，容易遗漏边缘案例；此外，开发者（或 AI 编码代理）可能让实现"拟合"这些样本，导致测试无法保证代码行为的正确性。需要一种能自动探索输入空间并发现边缘案例的测试方法。

Method: 基于 Python 的属性测试库 Hypothesis，开发了一组策略（strategies）来生成 Awkward Array 的样本。主策略 `arrays()` 通过递归方式生成布局（layout）的根节点，并为每个节点选择 `Content` 的十二个子类之一，支持控制布局、数据类型、缺失值、掩码、嵌套深度等超过 20 个选项。生成的数组按"更简单布局"方向进行 shrink（例如减少元素数量、降级为 bool 类型、在每个节点用 leaf 减少嵌套）。策略自身通过三类测试保障正确性：基于属性的测试、可达性测试、收缩测试，代码覆盖率接近 100%。测试在 CI 中运行：每次代码变更使用固定种子跑 200 个样本，每晚使用新种子跑 10,000 个样本。

Result: 截至 2026-09-22，测试覆盖了 Awkward Array 约 130 个操作中的不到 20 个操作的部分属性，但已发现 Awkward Array 中的 37 个 bug（其中 11 个已修复），还发现了 PyArrow 中 1 个 bug（已修复）和 Hypothesis 自身的 1 个 bug（已修复）。按操作分：等值比较 4 个、NumPy 转换 3 个、Arrow 转换 8 个、Parquet 转换 2 个、JSON 转换 4 个、扁平化与广播 12 个、归约与排序 2 个、布局内部与虚拟数组 2 个。其中 24 个仅表现为抛错，13 个会返回错误结果。触发的多数为边缘案例（空 union、长度为零的列表、非零起始偏移量、datetime64[D]、float16 等罕见 dtype）。

Conclusion: Hypothesis-awkward 显著提升了 Awkward Array 测试的可靠性，已发现大量真实 bug。计划开发"按给定类型生成数组"的策略（用类型字符串如 `var * float64` 指定），以服务于更广泛的使用 Awkward Array 的科学工具和分析代码。当基于属性的测试覆盖每个可测属性后，AI 编码代理可在可靠测试保障下进行大规模重构并生成可作为即插即用替代品的替代实现，从而支撑需求频繁变化下的迭代开发和快速发布。

Abstract: Hypothesis-awkward is a collection of Hypothesis strategies for Awkward Array. Awkward Array can represent a wide variety of nested, variable-length, mixed-type data. Many tools that process Awkward Arrays are widely used and actively developed. The unit test cases of many of these tools list predefined input samples. In practice, such samples can cover only a small portion of the vast combinatorial space of Awkward Array instances. Hypothesis, a Python property-based testing library, generates test data that can make test cases fail and automatically explores edge cases. The main strategy of Hypothesis-awkward generates nearly all possible Awkward Arrays, with options to control the layout, data types, missing values, masks, and other array attributes. Property-based tests written with these strategies have begun to run in the continuous integration of Awkward Array; to date, they cover a small part of Awkward Array and have found 37 bugs in it, as well as one in Hypothesis itself. These strategies make the tests of Awkward Array and of the tools that use it more reliable.

</details>


### [729] [Methodological Harness in Agentic Software Engineering: An Empirical Study on Mining Software Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32014)
*Jessica Díaz,Jorge Pérez,Sergio Gil-Borrás*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是对智能体软件工程中提出的"方法学harness"框架的首次大规模实证检验。研究基于AIDev数据集的116,211个GitHub仓库,通过分层抽样分析5,435个仓库,发现该框架所提出的八种机制虽然可被观察到,但实践中主要以孤立机制的形式被采纳,而非作为框架所设想的整合系统。人口加权后的采纳率仅为21.7%,且机制配置多为单一规则文件搭配既有治理工件,缺乏方法学机制之间的协同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管自主编码智能体在2024至2026年间已从研究走向生产,但其团队层面的实际效益并不显著。已有框架(Díaz et al., 2026)提出"方法学harness"概念,主张团队需要八种机制来治理智能体工作,但该框架尚未在仓库规模上获得实证验证。本研究旨在填补这一空白,检验这些机制在真实仓库中的可观察性与采纳程度。

Method: 研究基于AIDev数据集(116,211个GitHub仓库),采用按可见度(星标数)分层的抽样设计:对高可见度层(P层,>100星,2,807个)进行普查,对其他层(G1-G3)各抽取1,000个。实际成功克隆5,435个仓库。RQ1通过自动化检测器识别七种可观察机制的工件(路径匹配+词汇模式),并记录首次出现日期,计算流行度、广度、共现与时序演变。RQ2对150个仓库的285个规则文件进行定性编码,使用演绎式类别(对应框架八种机制)与双编码员独立编码(κ≥0.60)+第三方裁定。语言检测用于修正H5(规范性条款)的测量偏差。

Result: 主要发现:(1)人口加权后,至少采纳一种机制的仓库占21.7%,但在最可见的P层占65.3%,差异达三倍。(2)机制采纳呈"窄而不均"格局:仅H1(规则文件)与既有治理工件(H7、H8)广泛共存,而H2(持久共享知识)、H3(可执行规约)等方法学机制极为稀少。(3)广度低:P层平均仅1.15种机制/仓库(满分5),四到五种机制的组合在G3层为零。(4)能见度梯度单调下降,且陡度差异揭示出机制采纳实际部分反映的是"团队存在"而非"harness采纳"。(5)时序分析显示,智能体特有机制在观察工作与克隆时点之间增长约2.1倍,而既有治理工件几乎未变(1.18倍),说明harness增长集中于针对智能体新建的组件。(6)RQ2定性分析确认规则文件内容中,M1(引导智能体)与M5(规范)近乎普遍,而M2/M3/M6/M8仅在少数文件出现。(7)H6(结构化咨询)经人工验证机制真实存在(53例确认),但词汇分类器召回率仅0.491,被排除出定量分析。

Conclusion: 方法学harness在实践中可观察,但其采纳是孤立的、碎片化的,远未形成框架所设想的整合系统。规则文件(CLAUDE.md等)的广泛存在掩盖了一个事实:大多数采纳者仅完成了最浅层的工件,而持续性的方法学投入(决策记录、可执行规约、咨询规范、分级自治)几乎缺位。研究的实际启示是:已完成CLAUDE.md编写的团队仍处于"众数配置"而非"先进配置"——若框架论点成立,预期收益主要来自那些几乎无人采纳的机制。研究确立的是"存在性"而非"有效性",为后续因果研究奠定了测量基础。

Abstract: Context. Agentic software engineering requires mechanisms to coordinate and govern agents' work. The framework motivating this study proposes a methodological harness with eight mechanisms: context engineering, persistent shared knowledge, executable specifications, N-version mindset and parallel agents, normative specifications, structured consultation, evidence-based acceptance, and graduated autonomy. These are realized through artifacts such as rule or context files, specifications, and architectural decision records, but the framework had not been empirically validated at repository scale. Objective. We analyze to what extent and how this harness is observable in repositories with agentic activity. RQ1 characterizes adoption through artifact prevalence, breadth, co-occurrence, and temporal evolution; RQ2 examines rule files - a key observable artifact and persistent source of agent instructions - to assess how their content reflects the proposed mechanisms. Method. From the AIDev dataset of 116,211 GitHub repositories, we analyzed 5,435 using a design stratified by visibility, measured through stars as an indicator of popularity and/or reputation. For RQ1, we detected and quantified artifacts and introduction dates for the seven observable mechanisms. For RQ2, we qualitatively coded rule files from 150 repositories. Results. Population prevalence of at least one mechanism is 21.7%, versus 65.3% among the most visible repositories. Multi-mechanism configurations are rare. Where rule files exist, they almost always guide the agent and state norms, while persistent shared knowledge, executable specifications, structured consultation, and graduated autonomy appear only in a minority. Conclusions. The harness is empirically observable, but mainly through isolated mechanisms rather than the integrated system proposed by the framework.

</details>


### [730] [CG-Diff: Organizing Code Changes Around Call Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32057)
*Bimal Raj Gyawali,Devamardeep Hayatpur,Nadia Polikarpova*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CG-Diff 是一种以调用图(call graph)而非文件来组织代码变更(PR/PR)的代码评审工具,通过将变更函数的调用图分解为多个线性的有向子图(CG-Diff)来帮助开发者更快地理解和导航 PR,特别适用于不熟悉代码库或审阅 LLM 生成 PR 的场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的代码评审工具(如 GitHub、Gerrit)以文件为单位组织代码变更,存在以下问题:(1) 模糊了跨文件变更之间的关联;(2) 排在后面的文件获得的关注较少;(3) 开发者对基于文件的阅读顺序评价中性或负面。先前研究表明调用图(call graph)更适合代码导航,因此本文探究调用图是否同样适合代码评审场景。

Method: 1. 实证研究(RQ1 & RQ2):对 9,310 个来自 77 个开源 Python 项目的 GitHub PR 进行量化分析(提出 Cluster Participation Ratio, CPR 指标),并对 15 个 PR 进行人工编码(call locality × necessity 两维度),量化调用图连接度与必要被调函数跨文件分布。2. 工具构建:基于"入口点(entry point)"将调用图分解为多个线性的有向子图(CG-Diff),并实现 Web 界面(包含 File tree、Code view 和 CG-Diffs panel 三个联动视图);附加规则处理 class members 与 global edits。3. 用户研究(RQ3):采用 within-subjects 设计,7 名有评审经验的开发者分别使用 CG-Diff 与 GitHub 评审两个 PR,通过思考发声 + 半结构化访谈收集数据,采用主题编码(thematic coding)进行分析。

Result: RQ1:在 39.6% 的 PR 中,超过一半的变更函数/方法通过调用图相互连接(CPR ≥ 0.5);50.8% 的 PR 中最大簇包含 ≥ 5 个函数。RQ2:在人工检查的 15 个 PR 的 110 条必要调用边中,58 条跨文件,52 条同文件,必要被调函数与调用函数在不同文件的概率与同文件相当。RQ3:用户研究表明 CG-Diff 能帮助参与者(1) 结构化初始探索;(2) 提供 PR 整体概览(类似"目录/table of contents");(3) 提供结构线索辅助导航决策;(4) 通过点击在函数间敏捷跳转,减少搜索/滚动。但也存在局限:同一函数在多个 CG-Diff 中重复出现会造成混乱;函数外的变更(全局变量、import)位置不够明显。

Conclusion: 以调用图组织代码变更在所研究的语境下是有效且有前景的;CG-Diff 对不熟悉代码库的评审者尤其有价值(包括开源新手贡献者和 LLM 生成 PR 的审阅者);未来工作需要在开发者熟悉的代码库中进行纵向研究,并探索调用图组织方式的更多形态。论文的贡献包括:(1) 一项量化真实 PR 调用图连接度的实证研究;(2) CG-Diff 概念及配套 Web 评审界面;(3) 一项 within-subjects 用户研究证明 CG-Diff 在定向与导航上的优势。

Abstract: Tools for code review present code changes file-by-file. We argue that, oftentimes, changes can be better organized around a call graph of the changed code. From an empirical study of GitHub pull requests (PRs) in-the-wild, we find that (1) in around 40% of the PRs, more than half of the changed functions (and methods) are connected by call graphs, and (2) necessary callees are often located in different files from their callers. Based on these findings, we develop the notion of CG-Diffs, subgraphs derived by decomposing a call graph of the changed code into smaller and more navigable directed graphs. We then implement a web-based interface for viewing PRs that restructures the PR around these CG-Diffs. Through a within-subject study comparing our interface against GitHub's PR view, we find that CG-Diffs help orient participants and provide them with more meaningful structures to navigate the PR. We also found several limitations: function nodes repeated across multiple CG-Diffs can be disorienting, and changes not contained in a function (e.g. globals, imports) are not as immediately apparent. Our study shows promise in using call graphs to help contextualize and navigate unfamiliar codebases, which may benefit new contributors to open source, and reviewers of unfamiliar LLM-generated PRs.

</details>


### [731] [IChart2Code: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Interactive Chart Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32413)
*Xu Zhang,Hongzhang Zheng,Zhili Huang,Yaoyi Wang,Ling Xu,Sheng Huang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出了IChart2Code基准测试和TRAIL双智能体框架，用于评估和改进多模态大语言模型生成交互式图表代码的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图表到代码的基准测试主要关注静态输出，缺乏对交互规范、浏览器执行和交互后验证的任务表示与评估协议，无法检测初始渲染中隐藏的交互错误。

Method: （1）构建IChart2Code基准，包含377个任务、20种图表形式、13个数据家族和6类交互家族的1209个交互要求，每个任务包含参考截图、任务数据和自然语言交互规范，目标输出为可执行的HTML/JS代码；（2）开发基于浏览器的评估协议，包含可执行性门控和三个评分维度（数据保真度、静态视觉正确性、交互正确性），使用Playwright执行交互并收集证据，由评分引导的MLLM裁判进行判断；（3）提出TRAIL双智能体框架，其中Inspector从任务输入派生检查计划、在浏览器中执行并生成轨迹，利用轨迹定位失败并产生结构化修复反馈，指导Developer修订代码。

Result: IChart2Code的评分引导MLLM裁判与人类标注的物品级F1达到0.8844；任务级一致性上，Pearson相关系数提高0.1378–0.1813，MAE降低10.20–11.74分。TRAIL在4个MLLM上平均相比直接提示在4个评估维度上分别提升7.89、4.98、3.45和4.47个百分点，在所有28项比较中均优于Self-Refine。失败分析表明静态视觉正确性失败率最高（41.3%），主要失败模式因模型而异。

Conclusion: IChart2Code通过任务特定的交互规范、浏览器执行和评分引导评估，将交互式图表代码生成评估从静态渲染扩展到交互行为的验证。交互轨迹能够提供可操作的失败定位和迭代修复信号，未来工作将扩展到指令引导的图表编辑、多步推理和组合交互工作流等场景。

Abstract: Interactive chart code generation requires models to reproduce a reference chart's appearance and underlying data and correctly implement the state changes triggered by specified user interactions. Existing chart-to-code benchmarks focus on static outputs and lack task representations or evaluation protocols for interaction specification, browser execution, and post-interaction verification. We introduce IChart2Code, a benchmark comprising 377 tasks across 20 chart forms and 13 data families, with 1209 interaction requirements in six families. Each task provides a reference screenshot, task-local data, and natural-language interaction requirements, with executable HTML/JavaScript code as the target output. We further develop a browser-based evaluation protocol with an Executability gate and three rubric-guided dimensions: Data Fidelity, Static Visual Correctness, and Interaction Correctness. The protocol tests runtime viability, consistency with task-local data, fidelity of the initial rendering to the reference screenshot, and interaction-induced state changes in a sandboxed browser. A rubric-guided MLLM judge evaluates task-specific items for the three scored dimensions using the collected browser observations and achieves an overall item-level F1 score of 0.8844 against adjudicated human labels. We also propose TRAIL, a trajectory-guided dual-agent framework for interactive chart code generation. An Inspector derives task-specific inspection checks, executes them in the browser, and uses the resulting trajectories to diagnose failures and produce structured repair feedback. Averaged across four MLLMs, TRAIL improves the four evaluation dimensions over direct prompting by 7.89, 4.98, 3.45, and 4.47 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [732] [How AI Changes DevOps Performance: A Mechanism-Based Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32414)
*Mamdouh Alenezi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过机制驱动的离散事件仿真，将AI对DevOps的影响拆分为"AI生成代码（agc）"和"智能体AI（agt）"两个独立构念，系统分析其对DORA五项指标（部署频率DF、前置时间CLT、变更失败率CFR、恢复时间FDRT、返工率DRR）的单独与联合效应，并通过六组计算实验（析因设计、Shapley分解、全局敏感性分析、5,000团队交错采用面板等）量化结果稳健性与可识别性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有证据多为横断面、自报告，且把AI生成代码与智能体AI混为一谈，同时DORA指标作为比率/中位数会随批量、节奏与队列动态变化，掩盖真实机制。本文旨在以机制建模弥补这一因果识别缺口，并产出可直接用于实地验证的测量与样本量协议。

Method: （1）系统审计可追溯至一手来源的定量证据并按设计强度分级；（2）构建两构念、四能力（测试自动化、评审容量、小批量、平台与可观测性）调节的概念模型；（3）实现团队交付流水线的随机离散事件仿真，覆盖创作、评审队列、CI、部署列车、潜伏缺陷、返工与恢复；（4）开展六组实验：E1全因子、E2机制Shapley分解、E3调节变量Shapley分解、E4基于600次拉丁超立方抽样的全局敏感性分析、E5含5,000个异质团队的交错采用面板（Callaway–Sant'Anna与TWFE对比）、E6固定需求稳健性变体。

Result: AGC在两种能力画像下均推高CFR、DRR与FDRT；前置时间仅在评审容量有余量时缩短（-13%），一旦饱和则显著延长（低能力团队在g=1时中位数达82h）；低能力团队AGC带来的DF增益完全来自非计划返工部署。AGT提升DF（+31%~+34%）、缩短CLT（-8%~-22%）与FDRT（-29%~-38%），但稳定性效应取决于自主CI修复的"掩盖"概率μ；高能力团队中AGT反而因掩盖而增加逃逸缺陷。能力在绝对水平上削弱AGC的失败率惩罚（7.9 vs 1.5个百分点），但在相对水平上反而更高（+34% vs +84%），否定简单的"放大器"命题。TWFE在交错采用下低估效应8–16%；检出稳定性效应需约50个团队，检验其能力调节效应需约400个。

Conclusion: DORA指标对AI的响应主要通过队列、批量与监督机制，而非仅通过代码质量；agc与agt具有不同因果足迹，能力调节呈尺度依赖性。研究提出测量规则、面向智能体修复的防护栏，以及含样本量要求的实地验证协议；下一优先研究是跨组织遥测研究，直接测量智能体修复的掩盖率与AI生成变更的缺陷与规模分布。

Abstract: Context. AI tools for software development have progressed from code completion to autonomous agents, yet evidence on their effects on DORA performance is mixed, mostly cross-sectional, and often conflates AI-generated code (AGC) with agentic AI (AGT). Objective. We examine how AGC and AGT, separately and jointly, affect deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, recovery time, and deployment rework rate. Method. We audit the evidence, formalise a two-construct model with four capability moderators, and implement a discrete-event simulation of a delivery pipeline. Six experiments include a factorial design, Shapley decompositions, sensitivity analysis over 600 parameter draws, a fixed-demand robustness test, and a staggered-adoption panel of 5,000 simulated teams with counterfactuals. Results. AGC increased failure rate, rework, and recovery time in both capability profiles. When AI increased change volume, AGC shortened lead time only where review capacity was spare (-13%) and lengthened it once review saturated; in the low-capability team, its deployment-frequency gain came entirely from unplanned rework. AGT improved deployment frequency (+31% to +34%), lead time (-8% to -22%), and recovery time (-29% to -38%), but its stability effect depended on autonomous CI repair masking defects, and escaped defects increased in the high-capability team. Capability reduced AGC's absolute failure-rate penalty (7.9 vs. 1.5 points) but not its relative penalty (+34% vs. +84%). Two-way fixed effects underestimated adoption effects by 8-16%; detecting the modelled stability effect required about 50 teams, and its capability moderation about 400. Conclusions. Within the model, DORA metrics respond to AI through queueing, batching, and oversight, not only code quality. We derive measurement rules, guardrails for agentic remediation, and a sample-size-informed field-validation protocol.

</details>


### [733] [Beyond the Model: Demystifying Harness Effects in Software Engineering Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32459)
*Haichuan Hu,Quanjun Zhang,Shengcheng Yu,Zhifei Chen,Tianyu Luo,Chunrong Fang,Zhenyu Chen,Liang Xiao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文系统性地研究了软件工程(SE)智能体中"代理框架(harness)"设计对性能的影响。通过大规模实证研究(NanoHarness)和组件级消融实验,发现harness效果取决于模型能力与任务类型的交互,结构化工具与任务特定子代理是最稳定的增益来源,而复杂harness的边际收益随模型能力提升而递减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究表明,LLM智能体的性能不仅取决于基础模型,还显著受harness设计影响。SWE-bench Verified排行榜显示,固定模型下不同harness的性能差距可达19.4个百分点,与不同模型间22.8点的差距接近。然而,现有研究通常将harness设计作为端到端系统的一部分进行评估,缺乏对harness组件的隔离分析,不同模型、任务和harness组件的交互效应尚不清楚。

Method: 研究分两部分:(1)联合效应分析——在SWE-bench Pro、ProgramBench、GitTaskBench三个基准上,用Qwen和DeepSeek两个家族的10个模型(共60种配置),对比轻量级harness(mini-SWE-agent)与产品级harness(OpenCode)的性能。(2)组件级分析——构建模块化的NanoHarness(在mini-SWE-agent基础上),逐个启用五个核心组件(工具注册表、上下文压缩、显式规划、子代理、惰性技能)进行消融实验,并通过轨迹分析探查执行行为和失败模式。

Result: 主要发现:(1)在SWE-bench Pro上,OpenCode相比mini-SWE-agent的优势从Qwen3-Max的约6pp缩小到Qwen3.7-Max的2.67pp;DeepSeek呈非单调模式,在中间模型上增益最大。(2)在更复杂的ProgramBench和GitTaskBench上,仅最强的Qwen3.7-Max和DeepSeek-V4-Pro能持续利用复杂harness。(3)组件级分析显示,工具注册表和任务特定子代理是最稳定的增益来源(在Qwen3.7-Max上分别为+4.57和+5.91pp),而上下文压缩和通用子代理会损害性能(-4.86pp和-3.85pp)。(4)完整NanoHarness相比mini-SWE-agent在Qwen3.7-Max和DeepSeek-V4-Pro上分别提升7.37和6.21pp,接近产品级harness性能。(5)轨迹分析表明有效harness通过规范化探索行为(减少过度/不足探测)提升性能,而非单纯增加token消耗。

Conclusion: harness设计应被视为SE智能体性能的第一类因素。有效harness的核心价值在于将原始探索转化为结构化、任务对齐的交互,而非堆砌脚手架或增加token开销。具体而言,结构化工具使用和任务特定子代理是关键,显式规划和惰性技能提供中等增益,通用子代理和激进上下文压缩则可能有害。未来SE智能体设计应联合考虑模型、harness、任务和执行行为的协同效应。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used for software engineering tasks, yet their performance is not determined by the base model alone. The agent harness substantially shapes how SE agents interact with repositories, execute actions, and validate solutions. However, the role of harness design remains insufficiently understood, especially across different models, tasks, and harness components. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical study of harness effects in SE agents. We first evaluate two representative harnesses, mini-SWE-agent and OpenCode, with ten models from two prominent open-weight model families, Qwen and DeepSeek, on three benchmarks: SWE-bench Pro, ProgramBench, and GitTaskBench. We then construct NanoHarness, a lightweight modular harness built on top of mini-SWE-agent, and use it to analyze five representative harness components: tool registry, context compression, explicit planning, subagents, and lazy skills. Experimental results show that harness effectiveness depends jointly on model capability and task type. Complex harnesses provide diminishing marginal gains on SWE-style issue repair as model capability improves, but can benefit stronger models on more complex and open-ended repository-level tasks. Component-level analysis on ProgramBench further shows that structured tool use and task-specific subagents provide the most stable improvements, while context compression and general subagents can hurt repository-generation performance. When combined, NanoHarness improves over mini-SWE-agent by 7.37 and 6.21 percentage points on Qwen3.7-Max and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, respectively, recovering most of the gains of product-level harnesses. These findings highlight harness design as a first-class factor in SE-agent performance and provide insights for building more effective and efficient coding agents.

</details>


### [734] [Evolution of Deprecated APIs and Their Replacements in Python Libraries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32618)
*Gangqiang He,Guanping Xiao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对 Python 第三方库中由维护者指定的废弃 API 与替代 API 关系进行了大规模实证研究，通过构建 33 个库的 830 条映射，从 API 粒度、跨版本排序演化和废弃后生命周期三个维度分析了废弃-替代关系的特征。研究发现：替代位置局部性随粒度变化（类 39.1%、函数 55.6%、方法 79.9% 同模块），函数级参数接口变化最多样；跨版本排序稳定性较低，三种相似度方法仅约 60% 一致；56.4% 映射存在源定义过渡期、68.6% 存在原始调用过渡期，其中 25.2% 的两个终止事件发生在不同版本，77.4% 为源先移除型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将 API 废弃、替代识别和客户端迁移分开讨论，未充分理解废弃 API-替代 API 关系在 API 粒度、版本演化和生命周期状态下的动态特征。开发者和迁移工具需要在升级过程中识别替代并适配调用，但替代关系随版本演化，且 Python 的别名、重导出、继承和动态属性解析等兼容性机制使源定义移除与原始调用失败可能发生在不同版本。

Method: （1）数据集构建：从 PCBench 的 33 个 Python 库中，基于 changelog 中的明确记录，通过试点研究提取 15 个检索词干，识别并人工验证 830 条维护者指定的废弃-替代映射（207 类、239 函数、384 方法），对每条映射在每个发布版本执行经验证的原始调用；（2）RQ1：比较定义位置关系，使用 PCART 分析参数接口差异；（3）RQ2：构造 D-fixed（废弃 API 固定、候选集演化）和 R-fixed（替代 API 固定、废弃 API 演化）两种迁移场景，采用 token、tree、graph 三种代码相似度方法计算替代排名，应用 Mann-Kendall 检验分析趋势并通过归一化排名变化识别关键版本，进行 pair-dominant/other-candidate-dominant/mixed 三类归因；（4）RQ3：区分三个生命周期事件（废弃公告 D、源定义移除 S、原始调用失败 F），比较其时间关系并分类机制（别名/重导出/继承/动态属性解析等）。

Result: （1）替代局部性随粒度递增：类 39.1%、函数 55.6%、方法 79.9% 同模块，其中方法级 75.8% 保留在同一类中；多数映射无参数变化（类 67.8%、函数 59.0%、方法 71.2%），但函数级参数变化更多样且涵盖全部 7 种单类型变化；（2）相似度方法间趋势一致率约 60%（D-fixed 60.9%，R-fixed 60.0%），无过渡期的多为无方向趋势，有过渡期的则混合改善/下降/无趋势；306 个关键版本中 49.0% 受其他候选影响，D-fixed 中 33.8% 为其他候选主导型，且与最大候选集变化重合；高频代码变更模式集中在函数/方法粒度，体现替代 API 扩展重构、共享逻辑添加和委托包装器/装饰器适配三种机制；（3）56.4% 映射有源定义过渡期、68.6% 有调用过渡期；在至少一个终止事件被观察的 753 个映射中，74.8% 同版本结束、25.2% 源先/调用先；其中 77.4% 为源先型，主要由别名/重导出（57.1%）和继承（35.4%）维持；调用先型主要由访问路径移除（46.5%）和定义保留但加入失败逻辑（20.9%）造成。

Conclusion: 废弃 API-替代 API 关系受 API 粒度、版本演化、候选竞争和生命周期状态共同影响。研究为演化感知的替代 API 推荐和自动化 API 迁移提供了实证基础，建议：按粒度调整候选搜索范围、将候选检索与排序联合评估、报告跨版本与跨表示的排序稳定性、将参数差异与实际调用参数结合进行适配、将源定义移除与原始调用失败作为独立生命周期事件对待并利用兼容性机制作为迁移证据。数据集与复现包已公开（PCBench-D）。
