TL;DR: GPUPhysBench 是一个包含 50 个 GPU 物理仿真任务的基准测试，用于评估 LLM 编程智能体在编写正确且高效的 CUDA 物理仿真代码方面的能力。评估涵盖流体、可变形固体和颗粒材料，最强的两个智能体通过了全部任务，但即使最快的提交在仅 22% 的任务上达到参考性能的 0.9 倍，且没有任何提交超过参考 5% 以上，主要性能瓶颈出现在碰撞检测、约束求解和迭代求解器中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体评估基准主要针对机器学习算子的 GPU 内核生成或基于 CPU 的科学计算，未能覆盖物理仿真这一既需要数值正确性又需要高效 GPU 执行的领域。物理仿真对于游戏、机器人世界模型和具身智能越来越重要，需要既能自动化又能保证正确性与效率的 GPU 实现评估标准。

Method: 构建包含 50 个任务的基准，任务涵盖局部算子（如平移、LBM 流的推流与碰撞）和完整仿真步骤（如 PIC/FLIP、MPM、XPBD、稳定流体、CCD 等）。每任务提供自然语言提示、起始 CUDA 代码、Python 驱动和人类专家优化的参考实现。评估在固定时间预算（算子 30 分钟、完整仿真 60 分钟）下使用六种前沿模型-工具组合（如 Claude Code、Codex CLI），通过 Docker 隔离、防作弊审计（静态检查 + LLM 审计）确保公平性，使用 CUDA 事件计时，比较正确性（公开+隐藏输入）和相对于专家参考的速度。

Result: 六个模型中，Claude-Opus-5 和 GPT-5.6-Sol 通过全部 50 个任务；然而即使最快的 Opus 在仅 22% 的任务上达到参考速度的 0.9 倍（fast₀.₉=22%），fast₀.₅=66%，且没有任何提交超过参考 5% 以上。性能差距最大的任务集中在碰撞检测（CCD 四种基元对：fast₀.₅ 普遍低于 0.5）、约束求解（XPBD 任务）、迭代求解器（Poisson 求解、Newton 隐式步、投影动力学）。速度差距主要源于算法选择（如对角预条件 CG vs 多重网格）和数据组织（粒子空间分组与共享内存归约优化）。运行间差异较小（Opus 的 fast₀.₅ 在 64%-66% 之间），证明结果稳定。

Conclusion: 前沿编码智能体已能正确实现完整指定的物理仿真方法，但性能与专家优化参考实现之间仍存在显著差距，特别是在碰撞检测、约束求解和迭代求解器中。差距的根源在于算法选择与 GPU 执行的联合优化能力不足。GPUPhysBench 为评估自动化高效物理仿真器实现提供了首个专门测试平台，揭示了需要联合推理数值方法与 GPU 执行的下一代智能体方向。

Abstract: Writing fast GPU code for physical simulation is difficult: implementations must preserve numerical accuracy while handling irregular data access, synchronization, and iterative solvers. We introduce GPUPhysBench, a benchmark of 50 tasks testing whether coding agents can meet these demands. Tasks cover fluids, deformable solids, and granular materials, from individual simulation operators to complete simulators. Agents write, compile, test, and optimize GPU code with access to a NVIDIA GPU under fixed time budgets. We report pass rates and runtime performance relative to expert-optimized reference implementations. In a single-attempt evaluation of six frontier model-harness pairs, the two strongest pass all 50 tasks, but even the fastest reaches at least 0.9 the reference speed on only 22% of them, and no submission is more than 5% faster than the reference. The largest gaps arise in collision detection, constraint solving, and iterative solvers. GPUPhysBench brings physical simulation workloads to coding-agent evaluation, testing both the ability to implement numerical methods correctly and the ability to make them run efficiently.

</details>


### [806] [IceCube Takes Flight with Pelican - A First Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31851)
*David Schultz,Maclean Mansfield-Parisi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: IceCube中微子天文台将其全球网格计算中的数据传输系统从基于GridFTP和X.509证书的传统架构迁移到Pelican平台、开放科学数据联邦(OSDF)和WLCG OAuth2令牌。文章详细介绍了为适配其POSIX文件系统和HTCondor作业调度系统所做的定制化工作，包括自研令牌签发器、自定义HTCondor Provider/CredMon组件（Rust实现）以及作业转换模板，并总结了过渡期遇到的Pelican相关问题及经验教训。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于CILogon在2025年5月突然停止签发X.509证书（且未提前通知），加之GridFTP自2019年起被逐步淘汰，IceCube急需将其全球网格计算中依赖GridFTP和X.509代理证书的数据传输基础设施迁移到现代替代方案，以保证分布在全球的异构集群与UW-Madison主存储之间的数据交换不中断。

Method: 1. **自研OAuth2令牌签发器**：基于Python构建，将身份验证委托给现有Keycloak IDP，通过LDAP TTL缓存验证WLCG动态scope与POSIX文件系统用户/组权限的对应关系；支持设备授权流、动态客户端注册和令牌交换（含用户模拟），状态存储于MongoDB。2. **Pelican Origin部署**：以CephFS为后端，通过LDAP将令牌中的身份映射为本地用户，利用"切换用户"机制实现POSIX权限控制；注册到OSDF命名空间`osdf:///icecube/wipac`。3. **HTCondor定制集成**：用Rust编写自定义Provider（支持setuid以读取受保护的客户端密钥）和CredMon（定期刷新访问令牌）；通过Job Transforms抽象复杂的token/scope语法，为用户提供模板化提交接口。4. **过渡方案与生态协作**：保留Keycloak作为IDP（因动态scope bug放弃其作为签发器），与Pelican/HTCondor团队协作修复多项bug。

Result: 迁移已成功完成并投入生产。新系统在多个方面优于GridFTP：缓存和校验和验证改善了数据局部性与可靠性；用户可通过单一登录获取令牌并直接使用命令行工具；作业提交时即可校验权限，避免无效作业运行。过渡中遇到的问题包括：Pelican客户端错误退出码、禁止覆盖文件的破坏性变更（已通过新增选项解决）、Origin整数溢出bug、以及对OSDF Director的外部依赖导致的故障域扩大等。最小访问令牌有效期应大于CredMon间隔与EP更新间隔之和（实践中设为600秒）。

Conclusion: 从GridFTP/X.509到Pelican/OSDF/WLCG令牌的迁移整体成功，自定义令牌签发器、HTCondor组件与作业转换模板使系统在保持可靠性和性能的同时显著提升了可用性。经验表明：依赖外部联邦服务改变了传统无外部网络依赖的运维模型；清晰的错误信息和提交前校验对用户体验至关重要；未来工作将聚焦于自动化错误修复与改进提交验证流程。

Abstract: The IceCube Neutrino Observatory has removed GridFTP and x.509 certificate authentication for data transfers, migrating to the Pelican Platform, the Open Science Data Federation, and WLGC tokens. While this is a common solution on the computing infrastructure we use, we required several customizations to work with our existing data storage structure and make it easier for scientists to use. We wrote a custom WLCG token issuer to support our POSIX filesystem with custom user and group permissions across the entire filesystem. We also made several modifications to HTCondor to ease job submission using tokens, including a custom credmon. After an initially bumpy transition due to several now-resolved Pelican issues, the Pelican-based system has already proven superior to GridFTP in several ways.

</details>


### [807] [Towards Simple Models of Complex SmartNICs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32055)
*Robert Chang,Teng Jiang,Wonsup Yoon,Daehyeok Kim,Sam Kumar,George Varghese*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 ZRAM 模型，一种面向异构 SmartNIC（如 NVIDIA BlueField-3）的轻量级计算模型，通过平台图（处理区域与通道）与程序图（任务与流量分数）的配对，使用 capability、roofline、capacity 三个指标在编码前即可评估任务放置方案的可行性与瓶颈资源，并提炼出七种 SmartNIC 编程设计模式（含"sifting"早期筛选）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 SmartNIC 集成 eSwitch、DPA、ARM 核及固定功能加速器等多种处理区域，应用程序可被映射到多种放置方案，但难以在编码前预判哪种方案可行及其瓶颈资源。当前缺乏类似 RAM/PRAM 那样的抽象模型，使设计者只能依赖经验猜测和反复实现测试。

Method: ZRAM 模型包含：(1) 平台图 G_H=(Z,C)，每个区域 z 描述操作菜单 M_z、缓存阈值 κ_z、内存带宽 B_z、内存容量 Cap_z、并行宽度 w_z；(2) 程序图 G_P=(V,E)，每个任务 v 描述操作 op(v)、处理工作量 s_v、内存占用 m_v、流量分数 ρ_v；(3) 放置 μ:V→Z 将任务映射到区域；(4) 三个核心度量——M1 Capability（操作必须在区域菜单中）、M2 Roofline（带宽与通道容量约束，区分缓存/非缓存及并行/串行）、M3 Capacity（内存容量约束）。Python 模拟器读取平台图与程序图即可秒级输出可行性判定与瓶颈命名。文中以 BlueField-3 为例建立平台图（eSwitch、DPA、ARM、Host 四区域），并以 DDoS 检测器为主案例，辅以决策树推理与 RDMA 遍历。

Result: 三个 DDoS 探测器放置方案均通过 M1–M3，但瓶颈与最大攻击承受分数 ρ_max 不同：DPA/DPA 方案受 κ 阈值约束（1.5/1.5 MB），ρ_max=0.25；将 2b 或全部移至 ARM 后瓶颈转为 eSwitch 的 267/400 Gbps 头处理，ρ_max 提升至 0.50。决策树推理案例显示需将浅层前缀留在 DPA 缓存内、深层移至 ARM；RDMA 遍历案例表明串行链式追逐应由 ARM 而非 DPA 执行。提炼出七种设计模式：早期筛选(Sifting)、卸载至专用加速器、宽度匹配工作、阈值内适配、状态分叉、浅层判别引导、动态升级旁路。

Conclusion: ZRAM 将 SmartNIC 放置设计从"猜测-实现-测量"循环转变为"编辑图-重算指标"的秒级循环，能在常数因子精度内预测可行性与瓶颈，揭示"sifting 早期筛选可大幅降低下游 ρ"的核心洞察。模型可推广至 Intel IPU E2200、AMD Pensando Salina 400 等异构 SmartNIC，并开启了编译器自动搜索放置、多租户共享建模、闭环传输建模、反向指导硬件设计等研究议程。当前局限：不建模延迟、仅验证可用性而未在真实硬件上确认预测、假设单程序稳态前馈流、不处理共享资源竞争。

Abstract: Cloud vendors push ambitious in-network processing (e.g., crypto, telemetry) onto the NIC to offload servers even as link rates climb to terabit speeds. Vendors have responded with heterogeneous SmartNICs. For example, NVIDIA BlueField-3 interposes---between the wire and the host CPUs---a line-rate eSwitch, a multithreaded Data-Path Accelerator, general-purpose ARM cores, and a sea of fixed-function accelerators. These devices are notoriously hard to program, and harder still to predict. Applications can be implemented in many ways, with each choice potentially hitting a different bottleneck. A designer ideally needs to know---cheaply, and before a line of code is written---feasible choices and their bottlenecks, and design patterns to improve performance. Our paper offers a starting point to answer these questions using what we call the ZRAM model. It pairs a platform graph of processing zones and their channels with a program graph of tasks and their traffic fractions. The application designer or a compiler chooses a placement that maps the program graph onto the platform graph. Three metrics computed directly from this mapping---capability, roofline, and capacity---score the placement, deciding its feasibility and naming the bottleneck resource. We use a DDoS detector as a primary case study, and briefly explore two other applications, decision-tree inference and RDMA traversal. We distill seven design patterns for programming SmartNICs including a key one we call sifting. ZRAM generalizes to other SmartNICs such as Intel IPU E2200 and AMD Pensando Salina 400, and opens a new research agenda that includes compilers and hardware design.

</details>


### [808] [REBASE: Device-Cloud Experience Coherence for GUI Agents Across App Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32130)
*Beining Wu,Jun Huang,Yanxiao Zhao*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: REBASE提出了一种设备-云端协议，通过"更新时钟"（云端预演+设备逐步验证）和"失败时钟"（按层级递增发送轻量证据）两级机制，使GUI智能体在应用更新后仍能复用旧版经验，在两个Jetson设备和九个Android应用上以708倍更少字节和47.3倍更少云端调用恢复成功率至新版同等水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署在手机上的GUI智能体复用早期运行录制的"经验"（动作路径），应用更新后部分经验静默失效：成功率下降10.1点，且62.2%的执行中损坏步骤仍能找到匹配元素，平均延迟3步才被发现。现有方法（MAI-UI截图上传、CoMIC轨迹上传、自愈测试自动化）要么传输开销巨大，要么仅针对单设备离线修复，无法在设备-云端链路下跨应用版本保持经验一致性。

Method: REBASE协议包含三个角色（设备智能体、云端智能体、网关）和两个时钟：
1) 更新时钟：云端在新版本发布后于虚拟设备上回放云端副本，无需模型调用即可识别失败步骤D(v→v')，预计算补丁集P(v')并按版本键(α, v', f)索引推送；设备在更新后标记路径为Unverified(v')，执行时无模型调用地验证每一步ν_k（动作前检查元素匹配，动作后检查后继屏幕匹配）。
2) 失败时钟：验证失败时按四级证据阶梯递增发送：ξ_0（指纹+失败步骤，识别版本键）→ ξ_1（可访问性子树差异，约8KB）→ ξ_2（低分辨率裁剪）→ ξ_3（完整截图，约298KB），云端在虚拟设备上测试候选补丁，成功后提交至P(v')。
3) 版本键去重：以(应用、版本、指纹)为键而非设备ID，首次报告触发一次再推导，后续报告仅发送ξ_0即可接收已验证补丁。

Result: 在两个Jetson AGX Orin 64GB设备（运行Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct INT4）和一个Thor网关上，控制AndroidWorld中九个Android应用的版本对评估（K=5轮后更新）：
- 成功率（Succ@K）：REBASE达93.8±1.3%，相对陈旧经验提升56.1点，与新版录制的新鲜经验相差0.4点（无显著差异）；
- 字节开销：相比截图上传（MAI-UI形式）减少708倍（2.5KB vs 2912KB上行），相比轨迹上传（CoMIC形式）减少215倍；
- 云端调用：相比截图上传减少47.3倍（0.20 vs 9.60）；
- 设备能耗：每回合702J，相比无经验减少2.5倍，相比重探索减少2.3倍；
- 恢复延迟T_r：91.1%的云端可见单元首回合恢复，68.9%的盲单元首回合恢复（云端无法预获取v'的对）；
- 证据阶梯：79.4%的事件在ξ_0或ξ_1层级闭合；
- 车队扩展：基于轨迹驱动的100设备仿真，云端再推导次数比无版本键减少80.0倍（保持近|D|=42次而非随车队线性增长）；
- 链路鲁棒性：带宽从50降至2 Mbps、RTT从20升至250 ms时，成功率波动仅2.7-4.0点，回合延迟稳定在32.5-33.2秒；
- 消融：缺更新时钟（X1）下降3.3点，缺失败时钟（X2）在盲对上下降31.6点，固定证据层级（X7固定ξ_1）下降9.8点，文本指导替代可执行补丁（X8）下降13.3点。

Conclusion: REBASE是首个在设备-云端链路上跨应用更新保持GUI智能体经验一致性的系统并基于真实设备测量成本。核心洞见是：恢复依赖识别变化元素而非传输更多像素；两级时钟按事件触发类型选择证据；可执行补丁比文本指导更可靠地由小模型回放。局限：依赖可访问性树（画布或不透明Web视图缺失时从ξ_0跳至ξ_2）；仅评估Android，移动平台扩展及桌面智能体为下一步工作。

Abstract: A graphical user interface (GUI) agent that ships on a phone runs a small model and reuses experience: action paths recorded on earlier runs and cached from the cloud. When an app updates, part of this experience becomes silently wrong. On nine real app version pairs, an agent carrying experience recorded on the old version succeeds 10.1 points less often than one carrying none, and it does not notice the mismatch until 3 steps after acting on it. We propose REBASE, a protocol that keeps the device copy and the cloud copy of the experience coherent across updates. When a version changes, the cloud replays its copy on the new version and the device verifies each recorded step before executing it; when a step still fails, the device sends the cloud evidence in increasing size, starting from an accessibility-subtree diff, until the cloud re-derives an executable patch, keyed by version so that one repair serves the whole fleet. On two Jetson devices, REBASE restores the success rate of stale experience to that of fresh experience recorded on the new version within one episode, at 708x fewer bytes and 47.3x fewer cloud calls than uploading screenshots to the cloud, and 2.5x less device energy than running without experience.

</details>


### [809] [ThreadShift: Transparent Thread-Level Offloading on Transient Cloud Resources Using MPKs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32153)
*Antoine Murat,Clément Burgelin,Rachid Guerraoui*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: ThreadShift是一个透明线程级卸载系统，将未修改的Linux应用的计算密集型线程卸载到廉价的瞬态云资源上，通过线程粒度的检查点和基于MPK（Memory Protection Keys）的三种新机制（依赖跟踪、每线程脏页跟踪、延迟保护）实现快速增量检查点，在x86-64 Linux上实现，最快164µs完成卸载，检查点速度比CRIU快三个数量级，部署成本降低达56%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 瞬态云资源（如spot VMs）价格低廉但可能被随时回收，对于那些回收后无法安全重启的应用（如已产生外部可见副作用）使用困难。现有方法要么需要修改应用，要么依赖粗粒度检查点（如CRIU），开销大、需暂停整个应用，使频繁检查点不划算。本文要回答：未修改的应用能否利用瞬态资源而无需昂贵的粗粒度检查点？

Method: 系统由稳定机（运行未修改应用+注入manager，通过LD_PRELOAD）和瞬态机（运行worker线程接收卸载任务）组成。线程粒度操作：仅卸载计算密集线程，IO/延迟敏感线程保留在稳定机上；所有系统调用在稳定机执行以保证正确性。核心协议TMCP（类MESI但为线程卸载和worker丢失定制）维持页级内存一致性，并保证worker写只在相关线程安全检查点后才暴露。三个MPK创新机制：(1) 依赖跟踪——页按写者分组到专属MPK组，跨线程首次访问时捕获故障从而识别依赖；(2) 每线程脏页跟踪——扩展Linux soft-dirty机制按MPK组过滤，仅扫描相关组而不暂停整个应用；(3) 延迟保护——当MPK权限已经阻止违规访问时延迟mprotect，避免不必要的TLB失效和内核穿越。另有para-offloading优化层（网络IO批处理、内存分配器替换、同步原语替换）以摊销开销。

Result: 在AWS c6i VM上评估多种工作负载（PyTorch/ResNet50推理、Whisper.cpp、secp256k1加密、OneMKL蒙特卡洛、SQLite、std::map）：(1) 端到端：计算密集工作负载吞吐/美元提升最高达125%（Whisper.cpp 32线程），成本最高降低56%；(2) 卸载延迟：单页写入基础延迟164µs（其中~65µs网络、~10µs检查点创建、~30µs本地同步），4Ki页时约30ms；(3) 检查点比CRIU快三个数量级（10-49µs对比CRIU 61ms基础延迟），且CRIU延迟随线程数和页数增长而ThreadShift仅依赖检查点线程的写页数；(4) 网络para-offloading使服务器吞吐接近原生（112kOps对比原生138kOps，仅1.28ms延迟）；(5) 回收导致短暂的吞吐下降（与丢失工作量成正比），即使无通知也能快速恢复；(6) 消融实验证明三种MPK机制各自关键：依赖跟踪避免不必要的联合检查点（吞吐下降64-90%），脏页跟踪避免不相关线程停顿，延迟保护+预取对短卸载吞吐提升达19%。

Conclusion: ThreadShift是首个透明地将未修改Linux应用的线程卸载到瞬态资源并在回收下保持正确性的系统。线程粒度操作使快速检查点和选择性卸载成为可能；三个基于MPK的新机制解决了跨线程依赖下线程级检查点的核心难题。原型在商用云上证明透明线程级卸载的实用性：最快164µs卸载、检查点比CRIU快三个数量级、成本最多降低56%。主要局限：最适合计算密集、写集适中、可摊销开销的工作负载；对内存密集或修改大数据的工作负载效果有限；尚不支持信号和vDSO；自动识别卸载点仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Transient cloud resources offer significant cost savings, but their unpredictability makes them hard to use for applications that cannot be safely restarted after reclamation. Existing approaches require application changes or rely on coarse-grained checkpointing, whose cost limits its benefits. We present ThreadShift, a system that transparently offloads compute-intensive threads of unmodified Linux applications to cheap transient resources while preserving correctness under reclamation. By operating at thread granularity, ThreadShift enables fast, fine-grained checkpointing and offloads only the threads that benefit from transient execution. The main challenge is to checkpoint individual threads despite cross-thread dependencies. ThreadShift does so by efficiently tracking memory dependencies, identifying per-thread memory writes, and maintaining coherence across machines. Three novel uses of Memory Protection Keys (MPKs) make these mechanisms efficient, enabling fast incremental checkpoints without pausing the entire application. We implement ThreadShift on x86-64 Linux and evaluate it on workloads including machine-learning inference, cryptographic tasks, and in-memory data processing. ThreadShift offloads threads in as little as 164 us, performs checkpointing up to three orders of magnitude faster than CRIU, and reduces deployment cost by up to 56% on commodity clouds.

</details>


### [810] [SparSP: Exploiting Communication Sparsity for Sequence-Parallel Video DiTs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32197)
*Desen Sun,Xinrui Zhong,Yuke Wang,Sihang Liu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: SparSP是一个面向PCIe连接的商品GPU服务器的分布式视频DiT推理通信系统，将注意力稀疏性视为通信原语，通过依赖感知放置、需求导向路由、解耦传输运行时和细粒度分块调度，将核级稀疏性转化为通信开销的实质性降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散Transformer（DiT）在推理时因注意力机制的二次复杂度而产生巨大开销，需要在多GPU上进行序列并行推理。然而，在PCIe连接的GPU服务器上，通信带宽受限成为主要瓶颈。尽管稀疏注意力大幅降低计算量，但现有通信系统无法有效利用稀疏性：(1)朴素的序列分区使各rank聚合的KV需求接近密集；(2)Ring Attention的中继路由引入冗余传输；(3)NCCL通信与GPU计算争抢资源，仅能达到理论带宽的43.8–61.1%。因此需要重新设计通信机制以充分发挥稀疏性的优势。

Method: SparSP包含四个协同设计：(1)依赖感知放置（Dependency-Aware Placement）：利用视频注意力跨帧结构化局部性，按对角线周期布局将具有相似KV依赖的query块共置，降低rank级需求聚合；(2)需求导向KV路由（Demand-Directed KV Routing）：绕过Ring中继，按生产者-消费者直接路径传输，避免稀疏无关的转发流量；(3)解耦传输运行时（Decoupled Transfer Runtime）：通过DMA引擎和基于槽位的发布/获取原语，将数据传输与注意力计算解耦，提高有效带宽；(4)细粒度分块环（Fine-Grained Chunked Ring）：对管道末尾块采用更细粒度分块，并按关键路径贡献排序，最大化通信-计算重叠。

Result: 在三个PCIe平台（8×A100、8×L40S、4×RTX 6000 PRO）和三个视频扩散模型（LTX-Video、LTX-2、HunyuanVideo）上的评估显示：注意力性能提升1.38–1.5×；端到端平均加速1.17×（最高1.69×）；通信量降低12.54–23.05%；带宽比NCCL提升1.53–1.76×。随GPU数量增加，加速效果更加显著（从2卡的1.01×提升到8卡的1.21×）。

Conclusion: SparSP证明了计算稀疏性不会自动转化为通信节省，必须联合优化数据放置、路由、传输和通信-计算重叠才能释放稀疏性的全部潜力。其统一稀疏需求表示下的依赖引导交换、需求路由通信、解耦运行时和分块重叠调度为商品GPU上视频扩散推理的高效部署提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers have become the dominant architecture for video generation. Their substantial computational cost motivates scaling inference across multi-GPU servers, yet efficient scaling remains challenging on commodity GPUs connected via PCIe, whose bandwidth is limited. Although sparse attention substantially reduces computation, its implications for communication remain underexplored. This paper argues that attention sparsity should be treated as a communication primitive. We present SparSP, an efficient sparse sequence parallel communication system that co-designs token distribution, communication routing, and asynchronous execution for sparse video diffusion models. First, Dependency-Aware Placement distributes sequence blocks according to diffusion models' sparse attention patterns. Second, Demand-Directed KV Routing transfers KV blocks directly to requesting GPUs without intermediate relays. Third, a Decoupled Transfer Runtime separates communication from GPU computation to reduce resource contention and maximize effective bandwidth. Our evaluation shows that SparSP improves attention performance by 1.38- 1.5$\times$, achieves an average 1.17$\times$ (up to 1.69$\times$) end-to-end speedup across three representative servers and three video diffusion models, and reduces communication volume by 12.54-23.05%. Moreover, we achieve an average 1.53-1.76$\times$ bandwidth improvement over NCCL.

</details>


### [811] [No-Restart Elasticity in an Adaptive Runtime System for Cloud-Native HPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32217)
*Aditya Bhosale,Laxmikant Kale*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向Charm++运行时的"无重启"弹性伸缩机制，使存活进程在资源调整时不再退出，从而将弹性操作开销从秒级降至8-15ms（CPU）和7-11ms（GPU），并消除了GPU弹性所需的检查点守护进程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用云端折扣spot实例运行HPC应用时，需要在中断前收缩、在替换容量到达后扩展。现有机制采用kill-and-restart模型，重启阶段占总开销高达95%，且随节点数和GPU CUDA上下文初始化而增长，限制了对中断的响应策略。

Method: 设计包括：(1)轻量级外部TCP协调器维护集群成员视图；(2)基于longjmp的运行时再初始化路径，区分"必须保留的初始化时状态"与"必须调整的拓扑相关状态"；(3)UCX端点就地协调重映射；(4)基于SSH的charmrun_ssh启动器与协调器自举，消除对监督式进程管理器的依赖；(5)新进程通过+newcomer标志绕过main()并采用广播的read-only/group状态。

Result: 在4-32实例的EC2机群上，CPU收缩操作从约2.2s降至8.3-14.5ms，扩展从秒级降至5.2-11.7ms；GPU从7.2s降至7-11ms，整体比kill-and-restart快两个数量级以上。8个同时中断下，端到端开销从CPU 0.6%降至0.2%、GPU 3.4%降至0.6%；1%开销下可承受的rescaling频率提升7-9倍。

Conclusion: 无重启模型将成员变更从"重启作业"转变为"在配置活动进程"，使GPU弹性与CPU弹性成本相当，消除了检查点守护进程的复杂性，并扩大了可行的中断处理策略空间。该方法部分与Charm++无关，可推广至其他具有可迁移状态和可重入初始化路径的运行时系统。

Abstract: Exploiting discounted spot instances for HPC requires an application to change its resource allocation at runtime, shrinking ahead of an interruption and expanding onto replacement capacity. Existing elasticity mechanisms implement rescaling as a full process teardown followed by a cold restart at the new processor count, and the restart stage accounts for up to 95% of the total overhead, growing with node count and increasing substantially on GPUs due to CUDA context initialization. In this paper, we present a no-restart rescaling mechanism for the Charm++ runtime system in which surviving processes never exit: a rescaling operation consists of a membership negotiation with a lightweight external coordinator, reconciliation of the UCX communication endpoints with the new cluster view, and a return to the top of the runtime initialization path that preserves live application state. This reduces the cost of a rescaling operation, excluding the load balancing step that any rescaling model requires, from multiple seconds to 8--15ms on CPUs and 7--11ms on GPUs, at 4 to 32 instances. Because processes survive, GPU device state persists in place, eliminating the checkpointing daemons previously required for GPU elasticity, and a launcher-independent bootstrap mechanism removes the dependence on supervised process managers, which are incompatible with spot instance interruptions. Integrated with an existing spot instance management framework, the mechanism cuts the end-to-end overhead of eight simultaneous interruptions to 0.2% of runtime on CPUs and 0.6% on GPUs, and raises the rate at which a job can be rescaled below 1% overhead by a factor of seven.

</details>


### [812] [RR-Evict: Fine-Grained Prefix Cache Eviction beyond LRU for Agentic LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32278)
*Zaifeng Pan,Chris Wu,Zhengding Hu,Xinwei Qiang,Zhongkai Yu,Yufei Ding*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对长时任务LLM智能体场景下前缀缓存（Prefix Cache）的驱逐问题，提出了一种超越LRU的细粒度驱逐策略RR-Evict。论文发现由于各智能体的私有缓存节点访问时间高度同步（recency synchronization），传统LRU驱逐会集中回收少数智能体的整个上下文，导致这些智能体恢复时需要重新预填充（prefill）几乎全部历史，从而产生严重的尾延迟（TTFT）尖峰。RR-Evict采用轮询（round-robin）方式从每个空闲智能体的尾部逐块驱逐缓存，从而在相同内存回收量下为更多智能体保留部分可复用的前缀，显著降低P99 TTFT和未缓存token数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时任务LLM智能体的上下文可累积至数十万甚至上百万token，前缀缓存是降低TTFT的关键。但多智能体的私有历史使缓存总占用超过GPU容量时，传统LRU因"recency synchronization"现象会将驱逐集中到少数空闲智能体上，使其完全失去缓存复用能力，恢复时需重新预填充全部历史，产生严重的TTFT尾延迟异常。该论文动机是解决这种集中式缓存损失带来的尾延迟问题。

Method: 提出RR-Evict，一种细粒度的轮询尾块驱逐策略。其核心方法：(1) 按智能体轨迹对空闲缓存节点分组；(2) 采用轮询顺序从每个智能体尾部驱逐一个chunk（1024 token或叶子节点）；(3) 该智能体仍有可驱逐后缀则放回队列尾部继续轮询；(4) 维护活跃节点不被驱逐；(5) 支持通过完成信号立即释放已完成轨迹的缓存，或通过"recency tiering"在LRU基础上分层执行轮询。算法不需要预测未来到达或工具延迟。论文还给出了理想化分析模型，刻画了有效工作区间（na < m < n）及LRU与轮询的尾延迟对比。

Result: 在SGLang中实现RR-Evict，使用Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct在τ²-bench对话基准和Qwen3-8B在SWE-bench代码代理基准上进行评估，对比LRU和completion-aware LRU基线：对话基准上RR-Evict相对LRU将P99 TTFT降低高达75.4%、P99未缓存token降低65.7%；相对completion-aware LRU分别降低46.9%和30.6%。PD disaggregation编码代理基准上相对LRU分别降低60.7%和60.8%。结果显示RR-Evict在共部署和PD disaggregated两种配置下均稳定优于基线，尤其在高并发下效果更显著。

Conclusion: LRU策略在长时智能体负载下因recency synchronization而集中驱逐少数智能体的私有缓存，导致尾延迟尖峰。RR-Evict通过轮询尾部驱逐将缓存损失分散到更多智能体上，在无需预测未来到达或工具延迟的前提下保留部分可复用前缀。其有效区间为活跃上下文能装下但全部历史不能装下的中等内存压力区间（na < m < n）。该方法在共部署和PD disaggregated场景下均显著降低P99 TTFT。未来工作将扩展到更大规模、跨CPU/SSD的分级存储场景并考虑KV传输与重载开销。

Abstract: LLM-based agents execute long-horizon tasks through repeated model calls interleaved with tool execution and user interaction. As each call extends the history accumulated in previous turns, prefix caching avoids repeated prefill of the agent's entire context. However, the aggregate cache footprint grows with context length and concurrency, forcing serving systems to reclaim cached KV tensors. We identify recency synchronization: accesses to an agent's cached history refresh its cache nodes together, causing least recently used (LRU) eviction to concentrate on a few agents' private histories. When a fully evicted agent returns, it must recompute nearly its entire accumulated context, producing a large time-to-first-token (TTFT) outlier even if most other requests retain substantial cache reuse. We present RR-EVICT, a fine-grained prefix-cache eviction strategy that distributes reclamation across idle agent trajectories. RR-EVICT visits agents in round-robin order and evicts a tail chunk from each, preserving reusable prefixes for more agents when capacity remains for idle state. Returning agents can reuse these partial histories and recompute smaller missing suffixes. The policy requires no prediction of future arrivals or tool latency. We implement RR-EVICT in SGLang and evaluate conversational and coding-agent workloads under colocated and prefill-decode-disaggregated serving. Compared with LRU, RR-EVICT reduces P99 TTFT by up to 75.4% and P99 uncached prompt tokens by up to 65.7%.

</details>


### [813] [AgentReplay: Token-Wise Trace Replay Is Essential for Fair Serving System Performance Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32283)
*Zaifeng Pan,Michael Wang,Chris Wu,Zhengding Hu,Xinwei Qiang,Zhongkai Yu,Yufei Ding*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: AgentReplay是一个针对LLM智能体服务的可配置trace记录-回放框架，通过token级别的精确回放来解决智能体执行轨迹变化导致的服务性能评测不公平问题，并支持MoE路由和工具时长的可选回放，以及跨模型的长时间跨度评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体的多轮执行中，相同的初始任务可能因token差异、工具调用差异产生不同的执行轨迹，使得贪心解码和长度级回放都无法提供公平的服务系统性能比较基线，难以区分系统优化效果与工作负载变化。

Method: 1) Trace录制：记录输入/输出token ID、MoE专家选择、请求依赖图和工具耗时，构建trace τ=(G,X,Y,E,D)；2) 多层级回放：token-wise replay在解码阶段用记录token替换采样结果但保留自回归前向计算；MoE router replay固定逻辑专家ID；tool-duration replay通过非阻塞等待复现工具耗时；3) 跨模型长跨度评测：分离轨迹生成与性能测量，使用兼容tokenizer的小模型回放大模型生成的长时间跨度trace。

Result: 1) 贪心解码在Astropy/SymPy任务上仍产生9.24%/28.66%的turn数变异和26.33%/142.21%的输入token变异；token+tool回放将累计时间CV从25.58%/114.93%降至0.66%/1.30%（38.9×和88.7×改善）；2) 长度级回放使用随机token导致MoE专家负载集中度显著偏离真实分布，在EP=2下prefill rank时间比从1.92×膨胀到3.80×，但在offload场景下decode时间被低估至0.82×；3) 跨模型回放将SWE-bench长horizon trace的CV从114.93%降至0.45%（257.1×改善）。

Conclusion: Token级trace回放是智能体服务系统公平性能基准测试的必要条件，能够有效消除贪心解码和长度级回放无法避免的工作负载变异；AgentReplay通过保留模型计算和系统调度自由度的同时固定token历史、逻辑专家分配和工具耗时，为受控的服务性能比较提供了基础。

Abstract: LLM-based agents execute multi-turn workflows with interleaved model inference and tool calls, making efficient serving increasingly important. However, evaluating serving optimizations is challenging because identical tasks can produce different execution trajectories. Changes in generated tokens can alter subsequent prompts, tool calls, and reasoning turns, making it difficult to distinguish system improvements from workload variation. Greedy decoding does not guarantee identical outputs, while replaying only sequence lengths loses token information that affects prefix caching and mixture-of-experts (MoE) routing. To address these problems, we propose AgentReplay, a configurable trace record-and-replay framework for agent serving. AgentReplay records input/output tokens, expert selections, request dependencies, and tool durations. During replay, it forces the recorded output tokens while performing normal autoregressive computation, with optional controls for MoE expert selection and tool delays. This allows different systems to execute the same recorded workload while retaining their own batching, scheduling, and parallelization decisions. We further separate trajectory generation from performance evaluation, enabling compatible smaller models to replay long-horizon traces collected with more capable models. Our experiments show that token-wise replay in AgentReplay effectively eliminates workload variation that greedy decoding and length-wise replay cannot avoid, enabling fairer performance comparisons across serving configurations.

</details>


### [814] [Time Semantics and Liveness Artifacts in Adversarial Consensus Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32972)
*Nasit S Sony,Xianzhong Ding*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究VeriProtocol对抗性共识模拟器中时间语义对活性结论的影响，对比EventCoupled（每个调度事件推进协议时间）与RoundTick（解耦调度事件与超时推进）两种模型，发现在Multi-Paxos和Raft实验中，时间语义的差异会定性改变观察到的领导稳定性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在对抗性共识模拟中，仅有消息传递模型不够，还需时间模型。当超时敏感的协议将协议时间推进与调度器活动耦合时，原本只设计用于扰动通信的调度器会隐式获得控制失败检测器何时到期的能力，导致错误的活性结论。

Method: 在VeriProtocol确定性共识模拟器中实现两种时间语义（EventCoupled与RoundTick），使用相同的协议、调度器、网络模型、工作负载和随机种子进行控制变量对比。在Multi-Paxos主实验中以N=5、K=11为基准，并在K∈{0,6,8,10,11,12,14}的网格上扫描，同时在N=3和N=7做交叉验证；用Raft进行跨协议验证；通过种子42匹配追踪分析与心跳延迟控制实验分离机制与抑制效应。

Result: 在N=5、K=11条件下，EventCoupled下20次执行中15次（75%）出现额外领导选举（平均2.95次视图变更），而RoundTick下20次全部稳定（0%额外选举，平均1.00次）。延迟预算扫描中，EventCoupled的不稳定率从K=6的5%单调升至K=14的100%，而RoundTick在所有140次执行中均无额外选举。Raft实验中，EventCoupled在每个非零心跳延迟预算下均产生额外选举，RoundTick则全部稳定，即使将RoundTick扩展至400个逻辑刻度结果仍不变。心跳延迟控制证实RoundTick并未抑制超时驱动的选举。

Conclusion: 将调度事件与协议时间推进耦合会隐式扩展仅设计用于控制通信的对手的能力，使通信扰动与隐含的时间控制混淆。对超时敏感的分布式协议进行对抗性评估时，应将通信调度与协议时间推进视为独立实验维度，明确报告时间语义，避免将模拟器隐式赋予的时间能力错误归因于通信扰动本身。

Abstract: Adversarial consensus simulators require not only a model of message delivery but also a model of time. For timeout-sensitive protocols, coupling protocol-time progression to scheduler activity can allow communication scheduling to influence when failure detectors expire. We study this interaction in VeriProtocol using controlled Multi-Paxos and Raft experiments. In the primary Multi-Paxos study, we compare EventCoupled timing, where every scheduler opportunity advances protocol time, with RoundTick timing, which decouples individual scheduler events from timeout progression. At N=5, increasing the bounded message-delay budget from K=6 to K=14 increased the observed EventCoupled leadership-instability rate from 5\% to 100\% across the tested grid, while no additional valid leader elections occurred in any of the corresponding 140 RoundTick executions. At K=0, neither model produced additional elections. Matched-trace analysis identifies the mechanism: under EventCoupled timing, scheduler activity used to perturb communication also directly advances failure-detector state. Under RoundTick, comparable scheduler activity does not imply equivalent protocol-time progression. A targeted heartbeat-delay control confirms that RoundTick does not suppress timeout-driven elections; an additional election remains reachable when leader contact is unavailable across sufficient logical time.

</details>


### [815] [Simple and Fast Signature-Free Blockchain Consensus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32985)
*Giuliano Losa,Xuechao Wang,Zhuolun Xiang,Qianyu Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了两种简单无签名的区块链共识协议（最终同步模型下），分别针对 f<n/3（三轮延迟）和 f<n/5（两轮延迟）实现了最优的正常情况下提交延迟，并提出了Generic Simplex通用构造框架及其核心抽象"视图一致"（view agreement）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在后量子时代，可转移签名（threshold signatures）代价高昂，因此设计不依赖签名的区块链共识协议具有重要价值。现有无签名协议要么延迟较高（如 Shoup 的 Simplex 无签名变体需六轮），要么通信复杂度高（如 PBFT 为 O(n³)），难以兼顾低延迟与低通信量。

Method: 提出新抽象 "view agreement"（视图一致），规定每个视图中需要就哪些区块被准备或提交、视图是否被禁用达成一致。基于此抽象设计 Generic Simplex 通用构造，其外层协议处理视图切换与提案安全性，内层通过不同的视图一致实现实例化。给出两个无签名实现：1/3-VA（f<n/3，结合快速路径与 Bracha 风格放大）和 Fast VA（f<n/5，直接用 n-f 票提交）。

Result: 1/3-VA 协议：正常情况提交延迟 3δ，区块时间 2δ，视图超时 7Δ（强一致版本 6Δ），通信复杂度 O(n²)。Fast VA 协议：正常情况提交延迟 2δ（最优），区块时间 2δ，视图超时 5Δ（强一致版本 4Δ），通信复杂度 O(n²)。Generic Simplex 还能捕获 Simplex、Minimmit 等签名协议，以及一个同步下 f<n/4 达到 2δ 提交延迟的协议。证明在 n/4<f<n/3 时，无签名协议若要达到 δ 准备延迟则必须允许多值被准备。

Conclusion: 本文通过引入"视图一致"抽象，统一并简化了无签名区块链共识协议的设计，在保持 O(n²) 通信复杂度的同时达到最优的正常情况延迟。Generic Simplex 框架也成功涵盖了现有签名协议（Simplex、Minimmit），为区块链共识协议的设计提供了模块化方法。

Abstract: Signature-free protocols avoid the cost of post-quantum signatures. We present two simple signature-free blockchain consensus protocols for eventual synchrony with optimal good-case commit latency (three message delays for \(f<n/3\) and two for \(f<n/5\)), optimistic responsiveness, a block time of only two message delays without speculation, and \(O(n^2)\) communication per view. They instantiate Generic Simplex, a blockchain consensus construction parameterized by a new abstraction called view agreement. The same construction also captures Simplex, Minimmit, and a new synchronous signature-free protocol with optimal good-case commit latency of two message delays for \(f<n/4\).

</details>


### [816] [Tessera: Demand-Driven KV Cache Management for Retrieval-Augmented LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32999)
*Fei Fang,Chung-Hsiang Lo,Yi Liu,Yifan Hua,Chen Qian*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Tessera 是一个面向 RAG 和基于检索的智能体记忆场景的解耦式 LLM 推理服务系统，将"检索层"作为 KV 复用的控制平面，按需驱动缓存管理与请求路由，显著降低 TTFT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG 和智能体记忆中将检索内容注入 prompt 后，相同 context unit 常出现在不同位置或前缀之后，传统前缀缓存无法复用；作者实测发现 agent 场景中超过 70% 的注入记忆 token 属于前缀之外的重复。Composable KV-reuse 方法虽可复用这些状态，但在在线服务中，状态可能尚未计算、已被淘汰或在其他节点，亟需一种与检索需求联动的缓存管理与调度机制。

Method: 1. 量化分析：在 LoCoMo 与 τ²-bench 两个 agent 工作负载上刻画非前缀重复比例；2. 系统设计：提出 Tessera 解耦架构（Retrieval Pool 控制平面 + KV Pool 共享 RDMA 存储 + Generation Pool），检索后即生成"按 context unit 的准备与保留计划"，由控制平面综合检索历史、KV 驻留与生成负载进行准入/淘汰/路由；3. 执行机制：本地命中、远端 RDMA 获取、缺失 prefill 并发进行，miss 任务以内部请求形式加入 extend batch，同一节点对同一缺失单元可合并 prefill；4. 非阻塞保留：使用 storage epoch + read lease + 待发布/已发布两态机制，保证写入未完成或被引用时不会被读取或回收。原型基于 SGLang 扩展，复用策略采用 EPIC LegoLink。

Result: 在 RAG（2WikiMQA、MMLU、NQ、TriviaQA）和 agent 记忆（LoCoMo、τ²-bench）工作负载上，Tessera 相比 SGLang 和集成 EPIC 的 LMCache，在匹配请求率下平均 TTFT 最高降低 3.6×，并在基线已饱和的高负载下保持低 TTFT；消融实验表明检索感知的准入/淘汰起主导作用，缓存感知路由进一步将均值与 P95 TTFT 降低约 40%/50%；答案质量与底层 EPIC 组合策略基本一致（F1 差距 ≤ 0.34）。

Conclusion: 检索层提供的"请求到来前即可知所需 context unit"这一信息，是连接 KV 复用、缓存管理与请求调度的天然控制平面；以 context unit 为复用粒度、解耦检索/共享 KV/生成三层并按需做准入、路由与并发准备，可在不损失生成质量的前提下显著降低 RAG 与检索式智能体记忆场景的首 token 延迟。

Abstract: RAG and retrieval-based agent memory both inject retrieved content into LLM prompts, as document chunks and recalled memory records, respectively. The same content can recur across requests at different prompt positions or after different preceding contexts, preventing reuse through conventional prefix caching. Our characterization finds that records recurring outside the matching prefix account for over 70% of injected memory tokens in agent-memory workloads. Composable KV-reuse methods enable reuse in such cases, but online serving introduces a management problem: a recurring unit's KV states may not yet exist, may have been evicted, or may reside on another node. We present Tessera, a disaggregated serving system that makes retrieval the control plane for KV reuse. By exposing the context units needed before model execution, retrieval allows Tessera to combine current demand with retrieval history, KV residency, and generation load to coordinate cache management and request routing. Generation nodes concurrently prepare locally cached, remotely cached, and missing states, while retaining newly computed states off the request's critical path. Across RAG and agent-memory workloads, Tessera lowers mean TTFT by up to 3.6x over SGLang and LMCache with EPIC at matched request rates, and sustains low TTFT at rates where the baselines saturate, while matching the answer quality of the underlying composition policy.

</details>


### [817] [Hierarchical Secure Distributed Linearly Separable Computation with Arbitrary Heterogeneous Data Assignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33092)
*Ziting Zhang,Chenyi Sun,Kai Wan,Xiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究三层分层网络中带任意异构数据分配的安全分布式线性可分计算，提出了同时抗服务器与中继（含用户合谋）的信息论安全编码方案，给出了梯度聚合情形下的最优/阶最优通信速率，并将其推广至多维线性可分任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分层安全计算工作多局限于一维聚合任务（如梯度编码），且要么未考虑数据分配的异构性，要么无法同时保证抗服务器与抗中继的安全。本文旨在填补这一空白：研究任意异构数据分配下、抗用户掉线与合谋的三层分层安全分布式线性可分计算。

Method: 采用基于线性空间的混合设计策略：在中继-服务器层将聚合视为星形网络下的安全梯度编码，以中继为"虚拟用户"并用密钥保护消息；用户-中继层同样将密钥视为数据符号进行梯度编码。构造中引入了虚拟需求矩阵（virtual demand）与密钥加密线性组合，以同时满足两层异构的可编码性约束，并通过两个线性代数约束（约束1和约束2）严格保证抗中继与抗服务器的信息论安全。

Result: 对 Kc=1 的梯度聚合：(1) 当暴露聚类数 < U−r1 时，两层通信速率 (R1,R2,RZ)=(1/m1, 1/(m1 n2), 1/(m1 n2)) 是最优的；(2) 当暴露聚类数 ≥ U−r1 时，所提方案在因子2以内阶最优，速率为 (1/(m1−1), 1/((m1−1)n2), 1/((m1−1)n2))。对 Kc>1 的多维情形，在无掉线条件下给出可达任务维度 Kc ≤ min{R1(U−t1), K}，并在 T_u ≤ t_{2,u} 条件下保证安全。

Conclusion: 本文刻画了三层分层网络中任意异构数据分配下安全分布式线性可分计算的基本通信-安全折中：一维情形部分达到最优/阶最优，多维情形推广至无掉线场景。未来方向包括：掉线场景下多维任务通信开销-任务维度的折中、密钥总量最小化以及更强用户合谋容忍方案。

Abstract: This paper studies secure distributed linearly separable computation over a three-layer hierarchical network, where clustered users communicate with a central server through relays. The server aims to recover Kc linear combinations of K intermediate outcomes, where each intermediate outcome is a separable function of one dataset. We consider a more general setting with arbitrary heterogeneous data assignment across users, where ''arbitrary'' means that the data assignment is given in advance (which can be in any form) and ''heterogeneous'' means that the users may hold different numbers of datasets. Under this assignment, each user computes the intermediate outcomes of its assigned datasets and sends masked messages to its associated relay. The relays subsequently process and forward the received messages to the server. We impose two security constraints: (i) security against server, requiring the server to learn only the desired task function without gaining any additional information about users' inputs; and (ii) security against relays, ensuring each relay learns nothing about users' inputs. Moreover, the server or any relay may collude with a subset of users. For Kc=1, the underlying computation reduces to distributed gradient coding. We propose a secure scheme tolerating user dropouts and user collusion, achieving the optimal two-layer communication rates in one regime and order-optimal communication rates within a factor of 2 in the other regime. For Kc>1, we extend the proposed construction to multi-dimensional linearly separable tasks under the no-dropout setting.

</details>


### [818] [Splitting Prompt Prefill from Response Replay for Context-Parallel Long-Context LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33133)
*Yubing Bao,Zhihui Lu,Qiang Duan,Yuedong Xu,Sen Liu,Pan Zhou*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: AugTree 是一种针对长上下文 LLM 强化学习后训练中更新阶段的上下文并行（CP）执行方案。它将提示预填充（prompt prefill）与响应重放（response replay）两个阶段解耦，通过在线规划器在"移动 KV"和"移动 Q"两种通信语义之间进行选择，以适配不同提示-响应比例的工作负载，从而显著降低训练步耗时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 上下文窗口扩展至 256K–2M tokens，上下文并行成为训练关键。然而现有 CP 方案（Ring Attention、Ulysses、DCP 等）均针对预训练阶段的线性序列设计，忽略了 RL 后训练中"更新阶段"重放工作负载的独特结构：(1) 共享提示的响应组（一个 prompt 对应 G 个 response）；(2) 提示-响应比例在不同数据集上差异巨大（可达百倍）；(3) 序列长度与分组结构在线生成，无法离线静态规划。将树状提示-响应结构扁平化为独立序列会导致提示 KV 重复计算与不必要的注意力状态搬运，造成高达 98.4%（G=64）的冗余计算。

Method: AugTree 提出三阶段方法：(1) 提示 KV 复用——一次预填充计算共享 prompt KV，所有 response 分支复用（保持完全可微，梯度通过原始预填充图反传）；(2) 两种树感知通信原语——TreeMoveKV（响应占主导时，在 lane 局部环内旋转 KV 分片，保持响应路径局部性）与 MoveQ（提示占主导时，KV 保持静止，移动 response 查询并通过 partial-softmax 归约合并）；(3) 在线规划与执行引擎——异步规划器在 rollout 后枚举 CP degree、原语、grid 与 placement，通过 AssignGrid（受限 DP）求解最优分案；执行引擎将其映射为 process group、张量移动与注意力内核，对 autograd 透明。规划求解时间比 DCP 快三个数量级。

Result: 在 4 个真实后训练数据集（LongReward、LongAlign、LMSYS、OpenThoughts）和最多 64 张加速器上的实验显示：AugTree 在训练阶段步时上平均比 Megatron ring CP（无复用）快 7.08×，比带提示复用的 Megatron 基线快 2.63×，比 DCP 快 1.18×（最高 2.23×）。通信量在 256k tokens 下减少 5–16×；在 1.5B–14B 模型规模与 G=8–64 的响应组规模上均保持增益。规划求解时间从 0.018ms 到 1.70ms（DCP 在大图下达 3336.5ms），全流程（含 rollout+reward+update）在 prompt-heavy 工作负载上端到端加速最高 2.7×。

Conclusion: AugTree 通过将 RL 后训练更新阶段识别为"共享前缀 + 独立响应分支"的树状结构，并据此解耦预填充与重放、动态选择通信原语，证明了保留提示状态和选择通信对象比单纯优化 KV 移动策略更重要。该方法可作为现有 CP 训练器的即插即用替换，无需改变 rollout 调度、RL 损失或优化器，为 prompt-dominant 的长上下文后训练工作负载带来实质性的全流水线加速。未来工作可探索更一般的 DAG 感知 CP 与跨分支依赖。

Abstract: Training long-context LLM policies with RL requires re-evaluating groups of sampled responses under the updated policy, an update-stage attention workload that differs sharply from pre-training: each group shares one long prompt that fans out into multiple response branches. Standard context parallelism (CP) flattens each prompt--response pair into a linear sequence, so the same prompt key--value (KV) states are recomputed---or repeatedly rotated through the network---once per response branch. We present \textbf{AugTree}, a CP execution scheme built around this replay stage. AugTree separates the replay into two phases: a prompt-prefill phase that computes the shared prompt KV state once, and a response-replay phase that schedules the independent response branches over a bounded set of replay lanes. The replay phase instantiates two communication semantics, chosen by a lightweight online planner that enumerates CP degrees, schedules, and placements before GPU dispatch: rotating KV shards within response-local lanes when responses dominate, and moving response queries to stationary prompt-KV owners with a partial-softmax reduction when prompts dominate. The shared prompt state remains fully differentiable---response losses backpropagate into it and the accumulated prompt gradients propagate through the original prefill graph---so AugTree preserves exact training semantics rather than performing detached, inference-style KV caching. On four real post-training workloads and up to 64 accelerators, AugTree improves average training-stage step time by 1.18$\times$ over dynamic CP (up to 2.23$\times$), 2.63$\times$ over a Megatron ring CP baseline with prompt reuse, and 7.08$\times$ over the baseline without reuse.

</details>


### [819] [MpFA: Hardware-Efficient Train-Free QK4V8 FlashAttention Kernels on Blackwell GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33135)
*Chencheng Deng,Jianbin Fang,Dezun Dong*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出MpFA，一种面向NVIDIA B200数据中心Blackwell GPU的无训练QK4PV8混合精度FlashAttention内核。MpFA采用NVFP4用于QK^T、FP8用于PV，并通过基于Tensor Core MMA的秩一平滑补偿恢复精度。在B200上，跨16K-128K上下文，预填充平均加速1.31-1.33倍，端到端输出吞吐比BF16 FA4提升2.81倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理使注意力成为GPU服务的主要瓶颈。Blackwell B200提供FP4 Tensor Core高吞吐量，但完全FP4注意力无法转化为端到端加速，因为softmax路径上的在线量化、数据移动和张量内存争用等非矩阵乘法开销成为主导瓶颈。此外，现有低比特补偿方法将额外工作放在已经饱和的softmax路径上，进一步削弱了FP4的优势。

Method: 方法包含三大核心技术：(1) QK4PV8混合精度分配——NVFP4用于QK^T以利用高吞吐量，FP8用于PV以避免P矩阵量化的开销和FP8可直接从张量内存读取操作数的优势；(2) 秩一Tensor Core MMA补偿——通过序列中心化减去Q和K的均值，利用BF16 MMA将补偿项1_M·ΔS写入分数累加器，再与NVFP4 QK^T结果累加，避免在softmax路径上做逐元素加法；(3) 阶段专用优化——预填充采用细粒度异步流水线和双缓冲张量内存复用（标量因子借用对偶q阶段score区域），解码通过GQA打包、KV分区、对角分块softmax和列分割softmax恢复并行性。此外，P采用固定比例因子s_P=448量化到FP8，KV反向遍历以延迟注意力汇聚点。

Result: 在NVIDIA B200上，MpFA在16K-128K上下文下：预填充平均加速1.31-1.33倍（相对BF16 FA4）、1.15-1.17倍（相对FP8 FlashInfer）；解码相对启用split-KV的BF16 FA4平均加速2.08倍；端到端输出吞吐（输出令牌/秒）相对BF16 FA4提升2.81倍，相对FP8 FlashInfer提升1.06倍。秩一MMA补偿在仅约2.0%内核开销下恢复了NVFP4+FP8相对于BF16的62.5%精度损失（在五个基准和两个模型上平均）。TPOT在128K时从42.4ms降至6.5ms（Llama-3.1-8B）。

Conclusion: MpFA证明了在数据中心Blackwell GPU上，混合精度QK4PV8配合秩一Tensor Core MMA补偿能够实现高效训练免费的低比特注意力。精度选择不能仅基于Tensor Core峰值吞吐，还需考虑操作数传递路径和张量内存容量。B200上softmax路径的开销主导了注意力算子，将补偿从softmax转移到Tensor Core是恢复精度的关键。该工作为其他融合算子针对Blackwell非对称硬件扩展的优化提供了启示。

Abstract: Long-context LLM inference pushes modern GPU serving stacks into an attention-bound regime, where both compute and memory are dominated by the softmax-GEMM pipeline. On NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, FP4 Tensor Cores offer high matmul throughput, but we find that fully FP4 attention often fails to translate this throughput into end-to-end speedups due to non-matmul costs: online quantization after softmax, tensor/shared-memory data movement, and contention on the softmax path. We present MpFA, a training-free FlashAttention kernel optimized for Blackwell. Guided by hardware characterization, MpFA uses mixed precision: NVFP4 for QK and FP8 for PV (QK4PV8). This preserves low-bit QK throughput while avoiding the conversion and scaling overheads of FP4 PV. To recover accuracy without further stressing the softmax pipeline, MpFA introduces rank-one smoothing compensation implemented as an additional Tensor Core MMA. MpFA further improves performance with a fine-grained asynchronous pipeline, tensor-memory reuse, and adaptive parallel partitioning across prefill and decode. On an NVIDIA B200 and across 16K-128K contexts, MpFA improves prefill throughput over state-of-the-art BF16/FP8 baselines and increases end-to-end output throughput by 2.81$\times$ over BF16 FA4 across Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-14B. Across five benchmark suites and two models, rank-one compensation recovers 62.5% of the accuracy loss with about 2.0% kernel overhead.

</details>


### [820] [PackServe: SLO-Aware Request Scheduling for Agentic LLM Serving at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33224)
*Zhiyuan Tan,Dejiang Zhu,Jingzhe Jiang,Yihao Zheng,Yang Tian,Tao Wang,Minchen Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: PackServe 是一种面向智能体（agentic）大语言模型（LLM）推理服务的网关级请求调度器，通过基于白盒性能模型的 SLO 感知请求打包（packing）策略，在保留 KV 缓存（KVC）复用的前提下，减少 GPU 资源占用并满足 TPOT 时延 SLO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体 LLM 工作负载具有高输入/输出比、长共享前缀以及解码主导的时延特征。当前调度器难以同时兼顾 KV 缓存复用、TPOT SLO 和 GPU 资源效率三个目标：合并请求会牺牲缓存局部性并增加 prefill/decode 干扰。

Method: 1. 基于 Transformer 计算结构的轻量级白盒模型，对每种部署配置进行离线 profiling 校准，得到 prefill 和 decode 的延迟预测模型，并加入 BS 分段的在线 EMA 校准因子。2. 三阶段调度算法：(a) 容量过滤；(b) KVC 优先的重计算预算控制，限制每个候选实例相对于最优缓存命中的额外 prefill 开销；(c) SLO 感知准入，基于 TPOT 预测筛选满足目标的实例，并在这些实例中优选解码并发度更高者（缓存命中数和队列长度用于打破平局）；当无候选满足 TPOT 时回退到缓存感知的负载均衡。

Result: 在 64 张 NVIDIA H20 GPU 的测试平台上，PackServe 相比 LMetric 和 llm-d+ 在 30 ms 和 50 ms TPOT 目标下分别减少 13.0–16.8% 和 21.1–24.6% 的活跃 GPU 小时数，同时保持约 79.5–80.2% 的 KVC 命中率并满足分钟级 TPOT 目标；TPOT 预测中位误差仅 10.6 ms，调度开销 1.9 ms。在超过 1000 张 GPU 的生产集群中，与原生产缓存感知负载均衡策略相比，平均服务实例数减少 34.7%，单实例吞吐量提升 36.8%。

Conclusion: 通过将性能驱动的 SLO 准入与有界重计算控制相结合，能够在满足时延约束的前提下有效压缩智能体 LLM 推理的 GPU 资源占用，验证了缓存复用优先于请求打包的设计思路。

Abstract: Request scheduling is a key challenge in large-scale clusters serving agentic large language model (LLM) workloads. An effective scheduler must preserve key-value cache (KVC) reuse across long, shared prefixes, meet token-level latency service-level objectives (SLOs), and minimize GPU resource footprint. Existing schedulers struggle to reconcile these requirements: request consolidation can sacrifice cache locality and increase prefill/decode interference, compromising both SLO attainment and resource efficiency. We present PackServe, a scheduler designed to reduce resource costs while meeting latency SLOs for agentic LLM serving. PackServe uses compact white-box models to predict latency under prefill/decode interference. Guided by these predictions, it packs requests onto fewer serving instances while preserving KVC reuse and SLO constraints, trading available latency headroom for improved per-instance throughput. Evaluation on 64 NVIDIA H20 GPUs shows that PackServe uses up to 16.8% and 24.6% fewer GPU-hours than state-of-the-art schedulers under 30-ms and 50-ms TPOT targets, respectively, while meeting the target TPOT objectives. PackServe has also been deployed in our production cluster comprising over 1000 GPUs, where it reduces the resource footprint by 34.7% compared with the original production scheduler.

</details>


### [821] [CascadeEP: Asynchronous Expert Execution for MoE Prefill under Attention Imbalance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33252)
*Jin Qin,Tiancheng Hu,Shiyan Wang,Junhao Hu,Zexin Jian,Yuzheng Wang,Haoyu Li,Chunwei Xia,Ying Liu,Pixian Zhan,Di Wang,Zhongzhe Hu,Huimin Cui,Tao Xie,Chenxi Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出CascadeEP，一种针对MoE（混合专家）模型预填充阶段的分布式执行引擎，通过异步专家并行（Asynchronous EP）、流式FFN（streamFFN）和机会主义专家权重获取（OEWF）三种机制，解决数据并行注意力负载不均衡导致的同步EP空闲等待问题，在DeepSeek-V4-Flash、DeepSeek-V4-Pro和GLM-5.3上实现最高1.48×的p95 TTFT加速和最高1.17×的吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模MoE模型推理服务中，数据+专家并行（DEP）部署方式下，注意力副本因请求批次和上下文长度差异导致dispatch完成时间不同步；同步EP要求等待所有副本就绪才能启动FFN计算，造成已完成dispatch的副本长时间空闲等待。同时，请求调度策略在KV缓存复用与负载均衡之间存在权衡，无法彻底消除注意力阶段的负载不均衡（实测平均空闲时间占端到端运行时28.86%）。

Method: 提出CascadeEP分布式执行引擎，包含三个核心机制：(1) 异步EP——允许FFN GEMM内核在所有副本完成dispatch前即可启动；(2) streamFFN——通过基于阈值的批处理（达到目标吞吐量分数ρ=0.90时启动）和多CUDA流执行，平衡早期启动与FFN计算效率；(3) OEWF——协调贪心算法选择供体副本（donor）与待获取的专家权重，并通过成本模型比较当前与修订执行计划的完成时间，决定是否将未启动的FFN工作重分配给空闲的helper副本。同时基于DeepEP扩展了per-replica完成信号机制。

Result: 在三个模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.3）、两个真实负载（Tool&Agent和AgentX）和五种请求调度策略（轮询、最少负载、prefix-only、DualMap、Preble）下的评估显示：CascadeEP平均实现1.13×（最高1.48×）的p95 TTFT加速和1.06×（最高1.17×）的吞吐量提升。消融实验中，Async+SF贡献最大的TTFT减少，OEWF在Async+SF基础上进一步将平均和p95 TTFT分别降低7.8%和6.2%。streamFFN保留同步EP 97.3%的有效FFN吞吐量（仅损失2.7%），OEWF在77.4%的层前向中将延迟降低至少1%。在DeepSeek-V4-Flash + AgentX + least-loaded场景下，TTFT降低32.4%。

Conclusion: 本文提出的CascadeEP作为一种层内执行引擎，通过异步专家执行、流式FFN批处理和机会主义权重获取，有效缓解了注意力负载不均衡对MoE预填充性能的影响。理论证明OEWF在满足假设条件下保证层完成时间不增加（非退化性），实证表明层内异步执行与请求调度策略互补，可共同提升MoE预填充性能。该工作表明注意力负载不均衡是MoE推理服务的关键瓶颈，层内执行优化具有重要价值。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) serving commonly deploys data and expert parallelism (DEP): attention replicas run distinct request batches while routed experts are sharded across an expert-parallel (EP) group. During prefill, attention replicas finish dispatch at different times, but synchronous EP delays expert feed-forward network (FFN) computation until routed inputs from all replicas are ready. Request schedulers seek to balance load while reusing the key-value (KV) cache of shared prompt prefixes to avoid redundant prefill computation. These goals can conflict when a replica holding a matching prefix is already overloaded, leaving residual attention imbalance. We present ASYNCEP, a distributed execution engine for MoE prefill. ASYNCEP proposes three mechanisms. Asynchronous EP allows expert computation to start before tokens from all attention replicas are ready. streamFFN batches ready tokens to balance early execution with FFN computation efficiency. Opportunistic expert weight fetching (OEWF) allows a faster replica to fetch expert weights and execute unstarted work from other GPUs. We evaluate ASYNCEP on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and GLM-5.3, and our results show that ASYNCEP achieves up to 1.48x speedup in p95 time-to-first-token (TTFT) and improves the inference throughput by up to 1.17x.

</details>


### [822] [AgentLoop: Runtime Control of Slot-closed Execution Loops for Tool-augmented LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33315)
*Wanyi Zheng,Minxian Xu,Kan Hu,Kejiang Ye,Chengzhong Xu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: AgentLoop 是一种针对工具增强型 LLM 代理的运行时控制层，将开放式智能体迭代转化为基于状态的闭环执行控制。它通过"槽位闭合"(slot closure)、结构化验证和稳定性信号来判断任务是否完成,从而显著降低冗余执行和 token 成本,在多个基准测试中令牌成本最高减少 88.44%,服务调用平均减少 76.85%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具增强型 LLM 代理的循环缺乏判断何时停止的显式运行时信号。代理可能在运行时上下文已停止变化后仍继续推理和调用服务,或未能将已收集的证据合成为完整答案,导致资源浪费和服务质量下降。例如,在代理编程任务中,平均每个任务消耗约 4.17M 令牌,而更高的令牌使用未必能带来准确率提升。

Method: AgentLoop 在不修改基础模型和工具集的前提下,添加了一个运行时控制层。其核心组件包括:(1) 运行时状态管理器(维护紧凑的运行时状态对象);(2) 槽位状态验证器(对请求-答案-证据进行结构化验证,输出 answer_complete、missing evidence、need_tool、confidence、failure state);(3) 迭代控制器(结合有界稳定性信号和低增益信号,在三种动作间选择:Continue Invocation、Answer Synthesis、Terminate Iteration)。关键机制是"槽位闭合":当请求所需的信息槽位被充分证据覆盖且无未解决槽位时,触发终止。算法通过混合文本相似度(0.55 词法 + 0.45 Jaccard)比较相邻 LLM/工具轮次的调用和结果状态,识别稳定状态。

Result: 在 ToolBench(356 请求)、GAIA(1000 请求)和 Open-Agent-Trace(499 请求)三个数据集上,使用 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 两个骨干模型进行评估。对比 AutoGen、FC-Reflection 和 LangGraph 三个基线,主要结果:总令牌成本最高降低 88.44%,服务调用平均减少 76.85%;ToolBench 上平均延迟降低超过 70%;槽位闭合率在 ToolBench 上达 98.6%,GAIA 上为 81.6%;验证开销仅占端到端延迟的 0.40%-3.61%。消融实验显示,移除槽位中心控制路径后,ToolBench 平均深度从 3.4 增至 7.43,准确率从 0.938 降至 0.612;Open-Agent-Trace 上深度从 4.23 增至 6.86,准确率从 0.949 降至 0.584。

Conclusion: AgentLoop 证明了将开放式智能体迭代转化为显式运行时状态控制的可行性。槽位闭合提供任务级完成信号,而上下文稳定性、证据稳定性、预算压力和低价值启发式为执行级决策提供指导。实验验证了显式运行时信号对实现高效工具增强型代理的重要性。未来工作将探索更轻量的槽位验证、更细粒度的预算控制、领域特定槽位提取以及并发服务负载下的稳定性评估。

Abstract: Tool-augmented large language model (LLM) agents are becoming an important execution unit in service computing, but existing agent loops still lack explicit runtime signals for assessing task completion. The challenge lies in the fact that an agent may continue reasoning or invoking services even after the runtime context has stopped changing, while evidence already collected remains unsynthesized into a complete answer, which leads to inefficiency in resource usage. To address these challenges, this paper presents AgentLoop, which provides runtime control of slot-closed execution loops for tool-augmented agents. Slot closure means that the information slots required by a request have been covered by sufficient runtime evidence, and that unresolved slots are explicitly identified before the loop stops. AgentLoop converts open-ended agent iteration into state-driven execution control: it maintains a compact runtime state, uses model-assisted structured verification to check answer completeness and missing evidence, and applies bounded stability and low-gain signals over neighboring LLM/tool rounds before selecting one of three actions: Continue Invocation, Answer Synthesis, or Terminate Iteration. Experiments show that AgentLoop reduces redundant execution and context growth, with total token cost reduced by up to 88.44% and average service invocations reduced by up to 76.85% against baselines. The ablation study further shows that the slot-centered control path plays a central role, since disabling it increases execution depth and substantially reduces accuracy. Overall, the results suggest that efficient tool-augmented agents can benefit from explicit runtime signals for deciding when further LLM/tool iterations no longer add useful context or supported evidence.

</details>


### [823] [OLED-MoE: Accelerating MoE-Based dLLM Inference via Inter-Iteration Locality-Aware Expert Offloading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33385)
*Jingyuan Xiao,Jiayue Wang,Yitao Hu,Xinning Wang,Shi Chen,Ziqi Gong,Zhengchao Wang,Guotao Yang,Sheng Chen,Keqiu Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: OLED-MoE提出了一种针对基于MoE的扩散大语言模型(dLLM)的专家卸载系统，通过利用迭代间的专家路由局部性(token confidence指导的缓存保留)和CPU-GPU协作补偿，在受限的GPU内存下显著提升了推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的MoE专家卸载系统(如KTransformers、MoE-Infinity、FineMoE)主要为自回归(AR)解码设计，依赖迭代内的层级预取。但半自回归dLLM采用块状去噪，每轮迭代激活的专家集合约为AR的8倍，导致预取难以在时间内完成，经常退化为按需加载，造成高解码延迟。此外，块状路由扩大了活动专家工作集，使LRU/LFU等基于历史的缓存策略无法区分持久专家和瞬态专家，导致GPU专家缓存利用率低下。

Method: OLED-MoE包含两大核心组件：(1)时序局部性感知的专家保留机制——将token置信度和门控分数映射为专家复用优先级p(e,l,i)，并通过层激活比率与缓存利用率的乘积进行层自适应缓存分配；(2)动态负载与复用感知的协作补偿引擎——基于离线剖析的硬件基线比例ρ(ρ = n̄τ_CPU / (n̄τ_CPU + T_H2D))进行初始GPU/CPU分配，再通过有界交换两阶段启发式优化当前负载平衡与未来缓存效用。系统通过Python钩子架构非侵入式地集成到dInfer+vLLM后端。

Result: 在LLaDA2.0-mini(16B)和LLaDA2.0-flash(100B)上的GSM8K、HumanEval、GPQA三个数据集评估显示：相对SOTA卸载系统，TPOT降低1.23×–7.93×，专家缓存利用率提升1.44×–4.23×；仅使用40%的专家GPU显存即可达到仅比full-residency高23%的TPOT；与理想缓存上界差距仅1.93%–15.22%；策略开销仅为前向时间的0.59%–4.53%。消融实验表明各组件(Temporal-Locality Retention +20.56%, Layer-Adaptive +9.09%, Cooperative Compensation +9.14%)均有显著贡献。

Conclusion: OLED-MoE首次将"迭代间专家局部性"作为内存受限MoE-based dLLM服务的核心调度维度，通过从迭代内预取转向迭代间专家保留，显著提升了GPU专家缓存利用率。该方法揭示了dLLM块状去噪过程中固有的时间局部性，并展示了token confidence作为轻量级复用预测信号的可行性，为后续结合KV缓存卸载、量化等技术的统一内存管理奠定了基础。

Abstract: Semi-autoregressive diffusion large language models (dLLMs) improve decoding parallelism through iterative block-wise denoising, but scaling them with mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers introduces a large expert parameter footprint that exceeds memory-constrained GPU capacity. Expert offloading is a natural remedy, yet existing MoE serving systems target autoregressive decoding and rely on intra-iteration layer-wise prefetching: while computing one layer, they predict and load experts for subsequent layers. Under dLLM inference, block-wise routing expands the active expert working set within each iteration, making such prefetches difficult to complete in time and costly when mispredicted. Consequently, existing prefetch-based solutions often degenerate into on-demand expert loading with high decoding latency. We propose OLED-MoE, an expert offloading system that shifts the optimization target from intra-iteration prefetching to inter-iteration expert retention. Its key insight is that adjacent denoising iterations exhibit strong expert routing overlap, and token confidence indicates which experts are likely to be reused. OLED-MoE uses confidence-guided inter-iteration prediction to retain high-value experts in GPU memory without introducing extra prefetch traffic. It further compensates unavoidable cache misses through CPU-GPU cooperative execution, jointly considering dynamic expert computation load and predicted future reuse. Across diverse dLLM workloads, OLED-MoE reduces time per output token (TPOT) by 1.23x-7.93x and improves expert cache utilization by 1.44x-4.23x over state-of-the-art offloading systems. Notably, OLED-MoE approaches full-residency performance while using only 40% of the expert GPU memory, incurring merely 23% higher TPOT despite a 60% reduction in expert memory footprint. OLED-MoE's source code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [824] [Toward System-of-Systems Integration for Composable Cloud-HPC-Edge AI Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33427)
*Sumit Rakesh,Rajkumar Saini*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出将云-HPC-边缘AI平台视为系统之系统（SoS），并以"可组合集成"方法实现跨独立控制系统的协调，强调"使用上融合、控制上联邦"的原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI平台融合云服务、HPC、云原生编排、数据/制品系统、边缘/信息物理系统等多种异构基础设施栈，现有工作虽已实现局部桥接，但缺乏跨独立控制系统的通用组合推理框架。论文旨在弥补这一架构空缺。

Method: 提出SoS集成模型，包含四大贡献：(1) 对等组成系统视图与边界测试（区分组成系统与组件、外部系统）；(2) 本地、共享、作用域责任模型及七个集成表面（访问、控制平面接口、执行、数据/制品、可观测性、策略/治理、恢复/演化）；(3) 典型跨系统工作流（边缘-训练-服务反馈环路）及替代映射分析；(4) 六类可行性证据与五个研究问题。遵循ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010架构描述视角。

Result: 建立了概念框架而非具体实现：提出八条设计原则（D1-D8），涵盖保持组成系统自治、明确边界、通过接口和契约组合、支持多种执行映射、将数据/制品/策略视为集成对象、跨系统可观测性与恢复、拓扑中立与可演化、选择性工作流互操作性。通过一个边缘到训练到服务的示例工作流（C1-C7交接）展示了框架的适用性，并讨论了多租户隔离与Kubernetes-Slurm-vLLM等替代映射。

Conclusion: SoS视角为Cloud-HPC-Edge AI平台提供了更有纪律性的替代方案，通过显式接口和证据实现可组合集成，保留各组成系统的本地权威。该框架可作为可重现架构描述、可测试评估标准、增量组成系统替换及跨站点/组织联邦的基础，并可扩展至新兴的量子-HPC混合环境等。

Abstract: Modern AI platforms increasingly combine infrastructure stacks and operating models designed around different assumptions, including cloud-style service platforms, HPC workload-management systems, cloud-native orchestration, data and artifact systems, managed connectivity, observability, and edge or cyber-physical environments. Existing work demonstrates effective bridges between selected stacks, but a general way to reason about composition across independently controlled systems remains underdeveloped. We argue that such platforms can be usefully viewed as systems of systems (SoS) when independently useful systems retain their own control, management, lifecycles, policies, and failure semantics while contributing to a higher-level AI platform capability. We frame composable integration as an approach to cross-system coordination based on interfaces, contracts, mappings, references, policy context, and operational evidence, while preserving native control planes and avoiding dependence on a single topology or orchestration stack. The resulting direction is converged in use and federated in control. The paper presents a peer constituent-system view, a boundary test for distinguishing constituent systems from components, local dependencies, and independently useful systems outside the current SoS boundary, a local, shared, and scoped responsibility model, seven integration surfaces, and a representative cross-system workflow. It concludes with evidence classes and research questions for evaluating interoperability, governance, observability, fault containment, evolution, and reuse.

</details>


### [825] [Adaptive Client Clustering and Coordination for Federated Learning Workflow Management in Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33544)
*Jieping Luo,Qiyue Li,Yuxuan Chen,Hang Qi,Jiaying Yin,Jingjin Wu,Qian Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出A-CoDa框架，用于在边缘网络中管理具有依赖关系的联邦学习（FL）服务流。该框架结合了基于标签分布散度（LDD）的贪心平衡聚类、FedMIX不确定性感知的集群内/集群间参与机制以及依赖感知的DAG调度器，旨在减少端到端完成时间，同时保持竞争性的准确率。理论分析提供了在非IID数据、通信延迟和任务依赖约束下的收敛性上界，并通过手写识别、可穿戴感知、产品图像和医学影像四个任务的实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在边缘网络环境中，联邦学习越来越多地被部署为托管学习服务，而非孤立的训练作业。这些FL服务流需要协调异构客户端、非IID数据、波动通信延迟以及具有优先级约束的任务，同时满足服务级完成时间要求。现有FL客户端选择方案主要是静态的、动态的或基于聚类的，但要么忽视时变系统状态，要么聚焦于单一作业，要么需要重复重新聚类，且多作业FL调度通常假设作业独立而非具有依赖关系的服务流。这促使设计一个保持聚类协调效率同时支持依赖任务下轮次级参与管理的框架。

Method: 本文提出A-CoDa框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于ℓ1标签分布散度（LDD）的贪心平衡聚类，通过聚合聚类和贪心平衡步骤构建统计一致且大小均衡的客户端群组；(2) FedMIX不确定性感知的集群内/集群间参与机制，使用损失-延迟-不确定性效用评分对客户端排序，并通过停滞检测、外部不确定性和延迟拥塞信号自适应控制跨集群探测预算；(3) 基于PPO的依赖感知DAG调度器，按层级编排任务执行以同时尊重并行性和优先级约束。理论方面，在PL型目标下提供了充分损失域设计界，将LDD引起的采样失配、残余分布偏移、局部SGD漂移、随机方差和自适应探测预算与误差下界及充分通信轮次联系起来。

Result: 在四个分类任务（MNIST、UCI-HAR、FashionMNIST、Pneumonia X-ray）组成的三层DAG上的实验表明，A-CoDa在100个客户端设置下达到最低的端到端DAG完成时间83.9秒，相比最近的基线Inter-FL减少8.4%，相比CoDa-FL、Intra-FL、PSI-PFL和TDCFL分别减少23.4%、12.4%、25.0%和12.7%。各层完成时间在Layer-1、Layer-2和Layer-3上分别减少8.7%、6.7%和11.2%。可扩展性测试显示，在50至500个客户端范围内A-CoDa均保持最优，完成时间分别为147.4s、85.2s、51.9s、39.9s和29.7s。

Conclusion: A-CoDa提供了一个统一且自适应的框架，用于解决异构边缘网络中延迟感知和依赖感知的联邦学习工作流的客户端聚类和协调挑战。理论分析将收敛行为与统计异构性、局部SGD漂移和损失驱动方差联系起来，揭示了这些因素如何影响充分轮次界和稳态误差下界。实验验证了该框架在减少端到端完成时间方面的有效性，同时保持竞争性准确率，为异构边缘网络中可扩展、依赖感知且延迟高效的联邦学习工作流管理提供了原则性框架。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is increasingly deployed as a managed learning service rather than as a set of isolated training jobs. In networked edge environments, dependent FL service flows must coordinate heterogeneous clients, non-IID data, fluctuating communication latency, and precedence-constrained tasks under service-level completion requirements. These coupled factors make participant management central to both time-totarget performance and learning stability. This paper proposes A-CoDa, an adaptive clustered coordination framework for managing dependent FL flows. A-CoDa first uses label-distribution divergence (LDD)-based greedy-balanced clustering to construct statistically coherent and size-aware client groups, which serve as a scalable management abstraction. Building on this structure, we design FedMIX, an uncertainty-aware intra-/inter-cluster participation mechanism that ranks clients by a loss-latency-uncertainty utility and adaptively controls cross-cluster probing according to training progress and latency conditions. A dependency-aware DAG scheduler then orchestrates layer-wise task execution so that parallelism and precedence constraints are jointly respected. We further provide a convergence analysis that frames the result as a sufficient loss-domain design bound, explicitly relating the attainable error floor and sufficient communication rounds to LDDinduced sampling mismatch, residual distribution shift, local-SGD drift, stochastic variance, and adaptive probing budgets. Experiments on handwriting, wearable-sensing, product-image, and medical-imaging tasks evaluate A-CoDa under dependent FL workflows and demonstrate its effectiveness in reducing end-toend completion time while maintaining competitive accuracy.

</details>


### [826] [EfficientAgent: What Makes KV Cache Offloading Work for Concurrent Agents?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33762)
*Kunming Shao,Jierun Chen,Jiangnan Yu,Xiao-Hui Li,Chaofan Tao,Yanli Wang,Huanxin Lin,Kwang-Ting Cheng,Chi Ying Tsui,Haoli Bai*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: EfficientAgent通过基于"复用工作集"(reuse working set)对KV cache主机层进行容量规划与写入调度，解决LLM智能体并发服务中KV offloading效果不一致的问题，使offloading在异构硬件上都能稳定带来收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM编程智能体在每轮都会重新发送整个对话，其中98%以上token已在前一轮处理过。GPU KV缓存不够时offload到host内存本应始终有效，但实测在同一SWE-bench负载下对RTX 3090加速、H800反而变慢、H20无变化。论文要回答：offloading何时才真正有效？

Method: 1) 提出"复用工作集"概念：单个agent等待工具期间，服务器需处理其余A-1个agent的上下文，缓存必须存下整个agent池的可复用上下文，容量近似为 (A-1)·N̄·β_rank。2) Stack-distance模型：通过agent轨迹预测不同host容量下的可恢复prefix长度，定位容量转折点。3) Capacity-conditioned写入准入策略：当工作集估计 > host容量（γ_H>1）且tier满且在evict时，拒绝大型refill、保留对已缓存前缀的增量扩展；否则照常写入。4) Proposition 1理论证明：在LRU模型下，仅拒绝"下次复用距离D≥K_H"的miss不会降低命中数。5) 依赖保持的replay框架以固定token工作量复现SWE-bench Verified的4427次模型调用。

Result: 在H20上8卡TP8复现SWE-bench Verified：host层从5→20 GiB时recomputed prefill降低93.1%（76.7M→5.3M tokens），makespan缩短38.7%（209→128 min）。Stack-distance模型在实验前预测的20 GiB处prefill为5.19–5.78M，实测5.28M。固定准入策略在5 GiB时减少35%重计算但在40 GiB时反而导致4.3倍重计算增加；capacity-conditioned准入在两侧都保持增益。三种GPU对比：RTX 3090和H20（FLOP/byte≈2.2–2.3K）offload加速；H800（FLOP/byte≈15.5K）所有配置offload均变慢（1.08–1.87倍）。

Conclusion: 硬件决定一次host命中节省多少计算（峰值算力/host带宽比），并发工作集决定命中是否发生。EfficientAgent通过复用工作集同时完成host容量规划与运行时写入调度，使offloading在低FLOP/byte比的硬件上稳定有效，跨容量转折点保持增益，避免大tier上的写入过滤反噬。该工作集尺度 (A-1)·N̄·β_rank 也成为agent部署规划和上下文编辑策略评估的一阶量。

Abstract: LLM agents resend their whole conversation on every turn, and most of it was already processed on the previous turn. Serving systems avoid recomputing it by caching its key-value (KV) state and, when GPU memory runs out, by offloading that state to host memory. For agents, offloading gives inconsistent results: on the same coding-agent workload it speeds up one deployment, slows down another, and changes nothing on a third, even where loading a token back is several times cheaper than recomputing it. The reason is that cached state must survive until it is used again. While one agent waits for its tool, the server processes the contexts of all other agents, so an agent's prefix is reused only if the host tier holds the reusable context of the whole agent pool, which we call the reuse working set. A smaller tier keeps writing state that is evicted before anyone reads it. We present EfficientAgent, which sizes and manages the host tier by this working set. A stack-distance model estimates the working set from agent histories to size the host tier; its predictions, made before the experiments, located the capacity at which offloading starts to pay. When the tier is too small, a runtime policy stops writing large refills of evicted context and keeps extending prefixes that are still cached; when the tier is large enough, it writes everything. On SWE-bench Verified coding agents, a host tier sized to the estimated working set cuts recomputed prompt tokens by 93% and end-to-end time by 39%. With a small fixed tier, the policy cuts recomputation by 35%; with a large tier, it avoids the 4.3-fold increase caused by always filtering writes. Across three GPU types and two models, offloading pays off when the GPU has little compute per byte of host bandwidth and the host tier holds the working set. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [827] [Performance vs Portability in Heterogeneous HPC Environments: Why Pre-execution Benchmarking is Required](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33847)
*Mindaugas Macernis*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究在高性能计算(HPC)系统中，通过Podman容器运行预编译量子化学软件的性能，与直接在系统上执行进行比较，重点关注容器化对科学计算工作负载的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云计算(HPC与Kubernetes容器编排)与高性能计算(通过Slurm等批调度器管理)之间存在范式差异，随着共享计算资源需求增长，需要实现两类环境互操作。但容器化对科学计算特别是短任务工作负载的影响尚不清晰。

Method: 使用Podman作为用户可访问的容器工具，对预编译量子化学可执行文件进行基准测试，对比容器化执行与直接在系统上执行的性能差异，覆盖CPU优化构建和多计算节点配置，不涉及额外网络优化。

Result: 性能表现取决于三个关键因素：软件编译方式、启动开销和执行配置。容器准备阶段在短任务工作流中可能成为主导开销，而长时间运行的计算则需要监控计算进度。

Conclusion: 在HPC系统上以容器方式部署科学应用时，工作负载特定的基准测试和用户级监控至关重要，应根据不同任务特征选择合适的部署方式。

Abstract: Cloud computing and high-performance computing (HPC) typically follow different paradigms: cloud services are often orchestrated using Kubernetes, whereas HPC workloads are managed through batch schedulers such as Slurm. Growing demand for shared computational resources increases the need for interoperability between these environments. This study uses Podman as a user-accessible tool to benchmark quantum chemistry software distributed as precompiled executables. Containerized and on-system execution are compared across CPU-optimized builds and multiple compute nodes, without additional network optimizations. The results demonstrate that performance depends on software compilation, startup overhead, and execution configuration. Container preparation can dominate short-task workflows, while long-running calculations require monitoring of computational progress. These findings highlight the importance of workload-specific benchmarking and user-level monitoring when deploying scientific applications in containers on HPC systems.

</details>


### [828] [Kafila: Serving Large Language Models on a Trusted Set of Heterogeneous Commodity Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34045)
*Murtaza Rangwala,Richard O. Sinnott,Rajkumar Buyya*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 Kafila，一个面向可信异构消费级机器集群的大语言模型协同推理系统。其核心包含两个部分：(a) 一个 NAT 穿透会话协议，使用常在线 rendezvous 进行信令、优先建立直连打洞路径、失败时回退到中继；(b) 一个基于实测内存带宽/容量与可达性的规划器，将模型按 chain-on-chain 精确划分并联合决定 head 放置。在三个跨越共享 LAN、美国中西部到跨两大洲的舰队实验上，Kafila 将最慢流水线阶段缩短最多 5.2×（对比 GPipe 均匀划分）和 3×（对比 exo 内存比例划分），将硬件利用率从 <50% 提升到 75–87%，并能服务均匀划分完全放不下的 32B 模型。在共享 LAN 场景下，单用户吞吐量提升 1.56×（vs uniform）和 1.25×（vs mem-prop），四用户并发时优势扩大到 3.2×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Petals、SWARM/Parallax 等系统通过开放 swarm 池化算力，适合任意志愿者加入，但无法满足"只让可信设备持有模型权重"这一隐私场景。将成员限制为受邀设备会带来两个后果：(1) 激活泄露风险可由端到端加密 + 直连优先缓解；(2) 失去冗余后，最慢设备成为流水线瓶颈，无法在运行时绕开，因此必须"事先把划分做对"。此外，设备位于独立 NAT 后，无法接收未请求入站连接，使得会话的组建本身就是一个 NAT 穿透问题。现有流水线并行方法（GPipe 的均匀切分按层数、exo 的内存比例切分）都没有按实测带宽规划；而 PipeEdge/PipePar 等要求完整图和已部署权重的 profiling，会话场景不具备这些条件。

Method: Kafila 由两个核心组件构成：

1. **会话协议（NAT 穿透）**
   - 常在线 rendezvous 仅承担信令，不持有权重或执行推理。
   - 每个成员对外向 rendezvous 建立长连接并通过 STUN 分类自身 NAT 行为（permissive / ordinary / restrictive，遵循 RFC 4787）。
   - 先按 NAT 类别预测 O(m²) 边对的可达性，再用实际打洞仅验证 O(m) 条被采纳的边；预测错误均偏向"预测为 relay 但实际直连"的安全方向。
   - 数据面走 QUIC（UDP，避开 TCP simultaneous-open），优先打洞直连，失败时通过 rendezvous 转发密文中继；TLS 1.3 端到端密钥 rendezvous 不持有。

2. **规划器（划分、Head 放置、排序、准入）**
   - **代价模型**：batch=1 时每 stage 代价 ci = oi + ni·β_block/b̄i + 𝟙[head]·β_head/b̄i，其中 b̄i 为实测内存带宽，oi 为固定分派开销，β_block/β_head 来自 checkpoint manifest，无任何拟合项；模型在 165 个 stage 上预测中位误差 18%。
   - **环排序**：对所有成员测量到 rendezvous 的 RTT ri；直连边下界 |ri−rj|（三角不等），中继边代价 ri+rj；穷举排列（固定一名成员去旋转对称）取代价最小者；全中继平局时以"同类相聚"（最小化 Σ|ri−rj|）破平。
   - **块放置**：固定环序后转化为 chain-on-chain 划分（已知按 Pinar et al. 多项式时间可精确求解），通过对 O(km) 个候选 bottleneck 值做参数化二分，O(km log km) 求解最小可行 τ；Feasible 子例程左→右扫描按交换论证最优。
   - **Head 放置**：复用 Partition 对 m 个旋转各求一次，取代价最低者；用 5% 噪声裕度避免在两个 overhead 相近的设备间频繁换 head。
   - **准入/降级**：缺带宽探测时回退到算力吞吐比例；再退化到工作集比例；任何划分需校验成员剩余内存（含 KV cache 与并发预留），不足则拒绝并指明哪台设备。

3. **实现**：基于 Ollama fork，重定向到 MLX（统一 Apple Silicon 与 CUDA 后端），按 safetensors 字节范围按 shard 取权重；rendezvous 为两核云实例，无推理栈。

Result: 在三个舰队的实测（Qwen3-8B/14B/32B）：

**协议（NAT 穿透）**
- US Central（5 设备，5 个不同公网）：所有环边直连，中位 1.29 s。
- LAN（4 设备同私网）：本地地址 1.26 s 直连。
- 跨洲（5 设备跨两大洲）：仅共址两台直连（2.24 s），其余 4 边经 rendezvous 中继（中位 20.8 s）。
- NATlab 仿真 9 类 NAT 配对：7 类预测正确，2 类（ordinary-restrictive 双向）预测为 relay 实际直连，从不反向错误。

**规划器（表 IV）**
- 最慢/最快 stage 比：Kafila 1.4–1.8×，mem-prop 2.1–5.5×，uniform 高达 10.6×。
- 瓶颈缩短：最多 5.2×（vs uniform）和 3.0×（vs mem-prop）。
- 利用率：Kafila 75–87%，mem-prop/uniform 多 <50%。
- 跨洲舰队 Qwen3-32B：均匀划分不可行（18 GB 笔记本容不下预留 cache 的等份），Kafila 可服务。
- 吞吐量：LAN 12% 网络占比下，Kafila 21.5 tok/s，mem-prop 17.2，uniform 13.7（1.56×/1.25× lead，非重叠 5 次会话区间）。
- 跨洲 84–94% 网络占比下，三种划分 tok/s 落在彼此 5-session 区间内，差异被网络掩盖。

**多用户（图 2）**
- LAN 上 4 用户/1 用户：Kafila 4.0×，mem-prop 2.5×，uniform 2.0×；Kafila 单用户领先 1.6× 在四用户时扩大到 3.2×，因为不平衡划分将负载压在最慢 stage，多余请求只能排队。
- US Central 三种划分均达 3.9–4.0×；跨洲 3.5–4.0×。

Conclusion: Kafila 证明受信任异构消费设备集群能在零路由器配置下协同服务 LLM，且通过基于实测能力（而非内存或层数）的精确划分，能从既有方法中显著挤出性能与可行性。代价模型零拟合却有 ~18% 中位预测误差，使其规划结果可被独立校验而非事后调优。在网络占比 12% 的同一局域网场景下，Kafila 既提升单用户吞吐（1.56× vs uniform），又为多用户并发留出 stage 级 headroom，优势在四并发下叠加到 3.2× 而非衰退。论文明确列出未来工作：(1) 网络项的进一步优化（量化、跨成员 KV cache 共享等）；(2) 会话内成员变化时的缓存恢复与重规划节奏；(3) 移动设备两条关键属性（带宽+位置）漂移下的重规划策略；(4) 未到达 prompt 的预留 cache 回收与跨成员共享。会话放弃 swarm 的冗余，回报是成员、算力与连接性在服务开始前已知且划分可被规划——这恰是消费设备聚合推理场景所需的取舍。

Abstract: Between them, the members of a research group or a circle of friends own several consumer computers, none large enough to run a capable large language model. Existing systems pool such capacity across open swarms anyone may join, which a group admitting only trusted machines cannot use. Bounding membership removes what they depend on: a swarm holds each part of the model on several peers and routes around a slow one. A bounded session must use every device it admits. Its pipeline advances at the pace of whichever device received a share it cannot serve quickly, so the division has to be right before serving begins. We propose Kafila, whose protocol assembles a ring from behind NATs, preferring direct paths and relaying where traversal fails, while its planner measures each device's memory bandwidth, capacity and reachability, divides the model exactly for a fixed ring order, and places the head, which holds the embedding and output projection, together with that division rather than beforehand. On machines with different capabilities across three fleets, from a shared LAN to five devices spanning two continents, Kafila shortens the slowest pipeline stage by up to $5.2\times$ against the even split of pipeline parallelism, as in GPipe, and up to $3\times$ against the memory-proportional split of personal-device inference, as in exo, keeps 75 to 87 per cent of the committed hardware doing work where those divisions fall below half, and serves a model no uniform split can place on the fleet at all. What that is worth to a user depends on how much of a token is computation rather than network. Where the members share a network the same division returns $1.56\times$ the throughput of a uniform split and $1.25\times$ of a memory-proportional one, and under four concurrent users that lead compounds to $3.2\times$ rather than fading, each user served at almost the rate of one.

</details>


### [829] [Schedule Repair for DAG Workflows under Link Disruptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34048)
*Mohammadali Khodabandehlou,Jared Coleman,Bhaskar Krishnamachari,Kevin Chan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究对抗/动态网络环境下DAG工作流调度的"修复范围"决策问题，提出一个由等待、重路由、局部修复、全局修复组成的修复阶梯，针对四种不同相关性的链路中断过程（单次失败、随机抖动、移动性、干扰），在100个工作负载实例×5种CCR下进行评估，发现不存在最优的单一修复范围——最佳策略取决于中断过程的相关性结构、持续时间以及修复代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在对抗性网络环境中，无线链路因移动性、干扰和干扰而恶化，但DAG工作流调度通常假设网络稳定。已启动任务不可移动，传输中的数据可能丢失，因此核心问题是：链路中断时，应当重新调度多少待处理任务？现有工作要么研究节点故障下的容错（前提是预留冗余资源），要么研究任务到达时的抢占范围，未涉及链路级动态下的修复范围选择。

Method: 方法包含四方面：（1）定义具有精确中断语义和修复代价模型的修复阶梯——四种策略（等待L0、重路由L1、局部修复L2、全局修复L3）共享相同的HEFT放置器，仅在允许移动的任务集上不同；（2）构建四种具有不同相关性结构的中断生成器：单次失败（受控分析）、随机抖动（无记忆马尔可夫）、移动性（基于随机路点模型的趋势性中断）、干扰（全相关突发性中断）；（3）实现基于ncsim模拟器的可种子重现仿真；（4）定义代价模型：每次修复承担与其移动任务数k成正比的决策延迟τ'=τ+kδ。实验使用100个工作负载实例（合成图、RIoTBench IoT流水线、WfCommons科学工作流），每种在5种CCR（0.2、0.5、1、2、5）下运行，共500个变体，归一化为无中断makespan M₀和oracle makespan。

Result: 主要结果：（1）干扰（突发、全相关）场景下全局修复接近oracle（4%以内），重路由表现最差（26%偏差）；（2）随机抖动下，等待优于所有主动反应策略（1.13 vs 重路由的1.18 vs 全局修复的1.04），但CCR=5时重路由崩溃至2.7×oracle而等待胜出；（3）单次失败是重路由的最佳场景，几乎消除等待的30%代价；（4）移动性推翻作者假设：等待和重路由优于修复，因为移动性中断自愈，主动反应反而将任务迁移到即将离开的节点；（5）小工作负载（RIoTBench~10任务）下全局修复几乎在所有过程下领先，而大工作负载（WfCommons 45-102任务）下等待在抖动场景中决定性胜出；（6）随修复代价δ增长，大范围策略首先被侵蚀：δ=0.02时局部修复即可匹配或击败全局修复，δ=0.2-0.5时所有修复策略收敛到等待线；（7）结论性设计阶梯：短/自愈中断不响应；孤立持续失败重路由；局部化、有代价或大工作负载用局部修复；广泛、相关、持续中断用全局修复。

Conclusion: 本文得出三个核心结论：（1）修复范围应当根据中断过程的相关性结构、持续时间和修复代价自适应调整，而非由调度器固定；（2）反应应"宁少勿多"——每一次反应追逐的都是可能已不存在的网络状态；（3）更大工作负载和通信密集型场景都强化"克制"的论据。遗留两个开放问题：（1）控制平面——假设计划带外分发，在干扰黑场景下可行性受限，需要独立控制信道或去中心化修复；（2）预测性修复——基于移动性预警结果，预警本身不足，主动修复仍待研究。

Abstract: Schedules for directed acyclic graph (DAG) workflows in networked IoT systems are typically computed assuming a static or generally stable network. In contested and adversarial environments, this assumption is not valid. Links degrade and fail due to mobility, interference, and jamming. We study schedule repair: when a link disruption invalidates part of a schedule, how much of it should be rescheduled? We introduce a spectrum of repair policies that vary in repair scope, how much of the pending schedule each may move: wait out the disruption, reroute data around it, reschedule only the affected tasks locally, or reschedule all pending tasks globally. We evaluate each against an oracle and charge every repair a decision latency proportional to the extent to which it moves. Across 100 workload instances spanning synthetic task graphs, RIoTBench pipelines, and WfCommons scientific workflows, each run at five communication-to-computation ratios (CCRs) and disrupted by processes with deliberately different correlation structure, we find that no single scope wins: rerouting nearly erases isolated failures that cost waiting 30%, global repair comes within 4% of the oracle under jamming blackouts, waiting is favored under memoryless link flapping for larger and communication-heavy workloads (the scheduling analog of route-flap damping), self-healing mobility outages reward patience over reaction, and accounting for repair latency erodes large scopes first. We conclude that the scope of the repair should be adapted to the disruption process and the repair cost, rather than fixed by the scheduler.

</details>


### [830] [SlideDP: Scaling Host-Resident LLM Fine-Tuning Across Multiple GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34162)
*Ruijia Yang,Shiyuan Lin,Yulong Ao,Zhiyu Li,Yingli Zhao,Xianduo Li,Yonghua Lin,Zeyi Wen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: SlideDP是一个用于多GPU节点的同步数据并行运行时，通过共享主机状态、跨秩流水线和基于测量的策略选择，将基于主机的层流式LLM微调扩展到多个GPU，在减少冗余主机流量的同时保持与GPU驻留方案有竞争力的吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全参数LLM微调在GPU内存受限场景下需要将优化器状态卸载到主机内存；然而现有方法（如SlideFormer、MegaTrain）的多GPU扩展采用复制式参数传递和CPU端梯度归约，会随rank数量R放大主机流量（可避免的放大），且强扩展时计算窗口缩小会暴露剩余的主机工作（残余流水线暴露）。需要一种共享主机资源下的协同运行时来减少冗余并隐藏剩余主机工作。

Method: 三项核心贡献：(1) 共享主机运行时——维护单一权威主机状态（FP32主权重和Adam状态），解耦状态布局与通信路由（支持复制式/分片式参数传递），通过六条逻辑通道（参数准备/H2D、激活卸载/重载、GPU计算、梯度归约、梯度D2H、CPU LayerAdam）实现层内与跨层流水化重叠；(2) 解析步时间模型——基于资源共享服务需求和操作依赖（含参数版本门控、buffer复用、rank就绪），刻画host-bound与GPU-bound两种执行机制；(3) 测量引导的策略选择（AutoPolicy + Elastic Checkpointing）——通过运行时探测选择通信路由、chunk大小和激活布局，用MILP在GPU内存预算下分配各层策略。

Result: 在匹配batch扫描中，SlideDP对比SlideFormer、MegaTrain、ZeRO-Offload取得1.46–2.64×几何平均吞吐加速比。在4×H100上，Qwen3-14B小batch下接近GPU驻留FSDP2吞吐，大batch下处理超100万token/step并超过FSDP2峰值11.2%。支持256K长度序列微调Qwen3-14B，并在4×RTX 4090上微调Qwen2.5-72B。Qwen3-32B在2–8张A800上保持95–98%弱扩展效率。主机PSS仅为ZeRO-Offload的约59%，且MoE模型（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Gemma4-26B-A4B）也获得1.44–3.21×加速。

Conclusion: 共享主机多GPU微调需要协同优化状态移动、执行调度和内存分配，而非独立优化各组件；通信路由和GPU内存分配应依据其对暴露流水线工作的影响进行管理。这一设计思路使基于主机的层流式方法能在商用工作站和多GPU服务器上扩展可行工作负载并保持有竞争力的吞吐。

Abstract: Host-resident layer streaming enables full-parameter LLM fine-tuning beyond GPU memory, but data-parallel ranks compete for shared host resources. Replicated transfers amplify traffic, while strong scaling can expose host work as computation windows shrink. We present SlideDP, a synchronous data-parallel runtime for shared-host multi-GPU systems. It maintains one authoritative host state, decouples communication routes from state layout, and pipelines parameter delivery, gradient aggregation, and CPU updates across ranks and chunks. An analytical step-time model characterizes resource bottlenecks and pipeline exposure; runtime measurements guide communication, chunking, and activation policies under a GPU memory budget. In matched-batch sweeps, SlideDP achieves geometric-mean throughput ratios of 1.46-2.64$\times$ over SlideFormer, MegaTrain, and ZeRO-Offload. On four H100s, SlideDP approaches GPU-resident FSDP2 throughput for Qwen3-14B at a smaller batch size. With a larger batch, it processes over 1M tokens per step and exceeds FSDP2's measured peak throughput by 11.2%. Separately, it supports 256K-token sequences for the same model and fine-tunes Qwen2.5-72B on four RTX 4090 GPUs. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [831] [Arachne: Learning to Plan Parallel Training on Dynamic Heterogeneous Clusters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34244)
*Taeyoon Kim,Yonguk Song,Seoyeong Choy,Hexiao Duan,Dong Li,Seo Jin Park,Myeongjae Jeon*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Arachne是一个基于强化学习的分布式训练规划器，针对动态异构GPU集群，通过将规划问题分解为结构化模板的自回归构建（仅学习管道深度、阶段GPU类型和TP度），其余算术维度通过基于profile的规则和有限候选集自动填充。在异构集群上规划速度为0.7-8.4秒，吞吐量比五种现有规划器（AMP、Sailor、Metis、HexiScale、Espresso）最高提升84.5%（稠密模型）和4.6倍（MoE模型）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模ML训练面临两大挑战：(1) 共享GPU基础设施中GPU可用性动态变化；(2) 数据中心不断引入新GPU代际导致硬件异构性积累。现有的基于嵌套循环搜索的规划器存在根本矛盾：彻底搜索无法跟上资源变化频率，激进剪枝又可能丢弃高吞吐量计划。此外，现有规划器均不支持专家并行（EP），而这对DeepSeek、Qwen等前沿模型至关重要。

Method: Arachne的核心是**结构化模板（structural template）**抽象，每个模板指定管道的深度及每个阶段的GPU类型和TP度。方法包含三个核心组件：
1. **基于学习的规划器**：采用强化学习（GRPO），自回归构建管道结构（深度→阶段GPU类型→阶段TP度）。策略状态由GPU类型分数、归一化设备属性和集群规模（对数尺度）组成，可在未见过的集群配置上泛化。通过可行性掩码（feasibility masking）确保每个采样动作都能完成一个完整计划。
2. **基于profile的成本模型**：离线测量每个GPU类型、TP度和微批次大小下层的计算和通信成本，运行时查找精确匹配，估算迭代时间和每GPU峰值内存。
3. **算术自动填充（Arithmetic Auto-fill）**：层分配按GPU速度比例分配以平衡阶段时间；DP度由剩余节点打包决定；MBS从profile的2的幂中选择最优；MoE的EP/ETP/EDP因子分解通过穷举所有满足内存约束的分解（3-12个候选）选择最优。
训练采用GRPO，使用组内相对优势（无需学习价值基线），并通过正交梯度投影处理多组合之间的梯度冲突。自模仿学习（SIL）锚定每个深度的最佳计划。重新配置通过Direct State Migration（DSM）实现P2P GPU间状态迁移，无需远程存储。

Result: 在三种模型（LLaMA-3-8B、Qwen3-32B、Qwen3-64B）上的评估：
- **稠密模型**：在64-512 GPU、1-4种GPU类型（A100-40、A100-80、H100、A6000）的组合上，Arachne在12个统一组合中的11个上返回最高吞吐量计划，规划时间0.7-8.4秒；非均匀组合上吞吐量提升22.4%-84.5%。Metis在所有组合上耗尽600秒预算。
- **MoE模型**：在Mixtral-8x7B上比基线领先1.68-1.98倍；在Qwen3-30B-A3B上领先2.2-4.6倍；唯一能为DeepSeek-V3-like模型（168GB专家状态/层）生成可行计划。
- **真实硬件**：19个GPU（3 RTX PRO 6000 + 3×4 A6000 + 1×4 A5000），集群动态扩展时吞吐量领先19.9%-69.1%，成本模型预测精度在6.1%以内。
- **设计验证**：flat-RL（原始6维动作空间）需要2倍计划评估次数才能达到相同计划；随机搜索在32000次评估时仅达到0.035 iter/s，Arachne为0.053。
- **重新配置开销**：端到端19.2-21.5秒（状态迁移占约4秒，规划器调用2.16秒）。

Conclusion: Arachne证明：通过将规划问题分解为结构化决策（学习）和算术决策（基于规则/有界评估），强化学习规划器可以在动态异构集群上同时实现快速规划和高质量计划。模板级抽象使一个训练好的策略能够跨集群规模和配置泛化，无需重新训练。该方法支持全部四个并行维度（DP、PP、TP、EP），填补了现有规划器在专家并行支持上的空白。

Abstract: Training large machine learning models on shared GPU infrastructures faces two challenges: (1) GPU availability shifts dynamically with varying resource demands from tenants, and (2) hardware heterogeneity accumulates as datacenters continuously adopt new GPU generations. Due to the vast search space induced by heterogeneous GPU types and node sizes, training planners must prune it aggressively to remain tractable, yet must also derive high-throughput plans promptly as cluster configurations change. Arachne achieves this goal through a learning-based planner that reduces the full planning problem to a search over pipeline structures. Arachne encapsulates planning decisions in a structural template and learns to construct plans from templates over diverse cluster configurations offline. This design is effective because structural decisions constitute the performance-critical core of a parallelism plan, while the rest follows by rule or from a small priced candidate set once the plan structure is fixed. Evaluation shows that Arachne matches or exceeds the best plan found by five existing planners across clusters with varying GPU types and node sizes for three models of different sizes by up to 84.5% in throughput on dense models and 4.6x on MoE models.

</details>
