### [832] [HyDra: Demystifying and Taming Dynamic Context Parallelism at Production Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34318)
*Zihao Fan,Yunzhuo Liu,Bo Jiang,Changgang Zheng,Lin Zheng,Ray Ying,Key Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: HyDra提出了一种面向超大规模长上下文训练的动态上下文并行（DCP）系统。它通过负载驱动的调度器将所有rank拉向统一的负载目标（按注意力计算量而非token数平衡），并采用"内层Ulysses+外层浅环"的CP通信引擎突破Ulysses头数限制且降低通信开销。在512-GPU测试床和2,048-GPU生产集群上均显著优于Mcore DCP和静态CP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DCP系统（如Megatron-Core DCP）按内存预算（token数）为每条序列选择CP度，但注意力计算量随序列长度平方增长，导致token数相近的microbatch计算时间差异高达5×，产生46%的PP气泡和13%的DP气泡。同时，全池扫描的调度方式在11K+ GPU规模上消耗9%的迭代时间。其他DCP方案要么无法扩展，要么在MLA主流模型上性能急剧下降。

Method: 两个核心组件：(1) 负载驱动调度器——基于二次注意力负载推导每rank统一的负载目标Λ*=s²ₘₐₓ/C，通过闭式求解平衡PP气泡与per-MB开销的CP度上限C*，采用"最长优先piggyback装箱"和按CP度分桶的惰性堆实现O(N log G)的序列放置；(2) 平衡保持的CP通信引擎——将CP度P分解为内层Ulysses组（cpᵤ=min(P, h)）和外层浅环（cpᵣ=P/cpᵤ），通过将查询、键、值的all-to-all调度到独立通信流并与门控MLA的无依赖计算重叠来隐藏暴露的集合通信。

Result: 512-GPU H20测试床：32K上下文吞吐量平均提升1.18×（最高1.25×），256K上下文平均2.48×（最高3.08×），计算流利用率76-81%。2,048-GPU H800生产作业：PP气泡从36.4%降至13.6%，调度时间减少2.3×（16K GPU时达11.6×），吞吐量较Mcore DCP平均提升1.25×、较静态CP平均1.59×；估计2T token训练节省$271K-$632K成本。模拟扩展至40K GPU，在Hy3（GQA）和DeepSeek-V3（MLA）上均持续领先，MLA模型上对ByteScale领先1.53×，对ring静态CP最高达13.8×。训练损失曲线与静态CP在~8000次迭代内偏差在10⁻³以内。

Conclusion: HyDra通过协调规划和执行解决了生产规模DCP的根本失衡问题：按注意力计算量而非token数平衡MB与CP组，以闭式求解替代全局优化扫描，以Ulysses×Ring分解突破头数限制。论文贡献的四大设计原则——平衡计算、MB内外双平衡、轻量在线规划、通信不成为瓶颈——可指导学术界和工业界构建高效的大规模长上下文DCP系统。

Abstract: Long-context training runs on sequences whose lengths span orders of magnitude, and dynamic context parallelism (DCP) gives each sequence its own CP degree. Existing DCP systems either do not scale or perform poorly on mainstream models, leaving Megatron-Core (Mcore) DCP as the only option at production scale. Mcore DCP, however, sizes each degree to fit memory, which grows linearly with length while attention grows quadratically, so comparable token counts hide unequal computation. In our production 256K-context training job on more than 11K GPUs under Mcore DCP, per-rank microbatch times differ by up to 5x at similar token counts. The skew leads to a 46% pipeline bubble and a 13% data-parallel bubble. We present HyDra, a scalable load-driven DCP system. Its scheduler balances computation by pulling every rank toward one load target, and balance in turn makes that target solvable in closed form. It places sequences with lazy heaps rather than whole-pool scans. That balance asks for CP degrees larger than memory requires, so its CP engine nests an inner Ulysses group in a shallow outer ring, letting a higher degree lower computation and communication together. Evaluation at both scales shows consistent gains. On a 512-GPU testbed, HyDra raises throughput over Mcore DCP by 1.18x on average at 32K context and 2.48x at 256K. On a 2,048-GPU production job, it shrinks the pipeline bubble from 36% to 14%, cuts scheduling time by 2.3x, and raises throughput by 1.10-1.43x (avg. 1.25x) over Mcore DCP and 1.33-1.90x (avg. 1.59x) over static CP.

</details>


### [833] [VarioPath: Workload-Aware All-to-All Communication for PCIe GPU Clusters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34340)
*Yao Fei,Jin Fang,Size Zheng,Gongming Zhao,Hongli Xu,Jiacheng Zhu,Zhijing Xin*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: VarioPath是一个面向PCIe GPU集群的AlltoAllv通信调度框架。它通过离线拓扑感知分析器预计算无竞争的传输模式（AlltoAllv通道），结合在线需求感知调度器，将动态、倾斜的通信需求分解为通道序列，从而在PCIe系统上实现高效的AlltoAllv调度。在四个平台（最多256个GPU）上的评估显示，相较FAST平均加速5.88x，相较DeepEP平均加速1.72x，并可降低Qwen3推理延迟达27.2%、Wan2.1生成延迟6.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AlltoAllv通信是分布式大模型推理（尤其是MoE模型）的关键原语。PCIe GPU系统因缺少专用scale-up互联（如NVLink），内部节点间流量与NIC流量共享PCIe层级，易产生链路竞争。加之流量分布倾斜和需求动态变化，使得高效调度极具挑战。现有方案要么不适合PCIe系统，要么调度合成开销过大。

Method: 核心思想是将拓扑稳定性与需求动态性分离：1) 离线分析：利用拓扑对称性，将无竞争的并发传输模式压缩为"AlltoAllv通道"，并按"通道族"组织为树形目录，支持高效搜索；2) 在线调度：将每次调用的需求分解为一系列通道激活，使用瓶颈感知的通道形状选择、基于交替算法（AA）的端点绑定以及基于效用的体量分配，动态适应倾斜且快速变化的流量。模型定义通道为（置换, 路径向量），要求无共享建模资源。

Result: 在随机需求AlltoAllv上42个测试点全部领先，相较DeepEP平均加速1.55x–2.00x，相较FAST加速3.49x–9.41x；AlltoAll上相较NCCL加速1.82x，相较MSCCL加速1.99x；倾斜AlltoAllv（Zipf）相较FAST平均加速2.16x；256 GPU扩展实验中带宽达30.91 GB/s（DeepEP 28.11，NCCL 18.85）。端到端推理：Qwen3预填充延迟降低19.1%–27.2%，Wan2.1生成加速1.011x–1.066x。消融显示联合对端-路径设计为必要，调度质量达MILP最优解的99.18%。

Conclusion: VarioPath通过离线拓扑分析与在线需求分解的解耦，在PCIe GPU系统上实现了低开销、高质量的AlltoAllv调度。其通道族抽象和树形目录有效控制了搜索空间，在大规模部署中仍能保持规划和通信开销比（O/C）低于4.2%，验证了在实际部署中的实用性。

Abstract: AlltoAllv communication is a critical primitive in distributed large-model inference, particularly for mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. The growing adoption of PCIe GPU systems for cost-efficient inference makes AlltoAllv performance on these systems increasingly important. Without a dedicated scale-up interconnect (e.g., NVLink or Infinity Fabric), PCIe GPU systems carry both intra-node and inter-node traffic through the PCIe hierarchy, where concurrent transfers can contend for PCIe link bandwidth. This link contention, compounded by skewed traffic distributions and dynamic traffic demand, makes efficient AlltoAllv scheduling challenging. Existing approaches are either poorly suited to PCIe GPU systems or incur substantial schedule synthesis overhead that reduces their practicality in real-world deployments. We present VarioPath, an efficient AlltoAllv scheduling framework for PCIe GPU systems. It combines an offline topology-aware analyzer with an online demand-aware scheduler. The analyzer records contention-free transfer patterns as AlltoAllv channels and exploits topology symmetry to build a compact catalog for efficient search. The online scheduler decomposes each AlltoAllv invocation's demand across a sequence of channels, adapting to rapidly changing and skewed traffic while incurring low planning overhead. Evaluation on four platforms (up to 256 GPUs) shows average AlltoAllv speedups of 5.88x over FAST and 1.72x over DeepEP. End-to-end experiments show that VarioPath reduces Qwen3 inference latency by up to 27.2% and Wan2.1 generation latency by 6.1%.

</details>


### [834] [Semantics, Workflows, and Infrastructure: Understanding Agent Serving at Production Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34432)
*Yihao Zheng,Jingzhe Jiang,Dejiang Zhu,Zhiyuan Tan,Yang Tian,Tao Wang,Minchen Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文对大规模生产环境中智能体（agent）服务的推理负载进行了端到端的三层特征分析，基于两周内1170万条请求、94.8万个会话的追踪数据，覆盖超过10k GPU的推理基础设施。核心贡献是揭示了任务启动语义、工作流执行模式与基础设施服务需求之间的关联，并提出"episode"作为新的服务亲和性单元，针对跨层抽象、基于episode的调度、自适应KV缓存管理三个方向给出开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体负载特征研究多集中在请求级测量（如GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、Codex）或智能体执行分析，缺乏将任务启动、工作流执行与推理基础设施串联的端到端视角。理解应用行为如何塑造推理需求，对于设计高效的智能体服务系统（如请求调度、状态管理）至关重要。

Method: 对生产平台两周追踪数据进行三层关联分析：(1)任务层——比较用户触发与智能体触发任务在请求量、上下文长度、活动时长上的差异，并分析会话间请求集中度与周期性；(2)工作流层——将请求依赖建模为DAG，分析图规模、深度、宽度、串行/分支结构、兄弟请求重叠率、工具调用等待与缓存复用；(3)基础设施层——量化new-prefill/decode tokens与逻辑上下文驻留的集中度，引入"episode"作为服务亲和性单元（基于上下文事件与空闲间隔），并构建离线TTL分配优化模型评估不同等待类型的缓存保留收益。

Result: 共得出12项核心观察：任务层——智能体触发任务占35.8%但单任务负载较轻；前5%会话贡献56.1%请求且以纯用户触发为主；用户触发负载具工作日节律且变异性更高，智能体触发全天均匀；88.3%的周期性任务集中在中位复发间隔≤30分钟的组中。工作流层——多数DAG小而窄，但宽度>1的少数会话贡献68.19%请求；串行结构任务占77.6%请求但不足半数任务；12.0%串行任务存在单间隔超过任务跨度一半；仅0.225%逻辑兄弟请求对发生执行重叠；等待时间与后继缓存复用因工具类别而异。基础设施层——14.3%的高需求会话贡献98.5%上下文驻留、92.3% new-prefill与86.0% decode tokens；解码阶段占该组请求服务时长的76.1%；任务边界与服务亲和性不对齐（跨任务复用80.59%，任务内跨episode仅44.67%）；离线模型显示分类型TTL配置相对统一TTL可减少6.4%–13.9%的重计算。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了任务启动、工作流结构与推理基础设施之间的端到端关联特征，挑战了以整个会话绑定单一服务实例的常见假设。基于观察提出三个研究方向：(1)跨层抽象——将任务与工作流动态信号暴露给服务引擎；(2)基于episode的调度——根据上下文连续性与剩余工作量估计动态决定亲和性粒度与重分配时机；(3)自适应KV缓存管理——根据重用估计、内存压力与等待类型动态调整TTL。团队计划公开发布脱敏后的特征追踪数据。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents execute applications through a workflow of inference requests with tool calls and user interactions. Serving these applications at production scale requires understanding how application behavior shapes inference demand and for guiding efficient execution. Recent characterization studies provide request-level workload measurements and agent execution analysis. However, an end-to-end view connecting task initiation, workflow execution, and inference infrastructure remains unexplored. In this paper, we analyze a two-week trace of 11.7 million requests from a large-scale production platform for general-purpose agents, backed by inference infrastructure comprising over 10k GPUs. We characterize the platform at three connected levels: task-level initiation semantics, workflow-level execution patterns, and infrastructure level serving demands. Our measurements reveal workload patterns such as highly skewed request volumes across sessions, rare execution overlap among logical sibling requests, and context reuse across task boundaries. Building on these observations, we analyze deployment implications and identify open problems to guide future research on agent serving systems.

</details>


### [835] [AgentWare: Automating the Lifecycle of Agentic Applications across the Edge-to-Cloud Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34586)
*Michalis Kasioulis,Moysis Symeonides,George Pallis,Marios D. Dikaiakos*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: AgentWare是一个面向边缘到云连续环境的AgenticOps框架,通过自动化流水线实现LLM智能体应用的部署、可观测性与评估一体化,显著降低分布式智能体应用的开发与运维成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有解决方案分别关注智能体开发、可观测性或基准测试,缺乏对边缘到云连续环境中分布式智能体应用全生命周期的统一支持,尤其在硬件异构性、部署复杂性、可观测性和系统化评估方面存在显著挑战。

Method: 提出AgentWareOps(AWOps)生命周期模式,包含四个阶段:基础设施配置、智能体生成、智能体应用部署、评估。采用四层架构(输入/控制/运行时/物理层),结合Smolagents与Ray框架,通过AST代码生成将用户工具实现自动转换为分布式应用,使用Netdata+Prometheus进行基础设施遥测,Arize Phoenix进行智能体追踪,LLM-as-a-Judge进行语义评估。

Result: 在包含Intel Xeon服务器、Jetson AGX Orin和Raspberry Pi 4的异构测试床上部署分布式图书助手智能体,实验显示:仅需177行工具代码+60行配置即可生成445行部署就绪应用;服务放置显著影响性能与能耗(Orin全部署能耗降低5倍);LLM选择对准确性影响显著(GPT-4o mini达1.0,Gemma 2 2B仅0.5);框架支持细粒度的资源归因分析。

Conclusion: AgentWare是首个系统集成边缘到云环境下智能体应用生命周期自动化、可观测性和评估的框架,有效解决了分布式智能体应用的部署、监控与系统化评估难题,未来工作将扩展更多LLM支持、增强评估确定性和可扩展性实验。

Abstract: Deploying LLM-enabled agentic applications across the Edge-to-Cloud continuum remains challenging due to hardware heterogeneity, deployment complexity, limited observability, and the lack of systematic evaluation methods. Existing solutions address agent development, observability, or benchmarking separately, offering limited support for the full lifecycle of distributed agentic applications. This paper presents AgentWare, an AgenticOps framework that automates the provisioning, deployment, observability, and evaluation of agentic applications across Edge-to-Cloud infrastructures. AgentWare introduces an end-to-end lifecycle pipeline that automatically prepares heterogeneous execution environments, transforms user-defined agent implementations into distributed applications, deploys agent components across the continuum, and performs unified collection of execution traces, infrastructure telemetry, and evaluation metrics. The framework further supports automated semantic evaluation through LLM-as-a-Judge workflows and generates reproducible reports covering correctness, performance, resource utilization, and energy consumption. We demonstrate the applicability of AgentWare through a distributed book assistant agent deployed across real Edge-to-Cloud infrastructure under multiple deployment and model configurations. The results show that AgentWare enables systematic experimentation and evaluation of distributed agentic applications while significantly reducing the manual effort required for deployment, instrumentation, and analysis.

</details>


### [836] [Distributed Lower Bounds via Automatic Self-Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34753)
*Alkida Balliu,Francesco d'Amore,Dennis Olivetti*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文证明Khoury和Schild [FOCS 2025]提出的自归约(round elimination via self-reduction)技术实际上是经典轮消除(round elimination)技术的特例。作者引入了一种新的算法误差度量方式，并证明了在经典轮消除框架下，对于一类特定的图问题（2-separated且b-dominant的问题），可以得到ω(log log n)轮的随机化下界。作为应用，作者证明了二部正则2-着色图上的极大匹配、1/k-整数匹配以及极大H-打包问题的Ω(√log n)随机化下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典轮消除技术虽然是通用性的下界证明工具，但似乎无法证明ω(log log n)轮的随机化下界。Khoury和Schild提出的自归约技术虽然改进了极大匹配的下界，但专门针对该问题，无法直接推广。本文旨在将自归约技术转化为通用方法，揭示其与经典轮消除的联系，从而对一大类问题证明更强的随机化下界。

Method: 1. 提出新的误差度量：用配置到合法配置集的编辑距离（而非简单的失败节点计数）来衡量算法输出与合法解的距离。2. 引入2-separated和b-dominant的问题类定义。3. 设计新的从T轮算法构造(T-1)轮算法的方式（与标准方法显著不同），允许使用不可计算函数。4. 证明新的黑盒提升定理：对2-separated且b-dominant的问题，将标准提升定理中log_Δ(log 1/p)项改进为log(1/p)（即移除了对Δ的依赖，并从log log改进为log）。5. 通过将局部问题（如极大匹配）归约到2-separated的全局问题（如完美匹配），证明更弱问题的下界。

Result: 1. 证明自归约是经典轮消除的特例，将其转化为通用技术。3. 解决了[Balliu et al., 2022]中提出的开放问题6，证实经典轮消除可以得到ω(log log n)的随机化下界。4. 证明对2-分离性是必要的（Theorem 2.14），但b-支配性的某些情形不是必要的（Theorem 2.15）。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献在于将自归约技术统一纳入经典轮消除框架，通过引入更精细的误差度量，证明了对于一大类2-separated且b-dominant的图问题，经典轮消除技术确实能够产生比KMW构造更强的随机化下界。这一工作不仅统一了两种重要的下界证明方法，还为多个基本图问题（包括极大匹配、1/k-整数匹配、极大H-打包等）提供了新的Ω(√log n)下界。论文同时证明了2-分离性的必要性，并指出某些非支配性问题可能需要额外的限制才能获得更强的下界。

Abstract: The development of round elimination into a general-purpose technique [PODC 2019] marked a turning point in our understanding of the hardness of many graph problems in the distributed setting and led to several breakthrough results. However, the round elimination technique seems unable to yield randomized lower bounds of $\omega(\log \log n)$ rounds as a function of the number $n$ of nodes. Very recently, Khoury and Schild [FOCS 2025] introduced a new technique called round elimination via self-reduction, which bypasses the limitations of classical round elimination. Using this approach, the authors show that any randomized algorithm for maximal matching requires $\Omega(\sqrt{\log n})$ rounds in the LOCAL model. Their elegant technique is, in some respects, similar to classical round elimination while being fundamentally different in others. However, it is tailored specifically to maximal matching rather than being applicable to a broad class of problems. In this paper, we show that self-reduction is, in fact, a special case of classical round elimination, thereby turning it into a general-purpose approach. In particular, we introduce a new way to measure the error of an algorithm and show that, under this new measure, classical round elimination can indeed yield $\omega(\log \log n)$ randomized lower bounds. More specifically, we identify a large class of problems for which this improvement is entirely black-box: once a problem is shown to belong to the class, stronger randomized lower bounds follow automatically from the classical round-elimination framework. As an application, we prove $\Omega(\sqrt{\log n})$ randomized lower bounds for a range of graph problems, namely, maximal matching on regular $2$-colored graphs, $\frac{1}{k}$-integral matching, and maximal $H$-packing.

</details>


### [837] [WaveAlign: Cache-Aware Query-Row Scheduling for Sparse Attention in Long-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34814)
*Zijian Dai,Sen Han,Youhui Bai,Shannon Wang,Kan Wu,Jingkai Huang,Yuhang Wang,Jing Li,Cheng Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: WaveAlign提出了一种轻量级、缓存感知的查询行重排序框架，通过两阶段优化（SVD空间排序+NNZ时间对齐）解决动态稀疏注意力中的L2缓存局部性问题，在不改变稀疏注意力语义和后端内核的前提下，显著提升长视频生成的推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiT）生成长视频时，注意力模块因长token序列成为推理瓶颈（占耗时85.86%）。动态稀疏注意力虽减少FLOPs，但实际加速比仅为预期的80%。差距源于稀疏化导致L2缓存命中率从49.38%降至10-22%，使内核从计算受限转变为内存带宽受限。两个根本原因：(1)同一wave内查询行空间分散访问K/V块，重叠度低；(2)NNZ差异导致wave间时间错位，共享块在驱逐前未被复用。

Method: WaveAlign将查询行重排序形式化为优化问题，采用两阶段近似算法：Stage 1通过无矩阵秩-2 SVD（MFCSI算法，O(nnz)复杂度）对mask行嵌入后按极角排序，空间上聚类相似K/V访问模式；Stage 2在每个wave内按NNZ降序排列行，实现长-短行在wave边界互补对齐，减少执行偏差。自适应跳过模块在短序列、高稀疏或已局部有序时跳过重排序。仅对query和mask行置换，输出后逆置换恢复，保持语义不变。

Result: 在H100和A40两种GPU架构、Wan2.1和LTX2.3两种视频DiT、MInference/FlexPrefill/XAttention/SpargeAttn四种稀疏方法上：L2命中率从28.48%–36.35%提升至79.38%–89.06%，HBM读流量减少80.71%–92.11%；内核加速最高1.25×，端到端加速最高1.17×；重排序开销仅占注意力耗时1.1%–3.2%；质量指标（PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/VBench）与基线完全一致。A40上因L2更小（6MB vs 50MB），加速更显著（最高1.635×）。

Conclusion: WaveAlign是首个针对动态稀疏注意力的缓存感知查询行重排序框架，通过空间排序与时间对齐的协同设计，在不修改稀疏算法和后端内核的前提下，有效恢复了L2缓存局部性，将稀疏注意力从内存带宽受限拉回计算受限，为长视频生成提供了实用的推理加速方案。

Abstract: Long-video generation with diffusion transformers (DiTs) produces extremely long token sequences, making attention a dominant inference bottleneck. Dynamic sparse attention reduces computation, but its realized speedup remains limited because irregular query-row execution degrades L2 cache locality and increases HBM traffic. We present WaveAlign, a lightweight, cache-aware query-row reordering framework for dynamic sparse attention. WaveAlign formulates row ordering as an optimization problem and approximates it with two stages. The first stage derives a low-rank SVD representation of sparse-mask rows and groups query rows with similar K/V access patterns, increasing K/V overlap among concurrently scheduled rows. The second stage exploits streaming GPU scheduling by sorting rows within each wave in descending order of their K/V-block counts, so that short rows from the current wave are followed by long rows from the next. This aligns K/V accesses across wave boundaries and enables shared blocks to be reused before eviction. An adaptive skip module avoids unprofitable reordering. By only permuting query and mask rows, WaveAlign preserves sparse-attention semantics and requires no changes to existing methods or backend kernels. Across two GPU architectures, two video DiTs, and four sparse-attention methods, WaveAlign raises the L2 cache hit ratio from 28.48%--36.35% to 79.38%--89.06%, reduces HBM read traffic by up to 92.11%, and achieves up to 1.25x kernel and 1.17x end-to-end generation speedup without quality loss.

</details>


### [838] [Accelerator Choice Is Not Enough: AlphaFold2 Inference on Cloud TPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34818)
*Lorenzo Pazienza,Ihab El Bani*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文实测 AlphaFold2 在 CPU、GPU（T4）与 8 芯片 TPU v5e 切片上的推理性能，核心结论是：加速器选择并非唯一决定因素，软件层面的并行表达方式（vmap/pmap/自动分片）、冷启动编译开销以及切片计费模式共同决定了用户实际获得的吞吐与成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AlphaFold2 公开实现基于 JAX，同一代码可在 CPU/GPU/TPU 上编译运行，给用户造成"选择加速器即可"的印象。本文旨在系统测量该工作负载在不同后端上的端到端性能差距，并揭示软件层（编译路径、并行原语、计费模型）对用户实际收益的决定性影响。

Method: 在三个后端运行相同的 AlphaFold2 推理代码（model_3 配置、118 残基、未训练权重、float32）：Colab CPU、Colab T4 GPU、Stanford ME344 课程提供的 8 芯片 TPU v5e GKE 切片。使用 wall-clock 计时配合 jax.block_until_ready 同步；首调用与稳态分别计时；通过 jax.profiler.trace 捕获首次调用的栈轨迹；测试 jax.vmap、jax.pmap、自动分片对多芯片利用率的影响；在 16 点网格（chip 数 1/2/4/8 × 序列长度 100/250/500/1000）上做吞吐扩展性测量；按 2026 年 8 月的公开 list price 计算单次预测成本。

Result: 1) 稳态下，单芯片 TPU v5e 比 T4 快 27.8×（0.47 s vs 13.086 s），比 Colab CPU 快 451×。但 8 芯片切片默认只有 1 个芯片工作，其余 7 个 HBM 为 0 MB。2) jax.vmap 在批次 1/2/4/8 下吞吐均不超过单查询（最高仅 0.94×，最低 0.73×）。3) jax.pmap 将 8 个独立查询映射到 8 芯片，在 100–1000 残基范围内实现 6.53–7.91× 加速（并行效率 81.6%–98.9%），拟合吞吐 ∝ chips^0.963 × length^(-1.572)。4) 自动分片下每个芯片占用仍为 463 MB，与单芯片一致，呈复制而非切分表现，最可能因模型无 sharding 注解。5) 首调用栈迹显示 apply_fn 跨度的约 76%（12.55 s / 16.56 s）为 JAX 的 cache_miss 自身时间；持续编译缓存使 init_params 减少 6.81×、首 predict 减少 1.90×。6) 按 list price 计，TPU pod（$9.60/h）与 T4（$0.35/h）单次预测成本几乎相等（$1.25 vs $1.27/1k），因 pod 中 87.5% 容量闲置；8 芯片全工作时降至 $0.181/1k。7) 五周后重跑未复现 8 月基线：CPU 变慢 1.64–1.69×，GPU 变快约 2×。8) AlphaFold3 拒绝 --jax_backend=tpu，且 CPU/GPU 输出分差异显著（最高 32.33%）。

Conclusion: 加速器选择不足以决定实际获得的性能：对 JAX 编写的科学工作负载，性能差距由软件层决定——编译器/追踪冷启动占比、并行原语的选择（vmap 在设备内、pmap 跨设备）、自动分片在缺少 sharding 注解时的复制回退，以及切片是否被充分利用。运行单查询时租用 8 芯片 TPU pod 会浪费 87.5% 容量；显式 pmap 数据并行或外部构建的 ensemble 才能填满切片。结论强调，用户必须理解 JAX 并行原语语义而非依赖默认行为，且基准测试需关注冷启动、跨会话稳定性与计费模式，而非仅看稳态吞吐。

Abstract: AlphaFold2 is written in JAX, so the same inference code compiles and runs unchanged on CPUs, GPUs and Google Cloud TPUs. That portability makes the accelerator look like the main decision a user has to make. We show that it is not. Running one AlphaFold2 inference workload across a Colab CPU runtime, an NVIDIA T4 GPU and a dedicated eight-chip Cloud TPU v5e slice, we find a large hardware advantage for the TPU, 0.47 s per call in steady state on a single chip against 13.1 s on the T4 in the same measurement campaign, and three ways in which the software layer decides how much of it a user actually gets. The default execution path uses one chip of the eight, and at list prices the idle capacity makes the slice cost about as much per prediction as the GPU. Batching with this http URL never exceeds single-query throughput, while mapping queries across chips with this http URL gives eight chips 6.5-7.9x the throughput of one on a matched grid; automatic sharding leaves the per-chip footprint unchanged, consistent with replication, most plausibly because AlphaFold2 carries no sharding annotations. Our retained trace analysis of a first call at a new input shape reports about three quarters of the traced span in JAX tracing and compilation rather than execution. Reruns five weeks later reproduced neither cloud baseline, the GPU one off by roughly a factor of two, so the hardware ratio above is specific to one campaign.

</details>


### [839] [AReaL-TIK: Stateful Agentic Optimization of Unified RL Kernels through an Optimization IR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35140)
*Ran Yan,Youhe Jiang,Jiayi Nie,Wenshuang Li,Yingqi Peng,Taiyi Wang,Tongkai Yang,Binhang Yuan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文提出 AReaL-TIK，一个基于优化中间表示（IR）的智能体框架，用于联合优化 RL 后训练中 rollout 与 policy update 的 GPU 内核，同时保持位级一致性。核心创新在于将数值约束、工作负载测量与实现谱系通过 IR 链接，使智能体能够执行多分支探索并保留中间实现以实现后续优化。在端到端训练中实现 1.10× 平均吞吐加速，孤立层 1.40× 加速，统一注意力搜索在 H20 上达到 2.52× 加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL 后训练（PPO/GRPO）中，rollout 引擎（如 SGLang/vLLM）与 policy update 后端（如 FlashAttention）使用不同的 GPU 内核和执行路径，即使权重不变，数值计算差异（reduction order、精度转换、近似指令）也会扰动 token 概率比，导致训练-推理失配（TIM）。现有方案要么重新计算 log-probabilities 增加前向开销，要么缺乏在保持位级一致性的同时联合优化两种执行路径的方法。同时，已有智能体内核优化器只关注单一路径，缺乏对耦合路径数值依赖与多步优化的系统支持。

Method: 1. 问题形式化：定义实现 I 包含完整源代码，统一约束要求 full-sequence 与 token-wise decode 入口点的输出按位相等（公式 1）；联合优化目标为加权工作负载延迟之和 T(I)（公式 2），并施加每个工作负载的减速限制。2. 优化 IR 设计：包含五种记录类型——机会记录、实现记录、动作记录、审计记录、谱系管理记录，通过有向推导图链接，持久状态包含规范 S、推导图 G、前沿 F、归档 R、机会集合 O、当前最优 I* 和连续无改进计数器 κ。3. 智能体工作流：初始化后循环执行 Action（生成候选）→ Audit（验证与提升）→ Lineage Management（分支管理）；分支操作包括 Continue、Merge、Archive、Abandon。4. 多分支探索：保留已验证但未提升的中间实现，因为某些改进需要多步，中间实现可作为后续优化的父节点。

Result: 1. 端到端训练（Q1）：12 种配置下 H20 上平均吞吐量 1.10× AReaL（带重计算），训练奖励比值约为 1.00×；GRPO 平均 1.14×，PPO 平均 1.07×。2. 孤立层性能（Q2）：15 个模型-GPU 对平均加速 1.40×，13 个有提升；Qwen3-4B/8B 在 A100/H200 平均 2.10×，H20 五个模型平均 1.15×。3. 算子性能（Q3）：10 个算子在 A100、H20、H200 上均通过位级一致性检查；Hidden RMSNorm 预填充平均 10.30×，NeoX RoPE 预填充平均 18.03×、解码 2.90×；注意力由 GPT-6 生成，H200 优化耗时 2.51 小时，A100 耗时 1.38 小时。4. 搜索系统对比（Q4）：H20 统一注意力搜索中，AReaL-TIK 达到 2.52× 最佳聚合加速（SkyDiscover 2.00×、OpenEvolve 1.50×），使用 7M tokens（SkyDiscover 8.5M、OpenEvolve 10M）；在 step 60 时效率优势为 5.8×。5. 消融实验（Q5）：去除多分支谱系管理使加速降至 2.00×；去除持久历史达到 2.50×；去除机会记录、详细审计证据或数值需求达到 2.44-2.46×；去除数值需求时 token 消耗最高达 16M。

Conclusion: AReaL-TIK 证明优化 IR 可作为持久内存支持 RL 后训练耦合内核的联合源码搜索，数值需求、工作负载证据与已验证替代方案在位级一致性约束下支撑多步探索。统一内核在策略快照与概率处理匹配目标时可实现 rollout log-probability 复用，从而消除额外前向开销。端到端评估显示吞吐量提升但奖励存在配置依赖性；孤立层与算子级评估验证了 1.40× 平均加速。框架在搜索效率与可达性能上均优于 OpenEvolve 和 SkyDiscover，谱系管理是最关键的组件，数值需求记录对 token 效率影响最大。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training often uses distinct GPU kernels for rollout and policy update. In synchronous PPO and GRPO, numerical disagreement can perturb ratios between current token probabilities and those assigned during rollout. Recomputing rollout log-probabilities with the policy-update backend avoids this discrepancy but adds a forward pass. Bitwise-consistent unified kernels permit reuse when the policy snapshot and probability processing match the objective. Their optimization must preserve agreement across distinct execution regimes. We present KernelBraid, an agentic framework starting from a hand-tuned, bitwise-consistent implementation. Its optimization intermediate representation (IR) organizes source-code search by linking implementations and modifications to numerical requirements, workload measurements, and derivation history. The agent coordinates changes and retains verified intermediates for further exploration; promotion requires passing correctness checks and improving aggregate latency within per-workload limits. Across 12 end-to-end training configurations on H20, KernelBraid achieves 1.10x average throughput relative to AReaL with log-probability recomputation, and the mean training-reward ratio rounds to 1.00x. Isolated-layer profiling yields 1.40x average speedup in summed phase time across 15 model-GPU pairs. Operator-level evaluation covers correctness and performance for 10 operators on A100, H20, and H200, all passing the prescribed bitwise checks. Unified-attention search achieves 2.52x speedup in summed workload latency over the starting implementation using 7M LLM tokens; ablations assess the contributions of retained evidence and branch exploration to search efficiency and attained performance. Our code is open-sourced at this https URL .

</details>


### [840] [Analyzing Solana's Blocks and Transactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35171)
*Yaron Hay,Dvir David Biton,Roy Friedman*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文对100万个Solana区块进行了实证分析，统计了区块大小、交易执行时间、手续费、调用程序以及基于读集/写集的冲突图特性，发现大多数区块冲突较少但存在长冲突链和近团形结构，并证明基于图着色的并行执行可使区块执行时间提升1.2-3倍（极端情况达10倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Solana是最流行的智能合约区块链之一，声称通过并行执行引擎提升性能，但并行性的实际潜力受限于交易间的冲突。理解Solana上智能合约的执行模式及其交互，对区块链设计者和合约开发者均具有重要价值。同时，现有工作对Solana的实证分析较少且样本规模有限。

Method: 租用Solana全节点，采集100万个连续区块（约#390M-#391M）的交易追踪数据；通过getBlock RPC方法获取完整交易信息，从中提取computeUnitsConsumed、costUnits、fee、accountKeys、instructions等字段；基于writable标志构建读写集，进而构建冲突图；扩展ChainGrapher工具（Python 3.12 + networkx）支持Solana解析；使用DSatur贪心算法估计色数，Monte Carlo方法估计最长路径；将区块按大小分桶分析各类指标。

Result: 主要发现：(1)大多数区块约含1000笔交易，最大达8000笔；(2)交易执行时间与区块大小成反比，但手续费与之无关；(3)冲突图密度低，但存在长冲突链（可达区块大小59%）；(4)冲突交易倾向于形成近团（near-clique）结构而非Ethereum/Sui的hub-and-spoke结构；(5)基于图着色的并行排序策略相比当前任意排序可提速1.2-3倍，极端情况达6-10倍；(6)每笔交易平均调用1-3个程序，访问2-10个纯数据读账户；(7)非标准程序使用量不可忽略，且多数冲突由这些用户定义智能合约产生。

Conclusion: Solana独特的区块构建机制有效降低了冲突数量，但产生了长冲突链和近团结构。基于图着色的执行排序策略能显著改善执行时间。此外，Solana与Ethereum、Sui在冲突结构上的显著差异表明，不存在单一代表性的合成负载能覆盖所有区块链，未来工作可考虑开发参数化的TPC类基准。

Abstract: Solana is one of the most popular blockchains, and is arguably the most widely used blockchain for smart contracts, also known as dApps. Understanding the types of smart contracts that are being executed by Solana and their interplay is therefore highly beneficial both for designers of modern blockchains and developers of smart contracts. To that end, in this paper we analyze a million recent Solana blocks. We report statistics about the size of blocks (number of transactions per block), execution time units for individual transactions and fees, and invoked Solana programs. Further, based on the declared readset and writeset of each transaction, as mandated by Solana, we analyze the conflicts and corresponding conflict graphs arising within each block. These latter statistics are important to understand the potential for parallelism in the network, which is one of the main claimed benefits of Solana. The data and code are available in open source.

</details>


### [841] [Weaver: A System for AI-RAN Compute Sharing with Foundation Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35276)
*Leyang Xue,Tianxin Wang,Xin Zhe Khooi,Jiaxun Yang,Dheeraj Mahendiran,Yufeng Xia,Mun Choon Chan,Myungjin Lee,Mahesh K. Marina*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Weaver是一个利用AI-RAN基站GPU空闲算力进行去中心化基础模型训练的系统。它通过RAN中心的计算感知调度稳定SM预留，并采用两层弹性训练框架适应动态异构的空闲算力，在不损害RAN性能的前提下显著提升训练吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI-RAN基础设施的部署，基站GPU算力巨大（全球估计可达1 ZFLOP），但RAN处理通常仅使用其中15-60%的算力，存在大量时空上互补的空闲资源。与此同时，基础模型训练是计算密集型AI任务，目前高度集中在云端。本文旨在利用RAN分布式空闲GPU算力进行去中心化FM训练，作为云端训练的补充。

Method: 1) 首次刻画AI-RAN微/宏观尺度GPU空闲容量（LDPC解码为内存带宽受限，与计算密集型FM训练互补，40-85%算力空闲且跨站点空间互补）。2) RAN中心空闲算力控制器：集成到MAC调度器，通过计算感知调度（PRB预算、查表法、SM自适应调整、迭代控制）将突发性RAN SM需求平滑为稳定的SM预留，使用CUDA Green Contexts实现微秒级硬件隔离。3) 两层弹性训练框架：跨站点采用AIR（异步跨站点重路由）处理亚秒级波动+MLR（模型布局再平衡）处理持久性负载不均；站内将GEMM分解为细粒度tile，在RAN slot级粒度适配空闲算力。通过发布-订阅接口耦合两者。

Result: 在O-RAN对齐原型系统上，Weaver产生的可用空闲算力提升达4.9倍，消耗高达83%的可用空闲容量；在8站点多站点测试床上，FM训练吞吐量比基线提升2.1-3.7倍；512站点模拟中可训练OPT-70B且吞吐量为基线的4-7倍；且不损害RAN性能（HARQ deadline满足率保持99.8%，应用层KPI与基线相当）。

Conclusion: Weaver证明了利用AI-RAN分布式空闲GPU算力进行FM训练的可行性。其RAN优先设计理念（计算感知调度将突发性平滑为稳定SM预留）和跨时间尺度的两层弹性训练机制，有效解决了细粒度资源动态性与FM训练耦合需求之间的矛盾。该工作为去中心化AI基础设施提供了新范式，但仍有收敛性长期验证、多租户隔离、跨厂商GPU移植等开放问题。

Abstract: The emergence of AI-RAN infrastructure, which equips cell sites with GPU-accelerated hardware, creates an opportunity to colocate non-RAN workloads with primary RAN processing. We explore using this spare capacity for decentralized training of foundation models (FMs), one of the most compute-intensive AI workloads. We present the first characterization of spare GPU capacity in AI-RAN systems at both micro-scale--across transmission slots within a cell site--and macro-scale--across sites. Our analysis finds that 40-85% of GPU capacity is unused; although this capacity is temporally bursty at individual sites, it is spatially complementary across sites. To safely and efficiently harness these resources, we present Weaver, a system that opportunistically trains FMs alongside latency-critical RAN workloads without degrading RAN performance. Weaver adopts a RAN-first design: a spare-compute controller integrated into the MAC scheduler uses compute-aware scheduling to smooth RAN GPU demand and exposes more usable spare GPU capacity. A two-level elastic training framework then adapts to dynamic, heterogeneous spare capacity within and across sites. Experiments on an O-RAN-aligned system prototype show that Weaver creates up to 4.9x more usable spare compute and utilizes up to 83% of the available spare capacity. On a multi-site testbed, Weaver improves training throughput by 2.1-3.7x over baseline approaches.

</details>


### [842] [TopoEP: Topology-Aware Load Balancing for Expert-Parallel MoE Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35481)
*Jiacheng Zhu,Xie Zhao,Gongming Zhao,Hongli Xu,Yao Fei,Jin Fang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: TopoEP 是一个面向专家并行 MoE 训练的 GPU 原生、拓扑感知的负载均衡系统，通过两阶段确定性 GPU 求解器在每个 MoE 层和微批次内生成热专家复制与 token 重路由方案，在保持训练收敛性的同时将端到端吞吐量提升 6.2%–11.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模专家并行 MoE 训练中，动态路由导致专家负载严重倾斜，承载热专家的 GPU 成为拖慢整个 EP 阶段的 straggler。现有 EPLB 系统通常在 CPU 上规划方案，引入 device-host 数据传输与跨 rank 同步，使其难以在每一层和每个微批次的临界路径上高效运行；同时其规划模型忽略了 NVLink（域内）与 RDMA（域间）的层次化通信开销差异，无法在跨域副本放置与跨域 token 流量之间取得权衡。

Method: 系统由三部分组成：(1) GPU 原生负载均衡器：EP 组内 all-gather 后，每个 rank 基于全局路由矩阵 Ω，独立运行确定性的两阶段 GPU 求解器——阶段一为跨域放置（inter-node placement），按收益 b_{d,e}=2D_{d,e}S_tok−‖W_e‖ 筛选跨域副本；阶段二为域内细化（intra-node refinement），在每个 NVLink 域内通过迭代迁移降低剩余 rank 负载不均。整个流程以 block 级并发、共享内存缓存与 warp 级归约实现，无需数据相关的 host 同步。(2) 副本缓冲管理：为每个 rank 预分配 N_slot 个可复用副本槽，仅存放 BF16 参数（前向复用，后向存放副本梯度），通过对称内存窗口注册，由 TMA 处理域内 NVLink 传输、NCCL GIN 处理域间 RDMA 一侧传输。(3) 细粒度两 chunk 流水线：将路由 token 分成 c_1 与 c_2 两块，通信流与计算流分别调度，使 c_2 的 dispatch、c_1 的 combine、参数重拉取与梯度回收等开销被另一 chunk 的专家 FFN 计算所掩盖。形式化上，该方案是带副本容量、跨域放置判据与主实例固定等约束的联合副本放置 + token 重路由整数优化，通过两阶段启发式求可行解。

Result: 在 32 块 NVIDIA H800（4 节点 × 8 GPU，NVLink+NVSwitch 域内，rail-optimized InfiniBand 域间）集群上，与 Megatron-LM 基线相比：自然路由下端到端吞吐量在 Qwen3-30B-A3B、GLM-4.5-Air、DeepSeek-V2 上分别提升 9.5%、11.4%、6.2%；跨域 token–expert 分配比例从 50.0%–75.0% 降至 0.91%–1.88%；最大-平均 rank 负载比最低降至 1.03–1.41；求解器 kernel 在 EP=128、E=640 时仅 510 µs；straggler 专家计算时间下降 49.2%–64.0%，dispatch/combine 时间下降 34.9%–65.3%；10,000 步训练 loss 曲线与基线无可见差异。

Conclusion: TopoEP 通过将拓扑感知规划与 GPU 原生执行相结合，能够在不修改 Top-k 路由、不损害模型收敛的前提下，有效缓解大规模专家并行 MoE 训练中的负载不均与跨域通信开销，可作为 Megatron-LM 等训练框架的即插即用 EPLB 方案。

Abstract: Dynamic routing creates severe load imbalance in large-scale expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training, turning GPUs that host hot experts into stragglers. As each MoE layer waits for its slowest rank, these stragglers prolong the expert-parallel stage and reduce overall training efficiency. Existing expert-parallelism load-balancing (EPLB) systems commonly compute load-balancing plans on the CPU, incurring device--host data transfers and cross-rank synchronization that make scheduling at every layer and microbatch expensive. Their planning formulations also overlook the hierarchical communication costs of modern scale-up and scale-out GPU clusters. We present \textit{TopoEP}, a GPU-native, topology-aware load-balancing system for large-scale MoE training. At each MoE layer and training microbatch, \textit{TopoEP} converts the current routing result into hot-expert replication and token-rerouting decisions and executes the resulting plan without data-dependent host synchronization, reducing critical-path overhead. To generate these decisions, \textit{TopoEP} uses a deterministic GPU solver that performs inter-node placement followed by intra-node refinement, allowing all ranks to independently produce bitwise-identical plans. On a 32-GPU NVIDIA H800 cluster, integrating \textit{TopoEP} with Megatron-LM improves end-to-end training throughput by 6.2\%--11.4\% across three representative MoE models.

</details>


### [843] [Dynamic Wakeup under Costly Collisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35662)
*Umesh Biswas,Maxwell Young*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究动态唤醒问题中带代价碰撞的情形。设计了Lowball随机算法（无需碰撞检测且未知n），在大代价ℰ ≥ K·lg^(1/ε) n时取得期望延迟O(ℰ^(1/2+ε) ln ℰ)与期望碰撞代价O(√ℰ)；小代价时两者均为O(n·log^Θ(1/ε) n)。同时证明了基于年龄的批公平算法类中，最大期望延迟与碰撞代价至少为Ω(√ℰ) Ω(n/log n)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统唤醒算法只关注延迟，但实际无线系统中碰撞常带来显著额外延迟（WiFi传播延迟、长距离链路、移动网络等）。同时控制延迟与碰撞代价在大规模动态场景下面临根本性权衡——激进的传输策略缩短延迟但增加碰撞，保守策略反之。已有算法如DecreaseSlowly在动态唤醒中表现强延迟但会产生大量碰撞代价。

Method: Lowball算法：初始发送概率极低（1/w₀=2^(-ℰ^ε)），迭代由增长阶段Gₖ与缩减阶段Sₖ构成。每包按本地年龄分块（每块m=⌈d√ℰ ln ℰ⌉个时隙）。Gₖ中发送概率从1/w₀倍增至>1/2；Sₖ中发送概率从1开始倍减，迭代k中Sₖ长度翻倍。关键工具：1) 将时隙按竞争度（低/优/高）分类，目标区域ℊ=[α/√ℰ, β/√ℰ]；2) 通过Cauchy-Schwarz和碰撞概率引理控制延迟；3) 通过ℓ时间隔中"清洁缩减窗口"包含m连续优竞争时隙的概率论证。

Result: 大ℰ区域：期望延迟O(ℰ^(1/2+ε) ln ℰ)，期望碰撞代价O(√ℰ)；小ℰ区域：两者均为O(n·log^Θ(1/ε) n)。对年龄基批公平类算法证明了ℳ_A(n,ℰ)≥√ℰ/2下界，且该下界在固定ℰ时与经典Ω(n/log n)下界的关系得以澄清。Lowball的延迟上界在ε选择后距最优差因子O(ℰ^ε ln ℰ)。

Conclusion: Lowball在动态唤醒（无碰撞检测、未知n、自适应对手）下同时实现了低延迟与低碰撞代价，其O(√ℰ)碰撞代价上界与Ω(√ℰ)下界在量级上匹配，最大期望指标距离年龄基批公平类算法的最优差O(ℰ^ε ln ℰ)因子。遗留问题：1) 能否缩小此差距；2) 将下界推广至非年龄基/非批公平算法。经典Ω(n/log n)下界在ℰ随n变化时不能与√ℰ下界简单合并。

Abstract: The wakeup problem captures a fundamental symmetry-breaking challenge among devices sharing a communication channel. We study the dynamic setting, where packets become active at arbitrary times on a time-slotted multiple access channel. In each slot, a transmission succeeds if and only if exactly one packet transmits; two or more simultaneous transmissions cause a collision. The goal is to obtain a successful transmission quickly. Prior work on wakeup has largely focused on the number of slots until the first success, referred to as the latency. However, a collision may incur substantial additional delay, represented by a per-collision cost $C$. We therefore seek to control both latency and the collision cost of an execution, defined as $C$ times its number of collisions. We design and analyze a randomized algorithm for dynamic wakeup, Lowball, without collision detection or knowledge of the number of packets, $n$. Fix a constant $0<\epsilon\le 1/2$. There is a constant $K>0$ such that, when $C\ge K\lg^{1/\epsilon} n$, Lowball has expected latency $O(C^{1/2+\epsilon}\ln C)$ and expected collision cost $O(\sqrt{C})$. Below this threshold, both expectations are $O(n\log^{\Theta(1/\epsilon)} n)$. These guarantees hold against an adaptive, non-anticipating adversary, and the algorithm succeeds with probability 1. For algorithms in which each packet's transmission probability depends only on $C$ and the packet's local age, with packets activated together using the same probability schedule, we prove that the maximum of expected latency and expected collision cost is $\Omega(\sqrt{C})$.

</details>

### [844] [MM-VeriRec: Failure-Guided Fusion for Verifiable Agentic Multimodal Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31718)
*Yufeng Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MM-VeriRec 是一个针对多模态推荐的可验证基准协议和失败引导融合方法。它通过电影海报（MM-ML-1M）和产品图像（Amazon All_Beauty）数据集，揭示智能体在隐藏视觉约束、图文矛盾和不可能任务弃权场景下的失败模式（文本陷阱、视觉忽视、错误接受），并将失败标签映射到对应修复策略（阈值弃权、矛盾惩罚、属性门控），实现诊断-修复闭环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态推荐评估过度依赖文本指标，无法区分不同失败模式；推荐智能体需要能够基于图像证据推理、识别视觉不可能请求并弃权，但缺乏可验证的诊断工具来揭示失败原因并指导修复。

Method: 提出 MM-VeriRec 协议：构建包含用户历史、候选目录、可见文本偏好和隐藏视觉约束的任务；使用确定性视觉属性（亮度、颜色、对比度、风格）作为验证器；定义失败分类法（文本陷阱、视觉忽视、错误接受、策略违规等）；设计失败引导融合控制器，根据活跃失败模式选择对应修复（视觉验证阈值、文本陷阱惩罚、自适应属性门控）。所有修复均为确定性规则，无在线学习。

Result: 在 MM-ML-1M（360 任务）和 Amazon All_Beauty（270 任务）上：纯文本检索成功率约 0.36–0.37；MiniLM/CLIP 嵌入提升部分基线但无法消除结构性失败；自适应引导融合在验证器对齐的门控下达到 1.0000（MM-ML-1M）和 0.8963（Amazon）；使用独立 LOO CLIP 检测器（非对齐门）时仍达到 0.7028 和 0.6111，超过 VBPR 和纯融合基线；修复机制的有效性因领域而异（MM-ML-1M 先需要矛盾处理，Amazon 主要需要属性门控）。

Conclusion: MM-VeriRec 既是一个基准，也是一个实用的诊断循环，用于可信的智能体多模态推荐。核心教训是融合应当基于失败条件而非均匀多模态混合；更强嵌入有所帮助，但可验证诊断才是将多模态证据转化为可靠推荐行为的关键。基准定位为受控的低层视觉属性压力测试，不替代开放世界多模态评估；未来工作应扩展至人类验证的视觉标签、更丰富偏好和更大规模目录。

Abstract: Images often carry recommendation constraints that text metadata only hints at. A movie may need to look dark, a product may need a minimal style, and a visually impossible request should be rejected. Agentic multimodal recommenders must reason over text-image evidence, decide when visual evidence is decisive, and abstain when no valid action exists. We introduce MM-VeriRec, a verifiable multimodal recommendation protocol and failure-guided fusion method for hidden visual constraints, image-text mismatch, and impossible-task abstention. MM-VeriRec builds tasks from real movie-poster and product-image datasets, verifies each recommendation with deterministic visual attributes, and converts failures into actionable labels: text-trap following, visual ignorance, and false acceptance. Fusion should not merely concatenate modalities, but should diagnose which modality failed and route to the appropriate repair. Across MM-ML 1M and Amazon Reviews datasets, stronger text and vision embeddings improve retrieval but do not remove these failure modes, whereas failure-guided fusion does. The adaptive attribute gate reads the same tags the verifier checks and its scores are verifier-aligned upper bounds testing whether the taxonomy routes to the correct repair. More informative is transfer under a non-aligned gate: an independently derived leave-one-out CLIP detector still reaches 0.7028 and 0.6111 visual-grounded success, above both a VBPR baseline and plain fusion. The text-versus-visual gap reproduces across two LLM families, and the repair that helps differs by domain. MM-VeriRec is both a benchmark and a practical diagnostic loop for trustworthy agentic multimodal recommendation.

</details>


### [845] [Overview of the TREC 2025 Million Large Language Models track](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31921)
*Evangelos Kanoulas,Panagiotis Eustratiadis,Jamie Callan,Mark Sanderson,Yongkang Li,Jingfen Qiao,Gabrielle Poerwawinata,Vaishali Pal*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文介绍了TREC 2025 Million LLM Track，提出了一种新的检索范式——将检索目标从文档转向专家LLM本身。任务基于超过1000个模拟的领域专家LLM，参与者需根据模型在发现集上的可观测行为推断其专长，并在测试时对未见查询进行LLM排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着Agentic AI生态的发展，未来将出现数百万个领域专精的LLM。传统的文档检索范式已无法满足需求，需要一种能够动态评估模型专长、从可观测行为中推断能力的新型检索系统，以实现高效、自适应的专家模型选择。

Method: 使用RAG范式构建1131个模拟专家LLM（共享基础LLM + 专用检索器 + 独特文档集合）。基于ClueWeb22语料库，利用Bing语义标签进行K-means聚类生成1500个文档簇，通过prompt engineering和查询过滤减少知识泄露。采用单一全局索引的BM25检索策略实现高效扩展。提供发现集（含查询-答案-对数概率）、开发集（带相关性标签）和测试集供参与者训练和评估。

Result: 6个团队共提交19个runs。最佳系统nDCG@10达0.17447（submission_4），前三名（0.15-0.17区间）均基于无监督方法，表明模型响应中的行为信号（答案结构、词汇线索）对预测未来专长高度有效。使用devset进行有监督训练的系统表现中等（0.147-0.152），受限于开发集规模小（342个查询）及与测试查询分布差异。测试集仅16个查询且无人工相关性判断。

Conclusion: Million LLM Track首次将检索目标重新定义为专家模型排序，标志着信息访问从文档排序向专家模型选择与编排的根本转变。尽管在数据集建立方面面临挑战（测试查询少、缺乏人工判断），该任务为研究如何从行为证据推断模型专长提供了受控环境，参与者探索了从经典IR启发式到有监督神经架构的多种排序策略。

Abstract: Agentic AI envisions ecosystems of intelligent agents collaboratively solving complex tasks with minimal human intervention. In such ecosystems, each agent possesses specialized expertise, making effective expert selection central to overall system performance. While most current approaches assume a small number of well-documented models, real-world expertise is far more diverse and cannot be adequately captured through static metadata or hand-written descriptions. We anticipate a future with millions of specialized language models (LLMs), each excelling in different domains or problem types. Rather than relying on predefined capability statements, we propose a retrieval-based paradigm in which an assistant agent infers expertise dynamically by examining models' observable behavior. Upon receiving a user query, the assistant ranks candidate LLMs based on demonstrated competence, enabling efficient and adaptive expert selection. The TREC Million LLM Track operationalizes this paradigm by shifting the retrieval target from documents to expert LLMs. Participants are given a discovery set consisting of queries, answers, and log-probabilities from more than one thousand LLMs and are challenged to infer meaningful expertise representations for each model. Given an unseen test query, systems must then rank the LLMs according to their expected performance, providing the first large-scale benchmark for expertise retrieval in agentic AI.

</details>


### [846] [Inspire: Benchmarking Scientific Literature Search for Open Research Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33233)
*Jianrong Ding,Zhengyan Shi,Jianyuan Zhong,Kai Qiu,Qi Dai,Yifan Yang,Chong Luo,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: INSPIRE是一个用于评估智能体在开放研究问题下进行科学文献搜索能力的基准，将搜索过程解构为资源暴露（resource exposure）、选择（selection）和排序（ranking）三个耦合阶段，并基于截断日期后的目标论文引用谱系进行分级评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学搜索基准通常在搜索前或搜索过程中固定相关性标准（如线索、约束条件、候选集等），无法同时衡量智能体在搜索全流程中各阶段的失败原因。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出一个从开放问题出发、无预设相关性线索、且能诊断各阶段瓶颈的基准。

Method: 1. 数据构建：以影响力较高的近期CS论文为靶标，取靶标发布日期前3个月为截止日期，将靶标摘要改写为去除解决方案的"问题简报"，并对其截止前引用文献进行角色敏感的分级标注（T1/T2/T3概念性或基础设施性）。2. 评估协议：智能体在开放语料库上交互式搜索，提交最多10篇排序论文，评估采用分级nDCG@10。3. 阶段分解：基于日志轨迹计算暴露增益（Exposed gain）、选择增益（Selected gain）和最终nDCG@10，定位各阶段损失。4. 匹配实验：使用事后监督微调（hindsight SFT）验证基准的学习信号有效性。

Result: 在476个CS靶标上，最强智能体（Claude Opus 5）达到0.284 nDCG@10，72.3%的靶标至少恢复一个引用前驱，但仅32.1%能恢复三个；暴露增益是最大瓶颈（零暴露率17.4%-56.1%），选择与排序阶段存在进一步损失。事后SFT将Qwen3.6-35B-A3B的nDCG@10从0.082提升至0.166，暴露增益从0.153提升至0.251，表明基准提供了可操作的学习信号。

Conclusion: 当前智能体更擅长恢复单个孤立前驱而非构建广泛的相关文献组合；资源暴露是最大的观测瓶颈。INSPIRE通过阶段分解诊断和三阶段评估框架，既支持端到端比较，也支持针对性模型开发，证明了科学文献搜索需要作为耦合的多阶段过程来理解和改进。

Abstract: Scientific literature search often begins with an open research problem rather than a known target paper or a fixed candidate set. We introduce INSPIRE, a benchmark for evaluating agents that search prior literature to make progress on solution-redacted research problems. Each instance pairs a research brief with a target-specific cutoff three months before a later paper and evaluates ranked outputs against graded cited antecedents from that paper's realized research lineage. Search proceeds over an open corpus, while the identity of the target paper and membership of its cited antecedents remain hidden from the agent. Beyond end-to-end retrieval quality, INSPIRE uses logged search trajectories to distinguish three coupled stages: resource exposure, whether useful antecedents are surfaced during search; selection, whether exposed antecedents are retained; and ranking, how effectively retained papers are ordered. Across 476 computer-science targets under a shared search interface and budget, the strongest evaluated agent achieves 0.284 nDCG@10. Results show that current agents more readily recover an isolated antecedent than assemble a broader portfolio of relevant prior work. The stagewise analysis identifies resource exposure as the largest observed bottleneck, with further losses in selection and ranking. We additionally construct replay-valid hindsight demonstrations and show that they improve held-out search without changing test-time information, establishing that the benchmark provides an actionable learning signal. INSPIRE therefore enables both end-to-end comparison and stage-resolved diagnosis in a setting where the agent must construct its own working criterion of relevance.

</details>


### [847] [STITCH-RAG: Spatio-Temporal Influence Tracing over Topic Hypergraphs for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34127)
*Haodong Yang,Mengzhu Chen,Jia Cai*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: STITCH-RAG是一个面向多跳检索增强生成（RAG）的超图框架，通过半合并主题超图保留主题级共参与和块级实体状态，结合时空影响桥接传播（STIBP）与连续先验的个性化PageRank（PPR），在HotpotQA和2WikiMultiHopQA上取得了最高的Contain-Acc和LLM-Acc点估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG索引存在两个互补缺陷：基于块的RAG会断裂跨段落证据链；无标签的成对投影缺乏生成主题溯源，无法同时保留主题级共参与和逐出现实体描述。该研究旨在弥合这两个差距，提升多跳问答中的证据检索能力。

Method: 方法包含三个耦合组件：(1) 半合并主题超图，将多实体共参与编码为主题摘要超边，同时通过规范名等价保留逐块实体状态；(2) 时空影响桥接传播（STIBP），结合主题空间传播与跨名称等价状态的确定性块索引链接，使用频率自适应衰减函数 f(Δt)=exp(-tanh(αΔt))，其中 α=n_u/n̄；(3) 用连续STIBP分数替代二元实体匹配种子作为局部化PPR的先验，并提供了理论刻画（命题1-3和定理1）。

Result: 在HotpotQA和2WikiMultiHopQA上，STITCH-RAG在Contain-Acc和LLM-Acc指标上均取得最高报告点估计，相对最强基线有3.9/0.8和5.6/1.1点的提升；在Recall@8上也优于标准化检索对比方法。消融实验表明STIBP和PPR各自贡献非冗余增益，频率自适应衰减优于固定和指数衰减。

Conclusion: STITCH-RAG通过耦合主题保留超边、半合并局部实体状态、频率自适应STIBP和连续先验PPR，在多跳检索任务上表现出优越性。但理论结果仅刻画机制而非端到端最优性保证，且存在提取与名称链接错误、预处理顺序敏感等局限。

Abstract: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation requires a retriever to connect evidence distributed across documents while preserving a concise, faithful generation context. Existing indexes leave two complementary gaps: chunk-based RAG can break cross-passage evidence chains, whereas an unlabeled pairwise projection without generating-topic provenance cannot jointly preserve topic-level co-participation and per-occurrence entity descriptions. We propose STITCH-RAG, a hypergraph-based framework with three coupled components. First, a semi-merged topic hypergraph encodes multi-entity co-participation as topic-summary hyperedges while retaining per-chunk entity states linked by canonical-name equivalence. Second, spatio-temporal influence bridging propagation (STIBP) combines topic-space propagation with deterministic chunk-index linkage across name-equivalent states under frequency-adaptive decay. Third, continuous STIBP scores replace binary entity-match seeds in localized Personalized PageRank (PPR). We characterize the condition under which this prior assigns more PPR mass to ground-truth evidence than a binary prior. Under the reported protocol, STITCH-RAG attains the highest reported Contain-Acc and LLM-Acc point estimates among the compared methods on HotpotQA and 2WikiMultiHopQA, and higher Recall@8 than the methods included in the standardized retrieval comparison. Results on the mixed-domain benchmark remain auxiliary preference-based evidence because only LLM-judged accuracy is available.

</details>


### [848] [Eval4DiRec: A Unified and Systematic Evaluation Framework for Diffusion-based Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34404)
*Cong Wang,Shoujin Wang,Yishuo Li,Qi Zhang,Liang Hu,Wenpeng Lu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Eval4DiRec 是首个专为基于扩散模型的推荐系统（Diffusion-based RSs）设计的统一、开源、可复现的评估框架，支持 5 种推荐场景中 14 种代表性扩散推荐模型，提供一致的数据处理、训练配置、推理流程与评估协议，并基于此框架展开了系统性实证研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型凭借强大的生成能力和稳定的训练动力学，在推荐系统领域受到越来越多关注。然而，现有研究普遍存在数据处理不一致、数据划分策略不同、训练配置各异、推理流程缺乏标准化以及评估协议不统一等问题，导致实验结果难以复现、跨研究比较不公平，亟需一个统一且系统化的基准框架来推动该领域的公平评估与可持续发展。

Method: 提出 Eval4DiRec 框架，包含四个核心模块：（1）Data 模块：统一数据预处理与场景化划分（CF、序列、多模态、POI、跨域），自动记录统计信息并生成标准化 DataLoader；（2）DiRec 模块：解耦推荐主干与扩散过程，将扩散步数、噪声调度、噪声分布、采样器等作为框架级可配置组件；（3）Execution 模块：统一训练-验证-测试流程，支持早停与 checkpoint 选择；（4）Utils 模块：提供配置解析、随机种子管理、日志与指标计算。框架集成 14 个代表性模型（CF 4 个：CODIGEM、DiffRec、CF-Diff、DDRM；序列 5 个：DiffuRec、DiffuASR、T-DiffRec、CaDiRec、CDDRec；多模态 3 个：MCDRec、DiffMM、CCDRec；POI 1 个：Diff-POI；跨域 1 个：DiffCDR），并在 12 个公开数据集上进行评估，使用 Recall@20、NDCG@20、HR@20、MRR@20 四个指标，并配套扩散配置分析、鲁棒性分析、长尾分析等诊断实验。

Result: 实验得到以下核心发现：（1）整体性能：扩散推荐模型整体具有竞争力，DiffRec 在 CF 的 Yelp/ML-1M 上最佳，DDRM 在 Beauty 上最佳；CDDRec 在序列推荐三个数据集上均最佳；DiffMM 在 TikTok 多模态上最佳，CCDRec 在 Baby/Sports 上最佳；Diff-POI 在 POI 上显著优于 STAN；DiffCDR 在三个跨域任务上均优于 PTUPCDR。（2）扩散配置影响：线性和指数噪声调度最稳定；扩散步数较少时性能最佳，过多步数反而下降；高斯噪声分布最稳定但其他分布在特定数据集上可有增益。（3）鲁棒性：在 10%-50% 数据缺失或噪声注入下，扩散模型性能下降幅度显著小于非扩散基线。（4）长尾性能：扩散模型在长尾物品上的性能衰减更平缓，呈现更一致的尾部增益。（5）效率：扩散推荐模型普遍带来显著的训练与推理开销，需在精度与效率间权衡。

Conclusion: Eval4DiRec 为扩散推荐系统提供了首个统一、可复现的评估基础设施，揭示了扩散模型在推荐中的潜力与其面临的实际挑战。未来工作将从架构层面进一步解耦扩散过程组件（状态空间、扰动核、调度器、采样器等），并从评估层面拓展至多样性、校准性、公平性等可靠性维度，同时探索少步推理、轻量采样器与知识蒸馏等降低部署成本的路径。

Abstract: Leveraging the strong generative capabilities and stable training dynamics of diffusion models, diffusion-based recommender systems (RSs) have recently emerged as a novel recommendation paradigm, attracting increasing attention from both academia and industry. However, despite the rapid growth of diffusion-based RSs, a critical issue has emerged: the lack of a unified and systematic quantitative evaluation benchmark, which often results in irreproducible experimental results and unfair comparisons across studies due to inconsistent data processing, training configurations, inference procedures, and evaluation protocols. To address this challenge, we propose Eval4DiRec, the first unified and open-source evaluation framework specifically designed for diffusion-based RSs. Eval4DiRec supports 14 representative diffusion-based RS models across five different recommendation scenarios, providing consistent and reproducible experimental settings to systematically assess their performance. Built upon this framework, we conduct extensive empirical studies to benchmark these models under unified protocols. The results highlight the strong potential of diffusion models for recommendation while also revealing key factors and practical challenges that substantially affect their performance, thereby establishing a solid foundation to facilitate fair evaluation and guide future research in this promising field. Our code and data are available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [849] [PEAR: Progressive Evidence-Based AutoResearch for Industrial Search Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35031)
*Yifan Wang,Shipeng Zhu,Fei Xiong,Yuqin Yang,Yonghui Huang,Kunyao Wu,Yue Wang,Weichao Meng,Yu Gong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PEAR（Progressive Evidence-Based AutoResearch）是一个面向工业搜索系统的自动化研究框架，通过"证据驱动的AutoResearch"和"置信门控验证阶梯"两个互补组件，解决非平稳流量下可靠知识积累和异构评估证据统一指导候选晋升的挑战。在真实电商搜索系统的A/B实验中，分别使Main Order/DAU提升2.7336%和3.2957%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业搜索系统的策略需要持续迭代优化，但现有AutoResearch方法面临两大挑战：(1) 常用的"keep-if-better"规则在非平稳流量下易将瞬时增益误判为持续改进，损害搜索知识的可靠积累；(2) 候选修改可在多个保真度级别（从低成本代理到在线验证）评估，现有方法缺乏统一基础来跨级别利用证据指导搜索。

Method: PEAR包含两个互补组件：(1) 证据驱动的AutoResearch——为每个策略任务维护独立的、假设指导的研究状态（包含实验上下文、当前假设、候选干预空间和累积证据），通过Plan-Execute-Evaluate-Update转换循环演化，并融入贝叶斯优化启发的推理以平衡精化与探索；(2) 置信门控验证阶梯——将评估组织为四个递进保真度级别（L1离线回放、L2影子流量评估、L3快速在线评估、L4决策级在线评估），采用基于置信区间的统一晋升规则（PROMOTE/RETAIN/STOP），仅在统计显著正向效应时才晋升候选。

Result: 在真实工业搜索系统上的实验验证了三个研究问题：(1) 证据驱动假设修订——任务A通过控制性干预从G=(3,2)演进到容量中心假设G=(2,2)；任务B三个阶段中，前两阶段L4无显著增益，修订假设后第三阶段获得显著订单增益；(2) 渐进式候选评估——代理预测与在线结果在订单维度上的有符号相对误差为-3.49%，两个任务A候选从L2到L4保持方向一致的正向效应；(3) 在线有效性——任务A和任务B的策略在决策级在线A/B实验中分别使Main Order/DAU显著提升2.7336%和3.2957%，并在ASN、SKU Order/DAU等多个辅助业务指标上也获得统计显著的增益。

Conclusion: PEAR框架通过上下文证据和渐进式评估实现了可靠的工业搜索迭代优化。证据驱动AutoResearch将假设与证据及其实验上下文关联，支持可靠的知识积累；置信门控验证阶梯通过统一的置信区间基础晋升门连接四个评估级别。两个组件共同将评估结果转化为指导候选晋升和假设修订的信号，将低成本探索与决策级在线评估相连接。未来工作将探索更广泛的干预范围，包括模型架构和训练过程。局限性在于当前仅在单一电商通用搜索环境中验证，且搜索空间限于策略级参数。

Abstract: AutoResearch improves systems through iterative experimentation: agents propose candidate modifications, evaluate them, and use the results to guide subsequent exploration. Applying this paradigm to industrial search presents two challenges. (1) Common AutoResearch approaches follow a keep-if-better rule, retaining the highest-scoring candidate for subsequent experiments. Under non-stationary traffic, transient gains may be mistaken for persistent improvements, impairing reliable accumulation of search knowledge. (2) Candidate modifications can be evaluated at multiple fidelity levels, from low-cost proxies to online validation, differing in cost, objective alignment, and statistical reliability. Existing methods rely on individual signals or task-specific procedures, lacking a unified basis for using evidence across levels to guide search. We introduce Progressive Evidence-Based AutoResearch (PEAR) with two complementary components. Evidence-driven AutoResearch maintains an independent, hypothesis-guided research state for each strategy task within a predefined objective and intervention scope. Each state evolves through a Plan-Execute-Evaluate-Update transition that links experimentation to context-aware evidence interpretation and hypothesis revision. Confidence-Gated Verifier Ladder organizes evaluation into four levels of increasing fidelity: Offline Replay, Shadow-Traffic Evaluation, Rapid Online Evaluation, and Decision-Grade Online Evaluation. A unified confidence-based gate promotes candidates only when evidence supports a statistically significant positive effect, enabling broad low-cost exploration while reserving costly online experiments for promoted candidates. In a real-world industrial search system, strategies optimized with PEAR significantly increased Main Order/DAU by 2.7336% and 3.2957% relative to their respective baselines in two A/B experiments.

</details>


### [850] [Data Processing for Offline Evaluation in Recommender Systems: a Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31696)
*Alberto Carlo Maria Mancino,Angela Di Fazio,Danilo Danese,Matteo Attimonelli,Daniele Malitesta,Antonio Ferrara,Claudio Pomo,Tommaso Di Noia*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Offline evaluation is the dominant experimental paradigm in recommender systems research, enabling reproducible and cost-effective comparisons on historical interaction data. Yet, while considerable attention has been devoted to recommendation models and evaluation methodologies, the data processing decisions that precede model training have received less scrutiny. These decisions determine the information available to recommendation algorithms and can affect the comparability and reproducibility of experimental results. This survey provides a systematic, cross-domain characterisation of data processing practices for the offline evaluation of recommender systems. We examine the data-centric pipeline, from dataset selection and interaction representation to data preparation, multimodal feature extraction, and train-validation-test splitting. Our analysis spans recommendation paradigms, including collaborative, sequential, session-based, graph-based, knowledge-aware, context-aware, multimodal, federated, cross-domain, contrastive-learning, and LLM-based recommendation. Beyond reviewing existing practices, we introduce a unified framework and taxonomy for describing data transformations and feature-extraction strategies, distinguishing data preparation from the extraction of representations from multimodal side information. Our empirical analysis reveals a landscape dominated by a narrow set of dataset-level transformations, particularly support-driven filtering, while representation-dependent transformations remain less common. We further identify substantial heterogeneity in how auxiliary information is prepared and represented, as well as inconsistencies in the specification of data splitting protocols, where similar labels may conceal different experimental conditions.

### [851] [Recipe-Matching, Not Equivalence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31927)
*Ali Habibullah,Mohammad Alshiekh,Yazan Alshoibi,Salman Khan,Naeemullah Khan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MathNet-Retrieve asks a retriever to find, for a math problem, a document stating the same problem. An LLM under one fixed prompt writes each gold document and its near-miss distractors; LLM judges filter them. We call this procedure the "recipe", training on pairs built the same way "recipe-matching", and ask how much score it buys beyond the ability the benchmark claims to test. Two models from one base, matched in rows and settings, differ only in the training file: pairs written under the benchmark's published prompt by another vendor's LLM and judge, or computer-algebra-verified pairs with no LLM anywhere. The first leads by 45 R@1 points on the easy tier. By a non-LLM paraphrase control, half to two thirds of that gap comes from the pairs being LLM-written at all: LLM rewrites under two unrelated prompts, with the verified model's negatives, recover 30 and 22 of the 45 points; back-translations with the same negatives recover almost none. The remaining 15 to 25 points appear only under the benchmark's own prompt and vanish on real duplicates no generator wrote, the same problem in two languages. The hard tier rewards the recipe's pair structure, a deep rewrite against a minimal-edit near-miss: LLM rewrites alone score zero on it, attaching negatives unlocks it, and every negative that does so costs cross-language points; the sets scoring highest on it separate near-misses no LLM wrote worse than LLM rewrites with verified negatives. MELD also moves when a model trains on pairs built its way, without losing retention; on SABER-Math the registered attack fails, and the one gain, from its LLM-written summaries, is small but holds at a matched budget. Only on MathNet-Retrieve could we pin an inversion, benchmark score up and real retention down, to one edit of a training file. We release the generator-free duplicate evaluations, the near-miss test and three trained models.

### [852] [When Does Dense Retrieval Need Asymmetric Geometry? A Bias-Variance Theory of Shared and Dual Projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32488)
*Maojun Sun,Yancheng Yuan,Jian Huang,Ruijian Han*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Dense retrieval powers retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, and question answering, yet the theoretical basis for choosing between shared and dual query-document projections remains unclear. We introduce a bias-variance theory for low-rank bilinear scoring. Shared projections induce positive-semidefinite operators, whereas dual projections realize arbitrary low-rank operators. We derive their exact approximation gap and prove a local Gaussian boundary: dual has lower risk exactly when squared directional signal exceeds the estimation cost of its additional degrees of freedom. This boundary motivates the Cross-fitted Asymmetry Risk Selector (CARS), which estimates reproducible directional signal from training pairs; its Gaussian counterpart admits exact selection-power and regret formulas. Guided by the theory, we run retrieval experiments across multiple datasets and embedding models. The mean Dual-minus-Shared NDCG@10 advantage more than doubles as query rotation increases from 0 degrees to 90 degrees. In the rank-sample-size grids, Shared wins 13 of 16 cells at n=32, whereas Dual wins all 32 cells at n=1024 and n=2048. Consistent with this shift, all 168 comparable operator-risk curves move toward Dual as training data grow. Compared to the two fixed-geometry baselines, CARS reduces held-out regret by 49-96% and achieves 90.1% mean geometry-selection accuracy.

### [853] [Mend the Measurement Gap: Latent User Preference Modeling for Short-Form Video Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32839)
*Shuo Chang,Yueqi Wang,Zihuan Diao,Ali Montazer,Jiangguo Zhang,Joyneel Misra,Dapeng Hong,Tomer Margolin,Sourabh Bansod,Ningren Han*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Recommender systems rely heavily on heterogeneous behavioral feedback to infer user preference. Although abundant, these signals are imperfect measurements: the same observed behavior can arise from different underlying states, such as genuine enjoyment, passive consumption, or inattention. The challenge is especially acute in short-form video, where watch-based signals are strongly affected by measurement confounders such as video duration - the same watch time can imply different levels of preference for videos of different lengths, while ratio-based metrics can systematically favor short videos. As a result, optimizing raw engagement can amplify measurement artifacts rather than improving user value. We propose a Factorized Latent Value Model (FLVM) for measuring user preference from heterogeneous behavioral feedback. The model treats observed behaviors as noisy measurements of a low-dimensional, factorized latent value state and uses structured output heads to model heterogeneous feedback signals. A restricted baseline path captures predictable variation from measurement-confounding features such as video duration, user propensity, and session context, while a routed latent path estimates preference-relevant value advantage. The resulting latent value score can be integrated into an existing recommender system as a ranking feature or ranking score. On YouTube Shorts, a major short-form video platform, this model improves offline metrics and lifts a primary viewer enjoyment metric by 2.67% in online A/B tests.

### [854] [Recommendation Ranking Off-Policy Evaluation under Ranking-Dependent Examination via Examination-Relevance Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35034)
*Riki Okamura,Toshiharu Sugawara*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Off-policy evaluation, which estimates evaluation policy performance from logged data, is key for recommender ranking policies. However, logged clicks cannot distinguish unexamined items from examined non-clicks, causing bias in existing estimators when the assumed examination structures fail. We propose two estimators based on the decomposition of clicks into examination and relevance. First, the latent-examination independent inverse propensity score (LE-IIPS) estimator corrects the IIPS bias using policy examination probability ratios. Second, the examination-decomposed doubly robust (ED-DR) estimator extends LE-IIPS to a doubly robust framework. ED-DR is unbiased if the examination probabilities are correct regardless of relevance accuracy, or under ranking-independent examination, even if both model estimates are inaccurate. Experiments show that ED-DR achieves a lower MSE than existing methods with large sample sizes, especially when the examination depends on ranking. We also highlight its limitations under small samples or cascade user behavior conditions.

### [855] [ColNanoVDR: Document-Free Query Distillation for Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval via Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34899)
*Zhuchenyang Liu,Ziyi Wang,Yao Zhang,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Multi-vector retrievers built on vision-language models lead visual document retrieval (VDR), but they run a multi-billion-parameter query encoder on every search. Distilling this encoder into a small student that queries the teacher's existing index would remove the bottleneck. The standard recipe, however, matches the teacher's MaxSim scores and so requires encoding and caching every training page, which can reach terabytes of page tokens. NanoVDR avoids pages entirely by training on the teacher's query embeddings alone, but only for single-vector retrievers. We present ColNanoVDR, to our knowledge the first framework to bring this document-free distillation to multi-vector VDR. Its objective, OTW (Optimal Transport with Learned Weights), aligns the student's query tokens with the teacher's by entropic optimal transport, with a learned weight for each student token, and needs no correspondence between the two tokenizations. We prove that the resulting alignment cost bounds the MaxSim score difference on every page. Distilled from five state-of-the-art teachers, the 149M text-only students retain about 95% of their teachers' NDCG@5 on ViDoRe v1-v3 while encoding queries up to 26x faster. Under identical training, OTW matches score distillation while encoding no page and reading 12.6x less cached teacher data.

### [856] [Concepts Complement Dense Semantics: Learning Compact Sparse Spaces for Text-Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32671)
*Yoonseo Kim,Jungwoo Choi,Cheonyoung Park,Youngwook Kim,Yongho Song,SeongKu Kang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Cross-modal retrieval has been advanced by vision-language pre-trained models that encode images and texts into a shared dense embedding space. While dense representations effectively capture overall semantic similarity, they often obscure fine-grained visual-textual information needed for precise cross-modal matching. Recent methods introduce a learned sparse branch to complement dense matching with lexical evidence, but they rely on a redundant language-model token space and lack explicit grounding for sparse dimensions. We propose GRASP, a compact and grounded sparse learning framework that mines visual-textual concepts from the corpus. A lightweight sparse head is trained to predict concepts relevant to each image or text, yielding interpretable concept-level evidence that complements dense semantic matching. Extensive experiments show that GRASP improves retrieval accuracy over the state-of-the-art dense-sparse baselines while yielding a more compact and grounded sparse space.

### [857] [RandSlot: Learning Compact Visual Document Representations with Random Soft Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32699)
*Dewen Guo,Shi Yu,Lingxiao Zhang,Yang Zhang,Tao XU,Dan Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Visual document retrieval requires expressive representations to match queries with evidence distributed across text, tables, and page layouts. Multi-vector representations capture fine-grained information, but storing and comparing many vectors introduces substantial retrieval costs. In this paper, we introduce RandSlot, a simple approach to learn compact visual document representations with random soft tokens. During training, we append independently-sampled random unit vectors to query and document input sequences and resample them at every use, without introducing learnable soft-token parameters. The encoder contextualizes these auxiliary inputs with the original content to produce a small set of retrieval vectors. A standard late-interaction objective trains the encoder to extract relevant information under varying input conditions. Experiments with different backbone models show that RandSlot improves retrieval quality over alternative readout strategies under the same vector budget. Further analysis shows that these gains can persist when random soft tokens are replaced with zeros at inference, demonstrating that random inputs during training can improve compact retrieval representations even when inference no longer requires sampling.

### [858] [PILAR: A Page-Grounded Unified Evidence Representation via an Entity-Linked Assertion Graph for Open-Domain QA Agents over Multimodal Document Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32895)
*Joongmin Shin,Gyuho Shim,Jung-hun Lee,Jaehyung Seo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Open-domain question answering (ODQA) over multimodal document corpora requires linking evidence scattered across text, tables, and figures. Existing systems often store these sources separately or retrieve only coarse pages, which weakens global evidence linking. We present PILAR, a page-grounded unified evidence representation instantiated as an entity-linked assertion graph. PILAR maps sentence-, table-, and figure-derived facts into a common assertion space and uses the graph as a controlled linking layer over robust page retrieval. In a shared-reader evaluation with four agent frameworks, fourteen retrieval backends, and two benchmarks, PILAR achieves the best end-to-end EM/ANLS. Gains are largest on compositional, cross-document, and multimodal questions, with a single-shot improvement of +1.6 EM over flat retrieval, rising to +2.9 on compositional and +5.9 on 3-hop questions. Ablations show that current gains are driven mainly by the text-instantiated slice of the framework, while visual assertions help only after locality-aware filtering. We therefore position PILAR as a unified evidence representation for multimodal ODQA rather than a standalone visual-reasoning module.

Ablations show that current gains are driven mainly by the text-instantiated slice of the framework, while visual assertions help only after locality-aware filtering. We therefore position PILAR as a unified evidence representation for multimodal ODQA rather than a standalone visual-reasoning module.

</details>


### [859] [Overview and Analysis of the RecSys Challenge 2026: Conversational Music Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33045)
*Seungheon Doh,Sergio Oramas,Bruno Sguerra,Abhinav Bohra,Claudio Pomo,Francesco Barile*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: The RecSys Challenge 2026 studies conversational music recommendation as a joint item recommendation and response generation problem: given a multi-turn dialogue, systems must retrieve relevant tracks from a large catalog and produce a grounded natural-language response. This paper presents the challenge task, dataset, evaluation protocol, and official results. Beyond the leaderboard, we analyze the 16 accepted systems through a common retrieve--rerank--generate framework and examine how recommendation performance varies across users, requests, and dialogue contexts. Strong systems commonly combine heterogeneous candidate sources and preserve source-specific evidence for learned reranking. Across the system papers and our organizer-side analysis, robust design also means 1) grounding cold-start retrieval in multi-turn conversation and item signals, 2) using intent detectors, and 3) modeling the full multi-turn context rather than the current query alone. We further identify limitations of the benchmark and evaluation protocol, including single-ground-truth relevance and teacher-forced evaluation of synthetic dialogues. Together, these findings provide practical guidance for future conversational recommender systems and shared evaluation efforts.

### [860] [What Gets Measured Gets Managed: Sign-aware Recommendation Needs Sign-aware Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33346)
*Minchan Kim,Jungmin Hwang,Hyunwoo Park*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Sign-aware recommender systems have recently been developed to leverage negative feedback for a deeper understanding of user preferences. However, our empirical diagnosis reveals that state-of-the-art graph-based sign-aware recommender systems are paradoxically valence-blind. Even though they explicitly incorporate sign information during training, they consistently fail to differentiate liked items from disliked ones at the ranking stage, frequently infiltrating top-K recommendations with disliked content. Through linear probing, we show that while valence information exists in the learned embeddings, it remains inaccessible to the inner-product scoring function. This widespread failure remains entirely undetected because conventional evaluation metrics, such as Recall, HR, and NDCG, assign a uniform utility of zero to both negative and unobserved items, creating a systematic evaluation blind spot. To bridge this gap, we propose a family of signed metrics, Signed Recall, Signed HR, and Signed NDCG, that explicitly penalize the recommendation of disliked content. Systematic re-evaluation under our proposed metrics fundamentally reshapes the established performance landscape, revealing that methods ranked highly under conventional metrics often fail to protect users from disliked content. Finally, through a proof-of-concept auxiliary loss, we confirm that the proposed metrics provide actionable training signals, guiding models toward valence-aware behavior without sacrificing conventional relevance. For transparency, our source code is available at: this https URL

### [861] [From PDF to Evidence: Structure-Aware Retrieval for Clinical Practice Guidelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33447)
*Xingyu Lin,Dehui Du*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Guideline documents are published as unstructured PDFs whose evidence is locked in visual structures---tables, flowcharts, and graded recommendations---that standard retrieval pipelines flatten into fixed-size text chunks. We cast evidence access as a document image analysis problem: parse each page image into typed structural elements, then retrieve structure-aware evidence units that follow the document's own layout (sections, table rows, flowchart paths, graded recommendations), each keeping its structural context so a result points to a specific element rather than a page. On 26 clinical practice guidelines from 9 sources (3,619 pages, Chinese and English) with 199 evidence queries, structure-aware units rank the gold element first under BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval (hybrid Element Hit@1 of 0.382), with a significant element-level ranking gain over per-element OCR text (MRR_e +0.107, p=0.002; the Hit@5 gain is directional, p=0.17), while matching page-level recall (Page Hit@5 0.879 vs. 0.889, p=0.75) at 3.8x less context and clearly outperforming a ColPali visual-RAG baseline (PH@5 0.497).

### [862] [Beyond the Beam: Constructive Repair and Candidate Completion for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33745)
*Zijun Zhao,Peng Zhang,Gang Zhang,Yuanchi Ma,Hui He,Zhendong Niu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Generative recommenders retrieve items by generating identifiers, but a valid identifier can remain outside the beam after catalog expansion. This raises two connected questions: which failures can identifier assignment repair, and how should retrieval proceed beyond the initial beam? We characterize assignment repair with a fixed generator and retained old identifiers. Output-invariance certificates identify failures shared by all admissible assignments. Under a common effective prefix, coupled support and ranking constraints give the exact feasible interval of new-item counts for target recovery. Building on this characterization, Beyond the Beam (BB) obtains minimum-replacement repairs through an integral flow formulation, selects a shared map and adapts the generator. At inference, generative likelihood and collaborative evidence define one score for ranking, candidate priority and stopping. Retained prefix bounds guide candidate completion and certify its global Top-$K$ when the stopping condition is met. Exhaustive finite-catalog evaluation confirms construction in every feasible case. Across three Amazon Reviews categories and three random seeds, the full T5 procedure improves mean Recall@10 by 15.5--46.3% and NDCG@10 by 15.2--44.4% over the best-performing evaluated generative baseline for each dataset and metric. Matched controls show that shared construction and adaptation improve new-target ranking and certification efficiency on Beauty and Toys. Combined scoring and candidate completion improve NDCG@10 across all three datasets with both T5 and decoder-only LC-Rec.

### [863] [RidgeRank: Efficient Visual Document Reranking via Score Fusion and a Shallow Linear Readout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34192)
*Shubing Yang,Dongfang Zhao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Multimodal language models rerank visual document retrieval results accurately, but scoring every candidate page at full cost makes them slow. Some methods that compress these rerankers need relevance labels to regain accuracy, and they rank by the reranker score alone. RidgeRank measures how much relevance signal the reranker score lacks and recovers it from the retriever score through a closed-form fusion rule. Maximizing a correlation objective gives the optimal fusion weight, along with the exact condition under which the reranker score by itself cannot reach that optimum. The reranker is further corrected by a single vector applied to an intermediate hidden state, obtained through one centered ridge regression onto the same model's full-depth scores on uncompressed pages. On 12 datasets drawn from ViDoRe 2 and ViDoRe 3, evaluated with two retrievers and two language model backbones, RidgeRank brings NDCG@5 to within 1.2 pp of a full cross encoder with speedups of up to 48 times, advancing the accuracy and latency Pareto frontier for visual document reranking.

### [864] [Measuring and Mitigating Identity-Cue Preference Drift in LLM-based Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34229)
*Zhuoxiong Gan,Qiang Dong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: In large language model-based recommender systems, identity cues embedded in prompts can steer recommendations toward group-level patterns even when the underlying behavioral evidence remains unchanged. We introduce PromptShift, an interpretable, training-free framework for quantifying and mitigating such identity-cue preference drift. We define Drift as the divergence, in both item membership and ranking order, between a recommendation list generated under an identity-cued prompt and the reference list produced from the same user's interaction history alone. SliceShift then measures the extent to which a cued list gravitates, relative to the history-only reference, toward items that are more popular within the cued slice than among the global user population. Beyond conventional accuracy, we propose DifHitRate, a difficulty-weighted hit metric that credits only relevant items, assigning higher credit to hits that are less popular within the cued slice and ranked higher in the list. All components are supported by an identity-slice-by-item table constructed from positive interactions, which further enables an adaptive post-hoc reranking strategy: the reranker interpolates between the original LLM ranking and inverse slice-popularity, with personalized interpolation weight. Experiments on two datasets with three LLMs show that identity-cued prompts incur higher mean Drift than identity-free paraphrase controls, an effect beyond generic wording sensitivity, and that SliceShift is positive across all six dataset-model settings. PromptShift consistently reduces both Drift and SliceShift, lowering macro-mean SliceShift by 62.42%, while improving DifHitRate, HitRate and MRR. These results demonstrate that identity-cue preference drift can be measured and mitigated without any model training, albeit with a modest, metric-dependent utility cost.

### [865] [SPRINT: Single-Step Generative Recommendation via Average Probability Velocity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34306)
*Zhuo Cai,Shoujin Wang,Peilin Zhou,Min Xu,Julian McAuley,Fang Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Semantic ID (SID) based generative recommendation represents each item as a sequence of discrete tokens, and recommends by generating the SID of the item a user would like to interact with. Both dominant paradigms in this domain generally pay for generation token by token: autoregressive models decode the tokens left-to-right, while non-autoregressive models decode in parallel yet still need multiple rounds of refinement to stay competitive. Therefore, both generally spend multiple forward passes per item, a cost that is prohibitive in latency-sensitive recommender systems. We ask whether an item can be generated in a single forward pass, and answer it through a new perspective which we call average probability velocity. We view SID generation as a flow of token generation probabilities and characterize it by its average velocity over the whole generation process. We prove that this average velocity is fully determined by the average generation probability of each token. Therefore, we directly parameterize and learn the probabilities of all tokens in a single forward pass with a bidirectional Transformer. As these probabilities are generated independently across positions and the coherence among tokens is lost, we further design a dual-level flow contrastive objective to restore the coherence among an item's tokens. It contrasts the target SID against negative SIDs at both the token and SID levels. The token level ranks the generation probabilities of the target tokens above those of negative SIDs, while the SID level scores the tokens of each SID as a whole item for capturing token coherence of each item. Extensive experiments show that our model not only generates recommendations far more efficiently ($8.39-10.04\times$ speedup over the second-fastest AR/NAR method) but also attains superior recommendation accuracy ($7.77\%$ average improvement over the second-best.
