### [866] [Correcting to Predict: Pseudo-Value Correction for Multimodal Attribute Value Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34383)
*Junhao Zhang,Feiran Hu,Xiao Hu,Baoliang Cui,Xiaoyi Zeng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Product attribute value extraction (AVE) is a fundamental task in e-commerce, aiming to identify specific values of predefined attributes from multimodal product profiles such as text and images. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown promise for AVE, they face challenges in extracting implicit attributes that require joint reasoning over visual and textual cues, often confusing semantically similar values. However, existing methods often fail to resolve such ambiguities because the correct value often depends on subtle multimodal cues that are easy to miss or override. To address this challenge, we propose Correcting to Predict (C2P), a framework that treats attribute extraction as a correction process. Given an initial pseudo-value such as a retrieved candidate or placeholder, the model learns to correct it using multimodal evidence. During training, diverse pseudo-values help the model learn evidence-based correction behavior, and a self-consistency refinement stage further reduces sensitivity to pseudo-value perturbations. At inference, a fixed placeholder triggers the learned correction behavior, enabling efficient single-pass prediction without online retrieval or iterative refinement. We evaluate C2P on a public benchmark and a large-scale industrial dataset. Offline results show that C2P outperforms strong baselines, with notable gains on ambiguous attributes. Online A/B tests on AliExpress further show consistent improvements in seller adoption, attribute completeness, and user engagement, validating C2P's effectiveness and efficiency in real-world deployment.

### [867] [Relevance-Resolution Transfer via Scale-Decomposable Fractional Diffusion for Multi-Length Cross-Modal Hash Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34393)
*Xi Chen,Xu Chen,Xiangyang Jia,Ting Gan,Xu Zhang,Shuquan Wei,Sitong Fan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Cross-modal hashing enables efficient retrieval by encoding heterogeneous data into compact binary codes. Recent methods exploit fine-grained relations encoded in multi-label training structure, yet none of them constrains how those relations survive as consistent candidate rankings in finite, multi-length Hamming spaces, which we term the relevance resolution bottleneck (RRB). To address the RRB, we propose MultiBit, which transfers relevance resolution from multi-label structure to multi-length Hamming spaces. MultiBit first constructs a scale-decomposable fractional relation teacher from dataset-level label co-occurrence and label specificity, and models dependencies from local to long-range over continuous diffusion scales. It then maps the discretized diffusion scales and their quadrature weights to scale-aware bit subblocks of the maximum-length code, organizes the target code lengths as nested prefixes, and aligns their Hamming candidate rankings with the teacher relations. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate improved retrieval accuracy. Code is available in the supplementary material.

### [868] [EvoSkillRec: Skill-Genome Evolution for Recommender Architecture Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34552)
*Xiaopeng Li,Kuo Cai,Bo Chen,Wenlin Zhang,Mengyang Ma,Yingyi Zhang,Zichuan Fu,Yu Yang,Qidong Liu,Yiyu Wang,Ruiming Tang,Wenwu Ou,Jiang Wu,Zhanbo Xu,Xiangyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Modern recommender systems advance not only by scaling data and parameters, but also by encoding task-specific inductive biases through architecture, including sparse feature interactions for click-through rate (CTR) prediction, temporal attention for sequential recommendation, and expert routing for multi-task learning. However, these biases are typically human expert designed or searched within predefined operator spaces. Although Recent LLM-driven code evolution expands this space, unconstrained edits often produce invalid or ineffective architectures, underuse established architecture design knowledge, and fail to preserve successful innovations for reuse. We introduce EvoSkillRec, a promotion-and-reuse framework for cumulative recommender architecture evolution. It first decomposes recommenders into atomic executable skills and represents architectures as typed skill genomes, with each skill equipped with input--output types, semantic annotations, and implementation code. We then evolve models with different tasks through two coupled spaces: a constrained skill--space that mutates, recombines, specializes, and reuses validated skills, and an open-ended code--space in which LLM planners and synthesizers invent new skill modules using prior evolution traces and accumulated experience. An autoresearch controller evaluates candidates, diagnoses failures, retrieves relevant skills, promotes validated innovations into the skill library, and adaptively allocates the proposal budget between the two spaces. Extensive experiments on CTR prediction, multi-task learning, and multi-domain learning, including resource-constrained co-optimization of predictive quality and model FLOPs utilization in generative ranking models, consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed EvoSkillRec.

### [869] [No Attention, No Problem: Rethinking Session-based Recommendation with Pure Convolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34802)
*Tao Huang,Wei Zhou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Session-based recommendation (SBR) predicts the next choice in a session by analyzing recent interactions. Transformer-based models are widely used because of their ability to capture long-range dependencies through self-attention mechanisms. In contrast, traditional convolutional models, although more efficient, are often limited by their weak global modeling capabilities and are losing ground in SBR tasks. In this work, we propose a Next-generation Pure Convolutional Framework (NextConvRec) for SBR tasks, aiming to balance efficiency and performance. NextConvRec uses a Structural and Positional Convolutional Encoder (SPCE) for preprocessing, combining learnable convolutional positional biases with session-level structural signals extracted through GCN layers. Its backbone convolutional module effectively expands the effective receptive field through depthwise convolutions and pointwise convolutions, enabling robust long-range preference modeling without attention mechanisms. Extensive experiments on 4 benchmark datasets show that NextConvRec outperforms several state-of-the-art baselines by around 1.73% on average, and reduces the average inference time per session by 16.7%. The convolutional architectures remain a promising direction for efficient and accurate session-based recommendations.

Abstract: Session-based recommendation (SBR) predicts the next choice in a session by analyzing recent interactions. Transformer-based models are widely used because of their ability to capture long-range dependencies through self-attention mechanisms. In contrast, traditional convolutional models, although more efficient, are often limited by their weak global modeling capabilities and are losing ground in SBR tasks. In this work, we propose a Next-generation Pure Convolutional Framework (NextConvRec) for SBR tasks, aiming to balance efficiency and performance. NextConvRec uses a Structural and Positional Convolutional Encoder (SPCE) for preprocessing, combining learnable convolutional positional biases with session-level structural signals extracted through GCN layers. Its backbone convolutional module effectively expands the effective receptive field through depthwise convolutions and pointwise convolutions, enabling robust long-range preference modeling without attention mechanisms. Extensive experiments on 4 benchmark datasets show that NextConvRec outperforms several state-of-the-art baselines by around 1.73% on average, and reduces the average inference time per session by 16.7%. The convolutional architectures remain a promising direction for efficient and accurate session-based recommendations.

</details>


### [870] [Mitigating Popularity Bias in Recommendation with Global Listwise Learning and Progressive Bi-Weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35041)
*Tianyu Zhu,Jiandong Ding,Yansong Shi,Guoqing Chen,Jian-Yun Nie*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: In recommender systems, user feedback typically follows a long-tail distribution, which leads many recommendation algorithms to exacerbate popularity bias by disproportionately favoring popular items. To mitigate this issue, recent studies have employed Inverse Propensity Scoring (IPS) to rebalance training data via reweighting user-item interactions. However, the effectiveness of IPS-based approaches is often constrained by locally unbiased objectives and inaccurate propensity estimation. In this paper, we propose Multinomial Likelihood with Bi-Weighting (Mult-BiW) to address these limitations. First, we introduce a debiasing framework, termed Mult-IPS, which integrates multinomial likelihood with IPS to capture global and unbiased user preferences over the entire item set. Second, we develop a Bi-Weighting (BiW) strategy that jointly leverages propensity scores and a collection model, incorporating a smoothing mechanism to enhance the robustness of propensity estimation. We further provide theoretical analyses that establish an upper bound on the empirical bias and characterize the optimal form of the collection model. Third, to mitigate the adverse effects of aggressive reweighting on representation learning, we design a Progressive Bi-Weighting strategy that gradually transitions from discriminative representation learning to popularity debiasing. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that Mult-BiW consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

### [871] [RenderRank: Learning to Rerank Text with Compressed Visual Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35069)
*Seongtae Hong,Youngjoon Jang,Jungseob Lee,Hyeonseok Moon,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Rendering document text as images allows vision-language models to encode documents as visual tokens, which can reduce input sequence length compared with text input. This reduction in input length is particularly useful for reranking, where each query involves scoring multiple candidate documents and token savings apply to each candidate evaluation. We introduce RenderRank, a reranker that learns query-dependent relevance scoring from compressed visual document representations instead of the text token sequences used by conventional text-based rerankers. Training first aligns relevance scores from visual inputs with those of a text-based teacher, then refines the relative scores of positive and negative documents for the same query. Across 11 datasets from BEIR, RenderRank uses 16.5-35.5% fewer input tokens while achieving an average NDCG@10 of 55.96, outperforming all evaluated text-based baselines below 4B parameters and some larger models. Across four long-document datasets, it achieves an average NDCG@10 of 88.27 with approximately half the average input token count of the evaluated text-based rerankers. In this setting, RenderRank delivers 1.70x the highest average throughput of the evaluated baselines. These results demonstrate that compressed visual representations can support accurate document relevance scoring, providing an alternative to text token representations for reranking.

### [872] [Signal or Noise? Modality Contribution and Cooperation in Multimodal GraphRAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35304)
*Antonios Georgakopoulos,Paul Groth,Lise Stork*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Multimodal knowledge graphs (KGs) integrate information from text, figures, tables, and other modalities into a unified structured representation, with the promise that richer evidence enables better inference. In GraphRAG systems built over such graphs, it is commonly assumed that retrieving evidence from more modalities at inference time improves downstream performance. Yet, redundant or overlapping multimodal evidence may distract language models in question answering (QA), and whether each modality contributes equally across questions, models, and tasks remains poorly understood. In this work, we study how modality-aware retrieval affects downstream inference in a multimodal GraphRAG pipeline, using document visual question answering (DocVQA) as a testbed. We extend an existing KG-based QA framework to be modality-aware, leveraging the graph structure to track which modality supports which facts and to selectively filter evidence at the edge level. This enables us to investigate whether providing all available multimodal evidence at inference time benefits QA, and to evaluate the contribution and cooperation of modalities across question, task, and model characteristics. Through a controlled analysis within a state-of-the-art multimodal GraphRAG pipeline, five multimodal LLMs and two DocVQA benchmarks, we find that tables and text provide the strongest contributions, and that combining modalities frequently produces redundancy rather than synergy, particularly for pairs involving textual information. Positive cooperation appears mainly between non-text modalities and depends on question intent and task type. Our findings argue for selective, modality-aware retrieval in the design of more effective GraphRAG systems, where modalities are filtered according to the downstream task rather than retrieved uniformly.

### [873] [Can Generative Retrievers Learn Semantic IDs Without Forgetting How to Speak?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35430)
*Junchen Fu,Kleomenis Katevas,Vandana Rajan,Sofía Celi,Hamed Haddadi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Generative retrieval (GR) enables end-to-end retrieval by generating document semantic identifiers (SIDs). However, retrieval-only fine-tuning can over-specialize pretrained language models to SID prediction, substantially distorting their natural-language distribution and limiting their suitability for interactive systems that must both retrieve documents and generate natural-language responses. We introduce SpeakGR, a dual-objective framework that learns SIDs while preserving language generation. It combines supervised SID learning with speak-preserving regularization: an on-policy distillation objective that aligns the current model with a frozen copy of the original model on student-generated prefixes using forward KL over the original text vocabulary. We further propose Adaptive SpeakGR, which dynamically adjusts the preservation strength based on observed language drift. Compared with SFT-only, SpeakGR reduces WikiText-2 forward KL by 81.3-93.8% on MS MARCO and 81.2-85.2% on Natural Questions (NQ) while retaining effective retrieval across three different LLMs. Adaptive SpeakGR further improves retrieval over SpeakGR in most settings while maintaining substantially lower language drift than SFT-only.

### [874] [Rubric-Calibrated Preferences: Cross-Query Calibration of LLM Judgments via Item Response Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35739)
*Fabian David Schmidt,Donato Crisostomi,Carlos Lassance,Nils Reimers*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Rerankers decide which documents users and LLMs see, yet their standard metric, nDCG, relies on human relevance labels that are costly, sparse, noisy, and discretely graded. As rerankers approach each other in quality, nDCG on these labels therefore increasingly fails to separate them. LLM judges could supply dense labels. Relative judgments within one query tell even close candidates apart, yet their scores share no scale across queries. Absolute grades share one scale but are too coarse to distinguish documents of similar relevance. We propose Rubric-Calibrated Preferences (RCP), which combine both kinds of judgment. A listwise Bradley-Terry tournament orders each query's documents, and a rubric of yes/no criteria of increasing stringency provides an absolute standard. Item Response Theory (IRT), which scores test-takers based on their answers to common questions, then uses the shared criteria to put all queries' tournament scores on one scale. RCP's retrieval metric, RCP-nDCG, replaces nDCG's discrete labels with the resulting calibrated relevance probabilities. Against blind grades from 46 external annotators, calibration raises the correlation between a query's mean score and its mean human grade from 0.538 to 0.795. The probabilities rank a useful document above a non-useful one with probability 0.910 (AUC, chance 0.5), versus 0.651 for the benchmark labels. When the annotators' grades prefer one of two rerankers and exactly one metric agrees, that metric is RCP-nDCG in 72.4% of 185 comparisons (chance about 53%). On TREC-DL, RCP-nDCG sides with NIST assessors' grades on every reranker pair that these grades separate significantly. RCP-nDCG also resolves many of nDCG's ties and separates 1.9 times as many reranker pairs on NanoBEIR. Rubric calibration thus turns relative LLM judgments into dense relevance labels that are comparable across queries and agree with human judgment.

### [875] [Dynamic Flow, Static Graph: KV Cache Reuse for Efficient LLM Serving on Mobile NPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34727)
*Zhengxiang Huang,Shengheng Chen,Chaoyue Niu,Yujie Sun,Zhaode Wang,Zeyu Zhao,Chengfei Lv,Fan Wu,Guihai Chen*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个面向移动端NPU的端侧LLM KV缓存复用的系统设计，通过计算-存储协同设计，将云端GPU的KV复用技术适配到移动NPU的静态编译执行模型和受限的内存带宽/容量约束下，实现了前缀和非前缀KV的高效复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端LLM的KV缓存复用技术（如Prefix Caching、CacheBlend等）针对GPU和分布式存储设计，无法直接迁移到移动NPU：1）移动NPU要求静态预编译计算图，而KV选择性重计算具有动态张量形状、动态选择、动态数值范围、动态输出位置等5种动态性；2）端侧内存带宽比云端低1-2个数量级，KV张量加载存储开销巨大。需要面向移动NPU的新型引擎级设计。

Method: 1）计算层（Intra-graph）：采用chunk-pad-mask+scatter-gather机制将选择性重计算映射到静态NPU图；通过分析输入token长度频率分布确定最优图尺寸；采用FP16+INT8混合精度量化避免KV偏差计算的精度损失。2）计算层（Inter-graph）：基于动态规划的chunk合并算法，将新token合并到相邻欠利用的重计算图中以减少padding。3）存储层：三级层次化KV管理（NPU buffer → CPU内存池 → Flash存储），Flash端采用树-哈希-语义混合索引（prefix tree + hash + 语义embedding）支持前缀和非前缀复用，采用成本感知的预取和淘汰策略。4）流水线层：构建IO-CPU-NPU和分片级二维流水线，掩盖KV加载、重旋转（rerotation）和存储延迟。

Result: 在3类典型端侧工作负载（文档QA、长对话QA、Agent技能调用）、4个LLM（Qwen3-1.7B/4B、Llama3.2-1B/3B）和3款智能手机上的实验表明：相对无复用基线实现1.5-5.4倍prefill加速，相对前缀缓存实现1.3-2.5倍加速；TTFT降低40-60%；同时避免直接非前缀全复用导致的约30%的质量下降；prefill能耗降低52-77%。消融实验证实各组件均对端到端TTFT有显著贡献。

Conclusion: 本文构建了首个面向移动NPU的端侧KV复用系统，验证了在商用智能手机上高效非前缀KV复用的可行性，为资源受限移动设备上的可扩展长上下文推理奠定了基础，为本地优先的个人智能开辟了新机会。

Abstract: On-device large language model (LLM) serving is a cornerstone of local-first personal intelligence, offering users data sovereignty, strong privacy guarantees, and freedom from cloud API latency and cost. Although KV caching is widely used to reduce latency in long-context inference, existing designs were primarily optimized for cloud GPUs with dynamic execution environments and abundant memory bandwidth. These architectural assumptions do not hold on mobile NPUs, where computation graphs must be statically compiled and both memory capacity and I/O bandwidth are severely constrained. In this work, we present a compute-storage co-design for mobile-centric prefix and non-prefix KV reuse. We first propose an intra-graph mechanism that maps selective KV recomputation onto static NPU graphs, reconciling algorithmic dynamicity with NPU staticity. We further develop an inter-graph scheduler to optimize chunk merging and minimize padding with dynamic programming. To address mobile bandwidth limitations, we introduce a hierarchical KV manager featuring a tree-hash-semantic hybrid structure, along with cost-aware prefetching and eviction policies. We also build a two-dimensional pipeline that overlaps KV loading, rerotation, and storage with NPU execution, hiding data-movement latency. Experiments across representative on-device workloads and LLMs show that our design reduces time-to-first-token (TTFT) by $40-60\%$ compared with no reuse and prefix-only caching.

</details>


### [876] [Planarian: Managing Agent State with Statepoints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35366)
*Jinnan Guo,Hao Mark Chen,Kapil Vaswani,Andrew Paverd,Peter Pietzuch*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: Planarian是一个为LLM智能体设计的运行时系统，通过引入"状态点"(statepoints)抽象，实现本地（文件系统、进程）和远程（外部服务）环境状态的一致性快照、回滚和分支，支持智能体安全探索替代方案并从错误中恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在执行任务时会修改本地文件和进程状态，并通过MCP协议与远程服务交互。当智能体出错或需要探索替代方案时，目前缺乏统一的抽象机制来一致地恢复和分支这些混合的本地与远程状态。现有方法（框架检查点、沙箱检查点、工作流恢复）各自只解决了部分问题，无法同时保证本地/远程一致性（L/R）、智能体上下文/环境一致性（C/E），以及低开销的频繁状态管理。

Method: Planarian的核心方法包括三部分：(1) **Agent Statepoints抽象**：将本地沙箱状态（通过Podman容器+CRIU进程检查点+ZFS CoW文件系统快照捕获）和远程服务状态（通过透明MCP代理拦截请求并记录补偿动作）统一为一致性、可恢复的时间点版本，附带状态证据(state evidence)描述环境状态及历史执行结果。(2) **三种状态管理原语**：snapshot创建新状态点；rollback恢复到先前状态点（本地用CRIU+ZFS恢复，远程反向重放补偿动作）；fork从状态点创建隔离分支。(3) **持续增量检查点协议**：利用CRIU的pre-resume钩子清除soft-dirty位并重写父检查点创建时间，使得恢复后仍可进行增量检查点，避免每次恢复后必须全量转储的开销。远程状态代理将SQL语句改写为"前置镜像-原操作-后置镜像"事务，使破坏性更新可补偿。状态点管理器通过cgroup冻结和代理级锁保证跨域一致性，快照/分支操作与LLM推理异步重叠以隐藏延迟。

Result: 在Mario游戏中，使用Planarian的智能体得分是无状态管理基线的15倍；Flappy Bird和Minecraft中分别为1.4倍。在Terminal-Bench的MCTS风格搜索中，Planarian的快照开销是Full-snapshot基线的1/10（10倍加速），fork开销是其1/2，端到端快9%。在Terminal-Bench系统管理任务中，Planarian仅增加1%开销（Full-snapshot增加20%）；在DevOps-Gym中增加不到3%（Full-snapshot增加59%）；在Bird-interact-lite数据库任务（同时管理本地和远程状态）中仅增加3%开销。微基准测试中，8GB工作集下增量快照比Full-snapshot快74倍（内存）和231倍（文件系统），比CRIU原生增量检查点（CRIU-inc）快11倍；rollback快4-67倍，fork快4-61倍。

Conclusion: Planarian通过agent statepoints抽象统一了智能体本地和远程状态管理，在保证跨域一致性和智能体上下文一致性的同时，通过增量检查点协议、CoW文件系统和异步执行实现了低开销的频繁状态管理。这使智能体能够安全地探索替代执行路径、并行尝试不同策略，并让用户以最小代价从错误操作中恢复，为LLM智能体的可靠部署提供了基础架构支持。

Abstract: LLM agents solve complex tasks by iteratively changing files, invoking local tools, and interacting with remote services, which modifies state across their local environment and remote services. Today, agents and users must manage these changes explicitly, whether reverting exploratory actions or recovering from erroneous ones. Doing so safely requires coordinated actions, yet current agent harnesses lack unified abstractions and mechanisms for managing local and remote state consistently and efficiently. We describe Planarian, an agent runtime with state management that enables agents and users to recover from erroneous actions and explore alternative executions over consistent local and remote environment state. Planarian introduces the abstraction of agent statepoints, which are consistent, restorable point-in-time versions of the environment state. Planarian exposes three state-management primitives to agents and users: (i) snapshot creates a new statepoint spanning local and remote state without requiring external services to support checkpoints: it relies on efficient incremental process and file system snapshotting to capture local sandboxed state, and transparently records compensating actions to undo remote state changes; (ii) rollback restores the environment to a previous statepoint by reverting to a prior local checkpoint and replaying compensating actions for remote state changes; and (iii) fork creates multiple isolated branches from a statepoint, enabling the agent to explore alternatives in parallel. We show that Planarian enables agents to undo mistakes and explore alternatives in parallel, improving task quality by up to 15x, and allows users to recover from erroneous actions with only 3% overhead.

</details>


### [877] [Argus: Agentic, Reference-Calibrated, Tree-Guided, System-Software-Level Bottleneck Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35508)
*Vlad-Petru Nitu,Harsh Songara,Konstantinos Sgouras,Spiros Galanopoulos,Konstantinos Kanellopoulos,Onur Mutlu*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: Operating system (OS) code can account for a substantial share of CPU execution time. First, as application logic is offloaded to heterogeneous accelerators (e.g., GPUs), the CPU increasingly acts as an orchestrator, spending cycles in driver calls, data movement, and synchronization rather than in application code. Second, workloads such as serverless functions frequently invoke OS services. At the same time, the OS is a complex codebase spanning many subsystems (e.g., memory management, networking), making it hard to localize the specific code path responsible for a slowdown. Existing profilers expose measurements that require interpretation(e.g., perf and Intel VTune) or can perturb short operations when extensively instrumented (e.g., ftrace). Diagnosing OS bottlenecks can therefore require repeated kernel instrumentation and manual interpretation. We introduce Argus, an agentic LLM-based profiler that produces instrumentation code and autonomously reasons over potential OS-level bottlenecks. Argus integrates two key mechanisms: (i) a calibration methodology that involves collecting a measurement from an idle system and using it as a reference point to discover potential bottlenecks, and (ii) a tree-based data structure that represents the different OS execution paths, improving the agent's bottleneck localization accuracy. Argus aims to identify a specific kernel code path rather than stop at a subsystem-level diagnosis. In two case studies, we employ Argus to autonomously discover bottlenecks present in the memory management subsystem caused by (i) a THP aggressor co-running with other applications, and (ii) applications that incur different types of page faults. Argus produces 19 times fewer incorrect deep-path diagnoses than the strongest evaluated LLM-based baseline, which lacks reference calibration, while preserving low time-to-diagnosis (approximately 31 s)

Abstract: Operating system (OS) code can account for a substantial share of CPU execution time. First, as application logic is offloaded to heterogeneous accelerators (e.g., GPUs), the CPU increasingly acts as an orchestrator, spending cycles in driver calls, data movement, and synchronization rather than in application code. Second, workloads such as serverless functions frequently invoke OS services. At the same time, the OS is a complex codebase spanning many subsystems (e.g., memory management, networking), making it hard to localize the specific code path responsible for a slowdown. Existing profilers expose measurements that require interpretation(e.g., perf and Intel VTune) or can perturb short operations when extensively instrumented (e.g., ftrace). Diagnosing OS bottlenecks can therefore require repeated kernel instrumentation and manual interpretation. We introduce Argus, an agentic LLM-based profiler that produces instrumentation code and autonomously reasons over potential OS-level bottlenecks. Argus integrates two key mechanisms: (i) a calibration methodology that involves collecting a measurement from an idle system and using it as a reference point to discover potential bottlenecks, and (ii) a tree-based data structure that represents the different OS execution paths, improving the agent's bottleneck localization accuracy. Argus aims to identify a specific kernel code path rather than stop at a subsystem-level diagnosis. In two case studies, we employ Argus to autonomously discover bottlenecks present in the memory management subsystem caused by (i) a THP aggressor co-running with other applications, and (ii) applications that incur different types of page faults. Argus produces 19 times fewer incorrect deep-path diagnoses than the strongest evaluated LLM-based baseline, which lacks reference calibration, while preserving low time-to-diagnosis (approximately 31 s)

### [878] [Process Mining of Patient Flow in an Emergency Department: Bottlenecks, Variant Fragmentation, and Data-Driven Redesign](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32010)
*Iliano Fasolino*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文对某急诊科（ED）的匿名事件日志（1,820次就诊，25,115条事件）执行了一套完整的流程挖掘分析，揭示了急诊流程高度碎片化、缺乏规范化路径的现状，并提出了两个基于数据的流程再造方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急诊科（ED）拥挤是导致死亡、延误和患者满意度下降的结构性问题，但多数流程挖掘研究止于模型发现，缺少将诊断与可量化干预措施相连接的环节。本文旨在填补这一缺口：从数据中量化瓶颈、识别最受影响患者群体，并给出带量化目标的重设计方案。

Method: 采用四阶段流程挖掘流水线：① 预处理——将同时间戳突发事件聚合并区分缺失类型（前向/后向填充案例级属性、保留事件级NaN），并按完整性（≥4事件、边界）与时长（0.5–48 h）过滤；② 性能分析——定义吞吐时长、出院前等待、转换等待时间，统计均值/中位数/频次；③ 过程发现与一致性检查——使用Inductive Miner得到Petri网，通过基于token重放计算fitness/precision/generalization/simplicity四维质量；④ 变体与瓶颈分析——统计变体频次与Pareto偏离度，按紧急程度分层识别瓶颈。

Result: 过滤后日志含1,754次就诊、16,376条事件；平均吞吐时长6.58 h（中位5.08 h，重尾）；884个不同变体，最频繁变体仅占4.3%（远偏离Pareto期望，519个变体才能覆盖80%病例）；发现triage-to-triage时间为常量1秒的数据记录伪影；按紧急程度分层出现优先级倒置——紧急（acuity 2）患者平均停留8.03 h，比危重（acuity 1）的5.83 h长38%；生命体征监测自循环（v→v）是最主要瓶颈：均等待93.3分钟，发生2,159次，占约3,360患者小时；一致性指标呈现fitness=1.000、precision=0.714、零偏离痕迹的"无规范化路径"特征。基于此提出两个再造方案：① 按紧急程度分级的标准护理路径（目标：变体<50、top-10覆盖率80%、acuity 2降至5.5 h、precision>0.85）；② 预期性出院优化（3个月内出院时间由48 min降至30 min，6个月降至20 min）。

Conclusion: 该急诊科严重缺乏规范化流程定义：完美fitness叠加低precision的组合可作为"无规范化模型"的可复用诊断签名。两个量化重设计方案直接源自挖掘证据，建议通过基于患者特征的变体挖掘和离散事件仿真作为下一步研究方向，以验证干预目标并厘清监测瓶颈的根本原因（人手不足 vs 入院前占床）。

Abstract: Emergency departments (EDs) run some of the least standardized processes in healthcare, and long stays are often attributed to demand rather than measured on data. We analyze an anonymised event log of 1{,}820 ED stays (25{,}115 events) through a full process mining pipeline: preprocessing resolves burst logging and missing values, performance analysis quantifies flow at the case and transition level, and Inductive Miner with token-based conformance checking assesses process structure. The filtered log (1{,}754 cases, 16{,}376 events) exhibits a mean throughput of 6.58 hours with a heavy tail, 884 distinct control-flow variants whose most frequent one covers only 4.3\% of cases, and an inversion of clinical priority in which urgent patients (acuity 2, 8.03 h) stay 38\% longer than critical ones (acuity 1, 5.83 h). Perfect fitness (1.0) combined with low precision (0.71) reveals absence of normative pathways rather than deviance. Two redesign scenarios, acuity-based care pathways and anticipatory discharge, are derived with quantified targets.

</details>


### [879] [Robust Hierarchical Structures for Agentic Document Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33322)
*Ruiying Ma,Yiming Lin,Aditya G. Parameswaran*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 该论文提出SHED框架，用于从PDF和Word等结构化文档中自动提取鲁棒且紧凑的语义层次树（SHT），以提升基于LLM的智能体文档分析效率和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM及智能体通常将文档视为纯文本处理，忽略了其固有的层次结构（如章节与子章节），导致处理长文档时面临token成本高、上下文退化（context rot）等问题。同时，现有结构提取方法缺乏对推断结构与真实结构匹配程度的正式保证。

Method: 提出SHED，一种两阶段工作流：1）基于视觉特征聚类头部节点，通过语义深度（SD）推断方法（local-first或global-first）为每个聚类分配语义深度；2）根据语义深度的相对顺序组装紧凑SHT。理论层面，提出"语义深度一致性"（SD conformance）作为鲁棒性的充要条件，并刻画文档类别的层次关系（深度对齐、松散格式化等），推广至无限方法族𝒦。

Result: 在四个数据集上，SHED的F-1分数比非LLM基线高13%–68%，比昂贵的LLM基线高9%–15%。在智能体文档问答任务中，使用SHED的智能体准确率提高3%–23%，成本降低至1/10。SHED在600份真实文档中覆盖60.17%（松散格式化），是良好格式化文档（23.39%）的2.57倍。

Conclusion: SHED为文档层次结构提取提供了首个具有鲁棒性保证的形式化框架，且通过智能体问答验证了其实际价值，相比现有方法在准确性和成本上均有显著优势。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable us to better understand text documents, including PDFs and Word documents. However, LLMs, as well as more modern LLM agents, i.e., those with tool-calling abilities, typically treat such documents as plain text, ignoring the fact that they are often organized hierarchically into sections and subsections. Extracting this structure, while difficult, can improve efficiency and effectiveness for agents (and humans)---since only sections relevant to a given task need to be processed. Unfortunately, prior work on structure extraction provides no formal guarantees on how well the inferred structure matches the true one. Instead, we target a robust and compact variant that is feasible to infer and useful in practice. Robustness ensures that the text under each subsection header is a superset of the text under the same header in the true structure. Compactness seeks to minimize this superset, reducing agentic cost (or human cognitive load). We propose SHED, a two-stage workflow for inferring a robust and compact structure. The first stage is pluggable with an infinite family of approaches, each guaranteeing robustness for a specific document class. We theoretically characterize the document space using these classes and their hierarchical relationships. Empirically, SHED improves F-1 scores (measuring the robustness--compactness trade-off) by 13%--68% over non-LLM baselines and 9%--15% over expensive LLM-based approaches. Finally, we show how SHED-inferred structures are valuable for agentic document analysis: agents using SHED outperform baselines, achieving 3%--23% higher accuracy while being up to 10x cheaper.

</details>


### [880] [WeaveData: A Multimodal Data Analysis System with Self-Critiquing and Self-Evolving LLM Plans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34764)
*Min Jia,Shihao Zhou,Jun-Peng Zhu,Peng Cai,Kai Xu,Chao Zhang,Li Li,Aoying Zhou,Heng Long,Qiu Cui,Liu Tang,Qi Liu*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: WeaveData 是一个面向多模态数据（关系表、文本、图像）分析的系统，核心创新在于让 LLM 生成的计划能够进行自我批评（self-critiquing）和自我演化（self-evolving），以解决现有 LLM 计划在多模态分析中存在的三个问题：静默错误、无法从失败中恢复、以及多源多模态下的模糊性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的多模态数据分析系统存在三个关键局限：（1）LLM 生成的计划看似合理但实际计算了与问题不同的内容，且不会抛出异常（如用 LIMIT 截断并列排名、用子串匹配替代语义判断）；（2）一次性规划器（one-shot planner）在运行失败或结果不完整时无法恢复，用户必须重新表述问题并重复所有模型调用；（3）多模态问题常存在歧义（例如同一房源有3张照片，"照片中看起来现代"可能要求1张或全部3张满足条件），且不同模态的数据源之间往往缺乏共享键（如航线与 logo 图像只能通过内容关联）。这些问题导致 LLM 计划的可靠性差，阻碍其在数据管理社区的落地应用。

Method: WeaveData 采用三阶段、八步骤的架构，包含六大核心机制：（1）元数据知识图谱：对所有数据源预先分析（表的列统计与键引用、文本与图像的主题/实体/对象/SPO 关系），形成知识图谱；（2）用户澄清歧义：将问题改写为显式目标并检索相关源/字段/关系，对存在歧义的问题向用户询问，至多三轮；（3）类型化逻辑计划与自批评：使用 DAG 形式的类型化操作符（含 37 个操作符覆盖关系处理、文本/图像的逐项提取与分类、内容匹配等），通过确定性规则检查（合约检查、语义检查、列血缘追踪）+ LLM 逐步自批评（按执行顺序验证每步前置条件与效果），最多五轮草稿，否决需多数票同意；（4）结果自批评与自我演化：执行后二次批评结果是否回答问题，最多四轮，每轮复用有效中间结果；按行签名识别可复用步骤；判断结果按操作符/指令/内容/模型的指纹缓存；（6）经验教训机制：成功修复的问题转化为触发-描述-动作的教训，用于后续问题，按数据/通用两层管理，教训按结果而非原因归因，三次成功后升级为通用，两次失败超过成功则退役。所有模型判断均附带证据（文本引用或视觉细节）。

Result: 系统在两个公开多模态数据集上演示：（1）SemBench MMQA 场景——"为每个有欧洲目的地的航空公司找到 logo 图像"：前 4 个草稿因空 SQL 查询、表输入到文本操作符、类型不匹配、输出遗漏无 logo 的航空公司等原因被拒绝，第 5 个草稿通过；首次执行需 298 次模型调用，结果批评发现 SQL 步骤错误丢弃了 model_inferred 状态的匹配结果，自我演化计划修改 2 个步骤复用 7 个步骤的结果，修复仅需 6 次模型调用，匹配步骤通过缓存零成本完成，最终返回 5 个航空公司的 logo，与 SemBench 标注一致；（2）Palimpzest 房地产场景——"找出 MIT 两英里内、价格 60 万–200 万美元、照片现代有吸引力且阳光充足的房源"：通过澄清交互明确照片判定策略（任一照片满足即可），视觉模型判定 30 张照片中保留 6 套符合条件的房源，其中 21 个判断被标记为边缘情况，8 个为有争议。

Conclusion: WeaveData 展示了 LLM 计划在多模态数据分析中通过自批评与自演化实现端到端可靠分析的可行性；系统提供完整的交互式笔记本体验，使用户能够审视计划、检查证据、理解每步推理；该工作为解决 LLM 计划静默失败与不可恢复的局限提供了系统化的方案，并通过经验积累机制提升长期可靠性，对多模态数据管理与 LLM 增强的数据分析社区具有实践价值。

Abstract: Multimodal data analysis, which answers questions over relational tables, text, and images, has attracted growing attention in the data management community. Large language models (LLMs) enable such analysis in natural language by generating analysis plans over relational and semantic operators. However, LLM-generated plans are error-prone: a plan may silently compute something other than what was asked, fail during execution, or return a result that misses the question. This paper presents WeaveData, a multimodal data analysis system with self-critiquing and self-evolving LLM plans. First, WeaveData generates a typed logical plan for each question and critiques it step by step before execution, and it checks the executed result against the question afterwards. Second, WeaveData evolves a plan that fails or misses the question: it diagnoses the failure with the actual data, reuses the results that remain valid, and accumulates planning experience for later questions. Third, WeaveData grounds planning in a metadata knowledge graph of all modalities, clarifies ambiguous questions with the user, and backs every model judgment with evidence in an interactive notebook. We demonstrate WeaveData on two public multimodal datasets.

</details>


### [881] [Transformations for Evolving Property Graph Schemas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34789)
*Gauvain Devillez,Stefania Dumbrava,Angela Bonifati*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: GRAFT是一个基于逻辑的属性图模式演化框架，通过原子编辑构造可复用的元转换，将模式演化建模为有限元图的搜索问题，结合相似度引导的搜索与剪枝保证正确性、终止性和无重复，在基准和真实数据集上能高效生成高质量的模式转换序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 属性图数据库广泛使用但模式演化的系统化支持有限：现有模式转换多依赖手工定义、与应用耦合、难以跨模式或演化场景复用，亟需一种可复用的、自动化的框架来支持属性图模式演化。

Method: 将属性图模式演化建模为基于原子编辑（atomic edits）的、有序约束的、可复用的元转换（meta-transformations）；模式作为节点、接地元转换（grounded meta-transformations）作为边，构造有限元图进行搜索；采用相似度引导的搜索（similarity-guided search）与剪枝（pruning）相结合，保证无重复性（duplication-freeness）、终止性（termination）与正确性（correctness），并使用贪心探索策略。

Result: 在四个基准和真实属性图模式演化场景上的实验显示其能高效生成高质量的模式转换序列；贪心探索在多数数据集上能精确到达目标模式，运行时低且转换序列稳定；对真实和合成大规模数据集的定性研究表明所获得的可复用元转换具有高质量和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: GRAFT提供了一种逻辑化、可复用的属性图模式演化框架，通过有限元图搜索与相似度引导剪枝，有效解决了模式转换难以跨场景复用的问题，在效率、正确性和转换质量上均表现良好。

Abstract: Property graph databases are widely used to represent complex and evolving data; yet, systematic support for property graph schema evolution remains limited. In practice, schema transformations are typically defined manually, coupled to specific application contexts, and are difficult to reuse across schemas or evolution scenarios. We present GRAFT, a logic-based framework that models prop- erty graph schema evolution as reusable, order-constrained meta- transformations derived from atomic edits. Schema evolution is formulated as exploration of a finite meta-graph with schemas as nodes and grounded meta-transformations as edges. To ensure tractability, GRAFT combines similarity-guided search and pruning, guaranteeing duplication-freeness, termination and correctness. An experimental evaluation on four benchmark and real-world property graph schema evolution scenarios shows that GRAFT effi- ciently computes high-quality schema transformation sequences. Using greedy exploration, GRAFT reaches the exact target schema on most datasets, producing stable transformation sequences while keeping runtimes low. A qualitative study on both real-world and a synthetic large-scale dataset further shows the quality and robust- ness of the obtained reusable meta-transformations.

</details>

### [882] [What Next-Event Accuracy Cannot See: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Emergency Department Trajectory Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31635)
*Zhen Xuen Brandon Low*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出EDSim-Bench基准，系统量化了急诊科临床轨迹模型在闭环仿真（自回归生成）中的失败模式，揭示了next-event accuracy（下一事件准确率）无法反映的"仿真鸿沟"，并发现全位置监督训练可大幅提升闭环稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的临床轨迹生成模型主要通过next-event accuracy进行评估，但仿真任务要求模型基于自身生成的事件进行条件预测，误差会不断累积。论文旨在系统量化这一"仿真鸿沟"，揭示传统评估方法的不足。

Method: 基于MIMIC-IV-ED（425,028次就诊）和外部MC-MED数据集，构建EDSim-Bench闭环评估基准。从保留访问前缀开始生成剩余序列，在终止性、事件组成、时间校准、条件保真度和占用预测五个维度评估，以仅在训练集上拟合的3阶n-gram作为参考基线。比较Transformer、GRU、LSTM等架构在"仅前缀位置监督"与"全位置监督"下的表现。

Result: 1) next-event accuracy仅差0.001的三种神经架构在闭环滚动下表现差异巨大（如Transformer终止率0.43-0.96，事件分布发散为n-gram参考的4.2-137倍）；2) 推理时干预（过程约束、采样策略、容量扩展、与计数模型混合）可改善终止性但无法同时恢复事件组成和时间校准；3) 全位置监督训练使Transformer、GRU、LSTM的发散度降低1-2个数量级，在模型缩放、时间偏移和外部站点验证中均成立；4) 即使最佳模型生成的访问仅约为实际长度的一半；5) 在占用预测任务上模型排名发生反转。

Conclusion: next-event accuracy不足以评估临床轨迹仿真器。临床轨迹模型应通过多种子、多标准的闭环滚动评估进行验证，全位置监督是提高闭环稳定性的关键训练策略，但并不能解决所有评估维度上的问题。

Abstract: Clinical trajectory models are usually evaluated by next-event accuracy on observed histories. Simulation is different: models must condition on their own generated events, allowing errors to compound. Although this problem is well known in sequence modelling, it has not been systematically quantified for clinical trajectory simulators. We developed EDSim-Bench to evaluate this failure mode using 425,028 MIMIC-IV-ED stays, with external replication on MC-MED, and release the evaluation protocol and scoring code. Starting from held-out visit prefixes, models generate the remainder of each visit and are evaluated on termination, event composition, timing, conditional fidelity, and occupancy forecasting, with a train-only order-3 n-gram as a reference baseline. Despite next-event accuracies within 0.001, three neural architectures behaved very differently under rollout. Across seeds, one Transformer recipe ranged from 0.43 to 0.96 in termination score and from 4.2- to 137-fold the divergence of the n-gram; no prefix-trained neural model approached the n-gram on termination or event composition. Inference-time interventions improved termination but did not jointly recover composition and timing. Supervising every eligible sequence position rather than only the final prefix position was associated with one to two orders of magnitude lower divergence across Transformer, GRU, and LSTM models, with the pattern persisting under model scaling, temporal shift, and external-site evaluation. Nevertheless, even the best model generated visits approximately half as long as observed, and model rankings reversed on occupancy forecasting, a downstream quantity relevant to bed management. These results show that next-event accuracy is insufficient to evaluate clinical trajectory simulators and motivate closed-loop evaluation across seeds, rollout criteria, and downstream tasks.

</details>


### [883] [Energy-aware frugal Bayesian optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31638)
*Gaston Plat,Paul Saves,Nathalie Bartoli,Thierry Lefebvre,Joseph Morlier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种能耗感知的贝叶斯优化（BO）框架，将计算能耗作为额外目标嵌入超参数优化中，以平衡优化性能与计算资源消耗。实验验证表明该方法可显著降低能耗（最高96%）并保持或改善优化精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程设计优化中，模型追求预测精度而忽视计算开销，导致高维、多学科设计优化问题难以求解。现有研究缺乏将能耗纳入优化过程的正式框架，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 1. 使用拉丁超立方采样（LHS）生成初始设计矩阵；2. 采用高斯过程（GP）回归构建代理模型，引入分层GP处理层次变量关系；3. 基于SEGOMOE实现多目标贝叶斯优化，使用PI和EHVI采集函数；4. 引入CodeCarbon工具量化CPU/GPU能耗；5. 通过多目标优化在能耗与精度间寻找Pareto前沿。

Result: MLP分类器案例：能耗最多可降低96%，测试误差仅从4.34%增至7.81%；10-bar桁架案例：能耗降低91%，且可行质量最小值改善39%。实验证实存在明显的性能-能耗权衡Pareto前沿，且部分配置同时优于经验调参基线。

Conclusion: 能耗指标有效识别了搜索过程中的节能轨迹，参数配置对收敛性能与能耗平衡有显著影响。未来工作包括：采用低保真模型加速评估、非短视采集策略、动态自适应模型、分布式计算负载以及考虑温室气体排放和水资源消耗等更广泛的环境影响。

Abstract: Modern design optimization frameworks aim first and foremost for models with the most accurate predictions without balancing computational overhead. It remains a reason why scaled architecture and multidisciplinary design optimization problems are difficult to address, even with sample-efficient Bayesian optimizers. In this paper, a metric quantifying the computational energy footprint is introduced within a Bayesian optimization framework to guide the parameter setting of a model towards configurations that balance both performance and frugality. The computer experiments highlighted existing tradeoffs between optimum convergence and the underlying energy footprint, and sometimes resulted in both a better-found optimum and lower energy consumption.

</details>


### [884] [When Does Domain Adaptation Help on Physical Vibration Sensors? A Held-Out-Bearing Study of Neural-Operator and Convolutional Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31639)
*Kumbha Nagaswetha,Rabi Pathak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对滚动轴承振动故障诊断中的领域适应问题，提出"留出轴承单元"（held-out-bearing）评估协议，揭示传统窗口级划分所报告的99%以上准确率严重高估真实跨工况迁移能力。研究以计算阶次跟踪（computed order tracking）作为受控的输入表征变换，系统比较了傅里叶神经算子（FNO）与匹配特征维度的卷积网络在PU和CWRU两个公开数据集上的源域迁移与无监督对齐表现。核心结论是：对于故障频率随轴速移动的工况偏移，阶次域表征将FNO的源域迁移从0.36提升至0.61，归一化RBF-MMD对齐进一步达到0.95±0.06，逼近有目标监督的0.97上限；而同等条件下的卷积网络始终停留在接近随机水平。实验通过带宽匹配、时长控制、模态消融、转速假设误差敏感性等多组消融证实：决定适应成败的是输入表征而非对齐损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轴承故障诊断的领域适应文献普遍报告99%以上的迁移准确率，但其评估划分常将同一物理轴承的振动窗口同时放入训练集与测试集，使模型可能通过识别"具体单元"而非"故障类型"获得高分，掩盖了真实的跨工况泛化能力。本文质疑：在真正的留出单元协议下，源域迁移究竟有多强？影响迁移成败的关键到底是常用的对齐损失，还是更基本的输入表征选择？

Method: 1) 评估协议：采用留出轴承单元划分——PU数据集每类三个物理轴承构成三折交叉验证；CWRU以故障直径作为留出单元。2) 信号表征：原始振动经带通滤波（PU 2–6 kHz，CWRU 2.5–4.5 kHz）、Hilbert包络、解调到2 kHz后，分别保留为频率（Hz，L=2000）或阶次（order，L=1920，固定15转×128点/转）域表征。3) 模型架构：FNO采用16通道提升、两层谱块（保留最低200个傅里叶模式）与16维特征层；CNN采用四块卷积+池化、48基础宽度、匹配16维特征层（约207 k vs. 376 k参数）。4) 对齐损失：CORAL、DANN、线性MMD、归一化RBF-MMD五种选择。5) 标签预算：f∈{0, 0.03, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30}。6) 统计：每种配置三随机种子×三折=九次运行，配对Wilcoxon检验与自助置信区间。7) 消融：CNN超参数网格搜索（27配置）、频谱输入MLP、带宽匹配、时长裁剪（0.6 s固定、15转对齐）、故障阶次模态消融、转速假设误差±5%敏感性。

Result: PU数据集1500→900 rpm转速偏移：FNO源域迁移Hz域0.36→阶次域0.61（+0.25，Wilcoxon p=0.012，八胜一负）；归一化RBF-MMD无标签对齐下阶次域达0.95±0.06，逼近oracle的0.97±0.04，最低折0.86以上，每折标准差由0.33降至0.06。CNN在两种表征下均接近随机（Hz 0.38±0.16，order 0.43±0.16），对齐后阶次域反降至0.29–0.33。对于不改变故障频率位置的扭矩与径向力偏移，阶次跟踪无增益亦无损害（FNO Hz 0.93–0.95 vs. order 0.93–0.94）。标签预算曲线显示FNO在f=0.03时无对齐模型即从0.61跃至0.92，f≈0.20时稳定对齐方法均落入oracle 0.03以内；CNN最高仅0.83。CWRU：fold 1（留出0.007 inch直径）为负载偏移迁移测试，FNO阶次域达0.91±0.10而Hz域仅0.52±0.06，差距集中在内圈召回率（0.00）；fold 2–3为未见故障几何测试，oracle也无法识别0.014 inch外圈（召回0.00）与0.021 inch内圈（召回0.44）。消融证实：固定0.6 s时长裁剪不改变迁移（Δ=+0.01，p=0.74）；按15转对齐裁剪即恢复阶次域效果（0.63 vs. 0.61）；转速假设误差约1%以内可保持优势，2%则丧失；BPFO带消融专损外圈召回（0.74→0.33），控制带消融几乎无影响（<0.01）。

Conclusion: 对于滚动轴承振动故障的领域适应问题，输入表征（特别是阶次域对齐）比对齐损失的选择更具决定性：当故障频率因轴速变化而在频谱上移动时，阶次跟踪将故障特征固定在谱上的恒定位置，使频域敏感的FNO能够利用无监督对齐达到接近监督上限的迁移精度；面向局部时序模式的卷积网络在两种表征下均无法迁移。少量目标标签（f≈0.10–0.20）即可闭合剩余差距。留出单元协议同时揭示了一个常被忽视的失败模式——任何模型（含目标监督oracle）都无法泛化到训练中未见过的故障几何尺寸。该协议应为振动诊断领域的标准实践。

Abstract: Diagnosing rolling-element bearing faults from vibration is a canonical physical-sensing task and a widely used benchmark for domain adaptation under operating-condition shift. Accuracies above 99 percent are commonly reported, but under evaluation splits that place the same physical bearing in both training and test. We revisit the task under a held-out-bearing protocol, assigning every bearing unit entirely to either the training or the test set, and find that source-only transfer is far weaker than such numbers suggest: on a change of shaft speed it reaches only $0.36$, against a target-supervised ceiling of 0.97. We then study what governs transfer. Treating computed order tracking, a shaft-angle resampling that places fault frequencies at fixed shaft orders independent of running speed, as a controlled change of representation, we find that a Fourier Neural Operator raises source-only transfer from $0.36$ to $0.61$ on the speed shift, where the fault peaks move, while a convolutional network of matched feature dimension stays near chance in both representations. The representation also decides whether unsupervised alignment can work: with the same normalized RBF-MMD loss and no target labels, the operator reaches 0.71 in the frequency domain but 0.95 in the order domain, within 0.02 of the target-supervised ceiling and above $0.86$ on every held-out bearing fold. Once the representation is right, a small label budget adds little. These results indicate that, for this task, the input representation rather than the alignment method decides whether adaptation helps. A second dataset, whose held-out units are fault diameters rather than bearings, shows that the same protocol exposes failures that even a target-supervised model cannot avoid.

</details>


### [885] [Measure Learning at Steady State: A BIRD-SQL Formula 1 Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31640)
*Manoj Bajaj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在BIRD-SQL Formula 1长程任务上重新审视CL-Bench对ICL的"最优学习机制"结论，提出以稳态窗口(末40题)的探查效率、任务奖励与交付成本三条独立曲线衡量持续学习，并论证无界全上下文ICL虽能复用模式但代价高昂，不宜视为最佳学习机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CL-Bench以短期(数十题)增益对比基线，得出朴素全上下文ICL优于Mem0、ACE、ICL Notepad的结论。但生产代理应在长期共享世界中持续运行，且单一增益数字无法揭示学习系统在准确性、效率与成本上的分歧表现。

Method: 任务：BIRD-SQL Formula 1子集，174道固定顺序的SQL题，SQLite数据库。条件：基线为每题新建会话(fresh chat)，学习臂为同一会话续接(--resume-trajectory)。模型：openai/gpt-5.6-luna(基线3次重复+ICL 1次)与openai/gpt-5.6-terra(各1次)。度量拆分：探索效率(SQL探测次数db query)、任务奖励(二元命中hits)、交付成本(API美元与上下文token)；稳态窗口为预设的末40题(q135–174)。附加负向实验：≥25k token触发pi原生ctx.compact()压缩。

Result: Luna稳态ICL平均探测0.95次 vs 基线4.6–5.6次(节省约4.2次/题，约170次)；末40题命中13 vs 10–11；全程命中74 vs 65–67；API成本约$9.92 vs $4.47–4.55(约翻倍)；上下文从约4k增至约95k token。Terra稳态ICL探测1.08 vs 3.85，命中19 vs 9，成本$11.10 vs $3.63，上下文约3k→103k。40题窗口(对应CL-Bench时长)低估了后期节省且看不到成本反转。原生25k压缩虽控住token(末态约26–29k)并维持低探测，但成本反而升至$12.73(Luna)/$14.21(Terra)，且命中率下降。

Conclusion: 学习真实存在且稳态最大：ICL在长期任务中显著降低探查(约每题1次 vs 4–6次)。但短期增益聚合错误地"漂洗"了晚期的探查节省，且完全无法观测成本曲线反转。无界全上下文ICL是工作可用的模式存储，却也是线性增长的输入账单——不能视为最佳学习机制。正确度量应是：稳态窗口相对基线的缺口，并分别报告探索效率、任务奖励与交付成本；真正的目标是保留第一条曲线同时避免第三条恶化。

Abstract: Continual Learning Bench scores learning as short-horizon gain versus a reset baseline and finds naive full-context ICL strongest among the memories it tested. We treat ICL as one learning system and score it on a longer shared-world schedule. Steady-state learning is the gap versus baseline on a pre-set late window (last 40 of 174 BIRD-SQL formula-1 questions). We split the score into exploration efficiency (SQL probes), task reward (hits), and delivery cost (API dollars and context size). On gpt-5.6-luna, late probes fall from 4.6-5.6 to 0.95 while hits rise only modestly and ICL context grows to about 95k tokens with cost roughly doubling. Short-horizon gain understates the late probe saving and misses the cost inversion, so we find that unbounded ICL is a poor candidate for the learning mechanism.

</details>


### [886] [Information Design Against Gaming and Learning Adversaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31643)
*Madhava Gaikwad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究二元分类器部署中带弃权选项的机制设计问题，分析了"对抗性博弈者"（已知分类器，试图跨越决策边界）与"学习性对手"（未知分类器，试图重建边界）两类威胁，并刻画了两种自然防御策略——固定概率弃权（粗粒度）与边界附近弃权（局部化）——之间的根本权衡。

**核心问题：** 在固定弃权预算下，主体应选择何种弃权规则？这两种规则分别针对何种对手最优？

**关键发现：**
- **Blackwell不可比性**：粗粒度（E_coarse）与局部化（E_loc^δ）弃权实验无法通过信号后处理相互模拟。
- **学习查询复杂度**：
  - 粗粒度弃权下：L*_L(E_coarse, ε) = Θ̃(d·θ_{B,μ}(ε)·log(1/ε)/(1-ᾱ))，最坏情况下为 Θ̃(d·log(1/ε)/((1-ᾱ)·ε))
  - 局部化弃权下：L*_L(E_loc^δ, ε) = Θ(d·log(1/ε))，与弃权预算无关
  - 最坏情况下两者相差 1/ε 因子
- **博弈查询复杂度**：当 δ ≥ δ_G 时，局部化弃权使博弈者成功率严格为0；粗估令使博弈者以概率1成功。
- **Pareto前沿**：通过凸组合 E_λ = λ·E_coarse + (1-λ)·E_loc^δ 可得到两目标间的完整前沿，且族内无支配。

**方法论：**
- 模型：主体承诺分类器B与三元信号{接受、拒绝、弃权}机制E，满足标签真实性，弃权预算ᾱ < 1。
- 接收者：学习者（最小化重构误差）与博弈者（最大化近边界接受信号），均自适应查询。
- 关键工具：VC维d、不一致系数θ_{B,μ}(ε)、Assouad引理（粗粒度下界）、Fano不等式（局部化下界）、主动学习理论（CAL算法）、Blackwell序。
- 边界规则性假设4.3（沿d个坐标方向单调穿越）。

**实验验证：**
- 7个二元分类任务（表格、图像、文本嵌入），受害者为逻辑回归。
- 协议A（仅随机标签）显示幂律衰减（ρ ∈ [0.32, 1.12]）；协议B（标签+反事实）显示指数衰减（R² ≥ 0.72）。
- 在ACSIncome上，协议B在L ∈ [200, 1000]区间比ActiveThief基线快3–6倍。
- 在SST-2和Civil Comments上达到200×查询效率提升（ε = 0.02时）。
- 博弈抵抗验证：粗粒度弃权下博弈者成功率1.000，局部化弃权下严格为0。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着二元分类器通过API大规模部署，模型提取（model extraction）攻击已成为实际威胁（如Anthropic报告的约1600万次针对Claude的查询交换）。主体需要在承诺机制下保护决策边界免受两类对手攻击：已知分类器并试图跨越边界的博弈者，以及未知分类器并试图重建边界的学习者。弃权信号是主体唯一可设计的杠杆，但两类对手的最优防御策略相互矛盾——针对一方的最优策略恰为另一方的最劣策略。这一根本张力需要严格的信息论刻画。

Method: 1. **信息设计框架**：主体承诺实验E（马尔可夫核）映射(query, boundary) → {接受, 拒绝, 弃权}，满足标签真实性，受弃权预算ᾱ约束。学习者与博弈者均自适应查询但目标不同。

2. **两类极端实验**：
   - 粗粒度E_coarse：以概率ᾱ独立弃权，与位置和边界无关。
   - 局部化E_loc^δ：仅在距离边界δ内弃权，δ由预算校准。

3. **核心理论工具**：
   - **Blackwell序**：证明两实验不可比（定理4.1），通过构造一对边界使任一信号核无法同时匹配。
   - **Assouad引理**（粗粒度下界）：在碎裂集上构造2^d个边界，量化Hellinger距离，证明L ≥ Ω(d/((1-ᾱ)ε))。
   - **主动学习理论**（粗粒度上界）：CAL算法在(1-ᾱ)有效查询下达到 Õ(θ_{B,μ}(ε)·d·log(1/ε))。
   - **坐标二分搜索**（局部化上界）：利用弃权作为距离见证，沿d个坐标方向各需log(1/ε)查询，共O(d·log(1/ε))。
   - **Fano不等式**（局部化下界）：三值信号每查询至多log₂3比特，识别⌊1/ε⌋^d个边界需Ω(d·log(1/ε))查询。
   - **凸组合族E_λ**与**时间共享**：刻画Pareto前沿（定理5.2）。

4. **实验设计**：在7个任务（ACSIncome、MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、SST-2、AG News、Civil Comments、TREC）上比较三种提取协议（随机标签、ActiveThief主动学习基线、标签+反事实），通过幂律vs指数衰减拟合验证率预测。

Result: **理论结果：**
1. **率刻画（定理4.2 & 4.4）**：粗粒度下学习复杂度 Θ̃(d·θ_{B,μ}(ε)·log(1/ε)/(1-ᾱ))；局部化下 Θ(d·log(1/ε))。最坏情况下不一致系数Θ(1/ε)时差距1/ε因子；对数凹分布下的线性分类器，θ=O(1)，两率匹配。
2. **Blackwell不可比性（定理4.1）**：对ᾱ ∈ (0, 1/2)，两极端实验无法相互模拟——粗粒度实验的信号仅通过B(x)依赖于边界，而局部化实验编码距离见证信息。
3. **发散性（定理5.1）**：δ ≥ δ_G时局部化下博弈值严格为0，粗粒度下趋近1；学习率在最坏分布下比值Θ̃(1/ε)。
4. **Pareto前沿（定理5.2）**：E_λ族的可达成集为{(1/(λ(1-ᾱ)), min(粗率, d·log(1/ε)/((1-λ)(1-ᾱ)))) : λ ∈ (0,1]}，族内无支配。

**实验结果：**
- 7任务全部验证了粗粒度幂律衰减（ρ ∈ [0.32, 1.12]）和局部化指数衰减（β > 0, R² ≥ 0.72）。
- 端到端查询效率差距（在ε = 0.02时）：ACSIncome > 25×，TREC 40×，SST-2与Civil Comments 200×，AG News与MNIST ~5×，Fashion-MNIST ~10×。
- ACSIncome上ActiveThief（主动学习基线，ρ=1.43）比随机标签（ρ=0.80）快约2×，但标签+反事实仍快3–6×（L ∈ [200, 1000]）。
- 博弈抵抗：粗粒度弃权成功率1.000，局部化弃权0.000（200次试验，ACSIncome和TREC均如此）。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了二元分类器弃权机制设计中的一个基本二分法：无单一静态弃权规则能同时最优防御博弈型和学习型对手。粗粒度弃权（固定概率）与局部化弃权（边界附近）是Blackwell不可比的，分别对应Θ̃(d/ε)和Θ(d·log(1/ε))的学习查询复杂度，在最坏分布下相差1/ε因子。凸组合族E_λ给出了完整的Pareto前沿，但族内不存在同时改善两目标的混合。实验在7个跨模态任务上验证了率预测：标签加反事实访问比已发表的仅标签主动学习基线（ActiveThief）少用高达200×的查询即可达到ε=0.02的提取误差，同时严格阻断近边界操纵攻击。

**理论贡献**：首次在信息设计框架下严格刻画博弈与学习两类威胁对弃权规则的相反需求，给出两极端实验的Blackwell不可比性证明与紧查询复杂度界。

**实践意义**：为API部署者提供明确指南——若主要威胁为博弈（边界操纵），应采用局部化弃权；若主要威胁为模型提取，应采用粗粒度弃权；混合策略需在两目标间权衡。语言模型特征空间中反事实信息释放的指数级提取风险尤其值得关注。

**局限与未来方向**：（1）非规则边界类（如RBF网络）的率仍开放；（2）多类扩展需引入Natarajan维，不一致系数与二分搜索结构性退化；（3）非线性主体目标（准确性与人工审核成本）下最优解不一定为两极端之一；（4）动态时变规则是否可同时实现两目标至常数因子代价尚未确定；（5）需扩展到决策树、多项式阈值等非线性受害者模型及HopSkipJumpAttack等更强仅标签攻击基线。

Abstract: A principal who deploys a binary classifier with an abstention option must decide which queries the mechanism abstains on. The right choice depends on the adversary. A gaming adversary already knows the classifier and tries to manipulate features across the boundary, so the principal does best by abstaining on queries close to that boundary. The same boundary-localizing rule is the worst possible choice against a learning adversary who does not know the classifier: each abstention now tells the adversary that the boundary is nearby, which is enough to drive a binary search. We analyze this tension. The two natural defenses, abstaining at a fixed rate and abstaining near the boundary, are Blackwell-incomparable: neither can be simulated by post-processing the other's responses. The number of queries needed to reconstruct the boundary to error $\eps$ is $\tilde\Theta(d/\eps)$ under the first defense and $\Theta(d \log(1/\eps))$ under the second, where $d$ is the VC dimension of the classifier family and $\tilde\Theta$ suppresses factors polylogarithmic in $d$ and $1/\eps$. The first rate is a worst case over query distributions; no reconstruction algorithm can close the gap at the distributions that attain it. We characterize the Pareto frontier between the two defense objectives, and confirm both rates on seven binary-classification tasks spanning tabular, image, and language-model-feature inputs: label-plus-counterfactual access extracts the boundary with up to $200\times$ fewer queries than a published label-only baseline.

</details>


### [887] [MaD-RL: Matching Distributions for Calibrating LLMs with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31644)
*Sourabh Kulkarni,Ksheeraj Sai Vepuri,Basar Demir,Jason Bohrer,Emily Shen,Jianfa Chen,Nan Jiang,Ankit Jain,Harihar Subramanyam,Mannat Singh,Chirag Nagpal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MaD-RL提出了一种基于GRPO的强化学习框架，通过四种散度（L₂、前向KL、反向KL、Jensen-Shannon）将模型输出在潜在类别上的分布匹配到用户指定的目标分布，解决了标准RL后训练中输出多样性下降的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准RL后训练（如GRPO）针对个体输出最大化奖励，导致输出多样性降低、概率集中在单一模式上。但合成数据生成、公平性约束、策略探索等应用需要控制多次生成中输出的分布，而非仅最大化期望奖励。现有的熵正则化和采样温度仅作用于token空间且偏向均匀分布，无法满足非均匀目标需求。

Method: 方法核心是将分布匹配问题转化为策略梯度奖励：
1. **形式化**：对每个prompt采样G个completion，通过分类函数f分配到K个类别，估计类别频率q̂与目标p*的差距。
2. **四种散度的奖励函数**：
   - L₂：R = p*(z) - P̂_π(z)（恢复GAPO为特例）
   - 前向KL：R = p*(z)/P_π(z) - 1
   - 反向KL：R = log p*(z) - log P_π(z)
   - JSD：R = ½(log M(z) - log P_π(z))，与GAIL判别器等价
3. **理论保证**：通过score-function恒等式证明各奖励的策略梯度等于相应散度负梯度。
4. **两种组合形式**：加性（r=α·r_corr + (1-α)·r_div）和门控（r=r_corr·(1+λ_g·r_div)）。
5. **实验设置**：使用Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507，在合成选择题（闭集/开集）、多语言数学推理（GSM8K/MATH）和多语言编程（CodeContests）上测试，类别分别为5种语言/编程语言。

Result: 主要结果：
1. **正确性RL改变输出分布**：RLVR使模型偏离均匀分布（如GSM8K集中到中文，CodeContests回到Python）。
2. **均匀目标**：四个目标在所有数据集上均能紧密匹配，JSD<0.008。
3. **尖峰目标**：反向KL表现最佳，三个数据集×两种目标六种组合中五次最低JSD；L₂最差，在四种组合中最高，pass@1比RLVR低1.2-8.5个百分点。
4. **合成实验**：前向KL在闭集/开集选择任务上拟合最好但无效输出率较高，JSD在拟合-有效性前沿上提供最佳折中。
5. **关键发现**：L₂在所有post-training实验中拟合最差但准确性相当，因此不是以拟合换准确性。最佳散度取决于任务，无统一最优。
6. **局限性**：当目标类别缺失于rollout group时，加性奖励的组内相对中心化会使该项消失，无法恢复缺失类别。

Conclusion: MaD-RL提供了一种简单的方法来控制后训练中的分类输出分布，并明确权衡任务准确性与散度选择。结论包括：
1. 分布匹配可保持或改进起始模型准确度，但相比正确性RL有1.2-8.5点的pass@1损失。
2. GAPO风格的L₂奖励在分布匹配上最弱，建议使用KL或JSD替代。
3. 最佳散度依赖于任务：纯分布匹配时前向KL最优，与正确性联合训练时反向KL最优。
4. 在更大模型/数据集规模下，多样性提升有望改善探索并显著提升准确性。
5. 未来需进一步研究各散度优化动态的相对差异。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used in language-model post-training to maximize rewards assigned to individual model outputs, such as scores from binary verifiers or reward models trained on human feedback. However, applications such as synthetic-data generation, fairness-related constraint satisfaction, and policy exploration require controlling the distribution of outputs across model generations rather than only maximizing expected reward. We propose a general RL-based framework for \textit{Distribution Matching} allowing matching the distribution of a latent categorical attribute of model outputs to a specified target distribution. Empirically, we demonstrate that dominant post-training recipes such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) reduce output diversity by concentrating policy probability towards a single mode. Entropy regularization and sampling temperature can improve the spread of the distribution but have constrained effectiveness, limited to apply only in token space and toward uniform distributions. We show that prior work in this area is a specific case of Distribution Matching involving the $L_2$ divergence. We then propose reward functions for other divergences such as KL and Jensen-Shannon and motivate them with theoretical justification. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on a set of experiments involving mathematical reasoning and programming.

</details>


### [888] [STAR: Adaptive Spatial-Temporal Normalization for Unified Microservice Incident Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31645)
*Xinhua Miao,Linyu Zhu,Bowei Yang,Zhengong Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: STAR是一种面向大规模微服务系统的自适应时空归一化表示学习框架,通过时间自适应归一化(TAN)和空间自适应归一化(SAN)两大机制,解决多模态可观测数据中非平稳时间动态与异构服务依赖结构带来的表征偏差问题,并以端到端自监督方式统一支持异常检测、故障分类与根因定位三项任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督事件管理框架(如ART)采用静态归一化方法(如Z-score),无法适应非平稳、多尺度时间动态的微服务遥测数据(指标、日志、追踪),同时传统图编码器(如GraphSAGE)对所有节点施加统一的归一化,忽略了服务调用图中节点度的结构异质性,导致表征偏差,损害下游三项诊断任务的性能。

Method: STAR框架包含两大核心组件:(1) 时间自适应归一化(TAN):通过多尺度一维卷积和自适应平均池化提取多尺度时序上下文特征(对应指标、日志、追踪三种模态,N_s=3),由参数生成器输出动态的缩放与偏移参数γ₁,δ₁,γ₂,δ₂,经基础归一化、自适应变换和可学习加权融合三步处理,并在Transformer编码器后提供反归一化操作;(2) 空间自适应归一化(SAN):将节点入度通过可学习嵌入层映射为连续特征,以全图度嵌入的均值与标准差作为结构自适应缩放与偏置,叠加至标准可学习参数上,在改进的GraphSAGE编码器(含输入投影、残差连接与跳跃连接)末端实现结构感知归一化。两组件被嵌入统一的ART式自监督框架,通过ILD/SLD偏差进行无监督的三任务诊断。

Result: 在两个真实微服务基准数据集D1(46实例,电商系统)与D2(18实例,银行管理系统)上,STAR在AD、FT、RCL三项任务上均稳定优于所有基线模型(Hades、MicroCBR、PDiagnose、Eadro、Dejavu、DiagFusion、ART、TrioXpert),D2上AD F1达0.987,FT加权F1达0.855,RCL AVG@5达0.885;消融实验验证了TAN与SAN各自的有效性;与Z-score、BatchNorm、LayerNorm、RevIN、GraphNorm、DegNorm等替代归一化方法对比亦表现最佳;t-SNE可视化显示归一化后表征更具判别性;超参数N_s=3与各任务特定的最大度D取最优;端到端运行时间满足实时或近实时诊断需求。

Conclusion: STAR将归一化重构为可学习的、上下文条件化的变换,使其与微服务系统的非平稳时序动态和异构结构特性对齐,显著提升了多模态自监督表示学习的鲁棒性;实验证明自适应归一化是在复杂系统中实现稳健多模态表示学习的有效机制。未来可结合动态图神经网络、在线增量学习、模型剪枝与蒸馏等方向进一步提升在大规模、动态拓扑与演化故障场景下的可扩展性与适应性。

Abstract: Automated incident management in large-scale microservice systems relies on learning robust representations from multimodal observability data, including metrics, logs, and traces. Although recent self-supervised frameworks enable unified modeling for anomaly detection (AD), failure triage (FT), and root cause localization (RCL), they often struggle with non-stationary temporal dynamics and heterogeneous service dependency structures. In this paper, we propose STAR, a Spatial-Temporal Adaptive Representation learning framework that explicitly addresses these challenges through adaptive normalizations. STAR introduces two tightly coupled mechanisms: Temporal Adaptive Normalization (TAN), which dynamically normalizes multivariate time series using multi-scale temporal context, and Spatial Adaptive Normalization (SAN), which performs structure-aware normalization over service dependency graphs. Unlike prior methods that treat normalization as static or task-agnostic, STAR formulates it as a learnable, context-conditioned transformation aligned with the intrinsic properties of microservice systems. The resulting adaptive representations are integrated into a unified self-supervised framework, enabling end-to-end unsupervised support for AD, FT, and RCL tasks. Extensive experiments on two real-world microservice benchmarks demonstrate that STAR consistently outperforms all state-of-the-art baselines, yielding significant and stable improvements across all three tasks. Our results highlight adaptive normalization as a principled and effective mechanism for robust multimodal representation learning in complex software systems.

</details>


### [889] [Typed Temporal Interaction Features for Simulation-Backed Forecasting of Open-Source Game Release Incidents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31647)
*Shayma Alkobaisi,Anas Ali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot，一个用于预测开源游戏发布后30天内质量事故风险的类型化时序特征流水线。由于可获取的OSSGameBench数据缺乏人工审计的发布日期和事故标签，评估完全基于五个种子的仿真世界（120项目×24发布）。结果表明该方法未显著优于其最强的本地静态异构对比器（AUPRC 0.520 vs 0.522，差异无统计显著性）。论文强调这是一个协议验证而非部署有效性的实证声明，明确将自身标记为"NO-GO"投稿状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源游戏发布质量取决于代码、资产、配置、测试、贡献者和问题工作流之间的交互，而传统缺陷预测方法（尤其是JIT预测）通常将这些关系扁平化或忽略。游戏发布是比代码变更更大的协调单元，游戏资产也非简单的文档附件。因此需要一个能在严格防泄漏的发布级评估协议下捕捉跨模态类型化时序关系的风险预测框架。

Method: 形式化定义了一个类型化时序发布风险公式，包含八类节点（发布、提交、代码、资产、问题、PR、贡献者、测试）和带时间戳的关系边，构建严格的信息截止屏障（Eq.2）。GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot采用20个基础发布特征加10个类型化交互摘要（代码-资产耦合、资产-测试不匹配、审查变更、贡献者离散度等），输入直方图梯度提升模型。验证集上做Platt校准，按p̂/e的贪心策略分配测试预算。评估使用5个种子×120项目×24发布的仿真数据，项目不相交的验证和未来跨项目留出测试。

Result: GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot获得AUPRC 0.520（SD 0.040）、AUROC 0.673、Brier 0.207、ECE 0.071，在20%测试预算下努力感知召回率29.68%。最强本地对比器Static-Hetero-Reimpl达到AUPRC 0.522，差异-0.002经Holm校正后p=1.000无统计显著性。推理时间0.023毫秒/发布。消融实验显示去除类型化关系后性能接近HistGB-All。缺失掩蔽、漂移分析、引擎分层和排列归因均已执行但效果有限。

Conclusion: 论文得出明确的负面结果：所提出的类型化时序特征未能在控制环境中证明优于最强的本地静态异构对比器。该研究主要验证了一个防泄漏、可执行的实验脚手架，而非建立预测优越性。核心局限是构念效度——无人工审计的真实发布-事故标签可用，且实现使用固定关系摘要而非事件级异构图神经网络。论文自标记为"NO-GO"投稿状态，明确要求四项必备条件后才能期刊投稿：获取完整基准数据、人工审计发布映射与标签、复现至少两个官方图/缺陷预测基线、执行事件级时序异构学习。

Abstract: Open-source video-game quality depends on inter-actions among code, assets, configuration, tests, contributors, and issue workflows, yet conventional defect predictors usually flatten or omit these relations. We investigate release-level forecasting of a quality incident within thirty days using GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot, a typed temporal feature pipeline with calibrated risk estimates and effort-aware ranking. Because the accessible OS-SGameBench materials do not provide manually audited release dates and outbreak labels, the executed evaluation is explicitly simulation-backed rather than an empirical claim about real games. Five seeded worlds each contain 120 projects and 24 releases, with project-disjoint validation and future cross-project testing. The pilot obtains an AUPRC of 0.520, AUROC of 0.673, Brier score of 0.207, and 29.68% effort-aware recall at a twenty-percent testing budget. Its closest local comparator, Static-Hetero-Reimpl, reaches 0.522 AUPRC; the -0.002 difference is not statistically significant after Holm correction. Inference requires 0.023 milliseconds per release in the measured environment. Ablations and controlled missingness, drift, engine, project-size, alert-threshold, and attribution analyses expose where typed interactions help and where they fail. Results support the reproducibility of the proposed protocol, not deployment effectiveness. Real OSSGameBench release reconstruction, stratified label audits, and official graph-model comparisons remain mandatory before journal submission or operational use in practice. This boundary protects research integrity and supports credible evaluation.

</details>


### [890] [Energy Vision--Language--Action: A Controlled Multimodal Benchmark for Intent-Conditioned Residential Energy Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31648)
*Lyes Saad Saoud,Oualid Doukhi,Ehsan Reihani,Saeed Sepasi,Deok Jin Lee,Moussa Ayyash,Reza Ghorbani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EVLA是一个面向住宅能源管理的受控多模态基准测试，将电池调度构建为多模态轨迹预测问题（RGB能量场图像+数值运行状态+自然语言目标→16步电池动作轨迹），通过3隐藏机制×5语言目标的因子设计产生6,588,045个多模态样本。初始研究在5,000训练子集上评估36个配置，发现处理后的语言路径对预测质量至关重要（移除后MSE从0.3856升至0.8628），而当前RGB视觉路径在聚合误差上无明显优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有住宅能源管理系统主要基于优化控制或固定目标的数值学习方法，无法支持居民通过自然语言表达不同操作目标（如节能、舒适、电网支撑等）。同时现有的Vision-Language-Action (VLA)基准主要面向机器人领域，缺乏将数值状态、视觉上下文和语言意图联合控制的受控基准。此外，当多模态输入存在相关性时，仅凭聚合误差无法判断模型是否真正使用了各模态信息。

Method: 1) 数据集构建：从REFIT数据集的19个家庭提取439,203个基础运行窗口，每个窗口通过3隐藏机制×5语言目标扩展为15个受控变体（共6,588,045个多模态样本）。RGB能量场图像编码功率（R）、时序活动（G）和机制纹理（B）。2) 目标生成：基于有限时域采样射击MPC的参考轨迹生成器产生16步电池动作轨迹，候选动作集因机制而异。3) 模型架构：MobileNetV3-Small视觉编码器+简单语言编码器+FiLM条件Transformer（3层）+残差解码器+确定性基线。4) 训练：AdamW优化器，余弦退火，复合损失（MSE+平滑+SOC+动作限位+辅助视觉）。5) 评估：36个配置×3种子的受控子集（5,000/500/500实例），包括模态消融、视觉骨干对比、架构变体和神经基线。

Result: 视觉骨干对比中MobileNet最低MSE为0.3829±0.0003，但六个骨干间差异仅0.0025。MobileNet模态消融显示：完整模型MSE=0.3856±0.0039，移除视觉后MSE=0.3843±0.0013（无改善），移除语言后MSE=0.8628±0.0001（大幅恶化），仅状态MSE=0.8626。语言加扰诊断显示完整FiLM和MLP融合模型对文本敏感（差距约-0.93），但无残差模型敏感度仅-0.008。MLP和LSTM数值基线（0.3887和0.3893）与MobileNet接近。结论是处理后的语言路径对预测质量至关重要，当前RGB路径无聚合优势，低MSE不等于对语言意图有响应。

Conclusion: EVLA提供了首个将RGB能量场观察、数值状态和自然语言目标映射到连续电池动作轨迹的受控VLA风格基准，并支持配对干预分析。核心发现是当前实现的多模态预测器存在明显的模态使用不对称：语言路径与预测质量强相关，而视觉路径未提供聚合误差优势。研究强调模态干预质量比架构广度更重要，未来工作应聚焦于基于组的分区、保持目标本体论、配对机制测试和更强的可复现性控制。报告结果仅描述5,000实例的试点子集而非完整基准训练。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are studied mainly in robotics, where visual observations and language instructions are mapped to physical actions. This paper introduces Energy Vision-Language-Action (EVLA), a controlled multimodal benchmark for intent-conditioned residential energy management. EVLA frames battery scheduling as a multimodal trajectory-prediction problem in which an RGB energy-field representation, a numerical operating state, and a natural-language objective are mapped to a 16-step battery-action trajectory generated by a finite-horizon sampling-based reference generator. Source windows are derived from public residential electrical-load data, while electricity price, battery state of charge, indoor temperature, and time of day are generated benchmark metadata. A hidden operating regime is encoded only through energy-field texture, enabling paired visual changes while the explicit numerical state is fixed. Crossing 439,203 retained base windows with three hidden regimes and five language objectives yields 6,588,045 multimodal instances. An initial study evaluates 36 configurations over three training seeds using fixed subsets of 5,000 training, 500 validation, and 500 test instances. In the MobileNet-family comparison, removing processed language increases trajectory mean-squared error from 0.3856 +/- 0.0039 to 0.8628 +/- 0.0001, whereas removing vision yields 0.3843 +/- 0.0013, comparable to the full model. The results show strong asymmetry in modality use: the processed-language pathway is strongly associated with prediction quality, while the current RGB pathway provides no aggregate error advantage. These results characterize the fixed pilot subset and executed protocol rather than full-benchmark training. EVLA provides a controlled setting for studying how semantic intent and latent context influence residential energy-action prediction.

</details>


### [891] [From Phase Transition to Systemic Failure: A Decoupled Analytics Framework for GNN Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31656)
*Shuai Yan,Dan Peng,Jie Li,Ke Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个基于真实生态统计先验校准的合成同亲图回归测试平台，将标签噪声与特征分布偏移解耦为独立变量，在41种配置、410次实验中对GCN和GAT（含大小容量变体）进行系统评估，揭示GNN对中等标签噪声具有拓扑缓冲的渐进鲁棒性（50%噪声比附近出现相变），而在极端分布偏移下出现跨架构的系统性崩溃（MSE膨胀48–316倍，相关系数下降73–89%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN鲁棒性与OOD基准（如WILDS、GOOD）中，标签噪声、结构扰动和分布偏移等多种退化源高度纠缠，导致模型失效时无法归因于单一因素。本文的核心动机是建立受控的分析框架，将这两种本质上不同的数据质量挑战解耦，以诊断GNN在实际部署中崩溃的精确机制。

Method: （1）从11个真实生态观测数据集（青藏色拉山、青海三江源、甘南和海北草原，2007–2023年，9643条记录）中提取统计先验；（2）构建合成同亲图回归沙盒：500训练节点+200 OOD测试节点，6维标准高斯特征，KNN（K=5）构图，线性映射y=xᵀw+ϵ作为真值预言机；（3）标签噪声注入：随机选取比例p的标签加性扰动η∼N(0,α²)，扫描噪声比(0–100%)×噪声强度(α∈{0.5,1.0,1.5})；（4）分布偏移构造：测试图施加5σ均值偏移+协方差缩放；（5）评估模型：GCN-S/L与GAT-S/L共四种架构，每配置10个随机种子，使用MSE、Pearson r、Cohen's d和Wilcoxon秩和检验。

Result: （1）标签噪声：低至中等噪声下性能稳定（30%噪声比时MSE仅从3.49微升至3.65），在40–60%区间观察到渐进相变而非单点崩溃，但即使100%噪声下退化仍相对有限；（2）极端分布偏移：所有四种架构出现灾难性崩溃，GCN-S MSE膨胀249倍（2.77→691），GAT-S膨胀316倍（2.54→805），最低膨胀也达48倍（GAT-L），相关系数下降73–89%，Cohen's d均大于3.68；（3）关键发现——"容量幻觉"被打破：参数量最大的GAT-L（530K）在i.i.d.条件下表现良好，但OOD下MSE仍飙升48倍、相关性崩塌74%，证明模型复杂度无法补偿分布失配。

Conclusion: 在当前受控设置下，GNN的同亲图消息传递对中等标签噪声起到结构性低通滤波作用，使其具有渐进式而非突变式的鲁棒性；但特征分布偏移直接违反i.i.d.假设，导致跨架构的系统性失败，与模型容量无关。对工业级图挖掘和MLOps而言，算法层面的结构升级无法替代数据完整性保障，必须将输入特征分布漂移监测置于比监督噪声缓解更高的运维优先级，并据此建立自动化的漂移检测阈值与持续再校准工作流。研究局限在于仅对比了基线与极端偏移两个端点，未呈现中间梯度，且未在大型非平稳真实网络上验证。

Abstract: Data quality is a major bottleneck for the reliable deployment of graph neural networks (GNNs) in real-world graph mining tasks. Among various sources of degradation, label noise and feature distribution shift (hereafter referred to as distribution shift) are two common yet fundamentally different challenges. To study their effects under controlled conditions, this paper constructs a synthetic homophilic graph regression benchmark in which the two factors can be manipulated separately. A total of 41 configurations and 410 runs are conducted to evaluate the behavior of representative GNN models under varying noise and shift conditions. The results show two distinct patterns. First, under additive label corruption, performance remains relatively stable over a broad range of noise settings and begins to deteriorate sharply only after an observed transition region around the 50 percent noise ratio. Second, under extreme feature distribution shift, all tested models suffer substantial degradation, with test MSE increasing by 48 times to 316 times and correlation dropping by 73 percent to 89 percent. These findings suggest that, in the present controlled setting, GNNs are considerably more tolerant to moderate label perturbation than to severe distribution mismatch. The study provides a controlled empirical baseline for understanding how data quality affects GNN-based graph mining systems and offers practical implications for deployment-oriented monitoring and model maintenance.

</details>


### [892] [Active Causal Discovery Benchmark: Evaluating LLM Agents Under Budgeted Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31675)
*Sagar Deb,Devam Shah,Ashwanth Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ACDB 是一个基于线性高斯 SCM 的交互式基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体在预算受限的硬干预条件下恢复因果 DAG 结构的能力。在 v0 六级难度阶梯上，PC+贪心主动定向方法以 42.7% directed F1（SHD 4.79）成为最强非预言机方法；最强 LLM（Claude Sonnet 4.6 raw active）仅达到 31.7%（SHD 7.25），且部分 GPT-5.4 设置接近 23.6% 的结构盲随机基线。关键诊断是精度-召回分解：PC 欠承诺高精，LLM 过承诺低精，统计工具访问反而导致回避干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典因果发现算法（如 PC、GES）在小样本下脆弱且未指定干预预算分配策略；LLM 智能体在主动因果发现中的实际能力尚不清楚——是否能可靠恢复结构，还是仅生成"看似合理"的图。需要一个 SCM 基础的、受控的、可复现的基准来审计当前 LLM 智能体在预算受限硬干预下恢复因果 DAG 的真实表现，并区分不同失败模式。

Method: 构建 ACDB 基准：(1) 线性高斯 SCM 世界生成器，对不满足忠实性的实例拒绝；(2) 固定的 observe-intervene-submit 会话 API，硬干预且预算递减；(3) 三层评分契约——观测层（CPDAG 上的 skeleton F1 和 compelled F1）、DAG 层（directed F1 和 SHD，含 reversal=1、unresolved 等细粒度错误）、效率层（相对于预计算最优干预集的 η）；(4) 六级难度阶梯 L0–L5，沿图规模/密度、统计功效（样本量、噪声方差）、预算紧度三轴变化；(5) 评估三类智能体：PC+贪心主动定向、LLM（GPT-5.4 与 Claude Sonnet 4.6，各有 raw/stats 两配置，观测/主动两面板）、结构盲随机 DAG 基线与仅相关矩阵消融探针。所有智能体共享 8 seed 的同一清单。

Result: 在主动面板上：Oracle 100.0% directed F1；PC+贪心 42.7%（Dir P 66.9%，Dir R 32.8%，SHD 4.79，η 89.6%）；Sonnet 4.6 raw 31.7%（P 35.0%，R 29.6%，SHD 7.25）；GPT-5.4 raw 22.9%（P 36.3%，R 19.3%，SHD 9.27）；Sonnet/GPT stats 分别为 28.0% 和 18.8%，效率均 100% 但源自回避干预。随机基线达 23.6%，密度探针可降至 16.9%。PC+贪心对最佳 LLM 的 F1 优势具统计显著性（p=0.025），SHD 优势高度显著（p<10⁻⁴）。Sonnet 4.6 在所有 LLM 设置中均强于 GPT-5.4。在 L2 和 L5 样本最小的关卡，Sonnet 4.6 观测面板反而超过主动面板（39.3% vs 36.9%；40.1% vs 31.9%），表明干预未被有效转化为更好的定向决策。

Conclusion: 当前 LLM 智能体尚不能可靠替代经典因果发现算法：在 ACDB 假设范围内 PC+贪心仍为最强非预言机方法。LLM 的失败模式与 PC 本质不同——PC 欠承诺高精度，LLM 过承诺低精度，仅报告 F1 会掩盖这一差异。统计工具访问并未提升 directed F1，反而使智能体倾向回避干预并提交更少有向边。结构盲随机基线在密集 v0 阶梯上达 23.6% directed F1，弱 LLM 优势需谨慎解读。v1 版本应降低图密度以削弱密度泄露、运行完整相关摘要条件、增加种子数并检查干预驱动的边修订行为。该基准不是新算法贡献，而是用于追踪主动因果发现能力随模型与校准改进的脚手架。

Abstract: We introduce the Active Causal Discovery Benchmark (ACDB), an SCM-grounded environment for evaluating whether LLM agents recover causal graph structure from observations and budget-constrained hard interventions. ACDB pairs a linear-Gaussian world generator with a fixed observe-intervene-submit API and a three-layer scoring contract that separates skeleton recovery, DAG recovery, and intervention efficiency. On the current six-level ladder, PC with a greedy active orientation heuristic is the strongest non-oracle method (directed F1 42.7%, SHD 4.79), ahead of Claude Sonnet 4.6 raw active (31.7%, 7.25) and GPT-5.4 raw active (22.9%, 9.27). The most informative diagnostic is the precision-recall decomposition: PC under-commits with high precision, LLMs over-commit with lower precision, and statistical-tool access often increases abstention rather than useful intervention. A structure-blind random DAG baseline reaches 23.6% directed F1 on this dense v0 ladder; a density probe lowers this floor to 16.9%, motivating the v1 calibration pass. The current results should therefore be read as a benchmark audit and calibration report, not as evidence that current LLMs solve active causal discovery.

</details>


### [893] [Does Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture Pretraining Help Time Series Forecasting?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31680)
*Yutong Feng,Bowen Liao,See Kiong Ng,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过在9个骨干网络和11个时间序列预测基准上的大规模跨架构评估，系统检验了联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）预训练对时间序列预测的实际效用，发现JEPA预训练的效果高度依赖骨干网络选择，对部分架构带来稳定增益，对另一些则造成一致性能退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有JEPA在时间序列自监督学习中的收益证据不一致，且大多数研究仅在单一骨干或窄架构集上测试，无法判断JEPA预训练是一种可靠改进还是严重依赖于下游模型选择。时间序列骨干网络的架构谱系极广（卷积、图、注意力等），这一空白亟需填补。

Method: 采用基于LeJEPA目标的统一JEPA实例化方法：上下文视图为历史窗口x_{1:T}，目标视图为预测窗口x_{T+1:T+L}，编码器-预测器-解码器三段式结构（SIGReg正则化防止坍缩，无需目标编码器或动量更新）。在满足"可分解性准则"的9个骨干网络上应用，覆盖时间预测（ETTh1/2、ETTm1/2、Weather）与时空预测（METR-LA、PEMS-BAY、PEMS03/04/07/08）两大任务族。对每个骨干对比w/o JEPA与w/ JEPA两种条件，除预训练阶段外其余超参与训练流程完全一致，隔离JEPA预训练的独立贡献。

Result: 时序预测中：Crossformer与FEDformer在所有数据集上均获正收益（如FEDformer在Weather上MAE提升6.37%、RMSE提升7.89%）；iTransformer在4/5数据集上双指标退化（最高MAE退化2.93%）；Autoformer与PatchTST呈混合模式，Autoformer在Weather上MAE退化高达15.54%。时空预测中：STGCN稳定改善（5/6数据集，PEMS-BAY上MAE提升8.26%）；ASTGCN与STAEformer在多数数据集上双指标退化（ASTGCN在PEMS08上MAE退化10.36%）；STTN呈混合模式。架构层面观察：密集全局自注意力骨干（iTransformer、STAEformer、ASTGCN）总体获益较差；结构受限的混合骨干（STGCN的图卷积、FEDformer的频域分解、Crossformer的段维度注意力）总体获益较好。最大正负收益差距超过25个百分点，足以改变实际最佳模型选择。

Conclusion: JEPA预训练对时间序列预测的效用并非普遍成立，而是强烈依赖骨干网络选择；该变异性在两类任务族中独立出现，反映了预训练方法的内在属性而非数据集特异性。实践中应将JEPA视为骨干依赖型技术而非默认有益方案。观察到的架构模式（密集全局自注意力获益差 vs 结构受限混合获益好）为未来工作提供了方向，包括在单一骨干族内消融归纳偏置、以及独立消融预测器与SIGReg正则化以追溯变异性来源。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) have emerged as a promising self-supervised pretraining paradigm for time series, learning representations by predicting target embeddings in latent space rather than reconstructing raw signals. Yet evidence on their benefits remains mixed, and most studies test only a single backbone or a narrow set of architectures, leaving unclear whether JEPA pretraining is a reliable improvement or one that depends heavily on the downstream model. We address this gap through a large scale evaluation of one JEPA instantiation across nine backbones and eleven benchmarks spanning temporal and spatio-temporal forecasting, the most extensive cross architecture assessment of JEPA for time series to date. We find that the benefit of this instantiation varies sharply across backbones, producing consistent gains for some architectures and consistent degradation for others, even on the same dataset. This pattern holds across both task families, indicating the variability is a general property of this instantiation rather than a dataset specific artifact worth accounting for when choosing a backbone in practice.

</details>


### [894] [Autonomous Research Project Management as an Agent Skill: A Case Study in Exact Spectral Spatial Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31683)
*Alexander Chen,Jeffrey Meng,Bram Hoex,Tong Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于 FFT 的精确核岭回归（KRR）求解器，利用 BCCB 嵌入和 2D-FFT 谱收缩实现 O(N log N) 时间和 O(N) 内存的精确求解，并在 NOAA Kaplan SST v2 数据上进行验证；该研究完全由 DeepSeek V4 Flash 智能体在消费级硬件（Apple M2 Pro）上自主执行，仅需四次人工引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集核方法在规则空间网格上存在 O(N³) 计算瓶颈；现有近似方法（Nyström、RFF）牺牲精度；同时，自主机器学习研究的科学可信度与可审计性缺乏标准化框架。

Method: 1) 利用 BCCB 嵌入和 2D-FFT 谱收缩实现环面核的精确闭合解；2) 对非环面核使用 BTTB 镜像的精确自由边界 PCG 求解器；3) 采用基于文件系统的 issue-tracking 基板（EPIC.md/ISSUE.md）管理长期状态；4) 通过五阶段研究循环（Scoping→Validation→Execution→Staging→Synthesis）实现自主闭环。

Result: 谱求解器在 36×72 NOAA Kaplan SST v2 数据上达到 2.62×10⁻¹² 相对精度；Matérn-3/2 掩码重构 RMSE 为 0.082-0.088（约 14% 场标准差）；但转移预测假设在 0/4 预测范围内被推翻；自主执行 74 个子会话，消耗 1,625 次 LLM 调用和 2.033 亿 token，仅需 4 次人工引导。

Conclusion: 精确环面谱 KRR 是消费级 CPU 上可行的闭合形式解；但自主研究的科学可信度依赖于可检查状态、可证伪的审查门控以及透明地报告负面结果；社区应优先采用智能体可访问的结构化格式而非静态 PDF。

Abstract: This work presents an end-to-end demonstration of autonomous machine learning research conducted by an agent skill on consumer hardware. The demonstration evaluates an FFT-based Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) solver for regular spatial grids using 2005 monthly NOAA Kaplan SST v2 anomaly fields on a $36 \times 72$ grid. This was autonomously executed by DeepSeek V4 Flash, orchestrated by our agent skill suite within DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Experiments were executed on CPU-only hardware (Apple M2 Pro; 78.7 s solver time, 1.57 GB peak RSS). Long-horizon state was decoupled into a file-based epic- and issue-tracking substrate. Across 74 sub-agent sessions, the agent demonstrated closed-loop scientific resilience: routing two failed hypothesis review gates back to literature retrieval, patching bootstrap indexing bugs, and executing with only four discrete human steering events. Finally, we reflect on autonomous research governance, arguing that scientific credibility requires inspectable state, falsifiable review gates, and transparent reporting of negative results, urging the machine learning community to favour agent-accessible structured formats over static PDF manuscripts.

</details>


### [895] [What does FFN compression change downstream? Same-state causal restoration in diffusion language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31685)
*Shaurya Omar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Same-State Causal Restoration (SSR)，通过在被压缩 DLM 当前分支状态上精确还原原始 FFN，直接测量压缩移除计算对下游去噪轨迹的因果影响；证明局部 NMSE 不足以预测下游效应，固定窗口可在 LLaDA 激进压缩下恢复 89.9% 的精度损失并保留约 36.8% 的 MAC 节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 DLM 压缩目标多以局部误差（如 FFN NMSE）衡量被移除计算与原始计算的近似程度，但局部误差无法揭示哪些被移除的计算对下游去噪轨迹真正重要；论文旨在分离"局部失配"与"下游因果效应"及"最终任务修复"这三个常被混淆的概念，并给出可冻结、可迁移的诊断-恢复框架。

Method: SSR 在压缩模型所到达的同一当前分支 snapshot 上，对指定 (transition, layer) 集合 A 内的 FFN 事件执行原始 FFN 还原，其余事件继续使用压缩 FFN，追踪并比较压缩与还原分支的闭环续生产物 U_Q；以任务标签自由的源集效应筛选并冻结一个全局还原窗口 W_SSR，并在保持同等 MAC 预算下与同长度 NMSE 窗口（含末四步计划）对照；额外用负释放裕度等压缩侧状态可观测量在固定去噪相位下排序 U_dense，并用范数匹配的循环置换 Pδ 控制校正结构；测试对象为冻结的 LLaDA-8B-Instruct (c24/c14) 与 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B (c21) 结构性 FFN 宽度压缩、确定性 32 步长度 32 生成、ARC/SciQ/PIQA/HellaSwag + 冻结 MMLU 297 提示总体。

Result: 固定相位下压缩侧状态（负释放裕度）对 U_dense 的 Spearman 排序在 LLaDA 达 ρ=.456（NMSE −.041）、Dream 达 .522（−.103），并经 ARC-Challenge 预设复核得 ρ=.500、置换 p=.0022；范数匹配干预显示 LLaDA 26/6/0、Dream 轨迹 AUC 20/9/3 胜出，证明校正方向/对齐而非纯幅度决定效应；冻结迁移中 LLaDA c24 上 SSR 27/4 窗口将精度由 21.9% 提至 54.9%，恢复 89.9% 的密-压差，等长 NMSE/末四步窗口仅 49.8%（SSR 超 +5.05 pp，CI [2.36,8.08]，p=.00149），修复 92/115 密对压错机会且 98/99 SSR 独有正确转为有效；c14 上 SSR 与 NMSE 70.8% 平局；Dream c21 任务效应 +2.02 pp 不显著而密一致性 token 协议 +1.68 pp、AUC +.0082 显著；H=1 不足以再现 ARC 模式（1/12 vs 7/12 修复）。

Conclusion: SS

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable flexible, parallel generation, but their iterative denoising remains computationally expensive, motivating increasingly aggressive compression. Existing compression objectives largely measure how well compressed computation approximates the original locally, but local error does not reveal which removed computations actually matter to the downstream denoising trajectory. We introduce Same-State Causal Restoration (SSR), which restores the original FFN on the exact current input reached by the compressed model and measures how the resulting trajectory changes. To our knowledge, this is the first direct measurement of the same-current-input closed-loop effect of removed FFN computation in DLM compression.
