Method: 1. 定义RGI（相对泛化保持）：两模型对任意两个验证token的损失差相等，等价于两模型存在与token无关的常数泛化差；2. 提出两个度量指标——一致性相关系数（r_CCC）和归一化损失差异（r_diff）；3. 在124M/0.7B/4.5B NanoGPT模型上进行大量消融实验，比较Adam/Lion/Adam-mini/Soap/Muon/Scion等优化器、不同初始化、不同模型尺寸（隐藏维度从768到192）、不同注意力设计（RoPE/NoPE/ALiBi/SWA）和FFN激活（GELU/SiLU/SReLU）、不同训练数据流（FineWeb/C4/ArXiv/CodeParrot）和验证数据分布；4. 通过参数和隐藏状态的余弦相似度、ℓ₂距离检验NTK和mean-field两种理论解释；5. 在过参数化两层二次模型上对GD、Adam、Muon进行严格的理论证明。

Result: 1. RGI在多种优化器间近似成立（r_CCC>0.95, r_diff<0.05，约2000步后），且对学习率（0.25-1.25倍）、动量（0.85-0.95）、权重衰减、warmup步数等超参数均稳健；2. 在不同初始化、不同模型尺寸（768/384，但64维失败）、不同注意力/FFN设计间仍近似成立；3. 训练数据流改变会显著破坏RGI（即使同一优化器，在FineWeb训练而在ArXiv/CodeParrot评估时RGI不成立）；4. 验证分布的中等偏移可保留RGI，但极端偏移（如随机token）会破坏；5. 排除NTK解释：训练后参数和隐藏状态都大幅偏离初始化，不同优化器学到不同的表示；6. 排除mean-field解释：即使宽度降至192（标准宽度的1/4），RGI仍存在；7. 理论上构造了一个二次模型，证明了GD/Adam/Muon在不同初始化和学习率下均满足精确RGI，同时参数余弦相似度以O(1/t)衰减。

Conclusion: RGI是LLM预训练中的一种新现象，可以有效区分训练三要素的作用：优化器和架构的选择主要导致token损失近似均匀的平移，而训练数据流才是改变模型相对泛化能力（哪些token更难预测）的关键因素。这一发现挑战了NTK和mean-field等传统训练动力学理论，为理解LLM预训练机制提供了新视角，并可能简化未来研究中优化器和架构的选择与比较。然而，分析局限于自回归LLM，未来可推广至扩散模型等其他架构。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) pretraining performance is jointly shaped by three components of the training triplet: the optimizer, model architecture, and training data stream. However, how these components influence performance in distinct ways remains unclear. We take a first step toward isolating their effects by studying relative generalization. We introduce Relative Generalization Invariance (RGI), the invariance of the validation-loss difference between any two tokens across models. We show that RGI approximately holds across a wide range of optimizers and moderate architectural variations, suggesting that these choices induce an approximately uniform shift in token-wise losses. In contrast, changing the training data stream can substantially alter relative generalization. We further show that RGI cannot be explained by the neural tangent kernel or mean-field regimes alone and prove that it can emerge in an overparameterized quadratic model. Overall, our work identifies RGI as a new phenomenon in LLM pretraining that helps distinguish the effects of optimizers and architectures from those of training data.

</details>


### [950] [Łukasiewicz Neural Networks Extended: Residual Architectures and Crystallization Strategies for Interpretable Rule Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33028)
*Carlos Leandro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Łukasiewicz残差神经网络框架,通过引入残差连接(类似ResNet的跳跃连接)扩展了ŁNN至任意深度,并证明合并神经元(merge neuron)通过结构设计天然满足Łukasiewicz逻辑对应性;同时系统分析了三种权重整数化(crystallization)策略(LM修正版、STE、近端正则化),在6个UCI基准上验证了其可解释规则提取能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Łukasiewicz神经网络(ŁNN)通过整数权重{−1,0,+1}与截断恒等激活实现与Łukasiewicz多值逻辑的精确对应,从而支持符号知识提取。但该方法受限于两个障碍:(1)原Levenberg-Marquardt训练中结晶化(权重整数化)仅概率性成功,且原LM实现存在条件数bug导致发散;(2)理论保证仅对浅层前馈架构成立,深度网络下保证失效。本文旨在同时解决这两个问题。

Method: 方法包含两大核心贡献。理论上:定义Łukasiewicz残差块h^(k)=ψ_b(F^(k)(h^(k-1))+h^(k-1)),证明合并神经元天然满足Proposition 2(Theorem 4),因残差路径与捷径均以权重+1输入,无论内层权重如何,合并神经元结构必然落入Proposition 2的(n=0, p=2)参数化情形,严格保证可解释性。实践上:分析三种结晶化策略——(1)LM修正版(用μI替代Marquardt的μdiag(J^⊤J)缩放,消除小权重初始化时的发散);(2)直线估计STE,前向用T(w)=sgn(w)·1[|w|>1/3]量化,反向梯度近似直传,100%保证结晶化;(3)近端正则化,MSE+λ_s∑|w_k|(L1稀疏)+λ_a∑w_k^2(1-w_k^2)(三元吸引势,在{-1,0,+1}处为零的势阱),采用65/35双阶段训练。提取阶段:自底向上逐层,合并神经元用Theorem 4精确提取,否则用Proposition 2直接提取,不可表示的神经元用Rule R重写代数与λ-相似度近似。

Result: 在6个UCI基准(Mushroom、Heart Disease、MONK-1/2/3、Breast Cancer)各10次独立试验上:LM-Res在MONK-3上以6次迭代收敛至完全结晶,精确恢复公式F=¬(body_shape⊕jacket_colour),准确率97.2%;LM-Res在Heart Disease上结晶率从基线LM的0/10提升至9/10;STE在所有数据集实现10/10结晶化,综合准确率最优;Proximal在Heart Disease上提取出仅用5/22特征的稀疏公式DISEASE=¬(¬trestbps⊗¬oldpeak⊗¬ca)⊗¬(thalach⊗¬ca⊗¬(cp=4)),测试准确率85.0%(敏感度87.5%,特异度83.3%),其中ca(主要血管狭窄数)在10次重启中100%被选中。Proximal在5/6密集特征数据集上退化为常量输出(±0.000标准差),确认为结构性失败模式。LM-Res在4/6数据集上训练最快(MONK-3快STE 7.9×)。Wilcoxon检验显示LM-Res在MONK-3上显著优于STE(p=0.016)与Proximal(p=0.008)。无单一方法在所有数据集上占优。

Conclusion: 本文确立了ŁNN作为可解释神经符号学习的成熟框架。理论上,残差连接通过结构约束使合并神经元"构造性可解释"(Theorem 4),无需对内层施加额外约束,将ŁNN从浅层扩展至任意深度,满足McNaughton函数类在[0,1]^n上的形式完备性。实践上,LM修正版保证快速收敛与精确公式恢复,STE保证100%结晶化与最佳综合准确率,Proximal提供稀疏性与临床特征识别能力但存在密集特征退化失效。三种策略形成互补。Heart Disease公式证明该框架可从真实医疗数据生成透明、可审计、可独立验证的诊断规则,在IEC 62304/FDA AI/ML医疗设备监管要求下具有实际应用价值。未来方向包括:McNaughton函数类的万能逼近定理、其他剩余格逻辑的神经编码、残差深度对结晶动力学的系统性影响。

Abstract: A feed-forward neural network whose weights are integers and whose activation is the truncated identity implements, neuron by neuron, the connectives of Łukasiewicz many-valued logic. This exact correspondence --- established theoretically by Castro and Trillas and developed into a training algorithm by Leandro --- enables \emph{symbolic knowledge extraction}: training produces not a black-box model but a logical formula. Two obstacles have limited the approach to shallow architectures and small datasets: crystallization (forcing weights to integers) succeeds only probabilistically under the original Levenberg--Marquardt training scheme, and the theoretical guarantees break down as networks grow deeper. This paper addresses both obstacles. First, we prove that \emph{residual connections} (skip connections of the kind used in ResNets) extend Łukasiewicz neural networks to arbitrary depth while preserving the symbolic correspondence \emph{at merge neurons} by construction: merge neurons in a Łukasiewicz residual block automatically satisfy the neuron-classification proposition, regardless of the inner layer weights; inner-layer neurons are trained toward representability by the crystallization strategy. Second, we analyse three crystallization strategies --- Levenberg--Marquardt (corrected), straight-through estimation (STE), and proximal regularization --- characterizing their theoretical guarantees, failure modes, and interpretability trade-offs.

</details>


### [951] [Zero-Storage Procedural Neural Synthesis via Boundary Dynamics: Formal Verification in Lean 4 and Bare-Metal Gauntlet Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33066)
*Volkan Dağlı,Zerrin Dağlı,Dağhan Dağlı*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Mandelbrot集边界动力学的"零存储过程式神经合成"范式WERR/OED,通过24字节坐标种子实时合成非线性决策边界,并在Lean 4中完成机器验证,同时在EVM智能合约中以极低gas消耗原生执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决传统神经网络推理依赖高带宽VRAM存储密集浮点权重矩阵所导致的内存墙瓶颈,以及在确定性虚拟机(如EVM)中无法原生执行、ZK-ML证明延迟过高(10-300秒)无法实现区块内原子化防护的问题。

Method: 将二次递归 z_{n+1}=z_n²+c 投影到模9剩余环 Z/9Z 和Q_{16.16}定点域,采用两层架构:Tier 1为CPU边缘引擎(N_max=36,32×32网格),Tier 2为EVM链上反射内核(N_max∈{9,12},24字节种子),结合Cauchy Lévy飞行鞍点逃逸算子和sigmoidal M_CD4异常值衰减门。在Lean 4 v4.34.1+Mathlib4中形式化验证10条定理(零sorry)。

Result: 40核双Xeon服务器上100,000次决策耗时6.49秒(15,397.4 dec/s,0字节VRAM,15.15×加速);M_CD4门100%抑制对抗性尖峰同时保留89.60%干净信号;Cauchy Lévy飞行鞍点逃逸率达86.90%;EVM gas消耗≤22,557(<24,000上限);Lean 4验证10条定理零未证猜想。

Conclusion: 统一了两层过程式边界合成与交互式定理证明,证明了非线性决策内核可从24字节坐标种子合成,具备零持久张量存储、无Q_{16.16}溢出、四象限非恒定敏感性,并在EVM智能合约内以低于22,557 gas原生执行。

Abstract: Contemporary neural inference architectures rely on dense floating-point weight matrices stored in high-bandwidth memory (VRAM), incurring severe memory-wall bottlenecks and preventing native execution inside deterministic virtual machines like the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). Verifying termination and arithmetic invariants for recursive dynamical systems over continuous domains is generally undecidable in the Blum-Shub-Smale model. Here, we present the formal verification and bare-metal empirical validation of WERR (Waves & Errors) and Phase III Orbital Error Dynamics (OED), a non-tensor decision paradigm that procedurally synthesizes non-linear decision boundaries on demand from a 24-byte coordinate seed $\Theta = (c_x, c_y, \text{zoom})$ along the boundary of the Mandelbrot set ($\partial\mathcal{M}$). By projecting the recurrence $z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c$ onto the modular residue ring $\mathbb{Z}/9\mathbb{Z}$ and the fixed-point domain $\mathbb{Q}_{16.16}$, we establish ten machine-verified theorems in Lean 4 (v4.34.1) with Mathlib4 and zero unproven conjectures (sorry): proving $\mathcal{I}_3 = \{0,3,6\} \subset \mathbb{Z}/9\mathbb{Z}$ ideal closure, universal fuel-bounded halting ($\le 9$ and $\le 12$ steps), absence of $\mathbb{Q}_{16.16}$ square overflow below $2^{63}-1$, non-constant boundary escape sensitivity, and a parametric EVM gas bound ($\le 22,557 \le 24,000$ gas). Evaluated on a 40-core Dual Intel Xeon server, the vectorized 36-iteration CPU kernel processes 100,000 decisions in 6.49 s (15,397 decisions/s, 0 Bytes VRAM, 15.15x speedup), while a sigmoidal outlier gate suppresses 100.00% of adversarial spikes while preserving 89.60% of clean baseline signals.

</details>


### [952] [Algorithmic Harms Associated with Generative Model-Augmented Recommendation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33073)
*Christine Herlihy,Xumei Xi,Shloka Desai,Kevin Bannerman Hutchful,Pedro Silva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This paper extends existing algorithmic harm taxonomies to address novel harms arising from integrating generative models (e.g., LLMs, VLMs, T2I) into non-conversational recommendation systems. It introduces an expanded harm taxonomy covering representational harms, quality-of-service (QoS) harms, and a novel endogenous harm termed "sanitization" caused by semantic misalignment between system inputs, designer's objectives (expressed in prompts), and the generative model's inductive priors. The authors provide causal analyses and propose mitigation strategies involving prompt engineering, pipeline design, and evaluation-based interventions.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The motivation stems from a research gap: while algorithmic harms have been extensively studied in traditional ML recommendation systems, and adversarial risks of generative models have been widely investigated, the intersection—particularly harms arising when generative models are composed with ML pipelines in non-conversational recommendation settings—remains under-explored. Existing harm taxonomies do not adequately address: (1) novel causal drivers of well-known representational and QoS harms introduced by generative model augmentation; and (2) endogenous harms like sanitization, which paradoxically arise from prosocial mitigation efforts.

Method: The methodology involves: (1) Literature review of harms in modality-specific ML tasks (NLP, CV), generative model risks (LLMs, VLMs, T2I), and LLM-augmented recommendation systems; (2) Formal characterization of recommendation system stakeholders (human users and system designer) and their data transformations, including mathematical formalization of sensitive attributes (observed vs. inferred vs. true); (3) Decomposition of recommendation subtasks into pull-oriented (user-initiated: query refinement, retrieval, ranking) and push-oriented (system-initiated: data augmentation, intervention, evaluation, synthesis); (4) Empirical experimentation using GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo, and Meta-Llama-3-70B to demonstrate concrete harm instances across tasks like cold-start recommendation, travel tips, query refinement, query exploration, alt-text generation, and image captioning; (5) Causal analysis linking harms to drivers like RLHF-induced overconfidence, web-scale biased training data, and semantic misalignment between prompts/inputs/model priors.

Result: Key findings include: (1) Novel representational harms emerge from LLMs incorrectly inferring sensitive attributes (e.g., inferring gender from occupation/age, political affiliation from demographic info, or socioeconomic assumptions based on names like "Ali" vs. "Michael"); (2) Query refinement tasks propagate derogatory stereotypes (e.g., associating "tall women" with weight control, "transgender women" with hormone therapy); (3) QoS harms arise when safety instructions cause models to ignore legitimate sensitive attributes in user queries (e.g., "outfits for women 50+" loses age conditioning); (4) The novel "sanitization" harm is demonstrated: positive-tone instructions cause GPT-4o to caption images of syringes as environmental cleanup, or to mask embedded racist text in wartime posters; (5) "Pro-social injection" produces othering effects (e.g., explicitly describing skin tone diversity for marginalized groups but not default groups in alt-text); (6) Hallucination in attribute-sensitive contexts poses additional risks.

Conclusion: The paper concludes that generative model augmentation of recommendation systems introduces both persistent and novel algorithmic harms that require extending existing taxonomies. Semantic misalignment between inputs, designer's prompt-encoded objectives, and the generative model's inductive priors is a fundamental causal driver. Proposed mitigation strategies include: (1) Distinguishing user-intentional vs. system-generated sensitive attribute terms; (2) Defining domain-specific and sociotechnical terms explicitly in prompts; (3) Anticipating semantic misalignment with input screening, fallback options, and out-of-scope filtering. Future directions include benchmarking datasets, robust harm detectors, and prompt constraint validation techniques.

Abstract: In this work, we consider algorithmic harms that may arise as generative models are incorporated into machine learning platforms. We argue that existing harm taxonomies and threat models require extension to (1) address novel causal drivers of well-studied representational and quality-of-service harms; and (2) anticipate and mitigate endogenous harms, such as sanitization, which may arise when system inputs are misaligned with the system designer's objectives, or the generative model's inductive priors. To this end, we introduce an expanded taxonomy of algorithmic harms associated with the use of generative models in non-conversational recommendation systems. In addition, we offer a causal analysis of how problematic subsets of the (input, output) joint distribution can arise, in an effort to inform harms detection and mitigation efforts.

</details>


### [953] [How Linear Attention Remembers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33093)
*Kichang Lee,JaeYeon Park,Songkuk Kim,JeongGil Ko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对线性注意力中固定大小的循环状态作为记忆系统的机制进行了系统性的因果分析，揭示了信息如何被写入、保留和读取，以及在多事实和混合架构中的行为变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer的KV缓存随序列长度增长，限制了长上下文推理的内存效率。线性注意力用固定大小的循环状态取代KV缓存，但改变了信息的存储方式——多个令牌必须共享并反复更新同一内存。该研究旨在理解这种共享循环状态如何作为记忆系统运作，包括信息的写入、保留、读取以及其与全注意力KV记忆的关系。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 分析性分解框架，将循环状态分解为来自各位置的贡献(S_t = Σ C_i^(t))；(2) 因果干预方案，通过配对的"接收者-供体"输入进行干预，测量预测向供体值的偏移；(3) 受控联想回忆评估，使用WikiText-103构建的键值关联任务。模型涵盖预训练的GLA(340M)、Gated DeltaNet(340M/1.3B)、混合GDN-340M以及Qwen3.5-4B/9B。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1) 事实特定信息通过集中的、内容依赖的写入路径进入循环记忆，通过集中的查询时读取路径被访问；(2) 多个事实在同一状态中可选择性访问，但内部表征表现出跨事实因果耦合而非独立的KV式存储；(3) 随内存负载增加，回忆和定向可编辑性均下降，而仅延长上下文间隔的影响较小；(4) 干扰由与现有记忆重叠的后续写入塑造，而非仅由负载决定；(5) 在混合架构中，直接支持回忆的运行时记忆几乎完全转移到全注意力KV状态——纯GDN中循环状态恢复约100%的供体效应，而混合模型中KV恢复>99%，循环仅恢复<1%。

Conclusion: 固定大小的循环记忆应被视为结构化的共享记忆，而非压缩的token特定KV条目集合。这种组织在中等负载下支持选择性访问，但随负载增加产生干扰，其严重程度取决于内存负载和写入重叠。GDN的delta规则更新相比GLA的乘法门控在负载下更好地保持选择性。当全注意力可用时，记忆机制几乎完全转移到KV记忆。理解这些机制对设计高效长上下文系统（包括选择性门控、刷新、分区循环写入以及混合系统的动态分配）具有重要意义。

Abstract: Linear attention replaces the growing key--value (KV) cache of standard attention with a fixed-size recurrent state, substantially reducing memory growth with context length. This efficiency, however, changes how past information is stored: many tokens must share and repeatedly update the same memory. We study how this recurrent state functions as a memory system. Using an analytical decomposition together with controlled causal interventions in pretrained GLA and GDN models, we trace how recalled information is written, retained, and later accessed. We find that fact-specific information enters recurrent memory through concentrated, content-dependent writes and is later accessed through concentrated query-time read pathways. Multiple facts can remain selectively accessible within the same state, yet their internal representations exhibit cross-fact causal coupling rather than independent KV-like storage. As memory load increases, both recall and targeted editability degrade, whereas elapsed context alone has a substantially smaller effect within the tested regime. Causal interventions on subsequent writes further show that interference is shaped by their overlap with existing memory. Finally, in hybrid architectures that combine recurrent layers with full attention, the runtime memory directly supporting recall shifts predominantly to the full-attention KV state. Together, these results reveal how fixed-size recurrent memory supports selective recall despite shared storage, while exposing the interference and capacity limits that distinguish it from token-addressable KV memory.

</details>


### [954] [D-JEPA: Design-Recoverable JEPA Representation with Swappable Physics Decoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33110)
*Nitin Nagesh Kulkarni,Aashwin Anand Mishra,Yin Yu,Peter Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: D-JEPA提出了一种几何中心的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），将几何表示与物理预测解耦，通过轻量级、可替换的物理解码器支持跨工况、跨物理场的复用，同时通过显式设计可恢复性目标保留几何设计变量信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数化物理系统中的神经代理模型常将几何、工况和物理响应纠缠在单一表示中，限制其在工况变化或不同物理响应任务间的复用；现有JEPA方法仍受表示坍缩和缺乏显式设计可恢复性约束的限制。

Method: 1) 几何编码器仅从点云和法线计算128维几何潜变量g，不接收工况或物理标签；2) 轻量级FiLM调制隐式神经场解码器以g、查询位置和工况为输入预测物理场；3) 显式设计可恢复性损失通过线性探针从g恢复设计参数θ；4) 引入案例级SIGReg、方差铰链和目标重建损失以防止案例级表示坍缩；5) 通过冻结几何编码器+训练新解码器实现跨物理场迁移。

Result: 在四个3D基准（SHIFT-Wing、SHIFT-Submarine、SHIFT-SUV、AutoHood 3D）上，D-JEPA全场预测R²达到0.9937-0.9971，设计参数线性恢复R²达0.989-0.998（相比AeroJEPA提升0.116-0.306）；跨Mach工况插值R²≥0.9922；CFD到结构迁移仅需0.56M参数（4.1×减少）即快速适应；高保真CFD验证显示优化设计排名完全一致。

Conclusion: 将几何表示与物理预测显式分离可为科学代理建模提供实用且可复用的表示：单一冻结的几何编码器可跨工况、跨物理场复用，支持可微分设计优化，为多任务科学机器学习提供了有效的表示学习范式。

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide a framework for learning compact representations without directly reconstructing high-dimensional observations. However, in parameterized physical systems, learned representations can entangle geometry with operating conditions and task-specific physical responses, limiting their reuse across prediction tasks. We introduce D-JEPA (Design-recoverable JEPA), a geometry-centric JEPA that computes a compact representation from geometry alone and reuses it across operating conditions and physical response spaces through lightweight physics-specific decoders. An explicit design-recoverability objective encourages the geometry latent to preserve information about the underlying design variables, enabling the representation to support design analysis and optimization. We further identify a case-level collapse failure mode in which target representations become nearly invariant across distinct geometries despite low reconstruction error, and mitigate it using case-level variation constraints and auxiliary target reconstruction. Across four 3D aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and structural benchmarks, D-JEPA maintains or improves full-field prediction accuracy while achieving near-perfect linear recoverability of design parameters. The frozen geometry representation can be reused at held-out operating conditions and transferred to a structural response task with fewer trainable parameters. Finally, the representation supports differentiable design optimization, with designs validated using high-fidelity CFD, preserving the predicted ranking of candidate designs. These results demonstrate that separating a reusable geometry representation from physics-specific prediction provides a practical representation for scientific surrogate modeling and design.

</details>


### [955] [ECG-Scroll: A Long-Horizon, Streaming Benchmark and Agent Environment for Interpretation of Ambulatory Electrocardiograms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33117)
*Haitao Li,Chenglin Li,Zhengyao Ding,Ziyu Li,Yiheng Mao,Zhengxing Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ECG-Scroll将长时间动态心电图(Holter)解读重构为长视野、在线(流式、因果)序贯决策过程，发布了390条覆盖2,536小时两导联动态心电的流式基准与gym风格智能体环境，评估揭示当前LLM在自主"何时扫描、何时提交"的闭环规划能力上严重欠缺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ECG多模态大模型几乎都针对短时、可一次性读取的静态心电图，无法应对真实临床中Holter/监护记录数小时至数天的流式读取场景，且决定性发现是偶发性、短暂的事件——未来信号尚未发生，读取者必须在线工作、即时测量、即时提交证据。

Method: 将长时间ECG解读建模为因果流式决策过程：单调光标按块推进，智能体只能访问已流逝信号；动作集{skim, measure, write}；信号工具(心率/节律、P波、QRS、ST段、T波、QT间期，按临床读图顺序排列，仅返回数值)与诊断工具(返回现成标签)；类型化带时间戳的记忆账本；规则化评分器(temporal F1、相对误差、定位容差)与新增的"检测延迟"指标。

Result: Judge智能体(环境负责扫描，模型仅判断)在+dx下恢复至接近规则基线水平；Planning智能体(自主控制光标)在Episode F1≈0.03、Ischemia≈0等需长程覆盖的任务上彻底失败，跨8B–235B及推理增强变体一致；模型频繁测量却几乎不提交，半数以上记录以空账本结束——瓶颈为长视野规划与停-提交控制，而非识别或工具能力。

Conclusion: 当前LLM能识别并提交眼前事件，但无法自主决定何时观察、何时写入；自主流式信号的停-提交控制是长视野智能体最缺乏的能力，ECG-Scroll将其变为可测量。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now interpret a standard ten-second, twelve-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) with clinically grounded, reward-verified reasoning. Real cardiac monitoring is different. Ambulatory (Holter) and telemetry recordings span hours to days and are read as they stream in, and their clinically decisive findings are paroxysmal, brief episodes buried in an otherwise unremarkable trace. Such a recording cannot be held in one context at diagnostic resolution, and its future has not yet happened, so a reader must work online, deciding what to measure now, committing evidence to memory as it passes, and reporting events as they occur. We recast long-duration ECG interpretation as a long-horizon, online (streaming, causal) sequential decision process and introduce ECG-Scroll. As a benchmark, long ambulatory recordings are streamed to an agent chunk by chunk, and it must localize, quantify, and promptly flag paroxysmal events without access to future signal; because the underlying signal is retained, every answer is checkable against objective ground truth, giving rule-based rather than judge-based rewards, and the streaming formulation adds a metric batch evaluation cannot express, the detection latency between an event's onset and the moment the agent records it. As an agent environment, it is a fixed, gym-style interaction layer that exercises three competencies single-glance ECG models never touch: Memory, Tool use through signal-grounded measurement rather than reading pixels, and Planning of what to measure now and when to commit. We release 390 whole-recording instances spanning 2,536 hours of two-lead ambulatory ECG and evaluate a signal-threshold rule agent alongside off-the-shelf LLM agents online, characterizing how they use memory, tools, and planning and where the benchmark's head-room lies.

</details>


### [956] [Policy Plasticity Matters in Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning: Refitting Offline Policies for Online Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33127)
*Yuheng Huang,Yunpeng Qing,Yixiao Chi,Yilun Kong,Changqing Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对离线到在线强化学习（O2O RL）中策略网络在长时间离线训练后失去可塑性（plasticity）的问题，提出了一种轻量级、即插即用的方法 REFIT（Restoring plasticity via Fresh Initialization and policy Transfer）。REFIT 在 O2O 过渡阶段，将离线训练好的教师策略通过行为蒸馏迁移到一个全新初始化的学生网络中，并在蒸馏过程中随机冻结学生网络的一部分单元，以同时保留离线行为先验和网络的适应能力。在 D4RL 和 OGBench 上的大量实验表明，REFIT 显著优于现有 O2O 插件方法（如 OPT、PARS 等）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 O2O RL 方法主要关注价值校准，将离线训练好的策略视为给定初始化。然而，作者指出离线训练过程中持续的优化会逐渐降低网络的可塑性（即使离线性能已趋饱和），从而限制后续在线适应能力。本文从网络可塑性这一被忽视的视角出发研究 O2O 适应问题。

Method: REFIT 的核心方法包含三个步骤：(1) 新建一个完全初始化的学生策略网络；(2) 随机冻结学生网络中比例为 ρ（默认 0.5）的单元（输出通道），其余单元通过 MSE 蒸馏损失拟合离线教师策略在离线数据集上的行为；(3) 蒸馏完成后解除冻结，所有参数在在线微调阶段均可训练。Critic 和 Value 网络直接从离线阶段继承，不参与蒸馏。该方法仅作用于 Actor 网络。

Result: 在 D4RL（AntMaze、MuJoCo）和 OGBench 任务上，基于 IQL 和 Cal-QL 两种骨干网络的实验显示：(1) REFIT 相比 vanilla 基线分别提升 35.4%（IQL）和 20.3%（Cal-QL）的总分；(2) 优于对应的插件方法 OPT 和 PARS；(3) FAU（活跃单元比例）诊断显示 REFIT 在 O2O 过渡阶段显著恢复网络可塑性；(4) 消融实验验证了初始化、蒸馏、部分冻结三者缺一不可；(5) 冻结比例 ρ 在 0.25-0.75 区间内性能稳健；(6) 仅引入约 6.26% 的额外计算开销。

Conclusion: REFIT 通过一种简洁的模型级干预，在 O2O 过渡阶段有效恢复了策略网络的可塑性，同时保留了离线阶段学到的行为先验。这项工作强调了策略可塑性作为 O2O 适应重要因素的价值，证明了在 O2O 转换点显式恢复可塑性的有效性，并为未来将可塑性恢复与其他 O2O 机制（如价值校准）结合研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning (O2O RL) has emerged as a practical paradigm that pre-trains the policy using static offline datasets and subsequently adapts the policy through online interactions. Existing O2O methods primarily address the transition through value calibration, while generally treating the offline-trained policy as a given initialization. We instead study O2O adaptation from the perspective of network plasticity, asking whether the offline-trained policy remains sufficiently adaptable for online learning. Controlled experiments show that prolonged optimization on static offline data progressively reduces network plasticity even after offline performance has largely saturated, and that lower plasticity is associated with weaker subsequent online improvement. Motivated by these observations, we propose REstoring plasticity via Fresh Initialization and policy Transfer (REFIT), a lightweight model-level method for the O2O transition. Before online fine-tuning, REFIT distills the offline policy into a freshly initialized student while temporarily freezing a random subset of student units, transferring the learned offline behavior to a more plastic policy initialization. Extensive experiments on D4RL and OGBench demonstrate that REFIT consistently achieves higher aggregate performance than existing O2O plug-in methods across both Cal-QL and IQL backbones, while plasticity diagnostics and ablations provide further evidence of restored network plasticity.

</details>


### [957] [Flow-Matching-Based Protein Structure Tokenizer Made Efficient and Easy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33129)
*Zhe Zhang,Yikai Zhang,Jiangtao Feng,Ya-Qin Zhang,Wei-Ying Ma,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ProFiT是一种轻量级的基于流匹配（flow matching）的蛋白质结构分词器，通过简单的训练策略促进码本（codebook）的有效利用，无需手工语义对齐即可学习有意义的离散表征，并在重建质量和泛化能力上匹配或超越更大的分词器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质结构分词器依赖为特定下游任务精心设计的多重损失目标、大规模数据集以及单步推理架构，限制了其迁移性和可扩展性。图像领域的流匹配分词器已展现出解决这些局限的潜力，但在蛋白质领域的探索仍不充分，缺乏统一的跨任务评估和系统性的语义表征分析。

Method: 提出ProFiT，一个基于DiT（Diffusion Transformer）架构的流匹配自编码器，采用非等变（non-equivariant）网络。编码器将蛋白质主链坐标映射到低维潜空间，通过向量量化器（VQ）离散化（码本大小K=8192）。解码器使用条件流匹配（rectified flow），结合自条件（self-conditioning）和随机token掩码增强鲁棒性，并采用死码替换（dead code replacement）机制防止码本坍缩。训练仅使用单一流匹配损失，无需辅助语义损失。

Result: ProFiT在四个测试集（CAMEO2022、CASP15、CASP16、D_FS）上的重建质量匹配或超越更大基线（如DPLM2、ESM3），尤其在分布外（OOD）结构上保持稳定；在自回归和离散扩散两种生成架构下均表现强劲（唯一在两种架构下都保持强性能的tokenizer）；在蛋白质功能位点预测任务上无需语义监督即展现语义表征能力；码本利用率达98.91%，在所有基线中最高；训练仅需8块H20 GPU、约20小时（120k步）。

Conclusion: 蛋白质结构tokenization不必依赖复杂的多目标损失或等变骨干网络。ProFiT证明了基于流匹配的分词范式在蛋白质领域的有效性，其简单目标结合稳定的VQ训练策略即可实现高保真重建、跨任务可迁移性和涌现的token语义。流匹配分词器范式仍有较大探索空间，包括规模化策略、路径设计和跨生物模态的适应性。

Abstract: As the bridge between protein modality and discrete modeling, protein structure tokenization still largely relies on heavily engineered training objectives tailored to specific downstream tasks and large training datasets, which hinders its transfer to broader application scenarios. To address this issue, we propose ProFiT, a lightweight flow matching tokenizer. With simple training strategies that encourage healthy codebook utilization, ProFiT can be trained efficiently and naturally learns semantically meaningful representations without any manual semantic alignment, while achieving reconstruction quality and generalization that match or surpass those of substantially larger tokenizers. We conduct extensive evaluations across a wide range of settings and demonstrate that ProFiT is a plug-and-play tokenizer adaptable to diverse downstream tasks. This study further reveals the significant potential of the flow matching tokenizer paradigm. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [958] [Beyond the Training Horizon: Mechanisms and Limits of Length Generalization in Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33144)
*Jia Liang,Xi Jin,Liangming Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对两种循环 Transformer 架构（MR-Loop 与 DR-Loop）在长度泛化任务中的内部机制进行了系统的机制性分析，揭示了它们实现和丧失长度泛化的不同计算路径，并提出了一个共同的表征原则：成功的循环重用不仅需要正确的语义内容，还需该内容处于"计算可用状态"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 在处理需要可变步数的迭代推理任务时存在困难，因为其计算深度是固定的。循环 Transformer 通过重复应用共享的 Transformer 块来增加测试时的计算深度，但其在训练视野之外如何实现长度泛化、为何最终失败、以及是否真的忠实执行了逐步推理，这些机制性问题尚未得到解答。本研究旨在通过详细的机制分析回答这些问题。

Method: 对 MR-Loop（Matched-Recurrence）和 DR-Loop（Decoupled-Recurrence）两种循环 Transformer 架构进行比较性机制分析。在三类受控迭代任务族（多项式迭代、有限状态函数组合、知识图谱遍历）上进行实验，仅在最终答案上施加监督。综合运用注意力模式分析、logit-lens 中间状态解码、以及激活补丁（state-swap）因果干预来揭示内部计算机制。

Result: 发现三种主要结果：(1) MR-Loop 采用"固定读出位+推进式关系选择"机制，而 DR-Loop 采用"沿位置推进的计算前沿"机制，二者通过不同的循环算法实现长度泛化；两者共享一个表征原则——循环状态不仅编码任务相关内容，还编码其"计算状态"（MR-Loop 中的 live–consumed，DR-Loop 中的 fresh–aged）。(2) 极长距离泛化失败源于两个原因：支持计算的状态退化，以及学习到的循环动态对错误的自我修正能力有限。(3) 成功的最终答案泛化并不意味着忠实的逐步推理，模型可以通过利用任务结构（特别是可压缩任务）来获得正确答案，而无需显式表示每个中间状态。

Conclusion: 可靠的循环推理不仅取决于分配更多测试时计算，还取决于保持并刷新使该计算可重用的内部状态。本研究将"学习可重用的循环计算"与"忠实执行"区分开来，强调未来循环推理系统设计应关注如何保持计算可用状态而非仅仅增加循环深度。

Abstract: Looped Transformers can generalize to reasoning chains longer than those encountered during training, but the computations enabling this behavior and limiting its extent remain unclear. We mechanistically compare two looped-Transformer configurations, which we call the Matched-Recurrence Looped Transformer (MR-Loop) and Decoupled-Recurrence Looped Transformer (DR-Loop), reflecting their respective recurrence-training schemes. We evaluate polynomial iteration, finite-state composition, and knowledge-graph traversal using detailed mechanistic analysis. Attention analysis, intermediate-state decoding, and causal interventions reveal distinct mechanisms learned under final-answer supervision. MR-Loop updates an intermediate state at a fixed readout while advancing relation selection through adjacent-token interactions and a transferable progress cue. DR-Loop instead propagates intermediate states across relation positions, forming an advancing computational frontier. However, both mechanisms become unreliable at greater depths: MR-Loop exhibits degradation of its readout state and progress cues, while DR-Loop exhibits declining reliability of state propagation. Limited self-correction allows local errors to persist and compound. Across both models, we uncover a common representational principle: recurrent states encode not only task-relevant content but also its computational status, whether that content remains in a form that can support subsequent computation. Transferable live-consumed and fresh-aged residual directions causally control whether represented information can participate in subsequent computation, including beyond the training horizon. We further show that length generalization need not rely on faithful step-by-step reasoning, as Looped Transformers can exploit task structure without explicitly representing every intermediate state.

</details>


### [959] [SMORE: Stability-Promoting Mesh-Agnostic Model Reduction for Time-Dependent PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33205)
*Yangyuan Li,Weichao Li,Shaowu Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SMORE是一种用于时变偏微分方程降阶建模的网格无关框架，通过隐式神经表示(INR)自解码器结合结构化潜在动力学（线性Koopman或低秩线性二次型），并引入李雅普诺夫引导的稳定性正则化，在长时域外推、稀疏初始观测推理和内存效率方面均优于FNO、CNO、Transolver和DINo等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时变PDE的高保真模拟计算昂贵，现有数据驱动代理模型（如FNO、CNO、NeuralODE等）常存在时间稳定性差的问题，导致长时域自回归预测中的不稳定展开和反向传播梯度爆炸，限制了其在不确定性量化、数据同化等多查询任务中的应用。

Method: SMORE结合两个组件：(1) INR自解码器（基于MFN和FiLM调制）实现网格无关的连续场表示；(2) 结构化潜在动力学模型，包括SMORE-Koopman（线性）和SMORE-LRLQ（带低秩分解的线性二次型）；通过李雅普诺夫引导的稳定性正则化（惩罚对称矩阵Ws的正特征值和二次张量的循环能量守恒违反）促进稳定性；引入逐点小批处理(PM)降低GPU内存。

Result: 在2D波动、2D Navier-Stokes和3D球面浅水方程三个基准测试中，SMORE在六个评估列（in-horizon和extrapolation）中均取得最低MSE；SMORE-Koopman在波动和浅水方程上表现最佳，SMORE-LRLQ在Navier-Stokes上表现最佳，相比DINo外推误差降低13.8%-97.7%；在10%初始观测稀疏度下仍保持接近全观测的精度；PM64策略使单A100 GPU可处理1714×1714网格，是最佳基线CNO的约31倍空间点数。

Conclusion: SMORE通过结构化、稳定正则化的潜在动力学与坐标解码相结合，在单一降阶建模框架内支持长时域外推、经验鲁棒性提升、稀疏初始化推理和内存高效的空间执行；未来工作将扩展到参数化PDE并研究李雅普诺夫正则化的自适应加权。

Abstract: High-fidelity simulations of time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) are computationally expensive, motivating data-driven reduced-order surrogates for many-query tasks such as uncertainty quantification, design optimization, data assimilation, and optimal control. However, existing surrogate models often exhibit poor temporal stability, which can lead to unstable rollouts and exploding gradients during backpropagation, especially in multistep long-horizon forecasting. To address this, we propose SMORE, a mesh-agnostic framework for model order reduction of time-dependent PDEs. Its latent dynamics are trained with Lyapunov-guided stability regularization, which promotes stable long-horizon rollouts. We provide theoretical guarantees under the stated structural assumptions. Beyond forecasting PDE evolution, the learned latent dynamics, which are interpretable and linear or linear-quadratic, could bring benefits for downstream tasks such as data assimilation and optimal control. Moreover, our framework is capable of predicting continuous PDE solution fields from sparse measurements of the initial condition. We evaluate SMORE on a range of problems, including wave propagation, the Navier-Stokes equations, and the shallow water equations. Our results show that it improves long-horizon rollout generalization and empirical robustness, and achieves competitive accuracy at comparable parameter budgets relative to competitive baselines including DINo, FNO, CNO, and Transolver.

</details>


### [960] [When Do Models Admit They Are Wrong? Failure Disclosure Is Unstable Under Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33220)
*Steven Y. Feng,Noah D. Goodman,Michael C. Frank,Evan Hubinger,Paul C. Bogdan,Andrew Lampinen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于结果强化学习（RL）训练的语言模型在多次重复训练中"失败披露"行为（即模型是否承认其尝试的解决方案失败）的不稳定性。研究发现，尽管任务准确率在不同训练运行间保持稳定，但失败披露行为却表现出极大的变异性——跨运行差异远大于任务表现差异。本文系统地分析了这一选择性不可复现性现象的根源，并提出了一种"参考锚定"方法来减少这种变异性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于结果的强化学习（outcome-based RL）虽然能产出任务性能相当但沟通方式大相径庭的模型，但已有评估体系主要关注任务能力（如准确率），而忽视了安全性相关的行为（如模型是否承认失败）。如果任务准确率保持稳定但失败报告行为在不同训练运行间发生剧烈变化，仅依赖能力评估可能遗漏对监督者/监控者至关重要的信息变化。研究者需要直接测量这些跨运行的安全相关行为，并设计能保持其可靠性的训练方法。

Method: 本文采用系统性实验方法研究失败披露的不稳定性：
1. **实验设置**：在Countdown（算术推理）和最短路径等可验证推理任务上，使用GRPO和稳定化PPO算法，对Qwen2.5-1.5B、OLMo-2-1B、Qwen-7B和Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct等模型进行多次重复训练。
2. **变异性来源隔离**：（a）仅改变微批次/梯度累积分割的执行配置；（b）恢复中RL训练状态（步骤150）后仅改变未来rollout随机性的"延续实验"。
3. **多阶段分析**：将失败披露分解为检查答案、进入报告、完成承认等多个阶段，在不同位置插入段落分隔符或验证器判定来定位脆弱环节。
4. **中性控制实验**：使用弱约束的中性短语（如"谢谢提问"）与强约束的确定性线索（如Marker A/B）对比，检验行为稳定性差异。
6. **干预方法**：提出"失败条件参考锚定"（failure-conditional reference anchoring），即对错误但格式有效的响应施加参考策略惩罚，β=0.04。
5. **统计分析**：使用跨运行标准差比、对数尺度分析、分层τ估计和配对重采样等方法。

Result: 1. **选择性不可复现性**：在20次Qwen2.5-1.5B Countdown重训练中，失败披露跨运行标准差是任务求解率的3.9倍（披露范围0.257-0.903，求解率范围0.340-0.490）；OLMo-2-1B上为7.5倍；最短路径任务上为7.89倍；Qwen-7B上为2.3倍；指令条件32B上也观察到类似模式。
2. **数值敏感性**：仅改变微批次/梯度累积分割可使失败披露在0.186-0.848间变化，而任务求解率仅在0.327-0.463间变化。
3. **后期分化**：从相同的步骤150训练状态出发，仅改变未来rollout随机性，10次延续训练的失败披露率可从0.112到0.880不等。
4. **多阶段机制**：在主Countdown格式中，学习的段落转换是脆弱瓶颈；在7B内联报告和单行网格设置中，瓶颈位置不同。约70%的变化来自报告入口，23%来自后续坚持。
5. **弱约束行为特别易变**：弱约束中性短语跨运行范围0-0.90，而有确定性线索时则几乎完全可复现。
6. **参考锚定效果**：1.5B Countdown上参考锚定将披露SD从0.189降至0.089（降低53%），但任务性能下降约0.06；7B上将披露SD从0.281降至0.090（降低68%），任务性能反而小幅提升6.9个百分点。
7. **历史依赖性**：在已锚定的训练历史基础上保持锚定可将后续延续的变异性降低一半以上（SD比0.47），但从未锚定历史引入锚定的效果不显著。

Conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：**任务准确率的稳定性并不保证安全相关行为的稳定性**。基于结果的RL后训练可以产出任务能力相当但失败披露行为大相径庭的模型，这种选择性不可复现性源于任务目标中未明确指定的行为被弱约束于训练过程。微小的浮点运算和采样差异可以放大为显著的行为差异，并在后续on-policy训练中持续放大。失败披露并非单一决策，而是多阶段过程，不同任务和响应格式的脆弱环节不同。通过参考锚定可以显著减少这种变异性，但其在任务性能上的影响因设置而异——不能视为免费的正则化器。本文呼吁研究者：（1）直接测量跨多次训练运行的安全相关行为；（2）将这些行为纳入评估和训练目标；（3）开发能更少干扰任务学习的针对性行为保持方法。这一研究对AI监督和安全性具有重要意义：能力评估可能遗漏监控者获取的关键信息变化。

Abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning can produce models with similar task performance but very different ways of communicating about their mistakes. We study failure disclosure: whether a model admits that an attempted solution failed rather than staying silent or presenting it as successful. Across repeated outcome-only GRPO training runs, failure disclosure varies far more than task accuracy. The pattern extends to a second reasoning task and stabilized PPO, persists at 7B, and also appears in an instruction-conditioned 32B setting. We also find that small floating-point and sampling differences during training can redirect reporting behavior even when the task objective and earlier training history are held fixed. Additional tests show that failure disclosure is not a single decision: Checking the answer, entering a report, and completing the admission can separate, and the weak point depends on the task and response format. Further, experiments with neutral controls show more broadly that behaviors left weakly constrained by training are especially likely to vary across runs, of which failure disclosure is an example. We can reduce variability in failure disclosure by discouraging the model from drifting from its starting policy on failed, well-formed responses. This makes reporting substantially more consistent, though its effect on task performance depends on the setting. Stable task accuracy therefore does not guarantee stable safety-relevant behavior: Researchers should measure these behaviors directly across runs and design training methods that keep them reliable.

</details>


### [961] [BERT4DTI : BERT-based Model for Predicting Drug-Protein Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33254)
*Thanina Hamitouch,Khadidja Henni,Abdelkrim Arie,Amina Selma Haichour,Neila Mezghani,Lina Abou-Abbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BERT4DTI 是一种基于 BERT 的药物-蛋白质相互作用（DTI）二分类预测模型，通过 ChemBERTa 与部分微调的 ProtBERT 提取 SMILES 与氨基酸序列的 token 表征，利用双向互注意力机制实现跨模态对齐，并以 1D CNN 与 MLP 完成分类。该模型在 BIOSNAP、DAVIS、BindingDB 三个基准上具有竞争力，以 125M 可训练参数实现了优于全 BERT 微调（353M）的性能-参数量平衡，特别擅长正样本召回。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列型 DTI 预测面临三个实际困难：标注交互稀缺且分布不均、大型预训练编码器端到端微调代价昂贵、独立编码方式无法捕捉配对依赖。作者旨在构建一种兼顾参数效率与跨序列交互建模能力的二分类 DTI 筛选模型。

Method: 1) ChemBERTa（6 层）编码 SMILES，ProtBERT（截断为 18 层）编码氨基酸序列；2) 仅微调两个编码器的最后两层；3) 双向互注意力（d_e=384, h=4）实现 token 级跨模态对齐，并做 0.5/0.5 等权残差融合；4) 双路 1D CNN（32 通道，核 5）+ 三层 MLP（4960→256→32→1）+ Sigmoid；5) 损失函数为 SmoothL1Loss，评估指标含 ROC-AUC、PR-AUC、敏感度、特异度。

Result: 在 BIOSNAP 上取得最佳 ROC-AUC（0.920）与 PR-AUC（0.924），并在三个数据集上均获得最高敏感度（BIOSNAP 0.882、DAVIS 0.891、BindingDB 0.912）。DAVIS 消融实验表明：去除互注意力使 PR-AUC 由 0.37 降至 0.29，特异度由 0.83 降至 0.85，验证互注意力的贡献。可训练参数 125M，介于 MolTrans（62.8M）与全 BERT 微调（353M）之间。

Conclusion: BERT4DTI 是一种参数高效的序列型 DTI 筛选模型，在正样本检索方面表现突出，但在不平衡数据上的 PR-AUC 与特异度仍逊于部分竞争对手。论文对未来工作提出明确方向：融入生物医学知识图谱与检索增强语言模型，以实现可解释、基于证据的交互优先级排序；同时需补充运行时间分析、概率校准与防数据泄漏的验证。

Abstract: Understanding how drugs interact with protein targets is fundamental to drug discovery, drug repurposing and the early identification of promising therapeutic candidates before costly experimental testing. Sequence-based DTI models face three practical limitations: labelled interactions are scarce and unevenly distributed, large pretrained chemical and protein encoders are expensive to fine-tune end-to-end, and independently encoded sequences do not capture pair-specific dependencies. We present BERT4DTI, which encodes SMILES strings with ChemBERTa and amino-acid sequences with ProtBERT, applies bidirectional mutual attention between token-level representations, and classifies the resulting interaction features using convolutional layers and a multilayer perceptron. To reduce trainable size, ProtBERT is truncated to 18 retained layers and only the last two layers of each encoder are fine-tuned. On BIOSNAP, DAVIS and BindingDB, BERT4DTI is competitive, achieving the best ROC-AUC and PR-AUC on BIOSNAP and the highest sensitivity on all three benchmarks. An ablation on DAVIS shows that mutual attention improves PR-AUC and specificity. With 125M trainable parameters compared with 353M for full BERT fine-tuning, BERT4DTI provides a favourable performance-parameter trade-off for sequence-based DTI screening, while leaving runtime profiling, calibration and leakage-audited validation for future work.

</details>


### [962] [Domain Generalization under Sampling Pattern Shifts in Irregular Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33279)
*Changhun Kim,Joohyung Lee,Kwanhyung Lee,Donghwee Yoon,Grigorios Chrysos,Eunho Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 HAR-C（首个针对 ISMTS 采样模式偏移的受控基准）和 PRISM（一种模型无关的域泛化框架），通过学习互补的特征中心与采样中心表示，并在随机采样变化上进行最坏情况优化，来缓解采样捷径依赖问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不规则采样多变量时间序列（ISMTS）的采样过程在不同域间变化显著（如不同医院的监测频率），现代模型虽利用了采样信息但未充分检验其在采样模式偏移下的鲁棒性。采样模式既包含有用预测信息又具有域依赖性，导致现有域泛化方法仍易受采样捷径影响。

Method: 1) HAR-C 基准：基于 HAR 数据集，在固定 20% 观测预算下构造 Regular/Desync/Fixed-Feat./Rand-Feat./First/Last/Mid 等多种目标采样模式，隔离采样模式偏移与观测预算变化。2) PRISM 框架：(a) 无标签互补表示预训练——特征中心编码器通过掩码值重构学习 E_feat，采样中心编码器通过观测掩码重构学习 E_samp；(b) 有标签鲁棒学习——对每个样本生成 K 个随机采样变化，取最坏分类损失进行 minimax 优化，抑制脆弱的采样捷径依赖。

Result: 在 HAR-C 上 PRISM 平均准确率从最强基线 MLDG 的 72.70% 提升至 80.57%；eICU（leave-one-region-out）四个区域 AUROC 平均从 ERM 的 79.72% 提升至 82.47%；PAM（leave-fixed-sensors-out）在 50% 传感器缺失时从基线约 59% 提升至 81.97%。消融实验验证了互补预训练、采样变化和最坏视图损失的各自贡献，且效果在 CNN、SeFT、mTAND、GRU-D 等多种骨干网络上均保持一致。

Conclusion: 采样模式偏移是 ISMTS 中被忽视但关键的分布偏移源，PRISM 通过互补表示与最坏视图鲁棒优化有效缓解了采样捷径问题，实验证明其在受控和真实世界场景下均显著优于现有域泛化方法，且方法具有模型无关性。

Abstract: Irregularly sampled multivariate time series (ISMTS) are prevalent in real-world applications, where both observation times and available measurements can vary substantially across domains. While recent models increasingly exploit such sampling information for prediction, its robustness under sampling pattern shifts remains underexplored. We introduce HAR-C, to the best of our knowledge the first controlled benchmark for sampling pattern shifts in ISMTS, and show that sampling shifts alone can substantially degrade performance, induce sampling-specific shortcuts, and remain challenging for existing domain generalization (DG) methods. Motivated by these findings, we propose PRISM, a DG framework that first learns complementary feature-centric and sampling-centric representations without task labels, and subsequently performs robust supervised training across diverse sampling variations to discourage brittle shortcut reliance. Extensive experiments on controlled and real-world ISMTS benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM consistently improves robustness to unseen sampling shifts over existing methods. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [963] [BITS: Rethinking Fair and Comprehensive Evaluation for Irregular Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33303)
*Kangjia Yan,Linfeng Wang,Tianen Shen,Xiangfei Qiu,Ruitong Zhang,Hao Miao,Jilin Hu,Chenjuan Guo,Bin Yang,Christian S. Jensen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BITS是一个针对不规则时间序列预测（Irregular Time Series Forecasting, ITSF）的标准化、可复现且可扩展的基准测试。它涵盖了来自九个领域的十一个数据集，并从缺失率、缺失模式复杂性、采样不规则性和偏度四个维度刻画数据特性。该基准提供了统一的数据预处理、模型集成与评估流水线，并同时纳入了基于误差和非误差的评估指标，以解决现有评估中数据集覆盖有限、实验协议不一致以及评估维度单一的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前不规则时间序列预测领域缺乏统一且标准的评估基准。现有评估往往存在两个关键局限：一是数据集覆盖范围窄、划分策略不当（忽略时间顺序导致信息泄露）；二是评估协议不统一（归一化、窗口设置不同）且过度依赖基于误差的指标（无法反映模型对时间动态的捕捉能力），从而难以公平全面地比较不同方法。

Method: BITS提出了一个四层统一流水线框架（数据层、方法层、评估层、报告层）。具体方法包括：1) 收集并整合11个跨领域数据集，并根据观测数量采用时间感知（time-aware）或样本感知（sample-aware）的划分策略；2) 标准化预处理流程（如统一使用min-max归一化）并为各数据集设定定制化的回看（lookback）与预测长度；3) 集成六大类不规则预测方法、常规多变量预测方法以及时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）；4) 引入基于误差的指标（MSE, MAE等）和非误差指标（DTW, PCC, CPN, IER等）进行多维度评估，并从四个维度量化数据集的不规则特性。

Result: 基于BITS的广泛实验得出以下发现：1) 在不规则预测中，时间分段与聚合方法（如TiWeaver、TFMixer）和数据格式转换方法（如ASTGI）表现最为强劲，但没有任何单一方法能在所有不规则特性下保持最优；2) 常规预测模型（如DUET、SRSNet）在某些场景下甚至能超越专用的不规则方法；3) 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在零样本设置下普遍表现不佳，特别是在缺失严重的复杂数据集上；4) 基于误差的指标与非误差指标得出的模型排名存在显著差异，验证了多维评估的必要性。

Conclusion: BITS为不规则时间序列预测提供了一个公平、全面的开源评估平台。它不仅揭示了不同不规则特性下模型性能的显著差异，还强调了结合误差与非误差指标进行多维评估的重要性。该基准有助于推动该领域从设计更复杂的专用架构，转向开发兼具有效不规则处理能力与强鲁棒时序表征学习能力的模型，并激励不规则感知的预训练策略发展。

Abstract: Despite recent progress in irregular time series forecasting, the field still lacks a unified benchmark for fair and comprehensive evaluation. Existing evaluations are often conducted on a limited set of datasets with inconsistent experimental protocols and predominantly error-based metrics, rendering it difficult to compare and assess methods fairly and comprehensively across diverse settings. To eliminate these limitations and accelerate progress, we propose BITS, a standardized, reproducible, and extensible benchmark for advancing research on irregular time series forecasting. BITS covers eleven datasets from nine domains with diverse irregularity characteristics, and it characterizes the datasets according to their missing rate, missing pattern complexity, sampling irregularity, and skewness. Further, it offers a unified pipeline for data preprocessing, model integration and evaluation, and reporting. It accommodates regular and irregular time series forecasting methods, including time series foundation models, under consistent settings, incorporating both error-based and non-error-based evaluation metrics. Findings include that method performance varies substantially across irregularity characteristics, with no single modeling strategy consistently dominating. We also find that using error-based or non-error-based metrics can yield different model rankings, highlighting the need for multi-dimensional evaluation. The code can be found at this https URL .

</details>


### [964] [ZeroGAR: Benchmarking the Adversarial Robustness of Zero-Shot Graph Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33314)
*Zhongjian Zhang,Xiao Wang,Busheng Zhang,Bo Yan,Xingtong Yu,Yue Gao,Jia Li,Chuan Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZeroGAR 是首个针对零样本图模型（ZGMs）在未见目标图上对抗鲁棒性的系统基准。它在 4 个领域、8 个 TAG 数据集上评估了 13 个代表性 ZGM（涵盖 GNNPred、GTextLLM、GTokenLLM 三类范式），分别在结构、文本、节点注入三种攻击面下检验其鲁棒性，并考察现有图防御方法在零样本设定下的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 ZGM 几乎只在干净图上评估，而既有图鲁棒性基准又集中于监督设定，导致"未见目标图遭受对抗扰动时 ZGM 是否仍然鲁棒"这一基础问题长期未被回答；这阻碍了对图基础模型安全部署的理解。

Method: 提出 ZeroGAR 基准：(1) 收集 8 个文本属性图（学术、电商、社交、网页 4 个领域）作为目标图，覆盖域内（Arxiv→Cora/Citeseer, Products→History/Child）和跨域（→Instagram/WikiCS）零样本迁移；(2) 采用结构攻击 SGA、基于 LLM 的文本改写攻击（Qwen3.6-27B）以及 WTGIA 节点注入攻击，每种攻击设低/中/高三档扰动预算；(3) 灰盒设定，统一以 GCN+SBERT 作为代理模型生成对抗扰动；(4) 评测 13 个 ZGM（4 个 GNNPred、4 个 GTextLLM、5 个 GTokenLLM），并额外评估 GNNGuard 与 Jaccard 净化两种防御；(5) 采用 ACC、RDA、ASR 三种度量。

Result: 三大核心发现：(1) 脆弱性与预测机制强相关——GNNPred 对结构/节点注入攻击最脆弱（平均 RDA 18.37%/19.22%），而 GTextLLM 和 GTokenLLM 对文本攻击更脆弱（21.19% 和 20.27% vs. GNNPred 的 8.28%）；(2) 更强的 LLM 主干带来结构-文本鲁棒性权衡——结构鲁棒性提升但对误导性文本语义更敏感（如 Vicuna-7B 文本攻击 RDA 16.09%，而 Llama3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、G1 均超 22%）；(3) 现有图防御（GNNGuard、Jaccard 净化）在零样本设定下并不能稳定提升鲁棒性，反而可能损害干净性能；且 TextFooler 等词级文本攻击跨模型迁移能力差，故采用基于 LLM 的文本攻击以保证强攻击。

Conclusion: ZeroGAR 作为首个面向零样本图模型对抗鲁棒性的统一基准，揭示了干净性能强不代表对抗鲁棒、三类 ZGM 范式各具脆弱模式、以及现有防御难以直接迁移至零样本场景；呼吁未来研究在邻居聚合阶段提升 GNNPred 鲁棒性、在 LLM 类模型中结合图上下文校验文本证据、设计无标签感知的零样本鲁棒防御以打破结构-文本权衡。

Abstract: Zero-shot graph models (ZGMs), which learn transferable knowledge from source graphs and directly apply to unseen target graphs without any adaptation, have achieved promising performance and attracted considerable attention. Despite their proliferation, existing ZGMs are predominantly evaluated on clean graphs, while existing graph robustness benchmarks mainly focus on supervised settings, leaving a fundamental question largely unexplored: How robust are ZGMs when their unseen target graphs are exposed to adversarial manipulation? In this paper, we answer this question by proposing ZeroGAR, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating the adversarial robustness of ZGMs. ZeroGAR evaluates 13 representative ZGMs from 3 different paradigms on 8 graph datasets across 4 domains, covering both in-domain and cross-domain transfer under structural, textual, and node injection attacks with multiple perturbation budgets. It further investigates whether existing graph defenses remain effective in the zero-shot setting. Extensive experiments reveal that strong clean zero-shot performance does not guarantee adversarial robustness, with three key findings: (1) Vulnerability patterns are related to model prediction mechanisms: GNN-based methods are particularly vulnerable to structural and node injection attacks, whereas LLM-based methods are more vulnerable to textual attacks; (2) Stronger LLM backbones introduce a structure-text robustness trade-off; (3) Existing graph defense methods do not consistently improve zero-shot robustness and may compromise clean performance. We hope that ZeroGAR will facilitate rapid, equitable evaluation and inspire further innovative research in ZGM security.

</details>


### [965] [Beyond Conservatism: Recoverability-Conditioned Exploration for Model-Based Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33336)
*Xuanlin Chen,Ziyue Wang,Xunlan Zhou,Yuan-yih Shang,Qiang Wu,Shenghua Wan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RECON提出了一种基于可恢复性条件引导的探索方法，用于基于模型的模仿学习。它将保守的主策略（用于任务执行）与独立的探索者策略（用于真实环境数据收集）分离，探索者根据认知不确定性并结合可恢复性（主策略能否从该状态恢复到专家行为）来选择交互样本，从而将有限的真实交互预算集中于专家分布周围尚未充分探索的恢复区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保守的基于模型的模仿学习（如CMIL）虽然在策略优化中缓解了模型利用问题，但当真实环境交互也由同一保守策略收集时，专家分布周围的不确定恢复区域可能仍未被充分采样；而通用的不确定性驱动探索则可能浪费交互预算在与任务无关的远分布新区域上。论文旨在解决"模型获取"层面的盲点：在固定预算下，哪些未知动力学应优先被采样。

Method: RECON基于DreamerV2+CMIL框架，引入两个共享世界模型的策略：(1) 保守主策略π_m使用r^e = D_ψ - α·U_θ进行悲观策略优化（同CMIL）；(2) 探索者策略π_e使用r^e = D_ψ + β·U_θ·G_T进行数据采集，其中可恢复性门控G_T通过冻结主策略的5步想象回滚计算，取回滚尾段中判别器分数最大者。真实交互中，每回合分为15个时间层，每层采样一个10步探索窗口（其余由主策略执行），所有转移进入共享回放缓冲。可恢复性梯度路径式回传引导探索终点走向主策略可恢复的状态。理论证明：(a) 真实环境的模型误差在恢复占用率被覆盖时可通过密度比上界控制（定理1）；(b) 恢复加权控制定理界定认知不确定性与门控的平方根关系（定理2）；(c) 信息增益版本证明恢复门控与贝叶斯风险减少等价（定理3）。

Result: 在DMControl（Hopper Stand、Walker Run）、导航（U-Maze、PointMaze）和MetaWorld（Drawer Open、Faucet Close、Handle Press、Hammer）等8个任务中，RECON在相同交互预算下实现最佳或具有竞争力的模仿性能，相对CMIL在鲁棒性（动作噪声、延迟、冲量、动力学偏移）下有显著提升（如Walker延迟提升51.9 pp，PointMaze噪声提升57.0 pp）。PointMaze分析显示RECON将交互从远分布OOD区域转向近支持区域；消融实验验证可恢复性门控、多步想象、路径式梯度传播均为关键设计。保持相同部署主策略与世界模型骨干，RECON仅增加约18.3%参数和约4.4%的吞吐量开销。

Conclusion: RECON揭示了基于模型的模仿学习中保守模型使用与模型获取之间的互补盲点，提出可恢复性条件探索作为连接两者的机制：并非寻求全局更精确的世界模型，而是针对专家分布周围主策略可恢复的不确定区域进行定向数据采集。在控制、导航与操作任务上一致提升模仿效率、鲁棒性与恢复相关动力学建模精度，确立了"学习如何在不完美的世界模型中行动"与"学习在哪里改进世界模型"是模型强化模仿学习中两个互补的研究方向。

Abstract: Model-based imitation learning (MBIL) improves real-environment interaction efficiency by optimizing policies on imagined rollouts from a learned world model. However, the gap between model-induced and real-environment occupancies makes policy learning sensitive to model error. Conservative MBIL mitigates model exploitation during policy optimization, but when real-environment interactions are collected by the same conservative policy, uncertain regions around the expert distribution remain insufficiently sampled. Generic uncertainty-driven exploration, on the other hand, may allocate interaction to novel but task-irrelevant dynamics. We propose REcoverability-CONditioned Exploration for Model-Based Imitation Learning (RECON). RECON separates conservative policy learning from active data collection by maintaining a main policy for task execution and an explorer for real-environment interaction. The explorer is optimized based on epistemic uncertainty conditioned on recoverability estimated from multi-step main-policy imagination, focusing data collection on unknown states from which the main policy can still return toward expert behavior. Experiments on locomotion, navigation and manipulation show consistent gains in interaction efficiency, imitation performance, and robustness, indicating that RECON directs real-environment interaction toward recovery regions around the expert distribution that are underexplored by prior methods, and thereby learns a world model better suited for imitation.

</details>


### [966] [KoopCell: Koopman-Based Generative Model for Learning Single-Cell Dynamics from Distribution Snapshots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33350)
*Wanfeng Lu,Yutong Zhang,Keyi Zhou,Chenxin Ge,Wei Lin,Qunxi Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KoopCell是一个基于Koopman-Mori-Zwanzig理论的生成框架，用于从时间稀疏、无配对的分布快照中学习单细胞群体动力学。该方法联合学习表示和预测性线性潜在动力学，通过弱连续性方程推导Koopman生成元的闭式最小二乘估计器，并开发了引入非马尔可夫记忆的KoopCell-M扩展来处理分支动力学问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从时间稀疏、无配对的分布快照中学习群体动力学是发育生物学中的基础挑战。现有方法（基于神经微分方程和流匹配）在训练时间范围内插值表现良好，但难以外推超训练视野，且缺乏建模发育分支的机制。Koopman理论提供了将非线性动力学线性化的统一视角，但传统神经Koopman方法依赖配对轨迹数据。

Method: 提出KoopCell框架：1) 基于弱连续性方程推导Koopman生成元的闭式最小二乘估计器，并建立收敛保证；2) 交替进行表示学习和生成元估计，通过随机傅里叶测试构造测试空间；3) 开发KoopCell-M扩展，通过Mori-Zwanzig形式化引入非马尔可夫记忆，使用马尔可夫嵌入到增广潜在空间实现分支动力学建模；4) 引入离散路径变量R和路径一致性损失以编码发育路径。

Result: 在合成系统和三个scRNA-seq数据集（斑马鱼胚胎发育、果蝇胚胎发育、小鼠iPSC重编程）上的实验表明：1) KoopCell能恢复Koopman谱并支持稳定外推；2) KoopCell-M在分支建模任务上优于线性版本（SWD从0.156降至0.112）；3) 在中等难度和困难任务的外推部分，KoopCell-M相比最强基线将平均误差降低2.0%-7.3%；4) 生物学下游分析成功恢复了PSM和后脑谱系相关基因（MSGN1/TBX16和SOX19A/SOX3）。

Conclusion: KoopCell是首个从无配对分布快照学习Koopman生成动力学的统一框架，理论上建立了闭式估计器和收敛保证，实验上在单细胞群体动力学预测中达到了最先进的性能。未来方向包括多组学数据应用和从分布快照学习随机Koopman算子。

Abstract: Learning population dynamics from temporally sparse, unpaired distribution snapshots is a fundamental challenge in developmental biology. Recent approaches based on neural differential equations and flow matching can interpolate between observed population snapshots, but may struggle to extrapolate beyond the training horizon and often lack an explicit mechanism for modeling developmental branching. We propose KoopCell, a unified generative framework based on Koopman-Mori-Zwanzig theory that jointly learns representations and predictive linear latent dynamics. Theoretically, using the weak continuity equation, we derive a closed-form least-squares estimator for the Koopman generator from distribution snapshots and establish convergence guarantees under suitable assumptions. To model branching dynamics, we further develop KoopCell-M, which incorporates non-Markovian memory into the latent Koopman dynamics through a Markovian embedding. Experiments on synthetic systems and three scRNA-seq datasets demonstrate the ability of our framework to recover Koopman spectra, model branching through memory, and scale to predicting high-dimensional gene expression distributions, achieving state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods.

</details>


### [967] [Beyond Timestamps: Decision-Aligned On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33391)
*Mingju Chen,Can Lv,Jinrong Liu,Huan Zhang,Heng Chang,Shiji Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AlignOPSD 方法，通过决策对齐的监督校正和半马尔可夫分层信用分配，解决长视野智能体训练中特权监督的"决策-时间戳错位"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 仅提供稀疏的结果奖励，无法区分成功轨迹中的有效决策与偶然行为；现有的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）方法依赖时间戳局部监督，但存在两个问题：跨 rollout 时同一时间戳未必对应同一决策，同一决策可能跨越多个时间戳，导致监督的上下文和时间范围均错位。

Method: AlignOPSD 包含两个核心阶段：(1) 决策对齐监督校正——用 frozen 语义编码器编码思维轨迹，通过余弦相似度在兄弟 rollout 间建立功能级决策对应关系，对同一学生响应在功能匹配上下文下重新评分，并以置信度加权混合本地与对齐证据；(2) 半马尔可夫分层信用分配——通过相邻回合对应分布的 JSD 变化检测功能决策边界，生成变长决策跨度（span），利用校正后的证据在跨度级和回合级两级分配结果条件下的信用预算，最后通过 KL 正则化和有界归一化广播到 token 级优势。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、Search-QA、WebShop 三个基准上，使用 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 骨干，AlignOPSD 在所有 8 项骨干-聚合指标对比中均优于 GRPO（提升 5.5–8.7%）和 StepOPSD，其中 6 项排名第一；消融实验证实监督校正和自适应跨度分配均不可或缺；机理分析显示决策跨度长度具有任务依赖性（ALFWorld 4.41 回合、WebShop 3.92 回合、Search-QA 2.24 回合），且校正后教师-学生差距与原差距系统性偏离。

Conclusion: 长视野智能体训练中，监督信号应在用于结果条件下的信用分配之前先与功能决策对齐。AlignOPSD 通过跨 rollout 功能对应关系建立可比监督上下文，并从对应变化中推导自适应决策跨度，实现了跨决策层级和时间范围的双重对齐，在多个基准和模型规模上一致优于现有方法。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often relies on sparse outcome rewards, providing coarse supervision for long-horizon agents. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this signal with dense privileged feedback. However, we identify \emph{Decision--Timestamp Mismatch}: privileged guidance may be misaligned with the student's functional decision because the corresponding decision can occur at a different timestep, while the student's decision itself may span multiple timesteps rather than being tied to a single timestamp. Thus, timestamp-local supervision can misalign both the context and the temporal scope of credit. To address this mismatch, we introduce \textsc{AlignOPSD}, following the principle of aligning supervision before assigning credit. Decision-Aligned Supervision Rectification re-scores the same student-sampled response in functionally matched contexts across sibling rollouts to calibrate local teacher evidence. Semi-Markov Hierarchical Credit Assignment then derives variable-duration decision spans from correspondence changes and uses rectified evidence to allocate outcome-grounded credit across spans and their constituent turns. We evaluate \textsc{AlignOPSD} with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA against representative baselines. \textsc{AlignOPSD} outperforms both GRPO and StepOPSD across all eight backbone--aggregate-metric comparisons, improving on GRPO by 5.5--8.7 \% and ranking first in six. Additional analyzes examine the two alignment stages and hyperparameter sensitivity between tasks. Our code is avaliable at this https URL

</details>


### [968] [AutoHGNN: Robust and Efficient Neural Architecture Search for Hypergraph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33392)
*Sirui Li,Pietro Liò b,Xinsheng Li,Baisong Liu,Chengbin Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AutoHGNN提出了一种针对超图神经网络的可微神经架构搜索框架,核心贡献包括:设计基于超交互模块(HIM)的搜索空间以建模顶点-超边二阶段消息传递,以及提出超图稳定拓扑距离(HyperSTD)作为拓扑感知的架构选择标准。在多个图与超图基准数据集上,AutoHGNN在分类精度和搜索效率上均优于手工设计和自动搜索的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的图NAS方法主要针对传统二元边图设计,其搜索空间无法刻画超图中固有的顶点-超边消息传递机制,导致优化不稳定且选出的架构忽略了高阶拓扑结构。同时,超图神经网络架构的手工设计依赖大量领域知识,亟需自动化设计方法。因此,需要一种专为超图设计的NAS框架,兼顾拓扑保持与搜索效率。

Method: 方法包含三大组件:(1)超图搜索空间——以L层HIM为骨干,每层包含顶点→超边聚合器(Agg_e)、超边→顶点聚合器(Agg_v)和后处理层(归一化、激活、Dropout),并通过特征聚合算子F融合多尺度特征,各阶段候选算子包括sum/mean/softmax-sum/softmax-mean等;(2)可微搜索模块——构建权重共享超网络,采用解耦的可微采样器(基于Gumbel-Softmax松弛)和超网络训练模块分离优化架构参数α与网络权重ω;(3)两阶段架构选择——先在每轮采样中按HyperSTD(相对Frobenius距离度量预测标签与原始超图拓扑亲和矩阵的一致性)筛选top-K候选入池,再从全局候选池中选最优并重新训练评估。

Result: 在Pubmed/Computers/Physics三个图基准上,AutoHGNN准确率达83.17%/87.02%/95.53%,优于D2GNAS等最佳基线且每轮搜索时间低至0.11-0.22秒,比RL/EA方法低近一个数量级;在Cora-CA和DBLP超图基准上准确率达73.76%和88.91%,分别超越最佳手工HGNN基线至少1.07%和2.88%。消融实验证实了灵活聚合算子、特征融合和HyperSTD选择标准各自的贡献。

Conclusion: AutoHGNN是首个将可微NAS策略与拓扑感知选择方法相结合的HGNN架构搜索工作,验证了超图专用搜索空间设计与结构保真选择标准对自动化超图学习的必要性。其局限性在于搜索空间局限于两阶段消息传递且HyperSTD在极端情况下敏感,未来工作将扩展注意力/残差连接、引入更鲁棒的拓扑度量(如低秩近似后的余弦相似度)并应用于大规模动态超图和半监督场景。

Abstract: Hypergraph neural networks have achieved significant success in recent years. However, manual architecture crafting is labor-intensive and often fails to capture complex, higher-order relations, making the automation of hypergraph neural network structure design crucial. To improve the automation and adaptability of hypergraph learning, this paper proposes AutoHGNN, a neural architecture search framework tailored for hypergraph neural networks. First, we introduce a Hyper-Interaction Module (HIM) into the search space to address the mismatch between conventional graph neural network designs and hypergraph data. Second, we propose Hypergraph Stable Topological Distance (HyperSTD) as a structural selection criterion to identify architectures that best preserve the intrinsic structural affinities of the original hypergraph during differentiable search. Extensive experiments on various benchmark datasets demonstrate that AutoHGNN consistently outperforms manually designed and automatically searched baselines in classification accuracy and time efficiency, proving that the discovered architectures are significantly more effective.

</details>


### [969] [Decoupling Token Roles in Autoregressive Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33405)
*Suqin Yuan,Runqi Lin,Kevin Qinghong Lin,Junchi Yu,Lei Feng,Chris Russell,Tongliang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过控制性腐败实验揭示自回归预训练中每个token同时扮演"目标"和"上下文"两种角色,且这两种角色对同一token的偏好可能完全相反——使含噪token更易预测能减少其作为目标的损害,却增加其作为上下文的损害。这一发现对理解生成式文本作为训练数据以及token级干预方法具有重要意义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归预训练日益依赖异构数据(包括大量语言模型生成的文本),因此亟需在token级别理解模型究竟从单个token中学到了什么。传统的next-token prediction目标仅通过token自身的损失来衡量其贡献,完全忽略了同一token作为后续预测上下文所起的作用。这两种角色在常规训练中总是耦合在一起,无法被分开观察和衡量。

Method: 1. **角色解耦框架**:将自回归目标分解为context流(c)和target流(y),通过控制腐败路由实现四种条件——Clean、Target-only Noise、Context-only Noise、Standard Noise。
2. **两种可控腐败**:Random replacement(从词表均匀采样)和Predictable replacement(用冻结小模型基于干净前缀选择高排名候选词)。
3. **关系分离实验**:构建四组替换流,分别交叉"对前缀的拟合度"和"对后续的拟合度"两个维度。
4. **实践应用**:(a)将生成文本视为一种predictable replacement,分析其对固定后续的干扰;(b)在已知腐败位置的oracle条件下,比较loss masking(作用于目标)与reliability flag(作用于上下文)两种干预。
5. **多模型验证**:GPT-2-large(OpenWebText,9B tokens)、SmolLM2-135M/360M/1.7B(FineWeb-Edu,1-10B tokens)、Qwen3-1.7B/4B continued pretraining,跨多种seed、模型规模、训练预算和腐败率。

Result: 1. **角色反转现象**:Predictable replacement(own loss≈6.6)作为target损害小于random replacement(own loss≈17.4),但作为context时损害反而更大。该反转在所有测试的模型、规模(135M-1.7B)、训练预算(1B-10B tokens)、腐败率(3%-10%)和seeds下稳健存在。
2. **角色归因**:Target角色仅跟踪token对前缀的拟合度;Context角色的损害方向取决于后续是否拟合——后续拟合时更好的前缀拟合降低损害,后续不拟合时反而升高损害。
3. **生成文本的特殊性**:生成文本等同于predictable replacement,解码越贪婪(greedy)生成文本越易预测(NLL从3.5降至1.2),但其对固定人类后续的干扰越大(NLL增加从8.7升至9.6);随机token(NLL=13.6)对后续的干扰仅6.4,小于任何解码策略下的生成文本。
4. **干预的角色选择**:在oracle已知腐败位置时,Loss masking对predictable replacement的损害恢复率为-13%(GPT-2)和-0.3%(SmolLM2),即完全无效;而Reliability flag(在输入嵌入中加入可靠性标记)可恢复约39-41%的损害。

Conclusion: 自回归预训练中每个token同时承担"被预测的目标"和"作为上下文被使用"两种角色,而token的自身损失仅捕捉了其目标角色。两种角色对同一token的偏好可以完全相反:使token更易预测的内容反而可能成为更差的上下文。生成式文本因从不需适配独立确定的后续,而系统性地放大了这种不对称。Token级的数据控制必须分别决定"干预哪些token"和"通过哪个角色实施干预",仅依靠损失掩码是不够的,因为它只作用于目标角色。理解模型从token学到什么,本质上要求将这两种角色解耦对待。

Abstract: Autoregressive pretraining increasingly draws on heterogeneous data, making it important to understand how a model learns from an individual token. The next-token prediction objective naturally identifies a token's contribution with its own loss. However, each token is not only a prediction target but also context for what follows. Using controlled corruption, we decouple these two roles and find a reversal: making a noisy token easier to predict reduces its damage as a target but increases it as context. The same decoupling helps explain text generated by language models: generation selects each token by its fit to the prefix, while its role as context is never tested against an independently determined continuation, because that continuation is generated to fit it. At known corrupted positions, acting through the context can reduce damage that removing the token's own loss does not. Understanding and controlling what a model learns from a token therefore requires decoupling its roles.

</details>


### [970] [Investigating the Effect of k-NN Preprocessing on Developing Graph Neural Networks: A Fairness-Based Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33416)
*Nikolaos Zafeiropoulos,Emmanouil Mavrikos,George E. Tsekouras*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种设计公平图卷积神经网络（GCN）的方法，通过 k-近邻（k-NN）构建图结构，并将均等化机会（equalized odds）准则以损失函数项的形式嵌入到优化目标中，在三个含偏见的真实表格数据集上系统研究了邻域大小 k 与公平性约束对分类性能与公平性的权衡影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图卷积神经网络在节点分类等任务中表现出色，但其性能受图结构影响显著，且现有方法对图构建过程与公平性约束的联合优化研究不足。现实数据集中往往存在偏见（如性别、种族等受保护属性），如何在不显著牺牲分类精度的前提下缓解预测中的群体差异，成为 GCN 公平学习的关键问题。

Method: 1. **图构建**：采用 k-近邻算法基于输入特征构建图结构，邻居数 k 作为关键超参数。 2. **公平性准则**：采用均等化机会（equalized odds）作为公平性度量，要求模型在不同受保护群体上的假正率和假负率相近。 3. **损失函数设计**：将均等化机会对应的公平性损失项直接嵌入 GCN 的优化目标中，与分类损失联合优化。 4. **实验设计**：在三个含已知偏见的真实表格数据集上进行实验，系统改变 k 值并对比有无公平性约束的模型表现，分析图结构与公平性的交互作用。

Result: 1. **k 值影响**：分类性能随 k 值的变化趋势因数据集而异，表现为稳步提升或在中间值达到峰值。 2. **公平性效果**：施加公平性约束后，各群体间的假正率和假负率差异显著降低，有效缓解了群体间的不平等。 3. **精度代价**：公平性约束的引入未导致整体分类精度的大幅下降，表明公平性与准确性之间可实现较好平衡。 4. **联合优化意义**：图构建过程与公平性目标的协同设计对模型性能与公平性具有重要影响。

Conclusion: 本文证明了在 GCN 中联合优化图构建过程与公平性目标的可行性与有效性，提出了一种系统化的方法来构建更加公平且高效的图模型。均等化机会约束能够在不显著牺牲准确性的前提下显著缩小群体间预测差异，为图公平学习提供了新的思路，强调了图结构选择对公平机器学习的重要性。

Abstract: In this paper, a methodology to design fair graph convolutional neural networks (GCNs) is developed and tested over several application data sets. The graphs that are used as inputs to the network are constructed by a k-nearest neighbor-based preprocessing procedure, while fairness issues are considered in terms of the equalized odds criterion. To effectively incorporate the above heterogenous information, the equalized odds criterion is directly embedded into the model's optimization objective through an additional fairness-driven loss functional term. The proposed methodology investigates how varying the neighborhood size in the k-NN algorithm during graph construction influences both the classification performance and the fairness of the resulting models. Extensive experimentation is conducted on three real-world tabular datasets with known biases, evaluating the interplay between graph structure and fairness enforcement. The results demonstrate that the choice of the value of the parameter k critically impacts the performance trends, either steadily improving or peaking at intermediate values depending on dataset characteristics, while the application of fairness constraints significantly mitigates disparities in false positive and false negative rates across groups defined by the protected variable at hand, without incurring major sacrifices in overall accuracy. This study highlights the importance of jointly optimizing the graph construction process and fairness objectives in GCN-based learning, providing a systematic approach toward building more equitable and effective graph-based models.

</details>


### [971] [A Light Bilevel Refinement Aligns Self-Supervised Representations for Stronger Task-Specific Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33424)
*Gustav Wagner Zakarias,Zheng-Hua Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BiSSLight，一种基于双层优化的自监督表征对齐方法的高效可扩展变体，通过结合M-FAC隐式梯度近似与LoRA参数高效微调，显著降低了计算与内存开销，同时在多种ViT规模和下游任务上一致提升性能，且模型越大收益越明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督预训练模型在直接微调到下游任务时，由于预训练任务（pretext）与下游任务的目标和数据分布存在错位，可能导致对预训练特征的退化或覆盖。原始BiSSL框架通过双层优化引入过渡训练阶段来缓解该问题，但依赖共轭梯度（CG）近似隐式超梯度，计算成本随模型规模急剧上升，难以应用于现代大规模架构。

Method: BiSSLight用Matrix-Free Approximate Curvature（M-FAC）算法替代CG来近似逆Hessian-向量积（IHVP），利用经验Fisher矩阵的秩一结构和Woodbury-Morrison公式递归计算逆Fisher-向量积；同时冻结预训练骨干，仅在双层结构的两层各附加一组LoRA模块进行优化，将M-FAC的存储和计算限制在低维LoRA参数空间内，并通过分块（block-wise）M-FAC处理高维模型。此外复用下层预训练任务梯度作为M-FAC的输入，无需额外梯度计算。

Result: 在MAE预训练的ViT-B/16、ViT-L/16、ViT-H/14以及I-JEPA预训练的ViT-H/14上，BiSSLight在Pets、DTD、VOC07、Flowers、CUB200、Aircrafts六个分类基准上一致且通常统计显著地提升下游准确率，模型越大增益越显著（如Aircrafts上ViT-H增益达+6.7pp）。计算效率方面，在ViT-H上较BiSSL提速超10倍，峰值显存降低约3–4倍；注意力可视化显示BiSSLight使注意力更集中于任务相关目标区域；表征相似性分析（Linear CKA/RSA）表明BiSSLight学到的表征与原始BiSSL高度相似（平均CKA≈0.93）。

Conclusion: BiSSLight通过M-FAC与LoRA的结合，在保持BiSSL通用性（对架构、预训练任务、下游任务、PEFT方法均不可知）的同时，将双层表征对齐方法扩展到现代大规模设置，是一种实用且可即插即用的下游迁移性能增强手段。

Abstract: Self-supervised pretraining learns representations that are broadly transferable across downstream tasks, yet direct fine-tuning can be suboptimal due to misalignment between self-supervised and downstream task objectives, potentially degrading pretrained features beneficial to the downstream task. The BiSSL framework addressed this by introducing a transitional training stage formulated as a bilevel optimization problem, in which the downstream task objective guides the self-supervised learning process in refining pretrained representations to better facilitate subsequent fine-tuning. However, BiSSL relies on conventional bilevel optimization solving techniques whose costly implicit hypergradient approximations render the method increasingly impractical for contemporary model architectures. To make it efficient and scalable, we introduce BiSSLight, which combines M-FAC-based implicit gradient approximation with parameter-efficient fine-tuning via LoRA, enabling efficient application at larger scales that were previously impractical. Evaluation across multiple downstream tasks and contemporary model architectures shows that BiSSLight consistently improves downstream performance, with gains becoming more pronounced as model size increases despite stronger baselines. The method is highly computationally efficient, reducing computation time by more than a factor of ten compared to its predecessor on a ViT-H backbone.

</details>


### [972] [A Cheap Verifier is Good Enough: LLM Post-training is Robust to Erroneous Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33467)
*Andreas Plesner,Curtis Northcutt,Francisco Guzmán,Anish Athalye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM后训练中验证器选择问题，发现验证器与"金标"评判的一致性并不能可靠预测训练后模型的性能。昂贵的验证器不一定优于便宜验证器，开源的Gemma验证器表现出色。使用便宜验证器可节省98.8%-99.7%的评分成本，同时仅损失1-3分的训练后性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在RLVR(可验证奖励强化学习)扩展到半可验证的rubric-based rewards场景下，实践者面临如何选择验证器的关键决策。直观假设是验证器准确度越高、训练效果越好，但这一假设在真实rubric评分场景下是否成立尚不清楚。本文旨在验证"验证器一致性是否决定后训练性能"这一核心问题。

Method: 本文采用GRPO算法，使用Qwen3(1.7B-8B)作为训练模型，在HealthBench(医疗)和PRBench(金融、法律)三个领域进行实验。从52个候选模型中筛选12个训练时验证器，使用三个前沿LLM作为golden验证器(平均结果)，共消耗超过11000个H100 GPU小时。比较了"cost-reducing"(准确度≥0.80的最便宜验证器)和"balanced"(固定Gemma 4 26B)两种低成本选择。

Result: 1)验证器F1一致性与训练后策略得分无单调排序关系(如GPT oss 20B F1更高但训练得分低于F1较低的Grok 4.20);2)开源Gemma验证器产生最强训练效果之一;3)成本降低型Pareto验证器节省99.7%成本但得分差距+0.027;4)平衡型Pareto验证器(Gemma 4 26B)节省98.8%成本且仅+0.010得分差距，捕获95%的可用提升;5)弱验证器(LFM2 24B)确实会损害训练，特别是小模型;6)健康基准单个评分错误平均仅改变0.00085分。

Conclusion: 在半可验证rubric-based后训练任务中，便宜验证器可以在包含强大昂贵模型的候选池中实现强策略得分。验证器一致性仍然具有信息价值(尤其用于识别弱验证器)，但不能完全决定训练结果排名。开源Gemma验证器提供了特别有利的成本-得分权衡。该结论仅适用于测试场景，不意味着验证器选择完全可互换。

Abstract: When post-training large language models on tasks with semi-verifiable rewards, there are many factors (training steps, base model size, training order, data quality, verifier accuracy, etc.) that practitioners must contend with to maximize model performance. Yet, it remains unclear how well verifier agreement predicts post-training performance on such tasks. In this paper, we explore this question with over 11k H100 GPU-hours, across HealthBench and PRBench tasks in medical, legal, and finance domains. Across the tested domains, Qwen3 trainees (1.7B-8B on HealthBench; 8B on PRBench), evaluation splits, and frontier LLM reference judges (which we call golden verifiers), higher verifier agreement does not consistently identify the best training verifier. Expensive verifiers need not outperform inexpensive ones, and open-weight Gemma verifiers produce strong training outcomes. We compare two low-cost choices retrospectively -- a cost-reducing choice and a balanced choice -- with estimated grading cost reductions of 98.8%-99.7% relative to the golden grading protocols and average post-training score gaps of 1-3 points from the best evaluated training verifier. These averages include larger losses in individual settings; they do not establish that verifier choices are interchangeable.

</details>


### [973] [Chameleon: Dynamic Format Adapter for Efficient Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33496)
*Arnab Sanyal,Sandeep Chinchali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Chameleon提出了一种创新的扩散模型PTQ框架，将"数字格式"本身作为离散变量，根据权重通道和(layer, timestep bucket)激活张量动态选择INT8/FP8/MXFP8/INT4/NF4/FP4/MXINT4/MXFP4等格式，使用经验峰度和扩散SNR两个廉价统计量构建查找表，在固定比特宽度下实现跨架构（多步UNet、少步蒸馏、DiT）的最优量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型PTQ方法（如Q-Diffusion、PTQ4DM、MixDQ、Q-DiT）都将数字格式（通常为INT8）固定，只调整scale、zero point或逐层bit-width。但在固定bit-width下，最佳格式取决于被编码的分布，而扩散网络中分布因权重通道、层、以及扩散timestep（从重尾噪声主导到紧密聚类的结构化信号）而异，单一格式对大多数张量都不匹配，scale重调无法修复格式失配。

Method: Chameleon将数字格式视为离散变量进行PTQ。激活格式调色板包括{INT8-asym, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8 E4M3, MXINT8}，权重格式包括8bit的{INT8-sym, INT8-asym, MXINT8}和4bit的{INT4-sym, INT4-asym, NF4, FP4 E2M1, MXINT4, MXFP4 E2M1}。通过离线校准收集经验峰度κ_l(t)和闭式扩散SNR两个统计量，构建L×B查找表：UNet shortcut层强制路由至MXFP8；Phase 1（κ>5或SNR<0.2）选FP8 E5M2；Phase 3（κ≤3且SNR>2）选INT8-asym；其余选FP8 E4M3。权重按输出通道选择，通过重构误差（SQNR）离线决定。架构分叉适配多步UNet（SDXL，激活动态格式+静态scale）、少步蒸馏（SDXL-Turbo，仅权重palette+继承MixDQ激活）和DiT（PixArt-α，联合(g,f)搜索+逐样本动态scale）。

Result: 在COCO-2014（24,576张图像）上，Chameleon在所有6个backbone×bit-width组合上取得最佳FID：SDXL W4A8达14.43（Q-Diffusion为21.41，提升7.0点）；SDXL-Turbo W4A8达21.29（MixDQ为24.50，FP16为21.63）；PixArt-α W4A8达22.24（Q-DiT为23.53，FP16为27.63）。所有配置CLIP-score在FP16参考的0.24以内，W4A8上CLIP领先所有量化方法。高频细节保留（拉普拉斯方差）也优于基线。校准成本低于1小时（单A100）。

Conclusion: Chameleon证明在固定bit-width下，数字格式本身应是按张量（包括权重通道、层、以及扩散timestep）变化的离散变量。通过两个廉价统计量（峰度+SNR）驱动的查找表路由，配合UNet/少步/DiT架构分叉，可同时适配三种扩散范式。该框架是组合性的而非竞争性的——Q-DiT的分组权重和动态scale可无损叠加，MixDQ的激活流水线与权重palette组合后其BOS旁路变得不再必要。局限：使用fake-quantization而非真实低精度kernel，未评估效率；评估限于图像生成，未扩展到视频DiT；未涉及W2/W1等亚4bit场景。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is the standard way to run modern diffusion models on memory-constrained accelerators, yet every existing diffusion PTQ scheme fixes the $\mathit{number\ format}$ in advance and only tunes the scale, zero point, or per-layer bit-width. At a fixed bit-width the best format depends on the distribution being encoded, and that distribution differs across weight channels, across layers, and along the diffusion timestep, where activation distributions slide from heavy-tailed and noise-dominated to tightly clustered and structured. We propose Chameleon, a PTQ framework that holds the bit-width fixed and treats the format itself as a discrete variable, chosen per weight channel and per (layer, timestep bucket) activation tensor. Activation formats come from {INT8, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8, MXINT8}, selected ahead of time from two cheap statistics (empirical kurtosis and the closed-form diffusion SNR) and stored in a lookup table; weight formats come from {INT8, MXINT8} at 8 bits or {INT4, NF4, FP4 E2M1, MXINT4, MXFP4} at 4 bits, selected offline by reconstruction error. An architectural fork adapts the same selection layer to multi-step UNets, single-step distilled models, and Diffusion Transformers. Across SDXL, SDXL-Turbo, and PixArt-$\alpha$ on COCO-2014, Chameleon achieves the best FID in all six backbone $\times$ bit-width settings, with CLIP within 0.24 of the FP16 reference and the best of all quantized methods at $W_{4}A_{8}$.

</details>


### [974] [Source Anchoring for Physical Consistency in Flow Matching Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33510)
*Giulia Romoli,Filippo Ruffini,Paolo Soda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SAPC（Source Anchoring for Physical Consistency），一种函数流匹配（FFM）方法，通过在生成开始前将物理约束编码进源噪声分布来保持物理一致性，避免了传统基于投影的流匹配方法在采样时进行大修正导致样本偏离目标分布的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于投影的流匹配方法从无约束噪声分布开始生成，再在中间或最终步骤进行投影修正物理约束。这种后期修正（尤其在高噪声区域）会将生成的样本从目标解的分布推开，得到物理上可接受但偏离分布的解。本文旨在解决这一分布偏差问题。

Method: 在训练时，将源噪声样本𝒱₁投影到物理可行流形ℋ上得到𝒱̄₁=P(𝒱₁)，并以此为端点构建线性插值𝒱ₜ=(1−t)𝒱₀+t𝒱̄₁，速度场回归目标变为𝒱̄₁−𝒱₀。采样时，源端同样投影为𝒱̄₁=P(𝒱₁)，并在每个Euler步对后验均值估计𝒱₀,θ=𝒱ₜ−tv_θ进行投影P(𝒱₀,θ)。文章还给出了非线性约束下插值残差的理论界∥R(𝒱ₜ)∥≤½t(1−t)L∥𝒱₀−𝒱̄₁∥²，证明锚定源后整个流动保持靠近ℋ。

Result: 在5个PDE系统（Heat、Reaction-Diffusion、Stokes IC/BC、Burgers、2D Navier-Stokes）的6个任务上，SAPC在所有任务的分布匹配指标（MMSE、SMSE、FPD、W₂）上均达到最优，相对第二优方法在Heat、RD、Burgers上降低1-3个数量级；在Stokes和NS上优势较小但仍最佳。约束精度与最佳投影基线持平（10⁻⁶–10⁻⁷）。消融实验表明，仅端点投影（S1、S2）仅能降低约束误差而不改善分布；仅采样时源锚定（S3）效果差；SAPC的优势来源于源投影与匹配训练目标的协同。推理成本与其他投影方法相当，但D-Flow慢约100倍。

Conclusion: 源分布是物理一致生成建模中的关键设计选择。将物理约束在源头处编码而非在采样末尾修正，使生成过程从一开始就细化近一致的样本，避免大修正带来的分布偏差。SAPC为将物理一致性融入生成流匹配模型提供了一个原则性框架。

Abstract: Deep generative models are used to solve partial differential equations and model distributions of physical system states, but ensuring that the generated samples satisfy the governing laws remains challenging. Projection-based flow-matching methods enforce physics by correcting the flow from an unconstrained noise distribution. These corrections shift the generated samples away from the distribution of target solutions, especially in high noise regions. To address this limitation, we propose Source Anchoring for Physical Consistency (SAPC), a Functional Flow Matching method that encodes the physical constraints into the source noise before generation begins. We evaluate SAPC on five systems governed by partial differential equations, covering six tasks with linear and non-linear dynamics, and compare results against five baselines and the unconstrained backbone. Anchoring the source reduces the need for large corrections that drive samples onto admissible but off-distribution states, and SAPC reproduces the target distributions most accurately on every evaluated task, while matching the constraint precision of the best projection-based baselines. Ablation experiments show that this gain arises from pairing source projection with a matched training objective that regresses toward the projected source. These results identify the source distribution as a key design choice for physically consistent generative modelling.

</details>


### [975] [TerMeZO: Ternary Sparse Zeroth-Order Optimization for Fine-tuning BitNet Models at the Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33548)
*Houssem Sifaou,Prabodh Katti,Bipin Rajendran,Osvaldo Simeone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TerMeZO 是一种针对 BitNet（三元权重）模型在边缘设备上进行零阶优化的稀疏微调方法。它通过仅扰动和更新距离三元量化边界最近的潜在权重子集，显著降低 MeZO 微调的内存占用，使其接近推理内存水平，同时在多项任务上保持甚至超越全参数 MeZO 的性能，并具备收敛性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的 MeZO 方法在 BitNet 模型上失去了其"接近推理内存"的优势，因为需要更新所有全精度潜在权重。现有稀疏 ZO 方法要么忽略三元量化结构，要么需要一阶梯度信息来构建稀疏掩码，与 ZO 微调的目的相悖。需要一种专为三元量化结构设计、无需一阶信息的稀疏 MeZO 方案。

Method: TerMeZO 提出了一种基于"边界邻近性"（boundary proximity）的稀疏掩码选择准则。它选择距离三元量化决策边界（±τ）最近的 ρ₀ 比例的潜在权重进行扰动和更新，其余权重在三元空间中视为冻结。该掩码可通过离线线性扫描计算，无需一阶梯度。TerMeZO 还结合该方法保留了 BitNet 的三元算术特性，并对所有全精度参数（嵌入、归一化层、LM head）执行 ZO 更新。理论方面，作者分析了 SPSA 估计器对高斯平滑目标的收敛性，证明 TerMeZO 因降低了有效微调维度，可比全参数 MeZO 收敛更快。

Result: 在 BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T 和 Falcon-Edge（1B–3B）模型上，TerMeZO 在 GLUE/SuperGLUE 分类、指令遵循（MagiCoder）和数学推理（GSM8K）任务上匹配或超越全参数 MeZO。在内存方面，当 ρ₀=0.05 时相比 MeZO 减少约 3× 内存，ρ₀=0.01 时减少约 4×，接近推理内存水平。在 RL 微调（Countdown 任务）中，TerMeZO 也表现出更快的收敛速度和更好的最终奖励。

Conclusion: TerMeZO 成功将稀疏 MeZO 微调扩展到三元 BitNet 模型，通过利用量化器自身几何结构选择更新权重，无需一阶梯度信息，实现了与推理接近的内存占用，同时保持甚至超越全参数 MeZO 的性能。这使得在边缘设备上部署和微调量化 LLM 更为实用。未来工作包括开发硬件特定的内核以加速 TerMeZO、扩展到更大模型，以及与线性注意力模型结合以进一步降低 KV 缓存开销。

Abstract: Fine-tuning anguage models (LLMs) with first-order optimizers requires a memory several times larger than that required for inference. Memory-efficient zeroth-order optimization (MeZO) sidesteps this cost by estimating gradients from forward passes only. However, for BitNet architectures, a family of LLMs with ternary {-1,0,1\} weights and 8-bit activations, fine-tuning requires updating full-precision latent weights, and thus the memory footprint of MeZO no longer matches that of inference. A promising solution is to finetune only a subset of the latent weights, but existing sparse zeroth-order (ZO) methods either ignore the ternary structure or require first-order gradient information to build a sparse mask, which is at odds with the purpose of ZO fine-tuning. We propose TerMeZO, a sparse MeZO scheme that exploits the geometry of the ternary quantizer itself to identify the latent weights that are more likely to change values during fine-tuning, at no additional data or memory cost. Our convergence analysis shows that TerMeZO can converge faster than full-parameter MeZO, owing to its optimized reduction of the fine-tuning effective dimension. We run extensive experiments on BitNet models ranging from 1B to 3B parameters, spanning classification, instruction-following, and mathematical reasoning tasks. TerMeZO matches or exceeds the performance of full-parameter MeZO while substantially reducing the fine-tuning memory footprint.

</details>


### [976] [OOD Generalization as a Bifurcation Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33562)
*Nguyen-Thanh-Luong Doan,Quang-Vu Nguyen,Tang-Phu-Quy Le,Cong-Phap Huynh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了连续时间生成模型（扩散模型与条件流匹配）中组合绑定并非均匀过程，而是存在一个高度局部化的"语义分叉窗口"。基于此发现，作者提出了"外科手术式引导"（surgical guidance），仅在该关键时间窗口内使用精确分解评分，其余时段使用计算高效的联合评分，在 OOD 双数字 MNIST 测试上以仅 15% 的扩散轨迹干预实现了 +5.3% 的成对准确率提升，并揭示了扩散模型（SDE）与条件流匹配（ODE）在结构绑定时机上的本质拓扑差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准联合无分类器引导（CFG）在生成训练中未观测到的概念组合（OOD 组合泛化）时经常失败，而精确分解评分虽然可靠但计算开销严重（每步需三次前向传播）。作者假设这种严格分解仅在生成轨迹的特定阶段才是必要的，因此提出识别该阶段以兼顾效率与组合保真度。

Method: 1. 构建受限的双数字 MNIST 测试床，训练集仅包含部分数字对（如 2-3、3-5、5-8 等），测试未观测对（如 2-8、3-2）。2. 通过量化联合与分解向量场之间的 MSE 和余弦相似度，发现两者仅在轨迹中间某一狭窄区间显著分歧，定义为"语义分叉窗口" [t_start, t_end]。3. 提出外科手术式引导：在窗口内使用三遍分解评分，窗口外使用两遍联合 CFG。4. 分别在扩散模型（DDIM，SDE）和条件流匹配（CFM，ODE）框架下实现该策略，并通过滑动窗口扫描确定最优干预区间。

Result: 在双数字 MNIST OOD 测试上：扩散模型联合基线为 87.2% 成对准确率，在轨迹前 10%-15% 区间干预可获得 +5.3% 的绝对提升；CFM 基线为 94.2%，其分叉窗口延迟至 progress ∈ [0.10, 0.25]，带来 +1.1% 提升。CFDG 外科手术式采样的 FID 均值（15.4）优于 CFM（16.3）。在仅干预约 15% 轨迹的情况下，性能接近完整分解评分，同时大幅降低推理成本。

Conclusion: 组合绑定是一个动力学系统问题，而非静态表示问题。语义分叉窗口的存在意味着生成模型在特定、可预测的时间阶段解析概念冲突。扩散模型（SDE）在峰值噪声处几乎立即完成结构绑定，而条件流匹配（ODE）则推迟到中间特征出现时才解析。该时间框架为大尺度生成模型的动态解码加速提供了新思路。

Abstract: Systematic out-of-distribution (OOD) generation remains a critical bottleneck for continuous-time generative models.
