While standard joint classifier-free guidance (CFG) routinely fails to synthesize unobserved concept combinations, exact decomposed scoring generalizes robustly at the cost of severe computational overhead. In this work, we reveal that compositional binding is not a uniform process but a highly localized phase transition. We identify the semantic bifurcation window - the precise temporal interval where joint and decomposed vector fields meaningfully diverge. Exploiting this dynamic, we propose surgical guidance, a hybrid sampling strategy that restricts exact multi-pass scoring strictly to this critical window. On an OOD bi-digit MNIST testbed, surgical guidance achieves state-of-the-art compositional fidelity at a fraction of the inference cost, yielding a +5.3% absolute improvement in pairwise accuracy over the joint baseline by intervening during just the first 15% of the diffusion trajectory. Furthermore, our empirical analysis uncovers a fundamental topological divide: diffusion models (SDEs) force conceptual resolution immediately at peak noise, whereas Conditional Flow Matching (ODEs) delays structural binding until intermediate features emerge, establishing a new temporal framework for accelerating large-scale generative decoding.

</details>


### [977] [MA-JEPA: Joint-Embedding World Models for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33563)
*Brandon Gary Kaplowitz,Osaze James Obahor,Christian Schroeder de Witt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MA-JEPA 是首个将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）应用于多智能体强化学习的模型基方法，通过预测各智能体局部观察嵌入而非重建观察，实现了集中训练分散执行（CTDE），在 SMAC 基准上 8 个地图中的 4 个匹配或超越最强对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型基多智能体强化学习方法存在两个问题：(1) 世界模型质量影响策略学习效果，误差在想象中累积；(2) 局部世界模型无法建模智能体间交互，而集中式潜在状态会导致训练-执行不匹配。JEPA 通过预测嵌入而非重建观察，能学到对未来控制有用的表示，但此前未被应用于多智能体场景。

Method: MA-JEPA 采用集中训练分散执行框架：每个智能体维护独立的局部世界模型（包含观察编码器、因果 Transformer 动力学、分类潜在状态的后验和先验），共享策略仅基于本地状态执行。训练时引入联合预测器 J_ω，条件于所有智能体的局部状态和联合动作，预测每个智能体的下一局部观察嵌入。预测嵌入通过与真实交互相同的局部后验 q_θ 构造策略状态。集中式评论家 V_ξ 仅用于价值学习。采用 SIGReg 防止表征坍缩，使用 EMA 目标编码器。理论分析在动作条件高斯模型下证明了编码器-预测器对的恒等性和转移一致性。

Result: 在 SMAC 8 个任务（Easy/Hard/Super Hard）上与 DMAWM、MAMBA、MAPPO、QMIX、MAT 进行匹配交互预算对比：MA-JEPA 在 4/8 任务上匹配或超过最强对比方法的平均胜率，so_many_baneling 达到 95.0%，corridor 达 66.0%。在 3s_vs_4z 上表现较弱（74% vs DMAWM 的 95.7%），归因于风筝战术想象轨迹中的误差。消融实验显示结果梯度（outcome）与 JEPA 梯度对局部表示学习提供互补信号，两者结合在跨任务评估中平均胜率最高（77.0%）。

Conclusion: MA-JEPA 证明了联合嵌入预测可作为多智能体控制中重建式世界模型的可行替代方案。该架构通过预测嵌入而非重建观察来学习表示，支持潜在想象和分散控制。训练中联合模型通过预测各智能体的下一局部观察嵌入来捕获交互，这些预测通过与真实交互相同的局部后验处理。未来工作包括研究学习表示的哪些特性使其对世界模型预测和控制有效，并将方法扩展到更广泛的连续控制和异构多智能体场景。

Abstract: World models improve sample efficiency by training policies on imagined trajectories, but their usefulness depends on learning representations that capture the information needed for future control. We study whether self-supervised joint-embedding prediction (JEPA) can provide this learning signal for multi-agent reinforcement learning. We introduce MA-JEPA, a stochastic world model that replaces observation reconstruction with prediction of target representations, enabling model-based multi-agent reinforcement learning with centralized training and decentralized execution. A categorical latent state and a causal Transformer are trained with posterior and action-conditioned dynamics prediction objectives and are then used for actor-critic learning from latent imagination. A training-only joint predictor conditions on all agents' local states and actions to predict each agent's next local observation embedding. These predictions are passed through the same local posterior used during real interaction with a centralized critic that is used only for value learning, with execution remaining decentralized. Our experiments show that this architecture performs strongly on SMAC, matching or exceeding the strongest reported comparator mean win rate on four of eight evaluated maps.

</details>


### [978] [Compressing Value Predictions for Learning-Augmented Metrical Task Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33580)
*Sizhe Li,Yecheng Li,Kun He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究学习增强的度量任务系统(MTS)中如何压缩预测维度，提出基于"地标"(landmarks)的压缩价值预测框架，在仅保留m个代表性状态的对偶价值预测下，通过Lipschitz扩展重构其余值，使得值贪心策略获得加性额外开销O(T·r(L)+Σδ_t)。在稀疏有限线上证明匹配下界Ω(Tr_m)，并区分了绝对值与相对值预测接口的本质差异，最后给出PAC学习保证与Citi Bike K-server基准实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习增强MTS算法需要每个状态一个预测值，存储和拟合成本随状态数n线性增长。需要探索能否将预测压缩到少量代表性状态（地标），同时保留算法性能，并理解不同预测接口的信息论差异。

Method: 1. 引入地标压缩价值预测：预测器仅报告m个地标处的对偶值，其余通过McShane Lipschitz扩展重构。2. 值贪心策略选择最小化移动+服务+重构值的状态。3. 利用Bellman间隙的跨度表示推导加性额外开销上界。4. 通过四轮gadget构造在单位间隔有限线上建立匹配下界。5. 区分Raw（绝对值）与Relative（相对值）接口，建立接口分离定理。6. 使用跨度风险和重构失真构建经验风险最小化的线性规划，给出固定地标和联合地标-表格选择的PAC保证。

Result: 上界：值贪心策略满足ALG-OPT ≤ 2(T-1)r(L) + 2Σδ_t，其中r(L)为地标覆盖半径，δ_t为模加性平移后的预测误差。下界：在稀疏有限线（n-1≥16m）上，任何使用≤m个固定地标的随机算法有Ω(Tr_m(M))最坏期望额外开销，即使预先获得地标处精确绝对值表。接口分离：两状态一地标下，Raw接口允许与T无关的额外开销≤2a，Relative接口强制Ω(aT/4)。PAC保证：N_train ≥ 32D²/ε²·[(m-1)log(1+32D/ε)+log(2τ/β)]个样本足以学到ε-最优固定表格。实验：Citi Bike K-server基准上保留约20%预测值时，基于失真的地标选择（Distortion）方法在所有8种设置下均优于Random、Geometric、WFA和DC基线，部分设置下甚至优于Full预测器。

Conclusion: 地标压缩价值预测将预测维度从n降至m，同时将额外开销与度量覆盖半径和预测精度联系起来。在稀疏有限线区域达到极小极大最优Θ(Tr_m)。预测接口至关重要：绝对值信息可使某些策略获得与T无关的保证。重构失真κ_t可为零即使覆盖半径很大，指导联合学习地标和预测表格。实验证明基于失真的选择能在小预测预算下保留大部分Full预测器的性能。

Abstract: Learning-augmented algorithms for metrical task systems (MTS) can exploit predictions of canonical dual values, but existing formulations typically require a prediction for every state. We study whether these predictions can be compressed to a small set of representative states while retaining their algorithmic value. We introduce landmark-compressed value predictions, in which the predictor reports predicted dual values only at $m$ landmarks and the remaining values are reconstructed by a Lipschitz extension. Our algorithm achieves additive excess cost $O(T\,r(L) + \sum_t \delta_t)$, where $r(L)$ is the covering radius of the landmarks and $\delta_t$ measures prediction error up to additive shifts; local and value-dependent bounds refine this guarantee. For sparse landmark sets on unit-spaced finite lines, we prove a matching $\Omega(T r_m)$ lower bound for every randomized algorithm using fixed landmarks, even with advance access to their entire exact absolute-value table. The prediction interface also matters: on two states with one landmark, exact absolute values permit horizon-independent excess, whereas exact relative values force worst-case expected excess linear in $T$. We give PAC guarantees for learning compressed prediction tables, with efficient empirical-risk minimization for fixed landmarks. Our results connect metric coverage, prediction interfaces, and learning guarantees for compressed predictions in online MTS.

</details>


### [979] [Learning Dynamics of Continual Learning: A Unified View of Data Attribution, Forgetting, and Plasticity Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33620)
*Yi Ren,Wenlong Deng,Guanzhe Hong,Clare Lyle,Yarin Gal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的"更新-行为交互"框架，将LLM持续学习中的数据归因、灾难性遗忘和可塑性损失三个传统上分开研究的问题，整合为同一局部学习动力学在不同时间尺度上的不同表现。通过将token级别的softmax学习信号、共享读出矩阵和残差流分离，揭示了两条交互通道（CH1直接对齐与CH2读出介导），并据此提出了前向可计算的数据选择方法、区分"碰撞"与"侵蚀"两种遗忘机制的干预策略，以及基于读出传输的可塑性诊断与恢复方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代大语言模型需要在其生命周期内持续更新，而非一次性训练后冻结。这种持续适应面临三个紧密耦合的核心问题：应选择哪些经验进行学习、已有行为会如何被改变、以及更新后模型是否仍能有效学习新经验。现有研究通常将这些问题（数据归因、灾难性遗忘、可塑性损失）作为独立问题分别处理，缺乏统一的理论视角和分析框架。

Method: 1. 理论框架：推导token级"更新-行为交互"分解Δ_t(o,u)，将其分解为softmax力g_u、共享读出矩阵w和残差流三个组成部分。2. 近似推导：利用恒等路径近似和线性块近似，将难以计算的全参数Jacobian替换为前向传播可计算的隐藏状态相似度，得到CH1（直接词表对齐）和CH2（读出介导的扩散交互）两个交互通道。3. 干预策略：基于该分解设计数据选择评分函数S(u;D_ds)、能量控制（过滤高能量更新以缓解碰撞）和格式分离（缓解侵蚀）三种机制。4. 可塑性诊断：定义任务条件化读出传输指标R_D = E[||w^T g||²/||g||²]，用于检测未来可学习性的退化，并通过读出重置恢复可塑性。5. 实验验证：在Qwen2.5、Llama3.2、Qwen3等多个模型上进行数据归因、控制遗忘和长程训练可塑性实验。

Result: 1. 数据选择：CH1+CH2在受控任务上AUC达到1.000，跨语言检索准确率从0.488提升至0.625（MMLU）和0.445提升至0.600（GSM8K），且计算复杂度低于梯度方法；选取5%数据微调GSM8K，准确率达0.636（Qwen2.5-1.5B），优于随机选择和LESS。2. 遗忘分析：能量阈值掩码（E_u>1.8）几乎不影响下游性能但减少碰撞；响应格式分离保留更多指令跟随能力同时维持下游增益，证实碰撞与侵蚀由不同机制驱动。3. 可塑性诊断：在100M PubMed tokens长程训练中，OOD任务的R_D系统性下降，而ID任务保持稳定；读出重置显著恢复下游验证损失，且R_D退化程度与重置收益强相关（Spearman ρ=0.83）。

Conclusion: 持续学习的三个核心挑战——数据归因、灾难性遗忘和可塑性损失——并非独立问题，而是同一局部"更新-行为交互"在选择阶段（正交互）、适应阶段（负交互：碰撞与侵蚀）和长期演化阶段（交互几何重塑导致读出传输退化）中的不同表现。该统一框架不仅提供理论解释，还产出实用的前向可计算数据选择、机制特定的遗忘控制和基于读出的可塑性恢复方法。局限在于分析是局部的、一阶的，主要适用于SFT类更新，尚未涵盖完整训练轨迹和自适应优化器的历史依赖效应。

Abstract: Modern language models are likely to be updated throughout their lifetime rather than trained once and frozen. Each update therefore participates in a recurring cycle: decide which experience to learn from, understand what that update changes, and remain capable of learning from what comes next. We show that these challenges are governed by the same evolving update--behavior interaction. We derive a token- and layer-wise decomposition of how learning from one token changes another prediction. By separating the softmax force, shared readout geometry, and residual connections, it exposes two interaction channels and yields a forward-computable approximation. Following this interaction through time reveals a unified picture of continual adaptation. Positive interaction identifies useful experience; negative interaction produces either concentrated collision or accumulated erosion; over longer horizons, updates reshape the shared geometry mediating future learning signals, reducing their transmission. These predictions lead to effective data selection, mechanism-specific controls for interference, and a readout-based diagnostic of future learnability whose degradation predicts the benefit of restoring the readout. Across models and training regimes, the same local interaction thus explains both what an update changes now and how learning today changes what can be learned tomorrow. This view connects data attribution, forgetting, and plasticity loss as distinct regimes of the same evolving learning dynamics.

</details>


### [980] [From Distributions to Stochastic Processes: Neural Approximation of Measure-Valued Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33649)
*Yichen Wang,Ziyi Wang,Wenlian Lu,Chenghuang Shen,Jianfeng Liu,Zhengdong Xiao,Longjiu Luo,Qianrong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对"分布到分布"映射的学习问题，建立了以2-Wasserstein度量衡量的神经网络通用逼近理论框架，并将结果从有限维概率律扩展到可分希尔伯特空间上的随机过程律。通过有限维测试函数统计量+simplex值神经映射+共享原子输出支撑的构造，证明了在紧致输入律族上的均匀逼近定理和经验样本的查询界。两个实验（OU首达时间分布预测、Duffing振子响应路径律）验证了理论框架的实际可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多随机系统（不确定性传播、集合预报、贝叶斯反问题、随机偏微分方程等）天然以总体/分布层面描述，所需预测是输出律而非单个轨迹的响应。当观测对象为路径或场时，问题进一步涉及函数空间上的律。现有通用逼近理论主要处理有限维向量间的连续映射或确定性函数间的算子（如DeepONet、FNO），缺乏针对以概率律为输入和输出的"测度值映射"的均匀逼近理论，特别是W₂度量下的控制以及从有限维律到路径空间律的提升。

Method: 方法分为三层：  
(1) 编码层：从有限个有界连续测试函数ψ_i对输入律的期望∫ψ_i dμ和二阶矩m₂(μ)构成有限维特征向量E(μ)；  
(2) 神经映射层：以softmax网络产生概率单纯形Δ_N上的权重；  
(3) 解码层：用共享的有限输出原子a_1,…,a_N与权重组合，保证输出始终为合法概率测度∑ p_j δ_{a_j}。  
理论核心：紧致性保证有限测试函数可分离律族；W₂连续性传递误差；Tietze-Dugundji扩展保证单纯形值连续映射；公共支撑稳定性引理将权重误差转为W₂误差。  
对可分希尔伯特空间，通过固定有限秩正交投影（分析-合成映射对）将路径律编码为有限维坐标律，调用上述有限维结果，三角不等式分离输入投影、有限维逼近、输出重建三部分误差。  
对经验样本，使用Hoeffding不等式给出均匀高概率的查询界，W₂误差的额外项为N_in^{-1/4}阶。

Result: 理论结果：(1) 定理2.1——对W₂-紧致输入律族和W₂-连续目标算子，存在满足sup_μ W₂(𝒩̂_θ(μ), 𝒢(μ))<ε的神经网络逼近；(2) 命题B.5——经验特征替换为样本平均时W₂误差以N_in^{-1/4}速率受控；(3) 定理2.2——上述结论推广至可分希尔伯特空间上的过程律。  
实验结果：(1) OU首达时间——分布算子在NLL、Hellinger、KL、有限支撑W₂、尾误差五项指标上均优于固定特征MLP和核回归，且密度预测与Bessel桥解析参考曲线吻合；(2) Duffing振子响应路径律——基于条件RealNVP的分布在Sinkhorn散度、MMD、sliced W₂、能量距离上均优于两个基线；(3) 控制高斯分布映射——同样优于基线。

Conclusion: 本文证明了在W₂-紧致输入律族上，以有限律统计量、神经单纯形映射和共享原子输出支撑可实现分布到分布算子的均匀W₂逼近，并将该原理通过有限秩投影提升至可分希尔伯特空间上的随机过程律。理论具有模型无关性，为分布层面学习提供了表示可行性基础。两个物理驱动实验（OU首达时间和Duffing响应）以及一个控制高斯实验表明，任务自适应的神经网络模型能够从非配对集合中学习此类律级变换，并优于固定特征MLP和分布空间核回归基线。未来工作方向：加强构造理论与实用架构之间的联系、减弱紧致性与邻域假设、获得更优的统计与优化速率、在更广泛的随机系统上评估该框架。

Abstract: Learning mappings between probability distributions arises naturally when inputs and outputs are represented by populations of samples rather than individual observations. We develop an approximation-theoretic framework for distribution-to-distribution learning and extend it to mappings between stochastic processes. For continuous operators on $W_2$-compact families of finite-dimensional probability laws, we establish uniform neural approximation in the 2-Wasserstein metric using finite law statistics, a simplex-valued neural map, and a shared atomic output support that guarantees valid probability measures. We further extend this principle to probability laws on separable Hilbert spaces through finite-rank orthogonal projections. These results establish the representational feasibility of learning transformations between probability laws rather than deterministic vectors or functions. To demonstrate practical relevance, we study two problems naturally defined at the distribution level: prediction of first-passage-time distributions for an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process and nonlinear response-path laws of a Duffing oscillator. Because the theory is model-agnostic and broader than any single practical architecture, the experiments use task-adapted neural models rather than reproducing the theoretical construction exactly. In both problems, the proposed models outperform a fixed-feature MLP baseline and distribution-space kernel regression. These experiments complement the theory by demonstrating the practical learnability of distribution-to-distribution transformations in random systems.

</details>


### [981] [Dynamic Kuramoto-Hodge Operators for PDEs on Complex Geometries and Topologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33693)
*Xiang Li,Yue Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Dynamic Kuramoto-Hodge Operator (DKHO)，一种用于在复杂几何与拓扑上学习 PDE 算子的新型神经算子。其核心设计将"内容状态"（承载物理场信息）与"关系状态"（通过 Kuramoto 动力学自适应协调跨阶交互）解耦：拓扑（边界与上边界算子构成的 Dirac 算子）固定信息流动的路径，而学习到的动力学沿固定路径自适应调整交互方式。在三个基准测试（多孔介质 Darcy 流、环面输运-扩散、空腔静磁学）上，DKHO-large 平均减少约 61% 的预测误差，DKHO-small 仅用 11.5–24.3% 的参数量即可保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子（如 FNO、GNO、MGN、DeepONet、Geo-FNO、HSD）虽然能处理不规则几何，但往往忽视了一个关键事实：物理量在不同阶的上链（vertices、edges、faces）上有不同的自然支撑，且不同阶之间的耦合取决于具体 PDE 条件。在同一多孔介质中，改变材料系数或边界力会重定向流动而不改变网格连通性。因此需要一种方法，既能保留域的微分结构（拓扑约束），又能自适应地调整每个 PDE 实例的交互强度。

Method: DKHO 由三个组件构成：(1) Form-Aware Encoding——在各自的上链支撑（顶点、边、面）上编码已知 PDE 条件；(2) Conditional Dirac-Kuramoto Coordination——通过 Dirac 算子（d + δ）固定跨阶路径，沿该路径用 Kuramoto 启发的关系动力学（sine 非线性 + 门控 G、驱动 Ω、滞后 Λ）自适应调节交互，关系状态 θ 经 R 个子步骤演化，最终通过 sin/cos 周期性读出调制内容状态 z；(3) Hodge-Structured Decoding——在正交的 Hodge 子空间中分别重建非调和（精确 + 上精确）和调和响应。关键理论性质：小残差极限下，关系动力学恢复为离散 Hodge 松弛步（–τΔₖθ）；incidence 反馈范围确保精确/上精确/Hodge 分量的正交性。

Result: 在三个基准测试上（Darcy 流：带两非对称孔洞平面域；环面输运-扩散：三维闭合环面 Betti 数 (1,2,1)；空腔静磁学：球壳 Ω=B(0,2.0)\B̄(0,0.4)）：

• Darcy 流：DKHO-large 在 C⁰、C¹、C² 三个输出上 RelL2 分别为 0.0035、0.0155、0.0244，相对最佳基线分别降低约 84%、86%、78%；微分保真度 > 0.998。

• 环面输运-扩散：RelL2 分别为 0.1413、0.1262、0.1007，降低约 42%、20%、12%；Curl 保真度从 MGN 的 0.7160 提升至 0.8187。

• 空腔静磁学：RelL2 0.0140（降 74%），Curl MSE 从 7.03×10⁻³ 降至 3.92×10⁻⁴（降 94%），IoU 从 0.8268 升至 0.9724。

参数效率：DKHO-small 仅约 64K 参数，在 6/7 个目标上低于最佳基线，仅用基线 11.5%–24.3% 的参数量。

消融实验：移除 Dirac 路由（最大退化，Darcy C² 误差增至 12×）、移除关系状态（全部退化，空腔最严重）、移除调和解码（每个适用目标退化）均证实三组件互补。冻结模型分析表明相位更新与物理场结构存在显著空间对应（Dice 为随机配对的 2.11–3.23 倍）。

Conclusion: DKHO 证明将显式拓扑结构（DEC/Hodge 框架下的固定 incidence 路径）与条件自适应动力学（Kuramoto 启发的关系状态）相结合，可作为复杂几何与拓扑上 PDE 算子学习的有效归纳偏置。其设计原则——"拓扑决定何处交互，学习动力学决定如何交互"——在精度和参数效率上均优于现有方法。未来工作方向：扩展至可变几何与拓扑域。

Abstract: Learning PDE operators on complex domains requires capturing interactions among fields on vertices, edges, and faces, alongside global responses shaped by topology. Existing neural operators accommodate irregular geometries but often overlook these distinct field supports or their condition-dependent coupling. We introduce the Dynamic Kuramoto--Hodge Operator (DKHO), which combines topology-constrained interactions with learned coordination. DKHO encodes conditions on their native cochain supports, evolves Kuramoto-inspired relation states through the boundary and coboundary operators that compose the Dirac operator, and decodes non-harmonic and harmonic responses in orthogonal Hodge subspaces. Topology thus determines where information can flow, while learned dynamics adapts how it is exchanged to each PDE instance. Across porous-medium Darcy flow, torus transport--diffusion, and cavity magnetostatics, DKHO-large reduces prediction error by approximately 61% on average over leading baselines, while DKHO-small remains competitive using only 11.5--24.3% as many parameters. These results suggest that coupling topological structure with adaptive dynamics provides an effective inductive bias for accurate and parameter-efficient PDE operator learning on complex geometries and topologies.

</details>


### [982] [BOReFT: Manifold Steering of Language Models for Black-box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33722)
*Dhruv Agarwal,Rico Angell,Kavitha Srinivas,Tahira Naseem,Horst Samulowitz,Willie Neiswanger,Andrew McCallum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BOReFT learns a low-dimensional manifold of hidden-state interventions in a frozen language model using a VAE-style objective (reconstruction + KL prior + on-policy self-distillation), then applies Bayesian optimization over that compact continuous domain to solve black-box discrete search tasks. On Semantle it recovers 8/15 held-out targets (vs. ≤3/15 for LLM baselines), and on molecular property optimization (DRD2, GSK3β, JNK3) it achieves the highest score on JNK3 and GSK3β. The paper provides theory decomposing regret into a representational gap (bounded by semantic coverage + interpolation errors) and a search gap (standard stochastic-bandit observation model).


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing LLM-based black-box search methods (prompting, parameter updates) offer limited control over search-space exploration. Continuous optimizers like Bayesian optimization are principled but need a suitable continuous domain, while LLMs produce discrete stochastic outputs. The paper bridges this discrete-continuous mismatch by learning a compact, searchable continuous manifold inside the frozen LM.

Method: Two-phase method: (1) Learn a low-rank intervention manifold in a frozen LM using LoReFT-style interventions. A VAE encoder maps (target sequence, description) pairs through a frozen semantic encoder φ to diagonal Gaussian posteriors over intervention codes b∈ℝ^r. The loss combines teacher-forced reconstruction, KL regularization to a Gaussian prior, and on-policy forward-KL self-distillation from a description-conditioned teacher. The search domain B is the axis-aligned bounding box of the learned posterior means. (2) At inference, fit a GP surrogate over observed (code, score) pairs and select the next code by maximizing log expected improvement. Decode at temperature τ to obtain a discrete candidate, evaluate via external black-box objective f, and iterate. Rank r=64, intervention at the first transformer block.

Result: Semantle: BOReFT recovers 8/15 held-out targets at mean similarity 0.892 and novelty 0.691, versus ≤3/15 exact matches for all baselines (OPRO, BOPRO, MiGrATe, AutoDiscovery, SDPO-TTT, random, discrete BO). SFT alignment of baselines does not close the gap. Molecular optimization: BOReFT leads on JNK3 (mean 0.370, best 0.940) and achieves the best GSK3β score (0.670), but trails on DRD2 where it generalizes less well beyond its training distribution. Ablations show all four loss components contribute; coverage error decreases and search improves as training set grows. Theoretically, the method yields unbiased (Δf/2)-sub-Gaussian bandit observations and cumulative regret bounds control the best sequence emitted.

Conclusion: BOReFT provides a principled bridge between LLM discrete proposal spaces and continuous black-box optimization. The representational gap is bounded by semantic coverage and interpolation quality under a Lipschitz task score; the search gap admits standard bandit/BO guarantees. Limitations include coupling to training-data quality (the DRD2 shortfall), suggesting future work on continual learning to expand the manifold during search.

Abstract: Language models are increasingly used as proposal models for black-box search, from program optimization to molecular design. Existing approaches typically improve proposals through iterative prompting or parameter updates, offering limited control over how completely and efficiently the model's search space is explored. Continuous optimization methods, such as Bayesian optimization, provide a principled way to search but require a suitable domain to operate over. To address this, we introduce BOReFT, which learns a compact, low-dimensional space of hidden-state interventions in a frozen language model, and uses this space as the search domain for Bayesian optimization with an external scoring function. Empirically, we find that the learned domain spans semantic regions and exhibits smoothness properties that support search. Theoretically, we show that semantic coverage and interpolation control the best score available in the learned space, and that decoding from this space yields a standard stochastic-bandit observation model for adaptive search. We evaluate BOReFT on the interpretable word search task "Semantle" and on three more real-world discovery tasks in de novo molecule property optimization. Compared to strong LLM baselines, BOReFT finds in Semantle a higher number of hidden targets and, on two out of three molecular objectives, achieves higher property scores. Consequently, our method provides a principled new bridge between discrete proposal spaces of LLM-based search and continuous black-box optimization.

</details>


### [983] [Collaborative Synthetic Data for Privacy-Preserving Financial Fraud Detection Across Organizational Silos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33754)
*Simeon Allmendinger,Domenique Zipperling,Burhanettin Bahadir Kibar,Niklas K{ü}hl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对金融欺诈检测中数据稀缺与隐私限制的问题，提出并评估了 CollaFuse——一种基于扩散模型的协作式合成数据生成方法，发现在大多数数据集上其生成的合成数据对下游欺诈检测任务的提升效果优于传统过采样、本地生成基线和集中式扩散模型，但本地保真度并非最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融欺诈检测面临两大瓶颈：一是欺诈样本稀缺且类别极不平衡，单个机构本地数据有限；二是数据隐私和跨组织壁垒导致数据无法直接共享。虽然联邦学习允许多方协作训练，但并未解决少数类稀缺问题。现有协作生成方法多依赖联邦学习范式，给参与方带来沉重的训练负担。因此，需要一种轻量级、协作式的合成数据生成方案来提升跨组织欺诈检测能力。

Method: 研究提出 CollaFuse，一种基于扩散模型（diffusion model）的协作式合成数据生成替代方案。它不采用传统联邦学习训练范式，以降低组织侧的算力负担。研究在五个欺诈检测数据集上进行评估，将 CollaFuse 与三类基线方法进行对比：（1）经典过采样方法（如 SMOTE 等）；（2）本地生成基线；（3）集中式扩散模型基准。评估指标涵盖两个维度——合成数据的本地保真度（local fidelity）以及下游欺诈检测任务性能（downstream detection utility）。

Result: 在五个欺诈数据集上的实验结果显示：CollaFuse 在本地保真度上并非最优，落后于部分基线；但在下游欺诈检测性能上，CollaFuse 在大多数数据集上表现更稳定、更一致地优于经典过采样、本地生成基线和集中式扩散模型。这表明合成数据对下游任务的贡献并不主要来自局部统计真实性，而更多来自其捕获的、可跨组织迁移的数据结构。

Conclusion: CollaFuse 作为一种协作式扩散合成数据方案，能为跨组织金融欺诈检测提供更稳定的下游分析价值。核心结论是：合成数据的分析价值更多源于其传递的跨组织可迁移结构（transferable cross-organizational structure），而非对真实数据的局部高保真复现。这一发现为隐私受限场景下的协作机器学习提供了新思路，即应以下游任务效用而非生成保真度为主要评价标准。

Abstract: Organizations seek analytical value from AI, yet relevant data are often fragmented across organizations and constrained by privacy. This is acute in financial fraud detection, where rare fraud cases and imbalanced local datasets limit decision-relevant analytics. Federated learning enables collaboration without direct data sharing but does not resolve minority-class scarcity. Synthetic data generation can help, yet lightweight methods are interpolation-bound, while generative models require substantial data and computation. Existing collaborative generative approaches often rely on federated learning, imposing considerable organization-side training burdens. In this paper, we examine CollaFuse as a collaborative diffusion-based alternative for fraud detection and evaluate it across five fraud datasets. Compared with classical oversampling, local generative baselines, and centralized diffusion benchmarks, CollaFuse does not achieve the highest local fidelity but improves downstream fraud detection more consistently across most datasets. These findings suggest that synthetic data create analytical value less through local realism than through transferable cross-organizational structure.

</details>


### [984] [Beyond Fixed Features: Architecture-Dependent Sensitivity to Node Representations under Heterophily](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33764)
*Priyanath Maji,Sidharth Gaur,Rajavinoth Paul Durai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文对GNN架构在异质性图上的评估提出质疑：通过在Roman-Empire和Amazon-Ratings两个大规模异质性基准上交叉组合7种GNN架构与多种节点特征表示（fastText到BERT/RoBERTa/SBERT/MPNet），证明节点表示对性能的影响因架构而异，但架构的相对排名在不同表示下保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN架构对比通常使用固定的节点特征表示，未考察表示变化是否会改变关于异质性鲁棒性的结论。论文质疑"架构比较不应将节点特征视为无关的背景变量"。

Method: 采用交叉因子消融设计：(1) 两个大规模异质性基准（Roman-Empire 22,600节点、Amazon-Ratings 24,492节点），加上WebKB和引用网络作为辅助；(2) 7种GNN架构（GCN、GAT、GCN-sep、GAT-sep、GraphSAGE、H2GCN、GCNII）+ MLP控制；(3) 多种节点表示（fastText、BERT、RoBERTa、SBERT、MPNet、领域自训练Transformer）；(4) 10折交叉验证，Macro F1为主要指标；(5) Spearman/Kendall秩相关分析 + Holm校正检验架构排序稳定性；(6) 容量/结构控制实验（参数匹配）；(7) 一阶分析推导传播算子对节点表示的依赖性。

Result: Roman-Empire上，从fastText到最佳上下文表示的提升范围为2.38pp（GCN-sep）至13.67pp（GAT），H2GCN为8.77pp；Amazon-Ratings上对应范围为0.20pp（GCN-sep）至6.78pp（GAT）。架构排名跨表示高度稳定（Spearman ρ在多数对比中达到1.0000），12个名义上的排序反转经Holm校正后无一个统计显著。朴素变体对表示的敏感度均高于对应的分离变体（GAT 13.67pp vs GAT-sep 4.24pp）。自训练的"弱"自定义表示使即使最强的架构也大幅下降，表明架构无法完全补偿特征信息的不足。

Conclusion: 节点特征表示的影响因GNN架构而异，同一表示变化对不同架构产生不同幅度的性能增益。因此架构与表示不应被视为独立的评估因子。然而，在这两个基准上架构的相对排序在不同表示间保持稳定（差异性敏感度是主要效应，而非排序不稳定）。建议未来的GNN评估协议将节点表示作为显式实验因子而非固定背景条件。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) perform well on homophilic graphs but struggle in heterophilic settings, where connected nodes often carry dissimilar labels. Existing evaluations typically compare architectures under a fixed node-feature representation, leaving unclear whether conclusions about heterophily robustness remain stable as the input representation changes. We address this question by constructing parallel feature variants of two large-scale heterophilic benchmarks, Roman-Empire and Amazon-Ratings, pairing each graph with representations ranging from static fastText vectors to contextual Transformer embeddings and evaluating seven GNN architectures across these representations. We find that the effect of representation varies across architectures: on Roman-Empire, the contextual gain ranges from 2.38 percentage points for GCN-sep to 13.67 points for GAT, with H2GCN gaining 8.77 points. On Amazon-Ratings, where node text is limited to short product titles, GAT improves by 6.78 points from fastText to MPNet, while GCN-sep changes by only 0.20 points. These results show that architectural performance is conditional on node representation: the same representation change can produce different magnitudes of performance gain across architectures, so architecture and representation cannot be treated as independent evaluation factors. A rank-correlation analysis on these two benchmarks further shows that the relative ordering of architectures remains highly stable across representations, isolating differential sensitivity, rather than ranking instability, as the primary effect.

</details>


### [985] [DEALS: Decentralized Expertise-Aware Load Serving for Multi-Agent LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33768)
*Jingjuan Huang,Wenbin Wang,Yanchuan Yin,Alvaro Velasquez,Jia Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DEALS，一种面向多智能体LLM系统的去中心化负载均衡框架，通过结合局部积压差与任务成功率差实现轻量级路由决策，无需额外LLM调用或专用路由器训练，在准确率与吞吐量上均优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MAS方法要么依赖中心化控制器（可扩展性差）、固定协作模式（缺乏适应性），要么依赖去中心化动态路由但需要训练专用路由器或调用LLM进行智能体选择，计算开销大。需要一种支持并发任务处理的低复杂度去中心化自组织框架。

Method: 每个智能体维护按任务类型分类的FIFO本地队列。路由器基于路由分数 R_{i→j}(d) = B_i^d - B_j^d + V(q_j^d - q_i^d) 决策：综合考虑与邻居的积压差和Beta平滑后的任务成功率差。仅当最高分超过边际m时才转发，否则本地执行。每个智能体配备C_i个执行槽支持并发执行。执行器采用ReAct策略，支持execute（返回最终答案）和split（拆解子问题后回队列）两种动作，并可通过私有记忆检索成功轨迹作为示范。测试阶段记忆和成功率冻结，积压继续更新。

Result: 在MATH、BBH、MMLU-Pro三个基准上，DEALS在四种智能体配置中均取得最高平均准确率，并在12个评估中9个排名第一；吞吐量达到AgentNet基线的4.7×至22.7×。在异构智能体池中，引入质量权重V从0增至80使MATH准确率从44.29%提升至73.57%。消融实验证实质量信息对任务分配的重要性，并展示通过调整V可引导自组织行为（V=80时Qwen在MATH上完成99%的最终答案）。

Conclusion: DEALS通过将执行能力与任务求解能力相结合实现去中心化协调，独立任务异步执行，特别适用于异构智能体池。实验表明该框架在准确率和吞吐量上均优于SOTA基线，并为MAS自组织提供了无需中心控制器的有效方案。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) have recently emerged as an effective approach for coordinating large language model (LLM)-based agents to solve complex tasks through structured interactions. In practice, MASs often handle a stream of heterogeneous and complex tasks, requiring agents to decompose each task and then self-organize and self-evolve to adapt to incoming tasks while sharing execution resources. However, most early approaches to MASs rely on centralized controllers or fixed coordination patterns, which can limit scalability or adaptability. In contrast, existing decentralized and dynamic MASs often require training dedicated routers or invoking LLMs for agent selection, resulting in substantial computational costs and coordination overhead. To address these challenges and enable efficient task-level self-organization and self-evolution for task- and workload-level collaboration, we propose Decentralized Expertise-Aware Load Serving (DEALS), a decentralized and low-complexity framework that enables agents to self-organize and dynamically route concurrent tasks for processing. Specifically, each agent maintains local queues of incoming tasks, and its router decides whether to process a task locally or forward it to a neighbor based on differences in backlog and success rate. Meanwhile, executors process independent tasks concurrently within and across agents, and partially solved tasks can be resumed by other agents. Experiments show that DEALS not only improves performance along multiple dimensions (e.g., answer accuracy and task throughput) in both homogeneous and heterogeneous agent pools, but also balances agent expertise and workload in a self-organized manner, enabling effective decentralized coordination.

</details>


### [986] [Selecting Diverse SFT Traces Improves Post-RL Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33780)
*Dylan Zhang,Mingyuan Wu,Jinning Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了监督微调(SFT)数据中"推理路径多样性"对后续强化学习(RL)泛化能力的影响,提出了一种基于规则的轻量级指纹选择方法,在固定预算下从同一候选池中选择路径多样的验证解,可显著提升RL阶段后的问题覆盖率,包括对训练阶段未见的更困难问题的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理模型后训练流程通常先做SFT再做RLVR,但已验证的解在准备模型进入RL阶段时并非等效。SFT数据的选择——特别是推理路径的多样性——直接影响后续RL能发现哪些成功尝试,从而影响最终泛化能力。先前研究指出SFT准确率不足以预测RL准备度,作者假设练习更多样化的推理路径可使更多问题的正确答案落在采样可达范围内,为RL提供更多学习机会。

Method: 核心方法是基于规则提取推理路径的拓扑指纹(包含步骤类型序列、转换图、推理树结构、策略模式等特征),然后通过聚类+最远点采样(farthest-point)从同一候选池中选取路径多样的子集,同时用最近质心选择构建路径相似的对照组。所有比较严格匹配:学生模型初始化、SFT轨迹预算、训练配方、评估协议、检查点步骤,仅改变SFT数据中保留的解。具体包括:(1)教师数量扫描作为路径多样性的粗略代理;(2)从同一池中进行路径多样vs路径相似的直接选择实验;(3)单模型条件下(同一模型生成所有候选解)的验证;(4)在三个开源语料库上与随机选择、拓扑基线、梯度多样性、嵌入、词汇选择等基线比较。指纹计算无需模型调用、额外生成或梯度,可在CPU上对超过200万解的池运行。

Result: 在RLVE合成谜题上,路径多样SFT使OLMo3-7B在SFT未见环境上的pass@8提升16.9个百分点;多样模型解决了1133个相似模型未解决的问题(仅53个反向)。在Qwen3-1.7B和4B上均观察到一致优势,涵盖训练难度范围(1-10)和外推难度(11-15)。单模型条件下,Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507生成所有候选,从其池中选择路径多样数据使10个数学基准上pass@8均值提升3.39-6.17点。RL前诊断表明:路径多样检查点在数学提示上产生混合奖励(mixed rewards)的比例为54.7%,高于路径相似检查点的46.9%,尽管其平均准确率略低——这为组相对RL提供了更多有学习信号的提示。在OpenThoughts3、INTELLECT-3和Nemotron-Cascade 2三个开源语料库上,该CPU选择器在每次比较中均优于随机选择、拓扑基线和梯度多样性、嵌入、词汇基线,平均后RL性能相对增益1.2%-10.8%,而计算成本仅约3小时单CPU节点 vs 基线的64-232 GPU小时。

Conclusion: 已验证的解在准备RL时不可互换。推理路径多样性是选择SFT数据的实用标准——在固定演示预算下,选择推理路径多样的解可使相同RL获得更好的起点,并在训练阶段未见的更困难问题上提升覆盖率。优势在单模型条件下依然成立。基于规则、仅需文本的CPU指纹选择器成本极低,在三个发布语料库上全面优于更昂贵的基线选择方法。SFT数据选择应关注推理路径多样性,而不仅是正确性和任务覆盖率。

Abstract: Verified solutions are not equally useful for preparing reasoning models for reinforcement learning (RL). We present a comprehensive study of route diversity, the variation in the sequences of reasoning steps in supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data, and propose a lightweight, rule-based fingerprint to select for it. From one pool at one budget, with matched training recipes and checkpoints, selecting diverse rather than similar routes improves post-RL problem coverage across puzzles and mathematics, including on problems harder than those seen in either training stage. In synthetic experiments, route-diverse SFT improves OLMo3-7B's pass@8 by 16.9 points on environments held out from SFT. In a single-model condition, where one model writes every candidate, diverse selection gains up to 6.2 points of mean pass@8 across 10 mathematics benchmarks. Pre-RL diagnostics suggest why: diverse SFT can produce both successful and failed attempts on more prompts despite slightly lower mean accuracy, giving group-relative RL more prompts with a learning signal. On 3 open-source corpora, our CPU-only selector, without model calls, outperforms more expensive alternatives in every comparison of mean post-RL performance. These results identify reasoning-route diversity as a practical criterion for selecting SFT data that better prepares models for RL.

</details>


### [987] [Surprising Success, Repeated Failure: Entropy-Guided Credit Assignment for Exploration in LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33781)
*Woongyeong Yeo,Minki Kang,Chanuk Lee,Sangwoo Park,Jinheon Baek,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EAPO（Entropic Advantage Policy Optimization），一种基于熵引导的非对称信用分配方法，将策略熵与响应优势符号耦合，对成功响应中高熵决策施加更强强化，对失败响应中低熵决策施加更强惩罚，同时衰减失败响应中不确定位置的惩罚以保留探索机会。无需辅助模型、额外采样或特权信息。在数学、逻辑、算法推理任务上取得最佳综合性能，并促进更有效的探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法在结果级奖励下对响应内所有token均匀分配信用，忽略了不同决策对最终结果的差异化贡献。已有细粒度信用分配方法依赖辅助模型、额外采样或特权信息，且现有基于熵的方法在成功和失败下同等偏好高熵位置，可能在失败响应中将惩罚集中在仍具恢复潜力的不确定位置，抑制探索。

Method: 1）观察：成功下的高熵决策不易复现（surprising success），失败下的低熵决策倾向于重复失败（repeated failure），而失败响应中高熵位置仍保留恢复路径。2）EAPO将归一化策略熵与响应优势符号耦合，通过KL正则化不确定性分配重新分配token级优势：对正优势响应偏好高熵token，对负优势响应偏好低熵token，衰减负响应中高熵位置的惩罚。3）使用分位数归一化（10%-90%百分位）降低噪声敏感性，detach梯度防止信号回流。4）通过KL正则化框架和单步负更新分析提供理论解释。

Result: 在6个数学推理基准（AIME24/25/26、HMMT26、AMC23、MATH500-H）上，EAPO在4个backbone（Qwen3-4B/8B-Base、Qwen3-4B、Olmo-3-7B-Think-DPO）上均取得最佳平均avg@32和pass@32；在8个Reasoning Gym OOD任务上也达到最高宏平均。在pass@k、答案多样性、认知标记频率等探索指标上一致优于GRPO、EntropyAdv、HAPO、80/20、RLRT等基线。消融实验验证了非对称符号-熵耦合和κ=log4的默认选择。

Conclusion: 对成功和失败中不确定性的非对称处理能有效促进LLM推理中的探索。强化高熵成功决策使其更可重复，惩罚低熵失败决策纠正自信失败，同时保留不确定位置的恢复路径，为RLVR中基于内在信号的细粒度信用分配提供了实用且无需额外监督的方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models (LLMs) through outcome-level feedback, yet recent approaches to finer-grained credit assignment often require auxiliary models, additional sampling, or privileged information. Although policy entropy provides a readily available signal, prioritizing uncertain positions under both reinforcement and penalization concentrates penalties where failed responses still retain alternatives for recovery, which can suppress opportunities for exploration. To address this, we introduce Entropic Advantage Policy Optimization (EAPO), an entropy-guided credit assignment method that treats success and failure asymmetrically. Specifically, motivated by the observation that success under uncertainty is less repeatable while confident failures tend to recur, EAPO couples normalized policy entropy with the sign of the response advantage to reinforce surprising success and correct repeated failure. It assigns stronger reinforcement to high-entropy decisions in successful responses and stronger penalties to low-entropy decisions in failed responses, while attenuating penalties at uncertain positions to preserve opportunities for recovery. By redistributing the response advantage across tokens, EAPO derives token-level credit directly from existing rollout signals without additional supervision. We validate EAPO on a range of reasoning tasks across both base and reasoning backbones, demonstrating that it achieves the best overall performance. We further show that EAPO promotes more effective exploration, broadening problem coverage and generating more diverse candidate answers.

</details>


### [988] [Do We Really Need KL Divergence for On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33791)
*Wenze Lin,Jiyuan Long,Jiale Zhao,Shenzhi Wang,Xitai Jiang,Ce Luo,Rui Lan,Qianli Ma,Fukang Wen,Hui Wu,Liyuan Chen,Shuoling Liu,Jiangpeng Yan,Gao Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了"在策略蒸馏(OPD)必须使用KL散度"的传统认知，提出仅需保持更新方向（而非精确幅度）的二值奖励即可复现OPD效果，并进一步发现仅需对少量高分歧token维持正确方向即可，进而提出C-MOPD多教师蒸馏方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏自诞生以来一直以KL散度作为标准损失函数，近期兴起的在策略蒸馏(OPD)作为LLM高效后训练范式，自然继承了KL散度。然而KL散度的幅度信息是否真正必要，这一基础问题尚未被充分探讨。

Method: 1) 提出BinaryOPD：将KL散度替换为简单的二值方向奖励（教师概率高于学生则+1，否则-1），仅保留更新方向信息；2) 通过对token按对数比值ℓ_t=log(p_T/p_θ)进行分组（A:高分歧教师偏好、B:低分歧、C:高分歧学生偏好），实验验证仅高分歧token的方向至关重要；3) 提出C-MOPD：让每个样本同时接受所有教师监督，教师一致时向所有教师更新，教师冲突时若与领域教师方向不严重冲突则更新，否则奖励为0。

Result: 在5对数学学生-教师配对和2对代码配对上，BinaryOPD达到与标准OPD相当或略优的性能（如Qwen3-4B数学：65.1 vs 64.1）；仅保留不到1.5%的高分歧Group A token即可成功训练；C-MOPD(ε=0.8)在数学和代码基准上均稳定优于MOPD（如AIME24: 61.3 vs 60.0，LiveCodeBench v6: 32.9 vs 27.9）；验证器信号与OPD方向对齐与否对性能影响不大。

Conclusion: KL散度的精确幅度信息对于在策略蒸馏并非必要，仅需保证更新方向朝向教师即可；且仅需对不到2%的高分歧token维持正确方向就能实现有效训练；OPD训练状态空间存在高度冗余，使得反复的方向反馈足以替代单次的精确幅度信息；所提出的C-MOPD能有效整合多教师能力而避免领域间能力冲突。

Abstract: Since the advent of knowledge distillation, KL divergence has been the standard loss in distillation. Recently, on-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm for LLMs. As a distillation method, OPD naturally inherits KL divergence as its standard loss. However, in this work, we find that KL divergence may not be necessary for OPD. We show that simply preserving the update direction is sufficient for effective OPD. As long as the update direction is toward the teacher, OPD works. More precisely, it is not the direction of every token, but the direction of a small subset of tokens where the teacher and student disagree strongly. We first show that simply assigning a reward of (+1) to tokens where the teacher probability is higher than the student probability and (-1) where it is lower, which merely encourages updates toward the teacher, reproduces almost the same training mode as OPD with reverse KL. We further show that only the direction of a small subset of tokens with large teacher-student disagreement is critical, and training works as long as their update direction is toward the teacher, even if other tokens are pulled away from the teacher. And as an application of these findings, we introduce Consensus Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (C-MOPD) to improve Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Unlike MOPD, which routes each sample to a single teacher and may cause capability conflicts across domains, C-MOPD lets every sample be supervised by all teachers. Experiments show that C-MOPD consistently outperforms MOPD on both math and code benchmarks. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [989] [Diffusion Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33803)
*Xiangyang Wang,Bingxiang He,Zeyuan Liu,Jiaze WangZiqing Qiao,Yuxin Zuo,Huan-ang Gao,Cheng Qian,Wenbin Zhang,Ran Li,Youbang Sun,Ning Ding,Yuanchun Shi,Zhiyuan Liu,Chaojun Xiao,Chun Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出扩散奖励模型（DRM），将奖励建模重新定义为条件密度估计 p(r|x,y)，用扩散Transformer头替代传统标量奖励头，无需对输出分布作参数假设即可自然表达人类偏好的多模态结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有奖励模型（标量式、多属性式、参数化分布式）都将 p(r|x,y) 坍缩到单一标量或固定参数族分布，无法表达人类偏好的多模态、不确定性及多属性结构，导致奖励信号丢失关键信息并可能引发奖励黑客。

Method: DRM 采用冻结的 LLM 编码器提取 (x,y) 表示 h，轻量 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 以 h 为条件将高斯噪声去噪为 K 维奖励向量；统一框架支持多属性回归（掩码去噪损失）和成对偏好（Bradley-Terry 损失 + 去噪损失），推理时通过 DDIM 采样 N 次得到经验奖励分布，可聚合并分析均值、方差、分位数等。

Result: 在五个基准（RewardBench v2、PPE、RMB、RM-Bench、JudgeBench）上，DRM-8B 在匹配数据和骨干时优于 ArmoRM 和 QRM；与更大规模的判别式、分布式及生成式 RM 相比仍具竞争力；奖励分布与人类重复标注的分布高度一致，且多模态程度随人类分歧增大而增强；不确定性感知拒绝和 LCB 聚合进一步提升决策质量；作为 RLHF 训练奖励时，策略在 Arena-Hard v2 和 MT-Bench 上均优于 ArmoRM 和 FsfairX 基线。

Conclusion: DRM 证明了非参数化扩散头作为奖励建模新范式的可行性，单一架构即可处理多属性和成对偏好数据，并能通过分布统计提供超越标量的决策信号，对 RLHF 下游策略优化亦有实质增益；局限性在于训练规模仍远小于工业级 RM，且尚未在大骨干和大规模数据下充分验证扩展性。

Abstract: Reward models underpin the alignment of large language models, yet the dominant designs reduce each prompt--response pair to a point estimate or to a distribution from a fixed parametric family. This is at odds with human preference, which is inherently multimodal: the same response can be reasonably judged in many ways, and no single family covers all of them. To better fit this structure, we introduce DRM, a Diffusion Reward Model that recasts reward modeling as conditional density estimation over $p(\mathbf{r}\mid x,y)$. Conditioned on a frozen LLM encoder, a lightweight Diffusion Transformer denoises Gaussian noise into a reward vector, placing no parametric assumption on the output distribution and naturally representing its multimodal structure. A single architecture handles both multi-attribute regression and pairwise preference data, and at inference $N$ samples form an empirical reward distribution that can be aggregated into a scalar, a variance, or quantiles. Across five benchmarks, DRM matches or surpasses baselines under matched data and backbone, stays competitive with much larger discriminative, distributional, and generative RMs despite its modest training scale, and recovers multimodal reward structure where conventional heads collapse to a point. Uncertainty-aware rejection and lower-confidence-bound (LCB) aggregation further demonstrate that DRM can exploit distributional information beyond a scalar reward to improve reward-model decisions. Downstream RLHF experiments additionally show that using DRM as the training-time reward leads to improved policy performance, directly validating the practical benefit of diffusion-based reward modeling for RLHF training.

</details>


### [990] [MinkowskiPE: Minkowski Positional Encoding for Spatiotemporal Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33804)
*Yuhao Li,Louie Hong Yao,Tianyi Shi,Hanqun Cao,Hongxia Hao,Zhen Zhao,Shengchao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE)，一种基于Minkowski几何的相对位置编码方法，将时空联合坐标参数化为作用于query和key特征的Lorentz变换，使注意力分数仅依赖于相对时空位移，从而在保持标准点积注意力接口的同时引入显式的时空耦合几何偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时空建模方法存在权衡：物理驱动的动力学方法（如RNN、CNN、ODE）有较强先验但灵活性受限；学习驱动的方法（如Transformer注意力）灵活性高但时空耦合隐式。作者希望结合数据驱动的灵活性与显式的物理几何先验，联合建模时间与空间。

Method: 1) 将每个token视为时空事件，具有联合时空坐标 x=(t,r)；2) 用时空坐标通过可学习标量投影 ρ=w⊤x 参数化一维Lorentz boost变换；3) 将query和key特征分组为二维块，分别用 Lorentz(ρ) 和 η·Lorentz(ρ) 变换；4) 利用 Lorentz 群代数性质（Λ⊤η=ηΛ⁻¹）使注意力分数仅依赖相对位移 Δxij；5) 推广到多头注意力：每个二维块学习独立投影方向 w_p；6) 仅对 query-key 应用 MinkowskiPE，value 不变，可与 FlashAttention 兼容。附录A给出群论刻画：因 so(1,1) 一维，光滑同态必约化为标量投影形式。附录C证明有限维酉token-wise编码下，精确Galilean不变性会丢失相对空间分量。

Result: 1) 分子动力学：在MISATO数据集上，单轨迹设置10个蛋白-配体系统30项评估中26项进入前二，4个系统三项指标全部最优；多轨迹设置（MISATO-100/1000/Full）9项评估全部最优；2) 视频预测（KTH）：MSE降低9.9%、MAE降低5.7%、LPIPS降低1.7%，SSIM和PSNR具有竞争力，参数量仅2.5M（约基线方法的1/10）；3) 消融实验表明，去除MinkowskiPE后所有指标下降，验证了位置编码本身的有效性。

Conclusion: MinkowskiPE通过Minkowski几何为时空Transformer提供了一种轻量级、任务无关的相对位置编码机制。其核心价值在于：(1) 在不改变标准点积注意力接口的前提下引入了Lorentz几何偏置；(2) 同一公式可直接应用于不同维度（1+3D分子、1+2D视频）和不同物理尺度的任务；(3) 通过代数性质保证相对位移不变性。未来方向包括更高维Lorentz表示、伽利略对称位置编码、数据自适应几何结构，以及扩展到具身动力学、天气预报和生成模型等场景。

Abstract: Modeling spatiotemporal coupling is a key challenge in building physical intelligence across scales, from microscopic to macroscopic. Existing models capture such structure broadly through physics-motivated dynamical formulations or learning-motivated architectures. The former provide stronger priors but may constrain flexibility, whereas the latter are more flexible but leave the spatiotemporal coupling largely implicit. We therefore seek an approach that combines flexible learning with an explicit geometric bias for jointly modeling time and space. To this end, we propose Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE), which uses joint temporal and spatial coordinates to parameterize Lorentz transformations applied to query and key features. With MinkowskiPE, the query-key attention score depends on position only through the relative spacetime displacement between the two tokens and is therefore invariant to global translation of the coordinates. This paradigm retains the standard dot-product attention interface and remains compatible with efficient attention implementations. We evaluate MinkowskiPE on microscopic molecular dynamics and macroscopic video prediction tasks, achieving the best results on all nine multi-trajectory molecular evaluations and reducing KTH video-prediction MSE by 9.9% relative to the best baseline while using roughly one-tenth as many parameters.

</details>


### [991] [PI-NOMT: Physics-Informed Neural Optimal Mass Transport for Brain Fluid Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33857)
*Mehmet Emin Acar,Vahit Bugra Yesilkaynak,Helene Benveniste,Gozde Unal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PI-NOMT提出了一种物理信息神经最优质量传输框架，将脑部示踪剂传输恢复视为物理信息潜在状态推断问题，通过连续神经密度教师、可微分平流-扩散-源递归展开和非平衡最优传输正则化，从稀疏时空观测中恢复隐藏的速度场和源场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在脑部示踪剂成像中，动态增强MRI（DCE-MRI）提供时间分辨的示踪剂浓度测量，但控制示踪剂传播的底层速度和源机制不可观测。现有方法要么将速度场视为辅助变量，要么缺乏物理一致性约束，难以从稀疏观测中恢复可解释的传输机制。

Method: PI-NOMT采用两阶段框架：(1) 训练冻结的连续神经密度教师ρ_φ(x,t)，提供帧间监督和物理残差所需的导数；(2) 推断共享的连续神经速度场v_θ(x,t)和源场r_θ(x,t)，其中速度分解为幅值（softplus）和方向（归一化）分支。训练目标结合最终/中间重建损失、OMT正则化、源正则化、PDE残差和不可压缩性约束。展开通过K=10个子步的源-平流-扩散循环实现，平流采用可微分半拉格朗日回溯，扩散采用后向欧拉隐式求解（通过共轭梯度）。物理监督在近似不可压缩假设下评估PDE残差R_PDE = ∂_t ρ_φ + v_θ·∇ρ_φ - D∇²ρ_φ - ρ_φ r_θ。

Result: 合成高斯球基准测试：精确恢复预设速度场，速度EPE=0.01021，体素/数值时间单位，相对误差0.72%，角度误差0.293°，路径线EPE=0.130体素。九只对照组大鼠DCE-MRI数据：参考起始端点NMSE=0.680%±0.679%，欧拉平均速度≈0.00846 mm/min（0.141 μm/s），PDE残差MSE=0.0742，不可压缩性MSE=0.00701。消融研究表明递归展开、物理监督和幅值-方向速度参数化对稳定潜在传输恢复起互补作用。

Conclusion: PI-NOMT建立了一种物理信息潜在状态推断框架，可从时间分辨标量场观测中恢复隐藏的传输机制。合成实验证明了已知平流动力学的直接恢复，大鼠DCE-MRI实验证明了准确短间隔重建、物理学约束的潜在场和跨被试一致的传输特征。物理监督与适当的潜在场表示和递归传输公式相结合最为有效，物理方程充当约束可接受潜在传输解空间的结构先验。

Abstract: Recovering hidden transport mechanisms from sparse spatiotemporal observations is a fundamental inverse problem in scientific machine learning. In brain tracer imaging, dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI (DCE-MRI) provides time-resolved measurements of tracer concentration, while the underlying velocity and source mechanisms governing tracer propagation remain unobserved. We formulate this problem as physics-informed latent-state inference, in which the transport field itself is the primary object of inference rather than an auxiliary variable used only to reconstruct observed densities. We propose Physics-Informed Neural Optimal Mass Transport (PI-NOMT), a framework that represents density, velocity, and source as continuous neural fields and combines a continuous neural density teacher, recursive differentiable advection--diffusion--source rollout, unbalanced optimal-transport regularization, and governing-equation supervision. Physical laws act as structural priors that constrain the space of admissible transport mechanisms, while observed tracer dynamics provide evidence for estimating the latent transport state. We evaluate PI-NOMT on a synthetic benchmark with known ground-truth transport and on DCE-MRI sequences from nine control rats. On the synthetic benchmark, PI-NOMT accurately recovers the prescribed velocity field, including its magnitude, direction, and integrated trajectories, rather than merely reconstructing endpoint densities. Across the nine rat datasets, the framework yields sub-percent local endpoint error, consistent physical speed scales, and low post-training PDE and incompressibility residuals. These results support physics-informed latent-state inference as a general framework for recovering hidden transport mechanisms from observed dynamic scalar fields.

</details>


### [992] [Finite Probes Suffice: Identifiability and Universality for Weight-Space Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33901)
*Soutrik Sarangi,Yonatan Sverdlov,Adir Dayan,Haggai Maron,Nadav Dym*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论角度系统研究了基于有限探测（probe-based）方法学习神经网络函数性质（neural functionals）的可识别性与通用逼近性，并提出利用隐藏层激活的HIDDENPROBE架构，在多个基准上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的权重空间学习方法面临参数化对称性的复杂性问题，而探测方法虽在实践中表现良好，却缺乏理论支撑：尚不清楚有限探测是否足以唯一重构网络函数，也无法保证通用逼近性。此外，仅依赖最终输出可能丢失中间层的重要信息。

Method: 1) 对解析参数化族，利用有限见证定理（Finite Witness Theorem）证明2q+1个最终层探测足以唯一识别函数；2) 对MLP分析激活函数，证明d_max+1个隐藏层探测即可识别；3) 对softmax多头注意力，证明d(2H+1)+1个混合长度隐藏层探测足以识别；4) 基于分离性推出通用逼近定理；5) 提出HIDDENPROBE架构：MLP版本使用逐层Set Transformer处理隐藏激活的不变表示，Transformer版本使用共享探测库与通道轨迹编码器；6) 通过合成实验与INR分类、CNN模型zoo精度预测、Transformer精度预测等基准验证。

Result: 在INR分类（MNIST/FMNIST/CIFAR-10）上HIDDENPROBE达到0.986/0.886/0.580/0.606的最佳准确率；在5个CNN测试精度预测基准上均排名第一；Transformer精度预测在MNIST-Trans和AGNews-Trans上以Kendall's τ 0.920和0.916超越此前最佳（Transformer-NFN Quasi的0.911/0.914）；且仅用约一半的探测数即可匹配或超越ProbeGen；ReLU网络则给出了PAC风格的近似识别保证。

Conclusion: 有限探测（尤其是包含隐藏层激活的探测）在解析激活条件下足以唯一识别神经网络并支撑通用逼近；隐藏层信息相比仅用最终输出可大幅降低所需探测数量并提升实际性能；HIDDENPROBE作为简单有效的实现，在MLP与Transformer架构的多种神经函数学习任务中一致地达到最先进水平，为设计适用于更大规模模型（如语言模型或扩散核）的探测方法提供了理论与实践基础。

Abstract: Learning properties of neural networks has recently attracted growing interest, with existing approaches operating either directly on network parameters or through probe-based representations of network behavior. While probing methods have shown strong empirical performance, their theoretical foundations remain limited. In this work, we study when finite probe-based representations are sufficient for learning neural functionals. We establish general identification and universality results for probing, and show that using intermediate hidden representations can provide significantly more informative representations than relying only on final outputs. Motivated by these results, we introduce HIDDENPROBE, a simple architecture for learning from hidden probe responses. Across a range of neural functional benchmarks, including both MLPs and Transformers, HIDDENPROBE consistently improves over existing probing methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our code is publicly available on GitHub.

</details>


### [993] [JIVE: Jacobian-Informed Volume Expansion for Diverse Generative Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33906)
*Guangxun Zhang,Brian Cai,Boxuan Zhang,Chao Chen,Ruixiang Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JIVE 是一个无需训练的框架，通过在生成器端点雅可比的右奇异子空间中注入速度扰动，提升扩散/流匹配模型的样本多样性，并提供理论保证和高效计算方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散和流匹配生成模型常面临模式坍塌和样本多样性不足的问题，尤其在少步/单步生成中更为突出。现有批量互斥方法（如OSCAR）仅隐式地多样化轨迹端点，缺乏对端点多样性的显式优化。

Method: JIVE 通过分析生成器端点预测器的 Jacobian 矩阵，从其前 k 个右奇异向量张成的子空间（最大增益方向）中采样扰动，独立地为每个样本施加一次扰动。计算上避免显式构造 Jacobian，采用无矩阵迭代（幂迭代/JVP/JᵀJ），利用有限差分近似 JVP 和反向自动微分近似 Jᵀ 乘积。理论上证明了局部端点变化最大化与全局期望成对距离增长之间的联系。

Result: 在 PartiPrompts（1632 个提示）和 GenEval（553 个提示）基准上，JIVE 在 Feature Vendi、Pixel Vendi 和成对 L2 距离上一致优于 OSCAR 和未修改采样器；与 CADS 结合可进一步提升多样性。在 FLUX.1-schnell 和 SD3.5-Large-Turbo 上，单步/少步生成均有效。在 RF-Inversion 反演生成任务中亦能提升多样性而不损害质量。JᵀJ 变体优于 JVP，但计算成本更高。

Conclusion: JIVE 是一种即插即用的训练免费方法，通过利用生成器的局部几何结构（端点雅可比的右奇异子空间）显式最大化端点多样性，具有理论保证和实用效率，在文本到图像、反演生成等多种场景下均有效。

Abstract: Generative models often suffer from mode collapse and limited sample diversity. While prior works attempt to mitigate this by jointly generating a batch of samples and repelling their trajectories, these heuristics do not explicitly maximize the diversity of the resulting endpoints. We introduce JIVE, a training-free framework that enhances generative diversity by injecting velocity perturbations aligned with the leading right singular subspace of the generator's endpoint Jacobian. By leveraging this local geometric structure, JIVE provably maximizes endpoint diversity while preserving sample quality. To maintain practical efficiency, we compute these perturbation directions via matrix-free iterations rooted in classical numerical linear algebra, requiring only a small computational overhead. Across different benchmarks, JIVE boosts both pixel and feature-level diversity in few-step and one-step generation.

</details>


### [994] [Diffusion-Based Rollouts as a Stabilization Mechanism for Long-Horizon Environmental Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33930)
*Marina Vicens-Miquel,Amy McGovern,Aaron J. Hill,Efi Foufoula-Georgiou,Samuel S. P. Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究基于扩散模型的递归展开（diffusion-based rollouts）作为长期环境预报的稳定化机制。论文在低维水位时间序列和高维降水栅格场两种场景下，对比了扩散模型与确定性自回归方法的递归预报性能。研究发现扩散模型能持续抑制递归误差增长（尤其在确定性方法最不稳定的场景），但数值稳定并不等于预报保真度。当缺少外部预测信息约束时，扩散预报虽保持数值有界，但会向中心值收缩并丧失变率和事件级细节；而在持续获得HRRR数值天气预报条件约束时，扩散模型则能更好地保持空间结构和事件检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期环境预报中，递归预测（即反复将模型自身预测反馈作为输入来延长预报时效）虽能利用短期预报的高技巧，但会导致误差累积和失稳，尤其在非线性、混沌的环境系统中问题突出。现有方法多集中于架构改进和训练策略，而对递归过程中的不确定性建模关注不足。扩散模型作为强大的概率生成框架，其在递归应用中的稳定化潜力尚未被系统理解。此外，"稳定"与"保真"之间的区别常被忽视——数值稳定并不必然意味着预报具有信息量和实际价值。

Method: 论文采用对比实验设计，在两种预报场景中使用相同的预测骨干网络对比扩散模型（基于EDM框架）与确定性自回归方法的递归展开性能：(1) 低维表格数据：使用NOAA三个德州海湾潮位站（Bob Hall Pier、Rockport、Port Isabel）的6分钟分辨率水位数据，MLP架构，仅以当前和滞后风暴潮作为输入（不含风场信息以避免完美预报假设），预测12小时后的风暴潮；(2) 高维栅格数据：使用CONUS三个地区（俄克拉荷马、华盛顿特区、俄勒冈）的512×512 1km分辨率MRMS降水观测和HRRR预报，采用扩张注意力U-Net架构，预测1小时降水量残差。扩散模型训练采用混合损失函数（MSE+噪声缩放项，α=0.8）；栅格确定性模型使用基于分位数的加权MAE损失。递归展开时，水位实验逐步丢失外部气象强迫信息变为完全自回归，而降水实验持续获得推进的HRRR预报作为条件。评估指标包括MAE、分数技巧评分（FSS）和临界成功指数（CSI）。

Result: 两项实验均显示扩散模型可抑制递归误差增长，且确定性方法越不稳定的场景，扩散模型的相对改善越大。在水位实验中：Bob Hall Pier最为稳定，Port Isabel事件幅度损失较大，Rockport事件级保真度损失最严重——扩散预报虽保持数值有界但向中心值收缩，变率降低。在降水实验中：俄勒冈和华盛顿特区区域扩散模型在FSS和CSI上的改善显著大于MAE改善，表明主要优势在于保持降水空间结构和事件检测能力而非点值精度；俄克拉荷马区域改善较小但扩散仍减缓了结构退化。总体而言，扩散模型直接抑制递归不稳定性，但无法恢复缺失的预测信息；当外部预测条件在整个递归过程中持续可用时，扩散稳定化才伴随有意义的预报保真度提升。

Conclusion: 论文将扩散模型重新定位为递归预测的稳定化工具而非通用精度增强器。核心结论有三：(1) 系统评估了扩散基递归展开在多种环境预报场景中的稳定化效果；(2) 证明扩散稳定化具有场景依赖性，既取决于确定性递归退化程度，也取决于递归过程中可用的预测信息量；(3) 明确区分了"rollout稳定性"与"预报保真度"——数值稳定可在保留或丧失预测结构两种情况下出现，二者不可混同。论文强调，评估长期机器学习预报时，应将rollout稳定性和预报保真度作为互补但独立的属性分别评价。扩散模型有效应对递归不稳定性，但无法补偿模型输入中缺失的预测信息。

Abstract: Extending forecast lead times while maintaining predictive skill remains a major challenge in environmental forecasting. We investigate diffusion-based rollouts as a stabilization mechanism for recursive forecasting using low-dimensional water-level time series and high-dimensional precipitation fields. Across both modalities, diffusion suppresses recursive error growth, with the largest stabilization occurring where deterministic rollouts are most unstable. However, stabilization does not guarantee forecast fidelity. In the water-level experiments, forecasts progressively lose event-level fidelity as the rollout loses access to external predictive information, and trajectory-level comparisons show that diffusion can remain numerically stable while contracting toward central values and exhibiting reduced variability. In the precipitation experiments, which retain conditioning from numerical weather prediction throughout the rollout, diffusion better preserves spatial organization and event-detection skill. Together, these contrasting experiments indicate that diffusion can control recursive error amplification, while its practical benefit also depends on the predictive information available to constrain future evolution.

</details>


### [995] [GroupMask: Layer-Adaptive Group-wise Sparsity for Semi-Structured LLM Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33977)
*Zhengao Li,Shuoqiu Li,Xiaofang Zhang,Yukai Jin,Gokcen Kestor,Yanfu Zhang,Yiming Zeng,Bin Ren,Chuxu Zhang,Shangqian Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GroupMask 提出了一种基于组级稀疏的半结构化LLM剪枝方法，通过超网络生成层自适应组掩码，结合Gumbel-Sigmoid松弛和自蒸馏，在保持预训练权重冻结的前提下，联合学习各层的稀疏率，显著优于均匀分配和现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: N:M 半结构化稀疏在每一层强制固定的局部稀疏率，限制了该模式下的层自适应分配潜力。先前工作发现非均匀层稀疏率在N:M下效果不佳，但不确定这是半结构化剪枝的固有局限，还是N:M细粒度局部约束所致。本文旨在通过组级稀疏（保留规则结构但允许每层稀疏率自由变化）来区分这两种解释。

Method: GroupMask 将每个权重矩阵划分为规则组（如1×256），以组为单位整体保留或剪裁。核心方法包括：(1) 轻量级超网络（基于双向GRU）为所有层生成组选择器的logits；(2) 使用Gumbel-Sigmoid参数化和直通估计器（STE）将离散的二值选择器松弛为可微操作；(3) 对全局保留参数比例施加 log-ratio 稀疏预算正则化以满足目标稀疏率；(4) 通过自蒸馏（使用同一预训练模型的稠密版本作为教师，稀疏版本作为学生，最小化前向KL散度）提供训练信号。预训练权重始终冻结，仅优化超网络参数。

Result: 在 LLaMA-2-7B 上 50% 稀疏率、1×256 组结构下，自适应分配相比均匀分配将 WikiText-2 困惑度从 10.02 降至 8.30，零样本平均准确率从 0.455 提升至 0.496。GroupMask 在 LLaMA-2-7B 上取得最低 WikiText-2 困惑度（8.30），并在五个 LLaMA 和 Qwen 模型上使用 Alpaca 校准时取得最高的平均零样本准确率。在 LLaMA-2-7B 上学习到的分配中，注意力层保留 36.6% 参数，MLP 层保留 56.6%，且深层的 Q/K 组仅保留约 8%。

Conclusion: 研究证明，先前在 N:M 稀疏下层自适应分配效果不佳的观察是该模式本身所致，而非半结构化剪枝的固有局限。组级稀疏作为规则但无固定局部比例的模式，使层自适应分配重新发挥作用。GroupMask 以约 3.7 GPU 小时的计算成本实现了有竞争力的性能，但组级稀疏目前缺乏原生硬件支持，未来需要稀疏内核的端到端加速和协同设计。

Abstract: Semi-structured pruning compresses large language models (LLMs) while keeping a regular sparse structure, but the prevailing N:M pattern fixes the same local sparsity ratio in every layer. Layer-adaptive sparsity allocation improves unstructured pruning, yet it has been reported to be less effective under N:M sparsity, leaving open whether adaptive allocation is of limited value for semi-structured pruning in general or only under the fine-grained N:M pattern. We examine this question with group-level sparsity, which partitions each weight matrix into regular groups, retains or prunes each group as a whole, and allows each layer's sparsity ratio to vary under a global budget. We propose GroupMask, which generates the group selectors of all layers with a lightweight hypernetwork, relaxes them with a Gumbel-Sigmoid parameterization and a straight-through estimator, and learns them through sparsity-budget regularization and self-distillation while keeping the pretrained weights frozen. On LLaMA-2-7B at 50% sparsity with the same $1\times256$ group size, learned layer-adaptive allocation reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 10.02 to 8.30 and raises the average zero-shot accuracy from 0.455 to 0.496 relative to a uniform per-layer ratio. GroupMask obtains the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity on LLaMA-2-7B and the highest average zero-shot accuracy with Alpaca calibration among the evaluated baselines on five LLaMA and Qwen models. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [996] [When Known Physics Helps Neural PDE Models: Residual Constraints Out-Regularize Generic Priors for Nonlinear Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34012)
*Zahra Farazpay,Aniruddha Bora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了"已知物理先验"（如PDE方程残差）在神经网络PDE代理模型中的实际价值。在匹配调参预算和强基线下，发现已知方程残差在等量调参下持续优于通用正则化方法，但其优势在容量增大时仅对非线性PDE（Burgers、KdV、Allen-Cahn）保持稳健，而对线性PDE（热传导、平流-扩散）则消失甚至反转。该优势并非仅在数据稀疏时出现（推翻了预注册假设），但在网格欠分辨时反而有害。此外，跨族预训练和上下文条件化在所研究条件下均未能超过从头训练的强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络PDE代理常嵌入结构先验（如方程残差、跨族预训练），但其增益常被归因于弱基线（如无正则化或未经调优的从零训练模型）。本文旨在通过严格的对照实验，分离出"物理特定信息"与"通用正则化/训练选择"对模型预测的贡献，回答：在强基线下，已知物理结构何时真正带来非冗余增益？

Method: 采用一维Fourier神经算子(FNO)残差形式作为基础架构；在5个PDE族上对比：(1)物理残差惩罚(Crank-Nicolson格式，λ调参)；(2)同等调参预算下的通用正则化(数据仅/权重衰减/输入噪声)；进行容量扫描(宽度8-128)、观察密度扫描(ρ=0.03-1.0)、分辨率扫描、跨族迁移(预训练+微调、FiLM/注意力条件化)、相关度梯度实验；使用5种子bootstrap置信区间，并预先注册假设。

Result: 核心发现：(1)在固定宽度下，方程残差在所有观察密度(含全监督)上均优于最佳通用正则化；(2)容量扫描揭示非线性/线性分化——Burgers(3.1×)、KdV(3.5×)、Allen-Cahn(2.5×)保持稳健优势，而热传导降至1.95×(含差CI[0.76,3.03])、平流-扩散反转为0.64×(CI[0.49,0.84])；(3)预注册假设"残差优势仅在数据稀疏时被激活"被证伪；(4)在网格欠分辨下，Burgers/KdV的残差惩罚使性能降至基线的0.16-0.17倍，机制为谱截断闭合项τ_N；(5)跨族预训练在M≥2时不及从零训练，相关源产生负迁移，结构化但无关算子近似中性，无结构噪声预训练破坏性能；(6)FNO分辨率不变性成立(1D)，但局部CNN在未见几何上反超FNO约50%。

Conclusion: 已知物理对神经PDE模型的贡献并非均匀有利。方程残差在有效且非冗余时提供容量稳健的优势（仅限非线性算子），但在线性算子或非线性欠分辨条件下反而成为偏差来源。算子线性（非平滑性）是区分有效与无效的关键变量，定义非冗余内容ρ_nr=0当且仅当算子线性。跨族迁移在低源多样性下不超越强从零基线，源相关性本身不预测正迁移。结构先验需依具体泛化轴评估，不存在通用"更多结构更好"的标量规律。

Abstract: Neural PDE surrogates increasingly incorporate structural priors, yet it is often unclear whether their gains arise from physics-specific information or simply from regularization and training choices. We evaluate several such priors under a common protocol against a matched from-scratch neural operator baseline. Our central result is that a known-equation residual consistently outperforms the best generic regularizer at equal tuning budget. At fixed capacity this benefit appears across linear and nonlinear PDEs, but a capacity sweep reveals a sharp distinction: the advantage persists and grows for Burgers, KdV, and Allen-Cahn, while collapsing toward or below parity for linear heat and advection-diffusion. Thus, the durable value of the residual is specific to nonlinear operators. We further falsify a pre-registered hypothesis that the benefit is activated only by data sparsity: the residual remains advantageous even under full supervision. Its usefulness does, however, have a clear boundary. Under grid under-resolution, nonlinear coarse fields no longer satisfy the naive governing-equation residual, and enforcing it becomes actively harmful. In contrast, cross-family pretraining and in-context conditioning fail to outperform the strong from-scratch baseline in the regime studied. Together, these results identify when known physics provides non-redundant information to neural PDE models, when it does not, and when enforcing it introduces bias.

</details>


### [997] [SR4-Fit: A Unified Interpretable Rule-Based Machine Learning Framework for Informative and Trustworthy Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34019)
*Shyam Sundar Murali Krishnan,Dean Frederick Hougen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SR4-Fit（稀疏松弛正则化回归规则拟合），一种统一的可解释规则化机器学习框架，同时适用于分类与回归任务。该算法结合RuleFit的规则提取思想与SR3稀疏优化方法，通过随机森林生成、规则提取、特征构建、稀疏优化与模型剪枝五步流程，产生紧凑、稳定且可读的规则集。在美国众议院选举人口学数据及14个公开基准数据集（六分类、八回归）上的实验表明，SR4-Fit在精度、稳定性与紧凑性上均优于RuleFit与决策树等现有规则方法，同时与随机森林、XGBoost等黑箱模型的预测性能保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险应用（如选举预测、医疗）中，黑箱模型依赖事后解释，但事后解释可能与模型实际计算逻辑不一致，导致可解释性不可靠。现有规则化方法（如RuleFit、决策树）虽然透明，但在稳定性与预测精度上存在不足，使得"可解释性—预测性能"之间的权衡问题突出。本文旨在设计一种兼具内在可解释性与强预测能力的统一规则框架，打破这一权衡。

Method: SR4-Fit遵循五阶段流程：(1) 随机森林生成——分类采用一对多策略，回归直接训练单森林；(2) 规则提取——沿每棵树的根到叶路径生成if-then规则，以二值指标编码；(3) 特征构建——将原始特征与规则二值特征拼接为扩展矩阵Z=[X|R]；(4) 稀疏优化——基于SR3框架，对分类使用logistic损失、回归使用平方损失，通过交替更新β（梯度下降/闭式解）与w（软阈值化）实现稀疏性；(5) 模型剪枝——删除w_j=0的特征与规则。算法引入Rule Understandability Score (RUS)与Enhanced Interpretability Score (E-IPS)作为评估指标，采用Pareto分析与Wilcoxon符号秩检验评估性能差异。

Result: 在选举数据分类任务中，SR4-Fit在含政党比例特征的四种数据集配置下获得最高的E-IPS（0.6423–0.6728），并在移除政党比例后保持最稳定的性能轨迹。在Pareto分析中，SR4-Fit在选举分类、选举回归、公开分类与公开回归四个实验场景中均Pareto支配RuleFit与决策树（同时具备更高预测性能与更高RUS）。在14个公开基准数据集上，SR4-Fit在6个分类数据集中的3个（乳腺癌、E.coli、酵母）获得最高E-IPS，在8个回归数据集中的2个（住房、臭氧）获得最高E-IPS。Wilcoxon检验表明SR4-Fit在分类任务中相对RuleFit具有统计显著的预测优势，尤其在不含政党比例的配置下。提取的规则揭示了教育、种族构成、年龄分布等人口学变量对政党偏好的可解释交互作用。

Conclusion: SR4-Fit证明了内在可解释性与预测可靠性可以并存。通过SR3稀疏优化机制，算法在分类与回归任务中均产生紧凑、稳定且人类可读的规则集，在多个维度上Pareto优于现有规则方法，同时与黑箱模型保持竞争力。该框架为高风险决策场景提供了一种实用且透明的替代方案，尤其适用于选举预测等需要兼顾预测精度与公众问责的领域。

Abstract: In many high-stakes applications, machine learning is dominated by black-box models that require post hoc explanations to justify their predictions. These explanations are often unreliable because they do not reflect the model's actual computations, limiting accountability and trust. A natural alternative is to use models that are interpretable by design. However, existing rule-based approaches, such as RuleFit and decision trees, while transparent, often lack stability and predictive strength, reinforcing a perceived trade-off between traditional performance measures and model understandability. To address this, we propose Sparse Relaxed Regularized Regression Rule-Fit (SR4-Fit), an intrinsically interpretable algorithm for both classification and regression that produces compact and stable rule sets without sacrificing performance. Using demographic data from the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey, SR4-Fit predicts U.S. House election outcomes with high accuracy and interpretability while uncovering demographic interactions missed by black-box models. We further validate SR4-Fit across fourteen benchmark datasets (six classification and eight regression), where it outperforms existing rule-based methods, including RuleFit and decision trees in terms of accuracy, stability, and compactness while remaining competitive with black-box models in predictivity. These results demonstrate that interpretability and predictive reliability need not be mutually exclusive, offering a practical and transparent alternative for high-stakes decision-making.

</details>


### [998] [UOPD: Uncertainty-Aware Intervention for On-Policy Distillation of Multi-Turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34036)
*Wenbo Zhang,Pengcheng Xu,Weizhi Du,Jing Zhang,Hengrui Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UOPD提出了一种不确定性感知干预机制，用于多轮智能体在策略蒸馏(OPD)。核心思想是利用教师模型对学生活动的不确定性来选择干预时机，在低不确定性回合使用标准OPD损失，在高不确定性回合执行教师动作并通过SFT让学生模仿该动作，从而最小化前向KL散度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准OPD在多轮环境中存在错误累积问题：学生在关键决策步骤的失误会导致后续轨迹偏离良好状态，而标准OPD仅通过反向KL蒸馏降低错误动作的概率，但不能防止错误动作被执行。现有方法（监督重加权、回滚长度调整、教师前缀等）无法直接在错误产生的回合进行纠正。

Method: UOPD方法包含两个核心组件：(1) 干预规则——利用教师置信度（或师生置信度差距）作为不确定性分数，通过自适应阈值（基于历史不确定性的分位数）将干预率控制在预设目标值，训练过程中干预率从初始值线性衰减到最终值；(2) 干预条件蒸馏——低不确定性回合使用标准OPD（反向KL），高不确定性回合执行教师动作并通过SFT让学生模仿（等价于期望下最小化前向KL）。该方法还提供了理论分析：定理1证明在平均可恢复性假设下，选择性干预能保证回合回报提升；命题1构造了一个三动作例子，证明在某些决策步骤，模仿教师的SFT更新能提升回报，而反向KL更新会降低回报。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和多跳搜索任务上的实验表明，UOPD全面优于OPD及其他基线（TCOD-F2B、TCOD-B2F、FTB-OPD）。具体结果：在WebShop上将1.5B学生的得分从66.3提升至76.8（相对提升15.8%），并将平均交互回合数从7.9降至6.8；ALFWorld上3B学生的seen/unseen成功率分别为90.0%/88.8%；多跳搜索四个数据集上提升2.67-8.00个百分点。消融实验验证了不确定性选择信号、教师执行、SFT损失和干预调度表各组件的必要性，训练时间仅比OPD增加11.5%-14.7%，远低于FTB-OPD。

Conclusion: UOPD通过教师不确定性指导多轮智能体在策略蒸馏中的干预时机和学习目标选择，选择性纠正同时提供改进的执行轨迹和有效的模仿学习目标，显著提升任务性能和交互效率。理论分析揭示了干预的双重作用（执行改进和模仿目标），未来可扩展至更长视野的任务和自适应干预预算。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts using dense supervision from a teacher. In multi-turn environments, a mistake at a critical decision step can redirect the subsequent rollout toward poor outcomes. We use low teacher confidence on student actions to select high-uncertainty steps for correction. In a controlled ALFWorld study, a single teacher correction at a low-confidence step improves subsequent student behavior and task success, motivating selective intervention during distillation. We propose UOPD, an uncertainty-aware intervention method for on-policy distillation. At low-uncertainty turns, UOPD executes student actions and applies the standard OPD loss. At high-uncertainty turns, it samples and executes teacher actions and trains the student to imitate them through supervised fine-tuning, which minimizes forward Kullback-Leibler divergence in expectation. UOPD utilizes adaptive uncertainty thresholds to target a scheduled intervention rate. Empirically, we evaluate UOPD across a broad range of agentic tasks, including ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search, demonstrating its superior performance over OPD methods and their variants. UOPD improves WebShop score by up to $15.8\%$ relative to standard OPD.

</details>


### [999] [Do World Models Learn Global Understanding?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34058)
*Alexander Detkov,Matt Thomson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"理解"应被定义为学习约束并传播其全局推论，通过构建受控的幺半群世界来测试模型能否从局部观察推断全局结构。核心发现是：传统下一状态训练（next-state training）虽能拟合数据但无法传播非平凡约束，而组合训练（compositional training，即隐藏中间状态迫使模型内部组合动作）在Transformer/循环/状态空间架构上对逆、交换、复合约束达到96%准确率，在视觉世界模型（+42%交换约束）和Wikidata微调LLM（+73%复合传播）中同样有效。但传播深度有限，证明深度d=2时准确率从d=1的95%骤降至49%，呈现几何衰减（率0.4±0.1），不过增加组合路径长度T可加深传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI系统表现出"脆弱且碎片化"的行为——LLM能解释概念却不能应用，能在一个上下文遵循安全指令而在另一上下文却不能。这种将局部信息提升为全局理解的普遍失败促使作者寻求对"理解"的形式化研究。他们希望揭示：当模型只见过局部观察时，能否学习隐藏的全局约束并传播其推论。

Method: 1. 构造幺半群世界（monoid worlds）：状态集合+动作转移+全局约束（如逆、交换、复合、周期性），95%转移作为训练，5%语义蕴含的转移作为测试。2. 比较两种训练目标：下一状态训练（显示中间状态）与组合训练（隐藏中间状态迫使内部组合），控制变量下唯一区别。3. 定义证明深度d：推理隐藏转移所需的最少推理轮数。4. 跨架构测试（Transformer/LSTM/GRU/状态空间），跨领域测试（受控世界→AI2-THOR视觉环境→Wikidata知识图谱LLM微调）。5. 引入分支因子β研究逆vs对偶约束的传播差异。

Result: 核心结果：(1) 下一状态训练跨所有架构在非平凡约束上失败（呈"复制失败模式"，64%错误为复制其他动作的目标），缩放模型/世界/算力均无帮助。(2) 组合训练在T=2时对逆、交换、复合约束达平均96%准确率，复制100%；视觉世界模型提升+42%（交换），LLM复合传播+73%。(3) 周期性和对偶约束即使组合训练也失败。(4) 泛化随证明深度几何衰减（率0.4±0.1）：T=2时d=1为95%，d=2为49%，d=3为15%，d≥5随机水平。(5) 增加T=4使d=2达95%，并使深深度衰减变为平台状。(6) 训练动力学表明模型内部呈"约束级联"，按证明深度顺序依次习得，d=n+1的训练步数约为d=n的2.1倍。(7) 分支极敏感：β=0.1时逆约束传播从99%降至63%，β≥0.75降至≤3%。

Conclusion: 全局理解取决于训练目标如何要求局部观察的整合，而非架构或任务领域本身。组合训练通过隐藏中间状态迫使信息整合，是促进约束传播的关键设计选择。但即便组合训练，深传播仍然有限，呈现几何衰减，揭示模型可能执行一种缓慢且不精确的内部"约束级联"。增加组合路径长度T可拓展传播范围。结论认为：要实现真正的全局理解，训练方法必须鼓励模型整合局部观察并深度传播其推论。

Abstract: AI systems often feel brittle and fragmented. A large language model (LLM) may correctly explain a concept but fail to apply it, or follow safety instructions in one context but not another. This behavior suggests a general failure to lift local information to a global understanding. To gain fundamental insight, we frame "understanding" as learning constraints and propagating their consequences. We construct learning tasks on monoid worlds, sets of states connected by action transitions, where observed training transitions and an unseen constraint jointly determine held-out transitions. Measuring generalization tests whether models can learn global constraints from local transitions and propagate their consequences. We consider inverse, commutativity, composition, and periodicity constraints relevant to spatial and semantic structure. Across attention, recurrent, and state-space architectures, next-state training fits the data but fails to propagate non-trivial constraints. Compositional training, which uses identical paths but hides intermediate states from the input, achieves 96% accuracy on inverse, commutativity, and composition constraints across architectures, yields corresponding improvements in geometric generalization of world models trained on embodied environments and relational generalization in Wikidata-finetuned LLMs. How far do models propagate constraints when inferring an unseen fact may depend on first inferring others? We define proof depth d of a held-out transition, measuring the minimum number of inference rounds to infer the transition, and find that model generalization decreases sharply with proof depth. Increasing compositional path length T improves generalization. These results provide a formal way to investigate global understanding in language and world models and demonstrate that compositional training promotes information propagation and integration.

</details>


### [1000] [Learning Perturbation Robust Policies for LLM Agents with Stable Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34064)
*Pengxin Wang,Yuanzhe LI,Yuxin Ren,Huanrui Yang,Jingdi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习训练的长时域LLM智能体在策略扰动下的鲁棒性问题,提出SPrPO方法,通过在FFN通道中施加自适应、敏感度感知的高斯扰动,在保持训练稳定性的同时提升智能体在多种部署扰动下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL训练的LLM智能体在实际部署中常因剪枝、量化、噪声等扰动而性能急剧下降(如图1所示,WebShop上仅剪枝20% FFN通道即可使性能近乎崩溃),而现有针对LLM的鲁棒性方法通常针对单一扰动类型,缺乏对一般扰动族的通用鲁棒性研究,且长时域任务中微小策略偏差会通过序列交互累积放大。

Method: 1) 定义概率扰动鲁棒策略与TRPO单调改进理论的扰动扩展(定理1),给出保证扰动下稳定单调策略改进的充分条件;2) 在高斯扰动设定下推导出基于通道敏感度的稳定条件(推论1),表明应在敏感维度施加较小扰动方差;3) 提出SPrPO算法,对FFN中间通道施加乘性高斯扰动,标准差按 σ∝ m̂·Ŝ^(-α/2) 自适应分配,其中 m̂ 为PPO梯度范数(代理改进量),Ŝ 为通道敏感度;4) 证明满足稳定条件的策略更新序列的极限点是概率扰动鲁棒的(定理2)。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上,SPrPO在干净条件下及多种扰动(高斯噪声、Dropout、结构化/非结构化剪枝、量化)下均优于Vanilla、各项同性Gaussian和SAM基线。例如WebShop干净成功率60.00% vs Vanilla 57.00%;ALFWorld在r=0.70非结构化剪枝下58.03% vs Vanilla 41.12%。消融实验验证了敏感度自适应(α=1)和梯度范数调度的重要性,且奖励曲面可视化表明SPrPO具有更平坦的损失景观。

Conclusion: SPrPO通过理论驱动的自适应扰动分配,有效提升了RL训练LLM智能体对多样化部署扰动的鲁棒性,同时保持了稳定的训练过程;基于Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct+GiGPO的实验表明该方法在干净性能和扰动鲁棒性上均取得最优权衡,且训练开销可控(约1.7-1.8倍于Vanilla)。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective post-training paradigm for long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents. However, we find that the resulting policies can be sensitive to various policy perturbations, such as hidden-state noise, pruning, and quantization. In this work, we study how to improve perturbation robustness during policy optimization. We first introduce the notion of a perturbation robust policy and analyze conditions under which perturbed policy updates preserve stable monotonic improvement. Based on this analysis, we introduce Stable Perturbation-Robust Policy Optimization (SPrPO), which applies adaptive and sensitivity-aware perturbations during RL training. We evaluate SPrPO on ALFWorld and WebShop and conduct systematic experiments across multiple perturbation types and scales, showing improved perturbation robustness while maintaining stable policy optimization.

</details>


### [1001] [FLARE: Flow Matching with Local Axis-Angle Representations for Stochastic Micromagnetic Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34070)
*Pengyu Li,Renjie Tong,Xuanlue Jiang,Jianmin Li,Yuanyuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FLARE是一个基于流匹配的条件生成框架，通过锚点相对的局部轴角旋转表示，直接生成有限温度微磁演化的全场随机终点，避免了逐步LLG积分。在分布保真度上达到SOTA，并在5-ns双段协议上比MuMax³获得3,062倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程微磁模拟计算昂贵，传统和学习求解器通常逐步传播LLG动力学；现有学习方法多为确定性预测或保留逐步积分，全场、直接时域、随机终点预测在微磁学中基本未被探索。

Method: 将有限时间磁化转变表示为相对于当前锚点磁化的局部轴角旋转场（尊重S²几何并通过Rodrigues解码保持单位范数），在旋转空间中进行条件流匹配（CFM），并显式以物理预测时长Δt为条件；用U-Net+自注意参数化速度场，采用Heun-10采样，可递归组合多段控制。

Result: 在33个保留完整路径条件下：Distribution Score 0.762（最佳基线DPOT-Ti为0.707），角能量距离15.30°（比最强基线低29.9%），公平能量分数0.393（比NeuralMAG-x5低37.3%）；单GPU上5-ns两段协议比MuMax³快448×（B=1）至3,062×（最佳批量）；对未见电流掩模族和未见温度（90K、225K）泛化稳定；消融证实旋转坐标+流匹配+时长条件均必要。

Conclusion: 锚点相对旋转坐标是建模有限温度微磁动力学条件未来态分布的有效方式；FLARE在分布保真度上明显优于确定性基线和逐步学习方法，同时提供巨大计算加速；局限在于：多段组合在预测状态交接下存在累积误差，目前限于2D薄膜、固定材料参数和有限时域，扩展到3D、更广材料和更大规模数据是未来方向。

Abstract: Long-horizon micromagnetic simulation remains expensive because conventional and learned solvers typically propagate Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (LLG) dynamics step by step. Existing learned approaches generally retain stepwise integration or model deterministic evolution, leaving full-field, direct-horizon stochastic prediction largely unexplored. We propose FLARE, a flow-matching framework that recasts stochastic finite-time magnetization prediction as conditional transport over anchor-relative local axis-angle rotations. This rotation-space formulation respects the intrinsic geometry of magnetization dynamics and preserves pointwise unit norm by construction. By explicitly conditioning on the physical prediction horizon, FLARE directly generates full-field stochastic endpoints across multiple target times without stepwise integration. Against the strongest single-checkpoint external baseline on each metric, FLARE achieves 29.9% lower angular energy distance ($15.30^\circ$), and a 37.3% lower fair energy score (0.393). On a representative composed 5-ns two-segment protocol, FLARE achieves a $3{,}062\times$ best-batch speedup over the widely used GPU micromagnetic solver MuMax$^3$ on a single GPU.

</details>


### [1002] [MaskCoFT: Masked Co-Adaptive Fine-Tuning for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34077)
*Junfeng Wu,Zehao Fan,Hadjer Benmeziane,Kaoutar El Maghraoui,Liu Liu,Yinan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MaskCoFT是一种针对内存受限MoE推理的微调方法，通过可学习的二进制路由掩码将每层token集中在部分专家上，并联合微调路由器和专家（LoRA），在推理时将掩码作为软先验重排专家。在Mixtral-8x7B和DeepSeek-V2-Lite上显著减少专家加载次数并降低延迟，同时保持平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型参数量庞大（路由专家占参数96.6%/91.7%），超过单卡GPU显存，需将专家卸载到主机内存。但解码时专家加载占PCIe延迟的86%，缓存/预取受路由模式限制。现有ReMoE只微调路由器、专家冻结，无法适应新路由分配的token。

Method: 两阶段微调：Stage 1为每层学习一个可学习的实值掩码，通过softmax转为采样分布π，多项式采样E'=rE个专家形成浓度集，二值掩码将Top-K路由限制在该集合内，用直通估计器（STE）更新掩码梯度，累积T步后更新；Stage 2固定浓度集，联合微调路由器和专家LoRA适配器，使其适应被重定向的token。推理时用学习到的分布π作为软先验，对p进行加权重排（p⊙π），所有专家仍可选。训练仅用交叉熵损失，无需负载均衡或局部性正则项。

Result: 在Mixtral-8x7B（缓存4专家/层）和DeepSeek-V2-Lite（缓存12专家/层）上：LFU策略下每token专家加载次数分别减少23.7%和10.1%；三种策略（LRU/LFU/FIFO）和所有缓存预算下均有效；MoE-Offloading系统中TPOT分别降低16.4%和5.5%；九个基准平均准确率高于基线0.92和0.53个百分点。粗粒度Mixtral比细粒度DeepSeek获益更大，LFU策略下增益最大。

Conclusion: MaskCoFT通过掩码约束+路由器/专家联合微调，将token激活集中到共享的浓度集上，有效减少内存受限MoE推理中的专家迁移次数和延迟，同时维持模型质量。该方法与缓存策略正交互补，无需辅助损失超参，适用于不同专家粒度的MoE架构。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models often exceed the memory of a single GPU. Expert offloading keeps most experts in host memory and loads them on demand, so decoding speed depends on how many experts each token must fetch. Caching and prefetching reduce this cost only as far as the routing allows. Router-only fine-tuning can reshape the routing to reuse experts, but it keeps the experts frozen, so they cannot adapt to the tokens the new routing sends them. We propose MaskCoFT, a masked co-adaptive fine-tuning method that trains routers and experts together with the cross-entropy loss alone. During fine-tuning, a learnable binary mask restricts the Top-K routing of each layer to a subset of experts, and the experts adapt to the tokens redirected to them. At inference, the learned mask becomes a soft prior that re-ranks experts, so every expert remains selectable. We simulate a GPU cache of 4 experts per layer for Mixtral-8x7B and 12 for DeepSeek-V2-Lite. MaskCoFT cuts expert fetches per token by 23.7% and 10.1% relative to the base model. In real offloading system serving, it lowers the time per output token by up to 16.4% and 5.5%, respectively. Its average accuracy over nine benchmarks stays above the base model by 0.92 and 0.53 points.

</details>


### [1003] [TRACE: Expert-Aligned ECG Representation Learning with Rigorous Benchmarking and Real-World Validation in Acute Cardiac Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34088)
*Lovely Yeswanth Panchumarthi,Andrew Lu,Saurabh Kataria,Delgersuren Bold,Minxiao Wang,Runze Yan,Patricia Dykes,Brian J. Gow,Tom J. Pollard,Jessica K. Zègre-Hemsey,Dillon J. Dzikowicz,Lekshmi Kumar,Xiao Hu,Ran Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TRACE是一种多模态心电图(ECG)表征模型，通过结合单模态和跨模态学习，并利用LLM从心脏病学家报告中提取高保真临床发现，解决了CLIP风格训练在临床文本噪声处理上的不足。该模型在公开基准测试和真实急性冠脉闭塞(ACO)数据集上均表现出色，显著优于临床实践。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CLIP风格的多模态ECG训练存在两个主要局限：1)难以处理临床文本中的噪声；2)未能充分利用ECG单模态学习与ECG-报告跨模态学习的互补优势。此外，临床中现有的ST段抬高标准对急性冠脉闭塞(ACO)的漏诊率高达25-34%，亟需更精准的检测工具。

Method: 1. 提出混合架构，联合学习单模态(ECG信号)和跨模态(ECG与心脏病学家报告)表征；2. 采用基于不确定性加权的多任务学习策略平衡不同任务；3. 设计基于LLM的流水线，从心脏病学家报告中提取高保真临床发现作为文本监督信号。

Result: 1. 在公开基准测试(心律失常分类和结构性异常检测)上，性能优于现有单模态和跨模态ECG模型；2. 在大型私有ACO数据集(带专家标注)上，相比临床实际应用：灵敏度提升19.0%，或在临床基线下假阳性率降低62.6%。

Conclusion: TRACE在标准基准任务上表现出色，并在最紧急、高风险的心脏病临床场景(ACO检测)中具有切实的临床价值，证明结合LLM增强的文本监督与混合单模态/跨模态学习是构建临床可用ECG表征模型的有效路径。

Abstract: TRACE (Text-Reinforced Analysis of Cardio ECGs) is a multimodal electrocardiogram (ECG) representation model that learns clinically grounded signal embeddings for downstream cardiac classification. It is designed to address the limitations of existing CLIP-style training, which often struggles with noisy clinical text and fails to leverage the complementary strengths of unimodal (from ECG) and cross-modal (between ECG and matched cardiologist reports) learning. To bridge this gap, we propose a hybrid architecture that jointly learns unimodal and cross-modal representations via uncertainty-weighted multi-task learning while utilizing an LLM-based pipeline to extract high-fidelity findings from cardiologist reports. We evaluate TRACE across a spectrum of clinical urgency, establishing robust performance on public benchmarks for arrhythmia classification and structural abnormalities relative to existing unimodal and multimodal ECG models. To demonstrate real-world utility, we further validate the model on acute coronary occlusion (ACO), where the prevailing ST-elevation criteria miss 25-34% of true occlusions. Utilizing a large private ACO dataset with expert-annotated ground truth, TRACE significantly outperforms real-world clinical practice, yielding a 19.0% increase in sensitivity or a 62.6% reduction in false positive rates at the clinical baseline. This extensive evaluation confirms that TRACE delivers both strong performance on benchmark tasks and tangible clinical impact in the most acute, high-risk cardiac scenarios.

</details>


### [1004] [SlimWise: Decoupling Expert Pruning Across Prefill and Decode for Efficient MoE Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34117)
*Gunho Park,Kyoungho Jeun,Juntaek Oh,Byeongjun Shin,Baeseong Park,Minsoo Rhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SlimWise是一个面向MoE模型的推理服务框架，其核心思想是解耦Prefill和Decode阶段的专家集分配：Prefill使用完整专家池以保证计算质量，Decode使用剪枝后的专家池以减少权重流量并提升吞吐量，并通过直接复用Prefill生成的KV Cache实现两阶段的衔接，无需转换。配合一种低成本蒸馏阶段（仅更新共享专家、路由器和归一化层等少量参数），在50%专家剪枝下可实现最高1.81×的Decode吞吐加速，且精度损失极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然MoE模型每token仅激活少量专家，但批处理Decode阶段会逐步访问接近全部专家池，导致专家权重访存成为主要瓶颈。传统专家剪枝同时作用于Prefill与Decode，但Prefill本身是计算密集型，剪枝对吞吐帮助小却损害模型质量。作者观察到剪枝还会引发生成长度畸变（某些任务过度简短或冗长），且这些畸变难以仅通过benchmark分数发现。
