Method: 1) 相位感知专家分配：Prefill保留全部m个专家，Decode仅使用通过重要性准则（如Routing Mass、EAN、REAP）筛选的m'个专家。剪枝保持注意力结构和KV Cache格式不变，因此完整模型的KV Cache可被剪枝后的Decode直接复用，无需转换。2) 通过路由器掩码（mask）实现PD-分离（Disaggregated）和PD-共置（Colocated）两种部署模式：共置模式下用大负值τ屏蔽被剪专家，使top-k仅在保留集中选择。3) 低成本蒸馏：从完整模型采样一个随机分点s，教师（完整模型）处理前缀[0,s)生成KV Cache，学生（剪枝Decode）从该Cache继续。损失为α·L_CE + (1-α)·L_KD（α=0.1），KD使用top-K=64的KL散度加残差桶。仅更新共享专家（第二副本SE2初始化为零，作为可加修正）、归一化层和路由器（约0.42%–2.12%参数），路由器学习率设为其他参数的1/10。SE1与SE2最终合并导出为单checkpoint，不增加额外推理操作。

Result: 在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B和Gemma 4-26B-A4B-it上，使用三种剪枝准则（Mass、EAN、REAP）评测5个基准（GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval+、MBPP+、BFCLv4）。关键结果：① 无需训练的KV Cache交接即在多数设置下显著缩小精度差距；② 50%剪枝下精度与全模型相近，Decode吞吐提升1.40–1.81×（PD-Disaggregated），75%剪枝下达1.65–2.39×；③ 蒸馏后精度进一步提升并显著缓解生成长度畸变（例如MATH-500在75%剪枝下p90从32.8k降至14.0k tokens）；④ 揭示了benchmark精度可掩盖生成行为扭曲（如HumanEval+生成被过早截短，MATH-500推理链过长触及token预算）；⑤ PD-Colocated部署下SlimWise吞吐加速为1.36–2.28×，但路由器掩码增加约0.5 ms/步。

Conclusion: SlimWise通过将专家剪枝限制在Decode阶段并复用完整模型的KV Cache，有效缓解了MoE推理中专家权重流量瓶颈，同时恢复了大量因剪枝造成的精度损失；其低成本蒸馏阶段进一步缩小精度与生成长度差距。在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上以50%专家剪枝实现最高1.81× Decode加速。局限在于：Prefill成本不变，端到端加速取决于Decode所占时间比例；PD-Colocated模式仍保留完整专家池，未减小权重内存占用。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate few experts per token, yet batched decoding can access nearly the entire expert pool, making expert-weight traffic a major bottleneck. Expert pruning reduces this traffic, but conventional approaches also prune compute-bound prefill, sacrificing model quality for little throughput benefit. We present SlimWise, a serving framework that tailors the expert pool to each inference phase. SlimWise performs prefill with the full model and decode with a pruned model that directly reuses the prefill-generated KV cache without conversion. Across two MoE backbones and three pruning criteria, this training-free KV cache handoff substantially narrows accuracy gaps relative to the full model in many settings. We also show that benchmark accuracy can conceal substantial pruning-induced changes in generation length. To address these distortions and residual accuracy loss, SlimWise introduces a low-cost distillation stage that trains the decoder to continue from full-model KV caches while updating only a small subset of parameters. Implemented in vLLM, SlimWise supports both prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation and PD-colocated serving. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, SlimWise improves decode throughput by up to 1.81x at 50% expert pruning with minimal accuracy loss.

</details>


### [1005] [Probabilistic electrical power demand forecasting with uncertainty quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34120)
*Mahesh Neupane,Pragya Dhungana,Pradip Khatri,Swechhya Baskota,Hariom Dhungana*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对四种概率性电力需求预测模型（贝叶斯线性回归、MC Dropout、高斯过程回归、NGBoost）在摩洛哥Tetouan市三个配电网区域的真实数据上进行了系统性的实证比较，得出NGBoost在所有区域中均表现最优的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着可再生能源渗透率的提高和智能电网复杂性的增加，电力系统中的不确定性和波动性显著增强。传统确定性预测方法仅提供单点估计，无法量化预测中的不确定性，难以满足现代电网风险感知决策的需求。因此，需要采用概率性预测方法对不确定性进行显式量化，以支持可靠的电网规划与运行。

Method: 研究选取了四种互补的概率性预测框架：(1) 参数化的贝叶斯线性回归（BLR），通过高斯先验和贝叶斯定理获得闭式后验；(2) 近似贝叶斯深度学习方法MC Dropout，在推理时保留Dropout层并进行多次随机前向传播以近似贝叶斯推断；(3) 非参数核方法高斯过程回归（GPR），定义高斯过程先验并通过核函数度量输入相似性；(4) 分布提升方法NGBoost，通过自然梯度迭代学习完整预测分布的参数。实验使用摩洛哥Tetouan市三个配电区2017年全年10分钟分辨率的SCADA数据（52,416条记录），经重采样为小时粒度后按时间顺序以80%/20%划分训练集与测试集，并融合时间特征与气象变量（温度、湿度、风速、散射辐射通量）。评估采用七项指标：MAE、RMSE、NLL、CRPS、Pinball Loss、PICP和MPIW（95%预测区间）。此外还使用XGBoost的SHAP特征重要性分析以及KDE分布对比进行辅助可视化分析。

Result: 在三个配电区域中，NGBoost均取得了最低的MAE（Zone 1: 1682.57, Zone 2: 1400.45, Zone 3: 1265.71）和RMSE（Zone 1: 2241.14, Zone 2: 1799.98, Zone 3: 1760.22），同时在NLL、CRPS和Pinball Loss上表现最优，PICP达到0.95–0.96且MPIW最窄，呈现良好校准的预测区间。BLR和MC Dropout表现中等，BLR训练速度最快（0.01–0.05秒），MC Dropout略优。GPR表现最差，MAE和RMSE高出约一个数量级，PICP≈0，表明其不确定性估计严重失校，主要受限于核方法对非平稳高维数据的适应性差以及O(n³)计算复杂度。SHAP分析显示"小时"特征为最重要的预测变量。KDE可视化进一步验证NGBoost对真实数据双峰分布的捕获能力最强。

Conclusion: 研究表明，概率性预测方法相比传统确定性方法能提供更丰富、更有信息量的预测结果。在所比较的四种模型中，NGBoost凭借对非线性关系和异方差不确定性（heteroscedasticity）的有效捕捉，成为电力需求概率预测中最准确且可靠的框架。BLR适合小数据场景，MC Dropout提供实用的不确定性估计，GPR虽然原则上能处理复杂非线性但因计算成本过高不适合大规模部署。未来工作将引入异方差神经网络和贝叶斯深度学习方法，在统一评估框架下系统研究预测精度、不确定性质量与计算效率之间的权衡，以推动概率性预测在实际电网中的落地应用。

Abstract: The majority of research on electricity consumption forecasting has focused on deterministic approaches, which generate a single point estimate for each time step in the forecasting horizon. However, the increasing penetration of renewable energy sources and the growing complexity of modern smart grids have introduced greater variability and uncertainty into power-system demand and operation. Consequently, probabilistic forecasting, which quantifies the uncertainty and variability associated with future electricity demand, is becoming increasingly important for reliable power-system planning and operation. This study presents an empirical comparison of four contemporary probabilistic forecasting models for electricity consumption, highlighting their respective strengths and limitations. We have performed comparision on real-world power systems related datasets. Across all power-consumption zones, NGBoost demonstrates superior probabilistic forecasting performance, achieving the lowest MAE and RMSE while providing well-calibrated uncertainty estimates with high prediction-interval coverage and reasonably narrow intervals. These results indicate that NGBoost offers a more accurate and reliable forecasting framework than Bayesian, Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout, and Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) models for the considered electricity consumption data.

</details>


### [1006] [WorldGraph: Graph-Native World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34159)
*Zezhong Ding,Yipeng Li,Xike Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出图原生世界建模（Graph World Modeling, GWM）新范式，将演化图本身视为世界动力学；构建了 GWM-Zero 基准（8 个时序图数据集，节点/边/图三级转换任务），并提出 WorldGraph 框架，融合状态感知图Transformer与转换感知 GRPO，在三类任务上一致优于图表示、时序图学习、图预训练和图世界模型基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型多以图像等非结构化观测为输入，虽然部分工作引入图作为辅助结构，但并未将演化图本身作为建模对象；而现实环境中大量关系型数据天然以演化图形式存在（实体、关系与属性随时间变化），需要一种图原生（graph-native）的世界建模方法，显式建模图演化背后的潜在世界状态并预测异质图转换。

Method: 1) 问题形式化：将 GWM 分解为状态模型 f_s 与转换模型 f_Δ，潜状态 s_t = f_s(g_t, Δg_{t-1}, s_{t-1})，转换预测 Δg_t = f_Δ(g_t, Δg_{t-1}, s_t)；转换在节点级、边级、图级三个粒度上实例化。
2) WorldGraph 框架：
- 状态感知图 Transformer：第一阶段多粒度图编码器（hop 消息传递 + 随机游走路径采样 + 注意力融合）捕获多尺度结构；第二阶段历史感知状态编码器（时间距离嵌入 + 转换类型嵌入 + 历史记忆多头注意力 + 与最近转换相似性偏置 Π）整合历史转换。
- 转换感知 GRPO：① 动态分组采样，按历史频率的稀有度权重分配 rollout 预算；② 结构感知可验证奖励，结合节点度重要性 ℐ_s 与历史变化频率重要性 ℐ_v，定义粒度加权的 precision/recall/F1 式奖励 R_structure，并联合属性变化奖励 R_property 得到统一奖励 R。
3) 理论分析：定理 1 证明多视图状态感知 Transformer 相比 SGFormer 对理想潜状态的偏差上界更小；定理 2 证明动态分组策略相比标准 GRPO 具有更小的有效方差比（EVR）。

Result: 在 GWM-Zero（8 个时序图数据集：TGBN-Trade/Genre/Reddit、UN Vote、Contact、SocialEvo、Flights、Enron）上对比 11 个基线（GCN、GAT、GraphSAGE、SGFormer、NodeFormer、GraphGPS、TGN、TIDFormer、Graph-JEPA、MDGFM、L³P/C-SWM/GWM-E）。WorldGraph 在节点、边、图三级转换任务上均取得 SOTA：节点级 TGBN-Trade 删除 F1 提升 50.66%，边级 Macro-F1 平均提升 13.72%，图级 MAE/RMSE 平均降低 0.0757/0.1376；整体平均模型质量提升 10.77%。作为插件集成到 L³P、C-SWM、GWM-E 中亦带来稳定增益；消融实验验证多粒度编码器、历史感知编码器、动态分组、奖励设计均不可或缺；超参敏感性低；多步预测与图像到图的 rollout 实验亦证实泛化能力。

Conclusion: WorldGraph 首次系统性地定义了图原生世界建模任务，给出了包含潜在状态与异质图转换的形式化框架，并通过状态感知图 Transformer 与转换感知 GRPO 在多粒度图转换预测上取得一致最优，验证了图演化本身可作为世界动力学的可行性；为关系型环境的结构化世界建模与多模态图世界模型扩展奠定了基础。

Abstract: World models infer latent states of an environment to capture its underlying dynamics and predict future evolution. Many real-world environments, however, are inherently relational and observed as evolving graphs, where entities, relations, and their properties change over time. Prior graph-related world models use graph structures to organize internal states or support task-specific reasoning, rather than treating an evolving graph itself as the modeled world. We instead study graph world modeling (GWM), where graph evolution itself constitutes the world dynamics. We formulate graph world modeling over observed graph evolution, latent graph states, and heterogeneous graph-transition predictions. Based on this formulation, we construct GWM-Zero, a benchmark covering node-, edge-, and graph-level transitions over eight temporal graph datasets. We propose WorldGraph, which combines a state-aware graph transformer for multi-granularity structural and transition-conditioned evolution modeling with transition-aware GRPO using dynamic grouping and structure-aware verifiable rewards. Extensive experiments on GWM-Zero show that WorldGraph consistently outperforms representative graph representation, temporal graph learning, graph pretraining, and graph world-model baselines across all three transition granularities.

</details>


### [1007] [GradLev: Token-Parallel Test-Time Training Via Costate Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34174)
*Bo Liu,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GradLev 提出一种基于"成本状态预测"的并行测试时训练(TTT)框架:通过辅助因果网络 Q 预测每个 token 的输出梯度(costate),再结合关联前缀扫描(associative prefix scan)以完全并行的方式完成前向评估、反向传播和权重更新,从而在保留逐 token 在线学习能力的同时实现序列级并行训练。理论证明当一致性损失为零时,并行训练轨迹与串行在线学习者精确等价。在 300M 语言模型(仅适配最终 MLP)上的实验显示其优于静态 Transformer 与四块 Chunk-TTT,但提升幅度有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时训练(TTT)允许模型在推理时通过每个 token 后的梯度更新来改进预测,但其严格串行依赖(权重依赖于前一位置的梯度)阻碍了 Transformer 式并行训练。现有方法要么将更新粗粒度化为多 token 块(牺牲即时响应性),要么仅限于线性注意力/SSM 等简单关联递归。挑战在于:在保留逐 token、全前向+反向+权重更新的同时,实现序列级并行训练。

Method: GradLev 基于"提升式优化"(lifted optimization)框架: (1) 辅助因果网络 Q 作为预填充器,以并行方式预测所有 token 的 costate(输出层损失的梯度); (2) 给定预测的 costate 与输入,在线梯度下降解耦为仿射矩阵递归,可由 exclusive prefix scan 并行计算适配后的权重 Δ̂_t 和前向输出 ŷ_t;(3) 反向阶段通过 P 模型沿扫描权重回溯,生成"基础真值"costate 目标 g̃_t;(4) 联合优化交叉熵损失与一致性损失 ‖ĝ − sg(g̃)‖² 训练 Q。关键观察是:已知 costate 时,在线梯度下降对前向 W_t x_t 和反向 W_t⊤ g_t 都支持精确并行扫描。Q 在部署时被丢弃,P 改用逐 token 真实梯度进行原生更新。定理 1 证明该构造与串行在线学习者在精确算术下完全一致。

Result: 合成 MLP 实验(给定精确 costate):FP64 下前向输出、隐藏 costate 和第一层矩阵梯度的最大绝对误差分别为 1.18×10⁻¹⁶、2.22×10⁻¹⁶、6.66×10⁻¹⁶,与串行 TTT 仅相差舍入精度,验证了扫描构造的数值等价性(用慢权重转置替代时误差升至 0.376/0.626)。300M 语言模型实验(21 层 Transformer,仅适配最终 MLP,29.47B 训练 token):GradLev 验证 NLL=2.5707,优于 Chunk-TTT(2.5726)与 Static(2.5733);FineWeb-Edu BPB=0.7517 同样最低;LAMBADA 词困惑度 23.56 显著低于 24.54/24.66;八任务零样本平均准确率 50.99% vs 50.81%/50.77%。从第 65,536 步起 GradLev 持续领先。但 95% 配对置信区间包含零,作者承认增益幅度有限,仅适配最后一层 MLP 限制了表达能力。

Conclusion: GradLev 成功实现了 token 级 TTT 的完全并行训练,这是测试时训练领域长期未解的开放问题。其核心贡献是:(1) 揭示 costate 已知时梯度下降支持精确并行扫描这一结构;(2) 提出通过因果辅助网络预测 costate 并以一致性损失监督的训练机制;(3) 证明并行轨迹可精确恢复串行在线学习者。然而当前实验仅在 300M 规模、单一 MLP 层适配下进行,提升幅度温和,附录 D 还指出小的一致性残差在大放大系数 κ 下可能产生大轨迹误差,提示方法对预测误差可能敏感。未来工作需扩展至更大模型、更深适配、更广任务,并探索 Q 与 P 间参数共享以降低开销。

Abstract: Test-time training (TTT) allows a model to improve its predictions at inference time by updating weights after every observed token. However, sequential gra- dient writes make parallel training difficult. We observe that, given layer inputs and activation gradients (costates), online gradient descent admits exact parallel scans for both forward evaluation and reverse backpropagation. GradLev lever- ages this duality: a causal auxiliary network predicts costates across all tokens in parallel; associative scans compute the adapted weights and forward activations and propagate gradients backward; and the resulting gradient targets supervise the predictor via a consistency loss. Exact consistency guarantees exact recovery of the sequential online learner. At deployment, the auxiliary predictor is discarded, and the model updates natively via token-by-token forward and backward passes.

</details>


### [1008] [EntroPack: Fast and Accurate Entropy-Coded Weight Compression at Arbitrary Bitrates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34185)
*Hong Zhang,Zhongjie Duan,Yingda Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EntroPack是一种无需激活校准或微调的权重压缩方法，通过行归一化E8格量化与坐标条件概率模型相结合，支持任意目标比特率，并通过分块rANS编码实现GPU上的高效符号解码与权重重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定宽度格式（INT8、FP8、4-bit等）提供的存储选择粒度较粗，难以适配部署内存预算中位于两个固定格式之间的需求。熵编码虽支持更精细的码率，但实现面临两个挑战：(1) 如何在不反复全流编码的前提下将目标码率转化为量化分辨率；(2) 如何在推理时高效完成符号解码与权重数值重建以控制延迟开销。

Method: 核心方法包含四个关键组件：1) 行归一化E8格量化：将权重按行RMS归一化，按8维分块映射到E8格点上，并采用可逆整数域表示 (c, z1,...,z7, m)，其中m通过对第八坐标施加奇偶约束获得；2) 余集条件概率模型：用17个类别分布（1个余集+8个坐标各2个）刻画两个余集间坐标分布的差异；3) 基于采样存储估计的几何尺度选择：从采样行的字段计数估计C_CE，再结合格式开销得到存储字节数，通过几何二分搜索定位匹配目标码率的量化尺度s，避免重复全流编码；4) 分块rANS编码与GPU融合解码：将字段划分为独立可解码的tile（每tile含32个交错rANS状态，对应一个GPU warp），解码时符号恢复、格点重建与行重缩放在GPU上融合执行，无中间符号张量或重建码本。附加组件包括行尺度重拟合（最小二乘）与按行率失真优化（RDO）。

Result: 在Z-Image-Turbo图像生成模型上，EntroPack以4 bpp目标实现4.02 bpp存储与7.18%相对L2权重误差，优于NF4（4.50 bpp/9.41%），并以7.7%去噪步时间开销压缩仅3.5秒。在Qwen3.8-27B语言模型上，以4.03 bpp实现WikiText-2困惑度5.98→6.06，转换5.8秒（vs HRTN 109.1秒/ HyperQuant 149.6秒），prefill接近BF16参考。MiniMax-H3音视频生成验证了方法的扩展性。消融实验显示余集条件化在2 bpp节省0.05 bpp，奇偶约简跨目标节省0.10-0.13 bpp。重建开销随输入token数增大从132%（256 token）降至2.6%（16,384 token）。

Conclusion: EntroPack成功实现了校准无关、支持任意目标比特率且具备高效GPU重建的权重压缩。其核心技术——行归一化E8格量化、余集条件概率模型、采样驱动的尺度选择与分块rANS融合解码——在不依赖激活校准或微调的前提下，以更少存储实现比固定宽度格式更低的权重误差，并以显著更短的编码时间优于同类熵编码方法（HRTN、HyperQuant）。该方法将存储码率与数值精度解耦，可压缩FP8/INT8权重以支持低精度矩阵乘，在扩散去噪与Transformer prefill等计算密集型负载中仅引入温和推理开销。局限性：转换开销高于单次量化，推理时解码需物化稠密权重张量，小负载下摊销不充分；目前仅适用于静态权重，无法直接处理激活与KV cache等动态张量。

Abstract: Weight compression helps large neural networks fit deployment memory budgets, but common fixed-width formats offer only coarse storage choices. Entropy coding supports finer rates, yet the achieved size depends on the quantized weight distribution and coding overhead. Exploiting this flexibility requires accurate rate selection and efficient weight reconstruction for inference. We present EntroPack, an entropy-coded weight compressor that supports arbitrary target bitrates without activation calibration or fine-tuning. It combines row-normalized $E_8$ lattice quantization with a conditional probability model of lattice coordinates. Sampled storage estimates select the quantization resolution without repeated full-stream encoding. The final coordinates are entropy-coded in independently decodable tiles, enabling fast, fused symbol decoding and numerical weight reconstruction on the GPU. EntroPack supports floating-point and integer weight containers, such as BF16, FP16, FP8, and INT8, with storage bitrate controlled independently of numerical precision. Online decoding adds latency that grows with weight count, making the method well suited to compute-intensive workloads such as diffusion denoising and Transformer prefill. Experiments demonstrate fast encoding and modest inference overhead in these settings. When compressing the linear-layer weights of the image generator Z-Image-Turbo, EntroPack achieves substantially lower weight and denoiser output errors than fixed-width formats at comparable storage rates, with modest denoising-step overhead. Targeting 4 bits per parameter, it achieves lower weight and denoiser output errors than NF4, including about 24% lower relative $L_2$ weight error, with less storage. Source code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1009] [Direct Self-Evolving Optimization: Evolving LLMs without Challenger Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34279)
*Yuyang Deng,Yu Wang,Jiayun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DEO（Direct Self-Evolving Optimization），一种无需训练挑战者的自进化LLM方法，通过求解器引导的任务采样与LLM驱动的Metropolis选择来近似KL正则化挑战者分布，仅训练求解器。理论上证明能学习分布鲁棒的推理能力，实验上以R-Zero一半的训练时间达到竞争性推理性能，并支持API-only生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化方法（R-Zero、AZR、Agent0）需额外训练挑战者模型，增加优化开销和参数负担。但任务最终被求解器消费而非挑战器参数本身，因此核心问题是：能否在不显式训练挑战者的情况下，直接生成位于当前求解器能力前沿的任务？

Method: DEO将KL正则化挑战者目标视为对基础任务分布的指数倾斜分布（由Gibbs恒等式得出闭式解），冻结的LLM生成初始任务池并提出变异，求解器评分，通过近似Metropolis选择规则（基于奖励差的exp(Δ/β)接受率）将任务池推向挑战者目标分布。仅求解器通过GRPO训练，生成器全程冻结，因此可使用闭源API模型。理论分析证明理想化变体在KL邻域内具有最坏情况不确定性界和分布鲁棒答案准确性界。

Result: 在三个基座模型（OctoThinker-3B、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B）上的数学推理任务中，DEO在迭代三次后AVG7准确率分别达到28.30%、47.57%、53.60%，超越R-Zero的25.94%、45.93%、52.88%，且训练墙钟时间减少52%-61%。在8B模型上AVG3迁移性能达35.04%，优于R-Zero的34.30%。将本地生成器替换为Claude Haiku 4.5后，AVG7进一步提升至49.60%，HARD5从32.96提升至35.77。DEO的"在带"任务比例（68.95%）显著高于无游走基线（50.72%）。

Conclusion: DEO证明：(1)挑战者参数更新并非自进化训练的必要条件，求解器引导的任务采样即可实现竞争性能；(2)KL正则化挑战者目标定义了有意义的采样目标，LLM变异加Metropolis选择是有效的近似方法；(3)由于生成器仅需推理访问，闭源模型可作为任务生成器；(4)理论保证为分布鲁棒推理能力学习提供了形式化理解。但理论与实现存在差距：理论假设精确采样于倾斜分布，而实际使用有限步LLM游走，存在近似误差。

Abstract: Self-evolving language models improve by generating tasks and learning from their own feedback, but adapting the task generator often requires a separate challenger-training loop. Can we generate tasks adapted to the current solver without explicitly training a challenger? We introduce \textbf{D}irect Self-\textbf{E}volving \textbf{O}ptimization (DEO), which replaces challenger parameter updates with solver-guided task sampling. The KL-regularized challenger objective defines an exponential tilt of a fixed base task distribution. DEO uses this distribution as a sampling target: a frozen LLM generates and mutates tasks, the solver scores them, and an approximate Metropolis selection rule refines the training pool. Only the solver is trained. Theoretically, for an idealized variant that samples exactly from the tilted distribution, and under regularity, local gradient-dominance, and initialization conditions, we show that DEO learns distributionally robust reasoning ability. In experiments, DEO achieves reasoning performance competitive with R-Zero while using over $50\%$ less wall-clock training time, and improves reasoning accuracy over a no-walk ablation. Replacing the task generator with a frozen API-only LLM further improves the local solver, illustrating a capability enabled by removing challenger training.

</details>


### [1010] [One Sequence, Many Decodings: CAGenMol-2 Recasts Drug Design as Masked Molecular Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34301)
*Yanting Li,Enyan Dai,Lei Wang,Wen-Cai Ye,Li Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAGenMol-2 是一个统一的掩码扩散分子语言模型，将分子、连续标量属性和3D蛋白质口袋嵌入单一SAFE序列中，通过不同掩码模式实现属性预测、属性/口袋条件生成及局部优化等多种任务，无需任务特定架构。提出的AdaFO（自适应片段优化）将掩码重构转化为无梯度局部搜索，在CrossDocked2020上将成功率从30.2%提升至70.8%，刷新该协议最佳记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物设计涉及属性评估、条件生成、基于结构的设计和局部优化等多种能力，但现有机器学习方法通常为每个任务训练独立模型，导致工作流碎片化、表示不兼容。需要一个统一模型将这些操作直接组合在同一分子表示中。

Method: 1) 包裹式SAFE序列接口：将分子（SAFE token）、连续标量属性（Fourier特征编码）、蛋白质口袋（冻结DrugCLIP编码器+4 token交叉注意力瓶颈）映射到同一序列；2) 双向Transformer作为共享骨干；3) 掩码一致预训练：双非对称掩码机制（预测模式15%、生成模式85%）联合训练；4) AdaFO：基于MMR多样性的进化掩码-重构循环，外部奖励函数结合Vina对接、QED和SA；5) AdaFO-S：使用模型自身置信度和对比token显著性进行方向性编辑。

Result: 1) 从头生成：保持GenMol的质量-多样性前沿；2) 条件生成：ID命中率0.89，OOD命中率0.72；3) 原生属性预测：宏平均R²=0.910，Pearson=0.974，优于Morgan/GIN/ChemBERTa参考方法；4) MoleculeNet迁移：BBBP/Tox21/HIV上表现最佳；5) SBDD：CrossDocked2020上成功率30.2%→70.8%（最佳），同时保持药物样性和多样性；6) 方向性编辑：单一显著性引导编辑成功率为随机片段的2倍（76.3% vs 41.1%）；7) CRBN/VHL案例：生成化学多样化的候选分子，经MD和MM-GBSA验证。

Conclusion: CAGenMol-2通过将任务视为掩码属性而非架构差异，实现了单一预训练检查点支持多种药物设计功能。掩码扩散机制自然支持局部重构，AdaFO将其转化为无梯度局部优化器。该统一框架连接了分子生成、评估和修改，支持本地编辑和设计-筛选工作流。未来工作将改进数值外推、不确定性校准和实验导向的设计目标。

Abstract: Drug design couples property evaluation, conditional generation, structure-based design, and local optimization, yet machine learning systems typically address these capabilities with separate task-specific models. We introduce CAGenMol-2, a masked diffusion molecular language model that represents molecules, continuous scalar properties, and 3D protein pockets within a single wrapped sequence. Within this pretrained interface, downstream operations are selected by which sequence regions are observed or masked at inference, allowing one checkpoint to perform property prediction, property- and pocket-conditioned generation, and partial-constraint design without task-specific architectures or backbone fine-tuning. We further propose Adaptive Fragment Optimization (AdaFO), a gradient-free mask-and-refill search that turns the masked decoder into an iterative local molecular optimizer. On CrossDocked2020, AdaFO increases Success Rate from 30.2\% to 70.8\%, the best reported under this protocol, while largely preserving drug-likeness and diversity. Finally, scaffold-preserving directional editing and CRBN/VHL case studies demonstrate its use in compound design workflows spanning local molecular editing, structure-based prioritization, and downstream simulation-based screening.

</details>


### [1011] [Learning to Steer, Steering to See: Unveiling the Geometry of RLVR in Large Language Models via Trainable Vectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34344)
*Yuchen Cai,Ding Cao,Qixiang Yin,Xin Xu,Kai Yang,Siye Wu,Pengyuan Wang,Jiaxuan Wang,Weijie Liu,Saiyong Yang,Guangzhong Sun,Guiquan Liu,Junfeng Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型RLVR后训练中激活空间的几何结构，发现存在一个与RL增益相关的低维有效流形。提出两个几何性质（有效流形容量和控制流形分离），并据此设计了一个即插即用的稳定化框架Alpha-Stabler。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL后训练虽显著提升LLM推理能力，但高维参数更新使训练动态难以分析，限制了对其机制的理解及训练稳定性控制。

Method: 使用向量引导作为分析工具，冻结基座模型并在激活空间施加低维干预；通过单向量/多向量顺序正交引导、KL局部二次近似、主子空间投影等手段刻画RL诱导的几何结构；基于此设计Alpha-Stabler（Predictor+Controller），在反向传播中去除激活梯度的主成分分量。

Result: 实验涵盖5个LLM和6个验证奖励任务。结果表明：单一输入不变向量即可恢复RL增益的85%以上；有效控制方向集中在激活主子空间的低方差补空间内；跨任务几何对齐与能力迁移强相关（R²=0.91）；Alpha-Stabler可稳定训练2000步并持续提升RL增益，几乎不增加计算开销。

Conclusion: RLVR诱导的激活变化可被描述为激活主子空间低方差补空间中的低维流形；该几何视角将RLVR从黑箱参数优化转化为可解释的几何过程，为更鲁棒的后训练提供了理论基础与实用工具。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key paradigm for enhancing the reasoning of large language models, yet the high dimensionality of parameter updates makes its training dynamics hard to analyze. We study reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and use vector steering to identify a low-dimensional effective manifold in activation space associated with RL-induced gains. We uncover two geometric properties. (1) Effective Manifold Capacity: the capacity needed to reproduce RL gains can be very small but is not infinitely compressible; at extremely low capacity, intervention dimensionality and input-dependent expressiveness become key constraints, and this requirement varies with injection depth. (2) Control Manifold Separation: effective control directions lie mainly in the low-variance complement of the activation principal subspace. Within a task and base model, the learned geometry stays largely consistent across training configurations, and across tasks geometric alignment correlates with capability transfer. Experiments on 5 LLMs and 6 verifiable-reward tasks support these findings. We then propose Alpha-Stabler, a plug-and-play framework with a Predictor that monitors principal-subspace intrusion for early collapse warnings, and a Controller that removes the principal-subspace component of activation gradients during backpropagation while preserving the orthogonal complement. Alpha-Stabler stabilizes training for 2,000 steps and consistently improves RL gains, offering practical insights for robust post-training. Code: this https URL

</details>


### [1012] [Commutator Memory: Sparse, Path-Local Reading and Steering in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34348)
*John Sweeney*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"交换子记忆"(commutator memory)，一种基于李括号分解的语言模型训练路径记忆分析方法。通过将两个训练源交替更新的权重差分解为词汇表级别的稀疏标记分数，实现了对训练顺序的预测、因果干预和端点排序识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM后训练中多数据源顺序的组合效应只能通过整体基准测试差异来观察，无法定位顺序依赖残差在输出空间中的具体位置。这使得从业者无法在运行前预测哪些评估切片和输出标记会携带反称残差，也无法进行有针对性的干预。

Method: 核心方法是将交换两个梯度源A和B产生的权重差分解为李括号形式：θ_AB - θ_BA = η²b_AB，其中b_AB = H_B g_A - H_A g_B是梯度场的李括号。通过logit空间的Jacobian将该括号投影到词汇表级别，得到每token的τ_k分数，其总和等于括号对排序差距的预测值。三个测试维度：局部化（tokens）、因果效应（干预）和成对端点可读性。

Result: 在四个LLM上验证：(1) 局部化：bracket导出的token支持具有稀疏性和对特定性，top-20 token重叠率82-99% vs 随机方向35-49%；(2) 因果性：在Qwen-3-4B SFT中，对10个最大τ_k token降权使排序差距中位数缩减32%，频率匹配的零分控制几乎无效；(3) 端点可识别：通过反称统计量Δs在k=1 SGD下以91.7%准确率（chance 50%）识别训练顺序。DPO匹配批次修正中位数闭包，GRPO-style冻结rollout检查也验证了该结构。

Conclusion: 交换子记忆将两个训练更新的非交换性转化为四个可测量的对象：标量顺序预测、稀疏token报告、路径局部参数方向和成对端点统计量。该框架是pair-conditioned的测量而非部署工具，不声称逐项检索或长期记忆；其轨迹在持续训练下衰减。在BCH局部学习率窗口内可在运行前估计反称残差的token级支持。

Abstract: Gradient updates on different data generally do not commute: training a language model on two data sources in opposite orders gives different weights, even with the same data and total exposure. Loss or benchmark deltas show that the models differ, not where. We ask whether this path dependence leaves a parametric training-history memory: a weight component that flips sign when the two sources are swapped, is localized in output space, changes the held-out loss gap between the two orders under targeted interventions, and reveals which trained model came from which order. For one small SGD step of size $\eta$ on each of sources $A$ and $B$, the weight difference $\theta_{AB}-\theta_{BA}$ is, to leading order, $\eta^2 b_{AB}$, where $b_{AB}=H_Bg_A-H_Ag_B$ is the Lie bracket of the two gradient fields at the base model. We define commutator memory by projecting the bracket through the logits into one score per vocabulary token; the scores sum to the bracket's prediction of the gap. The scores are localized: on three models, the same readout of the measured $\theta_{AB}-\theta_{BA}$, or of a bracket from disjoint batches, shares 82-99% of the original top-20 tokens, versus 35-49% for norm-matched random directions. They are causally actionable: in Qwen-3-4B SFT, downweighting the ten tokens with the largest predicted share of the gap closes a median 32% of the measured gap, while frequency-matched tokens with near-zero scores have almost no effect. The weights themselves carry the component: projecting the difference between the two trained models onto $b_{AB}$ identifies which came from which order in 92% of cases across four LLMs (chance 50%). Controlled tests also cover matched-batch DPO, a frozen-rollout GRPO-style objective, and an AdamW endpoint check. The memory is defined per source pair, not per example, and its projection on $b_{AB}$ decays with further training.

</details>


### [1013] [ABC-Align: Prediction-Powered Alignment with Adaptive Bias Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34374)
*Eric Frankel,Banghua Zhu,Sewoong Oh,Lillian J. Ratliff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了ABC-Align，一种面向大语言模型（LLM）后训练的对齐方法。它通过引入两参数梯度估计器（ABC-SSL），自适应地控制"偏差-方差"权衡，从而突破了现有半监督方法（如PP-SSL）所固有的Θ(1/n)方差下界。该方法在RLHF奖励模型训练、DPO策略对齐及GRPO在线强化学习三个LLM对齐任务中均验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM后训练依赖大量人类偏好标注数据，但此类数据成本高昂、难以规模化。利用教师模型生成的伪标签虽然丰富，但存在系统性偏差。现有预测驱动推断（PPI）类半监督方法通过单参数校正保持梯度无偏，但在人类标注稀缺时面临Θ(1/n)的方差下界，无法通过增加伪标签数量来降低方差。

Method: 1. 提出ABC-SSL框架：采用两参数(a_t, b_t)的梯度估计器，其中a_t控制偏差（可在[0,1]内调整）、b_t控制零均值修正项的方差缩减。2. 推导oracle最优参数闭合形式，证明其在校师（bias小）时趋近伪标签主导的Θ(1/N)扩展，在差师（bias大）时恢复PP-SSL。3. 设计"修正范数代理"ℓ_t作为MSE忠实替代，通过投影AdaGrad在线调节(a_t, b_t)，获得O(√T)遗憾界。4. 在RM/DPO任务中使用该在线控制器，在on-policy GRPO中使用分批插件式估计。5. 提出双时间尺度扩展算法以渐近消除残余偏差。

Result: 1. 合成偏好实验：当教师较准确时，ABC-Align几乎匹配伪标签性能，在困难样本上显著优于基线。2. 奖励模型训练（Llama-3.2-3B）：在最困难设置（ρ=0.20，标签比例0.01）下达到0.77的成对准确率，PP-SSL为0.70，仅用标签为0.64；OOD基准RewardBench和PPE上均领先。3. DPO对齐（Llama-3.2-3B全参数微调）：标签比例0.05-0.30下均优于基线，5%标签即可匹配基线30%标签的效果。4. GRPO（GSM8K数学）：标签比例0.05-0.30下均最优，标签比例0.05时达0.721 pass@1，0.30时达0.752。

Conclusion: ABC-Align通过放松无偏约束、引入可控偏差作为代价换取方差缩减，突破了现有半监督对齐方法的Θ(1/n)方差下界。理论分析证明在oracle意义下严格优于最优静态PP-SSL，实验验证在RM、DPO和GRPO三个LLM对齐任务上均达到当前最优。这是首个将预测驱动方法规模化应用于LLM后训练的工作。

Abstract: Language model post-training is often bottlenecked by the need for human-collected preference data, which is expensive and difficult to scale. Reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) style approaches that leverage pseudo labels offer an abundant alternative but introduce systematic biases that degrade downstream alignment. Recent general-purpose semi-supervised methods correct for teacher bias using a small set of human-labeled examples, but suffer from high variance especially when human annotations are scarce. To this end, we propose ABC-Align, leveraging abundant pseudo label signal to minimize variance and applying a lightweight, adaptive correction grounded in the human-labeled subset. The correction strength is tuned automatically during training using plug-in estimates of the relevant bias--variance quantities. On LLM alignment with RLHF, DPO, and GRPO where human feedback is scarce, we empirically demonstrate that ABC-Align achieves superior performance over prior semi-supervised baselines in a series of experiments on an increasing scale. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1014] [LRC-JEPA: Disentangling Dynamics and Residual Context for Efficient World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34375)
*Luzhe Huang,Lei Chu,Jingyi Liang,Yuhuan Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LRC-JEPA提出了一种轻量级的端到端世界模型，通过将信息路由到紧凑预测潜变量z和残差上下文嵌入u的两种功能分工表示，有效解决了紧凑JEPA世界模型中控制相关动力学与视觉上下文纠缠导致的容量分配问题。该方法在多个仿真环境和真实机器人数据集上以仅5.5M参数的编码器超越了参数量大得多的预训练模型，同时实现了显著更快的规划速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑的JEPA世界模型在低维潜在空间中同时编码动作条件动力学和可预测的视觉上下文，这导致可控状态与高秩干扰性外观信息纠缠，随着场景复杂性增加而损害规划性能。现有单潜在表示方法无法保证最小性，SIGReg正则化虽然能防止坍缩并使特征去相关，但无法阻止控制无关的干扰信息占据潜在空间。该研究旨在通过功能化信息路由解决这一容量-紧凑性权衡问题。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 共享视觉编码器（ViT-Tiny）从每帧图像提取特征，预测潜变量z通过类令牌的两层投影头获得；(2) 学习查询的残差上下文u通过Q个可学习查询对ViT令牌集进行交叉注意力池化得到；(3) 动作条件潜变量预测器（6层因果Transformer配合AdaLN-Zero）对z进行动作条件前向传播。训练目标包括潜变量预测损失L_pred、SIGReg正则化L_SIG、时序VICReg风格的上下文正则化L_u（促进u在轨迹内稳定）和补丁重建损失L_rec。理论分析基于Achille-Soatto最优表示理论框架，证明LRC-JEPA的全局最小化解满足充分性、最小性、干扰不变性和坐标解耦四个性质。残差连接设计确保z保留z和u各自独立编码时无法重建的补充动态信息。

Result: 在四个仿真控制环境（Push-T、Reacher、TwoRoom、Cube）上，LRC-JEPA比参数匹配的LWM基线平均规划成功率提高9个百分点，在运动密集型任务上达到最高成功率。在真实世界Bridge-v2离线数据集上，LRC-JEPA以5.5M参数主动编码器在recall@1/5/10指标（0.38/0.64/0.72）上超越V-JEPA2-GAP-AC（303.9M参数）和DINO-WM（22.1M参数），规划时间仅需0.45秒。物理状态探针表明z更好地预测关节位置、速度、末端执行器和物体位置等运动学量，而u更好地预测缓慢变化的偏航角等上下文信息。重建干预实验证实u在轨迹内洗牌几乎不影响重建质量（PSNR 29.26 vs 29.58），而z的洗牌显著降低重建质量（PSNR 17.38）。消融研究表明阻断重建梯度使Bridge-v2的recall@1从0.38降至0.10，验证了残差连接的重要性。

Conclusion: LRC-JEPA通过将动作条件动力学路由到预测状态z、持续视觉上下文路由到仅用于重建的嵌入u，有效解决了紧凑JEPA世界模型中的容量分配问题。理论、探针和重建干预均支持预期的功能分离。该方法在效率上比DINO-WM快120倍，同时在真实世界数据集上控制性能提升38%（以专家动作排名百分位衡量）。主要局限包括假设干扰因素在训练范围内近似稳定、解码器和上下文正则器增加训练时计算、真实世界评估采用离线动作恢复而非闭环执行。

Abstract: Compact JEPA world models enable efficient latent-space planning, but low-dimensional representation trained under reward-free self-supervision must encode both action-conditioned dynamics and predictable visual context. This competition can entangle controllable state with high-rank nuisance appearance and degrade planning as scenes become more complex. We introduce LRC-JEPA, a lightweight end-to-end world model that routes information into a compact predictive latent $\mathbf{z}$ and learned-query residual-context embeddings $\mathbf{u}$. Only $\mathbf{z}$ is propagated by the dynamics model and used for planning, while $\mathbf{u}$ captures temporally persistent information for cross-attention reconstruction; a differentiable residual connection encourages the latent to retain complementary dynamic content. Under explicit assumptions, we show that the resulting representation is sufficient, minimal, nuisance-invariant, and disentangled. Across four simulated control environments, LRC-JEPA improves average planning success over a parameter-matched JEPA baseline by 9 percentage points and matches or exceeds substantially larger pretrained models. On the real-world Bridge-v2 set, its 5.5M-parameter active encoder outperforms DINO-WM (22.1M) and V-JEPA2 (303.9M) encoders while also enabling faster planning. Physical-state probes, reconstruction interventions, and ablations confirm the effectiveness of LRC-JEPA's representation disentanglement.

</details>


### [1015] [MASCIT: A Mask-Aware State Space Classifier for Naturally Irregular Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34409)
*Yoo-Min Jung,Hyeon-Gi Kim,Jonghun Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MASCIT——首个基于Mamba的、面向自然不规则时间序列分类的掩码感知选择性状态空间模型，通过掩码编码器和掩码池化处理缺失值/异步/变长/非均匀采样，并在34个数据集上取得最佳聚合性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然不规则时间序列（医疗、可穿戴、移动等）存在异步观测、缺失值、变长、非均匀采样等问题；密集适配器可能丢失时序结构，而现有方法（BRITS/GRU-D/NCDE/Raindrop等）或依赖插补、双向编码，或未充分利用选择性SSM的输入依赖机制。需要一种无需显式物理时间建模、且能直接处理致密化不规则序列的高效分类骨干。

Method: 将六个重叠不规则性指标（US/PO/VL/UL/SH/RS）形式化为二值观测掩码M；输入投影拼接[X‖M]送入单层部分选择性Mamba（d_model=128, d_state=16），三种SSM参数Δ/B/C各自独立选择时不变(TI)或时变(TV)；通过valid-step掩码m_t在多头门控时序池化中排除填充位置，采用最大头分数+softmax的聚合方式输出分类logits。

Result: 在PYRREGULAR全部34个数据集上，平均F1=69.2%、平均秩3.118（13项第一），显著优于12个基线（除ROCKET外p<0.05），且是唯一覆盖全部数据集的神经方法；在6个不规则性子集上均保持最低点秩；消融证实掩码编码+掩码池化联合最优；功能方差分析显示d_model(41.1%)和Δ的选择性(22.8%)为主导变化源，部分选择性优于全选择性。

Conclusion: MASCIT证实浅层选择性SSM配合掩码感知接口可作为致密化自然不规则时间序列分类的有效且可执行骨干，无需显式物理时间建模；部分选择性（特别是TI-Δ在多数情况下更优）优于对所有SSM因子施加输入依赖。

Abstract: Naturally irregular time series combine asynchronous observations, missing values, unequal lengths, and nonuniform sampling, while dense adapters can discard temporal structure. We propose a mask-aware state space classifier for irregular time series (MASCIT), which supplies observation masks to the encoder and excludes invalid steps from gated temporal aggregation. Across 34 irregular time series datasets, MASCIT yielded the strongest aggregate point estimate and was the only evaluated neural model with three-seed results on every dataset. MASCIT retained the lowest point rank across six overlapping irregularity indicators, while factorial ablations favored partial over full selectivity. These results support selective state space models as effective, executable backbones for naturally irregular time series classification.

</details>


### [1016] [Coding Agent Memory Post-training: Unlocking the Memory Potential of Pre-trained File Operations for Long-Horizon Tasks via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34422)
*Lirui Luo,Kelong Mao,Heming Xia,Rongqing Li,Xinwei Yang,Luyu Chen,Kieran Wong,Yudong Guo,Xinrui Wang,Jiayin Zhu,Simiu Gu,Sulong Xu,Cong Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CAMG环境套件和CAMG-RL方法，通过强化学习利用普通文件系统操作作为长程任务记忆，使小型模型在编码和机器学习工程任务上表现竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程任务中交互历史超出模型活动上下文，已有方法依赖预定义记忆工具，需要从零学习，导致后训练后智能体仍难以有效使用记忆。需要探索如何利用预训练中已有的代码能力来实现可复用的长程记忆。

Method: 构建CAMG（四个长程环境：Shop、Coding、DeepResearch、AutoResearch），统一提供episode持久化工作空间和shell访问。提出CAMG-RL：单个策略在四环境联合训练，使用双粒度PPO（响应级优势估计+token级裁剪）和完全异步PPO，直接从下游任务奖励学习基于文件的记忆行为。

Result: CAMG-RL-4B在CAMG测试集平均成功率54.4%（最高），在SWE-bench Verified上达到15.8%，MLE-bench Lite上4.5%，与Qwen3.5-35B-A3B相当；CAMG-RL-9B达到27.6%和9.1%，与Qwen3.5-122B-A10B相当。预训练基础模型已偏好文件系统操作而非专用记忆工具。

Conclusion: 在代码预训练基础上进行强化学习可以激发可复用的长程记忆能力。通过普通文件系统操作而非专用记忆工具，使智能体利用预训练中已有的偏好，比专用记忆工具或学习压缩方法更有效。

Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks whose interaction histories exceed the model's active context. Recent work has begun to use reinforcement learning to make memory control part of the policy, often relying on predefined memory tools within domain-specific training environments of relatively short horizons. This setup ties learned memory behavior to environment-specific interfaces that lie outside the base model's pre-training and must be learned from scratch, so even after post-training, agents struggle to use memory in long-horizon tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce Coding Agent Memory Gym (CAMG), a suite of long-horizon agentic-RL environments spanning Shop, Coding, DeepResearch, and AutoResearch. Alongside each environment's native task interface, CAMG provides executable shell access and an episode-persistent workspace, enabling agents to create, revise, search, and reuse files as memory throughout an episode. We also introduce CAMG-RL, which trains a single policy jointly across all four environments with fully asynchronous PPO, learning this file-based memory behavior directly from downstream task reward, and we train CAMG-RL-4B and CAMG-RL-9B from Qwen3.5 models of matching size. On SWE-bench Verified and MLE-bench Lite, CAMG-RL-4B and CAMG-RL-9B are competitive with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, respectively.

</details>


### [1017] [SPACE-LoRA: Allocating Activation-Subspace Protection for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34453)
*Seunghyun Yoo,Kiseok Kim,Hyeontae Joo,Junyeop Bang,Hwangnam Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SPACE-LoRA方法，通过硬约束投影LoRA输入因子到历史激活子空间的正交补，并基于Fisher覆盖率自适应分配每个模块的保护维度，有效缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LoRA的持续学习方法主要约束参数更新或学习子空间，但未充分考虑加性干扰：新添加的残差适配器在固定旧模型上对旧任务重要输入方向产生非零响应，改变先前预测。需要直接抑制新分支沿历史敏感激活方向的响应，并按模块自适应分配保护容量。

Method: 1) 残差响应消除：对每个模块，在每次优化后将新LoRA分支的输入因子A硬投影到历史激活Gram矩阵前k_m个特征向量所张成保护子空间的正交补，保证A·V=0，使新分支对保护子空间内任意输入产生严格零响应；2) 模块级Fisher覆盖率保护：基于历史激活特征值的特征向量排序，用输入空间经验Fisher信息沿各方向的敏感度计算Fisher覆盖率C_m(k)，选取最小k_m使覆盖率≥ρ，自适应确定每模块保护维度，上限为d_m−r以保留秩r的适配空间。

Result: 在ImageNet-R（5/10/20任务CIL）、DomainNet、VTAB、VDD（TIL）四个视觉基准以及15个NLP数据集的5/10/15任务语言基准上，使用ViT-B/16和T5-large进行评估。SPACE-LoRA在多数基准上达到最优或接近最优精度，在VTAB达到86.05%（ρ=0.90），语言10任务达73.95%。覆盖率消融显示ρ=0.90时性能最佳（平均保护维度211），过高保护（ρ=0.99，保护维度517）反而降低精度。Fisher引导保护相比均匀分配在ImageNet-R 5任务提升2.12个百分点（79.09% vs 76.97%），语言10任务提升1.34个百分点。

Conclusion: SPACE-LoRA通过硬参数投影而非软正则化实现激活子空间保护，保证新LoRA分支对保护方向严格零响应；Fisher覆盖率机制按模块敏感度差异分配保护容量，在固定秩约束下平衡稳定性与可塑性。实验验证了该方法在视觉和语言跨域持续学习中的有效性，但Fisher引导保护并不在所有情况下优于均匀保护，表明方向选择比容量分配更为关键。

Abstract: This study addresses the catastrophic forgetting problem that occurs when sequentially learning successive tasks using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) from a lifelong learning perspective. While existing approaches have primarily constrained parameter updates or learning subspaces to reduce interference with past knowledge, they have not fully considered additive interference. This occurs when a newly added residual adapter on top of a fixed past model generates non-zero responses along input directions important for old tasks, thereby altering previous predictions. To this end, we propose Subspace Protection with Allocated Capacity for Efficient Continual Adaptation (SPACE-LoRA). SPACE-LoRA directly suppresses the responses of the new residual branch along input activation directions that are important for old tasks and adaptively determines the protection coverage for each module based on past-task sensitivity estimated via a common Fisher sensitivity-based coverage target. Under a fixed LoRA rank, this approach adaptively adjusts module-specific protection coverage while suppressing interference along input directions sensitive to old tasks. We assess the effectiveness of activation-subspace protection in mitigating catastrophic forgetting and examine the role of sensitivity-guided protection in continual learning across diverse tasks. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1018] [Causal Routing for Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34475)
*Bardh Prenkaj,Andrea D'Angelo,Davide Mottin,Federico Fontana,Davide Gabrielli,Paola Velardi,Stefano Faralli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对大语言模型(LLM)的轻量级遗忘方法——因果路由遗忘(Causal Routing for Unlearning, CRU)。该方法通过两阶段流程实现:第一阶段在遗忘集上进行一次未训练的前向传播,根据神经元激活的方差排序,定位编码待遗忘概念的神经元;第二阶段为这些神经元附加小型路由MLP模块(仅占基础模型约0.01%的参数),在每个token位置根据输入动态决定抑制哪些概念神经元。基础模型在整个过程中保持冻结,所有行为变化完全可归因于门控神经元,因此具有因果性。在TOFU和RWKU基准测试中,CRU在遗忘效果、模型效用保留和计算效率(14 GiB vs 71 GiB)方面均优于现有最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法存在三个核心缺陷:(1)修改整个模型权重以改变一个概念,但无法说明哪个部分产生了变化;(2)干预在查询前就已固定,无法区分真正触及遗忘概念的提示与仅"擦肩而过"的提示,导致抑制被均匀消耗,模型效用不必要的下降;(3)需要重新训练基础模型,内存开销巨大(71 GiB),对中小型研究机构不实用。这些方法混淆了"抑制表面形式"与"真正移除知识"的区别。

Method: CRU包含两个阶段:阶段1(定位):从最后k个解码器块收集隐藏状态,对每个块在非填充位置做均值池化,计算各神经元在遗忘集示例间的激活方差,保留高于第p百分位的神经元作为候选集;阶段2(门控):为每个选中块附加一个小型MLP路由模块(Linear-ReLU-Linear-Sigmoid),读取块的输出隐藏状态,对每个选中神经元在每个token位置输出[0,1]的门控值,乘法作用于残差流的对应坐标。损失函数定义在门控值上而非模型输出上:L_suppress推动遗忘集门控值趋近0,L_pass推动保留集门控值趋近1(二次型),基础模型完全冻结,无梯度通过。

Result: 在TOFU基准上,CRU在所有遗忘规模和四种模型家族(DeepSeek 7B、Qwen2.5 7B、Llama 3.1 8B、Phi 3 Mini)上均保持最佳的效用-遗忘权衡,统计显著(p≤0.039),且永远不被Pareto支配;在forget01上与重训模型KS检验不可区分(p>0.05)。在RWKU基准上,CRU在对抗性探测下的ROUGE-L回忆率仅为0.052,远优于最强基线的0.250,表明知识真正被移除而非仅被隐藏。内存占用14 GiB(基线需71 GiB),每个概念24分钟(NPO需52分钟,GA/SimNPO需43分钟),仅使用约0.01%的基础模型参数。消融实验证实定位阶段选择的神经元具有概念特异性(与保留集的重叠率仅27%-59%),随机选择同等数量神经元则无法实现有效遗忘。

Conclusion: CRU将遗忘问题重新定义为"按查询决定干预",而非"训练前固定干预"。核心贡献在于:(1)高遗忘分数本身不能证明遗忘成功——在forget10上,GA/NPO/SimNPO报告0.97遗忘分数但效用为0.00,这只是报告了一个损坏的模型;(2)抑制表面形式不等于移除产生它的知识——所有基线在探测变难时都退步,而CRU在对抗性回忆上稳定在0.052;(3)遗忘成本主要来自重训练——通过消除基础模型的梯度和优化器状态,将内存从71 GiB降至14 GiB,使单设备逐概念遗忘成为可能。该方法为未来遗忘研究指明了新方向:将干预范围(scope)作为独立的设计选择对待。

Abstract: LLMs cannot forget the way we delete a file. Strangely, we are asked to remove something that was never put anywhere in particular. What the model took from a piece of text is now smeared across billions of weights. Existing methods rewrite all of them to change one thing, and none of them say which part produced that change. To address this, we introduce Causal Routing for Unlearning (CRU) by asking where the concept is expressed in the model and suppressing only that part. One untrained forward pass over the forget set ranks neurons by how their activations vary. Then, small routing modules on those neurons gate and suppress only the concepts that need to be forgotten. In CRU, the base model is frozen, and any change in behavior is caused only by the gated neurons; hence, why the routing is causal. Due to our parameter efficiency (only ~0.01% as many parameters as the base model), unlearning a concept costs 14 GiB, whereas the baselines require 71 GiB. On TOFU, CRU is indistinguishable from the retained model (p > 0.05, KS test) and is never Pareto-dominated, whereas every compared baseline matches its forgetting on the larger-forget batches only by collapsing utility. On RWKU, it achieves an adversarial-probe recall of 0.052, compared to 0.250 for the strongest baseline, meaning the knowledge is gone, not merely harder to reach. Thus, deciding on the intervention at query time, rather than fixing it beforehand, is the axis along which we argue that unlearning should proceed.

</details>


### [1019] [Learn Here, Move Less Elsewhere: Input-Conditioned Plasticity from Retained-Domain Activation Atlases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34478)
*Jiangtao Lin,Bangyang Wei,Yihang Ding,Siyi Liu,Yuhan Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ATLAS是一种用于语言模型任务适应的方法，通过"激活图谱"（activation atlas）将保留域的局部参考中心和方向滤波器注入到共享低秩残差中，实现"学新技能、少改旧行为"的目标。在Qwen3-8B上以共享编码性能为基准，其保留输出KL散度比七种已发表基线方法低10.16%–17.60%，并在五个骨干网络、两个保留域下均一致有效，同时能将数学答案改写率降低约54.6%、常识选择稳定性提升约38.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务特定的微调往往会超出训练任务范围，改变模型在其他领域（数学、常识等）的输出，从而破坏版本间的行为连续性。已有方法（如CorDA、LoRA-Null、TopLoRA等）虽利用代表性激活或输入条件化来约束更新，但未显式利用当前token局部保留邻域的几何结构作为参考。本文旨在通过将保留域的几何信息（局部中心和方向）转化为输入依赖的规则，在获得新技能的同时最大限度减少对既有行为的干扰。

Method: ATLAS构建一个由K=32个"图谱"（chart）组成的激活图谱，每个图谱通过在保留域校准输入上做K-means聚类得到一个中心c_j，并通过局部PCA得到一组正交基U_j（p=16维）。推理时，每个token状态h通过软路由选取q=4个最近中心，按softmax权重α_j(h)混合得到局部中心c(h)和方向滤波器N(h)=I−Σα_jU_jU_j⊤。残差定义为Δ(h)=ρ(h)·N(h)·B·tanh(A·N(h)(h−c(h)))，其中A、B为唯一可训练参数（2dr=131,072），ρ(h)=tanh(‖z‖₂/s)是PCA衍生缩放因子。该机制同时实现输入滤波、中心化、输出滤波和幅值缩放。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B（GSM8K为保留域）13个共享编码水平（148–160道MBPP+题目）下，ATLAS相比CorDA-KPM、LoRA-Null、OPLoRA(k=16/128)、CLoRA、TopLoRA、STM、TALR七种基线，平均保留输出KL降低10.16%–17.60%，且在三个训练种子上全部一致胜出。在Qwen3-4B/8B/3.5-9B/14B、GLM-4-9B五种骨干、GSM8K与CSQA两个保留域上，所有54项种子级比较ATLAS均胜出，合计KL降低62.03%。结构消融显示：相对无约束残差，中心化贡献最大（−38.44%），距离缩放再贡献−2.39%，PCA缩放再贡献−1.62%，输入/输出滤波器带来进一步改善。答案层面，Qwen3.5-9B上数学答案改写率从22.43%降至10.18%（−54.60%），错误翻转F和偶然修正G分别降低59.86%和59.57%；CSQA上选择改变率降低38.42%而条件选择准确率几乎不变。计算开销：解码慢2.52–3.13%，预填慢5.83–12.26%，图谱存储15.85 MiB。

Conclusion: ATLAS将保留激活的局部几何（中心与方向）作为输入依赖的"地址"，在共享低秩残差中实现新任务学习与既有行为保留的双重目标。实验证明：保留域激活图谱是适配过程中的可重用几何资源，能在不同骨干和保留域下稳定减少输出分布漂移与答案改写。未来工作可探索跨层图谱协调、根据激活结构自适应选择图谱数量与局部秩，以及在顺序专化中跟踪参考分布的演化。

Abstract: Task-specific fine-tuning can rewrite a language model's answers beyond the training task, complicating updates that must preserve existing behavior. We introduce ATLAS, which turns retained-domain representations into an input-dependent rule for task adaptation. An activation atlas supplies local reference centers and directional filters to a shared low-rank residual. Target supervision learns the residual, while retained geometry shapes its action throughout training and inference. On Qwen3-8B, ATLAS achieves lower mean retained-output Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence than all seven published baselines at shared coding-performance requirements, with consistent advantages across multiple training seeds. Structural comparisons identify the contributions of retained reference states and directional conditioning, and answer-level analyses show fewer rewritten mathematical answers and more stable commonsense choices. Experiments spanning five backbones and two retained domains further demonstrate coding gains with reduced retained-output movement. With compact storage and modest decoding overhead, ATLAS provides a practical mechanism for acquiring specialized skills while maintaining continuity in existing responses.

</details>


### [1020] [FlexLoop: Depth-Elastic Looped Policies for Adaptive Test-Time Computation in Deep RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34488)
*Xun Wang,Ruishuo Chen,Yu Chen,Zhuoran Li,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlexLoop是一个后训练框架，将固定循环深度的循环策略（looped policy）转化为深度弹性策略，通过结合原始RL目标与相邻深度策略蒸馏，使策略在推理时可在不同循环深度间自适应切换，最多减少43%的平均循环深度并获得1.34倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有固定深度训练的循环RL策略存在严重的循环深度特化（recurrent-depth specialization）现象——可靠的决策仅集中在完整训练深度附近，导致部署时计算量与该深度绑定，无法根据状态难度自适应分配计算资源。论文旨在解决如何使单一策略在多个循环深度上都能保持可靠决策的问题。

Method: FlexLoop采用后训练框架，包含两个关键组件：(1) 继续在原始RL目标上优化以保持完整深度能力和泛化性；(2) 引入相邻深度策略蒸馏（adjacent-depth policy distillation），通过KL散度将深层策略的决策质量逐步传递到浅层深度。该方法被实例化到GC-DQN、GC-PPO和GC-IQL三种目标条件RL算法中，并利用相邻深度间策略差异作为状态级自适应推理的停止信号。

Result: 在30个在线和离线长程目标条件环境（含BoxPick、LightsOut和OGBench）上的实验表明，FlexLoop在保持完整深度性能的同时显著提升浅层深度的可靠性，并将平均循环深度减少高达43%，在大规模压力测试中实现高达1.34倍的壁钟加速。该方法在未见任务上同样保持良好的深度弹性，并可推广到LSTM架构和不同预训练深度（K∈{4,5,8,10}）。

Conclusion: FlexLoop成功将深度特化的循环策略转化为深度弹性策略，通过统一的优化框架同时保持完整深度能力和浅层深度可靠性，并通过理论分析（相邻深度差异控制浅层性能边界）支撑自适应推理机制。未来的研究方向包括超越训练深度的弹性化、基于学习的自适应推理机制，以及在大规模Transformer循环架构中的应用。

Abstract: Looped architectures scale computation by reusing the same parameters across recurrent steps, and recent work shows that they substantially improve deep reinforcement learning policies on long-horizon tasks. Since recurrent depth directly controls computation, one may expect looped policies to naturally support elastic inference across recurrent depths. Surprisingly, we find that pretrained looped policies exhibit severe recurrent-depth specialization: reliable decisions are concentrated near the full trained depth, tying deployment computation to this depth even when less computation may suffice. Achieving depth elasticity, i.e., reliable decisions across recurrent depths with adaptive computation at deployment, therefore remains a key challenge. To address this, we propose FlexLoop, a novel post-training framework that converts pretrained fixed-depth looped policies into depth-elastic policies. FlexLoop keeps training on the original RL objective to preserve full-depth capability while performing adjacent-depth policy distillation to progressively transfer decision quality from deeper to shallower recurrent steps. The resulting policy supports reliable inference across recurrent depths and enables state-wise adaptive inference through recurrent-depth consistency. Experiments on $30$ online and offline long-horizon goal-conditioned environments show that FlexLoop preserves full-depth performance while making shallower depths effective. Keeping competitive performance, FlexLoop reduces average recurrent depth by up to $\bf{43\%}$ and achieves up to $\bf{1.34\times}$ wall-clock speedup in a stress test.

</details>


### [1021] [Scalable GNN-based Knowledge Graph Representation Learning with Efficient Message Passing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34499)
*Huu Tan Mai,Cuong Xuan Chu,Heiko Paulheim,Daria Stepanova*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种面向知识图谱（KG）的GNN消息传递（MP）通用可扩展优化方案，将原有仅支持加法和逐元素乘法的关系稀疏矩阵乘法（RSPMM）扩展为支持2×2块对角矩阵乘法、Givens旋转、循环相关等多种更具表达力的组合算子，实现O(|E|·d)空间复杂度下的大幅无损加速（最高32.2倍）和显存降低（最高10.7倍），并使多个GNN模型在大幅削减资源的同时保持接近SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN在知识图谱表示学习上表现优异，但其用户自定义消息传递算法带来的高计算复杂度和巨大内存占用严重阻碍了其在大型KG上的应用。现有可扩展性方案（如子图采样）通常针对特定任务/模型，且难以保证无损的运行时/空间缩减。因此需要一种任务无关、对多种组合算子通用的无损可扩展优化方法。

Method: 扩展关系稀疏矩阵乘法（RSPMM）。原有RSPMM仅支持逐元素加法与乘法（受TransE、DistMult启发）。本文将其推广至更广泛的组合算子ϕ，包括：2×2块对角矩阵乘法⊠（受RESCAL启发，可通过两次RSPMM_⊙调用实现）、Givens旋转/反射（受RotatE启发）、循环相关⋆（受HolE启发，可通过复数乘法及卷积定理实现）、以及支持加性偏置的通用形式。核心思路是将关系嵌入Z巧妙构造，使复杂算子可归约为已支持的基础RSPMM调用，整个MP保持在O(|E|⋅d)空间复杂度。

Result: 在WN18RR、FB15k-237、AM、AM+、dblp等多个KG基准上进行KGC与实体分类实验。结果显示：(1) 现有模型重实现后最高获得32.2倍加速、10.7倍显存降低，且性能理论等价；(2) 在web规模的dblp（450万实体，2200万边）上R-GCN基线OOM，而基于RSPMM的实现以33.8 GiB显存完成训练并达到0.72准确率；(3) 提出的两个原型模型（MODEL-A基于CompGCN，MODEL-B基于AdaProp）在KGC上以显著更少资源取得接近SOTA的结果；(4) 配合冻结LM初始特征的GNN（R-MPNN）在性能上可媲美甚至超过训练型LM方法（如SimKGC），而资源消耗大幅降低。

Conclusion: RSPMM扩展是一种简单、通用、无损的可扩展性工具，适用于多种现有面向KG的关系GNN，能以更低计算预算支持更强架构并达到接近SOTA性能，有望加速KG机器学习研究迭代并支持更大规模问题。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) excel at representation learning on Knowledge Graphs (KGs), achieving stateof-the-art performance on tasks like link prediction or entity classification. However, their high computational complexity, inherent to their user-defined message passing (MP) algorithm, still prohibits their widespread adoption, especially for large KGs. Current efforts to mitigate the scalability bottlenecks of GNNs on KGs, such as subgraph sampling, are often task- and model-specific, and do not reliably guarantee lossless (if applicable) runtime/space reductions. To address this, we extend Relational Sparse Matrix Multiplication (RSPMM), originally designed to losslessly lower the space complexity of composition-based MP with pointwise composition functions, to support more expressive functions (e.g., 2x2 block-diagonal matrix multiplication, Givens rotation, circular correlation). Our method delivers significant task-independent reductions in runtime and space for current GNNs on KGs and facilitates efficient re-implementations of GNNs that maintain near state-of-the-art performance on challenging KG tasks, for a fraction of computational costs.

</details>


### [1022] [Shallow Queries, Mature Values: Depth-Asynchronous Self-Speculation for Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34538)
*Guanghao Li,Zihan Su,Hao Yu,Jinyang Jiang,Tao Ren,Zehao Li,Feng Lu,Ming Tang,Chun Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对循环Transformer自回归解码开销大的问题，提出深度异步自推测解码（DAS），通过解耦草稿计算深度与已验证前缀表示深度，并结合Mature-V原语与并行优化策略，在多个模型与任务上实现4.00–6.96倍吞吐量加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer通过在递推深度上复用共享块来扩展推理计算，但自回归解码每个token需多次顺序递推，计算开销大。现有自推测解码方法通常将草稿计算与前缀表示绑定在同一递推深度，未充分挖掘前缀信息中已成熟但被草稿忽略的部分。

Method: 作者发现注意力通道在递推深度上成熟速度存在不对称性：Q/K较早趋近最终深度表示，而V成熟较慢。基于此，提出深度异步自推测（DAS），通过Mature-V原语让浅层草稿查询直接读取已物化的全深度前缀V值，无需额外递推。进一步构建DAS-Wave解码器，将深度异步前缀读取与携带式并行细化、渐进块增长及独立全深度验证器相结合。

Result: 在4个循环Transformer检查点（Huginn-0125及3个Raven变体）和数学/代码任务（GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval、MBPP）上，DAS-Wave实现4.00–6.96倍平均吞吐量加速，所有16个设置中均取得最优且接受草稿长度最长。消融实验表明Mature-V在顺序草稿中有效，而并行携带下联合Deep K/V策略更优，两者具有互补性。

Conclusion: DAS将草稿计算深度与前缀信息深度解耦，识别出"前缀信息深度"作为循环自推测的独立设计维度，使提议成本与前缀信息质量可独立优化，为结合廉价草稿计算与目标验证已产生的成熟信息开辟了更广阔的设计空间。

Abstract: Looped Transformers reuse a shared block across recurrent depths, making autoregressive decoding expensive because every generated token requires many sequential recurrent passes. Self-speculative decoders reduce this cost by drafting at an early depth and verifying at full depth, but typically bind draft computation to prefix representations from the same recurrent depth. We find that queries and keys approach their final-depth representations earlier than values, and controlled prefix-channel interventions show that mature values substantially improve shallow draft predictions. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce Depth-Asynchronous Self-Speculation (DAS), which decouples the depth of draft computation from the depth of verified-prefix representations it reads. Its Mature-V primitive lets shallow queries retrieve full-depth prefix values without additional recurrent computation. We further develop DAS-Wave, which combines depth-asynchronous prefix reads with carried parallel refinement, progressive block growth, and an independent full-depth verifier. Across four recurrent-model checkpoints and mathematics and code workloads, DAS-Wave achieves 4.00--6.96$\times$ mean throughput speedup over paired full-depth autoregressive decoding in the same inference stack. These results identify prefix-information depth as an effective design axis for recurrent self-speculation.

</details>


### [1023] [Learning What to Recall: Adaptive Multi-Cue Episodic Memory for World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34677)
*Beomsu Kim,Chieh-Hsin Lai,Bac Nguyen,Amir Bar,Jong Chul Ye,Yuki Mitsufuji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FAR（Future-Aware Recall），一种基于未来感知预测监督和自适应多线索评分的学习型情景记忆召回框架。它通过扩散预测损失衡量记忆的预测效用，训练一个推理时无需未来的检索器，并自适应融合时间、位姿、视觉、音频等多种检索线索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型在长时程预测中需要从庞大的情景记忆中选择有用的历史观测。现有方法依赖固定规则（时近性、位姿重叠、视觉相似度），但这些规则在不同环境下不可靠，且不同线索的可靠性因查询而异。需要一种能够学习"哪些记忆有用、哪些线索可信赖"的原则性方法。

Method: FAR采用隐变量检索增强框架：在训练时利用已观测的未来，通过条件对数似然（用负扩散预测损失近似）构建未来感知后验，作为教师信号监督未来盲检索器。检索器学习每种线索的相关性分数和查询相关的线索融合权重。通过时序分块的Top-K选择避免冗余，并采用EMDR²式的候选级近似处理组合爆炸问题。

Result: 在LoopNav（静态Minecraft导航）中，FAR在视觉线索下比LongLive-RAG的DreamSim降低17%，在元数据线索下比WorldMem降低19%；在SoundSpaces（带音频的室内导航）中，FAR自适应学习在稀疏记忆下信任音频线索；在AI2-THOR（可变状态环境）中，FAR能召回与当前世界状态一致的历史，正确处理反事实预测，并将场景外动态预测准确率从41.9%/32.4%提升至67.1%/94.6%。消融实验验证了查询相关线索权重的必要性。

Conclusion: FAR确立了预测效用作为情景记忆召回的原则性基础，能够灵活处理导航、多线索和状态变化等多种场景。其限制包括：仅关注外部情景记忆的读取，不涉及记忆写入/压缩/遗忘；依赖信息性检索线索；扩散损失效用可能低估语义重要的局部变化；实验限于受控仿真环境。

Abstract: World models predict future observations from current experience and actions, yet prediction can depend on observations seen far in the past. Episodic memory preserves past observations for later recall; however, as memory accumulates, it raises a fundamental question: which memories are useful for the current prediction, and which available retrieval cues should be trusted to find them? This is challenging because fixed criteria based on recency, pose overlap, or visual similarity can be unreliable across environments and queries. We propose Future-Aware Recall (FAR), a framework that learns episodic recall from future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring. During training, FAR measures predictive utility by the conditional log-likelihood of the realized future given recalled context, approximated by negative diffusion prediction loss, and uses it to train a retriever that remains future-blind at inference. The retriever learns cue-specific relevance and automatically determines which available retrieval cues, such as time, pose, vision, and audio, to trust for each query when selecting memories. Across three complementary settings, FAR outperforms hand-designed recall even with the same retrieval cues, automatically adapts which available cues to trust, and recalls the right history as the world changes. Together, these results establish FAR as a flexible, principled approach to episodic memory access in world models.

</details>


### [1024] [From Preference to Reciprocity: Decentralized Matching with Empirically Grounded LLM-agent Based Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34679)
*Wangxuan Fan,Xiaoyu Nie,Zhoutian Shi,Xiangcheng Meng,Shipei Zeng,Pin Gao,Yan Hu,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个去中心化双边匹配框架，将基于LLM的择偶偏好评估与个体化的Logistic-UCB上下文赌博机相结合，在中国婚姻市场模拟中分离"我喜欢谁"与"谁可能回喜欢我"两个决策。实验表明该框架在福利-稳定性权衡上优于Gale-Shapley等经典基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典匹配理论（Gale-Shapley）依赖完全偏好序和集中式计算，但现实中匹配过程是去中心化、异步、在有限信息下通过序贯交互进行的。现有LLM-ABM研究虽能模拟行为，但偏好形成机制仍需手工设定效用函数，且未解决"偏好"与"互惠接受"的耦合问题。本文旨在构建一个无需事前全局偏好排序、通过局部接触和在线学习实现去中心化双边匹配的框架。

Method: 1) 基于2015年中国人口抽样调查和Zhou等(2023)的择偶选择实验构建依赖感知的人口合成（含年龄、收入、教育、家庭背景、住房、外貌六维特征）；2) 用性别特定的CoT提示将LLM智能体的择偶偏好与实证条件logit参考对齐验证；3) 设计去中心化异步匹配协议：每期随机激活活跃智能体，每位智能体观察局部候选集，先用LLM评估偏好（产生效用改善ΔU），再用个体化Logistic-UCB模型（基于六维二元上下文）学习互惠接受概率，将二者结合形成提议索引 I = ΔU·p^UCB；4) 建立理论：局部提案遗憾界（可实现模型下 Õ(d√N)，动态误设定下附加累积误差项）。

Result: 在50×50匹配实验中：Bandit-UCB获得最高平均互惠福利56.01（vs Gale-Shapley 54.87），阻配对数16.28（在LLM-ABM策略中最少）；跨LLM骨干（DeepSeek/Qwen/GPT-OSS）均显示偏好提示优于无CoT基线；性别差异化的接受模型呈现可解释模式（外貌对男性提议者更重要，教育对女性提议者更重要）；反事实热身实验显示先验知识并不带来系统性单方面优势。

Conclusion: 该框架证实了去中心化、基于LLM行为建模和在线学习的双边匹配在不完整信息条件下的优势，将行为表达与交互机制解耦，便于独立变化行为假设、信息获取和制度规则。其模块化设计可推广至劳动力市场搜索、团队组建、平台匹配等场景。理论方面建立了动态误设定下的局部提案遗憾界，但承认终端福利最优性和稳定性收敛未被保证，且LLM行为建模仍受提示设计和模型选择影响。

Abstract: Bipartite matching is a fundamental problem in game theory and market design. Classical approaches such as Gale--Shapley assume complete preferences and centralized computation, whereas many real-world matching processes are decentralized, asynchronous, and shaped by sequential interaction under limited information. We propose a dynamic bipartite matching framework that combines large language model (LLM) agents with contextual bandits. In a simulated Chinese marriage market, economically grounded LLM agents evaluate locally encountered candidates, while agent-specific Logistic-UCB models learn reciprocal acceptance from realized proposal outcomes. The mechanism therefore separates two decisions---\emph{whom do I like?} and \emph{who is likely to like me back?}---without requiring ex ante market-wide preference rankings. We first validate LLM-induced mate preferences against the empirical conditional-logit reference across multiple LLM backbones. In the $50\times50$ matching experiment, Bandit-UCB achieves the highest mean mutual welfare (56.01 versus 54.87 for Gale--Shapley), a smaller gender rank gap than the classical baselines, and the fewest blocking pairs among the LLM-ABM policies. Learned acceptance models show economically interpretable gender-differentiated associations, while counterfactual setups reveal no systematic unilateral advantage from prior search knowledge. Overall, these results support the advantages of decentralized matching with LLM-based behavioral modeling and online learning under incomplete information for economic simulation and computational social science research.

</details>


### [1025] [Predictive Dual Smoothing for Column Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34740)
*Senne Berden,Noah Schutte,Andrea Lodi,Tias Guns*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"预测式对偶平滑"（Predictive Dual Smoothing）：在列生成（Column Generation）中，将当前对偶解与一个学习到的未来对偶预测进行凸组合，引导定价子问题生成在后续迭代中仍有用处的列，从而加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统列生成中，对偶振荡会导致反复生成仅对当前 RMP 有用的列，减慢收敛；经典对偶平滑使用历史对偶作为参考点，但这些历史对偶可能已被解决，无法引导定价产生长期有用的列。

Method: （1）使用监督学习训练一个轻量级 MLP（32 个 ReLU 单元的单隐藏层），从标准 CG 轨迹中预测未来 k 步的对偶向量；（2）特征为约束级的固定维向量，包含全局 CG 状态、约束状态、定价结构、列上下文四组通用 CG 量；（3）使用预测对偶与当前对偶做凸组合进行定价，预测仅修改定价目标，保留正确性检查和回退定价；（4）回退后按 γ 衰减平滑强度 α，逐步回归当前对偶。

Result: 在 CSP（切割库存）和 GAP（广义分配）两类问题上，预测式对偶平滑显著减少生成列数和墙钟时间：CSP 上配对运行时比率从 1.000 降至 0.630（减少 37%），GAP 上叠加 Du Merle 稳定化后从 0.078 降至 0.041；在分布外更大实例上（n=2000, 2500）同样有效；与经典稳定化方法互补，可叠加进一步提升。

Conclusion: 预测式对偶平滑是一种有效、与问题无关的列生成加速方法，可在不损失最优性保证的前提下大幅减少生成列数和求解时间，且能泛化到训练分布之外的更大实例，并可与现有强经典稳定化方法叠加。

Abstract: Solving large-scale linear programs efficiently is an important challenge in many optimization settings. A key technique is column generation, which alternates between solving the master problem over a restricted subset of the variables, and using a pricing subproblem to identify new variables to add. The pricing subproblem is guided by the dual solution of the current restricted master problem, but oscillations in these dual solutions can substantially slow convergence. Dual stabilization methods address this issue. Dual smoothing is a common stabilization method, which guides the pricing subproblem using a combination of the current dual solution and duals from previous iterations. However, while past dual solutions can stabilize the dual trajectory, they do not necessarily guide pricing towards useful new variables. We therefore introduce predictive dual smoothing, which instead combines the current dual solution with a learned prediction of future duals to steer pricing towards variables that are more useful in subsequent iterations. The predictor is trained offline using supervision extracted from standard column generation trajectories and is used only to modify the pricing subproblem's objective function, while exact reduced-cost checks and fallback pricing with the unsmoothed duals preserve correctness. Experiments on cutting stock and generalized assignment problems show that predictive dual smoothing substantially reduces generated columns and wall-clock time relative to standard column generation and existing classical and learned stabilization methods. These gains extend to out-of-distribution instance sizes, and predictive smoothing provides further improvements when combined with strong classical stabilization.

</details>


### [1026] [No Pain, More Gain: Iterative Merging for Effective Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34745)
*Seonghyeon Kim,Chaeyun Jang,Noah Lee,Boseop Kim,Juho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究多教师在策略蒸馏（MOPD）中如何有效合并来自同一基座但经过不同后训练（SFT/RL）的领域教师。核心发现是：初始化时的基准性能不能预测MOPD最终恢复效果，而合并初始化（task arithmetic）的有效性同时依赖于教师配比和整体合并规模λ，部分优配置位于凸单纯形外（λ>1）。为此提出IM-MOPD方法，从均匀合并出发，在蒸馏过程中周期性地对恢复不足的领域追加固定大小的任务向量增量。在5领域（Medical、Law、Tool Use、Finance、IF）实验中，IM-MOPD在Qwen3-4B上达到86.9%、在Qwen3-1.7B上达到76.0%的平均归一化恢复率，显著优于均匀合并初始化与SFT warm-up基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多教师在策略蒸馏中，学生初始化对恢复效果有重要影响，但仅依据初始基准分数选择初始化并不可靠；此外，合并初始化涉及教师配比与全局规模λ的联合搜索，一次性搜索代价高，因此需要一种能在训练过程中渐进调整教师贡献的方法。

Method: 提出IM-MOPD（Iterative Merging for MOPD）：从均匀任务向量合并出发，交替执行MOPD更新与按规则触发的合并修正。每隔H次MOPD更新，根据验证集上各领域的归一化恢复率是否低于阈值γ，选取恢复不足的领域集合M，按固定步长δ在权重空间追加相应任务向量增量θ ← θ + δ∑_{i∈M} τ_i。超参数γ（0.4/0.6）、δ（0.1–0.4）、H=25。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-1.7B两种规模、5领域设置下：IM-MOPD平均归一化恢复率分别为86.9%和76.0%，超过均匀合并（53.8%/46.3%）和SFT warm-up（59.0%/46.5%）。合并时机消融显示，将相同累积系数全部前移或后置均弱于交错应用（79.0%/23.3% vs 86.9%），说明合并需与蒸馏相互强化。教师续写诊断表明，合并初始化的学生前缀与教师兼容性更好，即使自身表现略低。

Conclusion: 研究表明，教师贡献的确定更适合在MOPD训练过程中渐进完成，而非训练前一次性确定。IM-MOPD以低代价（无需额外SFT阶段、无需专家训练数据）实现了5领域能力的均衡恢复，并展现出对超参数γ、δ的合理鲁棒性。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) combines independently developed domain teachers into a single student by distilling their predictions on student-generated samples. We study a setting where teachers share a reference model but undergo different post-training procedures, and find that MOPD can struggle to recover some teacher capabilities. Because distillation occurs on student-generated prefixes, the student initialization can strongly affect subsequent recovery. However, initial benchmark performance is not a reliable predictor of a good MOPD initialization. For example, merge initialization can start below SFT warm-up yet finish higher after MOPD. We further find that effective merging depends on both the relative teacher contributions and the overall merge scale, with some strong configurations lying outside the simplex of convex parameter averaging. Thus, selecting a good merge initialization requires evaluating not only its immediate performance but also the learning it enables under MOPD, making one-shot coefficient search difficult. We propose Iterative Merging for MOPD (IM-MOPD), which starts from a uniform merge and progressively adds task-vector increments for under-recovered domains during distillation. In a 5-domain setting, IM-MOPD achieves higher average normalized recovery than MOPD with either uniform merge initialization or SFT warm-up, showing that effective teacher contributions can be determined progressively during training.

</details>


### [1027] [A Unifying Framework of Concept-based Explainable AI with Completeness Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34750)
*Vojtěch Kůr,Adam Kukučka,Tomáš Brázdil,Vít Musil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的概念可解释AI理论框架，将概念检测、概念发现和瓶颈模型等方法纳入共同数学语言，通过概念自编码器视图重建模型完整性，并通过保真度误差和加性误差提供模型完整性和归因完整性的定量保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念可解释AI方法在概念定义、表示方式和与预测关联上差异显著，缺乏统一数学框架，难以进行跨方法的共享分析与理论保证，特别是关于模型完整性和归因完整性的定量保证。

Method: 1) 形式化概念、概念提取器、概念自编码器等基本要素，分离输入级概念、多维表示和标量激活；2) 通过重建误差(RE)→保真度误差(FE)→模型完整性误差(MCE)的链式不等式，利用Lipschitz假设建立定量界；3) 对标量输出定义插入、遮挡、梯度×输入三种归因规则，证明仿射解码头下加性误差为零，非仿射情况下用曲率界控制加性误差；4) 在ResNet-50/ImageNet-1k上用PCA、NMF、k-means、SAE、非线性自编码器经验评估界的紧度。

Result: 所有理论界在每种配置下均成立：1) 仿射解码头下，三种归因规则的加性误差接近零(ADD<2e-5)，归因误差等于保真度误差，界可达(ρ_ATE=1)；2) 保真度界存在结构松弛(layer4处ρ_FE≈0.10，penultimate处ρ_FE≈0.26)，源于重建误差沿预测头敏感方向的对齐不足和空间平均；3) 模型完整性界紧致(ρ̂_MCE在0.91–1.00之间)，最优头仅比重建解码头好约9%；4) 非线性解码器下曲率界较松(ρ_ATE在0.001–0.004之间)，但仍有效。

Conclusion: 该框架为现有概念可解释方法提供了共同语言和条件完整性保证——重建误差通过Lipschitz预测头控制保真度，进而控制模型完整性；归因误差由保真度加加性误差界定。这些保证与训练目标和优化过程无关，揭示了概念表示完整性的结构性条件，为评估和改进概念解释方法提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Concept-based explanations describe neural network predictions through human-understandable properties of inputs called concepts. The field encompasses approaches that differ in how they define and represent concepts and connect them to model predictions. We introduce a theoretical framework that describes these approaches in a common mathematical language and supports a shared analysis of their properties. For concept discovery, which identifies concepts automatically within a latent space of a trained model, we employ a concept autoencoder view. An encoder extracts concept representations from the model's latent space, and a decoder uses them to reconstruct the original latent representation. The autoencoder's reconstruction error measures how accurately its decoder recovers the original latent representation. We revisit model completeness: how well the concepts can reproduce the model's outputs. We show that model incompleteness of the concepts can be bounded by the autoencoder's reconstruction error. The autoencoder view also provides a common way to define individual concept attributions, which measure each concept's contribution to a prediction. We establish when these attributions sum to the model's prediction, and bound the discrepancy otherwise, thus providing attribution completeness guarantees.

</details>


### [1028] [Gaussian Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34825)
*Peter Kuhn,Victoria Heusinger-Heß*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了高斯神经网络（GaNN），通过在激活空间施加可学习的高斯先验作为新型正则化机制。在隐藏层活动上引入无监督的内损失（inner loss）函数，学习每个神经元的均值和方差先验，从而对"意外"的激活施加惩罚。提出了稀疏和密集两种架构变体。在十个分类和回归任务上表现优于标准神经网络（带或不带dropout/权重衰减），稀疏变体表现尤为突出。回归任务的不确定性量化结果良好，但分类任务上结果不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准神经网络缺乏对神经元激活向量"正常性"的显式表征，无法区分预期活动与意外活动。此外，神经网络本身不擅长处理和量化数据中的偶然不确定性（aleatoric）和参数的认识不确定性（epistemic）。传统正则化方法（如权重衰减）可视为在权重空间施加先验，但在激活空间施加先验仍是一个基本未被探索的方向。论文假设激活本身可被视为带噪声信号，从而通过学习激活空间的概率分布来引入内在正则化偏差。

Method: 1. **内高斯损失（Inner Gaussian Loss）**：为每个隐藏层神经元学习均值先验μ和方差先验σ²，通过类似方差头（variance head）的负对数似然作为无监督损失，与监督损失共同优化。总损失公式为：L = L_B + α·Θ(|L_B/L_I|)·L_I，其中Θ是no_grad算子，α控制正则化强度。
2. **稀疏高斯层**：方差先验仅依赖于该神经元的自身活动，通过Hadamard积和softplus激活函数加下界v保证正定性。每个神经元仅增加3个额外参数。
3. **密集高斯层**：方差先验依赖于前一层的所有活动和方差，参数更多但能学习更复杂模式。
4. **不确定性量化**：通过从学到的活动噪声分布中采样，向激活注入高斯噪声（强度由γ控制），获得预测分布；用Gaussian NLL和AUROC等指标评估。
5. **软正性约束**：使用softplus激活函数加硬编码下界v防止方差趋近于零。
6. **优化策略**：采用SGD，学习率0.1（回归）/0.01（分类），30轮后除以10，梯度范数裁剪至10，使用五折随机种子重复实验。

Result: **整体预测性能**：
- 稀疏GaNN在10个数据集中的9个上优于标准ANN（1个持平），密集GaNN在7个上优于ANN。
- 稀疏GaNN通常优于密集变体，且收敛更稳定；密集变体有时收敛过晚（如Airfoil、Yacht数据集），但收敛后性能更佳。
- GaNN与dropout可结合使用，产生互补效果。
- 训练初期GaNN学习较慢（先优化内损失），后期正则化效果使峰值性能更高。
- 在CIFAR100等数据集上，α在合理区间内性能不敏感，但过高（≥0.5）会导致崩溃。

**不确定性量化**：
- 回归任务：GaNN在Gaussian NLL上一致优于带方差头的ANN，稀疏GaNN+dropout组合表现最佳。
- 分类任务：结果不稳定，GaNN在部分数据集上不如标准方差头方法（如Fashion-MNIST）。
- 论文指出方差头未必仅量化偶然不确定性，实际上可能同时反映两种不确定性。

**超参数**：
- α易调，v主要用于数值稳定性，性能对v不敏感。

Conclusion: GaNN是一种理论上引人入胜且实践有效的架构，通过在激活空间学习高斯先验提供内在正则化。稀疏变体在效率和性能上均优于密集变体，训练更稳定。GaNN在多种分类和回归任务上一致优于标准正则化方法（权重衰减、dropout），且推理时无需额外参数。不确定性量化在回归任务上效果良好，但在分类任务上结果参差不齐。未来工作可探索将GaNN与卷积、注意力机制结合，扩展至非高斯分布假设，或将GaNN层与传统架构混合使用。

Abstract: Gaussian neural networks (GaNNs) are proposed as a novel regularization mechanism for neural networks. From a Bayesian perspective standard regularization techniques can be viewed as imposing priors over weight-space. Assuming priors over activation-space remains a largely unexplored possibility. GaNNs assume such priors. They do this by treating activities from earlier layers like signals with Gaussian noise and predicting the properties of the noise distribution using an additional unsupervised loss. While training, the unsupervised loss acts as a penalty on unexpected activities, allowing greater weight updates in less surprising directions. The paper demonstrates the superiority of Gaussian neural networks over standard neural networks on a variety of classification and regression tasks. We also investigate the ability of GaNNs to quantify uncertainty.

</details>


### [1029] [DivOPD: Spread Wide, Look Close for Asynchronous On-Policy Distillation of Multi-turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34838)
*Hanyang Wang,Zeyuan Liu,Zhengyu Chen,Jingqing Ruan,Chaoxu Pang,Zhongda Su,Wulin Xie,Zhizhao Zeng,Ke Zeng,Tianxiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DivOPD，一种用于异步多轮在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的学习端批次选择方法。它通过有效性过滤、回合优先覆盖和回合内分歧聚焦三个阶段，将固定回合预算更广泛地分配到更多回合并优先选择教师-学生分歧较大的回合；同时提出可选的有界教师恢复（+R）扩展来处理无进展回合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步多轮OPD中，到达顺序批处理会让少数早期或较长的rollout主导学习器更新，而其他有效rollout在过期前未被使用，造成已生成经验的浪费。论文通过训练日志量化了这一问题：vanilla OPD批次仅覆盖3.9-8.3个有效rollout，单个最大rollout占据24%-40%的批次令牌，约49%-59%的有效rollout从未进入优化器批次。现有的agentic OPD方法主要改进经验生成或单回合监督，而非学习器端批次构建问题。

Method: DivOPD包含三个阶段的批次组合器：(1) 有效性门控——过滤截断提示或无有效教师得分的回合；(2) 回合优先覆盖——按最早到达顺序处理rollout组，首次遍历每组最多贡献k个回合，确保至少⌈B/k⌉个不同rollout被覆盖，未选中的有效回合保留为pending供后续更新；(3) 回合内分歧聚焦——使用缓存的s(u)=Σ[log π_θv(u) - log π_φ]得分（累积教师-学生分歧）降序排列回合。可选扩展+R在连续p个无进展回合后让教师短暂介入最多m个回合，再交回学生控制，教师动作不参与蒸馏损失，评估时禁用。三阶段使用与vanilla OPD相同的每回合损失和优化器，仅改变哪些回合获得训练权重。

Result: 在ALFWorld（Qwen3-1.7B/4B）、WebShop（Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct）和ScienceWorld（Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B-Instruct）六个师生设置中，DivOPD将跨设置平均峰值成功率从77.4%提升至84.4%，最后五次评估平均成功率从71.5%提升至78.6%。相比vanilla OPD达到所有报告的设置特定目标，几何平均训练令牌加速1.84×，学习器GPU时间加速1.87×。+R扩展进一步将最后五次平均提升至82.4%，同时保持约1.7×学习器GPU加速。压力测试表明，在生产负载增加时优势更显著：重负载下DivOPD-base比vanilla OPD的最终SR高10.0点。回合利用率从49%-59%未使用降至7%-14%未使用。

Conclusion: 异步多轮OPD中的批次构建是学习算法的一部分，而非中立的系统基础设施。DivOPD通过将批次组合视为相关、过期rollout上的在线分配问题，在不改变每回合损失或优化器的情况下提升了成功率与训练效率。证据仅限于模拟基准和Qwen系列模型；未来工作应扩展设置、测量端到端资源并使分配适应队列压力。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains student agents through teacher supervision on their own interactions with an environment. However, in asynchronous multi-turn training, arrival-order batching can allow a few early or long rollouts to dominate learner updates while other valid rollouts become stale before being used, wasting already-generated experience. To address this problem, we introduce DivOPD, a simple learner-side batch-selection method that spreads a fixed turn budget across more rollouts and, within each rollout, prioritizes turns with larger cumulative teacher-student disagreement. Turns without usable teacher feedback are excluded. The per-turn loss and optimizer remain fixed; selection only changes which student-visited turns receive training weight. For no-progress rollouts, an optional extension briefly hands control to the teacher before returning it to the student. Across six teacher-student settings on the simulated ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop benchmarks, with 1.5B-7B students, DivOPD raises cross-setting mean peak success rate from 77.4 to 84.4 and mean success over the last five evaluations from 71.5 to 78.6. It reaches all reported setting-specific targets with geometric-mean speedups of 1.84x in training tokens and 1.87x in learner GPU time relative to vanilla OPD. Teacher intervention further raises this last-five mean to 82.4 while retaining about 1.7x learner-GPU speedup over vanilla OPD. Code will be released at this https URL .

</details>


### [1030] [Beyond Verbalized Confidence: Calibrating Reasoners with Differentiable Readouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34857)
*Chenxiao Fan,Chongming Gao,Gangyi Zhang,Leyang Shen,Yaxin Gong,Jiamin Wang,Jiakai Wang,Dong Wang,Yang Liu,Fuli Feng,Xiangnan He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）训练推理模型时存在的系统性过度自信问题，提出CREDO方法，用一对保留token的相对概率作为置信度的确定性读出，取代以往以文本形式采样数值置信度的做法，从而支持可微回归训练校准损失，并将置信度与正确性的差异作为权重反馈到答案学习上，在数学与代码推理任务上同时取得最优准确率与最佳校准，并带来拒绝预测与选择性预测的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR训练出的推理模型虽然答案正确率高，但报告的置信度普遍过度自信，且现有校准方法均让模型以文本形式“口述”数值置信度。这一设计带来两方面固有缺陷：①采样引入方差且实践中置信度坍缩到少数几个离散值，使正确与错误答案共享同一置信度；②采样使置信度不可微，校准信号只能通过标量奖励传递，梯度只能依赖得分函数估计，估计方差大且无法直接优化。

Method: CREDO包含四个核心设计：（1）置信度读出通道——在词汇表中预留一对特殊token {H, L}，将下一token分布限制在两者之间并重新归一化，以c=σ(z_H−z_L)∈(0,1)作为置信度，该值是输出分布的确定性泛函，连续且可微；（2）可微回归校准损失——以混合目标t_i=γ·a_i+(1−γ)·a̅_group训练c_i，通过∂ℓ/∂c·∇_θc的精确路径梯度直接优化，零估计方差；（3）策略梯度负责答案正确性与文本信用分配，对答案段与置信度分析段分别打分并分别做组内标准化；（4）差异加权——用|a_i−c_i|衡量置信度与结果的偏差，按偏差大小调整答案段优势，让“自信错误/意外成功”获得更高学习权重。训练总目标为L=−J+α·L_cal。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B（及1.7B、4B）上基于DeepScaleR（数学）与DeepCoder（代码）训练，评估DeepScaleR test、MATH-500、AIME 2024-26、AMC 2023-24、HumanEval+、LiveCodeBench v5/v6：域内CREDO在数学与代码上Acc/ECE/AUROC/Brier均领先（如数学Acc 0.752 vs DCPO 0.722，ECE 0.103 vs DCPO 0.217；代码Acc 0.600 vs DCPO 0.576，ECE 0.064 vs DCPO 0.153），且跨域迁移时校准优势仍保持；消融显示可微回归、置信度分析段、段级优势、差异加权均贡献显著；在选择性预测上CREDO以AURC 2.62%（数学）/16.80%（代码）、acc@90=0.927/0.617、可操作阈值372/932全面优于基线，可操作阈值数远高于GRPO/RLCR/DCPO（约10-22）。校准优势随模型规模增大而扩大。

Conclusion: 采样式的“口述置信度”是RLVR中校准方法的共同瓶颈。CREDO通过确定性读出（两token相对概率）替代采样，把校准损失变为可微回归，使梯度能直接落到置信度位置，并将置信-结果差异反馈为答案训练权重，由此同时改善准确率与校准，在数学与代码推理任务、域内外、以及下游拒绝/选择性预测中均取得最优表现，表明该通道设计具有通用价值，未来可扩展到带分级奖励模型的开域任务与生成过程中的置信度反馈。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains reasoning models to produce correct answers, but does not ensure that their stated confidence is calibrated. The resulting models are systematically overconfident. Recent methods train calibration inside the RLVR loop by having the model state a numerical confidence alongside its answer, but they all obtain the confidence by sampling it as text. This choice imposes two costs: a sampled confidence introduces variance and in practice collapses to a handful of distinct values, and sampling makes the confidence non-differentiable, forcing the calibration loss through a scalar reward. We propose CREDO (Confidence REaDOut) to replace sampling with a deterministic readout. While RLVR optimizes correctness, CREDO reads the confidence from a dedicated token pair in the model's output distribution and trains it by differentiable regression. CREDO further turns the trained confidence into a signal for accuracy, weighting rollouts by how far confidence and outcome disagree, so that accuracy and calibration improve together. Across mathematical and code reasoning, CREDO attains the best accuracy and calibration, and the gains extend to abstention and selective prediction.

</details>


### [1031] [Attention-based Hierarchical Variational Information Bottleneck for Robust Multi-Agent Communication under Variable Bandwidth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34860)
*Lukas Koch Vindbjerg,Qi Zhang,Yury Brodskiy,Lukas Esterle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AH-VIB提出了一种基于注意力机制的自回归变分通信模型，结合变分信息瓶颈(VIB)与层次化鲁棒性损失，用于解决多智能体在可变带宽、特别是前缀截断条件下通信的部分消息仍需保持可用性的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实多机器人系统中，带宽常因距离、干扰和环境遮挡而变化，导致消息只能部分到达。现有MARL通信方法多假设消息全到达或完全丢失，缺乏对前缀截断场景下消息维度排序（渐进式信息编码）的研究。

Method: 1) 将可变带宽建模为消息向量的前缀截断ρ=k/dm；2) 采用基于多头注意力的自回归消息编码器，每一维条件依赖先前维度，保证截断前缀的结构一致性；3) 引入层次化鲁棒性损失L_hier，通过铰链式惩罚Q_full与截断Q_k的差距，鼓励短前缀保留任务价值；4) 演员损失整合任务性能、VIB正则和层次损失三项。

Result: 在自定义协同物体检测与占据栅格建图任务（3个智能体，50×50栅格，d_m=32）上，AH-VIB在ρ=0.10和0.25最低带宽下取得最高均值回报（-0.2 vs VIB的-7.7、MADDPG的-5.4），且标准差显著降低（Δσ在-19.7至-23.8之间，对VIB的bootstrap概率100%）。在高带宽下CommNet略优。KL分析显示AH-VIB学到了更紧凑的消息表示。

Conclusion: AH-VIB通过自回归结构与层次化鲁棒性损失的协同设计，在带宽受限条件下显著提升了多智能体通信的可靠性和优雅降级能力，验证了渐进式信息编码作为带宽受限多机器人通信的有效设计原则。

Abstract: Learning-based multi-agent communication under limited bandwidth does not only require deciding what to communicate, but also structuring messages so that partial transmissions remain useful. We study this problem under prefix truncation, where only the first part of each message is received. To address it, we propose \textbf{AH-VIB}, an attention-based autoregressive variational communication model that combines a variational information bottleneck (VIB) with sequential message generation and a hierarchical robustness loss. We evaluate AH-VIB on a custom cooperative object-inspection and occupancy-mapping task, where agents equipped with a limited field-of-view sensor coordinate to scan inspection objects in an occupancy-grid world, under variable and fixed bandwidth conditions, and compare it against MADDPG, CommNet, a flat VIB baseline, and an autoregressive MLP ablation. AH-VIB achieves competitive mean return while improving performance reliability under the most constrained bandwidth conditions. These results indicate that AH-VIB improves the reliability and graceful degradation of learned communication under bandwidth constraints.

</details>


### [1032] [From Attention Sensitivity to Layer Role: Revisiting Mixed-Precision Quantization of Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34866)
*Nafiseh HosseinpourFardi,Negar Alihadi,Mahmoudreza Babaei,Milad Hosseini,Adrian Weller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出JAB框架，将Transformer混合精度后训练量化中注意力块的Q、K、V投影统一为单一联合目标同时用于权重重建与比特分配，并通过实验揭示"矩阵角色"在跨子层异构场景下比曲率敏感度更具分配信号价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练量化（PTQ）流水线通常以单矩阵权重重建为目标来拟合量化权重，却以另一种准则（如Hessian迹）来分配比特宽度——作者称这种"重建目标"与"重要性准则"之间的脱节为"代理差距"（proxy gap）。此外，针对注意力块，Q/K/V投影在softmax内部存在双线性耦合，分而治之可能丢失关键交互信号。

Method: 方法核心为JAB（Joint Attention-Based allocation）：（1）定义单一联合损失 $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{JAB}}$，对注意力块的Q/K/V拼接参数同时拟合真实的因果掩码注意力输出与softmax分布，含输出MSE与注意力图KL蒸馏项；（2）GPTQ预热初始化后用STE+LSQ进行联合微调；（3）以同一损失的Hessian迹（Hutchinson探针估计）作为敏感性评分，通过多重选择背包问题（MCKP）在参数加权预算下分配比特；（4）提出无需Hessian信息的Type-offset规则——按矩阵角色（q/k/v/o/gate/up/down）设定固定偏移量。结果在GPT-2 small与Mistral-7B上验证。

Result: 在仅注意力量化（Mistral-7B，3比特）下，JAB在四种标定/评估语料配对中恢复均匀GPTQ与全精度之间77%–90%的差距，其Hessian迹评分与需73次前向传播的oracle差距仅约0.17困惑度。但当MLP纳入分配后，JAB被无需敏感度估计的角色偏移规则（Type-offset）超越：Mistral-7B全模块量化在3比特下限下以4.5比特/参数实现6.933困惑度（fp16为6.643），压缩3.56×，14 GB降至3.93 GB；Type-offset仅用7个整数无需任何评分即优于JAB的7.250。另有两大发现：块局部重建目标与端到端困惑度可严重背离——某实验中块目标改善4.6×但困惑度反升32.5×；后训练量化似乎恢复注意力行为而非权重本身（KL项贡献88%的微调增益，权重可远离浮点值而注意力输出更接近）。

Conclusion: 联合目标在注意力场景下有效，但当模型含异构子层时，"权重在哪类矩阵"携带的分配信号强于任何可计算的曲率估计。注意力层面的重建与权重层面的重建并不等价：优化注意力输出与图可在远离浮点权重的同时降低困惑度。两个独立教训：（1）加性分配目标无法察觉低比特悬崖，3比特下限即可修复且无成本；（2）块局部目标的已认证改进并非全局改进的证据，量化管线必须以端到端指标验证每一步分配与微调。

Abstract: Most post-training quantization pipelines fit each weight matrix to its pretrained counterpart, one matrix at a time. Whether that proxy tracks what an attention block actually computes, or how errors in the Q, K and V projections compound inside the softmax, is rarely checked. We write the objective on the attention output instead, over all three projections at once, and reuse it throughout the pipeline. JAB defines one scalar loss over the joint Q, K, V weights of a block, evaluated against the block's real causally-masked attention output, and uses it twice: to fit the quantized weights (GPTQ warm start, then STE with learnable scales), and to score the block for a multiple-choice knapsack allocation. On attention-only quantization of Mistral-7B this works. At 3 bits JAB recovers 77-90% of the gap between uniform GPTQ and full precision, and its sensitivity estimate tracks an oracle costing 73 forward passes to within a fraction of a point. It stops working once MLP layers enter the allocation. A role-aware offset rule needing no sensitivity estimate at all beats JAB on GPT-2's MLP and on the full Mistral-7B model: with a 3-bit floor it quantizes 96.4% of the weights to 4.5 bits per parameter at 6.933 perplexity, within 4.4% of full precision (6.643) at 3.56x compression, against 7.158 for JAB at the same budget. Which matrix a weight sits in matters more than any sensitivity estimate we computed. Two things came out sideways. Block-local reconstruction is an unreliable proxy for end-to-end perplexity: one run improved a block's own objective 4.6x while perplexity rose 32x, which is why every allocation here is validated end-to-end. And on attention-only quantization, fine-tuning moved weights farther from their pretrained values while pulling attention outputs closer, with net gains. Post-training seems to recover attention behavior, not weights.

</details>


### [1033] [Reference-Tail Trust:Certified Probability Floors for Learned Updates Inside a Deployed Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34904)
*Abdolvahab Khalili Sadaghiani,Jose Nunez-Yanez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Reference-Tail Trust (RTT) 是一种针对已部署图神经网络（GNN）的认证框架，允许在冻结的内部网络中接纳学习到的状态更新，同时为实际服务的预测提供每节点概率下界和每调用损失预算保证。未通过认证的调用触发整调用回退至原始预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已部署的 GNN 模型在测试时引入学习更新（如传播规则变化、测试时适应）可能在平均指标上提升却对特定输入引入回归。需要一种机制在不替换原模型的前提下，按调用粒度决定是否接纳内部更新，并对实际服务的预测提供可验证的保护。
