Method: RTT 包含三个核心组件：(1) 参考尾部定价——通过冻结 incumbent 剩余的消息传递层将每个内部位移转换为最坏情况标签均匀的交叉熵增量；(2) 轨迹验证管——围绕执行轨迹构建区间管，以包含所有反事实连续路径的边界；(3) 独立检查器——在定向舍入算术下重新计算执行轨迹的管、因子、费用和下降条件，未通过则整调用回退。优化器在候选凸包内求解约束凸程序，使用支持函数特征实现对候选冗余的不变性。理论上推导了精确的概率下界前沿（通过注水算法）、架构受限效率刻画以及内部干预优于受限输出校正的信息条件。

Result: 在 ogbn-arxiv 审计中（2048 次调用，5 种扰动混合），RTT 实现每次调用均值增益 6.5×10⁻³ nats（95% CI [6.3, 6.7]），单侧 95% 回归率上界 0.95%，预留节点负翻转率上界 0.51%；均值增益为交叉拟合后验估计的输出空间前沿的 61%，比最强匹配单遍校正器高 +0.9×10⁻³ nats。代价为 1.42× incumbent 延迟、1.36× FLOPs（相比两遍顺序执行的 2.18×）。覆盖 8 种提议、6 种 incumbent 家族、分子预测（ogbg-molpcba AP 27.7→28.6）、ResNet-50 ImageNet-C（40.1%→45.6%）以及 TSA/STEM 适配。99.37% 调用首轮通过认证，0.34% 触发整调用回退。

Conclusion: RTT 将 GNN 适配从无条件的模型替换转变为预算化、可认证的推理决策。保护在检查器正确时独立于提议质量和部署标签；统计声明绑定于其抽样和选择假设。在近消除和长程证据机制下内部干预优于受限输出校正器，但证书保守性限制早期干预，全网络提议下两遍执行可能更快。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) need to exploit improved message passing without surrendering control over predictions already trusted in deployment. We introduce Reference-Tail Trust (RTT), a framework that admits learned updates inside a frozen GNN and certifies the prediction actually served. RTT couples graph-based proposal states with a constrained internal optimizer: each displacement is charged for its worst-case terminal cross-entropy increase through the incumbent's remaining message-passing layers. A trajectory-validated tube and an independent checker enforce per-node probability floors, $p^{\mathrm{s}}_{ic} \ge e^{-H_{\mathrm{row}}} p^{\mathrm{r}}_{ic}$, and a call-level budget, $\sum_i w_i D_\infty(p^{\mathrm{r}}_i \| p^{\mathrm{s}}_i) \le H^+$, uniformly over labels. Calls whose adapted outputs pass certification require no separate full incumbent rollout; failed certificates trigger whole-call fallback. We derive the exact probability-floor frontier by water-filling, characterize architecture-constrained efficiency, and establish conditions under which internal propagation exploits evidence unavailable to restricted output correctors. In the reported ogbn-arxiv audit, RTT achieves $6.5\times 10^{-3}$ nats of mean gain per call, with a one-sided 95% regression-rate upper bound of 0.95% and a 95% negative-flip upper bound of 0.51% on the uninspected part of the reserved node population. Its mean gain is 61% of a cross-fitted posterior-based frontier estimate and exceeds the strongest matched one-pass corrector by $+0.9\times 10^{-3}$ nats. Reported experiments span eight proposals, six graph-incumbent families, structural and temporal graph shifts, and molecular prediction, with additional image and tabular evaluations. RTT makes GNN adaptation a budgeted, certifiable inference decision rather than an unconditional model replacement.

</details>


### [1034] [Drug-Target Interaction Prediction via Hierarchical Sequential Cross-Attention over Chemical and Protein Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34921)
*Khadidja Henni,Hamza Abdelali,Abdelkrim Aries,Neila Mezghani,Brigitte Vannier,Sara Magdouli,Lina Abou-Abbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于序列的药物-靶点相互作用(DTI)预测架构，结合ChemBERTa(药物SMILES)和ESM-2(蛋白序列)两个预训练语言模型，通过1D CNN局部特征提取、序贯双向交叉注意力(受诱导契合原理启发)和注意力池化构建交互感知向量，仅用 25.2M 训练参数就在 BIOSNAP、Davis 和 BindingDB 上取得有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于序列的 DTI 预测方法通常在独立编码药物和蛋白后，仅在最终预测阶段进行晚期融合，限制了显式建模化学子结构与蛋白序列区域间细粒度跨分子依赖关系的能力。

Method: 1) 使用 ChemBERTa 和 ESM-2 作为预训练编码器(仅微调顶部两层)；2) 1D CNN(kernel=3, 128通道, MaxPool)压缩局部序列模式；3) 序贯双向交叉注意力：先用药物上下文精炼蛋白表示(公式4)，再用精炼后的蛋白表示精炼药物表示(公式5)；4) 注意力池化(可学习评分机制)保留位置信息；5) MLP(2d→256→128→1)二元预测头，二元交叉熵损失。

Result: BIOSNAP 上 AUROC=0.920, AUPRC=0.924 均为最佳；Davis 上 AUROC=0.920 匹配最佳，敏感性最高(0.901)，但 AUPRC=0.356 偏低；BindingDB 上 AUROC=0.920, AUPRC=0.642 具竞争力。冷启动测试中未见蛋白 ROC-AUC=0.87 优于 MolTrans(0.77)和 DeepDTA(0.85)。消融：去除 CNN 后 AUROC 由 0.920 降至 0.916；去除交叉注意力降至 0.911；序贯注意力优于并行注意力(AUROC 0.920 vs 0.914)。训练参数仅 25.2M，相比 MolTrans(62.8M)、DLM-DTI(86.7M)、全 BERT 微调(353M)分别减少 2.5×、3.4×、14×。

Conclusion: 该架构验证了预训练语言模型+CNN+序贯交叉注意力在 DTI 预测中的有效性，仅用 25.2M 参数即取得有竞争力结果；主要局限在于：纯序列方法缺乏结构信息、Davis 上 AUPRC 低反映类别不平衡下的精度限制、基线对比基于文献报告值非完全受控复现。未来方向包括引入分子图/3D 结构、注意力图验证、全受控基准复现。

Abstract: Predicting Drug-Target Interactions~(DTIs) is a central task in computational drug discovery, with direct applications in virtual screening, drug repurposing, and therapeutic candidate prioritization. Although recent deep learning methods have improved DTI prediction, many sequence-based models still process drugs and proteins independently and only combine their representations at a late prediction stage. This limits their ability to explicitly model cross-molecular dependencies between chemical substructures and protein sequence regions. In this paper, we propose a sequence-only DTI prediction architecture that combines two pre-trained language models, ChemBERTa for drug SMILES strings and ESM-2 for protein amino acid sequences, with a hierarchical interaction module. The proposed model first extracts contextual representations using pre-trained encoders, then applies 1D convolutional layers to condense local sequence patterns, followed by a sequential bidirectional cross-attention mechanism inspired by the induced-fit view of molecular recognition. Finally, attention-based pooling constructs fixed-size interaction-aware vectors for binary prediction. Experiments on BIOSNAP, Davis, and BindingDB show that the proposed model achieves the best performance on BIOSNAP, matches the best AUROC on Davis, and remains competitive on BindingDB while using only 25.2 million trainable parameters. Ablation results confirm the contribution of both the CNN and cross-attention modules, and cold-start experiments indicate promising generalization to unseen proteins and drugs.

</details>


### [1035] [Audit the Scaffold, Not the Checkpoint: A Stationarity Dichotomy for Recursive Self-Improvement in Agentic Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34924)
*Sebastian Bobadilla-Suarez,Bob Suh,Ryan Fortin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"平稳性二分法"：当智能体的可达编辑集合固定时，迭代自我修改必然遭遇严格递减收益；只有扩展该可达集合才能打破天花板。论文主张审计应聚焦于scaffold（脚手架/工具链）而非checkpoint（权重冻结状态），因为即使权重完全冻结，重写scaffold也能在不动权重的前提下扩展可达类，从而绕过表观的"安全饱和"假象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着Anthropic报告其80%以上生产代码由Claude编写，智能体编程已成为AI递归自我改进（RSI）研究的核心场景。然而现有实践缺乏严格的数学基础：应部署多少智能体、如何构造patch、何时停止迭代均为经验性操作。更关键的是，当前的安全审计框架（如Google DeepMind、OpenAI、Anthropic的评估规范）以"权重是否冻结"为主要监控指标，但这一指标存在根本缺陷——它无法捕获通过scaffold重写而发生的可达类扩张。论文试图回答：迭代自我修改何时耗尽空间？冻结的checkpoint是否是耗尽的证据？

Method: 论文将智能体编程建模为残差预测（gradient boosting on residual error）：弱编码智能体预测当前草案与目标之间的残差（表示为git diff/patch），而非从头生成完整文件。在理论层面，将该过程形式化为"精化博弈"（refinement game），并提出三个核心定理：(1) 定理2：单调改进定理——在质量度量有界（V≤1）下，总改进量∑ηₜ≤1-V(z₀)，从而饱和；(2) 命题3（平稳性二分法）：固定天花板⇒严格递减收益；持续边沿⇒发散；(3) 推论4（冻结权重天花板）：冻结权重仅保证最终天花板V*(W)，不保证路径上的平稳行为。在编排层面，证明命题5（最佳k选择恰好实现最佳工人的天花板，无法超越）、命题6（多数投票零错误的充要条件是m*<k/2）、命题7（重复使用固定池具有可计算边界）。所有代数推导在Lean 4中机器验证（含refuting一个猜想中的严格不等式）。实验层面：Part A用合成标签验证实现；Part B用mini-swe-agent在SWE-bench Lite 55任务×5种子上做2×3模型层级×反馈模式设计（1,650条轨迹）；Part C分析401个生产会话对比9,395个前AI人类基线。

Result: Part B：模型层级效应显著（partial η²=0.497, p<0.0001），Sonnet解决率85-89%，Haiku仅44-49%；反馈模式效应在K=55下为underpowered null（p=0.61，达到80%功效需7-9倍样本）。关键发现：精化趋于幂等——80.7%（Haiku）/69.1%（Sonnet）的轨迹从未改变质量，每轮平均改进衰减为0.097→0.036→0.033（Haiku）和0.156→0.068→0.029（Sonnet）。重叠统计m*=k=30处于最大值，多数票在23/55（42%）任务上失败（投票误差0.418, 95% CI [0.291, 0.545]）。Part C：70.0%多提交会话的代码改动量递减，几何衰减因子ρ≈0.77；与人类前AI基线（ρ=0.86）形状相同，表明饱和模式非AI特有；Opus与Sonnet在survivor ratio上无差异（ψ差=-0.003, 95% CI [-0.075, +0.069], p=0.93）。

Conclusion: 论文得出三个核心结论：(1) 审计scaffold而非checkpoint——冻结权重不构成安全饱和的充分条件，监管应监测scaffold是否自我扩展；(2) 同样的天花板在水平方向也成立——best-of-k编排无法超越最佳工人的天花板，加权投票需要的多样性在实际同族工作者中缺失；(3) 部署循环与boosting的差异在于"组合"与"保留"的结构差异——patch顺序组合而非并列投票——这两点是工程选择而非代码定律，共同指明了一个值得构建的harness设计方向。论文的核心信息是：测量的不是理论正确性，而是饱和——SWE-bench与401生产会话均落入有界制度；至于机制层面（固定可达类还是普通编辑经济学），尚需"固定权重同时变化scaffold"的实验设计来分离。本文是一篇"饱和与限制"论文而非"加速处方"，作者不发布任何扩展可达类的技术或scaffold。

Abstract: An auditor who checks whether a system's weights are frozen is checking the wrong thing. Our stationarity dichotomy says that iterative self-modification hits strict diminishing returns whenever the agent's reachable set of edits stays fixed, and can escape only if that set expands. Rewriting scaffolding (tools, verifiers, decomposition) expands what an agent reaches without touching a weight, so frozen weights buy an eventual ceiling but no stationarity along the way. The criterion also separates three regimes usually merged: search within a fixed class, test-time training that raises the ceiling itself, and scaffold rewriting between them. Audit the scaffold, not the checkpoint. The same ceiling binds sideways. Best-of-$k$ orchestration realizes the best worker's ceiling exactly: width buys rate, not budget. Re-consulting a fixed pool has a horizon computable in advance, decided by the pool alone, and the one arrangement that would beat it, a weighted vote, needs diversity real workers lack: on 30 same-family workers the failure overlap sits at its maximum, and a majority fails 23/55 (42%) of tasks. We obtain the criterion by reading refinement as gradient boosting on the residual error between draft and target, a patch or git diff, and then measuring where that reading breaks: patches compose instead of standing beside each other to be voted on, and failures overlap. What we measure is saturation. Per-round improvement decays toward zero on SWE-bench, and churn decays geometrically across 401 production sessions, a shape shared with a pre-AI human baseline that establishes the regime without identifying its cause. Both breaks are engineering choices rather than laws about code, so together they specify a harness worth building.

</details>


### [1036] [Cyclostationary Phase Conditioning for Medical Time Series Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34965)
*Samuel Ruiperez-Campillo,Michele Copetti,Jorge da Silva Goncalves,Sonia Laguna,Julia E. Vogt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PTSDiff，一种基于循环平稳性先验的生理时序信号扩散去噪框架，通过平移协变小波表示与逐样本相位条件两大归纳偏置，结合训练无关的循环平稳性指数和反轨迹对偶耦合采样，在四种生理模态上实现当前最优的信号恢复性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心电（ECG）、脑电（EEG）、光电容积描记（PPG）和肌电（EMG）等生理时序具有循环平稳性（统计量随相位周期变化）。现有扩散方法仅以被污染观测为条件，须隐式学习周期性结构。本文探究显式建模循环相位是否能提升信号恢复质量，并能否在训练前预判收益。

Method: 1. 平移协变小波帧（SWT，J=4）：扩散在平稳小波域进行，消除对窗口起始位置的敏感性。2. 学习的稠密相位场（Φ̂）：由相位编码器从被污染输入估计5通道相位信息（含循环内位置φ、正弦余弦嵌入、局部循环速率r、事件掩码m），以帧变换后拼接于U-Net输入；ECG用分析型QRS检测器做预热初始化。3. 上下文编码器经FiLM调制提供全局信息。4. 训练无关的循环平稳性指数Π（基于相位对齐平均或自相关代理），预判相位条件收益。5. 训练目标融合噪声预测L1重建与时序形态梯度惩罚。6. 反向轨迹对偶耦合（AV-K）：以K/2对反相起点降低采样方差，在相同NFE下以1对对偶即可匹配或超越10条独立轨迹。

Result: 在PPG（PPG-DaLiA/BIDMC）、ECG（PTB-XL/MIT-BIH/QTDB）、EMG（NinaPro DB2/DB3）、EEG（EEGdenoiseNet/EEGMMIDB）四个模态九个数据集上，PTSDiff-AV-10在所有模态ΔSNR最佳，三/四模态在PRD和CC亦最优；在三个ECG数据集上对所有基线（含FIR、SWT、TCDAE、DeScoD、TFCDiff）均达统计显著优势（配对Wilcoxon经Holm-Bonferroni校正，p<0.001）。跨数据集无重训练下迁移仍保持领先（EEG除外）。下游任务（HR估计、PTB-XL超诊断AUROC、MIT-BIH F1、肌电激活平衡准确率、EEG频段功率误差）均匹配或超越最佳基线。Π_AC排序PPG>ECG>EEG>EMG，与去除相位条件的损失排序一致；合成实验显示相位条件收益随Π增大（r=0.85）。ECG上AV-2即超越MC-10，NFE缩减5倍且时钟减少约5倍。

Conclusion: PTSDiff证明显式编码可测量的循环平稳结构能系统性改善生理时序去噪，相位条件收益随信号循环强度单调可预测；学习的相位编码器（而非分析检测器）是关键；对偶耦合采样在匹配NFE下提供免费的方差缩减。该框架为针对可测量循环平稳性设计时序模型开辟了方向。局限：当前为单通道、合成噪声、循环平稳性–收益关系有待更多真实伪迹验证；扩散方法计算开销仍高于单遍去噪。

Abstract: Many physiological time series, such as cardiac and brain recordings, exhibit cyclostationarity: their statistics vary periodically with an underlying cycle phase. Corruption from motion, poor contact, and physiological interference obscures morphology needed for diagnosis, making signal restoration essential. Existing diffusion approaches condition on corrupted observations alone and must learn cyclic structure implicitly. We instead propose two inductive biases which encode cyclostationarity: a shift-covariant wavelet representation and dense per-sample phase conditioning inferred from the corrupted input. We further introduce a training-free cyclostationarity index that quantifies phase structure and predicts when phase conditioning will help. Finally, we propose antithetic coupling of reverse trajectories to reduce sampling variance while achieving comparable performance with fivefold fewer network evaluations. Across modalities, our results show that explicitly encoding measurable cyclic structure improves physiological time-series restoration.

</details>


### [1037] [Composable Decoding on the Probability Simplex: Theory and Implementation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34992)
*Xiaotong Ji,Ahmed Khaled Khamis,Rasul Tutunov,Matthieu Zimmer,Haitham Bou-Ammar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将大语言模型解码重新定义为概率单纯形上的正则化优化问题，通过组合多个分布性偏好（如KL/JS散度、熵、覆盖率、多样性）在单一目标中实现，无需外部奖励、学习评判器或模型参数更新。核心贡献包括：(1) 推导KKT最优性条件，证实贪心、softmax、Top-K、Top-P、Sparsemax等标准解码器是该框架的特例；(2) 提出基于正则器加权和的目标组合机制，并引入Best-of-K (BoK) 解码作为新用例（结合KL正则化与K次采样覆盖效用）；(3) 实现开源库CompoSimplex，支持可配置的支持规则、正则化基元和单纯形求解器，集成Transformers与vLLM后端；(4) 在4个模型–基准（MATH500、GPQA Diamond、IFEval、LiveCodeBench v6）上系统评测，证明组合目标能在单样本质量、多样本成功率与多样性之间实现单一目标无法达到的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM解码方法（贪解码、Top-K、Top-P、Min-p、η采样等）被视为零散的启发式技巧，缺乏统一的理论框架来理解其隐含目标及相互关系。实践者只能凭直觉调参，无法系统地组合多种分布性偏好（如贴近模型分布、保持多样性、提高多样本覆盖率）。需要一个统一的优化视角将解码形式化，使新解码器能通过配置组合分布偏好，并保持互补优势。

Method: 方法核心是将解码建模为概率单纯形上的正则化优化问题：q*_t = argmax_{q∈Δ(V)} [⟨q, s_t⟩ - λΩ(q)], s.t. q∈C_t，其中s_t为模型logits，Ω为正则器，C_t为支持约束。推导KKT条件证明标准解码器是该框架特例（贪心=λ=0；softmax=负Shannon熵；Top-K/Top-P=受限支持上的负熵；Sparsemax=ℓ₂惩罚）。多个正则器通过加权求和Ω_α(q)=Σα_i Ω_i(q)组合，最优性条件中各正则器梯度可加性贡献。对无闭式解的组合目标，使用以负熵为势函数的镜像上升法求解，乘性更新天然保持分布合法性。引入BoK解码作为组合用例：Ω = α_KL·KL(q∥p_t) - α_U·Σ w_t(v)[1-(1-q(v))^K]，其中效用项鼓励K次采样中的token覆盖。CompoSimplex库实现支持规则（Top-k、Top-p、Min-p、η采样、典型采样）、正则化基元（KL/JS/熵/Coverage/Diversity）和求解器，支持镜像上升与闭式解，并通过自定义logits处理器集成HuggingFace Transformers与vLLM。

Result: 在四个模型-基准上系统对比标准采样器、单一正则器与组合：(1) MATH500+Qwen2.5-7B（Top-k）：KL+Diversity保持KL的pass@1=64.4%同时将pass@16从88.4%提升至90.0%；(2) GPQA+Qwen3-4B-Base（typical）：JS+Diversity将pass@16从80.8%提升至82.8%；(3) LiveCodeBench v6+Gemma-4-26B-A4B-IT（Top-p）：JS+Coverage的pass@4达66.9%，超过JS（65.7%）与Coverage（64.6%）。关键发现：组合在单样本质量、多样本成功率、语义多样性的Pareto前沿上覆盖更大区域；pass@1相对基线的最大增益（+10.6pp）大于pass@16（+5.1pp），表明正则化有效集中质量；强正则化（λ=2）下，单一Coverage/Diversity的pass@1降至41.0%/39.8%，而组合目标仍保持57.0%-62.6%；闭式正则器（KL/熵）开销与基线相当（1.13×），迭代求解器为1.13-2.88×；10步镜像上升、步长0.1时L₁距离0.033-0.062。

Conclusion: 本文将LLM解码统一为概率单纯形上的正则化优化框架，从理论层面将标准解码器恢复为特例，并通过加权正则器组合实现无需外部奖励/学习评判器/模型更新的新型解码器。CompoSimplex库提供可配置组件（支持规则、正则化基元、求解器）与统一评测接口。BoK解码作为组合用例展示如何平衡模型保真度与多样本覆盖。跨四个模型与基准的实验证明，组合目标在单样本准确性、多样本成功率和多样性之间的权衡是单一正则化目标无法达到的，且在强正则化下表现更稳健。该框架为通过显式可组合目标设计并评估解码策略提供了理论与实践基础。

Abstract: Decoding for large language models is typically treated as a collection of isolated sampling strategies, with limited theoretical understanding of the behaviours they induce and how their underlying objectives relate. We formulate decoding as an optimisation problem over next-token distributions on the probability simplex, balancing expected model score against regularisation under support constraints. This view recovers familiar decoding methods through choices of regularisers and support constraints; more importantly, it enables new decoders to be constructed by composing distributional preferences within a single optimisation problem without external rewards, learned critics, or model parameter updates. We introduce CompoSimplex, a library with configurable support rules, regularisation primitives, and simplex solvers for constructing and evaluating compositional decoders. We evaluate standard samplers, individual regularisers, and compositions across multiple models and reasoning tasks. Our results show that compositions can realise trade-offs between single-sample quality, multi-sample quality, and diversity that are not attained by individual decoding objectives.

</details>


### [1038] [Addressing Spatial Indistinguishability in Spatiotemporal Prediction via Optimal Transport-Guided Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35021)
*Guangyu Wang,Jiawei Tong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出STOT（SpatioTemporal Optimal Transport）自监督框架，通过最优传输引导的结构化掩码策略解决时空预测中的"空间不可区分性"问题。在六个真实数据集上验证有效性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时空预测中，不同节点可能具有相似的历史模式却演化出截然不同的未来趋势（即"空间不可区分性"），这一现象在实际传感器网络中占比超过50%。现有嵌入方法和GNN方法依赖历史相似性，无法捕捉未来行为差异，导致预测性能下降。

Method: 1. 设计时间步级别的空间不可区分性度量指标（基于高低相似性阈值之比）；2. 构建OT引导的掩码生成策略，通过Sinkhorn算法求解最优传输问题；3. 引入批次一致性约束和随机游走机制增强语义连贯性与多样性；4. 采用MAE架构进行掩码预训练，将SI增强表示与下游预测器融合。

Result: 在PeMS03/04/07/08、METR-LA、PeMS-BAY六个数据集上，STOT在MAE、RMSE、MAPE三项指标上均优于或与SOTA方法相当；高空间不可区分性子集上长程预测优势明显；Sinkhorn子步骤计算开销仅约0.21ms/批次，节点数量增长时仍保持高效；OT传输计划可视化揭示早晚高峰时段不可区分性最严重。

Conclusion: STOT通过OT引导的掩码机制将空间模糊性建模为消歧问题，兼顾有效性与可解释性；局限性在于OT在大规模节点或极长序列下存在计算瓶颈，且未充分纳入外生变量。未来工作包括快速OT近似、外生协变量融合以及异常检测与跨城市迁移。

Abstract: Spatiotemporal prediction aims to learn discriminative representations from correlated temporal signals over spatial structures for accurate future inference. A central challenge is \emph{spatial indistinguishability}: different nodes may share similar historical patterns yet evolve toward divergent futures, severely degrading forecasting performance in real-world sensor networks. Existing embedding-based and graph neural network (GNN)-based approaches can partially detect such ambiguous nodes but rely on historical similarity, struggling to capture \emph{future behavioral divergence}. We propose \textbf{STOT} (\textbf{S}patio\textbf{T}emporal \textbf{O}ptimal \textbf{T}ransport), a self-supervised framework that resolves spatiotemporal ambiguity via structured masking guided by optimal transport. Our key idea treats indistinguishability as a \emph{disambiguation} problem: future states are inferred by exploiting concurrent spatial correlations and their time-varying similarity. We design a similarity-aware metric for dynamic inter-node relationships and an optimal transport-based masking strategy to emphasize ambiguous positions during pre-training. A batch consistency constraint preserves semantic coherence, while a random-walk masking mechanism promotes structured context exploration. Experiments on six real-world datasets show that STOT performs competitively with state-of-the-art baselines on the evaluated benchmarks and improved interpretability through transport-plan visualizations.

</details>


### [1039] [VEX-Bench: Benchmarking Verification Complexity of LLM-Generated Misinformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35028)
*Hanxun Huang,Yutao Wu,Qizhou Wang,Silvia Montaña-Niño,Yige Li,Xiang Zheng,Elif Buse Doyuran,Phoebe Matich,Xiao Liu,Xingjun Ma,Sarah Erfani,Christopher Leckie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出VEX-Bench基准，用于评估LLM生成虚假信息的"验证复杂度"——即在事实核查筛选阶段，内容对有限验证资源的消耗程度。该基准融合新闻学和事实核查实践，定义了五个评估维度（可核查性、危害显著性、信源可信度、伪装合法性、验证成本），并提出VEX分数综合衡量抽取成功率与验证复杂度。实验覆盖7个前沿LLM与7种生成方法，共生成5,880篇文章，结果显示生成与验证之间存在3至169倍的成本不对称，且高VEX内容会优先获得筛选关注，造成系统性资源错配风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前针对LLM生成虚假信息的评估主要集中在生成阶段（能否被检测、能否被成功抽取），但忽略了这些内容在真实信息渠道中对有限验证资源的下游影响。事实核查机构、平台和媒体在严格的时间、人力和预算约束下，需要通过筛选来优先决定验证哪些内容。现有的基于"成功率"的安全评估指标将抽取效果与下游风险混为一谈，可能高估攻击者的实际效用。因此，需要一个新的评估维度来衡量虚假信息在筛选阶段呈现的"验证复杂度"，量化其对真实验证系统的负担。

Method: 方法包含三个核心部分：（1）**基准构建**：定义设置元组(t, d, q)（任务类别、领域、主题），涵盖两类任务（fabrication全新生成与rewrite基于真实文章改写）、6个高风险领域（健康、政治、公共安全、金融、身份群体、环境）和60个中性话题，采用结构化JSON输出；（2）**五维评估协议**：基于新闻学和事实核查实践定义可核查性(D1)、危害显著性(D2)、信源可信度(D3)、伪装合法性(D4)、验证成本(D5)五个维度，各以1–5分制评分；提出VEX分数综合抽取成功率(SR)、非拒绝率(NR)与所有非空维度子集(31种组合)的平均分；（3）**评估者验证**：采用LLM-as-judge进行可扩展评估，遵循内容分析方法论，使用序数Krippendorff α度量评估者间一致性（人–人、人–LLM、LLM–LLM），并辅以事实核查代理提供下游验证信号（claim support、entity integrity）。

Result: 主要发现包括：（1）fabrication与rewrite任务暴露不同的安全盲点——rewrite继承源文章的可信度信号但引入系统性扭曲，fabrication因缺少信源使验证成本(D5)更突出；（2）高抽取成功率不等于高验证复杂度——ISC、DisinfoCap、MisinfoQA虽成功率接近（≥95%）但验证复杂度差异显著，表明仅基于成功的评估会低估风险；（3）模型与方法交互效应显著——DisinfoCap+Grok-4.1组合在62个维度组合中排名第一达11次，PoisonedRAG达15次，但最高VEX内容并非始终来自最有效的抽取方法或风险最高的模型；（4）生成与验证间存在3×–169×的成本不对称，Qwen3.5-Flash和Grok-4.1-Fast每篇生成成本仅约0.1美分，验证成本却超过20美分；（5）fabrication任务中，模型善于引用真实机构（如美联储），但伪造的人物身份和联系方式构成可复用的"模型指纹"；（6）评估者验证显示Krippendorff α在主判断–人标注对上达到tentative至reliable区间（≥0.667–0.800），D3维度的agreement最强。

Conclusion: VEX-Bench将验证复杂度形式化为虚假信息风险的独立评估维度，揭示了基于成功率的安全指标的局限性。LLM可低成本生成高VEX内容，这些内容在筛选阶段容易被优先处理，从而消耗稀缺的事实验证资源，构成资源受限验证系统中的系统性误配风险。该基准为评估安全干预措施对下游验证负担的影响提供了统一框架，推动安全评估从"能否生成有害内容"向"对真实验证系统的影响"转变。作者强调这是风险评估工作而非攻击开发，所有数据均经过去标识化处理。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made misinformation inexpensive to produce but not to verify, creating a growing asymmetry in the information ecosystem. Under tight time, labor, and budget constraints, media organizations, platforms, and fact-checkers rely on screening to prioritize which content to verify. We introduce VEX-Bench, a unified benchmark for evaluating the verification complexity of LLM-generated misinformation, as perceived during screening, across models and generation methods. Verification complexity is assessed along multiple dimensions derived from journalistic and fact-checking practices, capturing checkability, harm potential, source credibility signals, imposter legitimacy, and expected verification effort. We define the VEX score as an integrated measure combining elicitation yield and verification complexity to quantify how generated content consumes limited verification capacity. We construct a benchmark spanning two misinformation categories, 6 high-stakes domains, and 60 real-world topics, and evaluate 7 frontier LLMs and 7 generation methods, yielding 5{,}880 articles. We employ an LLM-as-judge for scalable evaluation and validate it using content-analysis methodology, including ordinal Krippendorff $\alpha$ for inter-annotator reliability, complemented by fact-checking agents for verification. Our findings show that no single method dominates all dimensions, underscoring the need for multi-dimensional evaluation. LLMs can generate high-VEX misinformation at 3$\times$ to 169$\times$ lower cost than agent-based verification. Such content is often prioritized during screening, consuming scarce verification resources and introducing a systematic risk of misallocation in resource-constrained verification systems. The code is publicly available in our \href{ this https URL }{GitHub repository}.

</details>


### [1040] [BA-DPO: Bias-Adjusted Direct Preference Optimization for Language Model Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35044)
*Antonio Ferrara,Alberto Rumi,Francesco Bonchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BA-DPO 是对 DPO 的扩展，通过为每个标注者添加针对特定属性的偏置参数，解决偏好对齐中标注者系统性偏差（如性别、种族、长度等）被吸收并放大的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 DPO 基于 Bradley-Terry 模型假设标注者无偏，但实际标注者存在系统性偏差（如对长度、格式、签名等属性的偏好），这些偏差在对齐过程中被吸收并放大到策略中，使对齐模型偏离真实质量信号。

Method: 基于 BARP 模型，将每个标注者的偏差建模为对特定声明属性的可加偏置参数 θ_k，仅作用于奖励而不参与配分函数。损失函数为 L_BA-DPO = -E[log σ(u + b_k)]，其中 u 是 DPO 的隐式奖励边际，b_k = θ_k · Δδ。提出 pooled（共享标量）、per-annotator（每标注者独立参数）和 shared-mean（共享均值+偏差）三种参数化变体。理论上证明了目标函数关于偏置参数是凸的，且投票确定各标注者偏差之差（至一个共享常数），该常数决定对齐模型的属性率。

Result: 在 Signed-UltraFeedback（注入偏差）上，DPO 将属性概率从 0.50 推至 0.96-0.99，BA-DPO 移除 81-95% 的偏移；在 MultiPref（真实标注者）上，BA-DPO 移除 DPO 所致长度增加的约一半。在 0.5B（全参数微调）和 8B/7B（LoRA）上均有效，KL 散度不高于 DPO，判断质量无损失。学习的偏置参数与注入值相关性达 r=0.95-0.98，可准确预测各标注者的投票。

Conclusion: BA-DPO 通过显式建模标注者偏差，成功将共享偏差从偏好信号中分离并移除，且无需奖励模型或额外网络。其识别性分析揭示了一个无法由数据决定的自由常数（决定属性率），可通过参考策略锚定或目标率锚定（如统计平价）来设定。方法在多个模型、规模和属性上一致有效，验证了通用性。

Abstract: Preference-based alignment methods such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) use pairwise preferences labeled by human annotators to fine-tune language models. However, annotators carry systematic biases toward some attributes: a name that signals a gender or an ethnicity, a persona, a language variety, a formatting convention, or length. If not properly addressed, these systematic biases can be absorbed and amplified during alignment. Existing methods address length bias or annotator disagreement, but fail to eliminate biases toward arbitrary attributes. To address this limitation, we propose Bias-Adjusted DPO (BA-DPO), a generalization of DPO that adds one bias parameter per annotator toward responses carrying a declared attribute. We prove that the objective is convex in the bias parameters and that the votes identify each annotator's bias up to a shared constant. The remaining constant is what fixes the aligned model's attribute rate: by default the rate of the reference model, or a target rate, which we use to bring a biased policy to statistical parity. On a corpus with planted biases, DPO drives the attribute from a balanced start to probability 0.96 and BA-DPO removes 81 to 95\% of that shift; on MultiPref with real annotators it removes about half of DPO's lengthening. Both hold at 0.5B with full fine-tuning and at 8B with LoRA, at no higher KL than DPO and no loss in judged quality.

</details>


### [1041] [TIDE: Teacher-Student Transition via Informative Distillation and Exploration for Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35058)
*Yibin Huang,Xinming Xu,Conghui Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TIDE方法，通过两尺度（全局训练调度+局部轮次分配）动态协调多轮智能体强化学习中在线策略蒸馏(OPD)与强化学习(RL)的权重分配。全局使用教师-学生分歧趋势作为事件信号触发OPD到RL的渐进交接，局部结合相对动作价值与分歧度在轨迹内分配师生指导与奖励驱动的更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定权重的OPD-RL混合方法存在两个尺度上的问题：(1) 全局层面，持续的强蒸馏压力会限制学生模型超越教师能力；(2) 局部层面，师生分歧无法区分有价值的探索与低质量策略漂移。因此需要动态重新平衡教师指导与奖励优化的关系。

Method: 两尺度设计：①全局控制器用EMA平滑的批次级师生分歧趋势作为事件信号，当分歧缓慢下降但仍为正时逐步增大RL权重，减小OPD权重(λ↓, β↑)；②局部调制器对每个轮次计算相对动作价值Q_t(基于GiGPO的匹配历史分组)和分歧度D_t，归一化后以乘积z_t=Q̃_t×D̃_t作为OPD轮次权重，以D̃_t作为RL轮次权重，组合优势A^TIDE=β_k·w_t^RL·Q_t+λ_k·w_t^OPD·δ_{t,j}，用裁剪替代目标优化。

Result: 在WebShop和ALFWorld上以Qwen2.5-Instruct 1.5B/3B/7B为学生模型：1.5B达WebShop SR 77.2%、ALFWorld 86.0%；3B和7B在WebShop SR上均取得最高(79.0%和83.2%)；7B在ALFWorld达92.1%。消融实验显示分歧触发交接优于固定1:1、线性、余弦和成功率调度；乘积融合优于加性融合；移除任一信号均导致性能下降。SearchQA上全局交接也带来3.1点的EM提升。额外计算开销可忽略(教师前向占5-11%)。

Conclusion: TIDE通过两尺度OPD-RL协调机制有效解决了固定混合方法的局限性：全局用分歧趋势自适应调度师生指导的权重，局部用相对价值与分歧联合分配轮次级更新信号。该方法在多基准和多规模上均优于现有混合基线，且对超参数ζ和η在5倍范围内鲁棒。

Abstract: Effective multi-turn agents require interaction strategies that coordinate information gathering, actions, and feedback over long horizons. GRPO is a reinforcement learning algorithm used to train these agents, but sparse trajectory-level rewards limit early exploration in small models. Recent methods augment RL with on-policy distillation (OPD) from a stronger teacher. However, a fixed mixture assumes that teacher guidance and reward optimization should retain a constant relative role throughout training and across interaction turns. This assumption can fail at two scales. Globally, as training progresses, maintaining strong distillation pressure can constrain the model from moving beyond the teacher's capabilities. Locally, teacher--student disagreement identifies where the student departs from the teacher, but cannot tell whether that departure is exploration supported by better outcomes or low-quality policy drift. Our methodological insight is that teacher guidance and reward optimization should be dynamically rebalanced over training and jointly allocated across turns. We instantiate this insight in \tide. Globally, \tide uses the measured disagreement trend as a practical schedule signal, advancing an OPD-to-RL handoff when discrepancy reduction becomes slow but remains positive and progressively increasing the relative weight of RL. Locally, \tide jointly modulates teacher-guided and reward-driven updates: relative action value and disagreement prioritize the OPD signal, whereas relative action value supplies the RL advantage and normalized disagreement reweights it across turns. Coupled with the global handoff, \tide allocates stronger teacher guidance early and gives reward-driven updates greater relative weight later in training. Experiments across multiple benchmarks, student scales, and controlled ablations support the effectiveness of TIDE's adaptive OPD--RL coordination.

</details>


### [1042] [SpikeLite: Lightweight Spiking Neural Networks for Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35097)
*Bang Hu,Changze Lv,Mingjie Li,Xiaoqing Zheng,Wei cao,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SpikeLite是一个面向时间序列预测的轻量级脉冲神经网络框架，通过频率选择性脉冲编码器（FSSE）和稀疏脉冲通道注意力（SSCA）两个核心模块，在保持预测精度的同时显著降低能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SNN预测模型通过引入复杂的注意力机制或专门的神经元动力学来追求更高精度，削弱了SNN的轻量化优势。SpikeLite旨在解决如何在保持SNN能效优势的同时维持预测准确性的核心问题。

Method: 1. 频率选择性脉冲编码器（FSSE）：利用LIF神经元的低通滤波特性，通过并行LIF分支和可学习衰减因子，将输入序列重组为频率敏感分量，同时通过逐次差分构造保持输入的完整性。2. 稀疏脉冲通道注意力（SSCA）：通过从频谱描述符学习二值交互掩码，在脉冲驱动的自注意力中选择性交换跨通道信息，抑制冗余连接。3. 可选轻量化路径：当不需要显式通道交互时，可仅使用FSSE的通道独立路径。

Result: 在SeqSNN协议下（4个标准多变量基准），SpikeLite达到平均R²=0.790和RSE=0.440的最优综合性能；在SpikF协议下（8个长期预测基准），平均MSE=0.343、MAE=0.345为最低。在ECL数据集上，SpikeLite实现最低能耗95.30μJ，比SpikF降低约19.0%，比iTransformer降低约97.1%。

Conclusion: SpikeLite通过FSSE的频率敏感编码和SSCA的选择性跨通道交互，在标准多变量和长期预测基准上均取得领先的预测精度，同时在能耗方面具有显著优势，是面向能效敏感应用场景的高效时间序列预测框架。局限在于当前仅在完整窗口数据上验证，未来将扩展到不规则时间序列、缺失数据预测以及神经形态硬件实现。

Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient paradigm for time-series forecasting through spike-driven computation. However, recent SNN forecasters often pursue higher accuracy through increasingly complex attention mechanisms, or specialized neuronal dynamics, weakening the lightweight motivation of SNNs. We introduce SpikeLite, a spiking forecasting framework built around two modules: a Frequency-Selective Spiking Encoder (FSSE) for frequency-sensitive temporal encoding and a Sparse Spiking Channel Attention (SSCA) module for selective cross-channel interaction. FSSE exploits the low-pass filtering behavior of LIF dynamics to reorganize each input sequence into frequency-sensitive components while collectively preserving the input at the decomposition stage. SSCA then learns a binary mask from encoded channel representations and uses it to selectively exchange information within spike-driven self-attention, retaining informative cross-channel interactions while suppressing redundant ones. When explicit channel interaction is unnecessary, SpikeLite uses the lighter FSSE-only channel-independent path. Experiments under the SeqSNN and SpikF protocols cover four standard multivariate and eight long-term forecasting benchmarks. SpikeLite achieves the best aggregate performance under both protocols, with an average $R^2$ of 0.790 and RSE of 0.440, and lowest average MSE/MAE of 0.343/0.345 in long-term forecasting. Moreover, evaluation on the ECL dataset shows that SpikeLite achieves the lowest reported energy consumption, further demonstrating its potential for energy-efficient time-series forecasting.

</details>


### [1043] [CTP-FL: Common-Trajectory Gradient Prediction for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35130)
*Junkang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CTP-FL提出了一种新的联邦学习优化方法，重新分配客户端在通信轮次间的K次梯度评估：将K次梯度评估从独立的本地轨迹转移到一条所有客户端共享的预测轨迹上。在每个通信轮次中，所有客户端在由当前全局模型和上一轮聚合方向定义的相同查询点序列上评估梯度，上传其平均后由服务器执行单次全局更新。该方法在完全参与下无需假设有界梯度或有界客户端梯度差异，在光滑非凸目标上获得了与FedAvg-M同阶的O(√(LΔσ²/(NKR)) + LΔ/R)平均驻点收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习的本地更新方法（如FedAvg、FedAvg-M等）让每个客户端独立执行K次本地更新后再聚合。在数据异构条件下，各客户端沿不同的本地轨迹前进，导致后续梯度在不同的位置被评估，使得聚合后的更新难以解释为全局目标在某个公共点处的梯度。此外，传统方法通常需要假设有界客户端梯度差异或控制变量（如SCAFFOLD）来处理客户端漂移问题。本文质疑：是否必须在客户端之间执行K次独立的本地更新？同一计算预算能否以另一种方式分配以获得更有意义的聚合梯度？

Method: CTP-FL的核心方法是在每个通信轮次r，由当前全局模型x^r和上一轮聚合方向v^r定义K个共享查询点z_k^r = x^r - t_k·v^r（t_k在[0,h]区间内均匀分布）。所有客户端在相同的K个查询点上各评估一个mini-batch梯度，上传这些梯度的平均。服务器聚合客户端向量得到v^{r+1}，然后执行单次全局更新x^{r+1} = x^r - γv^{r+1}。每轮使用K次mini-batch梯度和每个方向一个模型大小的向量通信，与全参与FedAvg-M的计算和通信预算相同。前一方向可从连续模型中恢复，无需额外传输。当h=0时，该方法退化为同步的mini-batch SGD基线；预测步长h是控制前向信息与位移偏差之间权衡的核心参数。

Result: 理论结果：(1) 全参与条件下，在L-光滑、随机梯度无偏且方差至多σ²的假设下，取h=γ、步长γ≤1/(4L)，获得平均驻点界O(√(LΔσ²/(NKR)) + LΔ/R)，无需有界梯度或有界客户端差异假设。(2) 部分参与条件下，获得含客户端采样方差项的依赖轨迹的界。(3) 构造了两客户端反例，证明S<N时不能仅凭Δ、L、σ、N、S、K、R、γ获得一致的均匀收敛率。(4) 二次函数曲率解释：当F为常Hessian二次函数时，路径平均方向恰好等于∇F(x^r) - (h/2)Hv^r，即通过梯度评估隐式引入Hessian-方向校正项。实验结果：在CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet数据集上，使用ResNet-18和ViT-Tiny，N=100客户端、S=10参与、Dirichlet浓度α∈{0.1,0.05}的强异构设置下，300轮后CTP-FL在全部8个设置中取得最高测试精度。在CIFAR-100+ViT-Tiny上Dir-0.1和Dir-0.05下分别比最强基线高出22.93和21.81个百分点；在Tiny-ImageNet+ViT-Tiny上分别高出15.44和13.18个百分点。

Conclusion: CTP-FL通过重新分配通信轮次间的计算预算（将K次本地梯度更新替换为K次共享预测路径上的梯度评估），在完全参与条件下获得与FedAvg-M同阶的收敛率，且无需有界梯度或客户端异构性假设。共享查询点的设计使得聚合方向成为路径上平均全局梯度的无偏估计器，剩余偏差由路径长度h控制且可通过光滑性显式界定。预测步长h揭示了一个可检验的核心权衡：延长预测路径提供更具前瞻性的梯度信息，但增加位移偏差。然而，理论结果仅适用于完全参与；部分参与时采样方差引入额外的依赖轨迹分散度的项，当前算法无法消除。未来工作应研究部分参与下的控制机制，并确定在匹配计算与通信预算的条件下何时探测预测轨迹真正优于仅查询当前模型。

Abstract: Communication-efficient federated optimization commonly spends several gradient evaluations between server updates. Existing local-update methods use this computation to advance an independent model on each client. Under heterogeneous data, however, these models evaluate gradients at different locations, making the aggregated update difficult to interpret as a gradient of the global objective. We study an alternative use of the same computation budget: \emph{evaluate the global objective along a shared, predicted path}. We propose Common-Trajectory Predictive Federated Learning (\texttt{CTP-FL}). At each round, all clients construct the same sequence of query points from the current global model and the previous aggregated direction, evaluate $K$ stochastic gradients along this sequence, and upload their average. The server then performs a single global update. Thus, \texttt{CTP-FL} uses $K$ mini-batch gradients per client and one model-sized vector in each communication direction, matching the per-round computation and communication of full-participation FedAvg-M. Shared query points make the aggregated direction an unbiased estimator of the average \emph{global} gradient along the predicted path. The remaining discrepancy from the gradient at the current model is controlled by the path length, without assuming bounded client-gradient dissimilarity or bounded gradients. For smooth non-convex objectives, we establish an $\mathcal{O}\!\left( \sqrt{L\Delta\sigma^2/(NKR)}+L\Delta/R \right)$ average-stationarity bound under full participation. The analysis isolates a testable trade-off: extending the prediction path provides more forward-looking gradient information but increases its displacement bias.

</details>


### [1044] [Learning to Re-Draft: A Variational Stackelberg Game for Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35166)
*Dmitrii Moor,Federico Tomasi,Paul N. Bennett,Alice Wang,Mounia Lalmas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出VSDD（Variational Stackelberg Discrete Diffusion），将离散扩散模型中前向噪声过程的学习建模为Stackelberg博弈，通过领导者-跟随者机制学习语义感知的腐蚀过程，避免联合优化导致的退化噪声问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散扩散模型（如MDLM、D3PM-Uniform）使用固定的预定义前向噪声过程，要么固定已解码token无法修订，要么使用均匀随机替换，未能利用数据结构和去噪器学习到的token关系。此外，联合优化前向过程和去噪器可能导致退化解——前向过程会简化任务以适应当前去噪器，而非提供有助于去噪器提升的有信息量的腐蚀。

Method: 1）语义感知噪声过程：参数化为去噪器的token嵌入与可学习双线性变换矩阵的组合，捕获token间的语义相关性；2）变分Stackelberg博弈：领导者选择腐蚀过程，跟随者优化去噪器参数；3）跟随者使用标准ELBO目标（固定领导者策略）；4）领导者通过"更好的响应"（单步虚拟梯度更新）评估腐蚀，并在固定参考噪声下测量去噪器改进作为奖励；5）使用带留一基线的得分函数估计器优化领导者参数，降低方差。

Result: 在分子（ZINC/SMILES）、文本（TinyStories）、播放列表三个领域上：分子生成化学有效性达84.3%，显著优于MDLM（58.7%）和D3PM-Uniform（48.1%）；文本生成将D3PM-Uniform的困惑度从236.33降至106.71，接近MDLM的103.26；播放列表推荐NDCG@3达0.108，优于所有基线。token嵌入相似度与学习转移概率的Spearman相关性达0.70-0.74，表明学到的噪声捕获了有意义的语义结构。同时在再起草（re-drafting）任务上表现优异。

Conclusion: VSDD通过Stackelberg博弈机制成功学习了对去噪器有价值的语义感知前向腐蚀过程，避免了联合优化的退化问题。实验表明，有效的离散扩散不仅需要学习如何逆转腐蚀，还需学习哪些腐蚀有助于去噪器学习修订。该框架在生成质量、再起草能力和跨领域泛化方面均优于固定和可学习噪声基线。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models offer the ability to re-draft, revisiting and correcting earlier tokens throughout generation. This capability depends on the forward corruption process that defines what the denoiser learns to correct. Masked diffusion models fix tokens once they are unmasked, while uniform diffusion permits revisions but relies on uniformly random token substitutions. We instead learn which substitutions are most useful for training the denoiser to re-draft. We introduce Variational Stackelberg Discrete Diffusion (VSDD), a framework for learning a semantically aware corruption process. VSDD formulates training as a leader-follower game: the leader defines a Markovian corruption process parameterized by the denoiser's token embeddings, while the follower optimizes a variational denoising objective with the corruption process held fixed. The leader rewards corruptions based on how much the denoiser improves after learning from them, rather than on how easily the current denoiser can reconstruct them. We measure this improvement under a fixed reference corruption process, approximate the follower's response with a one-step gradient update, and optimize the leader using a score-function estimator. We evaluate VSDD across molecular, text, and playlist generation. VSDD substantially improves molecular validity over uniform and masked diffusion, reduces text perplexity relative to uniform diffusion while remaining competitive with masked diffusion, and achieves sizable improvements in offline playlist recommendation metrics.

</details>


### [1045] [QAM: Quadratic-Accurate Checkpoint Merging via Sequential Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35168)
*Shihao Wang,Rui Kong,Xinran Chen,Hui Wu,Qipeng Qian,Jinman Zhao,Jiashu Zhao,Yuchen Li,Jimmy Huang,Dawei Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QAM（Quadratic-Accurate Merging），一种针对预训练checkpoint合并的系数设计方法。其核心理论贡献是在局部转移模型下刻画了所有与"序贯参考"二阶一致的凸合并需满足的索引矩条件，并证明了使用固定长度GD历史的算法在重建参考终点时存在Ω(h³)的极小化下界，QAM达到匹配的最优O(h³)上界。此外，二次目标精确匹配条件在二阶一致的解族中唯一确定QAM系数。在两个公开Adam轨迹（SmolLM3-3B和OpenEuroLLM-Prelude-9B）上的实验显示，QAM在中等及长窗口上较WSM有更稳定优势，但在短窗口上结果混合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM预训练中，warmup-stable学习率计划允许在训练过程中调整计划，但固定的LR衰减计划不易适应这种灵活性。已保存的checkpoint平均能改善模型质量，但关键问题是：单一保存的历史能够多大程度地重建改变后的训练行为？WSM（Tian et al., 2026）给出了checkpoint权重与更新权重的精确尾部和对应对应关系，但将其权重应用于稀疏的Adam历史仍是启发式。本文寻求一个原则性的系数设计准则，并刻画仅依赖保存历史的重建精度极限。

Method: 1. 在常见局部转移模型 F_h(θ)=θ+hf(θ)+h²a(θ)+O(h³) 下，定义"序贯参考" ϕ_k^W：对每个记录的区间以当前状态重新计算relaxed转移；2. 证明：在一般非退化分布下，二阶一致（与参考差为O(h³)）等价于合并系数满足索引均值 𝔼I=A_W 和二阶矩 𝔼(I choose 2)=B_W 两个条件；3. 证明重建极小化下界：构造两个光滑强凸损失函数具有完全相同的GD checkpoint历史（包括梯度、损失值）但参考终点相差Ω(h³)，因此对任意确定性或随机算法至少有一损失的重建误差≥Ω(h³)；4. QAM系数定义：将W_j视为独立Bernoulli参数，系数为生成多项式 Q_W(t)=∏(1-W_j+W_j t) 的展开系数；5. 二次目标精确匹配定理：在所有固定二次目标上与GD参考终点精确相等的合并中，QAM系数是唯一由W确定的实系数向量；6. 通过标量卷积 O(k²) 构造系数，无需梯度、优化器状态或额外训练；7. 在SmolLM3-3B和OpenEuroLLM-Prelude-9B的Adam checkpoint轨迹上，3种窗口×3种profile×15个任务进行评估。

Result: 1. 理论：QAM实现匹配极小化率ch³ ≤ R_h ≤ Ch³，在非退化profile下QAM的O(h³)上界为最优；当S_W=0时，QAM精确重建；2. 合并系数几何：WSM和QAM的索引方差差为2Δ₂(W)，显示QAM通过减少索引方差来取消二阶局部差异系数；3. 实验（vs 平均组成checkpoint得分）：QAM在108项能力比较中胜出105项，包括Knowledge/Commonsense/Math/Semantics全部配置；4. 实验（vs WSM）：短窗口差距小且混合（21/36 QAM较低），中间窗口QAM胜28/36，长窗口胜29/36；5. 实验（vs 独立checkpoint）：QAM在3808/4500（84.6%）的check-point-任务对比中胜出，超过最新checkpoint 219/270，超过任务最佳checkpoint 147/270；6. 二次匹配诊断：长窗口Math任务上Prelude Last-40 WSM出现严重生成失败（flexible仅11.83-14.03，QAM 42.84-45.41），WSM-QAM插值显示生成行为的渐进恢复；7. 匹配矩诊断：保持first-二索引矩的最大熵分布在GSM8K上与WSM-QAM混合得分差异显著（最大15.15点），表明二阶一致性并不唯一决定下游得分。

Conclusion: 本文刻画了仅依赖保存checkpoint历史的参考终点重建极限：信息论下界为Ω(h³)，QAM达到匹配的最优O(h³)率，且通过二次目标精确匹配在二阶一致的合并族中被唯一确定。理论贡献包括(i)二阶一致性等价于两个索引矩条件的充要刻画，(ii)固定GD历史的重建信息极限定理，(iii)基于独立Bernoulli和分布的系数设计。在两个公开预训练轨迹上的实验表明QAM是实用的，在较长窗口上提供比WSM更广泛的优势。但匹配矩的GSM8K诊断显示局部一致性与下游得分并不完全一致，区分了理论重建精度与实际任务性能。

Abstract: Saved checkpoints record states along a training trajectory, but generally do not determine the updates at states that would be visited under a different schedule. We study how accurately these checkpoints can reconstruct the endpoint of a sequential reference with prescribed update strengths. Under a common local transition model, two checkpoint-index moment conditions characterize all convex merges that agree with this reference through second order. We then prove an information limit that for nondegenerate profiles, no algorithm using only a fixed-length gradient-descent (GD) history with step size $h$ can achieve $o(h^3)$ endpoint error uniformly over a fixed class of smooth, strongly convex losses. The lower bound follows from two losses with identical GD checkpoint histories but sequential reference endpoints separated by $\Omega(h^3)$. \textbf{Quadratic-Accurate Merging} (QAM) achieves a matching uniform $O(h^3)$ endpoint error bound. Its explicit coefficients also define the unique profile-dependent merge that exactly matches the sequential GD reference across all fixed quadratic objectives. Across two public Adam checkpoint trajectories (SmolLM3-3B and OpenEuroLLM-Prelude-9B), three windows and three profiles per model, and 15 tasks, QAM shows mixed results for short windows and broader advantages over \textbf{Warmup-Stable and Merge} (WSM) for longer windows. Matched-moment GSM8K diagnostics further show that local consistency alone does not fully determine downstream scores. These results characterize the reconstruction limits of saved histories, provide a coefficient rule that attains the optimal rate, and assess its practical utility.

</details>


### [1046] [eval-unlearn: Benchmarking unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35269)
*Mansi,Nikhil Raghavan,Zixia Huang,Kai Sheng Ong,Ji Shen Lim,Brandon Siao Xiang Ling,Francesco Leofante*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 eval-unlearn，一个用于文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型中概念遗忘（unlearning）技术的统一、可复现的开源基准测试框架。它集成了12种遗忘方法（含微调、闭式模型编辑和推理时干预三大类）和9种评估指标，并采用插件式架构便于扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 T2I 扩散模型中概念遗忘技术的快速增多，不同方法在异构的实验条件（数据集、指标、超参数）下被评估，导致难以进行公平、可复现的跨方法比较。现有基准（如 UnlearnCanvas、Holistic Unlearning Benchmark）覆盖范围窄且不易扩展，亟需一个统一且可扩展的评估框架。

Method: eval-unlearn 基于适配器设计模式构建核心抽象接口，通过 Python entry points 实现插件自动注册。框架包含五大组件：Technique（统一 generate() 接口的遗忘方法包装器）、Metric（基于 update()/compute() 流式计算得分）、Dataset Loader（流式加载/按需生成数据集）、Configuration（冻结 dataclass 校验超参数）以及 Runner（串联上述组件执行单次/多次基准实验）。所有实验默认在 Stable Diffusion v1.4 上以 FP16 推理运行，并通过 CLI/YAML 驱动。

Result: 框架（v1.1.2）已整合12种遗忘技术（涵盖 ESD、CA、CoGFD、AdvUnlearn、SSD、UCE、MACE、SLD、SAFREE、TraSCE、ConceptSteerers、SAeUron）和9项指标（攻击成功率 ASR、三种对抗鲁棒性红队攻击、FID、CLIP Score、TIFA、ERR、UA-IRA）。其在 HuggingFace 上发布了附带完整超参数的公开排行榜，通过裸露概念擦除案例研究揭示了被异构评估所掩盖的显著的"准确性—生成质量"权衡。测试覆盖率达 99.82%。

Conclusion: eval-unlearn 提供了一个标准化、可复现的概念遗忘基准框架，支持跨方法的公平比较。其插件式架构与 MIT 协议降低了社区贡献门槛。未来的工作将扩展至更新的 Stable Diffusion 变体（v2、SDXL）、增加计算开销指标（延迟、显存峰值）以及拓展概念覆盖范围（如暴力等）。

Abstract: The rising number of concept unlearning techniques for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has produced a fragmented evaluation landscape. Methods are assessed under heterogeneous experimental conditions making principled cross-method comparison difficult. We present eval-unlearn, an open-source Python library providing a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework for concept unlearning in T2I Diffusion models. eval-unlearn integrates twelve published unlearning techniques spanning fine-tuning, closed-form model editing, and inference-time intervention, alongside nine complementary evaluation metrics covering erasure efficacy, adversarial robustness, generative quality, and concept retention. Its plugin architecture lets third-party techniques and metrics self-register without modifying the core framework, and its streaming, batched pipeline supports efficient evaluation of both standard NSFW concepts and arbitrary general concepts. As a further contribution, we release a public leaderboard on HuggingFace along with an interactive tool for real-time evaluation of unlearning techniques. The leaderboard compares nudity concept erasure case study across all twelve techniques, exposing significant accuracy-quality trade-offs that are obscured by heterogeneous evaluation. eval-unlearn is released under the MIT license; the package, code, leaderboard, and documentation are all available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1047] [Multi-Attractor GNNs: Set-Valued Expressivity Beyond Unique Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35274)
*Jialin Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出多吸引子图神经网络（Multi-Attractor GNNs），证明通过共享权重的循环消息传递GNN可以利用多个平衡点来表示集合值等变映射。理论证明包含三个主要定理：存在性定理（构造全局Lipschitz等变动力学）、消息传递近似实现定理（通过连续分量映射的循环GNN任意精确地近似理想动力学）、以及唯一平衡点的局限性定理（连续等变收缩算子会以正概率错过所有有效解）。在Ising模型、蛋白质图模块检测和化学反应网络三个科学任务上的实验表明，能量训练无需解标签即可产生多个高质量预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多组合和科学问题对同一图存在多个有效解，没有首选解。传统循环GNN和平衡GNN通常强制唯一不动点或对每张图使用单一训练目标，这会施加任意的选择规则。对于节点重标记不变的任务，对称图的对称解集可能没有对称解，孤立单一目标会施加任意的对称破缺选择。本文旨在将多平衡点视为资源而非缺陷。

Method: 方法包含三个层面：(1) 理论层面——证明存在性定理（全Lipschitz等变多吸引子动力学几乎处处收敛到有效解，每个分支以正概率到达），通过引入"坏集"和"位移函数"构造理想算子；证明消息传递GNN的近似实现（通过节点状态对称破缺机制，即随机初始状态既识别节点又选择解分支）；证明收缩等变算子错过有效解的障碍（通过三角形图实例）。(2) 架构层面——采用权重共享的循环GNN块，从随机初始状态迭代，不同初始状态收敛到不同有效解。(3) 训练层面——使用问题特定的能量函数（Ising能量、模块度、残差）进行无标签训练，避免指定单一目标。

Result: 在三个科学任务上：(1) Ising模型基态——平均能量-1.0794（最低），Hit10达83.98%，收敛率99.96%，平均发现2.16个不同最优解，68.73%的图找到至少两个最优解。(2) 蛋白质图模块检测——平均模块度0.5560（最高），Hit10达77.49%，平均发现5.83个不同分区。(3) 化学反应网络多稳态——命中率达83.77%，平均3.506个接受的预测簇。在所有任务上，所提方法的平均解质量优于单目标监督、唯一平衡点、前馈基线，并具有与远大的扩散求解器相比的竞争力。模型参数量仅约3,000-36,000，远小于DIFUSCO大模型的190万-190万参数。

Conclusion: 多吸引子动力学为用循环、权重共享的GNN表示集合值图任务提供了一种机制。在所述假设下，一个共享更新可以任意接近不同有效解，而连续等变收缩则可能阻碍恢复任何解。在三个科学任务上，能量或残差训练无需解标签即可产生多个高质量预测和高的数值收敛率。这些发现表明在任务允许多个答案时保留对多个平衡点的访问是有价值的。该框架为图应用开辟了机会，理解训练如何影响收敛和解覆盖仍是重要方向。

Abstract: Recurrent and equilibrium graph neural networks (GNNs) often enforce a unique fixed point or use one training target per graph. Yet many combinatorial and scientific problems admit multiple valid solutions, with no preferred one. A designated target can then impose an arbitrary selection rule. For tasks invariant to node relabeling, a symmetric graph may have a symmetric solution set but no symmetric solution. We show that multiple equilibria enable one weight-tied message-passing GNN to represent set-valued equivariant maps: different initializations approach different valid solutions. Under stated regularity assumptions, we first construct globally Lipschitz, permutation-equivariant dynamics that converge almost surely to valid solutions and reach every solution branch with positive probability. We then establish approximate realization by recurrent message passing with continuous component maps, with arbitrarily small update and limiting errors and arbitrarily high probability. This goes beyond standard universality arguments: although message passing alone cannot distinguish symmetric nodes, the evolving state keeps nodes distinguishable at every finite step without auxiliary node identifiers. Such dynamics can be learned without solution labels using problem-specific energies. On Ising ground states, structural module detection in protein graphs, and chemical reaction steady states, the learned updates produce multiple high-quality predictions with high numerical convergence rates. They achieve better average solution quality than the tested unique-equilibrium, single-target, and feedforward baselines, while remaining competitive with much larger diffusion-based solvers.

</details>


### [1048] [Teacher-Student Gaps Are Not Enough: Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35319)
*Tong Zhang,Zhou Liu,Yihao Liu,Jiahua Bao,Xuchen Li,Honglin Lin,Tao Cheng,Zhihan Yu,Kai Tang,Xiaoxi Jiang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出OG-OPD，通过成对学生续行的最终任务结果来校准基于轨迹的教师监督权重，解决多轮自主代理中token级教师-学生分布差距不足以判定教师指导是否对学生有益的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy distillation方法常将大的teacher-student token级差距视为需要干预的信号，但经验分析表明大差距可能无害而小差距可能对结果至关重要，存在监督-收益不匹配现象。

Method: OG-OPD包含三个组件：1）轨迹相对加权，基于当前gap和前序轮次的突变选取候选轮次；2）候选选择，基于gap幅度阈值和正向突变阈值筛选候选轮；3）基于结果的校准，在候选轮执行成对续行（原始学生动作vs教师动作），仅当学生原始动作失败但教师动作成功时，才在原轨迹的该轮增强监督权重。

Result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和WebShop三个基准上，使用Qwen3-32B→Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-8B-RL→Qwen3-4B两套师生配置，OG-OPD在所有设置中均取得最高平均任务成功率，相对vanilla OPD提升3.6-17.7个百分点，相对最强基线提升最高7.0个百分点。消融实验验证了三个组件的互补性。

Conclusion: 对于多轮自主代理，仅依靠teacher-student token级分布差距不足以判断教师指导是否使当前学生受益。OG-OPD通过将最终任务结果作为监督校准信号，在保留密集教师监督的同时，选择性地增强真正有益的轮次上的监督。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense teacher supervision. Recent work on OPD for multi-turn autonomous agents often treats large teacher-student token-level distributional gaps as promising intervention points, linking larger gaps to a greater need for correction. Yet, our empirical analysis reveals a supervision-benefit mismatch: large gaps can be benign, while small gaps can be outcome-critical. Teacher-student gaps capture differences at the current turn, whereas the benefit of teacher guidance depends on how the current student interacts with the environment afterward. The student may still succeed despite choosing an action that differs from the teacher's, while a teacher-preferred action may lead to a state from which the student cannot complete the task. Local gaps alone are therefore not enough to determine whether teacher guidance benefits the current student. Effective supervision should instead emphasize guidance that the current student can translate into better final task outcomes. Accordingly, we propose Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation (OG-OPD), which applies trajectory-relative weighting to teacher supervision and calibrates these weights using final task outcomes from paired student continuations. This calibration selectively strengthens supervision on the student's original trajectories at turns where teacher guidance benefits the current student. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, OG-OPD consistently outperforms baselines under diverse settings. It improves task success rates by 3.6-17.7 percentage points over vanilla OPD and by up to 7.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [1049] [Large Language Models for Automated Cross-Domain Machine Learning Task Type Identification: A Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35335)
*Petros Tsialis,Steffen Limmer,Tobias Rodemann,Martin Heckmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型(LLM)的机器学习任务类型识别系统，能够仅根据目标特征从数据集级别信息推断数据领域(表格型/时间序列)和下游预测任务(二分类/多分类/回归)，并发布了一个包含625个公开数据集的标注基准。实验证明LLM方法在表格任务上优于AutoGluon(0.98 vs 0.93 F1)，在跨领域设置下最佳模型达0.90 F1，但小型本地可部署模型仅达0.75，揭示了准确性与部署可行性之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在AutoML实践中，下游任务类型(分类、回归、时间序列预测)通常需要数据科学家手动指定，这在工业场景中(数据集异构、文档不完善、非专家用户)是主要瓶颈。现有AutoML框架要么不显式处理此问题，要么依赖针对表格数据的启发式方法，无法跨领域识别数据模态结构。LLM在处理结构化输入和零样本/少样本分类方面的强大能力为自动任务识别提供了新可能。

Method: 系统工作流程：(1)输入数据集、显式目标特征及可选文本描述；(2)提取目标特征统计量(值计数、均值、方差等)；(3)将数据集序列化为紧凑的矩阵式DataFrame表示，保留行列结构与特征名，并采用分组随机采样控制上下文长度；(4)构建结合系统提示、序列化数据、目标特征信息与统计量的提示词。评估设置采用分层划分(训练20%/验证20%/测试60%)，超参数优化独立进行，测试结果采用1000次bootstrap重采样评估统计稳健性。比较的模型包括云端GPT-5.3与本地可部署的Qwen3-14B、Qwen2.5-14B、Qwen3-4B系列，覆盖零样本/少样本、推理模式开关、是否加入数据集描述与目标统计等配置维度。

Result: 实验1(表格数据)：LLM方法全部优于AutoGluon，Qwen3-14B达0.98 F1 macro vs AutoGluon 0.93，H2O仅0.59；AutoGluon主要混淆回归与多分类。实验2(跨领域表格+时间序列)：GPT-5.3结合推理在DD+ST配置下few-shot达0.90 F1，本地最佳Qwen2.5-14B达0.84；主要混淆发生在同任务跨领域之间。实验3(资源受限本地部署)：Qwen3-4B-Instruct在DD+ST下达0.75 F1，移除数据集描述后降至0.50；推理导向的Qwen3-4B-Thinking性能较差(0.45-0.62)。延迟方面AutoGluon仅0.0004秒，Qwen本地模型数秒至数十秒，GPT-5.3 API成本每提示$0.003-0.009。

Conclusion: LLM-based方法能有效识别机器学习任务类型，在表格设置中超越启发式AutoML基线，并能泛化到跨领域场景(表格与时间序列)。小型本地模型可行但需语义上下文辅助，呈现明显的精度-部署性权衡。研究支持将任务识别作为AutoML管道的显式组件而非固定的用户输入。局限性包括基准主要使用公开精选数据集、存在数据污染可能性、未测量任务识别错误对下游管道的影响，以及当前仍需用户手动指定目标特征。未来工作应包括污染分析、自动化目标特征识别、以及量化错误对下游各阶段的影响。

Abstract: Machine learning task type identification is essential for constructing valid ML pipelines, yet in practice it is typically specified manually. We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can infer both the data domain and the downstream prediction task directly from dataset-level information when only the target feature is provided by the user. Together with our LLM-based system we also release an annotated benchmark comprising 625 public tabular and time series datasets. We evaluate the proposed approach in three settings: (i) tabular datasets in comparison with established AutoML heuristics, (ii) cross-domain evaluation across tabular and time series datasets, and (iii) a practical deployment scenario using smaller local models. The results show consistent advantages for LLM-based task type identification, with increasing difficulty in heterogeneous and resource-constrained settings. LLM-based approaches outperform AutoGluon in the tabular setting, reaching 0.98 F1 macro compared to 0.93. In the cross-domain setting, the best model achieves 0.90 F1 macro, while smaller locally deployable models reach 0.75, indicating a trade-off between deployment feasibility and accuracy.

</details>


### [1050] [From Data to Program: Fast & Direct Generative Program Inference from Empirical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35348)
*Simon Klüttermann,Xueying Ding,Leman Akoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PRODiGI，一个预训练的“数据到程序”模型，能够在单次前向传播中将经验数据映射为可执行生成程序（GMM/SCM/Copula），并通过程序空间微调进一步优化。该方法在密度估计、分数估计和生成质量上以更低误差和数倍速度优于现有预训练基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统概率密度估计需针对每个数据集进行特定拟合（如 EM、因果图搜索、核密度估计），计算成本高且不便解释。现有表格基础模型（TFMs）虽然利用合成数据集预训练，但在采样后丢弃了生成程序，限制了解释性和直接统计查询能力。

Method: 1. 数据编码器：使用排列不变的 Set Transformer 将输入数据集编码为固定大小表示。2. 程序模板预测：预测程序家族（GMM/SCM/Copula）及离散结构属性。3. 非自自回归解码器：通过模板槽位填充，并行解码分类、整数和连续参数。4. 程序规范化：训练时对生成程序本身进行零均值单位方差标准化，使数据与程序目标坐标系一致。5. 程序空间微调：冻结预训练模型参数，仅微调推断程序的可微参数（GMM/Copula 使用 NLL，SCM 使用 MMD）。

Result: 在 96 个合成数据集和 96 个真实数据集上，PRODiGI 的平均密度 MAE（2.19）和分数 MAE（2.38）均优于 DiScoFormer、TabPFN、NNKDE 等基线；生成速度比次快方法快 8 倍；程序空间微调使生成 MMD 降低 84%，在密度估计和分数估计任务上均取得最低平均排名。

Conclusion: PRODiGI 通过将经验数据直接映射为显式、可重用、可执行的生成程序，实现了快速且可解释的表格生成建模，开辟了数据到程序的新范式；其统一了多个生成家族并支持直接采样、密度查询和分数评估。局限性在于仅支持连续分布且真实数据性能受限于预训练先验覆盖范围。

Abstract: Estimating probability densities from a finite set of samples typically requires dataset-specific model fitting. We introduce PRODiGI, a pretrained data-to-program model that infers an explicit, executable generative program in a single forward pass. Pretrained on synthetic datasets paired with their ground-truth programs, PRODiGI accommodates diverse generative families and data dimensionalities through template prediction and non-autoregressive program parameter decoding. Its inferred programs support direct sampling, density and score evaluation, and inspection independently of the pretrained model. We further introduce program-space fine-tuning, which refines differentiable program parameters by matching generated and empirical samples while keeping model parameters intact. Experiments show that PRODiGI achieves lower average density and score MAE than existing pretrained models, while offering multi-fold speedups over its closest competitors. Program-space fine-tuning further reduces generation MMD by 84%. By turning empirical data into explicit, reusable programs, PRODiGI introduces a new direction for fast, interpretable tabular generative modeling.

</details>


### [1051] [d-OPD: Future-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Block Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35362)
*Ruitao Liu,Qinghao Hu,Song Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 d-OPD（Future-Aware On-Policy Distillation），用于将预训练的自回归（AR）大语言模型转换为块扩散语言模型（block dLLM）。针对现有 on-policy 蒸馏中 AR 教师仅基于因果前缀而块扩散学生可利用块内可见未来信息之间的目标条件不匹配问题，d-OPD 利用同一 on-policy rollout 的已完成轨迹作为未来证据，对教师分布进行重加权。在 Qwen3 0.6B–8B 上的六个基准测试中，平均提升高达 4.0 分，训练加速 1.35×–1.58×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 AR-to-block-dLLM 转换中，现有的 on-policy 蒸馏方法（如 OPDLM）虽然解决了训练状态与生成状态的分布对齐问题，但仍存在根本性的目标条件不匹配：AR 教师的目标分布仅依赖于因果前缀，而块扩散学生可以同时利用当前块内可见的未来上下文。这导致教师监督信号与学生可见信息不对齐，尤其在较大块尺寸下问题更加突出。

Method: 1) 通过贝叶斯公式推导，将理想的教师目标定义为在完整学生可见状态下的 AR 教师后验分布：先验为因果教师分布 p_T(v|q,z,A_i)，再乘以未来兼容性项 p_T(O_i|q,z,A_i,v)；2) 由于精确条件化需要对未去噪前缀和未来进行不可处理的边际化，采用已完成 on-policy 轨迹作为近似，用已完成的未来 Ĉ_i 在每个候选 v 下的似然作为未来分数 s_i(v)；3) 引入参考 token（rollout 实际生成 token x̂_i）进行相对归一化 Δs_i(v) = s_i(v) - s_i(x̂_i)，避免绝对似然值过小导致的偏差；4) 仅对教师与学生 top-k 并集（默认 k=16）进行未来评分，其余 token 不修正；5) 引入正确性门控：仅对通过任务验证器的 rollout 应用未来感知修正，不通过的回退到标准因果教师监督；6) 训练目标为修正后的教师目标与学生分布之间的前向 KL 散度。

Result: 在 Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B/4B/8B 六个基准（MMLU、MMLU-Pro、GPQA-Diamond、GSM8K、MATH500、AIME25）上，d-OPD 持续优于 OPDLM：在六基准平均上提升 2.6–4.0 分，在 8B 模型 N=16 块大小下达到最大提升 4.0 分；在训练效率上，达到 OPDLM 相同性能所需的 wall-clock 时间加速 1.35×–1.58×（最大加速在 Qwen3-8B 上）。在受控可枚举设置下（49,948 个遮蔽 token 边际），相对精确后验的 KL 散度从 0.4444 降至 0.1249，减少 71.9%，直接验证了目标不匹配的存在与修正的有效性。消融实验显示 k=16 在覆盖率和计算开销间取得最佳平衡（覆盖率 >99%，训练开销仅 2.63%），正确性门控将平均分从 58.8 提升至 59.8。

Conclusion: d-OPD 通过在 on-policy 蒸馏中显式利用块内可见的未来上下文修正 AR 教师分布，有效解决了 AR-to-block-dLLM 转换中的目标条件不匹配问题。该方法在不改变学生架构或训练目标的前提下，仅修改教师监督信号即可带来一致且可扩展的性能提升和训练效率改进，且收益随块大小增大而增大，表明块内未来信息在较大块下愈发重要。d-OPD 可与 SFT 等方法互补，未来可探索多轨迹聚合、其他模型族与块尺寸的扩展。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) typically generate text autoregressively (AR), predicting one token at a time. Block diffusion language models (dLLMs) instead generate blocks sequentially while denoising multiple tokens in parallel within each block, offering a promising way to accelerate generation. Rather than training such models from scratch, recent work adapts strong pretrained AR models into block dLLMs through distillation. On-policy distillation (OPD) has been widely used for LLM training because it supervises the student on states generated by its current policy, rather than only on fixed offline trajectories. By training on the states the student actually visits, it reduces the mismatch between training and generation and can provide more relevant supervision as the student evolves. Recent work has extended this idea to AR-to-block-diffusion conversion. However, this setting introduces a fundamental mismatch in supervision: the block-diffusion student and the causal AR teacher condition on different information at the same training state. The student predicts from the entire partially denoised block, including visible future context, whereas the standard AR teacher target is defined only from the causal prefix. As a result, the teacher distribution used for distillation is not fully aligned with the information available to the student. We therefore introduce d-OPD, a future-aware on-policy distillation method that corrects the AR teacher distribution to better align with the student-visible state by incorporating visible future information within each block, providing supervision that better matches the information used by the student. Across Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B, d-OPD improves the six-benchmark average by up to $4.0$ points over OPDLM and reduces training time by $1.35$-$1.58\times$. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1052] [Do Temporal Link Predictors Need Learned Memory? A Smoothed-Count Baseline with a Handful of Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35364)
*Lisi Qarkaxhija,Ingo Scholtes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于统计语言建模的时序链路预测模型，仅用9-13个可学习参数（无节点嵌入），通过池化转移与共现计数并结合Kneser-Ney等平滑技术，在TGB和TGB-Seq的16个数据集中的7个上取得了最高MRR，并在所有16个数据集上优于EdgeBank和Base3。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序链路预测方法多依赖复杂的节点表示学习（嵌入、记忆或图编码），但近期研究质疑是否需要如此复杂的架构；简单基于计数的方法（如EdgeBank、PopTrack）虽具竞争力，但仅利用了部分历史信息，且在少重复边的数据集上表现未被充分研究。本文旨在检验能否仅用平滑计数与最近性特征，不学节点表示，即实现具有竞争力的预测性能。

Method: 模型维护多种指数衰减计数表（目标频率、源-目标对、转移、窗口共现），使用Dirichlet平滑（边际回退或Kneser-Ney连续回退）对稀疏条件概率进行平滑；通过共享的对数线性评分规则将各特征（含源历史、K个最近目标的转移估计、共现、全局/多尺度最近性）以可学习权重组合，仅9-13个全局共享参数，使用sampled softmax损失训练。

Result: 在16个TGB和TGB-Seq数据集上，模型在7个数据集上取得最高MRR，16/16超过EdgeBank和Base3，14/16超过启发式方法；在ML-20M、Flickr、YouTube（pair coverage为零）上也超越神经参考方法；池化转移证据可用性（>96.1%）远高于源特定转移证据；最长上下文深度K=1→20在TGB-Seq上均带来提升，但K=5后增益有限。

Conclusion: 统计语言建模方法（池化平滑计数+最近性+少量共享参数的对数线性规则）即可在时序链路预测上超越多种神经模型和强计数基线，尤其在源特定转移证据缺失时仍有效；该极简模型（9-13个参数）可作为未来神经时序链路预测器的强基线。

Abstract: Many temporal link predictors summarize past interactions through learned node representations. We examine whether simple counts of recurring interaction patterns can provide competitive predictions without learning these representations. We propose a temporal link predictor based on statistical language modelling. It pools transition and co-occurrence counts across sources to predict links that a source has never formed. We smooth sparse estimates using destination frequencies or Kneser-Ney continuation counts. A shared log-linear rule combines these estimates with popularity, source history, and recency, without node embeddings. In our main evaluation, the model achieves the highest MRR among the compared methods on 7 out of 16 datasets from TGB and TGB-Seq. It also outperforms EdgeBank and Base3 on all 16 datasets and the heuristic family on 14. These gains extend to datasets designed to limit repeated edges. With only 9--13 learned parameters, our model provides a simple and competitive baseline for evaluating future neural temporal link predictors.

</details>


### [1053] [The Hidden Ratio in Adam: Stable Structure, Compression, and Sign Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35392)
*Yihe Zhou,Tongtian Zhu,Yingxiao Huo,Satya Prakash Dash,Can Wang,Samuel Kaski,Mingfei Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了Adam优化器在"tied-β"（β₁=β₂）设定下的自适应动力学，提出了一种称为"隐藏比率"的变换比率y_t = (1-β)/β · (v_t - m_t²)/m_t²，发现其在不同任务、模型规模和训练阶段中表现出稳定的重尾分布。基于此，作者提出了两个应用：(1)用4-bit固定码本量化该比率作为可压缩状态表示，性能与全精度Adam相当；(2)揭示了Adam与Signum方法之间的联系，将y_t替换为常数即可恢复Signum类极限，并提供了学习率迁移规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管Adam是训练现代深度神经网络的默认优化器，但由于其一阶矩和二阶矩EMA之间复杂的交互作用，其自适应行为仍然难以理解。近期大规模训练倾向于使用相近的衰减率（如(0.9, 0.95)），这激发了tied-β设定下的研究。作者希望揭示Adam自适应动力学中一个简单的、可解释的稳定结构。

Method: 1. **理论分析**：在β₁=β₂=β的tied-β设定下，定义变换比率y_t = (1-β)/β · (v_t - m_t²)/m_t²，将Adam的自适应因子重写为sign(m_t)/√(1 + β/(1-β) · y_t)。2. **分布性质**：在局部高斯窗口假设下，证明y_t满足y_t = Y_a(1+η_t/2)的因式分解形式（命题1），其中Y_a = 2/(Z+a)²为位移逆平方参考分布，并通过二阶匹配论证其分布稳定性。3. **递归重参数化**：推导标量递归y_t = βx_t²y_{t-1} + (1-x_t)²（其中x_t = m_{t-1}/m_t），证明Adam可等价地用(m_t, y_t)参数化。4. **4-bit量化**：定义固定16级码本C = {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64}对y_t进行最近邻投影量化，无需辅助缩放因子。5. **Signum联系**：通过常数状态近似y_t ≈ y_const推导Adam与Signum之间的学习率匹配规则η_sign ≈ η_adam(1 + β/(1-β)y_const)^{-1/2}。

Result: **实证稳定性**：在预训练(Pythia-160M)、SFT(Pythia-1B)和RLHF(LLaMA-1B)等不同训练阶段，以及β∈{0.90, 0.92, 0.95}下，y_t的分布均呈现紧凑的单数位主体和持续的重尾，与原始矩幅度m_t和v_t的可变性形成对比。**4-bit量化性能**：在预训练中，4-bit y_t（结合FP32或FP8的m_t存储）的TR-Adam与全精度Adam几乎完全重叠；在SFT和RLHF中，性能相当甚至略有提升。**Signum联系验证**：学习率扫描显示，Signum的最优学习率随β增大而系统性减小，而常数状态代理y_const ∈ {3, 5}更好地保留了Adam的学习率尺度。**衰减匹配常数**：在位移逆平方参考模型下，y_const^eff(β,c)略高于3（β∈[0.90, 0.97]时约为3.1-3.36）。

Conclusion: Tied-β Adam的自适应行为可通过一个粗粒度但稳定的比率结构来捕获：(1) 变换比率y_t是Adam自适应分母的自然尺度状态，其分布比原始矩状态更为稳定；(2) 固定4-bit码本足以存储该状态而无需辅助缩放，在预训练、SFT和RLHF各阶段均保持与全精度Adam相当的性能；(3) 将y_t替换为常数可恢复Signum类极限，提供Adam与Signum之间原则性的学习率迁移规则。局限性：实验仅限于最大1B参数的Transformer语言模型，更大规模和非Transformer架构的验证仍是未来工作。

Abstract: Adam is the default optimizer for training modern deep neural networks, yet its adaptive behavior remains poorly understood due to the complex interaction between its first- and second-moment exponential moving averages (EMAs). We study Adam in the tied-$\beta$ regime, where the two EMA decay rates are equal, and show that its adaptive dynamics can be expressed through a transformed ratio with approximately scale-stable behavior. Empirically, this transformed ratio exhibits a stable, heavy-tailed distribution across tasks, model scales, and training stages, in contrast to the variability of raw moment magnitudes. This empirical stability has both practical and conceptual consequences. First, we derive a recurrence for the transformed ratio, yielding a reparameterization of Adam that replaces the second moment with a compressible state. Leveraging its stable distribution, we show that a fixed 4-bit codebook is sufficient in our experiments to store this state without auxiliary scaling, achieving performance competitive with full-precision Adam. Second, the transformed ratio view clarifies Adam's connection to sign-based methods: Adam reduces to sign-based momentum modulated by the transformed ratio, and replacing it with a constant recovers Signum as a limiting case. This perspective further provides a simple rule for transferring learning rates between the two methods. Together, these results suggest that tied-$\beta$ Adam admits a simple and approximately stable ratio structure underlying its adaptive behavior and demonstrate its utility for both analysis and efficient implementation.

</details>


### [1054] [Frontier Learning: Training LLM Reasoners at the Edge of Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35426)
*Robin Faro,Shyam Sundhar Ramesh,Ilija Bogunovic,Aurelien Lucchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"前沿学习"(Frontier Learning)，一种基于程序化生成器的开放式强化学习后训练方法，通过在线生成处于模型能力边缘的训练问题，动态跟踪LLM推理能力边界，在多个推理任务和模型族上持续优于固定题库基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于GRPO的RL后训练流程依赖训练前固定的题库，存在根本局限：GRPO需要策略输出混合成功与失败的样本才能产生学习信号，而固定题库中有效部分会随模型提升迅速过时，导致零梯度现象和训练停滞。需要一种能在线适应模型能力演化的训练分布调整机制。

Method: 前沿学习包含三个核心机制：(1) 动态层级缓冲区，维护一组前沿难度层级；(2) 基于遗憾(regret)的优先级信号ρ(x)=𝟏[s≥1]-s(x)（可解性指标与经验成功率之差），仅用已有GRPO采样即可识别并优先处理具有学习潜力的层级，加入陈旧性修正形成优先级分数P(ℓ,t)=R(ℓ)+λ_s·(t-t_ℓ)；(3) 通过随机探索（概率ϕ）和状态依赖的层级变异（基于成功率分段设置变异概率p_inf > p_easy ≥ p_hard），不断搜寻并纳入新前沿层级。算法实例化于GRPO，使用网格种子初始化缓冲区，按Zipfian分布采样层级。

Result: 在5个程序化生成的推理任务（Countdown、Sokoban、Dice、Decimal Arithmetic、Largest Island）和3个模型族（Qwen3、Llama-3.2、Olmo3，3B-7B参数规模）上实验：标准200步预算下，Countdown/Sokoban/Decimal Arith.上相对增益+10.0%至+13.9%；长程500步Dice任务上达71.8%准确率，远超最强基线SEC的33.3%（+115.6%）；跨模型族的Largest Island（Olmo3-7B）达73.7% vs 基线52.0%（+41.7%）。消融实验表明，遗憾引导的变异是推动能力边界扩展的关键，PLR+Mut去掉随机探索后仍达62.5%。在PLR计算预算匹配条件下前沿学习仍达68.0%，证明优势非源于额外算力。

Conclusion: 有效的RL后训练不仅需要选择有用的问题，更需要在模型能力边缘持续生成新问题。前沿学习通过程序化生成器在线搜索配置空间，无需假设难度参数的单调排序，可在长时间训练中持续扩展模型推理能力边界。局限性在于依赖具有连续或离散任务特定参数的程序化生成器，对无法程序化生成的任务适用性受限。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning-based post-training of Large Language Models (LLM) has been successfully applied to improve their reasoning capabilities. Existing pipelines primarily finetune LLMs on a fixed pool of problems specified prior to training using the GRPO loss. This is fundamentally limiting, as learning signal arises only when policy rollouts mix successes and failures, causing the useful portion of any fixed pool to quickly become stale as the model improves. To address this, we propose frontier learning, an open-ended post-training approach in which procedural generators are used online to continually produce informative training problems. It treats the generator's task-specific parameters as a search space and uses a regret signal to prioritize and explore frontier difficulty levels in order to focus training at the edge of the model's evolving reasoning capabilities. Across several reasoning tasks and model families, our approach consistently achieves higher relative gains over fixed-pool baselines, demonstrating that effective post-training requires not only selecting useful problems, but continually generating them at the edge of capability.

</details>


### [1055] [ReSPO: Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization for Gradient Starvation in Off-Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35433)
*Yihang Chen,Yuanhao Ban,Cho-Jui Hsieh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReSPO提出了一种基于α-散度变分目标与指数倾斜的序列级重塑核，用双分支设计替代GRPO/GSPO的硬截断，解决离策略学习中符号依赖的梯度饥饿问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR中常用的rollout复用导致策略偏离加剧。现有截断式策略优化(GRPO、GSPO)在重要性权重两端存在符号依赖的梯度分配失衡：正优势的低权重尾部响应被抑制、负优势的高权重尾部响应主导更新，导致欠生成正响应恢复信号消失、过生成负响应权重无界增长。

Method: 1. 将权重重塑建模为测度变换，τ=μϕ(W)；2. 通过α-Bregman对偶邻近目标推导无约束重塑核ϕ₀(W)=[(1-β)+βW^(α-1)]^(1/(α-1))；3. 通过KL投影施加二阶矩控制得到指数倾斜ϕ(W)=ϕ₀(W)·exp(λ(1-ϕ₀(W)))；4. 按优势符号分双支设计：正分支取α⁺=2使ϕ⁺(0)=e/2≈1.36>0保留欠生成正响应，负分支取α⁻→1使ϕ⁻(0)=ϕ⁻(∞)=0同时抑制过生成与已抑制负响应；5. 重塑核作用于未归一化序列权重W，stop-gradient后作为REINFORCE式估计器的逐序列梯度缩放系数；6. 超参通过解析尾部要求与W=1处导数匹配确定(β⁺=β⁻=0.5, λ⁺=λ⁻=2)。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B-Base与Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base两个模型、N∈{8,16,32}三种rollout复用比、1024次策略更新的设定下，ReSPO在6个模型-N组合中的5个取得最高早期峰值(前256步)、5个取得最高晚期均值(末128步)。在AIME25/24、AMC23、OlympiadBench、MinervaMath、MATH-500六个基准上，N∈{16,32}时四个组合中均取得最高宏平均。在N=32时，1.7B晚期均值超最优截断基线7.9pp，30B超8.4pp；30B在三个竞赛基准上的均值超最优基线3.4-6.3pp。正分支诊断显示ReSPO在log W<-1尾部对正响应的系数放大1.69×(VESPO为0.93×)，在(-5,-2)区间放大2.00×(VESPO为0.30×)。MoE消融显示ReSPO与Routing Replay正交兼容，联合使用可将晚期均值再提升1.84pp。三种子实验标准差(0.54pp/0.95pp/0.47pp)远小于其相对基线的增益。

Conclusion: ReSPO通过α-散度变分框架与符号相关双分支重塑核，从理论上解决了截断策略优化在重要性权重尾部上的梯度饥饿问题。其正分支在W→0处保持非零系数使欠生成正响应得以恢复，负分支在两端归零抑制过生成负响应的无界贡献。该方法在dense与MoE两种Qwen3模型、不同off-policy程度下均稳定加速早期优化并提升最终泛化性能，且与MoE路由重放技术正交互补，为离策略LLM强化学习中重要性权重尾部控制提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) frequently reuses rollouts across multiple policy updates, increasing the mismatch between the current policy and the data-generating policy. We identify a sign-dependent gradient starvation problem in clipped policy optimization: clipping suppresses under-generated positive responses at the low-importance-weight tail while permitting severely over-generated negative responses to dominate the high-weight tail. To address this, we propose ReSPO (Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization), which replaces clipping with a smooth, two-branch sequence-level kernel derived from an $\alpha$-divergence variational objective and an exponential variance-control tilt. The positive branch preserves a nonzero gradient weight for under-generated positive responses, while the negative branch suppresses heavily over-generated negative responses. We demonstrate that ReSPO effectively learns from long positive reasoning trajectories during early training, even when accumulated policy drift relegates them to the low-importance-weight tail. On dense and MoE Qwen3 models, ReSPO accelerates early optimization, improves final training scores, and achieves higher held-out benchmark performance under a rollout reuse, validating our approach on importance-weight tail control in off-policy learning.

</details>


### [1056] [Riccati State Space Models: Non-iterative Parallelization for Nonlinear Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35441)
*Mónika Farsang,Ramin Hasani,Daniela Rus,Radu Grosu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RiccatiSSM，一种非线性状态空间模型，其每维状态遵循输入条件化的Riccati微分方程。由于Riccati ODE的精确零阶保持流是Möbius变换，可通过2×2矩阵乘法复合，因此整个序列可以在单次关联并行扫描中精确求值，无需牛顿迭代等迭代线性化方法。模型还引入了保证有界、收缩动力学的约束参数化。在长序列分类、回归和预测任务中达到与非线性LrcSSM相当的性能，同时端到端运行时间减少22–33%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有线性SSM虽支持关联并行扫描，但状态Jacobian与状态无关，丧失液态神经网络的"状态依赖动力学"特性；而一般非线性循环模型（如LrcSSM、DEER）虽具状态依赖性，却需通过迭代线性化（牛顿迭代）恢复并行性，多次扫描代价高昂。核心问题：能否设计一种非线性动力学族，使其在组成下仍保持封闭，从而在单次并行扫描内精确求值？

Method: 1. **Riccati动力学构建**：每维状态x_i服从输入条件化的Riccati ODE：ẋ_i = ε_i(u)[α_i(u) + β_i(u)x_i + γ_i(u)x_i²]，其中二次项γ·x²使局部Jacobian显式依赖于状态。2. **投影提升**：将标量Riccati方程表示为二维线性系统 ẋ = x/x 的导数形式，利用零阶保持假设得到精确一步流为Möbius变换 x_t = (a_t x_{t-1} + b_t)/(c_t x_{t-1} + d_t)。3. **并行扫描**：Möbius映射通过2×2矩阵乘法复合，利用关联性单次扫描计算前缀积P_t = M_t⋯M_1，状态由 x_t = (P_t^{(11)}x_0 + P_t^{(12)})/(P_t^{(21)}x_0 + P_t^{(22)}) 恢复。4. **稳定参数化**：通过约束α、β、γ、ε，保证区间[-B,B]前向不变、Jacobian收缩严格为负（≥ -ε·s_min），且矩阵指数始终取实双曲支（β²/4 - αγ > 0），避免极点。5. **三阶段前向传播**：系数生成→单次关联扫描→投影读出。

Result: 1. **长序列分类**（UEA数据集，序列长度405–17,984）：RiccatiSSM在Heartbeat (73.0%)、SCP1 (87.4%)、SCP2 (53.2%)、Ethanol (36.6%)、MotorImagery (59.6%)、EigenWorms (83.9%)上与LrcSSM表现相当，并在SCP1和MotorImagery上优于LrcSSM。2. **回归（PPG-DaLiA）**：MSE = 7.15±1.01×10⁻²，显著优于LrcSSM (10.89±0.96×10⁻²)，接近最强基线LinOSS-IM (6.40±0.23×10⁻²)。3. **预测（Weather，720→720）**：MAE = 0.5681，优于LrcSSM (0.5888)和S4 (0.5783)，接近LinOSS-IMEX (0.5081)。4. **运行效率**：在匹配架构下，相比LrcSSM（需约3次准DEER迭代）端到端运行时间减少22–33%（LrcSSM的67–78%），最长序列EigenWorms上差距最显著。5. **消融实验**：输入依赖速度因子ε(u)被去除时MSE上升至8.45×10⁻²；仅保留α(u)输入依赖时MSE为8.71×10⁻²；LRC-Taylor匹配参数化为8.47×10⁻²，均低于自由参数化(7.15×10⁻²)。6. **匹配动力学分析**：Riccati二次截断相对RMSE为1.73×10⁻⁵，比LrcSSM自身Euler离散化误差(7.16×10⁻³)低约两个数量级。

Conclusion: RiccatiSSM证明：状态依赖的非线性动力学与精确并行评估并非互斥——通过将动力学限制为在复合下封闭的非线性族（Möbius变换），可以在单次关联并行扫描中实现非线性状态空间模型的精确求值，无需任何迭代线性化。约束参数化同时保证了有界性、收缩性和无极点特性。该模型在液态动力学（LTC/LRC）的状态依赖时间常数特性和并行扫描效率之间取得了平衡，为非线性SSM开辟了一条新路径。

Abstract: State space models (SSMs) achieve efficient sequence processing because their affine state updates are closed under composition and can therefore be evaluated with an associative parallel scan. Nonlinear recurrent models can provide richer, state-dependent dynamics, but generally lose this compositional structure: parallel evaluation then requires iterative methods that repeatedly linearize and scan the recurrence. We ask, what state-dependent nonlinear dynamics can be designed to remain exactly composable? We answer by introducing RiccatiSSM, a nonlinear SSM, in which each state dimension follows an input-conditioned Riccati differential equation. Its quadratic state dependence makes the local Jacobian explicitly state-dependent, while its exact per-step flow under piecewise-constant inputs is a Möbius transformation. Since Möbius maps are closed under composition and compose through $2\times 2$ matrix multiplication, the complete nonlinear state trajectory can be evaluated exactly with a single associative parallel scan, without iterative linearization. We further derive a constrained parameterization that ensures bounded, contractive dynamics, and avoids poles in the fractional-linear state update. Across long-sequence classification, regression, and forecasting tasks, RiccatiSSM achieves competitive predictive performance while reducing runtime by $22{-}33\%$ compared to the nonlinear LrcSSM under matched architectures. These results demonstrate that state-dependent nonlinear dynamics can retain exact composability and be evaluated efficiently within a single parallel scan.

</details>


### [1057] [CLIMB: A Clinical Multimorbidity Benchmark for Diagnosing Co-occurring Conditions through Multiturn Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35462)
*Yusuf Kesmen,Aniruddha Mukherjee,Yena Chang,David Sasu,Trevor Brokowski,Alexandra V. Kulinkina,Kristina Keitel,Akhil Arora,Lars Henning Klein,Mary-Anne Hartley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了 CLIMB 基准,用于评估大语言模型在多轮交互诊断中共病(co-occurring conditions)的多标签识别能力。研究发现六个前沿模型在交互式共病诊断中均表现极差(完全恢复诊断集的比例不超过10%),模型表现出"单假设跟踪"行为——锚定于首个假设,即使继续追问也只会增加错误诊断而非补充遗漏的共病。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的临床大语言模型基准多为单轮、单标签的诊断任务,与真实临床咨询中医生需要通过多轮问诊、同时识别多种共存疾病(共病)的场景严重脱节。共病在65岁以上人群中影响超过一半人口,诊断遗漏会带来严重临床后果。然而,现有研究缺乏对多轮交互+多标签诊断这一交叉维度的受控评估与分析。

Method: CLIMB 基于两个临床来源(ePOCT+儿科决策算法、DDXPlus合成患者记录)合成多标签患者病例,共病采样器通过经验流行率和LLM诱导的共现因子构建诊断集,使用路径提取、记录合并、一致性检查与拒绝重采样保证病例质量。评估协议包括:完整信息(一次性提供所有发现)与交互式(20轮问诊预算,医生模型与模拟患者对话)两种信息条件,辅以预知真实k值、单诊断控制等对照实验。系统测试了6个模型(GPT-5.6、Gemini-3.8-Flash、Qwen3.8-Flash、Gemma-4、GLM-5.3-Flash、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash),采用Jaccard和精确集恢复作为指标,并通过匹配呼吸系统队列、设计性k=2队列、症状共享队列等受控实验进行失败分析。

Result: 六个模型在交互式诊断中完全恢复共病集的比例均不超过10%(最佳Gemini-3.8-Flash在DDXPlus上仅8%)。诊断性能随共病数量k增加急剧下降:在k=1时DDXPlus上完整恢复率可达22-76%,但在k=4时几乎为0。即使提供完整临床记录或告知真实疾病数量,性能差距也无法弥合。受控实验表明:(1)模型的提问效率显著低于决策树参考(每题信息增益低);(2)模型存在强烈的锚定效应——倾向于追随开场所呈现的诊断A,对同等严重度的B诊断恢复率仅为A的一半左右;(3)共享症状只能轻微提高B的检出率(从37%升至51%),但同时报告两者的比例仅从27%升至32%;(4)强制模型在自然停止点之后继续提问,主要增加的是错误诊断而非遗漏的共病,Jaccard分数不再上升。研究还形式化了"单假设跟踪"理论参考模型,并证明模型不符合"集合跟踪"假设(Proposition 2)。

Conclusion: CLIMB 揭示了当前大语言模型在多轮交互共病诊断中存在系统性缺陷:模型表现为"单假设跟踪器",锚定于开场所暗示的诊断,即使显式提示不要过早停止也无法恢复完整的共病集。这一发现对临床部署具有警示意义,因为共病在现实中极为常见,而仅靠单标签评估指标会掩盖这一失败模式。未来工作需要改进证据收集策略与多假设并行跟踪能力。

Abstract: Patients often have several co-occurring clinical conditions, and the findings needed to identify and disambiguate them emerge over the course of a consultation. Evaluating clinical reasoning in this setting requires both multi-turn interaction and multi-label diagnosis. We introduce CLIMB, a benchmark in which a doctor model interviews a simulated patient to recover a ground truth set of co-occurring clinical conditions. Cases are synthesized from clinical decision algorithms and diagnostic datasets, grounding multimorbid presentations in structured clinical knowledge. Across six frontier and open models, none recovers the exact set of conditions in more than 10% of interactive cases. Diagnostic performance declines when conditions co-occur, even when models receive the full clinical record and the true number of conditions. Interaction reduces performance further. In controlled experiments, models behave like single-hypothesis trackers: they anchor on the diagnosis suggested by the opening findings, keep questioning around it, and recover a second condition mainly when a finding in view points to it. Questioning them further does not complete the set but adds mostly wrong diagnoses. We formalise this pattern with a theoretical reference model of single-hypothesis tracking. The benchmark, generator, and evaluation code are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1058] [Improving Generative Model Self-Training with Geometrically Modified Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35512)
*Patrick Batsell,Thomas Walker,Richard Baraniuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出几何修正输出（GMOs），通过对生成器输入-输出Jacobian矩阵的奇异值进行重新加权来增强自训练中负信号的强度，从而在多种一步生成模型上一致地提升Neon和SIMS等负引导自训练算法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着高质量训练数据的日益稀缺，自训练（使用模型自身输出持续改进模型）对生成模型变得越来越重要。然而，朴素的微调会导致模型崩溃（model collapse）和自噬障碍（MAD），现有的负引导自训练方法（如Neon、SIMS）虽然将这种退化转化为有用的信号，但直接采用标准模型输出中的负信号，没有探索是否可以显式增强该信号。

Method: 1. 几何视角：基于生成器输入-输出Jacobian的局部谱性质，将模型输出分解为 s = J_z·z + b_z；2. GMO生成：通过参数α重新加权Jacobian的奇异值，将尾部谱能量的一部分转移到第一奇异分量，保持Frobenius范数不变，从而放大mode-seeking行为和模型失真；3. 计算优化：提出基于幂迭代和Hutchinson估计器的近似实现，将计算复杂度从 O(min(d,h)·C_f) 降至 O((k+m)·C_f)；4. 集成到自训练：将GMOs用于Neon（权重空间外推）和SIMS（输出空间引导）两种负引导自训练算法。

Result: 在IMM、MeanFlow（SiT-B/2和SiT-L/2）和AlphaFlow（SiT-B/2和SiT-XL/2）共5个一步生成模型（均在ImageNet256上预训练）上的实验表明，使用GMOs的Neon在所有架构上一致优于使用标准输出的Neon：FID降幅在标准Neon降幅基础上额外增加17%-105%（IMM上接近翻倍，AlphaFlow SiT-B/2上超过翻倍）。GMOs同时提升了密度（density）和覆盖率（coverage），证明质量和多样性同时改善而非权衡。SIMS引导从7.59降至6.92。在MeanFlow CIFAR10上，增大α系统性地降低达到最优所需的微调预算和合并权重w。GMOs具有跨模型尺寸和推理策略的可迁移性（如用SiT-B/2的GMOs改进SiT-L/2）。

Conclusion: GMOs是一种通用的、基于几何结构的输出增强技术，可显著加强负引导自训练方法中的负信号，在多种一步生成模型和自训练算法上带来一致且统计显著的改进，同时保持Neon的采样效率。局限性包括需要指定超参数α，以及目前仅在图像域进行了验证。

Abstract: Self-training generative models - the continued improvement of a model using its own outputs - is becoming increasingly important as high-quality training data becomes scarce. However, naively finetuning on model-generated samples leads to degradation through model collapse and the model autophagy disorder. Negative-guidance self-training methods turn this degradation into a useful signal, using a model finetuned on its own outputs to guide the original model toward improved generation. Existing methods, however, take the negative signal in standard model outputs as given. We instead ask whether this signal can be explicitly strengthened. We introduce Geometrically Modified Outputs (GMOs), which reweight the singular values of the generator's input-output Jacobian to increase the influence of its leading singular directions. This geometric modification amplifies the mode-seeking behavior and distortions of standard outputs, providing a stronger and more targeted negative signal for self-training. Across a range of one-step generative models, GMOs consistently improve the performance of negative-guidance methods, including Neon and SIMS, compared with using standard model outputs.

</details>


### [1059] [Let the Neurons Die: Exploiting ReLU-Induced Model Degradation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35528)
*Kexin Li,Wenjun Qiu,Joshua Abraham,Aditi Maheshwari,David Lie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对ReLU网络的"神经元死亡"（dying ReLU）故障模式，提出了三种训练阶段的可用性攻击：基于数据排序的DOA，以及基于梯度反演合成毒化样本的IG-DOA和IG-SKA。在MNIST全连接网络上，仅重排100/60000样本即可将准确率从96%降至95%；加入200个单类毒化样本后，多数情况下准确率降至86-88%，证明无需直接修改模型参数即可通过训练数据干扰学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReLU因负输入梯度为零而产生"dying ReLU"故障，使神经元永久失活。先前工作（Grosse et al.）已证明可通过初始化时的权重置换利用此弱点，但需要控制模型初始化。本文探索一种更实际的威胁场景：攻击者无需修改模型参数，仅通过控制训练数据的排列顺序或注入合成样本，能否诱导ReLU失活并降低模型可用性。

Method: 1. DOA（动态数据排序攻击）：贪心地从候选池中逐步选择能最小化目标层权重和的样本，构建有序前缀，迫使ReLU层的预激活趋向负值。2. Soft Knockout（SK）：改编自Grosse等人的方法，将相邻层的权重重排，使负贡献集中化。3. IG-DOA与IG-SKA：在DOA或SK构造的对抗性模型状态下，利用梯度反演（基于余弦相似度的目标函数和图像先验）合成类别条件毒化样本，然后注入到独立初始化的受害模型的训练集中。威胁模型为白盒攻击者，能访问模型架构、损失函数和训练数据。

Result: 在MNIST全连接网络上训练5个epoch：1. 数据排序：重排100/60000样本后，最终测试准确率从95.93%降至95.04%；排序造成的精度损失随前缀长度增加而增大。2. 毒化攻击：IG-DOA和IG-SKA各加入200个单类毒化样本（占训练集约0.33%）后，十个单类条件中有九个最终准确率约为86-88%，比干净基线低约10个百分点。"All"条件和部分类别（如C6、C9）在五轮训练内有不同程度的恢复，攻击效果存在类别依赖性。实验表明，ReLU定向的数据排序和毒化可在不直接修改受害模型参数的情况下损害学习。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了ReLU定向的训练时间攻击（数据排序与毒化）能在不触碰模型参数的前提下损害模型可用性，是对Grosse等人基于初始化攻击的重要扩展。研究结果为训练流水线的完整性审计提供了概念验证，包括检查样本顺序、监控激活/梯度行为以及检测毒化数据等防御方向。但实验仅限于MNIST和简单MLP，攻击效果的持续性、泛化性以及防御措施的有效性仍有待未来工作验证。

Abstract: Rectified linear unit (ReLU) networks can suffer from dying neurons, where units with persistently negative pre-activations produce zero outputs, blocking gradients through their activations. To exploit this failure mode, we present three training-time availability attacks based on data ordering and poisoning. We begin with the basic dynamic data-ordering attack (DOA), which greedily constructs a training prefix by selecting the next example that minimizes the target layer's post-update weight sum, aiming to push ReLU units toward negative pre-activations without modifying training samples or labels.
