We then develop two poisoning attacks, IG-DOA and IG-SKA, which use gradient inversion to synthesize class-conditioned samples by matching reference gradients in adverse model states constructed through data ordering or soft knockout, respectively. Soft knockout rearranges weights across adjacent layers to concentrate negative contributions. On a fully connected ReLU network trained on MNIST, ordering 100 of 60,000 training examples reduces test accuracy from 96% to 95% after only five epochs. Adding 200 poisoned samples from a single class reduces test accuracy to approximately 86-88% after five epochs in most evaluated conditions, compared with approximately 96% under clean training. These results demonstrate that ReLU-targeted data ordering and poisoning can impair learning without directly modifying the victim model's parameters.

</details>


### [1060] [Graph World Models for Constrained Epidemic Policy Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35545)
*Yiqi Su,Rashed Shelim,Lingyi Wang,Walid Saad,Naren Ramakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EpiMind框架，将图世界模型与图时序ADMM约束规划相结合，用于跨区域、共享有限资源的疫情政策规划。该方法通过参数共享的图因子化循环状态空间模型(GF-RSSM)生成联合策略条件下的多区域轨迹预测，并通过GT-ADMM协调区域干预、投影保证共享资源可行性，最后在投影动作上重新评估时序逻辑规范。实验表明，相比无图动力学建模，入院预测RMSE降低29%，且在保证共享预算可行性的前提下，规划性能接近最优可行常数策略(差距1-5%)，在真实情境评估中优于所有可部署基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 疫情政策规划需要在多个地理区域间进行协调，考虑流动性驱动的疫情溢出效应和有限资源的分配。现有的方法存在以下局限：分室模型(如SEIR)将政策视为外生输入而非决策变量；GNN时空预测器缺乏动作空间，无法区分干预效果与混杂因素(如检测减少)；强化学习方法将资源约束融入奖励塑造中，仅保证期望层面的可行性而非每时刻硬约束；数学规划方法需要预先拟合的传播动力学，无法随决策自适应。核心需求是：能够从含噪策略依赖观测中推断潜在疫情状态，预测图耦合演化，并保证每时刻共享资源约束的硬可行性。

Method: 方法包含两个核心组件：(1) 图因子化循环状态空间模型(GF-RSSM)：参数跨区域共享，每个区域维护独立的循环信念b_t^i和随机潜状态z_t^i，通过图注意力机制聚合邻居信息c_t^i=GAT({z_t^j, a_t^j, E_t^ij})，更新信念b_t^i=f_θ(b_{t-1}^i, z_{t-1}^i, a_{t-1}^i, c_{t-1}^i)，并通过后验q_θ(z_t^i|b_t^i, e_θ(o_t^i))同化观测。训练损失包括观测、奖励、KL、rollout、效应和校准六项。(2) 图时序ADMM(GT-ADMM)约束规划器：在预测轨迹上优化区域行动序列，引入三个协调信号——邻居共识γ^i(跟踪与移动连接区域的分歧)、共享资源压力u^i(反映预算稀缺)、溢出敏感度η^i(预测跨区域溢出敏感性)。区域提案更新通过冻结世界模型的梯度下降求解，资源投影通过受限单纯形投影保证每时刻共享预算可行性。最后对投影后的执行动作重新进行联合rollout，用精确STL鲁棒性进行验证。整体形成"信念更新→联合rollout→约束规划→投影与验证→执行"的闭环序列。

Result: 实验在三类环境中评估：(1) 5区域移动耦合合成模拟器(N=5, T=26周)；(2) 美国州级回顾性面板；(3) 真实数据初始化的半合成模拟器。主要结果：在世界模型保真度方面，GF-RSSM将入院MAE从0.211降至0.156，RMSE从0.311降至0.221(相对降低29%)，5步累积误差从0.070降至0.036(相对降低49%)；在规划性能方面，在λ_NPI∈{3,10,30}三种干预成本下，规划结果分别为55.3、59.8、74.4，与最优可行常数策略(54.7、58.9、70.9)的差距仅1.1%-4.9%，配对遗憾0.93±1.10(λ=10)，且所有执行分配的事后预算超额为零；在约束处理方面，合成和真实情境下可行性均达100%，STL规范满足率100%，最大预算超额为0；在真实情境半合成评估中，相对无干预减少53.4%的入院，相对标准ADMM、图无关规划、时间打乱规划和独立MPC分别减少1.14%、2.13%、2.21%和3.40%；在校准消融中，专用校准头在λ=10时相对共享解码器减少64.2%的遗憾；在协调消融中，匹配干预负担条件下，图结构带来的增益降至1%以下，说明大部分未匹配负担下的差异源于干预努力而非协调本身。模型失配(+6.47%)是测试中最显著的失效模式，优于操作扰动的影响。

Conclusion: EpiMind框架证明了图结构策略想象与显式约束协调相结合可支持从学习动力学中获得有效的疫情干预。贡献包括：(1) 将多区域疫情规划问题形式化为动态策略图，耦合区域动力学与有限共享资源；(2) 将参数共享图世界模型与约束多区域规划器耦合用于联合策略rollout、资源可行分配和时序逻辑评估；(3) 在真实情境评估中实现近oracle性能，相对无干预减少53.4%入院同时满足所有共享资源约束。但存在若干局限：投影仅保证可行集中编码的约束；STL满足性是模型相对的，不认证未知真实环境；规划质量依赖世界模型校准；非凸GT-ADMM无全局收敛保证；预测轨迹和溢出效应是模型敏感性而非因果识别反事实；干预成本和分配优先级需反映当地经济、伦理和公共卫生考量。EpiMind旨在支持政策比较与资源分配，而非自主决策。

Abstract: Epidemic policy planning often requires coordination between geographical regions, taking into account mobility-driven spillovers and how to make use of limited resources. Existing methods either lack action-conditioned models of coupled dynamics or cannot guarantee per-period feasibility. We present EpiMind, a graph world model framework for constrained epidemic policy planning across regions. A graph-factored recurrent state-space model generates joint policy-conditioned rollouts from regional latent beliefs, while graph-temporal ADMM optimizes regional interventions, enforces shared-resource feasibility through projection, and evaluates temporal specifications under the learned model. EpiMind reduces admission RMSE by 29% relative to graph-free dynamics modeling, plans within 1-5% of the best feasible constant policy with guaranteed shared-budget feasibility, and outperforms all deployable baselines across three resource budgets in real-context evaluation. These results demonstrate that graph-structured policy imagination with explicit constrained coordination supports effective epidemic interventions from learned dynamics.

</details>


### [1061] [Twist, Don't Tilt: Trajectory-Exact Constrained Decoding for Masked Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35609)
*Aditya Thimmaiah,Lara Marinov,Jayanth Srinivasa,Haris Vikalo,Junyi Jessy Li,Milos Gligoric*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）逐步精确约束解码中存在的"轨迹偏差"问题——尽管每一步采样是精确且满足约束的，但跨步组合后会偏离模型对合法轨迹的相对概率分布。论文提出了TWISTER算法，通过Feynman-Kac扭曲SMC方法，利用局部与钳制配分和的比值作为增量势函数，精确修正该偏差，使最终分布匹配无偏的Doob h-变换路径律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MDLM约束解码方法（如Dang and Ermon, 2026）在每一步对自动机约束后验进行精确采样，但论文证明这种"逐步精确"在跨步组合后会产生轨迹偏差，改变模型对合法轨迹的相对概率。需要一种能修正此偏差的轨迹精确解码方法。

Method: 1) 通过Doob h-变换定义无偏目标分布；2) 分析逐步精确核，证明其等于"冻结"于当前状态的马尔可夫链的Doob变换，每步重新冻结导致偏差；3) 推导出偏差的精确表达式——重新冻结比值Z(xt;xt-1)/Z(xt;xt)的乘积；4) 提出TWISTER算法：以逐步精确核作为提议分布，用Feynman-Kac SMC框架，以局部配分和Z(x;x)作为扭曲函数，增量势函数即为重新冻结比值；5) 证明该Feynman-Kac模型精确目标于Doob h-变换路径律。

Result: 1) 理论证明：TWISTER的Feynman-Kac修正精确消除轨迹偏差，目标于无偏Doob路径律；2) 对正则语言约束，Feynman-Kac势函数可由FFBS预计算量精确高效计算，无需额外去噪器调用；3) 复杂度为O(KTN|Q||V|)；4) 实验显示TWISTER显著降低轨迹偏差（TVD指标），同时保持100%约束满足率（JSON-Mode-Eval上94个数据点全部满足模式有效性）；5) 偏差在空约束或单步全揭示时消失。

Conclusion: TWISTER是首个用于MDLM的自动机扭曲SMC约束解码器，通过精确的Feynman-Kac修正消除了逐步精确解码固有的轨迹偏差，在不牺牲约束满足的前提下实现了轨迹级精确的全局约束采样，为MDLM的结构化生成提供了理论基础和实用算法。

Abstract: Constrained decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) aims to ensure that generated outputs satisfy a specified structure or syntax constraint. MDLMs generate outputs by repeatedly unmasking masked positions present in their current state. Recent strategies for constrained decoding constrain the model's per-step mean-field posterior (which factorizes over masked positions) by enforcing the desired constraint with an automaton. The resulting chain-structured factor graph allows exact constrained sampling via dynamic programming. However, despite each draw being exact and constraint-satisfying, we prove that their composition, in general, tilts away from the model's relative probabilities over valid trajectories, thus leading to trajectory bias. We derive an exact expression for this bias as a product of ratios measuring how valid continuation mass changes when the denoiser is reconditioned, and characterize when the bias vanishes. We then correct the bias by introducing TWISTER, the first automaton-twisted Sequential Monte Carlo decoder for MDLMs, using the step-exact decoder as the proposal. We show that for regular language constraints, the Feynman-Kac correction is exactly computable, with the twists obtained efficiently using quantities pre-computed for step-exact sampling. We prove that the resulting Feynman-Kac model targets the unbiased Doob h-transformed path law conditioned on constraint satisfaction.

</details>


### [1062] [Behavioral Foundation Models for Quality Diversity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35615)
*Nazim Bendib,Nicolas Perrin-Gilbert,Olivier Sigaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BFM-QD框架，将质量多样性（QD）搜索从高维策略参数空间迁移到行为基础模型（BFM）的紧凑潜空间中，实现零样本提取多种多样高性能策略库，并在稀疏奖励任务上显著优于参数空间基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统QD方法直接在神经网络的高维参数空间搜索，随机扰动几乎不产生有意义的奖励行为，限制了QD在稀疏/欺骗性任务中的效果。BFM的潜空间天然编码了多样行为但现有方法仅从中提取单一最优策略，未充分利用其行为结构。

Method: 在冻结的预训练BFM（FB或TD-JEPA）的潜空间Z中运行QD算法（ME/CMA-ME），存储与扰动潜码z而非网络权重θ；提出Backward Inference（BI）算子：通过闭式求解z*（无需critic或反向传播），将每个父代朝z*方向插值，被证明等价于策略改善目标上的近似二阶Newton步；并探索了潜空间插值交叉算子（Iso）。

Result: 在Walker、HalfCheetah、AntMaze-medium和Cube-single共18个连续控制任务上，BFM-QD变体（FB-ME、FB-CMA-ME、TD-JEPA-CMA-ME）在所有任务上一致优于ME、CMA-ME、PGA-ME、DCRL-ME、DDE-Elites和ME+Pretrain基线；在稀疏导航与接触富操作任务中，参数空间方法全部崩溃至近零性能，而BFM-QD保持高QD-score与覆盖率；BI算子性能匹配基于TD3梯度的PGA-ME但无需critic训练；QD性能在BFM预训练早期就饱和，无需完全收敛的BFM。

Conclusion: BFM的潜空间是QD的理想搜索空间，结合低维行为丰富的潜空间结构与多样化离线预训练，BFM-QD成为QD优化的通用骨干框架，将BFM的用途从单任务零样本策略提取拓展到多样化行为库的发现。

Abstract: Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) are an emerging paradigm in reinforcement learning, playing a role analogous to large language models in natural language processing: they have shown remarkable versatility, enabling zero-shot performance, fast imitation, and online adaptation, all by exploiting the structure of a latent space. In this work, we investigate whether the latent behavioral space induced by BFMs can serve as an effective search space to discover large repertoires of behaviorally diverse and high-performing policies through Quality-Diversity (QD) methods. While QD methods generally search directly in high-dimensional policy parameter space, in this paper, we present BFM-QD, a framework that performs QD search in the compact latent space of a BFM. We further show that the BFM-QD framework provides a closed-form, gradient-free policy improvement operator that approximates a policy gradient update, but requires no critic training and no backpropagation. Across continuous-control benchmarks spanning dense locomotion, sparse navigation, and contact-rich manipulation, BFM-QD consistently outperforms parameter-space baselines, with particularly stark gains in sparse and deceptive settings, where all tested parameter-space QD methods collapse to near-zero performance. These results show the effectiveness of the BFM-QD framework, benefiting from the synergy between dimensionality reduction of the search space and offline pretraining from diverse behavioral data. This positions BFMs as a general-purpose backbone for QD optimization, extending their utility beyond zero-shot task solving to the discovery of diverse behavioral repertoires.

</details>


### [1063] [DR-net-Mamba: Selective State-Space Modeling for Long-Range ECG Time-Series Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35634)
*Basile Morel,Samuel Ruiperez-Campillo,Andreas P. Streich,Julia E. Vogt,Thomas Hofmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DR-net-Mamba，一种在卷积UNet瓶颈处插入选择性状态空间（Mamba）块的ECG去噪模型，结合局部特征提取与长程时序建模（线性复杂度），在重建保真度、噪声鲁棒性、记录长度扩展性及下游44类病理分类任务上均优于现有卷积、循环、Transformer及基于扩散的去噪基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ECG信号常受非平稳噪声污染，影响诊断可靠性。现有深度去噪方法存在局限：卷积网络感受野有限，Transformer随序列长度二次方增长，扩散模型推理成本高，亟需一种兼顾长程建模能力与计算效率的架构用于长时程动态ECG去噪。

Method: 采用两阶段架构：第一阶段为1D UNet编解码器（编码器三层下采样×20），在瓶颈处插入三个Mamba-1选择性状态空间块（状态维度256，扩展因子4），将有效感受野从约1.5s扩展到全序列长度；可选级联多分支细节恢复网络（DR-net）构成第二阶段。输入端采用可学习对数压缩层归一化动态范围。使用MSE损失在合成（ODE生成）、PTB-XL及European ST-T数据集上训练，引入四种噪声源（基线漂移、肌电、电极运动、AWGN）同时在线加噪。下游使用Inception1D和ResNet1D-Wang两个独立分类器评估44类PTB-XL诊断标签。

Result: 在三个数据集上，DR-net-Mamba均取得最高SNR与最低RMSE（提升0.3-0.9 dB SNR，配对bootstrap检验显著）。Mamba优势随序列长度增长而增大，在低SNR与重AWGN条件下尤为明显。下游分类中，Mamba模型在两个分类器上均取得最佳macro AUROC；lead-specific Mamba变体是唯一在两个分类器上同时改善BCE和Brier校准指标的模型。逐类分析显示，Mamba显著提升ST/T改变（STTC）诊断性能（因依赖宽带上下文敏感波形），而对QRS内部间隔诊断的传导障碍（CD）改善有限。推理延迟11.9 ms/10s段，满足实时部署。

Conclusion: 在卷积瓶颈中注入选择性状态空间块是参数高效的长程建模策略，重建增益随记录长度增长而扩大。重建质量提升并不自动转化为临床效用——长程上下文对依赖上下文敏感波形的诊断（如STTC）最有益，而尖锐特征（如QRS）可能被瓶颈过度平滑。此外，逐导联专用去噪在保持分类器校准方面优于导联无关模型，提示临床部署需超越判别性指标，评估校准性。校准结果存在分类器依赖性，强调评估去噪下游效用需逐分类器进行。

Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings are corrupted by non-stationary noise sources that degrade diagnostic reliability, particularly in ambulatory and long-duration recordings. Deep learning denoisers exist, but convolutional architectures are limited by their receptive field, transformer-based models scale quadratically with sequence length, and diffusion-based approaches incur prohibitive inference cost. We propose a Mamba-augmented model that inserts selective state-space blocks at the convolutional bottleneck, combining local feature extraction with long-range temporal modeling at linear complexity. We comprehensively evaluate the proposed model with respect to reconstruction fidelity, noise robustness, recording-length scaling, and downstream diagnostic classification across over 40 pathology classes. On synthetic and real datasets, our model achieves the highest SNR and lowest RMSE, with the Mamba advantage increasing with sequence length and in low-SNR regimes. On classification with two independent classifiers, the proposed Mamba-based models achieve the best macro AUROC among all denoisers and improve over their convolutional base models. Calibration is more nuanced and classifier-dependent: denoising improves Binary Cross-Entropy and Brier score on Inception1D but often fails to beat the noisy input on ResNet1D-Wang, and the lead-specific Mamba variant is the only denoiser to improve both calibration metrics over the noisy baseline on both classifiers. Per-class analysis reveals a morphology-dependent benefit: Mamba substantially improves ST/T-change diagnoses, which depend on broad, context-sensitive waveforms.

</details>


### [1064] [Rethinking Circuit Evaluation: Do Circuits Explain Model Errors?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35686)
*Li Zhang,Chuqin Geng,Mark Zhang,Chen Yang,Luke Zhang,Haolin Ye,Xujie Si*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出当前机制可解释性中的电路评估方法存在重大缺陷：电路虽然能高保真地复现模型的正确预测，却往往无法解释模型的错误。基于IOI、Docstring和MIB基准的实验表明，被广泛使用的电路在模型错误样本上的一致性远低于正确样本的一致性。作者提出精确错误复现应作为电路解释能力的必要测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机制可解释性（MI）通过电路来解释模型行为，但现有评估主要基于任务得分（如平均logit差异）或输出分布相似度，掩盖了模型在错误样本上的表现。一个仅能复现模型正确决策的电路，无法解释模型为何犯错，限制了其作为诊断工具的价值。

Method: 将评估数据按模型是否答对分层，分别报告电路在正确集（$A_{ok}$）和错误集（$A_{err}$）上的argmax一致性及其差值$\Delta$。在IOI、Docstring任务及MIB的6个模型-任务设置上，对比手动电路（IOI 26头、Docstring 8头）和自动提取电路（ACDC、EAP-IG-KL、Edge Pruning）在mean、resample和optimal ablation下的表现。IOI案例研究在GPT-2 small上从参考电路$C_0$贪心扩展，使用目标函数$J(C)=A_{err}(C)-\alpha[A_{ok}(C_0)-A_{ok}(C)-\epsilon]_+-\lambda_P P_{added}(C)$，并通过activation patching和path patching追踪机制。

Result: IOI mean ablation下，手动电路、ACDC、EAP-IG-KL和Edge Pruning在正确集上一致性达97.3%–99.5%，但在错误集上仅11.4%–41.7%；手动电路归一化忠实度$F=0.956$却仅复现15.2%的错误。IOI案例研究中，扩展$C^*$在26,000测试集上将错误复现率从14.22%提升至75.11%，正确一致性仅下降0.41个百分点，超出所有结构匹配的随机扩展（17.33%–41.33%）和标量偏置控制（20.44%）。机制分析发现两类被遗漏的计算：(1) 物体相关信息改变S-Inhibition的query，导致Name Mover复制错误主体（在137个恢复错误中影响120个）；(2) 第一层五个头（0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.6, 0.10）在IO位置修改Name Mover的key，影响35/137的错误。对象词替换修复107/137的正确，但被S-Inhibition约束后仅保留39个。边界匹配、加权发现集、错误条件激活替换和后验校准等补救措施效果有限或以正确性能为代价。

Conclusion: 电路可以保留任务成功但无法充分解释模型失败，这两者是不同范围的能力。精确错误复现应作为电路解释行为的必要测试。建议：(1) 报告$A_{ok}$、$A_{err}$及其差值$\Delta$；(2) 在多个电路规模上评估分层一致性曲线；(3) 报告评估分割、各层提示数量、电路规模和消融规则，因为电路评估依赖这些方法论选择。研究局限在于仅涵盖测试的设置和基准，案例研究限于一个IOI参考电路及其扩展，未建立可推广到其他电路或任务的通用解决方案。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) aims to explain a model's behaviour through analyzing its internal computations; circuit-based explanations aim to isolate these computations with compact subnetworks validated by ablating the rest of the model. We show that circuits validated this way may fail to recover the underlying mechanism of the model's behaviour by closely reproducing its successful decisions while failing to account for most of its errors. Such explanations should account for the model's particular errors as well as its successes. We evaluate this requirement by measuring exact answer agreement separately on model successes and failures, across circuit sizes and ablation settings, on IOI, Docstring, and six model-task settings from the Mechanistic Interpretability Benchmark. We discover that many tested circuits closely replicate correct behaviour while missing most of the model's errors. On indirect object identification (IOI) for GPT-2 small, under mean ablation, the manual circuit and tested automated circuits, including one trained against the model's full output distribution, agree with the model on 97.3-99.5% of prompts it answers correctly but only 11.4-41.7% of errors. An IOI case study shows that lost errors are recoverable by restoring omitted attention-heads which raise error reproduction from 14.2% to 75.1% on a separate held-out set with 0.41 percentage point decrease on correct agreement, exceeding matched random extensions and scalar-biased control. Intervention traces show how omitted computations produce specific wrong answers for a reproducible subset of errors. In all, these findings show circuits can preserve task success without adequately explaining model's failures, and support exact error reproduction as a necessary, but not sufficient, test of circuit-based explanations of model behaviour.

</details>


### [1065] [Distillation Defenses Easily Break After Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35699)
*Shidan Javaheri,Alexander Panfilov,Oliver Britton,Yarin Gal,Yonatan Gideoni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有针对蒸馏攻击(distillation attack)的防御措施在攻击者对蒸馏后的模型继续进行强化学习(RL)训练后失效;仅依赖API返回的推理摘要即可通过"摘要-扩展"攻击窃取闭源模型的推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeepSeek-R1事件引发了对蒸馏攻击的广泛关注,但现有防御评估均在蒸馏后立即进行,隐含假设攻击者不再继续训练。本文认为该威胁模型设定错误——一个有能力追求SOTA性能的攻击者极可能在蒸馏后继续进行RL训练,从而使现有防御产生虚假的安全感。

Method: 1. 在多个模型家族(Qwen2.5、Llama3、Gemma)和规模(0.5B-32B)上系统比较RL、蒸馏、蒸馏+RL三种训练范式;2. 以antidistillation sampling为案例,评估"蒸馏后+RL"对其防御效果的破坏程度;3. 提出"摘要-扩展攻击":利用闭源API返回的推理摘要与最终答案,通过弱扩展模型重建近似完整推理链,再结合RL训练;4. 在开源(Qwen2.5-14B-RL)和闭源(Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5 mini、Gemini Flash 3.6)设置中验证攻击效果。

Result: 1. 在绝大多数设置中,RL优于蒸馏,蒸馏+RL效果最佳,说明蒸馏为后续RL提供了"引导"(bootstrap);2. antidistillation sampling在低至中等毒化水平下,蒸馏后看似有效,但经RL训练后防御效果基本消失;3. "摘要-扩展"攻击经RL训练后,在开源与闭源教师模型上均能达到与使用完整隐藏推理链蒸馏相近的性能;4. 任何泄露足够信息以重建近似推理链的响应级防御均可能无效。

Conclusion: 现有蒸馏防御评估的威胁模型设定错误,导致防御失效;响应级(response-level)防御因信息的双重使用性(dual-use)难以兼顾安全与可用性。未来应转向批级(batch-level)防御,即基于查询模式而非单次响应进行检测,这对更广泛的LLM漏洞(如越狱、奖励模型滥用)同样重要。

Abstract: Distillation attacks copy the reasoning capabilities of closed-source large language models, allowing bad actors to replicate state-of-the-art performance at low cost. Attackers systematically collect a large volume of frontier model reasoning traces and then train (i.e., "distill") their own models on these traces. Existing defenses against distillation attacks are typically evaluated immediately after distillation, implicitly assuming attackers do not train their models any further. In this paper, we argue that a more realistic threat model includes further training with reinforcement learning after distillation. A misspecified threat model can give a false sense of security -- some defenses that seem effective after distillation can be broken after subsequent reinforcement learning. Practically, reinforcement learning lowers the bar for a distillation attack to be effective. We show that simple attacks can steal reasoning capabilities from existing closed-source language models using data easily obtainable from current APIs, yielding reasoning improvements equivalent to more sophisticated attacks that extract the full hidden traces. Results indicate that any distillation defense that leaks sufficient information to reconstruct approximate reasoning traces is likely ineffective. We conclude by discussing broader implications and batch-level distillation defenses which could be more effective.

</details>


### [1066] [A Unified Uncertainty Representation for Graph Neural Networks via Doubly-Spectral Stochastic Expansion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35703)
*Fred Xu,Thomas Markovich,Florence Regol,Yizhou Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DSS-GNN，一种基于双重谱随机展开（doubly-spectral stochastic expansion）的图神经网络不确定性表示方法，将节点嵌入建模为图结构变化（通过图傅里叶滤波）与潜在随机变化（通过Hermite多项式混沌展开）的张量积，在单一表示中提供任务定制化的不确定性读出（均值logit用于OOD能量分数、高阶系数编码logit变化、混沌坐标上的求积平均定义预测分布），并以standalone或hybrid两种部署模式在14个校准基准、11个OOD设置和7个GOOD概念偏移基准上实现先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络的可靠部署需要同时满足校准、OOD检测和分布偏移鲁棒性，但现有方法使用分离的模型和目标函数分别处理这些需求，缺乏统一的概率表示。本文旨在通过一种能够编码预测不确定性的统一表示，从同一信号同时获得校准概率、OOD证据和偏移下的正则化残差。

Method: 将不确定的节点嵌入建模为随机图信号，在图频率轴（通过拉普拉斯特征基与双重Chebyshev低/高通滤波器）和混沌阶数轴（通过共享高斯潜变量 ω 的正交Hermite多项式基）上进行张量积展开，构成双重谱随机展开（DSS）。DSS层通过耦合传播规则学习联合图频率/混沌阶系数，使用Gauss-Hermite求积进行非介入投影处理逐点非线性，无需随机采样。读出阶段：均值logit（零阶系数）提供能量分数用于OOD检测；高阶系数编码logit协方差；混沌坐标上的求积平均softmax定义单一预测分布用于预测和校准。理论方面证明了在全秩特征假设下受限子族的表达容量，以及截断误差的指数衰减。两种部署模式：standalone DSS-GNN用于校准密集型单图场景；DSS-Hybrid在确定性编码器（如GCN）旁添加DSS残差分支用于偏移鲁棒性。

Result: 1. 校准：standalone DSS-GNN在14个节点分类基准上均获得最低Brier分数（无需后处理校准），在13个上获得最佳准确率。2. OOD检测：DSS-Hybrid在9个节点OOD设置中的7个和Twitch跨图OOD上获得最佳AUROC，以单次前向传播超越MC-dropout（M=20）和Deep Ensembles（M=5）。3. 分布偏移：DSS-Hybrid在ERM训练下在7个GOOD概念偏移基准上均获得最强偏移准确率，优势范围从0.08到9.94个百分点。4. 跨评估：两种模式在彼此的任务上仍然有效，提供了明确的部署指导（standalone用于校准关键的单图/异质性场景，hybrid用于存在强传统编码器、跨图迁移和稀疏标签OOD检测）。5. 理论验证：容量定理证实在全秩特征假设下受限DSS子族能匹配任何高斯潜变量随机图信号的混沌系数，且截断误差指数衰减。

Conclusion: DSS-GNN是一种统一的不确定性表示（双重谱随机展开），具有任务定制化的读出和两种部署模式。standalone在所有14个校准基准上获得最低Brier分数，hybrid在大多数节点OOD设置上获得最强AUROC，在所有7个概念偏移基准上获得ERM下最强偏移准确率。两种模式在所有三个任务上都有效，但存在文档化的例外情况。作者给出了明确的部署指导，识别了未来工作的方向（向量潜变量用于跨节点联合不确定性建模）。

Abstract: Reliable deployment of graph neural networks requires calibration, out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, and robustness to distribution shift, yet existing methods address these needs with separate models and objectives. We model uncertain node embeddings as random graph signals: graph Fourier filters capture structural variation, and a scalar orthogonal-polynomial chaos coordinate captures latent stochastic variation. The resulting doubly-spectral stochastic (DSS) expansion supplies task-matched readouts from one representation: the mean coefficient encodes class evidence for the energy-based OOD score, the higher-order coefficients encode structured logit variation, and quadrature averaging over the chaos coordinate defines the single predictive distribution used for prediction and calibration. A capacity theorem shows that, under a full-rank feature assumption, a restricted subfamily matches the chaos coefficients of any Gaussian-latent random graph signal, with exponentially decaying truncation error under a growth condition; the task-level claims are established empirically. DSS-GNN has two deployment modes: standalone, or as a residual branch beside a deterministic encoder (DSS-Hybrid). Standalone DSS-GNN achieves the lowest Brier score among the compared uncertainty-aware baselines on all 14 node classification benchmarks without post-hoc correction; DSS-Hybrid achieves the best AUROC on most node-OOD settings, competitive cross-graph OOD detection, and the strongest shifted accuracy on all 7 GOOD concept-shift benchmarks under standard empirical risk minimization (ERM). Cross-evaluating both modes on all three tasks shows that each remains effective on the other's tasks, with documented exceptions, and yields explicit deployment guidance.

</details>


### [1067] [X-Reset: Scaling Object-Centric Reinforcement Learning via Cross-Embodiment Resets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35715)
*Prithwish Dan,Chenyang Ma,Wei Zhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: X-Reset提出了一种新颖框架，通过将人类手-物体演示作为强化学习的重置分布（而非模仿目标），解决灵巧操作RL中从零开始探索的难题。该方法在三种机器人本体上训练通用策略，显著提升了重定向成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作RL从零开始训练面临严峻的探索挑战：接近、抓取和重定向高自由度物体非常困难。先前工作依赖高质量机器人演示、逐任务奖励设计或限制行为模式。本文旨在使用易于获取的人类手-物体视频数据作为引导，通过任务无关的奖励训练通用策略。

Method: X-Reset框架包含两个阶段：(1) 从人类演示中生成重置状态——使用PyRoki进行运动学重定向，将手-物体轨迹映射到机器人状态，并通过cuRobo求解臂部逆运动学；过滤仿真中不稳定的状态。(2) 在RL训练中以概率p从演示重置分布采样，否则从默认重置分布采样。使用PPO训练LSTM策略，输入为机器人本体感知、物体关键点和目标关键点，采用非对称评论家架构和通用物体中心奖励（接近+重定向+成功+平滑+安全）。

Result: 在DexYCB的20个物体上、三种本体（UR7e+Sharpa、KUKA+Sharpa、UR7e+Robotiq夹爪）训练通用策略：物体中心奖励下的平均重定向成功率从11.0%提升至66.6%；手-物体奖励下从42.1%提升至59.6%。策略可随训练物体数量扩展，零样本泛化到未见物体（EBench），可从不完美手部姿态估计学习，并零样本从仿真迁移到真实世界。

Conclusion: X-Reset验证了人类手-物体状态作为重置分布可有效解决物体中心RL的探索问题。生成的策略依赖任务无关奖励，具有良好的扩展性、泛化性和对噪声手部跟踪的鲁棒性，并实现了零样本仿真到真实迁移。局限性在于策略依赖物体位姿估计噪声，需视觉或视觉-触觉蒸馏；尚未扩展到大规模自我中心视频数据集。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation can train dexterous manipulation policies without robot demonstrations, but training a single generalist policy with task-agnostic rewards faces a severe exploration problem: approaching, grasping, and reorienting diverse objects with many degrees of freedom is difficult to discover from scratch. Prior works make exploration tractable with high-quality robot demonstrations, per-task reward shaping, or by restricting policies to narrow modes of behavior. We propose X-Reset, a framework that instead resolves exploration with human hand-object demonstrations. Rather than imitating or tracking retargeted human motion, X-Reset kinematically retargets hand-object states to noisy robot states, filters out states that are unstable in simulation, and samples the remainder as resets during RL training with general-purpose object-centric rewards. The resulting policy depends only on object state and goal, with demonstrations entering training through the reset distribution. We show that X-Reset trains generalist policies on 20 objects across three embodiments---a 22-DoF hand on two different arms and a parallel-jaw gripper---and resolves the exploration challenges of RL from scratch. X-Reset scales with the number of training objects, generalizes to unseen objects, can learn from imperfect hand-pose estimates, and transfers behaviors zero-shot from sim-to-real.

</details>


### [1068] [KV-streams for Efficient Compaction in Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35750)
*Emiliano Penaloza,Dane Malenfant,Dheeraj Vattikonda,Roger Creus Castanyer,Siddarth Venkatraman,Abhay Puri,Jonathan Light,Matthew James Sargent,Augustine N. Mavor-Parker,Massimo Caccia,Lucas Caccia,Glen Berseth,Esmeralda S. Whitammer,Alessandro Sordoni,Minseon Kim,Marc-Alexandre Côté,Laurent Charlin,Guillaume Lajoie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KV-streams，一种即插即用的策略，通过在压缩后保留并前向流式传输KV缓存而非重新预填充，将长视野智能体LLM的强化学习训练加速2.6至5倍。该方法与任何压缩策略兼容，且证明仅靠RL（无需SFT预热）即可让KV缓存充当伪循环状态，承载已从上下文中消失的信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视野智能体LLM的强化学习受限于GPU内存容量。上下文压缩虽可保持恒定内存，但需反复预填充保留的token，导致训练吞吐量下降。现有方法在重新预填充上耗费大量计算资源，且先前工作认为实现KV缓存的"伪循环"行为需要先进行SFT阶段。

Method: KV-streams的核心思想：在推理引擎中直接驱逐被删除token的KV条目，但保留被保留token的KV条目及其位置编码，使其作为连续流前向传递，而非像传统re-prefill压缩那样在新trace中重置并重新预填充。在训练端，通过自定义注意力掩码（attention mask）阻止对已驱逐span的注意力，从而在单次前向传播中复现驱逐效果，避免任何token的重复处理。推导了重复预填充成本公式 Δ_re-prefill = N·r/(B−r)，证明该成本随保留token接近预算B而发散，而KV-streams使 Δ_re-prefill = 0。

Result: 在TextWorld上实现5×加速，ALFWorld上1.3×加速，SWE-bench Verified软件工程任务上3×加速（峰值性能更快达到）。评估了四种压缩策略：Summary、Markovian Thinker、Markovian Pick、Sliding Window。在文本游戏中KV-streams训练的模型可迁移到未见过的游戏。在控制合成实验中证明：仅用RL训练即可让KV缓存充当伪循环状态（无需SFT预热），当KV缓存容量足够大时召回率可达100%，且能泛化到训练分布外的目标（如演员姓名），甚至能恢复基础模型零概率分配的目标（如电视）。

Conclusion: KV-streams是一种轻量级、即插即用的机制，可添加到任何压缩策略和后训练流水线中。它通过避免重复预填充成本显著减少实验wall-clock时间，性能不逊于甚至优于re-prefill压缩，并能有效泛化。与先前工作不同，证明无需昂贵的SFT预热阶段即可通过RL实现伪循环KV行为，极大简化了采用门槛。

Abstract: Scaling the horizon of agentic LLMs is bottlenecked by the need to fit ever longer context traces in GPU memory. Context compaction has been the most popular mechanism to alleviate this issue, keeping GPU memory constant for a given trace. Unfortunately, most compaction strategies rely on prefilling the LLM context many times over, hindering training throughput. To alleviate this bottleneck and enable efficient trainable compaction, we propose KV-streams, a plug-and-play strategy compatible with any compaction strategy that substantially increases throughput while showing no evidence of hindering performance. KV-streams enable scalable compaction by streaming the KV cache forward rather than flushing it after each compaction. We show that KV-streams enable three different compaction strategies, achieving a 2.6 to 5x wall-clock speedup in training. Beyond efficiency, we find that the streamed KV cache can act as a recurrent state, carrying forward information that has long since disappeared from the context. Specifically, in a controlled setting we show that, contrary to prior work, RL alone is all that is needed for this behavior to emerge. Overall, we show KV-streams to be an efficient and lightweight plug-and-play addition to any post-training pipeline.

</details>


### [1069] [How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35751)
*Shouren Wang,Chuang Ma,Mohsen Hariri,Debargha Ganguly,Wang Yang,Xiaoqing Tong,Qianying Liu,Xiaotian Han,Vipin Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了 Foil，一种在固定专家参数量和每 token 计算量的前提下循环稀疏 MoE 的新设计方法：通过"展平专家"（将专家层数减半、每层专家数翻倍、循环次数翻倍，使每次路由从更大的专家池中选取）和"解绑注意力"（让每次循环拥有独立的注意力参数，而专家与路由器共享），在 20B 和 100B token 预训练中均优于未展平基线，并提炼出循环 MoE 的设计指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复使用同一组层以更多计算换取更强的固定规模模型；稀疏 MoE 每层仅激活少数专家，参数远多于计算。两者天然互补——循环让 token 在不增加存储的情况下接触更多不同专家——但如何在固定专家参数量与计算量的前提下组织循环 MoE（层数、每层专家数、循环次数）尚未被研究。此外，传统循环模型共享全部参数（包括注意力），展平会丢弃注意力参数，因此需要回答注意力是否应在各次循环间共享。

Method: Foil 在 Huginn 循环骨架上做两项改动：(1) 展平专家——保持真实专家数 E·D 与每 token 专家调用数 k·D·L 不变，将 (E,D,L) 映射为 (2E, D/2, 2L)，每次路由从更大池中选取；(2) 解绑注意力——专家与路由器在各次循环间共享，但每次循环拥有自己的注意力参数（不增加计算），以恢复展平丢弃的注意力预算。文章还提出三个专家利用度量：每 token 触及的不同专家数 U_t、负载均衡 B_2（Jain 公平性指数）、路由置信度 MMR（首选专家概率与中位排名专家概率之比的几何均值）。设计基线 Base (8,8,2) 与三个 Foil（Foil-3: (16,4,4)、Foil-2: (32,2,8)、Foil-1: (64,1,16)），以及共享注意力的对照模型。

Result: 展平+解绑注意力在 20B 和 100B token 上均优于未展平基线：100B token 下 Foil-1 损失比基线低 0.012 nat，下游准确率持平或略优；展平程度越高，损失单调下降。在同等形状下，解绑注意力在所有四个对比中均优于共享注意力（最展平时 100B 下差距达 0.049 nat），且路由更均衡、更自信。消融表明：(1) 加宽专家层与增加循环次数的收益相互放大；(2) 负载均衡单独不足以反映健康的专家特化（MMR 比 B_2 更好追踪循环收益）；(3) MMR 的逐 pass 峰值标志着展平或循环收益接近耗尽。据此提出设计建议：稀疏循环 MoE 应使用更多每层专家与更多循环次数。

Conclusion: Foil 通过展平专家和解绑注意力，在固定专家参数与计算预算下显著优于未展平的循环 MoE 基线；其展平程度在 100B token 下与损失呈单调改善关系；解绑注意力恢复了展平丢弃的参数且不增加计算，同时带来更健康的路由。消融提炼出循环 MoE 的设计原则：加宽与循环互补、路由置信度（MMR）优于负载均衡作为特化指标、MMR 逐 pass 峰值可指示循环收益极限。

Abstract: Looped Transformers reuse one block of layers several times: by spending extra computation they push a model of fixed size further, and so use its parameters more fully; while sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few of many experts for each token. Looped MoE bridges these two design philosophies and gives MoE models new potential for better expert usage, but it raises a question: how to loop a MoE? We answer it with Foil. With the expert parameters and the expert compute per token held fixed, Foil (1) flattens the experts, halving the expert layers, doubling the experts per layer and doubling the passes, so that every routing decision chooses from a larger pool, and (2) unties the attention, giving each pass its own attention parameters while the experts and routers stay shared. Experiments show that Foil clearly outperforms the unflattened looped baseline: at 20B tokens every Foil model has lower pretraining loss than the baseline; at 100B tokens the loss improves monotonically with the degree of flattening, the most flattened Foil ending 0.012 nat below the baseline at equal parameters and compute, with downstream accuracy on par or better; untying the attention also yields more balanced and more confident routing at equal shape. Our ablations analyse why Foil works and turn the findings into design guidance for looped MoE: the returns of looping and of widening the expert layers amplify each other, routing confidence tracks healthy expert use better than load balance, and a sparse looped MoE should therefore use more experts per layer and more passes. Code and configurations are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1070] [TokenCast: Forecasting Token Consumption During LLM Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35760)
*Chaoqian Ouyang,Ling Yue,Libin Zheng,Huanghui Guo,Shengxiang Xu,YiShu Wang,Ran Li,Jian Yin,Shaowu Pan,Shimin Di*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TokenCast提出了一种可组合的段级成本表示与精确组合恒等式，用于在LLM智能体执行过程中在线预测Token消耗。该方法在四个基准和六种智能体模型上平均比最强基线降低14.5%的MAE，并在SWE-bench Verified上每运行仅需32.8 ms的累计预测时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体执行同一任务时Token消耗差异可达30倍，原因在于上下文累积使得每次调用的输入成本随历史轨迹增长而膨胀，导致执行前难以准确预测总成本、需随执行推进持续修正预测。

Method: 将每个执行段表示为三元组φ=(n, g, b)（调用次数、上下文净增量、起始输入基线之外的残差），并推导相邻段的精确组合恒等式ϕ_{A∘B}=(n_A+n_B, g_A+g_B, b_A+b_B+n_B·g_A)。采用LightGBM拟合直接路径与组合路径（含前缀-后缀分解），通过交叉拟合与代价加权损失处理边界预测误差，再以修正模型融合两种预测，并在执行过程中逐步刷新。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified、Search-R1、MMLU-Pro、LongBench-v2四个基准和六种智能体LLM的96种组合中，MAE平均相对最强基线降低14.5%；在Task Update和In-call Update上分别平均降低27.8%和30.4%。预算控制重放在七个预算下平均节省21.3% Token且保持固定预算的轨迹完成率。每调用一次更新的累计预测时间仅32.8 ms（占GPT-5.4运行129 s中位数时间的<0.03%）。

Conclusion: TokenCast提供了一个轻量级、无需额外LLM调用的预测层，可在线预估智能体执行成本。其段级组合表示在域迁移和模型迁移场景下表现鲁棒，仅需少量目标任务即可达到优于目标域单独训练的效果，为智能体运行时的预算管理决策奠定了基础。

Abstract: When a large language model (LLM) agent executes the same task, token consumption can vary by over an order of magnitude across runs. The agent chooses its next steps based on tool feedback and intermediate results, while the growing context steadily inflates the input size of every subsequent call. The total consumption of a task is therefore hard to predict before execution and the prediction must be revised as the run unfolds. In this paper, we propose TokenCast, which learns a composable cost representation for each execution segment, recording its own consumption and the context growth it introduces. Composing adjacent segments yields a cumulative estimate that captures the extra input cost incurred when context from earlier segments is re-read by every later call. As execution unfolds, newly observed evidence refreshes the forecast, requiring no additional LLM calls and incurring a mean cumulative prediction time of 32.8 ms per run on SWE-bench Verified. Across 4 task suites and 6 agent models, TokenCast's mean absolute error reduction against the strongest comparator averages 14.5% over 96 evaluated combinations. In offline budget-control replay, TokenCast uses 21.3% fewer tokens on average than a fixed-budget policy at matched trace completion. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1071] [Trapped by Their Own Rollouts: Understanding Aggregation--Rollout Feedback in Federated On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32573)
*Jinqian Chen,Jihua Zhu,Chang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究联邦在线策略蒸馏（FedOPD），发现FedAvg的协作增益高度依赖学习率：在小学习率下可能无增益甚至为负，而大学习率下恢复明显优势。作者将此归因于"聚合-展开反馈"机制，并通过可解模型理论加以解释，提出FedTOPS方法以教师反馈自适应地调整聚合更新幅度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究当适配提示分布在不同客户端时，联邦协作是否能提升在线策略蒸馏的效果，并理解为什么协作增益在不同学习率下表现出极大差异。

Method: 1) 区分学习者与生成器两个角色，建立聚合-展开反馈理论框架；2) 构造两阶段高斯自回归可解模型，证明聚合导致的优化滞后会延迟未来监督的获取；3) 提出FedTOPS（联邦教师引导的在线策略缩放），复用当前轨迹的教师反馈，在客户端预测变化约束下自适应选择FedAvg更新的幅度倍数a∈{0.5,1,2,3,5,10}。

Result: 在六个数学推理基准上，FedTOPS相对FedAvg的macro Avg@8提升4.56–14.57个百分点；在0.6B学生参考学习率下从3.91%提升到16.84%，超过Centralized基线；在1.7B学生上从11.74%提升到26.31%，接近Centralized的26.21%。Rollout源干预实验证实生成器源直接影响后续学习效果。

Conclusion: 联邦在线策略蒸馏中，聚合不仅影响当前学习，还通过改变学生生成的轨迹分布来影响未来监督的可用性。学习率具有"学习当前监督"和"到达未来监督"两个耦合角色。有效的联邦聚合必须同时考虑当前更新带来的进步和由此产生的学生所创造的学习机会，FedTOPS通过教师引导的幅度选择有效解决了这一耦合问题。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach to language-model adaptation, aligning teacher supervision with the student's own generated trajectories. When adaptation prompts are distributed across clients, can this process benefit from federated collaboration? We study federated OPD and find that substantial collaboration gains can be obscured by learning-rate sensitivity: FedAvg can perform no better than independent local training at a small learning rate, yet recover a clear advantage at a larger rate. We explain this phenomenon through the student's dual role as learner and generator of future training data. An aggregation-induced optimization lag can delay access to useful teacher supervision, which in turn slows subsequent learning. Our theory establishes this aggregation--rollout feedback in a solvable model with a common optimum and stable updates, and identifies two coupled roles of learning rate: learning from current supervision and reaching future supervision. Guided by this analysis, we propose FedTOPS (Federated Teacher-guided On-Policy Scaling), which reuses teacher feedback on current trajectories to adapt the FedAvg update magnitude under clientwise predictive-change constraints. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, FedTOPS improves macro Avg@8 over FedAvg by 4.56--14.57 percentage points across the evaluated student models and local learning rates.

</details>


### [1072] [Over-the-Air Federated Learning in Heterogeneous Mobile Wireless Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32832)
*Ming Xiang,Nicolò Michelusi,Yonina C. Eldar,Lili Su*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 FedOAG 算法，用于在异构移动无线网络中进行空中计算联邦学习。该算法通过截断信道反转结合梯度归一化实现能量约束自动满足，并通过隐式 gossip 实现设备更新的均匀混合，无需所有设备传输、不依赖特定衰落模型或时变信道分布知识。理论证明在非凸条件下达到最优 O(1/√T) 收敛速率，实验在 MNIST 数据集上验证了在动态无线条件下的优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空中计算联邦学习方法在异构衰落信道下面临两大挑战：(1) 强制所有设备无偏更新会因最弱信道大幅放大接收端噪声；(2) 允许部分设备贡献的方法对衰落模型失配敏感，且仅收敛到有偏目标。本文旨在解决异构、时变、未知统计信道分布下的无偏联邦学习问题。

Method: FedOAG 算法包含两大核心机制：(1) 截断信道反转配合梯度归一化——通过在线范数追踪器 Bt 对本地更新进行归一化，自动满足每设备能量约束，无需预先知道梯度范数上界；(2) 延迟全局模型广播——参数服务器在每轮末尾而非开头广播更新模型，使活跃设备通过隐式 gossip 均匀混合信息，无需设备间直接通信。算法无需统计信道分布信息，适用于任意衰落模型。

Result: 理论方面：证明 FedOAG 在满足各假设条件下收敛到非凸目标函数的无偏驻点，收敛速率为 O(1/√T)（任意随机一阶方法的最佳可能速率）。实验方面：在 MNIST 数据集、30 个设备的设置下，FedOAG 在静止、非平稳（移动速度 0-2.5 m/s）和混合移动场景中均达到约 83% 测试精度，优于 SCA（约 81%）和其他 OTA 基线方法，且在 γ=10^-9 时取得最优的活跃设备数与接收噪声平衡。

Conclusion: FedOAG 是首个能够在异构、时变、未知统计信道分布条件下实现无偏收敛的空中计算联邦学习算法，通过截断传输与梯度归一化、延迟广播两项创新解决能量约束与偏差修正问题。未来工作方向包括：提高存储效率、避免保存检查点、放松有界梯度假设、以及设计不依赖 CDI 知识的 γ 自适应调参框架。

Abstract: Over-the-air computation has emerged as a scalable and efficient solution for deploying federated learning algorithms in wireless networks by exploiting waveform superposition for simultaneous model aggregation. Most existing work struggles with heterogeneous fading channels. These approaches either enforce unbiased updates from all devices or allow partial device contributions, requiring careful tuning of the convergence bound to mitigate bias under specific fading models. However, the former significantly amplifies receiver noise due to the weakest channel, whereas the latter is sensitive to fading model mismatch and converges only to a biased objective. To tackle these challenges, we propose FedOAG, which employs algorithmic components to automatically satisfy energy constraints via gradient normalization and evenly mix devices' updates through implicit gossiping. Importantly, FedOAG does not require transmission from all devices, nor does it rely on a specific fading model or knowledge of time-varying statistical channel distributions. We show that FedOAG converges to a stationary point of an unbiased non-convex objective at the best possible rate $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ for any stochastic first-order method. We corroborate our analysis with numerical experiments over dynamic wireless conditions on real-world datasets.

</details>


### [1073] [SketchSSM: Write to the Full State, Read from a Compact Sketch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33051)
*Omin Kwon,JoongWon Shin,Minseo Kim,Kurt Keutzer,Sehoon Kim,Jae W. Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SketchSSM 是一种训练无关的推理加速方法，用于混合注意力模型中的线性注意力层。它通过在状态刷新时用一次完整状态读预计算固定查询基向量的输出（形成一个紧凑的"草图"），并在随后的解码步骤中通过查询相关的系数线性组合这些草图向量来重建输出，从而显著减少状态读取流量（约10×），同时保持完整状态更新的精确性，在Mamba-2/GDN/KDA模型上实现了高达7.78×的线性注意力核加速和2.64×的解码吞吐提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合注意力模型虽然通过将大多数softmax注意力替换为线性注意力来减少KV缓存增长、增大解码批量，但在大批量场景下，循环状态的读写成为主要瓶颈。现有的状态压缩方法（量化、剪枝）会引入误差在后续解码步骤中累积传播；ReplaySSM虽通过缓冲键值摊销了写入流量，但每个新查询仍需完整状态读取，导致读取流量未被减少。需要一种能减少读取流量且不传播压缩误差的方法。

Method: 核心观察：状态读取输出可通过低秩状态加权查询近似来准确重建，未来查询虽未知但查询基向量可离线固定。SketchSSM在每次状态更新（flush）时通过一次完整状态读，将状态与G个固定查询基向量相乘，预计算输出存入紧凑草图U∈ℝ^{V×G}。后续每个解码步骤中，通过查询相关的系数c_t = C·q̃_t线性组合草图向量重建输出，无需读完整状态。离线校准：Ω通过状态加权查询的PCA获得；草图秩通过多选择背包问题在各层各头间非均匀分配；系数图C用低秩加对角近似加速。完整状态更新仍精确进行，压缩仅用于读取。

Result: 在四个模型（Nemotron Nano 9B v2/Nemotron 3 Super基于Mamba-2、Qwen3.8 Flash Next基于GDN、GLM 5.3 Flash基于KDA）上，SketchSSM将状态访问流量减少约10×，同时在MATH-500/AIME25/GPQA-D/LiveCodeBench四个基准上保持平均准确率，在RULER四个检索任务上保持召回率。在NVIDIA B300上，相对vLLM标准基线，线性注意力核加速比达7.78×/5.22×/5.20×（Mamba-2/GDN/KDA），Nemotron 3 Super上解码吞吐量提升达2.64×。消融实验显示：校准基比随机正交基提升15.0-51.7点，状态依赖系数比离线映射提升7.4-46.4点，非均匀秩分配比均匀分配提升6.1-29.6点。

Conclusion: SketchSSM通过解耦状态更新与状态读取——保持完整状态进行精确更新、仅近似读取——成功解决了混合注意力模型中线性注意力的状态读取瓶颈。其离线校准的查询基、状态依赖系数图和头级秩分配机制使其在大幅减少状态访问流量（~10×）的同时保持模型准确率，为线性注意力推理加速提供了一种训练无关的实用方案，相对状态量化和剪枝方法在精度-流量权衡上有显著优势。

Abstract: Hybrid-attention models replace most softmax attention layers with linear attention, reducing KV-cache growth and enabling larger decode batches where recurrent state access becomes a major bottleneck. ReplaySSM amortizes state updates by buffering keys and values, but each new query still requires a full-state read even though the state remains unchanged between state updates. We observe that low-rank state-weighted query approximation accurately preserves state-read outputs. Although future queries are unknown, the basis vectors used to approximate them can be fixed offline. Based on this observation, we introduce SketchSSM, which preserves full-state updates while approximating reads. At each state update, SketchSSM reads the full state once to precompute outputs for these basis vectors, storing them in a compact sketch. Each subsequent decode step combines the sketch vectors with query-dependent coefficients to reconstruct the output without a full-state read. Across four Mamba-2-, GDN-, and KDA-based models, SketchSSM reduces state-access traffic by approximately 10x while largely preserving average accuracy across four decode benchmarks and recall on four RULER retrieval tasks. On one NVIDIA B300, linear-attention kernel speedups over the standard vLLM baseline reach 7.78x, 5.22x, and 5.20x for Mamba-2, GDN, and KDA, respectively, with up to 2.64x higher decode throughput on Nemotron 3 Super.

</details>


### [1074] [FoldAttention: Declared-Reference Softmax for Fast Decode and Deterministic Backward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33410)
*Sriman Achanta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FoldAttention提出了一种基于"声明参考值"的softmax注意力方法，通过在扫描KV cache前预先固定参考值Zi，使每个权重在计算时就已确定，从而支持按最终权重门控读取键值数据、在长上下文自回归解码中实现1.36-3.09倍加速，并使反向传播具备无序确定性且比最快非确定性内核更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高性能注意力内核使用在线softmax，在扫描键时发现行的归一化参考值，导致早期贡献是临时的可能需要重新缩放，带宽已接近上限时难以进一步加速解码；反向传播中FP32加法非结合性导致位模式依赖CTA到达顺序，确定性模式带来显著吞吐量损失（FA-3达38%、FA-4达25%）。作者主张参考值无需"发现"而应"声明"，因为softmax对公共偏移不变。

Method: FoldAttention采用加性softmax公式，在扫描KV cache前为每个查询行固定有限参考Zi。每个权重2^{sij-Zi}在计算时即为最终值，使得不相交键范围的贡献可直接相加。解码内核利用INT8双平面键缓存（平面A+缩放给出最终权重用于门控平面B和值的读取），并引入每调用深度T参数丢弃低于2^{-T}的键但保留其质量。反向传播中各CTA将偏梯度舍入到预先声明的2的幂次网格上，以整数形式任意顺序相加，实现确定性。

Result: 在H100上，T=16时FoldAttention解码七个真实模型生成比最快BF16基线快1.36-2.30倍，MHA和GQA形状扫描中最高达3.09倍加速，误差在六/七个案例中处于最低BF16误差的1.5%以内；读取所有键时匹配误差下仍快1.14-1.30倍。Qwen3-8B上完整解码步骤最高加速1.46倍，可能性与长上下文精度匹配BF16内核。确定性反向传播比确定性FA-3/4快最高1.84倍，比最快非确定性内核快1.05倍，梯度位完全相同。

Conclusion: FoldAttention通过"声明"而非"发现"数值参考值，解耦了softmax注意力中的并行工作依赖关系。最终权重使解码仅读取所需字节，从BF16内核精度到3倍加速共用同一缓存；声明的网格使反向传播可任意顺序求和整数，确定性且比非确定性更快。该工作针对Hopper架构，头维64/128，支持MHA和GQA，不支持MLA等潜在缓存。

Abstract: Autoregressive decode repeatedly streams a growing KV cache, making attention a major cost at long context. Existing high-performance kernels use online softmax, which discovers a row's normalization reference as it scans keys. Earlier contributions therefore remain provisional and may require rescaling. We argue that the reference need not be discovered: softmax is invariant to a common shift, so the reference only has to keep the weights in range. We present FoldAttention, an additive formulation of softmax attention that fixes a finite reference $Z_i$ before scanning the KV cache. Each weight $2^{s_{ij}-Z_i}$ is then final when computed, so contributions add across disjoint key ranges and their quotient equals softmax attention in real arithmetic. We use this property to develop two techniques for Hopper decode: (1) final weights gate key and value reads before the bytes are fetched, and a per-call depth $T$ cuts keys below $2^{-T}$ while keeping their mass, and (2) additive partials compose split KV and shared-prefix cascades without rescaling. On H100 at $T=16$, FoldAttention decodes seven real-model generations 1.36-2.30$\times$ faster than the fastest BF16 baseline, and up to 3.09$\times$ faster across MHA and GQA shapes, at an error within 1.5% of the lowest BF16 error on six of the seven; reading every key, it is 1.14-1.30$\times$ faster at matched error. We validate on Qwen3-8B that a whole decode step is up to 1.46$\times$ faster while likelihood and long-context accuracy match those under BF16 kernels. The same principle makes the backward deterministic: CTAs round bounded partial gradients onto an integer grid declared before the reduction and add them in any order. FoldAttention thereby removes the determinism tax: its deterministic backward is up to 1.84$\times$ faster than deterministic FlashAttention-3/4 and 1.05$\times$ faster than the fastest nondeterministic kernel.

</details>


### [1075] [QwenGyre: An Elastic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Training xLong-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33848)
*Weiqi Wang,Yuxin Zhou,Mouxiang Chen,Siyuan Zhang,Yi Zhang,Yuyan Luo,Zhiyu Yin,Chencan Wu,Jiemin Jiang,Wentao Yao,Chujie Zheng,JianWei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QwenGyre是一个端到端的在线强化学习框架，专为xLong-horizon（超长时程）LLM智能体训练设计。它通过弹性调度器在rollout和training之间动态重新分配GPU，同时通过轨迹处理器处理由黑盒harness产生的非线性和分支轨迹，以解决xLong场景下的GPU空闲和训练冗余两大核心挑战。在旗舰模型Qwen 3.8 2.4T上，48步内将NL2RepoBench的passrate从52.5%提升至58.5%，相比Colocate和Async基线分别获得最高1.85×和1.78×的端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体承担越来越复杂的软件工程任务（如仓库生成、代码库重构），单次执行需要持续数小时、跨越数百次模型-环境交互并处理近1M tokens。在xLong-horizon场景下，传统在线RL面临两大根本挑战：（1）rollout执行方差大且尾延迟长，导致严重的GPU空闲；（2）harness驱动的上下文压缩、子代理委托和重试产生非线性的分支轨迹，造成严重的训练冗余。现有Colocate（共享池交替）和Async（固定分区）方案都无法同时解决这两个问题。

Method: 框架包含两大核心组件：(1) **弹性调度器**：将GPU组织为多个弹性cell和一个可选的独立rollout池，基于waterlevel（未完成执行数）动态在rollout和training之间切换cell角色而不中断harness执行；通过RDMA进行KV-cache迁移和参数同步以支持harness保持；采用集中式动态数据并行，新加入的satellite cell可在batch中途加入训练；通过流式训练（streaming training）和micro-step分配均衡各cell的训练负载。(2) **轨迹处理器**：通过TITO（token-in, token-out）代理记录精确的模型请求token和log-prob；将执行记录组织为带共享前缀的轨迹树，保留每个输出的原始条件上下文；对超时后的部分工作进行评估以获得有效奖励；在训练时按角色优先级（main > main-summary > sub-agent > sub-agent-summary）选取最多J_max条轨迹/执行，并通过树上掩码确保共享目标仅贡献一次损失；执行级损失归一化避免多轨迹执行获得过大权重。RL算法采用GSPO适配，结合token级重要性加权和执行级clipping。

Result: 在NL2RepoBench（Qwen 3.6 122B, 32节点8 cell）上，QwenGyre相比Async获得1.42-1.53×加速，相比Colocate获得1.36-1.47×加速，平均执行时间约1.93小时/rollout。在NL2RepoBench（Qwen 3.8 2.4T, 4×48节点cell）上，48步训练仅需75.42小时（vs Async 134.55小时, Colocate 91.47小时），passrate从52.48%提升至58.54%。在DeepSWE和TerminalBench上也获得一致的1.38-1.85×加速。消融实验表明：细粒度弹性分配（fine-grained cell switching）相比粗粒度切换带来1.19×加速；流式训练相比Async减少11.6%时间；轨迹采样预算J_max=5在保持训练分数的同时减少25.2%的前向-反向时间。附录中通过执行f3ad38e5的案例研究展示了636次代理请求如何被组织为10条候选轨迹，以及共享前缀和压缩带来的冗余。

Conclusion: QwenGyre通过弹性调度和轨迹处理的协同设计，成功将在线RL扩展到xLong-horizon智能体训练场景。弹性调度在保持harness持续服务的同时最大化GPU利用率；轨迹处理器通过前缀共享、角色优先级采样和执行级归一化，将分支执行高效转换为有界的训练样本。在三个基准测试上一致优于Colocate和Async基线，且训练分数相当，证明了该框架在效率和有效性上的优势。局限性包括：小GPU预算下细粒度cell划分的可行性未评估；多步burst下无法全局打乱数据。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly undertake extreme-long (xlong) horizon tasks, where a single execution can span hours, hundreds of model--environment interactions, and nearly 1M tokens per rollout. Applying online reinforcement learning (RL) to such executions poses two fundamental challenges: (1) severe execution variance and prolonged rollout delays cause massive GPU idling; and (2) complex non-linear branching generates massive trajectory redundancy, crippling training efficiency. To address these, we presents QwenGyre, an end-to-end framework for xlong-horizon online RL. QwenGyre elastically reallocates GPUs between rollout and training without interrupting live executions, while its trajectory processor reconstructs branching histories, scores partial progress, and deduplicates redundant paths to bound training costs. Scaled to our flagship model, Qwen~3.8 2.4T, with 700K tokens per rollout, QwenGyre yields a 6.0% absolute gain on NL2RepoBench (52.5% $\to$ 58.5%) in 48 steps. Across our evaluations on diverse domains of training datasets, QwenGyre delivers up to $1.85\times$ and $1.78\times$ speedups over Colocate and Async, respectively.

</details>


### [1076] [Broken Symmetry in BF16 Attention: Why FlashAttention Gradients Blow Up Late in Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34272)
*Junlin Chen,Daize Dong,Huanwei Di,Haolong Jia,Jiawei Wu,Haotian Xie,Mingkai Zheng,Yang Li,Leshang Chen,Huishu Wang,Eric P. Xing,Hongyi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示了FlashAttention-3在BF16精度下后期训练崩溃的根因：注意力反向传播中score梯度被cast到BF16后,其行和(守恒律)被打破,产生一个沿均值键方向的"泄漏"误差,该误差在训练后期键范数增大、注意力尖锐化时被放大。作者提出GProj(gauge projection)方法,通过两次rank-one修正恢复零行和,将query/key梯度误差从219%/13%降至0.34%/0.37%,仅增加4.7%训练时间,与FP32注意力达到相同精度和最终损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模预训练中,FlashAttention-3等BF16融合注意力核被广泛信赖,但其反向传播的数值精度很少在训练后期这种关键场景下被检验。作者在使用FA3预训练450M参数Transformer到50B tokens时发现:前25B tokens训练正常,之后梯度范数暴增1000倍、损失比FP32注意力高0.2 nats,但全程无NaN。这种"静默"失败难以诊断,容易被归因于超参数或数据。

Method: 方法分两阶段:(1)理论分析——将误差定位到两个通道:通道1是前向softmax中FMA融合的"scale+subtract max"操作导致saved output有误;通道2是反向中score梯度g被cast到BF16的t后,行和ρ=Σtⱼ≠0,产生沿均值键μₖ的泄漏项α·ρ·μₖ。证明该泄漏无法通过任何前向修复消除,且随键范数‖μₖ‖/σₖ增长。(2)解决方案GProj——在cast之后,用BF16概率r的实际质量m=Σrⱼ计算λ=ρ/m,对t作两次rank-one修正t⊥=t−λr(查询端)和对应键端修正,恢复零行和守恒律,使误差界变为|α|u_b σₖ·σₐ(与‖μₖ‖无关),并保持键平移不变性。

Result: 在8个从训练中捕获的真实注意力输入上,GProj将中位query/key梯度相对L₂误差从FA3-SBS修复前向后的219%/13%降至0.34%/0.37%,与FP32注意力(0.384%/0.371%)持平;在四键合成案例中精确恢复真实零梯度;通过60个合成案例(含common-key shift、GQA、长序列等)全部合格。从头训练450M模型50B tokens:GProj最终损失1.665与FP32注意力一致,FA3高出0.2 nats,FA3-SBS虽稳定但高出0.01-0.02 nats且进入大logit区,key smoothing延迟约3B tokens后仍崩溃,Qiu-Yao动态位移在13.2B tokens即停滞。代价:GProj每步仅增加4.7%时间(融合FP32为33.4%),不增加额外前向存储。

Conclusion: 论文确立了一个一般性原理:低精度注意力核应在其实际乘以的操作数上验证精确恒等式(此处为零行和守恒律)。GProj通过在BF16 cast后做最小二乘意义下的零和投影,恢复了该守恒律,把query/key梯度误差压到BF16硬件下界,以极低代价匹配FP32精度,为审计和修复其他低精度核提供了实用方法。

Abstract: BF16 is now standard in large-scale pretraining, including in fused attention kernels such as FlashAttention, and these kernels are widely trusted. When we used FlashAttention-3 to pretrain a 450M-parameter transformer on 50B tokens, however, we ran into a problem: training was healthy for 25B tokens, then the gradient norm grew a thousandfold and the loss ended 0.2 nats above FP32 attention, without a single NaN. Recomputing the attention backward of just two layers in FP32 removes almost all of the excess gradient. Part of the cause is known: a fused multiply-add in the forward softmax, so far treated as an extreme-input NaN case and never fixed in FlashAttention-3. Repairing it stops the blow-up, but the query gradient is still wrong by more than its own size, and training still drives attention logits to thousands of times their size under accurate gradients. The remaining error comes from a broken conservation law. The softmax score gradient sums to zero along every row, which makes the query gradient blind to where the keys sit as a group; rounding it to BF16 leaves a small nonzero sum that leaks the mean key into the gradient, and the leak grows exactly as late training makes keys large and attention sharp. We introduce GProj (gauge projection), which restores the zero sum after the cast with two rank-one corrections per row. It cuts the remaining median query/key gradient errors from 219%/13% to 0.34%/0.37%, on par with FP32 attention, for 4.7% more time per training step. In matched from-scratch runs it trains to the same loss as FP32 attention, while FlashAttention-3 and key smoothing both destabilize.

</details>


### [1077] [Spexis: Speculative Lookahead Scheduling for LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34370)
*Hyungyu Jung,Jaehyeok Yu,Hoonseo Choi,Sungkyun Kim,Jinho Lee,Jiwon Seo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Spexis是一个多GPU LLM推理框架,通过将推测解码与正常执行并行运行,引入新的"推测并行"(SP)维度,在不增加KV-cache内存的前提下提升管道并行(PP)与张量并行(TP)的效率;结合前瞻调度(选择性推测+剩余长度感知调度),在多种GPU配置下相比最优PP+TP基线实现最高34%的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多GPU LLM推理面临PP(微批次导致内存压力增大、批次减小)和TP(同步通信开销)两类瓶颈,且随GPU数量增加而恶化,简单的并行度扩展不一定能提升吞吐。需要一种新的并行执行策略来同时缓解两类瓶颈。

Method: 1) 推测并行(SP):采用自推测模型,在管道第一阶段生成草稿token后,让第一阶段继续执行推测执行,同时第二阶段进行验证,推测与正常执行共享KV-cache,从而获得额外的并行轴而不增加显存。2) 解析成本模型:为PP/TP/SP建立稳态吞吐估计,通过profile得到各项延迟,选择最优PP/TP/SP组合。3) 前瞻调度:(a) 选择性推测——按置信度丢弃低分token(比例α),仅对高置信token推测以提升准确率;(b) 剩余长度感知调度——用三层MLP预测剩余输出长度的阈值区间,预估未来64步KV-cache使用,延迟可能引发驱逐的新请求,并通过分析模型权衡驱逐重计算代价与延迟收益。

Result: 在私有集群(跨节点RTX PRO 6000×2与节点内A40×8)及Runpod云(H100/A100/RTX PRO 6000/L40S,各8卡)上,用Llama-3.3-70B与Qwen3-32B在SpecBench/LMSYS-Chat/UltraChat评估。跨节点设置最高34%加速(归一化时延),解码吞吐最高54%加速;节点内8卡优于PP+TP 8%–16%;PCIe平台SP全面优于TP(1.02–1.21×),A100 SXM上Llama达1.27×;高带宽NVLink场景TP仍具优势。逐项消融:SP基础带来10–15%,选择性推测再增3–12pp,长度感知调度再增3pp。推测准确率1/2退出层为0.60–0.79,选择性推测可提升8–14pp;剩余长度预测精度多为70%–90.7%。

Conclusion: Spexis证明了推测解码不仅可作为算法加速手段,也可作为系统级机制提升分布式LLM推理性能;通过SP+前瞻调度在多GPU/多种互连下普遍优于最优PP+TP基线,但优势幅度取决于互连带宽与推测准确率,且需要训练草稿适配器与长度预测器。

Abstract: Spexis is a multi-GPU LLM inference framework that improves the efficiency of pipeline and tensor parallelism through speculative parallelism. Rather than using speculative decoding only to accelerate token generation, Spexis runs speculation in parallel with normal execution, introducing a new parallelism axis without increasing KV-cache memory usage. This improves memory efficiency and helps mitigate the bottlenecks of multi-GPU inference. Spexis further uses lookahead scheduling to predict speculation quality and future memory pressure, allowing it to reduce wasted speculation, KV-cache eviction, and recomputation. Built on top of vLLM, Spexis largely improves serving performance across a range of GPU configurations, achieving speedups of up to 34% over a baseline that uses the optimal combination of pipeline and tensor parallelism. Spexis's source code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1078] [E3J: An Efficient and Open-Source Backend for Euclidean Equivariant Operations on GPU and TPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35099)
*Olivier Peltre,Armand Picard,Adrien Pichard,Miguel Bragança,Luca Giacomoni,Valentin Heyraud,Zachary Weller-Davies,Christoph Brunken,Jules Tilly*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: e3j 是一个开源、高性能的 Euclid 等变运算后端库，为 JAX 框架提供 GPU 和 TPU 上的加速内核，通过优化 CUDA 和 Pallas 内核实现张量积与消息传递卷积的 SOTA 性能，在 H100 GPU 上达到超过 80% 的 HBM 带宽。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Euclid 等变神经网络（特别是机器学习原子间势 MLIP）需要精确的等变保证，但现有等变运算后端（如 e3nn、cuEquivariance、OpenEquivariance）存在平台兼容性差、闭源或 TPU 支持不足等问题。e3j 旨在提供一个统一的、开源的、跨 GPU 和 TPU 平台的高性能等变运算后端，填补大规模等变深度学习在 TPU 上的空白。

Method: 1. **三套内核实现**：CUDA 内核（确定性、广兼容，AOT 编译）、Pallas GPU 内核（高性能，依赖 Mosaic JIT 编译，前向确定性）、Pallas TPU 内核（针对 TPU v6e 优化）。2. **CUDA 核心优化**：采用尾部通道并行、float2/float4 向量化、系数打包（uint8/int32 索引）、SMEM 输入行缓冲和按输出索引分组的系数分布。3. **Pallas GPU 关键创新**：追踪时（trace-time）CG 系数特化，将系数嵌入生成代码；接收方排序的 CSR 边遍历，避免原子操作。4. **Pallas TPU 关键设计**：边分块（edge-tile）调度，VMEM 容纳边级消息块，SMEM 存索引；分段接收方归约；边标量从路径求和中提取出来。5. **微分设计**：通过循环引用低阶微分定义无穷可微 JAX 原语；卷积反向使用专门的 Pallas 内核（CUDA 复用前向代码）。

Result: 在 H100 GPU 上：Pallas GPU 内核消息传递卷积前向吞吐达 1621-2074 GB/s（约为 cuEquivariance 的 2 倍），达 H100 峰值带宽（3.35 TB/s）的 80% 以上；MACE 水盒 NPT 模拟比 cuEquivariance 快 34%（17.61 vs 13.12 ns/day），比 OpenEquivariance 快 2 倍。在 TPU v6e 上：张量积和卷积吞吐比 e3nn-jax 高一个数量级，达到 TPUv6e 峰值带宽（1.64 TB/s）的 81%。端到端 MACE/NequIP 力推理在 TPU 上比 e3nn 快约 5 倍。支持最多 64k 原子的 MACE 系统规模。单 H100 上。

Conclusion: e3j 通过精心设计的 CUDA 和 Pallas 内核，成功实现了高效、开源且跨 GPU/TPU 平台的 Euclid 等变运算后端，在小 L≤3 区域达到接近硬件极限的内存带宽利用率。这表明通过适当的工程实现，完全 CG 张量积和消息传递可以在 GPU 和 TPU 上达到 SOTA 效率，为等变网络与高度优化的 Transformer 架构之间的公平比较提供了更平等的基础。作为开源 Apache 2.0 项目发布，有望成为社区继续优化等变运算的新起点。

Abstract: We present e3j, a fast Euclid-equivariance backend for geometric deep learning applications with JAX bindings for GPU and TPU. Leveraging both optimized CUDA and Pallas kernels and algorithmic improvements, the library achieves state-of-the-art throughput and runtime on both forward and backward paths. On a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) use case, it outperforms established backends, measuring up to 34% speed-up over cuEquivariance on water box NPT simulation using MACE, while remaining fully open source. E3j achieves over 80% efficiency over the H100 maximum memory bandwidth on tensor product operations, and in many cases more than doubles throughput of message passing convolutions forward compared to previously available backends. In addition, with the release of dedicated Pallas TPU kernel, e3j opens the possibility of large scale equivariant deep learning workloads on TPU architectures, which has so far been difficult to achieve. Our benchmarks show that e3j also achieves over 80% of a TPUv6e memory bandwidth, up to one order of magnitude more than e3nn-jax. The library is available on GitHub, PyPI and is released under an open source Apache 2.0 license.

</details>


### [1079] [EdgeCraft: Automated Model Crafting for Edge IoT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35167)
*Genglin Wang,Kaiwei Liu,Liekang Zeng,Wangsong Yin,Shangcheng Jin,Guoliang Xing,Zhenyu Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EdgeCraft是一个LLM驱动的Model Crafting as a Service (MCaaS)系统，将高层意图自动转化为可在边缘IoT设备上部署的机器学习制品。它通过约束感知合成树和多保真验证器解决了边缘ML开发中搜索空间巨大、验证成本高两大核心挑战，在50个公开任务上超越了任务特定的Reference基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘IoT应用中ML部署面临三大难题：(1) 应用多样且SLO各异（视觉/语言/音频/感知等任务的延迟、能耗、质量要求差异巨大）；(2) 搜索空间巨大（数据表示、模型家族、训练方案、推理运行时需耦合选择）；(3) 执行环境碎片化（Raspberry Pi、Jetson等不同硬件栈）。现有自动化方法覆盖不全、难以跨场景扩展，且LLM生成的代码虽易通过语法检查但极少能在目标设备上真正运行（81个候选中仅10个可在目标设备执行，0个通过SLO）。亟需一种将代码合成与目标设备物理验证深度结合的端到端服务。

Method: 提出MCaaS服务抽象，EdgeCraft采用"提议与决策分离"的核心设计原则：(1) 约束感知合成树——将边缘ML开发组织为树结构，每个节点存储候选及其验证结果，用有符号SLO缺口（正值未满足、负值有裕量）指导分支扩展与剪枝；(2) 多保真验证器——通过P0静态检查→P1目标设备预训练测量→P2完整训练与设备验证三级递进，采用校准后的保守下界（m̂-2σ-ε_cal > τ）实现早期安全剪枝；(3) 跨租户共享服务——通过pipeline sharing（流水线共享，使云训练与设备验证在不同请求间重叠）和rule sharing（规则共享，将复现的设备-运行时失败转化为可复用的验证规则）。决策权限与验证保真度绑定：仅P2可接受制品。

Result: 在50个公开任务（覆盖CV、NLP、音频、传感时序、表格、多模态六类）上：EdgeCraft在40个任务上超越Reference的best-observed质量，在45个任务上找到SLO可行的制品（两者重叠38个），相较MetaGPT-Verification产出2.4倍多的SLO可行任务，token消耗减少55.8%（0.71M vs 1.61M），开发时间缩短10.6倍。多保真验证器减少验证时间25.7%而保持相同选中制品；验证失败复用使设备评估从101次降至44次（56.4%）。在自收集的SEN可穿戴情感识别数据集上，sample-level AUROC达0.8953（最佳），cross-subject AUROC达0.5683（与最强基线MiniRocket持平）。在0.3×严格SLO下仍能保留73.1%的任务质量。

Conclusion: EdgeCraft是首个将开放式代码合成与目标设备验证深度耦合的MCaaS系统，通过约束感知合成树、多保真验证器与跨租户共享服务实现了边缘ML制品的全自动化合成。该系统在广泛的任务覆盖、竞争性的质量、更低的验证成本和token消耗之间取得了平衡，并在真实世界可穿戴IoT感知任务上展现出良好的泛化能力。其能力边界出现在质量高度依赖高容量任务专属骨干网络的场景（如车辆重识别T16），以及极端严格SLO下覆盖范围显著收窄的情况（0.1×时仅42任务中21个可行）。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) increasingly powers Internet of Things (IoT) applications at the edge. Yet producing a deployable edge ML artifact for a specific scenario requires navigating a huge search space spanning data representation, model design, training on domain-specific data, and runtime customization. This workflow is fragmented and difficult to scale across diverse edge applications. We present EdgeCraft, an LLM-driven system that turns high-level intent into deployable edge ML artifacts. Building such a system raises two challenges: (1) How can an LLM be guided to find high-quality solutions that meet dynamic SLOs for task quality, latency, and energy? (2) How can trustworthy target-device verification be obtained at low cost? EdgeCraft addresses these challenges with two designs. (1) A constraint-aware synthesis tree explores alternative candidates and uses measured SLO gaps to guide each improvement. (2) A multi-fidelity verifier progressively combines low-cost checks with full target-device verification to reduce verification cost while preserving reliable verification results. It also records verified failures for reuse, avoiding repeated device work. To support concurrency, EdgeCraft provides a multi-tenant runtime that runs cloud training and target-device verification in parallel while isolating requests. Across 50 public tasks, EdgeCraft exceeds the task-specific Reference in best-observed quality on 40 tasks and finds an SLO-feasible artifact on 45, with the two outcomes overlapping on 38 tasks. Moreover, EdgeCraft achieves competitive performance on our self-collected SEN dataset, suggesting its generalizability to real-world IoT sensing tasks.

</details>


### [1080] [SOLO: Pretraining Billion-Parameter Language Models with Shared-Output Local Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35440)
*Bojian Yin,Shurong Wang,Yuqi Pan,Guoqi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SOLO提出了一种新的局部学习方法，通过共享终端读出层（readout）的只读副本替代私有读出层，使十亿参数语言模型的预训练在质量上接近反向传播，同时消除更新锁定（update locking），显著提升流水线训练的吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统反向传播存在"更新锁定"问题：每层必须等待所有更深层的梯度回传后才能更新，导致内存开销大且存在空闲时间。传统局部学习虽通过为每个模块配备独立私有读出头来消除此依赖，但缺乏来自更深模块的信息，在十亿参数语言模型预训练上未能成功。核心问题是：局部学习能否在接近BP质量的前提下预训练十亿参数语言模型，并提升训练效率？

Method: SOLO（Shared-Output Local Learning）保留模块间的梯度隔离（stop-gradient），但将所有辅助头的私有读出层替换为终端读出层W的只读副本sg(W̄)。该副本取自前一步优化步骤，仅由最终损失更新，因此能从最终模块向所有头传递信息而不传递梯度或重新引入更新锁定。每个辅助头包含堆叠的Transformer块、标量温度τₖ和终端读出副本。读出副本可每S步刷新一次以减少同步开销。理论分析将局部梯度与BP梯度的差距分解为读出、残差和路径三项，SOLO通过共享读出消除读出项。

Result: 在340M至2B参数Transformer上用15B SlimPajama token预训练时，SOLO（K=2）将平均零样本准确率保持在BP的1分以内，WikiText困惑度差距随规模增大而缩小（340M时3.6%，2B时3.1%）。读出消融实验证实优势来源于共享（共享一个随机矩阵也比各头独立随机矩阵更好）。在流水线训练中，SOLO每个阶段仅需O(1)个微批次的激活内存（而非O(p)），吞吐速度最高达同分区1F1B的1.44倍（相同内存下1.43倍），对慢速链路容忍度高（降至1Gb/s时吞吐量仅下降1.2%，而1F1B下降51%）。每个SOLO模块的中间表示均可通过终端读出解码。

Conclusion: SOLO是首个能从零预训练十亿参数语言模型的局部学习方法。通过共享只读的终端读出副本，在保持梯度隔离的同时恢复了来自最终模块的信息流，使局部学习在340M至2B参数规模上接近BP。消除更新锁定后，流水线阶段仅持有O(1)个微批次激活，节省的内存可转化为更大的微批次和更高吞吐量。因此局部学习成为预训练大模型时在内存或带宽受限场景下的实用替代方案。局限：仅测试K=2和K=4的划分；辅助头增加11-13% FLOPs；仅在单节点评估；未涉及MoE、Grouped-Query Attention等现代架构。

Abstract: Large language models are trained with backpropagation, whose global gradient coordinates all layers but forces each to hold its activations and wait for the gradient to pass back through every deeper layer. Conventional local learning removes this update locking by training each module to predict the target through its own readout, but has not scaled to billion-parameter pretraining. We identify these private readouts as a key weakness, since they leave each module without information from deeper modules. We propose Shared-Output LOcal learning (SOLO), which replaces them with a shared, read-only copy of the final module's readout, the only one trained on the output of the whole network. Taken from the previous step, the copy transmits information from the final module without passing gradients between modules or reintroducing update locking. SOLO approaches backpropagation on Transformers of 340M to 2B parameters pretrained on 15B tokens, staying within one point in average zero-shot accuracy with a perplexity gap that narrows with scale. Readout ablations attribute SOLO's improvement over private readouts to sharing. Without update locking, each of p pipeline stages holds activations for O(1) micro-batches instead of O(p). The freed memory permits larger micro-batches, which reach up to 1.44x the best measured throughput of pipeline backpropagation on the same partition. To our knowledge, SOLO is the first local learning method to show such memory and throughput gains in billion-parameter language-model pretraining. Local learning thus becomes a practical alternative to backpropagation for large-scale pretraining.

</details>


### [1081] [KernelZero: Co-Evolving Proposer and Coder for Continuously Improved GPU Kernel Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33074)
*Changxin Ke,Rui Zhang,Zixiang Fang,Zhenghong Li,Yuanbo Wen,Jiashuo Shen,Shuo Wang,Jiaming Guo,Ling Li,Qi Guo,Yunji Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KernelZero提出了一种由Proposer和Coder协同进化的框架,用于持续改进GPU内核生成。前者从API集合生成Torch模块,后者将其翻译为CUDA或Triton内核,通过前沿驱动的模块生成和正确性感知的GRPO(CA-GRPO)实现自动课程学习。7B参数的KernelZero在KernelBench上超越Claude-4.5-Sonnet(CUDA)和DeepSeek-V4-Pro(Triton)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的GPU内核生成方法面临两大挑战:(1)与模型当前能力对齐的高质量训练数据稀缺,导致训练难以收敛或成本极高;(2)内核正确性与性能之间存在固有权衡——单独优化正确性往往导致保守的低加速比实现,而激进的性能优化则会显著增加错误风险。因此需要一种既能针对性提升又能兼顾正确性和性能的训练范式。

Method: 框架采用交替优化策略,包含两个基于Qwen2.5-Coder-7B初始化的模型:Proposer通过API共现分布采样API子集生成Torch模块,并经过AST检查、可运行检查和数值稳定性三重验证,通过FO-GRPO以"前沿奖励"(模块使Coder正确率接近50%时奖励最高)训练;Coder先经过基于四大优化原则(Tiling、Fusion、Pipeline、Reordering)的冷启动蒸馏,再通过CA-GRPO训练——该方法仅在组正确率达到阈值α时才对正确内核施加归一化加速比奖励,从而解耦正确性与性能信号。评估基础设施使用自研的Keck验证服务器,实现单样本GPU隔离执行和参数一致性。

Result: KernelZero-7B在KernelBench Level 1/2上CUDA pass@1达到75.8%/69.6%,pass@10达100%/97%;Triton pass@1达77.2%/72.5%。在CUDA上接近Claude-4.5-Sonnet(76.4%),在Triton上超越DeepSeek-V4-Pro(49.7%)和Dr.Kernel-8B/14B。消融实验表明持续更新Proposer使pass@1提升0.9-5.2个百分点,CA-GRPO中α=0.5在正确性和性能间取得最佳平衡(对比α=0/0.9/1.1)。Triton的fast_1@1显著优于CUDA,原因在于PyTorch Level 2任务依赖cuDNN/cuBLAS等高度优化的库。

Conclusion: 能力对齐的数据生成与正确性感知的优化相结合,能够在不同编程后端上同时提升执行准确性和内核性能。Proposer-Coder协同进化形成的自动课程学习范式无需人工标注,且仅需少量训练步数即可持续扩展模型能力边界,验证了针对性训练可使紧凑模型接近甚至超越参数量大数十倍的通用LLM。

Abstract: High-performance GPU kernels are essential to modern machine learning systems, yet automatically generating kernels that are both correct and efficient remains challenging. Existing LLM-based approaches face two major limitations: the scarcity of high-quality training data aligned with the model's current capabilities, and the inherent trade-off between kernel correctness and performance. To address these challenges, we propose KernelZero, a co-evolution framework that continuously improves GPU kernel generation through two specialized models: a Proposer that generates Torch modules from API sets and a Coder that translates them into CUDA or Triton kernels. KernelZero uses a frontier-driven module generation mechanism to continuously produce capability-aligned training modules based on the Coder's current weaknesses. It further introduces Correctness-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (CA-GRPO), which optimizes performance only after correctness becomes sufficiently reliable. By alternating the optimization of the Proposer and Coder, KernelZero forms an automatic curriculum that enables targeted and training-efficient capability improvement. Empirically, KernelZero-7B surpasses Claude-4.5-Sonnet on CUDA and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on Triton. On KernelBench Level 1 and 2, it achieves CUDA pass@1 scores of 75.8% and 69.6%, respectively, with pass@10 reaching 100% and 97%. On Triton, it achieves pass@1 scores of 77.2% and 72.5%, respectively.

</details>


### [1082] [ZonoGPT: Towards An Abstract Domain for Verifying Large GPT Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34457)
*Hai Duong,Thanh Le,ThanhVu Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZonoGPT是首个用于验证标准GPT-2架构的抽象域方法，通过结构化zonotope和块级融合变换，将空间复杂度与网络深度解耦，成功验证了GPT-2 Medium（24块，3亿+参数）模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer模型广泛用于关键任务，但现有神经网络验证方法仅限于小型或受限的Transformer架构，且在深层网络中精度损失严重，迫切需要可扩展到标准GPT架构的形式化验证技术来提供鲁棒性、安全性等保证。

Method: 提出ZonoGPT抽象域，包含三个核心组件：(1)结构化zonotope表示，使用共享生成器捕捉跨token相关性，局部生成器捕捉token内特征关系，区间分量控制深度增长；(2)块级融合变换，对注意力残差块联合上界近似skip和attention分支（基于残差Taylor展开），对LayerNorm进行融合处理，对GELU使用仿射变换；(3)生成器约简机制，通过选择重要生成器并将其余归入区间，确保空间复杂度O(Sd(m+q+1)+Sd²+HS²d)独立于网络深度L。

Result: 在2880个文本（MNIST、SST）和视觉任务实例上评估，ZonoGPT-A成功验证1339个实例（46.5%），其中4+块深度模型验证867个（40.1%），而所有基线方法（IBP、DeepZ、αβ-CROWN、CoVeNN）验证数量均为零。这是首个能验证官方HuggingFace标准架构GPT-2 Medium（24块，3亿+参数）的方法。消融实验证实：融合注意力变换对深层模型至关重要，融合MLP变换反而降低精度（验证实例减少19.6%）。

Conclusion: ZonoGPT通过结构化zonotope和块级融合变换突破了Transformer验证的可扩展性瓶颈，在标准GPT-2架构上实现了深度无关的空间复杂度和有效验证；未来工作将扩展到自回归解码的KV缓存联合上界和扩散模型验证。

Abstract: Transformer-based models are widely used for reasoning, coding, and multimodal agentic tasks. To provide formal assurance of desirable behaviors, such as robustness, safety, and fairness, neural network verification techniques prove required properties and provide auditable guarantees before deployment. However, prior work remains limited to small or restricted Transformers, and maintaining precision across deep models remains challenging. In this work, we introduce ZonoGPT, an abstract domain for verifying large transformers that maintains a space complexity independent of network depth. ZonoGPT uses a structured zonotope and a generator reduction mechanism to efficiently preserve correlations. To maintain precision, it introduces block-specific fused transformations for Attention and LayerNorm that retain feature relations, along with an affine transform for GELU that preserves generator relations. These mechanisms enable \tool{} to be the first approach to verify standard architectures, scaling to official HuggingFace models up to GPT-2 Medium (24 blocks, 300M+ parameters) and successfully verifying 1,339 instances across text and vision tasks.

</details>


### [1083] [Verifying Neural Networks with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34553)
*Hai Duong,Thanh Le,ThanhVu Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RSB，一个基于深度强化学习的框架，用于改进DNN验证器中分支定界(BaB)框架的分支(branching)启发式策略。RSB通过actor-critic架构学习调整现有启发式（如Fsb）的评分权重，以最大化长期累积奖励而非即时贪心得分。在600个挑战性验证实例上的评估表明，RSB比现有最优启发式多解决11%的实例，同时减少50%的分支探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DNN验证器在分支定界框架中的分支启发式（如BaBSR、Fsb）依赖手工设计的静态评分函数，存在三个主要局限：(1)需要领域专家针对不同问题特征设计；(2)每步贪心决策，不考虑长期搜索效率；(3)无法利用日益增长的验证数据进行性能改进。分支顺序对验证效率影响显著，但相对边界计算(bounding)而言研究不足。

Method: RSB将分支决策建模为深度强化学习问题：(1)状态空间：验证实例加上累积分支分配；观察空间：通过GCN（Graph Convolutional Network）编码的原始神经元特征（边界、偏置、掩码）与图嵌入的组合，仅关注不稳定神经元。(2)动作空间：每个不稳定神经元的[0,1]注意力权重，与基础启发式评分（如Fsb）逐元素相乘，引导分支选择。(3)奖励函数：每个通过边界计算立即解决的子问题获得+1奖励，最大化累积折扣奖励等价于最小化总子问题数。(4)使用基于PointerNet的actor-critic（软actor-critic变体），自然处理可变长度输入。(5)训练过程针对BaB的双子问题结构做适配：扩展replay buffer存储两个后继子问题的转移，critic损失函数在Bellman方程中用终止掩码加权两个后继分支。RSB保持BaB的soundness和completeness（定理1）。

Result: 在600个挑战性验证实例（FNN、CNN、Sigmoid三类架构各200个，CNN和Sigmoid为训练分布外的未见架构）上的实验结果：RSB总共解决165个实例（Fsb 148个，Upb 110个，Polarity 11个），比Fsb多解决11%，分支探索减少50%。具体而言：FNN上多解决16%（50 vs 43），分支减少72%；Sigmoid上多解决26%（43 vs 34），分支减少43%；CNN上多解决1个实例。RSB的决策时间(~0.11s)略低于Fsb和Upb(~0.13s)，因为更好的分支选择使得每步处理的子问题队列更小。RSB展现出对未见架构的泛化能力，在CNN和Sigmoid上均优于所有基线。在5次不同种子的运行中，RSB的优势统计一致且散布更紧。

Conclusion: 深度强化学习可有效学习超越成熟手工启发式的DNN验证分支策略。实验证明DRL能捕捉长期搜索策略，优于贪心启发式。作为学习型方法，RSB可随训练数据增长、DRL算法进步和新网络架构的出现而持续改进。未来工作包括将RSB扩展到输入空间分支以及在线适应。RSB可与现有抽象方法互补，通过聚焦分支决策这一相对未充分探索的方向，为提高DNN验证效率开辟新途径。

Abstract: Formal verification can play a key role in ensuring the reliability of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) deployed in safety-critical systems. Modern DNN verifiers employ a branch-and-bound framework, which alternates between branching (splitting into smaller subproblems) and bounding (pruning subproblems) to efficiently explore the verification space. However, existing branching heuristics make greedy decisions based on static scoring functions. They do not anticipate long-term efficiency or leverage the growing availability of verification data to improve performance. This work introduces RSB, a reinforcement learning framework that learns to refine baseline branching heuristics. It trains an actor-critic architecture to maximize cumulative future rewards rather than immediate scores. The actor generates attention weights from observations of raw neuron features and learned graph embeddings, which rescale baseline heuristic scores to guide neuron branching. Evaluation on 600 challenging instances demonstrates that RSB consistently outperforms state-of-the-art branching heuristics, solving 11% more instances while reducing branch exploration by 50%.

</details>


### [1084] [Replay in the Silent Degrees of Freedom: Continual Learning Without an Offline Phase](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31630)
*Zhang Yanhai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种生物启发的持续学习机制，通过"隔离掩码"和"不应期轮换"两个规则，使网络能够在推理过程中（无离线阶段）进行基于回放的记忆巩固。在k-winner-take-all稀疏动态下，隔离规则将回放更新限制在对当前输入不可见的隐藏突触上，而不应期轮换规则让最近激活的单元在下一轮竞争中"休息"，从而扩展可巩固的突触集合。在split-MNIST上达到91.6%准确率，无需离线阶段，性能与最佳离线夜间调度相当或更优，与DER++持平，并优于BP+ER、ER-ACE、A-GEM和无掩码局部回放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于回放的持续学习通常需要专门的离线巩固阶段，或通过将回放样本与输入流交错进行。然而，生物大脑通过清醒期间的局部睡眠（局部、短暂、使用依赖的电路关闭期）也能进行巩固。本文旨在探索：由生物约束的局部学习规则训练的网络是否能在完全没有离线阶段的情况下进行记忆巩固。核心思想是逆转传统持续学习的"保护过去任务"方向，转而保持当前推理计算的不变性，同时将过去记忆写入当前批次未使用的自由度中。

Method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) 隔离规则（Isolation Rule）：定义突触掩码 M^ℓ_ij = 1[j∉𝒜^(ℓ-1)(X) ∨ i∉𝒜^ℓ(X)]，即只有突触前单元对当前输入沉默或突触后单元处于休眠状态时，回放更新才能作用于该突触。优化器状态（动量、Adam矩）也仅在掩码内推进。(2) 不应期轮换（Refractory Rotation）：令最近激活的单元在下一批次的竞争中"休息"，使它们变为可巩固状态，从而将隔离通道从自然静默的0.2-0.3扩展到约0.53。(3) 内部控制信号：单元级稳态压力（homeostatic pressure）决定何时触发回放突发，相对新颖性门（relative-novelty gate）决定何时执行轮换。理论上证明了两个命题：命题1保证当权重更新仅作用于突触前沉默单元时，隐藏活动完全不变；命题2保证当更新作用于突触后休眠单元时，在一定边界条件下隐藏活动不变。推论1表明被轮换抑制的单元（s_i^ℓ=1）对任意幅度的更新都是精确不可见的。

Result: 在split-MNIST上，系统达到91.6±0.3%（6个种子，K=1000），无需离线阶段，优于最佳离线夜间调度（88.5±2.8%）、BP+ER（88.8±0.3%）、ER-ACE（90.2±0.4%）、A-GEM（68.5±7.0%）和无掩码局部回放，与DER++（91.5±0.5%）持平。在单次通过中，系统达到91.8±0.3%，优于DER++（90.1±0.7%），而夜间调度仅76.9±3.4%。在K=200的小缓冲区上优势最大（83.0±1.4% vs DER++的77.1±0.9%）；在K=5000时，反向传播参考方法反超。在split CIFAR-10上，系统领先离线排练和BP+ER，但落后ER-ACE和DER++约2-3点。消融研究表明：轮换贡献+3.6点，隔离贡献+2.6点（无轮换时）或+0.1点（有轮换时），但提供不变性保证。该机制不局限于局部学习规则：在带k-WTA隐藏层的反向传播网络上，轮换同样有效，隔离保证仍是"免费"的。能量分析显示，脉冲推理运行在密集速率推理的1/21能量下。

Conclusion: 在评估的类增量MLP设置中，巩固不需要单独的离线阶段。隔离提供的不变性不保护已完成的正向传播，而是关闭巩固会干扰当前流所用单元的通道。其准确率贡献为：无轮换时+2.6点，有轮换时+0.1-0.3点。一旦联盟交替，活动单元在4样本微批次下也能容忍无掩码回放；隔离额外提供保证。在两个保留分割上都与测试的离线夜间调度具有竞争力，在第一个分割上以+2.6领先，在第二个分割上以+0.3领先，与DER++持平，在所有参考方法之上。该机制不依赖于局部学习规则。在大缓冲区和原始CIFAR-10上对交叉熵反向传播参考方法的不足，是局部学习器的不足，不是机制的不足；在同一学习器上移除离线阶段在任何测量点上都没有代价。

Abstract: Replay-based continual learning almost always consolidates in a dedicated offline phase or by interleaving replayed samples with the input stream, whereas brains also consolidate during wakefulness through local sleep, brief use-dependent off-periods of individual circuits. We ask whether a network trained by local, biologically constrained rules can consolidate with no offline phase at all. An isolation rule confines replay updates to hidden synapses invisible to the current input under k-winner-take-all dynamics, with optimiser state advanced only inside the mask; a refractory rotation rule makes units that have just fired sit out the next competition, widening the consolidable set; a homeostatic pressure and a relative-novelty gate decide when replay bursts fire and when rotation runs. This inverts the usual direction of non-interfering continual learning: the hidden computation on the current input is held invariant (exactly on the proven channels, and for all but 0.3% of waking samples per update elsewhere) while past memories are written into the degrees of freedom the current batch leaves unused. On class-incremental split-MNIST the system reaches 91.6+-0.3% with no offline phase, at or above the best offline-night schedule on two held-out splits, tied with DER++ and above experience replay, ER-ACE, A-GEM and unmasked local replay; in a single pass it leads DER++ (91.8% against 90.1%) while the night falls to 76.9%. The advantage is largest at small buffers and gives way to the backpropagation references at large ones; on split CIFAR-10 the system leads offline rehearsal and experience replay but trails ER-ACE and DER++. Rotation carries most of the gain; isolation adds the invariance guarantee. The mechanism is not tied to the local rule: under the same schedule a backpropagation network with k-WTA hidden layers gains from rotation, and isolation is again free on top of it.

</details>


### [1085] [OMP-MoE: Efficient Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs via Orthogonal Matching Pursuit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31631)
*Dezhi Li,Lujun Li,Qiyuan Zhu,Hao Gu,Bei Liu,Sirui Han,Yike Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OMP-MoE是一种针对混合专家（MoE）大语言模型的免训练专家剪枝框架，将专家剪枝重新建模为稀疏信号重构问题，通过正交匹配追踪（OMP）以线性计算复杂度贪心地选择最大化重构增益的专家，并结合跨层"注水"策略进行专家预算分配以及OMP-MoE†自适应推理机制，在25%-50%剪枝率下持续优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型虽然通过稀疏激活实现了高效扩展，但其庞大的内存需求给部署带来挑战。现有专家剪枝方法要么面临组合搜索空间的指数级计算成本（如NAEE需要搜索约2.4×10^37种组合），要么忽视了专家间的动态相互依赖关系，或者依赖Hessian等二阶信息带来高额计算开销。本文旨在设计一种兼顾搜索效率与性能的免训练专家剪枝框架。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 单层OMP专家选择——将每个专家的加权贡献视为字典原子，通过最大化重构增益Δ_e = 2⟨R_t, V_e⟩ - ‖V_e‖² 贪心地迭代选择专家，将组合搜索降为线性复杂度O(L·n·N_e·Bd)；(2) 跨层预算分配——结合归一化重构误差r_l(k)与路由稳定性风险ψ_l(k) = -log(C_l(k)+ζ)，通过离散"注水"过程将总预算分配到各层；(3) OMP-MoE†自适应推理——基于预计算的能量系数α_e和门控权重预测每个token所需激活的最小专家数k_i，以满足相对残差阈值ε。文中还给出了二元约束下贪心准则的局部最优性证明以及基于子模优化的全局分配最优性条件。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、GPT-OSS-20B和Mixtral-8×7B四个MoE架构上的实验显示：在50%剪枝率下，OMP-MoE在Qwen3-30B-A3B上保留93.3%原始性能（0.597/0.640），显著优于MC-SMoE（0.339）和NAEE（0.515）；搜索时间仅641秒，比NAEE快33×，比DiEP快14×，且峰值内存更低；OMP-MoE†在DeepSeek-V2-Lite 50%剪枝下实现1.46×端到端加速，在Qwen3-30B-A3B上实现1.55×加速；在GSM8K推理任务上保留59.6%性能（0.531），远优于最佳基线（NAEE仅0.236）；与GPTQ、SparseGPT、Wanda等量化和非结构化剪枝方法正交互兼容；在更大模型Qwen3-235B-A22B上仍保持12×于DiEP的搜索速度优势。消融实验证实跨层分配和路由风险惩罚λ对性能均有正向贡献。

Conclusion: OMP-MoE通过将MoE专家剪枝重新建模为稀疏信号重构问题，在线性搜索复杂度下实现了高效的专家子集选择。该框架利用OMP的贪心性质自动捕捉专家间的动态相关性，通过跨层"注水"策略优化整体资源分配，并结合OMP-MoE†自适应推理机制进一步降低推理成本。其免训练特性和对多种架构、量化与剪枝方法的正交兼容性使其成为MoE大模型部署的实用解决方案。未来工作可探索更先进的校准策略以及与领域自适应压缩技术的结合。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling of large language models but face critical deployment challenges due to massive memory requirements. Existing pruning methods either incur prohibitive search costs or neglect the dynamic interdependencies between experts. To address these challenges, we present OMP-MoE, a novel training-free compression framework for reducing expert redundancy in MoE-based LLMs. Based on observations of expert contribution patterns, we reformulate the pruning problem as a sparse signal reconstruction task solved through Orthogonal Matching Pursuit. Specifically, our method first treats individual expert contributions as dictionary atoms and selects experts that greedily minimize reconstruction error with linear computational complexity. Then, we optimize cross-layer expert allocation through a water-filling strategy that accounts for both reconstruction quality and routing stability. Finally, we introduce OMP-MoE†, an adaptive inference mechanism that dynamically adjusts expert activation based on energy prediction. Comprehensive experiments on Qwen, DeepSeek-V2, GPT-OSS, and Mixtral MoE demonstrate consistent improvements over existing methods at 25-50% pruning ratios. For Qwen3-30B-A3B at 50% compression, we retain 93.3% of original performance, achieving 33$\times$ faster search and 1.55$\times$ inference speedup. Codes will be available after acceptance.

</details>


### [1086] [EEGAgentBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Short- and Long-Horizon EEG Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31632)
*Huyu Wu,Weining Weng,Yuchen Liu,Yiqiang Chen,Yang Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EEGAgentBench 是首个统一的脑电图（EEG）分析基准测试，旨在系统评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体在短时程与长时程 EEG 分析中的推理、工具使用和工作流构建能力，覆盖六个任务和 29 个前沿 LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 EEG 智能体评估碎片化，仅覆盖有限任务和狭窄时间范围，且缺乏对推理、工具使用和工作流构建能力的综合评估；EEG 分析正从短片段分类向长时程解读演进，亟需统一基准来评估智能体的多步推理与持续证据积累能力。

Method: 构建包含 1,072 个评估实例的统一基准，涵盖六个代表性 EEG 任务（知识问答、伪迹识别、正常-癫痫筛查、痴呆队列分类、癫痫事件检测、睡眠分期）；提供 10 个确定性非参数信号处理工具；采用 ReAct 风格多轮交互协议；评估 29 个来自 15 个模型家族的前沿 LLM。

Result: GPT-5.6-sol 以 Overall 0.631 排名第一，MiniMax-M3 以 0.530 紧随其后；基准能有效区分智能体能力（超越模型规模和推理成本）；当前 LLM 智能体在长时程 EEG 分析中表现显著不足，特别是在持续证据积累和多步推理方面；28/29 模型在睡眠分期中随录音时长增加（从 8 小时到 20+ 小时）性能下降，中位 Macro-F1 下降 0.123（相对降幅 44.4%）。

Conclusion: EEGAgentBench 作为首个统一基准，为评估自主 EEG 智能体提供了标准化基础；揭示了当前 LLM 在长时程脑电分析中的根本局限性，特别是在超长录音上维持可靠推理的困难，为下一代自主 EEG 智能体的发展提供了重要参考。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis is evolving from short-segment classification toward long-horizon interpretation that demands iterative evidence accumulation, multi-step reasoning, and coordinated use of specialized signal-processing tools. Although large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise as autonomous agents for EEG analysis, existing EEG agentic evaluations remain fragmented, covering limited tasks over narrow temporal horizons with inconsistent protocols, and providing no comprehensive assessment of agents' reasoning, tool-use, and workflow construction capabilities. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{EEGAgentBench}, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM agents on short- and long-horizon EEG analysis. EEGAgentBench spans six representative EEG applications ranging from knowledge question answering to sleep staging. It encompasses signal durations from 2 seconds to nearly 23 hours, with prediction targets ranging from class labels to event intervals and epoch-level sequences. This design supports unified evaluation across knowledge reasoning, short-horizon interpretation, long-horizon event detection, and sequential understanding. The benchmark further provides 10 deterministic EEG analysis tools that expose only task-relevant signal measurements. Agents must therefore select tools autonomously, accumulate evidence iteratively, and construct multi-step workflows. For evaluation, we benchmark 29 frontier LLMs from 15 model families. Results demonstrate that EEGAgentBench effectively distinguishes agent capabilities beyond model scale and inference cost, while revealing substantial limitations of current LLM agents in long-horizon EEG analysis, particularly in sustained evidence accumulation and multi-step reasoning.

</details>
