### [1087] [Enhancing generalization in endwall film cooling prediction: Incorporating the superposition principle into transformer-based neural operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31633)
*Qineng Wang,Liming Song,Tianyuan Liu,Zhendong Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种融合物理叠加原理与深度神经算子的SDNO框架，通过"分解-计算-叠加"策略和SDF几何编码，实现涡轮端壁气膜冷却温度场在变孔数条件下的高精度外推预测（训练用1-5孔，可外推至10-20孔）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯数据驱动的全监督深度学习模型在训练分布外（如气膜孔数变化）预测精度急剧下降（误差增加20-100倍）；传统Seller叠加公式在复杂耦合传热中失效；缺乏兼具高精度与外推泛化能力的气膜冷却预测模型。

Method: 1) SDF预处理编码冷却孔位置信息；2) Transformer-based Calculate Net预测子布局温度场；3) FNO-based Super Net以二元可交换可结合方式叠加子场；4) "分解-计算-叠加"训练策略（随机分解增强数据多样性，推理时均匀分配）；5) 联合训练+微调训练两阶段策略；6) 数据集：Pak-B叶片端壁，训练集1-5孔（2000样本），验证集含10/15/20孔（OOD测试）。

Result: 10孔验证样本平均绝对温度误差0.0048K，较全监督基线降低79%；10/15/20孔OOD样本MRVE从41.884%/37.297%/33.697%降至1.084%/1.383%/2.756%（相对降幅>90%）；微调后最大温度场预测误差<0.5K；SDNO仅需10个高保真样本微调即可显著提升外推精度。

Conclusion: 将物理叠加原理抽象为可学习的神经算子算子，成功实现气膜冷却温度场预测从ID到OOD的泛化突破；SDF编码有效处理小尺度几何特征；微调策略降低数据依赖；未来可融合多保真度数据并扩展至变工况、变孔径、变喷射角等更广泛输入空间。

Abstract: In this study, a physics-enhanced neural operator framework is proposed to enhance the generalization prediction ability of the cooling layout of a turbine endwall with variable number of film holes. Specifically, inspired by the film cooling superposition principle, we propose a film cooling prediction model, namely superposition-based deep neural operator (SDNO), that divides the endwall temperature field prediction into two stages. In the first stage, the cooling layout of a turbine endwall is divided into several sub-parts with randomly assigned film holes, and a Transformer-based neural operator network, namely Calculate Net, is designed to predict the temperature field of each sub-part. Then, in the second stage, another neural operator network, i.e., Super Net, is trained to combine the temperature fields predicted by Calculate Net for each sub-part and obtain the superposed temperature field of the full cooling layout. Additionally, instead of directly taking the film cooling contours as pixel plots, a signed distance function (SDF) which is sensitive to the variable locations of cooling holes, is designed to encode the location information of cooling holes. Furthermore, the proposed endwall film cooling prediction model is trained with the samples that changing the number of film holes from 1-5 with variable locations. Then, the trained prediction shows excellent generalization prediction ability, which can accurately predict the film effectiveness of the cooling layout with 10-20 film cooling holes that are unseen in the training samples. The proposed SDNO also improves prediction accuracy relative to the fully supervised baseline. With the above, the effectiveness of our proposed prediction model has been well demonstrated.

</details>


### [1088] [Symmetry-quotient Flatness and Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31634)
*Taiki Miyagawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在对称商空间上的对称感知平坦性理论，建立了从商线性稳定性到商平坦性、再到输入平滑性、最终到泛化能力的完整定理级流水线，核心是将平坦性定义在去除函数保持对称性的商流形上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的参数空间平坦性度量不具有函数保持对称性（如正重缩放、隐藏单元置换）下的不变性，导致平坦性与泛化能力之间的关联缺乏数学严谨性。本文旨在构建一个在商几何下显式的平坦性到泛化理论。

Method: 在正则商流形上，将商平坦性定义为经验平方损失Hessian的迹；在插值解处，证明商平坦性等于样本输出商梯度范数平方的均值。通过局部规范截面和乘法第一层表示，将商平坦性与输入梯度联系。在切空间中定义商线性化SGD，利用一步均方稳定性推导商平坦性关于批量大小B和学习率η的显式上界2B/η，并推广到高阶张量矩。最后，在(ε,δ,ν)-平衡局部覆盖条件下导出泛化界。

Result: 建立了完整的定理级流水线：商线性稳定性 ⇒ 商平坦性 ≤ 2B/η ⇒ 输入平滑性 ⇒ 泛化界 2νε²(2BΛ⋆²C²sec/(ηρ²)+L⋆²)+4M²δ。在教师-学生两层ReLU回归实验中验证了平坦性上界、输入平滑性中间关系及泛化界均成立（28个收敛模型均低于理论界）。

Conclusion: 本文成功地将平坦性-泛化理论从原始参数空间重构到对称商流形上，证明了一旦去除函数保持对称性，商平坦性即可有效控制SGD的优化行为和神经网络的泛化能力，为平坦性叙事提供了数学显式、对称感知的版本。局限性包括交叉熵损失下的曲率残差、全局置换商的奇异点结构，以及深度架构中的实证验证困难。

Abstract: This paper develops a theorem-level pipeline in symmetry-quotient settings: quotient linear stability implies quotient flatness, quotient flatness implies input smoothness, and input smoothness yields generalization under local covering assumptions. Flatness is often associated with generalization, and Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is frequently viewed as implicitly biased toward flat solutions. However, standard flatness measures are typically defined in the raw parameter space and are therefore not invariant under function-preserving symmetries such as positive rescaling. We develop a symmetry-aware theory of quotient flatness, quotient linear stability, input smoothness, and generalization on quotient spaces of neural-network parameters. For square loss and models equipped with function-preserving group actions, we define quotient flatness as the trace of the Hessian of the empirical loss on the regular quotient manifold. We show that quotient flatness controls input smoothness through a quotient-space analogue of the flatness-to-smoothness argument. We also prove that one-step mean-square quotient linear stability of the linearized SGD dynamics implies an explicit quotient-flatness bound in terms of the batch size and learning rate, and extend this analysis to higher-order tensor moments. Finally, under local covering and boundedness assumptions, we derive population generalization bounds in terms of quotient flatness and, consequently, in terms of quotient linear stability.

</details>


### [1089] [Grounding Vision-Language Models in Driving Semantics: A Multi-Dataset Predicate Framework for Explainable Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31636)
*Mohamed Chouai,Fazli Faruk Okumus,Stefan Kugele*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种确定性的多数据集谓词框架（Predicate Framework），用于将驾驶场景语义关系从可测量的几何、运动、时间、地图和交通控制证据中推导出来。该框架在 nuPlan 和 nuScenes 数据集上实现了跨数据集的语义一致性验证，并通过将谓词知识图谱（Predicate KG）注入冻结的 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 模型，在 NuPlanQA 任务上显著提升了视觉-语言推理的可解释性与准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在自动驾驶场景理解中生成的语义关系难以与底层交通情境进行验证。同时，自动驾驶数据集之间的异构性（对象分类、地图表示、标注格式差异）限制了语义关系的跨数据集统一表达与系统性评估。因此，需要一个可追溯的、与数据集无关的语义接口来桥接异构驾驶数据与下游推理任务。

Method: 1. **数据集接地（Dataset Grounding）**：针对 nuPlan 和 nuScenes，构建数据集特定的接口，仅用于恢复场景智能体的状态信息（位置、朝向、速度、边界框）以及地图与交通控制信息。2. **谓词定义与推导（Predicate Definition）**：定义 83 个语义谓词（分为空间、运动、时间、地图、交互、交通控制、风险七大类），每个谓词由显式的布尔决策函数 f_P 根据可测量的场景证据进行确定性推导，安全相关阈值基于 UN R157 法规。3. **谓词知识图谱（Predicate KG）**：将推导出的关系以五元组 (S, P, O, t, π) 形式物化，包含来源证据与推导规则。4. **评估**：在 200 个手动标注场景中进行语义验证（macro F1），并在 NuPlanQA 9 个子任务上以冻结的 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 评估五种输入条件下的推理准确性。

Result: **语义验证**：在 200 个场景的人工标注上，nuPlan 宏 F1 为 0.94，nuScenes 为 0.93，跨数据集平均差异仅 0.02。谓词如 follows (0.97-0.98) 和 queuesBehind (0.99) 表现最佳，而需要更长时间序列的 overtakes 跨数据集差异最大（0.93 vs 0.87）。**视觉-语言推理**：在 NuPlanQA 9 个子任务中，谓词接地（Predicate KG）在视觉输入条件下有 7 个子任务取得最高准确率：Traffic Light（53.2% → 71.5%）、Situation Assessment（76.2% → 86.1%）、Action Recommendation（82.9% → 89.0%）、Traffic Flow（77.6% → 85.8%）、Ego Control（75.4% → 83.9%）、Key Objects（73.2% → 82.3%）、Road Type（96.4% → 96.8%）。无视觉输入条件下，Predicate KG 仅输入在 8/9 子任务上优于元数据输入。Weather/Lighting 基本不变（89.4% vs 88.8%），因无对应天气谓词。

Conclusion: 研究证实：1）确定性谓词能够从可测量的场景证据中提供一致且可追溯的语义表示（RQ1）；2）跨数据集的共享语义保持稳定（nuPlan/nuScenes 平均 F1 差异仅 0.02）（RQ2）；3）在预言式接地（oracle grounding）条件下，谓词能有效降低视觉依赖，为 VLM 推理提供明确的语义基础（RQ3）。未来工作将扩展数据集覆盖范围并研究直接从传感器观测中提取谓词。

Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used for driving-scene understanding, yet the semantic relations expressed in their outputs are often difficult to verify against the underlying traffic situation. This paper introduces a deterministic multi-dataset predicate framework that derives driving-scene semantics from measurable geometric, kinematic, temporal, map, and traffic-control evidence. Dataset-specific interfaces are used only to recover the required scene information, while predicate definitions remain unchanged across nuPlan and nuScenes and are materialised in a common Predicate Knowledge Graph. Quantitative semantic validation against manually annotated predicate relations on 200 scenarios from each dataset yields macro F1 scores of 0.94 on nuPlan and 0.93 on nuScenes, with an average cross-dataset difference of 0.02 across the shared predicates. The Predicate KG is further evaluated using a frozen LLaVA-OneVision-7B model on the nine NuPlanQA subtasks. Predicate grounding achieves the highest accuracy among the evaluated visual-input conditions in seven of nine NuPlanQA subtasks, including Traffic Light (53.2% to 71.5%), Situation Assessment (76.2% to 86.1%), and Action Recommendation (82.9% to 89.0%). Weather/Lighting remains essentially unchanged (89.4% vs. 88.8%), consistent with the absence of corresponding predicates, while Predicate KG only input outperforms metadata-only input in eight of nine subtasks. The results show that deterministic predicates provide a consistent and traceable semantic representation and, under oracle grounding, can reduce visual dependence for reasoning tasks covered by the predicate vocabulary.

</details>


### [1090] [FIDAL: Diversity-Aware Federated Active Learning Under Real-World Distribution Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31637)
*David Dueñas Gaviria,Shadi Albarqouni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FIDAL提出了一种面向医学影像的开集联邦主动学习框架，通过融合校准的全局-局部证据不确定性、支持集多样性加权和自适应OOD拒绝机制，在三个多中心医学影像基准上同时实现了最高的准确率和最高的ID纯度，显著减少了浪费在无关样本上的标注预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习虽能实现跨机构协作训练，但高标注成本、领域漂移和类别不平衡仍是主要障碍。现有主动学习方法仅针对封闭集中的ID数据，无法处理真实临床场景中不可避免的OOD样本（如协议差异、罕见病理、跨站点域偏移），导致标注预算被无关样本大量浪费，而关键的ID类别尤其是稀有类别反而标注不足。

Method: FIDAL在统一评分函数中集成四个机制：(1) 非对称的全局-局部证据不确定性校准——全局认知不确定性捕捉域偏移，全局和局部偶然不确定性之和避免噪声样本；(2) 支持集多样性加权——通过基于相似度邻域计数的指数权重显式促进ID特征空间中欠表达区域的覆盖；(3) 自适应逐客户端OOD惩罚——基于客户端已标注OOD集的余弦相似度；(4) 基础模型高斯覆盖信号+Otsu自适应门控——在冻结的FM编码器（PanDerm/CHIEF/MammoCLIP）空间中对每客户端每轮的对数似然分布用Otsu准则自动确定阈值，无需人工调参。查询时硬拒绝门控下的样本，存活样本的覆盖信号作为软乘性权重参与排序。

Result: 在FedISIC（皮肤病学）、FedCamelyon（组织病理学）和FedEMBED（乳腺X线摄影含自然产生伪影）三个真实开放集基准上，FIDAL分别达到71.14% BMA/81.9%纯度、97.34% ACC/83.8%纯度和69.49% BMA/92.3%纯度，是唯一在所有三个数据集的准确率-ID纯度Pareto前沿上的方法；在FedEMBED上以部分数据标注即匹配全监督性能；在等查询预算下，OOD标注数比所有准确率匹配的基线少1.3–3.8倍，在乳腺X线摄影上节省约7–29小时专家阅读时间；OOD检测器类基线最多落后12个百分点。

Conclusion: FIDAL是首个在单一采集策略中联合处理联邦训练、开集OOD拒绝和紧标注预算三轴问题的框架。其核心贡献在于：通过FM覆盖信号+Otsu自适应门控将"何为OOD"与"如何对存活样本排序"两个决策解耦，使门控继承FM先验的鲁棒性，排序仍受益于任务微调的不确定性信号；门控与S_OOD惩罚互补，前者拒绝未见过的新型OOD，后者捕获与已标注伪影相似的样本。消融研究表明各组件各司其职：门控负责纯度轴，多样性负责准确率轴。未来工作将扩展至更异构的联邦环境、变化标注预算和真实标签噪声模式，以及ID/OOD边界本身跨机构漂移的场景。

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across institutions without centralizing data, yet high annotation costs, domain shifts, and class imbalance remain major obstacles, especially when irrelevant out-of-distribution (OOD) samples dilute the labeled data. Existing active learning methods target uncertainty or diversity within in-distribution (ID) data and overlook unknown samples in federated clinical settings. We propose FIDAL, an open-set federated active learning framework that combines calibrated global-local evidential uncertainty, support-set diversity weighting, and adaptive OOD rejection. The rejection gate thresholds a foundation-model Gaussian-coverage signal per client and per round with Otsu's criterion, so that highly informative ID samples are queried while irrelevant outliers are excluded without any hand-tuned threshold. Evaluated on three multi-center medical imaging benchmarks (dermatology, histopathology, and mammography with organically occurring artifacts) in realistic open-set scenarios, FIDAL outperforms detector-based open-set methods by up to about 12 percentage points of balanced accuracy and is the only method on the accuracy-ID purity Pareto front of all three benchmarks. At an equal query budget it spends at least 1.3 times fewer annotations on OOD samples than every accuracy-matched baseline, saving an estimated 7-29 hours of expert reading on the mammography benchmark. By labeling only a fraction of the data pool, it matches or exceeds fully supervised performance across modalities. These results highlight the value of integrating uncertainty, diversity, and OOD rejection in open-set federated active learning for medicine.

</details>


### [1091] [Product-Aware Deterministic Rounding for Quantized Matrix Multiplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31641)
*Piyush Sao,Narasinga Miniskar,Pedro Valero-Lara,Keita Teranishi,Sudip Seal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对量化矩阵乘法中逐元素独立取整（round-to-nearest）忽略标量误差在乘积中可相互抵消的问题，研究了在尺度、裁剪界与网格固定后、产品感知的确定性取整方法。对于动态激活取整，利用低秩权值块的零空间归约将待定决策压缩至最多 r 个，再以条件期望完成获得 OPT_dyn + r·ν²_max/4 的加性证书；对于可重用静态权值，给出了精确的期望乘积损失度量（无偏置时为非中心二阶矩，自由偏置重校时为中心协方差），并证明即使在秩一时精确优化亦为 NP 难。通过合成块与 Digits 实验验证了理论：在 K=1024、r=16 的平衡块中条件期望完成取得 0.010 的抖动归一化中位误差（RTN 为 0.899），裁剪感知初始化在 10% 裁剪下将归一化误差降低 43.4 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准量化方法对矩阵乘法中每个标量独立取整，忽略了矩阵乘法的误差可在不同坐标间相互抵消这一事实。需要一种在固定网格下、协调各标量上/下取整以最小化乘积误差的确定性算法与可证明保证。

Method: 1) 将取整选择表示为二值最小二乘目标；2) 零空间归约：沿 ker(V^T) 移动连续松弛解，将至多 r 个分数坐标固定为整数，保留乘积像；3) 条件期望完成：对剩余至多 r 个分数决策依次取条件期望最小值，得到确定性多项式时间算法，平方乘积误差上界为 OPT_dyn + r·R²/4；4) 静态部分给出以 M=E[x^T x] 为度量的精确损失分解，并按列独立最小化；5) 重行枚举给出 OPT_dyn + ε·D(V) + η 的近似；6) Gram-Schmidt 游走扩展用于多方向控制。

Result: 理论结果：(i) 动态加性保证 OPT_dyn + r·ν²_max/4；(ii) 静态精确度量为无中心二阶矩 M 或中心协方差；(iii) 秩一时精确零误差决策为弱 NP 完全（归约到 Partition）；(iv) 一般 PSD 二次阈值决策为强 NP 完全（归约到 Max-Cut/符号 Laplacian Q_G=HH^T）。实验结果：在 K=1024、r=16 平衡合成块中 CE 完成取得 0.010 抖动归一化中位误差（RTN 为 0.899）；随 K/r 增大协调误差下降；行能量集中使证书弱化（α=2 时比值升至 11 倍抖动但实测仍低）；裁剪感知 QP 初始化在 10% 裁剪下将中位归一化误差从 0.450 降至 0.010（43.4 倍改进）；Digits 实验中固定偏置下中心化取整在所有 4 种位宽/校准设置中位误差均高于 RTN，而中心化+偏置校正和非中心化则低于 RTN。

Conclusion: 在固定量化网格下，产品感知确定性取整可通过零空间归约与条件期望完成实现，其保证以权值块秩 r 和最大行范数为代价。该方法在平衡块中显著优于逐元素最近取整；裁剪感知初始化对固定偏移补偿至关重要；静态可重用权值的正确损失度量取决于部署时的偏置自由度（固定偏置用 M，自由偏置用协方差）。遗留开放问题包括共享舍入激活副本的多块联合控制、参数化精确算法以及尾谱算子的多项式时间可控性。

Abstract: Scalar rounding decisions interact through matrix multiplication. We study deterministic product-aware rounding after scales, clipping bounds, and grids are fixed, with each active scalar choosing between adjacent levels. For dynamic activation rounding, null-space reduction preserves the relaxed product while leaving at most $r$ fractional decisions, where $r$ is the rank of the active gap-weighted weight block. Conditional-expectation completion gives a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm with squared product error at most $ \mathrm{OPT}_{\mathrm{dyn}}+r\nu_{\max}^2/4$, where $\mathrm{OPT}_{\mathrm{dyn}}$ is the best admissible error and $\nu_{\max}$ is the largest row norm of that block. For reusable static weights, the exact expected product-loss metric is the uncentered input second moment with fixed output bias; free bias recalibration yields the centered covariance. Exact optimization is NP-hard even at rank one. In balanced blocks with $K=1024$ and $r=16$, conditional- expectation completion attains a dither-normalized median error of $0.010$, compared with $0.899$ for round-to-nearest. Clipping-aware initialization reduces median normalized error by a factor of $43.4$ at ten-percent clipping. Held-out Digits experiments show that retaining the input mean or correcting the output bias improves median product error over round-to-nearest in all four tested bit-width and calibration-size settings.

</details>


### [1092] [Cross-Material Support Transfer for Core-Loss Prediction Under Waveform Covariate Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31659)
*Cong Yao,Chunye Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对MagNet挑战赛中材料D在波形协变量偏移下磁芯损耗预测困难的问题，本文提出MIST（材料身份支持迁移）方法：通过单一2784参数的联合模型，利用FiLM条件化从兄弟材料借取缺失的测量支持，将材料D的p95相对误差从20.39%降至12.38%，超越最佳参赛结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力磁芯损耗建模面临表征-部署失配：实验室以正弦/三角波形表征材料，但部署环境（功率变换器）以梯形/PWM波形激励。MagNet挑战赛中材料D的梯形波形训练样本仅占1.4%（8个），测试集却占16.4%，且高频段无训练支持，导致最佳提交结果（基于序贯迁移）仍达15.9% p95误差，为五材料中最差。本文质疑该困难是否源于类别不平衡，探究是否能从兄弟材料借取缺失的实测支持。

Method: 1) 四种单材料补救方法（连续波形描述符、iGSE伪标签、过采样、极性对称增强）均失败，匹配测试集占比反而恶化误差，排除类别不平衡假设，确认为协变量偏移下的信息缺失。2) 提出MIST（材料身份支持迁移）：单一2784参数共享灰盒重建骨干（CAHR-Net，扩展自HARDCORE），联合训练全部五种材料；材料身份（五维one-hot）通过特征线性调制（FiLM）注入；稀缺材料D的损失项以w_D=5加权；材料D不进行微调以避免灾难性遗忘。3) 物理上合理的混合批次处理：每样本保留各自的输入/输出归一化和物理边界。

Result: 主要结果：材料D的p95从基线20.39±2.03%降至12.38±0.92%（五个种子均低于14%），梯形类p95从37.4±8.8%降至15.16±1.69%（方差降为五分之一），五材料聚合从7.89±0.36%降至7.32±0.19%。以约1/6的参数超越MagLearn最佳提交15.9%。消融研究证实信息而非容量起关键作用：去除材料身份列导致误差膨胀一个数量级（145.5%）；保留身份列但填常量（同等容量2784参数）仍达125.12%。频率带分解显示在零支持频段改善28个百分点。零样本迁移（去除材料D全部8个梯形样本）仍达p95=15.49%，证实改善主要源于借取的支持。加入10种遗留材料进一步提升性能，但兄弟材料已覆盖目标支持99.3%，收益递减。任何对材料D的微调均导致梯形精度损失（头微调17.1%、全微调25.2%）。

Conclusion: 论文得出三项可迁移原则：1）当类占比匹配无助于改善时，困难本质为信息缺失，类别不平衡工具箱不适用；2）标签应仅来自测量或精确对称，伪造标签会将先验偏差传播至共享权重；3）缺失支持应通过身份条件化从外部实测数据借取，稀缺材料不应在其偏置集上微调。局限：证据限于材料D的特定实例；未验证跨材料类别（如纳米晶、粉末磁芯）的迁移。MIST为磁芯损耗建模乃至更广泛的波形协变量偏移问题提供了新范式。

Abstract: Power magnetic materials are characterized on the sinusoidal and triangular waveforms that excitation hardware conveniently produces, whereas deployed converters expose cores to trapezoidal, PWM-shaped flux trajectories, so loss models must predict exactly where their training data are thinnest. The final test of the MagNet Challenge embeds a deliberately extreme instance of this characterization-deployment mismatch: for material D, trapezoids form 16.4% of the test set but only 1.4% of the training set. The 95th-percentile relative error, hereafter p95, of the best submission, built on sequential transfer learning, stalled at 15.9%, the worst among the five materials. This paper shows that the obstacle is missing information under covariate shift rather than class imbalance, and that the missing support can be borrowed from sibling materials instead of being extrapolated. Controlled experiments first refute the imbalance reading: four standard remedies fail, and raising the trapezoidal share to the test-set level degrades accuracy further. The proposed material-identity support transfer, MIST, then trains one 2784-parameter predictor jointly on all five challenge materials. Material identity enters through feature-wise linear modulation, or FiLM, the scarce material's true-label loss is reweighted, and material D receives no fine-tuning, so that the bias of its trapezoid-free training set is never re-installed. MIST lowers the five-seed material-D p95 from 20.39+/-2.03% to 12.38+/-0.92% and the trapezoidal-class p95 from 37.4+/-8.8% to 15.16+/-1.69%, surpassing the best submission with one-sixth of its parameters and no fine-tuning stage; removing material identity at matched capacity inflates the error by an order of magnitude. These results argue that scarce materials should be characterized jointly with their siblings.

</details>


### [1093] [Beyond the Graph: An Adaptive Meta-Learner Fuses Explainability, Weather, and Dynamics for Robust Bus ETA Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31667)
*Pratham Payra,Jagadish*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HYB(nm)自适应混合集成框架，通过元学习器动态融合五个互补模型（MST-AV历史基线、GDRN-DFT周期模式分析、KOOP-NET非线性动力学、FENN天气集成神经网络、MGCN实时图卷积网络），用于公交车到站时间（ETA）预测。在加尔各答三条线路4000余趟GPS与天气数据上验证，HYB(2)以最高48.9%的胜率在MAE/MAPE/RMSE上全面优于DCRNN、STGCN、GWNet等八种主流时空图模型基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公交ETA预测模型难以应对非线性时空动力学、数据稀疏性以及天气等外部因素干扰，亟需一种能够自适应融合多种建模范式、兼顾可解释性与计算效率的混合框架。

Method: 框架包含五个基模型：(1) MST-AV——基于最小生成树的50m网格历史平均速度基线；(2) GDRN-DFT——图扩散双向LSTM结合离散傅里叶变换捕捉周期性并填补缺失数据；(3) KOOP-NET——基于Koopman算子的神经网络，在对数变换潜空间中线性化非线性速度动力学；(4) FENN——融合坐标、API天气数据、正弦时间编码的特征工程神经网络；(5) MGCN——掩码图卷积网络融合实时观测与DFT估计。元学习器f_NN根据实时上下文生成Softmax权重，HYB(n_m)通过Top-n_m筛选实现模型压缩；logit与sigmoid变换约束速度在可行域内。

Result: 在三条加尔各答公交线路（>4000趟行程，2024年8月至2025年3月）的测试集（N=10000趟/线路）上：HYB(2)总体MAE为4.5–5.7分钟、MAPE 12.3–14.9%、RMSE 5.4–6.9分钟；在5个ETA区间×3条线路×3种指标的45项对比中胜率48.9%，显著优于DCRNN（20.0%）、GWNet（22.2%）等八种时空图神经网络基准；在短距（0–10分钟）上与DCRNN、MTGNN相当，长距（45+分钟）上与GWNet、MTGNN相当，整体平衡性最佳。所有模型在极端天气下误差均上升，HYB(2)表现出最强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: HYB(2)在准确性、稳定性、计算效率三方面取得最优权衡，是可扩展HYB(k)架构的典范；为公交机构提供从经济型单模型（MST-AV/GDRN-DFT）到高精度混合模型的灵活工具，未来将扩展多城市验证、整合突发事件等多模态数据并开发边缘可部署的元学习器。

Abstract: Accurate bus Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction is vital for urban mobility, passenger satisfaction, and transit efficiency, yet existing models falter against nonlinear spatiotemporal dynamics, data sparsity, and factors such as weather. This paper proposes HYB(nm), an adaptive hybrid ensemble framework that dynamically fuses five complementary models - a historical baseline (MST-AV), periodical temporal pattern analysis (GDRN-DFT), Koopman Neural Operators for nonlinear dynamics (KOOP-NET), weather-integrated feature-engineered neural networks (FENN), and real-time graph convolutional networks (MGCN) - via a meta-learner attuned to real-time context. Evaluated on GPS and weather data from three Kolkata bus routes comprising more than 4,000 trips, the framework leverages the individual strengths of its components (for example, the low-latency explainability of MST-AV, the weather resilience of FENN, and the network-dynamics capture of MGCN) to deliver the superior robustness of HYB(2), state-of-the-art accuracy rivalling leading graph neural networks, and balanced trade-offs in stability and efficiency across prediction horizons and operating conditions. The extensible HYB(k) architecture equips transit agencies with flexible tools, ranging from economical single models to tailored high-fidelity hybrids, advancing predictive, equitable urban transport.

</details>


### [1094] [NanoForecast v0.5: Competitive Time Series Forecasting Through Training Pipeline Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31669)
*Gautam Kishore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NanoForecast v0.5 仅通过修复训练流程（不改动架构），将一个 6.5M 参数的时序预测模型的 MASE 从 3.030 降至 1.704（下降 43.8%），并在三个 ETT 数据集和汇率数据集上击败了 200M 参数的 TimesFM，在所有 ETT 数据集上击败了 15M+ 参数的 PatchTST。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型时序基础模型（如 TimesFM 200M、Chronos 710M）需要 GPU 推理，难以部署到边缘设备。作者质疑：架构创新获得的性能提升是否掩盖了训练流程中的潜在 bug？他们旨在通过系统地修复训练流程问题，证明小型模型在合理精度下即可在消费级硬件上训练并在边缘设备上部署。

Method: 保留 v0.3 架构（6.5M 参数，由 LongConv + DeltaNet RNN + SwiGLU MLP 经门控路由混合组成），仅修复三项训练流程 bug：(1) 损失范围处理——在 multi_horizon=False 时未截断预测至预测步长，导致梯度回传至已观测历史；(2) 张量形状对齐——分位数损失在截断前计算，导致维度错配；(3) 数据增强覆盖——新增时间反转（flip）增强以扩展有效分布。训练：200 epoch，OneCycleLR，T4 GPU 约 12 小时。评估在 6 个标准基准（ETTh1/h2、ETTm1、Exchange、Electricity、Traffic）上进行，统一协议下对比 TimesFM 与 PatchTST。

Result: 总体 MASE 从 v0.3 的 3.030 降至 v0.5 的 1.704（-43.8%）；在 ETTh1（0.676 vs 0.705）、ETTh2（1.110 vs 1.360）、ETTm1（0.287 vs 0.545）和 Exchange（4.317 vs 4.383）上击败 TimesFM；在所有 ETT 数据集上击败 PatchTST；在 Electricity（2.029 vs 0.923）和 Traffic（1.805 vs 0.765）上落后于 TimesFM。推理延迟：Apple M4 CPU 上 19.5 ms（PyTorch FP32）、10.7 ms（ONNX Runtime FP32）、19.1 ms（流式更新）。效率比 ℰ 是 TimesFM 的 26 倍、PatchTST 的 2 倍。分位数校准偏窄（80% 名义带宽实际覆盖率 51.3%）。

Conclusion: 训练流程的修复（三项具体 bug：损失范围、张量形状、增强覆盖）在不改变架构的情况下带来超过 40% 的精度提升，幅度远超多数架构改进。在评估新架构前，应先排除此类训练流程缺陷。小型模型（6.5M 参数）在 ETT 等领域可与 200M 参数的 TimesFM 抗衡，但在高基数、多通道数据集（电力、交通）上仍存在差距。分位数校准、流式部署的边缘基准测试、多 horizon 泛化是未来方向。

Abstract: We present NanoForecast v0.5, a 6.5M-parameter forecaster that competes with models 31x its size (TimesFM, 200M parameters) after training pipeline fixes and no architecture change. Retraining the v0.3 architecture with corrected loss-scope handling, tensor shape alignment, and wider augmentation coverage cuts overall Mean Absolute Scaled Error by 43.8% under one fixed protocol (MASE 3.030 to 1.704) on the same data and compute budget. NanoForecast v0.5 beats TimesFM on all three ETT datasets (MASE 0.676/1.110/0.287 vs. 0.705/1.360/0.545) and on exchange rate (4.317 vs. 4.383); TimesFM keeps a clear lead on the high-cardinality electricity and traffic sets. Against PatchTST (15M+ parameters, official configuration), v0.5 wins all three ETT sets. Training takes about 12 hours on a single cloud GPU (NVIDIA T4, Google Colab) and inference needs no GPU (measurements in this paper are on an Apple M4 CPU). We release all code, pretrained checkpoints, and evaluation framework under Apache 2.0 at this https URL

</details>


### [1095] [When Keywords Drop but Classifiers Hold: Soft Refusals under KV Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31678)
*Kang Chen,Xiuze Zhou,Hong Chen,Yuanguo Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KV cache压缩（特别是长上下文尾部驱逐）下，轻量级关键词拒答监控器与强学习分类器之间会出现显著分歧：关键词拒答率大幅下降，而HarmBench分类器保持饱和，任务准确率不变。这是"软拒答"导致的监控盲点，而非对齐失败。该分歧具有条件性，随压缩方法、填充长度、模型规模等因素变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产部署系统常用关键词过滤器监控LLM拒答行为，但KV cache压缩改变了上下文token的保留情况。在任务精度保持不变的前提下，轻量级词法监控器与更强拒答分类器之间是否仍保持一致——这一问题尚未得到系统研究。监控器不一致会导致误报（误判对齐失败）或漏报，产生部署安全风险。

Method: 配对评估协议（n=200有害提示）：每条提示在完整保留（ret=1.0）和匹配驱逐（ret=0.3，尾部驱逐+4个前缀sink，2048 token填充）下各生成一次，对相同回复用四种评判器评分：关键词启发式、HarmBench Llama-2-13B分类器、辅助LLM法官、人类标注（针对分歧案例）。配对McNemar精确检验，Wilson 95% CI。消融实验涵盖SnapKV、填充长度（0/512/2048）、系统提示、前缀sink大小（4/16/64/128）、模型规模/家族（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.2-3B）。

Result: 主设置（Qwen2.5-3B bf16，filler=2048）下：关键词拒答从98.0%降至80.5%（McNemar p≈1e-8），HarmBench分类器拒答99.0%→99.5%（不变），MMLU数学准确率50.0%→50.0%（不变）。56例关键词-分类器分歧中，94.6%人类标注与分类器一致，判定为"软拒答"。分歧具条件性：SnapKV下关键词不变（98.0%→98.0%）；filler=0时无变化；filler=512时仅降3.0pp；4-bit Qwen2.5-7B仅降1.5pp；Llama-3.2-3B降57.0pp；官方HarmBench提示集上两者同步下降（4.5pp对齐）；增大sink可部分恢复（80.5%→87.5%，sink=64饱和）。

Conclusion: KV cache压缩下存在监控器分歧盲点，而非通用对齐失败。生产部署的安全审计应在实际服务的压缩策略、上下文长度和提示分布下，使用多层级评判器而非单一关键词拒答率。实用建议：优先注意力感知保留策略（如SnapKV）；增大前缀sink预算（但有边际递减）；将长填充上下文视为压力测试场景；按提示分布分层审计。

Abstract: KV cache compression is widely used for long context LLM inference under memory constraints, while deployed systems typically score refusals after generation with keyword filters or learned classifiers. Such monitors are intended to indicate whether a model declined a harmful request under the serving regime actually used. However, it remains unclear whether matched compression that preserves task accuracy also preserves agreement between lightweight lexical monitors and stronger refusal classifiers. We study this with a paired protocol on n=200 harmful prompts with a long filler context: each prompt is answered once under full retention and once under matched eviction after a shared prefill, and the same replies are scored by keyword heuristics, the HarmBench Llama-2-13B classifier, an auxiliary LLM judge, and humans on disagreements. On Qwen2.5-3B, keyword refusal falls from 98.0% to 80.5% (McNemar p~1e-8) while classifier refusal stays near ceiling (99.0%-99.5%) and MMLU accuracy is unchanged (50.0%); human labels predominantly follow the classifier, consistent with soft refusals. The gap is not universal and weakens under short fillers and paired SnapKV, so safety auditing under compression should rely on several judges matched to the serving context rather than on keyword rates alone.

</details>


### [1096] [3-D Emissions Mapping and Social Cost Estimation for US Domestic Aviation at West Coast Hubs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31686)
*Hesam Shafiei Nia,Don MacKenzie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于物理约束自编码器（CBiG3D-AE）的ADS-B轨迹重建方法，用于构建美国西海岸枢纽机场的三维航空排放清单，并量化其社会成本与健康影响。研究发现NOx虽仅占CO2质量的不到0.4%，却占空气质量与健康货币化成本的99.7%，是主要的健康成本驱动因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有航空排放清单缺乏高分辨率轨迹数据，导致社会成本和健康影响评估不准确。传统插值方法（如三次样条）无法捕捉高度、速度与推力之间的非线性物理关系，且气候影响与近机场健康影响研究往往独立进行，缺乏整合框架。

Method: 1. **轨迹重建**：提出CBiG3D-AE自编码器，编码器采用CNN（空间特征）、Bi-GRU（时序特征）和3D-CNN（时空交互）双分支结构，带跳跃连接，解码器使用TCN。训练时采用自监督掩码（散点掩码40%、连续块掩码40%、尖峰注入20%），并加入物理约束损失函数（垂直速率一致性、平滑度、高度边界、地速平滑度）。2. **排放估算**：基于EUROCONTROL BADA性能表和ICAO EEDB排放指数，结合BFFM2进行高度修正，按飞行阶段（LTO <914m、低、中、高、巡航）估算CO2、NOx、CO、HC、nvPM。3. **社会成本与健康评估**：采用EPA的CO2社会成本（190美元/吨）和Grobler等人（2019）的分阶段边际损害成本，对2025年1月KSEA、KLAX、KSFO三枢纽20,134条航班的排放进行货币化。

Result: **轨迹重建**：所提AE模型在5%–50%缺失率下均优于TCN-AE和三次样条插值，总体MAE为0.061，RMSE为0.139；高度MAE为311.4m，垂直速率MAE为12.42m/s，远优于对比方法。**排放清单**：总燃耗124,687.9吨，CO2排放394,013.9吨，NOx排放1,476.0吨；巡航占燃耗64.8%，NOx占56.5%；LTO阶段NOx占比高于其燃耗占比，呈现热力学驱动的爬升阶段高排放特征。**社会成本**：总社会成本约1.083亿美元，其中气候成本7,350万美元（CO2占绝大多数），空气质量与健康成本3,475万美元；NOx虽产生轻微净冷却气候效应（-135万美元），但在空气质量与健康成本中占99.7%（3,464万美元），是绝对主导的健康成本驱动因素。

Conclusion: 该研究是首批将基于自编码器的轨迹重建与独立时空特征编码和基于高度的排放建模相结合的工作之一，生成的排放图和社会成本估算可为美国国内航空的环境影响评估和近机场健康政策制定提供量化依据。未来工作将引入基于高度的动态成本函数并扩展至更大区域。研究建议对NOx实施针对性定价机制，作为碳定价的补充工具，以更有效降低航空的环境与健康影响。

Abstract: Existing aviation emissions inventories lack accurate trajectory data for high-resolution social cost and health impact assessment. This paper develops a 3-D emissions map by reconstructing flight trajectories for US west coast hubs to estimate regional environmental and near-airport health impacts. A physics-informed autoencoder (AE) is applied to ADS-B trajectory records for January 2025 covering US west coast hubs. The encoder combines a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a Bi-GRU, and a 3-D CNN with skip connection; the decoder is a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN). It is benchmarked against a baseline-AE and cubic spline interpolation. Emissions are mapped via EUROCONTROL Base of Aircraft Data (BADA) performance tables and ICAO Engine Emissions Databank (EEDB) emission indices, with altitude corrections via Boeing Fuel Flow Method 2 (BFFM2). Social costs are quantified for all flight phases, with health impacts assessed for Landing and Takeoff cycles within 50 km of each hub. The proposed AE model outperforms both a TCN-AE and cubic spline interpolation across 5% to 50% missing rates. Monetizing the emissions inventory shows NOx produces a small net cooling effect in direct climate forcing, while accounting for 99.7% of monetized air-quality and health cost despite being under 0.4% of CO2 by mass, making it the dominant health-cost driver. To our knowledge, this is among the first studies combining AE-based trajectory reconstruction with separate spatial-temporal feature encoding and altitude-based emissions modeling to produce a regional aviation emissions inventory for air quality, climate impact and population exposure. The resulting emissions map and social cost estimates provide quantitative context for environmental impact assessment and near-airport health policy evaluation for US domestic aviation.

</details>


### [1097] [seq2cause: One Autoregressive Backbone, Four Causal Discovery Tasks in Event Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31801)
*Hugo Math*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Seq2Cause提出一个统一框架，利用预训练的自回归模型作为摊销条件独立性测试引擎，无需任务特定再训练即可同时解决离散事件序列中四种结构不同的因果发现任务（事件→事件/事件→结果 × 样本级/总体级），通过预测-因果对偶性建立模型交叉熵与因果识别误差的理论联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事件序列因果发现方法存在两个根本局限：一是所有方法均假设多流结构和低词汇量，无法处理单流高词汇量设置；二是没有任何方法能同时解决由依赖类型（事件→事件 vs 事件→结果）和因果范围（样本级 vs 总体级）两轴定义的四个结构不同的因果发现任务。车辆诊断、患者轨迹、基因组序列等领域中，核心问题是因果性的而非预测性的，亟需可扩展的统一框架。

Method: 核心方法是将任意预训练自回归模型（如LLaMA、GPT、Mamba）重新用作摊销的条件独立性测试引擎，具体包括：(1) 样本级：通过条件互信息（CMI）的蒙特卡洛估计进行条件独立性测试，对事件→事件中的滞后效应采用do-干预中介变量来识别受控直接效应；(2) 总体级：采用最小描述长度（MDL）准则聚合因果证据，并推导出自适应阈值τ*_{uv} = c_type + √(ε_T/2)·η_uv，其误差修正项源自模型近似误差；(3) 理论核心是预测-因果对偶性：证明AR模型的超额交叉熵ε同时控制CMI估计误差（定理1）、样本级图正确性（定理2）和MDL总体边包含误差（引理1）。

Result: 在非线性SCM（词汇量达8,000）和真实车辆诊断日志（29,100事件类型，474失败结果）上的实验表明：(a) 样本级事件图：F1达91%，最强基线（Neural Granger）为69%；(b) 样本级马尔可夫边界：在29,100词汇量下所有经典MB算法超时不可行，seq2cause F1达46.1%；(c) 总体级事件图：F1达65.4%（精度81.5%，召回54.6%），远超PMI/TF-IDF基线；(d) 总体级马尔可夫边界：在474个结果上精度68.6%。在ε≈0.1处出现相变，性能稳定保持至词汇量8,000，对噪声注入和时间步缺失具有鲁棒性，无修正时精度在N>1000后崩溃，验证了引理1。

Conclusion: Seq2Cause是首个用单个冻结骨干网络在所有四个因果发现机制中同时填充所有单元的方法，建立了预测-因果对偶性理论，使序列建模的每一次进步都能免费收紧因果识别保证，无需重新训练。该框架将任意预训练AR模型转化为并行化因果发现引擎，为单流高词汇量序列中的因果发现提供了可扩展且理论保证的解决方案。

Abstract: Complex systems such as vehicles, patients, or genomes emit discrete event sequences whose operative question is causal, not predictive: which events cause which other events, and which cause higher-level outcomes such as failures or diseases? This question decomposes along two axes -- dependency type (event $\to$ event vs.\ event $\to$ outcome) and causal scope (single sequence vs.\ population) -- yielding four structurally distinct regimes with different identifiability conditions. No existing method addresses more than one, because all assume multi-stream structure with low vocabulary, and none scales beyond a few hundred event types. We present \textsc{Seq2Cause}, a unified framework that resolves all four regimes through a single shared primitive: a pretrained autoregressive model repurposed as an amortized conditional independence testing engine requiring no task-specific retraining. We establish a prediction--causality duality: the model's excess cross-entropy simultaneously bounds causal identification error across all four regimes, so that every improvement in next-token prediction tightens causal guarantees for free. On nonlinear SCMs (vocabularies up to $8{,}000$ types) and real-world vehicle diagnostic logs ($29$K event types, $474$ failure outcomes), \textsc{Seq2Cause} is the first method to populate all four regimes at scale with a single frozen backbone. Existing methods are either inapplicable, inaccurate, or computationally intractable in this setting.

</details>


### [1098] [Medium-Term Multi-Resolution Electric Load Forecasting using Economic Data and Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31806)
*Lindas Eloi,Goude Yannig,Ciais Philippe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究社会经济数据对中短期（1-48个月）电力负荷预测（MTLF）的影响，使用表格基础模型对法国电力负荷进行预测，发现精选的经济协变量可将预测技能提升20%，且随着预测期限延长，经济特征的重要性增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中短期电力负荷预测（MTLF）在长期（LTLF，依赖经济预测）和短期（STLF，依赖天气、日历等模式）之间，既需要外推能力又需要变异性建模，但经济指标对MTLF的贡献尚不明确，特别是在何种预测期限和分辨率下能带来收益。

Method: 构建了一个涵盖20年法国电力负荷、天气变量和经济特征（消费价格指数、生产指数、电动车数量、就业率等）的数据集；采用表格基础模型（Foundation Model）；提出一种新的特征选择流水线，通过多样特征子集的专家模型集成进行特征筛选；在月度与日度两种分辨率下，评估1至48个月预测期限的表现；并通过特征重要性和上下文重要性进行模型可解释性分析。

Result: 精选的经济协变量使2015-2025年的预测技能提升20%，这一改进在不同预测期限和分辨率下均稳定存在，月度粒度下MAPE限制在4%，日度粒度下MAPE限制在5%。模型在上下文利用方面存在局限性，提示可通过缩减上下文实现计算节省；同时经济预测变量的重要性随预测期限增长而上升。

Conclusion: 在中短期电力负荷预测中加入经济数据能够弥合与长期负荷预测之间的差距，实现无缝衔接的预测；表格基础模型上下文利用效率有限，提示有计算优化空间；经济特征在更长预测期限中发挥更大作用。

Abstract: Accurate medium-term, from a few months to a few years, electricity load forecasts are crucial for informed decision-making in power plant maintenance scheduling, load dispatch and price settlement. Being comprised between Long-Term Load Forecasting (LTLF) which uses mostly economic projections and appliances development scenarios, and Short-Term Load Forecasting (STLF) driven by weather, calendar and autoregressive patterns, Medium-Term Load Forecasting (MTLF) requires both extrapolation capabilities and variability modeling. Yet, it remains unclear if MTLF can benefit from economic indicators, and especially at which forecast horizon and resolution. To address these challenges we investigated the impact of socioeconomic data on predictions issued 1 month and up to 48 months in advance for France at monthly and daily resolution using a tabular Foundation Model (FM). A dataset covering 20 years of observations of electricity load, weather variables and economic features such as consumer price and production indices, electric vehicle counts or employment is created for the study. To avoid noisy data, we used a new feature selection pipeline, creating ensemble of expert models with diverse feature subsets, to demonstrate that selected economic covariates improve forecast skill by 20% over 2015-2025. This enhancement is steady across lead times and resolutions limiting the Mean Absolute Percentage Error to 4% for monthly granularity and 5% for daily granularity. Explainability of the models is investigated through feature and context importance. Results showed that the FM is limited in the context it leverages pointing towards potential computational savings with a reduced context, while feature importance of economic predictors grows with the forecast horizon. This suggests that including economic data in MTLF could bridge the gap with LTLF leading to seamless forecasts.

</details>


### [1099] [Relational Compression: A Framework for Relational Fidelity in Constrained Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31816)
*Yaniv Shulman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"关系压缩"(Relational Compression)框架,将经典信源-描述-重建范式扩展到以关系结构为保真度核心内容的场景。作者将图摘要、谱稀疏化、相似性保持表示和关系蒸馏等方法统一在该框架下,并开发了"有限码字碰撞"(finite-codeword collision)作为具体实现机制,揭示了它与质心重建、归一化图关联/切割之间的精确对应关系,通过图和图像实验展示了不同关系保真度要求如何在该框架内被形式化和测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当信息价值在于元素间关系而非元素本身时,压缩应保留什么?现有方法(图摘要、谱稀疏化、相似性哈希、关系蒸馏)各自处理此问题但缺乏统一框架,使得不同方法的保真度、资源约束和重建假设难以比较。作者旨在建立一个通用的关系压缩接口,明确区分信源关系、保留描述、重建/评估关系、保真度准则和受限资源等组件。

Method: (1) 将关系压缩形式化为信源 S→描述 m_S→重建 S̃ 的经典压缩范式,但以关系结构为保真度承载内容;(2) 开发有限码字碰撞机制:将硬分配 c: V→{1,...,K} 松弛为类别分布 q_θ(·|x),定义碰撞概率 k_θ(x,x')=Σ_z q_θ(z|x)q_θ(z|x') 作为成对关系的连续松弛;(3) 建立参考加权亲和度 a_r(x,x') 和 Rényi-2 占用度量 H_2(q_Z),揭示碰撞几何与正球面几何的联系;(4) 证明平方欧氏质心重建和归一化图关联/切割的精确目标对应关系;(5) 通过五项实验验证:合成验证、图上交换保真度准则、归纳式归一化切割、图像重建定义的关系、教师定义的关系。

Result: (1) 框架成功统一了图摘要、谱稀疏化、谱哈希、t-SNE、关系蒸馏和质心量化等方法,使其可通过共同的源-描述-重建接口比较;(2) 合成实验验证了质心-成对目标对应关系在数值和梯度上一致(差异<2×10⁻⁶),未经逆质量校正的对比失败(ME=4.79);(3) 图实验中,有效电阻扭曲 D_F 和源碰撞探针 D_C 在 MalNet 和 PROTEINS 上高度一致(斯皮尔曼相关系数 0.975/0.981),而熵场准则 D_{H₂} 与之差异较大;(4) MalNet 归纳实验中,纯归一化切割达到测试 Ncut 1.160,与谱参考(1.159)接近,但占用组织不同;(5) Flowers102 重建实验中,基线设置达到 24.83 dB PSNR、K_eff=13,388;教师定义关系实验中,受偏好的碰撞富集 12.4 倍,受回避的碰撞抑制 85.8%,无需重建即可组织代码。

Conclusion: 关系压缩框架将关系结构明确为保真度承载内容,有限码字碰撞提供了同码字概率这一可重用的表示机制,将局部对齐/分离与聚合 Rényi-2 占用和正球面几何联系起来。精确对应关系揭示了质心重建和归一化切割是同一亲和度构造的不同实例。实验表明图定义、图像重建定义和教师定义的关系要求可在统一框架内实现并测试,同时占用组织(如 K_eff、归一化切割值)能揭示单一保真度准则下不可见的表示差异。该框架为未来在完整描述预算下比较描述机制、开发更丰富的关系级解码器以及将关系压缩扩展到更广泛信源类别提供了共同基础。

Abstract: What should a compressed representation preserve when the information of interest lies in relationships among elements rather than in the elements themselves? We formulate relational compression in the classical source-description-reconstruction sense, but with relational structure itself as the fidelity-bearing content. Each instance specifies the source relation, retained description, reconstructed or evaluated relation, fidelity criterion, and constrained resource. We use this interface to situate selected methods from graph summarization, spectral sparsification, similarity-preserving representation, and relational distillation within a common formulation while keeping their different reconstruction and resource assumptions explicit. We develop finite-codeword collision as one concrete realization. Same-codeword probability yields a relational geometry linking pair-specific alignment and separation to aggregate Rényi-2 occupancy and the spherical geometry of categorical assignments, with exact objective correspondences to squared-Euclidean centroid reconstruction and normalized graph association and cut. Graph and image studies illustrate complementary routes within the finite-codeword family: graph- and teacher-defined relational requirements act directly on equality or collision, while reconstruction acts through a joint decoder. Together, these results illustrate how distinct relational requirements can be formulated and tested within a common constrained-representation framework.

</details>


### [1100] [Averaged Mirror Descent and Dual Gradient Methods: Convergent Algorithms for Entropic Gromov-Wasserstein Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31848)
*Joanna Mark,Gabriel Rioux,Riccardo Passegger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出平均镜像下降（AMD）和固定步长对偶梯度方法，用于求解任意成本矩阵下的熵正则化Gromov-Wasserstein（EGW）问题，弥补了经典镜像下降（MD）在非CNT成本下可能不收敛的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein距离在机器学习中有广泛应用，而其最流行的求解器——镜像下降（MD）算法——目前仅在受限的成本函数类（如条件负定型，CNT）下有收敛性保证。此外，现有的对偶梯度方法虽然适用于一般成本，但步长依赖于正则化参数ε，在小ε时步长过小导致实际收敛缓慢。因此需要设计对任意成本均能保证收敛且步长不依赖ε的算法。

Method: 1）平均镜像下降（AMD）：在标准MD步骤后引入加权平均步骤 x_{j+1}=(1-α_j)x_j+α_j x̃_j，将算法纳入条件梯度（conditional gradient）框架进行分析。2）对偶梯度方法：利用Rioux等人[27]提出的EGW对偶公式，将成本矩阵分解为M=B₁ᵀB₁-B₀ᵀB₀，通过最小化光滑函数ℓ_ε进行优化，采用固定步长1（不依赖ε）。3）两种算法均分析了精确和不精确（Sinkhorn迭代近似求解EOT子问题）两种情形下的非渐近收敛性。

Result: 理论上：1）AMD获得了O(1/J)的近似驻点收敛速率（精确情形），并在不精确情形下证明了优化误差与逼近误差的分解；2）对偶梯度方法获得min‖∇ℓ_ε(u_j)‖²=O(1/J)的收敛速率，且不随ε减小而恶化；3）证明了对偶驻点与原始问题近似驻点之间的量化关系。实验上：在高斯混合、球面点云（非CNT：六次幂欧氏距离的Gaussian-to-Ring问题）等数据集上验证，经典MD（α=1）在非CNT情形下10次运行均不收敛，而AMD和Variational(1)在所有情形下均能收敛。

Conclusion: 本文成功为EGW问题提供了两种对任意成本矩阵均具有理论收敛保证的算法。AMD作为MD的简单修改，保持了每步求解EOT子问题的便利性，同时具备收敛保证；对偶梯度方法虽然每步计算更复杂，但提供了更直接的收敛度量且不依赖ε。实验验证了理论发现，特别是经典MD在非CNT成本下振荡不收敛而新方法能够克服这一缺陷。未来工作方向是加速对偶梯度方法中梯度计算的效率。

Abstract: The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distance measures the discrepancy between metric measure (mm) spaces and identifies optimal alignments between them based solely on their intrinsic structure. Since it identifies isomorphic mm spaces, it provides a natural notion of distance for heterogeneous datasets which may admit isomorphic representations. In order to accelerate computation of GW distances, many practitioners employ entropic regularization to obtain an Entropic GW (EGW) problem. The most popular EGW solver is the Mirror Descent (MD) algorithm, which reduces EGW computations to an iterative process where an entropic optimal transport (EOT) problem is solved at each iteration. Despite its widespread use, the convergence of MD for this problem has only been established for restricted classes of costs. On the other hand, a recently proposed dual gradient method is available for general costs, but requires a choice of step size which depends on the regularization parameter. To address these two issues, we introduce Averaged Mirror Descent (AMD), which averages consecutive MD steps, and prove its convergence for arbitrary costs. Then, we establish that the dual gradient method with a fixed step size also converges for arbitrary costs at the cost of a more complicated iteration. In both cases, we also account for inexact iterations which are inescapable in practice. We compare the empirical performance of these methods across various settings and, in particular, show that AMD and the dual gradient method both converge on an example where classical MD fails.

</details>


### [1101] [TemporalGraphLLM: Temporal Graph Neural Networks with Large Language Models for Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31881)
*Moran Beladev,Or Eitan,Gilad Katz,Lior Rokach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TemporalGraphLLM 框架,通过将时序图神经网络(TGNN)的时序感知节点嵌入通过学习的投影注入到 LLM 的特殊占位符 token 中,实现对动态文本属性图(DTAG)的联合推理。该框架与具体 TGNN 和 LLM 解耦,在多个真实 DTAG 数据集上的链接预测、边分类和边文本生成任务中达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以同时建模图结构的时序演化和文本属性的语义丰富性:TGNN 擅长捕捉动态节点关系但缺乏上下文文本推理能力,而 LLM 擅长文本理解但在时序结构化图推理上存在不足。两者融合方法缺乏对时序节点表示与 LLM 推理的整合,尤其在节点、边和文本属性均随时间演化的场景下。

Method: 1) 时序图嵌入:使用任意 TGNN(TGAT/GraphMixer/DyGFormer)生成时序感知节点嵌入 h_u^t, h_v^t;2) 提示编码:通过学习线性投影 W 将 TGNN 嵌入映射至 LLM token 空间,使用近期加权采样选取 k=10 个时序邻居构造提示,并用投影向量覆盖 LLM 流中特殊占位符 token;3) 微调与预测:TGNN 与 LLM 通过 QLoRA 联合训练,采用多目标损失 L=λ₁L_edge+λ₂L_LLM 联合监督结构预测(BCE/多类交叉熵)与下一 token 预测。负采样采用时序有效的未交互节点。

Result: 在 Enron、Googlemap CT、Stack Elec、GDELT、Amazon Movies 五个数据集上,TemporalGraphLLM 链接预测准确率最高提升约 6%(Stack Elec TGAT+Mistral-7B 达 0.9053),边分类 F1 加权值最高提升约 5 个百分点,文本生成方面 BERTScore 和 SBERT 相似度普遍优于纯 LLM 基线。Kruskal-Wallis 与 Wilcoxon 检验显示显著差异(p<0.05)。消融实验验证:时序采样优于随机采样,k=10 表现最优,(λ₁=2, λ₂=1)效果最佳。值得注意的是,3B/7B 模型与 TGNN 结合后训练时间反而减少(Llama-3B: 19h→13h;Mistral-7B: 28h→21h)。

Conclusion: TemporalGraphLLM 是首个将任意 TGNN 与任意 LLM 端到端联合训练的通用框架,通过占位符 token 替换机制在 LLM 流中注入时序图嵌入,有效融合结构、时序与文本三种信号,在 DTAG 任务上同时超越了纯 TGNN 和纯 LLM 基线。未来方向包括联合预测边描述与标签,以及引入强化学习优化时序路径选择与生成描述。

Abstract: Dynamic text-attributed graphs (DTAGs), where nodes, edges, and textual attributes evolve over time, are crucial in applications such as social networks, citation graphs, and knowledge graphs. However, existing approaches struggle to jointly model the temporal evolution of graph structures and the semantic richness of textual attributes. While Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNNs) capture evolving node relationships, they often lack contextual text reasoning. Conversely, Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in textual understanding but struggle with structured graph reasoning in temporal settings. To bridge this gap, we propose TemporalGraphLLM, a novel framework that can integrate any temporal GNN with an LLM for enhanced reasoning in DTAGs. Our approach fine-tunes LLMs using graph-time-aware instruction tuning and novel temporal GNNs injection to replace dedicated added tokens with graph embeddings. TemporalGraphLLM effectively leverages pretrained TGNNs within an LLM framework to achieve state-of-the-art performance on edge classification, link prediction, and edge-based text generation tasks. Extensive evaluation on real-world dynamic graph datasets demonstrates state-of-the-art performance. Our findings highlight the synergistic potential of LLMs and TGNNs, opening new directions for learning on evolving graphs.

</details>


### [1102] [Resource-Aware Federated Mixture-of-Experts with Adaptive Pruning for Onboard Learning in LEO Satellite Constellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31932)
*Mohamed Shaaban,Mohamed Elmahallawy,Marius Bernahrndt,Tobias Hecking*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出COSMIC-FL框架,针对低地球轨道(LEO)卫星星座资源受限的星上联邦学习场景,结合两种混合专家(MoE)架构(Sliced-MoE与Modular-MoE)与三种结构化剪枝策略,在六个图像分类基准上以高达80%的通信、计算与能耗降低保持具有竞争力的准确率,并在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin嵌入式平台上验证了实际部署可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习(FL)假设充足的算力、内存和通信资源,不适用于计算、存储与带宽严重受限的LEO卫星平台;同时,下传原始影像受限于隐私与商业监管以及稀缺的地面站接触窗口。需要一种资源感知的星上联邦学习框架,在不牺牲过多准确率的前提下,显著降低星上训练与通信开销。

Method: 1) 两种互补MoE架构:Sliced-MoE共享骨干卷积张量并按通道切片划分专家路径,Modular-MoE为每个专家配备独立的塔式网络(含残差块)与分类头;2) 基于辅助数据集与K-Means语义聚类的class-to-expert映射,由轻量级门控网络在推理阶段软加权聚合专家输出;3) 分阶段联邦训练协议(专家轮转专化→门控微调→分类头微调),每阶段仅通信对应活跃参数;4) 三种结构化剪枝策略:服务器端基于聚合权重L1的全局剪枝、客户端固定比例投票剪枝(均值聚合)、以及基于MAD差距准则的客户端自适应逐层剪枝;5) 稀疏专家参与机制,客户端仅训练覆盖本地类别的专家路径。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、AID、EuroSAT、UCMerced、RESISC45六个基准上,客户端数S∈{10,50,100},专家数E∈{3,5,7,10},Dirichlet α∈{0.1,0.3,1.0,10.0}的非i.i.d.设置下,COSMIC-FL相对FedAvg/FedProx/PM-MoE/FedDropout/HeteroFL在准确率-效率权衡上保持竞争力:100客户端时Sliced-MoE稀疏训练可减少89%总上行通信,E=3为最优专家数,自适应剪枝可减少60%峰值显存与约11%板载功耗;但i.i.d.准确率略低于CentMoE;Modular变体准确率略优于Sliced但通信开销更大。Jetson AGX Orin实测显示训练1,103分钟可达87.78%准确率,EuroSAT推理延迟21ms(切片)/11ms(模块化),吞吐量分别为47/89 img/s,峰值显存42/62 MB。

Conclusion: COSMIC-FL通过MoE专家稀疏参与与结构化剪枝的联合优化,为资源异构的LEO星座提供了一种可行的星上联邦学习方案,在通信、计算与能耗上实现最高约80%降低,嵌入式实测证实其内存与功耗优势;FLOPs、参数计数与实测延迟应作为互补的效率指标看待。未来工作将探索切片执行的算子级优化以及动态卫星连通性下的自适应专家调度。

Abstract: Low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellites are increasingly expected to perform onboard learning for applications such as disaster response and environmental monitoring. However, conventional federated learning (FL) is ill-suited to onboard satellite learning, as it assumes computational, memory, and communication resources beyond the capabilities of resource-constrained LEO platforms, often necessitating the transmission of raw imagery to ground stations. We present COSMIC-FL, a resource-aware FL framework for efficient onboard learning in LEO satellite constellations. COSMIC-FL introduces two complementary Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures: a Sliced design that shares backbone representations while activating task-specific channel subsets, and a Modular design that employs lightweight gating to route inputs to physically separated expert networks. A semantic class-to-expert mapping enables each satellite to train, update, and communicate only the expert paths relevant to its local data. To further improve efficiency, COSMIC-FL integrates staged optimization with three structured pruning strategies: server-side pruning, client-side fixed-ratio pruning with mean-vote aggregation, and adaptive client-side per-layer pruning based on aggregated importance and a MAD-based gap criterion. Combined with semantic expert routing, these techniques jointly adapt computation and model sparsity to both data semantics and layer importance, yielding a favourable accuracy--efficiency trade-off for heterogeneous space platforms. Experiments on six image classification benchmarks under highly non-i.i.d. settings show that COSMIC-FL maintains competitive accuracy while reducing communication, computation, and energy consumption by up to 80% over SOTA FL methods. We further validate COSMIC-FL on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, confirming its efficiency gains under realistic embedded deployment constraints.

</details>


### [1103] [Cache-Aware Conv3D Lowering Across Embedded World-Model Decoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31938)
*Jiaming Zhang,Wu Yang,Shuai Tao,Wulong Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种缓存感知的运行时降级(caching-aware lowering)方法，将支持的时间因果 Conv3D 调用转换为批量空间 Conv2D 操作，在不修改预训练权重的前提下加速嵌入式设备(Jetson AGX Orin)上视频世界模型 VAE 解码器的推理，并通过跨架构(Wan2.2/Wan2.1)转移和与 TensorRT 的对比验证其有效性与局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式世界模型在边缘设备上的可行性不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于运行时的操作表示方式。Cosmos3-Nano 的 profile 显示 Conv3D 占 VAE 解码 GPU 时间的 95.95%，其中高开销调用集中在时间维度短、空间特征图大的模式上，因此希望仅通过运行时变换而非修改模型来提升推理速度。

Method: 缓存感知降级(cache-aware lowering)：将因果 Conv3D 的每个时间抽头(temporal tap)分解为对缓存帧的批量空间 Conv2D 操作，沿时间维度将有效区间折入 batch 维度执行。保持预训练权重、因果缓存语义、卷积参数、偏置位置和输出布局不变。支持条件包括5维输入、单位时间步幅、单卷积组；不支持的调用回退到原始 Conv3D，并配备 guard、reversible installation、derived-weight caching 和 route counters。

Result: 在 Jetson AGX Orin 上，Cosmos3-Edge 25帧 I2V 流水线 VAE 解码加速约 6.91×，完整生成加速 2.21×；VAE 编码同样获益约 6.35×。Cosmos3-Nano 解码加速 4.74×–6.65×，LingBot-World (Wan2.1 VAE) 加速 2.70×–5.75×，所有解码器调用均达 100% fast-path 覆盖。BF16 数值一致(余弦相似度 ≥0.99998)，FP32 进一步提升。Clean-device 对比中，TensorRT 在 17 帧解码器上进一步实现 1.36× 稳态加速，但需 99 个固定形状引擎、1637.6s AOT 编译、3.16 GB 序列化引擎、7.58s 冷启动及 14.57 GB CUDA 分配 / 34.19 GB VmHWM；本方法捕获了 95.55% 的绝对延迟缩减，峰值 CUDA 分配仅 7.31 GB。

Conclusion: 该缓存感知降级方法为预训练视频世界模型解码器在嵌入式 GPU 上的加速提供了一种轻量级运行时优化路径，无需修改学习模型即可恢复大部分可用的解码器加速；其优势在于无需逐模块/逐状态的 AOT 引擎构建，内存占用显著低于 TensorRT，但在稳态吞吐上仍逊于完全特化的 TensorRT，并且受限于支持条件(5维输入、单位时间步幅、单分组)，架构转移仅在已评测的 Wan 系列内得到验证。

Abstract: Generative world models can provide visual rollouts for embodied planning, yet their feasibility on edge devices depends not only on the learned model but also on how the execution runtime represents its operations. We introduce a cache-aware lowering that expresses supported causal Conv3D calls as batched spatial Conv2D operations while preserving pretrained weights, temporal-cache semantics, convolution parameters, bias placement, and output layout. Across the complete Cosmos3-Edge image-to-video pipeline on a 64-GB NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, the proposed route accelerates VAE decoding by approximately $7\times$ and reduces complete-generation latency by more than $2\times$, while repeated decoder evaluations maintain complete fast-path coverage without fallbacks. The unchanged lowering also improves Cosmos3-Nano and transfers to LingBot-World's architecturally distinct Wan2.1 VAE. A clean-device comparison against fully specialized TensorRT shows that TensorRT provides a further $1.36\times$ steady-state improvement, but requires substantially greater per-module and per-runtime-state AOT specialization. Same-latent BF16 and FP32 evaluations characterize the finite-precision differences introduced by the alternative execution order. Together, these results position cache-aware lowering as a lightweight runtime optimization that recovers most of the available decoder acceleration without modifying the learned models themselves.

</details>


### [1104] [Simple Extensions of Single-Objective Acquisition Functions and Hedge Strategies for Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31940)
*Haris Moazam Sheikh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种简单而有效的多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）框架，通过超体积排名机制将标准单目标采集函数（如UCB、EI）直接扩展到多目标设置，避免了复杂的多目标采集函数设计；同时引入了多目标对冲策略（MO-Hedge），自适应选择采集函数组合，实现在多个基准测试中匹配或超越现有先进MOBO方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MOBO方法通常需要专门设计多目标采集函数（如超体积改进、信息论目标），实现复杂且计算成本高；且没有单一采集函数在所有问题上表现最佳，采集函数选择对问题结构敏感。研究动机在于：是否可以不设计专门的多目标采集机制，而是通过简单扩展现有单目标采集策略实现高效MOBO。

Method: 提出两个核心方法：(1) qHAX-α框架——为每个目标独立计算单目标采集函数形成向量采集，通过NSGA-II等Pareto优化器生成多样化候选集，再利用后验均值构造去噪Pareto前沿，通过超体积排名选择下一评估点，支持q批次并行选择；(2) MO-Hedge策略——维护采集函数组合，基于各采集函数历史候选集的超体积贡献，使用指数加权更新（exponentiated-weights）计算选择概率，自适应分配采集权重。两者都基于超体积的次模性获得(1-1/e)近似保证。

Result: 在9个基准测试（ZDT2/4/6、DTLZ1/2/3、Branin-Currin、焊接梁、车辆碰撞安全）上，使用20次独立运行、初始30个数据点+75次评估的实验设置：qHAX-UCB表现最强且稳定，在多数问题上达到最佳或接近最佳的超体积和IGD性能；qHAX-EI在工程问题上竞争力强但在合成问题上稍弱；MO-Hedge两个变体均能稳健追踪组合中最佳成员性能；qHAX-α运行时间远低于qMOJES等基线（通常低一个数量级），且对问题维度和目标数变化不敏感。

Conclusion: 研究表明，通过超体积排名机制简单扩展经典单目标采集函数即可在多种多目标优化问题上实现与复杂最先进方法相当或更优的性能，同时保持低计算成本和实现简洁性；MO-Hedge策略进一步通过自适应采集选择提升了鲁棒性。这为MOBO提供了一种更简单、更灵活的替代方案，验证了"复用并适当扩展成熟单目标策略"这一思路的实用价值。

Abstract: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) is commonly approached through specialized acquisition functions or scalarization schemes designed to explicitly account for trade-offs among non-preferential objectives. In this work, we show that such complexity might be unnecessary. We propose a framework that extends standard single-objective acquisition functions directly to the multi-objective setting through a hypervolume-based transformation. We further extend hedge strategies for acquisition functions, which are typically used only in single-objective optimization, to the multi-objective regime. Our approach requires minimal modification to existing Bayesian optimization pipelines and avoids the need for bespoke multi-objective formulations. We demonstrate how a broad class of commonly used single-objective acquisition functions and hedge strategies can be adapted in a principled manner to handle multiple objectives, while preserving their intuitive interpretation and computational efficiency. Empirically, we evaluate the proposed methods across a range of synthetic and real-world multi-objective benchmarks. Despite their simplicity, our extensions consistently match or outperform more complex state-of-the-art MOBO methods in terms of optimization performance and sample efficiency. These results suggest that effective multi-objective Bayesian optimization can be achieved by reusing and carefully extending well-established single-objective acquisition strategies, offering a simpler and more flexible alternative to existing approaches.

</details>


### [1105] [On-Policy Attention Linearization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31947)
*Arian Raje,Anupam Nayak,Anthony Fei,Akaash Parthasarathy,Mohamed Abdelfattah,Gauri Joshi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OPAL（On-Policy Attention Linearization），一种将训练好的全注意力Transformer转化为混合注意力模型（用GDN或Mamba-3替换75%注意力层）的方法。核心贡献是引入第三阶段——长时间在线策略蒸馏（OPD），让学生采样自己的长上下文轨迹并接受冻结的全注意力教师的密集监督，从而解决现有离线蒸馏方法在长上下文检索与推理任务上崩溃的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合线性注意力模型（用GDN/Mamba替换大部分softmax注意力）相比全注意力Transformer具有更高的推理效率，但现有基于离线蒸馏的线性化方法在短上下文似然基准上表现良好，却在长上下文检索与多步推理（尤其是思考模式）任务上严重退化。其根本原因在于：线性注意力需将上下文压缩为固定大小的循环状态，误差随序列累积；而离线蒸馏仅在固定语料前缀上监督学生，从未训练学生从自身偏差中恢复，导致长序列生成中状态漂移难以纠回。

Method: OPAL采用三阶段流水线：（1）隐藏状态匹配——用L2损失逐层对齐学生GDN层与教师全注意力层的隐藏状态；（2）离线蒸馏——先在4K短序列、后在32K长序列上用前向KL蒸馏使学生匹配教师的下一token分布；（3）长时间在线策略蒸馏（OPD）——这是关键创新，学生自采样续文，教师在每个位置提供密集监督，使用反向KL损失。三项关键技术提升OPD效果：① KL引导的轨迹长度倍增——起始512 token，当师生KL平稳时倍增直至32K；③ 难度课程——逐步引入长上下文检索与更难的数学题；② WSD学习率调度——以"预衰减-评估/扩展"梯子结构扩展训练至2B token且无需重启。所有阶段训练量约3B token，无需SFT或RLVR后训练。应用于Qwen3-4B与MiMo-7B-RL-0530，将36层中9层保留为全注意力，27层替换为GDN。

Result: 在NIAH检索上：OPAL-Qwen3与OPAL-MiMo均恢复教师100%检索性能（4K–32K全长度），而最强先前方法Zebra-Llama-8B仅恢复68%。在数学推理上：OPAL恢复教师87–94%常识推理、83–93%数学推理能力，MATH-500达92–94%（教师96–97%），AIME'24 pass@8恢复92.3–100%，绝对数学推理均值67.6–72.2%，是先前最强方法（21.6%）的3倍以上。在相同预算对照实验中，OPD在AIME'24/25上分别比离线基线高16.2%/15.9%。效率方面，128K上下文时KV缓存内存降低约4倍，吞吐量提升约2倍。方法通用：Mamba-3混合架构同样有效。相比滑动窗口注意力与TransMLA等非蒸馏转换基线，OPAL在长上下文任务上优势显著。同时在常识基准上存在一定性能折损（恢复87–94%）。

Conclusion: OPAL证明已训练Transformer的长上下文检索与推理能力可以在后期架构转换中存活，并通过持续在线策略训练廉价高效地恢复。研究成果将在线策略训练定位为后期架构转换的重要组成成分，表明模型能力不必与学习时的原始架构绑定，为其他架构转换任务提供了可推广的思路。

Abstract: Hybrid transformer architectures that replace most softmax attention layers with linear attention offer transformer-level quality at a fraction of the memory cost. Rather than pretraining such models, a growing body of work distills them from already trained full-attention transformers. However, these distilled models often collapse on long-context retrieval and reasoning tasks, particularly when operating in thinking mode, where the efficiency gains of hybrid architectures matter most. Since linear attention layers must compress context into a fixed-size state, their errors compound over long sequences. As off-policy distillation never teaches the student model to recover from this drift, tasks that necessitate longer sequence lengths become especially challenging. We introduce On-Policy Attention Linearization (OPAL) in which the hybrid attention student samples its own long-context trajectories and receives dense supervision from the frozen full-attention teacher. Applying OPAL to Qwen3-4B and MiMo-7B-RL-0530, we recover $87$--$94\%$ of full-attention performance on commonsense reasoning, $100\%$ on needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) retrieval, and $83$--$93\%$ on mathematical reasoning with only 3B training tokens. We achieve these results without supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Compared with the strongest prior linearization method, which recovers $68\%$ of its teacher's retrieval performance and $21.6\%$ absolute average mathematical reasoning accuracy, OPAL fully recovers retrieval and achieves $67.6$--$72.2\%$ on math reasoning.

</details>


### [1106] [Model-Agnostic Online Certificate-Driven Calibration for Time Series Forecasting Under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31960)
*Chenfeng Huang,Zixuan Ma,George Michailidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OMPB（Online Martingale PAC-Bayes）框架，一种模型无关的在线证书驱动校准方法，用于时间序列预测在协变量偏移和概念偏移下的鲁棒泛化。核心创新是用鞅浓度不等式替代独立样本PAC-Bayes界的i.i.d.假设，推导有限样本保证的时间自适应证书，并将该证书作为代理正则化器对冻结骨干网络上的门控残差贝叶斯头进行在线校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列OOD泛化面临协变量偏移、概念偏移和时序依赖性三重挑战，标准PAC-Bayes域适应假设独立同分布，在时序设定下失效；现有在线适应方法如OneNet、SOLID、PROCEED缺乏对延迟反馈下分布偏移的严格量化证书，且常因激进的在线微调在滞后监督下过拟合。

Method: 1）将源域序列建模为滤波随机过程，用Freedman鞅浓度和亚Gamma条件推导有界损失和无界损失下的PAC-Bayes域适应界（定理3-4）；2）构造门控残差贝叶斯头（gated residual Bayesian head），在固定骨干网络之上学习低秩残差校正，门控参数σ(α)初始化接近零以保证安全回退；3）定义有界预测不一致代理度量，基于后验样本对在目标窗口上的差异计算时间自适应源-目标不匹配信号diŝ_ρ(t)；4）在线证书P̂B_γ(t)=源经验风险+亚Gamma校正+不一致项，作为代理正则化与延迟监督反馈联合最小化；5）采用"先预测后更新"协议，严格遵守因果性。

Result: 在ETTh（协变量偏移，TCN H=24 OOD MAE从2.5145降至0.5292）、ILI（COVID概念偏移，GPT4TS H=24 COVID MAE从1.3245降至1.0906）和WEATHER-5K（近/远OOD，GPT4TS H=336 NYC MAE从1.0442降至0.6480）三个数据集上，跨TCN、Autoformer、GPT4TS三种骨干网络均显著优于SOLID、OneNet、PROCEED基线，同时保持或提升ID性能；消融实验证实证书正则化和在线校准阶段均必要；延迟反馈分析表明方法在标签延迟达2H时仍优于原始模型；证书与真实目标误差呈正相关（ETTh Pearson r=0.592, WEATHER-5K Spearman ρ=0.488）。

Conclusion: OMPB为时间序列OOD预测提供了首个将鞅PAC-Bayes域适应理论与在线校准相结合的模型无关框架，通过有界代理证书实现了对延迟反馈下分布偏移的严格监测与保守适应，在多种骨干网络和偏移类型下验证了稳定性和精度优势，但其证书界作用于有界代理损失而非原始MAE/MSE，且对后验校准和τ_d尺度选择有一定敏感性。

Abstract: Time series out-of-distribution generalization requires forecasters to remain reliable when deployment dynamics differ from training conditions due to covariate shift, concept shift, and temporal dependence. Probably Approximately Correct Bayesian domain adaptation provides computable certificates by decomposing target risk into a source risk term, a source-to-target mismatch term, and a complexity term, but standard analyses rely on independent sampling and distributional stability, assumptions that are violated in time series by serial dependence and nonstationary shift. We propose a model-agnostic online martingale Probably Approximately Correct Bayesian framework that yields finite-sample certificates under temporal dependence and distribution shift. The certificate replaces independent-sample concentration with martingale concentration that adapts to loss scale and predictable variation. We use the certificate as a surrogate regularizer for online calibration by training a gated residual Bayesian head on top of a fixed forecasting backbone, producing a corrective update that reverts to the backbone prediction when the gate is closed. Online calibration combines a source risk anchor, a posterior-shift penalty, and a time-adaptive mismatch term computed from target windows observed before forecasting. It follows a predict-then-update protocol in which outcomes become available only after forecasting and are used to update subsequent predictions. Experiments across convolutional, attention-based, and large language model-based forecasters show improved stability and accuracy under covariate and concept shift.

</details>


### [1107] [Model Casting and Low-Parameter Gating: Towards More Sparsely Activated FFNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31975)
*Maria Lomeli,Antoine Groudiev,Matthijs Douze,Loïc Cabannes,Pierre Emmanuel Mazaré,François Fleuret,Maximilian Beck,Gergely Szilvasy,Naila Murray,Hervé Jégou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"模型铸造"(Model Casting) 与"低参数门控"(LoPA Gating) 两种方法，通过在训练中途将激活函数替换为稀疏版本 R-S+，并对门控矩阵 W₁ 进行低秩加固定矩阵的参数化，从而大幅提升 Transformer FFN 层中激活值的稀疏度，使推理时的 FLOPs 降低最高达 5.8×，实际 GPU 加速达 3.31×（突破标准门控的 3× 上限），显著优于 RELU-fication、top-p 和 TEAL 等已有稀疏化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流 Transformer 的 FFN 层采用 SwiGLU 设计（SiLU 激活），其门控矩阵的中间激活值几乎不存在精确零，导致无法像早期 ReLU 模型那样利用激活稀疏性来跳过计算；现有方法（ReLU-fication、top-p、TEAL 等）要么稀疏度上限受限（低于 80%），要么只能做训练后剪枝而不能精确控制目标稀疏度，推理加速能力受限。本文旨在突破标准门控 3× 的 FLOPs 理论上限，将训练式稀疏度推向 90% 以上，并保持 NLL 退化低于 1%。

Method: 1) **Model Casting（模型铸造）**：在预训练完成后进行"中段训练"，将 FFN 的 SiLU 激活替换为 R-S+ 激活（正半轴同 SiLU、负半轴为 0 的混合激活），并添加自适应 ℓ₁ 惩罚项以精确控制目标稀疏度（如 90%）。三种设置：(a) Activation Casting 仅替换激活；(b) LoPA Casting 从头即采用 LoPA 门控再铸造；(c) Architecture Casting 将预训练好的 W₁ 分解为 LoPA 形式再铸造。2) **LoPA Gating（低参数门控）**：将门控矩阵 W₁ 分解为 W₁ = G + U·V，其中 G 是每行恰好一个 ±1 的固定稀疏矩阵，U∈ℝ^{H×r}、V∈ℝ^{r×D} 为低秩可训练矩阵（r=αD，α=1/8）；通过自适应隐藏维度 H′ 保持参数总量不变，并引入 RMSNorm 与"双激活"技巧以稳定训练、保持性能。这大幅降低了不可稀疏化的门控矩阵计算成本，使 FLOP-ratio 上限突破 3 达到 13.5。3) **专用推理内核**：CPU 使用 AVX-512 稀疏感知核，GPU 使用 Triton 核融合 W₂/W₃ 投影并跳过非激活神经元。

Result: - 0.81B 模型 Activation Casting @90% 稀疏度：NLL 仅 +0.68%，理论加速 2.48×；LoPA Casting @90%：NLL +0.93%，理论加速 5.83×。5.79B 模型 LoPA Casting @90%：NLL 仅 +0.65%（绝对值 1.792）。- 相比 top-p 与 TEAL，匹配 NLL 下加速 3.2× vs 最高 1.6×（同质量下 2–3 倍优势）。- 实际 GPU 加速：90% 稀疏度下 Standard Gating 2.06×、LoPA Gating 3.31×；95% 稀疏度下 LoPA Gating 达 3.90×，突破标准门控 3× 上限。实际 CPU 端到端加速：1.53×（Standard）/ 1.88×（LoPA）。- 量化兼容：LoPA + int4 在 90% 稀疏度下实测 8.51× 加速。- 通用性验证：可应用于 MoE 模型的专家 FFN 与路由器；成功改造 Qwen3-1.7B-Base，Activation Casting @90% 达 89.6% 稀疏度、2.48× 加速、5T 训练后 NLL 仅 1.875。- 大模型更易稀疏化（ℓ₁ 固定权重下稀疏度随模型增大而提高）；后训练（LCFT/SFT）后 75% 稀疏度的铸造模型甚至略优于密集基线。

Conclusion: Model Casting 通过 R-S+ 激活替换 + 自适应 ℓ₁ 损失，将"训练式激活稀疏度"从 ReLU-fication 的 ~75% 推至 90%，并首次使稀疏度成为可设定的训练目标；LoPA Gating 通过低秩加固定矩阵的参数化打破了标准门控 3× FLOPs 理论上限。两者的结合在保持 NLL 退化 < 1% 的前提下，实现了高达 3.31× 的实际 GPU 加速和 5.83× 的理论加速，显著优于现有 FFN 稀疏化方法，且与量化、MoE、Qwen3 等异构模型兼容，是一种实用且可扩展的 LLM 推理加速方案。

Abstract: This paper introduces model casting, a mid-training recipe that drastically sparsifies the activations within the Feed-Forward Network (FFN) layer. With this strategy, at inference time, we first compute the output of the gating matrix and, thanks to its high sparsity, we avoid computations with the two other matrices, reducing the FLOP count by up to 3x. While this theoretical speedup is an upper bound, model casting translates into significant speedups both on CPU and GPU. We then introduce LoPA Gating, a new FFN design that increases the maximum theoretical speedup. It is a low-FLOPs parameterization of the gating matrix that overcomes the 3x cap by allocating fewer FLOPs and parameters to the gating matrix, compared to the two other FFN matrices that are sparsely activated. We consider two cases: (i) we cast a pre-trained model with a sparsity inducing activation; (ii) we train with LoPA from scratch. In all settings, we significantly outperform existing pruning solutions and regular RELU-fication. For instance, at matched quality, we achieve a 3.2x FLOP speedup with LoPA Casting, against 1.6x at best for competing methods top-p and TEAL. Using dedicated kernels, we achieve an actual 3.31x speed-up on GPU at 90% sparsity, past the 3x ceiling of standard gating; RELU-fication, meanwhile, plateaus below 80% sparsity.

</details>


### [1108] [Understanding the Subspace Stabilization of the Hessian and Gradient Covariance Matrix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31983)
*Fangshuo Liao,Anastasios Kyrillidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络训练中Hessian矩阵顶部子空间稳定化现象。作者提出了一个独立于参数更新幅度的不稳定性度量，发现梯度协方差矩阵与Hessian矩阵共享类似的低秩顶部子空间结构，并利用类间/类内分解给出了顶部(C-1)子空间的显式标识符，最终通过梯度流分析证明子空间缓慢演化源于Hessian矩阵异常值与体本征值之间的分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Hessian顶部子空间稳定化是理解神经网络训练二阶信息的关键现象，但此前工作(Gur-Ari et al., 2018)使用的子空间重叠度量受参数更新幅度混淆(Jaiswal et al., 2025的解释)，无法独立确认稳定化是否真正发生。此外，为何会发生顶部子空间稳定化缺乏理论解释。梯度协方差矩阵与Hessian的关系虽有研究(Zhu et al., 2019; Kunstner et al., 2019)，但其顶部子空间的对应关系未被探索。

Method: 1) 定义新的不稳定性度量（Instability metric），将子空间变化归一化去除学习率的混淆；2) 将梯度协方差矩阵分解为类间协方差和类内协方差之和，识别出中心化类梯度张成的span作为top-(C-1)子空间的显式标识符；3) 通过Papyan (2020)的跨类结构论证连接该标识符；4) 在梯度流设置下利用矩阵ODE工具，证明投影算子变化率受Hessian投影到体子空间上的算子范数控制（定理1和定理2）；5) 在MLP/MNIST、2层CNN/CIFAR-10和3层CNN（带BN）/CIFAR-10三个实验设置上验证。

Result: 1) 不稳定性度量揭示标准训练中只有K=C-1子空间真正稳定，而K<C-1或K>C-1的子空间均不稳定；2) 3层CNN+BN的设置中，overlap metric显示接近1但instability metric较大，表明顶部子空间稳定化失败；3) 梯度协方差与Hessian的top-(C-1)子空间近乎完美对齐；4) span(g_c-g)与两者top-(C-1)子空间在稳定化设置中近乎完美重叠；5) 理论证明top-(C-1)子空间的变化率受控于体本征值相对于异常值的分离程度。

Conclusion: 本文确立了Hessian顶部子空间稳定化是一个独立于参数更新幅度的真实现象，并将其机制归结为Hessian矩阵异常值与体本征值之间的谱分离。梯度协方差矩阵的顶部子空间可作为Hessian顶部子空间的代理，由中心化类梯度显式张成。3层CNN+BN设置中稳定化的失败可归因于异常值-体分离的消失以及类梯度span对顶部子空间解释力的下降。开放问题包括：为何类梯度span能标识Hessian顶部的理论证明、稳定化失败的精确机制、顶部(C-1)本征值的增长原因。

Abstract: The phenomenon of the top subspace stabilization of the Hessian matrix is an surprising and critical aspect in study of the second-order information of neural network training. Prior work argues that the top subspace of the Hessian stabilizes by measuring the overlap between the top subspaces of the step-wise Hessian, and explains this stabilization with diminishing parameter change in the late phase of training. In this paper, we define a new instability metric for the subspace evolution, and use it to detect subspace stabilization that is independent of the magnitude of parameter change. In the meantime, we observe that the gradient covariance matrix has a similar property of its top subspace to the Hessian. By using a between-class and within-class decomposition of the gradient covariance matrix, we identify an explicit form that gives a near-perfect approximation of the top-$(C-1)$ subspace of the Hessian and the gradient covariance matrix. In the gradient flow set-up, we show that the slow evolution of the idenfied approximation is due to the separation between the outlier and the bulk eigenvalues of the Hessian matrix, thus providing an explanation to the phenomenon of the top subspace stabilization of the Hessian matrix.

</details>


### [1109] [Lagrangian and Hamiltonian Neural Networks With a Dissipative System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31988)
*V. Rayamajhi,J. Singal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了拉格朗日神经网络（LNN）和哈密顿神经网络（HNN）在一维一成分阻尼谐振子（耗散系统）中的适用性。该系统的拉格朗日量、哈密顿量和总能量均具有显式时间依赖性。研究发现，LNN和HNN均能成功预测阻尼振子的动力学行为，并在不同程度上学习到相应的拉格朗日量和哈密顿量。此外，论文还揭示了拉格朗日力学中"拉格朗日量不唯一"的性质——存在多种等价变换形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的拉格朗日神经网络和哈密顿神经网络研究主要集中于能量守恒系统（拉格朗日量和哈密顿量无显式时间依赖）。然而物理中许多重要系统是耗散的，能量不守恒。本文旨在将这些物理信息神经网络方法扩展到耗散系统，检验其在更复杂条件下的适用性。

Method: 研究采用模拟数据生成方法：模拟一维一成分谐振子的位置-时间轨迹，无阻尼情况作为对照，阻尼情况使用弱阻尼系数。数据参数包括初始能量在0.1-1.0 J之间均匀分布，添加高斯噪声模拟观测误差。方法上：
- 拉格朗日神经网络（LNN）：以广义坐标q、广义速度q̇和时间t作为输入，利用PyTorch自动微分计算拉格朗日量的各阶导数，通过损失函数训练预测加速度q̈。
- 哈密顿神经网络（HNN）：以广义坐标q、广义动量p（阻尼情况下需用正则动量）和时间t作为输入，通过哈密顿正则方程预测速度和动量变化率。
- 还探索了使用线性动量作为输入的"能量神经网络"变体。
网络架构使用Xavier初始化、tanh激活函数、Adam优化器等标准配置，并测试了不同超参数组合。

Result: 主要结果包括：
1. 动力学预测：LNN和HNN均能成功预测阻尼振子系统的动力学行为（包括加速度、速度和动量变化率），无论是否添加噪声均表现良好。
2. 拉格朗日量学习：LNN能够学习到耗散系统的拉格朗日量，但学习到的形式与理论形式（方程18）不完全一致。作者解释这是由于拉格朗日力学中L' = A'(L + dF/dt) + C的不唯一性，证明模型实际上学到了系统的"有效拉格朗日量"。
3. 哈密顿量学习：使用正则动量作为输入并加入时间参数时，HNN能正确学习阻尼系统的哈密顿量；不使用时间参数但使用线性动量时，模型实际上学习到的是非耗散总能量E_D,tot而非真正的哈密顿量。
4. 阻尼LNN的两种工作方式：i) 时间作为输入参数；ii) ∂L/∂t是L的常数倍时无需时间输入但损失函数隐含编码阻尼信息。
5. 该工作揭示了阻尼系统中正则动量与线性动量的区别，以及哈密顿量不等于系统总能量的现象。

Conclusion: 结论是拉格朗日神经网络和哈密顿神经网络可以成功应用于具有显式时间依赖性的耗散系统，但需满足一定条件。LNN学习到的拉格朗日量虽与"标准形式"不同，但实际上是满足拉格朗日量不唯一性变换的有效形式。HNN在阻尼情况下可以正确学习哈密顿量（使用正则动量+时间参数），或学习到非耗散总能量（使用线性动量）。这项工作展示了物理信息神经网络在更复杂物理系统中的潜力，同时揭示了拉格朗日力学和哈密顿力学的重要理论性质。

Abstract: We investigate the applicability of Lagrangian and Hamiltonian Neural Network models to a dissipative system that has explicit time dependence in its Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, and total energy. To do so we consider these neural network models for simulated systems of a harmonic one-dimensional, one-component oscillator with damping, as well as without damping for comparison. We find that both the Lagrangian and Hamiltonian approaches are able to predict the empirical physical behavior of the damped oscillator systems and to effectively ``learn'' to varying degrees the underlying Lagrangians and Hamiltonians, as has previously been shown to be the case with undamped oscillator systems. These investigations elucidate important properties of Lagrangian and Hamiltonian mechanics, including properties that are not manifest when considering systems without explicit time dependence.

</details>


### [1110] [Mechanistic Interpretability Reveals Shared Causal Subspaces in Brain-to-Speech Decoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31992)
*Maryam Maghsoudi,Ayushi Mishra,Sanghamitra Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用机械可解释性方法（activation patching）探究语音解码器内部神经元在跨语音形式（发声、唇动、想象）迁移中的角色，发现跨模态增益由小群神经元而非单个神经元驱动，这些神经元在解码器早期阶段具有条件特异性，在后期阶段趋于重叠，且发声语音是最有用的源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解码唇动或想象等隐蔽语音（covert speech）比解码发声语音更困难。跨模态迁移（即利用一种语音形式的信息帮助解码另一种）是一种有前景的解决方案，但解码器内部如何表征和处理不同语音形式的脑活动尚不清楚。理解哪些内部神经元承载跨模态信息以及这些神经元是否在不同语音形式间共享，对构建数据高效的隐蔽语音解码器至关重要。

Method: 采用机械可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）方法。具体使用 activation patching 技术：记录同一句子在发声（vocalized）、唇动（mimed）和想象（imagined）三种条件下的脑活动对，将解码器在一种条件下处理某句子时的内部神经元激活，插入到其在另一种条件下处理同一句子时的计算中，测量解码准确率的变化。通过系统性分析，识别出驱动跨模态增益的具体神经元群体，并考察这些群体在解码器早期与后期阶段的共享程度。

Result: 研究发现：1）没有任何单个神经元对跨模态增益起决定性作用，增益由小群神经元协同贡献；2）在三种语音形式中，发声语音作为源（source）时提供的迁移收益最大；3）这些神经元群体在解码器的早期阶段基本上是条件特异性的（condition-specific），但到后期阶段则出现显著重叠。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，通过设计训练目标以促进解码器后期阶段的共享表征学习（主要基于发声语音数据），有望构建数据更高效的隐蔽语音解码器。这一发现为跨模态语音BCI/解码研究提供了关于内部表征结构的可解释性洞见。

Abstract: Decoding covert speech, such as mimed or imagined, from brain activity is harder than decoding vocalized speech. Cross-modal transfer, where information from one speech form helps decode another, is a promising remedy; yet how a decoder internally represents and processes brain activity from different speech forms remains unclear. In this work, we ask: which internal neurons of a decoder carry cross-modal information, and are these neurons shared across different speech forms? To answer these questions, we leverage mechanistic interpretability, using recordings of the same sentences in vocalized, mimed, and imagined input pairs for activation patching. We insert the decoder's internal activity for a sentence in one condition into its processing of the same sentence in another and measure the change in decoding accuracy. We find that no single neuron drives this benefit; instead, it arises from small groups of neurons, with vocalized speech as the most useful source. These groups are largely condition-specific in the early stage of the decoder but overlap in the later stage. These findings point toward more data-efficient covert speech decoders through training objectives that encourage shared later-stage representations learned mainly from vocalized data.

</details>


### [1111] [Can Circuit Alignment Predict OOD Generalization?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31996)
*Ayan Banerjee,Abhra Chaudhuri,Josep Llados,Umapada Pal,Anjan Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了电路对齐分数（CAS），这是一种仅基于训练模型权重即可预测分布外（OOD）泛化能力的度量指标，无需任何目标域数据或标签。通过比较跨域的类别特定电路并分解为同类一致性和跨类混淆，CAS在PACS数据集上48个学习者中实现了与OOD准确率0.88的秩相关，显著优于CKA（0.58）、SVCCA（0.23）和RSA（0.14）等现有表示相似性度量。理论证明其蒙特卡洛估计以O(1/M)速率恢复学习者的真实OOD排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表示相似性度量（CKA、SVCCA、RSA）仅比较激活值而非预测泛化能力，且被证明对计算图中的结构性重路由不敏感——而分布偏移恰恰会引发这种重路由。核心问题是：能否仅从训练模型的权重预测OOD泛化能力，无需目标域数据或标签？现有方法要么需要未标记的目标数据，要么仅给出理论刻画而无计算可行的诊断。缺乏任何先前工作推导出仅基于权重的OOD预测器必须满足的结构条件，或建立对学习者排序的一致性保证。

Method: 作者首先通过三个不可能性定理推导出任何权重仅OOD预测度量必须满足的三个必要条件：（1）结构敏感性——对结构性重路由敏感；（2）类条件分辨力——能分别区分同类保持与跨类纠缠；（3）语义一致性——对渐进扰动作单调响应。证明CKA、SVCCA、RSA各违反至少两条。基于这些条件构造电路对齐分数（CAS），分三步：（1）使用图核（treelet、随机游走、最优传输）比较电路图结构；（2）构建类条件相似度矩阵S，其对角线元素衡量同类电路保持（电路漂移），非对角线元素衡量跨类纠缠；（3）聚合为对角均值减去非对角均值之差。将总体CAS视为域分布上的Lebesgue积分，证明其M样本蒙特卡洛估计量的成对反转误差以O(1/M)速率消失。使用自适应电路提取（ACE）框架——在预训练骨干网络中插入适配器并通过激活补丁提取类别特定电路。

Result: 在PACS数据集上48个学习者（涵盖4种架构：MLP、ResNet50、MobileNetV2、ViT-B/16；4种训练目标：ERM、IRM、CORAL、DANN；3种正则化设置）中，CAS的Spearman秩相关达到ρ_S=0.88（平均），远优于CKA（0.58）、SVCCA（0.23）和RSA（0.14）。在Office-Home（65类）和DomainNet（345类，60万图像）上趋势一致。CAS甚至超越了需要目标域数据的方法：ALine-D（ρ_S=0.72）、ATC（0.58）、ProjNorm（0.64）。通过LoRA插值在Stable Diffusion XL上的受控实验证实CAS随连续域偏移单调变化。CAS完美恢复了PACS六对域对的真实距离排序。信号-噪声分析显示跨域电路差异主要由真实的域诱导重组驱动（SNR平均4.22）。

Conclusion: CAS是首个具有结构性论证和一致性保证的仅基于权重的OOD预测器。其理论贡献包括：（i）证明OOD鲁棒性在极限情况下结构性地蕴含电路鲁棒性；（ii）通过不可能性定理推导出三个必要条件；（iii）构造CAS使其凭设计满足所有三个条件；（iv）证明经验CAS排序以O(1/M)成对反转误差恢复真实OOD排序；（v）在三个基准的48个学习者上经验验证整个链条。CAS可作为临床预部署、低资源和联邦系统等目标数据不可用场景的模型选择辅助工具。局限性包括：单调性条件仅经验验证而非在有限精度范围内证明；目前专门用于有界类别数的分类任务；ACE需要源域适配器训练。

Abstract: Can out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization be predicted from a trained model's weights alone, without any target-domain data? Existing representational similarity metrics (CKA, SVCCA, RSA) compare activations rather than forecast generalization. We show they are provably insensitive to structural rerouting in the computational graph, the very change distribution shift induces. We close this gap with the Circuit Alignment Score (CAS), which compares class-specific circuits across domains via graph kernels, decomposed into same-class coherence and cross-class confusion. Casting CAS as a Lebesgue integral over the domain distribution, we prove its Monte Carlo estimate recovers the ground-truth ranking of learners by OOD accuracy, with pairwise inversion error vanishing at rate $O(1/M)$, where $M$ is the number of sampled domains. Across $48$ learners on PACS, CAS attains $0.88$ rank correlation with OOD accuracy, versus $0.58$ (CKA), $0.23$ (SVCCA), and $0.14$ (RSA), with similar trends on other benchmarks and even against data-dependent methods, making it the first provably consistent predictor of distributional robustness requiring neither target-domain data nor labels. The code is available at: this https URL

</details>


### [1112] [Integrating Language Models into Listened and Imagined Speech Decoding from MEG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31997)
*Maryam Maghsoudi,Sai Samrat Kankanala,Shihab A. Shamma,Sriram Ganapathy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合语言模型的MEG语音解码框架，通过对比学习将MEG信号与wav2vec 2.0（声学）和GPT-2（上下文语言）表示对齐，并在推理阶段通过神经约束束搜索融合神经证据与语言模型概率。核心发现是：想象语音（imagined speech）的神经证据较弱，因此其解码更依赖语言模型，最优融合权重α更高，且相对增益也大于聆听语音（listened speech）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 想象语音解码是脑机接口（BCI）的重要目标，但由于神经响应弱、信噪比低、想象语音数据集有限，进展困难。语言模型虽能提供上下文先验，但其对想象语音（神经证据弱）与聆听语音（神经证据强）的贡献差异尚不清楚——即语言先验的收益是否随神经证据可靠性变化而变化。

Method: 方法分两阶段：(1) 对比神经解码器训练——使用1×1×空间卷积+因果膨胀TCN编码MEG信号，通过双InfoNCE目标对齐wav2vec 2.0（帧级声学，第6层）和GPT-2（词级上下文，第8层）表示，损失权重λ_e从0.8余弦退火至0.2。(2) 神经约束束搜索推理——MEG解码器选top-k候选词，GPT-2基于各beam自身解码历史评分，归一化后按权重α线性融合。在配对的聆听-想象MEG数据集（13名被试，两首诗）上采用留一被试交叉验证（LOSO），并通过想象-到-聆听映射处理想象语音。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 对比解码器大幅提升跨被试词解码：聆听语音Top-1从1.44%升至14.17%，映射想象语音从1.26%升至7.05%；(2) 教师强制下，两种条件均在α≈1时最优；(3) 神经约束束搜索（B=3, k=10）下，两种条件均在中间α处达到峰值；(4) 关键差异：想象语音的最优α*显著高于聆听语音（p<0.01），且相对增益也更大（p<0.001）——聆听语音在α=0（纯神经）优于α=1，而想象语音在α=1优于α=0。结果在GPT-2和SmolLM上一致。

Conclusion: 语言先验的价值随神经证据可靠性降低而增加：神经证据强时（聆听语音）以神经为主收益更大，神经证据弱时（想象语音）语言模型贡献更关键。这表明未来语音BCI应根据神经预测可靠性动态调整语言上下文权重——神经强时依赖神经，神经不确定时更多依赖语言。局限：仅两首诗、封闭词表、13名训练音乐家、已知词边界，未测试未见过刺激或连续语音。

Abstract: Decoding imagined speech is an important goal for brain-computer interfaces but remains challenging due to weak neural responses, low signal-to-noise ratio, and limited imagined-speech datasets. Language models provide strong contextual cues for text prediction, but how much they can help neural decoding and whether their contribution differs for decoding perceived and imagined speech remains unclear. To investigate this, we use a paired listened-imagined MEG dataset and incorporate language-model information at two stages. First, we train a contrastive neural decoder that aligns MEG representations with acoustic and contextual language representations, improving cross-subject word decoding for both listened and imagined speech. Second, at inference, we introduce a neural-constrained beam-search framework that combines neural evidence with language-model next-word probabilities. We find that imagined-speech decoding benefits more from the language model than listened-speech decoding. For Imagined speech, the best-performing balance between neural and language-model evidence shifts toward the language model, and the gain over neural-only decoding is larger. Together, these results suggest that language priors are most useful when neural evidence is weaker, making them particularly valuable for imagined-speech BCIs.

</details>


### [1113] [Human Activity Recognition via Ultra-Wideband Data: A Framework for Dimensionality Reduction, Pattern Discovery, and Predictive Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32008)
*Nahid Sahel Gozin,Reza Sedaghat,Prathap Siddavaatam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于超宽带（UWB）雷达数据的人类活动识别（HAR）框架，集成两种新型降维方法（Clustered Polynomial Expansion with Incremental PCA, CPE-IPCA 和 Post-PCA Standardization Approach, PPSA）、关联规则挖掘（Apriori 和 FP-Growth）以及两种分类器（Random Forest 和 Vector Space Model, VSM），用于在资源受限环境中高效、准确地识别六种人体活动（Standff、Liedown、Noactivity、Sit、Stand、Walk）。CPE-IPCA 仅用 50 个分量保留 100% 方差，PPSA 用 80 个分量保留 99.1% 方差；最终 CPE-IPCA + RF 达到 100% 准确率，VSM 在 PPSA 上取得完美精确率/召回率/F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UWB 雷达信号具有高维、噪声、非线性等特点，传统降维方法（PCA、CAE、t-SNE）产生的特征难以解释、计算开销大，难以满足实时、资源受限场景（如医疗、辅助生活、智能环境）的需求。论文动机在于弥合 UWB 数据高复杂度与 HAR 系统对可解释性、低计算成本、高准确率要求之间的差距。

Method: 1. 数据预处理：UWB 原始 CIR 复数数据分离实虚部，去除低贡献属性（如 RX Power），共 17,063 条样本、2,040 个特征，类别包括 noactivity、liedown、standff、sit、stand、walk。2. 降维：（a）CPE-IPCA——基于相关性矩阵对特征进行 K-means 聚类 → 簇内多项式展开（含线性项和成对乘积项）→ 增量 PCA 批处理更新均值/协方差并做特征分解 → 标准化主成分；复杂度 O(mn²)。(b) PPSA——先中心化 → 标准 PCA 投影 → 对投影结果做列标准化（零均值单位方差）。3. 关联规则挖掘：将主成分二值化后用 Apriori（广度优先）和 FP-Growth（深度优先、FP-tree 结构）挖掘频繁项集，用 Support、Confidence、Lift 评估，并通过网络可视化对比。4. 分类：在提取的 10 个二值规则特征上训练 RF 和 VSM，按 70/30 划分训练/测试集，使用 Precision、Recall、F1、Accuracy 评估。整体集成于自研仿真平台 UWB-PRISM-C（Python 3.10）。

Result: 1. 线性分析：线性回归 R²=0.1331，RF 回归 R²=0.8677，证实数据强非线性。2. 传统 PCA 需 723 个分量才能保留 90% 方差，PC1 仅约 5%。3. CPE-IPCA：PC1 占 12.98%，Knee-Locator 在 PC13（累计 86%），50 个分量保留 100% 方差。4. PPSA：前两个 PC 占 34.72%，前十个 PC 占 76.14%，80 个分量保留 99.1% 方差。5. 关联规则：PPSA 上 Apriori 与 FP-Growth 找出相同规则（约 4.5 万条），FP-Growth 更快；CPE-IPCA 上规则更稀疏但 lift 更高（如 PC47,PC9→PC1,PC48,PC7 lift=9.35）。6. 分类：RF 在 CPE-IPCA 上达 100% 准确率，PPSA 上 99%（仅 Liedown 召回率较低）；VSM 在 PPSA 上对所有类获得 1.00 精确率/召回率/F1，CPE-IPCA 上 Liedown 召回率 0.99、Noactivity 0.98，其余 1.00。

Conclusion: 论文提出的 UWB-PRISM-C 框架通过 CPE-IPCA 与 PPSA 两种新型降维方法、关联规则挖掘与 RF/VSM 分类器的级联，实现了对六种 UWB 活动的高精度、可解释、近实时识别，分类准确率达 99–100%，并验证了在低支持类（如 Liedown）上的非线性优势。相比 KPCA、t-SNE、UMAP 等方法，本框架在非线性建模能力、可解释性和计算效率方面具有优势，适用于医疗监护、辅助生活和智能环境等场景。局限在于 RF 在某些低样本活动（如 Liedown、Stand）上存在轻微误分类，提示规则阈值选择与样本平衡仍有优化空间。

Abstract: Recent advances in sensor technology have enabled more effective human activity recognition (HAR), particularly in real-time systems with limited computational resources. However, Ultra-Wideband (UWB) radar data remain challenging due to high dimensionality, noise, complexity, and nonlinear characteristics. This research proposes a framework to efficiently reduce data size, uncover significant patterns, and classify six activity types (Standff, Liedown, Noactivity, Sit, Stand, and Walk) from UWB signals with high accuracy. Two novel dimensionality reduction techniques are introduced in this paper. The first, Clustered Polynomial Expansion with Incremental PCA (CPE-IPCA), combines clustering and polynomial feature expansion with Incremental PCA, preserving 100% of the variance in only 50 components. The second, Post-PCA Standardization Approach (PPSA), standardizes data after PCA and retains 99.1% of the variance in 80 components, achieving superior compression and computational efficiency compared to conventional nonlinear methods. Frequent patterns are identified using Apriori and FP-Growth, which are then classified with Random Forest and a Vector Space Model (VSM). The framework achieves 100% accuracy with Random Forest on CPE-IPCA and 99% on PPSA, while VSM attains 100% precision, recall, and F1 on PPSA and near-perfect performance on CPE-IPCA (precision 1.00, recall 0.98-1.00, F1 0.99-1.00), demonstrating a fast, interpretable, and robust HAR system suitable for healthcare, assisted living, and smart environments.

</details>


### [1114] [Representation Learning for Exact Preimages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32018)
*Konstantin Hess,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG
