We leverage the theory of averaging neural operators to explain and corroborate our findings by showing that just slicing/deslicing, in conjunction with pointwise MLPs, already suffices for universal approximation of continuous operators and attention is redundant in this context. Finally, we provide a novel FlashAttention-style efficient implementation of the key slicing/deslicing module of Transolver. This flashslice kernel streams slice and deslice over the points without materializing the heavy slice-weight tensor, while reproducing the best available implementation to floating point error. At the same time, it leads to very significant memory and compute savings, particularly at large slice counts.

</details>


### [1170] [Shared Autoregressive Context Can Distort Relationships in Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32546)
*Thomas S. Robinson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了大语言模型在单次自回归补全中批量生成多条记录（共享完成批次）会扭曲合成数据中变量间的相关关系，导致相关性强度被系统性放大，且答案历史构成因果通道。请求构造应被视为数据生成过程的一部分，合成数据的有效性必须针对其拟支持的分析进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前合成调查数据的应用实践中，常将多条受访者的回答放在一次自回归补全中生成（如每次请求50名受访者）。但这种"共享完成批次"会使前面的回答成为后续回答的上下文，潜在影响合成数据的统计关系。作者提出"请求分区不变性"作为理想标准：同一组人口档案被拆分到不同请求中生成时，估计的总体量不应发生实质性变化。本文旨在系统检验该不变性是否成立，并识别答案历史作为因果通道的作用。

Method: 采用匹配实验设计，控制人口档案、示例、问题和解码参数不变，仅改变请求大小（1人 vs 10人）。使用2,000份ESS（欧洲社会调查）档案、800份NHANES档案和800份ACS档案，对比Qwen3.8-27B和Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct两个模型在171个ESS组内相关性上的平均绝对误差（MAE）。进一步设计控制干预：(1) 重新配对相同的前序数值（保持分布不变），检验其对后续生成相关性的因果影响；(2) 隐藏先前生成的答案（通过阻止其更新注意力键值），检验访问历史对人类数据准确性的影响。最后使用依赖映射（dependence map）等后处理校正方法，测试降低相关性误差是否改善边际分布和回归估计。

Result: 主要发现：(1) 共享完成批次显著放大相关性强度：10人请求使ESS组内相关性的MAE增加48-58%（Qwen）和114-127%（Llama），平均|r|从0.360升至0.459（Qwen）、0.355升至0.596（Llama），而人类参考值为0.193；放大效应主要体现在强度而非排序模式（Spearman一致性仍达0.864-0.866）。(2) 答案历史被确立为因果通道：将相同BMI/久坐时间值从正配对改为负配对，使生成的相关性从0.963变为-0.670（Qwen/NHANES）。隐藏先前答案可降低相关性误差（Qwen/NHANES位置10时从0.367降至0.197），但恶化边际分布精度。(3) 依赖映射校正虽在所有六个设置中降低相关性误差，却使边际Wasserstein误差在每种情况下恶化，且ACS/Qwen的回归系数MAE从0.032升至0.124。效应在不同温度和提示词变体下保持稳健。

Conclusion: 请求构造（每请求的记录数和对先前答案的访问）是合成数据生成过程的组成部分，不应被视为中立的技术细节。共享完成批次系统性地扭曲变量间的统计关系，夸大相关性强度。答案历史构成因果通道，模型利用先前生成值影响后续关系。降低相关性误差的后处理校正并不保证改善边际分布或下游回归分析的有效性。因此，合成数据的验证必须针对拟支持的具体分析（边际分布、依赖结构、回归估计等）进行多维度评估，而非依赖单一指标。

Abstract: Large language models can generate several records within one autoregressive completion, making earlier answers available as context for later records. This paper shows that such shared-completion batching can distort relationships among variables in the resulting synthetic data, using controlled tests on synthetic survey respondents. In a matched experiment on 2,000 European Social Survey profiles, generating ten rather than one respondent per request increases mean absolute error in within-country correlations by 48-58% for Qwen3.8-27B and 114-127% for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct across three seeds, holding profiles, examples, questions and decoding parameters fixed. The distortion primarily reflects exaggerated relationship strength, while retaining substantial agreement with the human ordering of correlations. Controlled interventions establish answer history as a causal channel: re-pairing the same preceding values, with profiles and marginal distributions fixed, changes correlations among subsequently generated responses. Hiding preceding answers reduces correlation error in the tested settings but worsens marginal accuracy. Exploratory corrections across social-attitude, health and economic data likewise show that lower correlation error can coexist with worse marginal distributions and regression estimates. Request construction is therefore part of the data-generating process, and synthetic-data validity must be evaluated against the analyses the generated data are intended to support.

</details>


### [1171] [Prioritizing Repeated LLM Evaluation for Hidden Failure Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32547)
*Keita Broadwater,Akin Broadwater*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种预算受限的"隐藏失败发现"框架，对LLM进行浅层评估后，利用prompt的特征表示（语义嵌入、文本特征、关系特征等）对浅层评估中零失败的prompt进行风险排序，从而将深层评估预算集中在更可能暴露隐藏失败的prompt上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估通常对每个prompt仅生成少量随机响应（浅层评估），可能遗漏低概率但具有重要操作意义的失败（即"隐藏失败"）。给定有限的推理预算，如何识别哪些看似安全但实际仍有失败风险的prompt进行更深入的评估。

Method: 1. 两阶段框架：浅层评估（N₀=5次生成）→ 特征构建 → 训练XGBoost排序模型 → 深层评估（N=150次）；2. prompt表示包括1024维语义嵌入、35维文本特征、694维元数据、66维图关系特征；3. 五折、按intent分组、输出平衡的out-of-fold预测；4. 仅使用浅层评估结果训练模型，深层评估结果仅用于评估。

Result: 在AIRBench（5694个prompt，Qwen 2.5 7B和Gemma 3n E4B两个模型）上：最高风险10%的未解prompt在深层评估中捕获了Qwen 25.4%、Gemma 18.7%的隐藏失败，lift分别为2.54×和1.87×。语义邻域基线（20-NN浅层正例比例）也表现强劲（2.31×和1.82×）。在StrongREJECT上稀疏事件条件下提供定性支持。隐藏失败率Qwen为16.0%、Gemma为3.8%，尽管总体不安全响应率几乎不变。

Conclusion: 证明prompt空间中的潜在失败倾向具有可恢复的结构：浅层评估中零失败的prompt可以根据其特征被有效排序以预测深层失败。该方法能在固定推理预算下显著提升隐藏失败发现效率，但低分不等同于安全保证，且结果存在模型和benchmark依赖性。

Abstract: Large language models are commonly evaluated by generating a small number of stochastic responses for each prompt in a benchmark. Because inference budgets are limited, this shallow evaluation may fail to observe low-probability but operationally important failures. A prompt that produces no failures in a small sample may therefore appear reliable despite having a nonzero latent probability of failure under repeated inference. We formulate LLM reliability evaluation as a budget-constrained discovery problem in which each prompt is associated with an unknown per-generation failure probability. We propose a budgeted discovery framework that first performs shallow evaluation across the prompt set and then uses trial-level failure outcomes together with prompt-derived representations to learn a feature-based ranking of failure propensity. The resulting scores prioritize prompts with zero observed shallow failures for deeper evaluation, concentrating the deep-evaluation budget where hidden failures are more likely to be discovered. We evaluate this approach on AIRBench and StrongREJECT across multiple model and system-prompt conditions. The central empirical test asks whether models fit without access to deep-evaluation outcomes can rank prompts with zero observed shallow failures according to their likelihood of producing failures under deeper evaluation. On AIRBench, the highest-ranked 10\% of unresolved prompts achieves 2.54x hidden-failure lift for Qwen 2.5 7B and 1.87x for Gemma 3n E4B, recovering 25.4\% and 18.7\% of subsequently observed hidden failures, respectively, compared with 10\% expected under random allocation. Semantic-neighborhood and feature-ablation analyses further show that this predictive signal can be recovered from multiple representations of prompt content and relationships.

</details>


### [1172] [Compositional Objectives: Learning Structure in Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32566)
*Pranavchandra Vivekananda,Sumukh Bettadapura,Ajan Subramanian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析谱近似 epiplexity 目标在固定迹约束下偏好均匀谱分布，但通过反例证明相同谱分布不代表相同的下游任务效用。作者提出一个组合性目标 S_comp，通过让观察者接收掩码视图、关系令牌和交互令牌来测量表示变差的可预测性。在 ImageNet-1K 上的实验表明：观察者所见内容（输入压力）对性能的提升远超架构改动；并且谱多样性、可预测性和下游效用是三个可分离的属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于谱近似的 epiplexity 训练目标只衡量观察者从数据中提取了多少结构，但无法保证这种结构对下游任务有用。作者将智能分解为三个部分：发现模式、压缩为可重用部件、以及组合（composition）。本文的动机在于揭示谱目标实际奖励的是谱分布的均匀化（而非任务相关特征），并通过引入组合性目标来弥补这一空白。

Method: 1) 理论分析：在固定迹约束下，通过 Jensen 不等式证明谱目标偏好将谱质量均匀分布于多个方向（命题 3.1），并构造反例证明相同协变谱的表示可以有不同的分类效用（命题 3.2）。2) 组合性目标 S_comp：观察者接收三种令牌——8 个掩码视图令牌（每视图 49 个 patch）、28 个关系令牌（视图对可见性）、28 个交互令牌（两视图内容的固定投影交互）。该目标测量观察者特征能解释多少表示方差（归一化预测协变增益），等价于正则化互信息。3) 三种方法在 ImageNet-1K 训练 ViT（10 epoch, batch size 384, 无标签），冻结评估线性探测和迁移任务。

Result: 1) 理论：谱目标在固定迹下偏好均匀谱分布；存在相同谱但下游效用截然不同的表示对。2) S^φ_comp（仅掩码视图，无关系/交互令牌）在多数分类评估中表现最强：ImageNet top-1 从 3.19% 翻倍至 7.02%，CIFAR-100 从 8.32% 升至 9.68%，EuroSAT 从 63.50% 升至 68.02%。3) S_comp 在 DTD 上略优（11.33%），其表示有效秩仅 27.07（高度集中），但保留性预测误差降低 83.51%，远高于 S^φ_comp 的 18.56%。4) 三种方法在谱多样性、可预测性、下游效用上呈现三种不同排序，证明这些是可分离的属性。

Conclusion: 谱扩展（spectral spreading）对下游任务的帮助不仅取决于保留了多少结构，更取决于观察者将哪些关系暴露给目标。改变观察者的输入（从全图到掩码视图）是提升性能的最强杠杆；增加关系和交互令牌并切换到预测性目标并未带来额外分类收益，但显著提升了可预测性。谱多样性、可预测性和下游效用是三个不同的属性，需要分开考量。未来工作应构建直接奖励成分连接本身的目标，并在更大规模和组合泛化任务上测试。

Abstract: Intelligence is defined in many ways. One of these definitions defines intelligence as the pursuit of learnable novelty. However, learnable novelty can be meaningless without the ability to compose the learned structures to take action and achieve goals. Learnable novelty builds on epiplexity, which is a way to measure learnable structure in data through a bounded observer. In this paper, we investigate a closed-form spectral approximation to compute epiplexity. We use a fixed-trace constraint and find that the epiplexity objective prefers a more uniform distribution of spectral mass rather than concentrating it in a small number of directions. However, a representation may spread information across many directions without organizing that information into features useful for a particular task. To address this gap, we propose a compositional objective whose observer measures the relationships between the parts and interactions of an image. We compare it with the original spectral objective given only the masked parts. In our ImageNet training runs, the spectral objective with masked parts produces an almost maximally spread representation while achieving the strongest frozen-feature classification performance on most evaluations, more than doubling the linear-probe accuracy of the whole-image baseline. Across multiple image benchmarks, changing what the observer sees matters more than adding relation and interaction tokens. At the same time, our prediction-oriented compositional objective produces substantially better held-out observer prediction but relatively weaker classification, revealing that spectral diversity, predictability, and downstream utility are distinct properties. These results suggest that the usefulness of spectral spreading depends not only on how much structure is preserved, but on which relationships the observer makes available to the objective.

</details>


### [1173] [CAESAR: Clustering via Autonomous Embedding-Space Agglomerative Reorganization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32570)
*Ilan Bacry,Rémi Devaux,Antoine Jardin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAESAR 提出了一种在预训练嵌入空间上进行"重组织"（reorganization）的方法，通过训练一个轻量级网络将互近邻拉近、将非近邻推远，从而显著提升基于最近邻图的聚类（如 FINCH）的效果。核心优势在于整个流程无需预设聚类数目 K。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于最近邻图的聚类算法（如 FINCH）依赖嵌入空间的局部邻域结构，而预训练 LLM/VLM 的嵌入因各向异性和面向生成/检索的目标，并非为聚类优化，导致邻域图噪声大。同时，现实无监督场景中聚类数目 K 通常未知，而大多数强聚类方法都需要 K 作为输入。作者希望同时解决这两个问题。

Method: 方法流程包括四个阶段：① 在预训练嵌入 X 上构建互 k-近邻图（k 由曲率最大处自动确定）；② 训练一个轻量 MLP 重组织网络 f_θ（d→1024→512→256，SELU 激活）将 X 映射到重组织空间 Z；③ 用 pull–push 目标训练 f_θ，其中 pull 项对互近邻加权 1/r 拉近，push 项通过存储整个数据集嵌入的 memory bank 对所有非近邻施加带零截断的排斥，权重 λ=0.5 在所有数据集统一；④ 用 FINCH 在 Z 上聚类，并通过轮廓系数（silhouette）无监督地从 FINCH 层次中选择最终划分。全流程无需 K。

Result: 在 AG News、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-20、STL-10 四个数据集上，使用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B（文本）和 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B（图像）。文本上：CAESAR NMI 61.5，ACC 78.3，大幅超越使用真实 K 的 oracle FINCH（49.6/58.5）以及 EVoC（36.2/21.8）。图像上：CIFAR-20 上 CAESAR NMI 61.5、ACC 60.9，超过所有使用真实 K 的深度聚类方法（TAC 61.1/60.7，SIC 59.3/58.3 等）；CIFAR-10/STL-10 上 NMI 仍具竞争力（81.5/83.0），但 ACC 因聚类粒度略有偏差落后。消融实验证实：仅 pull 会导致完全坍缩（NMI 2.4），in-batch push 提升有限，全 memory bank push 带来最大增益（NMI 71.9）。换用 CLIP ViT-B/32 时仍带来相近提升，证实增益来自重组织而非编码器本身。

Conclusion: CAESAR 是一种简单而强大的聚类路线：通过在预训练嵌入空间上施加 pull–push 重组织即可显著改善基于图的聚类效果。最大优势在于完全无需聚类数目 K，在类重叠严重、真实数据场景下表现尤为突出（文本与高纠缠图像数据集均达 SOTA）。局限：当预训练编码器本身语义信息不足时收益有限；ACC 在可分性较强的数据集上因聚类粒度匹配问题落后于使用真实 K 的方法。整体结论是：对真实无监督聚类任务，"重组织预训练嵌入"是一种值得优先考虑的轻量方案。

Abstract: Clustering algorithms that operate on nearest-neighbor graphs, such as FINCH (First Integer Neighbor Clustering Hierarchy), depend heavily on the quality of the embedding space they are given. However, pretrained vision and language model embeddings are not optimized for this purpose. We propose CAESAR, a method that reorganizes a pretrained embedding space: a reorganization network is trained to pull mutual nearest neighbors together and push non-neighbors apart, yielding a reorganized embedding space substantially better suited to clustering. CAESAR offers a second major advantage: it never requires the number of clusters $K$. This matters because in realistic unsupervised settings, $K$ is typically unknown and discovering it is often part of the problem, yet most strong clustering methods take it as an input. We therefore design the entire CAESAR pipeline to infer $K$ rather than assume it is known. Empirically, reorganizing the embeddings consistently improves clustering over the raw space on both text and image datasets. Since the few deep clustering methods that also infer $K$ do not release their code, we complement controlled comparisons with methods that infer $K$ on the same embedding space by comparisons with strong deep clustering methods that are given the true $K$, giving them a substantial oracle advantage. Even so, CAESAR outperforms all of them on text, achieves the best results on the most challenging image benchmark and remains competitive on the others. Reorganizing pretrained embeddings thus emerges as a simple and powerful route to clustering realistic data, where classes overlap and the number of clusters is unknown.

</details>


### [1174] [DimPO: Dimensionality Reduction for Attention using Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32579)
*Vojtěch Lanz,Yufei Cui,Prasanna Parthasarathi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DimPO，一种用于降低注意力机制中Query和Key向量维度的列表式偏好优化方法，通过结合无参考模型的列表式偏好损失和top-k交叉熵头来保留键间的偏好排序和最高权重键上的注意力质量。在LLaMA和Qwen系列模型上的实验表明，尽管KL方法能更好地重建原始注意力分布，DimPO在下游任务（尤其是长上下文RULER）上表现更优，揭示了在维度压缩下保留偏序与集中度比匹配完整分布更重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer注意力机制中的KV cache是长上下文推理的内存和计算瓶颈。现有的维度压缩方法（如随机投影、Mongoose三体损失、DASH-KV的KL蒸馏）主要匹配完整注意力分布，但作者质疑：在维度压缩场景下，匹配完整分布是否是最佳策略？键间的偏好排序和最高权重键上的注意力质量是否提供了更好的训练信号？

Method: 1. 学习一个共享的线性投影 F: R^d → R^{d'}，将query和key映射到低维空间，value保持原维度；2. 采用孪生网络框架，每层独立训练投影；3. 提出DimPO损失 = 列表式偏好优化项（无参考模型，利用全部键的偏序关系）+ top-k交叉熵头项（保留最高权重键上的注意力质量）；4. 使用BOOKSUM长文本训练，4096 token序列，40960训练实例/层；5. 从最后一层往前应用投影以控制误差传播。

Result: 1. 在LLaMA3.2-3B/3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-4B模型上，pairwise偏好目标优于triplet基线，在投影≤40%层时保留98%短上下文性能；2. KL方法在注意力分布KL散度和输出MSE上最接近原始模型，但DimPO在下游任务上更优；3. 在50%层投影时，DimPO和KL在LLaMA3.1-8B上保留约95%的RULER 4k分数；4. 超过50%层投影时，DimPO在SQuAD、常见词提取、频繁词提取、变量追踪等复杂任务上显著优于KL；5. DimPO与SnapKV/KIVI正交兼容，可叠加使用而不增加性能损失。

Conclusion: 在注意力维度压缩场景下，最能重建原始注意力分布的训练目标（KL）并不一定最能保留模型行为。DimPO通过保留键间的偏好排序和最高权重键的注意力集中度，在长上下文任务上取得了更好的下游性能，表明相对重要性和集中度的保留比完整分布的重建更有价值。

Abstract: A linear projection can reduce the dimension of query and key vectors without updating the pretrained model, but it remains unclear which training objective best preserves model behavior. We ask whether preferences over keys and attention mass on the highest-weighted keys provide a better signal than matching the full attention distribution with KL divergence, especially in long-context settings. We introduce DimPO, which combines listwise preference optimization with a lightweight top-k cross-entropy term for head-fidelity. DimPO is trained offline from the attention patterns of a frozen language model, with one map per layer, shared by the query and the keys and trained separately from the other layers. Across LLaMA3.2-3B, LLaMA3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Qwen3-4B Instruct models, pairwise preference objectives outperform the triplet baseline and retain 98% of the original score on short-context tasks when projecting to half the dimension on the last 40% of the layers. With more projected layers or on long-context RULER, they degrade rapidly. In contrast, KL and DimPO, which use every key during training, retain about 95% of the original RULER 4k score on the 8B model when projecting up to 50% of the layers. KL-based projections remain closer to the original attention distribution and attention output, yet DimPO achieves better downstream performance. Beyond 50% of projected layers, DimPO increasingly outperforms KL on tasks including SQuAD, common-word extraction, frequent-word extraction, and variable tracking. These results suggest that under dimensionality reduction, preserving the ordering and concentration of task-relevant attention can matter more than reproducing the full attention distribution.

</details>


### [1175] [Age of Learning: Temporal Persistence of Prediction Errors as a Learning Signal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32593)
*Chenyang Wang,Stefan Forsström,Roger Olsson,Di Yuan,Qing He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"学习年龄"(Age of Learning, AoL)——一种衡量预测错误在训练中持续时间的时间性学习状态变量。AoL在样本被持续误分类时递增，在正确分类时重置，并可通过EMA聚合形成样本级和类别级信号，用于离线与流式场景下的损失重加权与重采样。实验表明，在长尾分类任务中AoL能改善或匹配基线，在流式学习且难度时间持久时增益最显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ML/DL方法主要依赖瞬时信号(loss、margin、confidence等)刻画模型行为，无法捕捉"一个错误已经持续了多长时间"。两个当前同样误分类的样本可能学习历史截然不同(一个刚出错、一个长期未被学会)，但瞬时难度信号将它们一视同仁。这一时间维度在长尾学习(稀有类长期欠学习)和流式学习(分布演化导致类被忽视)场景中尤为关键。

Method: 1) **离线AoL**：定义样本级即时AoL $a_i^{(e)}$，正确分类时重置为1，否则+1；用EMA聚合为$\bar{a}_i^{(e)}$以平滑波动，并聚合为类别级$\bar{a}_c^{(e)}$；通过均值归一化得到样本/类别权重$w_c^{(e)}$，应用于Softmax/Sigmoid损失的reweighting或weighted resampling。2) **流式AoL**：由于历史不可访问，改为维护轻量级类别级状态——利用当前mini-batch与可选memory buffer估计类准确率$r_c^{(t)}$，与中位数阈值$\tau^{(t)}$比较后更新AoL(低于阈值+1，达到则重置为1，未观察保持不变)，同样经EMA与归一化得到类别权重。3) 计算开销：每epoch一次前向评估即可更新，无需额外反向传播，额外存储$O(N)$样本级或$O(C)$类别级状态。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100长尾分类中：Softmax+AoL在IF-400下将CIFAR-100从31.50%提升至32.43%、CIFAR-10从60.32%提升至63.94%。在Period-10流式协议下(三随机种子)CIFAR-10 IF-200平均提升+3.10±0.51、CIFAR-100 IF-200平均提升+2.31±0.89。大规模Places365与ImageNet-1k IF-200下AoL分别+2.56和+1.57点。相关性分析表明AoL与类频/损失/margin强相关但不完全决定(IF-1下AoL与类频测试相关-0.8231；IF-200下-0.8225)，证明AoL携带超出静态统计和瞬时信号的额外时间信息。在稀疏到达(1%–5%)平衡数据设置中AoL同样增益最大，验证其捕捉样本欠曝光持续时间的能力。Period-1快速变化流下AoL增益不稳定，说明其依赖足够的时间一致性。

Conclusion: AoL将"错误持续时间"转化为可用的学习信号，是loss/margin/frequency等传统难度度量的互补维度。它不替代现有方法，而是为不平衡与非平稳环境中的自适应训练提供一种轻量、通用的时间性补充机制。未来可扩展包括置信度/不确定性感知AoL、噪声标签鲁棒变体及结构化/生成式模型的任务特定学习状态定义。

Abstract: Current machine learning algorithms primarily rely on instantaneous signals such as loss, margin, and prediction confidence to characterize model behavior. These signals indicate how difficult a prediction is at the current optimization step, but they do not capture how long the model has remained incorrect. We study this temporal dimension of learning and introduce Age of Learning (AoL), a learning-state variable that measures the persistence of prediction errors over time. AoL increases while an error remains unresolved and resets when a correct prediction is achieved, thereby distinguishing persistent under-learning from transient mistakes. We develop AoL-based training strategies for both offline and streaming settings. In offline learning, sample-level AoL is accumulated over training and aggregated into class-level states that guide adaptive reweighting and resampling. In streaming learning, where full historical access is unavailable, we maintain lightweight class-level AoL states using current and buffered observations. Across long-tailed classification settings, AoL improves or matches standard training baselines, with larger benefits when learning difficulty persists over time. Multi-seed streaming experiments further show reproducible gains under temporally stable imbalance. Analysis of class frequency, loss, and margin shows that AoL is related to conventional difficulty measures but captures additional information about error duration. These results suggest that temporal persistence provides a useful complementary signal for characterizing and controlling learning dynamics in imbalanced and non-stationary environments.

</details>


### [1176] [Learning the Graph and the Embedding Together: Classifier-Independent Rewiring for Heterophilic Node Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32613)
*Harshit Kumar,Sujan Chakraborty,Priyanka Saha,Pritam Kar,Saptarshi Bej*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Glare（Graph Learning through Affinity-guided Rewiring），一种面向异质性（heterophilic）图节点分类的亲和性引导重布线方法。该方法以 EM 风格交替学习图结构与节点嵌入，并同时输出两个与下游分类器无关的结果：重布线后的图与学到的嵌入。在六个异质性基准上使用五个分类器评估，Glare 在 30 个分类器-数据集组合中的 23 个上提升准确率（平均提升 5.8 点），并将分类器之间的准确率离散度降低约四倍。同时提出了完全无监督变体 Glare-U，无需任何标签即可保留大部分增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN 在异质性图（邻居往往携带不同类别标签）上失去优势。现有图重布线方法几乎总是与单一特定分类器（多为两层 GCN）联合评估，难以判断增益来自新拓扑还是该特定配对。文章明确质疑：单一重布线过程能否对整个分类器家族（含同质性假设的 GNN 与专为异质性设计的架构）大致一致地提升性能？是否能让分类器选择变得不重要？两个输出（重布线图与嵌入）各自贡献什么？多少收益依赖标签？重布线是否真的让图结构更同质？

Method: Glare 包含四个阶段：
1) 相似性编码器：通过 NT-Xent 对比损失在特征 dropout 视图上预训练编码器，得到节点相似度 S，并用 M 跳传播嵌入增强（可视标签下进一步微调）。
2) 候选边池与亲和性打分：候选池 C = 原边 ∪ 2 跳对 ∪ 特征近邻 ∪ kNN(S) ∪ 随机对（预算 B=10^4）；亲和性 w_uv = λ_S·S_uv + (1-λ_S)·Φ_uv，其中 Φ 为基于标签与特征 M 跳传播分布的去中心余弦亲和性。
3) EM 风格交替优化：对候选边维护 logit Θ_uv，软权重 ã_uv = σ(Θ_uv/τ)，τ 余弦退火。E 步在当前软图上训练两层加权 GraphSAGE f_θ，得到嵌入 H 与伪标签 Ỹ；M 步在固定 H,Ỹ 下更新 Θ，目标 L = L_mod（嵌入相似性驱动的负模块度）+ λ_h·L_hom（伪标签同质性项）+ 正则（熵/先验/度预算）。
4) 两个输出：阈值化得重布线图 Ã；在 Ã 上计算两跳表示 Z，将 ℓ2(X) 与 ℓ2(Z) 拼接为 X̂，输入 (X̂, Ã) 给任意下游分类器。
变体 Glare-U：令 ρ=0，禁用所有标签通路（Φ 仅留特征、E 步网络随机初始化、同质性项为零），保留最后一次迭代。整体复杂度关于候选边数线性。

Result: 在 6 个异质性基准（Actor、Chameleon、Squirrel、Roman-empire、Amazon-ratings、Tolokers）与 5 个分类器（GCN、GAT、GraphSAGE、H2GCN、LINKX）上：
- Glare 在 23/30 单元上相对原始图+ℓ2 归一化特征提升准确率，平均增益 5.8 点（最大如 GCN 在 Squirrel 上 +22.6 点），并将分类器间准确率标准差从 3.2 降到 0.8（约四倍）。
- Glare 在 Actor、Roman-empire、Tolokers 上取得最佳重布线方法准确率，均准确率 0.571–0.574，超过所有基线（含 DHGR 的 0.554）。
- Tolokers 上 ROC-AUC：Glare 0.771–0.806，全部高于基线（最高 0.734）。
- 2×2 消融：嵌入 Z 单独贡献大部分准确率提升（+6.5 点，25/30 单元），重布线图 Ã 单独将分类器间离散度从 3.2 降至 1.5；两者结合离散度最低（0.7）。
- Glare-U（无标签）在 20/30 单元上提升，均增益 4.8 点，离散度 2.6；E 步训练主要改善一致性而非准确率。
- 结构层面：Glare 在 4/6 数据集上取得五种同质性指标的最大提升，在 Roman-empire 上将 h_adj 提高 0.738、LI 提高 0.451；在 Roman-empire/Actor 上把近随机的图变为强同质结构。
- 标签传播：Glare 均测试准确率 0.515（基线 0.351，DHGR 0.469）。
- 社区检测（全图与仅测试节点）：Glare 在 NMI/ARI/聚类准确率均值上均居首。
- 嵌入聚类与线性/MLP 探测：Glare 在五种聚类指标均值上最高；冻结嵌入上 LR+MLP 均准确率 0.559（IDGL 0.412，LPkG 0.420）。
- 局限：Roman-empire 上 4/5 分类器准确率下降；Amazon-ratings 上 H2GCN/LINKX 下降；Chameleon/Squirrel 上不及 DHGR；监督版 Glare 因每轮训练 GNN 而较慢；最邻近搜索 O(N²D) 限制可扩展性。

Conclusion: 单一重布线过程可大致均匀地提升整个分类器家族在异质性图上的表现：Glare 在 23/30 组合上提升、平均 5.8 点，并把分类器间准确率离散度降低约四倍。其两个输出互补：嵌入承载主要准确率增益，重布线图让不同分类器达成一致。绝大部分收益不依赖标签——完全无监督的 Glare-U 保留 4.8 点。同时，重布线后的图更同质，并改善了标签传播与社区检测。失败的案例（Roman-empire 等）提示：奖励同质性边的目标可能丢弃结构化信息；未来工作包括支持信息性异质性边的目标、可扩展近似最邻搜索、以及面向有向/动态/异质图与链接预测的扩展。文章亦主张：重布线评估应跨多个分类器并报告一致性，同时明确参考特征预处理（如 ℓ2 归一化），因其会显著改变所报告增益。

Abstract: Graph neural networks lose much of their advantage on heterophilic graphs, where connected nodes often carry different labels. Graph rewiring is a popular remedy, but rewiring methods are usually evaluated with a single classifier, which makes it hard to tell whether the gains come from the new topology or from that particular pairing. We propose an affinity-guided rewiring method that estimates the graph and the node representation together. It alternates, in the spirit of expectation maximisation, between training a lightweight graph neural network on the current graph and re-weighting candidate edges under a modularity objective with a pseudo-label homophily term. Candidate edges come from a compact pool scored by a contrastively learned node similarity and a neighbourhood-distribution affinity. The method returns two classifier-independent outputs: a rewired graph and a node embedding learned on it. Across six heterophilic benchmarks and five downstream classifiers, it improves accuracy over the original graph with normalised features in 23 of 30 classifier-dataset combinations, with a mean gain of 5.8 points, and reduces the accuracy spread between classifiers about fourfold. A controlled ablation shows that the two outputs are each useful and play complementary roles: the embedding contributes most of the accuracy gain, while the rewired graph makes different classifiers agree. A fully unsupervised variant, which uses no labels during rewiring, retains most of the improvement. The rewired graphs are also more homophilic and improve label propagation and community detection.

</details>


### [1177] [Stabilizing the Dynamic Low-Rank Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32615)
*Zhonghan Xu,Ling Wang,Junhao Chen,Jianwei Zhao,Jinwei Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对动态低秩训练（DLRT）在高压缩率下训练不稳定、无法找到可训练子网络的问题，推导了最佳秩-r近似的梯度流方程，识别出DLRT忽略的曲率耦合项，并提出SDLRT方法，通过引入补偿缓冲区存储被截断的奇异方向和负反馈机制来稳定训练。在视觉和语言任务上均验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DLRT通过Galerkin投影将权重约束在秩-r流形上，能动态识别高效子网络，但在高压缩率（如~69.6%）下出现秩崩塌现象，无法找到可训练网络。作者旨在揭示DLRT不稳定的理论根源并提出解决方案。

Method: 1) 推导全参数权重最佳秩-r近似的梯度流方程（定理3.1），识别出DLRT缺失的曲率耦合项（由因子σ_{r+j}/(σ_i²-σ_{r+j}²)控制）；2) 提出SDLRT，引入补偿缓冲区(U_neg, V_neg)存储被截断的奇异方向，在更新S时重新注入；3) 引入截断容差ϑ上的负反馈机制稳定每层秩；4) 提供精确性保证（定理3.2）和误差界（定理3.3）。

Result: 1) 在CIFAR-10/100上，压缩率>80%时，SDLRT准确率仍保持90%以上（VGG-16），而DLRT和CondLR显著下降；2) VGG-19/CIFAR-100上，SDLRT收敛时与全秩解的距离比DLRT减少约10%；3) 作为DeBERTa-v3的PEFT适配器，SuperGLUE六项任务平均得分85.15%，仅比LoRA多2.8%参数开销；4) 计算成本O(r²(n+m))与DLRT相当；5) VGG-19测试准确率53.87%→61.86%，内存仅增加30MB。

Conclusion: SDLRT通过补偿缓冲区部分恢复了DLRT遗漏的曲率耦合项，结合负反馈机制，在激进压缩下稳定识别可训练低秩子网络，理论上具有收敛性和近似保证，实验上在视觉压缩和语言PEFT任务上均优于DLRT和现有方法。限制包括负反馈因子ω需启发式设置，扩展到大规模架构仍是未来工作。

Abstract: Training neural networks directly in a low-rank parameterization is an appealing route to reducing memory, compute, and storage simultaneously during both training and inference. Dynamic low-rank training (DLRT), which confines weights to a rank-$r$ manifold via the Galerkin projection of the gradient flow, is particularly attractive because it identifies efficient subnetworks on the fly without specialized initialization or post-factorization. However, DLRT fails to find trainable networks under high compression. In this paper, we derive the gradient flow of the best rank-$r$ approximation and point out that the offset of DLRT comes from a curvature-coupling term which is large and thus non-negligible under aggressive compression. Guided by this analysis, we propose a stable dynamic low-rank training method, named SDLRT, which maintains a lightweight compensation buffer that reinjects the top neglected singular directions. Additionally, we introduce a negative feedback on the truncation tolerance to stabilize each layer's rank. Experimentally, SDLRT reliably finds trainable subnetworks where DLRT collapses and as a PEFT adapter on DeBERTa-v3, it achieves the best average score on SuperGLUE at only $2.8\%$ parameter overhead over LoRA.

</details>


### [1178] [Extremely Fast and Compact Binary Graph Representations via Randomized Operator Sketching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32641)
*Srajan Agarwal,Megha P,Bikas C Das,Zakaria Laskar,Saptarshi Bej*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了NyS-Binary，一种用于图节点分类的超快速、完全基于代数的二进制哈希方法。该方法通过随机Nyström启发的列采样来近似高阶结构转移矩阵，并结合防标签泄漏的语义传播机制，最后通过列自适应阈值化生成紧凑的二进制节点表示。无需节点特征或梯度训练，在10个节点分类数据集上以亚秒级生成速度 consistently 优于现有无特征二进制基线方法，且天然兼容神经形态脉冲神经网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络通常依赖密集的浮点节点表示，在大规模场景下面临严重的内存和计算瓶颈。现有二进制图哈希方法要么为计算效率牺牲全局拓扑信息，要么生成成本过高（分钟到小时级）。亟需一种快速构建、判别性强且兼容多种分类器（包括神经形态硬件）的紧凑二进制节点编码方案。

Method: 1. 将邻接矩阵加上自环并进行行归一化，得到随机游走转移矩阵P。
2. **结构通道**：采用Nyström启发的非对称列采样草图，对P的m=125个地标节点的子矩阵进行截断SVD，再通过外样本扩展公式 R_str = P[:, L] U_Σ (Σ+εI)^(-1) 生成所有节点的连续结构坐标。
3. **语义通道**：通过QR分解生成C类正交超立方体码本；将训练标签的真值码字与基于3步随机游走置信度阈值τ≥0.5筛选的伪标签码字进行融合。
4. **融合与量化**：将结构坐标与语义码字拼接后进行H=3的多项式图扩散，再以凸组合权重α=0.5混合两个流，最后通过列自适应中位数阈值化（μ=0.5）将连续表示离散化为K=250位的二进制码。
5. 在节点分类任务中评估9种分类器（含脉冲神经网络SADP）；支持完全无监督变体（struct_ratio=1.0）。

Result: 在10个节点分类基准上，NyS-Binary在9种分类器上 consistently 优于所有无特征二进制基线（如NodeSig、NodeSketch、node2binary）。在非关系型探针上比NodeSig高+9.41%（MLP）和+9.97%（逻辑回归）；在脉冲分类器SADP上比NodeSig高+26.81%，比学习型Bi-GCN高+9.45%。生成时间平均0.38秒，比Bi-GCN快13.9倍，比node2binary快4531倍。完全无监督变体同样建立了标签无关、特征无关二进制哈希的新SOTA。在2.4百万节点的ogbn-products上成功生成二进制嵌入。优势在同质性图上最显著，在强异质性图上优势减弱（无监督变体在此场景更优）。

Conclusion: NyS-Binary证明了通过简单的、理论驱动的代数近似（随机Nyström结构草图+多项式扩散+自适应二值化），可以构建紧凑且判别性强的图节点二进制码，避免复杂的梯度学习流程。其方法在同质性图上达到了当前最佳精度-效率权衡，存储开销较Float32降低32倍，并且天然适配神经形态事件驱动计算与无梯度学习规则。未来工作方向包括为异质性图设计自适应/符号多项式滤波器、度分层地标采样以及更大规模网络的可扩展性。

Abstract: Graph neural networks typically rely on dense, floating-point node representations, which can impose substantial memory and computational costs. Binary graph hashing offers an alternative by encoding node information as compact bit strings. However, existing approaches either sacrifice global topological information for computational efficiency or incur substantial generation costs. We introduce an ultra-fast, entirely algebraic hashing method that constructs binary node representations directly from graph structure, without requiring node features or gradient-based training. Our method approximates a high-order structural transition matrix using randomized column sampling inspired by the Nyström method and combines it with an efficient label-safe semantic propagation mechanism. The resulting continuous representations are discretized through column-wise thresholding to obtain compact binary codes. Experiments on ten node classification datasets show that the proposed method consistently improves classification accuracy over existing feature-free binary baselines while requiring sub-second code generation on many datasets. The resulting binary representations are also naturally suited to event-driven computation, making them compatible with neuromorphic spiking neural networks and gradient-free learning rules. These results demonstrate that simple algebraic approximations can provide an efficient alternative to learned pipelines for discrete graph representation learning.

</details>


### [1179] [Quantization-Aware Pre-Training with Constrained Empirical Weight Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32659)
*Ningfeng Yang,Tor M. Aamodt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CEWT（Constrained Empirical Weight Distribution），一种用于量化感知预训练（QAPT）的超球优化器后更新步骤，通过将权重投影到经验直方图匹配零均值高斯分布的最近点，以硬约束形式抑制四舍五入边界权重振荡（rounding boundary weight oscillation），在无需超参数、无额外内存开销的情况下持续提升低精度LLM/GPT预训练性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化感知训练（QAT）尤其是量化感知预训练（QAPT）中，STE等舍入雅可比估计器的梯度偏差导致"四舍五入边界权重振荡"现象——大量参数聚集在量化舍入边界附近并在两侧反复振荡，引入有害噪声、严重降低收敛速度。现有抑制方法要么引入额外超参数（调参困难且开销大），要么带来内存开销，要么因优化目标有偏而无法持续提升模型精度。因此需要一种无超参数、无内存开销、能持续改善QAPT性能的振荡抑制方法。

Method: 提出CEWT方法，核心是一个优化器的后更新步骤：将权重 $\bar{W}^{(t)}$ 通过"排序→归一化→逆高斯CDF"映射（基于逆变换采样/经验分布匹配），投影到经验直方图严格匹配标准高斯分布 $\mathcal{N}(0,1)$ 的最近点。具体步骤为：对权重排序得到ranks，归一化到 $(0,1)$ 后通过 $\Phi^{-1}$ 映射为高斯分位数。由此实现三个特性：① 保持相对顺序；② 输出直方图恒为标准高斯；③ 自然地将权重从舍入边界拉离。同时提出两项配套修改：① 移除量化器中的Hadamard变换以减少计算开销并提升性能；② 对逐通道（per-channel）量化器采用TGCS（逐张量量化网格+逐通道反量化缩放），使零均值高斯先验在张量级别成立。作者还在1D和2D玩具问题上证明振荡的根因（STE在离散变量上无法编码使梯度为零的最优值）以及参数间依赖导致梯度方差放大。

Result: 在玩具问题（200次迭代，$n=d=2^{10}$）上，CEWT无需任何超参数即可达到与精心调参后的Dampening Loss、Iterative Freezing、Confidence-Guided Annealing、Periodic Interpolation相当的MSE（$45\times10^{-3}$），显著优于STE的 $81\times10^{-3}$ 和PQN的有偏目标。在大规模QAPT实验中（覆盖LLaMA/GPT，95M–610M参数，AdamH/MuonH/LionH/SSO四种优化器，BBQ/QuEST/LSQ三种量化器，1-bit/2-bit权重与激活），CEWT以平均仅增加4%训练时间的代价（几何平均），在所有配置下均一致地降低预训练困惑度：平均降低2.5个PPL点、最高降低21个PPL点。Rounding Boundary Mass（RBM）指标在CEWT下对优化器和模型规模不变，仅取决于量化器与精度，证实其"由设计控制边界附近参数数量"的关键特性。消融实验验证：移除Hadamard变换+使用vanilla CEWT优于保留HT+CEWT-HT；TGCS进一步提升振荡抑制效果。CEWT在DEIT视觉模型上也得到验证（在权重仅量化与长训练时长下改善明显）。

Conclusion: CEWT是首个在QAPT中无需超参数、无内存开销即可持续抑制舍入边界权重振荡的方法。它通过将"零均值高斯分布"这一许多量化器设计中的隐含先验由假设提升为硬约束，从根本上解决了参数在舍入边界附近堆积的问题。其核心机制——将权重经验直方图强制匹配高斯分布——可视为Dampening Loss和Periodic Interpolation的无超参数硬约束变体。CEWT特别适用于大规模QAPT（参数多、训练时长长、数据集大），对极小层（< $2^{10}$ 参数）效果下降，且可能不适用于训练时长短的QAFT场景。该工作为超球优化族（AdamH/MuonH/LionH/SSO）的硬约束设计范式提供了一个新范例：通过将难以调参的软正则化转化为有理论依据的硬约束，可以有效移除超参数。

Abstract: Quantization-Aware Pre-Training (QAPT) can increase the inference efficiency of DNNs, but a problematic behaviour known as rounding boundary weight oscillation can introduce detrimental noise into the training process and significantly reduce convergence speed. While existing methods can reduce this detrimental noise, they either introduce additional hyperparameters or memory overhead, or cannot consistently improve model accuracy. In this work, we propose optimization with $\textbf{C}$onstrained $\textbf{E}$mpirical $\textbf{W}$eight dis$\textbf{T}$ribution (CEWT), the first hyperparameter-free memory-overhead-free oscillation suppression method that consistently improves QAPT performance: an optimizer post-update step that projects weights to the nearest point in weight space whose empirical distribution (histogram) matches a zero-mean Gaussian. Our key insight is many quantizers are designed with the implicit assumption that the to-be-quantized data are permutations of samples from a zero-mean Gaussian, and this assumption is not true during QAPT. By enforcing the zero-mean Gaussian prior as a hard constraint, CEWT can suppress this detrimental noise. Empirical results on various combinations of SOTA quantizers and hypersphere optimizers suggest, that with a geomean increase of 4% in training time, CEWT can consistently reduce the pre-training perplexity (by an average of 2.5 and up to 21 points) of low-precision (down to 1-bit activations and weights and up to 610M parameters) LLaMA/GPT models without introducing any hyperparameters or storage overhead. Code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [1180] [Equivariant Neural Primal-Dual Assignment for Maximum Common Edge Subgraphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32661)
*Jiaqing Xie,Yanchao Li,Zhuo Yang,Yuxin Wang,Tianfan Fu,Yuqiang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ENPDA是一种等变神经原始-对偶分配方法，用于最大公共边子图(MCES)匹配。它学习一个共享的匹配策略，可在不重新训练的情况下应用于新的图对，速度比逐对训练的基线快约三个数量级，并通过四轮更新和匈牙利投影产生部分一对一的匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的最强MCES基线（如NGA）虽然精度高，但需要为每个图对单独训练网络，导致重复查询开销巨大。分子相似性搜索需要处理大量图对，因此降低单次查询成本至关重要。论文探索是否可以学习一个跨图对的共享更新策略，在推理时冻结，使实例特定的分配状态能在一对一约束下适应竞争性匹配。

Method: ENPDA采用神经拍卖机制，源顶点为买家、目标为物品。出价表示匹配偏好。共享的等变网络利用关联公共图(ACG)结构初始化出价并指导更新。当多个源竞争同一目标时，其价格上升以抑制该匹配。策略冻结，出价和价格适应每对图。最终匈牙利投影返回部分一对一对应。四轮共享权重更新后，应用矩形匈牙利投影。使用教师映射进行模仿学习，损失函数包括轨迹模仿损失、相对分析对应物的相对损失、边保留奖励、容量惩罚和价格正则化。还提供了严格的理论保证，包括置换等变性、可行性、以及通过修复神经网络价格获得有效上界。

Result: 在三个分子基准（AIDS、MOLHIV、MCF-7）上，ENPDA-Core在相同四轮更新和一次投影预算下，比分析对应物提高7.4-8.6个精度点；一秒细化搜索后仍有2.5-3点的增益。在500个跨域传输对（IMDB-BINARY、PROTEINS、ENZYMES的边删除任务）上，无需微调即可获得9.1-17.6点的提升。ENPDA平均每查询0.19秒，相对三次NGA拟合的交叉点约为40次查询。在保持芳香环完整的约束下，ENPDA-Solver在三个数据集上恢复的参考键多于所有基线。修复的价格为所有291个测试对提供有效上界，并证明其中60对达到全局最优。

Conclusion: ENPDA是一种等变神经原始-对偶方法，用于MCES搜索，将学习更新与可行投影和有效对偶界相结合。ENPDA改进了固定深度MCES提案、短期预算细化和冻结传输。当匹配必须保持芳香环完整时，ENPDA保留的参考键多于所有基线。未来工作包括扩展训练对、超越n×m网格的规模化以及建立收敛性或近似保证。

Abstract: Maximum common edge subgraph (MCES) matching finds a partial vertex correspondence between two labeled graphs that preserves as many labeled edges as possible. Molecular similarity search requires matching many graph pairs, making the cost of repeated queries important. The strongest baseline attains accurate MCES solutions but trains a separate network for each pair. We introduce Equivariant Neural Primal-Dual Assignment (ENPDA), which learns a shared matching policy and applies it to new pairs without further training, answering queries roughly three orders of magnitude faster and recovering its training cost after a few dozen queries. The policy recomputes exact objective marginals for candidate matches and learns corrections and step sizes that update their scores. Target prices respond to competition when several source vertices favor the same target. Four update rounds and a Hungarian projection produce a partial one-to-one matching. We prove per-pair guarantees that hold for any network parameters. In exact arithmetic, reordering either graph permutes the assignment and price states, the projected matching is one-to-one, and repaired prices give a valid MCES upper bound. Subtracting the preserved-edge count bounds the optimality gap; combined with structural caps, these certificates prove global optimality for 60 of 291 native test pairs. On three molecular benchmarks with disjoint train/validation/test splits, ENPDA improves over an analytic counterpart with the same update and projection budget by 7.4-8.6 accuracy points; after one second of refinement search, 2.5-3 points of the gain remain. Transferred without fine-tuning to edge-deletion tasks from social and protein graphs, the policy gains 9.1-17.6 points over the analytic counterpart. When output matchings must keep aromatic rings intact, ENPDA recovers more reference bonds than the baselines on all three datasets.

</details>


### [1181] [Distance-KV: Exploiting Relative Distance for Efficient Long-Context Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32663)
*Xianpeng Shang,Canbin Huang,Jiang Li,Tian Lan,Qianyi Cai,Xiaojun Quan,Xiangdong Su*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Distance-KV 提出了一种基于"层-查询头-相对距离"三维联合空间的静态 KV 缓存保留模式，通过离线学习并在推理时直接复用，实现无在线评分的 KV 缓存压缩，在长上下文任务中以 20% 的逻辑保留率取得了接近 Dense 的性能，并显著降低显存和延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 KV 缓存压缩方法（包括基于检索头的方法）通常以整个注意力头为粒度做分配决策，但同一注意力头在不同相对距离上的检索能力差异很大，头级分配无法区分同一头内有用与冗余的距离区间，导致缓存预算在低贡献距离上浪费或在有价值距离上丢失。

Method: 1) 通过合成检索任务探针测量每个查询头在各相对距离区间上的 distance-conditioned retrieval score@5，作为先验；2) 定义二进制三维张量 M∈{0,1}^{L×H×D} 表示每层每查询头每距离区间的保留决策；3) 在语言模型冻结的条件下，使用 Hard Concrete 门进行松弛优化（保留检索交叉熵 + L0 正则），再用 straight-through Top-K 优化得到精确预算的二元模式；4) 推理时将相对距离映射到当前上下文位置，配合 sink+recent token 一次性物理剪枝并打包 KV 缓存，GQA 模型通过查询头决策取并集映射到共享物理 KV 头。

Result: 在 Llama-2-7B-32K、Llama-3.1-8B 与 Qwen2.5-7B 三个模型及 NIAH、LongBench、RULER、SCBench 四个基准上，20% 逻辑保留率下 Distance-KV 在所有压缩方法中平均表现最优，RULER 128K 上比最强压缩基线最多提升 9.3 分；在 Llama-3.1-8B 128K 下 KV 缓存减少 65.4%，解码速度提升 1.66×；Qwen2.5 下 KV 缓存减少 52.0%，解码加速 5.80×；SCBench 多轮共享上下文场景中亦在两类能力分组上排名第一。结构消融验证 head-only、distance-only、distance-shuffled 变体分别掉 19.2/51.0/9.0 分，表明层-头-距离的联合对应关系对性能至关重要。

Conclusion: 相对距离是刻画长上下文检索能力的关键结构维度；Distance-KV 通过离线学得的、与输入无关的静态保留模式在层-查询头-距离三维空间上分配 KV 缓存，无需在线评分即可在显著降低显存与延迟的同时保持接近全缓存的长上下文性能，并确立了"查询头-距离"对应关系作为 KV 分配研究的重要方向。

Abstract: The memory usage and decoding latency of LLM inference grow rapidly with context length. To reduce these costs, key-value (KV) cache compression methods selectively retain cached states based on token importance or differences in attention patterns across heads. However, we discover that retrieval capability varies substantially with relative distance, even within the same attention head. To exploit this structure, we introduce Distance-KV, which learns a static KV retention pattern over the joint space of layers, attention heads, and relative distances. The pattern is learned offline with the language model frozen and reused across inputs to prune and compact the KV cache without online importance scoring. Across three backbone models and four long-context benchmarks, Distance-KV consistently achieves the best overall performance among competing KV cache compression methods, exceeding the strongest compression baseline by up to 9.3 points on RULER at 128K. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at 128K, Distance-KV reduces KV cache memory by 65.4% and achieves a $1.66\times$ decoding speedup relative to Dense. Together, these results identify relative distance as an important structural dimension for understanding how LLMs retrieve information over long contexts and for designing more efficient inference methods.

</details>


### [1182] [SIFT: Enhancing Time Series Foundation Models via Semantic Invariance and Structural Fidelity Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32676)
*Yi Tang,Tengxue Zhang,Yang Shu,Chenjuan Guo,Chenchen Sun,Yisheng An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SIFT提出了一种针对时间序列基础模型(TSFMs)的微调方法，通过保持语义不变性和结构保真度来解决微调过程中的过拟合和均值预测陷阱问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型虽然通过大规模预训练实现了优异的零样本性能，但直接微调时面临两大挑战：一是由于时间序列的低维特性导致的过拟合问题，二是由于下游数据与预训练分布差异导致的均值预测陷阱（过平滑输出）。现有PEFT方法（如LoRA、AdaLoRA等）主要源自NLP/CV领域，未能充分考虑时序数据的独特非平稳性，无法有效保持语义一致性和细粒度结构信息。

Method: SIFT包含两大核心模块：(1) 语义不变对抗增强（SIAA）：通过语义频谱分解将输入空间划分为核心语义子空间、辅助语义子空间和噪声子空间，利用SVD和Marchenko-Pastur定律确定边界，训练对抗扰动生成器在辅助子空间内生成扰动，微调时强制原始与扰动输入的预测一致性；(2) 基于分量的结构保真度增强（CSFE）：通过总变差(TV)分数筛选高波动性样本，对样本进行趋势-季节性分解后进行跨样本分量混合（将样本a的趋势与样本b的季节性重组），并施加分量级重建损失对齐预测输出与真实值的趋势和季节分量。训练总损失为MSE预测损失+一致性损失+重建损失的加权和。

Result: 在10个真实世界数据集（ETTh1/h2/m1/m2、Exchange、ZafNoo、Weather、ECL、Solar、AQShunyi）上，使用4个代表性TSFMs（Moirai、UniTS、Timer、Sundial）进行实验。SIFT在绝大多数骨干-数据集设置中实现了最优微调性能，相比全微调，Timer平均MSE降低11.9%，Weather降低17.0%，ETTm2降低9.3%。在4个预测horizon（96/192/336/720）上均表现优异。消融实验验证了SIAA和CSFE各自的贡献以及组合时的互补效应。参数敏感性分析显示模型在合理超参数范围内具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: SIFT是一种有效的TSFM微调方法，通过语义不变对抗增强缓解过拟合，通过分量级结构保真度增强缓解均值预测陷阱，实验证明其在多种TSFM架构和多样化下游任务上均能显著提升微调性能，且推理阶段不引入额外计算开销。局限性在于时序分解方法提供的是趋势和季节性的近似分离，对于强非平稳或多尺度信号效果可能受影响。

Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have achieved remarkable zero-shot performance through extensive pre-training on massive time series datasets. Nevertheless, due to the low-dimensional properties and diverse structural patterns of time series data, performing naive fine-tuning on TSFMs often leads to overfitting and falling into the mean-prediction trap. To address these challenges, we propose SIFT, a robust adaptation method that enhances time series foundation models by preserving Semantic Invariance and structural Fidelity throughout the fine-Tuning process. We employ semantic-invariant adversarial augmentation, which utilizes semantic spectrum decomposition to partition the semantic space and then generates perturbations within the non-core semantic subspace to bolster the model's robustness against these perturbations, mitigating overfitting. We implement a component-based structural fidelity enhancement, which facilitates component-wise mixup and imposes a reconstruction objective to improve the model's ability to preserve structural fidelity, alleviating the mean-prediction trap. Extensive experiments on representative TSFMs covering 10 real-world datasets demonstrate that SIFT can significantly enhance the performance of TSFMs.

</details>


### [1183] [Self-Evolving Time-Series Forecasting Agents with Episodic Memory and Online Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32689)
*Junyi Wang,Yilin Wang,Wen Wu,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FASE，一种利用已完成预测实例的延迟反馈来持续自我演化的LLM时间序列预测智能体，通过情景记忆和在线策略学习实现不更新LLM参数的持续适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的预测智能体仅关注当前预测实例，忽视了在线部署中已完成实例的真实值所提供的延迟反馈，无法利用历史经验改进后续的工具选择。

Method: 设计FASE框架，包含两个互补机制：(1)情景记忆，用18维统计特征表示历史，按归一化统计距离检索相似已完成实例；(2)在线策略学习，轻量MLP排序器将累积反馈提炼为工具排名。LLM结合当前统计上下文、检索证据和策略指导选择工具。

Result: 在GIFT-Eval的29个配置上，FASE取得最强聚合点预测性能，归一化MAE相对最佳基础模型降低9.1%；消融实验表明两种机制互补使用效果最佳；累积优势随反馈积累从3.8%增长至8.6%。

Conclusion: FASE能够通过已完成实例的反馈持续自我演化，无需更新LLM参数，证明了延迟反馈驱动的外部状态更新可有效提升在线时间序列预测的工具选择质量。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly used for time-series forecasting because they can organise contextual information, perform multi-step analysis, and guide the sequence of actions required to complete forecasting tasks. Most existing agents focus only on the current forecasting instance. However, in real-world deployments, forecasting commonly operates online, with new forecasts issued from the currently available history as the forecast origin advances and the ground-truth targets of earlier instances progressively become available. These targets provide feedback on the actions taken in earlier instances, yet existing agents generally do not preserve or utilise this information to adapt their subsequent actions. To address this limitation, we introduce FASE, a Feedback-Aware Self-Evolving forecasting agent that converts such feedback into task-specific experience for subsequent forecasting instances. FASE combines episodic memory, which retrieves relevant completed instances, with online policy learning, which summarises the feedback accumulated across instances into ranking guidance. The proposed framework is evaluated on 29 dataset configurations selected from the GIFT-Eval benchmark. Across these 29 configurations, FASE attains the strongest aggregate point forecasting performance among the evaluated methods and reduces the normalised MAE by 9.1% relative to the best individual foundation model baseline. The results further indicate that the cumulative advantage of FASE increases as delayed feedback accumulates. Together, these findings demonstrate that FASE can continually self-evolve through feedback from completed forecasting instances without updating the parameters of the LLM.

</details>


### [1184] [BiasReducer: Adaptive Bias Mitigation for Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32720)
*Shuang Liu,Yongliang Miao,Yanguang Liu,Haoyi Xiong,Mengnan Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出轻量级框架 BiasReducer，仅编辑奖励头并为每个新数据集自适应选择相关偏差修正项，无需重新训练即可降低奖励模型对表层属性的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励模型倾向于长度、置信度等表层属性，导致 LLM 在 RLHF 中产生高分但低质量的输出（reward hacking）；现有方法要么需要重训，要么需预先指定单一偏差。

Method: 三阶段：1) 用 SAE 编码器结合语义监督（行为监督 + 干预监督 + 伪迹监督）学习可解释属性表征；2) 沿协方差方向确定每个属性的编辑方向和强度，形成可重用编辑库；4) 对新数据集通过奖励依赖度与编辑影响力秩和聚合，自适应选择单编辑（S）或多编辑组合（M）。

Result: 在 5 个奖励模型和 3 个偏差基准上，BiasReducer-M 平均提升 8.3、18.0、6.9 个百分点，优于 RRM 和干预微调基线；下游 GRPO 训练减少冗长和谄媚，best-of-N 选择亦有效。

Conclusion: 奖励模型编辑的核心原则是：先一次性学习可复用属性修正项，再根据新数据集的奖励行为自适应选择应用哪些修正。语义监督、基于奖励的编辑方向与强度、面向数据集的选择均对性能有重要贡献。

Abstract: Reward models score responses from large language models (LLMs) and guide LLM training toward human preferences. However, reward models can favor superficial attributes such as length or confidence, leading LLMs to produce higher-scoring but not more correct responses. Existing mitigation methods either retrain the reward model or apply a fixed correction to one known bias, such as a preference for longer responses. Retraining requires additional data and computational resources, while existing editing methods require the target bias to be specified in advance and use a fixed edit for that bias. To this end, we propose BiasReducer, a lightweight framework that edits only the linear reward head and selects the relevant edits for each new dataset. First, BiasReducer uses a sparse autoencoder (SAE)-style encoder to learn which attributes (e.g., length and confidence) the reward model is sensitive to. Second, it learns how to reduce the reward model's dependence on each attribute by determining which direction to adjust the reward head and how much to adjust it. Third, for a new dataset, it ranks the attributes by their influence on reward scores, selects the relevant ones, and edits the reward model accordingly. BiasReducer consistently improves reward-model robustness to biases toward superficial response attributes. Across five reward models, BiasReducer-M improves the three benchmarks by 8.3, 18.0, and 6.9 percentage points on average, outperforming the two training-based baselines. The gains transfer downstream, reducing unnecessary verbosity and sycophancy while maintaining comparable judged quality.

</details>


### [1185] [Scaling Properties of Same-Family On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32722)
*Yuntai Bao,Qinfeng Li,Guoqing Jiang,Liwei Chen,Zhiheng Qin,Xuanping Li,Wenqi Zhang,Xuhong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了同族（Qwen2.5）大语言模型在数学推理任务上策略内蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）的缩放规律。通过控制实验拟合了峰值能力与有效传递率关于学生规模、教师规模与教师得分的联合幂律，并比较了Vanilla-OPD、Delta-OPD、离线冷启动与自举链等设计选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL可以赋予LLM显著推理能力，但这种能力在不同规模模型之间如何迁移、迁移多快仍不清楚。已有OPD工作侧重目标函数设计与训练动态诊断，却未系统刻画师生规模对结果的预测性影响。如果能用"定律式"的关系在训练前预测学生策略的最终表现，将对模型家族的部署具有重要实践意义。

Method: 使用Qwen2.5 Base（0.5B–14B）经统一SFT+GRPO流程得到教师，构造25组Vanilla-OPD和17组Delta-OPD配置（含弱到强、同基、强到弱三种设置）。以token级reverse KL的平方根 d 作为训练进度坐标，将gold score G 沿 d 拟合为线性；随后对峰值能力 G_peak 与初始斜率 m 在学生规模、截断教师规模与教师得分上拟合乘性幂律；并通过外推留一规模法、含中间检查点的离样本对照以及自举链评估设计选择（目标函数、on-policy程度、自举）。

Result: 1) 所有25条Vanilla轨迹初始阶段G对d近似线性（R²∈[0.932,0.988]），后期出现衰减改进、饱和或回归；2) 联合幂律 1−G_peak=A·N_S^(-α)·(N_T^eff)^(-β)·(1−G_T^eff)^ζ 中 ζ≈1，β<0，即在得分匹配时较小教师反而传递更好；3) Delta-OPD在17对中15对获得更大局部匹配KL增益斜率、12对获得更大峰值，优势集中在弱到强对；4) 离策略冷启动对弱到强传递损害随能力差距增大（对14B学生损失19.4点）；5) 自举链全部低于直接从最小专家蒸馏的结果，否定了Burns等人的自举增益结论；6) 联合律在留一规模与外推（最大学生/教师）RMSE上分别为0.55/0.68（Vanilla）与0.20/0.32（Delta），验证了规模预测能力。

Conclusion: OPD可在训练前通过师生规模与教师得分预测学生策略的峰值能力：能力传递呈两阶段（线性有用传递+噪声尾部），弱到强方向上紧凑专家可向更大学生迁移能力；教师规模回报仅在接近学生规模前显著；自举与离策略冷启动均不能提升传递。该框架为在模型家族中一次性训练RL专家并按可预测方式推广提供了实证基础。

Abstract: *Reinforcement learning (RL)* can induce substantial reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs), but how much of this capability transfers across model scales, and how quickly, remains unclear. We study the scaling properties of *on-policy distillation (OPD)* across *weak-to-strong*, *same-base*, and *strong-to-weak* teacher--student setups. We find that early OPD training dynamics uniformly exhibit a regular *useful-transfer* regime, in which held-out accuracy (the *gold score*, $G$) rises approximately linearly in $d=\sqrt{\mathrm{KL}(\pi_\theta \Vert \pi_{\mathrm{ref}})}$, the square root of token-level reverse KL divergence from the student initialization. In every observed weak-to-strong pair, the student's peak gold score exceeds its teacher's own, so a compact RL expert can transfer capability to a much larger student via OPD. To estimate OPD outcomes, we fit *power laws* for how $G_{\mathrm{peak}}$ and the slope of the useful-transfer regime scale with student and teacher parameter counts and with teacher gold score. These laws show that peak gold score improves with teacher scale only up to roughly the student's scale, and that at a matched gold score smaller teachers transfer better, so a teacher's score alone does not define its supervision value. We also study the scaling effects of two OPD variants, bootstrapping weak-to-strong OPD, and the degree of on-policy supervision.

</details>


### [1186] [Distributionally Robust Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning: Finite-Sample Guarantees under Weak Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32727)
*Chenyu Lu,Zijun Chen,Nian Si*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究弱通信条件下的分布鲁棒平均奖赏强化学习(DR-RL)，针对SA-矩形和S-矩形结构，在基于散度和基于距离的不确定性集下，提供了估计鲁棒最优平均奖赏和学习近最优策略的有限样本保证，并给出了紧致的Span上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布鲁棒强化学习在模型误指定下具有重要意义。现有研究主要集中在折扣设置或需要较强通信性假设的平均奖赏设置。本文旨在弱通信条件下建立平均奖赏DR-RL的有限样本理论保证，填补文献空白。

Method: 提出一种无需先验知识的算法。对于KL和$f_k$-散度球，建立显式半径条件使得鲁棒Bellman方程存在常数增益解；对于全变差和Wasserstein球，证明任意正半径均足够而无需弱通信假设。分析SA-矩形和S-矩形两种结构下的样本复杂度，并推导鲁棒最优偏差函数Span的几乎紧显式上界。

Result: 估计鲁棒最优平均奖赏的样本复杂度为$\widetilde{O}(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-1}\operatorname{Span}^2(u_\delta^*)\epsilon^{-2})$；学习$\epsilon$-最优策略的样本复杂度为$\widetilde{O}(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-2}\operatorname{Span}^2(u_\delta^*)\epsilon^{-2})$。并给出$\operatorname{Span}(u_\delta^*)$的几乎紧上界。数值实验验证了$n^{-1/2}$的收敛速率。

Conclusion: 本文在弱通信条件下为分布鲁棒平均奖赏强化学习提供了首个有限样本保证，区分了不同不确定性集类型对假设条件的要求，并给出了几乎紧的样本复杂度结果和Span的显式上界。

Abstract: We study distributionally robust reinforcement learning (DR-RL) in the average-reward setting under weak communication. Our main result provides finite-sample guarantees for estimating the robust optimal average reward and learning a near-optimal policy, covering both SA-rectangular and S-rectangular structures with divergence-based and distance-based uncertainty sets. Specifically, for Kullback--Leibler and $f_k$-divergence balls, we establish explicit radius conditions under which the robust average-reward Bellman equation admits a constant-gain solution, while for total variation and Wasserstein balls, any positive radius suffices without requiring the nominal MDP to be weakly communicating. Our algorithm is prior-knowledge-free and achieves sample complexities of $\widetilde O(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-1}\operatorname{Span}^{2}(u_{\delta}^{\ast})\epsilon^{-2})$ for estimating the robust optimal average reward and $\widetilde O(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-2}\operatorname{Span}^{2}(u_{\delta}^{\ast})\epsilon^{-2})$ for learning an $\epsilon$-optimal policy. Here, $p_{\wedge}$ is the smallest positive nominal transition probability and $u_{\delta}^{\ast}$ is a robust optimal bias function. We further provide an almost-tight explicit upper bound on $\operatorname{Span}(u_{\delta}^{\ast})$. Finally, we validate the predicted $n^{-1/2}$ convergence rate through numerical experiments.

</details>


### [1187] [Predicting the Financial Impact of Supply Chain Risk for Major AI-Related Semiconductor Firms: A Heterogeneous Graph Patch Transformer Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32741)
*Jianna Hur,Sagar Samtani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种异构图补丁Transformer（Heterogeneous Graph Patch Transformer），用于预测半导体公司季度财务报表变化，提前1-2个季度预警供应链压力传导风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半导体生产依赖全球分布式多层供应链，财务压力会沿供应链延迟传导，影响AI芯片设计公司的营收、库存和盈利。现有研究多针对市场风险指标，鲜有工具预测供应链压力如何反映在财务报表中，且企业通常仅能看到直接合作伙伴，缺乏对多层网络风险的感知能力。

Method: 1. 构建包含15,186家公司的多层供应链网络，跨度60个季度，融合季度基本面数据与宏观贸易、事件、灾害信号，通过学习门控机制进行特征整合；2. 在供应商、客户、所有权和总部关系上进行类型化、方向特定的风险传播建模；3. 采用基于补丁（patch）的令牌化方法编码传播后的时间序列历史；4. 提出异构图补丁Transformer架构，预测116家焦点半导体企业的季度营收、库存和盈利变化。

Result: 在116家焦点半导体企业的初步实验中，模型在1个季度和2个季度预测 horizon 上对所有目标变量（营收、库存、盈利）均实现了最低误差，且在2个季度预测时盈利预测的优势进一步扩大。

Conclusion: 该模型能帮助供应链管理者和投资者在供应链压力反映到财务报表之前采取行动，为半导体行业多层供应链风险预警提供了有效工具，填补了财务报表层面供应链风险预测的研究空白。

Abstract: Modern semiconductor production relies on a globally distributed, multi-tier supply chain in which financial stress at one firm spreads with a delay and eventually affects the revenue, inventory, and profitability of the companies that design AI chips. Most firms see only their direct partners, and prior predictive research has mainly targeted market-based risk measures, so few tools forecast how supply chain stress will appear in reported financials. In this study, we propose a heterogeneous graph patch transformer that forecasts these quarterly changes one and two quarters ahead. Learning from a 15,186-company network over 60 quarters, the proposed model fuses quarterly fundamentals with macro-trade, event, and disaster signals through learned gates, carries risk across supplier, customer, ownership, and headquarters relations through typed, direction-specific propagation, and encodes the propagated histories with patch-based tokenization. In preliminary experiments on 116 focal semiconductor firms, the proposed model achieves the lowest error on every target at both horizons, and its profitability advantage widens at the two-quarter horizon. These forecasts can help supply chain managers and investors act before disruptions appear in reported financials.

</details>


### [1188] [Benchmarking EEG Foundation Models at Scale: Lessons from 20,000 Evaluations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32743)
*Zhige Chen,Shu Peng,Chengxuan Qin,Rui Liu,Rui Yang,Kay Chen Tan,Jibin Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EEG-Arena，一个大规模EEG基础模型基准测试框架，覆盖30个EEG基础模型和25个监督基线，在57个下游任务（23个公开数据集）上进行超过20,000次评估，旨在系统性地分析EEG基础模型的迁移能力、模型规模与预训练数据规模的扩展效应及通道配置的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型评估存在三大不足：(1) 缺乏与强监督基线的系统比较；(2) 模型架构、参数量、预训练数据等差异混杂，难以隔离各因素贡献；(3) 评估协议不一致，结果难以复现和对比。

Method: 提出五个实验协议：协议I比较EEG基础模型与监督基线（使用平均排名和Top-5 Count）；协议II通过全微调(Full-FT)与架构匹配的从头训练(Scratch-ST)对比，在2%-100%六个数据预算下评估预训练收益；协议III在不同参数量模型变体间分析模型规模扩展趋势；协议IV以固定架构(REVE-base)在600至30,000小时预训练数据上进行受控数据扩展实验，通过相对参数位移和CKA表征变化衡量适应过程；协议V比较通道受限与通道灵活模型在缩减通道配置下的性能。

Result: 关键发现：(1) EEG基础模型在大多数任务上优于监督基线，尤其在非双极导联设置下；(2) 预训练带来早期优化优势和持续下游收益，标签数据越多收益越大（d≥25%时10个模型均获正收益，从d=2%的0.4%增至d=100%的8.2%）；(3) 现有EEG基础模型参数量与性能无一致正相关（REVE-base优于REVE-large）；(4) 固定架构下扩大预训练数据持续提升性能（WS提升6.69个百分点，CS提升4.22个百分点），且参数位移减小但输出层表征变化增大；(5) 通道灵活模型在所有通道缩减设置下绝对性能均高于通道受限模型。

Conclusion: 预训练数据规模扩展是推进EEG基础模型发展的最有前景方向；不存在通用最优EEG基础模型，应根据任务需求、标签数据可用性、通道配置和计算预算进行多维度选择；EEG-Arena作为开源框架支持标准化、可复现的基准评估和未来模型开发的社区驱动发展。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models (FMs) promise transferable neural representations, yet their advantages over strong supervised baselines and their prospects for further scaling remain unclear. To address these questions, we introduce EEG-Arena, an open-source benchmark covering 30 EEG FMs and 25 supervised baselines evaluated on 57 downstream tasks from 23 public datasets. Through more than 20,000 evaluations across five experimental protocols, we assess downstream performance, pretraining benefits, model size scaling, pretraining data scaling, and robustness to channel configuration. We find that (1) EEG FMs outperform strong task-specific supervised baselines on most evaluated tasks, particularly under non-bipolar settings; (2) compared with architecture-matched supervised training from scratch, pretraining improves both early optimization and final downstream performance, with larger and more consistent gains as more labeled downstream data become available; (3) existing EEG FMs do not exhibit a consistent positive relationship between parameter count and downstream performance; (4) under a fixed architecture, increasing the pretraining data scale yields sustained downstream gains; and (5) channel-flexible FMs achieve higher absolute performance than channel-constrained models across most evaluated channel configurations. Together, these findings demonstrate the downstream value of EEG FMs and identify pretraining data expansion as a promising direction for further progress. To support continued research, we release EEG-Arena as an open-source evaluation framework that provides shared infrastructure for reproducible benchmarking, model comparison, and community-driven development.

</details>


### [1189] [Reuse or Relearn? A Spectral View of Earth Observation Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32756)
*Mehmet Ozgur Turkoglu,Valerio Marsocci,Dominik J. Mühlematter,Dominik Senti,Konrad Schindler,Helge Aasen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套基于奇异值分解的频谱诊断工具（Spectral Diagnostics），用以审计地球观测（EO）基础模型在微调过程中是否真正"复用"了预训练表示，还是"重新学习"了新的表示。通过对比CV与EO基础模型，发现EO模型在微调中经历更大、更高秩的权重更新，保留更少的预训练子空间结构，表明当前EO基础模型的可复用性弱于自然图像领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型的核心理念是学习可跨任务复用的表示，但EO领域模型在下游任务中普遍依赖微调，而下游准确率指标无法区分"复用"与"重新学习"。现有研究多关注基准性能，忽视了预训练结构的保留程度与适配机制。本文旨在填补这一空白，将评估视角从"性能"扩展到"结构层面"的表示复用。

Method: 提出三个互补的频谱诊断指标：(1) Spectral Stability Index (SSI)：通过前k个奇异向量之间的主角度余弦平方均值，度量预训练主导子空间的保留程度（k=32）；(2) Effective Rank of Adaptation (ERA)：基于ΔW奇异值分布的熵，归一化后衡量更新所涉及的方向数量；(3) Relative Weight Change (ρ)：Frobenius范数比值，量化更新幅度。对五个EO基准（MADOS、PASTIS、FLAIR-2、BraDD、TimeMatch）上的CROMA、DOFA、Prithvi-2、TerraMind、SSL4EO-MAE五个骨干进行全微调，并与LoRA、SVF（参数高效方法）对比；CV参考使用CLIP、DINOv2、DINOv3在Flowers-102、CIFAR-10、Pets、VOC上的表现。还设计了预训练增益（vs.随机初始化）、学习率敏感性扫描、解码器容量消融、跨模态迁移实验（Aurora天气模型作为同架构验证）。

Result: (1) EO模型平均SSI为0.543/0.548（Attn/MLP），远低于CV模型的≈0.99；ERA和ρ高出数倍，表明EO模型经历显著更大、更高秩、更高幅度的更新；(2) 跨基准上MADOS是唯一表现出"复用特征"的EO基准（最高SSI 0.765/0.815，最低ERA 0.464/0.596，最低ρ 0.284/0.277），此处LoRA和SVF均超过全微调（58.5、57.7 vs. 56.9 mIoU）；TimeMatch则相反（最低SSI 0.388/0.366，最高ρ 0.882/0.901），SVF落后全微调18个百分点；(3) CV模型中DINOv3比DINOv2保持更高SSI、更低ρ和ERA，表明更强的预训练与更集中的子空间保留相关；(4) 高SSI并不必然意味着低维适配：Tessera在TimeMatch上同时实现高SSI和高ERA，且达到最高精度；(5) 子空间变化集中于早期和中间层，后期层保留更多；(6) CROMA跨模态实验显示强性能可与大量重写共存，而高子空间保留也可能伴随差迁移（如SAR编码器在MADOS上）；(7) Aurora同模型对比验证了诊断指标对分辨率变化的敏感性；(8) 学习率扫描表明CV模型跨近两个数量级保持高SSI，而EO模型SSI随学习率上升从~0.9降至<0.25。

Conclusion: 本文提出了频谱诊断框架，为审计预训练表示复用提供了超越基准准确率的结构性视角。核心发现是：当前EO基础模型普遍处于"重新学习"而非"复用"模式，其下游性能常以大幅重写预训练权重结构为代价；而CV模型（尤其DINOv3）展现出明确的复用特征，提示更强的预训练能产生更可复用的特征基。这些结果意味着EO基础模型的评估应同时考虑性能、预训练收益与结构保留，三者结合才能刻画真正的表示复用，并为设计更可复用的EO预训练目标提供方向。

Abstract: Foundation models are rarely used as generic, frozen feature extractors; instead, they are fine-tuned for the target downstream application. This practice is particularly prevalent in Earth observation (EO), and it raises a question that downstream accuracy alone cannot answer: does fine-tuning reuse the pretrained representation, or does it relearn a new one? We study this with spectral diagnostics that compare a model before and after adaptation, quantifying how well its dominant singular subspaces are preserved, how broadly the weight update is distributed, and how large it is. Using natural image models such as CLIP and DINO as a reference, we find that, under the evaluated fine-tuning settings, EO models undergo far larger, higher-rank updates and retain much less of their pretrained structure, so their downstream performance is often obtained with substantial changes to the pretrained weight structure. The diagnostics further provide insight into how cheaply a model can be adapted: where the pretrained subspaces are preserved, adapting a small fraction of the parameters can match full fine-tuning, and where they are not, it can fall behind. More broadly, foundation models, and EO foundation models in particular, should be assessed not only by benchmark accuracy, but also by how reusable their pretrained representation is.

</details>


### [1190] [AnchorMixGAN: Anchor-Aligned Generative Semi-Supervision for DDoS Detection in Cloud-Integrated IoT Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32764)
*Jin Yang,Xufeng Liu,Yong Hu,Xueyang Wang,Honglu Yang,Gang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AnchorMixGAN，一种用于云集成IoT网络中DDoS检测的生成式半监督学习框架。其核心是Anchor-MAS模块，通过字段组级别的供体视图构造和锚点对齐的软目标生成，在标注数据稀缺场景下提升检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在云集成IoT网络中检测DDoS攻击时，标注流量获取成本高昂。现有生成式半监督方法（如MixGAN）通过合成视图的预测平均与锐化构造伪标签，但视图引发的预测偏移可能导致目标不准确，且未在理论上分离参考分类器误差、视图构造与锐化各自对目标误差的贡献。表格数据的字段结构特殊性（分类型编码与数值属性的关联）也要求更精细的视图构造策略。

Method: 方法包含三个关键设计：(1) 分组字段供体视图构造——将输入坐标划分为不相交的字段组，每个视图从一个生成记录中替换一个完整字段组的值，其余字段保留锚点原值；(2) Anchor-MAS目标估计——冻结的参考分类器预测完整锚点及其K个视图，预测结果取平均后经温度锐化（T=0.5）生成软目标，并与原锚点配对缓存；(3) MixUp检测器训练——将锚点与标注样本按Beta分布(α=0.75)插值，目标同步插值，损失为监督损失与混合损失的等权平均。理论分析将目标误差分解为参考分类器误差、视图位移与锐化位移三项，并推导了固定检测器预测下交叉熵变化的边界。

Result: 在90%训练数据、20%标注比例的设置下，AnchorMixGAN在NSL-KDD、BoT-IoT和CICIoT2023上分别达到97.3%、97.4%和96.5%的准确率，较MixGAN分别提升1.6、1.0和4.4个百分点。在CICIoT2023上F1提升4.5个百分点，TNR从86.4%提升至97.2%。在BoT-IoT上仅用1%标注数据即可达到92.6%准确率。参数分析表明α=0.75、T=0.5为最佳组合，推理效率与MixGAN基本一致（相同498,514参数）。

Conclusion: AnchorMixGAN通过字段组级别的锚点对齐目标构造，有效解决了生成式半监督学习中合成视图引入的预测偏移问题。理论分解清晰揭示了参考分类器误差、视图位移和锐化对目标误差的独立贡献。实验证明该方法在多个数据集和不同标注比例下均优于现有方法，尤其在标注极度稀缺（1%）时仍保持92.6%以上的检测能力，且推理阶段仅需单个检测器，具有实际部署价值。

Abstract: Detecting distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks in cloud-integrated IoT networks is difficult when labeled traffic is scarce. Generative semi-supervised learning can supplement the available training data, but prediction shifts induced by synthetic views may affect the targets assigned to real unlabeled flows. We propose AnchorMixGAN, a generative semi-supervised framework that addresses this problem through anchor-aligned target construction. Its Anchor-MAS module treats each real unlabeled flow as an anchor and creates alternative views by replacing one field group at a time with values from generated traffic. A frozen reference classifier predicts the anchor and its views; averaging and sharpening these predictions produces a soft target for the original flow. The flow and its target are then mixed with a labeled example using MixUp, allowing the detector to learn from both the original labeled records and the mixed examples. We analyze how reference-classifier error, view construction, and sharpening affect the target, and derive a bound on the resulting change in cross-entropy at a fixed detector prediction. At the reported 90% training setting with 20% of the training records labeled, AnchorMixGAN attains accuracies of 97.3%, 97.4%, and 96.5% on NSLKDD, BoT-IoT, and CICIoT2023, respectively, exceeding the corresponding MixGAN results by 1.6, 1.0, and 4.4 percentage points.

</details>


### [1191] [Structuring Relations Among Learning Paradigms via Protocol--Objective--Resource Reductions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32766)
*Junwei Su,Changjie Wang,Dongyang Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出POR（协议-目标-资源）框架，通过将学习范式分解为环境类、观察协议、可接受学习器类、性能泛函和资源核算规则五个组件，并定义POR归约（含环境嵌入、学习器编译器、阈值映射和仿射开销）来严格比较不同学习范式间的难度关系。在共同假设族下证明归约蕴含最坏情况复杂度支配（定理3.4），并应用于监督/迁移/持续/元学习四个范式，得到规范的特殊包含关系：Cont⪰_ex Trans⪰_ex Sup及Meta⪰_ex Sup。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习中，监督、迁移、持续、元学习等范式常共享相同的假设族、架构和优化器，却因信息访问、成功标准、记忆约束和样本核算等差异而难以判断其本质区别或特殊包含关系。现有学习理论工具（如VC维、Rademacher复杂度）仅在固定学习设定下比较假设类，无法分离表示容量与协议/目标/资源效应差异，需要一个结构化理论框架来精确刻画范式间关系。

Method: 1. 定义POR对象：五元组P=(环境类E, 观察协议O, 可接受学习器类T, 性能泛函J, 资源核算规则κ)；2. 定义POR归约B⪯_POR A：由环境嵌入Φ、编译器C、阈值映射Γ和仿射开销(a,b)构成，需满足可接受性与协议有效性、资源校准、目标转移三项耦合检验；3. 证明主定理（定理3.4）：POR归约蕴含最小最大声明资源复杂度在嵌入比较类上的支配关系N*_B ≤ aN*_A+b；4. 建立结构性质：阈值/比较类单调性、预序结构、等价类、可重用证明模板（特殊嵌入、目标强化、信息单调性、资源单调性）；5. 严格性证明：目标强化可严格增加样本复杂度（命题3.13/3.14）；6. 实例化于四个范式得出规范包含关系。

Result: 1. 理论结果：POR归约精确刻画了最小最大复杂度在范式间的传递性，定理3.4为框架核心，命题3.13证明目标强化可使样本复杂度从⌈log₂(1/(2δ))⌉严格增至⌈log₂(1/δ)⌉；2. 范式关系：在显式接口兼容性假设4.1-4.3下，建立规范层级Cont_{K+1}⪰_ex Trans_K⪰_ex Sup，Meta⪰_ex Sup，并将VC维下界自动传递至嵌入的迁移和持续学习类；3. 非精确归约：情景元学习的回合-样本归约具有开销(s+u, 0)，精确归约在限制比较类上不可行（命题3.3）；4. 内部范式精化：重放记忆预算单调性（命题A.2）和任务标识符边信息单调性（命题A.3）。

Conclusion: POR框架为学习范式间的关系提供了一种结构化语言，将"一个范式是否包含另一个"的非形式直觉转化为可审计的形式化义务（环境嵌入、编译器、阈值映射、资源校准）。该框架仅做最坏情况结构声明，不主张优化难度或经验性能相同，也不强加全局全序，但在显式假设下能精确识别包含关系并传递上下界。框架自然扩展方向包括多资源（样本、记忆、计算、通信同时核算）、近似归约（允许阈值松弛）、分布依赖归约，以及在主动学习、半监督学习、联邦学习、强化学习等场景中的应用。

Abstract: Modern machine learning spans supervised, transfer, continual, meta-learning, and related regimes that often reuse the same hypothesis classes, architectures, and optimizers but differ in information access, objectives, memory, adaptation, and sample accounting. This makes it difficult to determine whether one paradigm is genuinely distinct, a special case of another, or part of a broader structural hierarchy. We introduce a protocol-objective-resource (POR) framework that separates representational capacity from these design choices. A paradigm is specified by an environment class, observation protocol, admissible learners, performance functional, and resource accounting rule. POR reductions combine environment embeddings, learner compilers, threshold maps, and calibrated resource overheads. Our main theorem shows that such reductions imply worst-case complexity domination on embedded comparison classes, transferring upper bounds forward and lower bounds backward; under labeled-example accounting, this yields sample complexity domination. We also show that calibrated nontrivial accuracy regimes are necessary to avoid vacuous comparisons, and that strengthening the objective can strictly increase minimax sample complexity even with unchanged protocols and learner classes. Instantiating the framework for supervised, transfer, continual, and meta-learning yields canonical special-case relations: continual contains transfer, transfer contains supervised, and meta-learning contains supervised under aligned raw-example accounting. We further derive a non-exact episode-to-example reduction for episodic meta-learning and capture within-paradigm refinements such as replay memory and task identifiers. The framework thus provides a unified language for structuring learning paradigms and transferring complexity guarantees across them.

</details>


### [1192] [Beyond Gaussian Assumptions: Distribution-Aware Channel Capacity for Effective Connectivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32774)
*Jianan Jian,Jacob Kang,Nurahmed Multezem,Benjamin Li,Nan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于信道容量的分布感知有效连接（EC）估计框架Dual-flow，突破了传统高斯残差假设的局限。该方法利用归一化流构建双流极小极大博弈估计器，在一般（非高斯）残差分布下估计信道容量，并在脑仿真和真实数据中优于多种基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有有效连接估计方法（如Granger因果、VAR-LiNGAM、GIMME等）大多依赖高斯残差或二阶统计假设。然而，脑信号（fMRI、EEG、LFP等）及其拟合残差常呈现重尾、偏态等非高斯特征，导致传统方法可能丢失有价值的分布信息或扭曲有向交互推断。需发展能捕捉完整残差分布结构的分布感知EC度量。

Method: 1) 将每个有向ROI对建模为FIR线性信道 y=Bx+w，不对残差噪声 w 施加参数化形式，用拟合残差池作为经验样本。2) 定义分布感知信道容量 C = sup_{P_X∈P_P} [h(BX+W) - h(W)]。3) 提出Dual-flow极小极大估计器：生成器（归一化流）在功率约束下搜索最优输入分布；观测器（归一化流）估计输出微分熵。两者均使用1D Real NVP耦合层。4) 理论分析：观测器目标恢复差分熵至KL近似项；公式在高斯情况下退化为经典高斯容量；残差熵可影响可达信息速率（熵功率不等式）；给出博弈间隙诊断和误差分解。5) 训练算法采用Adam交替更新生成器和观测器，按对数差分熵的指数移动平均收敛判定。

Result: 1) 跨模态诊断：在大鼠LFP-BOLD、HCP运动fMRI和EEG-fMRI数据中，脑信号及拟合残差均频繁偏离高斯性。2) 仿真验证：在10种脑类网络条件（含隐驱动、反馈、模块化、异质HRF、最大28-ROI网络）中，Dual-flow的AUROC（.858–.949）和AUPRC（.521–.891）均最优。3) 真实数据应用：在HCP舌头运动fMRI中检测出3条与已知神经回路一致的任务敏感有向连接；在跨模态BOLD-LFP分析中，多个频段的对应性优于GCap、GC和VAR-LiNGAM。4) 计算成本：Mod10工作量平均每对约1.41秒。

Conclusion: Dual-flow建立了超越高斯残差建模的原则性分布感知EC估计框架，通过信道容量直接融入残差的完整分布结构。理论保证其恢复经典高斯容量作为特例，并揭示残差熵（而非仅方差）对可达信息速率的影响。在仿真和真实脑信号中均展示了优越的有向连接恢复能力，适合假设驱动的中小规模子网络分析，为计算神经科学和临床神经影像提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Effective-connectivity estimation from brain signals often relies on Gaussian residual modeling, which enables tractable estimation but can discard informative distributional structure and distort inferred directed interactions when empirical residuals are non-Gaussian. We show across multiple modalities, species, and experimental conditions that both brain signals and fitted channel residuals frequently deviate from Gaussianity. We therefore introduce a distribution-aware, information-theoretic measure of effective connectivity based on channel capacity under general residual distributions. To estimate the resulting capacity from empirical, potentially non-Gaussian residuals, we develop a dual-flow min-max estimator based on normalizing flows, in which a generator searches over admissible input distributions under a power constraint while an observer estimates output entropy. We provide a theoretical characterization of the estimator, showing that the observer objective recovers differential entropy up to a KL approximation term, that the formulation reduces to classical Gaussian capacity as a special case, and that residual entropy can alter achievable information rates beyond variance; game-gap and error analyses further characterize optimization and approximation sources. In brain-like simulations with known directed connectivity, Dual-flow achieves the highest AUROC and AUPRC across ten conditions spanning diverse network topologies, hidden drivers, feedback, and heterogeneous hemodynamics, compared with Gaussian capacity, Granger causality, VAR-LiNGAM, and GIMME. Applied to multimodal brain signals, the method reveals time- and condition-resolved directed interactions consistent with known neurobiological circuitry. Together, these results establish a principled distribution-aware framework for effective-connectivity estimation beyond Gaussian residual modeling.

</details>


### [1193] [Robust Bayesian Optimization with Q-Exponential Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32775)
*Richard Cornelius Suwandi,Zhidi Lin,Feng Yin,Abdelhak M. Zoubir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 q-ED-BO，一种基于 q 指数分布（q-ED）替代模型的鲁棒贝叶斯优化方法，通过形状参数 q 控制预测分布的尾部厚度，在 q=2 时退化为标准 GP-BO；推导了闭式 q-UCB 的亚线性遗憾界和精确 q-EI 表达式，并在波束成形与自适应滤波调参实验中验证了其在脉冲噪声污染下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 GP-BO 基于高斯假设，对异常值和重尾噪声敏感。现有鲁棒 BO 方法（Student-t 似然、t 过程 BO、截断均值 BO）各有不足：Student-t 非共轭导致后验无闭式解；t 过程的多项式尾无法给出解析的置信宽度和遗憾保证；截断均值仅鲁棒化拟合而不鲁棒化探索。因此需要一种兼具闭式可处理性、可调尾部、和理论保证的替代模型。

Method: 1) 用一元 q-ED 分布作为预测分布，均值和方差沿用 GP 的闭式后验 (1)-(2)，形状参数 q 控制尾部（q=2 退化为高斯，q 越小尾越重）；2) 证明 q-ED 预测的拉伸指数尾界（Lemma 3），由此导出闭式 q-UCB 采集函数（式 9-10）并证明亚线性遗憾界 R_T = Õ((log T)^{1/q} √(Tγ_T))，q<2 时仅多一个 (log T)^{1/q - 1/2} 因子；4) 利用 Gaussian CDF 和上不完全 Gamma 函数推导精确闭式 q-EI 表达式（式 12），q=2 时恢复经典 EI；5) 似然仍为高斯，核超参数通过最大化 q-ED 密度拟合。

Result: 在 MVDR 波束成形（4 维黑盒，16 元 ULA，4 个干扰）和泄漏 NLMS 自适应滤波（3 维黑盒）两个信号处理任务上对比 GP-UCB、GP-EI、TP-EI、TruncMean：在清洁高斯数据下 q-EI（q=1）略优，所有方法差距 ≈0.2 dB；在脉冲污染下，q=1.5 的 q-ED-BO 比最强基线 TruncMean 在输出 SINR 上提升 ≈0.7 dB，在 NLMS 失配度减少上提升 1.1–1.2 dB，且 Wilcoxon 检验显著；q=0.5 因置信区间过宽而过探索。

Conclusion: q-ED-BO 通过单一形状参数 q 在 GP-BO 与重尾 BO 之间提供闭式可处理的连续插值，兼具理论遗憾保证（q-UCB）和精确采集函数（q-EI），且对核函数选择透明；在信号处理调参任务中对脉冲异常值具有鲁棒性。建议默认 q=1.5，重度污染时可取更小 q；未来工作包括 q 的联合/在线学习及 q-EI 的一致性分析。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a widely used framework for optimizing expensive black-box objectives, but standard BO methods often use Gaussian process (GP) surrogates whose Gaussian assumption is sensitive to outliers and heavy-tailed noise. We introduce q-ED-BO, a robust BO method whose surrogate follows a univariate q-exponential (q-ED) distribution, preserving GP-BO's closed-form posterior mean and variance while a shape parameter q controls the tail behavior, recovering the GP at q = 2 and growing heavier-tailed with wider confidence bounds as q decreases. This tractability yields a closed-form q-upper confidence bound (q-UCB) with sublinear regret, and an exact closed-form q-expected improvement (q-EI) that generalizes EI to the heavy-tailed predictive, recovering classical EI at q = 2. Experiments on beamformer and adaptive filter tuning with impulsive outliers show that q-ED-BO matches or exceeds existing baselines on clean data, and under corruption, improves the strongest baseline by approximately 0.7 dB in output SINR and 1.1 to 1.2 dB in misalignment reduction.

</details>


### [1194] [Learning When to Recur: Token-Adaptive Recursion for Imbalanced Ophthalmic Domain Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32785)
*Nanxi Yu,Kang Li,Ye Du,Xiaowei Hu,Weihua Yang,Shujun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ToRe框架，一种用于眼科领域增量学习(DIL)的免重放(parameter isolation)+参数高效微调(PEFT)方法，通过token-adaptive recursion机制自适应分配计算深度，缓解标签分布偏移(LDS)和类别不平衡导致的灾难性遗忘问题，在九个异构数据集上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有眼科DIL方法主要解决由风格变化引起的域偏移，但忽视了临床转诊系统中固有的严重类别不平衡问题。不同机构间类别先验的剧烈波动导致标签分布偏移(LDS)，进而引发严重的灾难性遗忘。此外，数据隐私法规限制了重放缓冲区的构建，全量微调的计算负担也阻碍临床部署。

Method: ToRe基于冻结的眼科基础模型(RETFound)，采用参数隔离策略为每个域分配独立的优化路径(包含门控模块、LoRA参数和分类头)。核心创新是token-adaptive recursion机制：通过轻量级门控模块学习选择复杂token(如病灶相关)进行递归处理，简易token提前退出，从而打破标准ViT的均匀深度约束。自适应递归通过Straight-Through Estimator(STE)训练。推理时利用基于特征的域识别(余弦相似度选择域键)从模块库中检索匹配模块。

Result: 在DR分级(APTOS/Messidor-2/IDRiD)、AMD分级(ODIR/ADAM/HYAMD)和OCT多标签生物标志物预测(RETOUCH/AMD-SD/APTOS-2021)三个基准上，ToRe在平均准确率、F1、平衡准确率和MCC等指标上均优于现有SOTA方法，遗忘率接近零(DR:0.10%, AMD:0.03%, OCT:0.21%)。参数效率高：累积可学习参数约0.92M，仅占完整模型的0.30%。门控模块分析表明，病变token的选择率(45.30%)显著高于非病变token(38.74%)。

Conclusion: ToRe通过协调参数隔离、域识别和token-adaptive recursion三种机制，在不平衡眼科DIL场景下实现了强类别平衡性能与低遗忘的统一。未来工作将研究更高效的递归执行、多模态语义引导以及开放集域识别与自动新域检测。

Abstract: Domain incremental learning is essential for adapting ophthalmic deep learning models to sequential clinical domains while preserving diagnostic expertise. Existing domain incremental learning methods predominantly address the domain shift induced by style variations. However, they often overlook the severe class imbalance inherent in real-world clinical scenarios, such as clinical referral systems. Institutions in these systems encounter drastic fluctuations in class priors, resulting in label distribution shift, a critical form of domain shift that triggers severe catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose ToRe, a rehearsal-free and parameter-efficient framework that leverages frozen ophthalmic foundation models for robust incremental adaptation. ToRe employs a parameter isolation strategy to decouple domain-specific optimization paths, thereby helping mitigate catastrophic forgetting driven by both label distribution shift and style variations. Simultaneously, it introduces token-adaptive recursion that adaptively allocates additional computational depth across tokens, allowing simple tokens to exit the recursion loop early while subjecting complex tokens, such as those associated with lesions, to deeper recursive processing. This mechanism enhances the feature representations for minority classes, thereby supporting generalization throughout the domain incremental learning process. Extensive evaluations on nine heterogeneous datasets demonstrate that ToRe consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in overall performance across the three benchmarks, while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Together, these results support the applicability of ToRe to dynamic and imbalanced clinical environments. The code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [1195] [FedHV: Low-Overhead Hypervolume Weighting for Federated Multi-Objective Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32790)
*Amirardalan Dehghanpour,Seyed Mohammad Azimi-Abarghouyi,Christopher G. Brinton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedHV是一种用于任务级联邦多目标优化（FedMOO）的通信高效方法，通过逆参考相对松弛映射将目标值标量转换为封闭形式的逆松弛权重，每个客户端优化单个加权损失，仅增加2m个辅助标量进行上行通信，无需任务特定的几何信息或额外的服务器端优化阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务级联邦多目标优化需要在异构客户端数据、部分参与和通信约束下平衡多个相互冲突的目标。现有方法（如FSMGDA和FedCMOO）依赖任务特定梯度几何信息或迭代服务器优化，导致通信开销大且需要额外同步阶段。FedHV旨在通过仅传输低维目标标量值来实现自适应任务加权，从而显著降低通信成本。

Method: FedHV基于对数超体积目标$\Phi(\theta)=-\sum_i \log(r_i-f_i(\theta))$，使用封闭形式的逆松弛权重$w_i \propto 1/(r_i-f_i(\theta))$。参考向量$r$通过均匀权重校准阶段预先确定并冻结。每轮中，选定的客户端在共同预更新模型上评估目标估计值，使用上一轮的权重进行K步本地SGD，并返回模型更新和目标估计。服务器聚合后形成下一轮权重，形成单轮延迟协议。理论分析使用偏置-方差-漂移分解处理部分参与、客户端异构性、多步本地更新、有限样本目标报告和一权重延迟误差。

Result: 在六个Dirichlet分区的非IID设置（来自四个视觉基准家族和三个训练种子）上，FedHV在五个设置中的平均准确率超过了FSMGDA和FedCMOO，在四个设置中达到了最高的最低任务准确率，并在两个CIFAR10-MNIST设置中改善了困难的CIFAR-10目标。理论分析证明了在固定视域正松弛参考条件下，FedHV以$O(T^{-1/2})$的速率实现平均平方对数超体积梯度范数，收敛上界明确分离了初始目标差距、随机梯度方差、部分参与异构性、多步本地漂移、报告误差和权重陈旧性等误差源。通信开销为每客户端$\Theta(d+m)$，远低于FSMGDA的$\Theta(md)$，且无需额外同步阶段。端到端墙钟时间比FSMGDA快约32.9%，比FedCMOO快约24.7%。

Conclusion: FedHV通过利用目标值标量而非任务梯度几何信息，实现了一种通信高效的联邦多目标优化方法，在保持理论收敛保证的同时显著降低了通信和计算开销。该方法特别适用于任务难度不平衡的场景，能有效改善最差任务性能。然而，其理论保证依赖于固定参考向量保持严格正松弛的参考域条件，这需要通过校准边际和初始化的仔细管理来保证。生成式AI工具被用于辅助文献检索、构思、代码实现、实验设计和部分证明撰写，但所有数学推导、假设和实验结果均经过作者独立验证。

Abstract: Task-wise federated multi-objective optimization (FedMOO) trains a shared model for competing prediction objectives under heterogeneous data, partial participation, and communication constraints. Existing methods commonly derive task weights from gradient or update geometry. This requires task-specific information or iterative server-side optimization. We introduce FedHV, which maps reference-relative objective slacks to closed-form inverse-slack weights. Each client optimizes one weighted loss and returns objective estimates with its model update. The protocol adds exactly 2m auxiliary scalars per participating client, yielding Theta(d + m) total per-client communication, compared with the Theta(md) task-specific communication of FSMGDA, and requires no additional synchronization stage. We analyze the resulting one-round-delayed weights under client heterogeneity, multi-step local updates, partial participation, and finite-sample objective reports. Under a fixed-horizon positive-slack reference condition, with the prescribed horizon-dependent step size and vanishing report error, FedHV achieves an O(T^(-1/2)) rate for the average squared log-hypervolume gradient norm; persistent report error determines the resulting stationarity neighborhood. The same bound controls the squared Pareto-stationarity residual. Across six Dirichlet-partitioned non-IID settings from four vision benchmark families and three training seeds, FedHV exceeds FSMGDA and FedCMOO in mean accuracy in five settings. Among these methods and uniform scalarization, it achieves the highest worst-task accuracy in four settings and improves the difficult CIFAR-10 objective in both CIFAR10-MNIST settings.

</details>


### [1196] [Understanding and Exploiting Anisotropy in Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32792)
*Samyak Jha,Harshvardhan Saini,Yizhen Liao,Yiming Tang,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视LLM表征中的各向异性现象，将其视为一种功能分工而非缺陷：约5%的残差通道构成"连贯性基底"（coherence substrate），维持语言建模能力；而剩余"推理通道"才是RL后训练真正适应的对象。基于此，作者提出SphereGate——一种仅学习每个残差通道一个正增益的高效参数适配方法，在冻结骨干上以0.1M参数在MATH-500等基准上超越其他PEFT基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 各向异性（anisotropy）是LLM表征中已被广泛记录的现象，通常被视为缺陷，但其功能以及与SFT/RL后训练的交互机制尚不清楚。本文动机在于：(1) 理解各向异性通道在后训练中的角色；(2) 利用该结构设计更高效的参数适配方法。

Method: 方法包括两部分： (1) 分析部分：使用基于绝对均值激活的无标签离群点规则识别约5%的各向异性通道（连贯性通道），并通过rollout子空间重叠分析、成员集变化、基线相对激活漂移等指标，对比SFT与GRPO对两类通道的不同影响。 (2) 方法部分：提出SphereGate——在每个解码器块的全残差状态上学习一个有界正增益 $g^l = \exp(\theta^l)$（$\theta$ 初始化为0，夹紧在 $|θ_k| < c$），骨干网络全部冻结。理论分析（Proposition 1）证明其激活加权梯度在能量加权度量下对高能连贯性通道的运动提供 $1/\sqrt{E_j}$ 包络约束，从而将适配压力集中在互补通道上。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Instruct (0.5B–7B) 和 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上，SphereGate 以约0.1M可训练参数在MATH-500上全面超越最强的PEFT基线（LoRA-XS、TinyLoRA、Subnetwork、IA³），领先2.0–7.3个百分点，性能可比或超过全模型GRPO。在AMC23、Minerva Math、AIME24、OlympiadBench上同样领先。消融实验显示：(a) 仅训练互补通道的MATH-500精度为69.4，与全通道70.0接近；(b) 移除各向异性通道使预训练模型WikiText-2困惑度从8.84飙升至 $3.91 \times 10^6$，而移除等量随机通道仅升至31.18。

Conclusion: 各向异性不是缺陷，而是LLM表征中的一种功能分工——各向异性通道构成连贯性基底，推理适应发生在其余通道上。SphereGate通过简单的逐通道缩放在冻结骨干上实现了高效且稳定的GRPO适配，为PEFT设计提供了基于表征几何的新视角。

Abstract: LLM post-training combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT), a mode-covering forward-KL objective, with reinforcement learning (RL), a mode-seeking reverse-KL objective. Frequency-weighted likelihood training leaves a well-known signature: \emph{anisotropy}, in which a few residual channels carry disproportionately large activations. Anisotropy is widely documented and usually treated as a defect, yet its function and its interaction with post-training remain unclear. We first analyze it.
