Existing approaches, however, mainly generate samples that match the target condition without explicitly modeling how an observed source recording should be transformed, making it difficult to leverage abundant source recordings from a specific population or cohort for targeted augmentation. We introduce PulseFlow, a source-conditioned counterfactual generation framework that combines conditional representation learning with invertible latent transport to edit cardiac rhythm while retaining information from the source. Experiments across two clinical cohorts demonstrate effective rhythm transformation, measurable source correspondence, and improved AF classification under limited labels.

</details>


### [1281] [SLP-ProbHard: Probabilistic Hard-Constrained Learning via Structural Latent Parameterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33515)
*Wondesen Teshome Bekele,Marco D'Oria*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SLP-ProbHard提出了一种以表征为中心的概率硬约束学习框架，通过结构可行潜在参数化(SFLP)在可行坐标中直接定义预测分布，而非先预测后投影。核心创新在于揭示"满足硬约束"并不唯一确定预测律——结构映射的选择决定了边界概率、随机维度、协方差族及校准特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的概率硬约束方法（如ProbHardE2E/DPPL）在环境空间中生成预测后进行投影或修正，但精确可行性本身并不唯一决定预测律。当存在科学上有意义的可行表征时，直接在可行坐标中定义预测分布可能更具优势。论文旨在系统研究结构表征选择对预测概率分布的影响。

Method: 框架核心为结构可行潜在参数化(SFLP)：结构潜在律 Z~P^Z_θ(·|x) 与可行映射 Y=h_φ(x,Z) 联合定义预测律 P^Y_θ = h_φ,x# P^Z_θ，满足 h_φ(x,z)∈C(x)。实验采用高斯潜在律和固定几何导出映射，覆盖仿射等式、序约束、单纯形、非线性流形（圆、尺度-形状），以及三种水文流量持续曲线(FDC)表征。包含与ProbHardE2E/DPPL官方源的直接对比。

Result: 仿射对比中SLP-ProbHard与DPPL均实现零约束违反；SLP-ProbHard使用8而非11个随机坐标，改进MSE/MAE；DPPL在边际CRPS和覆盖率上更优；配对检验未检测到Energy Score差异（10个种子）。实世界FDC表征将随机坐标从13降至7（仿射）、14降至8（非线性）。结构表征选择导致边界概率、随机维度、协方差表达能力和校准-锐度权衡存在系统性差异。

Conclusion: 精确可行性并不唯一确定预测律；不同的可行映射可产生不同的预测律家族。SLP-ProbHard为具有明确可行表征的场景提供了直接结构生成的统一框架，而投影方法在隐式或难以参数化的可行集上仍有价值。二者是互补的硬约束范式。

Abstract: Many probabilistic predictors must satisfy exact structure in every stochastic realization, yet common hard-constraint approaches form predictions in ambient coordinates and then correct or project them. We introduce SLP-ProbHard, a cross-family, representation-centered framework for probabilistic hard-constrained learning when explicit structural parameterizations are available. Its core object, a Structural Feasible Latent Parameterization (SFLP), combines a structural latent law $Z \sim P^Z_\theta(\cdot\mid x)$ with a feasible map $Y=h_\phi(x,Z)$ that satisfies the constraint for every latent realization. Together these components define the predictive law itself, including its support and boundary probabilities, rather than serving as a final feasibility wrapper. We study how feasible coordinates and maps affect stochastic dimension, dependence, calibration, expressiveness, and computation. Experiments use Gaussian latent laws and fixed geometry-derived maps across affine equalities, ordering and simplex constraints, nonlinear manifolds, and three structural representations of seven-basin hydrological flow-duration-curve (FDC) data. In an official-source affine comparison with ProbHardE2E/DPPL, both methods achieve zero practical constraint violations. SLP-ProbHard uses 8 instead of 11 stochastic coordinates and improves MSE/MAE, while DPPL yields better marginal CRPS and closer-to-nominal coverage; a paired test detects no Energy Score difference across ten seeds. Real-world affine and nonlinear FDC representations reduce 13 to 7 and 14 to 8 ambient versus computational coordinates, respectively. Exact feasibility alone thus does not determine a predictive law, motivating direct structural generation when meaningful feasible coordinates are available.

</details>


### [1282] [LLM4Trust: Exploring the Capabilities of Large Language Models for Trust Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33521)
*Jie Wang,Yanbo Sun,Zheng Yan,Jiahe Lan,Elisa Bertino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LLM4Trust是首个系统性评估大语言模型在信任评估任务中能力的基准，针对信任属性理解和真实场景信任评估两个研究问题，通过合成信任图与真实数据集进行实验，揭示了LLM在少监督场景下的优势及鲁棒性、效率方面的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于学习的信任评估方法依赖大量标注数据、训练成本高、缺乏对基本信任属性的全面支持且可解释性有限。LLM具备零样本/少样本推理能力、广泛的知识基础和分步推理能力，理论上可弥补上述不足，但其在信任评估领域的潜力尚未被系统探索。

Method: 提出LLM4Trust基准框架：(1) 使用三种图生成器（Erdős-Rényi、Stochastic Block、Forest Fire）构建多样化的合成信任图，设计五个属性理解任务（动态性、不对称性、条件传递性、可组合性、上下文感知）；(2) 评估八个代表性LLM在九种提示方法下的表现；(3) 针对上下文窗口限制，提出基于跳数和子图规模的关键信息提取策略（结构原则与时间原则）；(4) 在五个真实数据集上与十种代表性方法对比，并评估对信任图攻击和少样本示例攻击的鲁棒性；(5) 提出集成对抗示例增强、时间边过滤和一致性修正的输入级防御机制。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1) LLM能有效理解基本信任属性，最佳LLM-提示组合在所有属性理解任务上达到97%以上准确率；(2) 图规模和时序复杂度增加会降低理解性能，而图生成器、信任级别范围和图密度影响较小；(3) 在静态数据集上LLM优于非学习方法但在标签充足时劣于GNN，在少监督场景下表现优异（如DeepSeek-V3在Epinions上用3个标注即匹配TrustGNN用569,206个标注的性能）；(4) LLM的分步推理提升了可解释性，用户研究显示解释使决策准确率提升28.97%、自信度提升24.73%；(5) LLM易受混合攻击、时间感知攻击和示例攻击影响，所提防御可恢复最高29.08%的性能；(6) LLM推理成本高，批处理可显著提升效率但会牺牲准确性和可解释性。

Conclusion: LLM在信任评估中展现出强大潜力，尤其是在少监督场景下可作为有效的初始评估器，并通过分步推理提供透明性。然而，其在鲁棒性和推理效率方面仍面临挑战，需进一步研究更强防御机制与高效部署方案以推动实际应用。论文贡献包括首个系统性基准框架、五项属性理解任务、应对上下文窗口限制的子图提取策略以及对应的鲁棒性和可扩展性解决方案。

Abstract: Trust evaluation plays a critical role in cybersecurity by supporting risk mitigation and decision-making. A variety of trust evaluation methods have been proposed, with learning-based approaches offering high accuracy and automation. However, they often require substantial ground truth, suffer from low training efficiency, lack support for basic trust properties, and provide limited explainability. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a compelling alternative due to their strong zero-/few-shot reasoning abilities and broad knowledge. To this end, we propose LLM4Trust, the first benchmark framework that systematically explores the capabilities of LLMs for trust evaluation. We first construct diverse trust graphs to model five basic trust properties and design corresponding property understanding tasks. We then assess the ability of eight representative LLMs to understand these properties under nine prompt methods. Based on this exploration, we identify the most effective LLM-prompt combinations and apply them to five real-world datasets for validating LLMs' trust evaluation capability. During this process, we propose two strategies to extract key information from large-scale trust graphs, addressing the context window limitations of LLMs. Extensive experiments show that LLMs can effectively understand basic trust properties and have great potential for real-world trust evaluation, particularly under limited supervision. However, they remain vulnerable to attacks targeting trust graphs and demonstration examples used in few-shot prompting, and incur high inference costs. Accordingly, we propose a defense mechanism and batch inference to improve the robustness and efficiency of LLM-based trust evaluation. The source code of LLM4Trust is available at this https URL

</details>


### [1283] [Discovering Symmetries in Neural Network Parameter Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33527)
*Bo Zhao,Nima Dehmamy,Robin Walters,Rose Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自动化发现神经网络参数空间对称性的框架，通过无穷小表征将数据依赖的群作用公理转化为可微分目标，并结合子网络提升与分解理论，实现了对已知与未知对称性（包括预训练Transformer中的对称性）的系统发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数空间对称性深刻影响神经网络的损失景观、训练动力学和泛化能力，但目前识别这些对称性的方法学分散且不完整，亟需一种系统化、可扩展的自动化发现框架。现有工作多为针对特定架构的特例推导，缺乏统一的理论指导。

Method: 1) 形式化数据依赖的广义群作用，利用李群无穷小生成元推导出损失不变性和群作用公理的微分条件（定理3.1与3.2），作为可微分优化目标；2) 通过参数分解提出子网络对称性向完整网络提升的条件（命题4.1及其推论），并证明平滑两层网络的输出保持变换可分解为作用于k+1个隐藏单元块的子网络变换（定理4.5）；3) 基于无穷小条件构造有限误差界（命题5.1），并提出混合目标函数（式13）联合学习矩阵生成元和非线性作用映射；4) 在Pythia等预训练Transformer上通过子网络边界输出约束实现对称性的实际发现。

Result: 1) 理论层面：建立了数据依赖参数对称性的完整无穷小表征，证明了有限变换的组合误差与损失变化可由微分残差控制；构造了显式的有限批次加性群作用族（推论4.6）；2) 实验层面：在线性网络（恢复4-8维隐藏基变换代数）、ReLU网络（恢复3-8维正重缩放代数）、sigmoid网络（发现非线性补偿机制）中成功恢复已知对称性；在(4,16,16,2) tanh/GELU网络上学习到跨越非连续层的协调变换；3) 预训练模型层面：在Pythia-160M和Pythia-1B的前馈模块中学习到有效的对称性变换，在原始检查点安装后可使受保护logits的相对漂移减少约129倍（相比随机平移），且混合目标相比纯有限约束目标将存储权重的组合误差降低约5-8倍。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一套基于无穷小表征和子网络结构的参数对称性发现统一框架，理论上将对称性公理转化为可微分目标并给出有限误差保证，实践上在多种架构（包括大规模预训练Transformer）中发现了有效的新对称性，包括数据依赖的非线性作用。剩余开放问题包括：神经网络参数空间对称性的存在性与完整分类、对称性是否受数据分布影响、以及训练过程中对称性结构是否动态变化。学习的对称性有望用于权重空间学习、等变架构设计与帧平均等下游应用。

Abstract: Parameter space symmetries are important for understanding neural networks' loss landscape, training dynamics, and generalization. However, systematically identifying these symmetries remains a challenge. In this paper, we formalize data-dependent parameter symmetries and characterize loss invariance and the group-action axioms through infinitesimal conditions, which provide objectives for jointly learning group generators and nonlinear action maps. Our framework systematically uncovers parameter symmetries, including previously unknown ones. To study larger networks, we establish conditions under which subnetwork symmetries extend to the full model. The same construction gives an explicit family of finite-batch symmetries, providing both analytical examples and a foundation for discovery through small subnetworks. Using the infinitesimal characterization and subnetwork construction, we implement a framework for automated discovery of parameter symmetries, and successfully uncovered symmetries in various architectures, including pretrained transformer models.

</details>


### [1284] [Does Execution Require Target KV Fidelity? A Mixed-Fidelity KV Runtime for LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33536)
*Jiantong Jiang,Yue Yang,Peiyu Yang,Feng Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ElasticKV提出了一种混合保真度KV缓存运行时，将KV保真度作为运行时管理的执行属性而非目标保真度门控，允许请求以紧凑的中间BASE状态执行以避免内存压力下的抢占和延迟激增。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM服务中KV缓存占用的GPU内存日益成为瓶颈。现有的压缩、淘汰和卸载技术虽然缓解了内存压力，但服务运行时通常仅将配置的目标保真度（TARGET）视为可执行状态。当内存不足时，这种目标独占执行契约会导致请求停滞、抢占和上下文重计算，造成P90 TTFT延迟急剧恶化。因此，瓶颈不仅在于能存多少KV，还在于运行时接受何种KV表示用于执行。

Method: ElasticKV引入了一种紧凑的中间BASE状态（保留TARGET的高8位，丢奔低8位），将保真度从执行前提转为运行时属性。其实现包含三个协调机制：(1) 配对结构化KV布局（pair-structured layout）：两个逻辑块组成一对，BASE状态可打包到一个物理块中，释放的块返回GPU KV池；(2) 双模式弹性注意力后端：TARGET独占批次走原生路径，含BASE的批次走弹性路径，保护注意力锚点（attention sink）和近期token对，通常形成TARGET-BASE-TARGET结构模式；(3) 压力感知保真度管理：基于预分配钩子的短缺探测触发同步降级，异步升级由衰减保留预算控制以避免振荡。系统基于vLLM v0.15.0实现，注意力内核采用Triton。

Result: 在A100（80GB）上使用Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen3-8B的评估中，ElasticKV在高并发下比vLLM Full-GPU降低3.8-4.0倍平均TTFT和9.1倍P90 TTFT，且无请求抢占。在ShareGPT工作负载上，P90 TTFT降低4.3-6.5倍。在Mooncake生产轨迹回放中，Eff@300在所有窗口均有改善。在8×AMD MI355X上部署Llama-3.1-70B（TP2×DP4）时，平均Eff@300提升34.1%，平均排空时间降低70.5%。生成质量方面，LongBench 21任务平均分在5%/10%/20% BASE暴露上限下基本与FP16持平，而全BASE压力端点仅下降约1.4-1.7分。运行开销为每步4.37ms（在线控制0.32ms + 同步降级2.82ms + 弹性元数据1.23ms）。

Conclusion: ElasticKV证明了LLM KV缓存优化应将保真度视为运行时管理的执行属性而非静态表示选择。通过将目标保真度从执行门控中解耦，ElasticKV在保持生成质量的同时显著扩展了可服务的并发范围，降低了内存压力下的尾部延迟，并在多种模型规模和工作负载上展现了一致性增益，包括跨NVIDIA和AMD GPU平台的可移植性。该工作表明，KV优化需要从表示层面的选择扩展到运行时层面的弹性执行契约管理。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly constrained by the GPU memory consumed by key-value (KV) caches. Existing compression, eviction, and offloading techniques alleviate this pressure, but serving runtimes typically treat only the configured target KV representation as execution-ready. Under memory pressure, this target-only contract can turn KV shortage into request stalls and preemptions. We present ElasticKV, a mixed-fidelity KV runtime built on the observation that target fidelity need not gate execution. ElasticKV introduces a compact intermediate KV state, making fidelity a runtime-managed execution property. To realize this state in a paged serving runtime, ElasticKV combines (i) a pair-structured layout that turns fidelity reduction into reusable GPU capacity, (ii) a dual-mode attention backend that directly consumes the compact state while preserving the native target-only path, and (iii) pressure-aware fidelity management that adapts KV fidelity to memory pressure. Our extensive evaluation across diverse workloads, model families and scales, and GPU platforms demonstrates the effectiveness and generality of ElasticKV. Under high concurrency, ElasticKV achieves 3.8-4.0$\times$ lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) and 9.1$\times$ lower P90 TTFT than vLLM while preserving generation quality.

</details>


### [1285] [Fine Until Fine-Tuned: Repeated Solutions Make Reasoning Fragile](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33559)
*Ely Sheikh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发现，反复用同一批解答训练推理模型（"钻取式"训练）虽然在训练结束时看起来无害，但在后续的任何微调阶段中都会导致推理能力的脆弱性。真正的损害来自"看到相同的文本"，而非"问题数量少"——使用新鲜解答的训练则完好无损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型（如 s1、LIMO）通过少量解题过程数据的多次重复训练获得能力，评估时表现良好。然而这些模型经常会被进一步微调——本研究探究重复训练是否会损害推理能力对下一阶段的鲁棒性。

Method: 对比三种训练方式：(1) 钻取式——少量解答（约 579 个）重复约 8 次；(2) 单次训练——大量不同解答（4480 个）各看一次；(3) 新鲜解答——钻取式访问频次但每次给不同解答。在 Qwen3.5-9B-Base 等模型上使用 LoRA 微调，然后施加后续指令微调阶段进行压力测试。使用 MATH-500 等基准测试，引入 B 散度指标衡量模型偏离基础模型的距离，并预先注册 70 项预测。

Result: 在交接点，三种模型表现相近（约 95% 准确率）。但经历后续微调后，钻取式模型崩溃（如指令调优后跌至 86.0%，严格测试降至 22.5%），而单次训练和新鲜解答模型保持稳定。效应在多个模型（35B、Nemotron）和任务（算术搜索、合成技能）中复现。后续阶段"压制"而非"消除"了推理能力——仅需 5 次推理训练更新即可几乎完全恢复。新鲜解答和重放 6.25% 原始数据可防止损害。过度锐化不能完全解释损害——无重复的同等锐化模型未受损伤。

Conclusion: 实践启示：训练推理模型时应在后续训练阶段后进行评估（强制推理和自由推理均要测试）；如必须重访相同问题，使用新鲜解答可防止损害，6.25% 的重放也有保护作用，约 160 个示例的推理训练可修复已受损的模型。反复看相同文本的代价超出其引起的分布锐化效应本身。

Abstract: Recipes such as s1 and LIMO teach a model to reason with little data by showing it the same thousand or fewer worked solutions many times over. Judged when that training ends, the repetition looks harmless. But reasoning models are often trained again, and we find that repetition leaves their reasoning fragile to that next stage, even when the stage has nothing to do with reasoning. We fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B-Base on its own correct solutions to competition math problems, either drilling a few hundred of them about eight times each or showing many more once; with the same amount of training, both solve about 95% of held-out problems. A single pass of ordinary instruction tuning leaves the once-trained model where it was, while the drilled one falls to 86.0%, and harsher later stages take it to 59.3% or below. A third model that visited the drilled problems just as often, with a new solution at every visit, was unharmed, so the damage comes from seeing the same texts again rather than from having few problems. The break recurs with a stronger model's traces, in further training runs and on other models and tasks. It is also cheap to undo: the reasoning is suppressed rather than erased, and five updates of reasoning training bring almost all of it back, as does brief training on the reasoning format with almost no mathematics. Fresh solutions prevented the damage, and so did replaying 6.25% of the original solutions in a gentler later stage, so our claim concerns later training without such replay. Sharpening alone does not explain the break, since a model sharpened three-quarters as much without repetition was unharmed. On a skill the base model could not perform within a token budget, repetition mainly cost learning.

</details>


### [1286] [GraphSelect for Budgeted Representation Selection in Multimodal Graph Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33561)
*Xu Wang,Xunkai Li,Yinlin Zhu,Rong-Hua Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 GraphSelect 方法，解决多模态图推理中预算受限的表示选择问题——在文本和图像各自独立容量约束下，选择最少的候选表示以保持已训练图预测器的预测结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态属性图（融合文本、图像与关系）在推荐、跨模态匹配等任务中表现良好，但实践中存储与计算资源有限，需决定哪些已编码的文本/图像向量应被保留。现有特征归因或解释方法（如 Shapley、Integrated Gradients、GNNExplainer 等）未针对该受限容量下的联合选择进行优化，且未考虑表示之间、模态之间以及图传播带来的复杂交互。

Method: 1) 形式化预算受限表示选择问题：每个模态分别设定配额 K_m，以完整输入预测的类别为目标，最小化目标节点上预测类别的负对数概率损失 R(S)。2) 经验研究三个设计选择——评估候选时使用参考输入的"加法增益"优于完整输入下的"删除得分"；预测类别的交叉熵在硬一致饱和后仍提供信息；随子集变化更新得分能持续改进选择。3) GraphSelect 方法：先用个体候选的初始化增益填满两种模态配额，再对当前子集维护"移除短名单"和"加入短名单"（各 L 个候选），联合评估同模态的"移除+加入"交换，接受使 R 严格下降的交换并更新两短名单，直至无改进或耗尽评估预算。4) 对可加图预测器，利用 logit 变化的稀疏性，仅在受影响的目标行上精确评估加入与交换的增益。

Result: 在六个多模态图基准上，GraphSelect 在 5%、10%、20% 三档容量下的平均目标恢复率均高于六种适配的归因/解释方法（含 Shapley Sampling、Integrated Gradients、Feature Ablation、GNNExplainer、GOAt、Zorro）。在 Grocery 和 RedditS 两个图上对九种训练架构的实验中，保留每模态 20% 的候选表示，相对完整输入的平均准确率下降仅 0.10 个百分点，Macro-F1 下降 0.065 个百分点。消融实验表明，移除交换优化在 112/126 设置中变差，保留初始得分在 62 设置中变差。

Conclusion: GraphSelect 通过跟随当前所选子集、联合评估交换并更新得分，能在严苛的每模态容量预算下有效保持多模态图预测器的预测质量。其精确评估对加性预测器利用稀疏性，非线性模型则需完整前向传播。研究成果说明联合选择优于单纯依赖归因排序，且小容量下的类别概率恢复与分类性能并不完全等同。

Abstract: Multimodal graph predictors combine text, images, and relations to classify connected entities. How much of this input is needed to preserve their predictions? We study budgeted representation selection, which chooses a subset of candidate text and image vectors under a separate capacity for each modality. Predictions from the complete candidate input define the classes to preserve. The challenge is that a representation's contribution depends on the other selected inputs, while graph propagation extends its effects across nodes. Our empirical study shows that candidate rankings change with the selected input, while predicted probabilities remain informative after the class stops changing. Updating scores improves selection, and exchanging inputs can improve a subset whose capacity is already filled. These findings lead to GraphSelect, which starts from individual candidate gains and refines the subset through jointly evaluated exchanges. It screens promising removals and additions, accepts an exchange when it reduces the prediction loss, and updates the scores. Experiments on six graphs show higher mean objective recovery than six attribution and explanation methods adapted to the selection task. Across nine trained architectures on two graphs, retaining 20% of the candidate representations per modality gives a mean accuracy drop of 0.10 percentage points relative to full candidate input, preserving classification performance with substantially fewer text and image representations.

</details>


### [1287] [Correct then Forecast: Observer State-Space Models for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33566)
*Alexis-Raja Brachet,Guillaume Clavier--Frémond,Abdelhakim Ziani,Pierre-Yves Richard,Céline Hudelot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Observer State-Space Models (OSSMs)，从控制理论的状态估计角度重新设计循环预测头，将观测值视为对潜在自主动力学系统状态的测量（修正项），而非控制输入。OSSM在14个数据集、4个预测时长、8种配置、6个种子共5,376次配对实验中，参数和训练协议完全一致的情况下，多数数据集上显著优于标准SSM预测头（如Electricity提升22.9%、NN5提升16.1%），且发散运行次数从225次降至96次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环预测模型（RNN/LSTM/SSM）在时间序列预测任务中，将观测值当作控制输入直接驱动潜在动力学，导致上下文区间（受控系统）与预测区间（自主系统）之间存在建模不一致与动力学跳变的问题。论文质疑这一建模假设并寻求一种内在一致的循环预测形式。

Method: 借鉴Luenberger观测器理论，提出OSSM：将观测序列解释为底层线性潜在动力系统的输出测量，潜在状态转移矩阵 A_O 在上下文和预测区间保持不变；当测量可用时（m_t=1），通过测量残差 (E(y_t) - ŷ_t) 和观测器增益 L_O 修正状态估计；当测量不可用时（m_t=0）则仅做自主传播。证明OSSM同时满足建模一致性、时间传播一致性、体制一致性三项性质。进一步证明传统闭环SSM和SpaceTime均可通过坐标变换重写为OSSM的特殊实例（但A_O与L_O、C_O存在耦合建模失配）。通过学习A_O、C_O、L_O三者并控制初始谱半径ρ(A_O)=0.9与ρ(A_O - L_O C_O)=0.91实现稳定训练。

Result: 在TFB基准14个数据集（ETT家族、Electricity、Traffic、Solar、Wind、Exchange、Weather、NN5、NYSE、NASDAQ、ILI）上的5,376次严格配对对比显示：OSSM在多数数据集的五项指标（MSE、MAE、WAPE、sMAPE、msMAPE）上一致优于标准SSM头部；最长预测时长下提升尤为显著（Electricity MSE提升22.9%、Traffic 12.2%、NN5 16.1%）；优化稳定性显著改善（发散次数96 vs 225）。但效果并不普遍适用——NASDAQ、ETTh2、Weather上效果接近持平，NYSE、ILI等部分结果不具统计显著性。论文强调该证据是受控设置下的归纳偏置优势，并非在所有数据集或所有现代TSF架构上的普遍优越性。

Conclusion: OSSM提供了一种满足三项一致性原则的循环预测形式，将"观测修正状态"与"动力学传播状态"显式解耦，是传统SSM和SpaceTime的统一重参数化视角。控制理论工具（如可观测性、误差收敛）为该设计提供了理论支撑。实验验证了"观测用于修正而非驱动动力学"这一简洁原则的有效性。未来方向包括：更通用SpaceTime兼容的解耦参数化、与更强编码器结合、以及扩展到间歇观测场景（自主传播桥接缺失区间）。

Abstract: Time series forecasting requires extrapolating the dynamics of an observed process beyond the last available measurement. Yet recurrent forecasting models typically treat observations as inputs that directly control their latent dynamics. It leads to a regime change when these observations become unavailable at prediction time. Following a state-estimation perspective, we introduce Observer State-Space Models (OSSMs), a class of recurrent models that interprets the observed input time series as measurements of an underlying autonomous dynamical system. OSSMs explicitly separate latent-state propagation from measurement assimilation: a single transition governs the dynamics across both context and forecasting intervals, while available observations correct the estimated state through an observer. This formulation naturally exposes classical control-theoretic properties, including observability and convergence of the state estimation error. We further show that conventional and recent SSMs can be recovered as particular instances of our OSSM framework, thereby providing a unified interpretation of their recurrent dynamics and revealing modeling inconsistencies. We perform experiments across several benchmarks showing that OSSM achieves substantial improvements while maintaining the same parameter count and training setup as the corresponding SSM baseline. These results support a simple principle for recurrent forecasting: observations should correct the estimated latent state, rather than control the dynamics used to propagate it.

</details>


### [1288] [HiLoRe: What to Store, Compress, or Recompute for Efficient GRPO Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33570)
*Xinrui Chen,Mengyang Li,Ou Wu,Ji Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HiLoRe，一种面向GRPO训练的激活管理框架，通过将恢复单元在精确存储(H)、低精度压缩(L)和重计算(R)之间进行分配，利用GRPO特有的策略更新暴露度(policy-update exposure)来指导状态保真度分配，从而在固定内存预算下提升actor-update吞吐量，同时保持训练质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO训练中学习器侧激活是内存-计算瓶颈；现有激活管理方法（梯度检查点、压缩、混合恢复）的固定调度在48GB GPU上会留下约18GB未利用内存，且未将GRPO分析更新结构纳入保真度分配。诊断分析显示54.8-73.6%的响应槽对策略梯度贡献为零，前10%槽承载52.4-66.8%的系数质量，表明更新存在显著稀疏性，可用于指导恢复决策。

Method: 核心方法包括：(1)策略更新暴露度——利用前向可精确计算的GRPO token级更新系数ω_t，结合图可达性J(A)和二阶灵敏度H_u，推导状态级梯度偏差上界；(2)图归因恢复单元——构建覆盖融合操作、共享输入、检查点边界的图有效单元；(3)校准近似风险——通过初始化校准建立susceptibility κ_c和平均重建误差，将暴露度与重建误差结合得到校准风险代理ψ_u；(4)联合H/L/R分配——在内存和保真度预算约束下，通过加性效用、内存和风险估计构建双约束多选择背包问题，用动态规划精确求解。

Result: 在五种模型-任务设置（Qwen2.5-3B/Phi-3.5-mini/Llama-3.1-8B × 数学/代码/逻辑推理）上，使用2K响应和≤1.10×B_GC内存预算，HiLoRe的actor-update吞吐量相比梯度检查点提升13.5%，相比最快评估基线提升7.9%，下游分数差异降低0.6个百分点以下；具体在Qwen2.5-3B上提升10.16%，Phi-3.5-mini上提升12.64%，Llama-3.1-8B上提升13.47%。重计算时间减少42.79%（从207.38s降至118.64s），平均相对梯度误差0.0091-0.0104，低于0.015阈值；后更新诊断回放中ψ_u预测器达到Spearman相关系数0.75-0.78。

Conclusion: HiLoRe验证了"恢复精度应遵循活动更新对保存状态的敏感度"的原则，结合GRPO分析更新结构与恢复效用，在内存和校准风险预算下实现H/L/R联合分配，显著提升GRPO训练效率且保持训练质量，为大语言模型RL后训练的高效激活恢复建立了基于更新信号的新范式。

Abstract: Group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) makes learner-side activations a major memory-computation bottleneck: gradient checkpointing reduces activation memory through recomputation, but fixed schedules can leave roughly 18 GB unused on a 48-GB GPU despite substantial recomputation overhead. Existing activation-management methods set state fidelity from execution cost, tensor properties, or generic compression sensitivity, without explicitly incorporating GRPO's analytic update structure into state-fidelity allocation. We formalize this dependence as policy-update exposure, linking the current GRPO loss coefficients to state-level approximation sensitivity. These coefficients are available before backward without an additional backward pass. We introduce HiLoRe, which allocates graph-attributed recovery units among high-precision storage, low-precision compression, and deterministic recomputation using measured recovery utility and update-conditioned approximation risk. It combines high-precision storage and deterministic recomputation with low-precision recovery under a calibrated risk budget. Across five model-task settings with 2K responses and memory < 1.10 times GC's per-GPU actor-update peak, HiLoRe's actor-update throughput gains reach 13.5% over GC and 7.9% over the fastest evaluated baseline, with paired mean downstream-score differences below 0.6 percentage points.

</details>


### [1289] [Approximating Softmax in Pretrained LLMs: Model Sensitivity and Kernel Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33586)
*Shangzhen Zhu,Muyan Hu,Tomasz Kozlowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在预训练LLM推理中近似softmax的可能性，提出Rowmax-PoT（一种以行最大值为锚点的对数权重近似）及其在B200硬件上的特化版本Rowmax-H15，在FlashAttention-4内核中以两值/八度近似指数运算，可在保持极低困惑度损失的同时显著加速注意力前向计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在NVIDIA Blackwell B200上，张量核吞吐量远超特殊函数单元的指数运算能力（两个数量级以上），使得融合注意力内核中的指数评估成为瓶颈。问题是：预训练Transformer是否真的需要在每个位置上精确评估softmax？论文旨在找出在冻结解码器模型中可以放宽的softmax计算属性，以及这些近似是否能加速融合注意力内核。

Method: 1. 在10个冻结的decoder-only模型（0.5B-72B）上进行受控干预实验，每次改变softmax的一个属性（支撑集、加权方式、区间数量、分配、重构、指数评估）；2. 基于WikiText-103 NLL和配对自助法置信区间评估；3. 提出Rowmax-PoT：以行最大值为锚点的粗粒度对数权重表示；4. 实现Rowmax-H15：FlashAttention-4内核特化，用{1, 1.5}×2^k的FP32位操作替代exp2；5. 在B200上测量FP8/BF16路径下的调用延迟、能耗和模型保真度。

Result: 1. 支撑集和网格分辨率可大幅削减（Qwen2.5-1.5B保留每行最大一半仅增加0.131%困惑度），但相同支撑上的均匀加权严重损害模型；2. 固定分辨率预算的放置位置与大小同样重要——行最大值附近的更高分辨率在10个模型中一致降低NLL；3. 标量失真匹配下，扁平化在7个模型中比锐化更有害，在2个模型中相反；4. Rowmax-PoT（K_max=20）在9/10模型中困惑度增加低于1%；5. Rowmax-H15在B200上：FP8因果8K注意力前向加速12.4%，非因果8K加速25.8%，16K因果每前向能耗降低8.4%；BF16路径2K下5个模型困惑度仅增加0.091-0.492%。

Conclusion: 冻结语言模型对softmax近似具有非平凡的容忍度——支撑集大小和网格分辨率可以大幅缩减，均匀加权则不可接受；分辨率应分配在行最大值附近，因为这些区域承载大部分注意力质量。Rowmax-H15证明了在FlashAttention-4中用半八度量化指数运算可以在保持极小模型保真度损失的同时获得显著的注意力前向计算加速和能效改进。然而，选择softmax近似需要通过模型NLL直接评估其对冻结模型的影响，而非仅依赖标量失真度量。

Abstract: On NVIDIA Blackwell B200, tensor-core throughput outpaces special-function exponential throughput by more than two orders of magnitude, exposing exponential evaluation in fused attention kernels. A pretrained Transformer, however, may not need it evaluated accurately at every element. We characterize what a pretrained model does need by approximating softmax at inference in ten frozen decoder-only models (0.5B-72B). The number of positions the softmax map assigns probability to and within-row resolution can be cut substantially, yet uniform weighting of the same positions is damaging. Where a fixed resolution budget is placed matters as much as its size, with resolution near the row maximum consistently favored. Perturbations matched on scalar distortion produce model-dependent responses of opposite sign. These findings motivate Rowmax-PoT, a coarse logarithmic weight representation anchored at each row maximum, and Rowmax-H15, its hardware specialization in FlashAttention-4. On B200, the patched FP8 attention forward is 12.4% faster at causal 8K and 25.8% faster at non-causal 8K in host-side call-latency measurements; board energy per forward falls by 8.4% at causal 16K. Measured separately on the BF16 kernel path at 2K, Rowmax-H15 increases perplexity by 0.091-0.492% across five models from three families.

</details>


### [1290] [TGRL: Temperature-Grouped Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Exploration in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33589)
*Zihan Lin,Xiaohan Wang,Jie Cao,Jiajun Chai,Wei Lin,Guojun Yin,Ran He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TGRL提出了一种温度分组的强化学习框架，通过将每个prompt的rollout组划分为低温和高温子组，利用奖励差估计探索增益，并通过JS散度将组级信号分配到token级信用，在不增加rollout预算的情况下显著提升LLM在数学推理、代码生成和智能体任务上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法中，探索效率是核心瓶颈。温度控制和测试时扩展策略虽能增加rollout多样性，但要么扩大采样预算，要么无法量化探索收益。本文旨在将温度诱导的多样性转化为显式的训练信号。

Method: TGRL将每个prompt的rollout组划分为低温参考组(T₀=0.3)和高温探索组(T₁=1.2)，通过两组的奖励差ΔR_g估计prompt级探索增益，并利用同一logits在两个温度下产生的next-token分布之间的JS散度作为token级信用分配权重，仅对高温组进行策略梯度更新。

Result: 在11个基准测试中，TGRL比强RLVR基线提升显著：32B模型数学平均提升1.6%，CodeForces评分提升196.7分，LiveCodeBench Pass@16提升4.4%，ALFWorld/WebShop成功率分别提升6.3%/4.9%；达到同等精度比DAPO快36%。

Conclusion: TGRL证明了采样温度不仅可作为解码参数，还可作为构建RLVR探索信号的工具。其混合温度分组和JS散度信用分配机制为高效RLVR探索提供了通用设计原则。

Abstract: Efficient exploration often remains a central bottleneck in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Although temperature control and test-time scaling strategies can increase rollout diversity of large language models (LLMs), they either expand the sample budget at rollout time or leave the benefit of exploration unquantified. To this end, we propose Temperature-Grouped Reinforcement Learning (TGRL), which turns temperature-induced diversity into an explicit training signal. For each prompt, TGRL partitions its rollout group into low- and high-temperature subsets, estimates exploration gain through their reward contrast, and allocates this group-level signal as token-level credit using Jensen--Shannon (JS) divergence between the corresponding temperature-scaled next-token distributions induced by the same logits. Notably, TGRL reaches equivalent accuracy up to 36% faster than strong RLVR baselines without expanding the rollout budget. Across 11 benchmarks from diverse domains, TGRL broadly improves over strong RLVR baselines: it improves the six-benchmark math average by 1.6% at 32B, raises CodeForces rating by 196.7 points and LiveCodeBench Pass@16 by 4.4%, and improves ALFWorld/WebShop success rates by 6.3%/4.9%. Comprehensive ablations and wall-clock analysis confirm the efficacy of all proposed components. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1291] [Pretraining Transformers with Quantized Softmax in Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33591)
*Shangzhen Zhu,Muyan Hu,Tomasz Kozlowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究系统分析了Transformer预训练中使用K区间量化softmax（K-interval attention）时，前向近似（校准策略、重建方式）与反向传播规则（代理梯度放置位置）之间的相互作用及其对预训练性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低精度Transformer系统倾向于量化注意力矩阵乘法，但softmax通常保持高精度。在预训练阶段，近似softmax同时改变前向计算和梯度反向传播，现有研究对训练时使用低精度指数重建的可行性存在分歧。该研究旨在厘清量化softmax在预训练中的前向-反向交互机制。

Method: 提出"K区间注意力"算子族，围绕三个设计轴展开：（1）校准策略（MinMax逐行极差校准 vs FWM固定窗口锚定行最大值）；（2）重建方式（分段线性插值LERP vs 最近邻取整Nearest）；（3）代理梯度（STE）放置位置（未归一化权重层Weight-STE vs 归一化概率层Prob-STE）。推导包含校准导数项的完整反向梯度公式和零和恒等式。设计了四个匹配实验套件（Suite A-D），涵盖124M到1B参数、100M到2.5B训练token、FineWebEdu和WikiText-103语料，并在五种种子上进行验证。

Result: 主要发现：（1）断开行极值的梯度（detach）保持前向不变但引发延迟训练失败，差距达+0.65至+3.07 nats，仅恢复零和恒等式不能修复；（2）K=4时MinMax×Weight-STE组合产生巨大损失差距（+0.39 nats@250M，+0.89 nats@2.5B），但改为Prob-STE或FWM中任一项即可大幅缩小差距；（3）保留仅行最大值梯度即可恢复98%以上差距，而保留仅最小值梯度几乎无效；（4）LERP在2.5B token下K∈{4,16,32}时与softmax差距≤0.005 nats；FWM-Weight K=16为+0.004 nats；（5）下游任务中大差距条件普遍低于softmax，但小NLL差距不等价于下游任务等价；（6）MinMax-Weight K=4在训练中引发严重的几何反馈：行跨度增长7倍，99.5%概率质量坍缩到单一量化桶。

Conclusion: 预训练中使用量化softmax同时取决于前向近似和反向规则。完整的校准梯度（含行极值导数）至关重要；硬重建下校准策略和代理放置位置强烈影响训练质量；FWM校准与Prob-STE具有替代性；分段插值重建在足够训练预算下可接近softmax性能；但小NLL差距不构成下游任务等价性。因此评估近似softmax算子应联合考虑其校准、重建和反向规则三个维度。

Abstract: Low-precision Transformer systems increasingly quantize attention matrix multiplications, while softmax often remains at higher precision. During pretraining, an approximate softmax changes the gradients that train the model as well as its forward computation. We study this interaction with K-interval attention, which approximates the exponential using K+1 grid values. We vary per-row grid calibration, interpolation versus hard rounding, and the placement of a straight-through surrogate relative to normalization. We derive the corresponding backward rules, including calibration derivatives, and compare these choices in pretraining experiments matched on model, data, and optimizer. Detaching the row extrema leaves the forward computation unchanged but produces a delayed increase in validation loss. With hard rounding at K=4, min-max calibration and a pre-normalization surrogate incur a large loss gap; changing either choice substantially reduces it. At 124M parameters and 2.5B training tokens, fixed-window calibration with a post-normalization surrogate yields a validation loss gap of +0.019 nats relative to softmax at K=4, and with a pre-normalization surrogate yields +0.004 nats at K=16.

</details>


### [1292] [Short-Length Code Designs for Integrated Sensing and Communications: A Deep Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33605)
*Muah Kim,Shuangyang Li,Tayyebeh Jahani-Nezhad,Rafael F. Schaefer,Giuseppe Caire*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对短包长非相干ISAC场景，提出了一种基于自编码器(AE)的联合波形设计框架。通过推导多目标时延估计的修正克拉美罗下界(MCRB)和相关衰落下的非相干最大似然解码规则，揭示了通信与感知目标在波形设计上的结构联系与权衡，并利用可调参数γ控制通信-感知折中。仿真结果表明，所提方案在短包长和衰落条件下的通信可靠性和感知精度均优于传统方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISAC系统需要共享波形同时实现通信和感知功能，但在短包长(10-200符号)区域，传统基于渐近块长分析的编码理论不再适用，且导频辅助信道估计开销过大，非相干检测成为必然选择。因此，如何在短包长非相干条件下联合设计同时优化通信和感知性能的波形是一个核心难题，现有深度学习方法也未充分解决这一问题。

Method: 1) 系统建模：单载波频率平坦Rayleigh相关衰落通信信道(Jakes-Clarke模型，多普勒参数f_D表征相关程度)与Toeplitz结构感知信道(多目标时延估计)。2) 理论分析：推导非相干ML解码规则(闭式似然函数)和多目标时延估计的MCRB(对角FIM)，分析两种极端相关情况(ρ_c=0,1)下的成对错误概率和期望LLR。3) AE框架：编码器f_θ将K比特消息映射为长度N功率归一化码字，解码器g_θ输出软判决；损失函数为加权和ℓ_j = γℓ_c + (1-γ)ℓ_s，其中通信损失采用BCE，感知损失采用归一化MCRB均值；采用迭代训练策略(RX 5 epochs + TX 1 epoch)。4) 三种架构：CNN、Turbo-CNN、Turbo-RNN，实值码率1/3，复数等效2/3。

Result: 1) 通信性能：在K=6, N=9短包长配置下，AE在完全相关、部分相关(f_D=0.1)和不相关衰落三种场景的BER均优于CC-DBPSK、BPSK、BASK等传统方案；尤其在弱相关低中SNR区域增益显著；在N=90中等短包长时，联合设计γ=0.5可同时接近通信和感知最优曲线。2) 感知性能：AE学习码字的MCRB低于ZC序列、BPSK和1H-OOK；学习到的星座呈现PSK类结构但幅度非均匀(功率分配不均)，验证了理论分析；匹配滤波检测的MSE在非中断情况下接近MCRB/CRLB。3) 折中特性：γ从0到1连续调节BER-MCRB Pareto曲线，在弱相关条件下折中更明显；DBPSK和ZC等基方案落在Pareto曲线之外，表明折中效率较低。4) 鲁棒性：混合数据集训练改善最差情况性能但非各场景最优；高多普勒训练模型对信道相关变化更鲁棒。

Conclusion: 本文提出的AE框架能够在短包长非相干ISAC场景下有效联合设计通信与感知波形，通过单一参数γ实现可控的BER-感知精度折中。学习到的波形在低中SNR和弱相关衰落条件下显著优于传统方案。理论分析揭示了通信(变幅度+强分量错位)与感知(主特征向量方向+相位旋转不变性)在码字设计上的结构相似性与差异，为理解ISAC折中提供了理论依据。未来工作包括扩展到联合时延-多普勒估计、动态目标数P、以及引入恒模/峰均比等硬件约束。

Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables joint communication and sensing using a shared waveform, but its signal design is challenging due to the inherent trade-off between the two objectives, particularly in the short blocklength regime. This paper proposes an autoencoder (AE)-based framework for ISAC waveform design in noncoherent settings. We derive a modified Cramér-Rao bound for multi-target delay estimation and analyze the maximum-likelihood decoding rule for noncoherent communication under correlated fading. These results reveal structural connections and trade-offs between communication and sensing objectives in waveform design. Based on this analysis, the AE learns waveform representations that jointly optimize both functionalities, with a tunable parameter controlling the trade-off. Simulation results show that the proposed design outperforms conventional schemes in both communication reliability and sensing accuracy, especially under short blocklength and fading conditions.

</details>


### [1293] [Hierarchical Response Preservation for Continual Adaptation of Zero-Shot Graph-Text Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33607)
*Haopeng Zhang,Yuhan Wang,Yubing Su,Yingxin Chen,Xiao Wang,Ruijie Wang,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HiRP（分层响应保持）框架，用于预训练图-文本模型的跨域类增量持续适应。HiRP通过分层响应（保留每个历史类别概率并将新类别概率聚合）解决新类别推翻历史预测和过度严格响应保持阻碍新类别学习的两个挑战，并利用响应几何指导受约束更新。在三类增量设置中，HiRP在平均准确率上比最强基线绝对提升1.84-7.95个百分点，同时缓解零样本迁移性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练图-文本模型（如GraphCLIP）通过将图表示与文本语义对齐，实现未见类别的零样本识别和跨图域迁移。但当图数据和类别持续到达时，模型需要学习新监督的同时保留零样本迁移能力和历史任务知识，存在两个挑战：(1) 新类别可能推翻历史预测，即使历史类别间的区分得以保持；(2) 过于严格的响应保持会阻碍新类别学习。简单的参数约束或保留历史输出不足以保证扩展候选空间中的预测稳定性。

Method: HiRP包含三个连接步骤：(1) 共享表示——冻结图和文本编码器，仅适配读出器W；(2) 分层竞争响应——保持每个历史类别概率p_q_o，并将当前类别概率聚合为q_N；(3) KL约束更新——使用同一响应KL定义每步漂移约束（局部δ=0.002）和任务级漂移约束（ρ=0.1），以及局部Fisher度量G_k=F_k+λI（λ=0.01）。当任务级KL达到95%预算边界且当前更新有外向分量时，执行切线修正（去除一阶外向分量并保留切线运动），结合非线性KL可行性检查。核心定理给出预测稳定性的充分条件：D_H < δ_R²/2 ⇒ 历史胜者类别保持预测稳定。通过KL链规则，分层响应KL分解为聚合群体竞争KL和历史条件结构KL。算法使用共轭梯度法求解隐式Fisher积，最多12次迭代；采用48步区间搜索进行可行性检查。

Result: 在三个类增量设置（4数据集/4任务、6数据集/6任务、4数据集/10任务）上，HiRP在FA上分别超过最强基线3.45、3.04和13.43个百分点，在AA上分别提升1.84、2.51和7.95个百分点。在History域零样本迁移上，HiRP从初始49.69%保持到52.64%，而GraphCLIP联合微调降至1.46%。消融实验显示分层响应与切线修正需联合设计，单独使用切线修正对Mass响应收益不一致。单图设置（Cora, CiteSeer, WikiCS, Photo）上HiRP均达最优，FA分别为75.09%、73.88%、74.22%、71.23%。定理1的实证覆盖率在80.86%-96.42%之间，认证对中无一例发生正确到错误的改变。训练时间显著低于GraphGPT、LLaGA、InfLoRA和SD-LoRA。

Conclusion: 研究证明仅保留历史类别间的区分不足以应对新候选进入预测空间：历史类别与新类之间的竞争同样重要。HiRP通过分层响应捕获这些关系，并利用该响应约束和引导读出器更新。在三个类增量流上，它提升了统一分类性能并缓解了保留域上的零样本退化。结果表明持续适应受益于识别应保留的预测关系并在由此产生的约束内更新模型。局限性包括聚合当前质量允许组内变化、有界支持可能遗漏历史区域、任务入口参考可能已包含候选插入错误。

Abstract: Pretrained graph-text models align graph representations with textual semantics, enabling recognition of unseen classes and transfer across graph domains. However, as graph data and classes continually arrive, models should learn from new supervision while retaining their zero-shot transfer capabilities and historical task knowledge. Two challenges arise: (i) new classes can overturn historical predictions despite preserved distinctions among historical classes, and (ii) overly strict response preservation can stall learning of new classes. To address these challenges, we propose Hierarchical Response Preservation (HiRP). HiRP represents this competition through a hierarchical response that keeps each historical-class probability and sums new-class probabilities, preserving historical distinctions and aggregate competition while allowing distinctions within the new class group to adapt. It further uses the geometry induced by this response to guide constrained updates, retaining useful adaptation directions while controlling response drift. Across three class-incremental settings, HiRP achieves absolute gains of 1.84-7.95 percentage points in average accuracy over the strongest compared baseline in each setting, while mitigating zero-shot transfer degradation.

</details>


### [1294] [You Only Edit Once: Incentivizing In-Context Capability of LLMs via Local Demonstration Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33609)
*Jiarong Wen,Qi Wang,Yun Qu,Yixiu Mao,Heming Zou,Haoang Chi,Lizhou Cai,Yiqin Lv,Kaiyu Zhang,Yuhang Jiang,Xiangyang Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出局部演示编辑（LDE）方法，将少样本上下文学习（ICL）中的演示选择问题重新定义为约束局部搜索问题。训练一个小型LLM（Jev-LDE，基于Qwen3-1.7B），使用GRPO强化学习从冻结目标模型的二值正确性反馈中学习，对检索到的演示集执行单次结构化编辑（Keep、Delete或Replace）。测试时只需一次编辑加一次目标推理，避免迭代上下文评分。实验显示Jev-LDE在分类基准上显著优于现有选择器，并在未见基准/模型上具有良好的可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1）ICL性能高度依赖演示示例的选择与质量，而穷举子集搜索是组合爆炸问题；2）现有选择器依赖相关性或似然代理，且需要反复查询目标LLM，开销大；3）作者观察到对初始检索集做一次成员编辑即可显著提升准确率，暗示大部分潜在增益集中在单步编辑邻域内。因此动机是用单次结构化编辑替代全局子集搜索，以更高效地激发LLM的ICL能力。

Method: 1）将k-shot演示选择定义为组合优化问题（Eq.1），定义"单编辑邻域"为与初始集替换距离≤1的集合（Def.2）；2）LDE形式化（Eq.2）：在单编辑约束下最大化目标LLM的对数似然；3）训练Jev-LDE（小LLM编辑器π_φ），输入为任务指令、查询x、初始Z₀、替换候选集C⁻，输出JSON格式动作（Keep/Delete/Replace）；4）奖励采用可验证奖励（RLVR）：r=𝕀[目标LLM预测=金标]，用冻结Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct提供反馈；5）优化目标为带组相对优势的GRPO（clipped objective，Eq.J_GRPO）；6）训练态筛选：仅保留探测动作中同时包含0和1奖励的状态，确保RL信号有效；7）推理时温度为0，单次编辑+单次目标推理，解析失败回退到Keep。

Result: 1）主实验（Table 1）：在TREC、DBPedia、Banking77×4个目标LLM（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3-8B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B）×k∈{1,2,3,4}共48组配置中，Jev-LDE在46组上优于Semantic TopK初始化，44组取得最佳或并列最佳；one-shot平均准确率从81.2%提升至88.1%；2）迁移能力（Fig.5）：在DeepSeek-V4-Flash+TACRED/TREC-50（完全未见模型+基准）上Jev-LDE在所有shot预算下均带来提升（0.3–4.4点）；Qwen目标35/36组改善，Banking77 14/16组改善，SST-2全部改善；3）预选择器消融（图6右）：将Jev-LDE应用于BM25/CASE/TopK+ConE的初始化，24/24组合均带来改善；4）候选池消融：默认N=16效果最佳（80.6%），扩大至N=32反而下降（79.4%）；5）RLVR消融（图7）：Jev-LDE 65.6% > 直接prompt的Llama-3-8B编辑器57.8% > Keep 52.8% > Qwen3-1.7B未训练31.2% > Random 23.2%，证明RL后训练价值；6）计算成本（图8）：one-shot TREC上Jev-LDE比TopK+ConE快得多，仅比Semantic TopK增加11%端到端时间；7）大shot预算（附录E）：8-shot和16-shot下Jev-LDE在18/24配置上仍优于TopK；8）局限：GSM8K改善不明显，AQuA-RAT在两个目标上分别下降0.8和1.9点。

Conclusion: 1）LDE将演示选择重新定义为受约束的局部搜索问题，通过单次结构化成员编辑平衡性能增益与搜索效率；2）Jev-LDE作为轻量级、即插即用的System-1模块，通过RL（GRPO+RLVR）学习目标模型反馈驱动的单编辑策略，无需目标模型迭代查询；3）该方法在分类任务中达到最佳或并列最佳，并且无需重训练即可泛化到未见基准和目标LLM；4）理论分析（Prop.1）给出单替换覆盖度的几何尾界，Prop.2给出反馈复杂度与动作空间大小成线性关系的PAC风格界，为局部编辑提供理论支撑；5）局限：对数学推理任务（GSM8K/AQuA-RAT）改善有限或为负，且单编辑约束无法恢复候选池外的有用示例。整体结论是：学习的局部编辑是增强少样本ICL的实用方法。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) is crucial for boosting the inference performance of large language models (LLMs). However, the effectiveness of ICL in LLMs is greatly influenced by the choice of demonstration sets. Exhaustive searches over these sets are combinatorial, and existing selectors often rely on relevance or likelihood proxies to implicitly assess ICL quality. Making repeated queries to the target LLM with these strategies can incur substantial costs. This work simplifies selection by framing it as a constrained local search problem and presents local demonstration editing (LDE). Starting with an initially retrieved set of demonstrations, LDE employs a single structured edit to explore its surrounding neighborhood while balancing performance gains with search costs. Technically, LDE is reduced to a policy search problem, for which we train a small LLM, referred to as Jev-LDE. This model as the System-1 modifies the retrieved demonstration set by performing actions such as \texttt{Keep}, \texttt{Delete}, or \texttt{Replace} elements, all within a framework of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. At test time, Jev-LDE executes a single edit of the retrieved demonstration set, followed by one inference from the target LLM, avoiding the need for iterative context scoring or subset searches. Across standard classification benchmarks, various target LLMs with Jev-LDE as the plug-and-play module consistently improve ICL performance, and Jev-LDE shows transferability to held-out benchmarks and models without retraining. These findings indicate that the LDE approach offers an efficient and adaptable method for harnessing the ICL capabilities of target LLMs.

</details>


### [1295] [Climbing the Hill: Prompt Injection Red-Teaming Against Frontier Models with Curriculum Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33628)
*Chenlong Yin,Xiaolong Jin,Wei Zou,Yanting Wang,Jinyuan Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于课程学习（curriculum learning）的方法来解决RL-based提示注入红队攻击中的冷启动问题，通过按目标LLM稳健性递增的顺序训练攻击者LLM，成功攻击了前沿LLM，并发现训练后的攻击者LLM具有跨目标模型的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的提示注入红队方法（如PISmith、RL-Hammer）在攻击前沿大语言模型（如GPT-5.6系列）时面临严重的冷启动问题：初始攻击者LLLM对所有攻击尝试均失败，获得零奖励，导致无学习信号可用。简单的"先弱后强"课程设计同样无法解决此问题，因此需要一种系统性的课程设计原则。

Method: 核心方法是在目标LLM空间上构建课程：
1. **冷启动问题分析**：形式化定义"informative group"的概率Λ_K，证明当前状态下Λ_K坍缩至零
2. **目标课程构建**：固定训练任务，按目标LLM稳健性递增顺序训练单一攻击者LLM，每阶段从前一阶段攻击者LLM热启动
3. **设计原则**：每阶段结束后，攻击者LLM必须对下一阶段目标有"部分成功"（non-zero pre-stage ASR），确保能采样到informative group
4. **预测试机制**：通过廉价的pre-stage ASR测试判断课程阶段是否可训练（Algorithm 1）
5. **迁移利用**：利用已训练的攻击者LLM作为新目标的初始化，通过继续RL训练进一步提升效果

Result: 在AgentDyn基准上：
- **GPT-5.6-Luna攻击**：ASR@10达93.8%（PISmith/RL-Hammer均为0%）
- **GPT-5.6-Terra攻击**：通过三阶段课程（GPT-5-nano→GPT-5.6-Luna→GPT-5.6-Terra）ASR@10达45.0%（直接训练仅1.6%）
- **跨目标迁移**：在GPT-5.6-Terra上训练的攻击者LLM对6个未见目标LLM均有非零ASR@10（21.8%~95.4%）
- **跨基准迁移**：在AgentDyn训练后在AgentDojo上仍有效（GPT-5.6-Luna上ASR@10达72.5%）
- **持续训练**：以已训练模型初始化，对Muse-Spark-1.2继续训练后ASR@10从35.5%提升至82.3%

Conclusion: 课程设计是攻击成功的核心——简单的"弱→强"策略不足以解决冷启动问题，必须确保每阶段过渡时的"部分成功"条件。前沿LLM及现有防御（如SecOPD）对自适应提示注入攻击仍存在显著脆弱性，训练所得攻击者LLM具备良好的跨目标和跨基准迁移能力，可作为新目标红队评估的可重用起点。

Abstract: Prompt injection is a leading security risk for LLMs and LLM-based applications such as agents. State-of-the-art red-teaming methods for prompt injection leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to train an attacker LLM to generate effective injected prompts. However, when targeting frontier LLMs such as GPT-6-Luna, a major challenge is the cold-start problem: every attack attempt by the attacker LLM fails and thus receives zero reward, providing no signal for learning. In this work, we propose a curriculum learning-based method to address the cold-start problem. In particular, we propose to train the attacker LLM against a sequence of increasingly robust target LLMs, with each stage warm-starting from the attacker LLM obtained in the previous one. However, simply training against a weak target (e.g., GPT-4o-mini) may not sufficiently prepare the attacker LLM to obtain useful learning signals against a frontier LLM (e.g., GPT-5.6-Terra). Instead, we find that the design of the curriculum is critical: after each stage, the attacker LLM needs to partially succeed against the next target LLM such that it can learn from successful attempts to attack the new target. Our extensive evaluation shows that our method can effectively red-team frontier LLMs, achieving an attack success rate (ASR@10) of 93.8\% and 45.0\% against GPT-5.6-Luna and GPT-5.6-Terra on AgentDyn, whereas state-of-the-art RL methods such as RL-Hammer and PISmith achieve 0\% ASR under the same setting. Moreover, we find that the attacker LLM transfers across targets, e.g., an attacker LLM trained to defeat one strong LLM (GPT-5.6-Terra) also succeeds against six other frontier LLMs (e.g., GPT-6-Luna) it was never trained on. Our code is available at \href{ this https URL }{here}.

</details>


### [1296] [Quantifying Behavioral Tails in Black-Box Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33638)
*Elsayed Eshra,Ali Al-Lawati,Dongwon Lee,Suhang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RareTrap是一个黑盒框架，通过代理LLM的嵌入几何构造潜在空间到离散提示的映射，诱导明确的参考提示分布，并结合序贯蒙特卡洛（Subset Simulation）估计大语言模型在严重响应行为（如过度生成、退化重复）下的超越概率，可在仅约200次评估内解析低至10⁻⁴的尾部概率，应用于12个开源及前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM安全评估在分布尾部（即严重行为罕见事件）缺乏统计分辨率：直接评估在低概率区域失去精度，红队方法虽能引出失败但丧失概率解释。需要在显式参考提示分布下量化严重行为的超越概率，以辅助模型开发者优先对齐工作并管理风险。

Method: 框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 几何感知的潜在到提示映射——从标准高斯潜在变量出发，通过代理模型的token嵌入协方差和低维正交投影构造连续slot，再经最近token离散化与代理解码生成提示，从而诱导显式的离散提示分布ℙ_S；(2) 基于Subset Simulation的序贯蒙特卡洛方法——通过嵌套中间事件和分量Metropolis-Hastings采样，分解小目标概率为一系列更大的条件概率之积，同时保留参考分布下的概率解释，仅需对目标模型进行prompt-response级别的黑盒访问。

Result: 在10个开源模型和2个前沿模型（GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6）上的42组评估中，RareTrap均能到达目标事件并在最多4层（3700次评估）内返回概率估计，最低解析至约10⁻⁴的超越概率。Phi-4-reasoning几乎所有提示都触发过度生成（p̂_F=1.0），Qwen3-14B则仅约4×10⁻³。估计结果与直接蒙特卡洛一致，且逐次条件化使响应严重度的P25/中位数/P75系统性升高，证明尾部富集。消融实验表明嵌入几何感知的映射在多数模型上比嵌入无关的高斯投影产生更高的严重度。框架还揭示了多种定性失败模式（如忽略停止信号、固定框架漂移、单符号坍缩等）。

Conclusion: RareTrap将稀有行为评估从孤立引出推进到在指定提示分布下对行为尾部的概率化表征，为跨模型尾部风险比较提供共同基础。该框架仅需API访问，适用于闭源前沿模型；其估计的尾部概率是相对参考分布的受控度量而非部署流行率。局限在于概率估计准确性仅在蒙特卡洛可验证范围内验证、更深概率未经验证，离散响应度量中的平局未显式处理，模型修复未在研究范围内。

Abstract: We introduce RareTrap, a framework for estimating the probability of severe behaviors in black box large language models (LLMs). A key challenge for probability estimation is defining a tractable distribution over the input space. To accomplish that, RareTrap uses a surrogate LLM and constructs a geometry-aware mapping from a lower-dimensional latent reference space into its token-embedding space to induce an explicit and reproducible distribution over input prompts. A response-level performance function is utilized on the response to quantify behavior severity. This enables sequential rare event simulation that concentrates evaluations on progressively more severe behaviors while preserving probability under the induced prompt distribution, which would otherwise be prohibitive to measure. Across 10 open-weight and two frontier models (GPT-5.4 and Claude Sonnet 4.6), we find that RareTrap successfully induces severe resource consumption behaviors and computes their probability with as few as 200 evaluations. RareTrap provides model developers a principled approach for evaluating language models under a common distribution, and prioritizing alignment effort to improve safety and mitigate risks. Code is published online: this https URL .

</details>


### [1297] [SafeMol: Dual-Modality Safety Alignment for Molecular Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33640)
*Xinmiao Wang,Ruijie Wang,Menghui Wang,Jiawei Chen,Haoyue Deng,Ran Zhang,Xingxuan Zhang,Xiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了SafeMolBench基准和SafeMol框架，系统研究并解决了分子多模态模型在处理危险分子时的安全对齐问题。SafeMol通过参数高效的方式联合优化文本和图条件输入下的安全性、过度拒绝和实用性，显著降低了攻击成功率，同时保持了较低的过度拒绝率和分子任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子多模态模型在整合分子图与语言模型时引入了新的安全漏洞，特别是在处理危险化合物相关的操作请求时。现有研究表明，多模态适配会降低原始语言模型的安全行为，且不同模态条件下的安全对齐效果难以泛化。此外，需要在安全性、过度拒绝和任务实用性之间取得平衡，而非简单拒绝所有涉及危险分子的请求。

Method: 1. 构建SafeMolBench基准（3702样本，涵盖618种危险分子），包含危险-有害（H）、危险-允许（A）和效用-回放（U）三个子集；2. 提出SafeMol参数高效安全对齐框架，采用四个可训练组件：跨模态投影器、Safety-LoRA、危险分类头和操作意图分类头；3. 使用MMD（最大均值差异）在分布层面对齐图与文本表示；4. 通过信息瓶颈理论统一四个损失函数（SFT+MMD+危险分类+操作意图分类）。

Result: 在Omni-Mol v2上，尝试率分别降低50和90个百分点，过程成功率降低38和66个百分点；ORR-A从2%/5%降至1%，且在文本条件下所有BLEU和ROUGE指标均优于原始模型。在ReactXT上也实现显著安全提升（额外GPU时间<4小时，仅占原始训练约0.6%）。在16个分子任务中，14个保留了80%以上的原始性能。隐藏状态分析表明SafeMol有效减少了图条件与无图条件之间的表示差距。

Conclusion: SafeMol有效解决了分子多模态模型的安全对齐挑战，通过参数高效设计在安全性、过度拒绝和实用性三者间取得良好平衡。该框架具有强泛化能力（OOD指令测试验证），且对原始分子任务能力影响较小，为分子多模态模型的安全部署提供了可行方案。研究强调了模态鲁棒性安全对齐的必要性，以及将分子危险性与操作意图解耦的重要性。

Abstract: Molecular multimodal models support diverse understanding and generation tasks but may introduce safety vulnerabilities when handling hazardous molecules. In this work, We reveal substantial jailbreak vulnerabilities under both text-only and graph-conditioned settings. Our analysis further shows that safety robustness must hold across input modalities while balancing safety, over-refusal, and utility. To address these challenges, we construct SafeMolBench, a molecular multimodal safety-alignment benchmark with 3702 samples covering 618 unique hazardous molecules and safe molecular tasks, organized into hazardous-harmful, hazardous-allowed, and utility-replay subsets to support unified training and evaluation of safety, over-refusal, and utility. Based on SafeMolBench, we propose SafeMol, a parameter-efficient safety alignment framework that jointly optimizes lightweight modules across text-only and graph-conditioned inputs, uses MMD for distribution-level representation alignment to reduce modality-induced discrepancies, and explicitly models molecular hazardousness and harmful operational intent. Experiments on SafeMolBench show that SafeMol reduces attack success by several tens of percentage points while largely maintaining low over-refusal and preserving molecular-task utility.

</details>


### [1298] [FuseAlign: Forced Alignment in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33650)
*Mithilesh Vaidya,Stephen Bailey,Sumukh Badam,Matthew Bendel,Xingzhe He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对实际媒体与数据处理场景中词级强制对齐任务的评估与建模两大缺口，提出了新的评估协议、新的多样化基准 AlignBench，以及基于 Transformer 的强制对齐器 FuseAlign。FuseAlign 在真实长音频、噪声、口音与 ASR 转写条件下显著优于 Gentle、MFA、Nyra、MMS-FA 与 WhisperX 等基线；消融实验表明卷积上采样与 EMA 标签校正比模型规模更关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强制对齐的评估存在三个不足：(1) 基准语料多为短而干净的朗读语音，缺乏真实长音频、多说话人、口音多样、噪声与混响等条件；(2) 传统指标（如对称边界 MAE、按边界独立阈值计分、仅对已对齐词打分）掩盖了真正影响编辑/应用的失败模式；(3) 评测均基于与音频完全一致的人工转写，忽略了实际媒体与数据流水线中 ASR 转写常含替换/删除/插入错误。此外，现有对齐器在精度与对转写/发音错误的鲁棒性之间存在固有权衡：词典+HMM 系统依赖发音词典与全局 Viterbi 解码，易受局部错配连锁影响；CTC 对齐器目标不直接监督词边界；语音 LLM 对齐器时间戳分辨率太粗。

Method: 1) 评估框架：提出非对称边界误差（仅惩罚切进语音的位移，落在静默区间内为零），按词最差边界阈值计分（编辑应用需两端皆可），并对所有转写词打分（含 fallback 区间）以公平对比不同拒绝词策略的系统；扩展至 ASR 转写：基于最小编辑距离匹配 ASR 与参考词，仅在完全匹配上计算边界指标，并定义含插入/替换词的检测 P/R/F1。2) AlignBench 基准：73 个片段、约 0.83 小时、8072 词，源自 People's Speech、VoxPopuli、AMI，覆盖 21.9% 非美音、27.4% 多说话人、9.6% 难写词；按目标分布分层采样；三位标注员独立标注每词边界，以多数投票决定相邻词是否相接。3) FuseAlign 模型：基于联合音频-文本 Transformer（12 层、宽度 1024、冻结 Dia TTS 文本编码器），文本 token 通过分数位置嵌入均匀展开到音频时间轴，形成"软对角线"注意力先验；用 16 ms 音频 patch 经 4 段转置卷积上采样到 1 ms 输出网格，分别预测词开始/结束热图；通过 mean-pool 文本表征得到每词向量，由 MLP 映射为分类器 W_s、W_e 与存在概率 p，对未在音频中出现的词（5% 随机插入作为负样本）输出空区间；训练采用 σ=10 ms 高斯软目标的 Focal BCE 损失 + 软 argmax 平滑 L1 距离损失（线性段 300 ms/30 s），并通过 EMA 快照集成在 20k 步后启动在线标签校正；长音频通过 ASR 粗时间戳路由至重叠 chunk 拼接。

Result: 在 AlignBench（手校正转写）上 FuseAlign 的 >300 ms 灾难率仅 0.38%，为基线最低（Gentle 2.11%、MFA 4.15%、Nyra 1.28%、MMS-FA 2.49%、WhisperX 1.41%）；平均非对称误差 17.16 ms，显著低于 Gentle 31.43、MFA 73.00、Nyra 33.18；在 Whisper 高噪声转写下 FuseAlign 仍保持 1.71% 灾难率与 32.82 ms 平均误差，远优于 MFA（10.82%/374.26 ms）。在干净朗读 TIMIT 上 Nyra 略优（FuseAlign 在 >300 ms 与 50 ms 上与 Nyra 统计持平），Buckeye 上 FuseAlign 在尾部分布（>300 ms：0.40% vs Nyra 0.59%）与 Whisper 转写下最佳；F1 检测上 MFA/Nyra 常接近 100%，表明检测能力与边界精度需分别评估。子组分析：多说话人片段对所有系统均更难，FuseAlign 在单/多说话人两侧均为最佳；难写词（数字、缩写、命名实体等）对词典-HMM 系统影响更大。消融（Table 4）：60M–415M 参数模型性能相近，821M 反而更差；patch 大小、文本表征、批量大小、音频增广等改动小；卷积上采样（1 ms→16 ms 网格使平均误差由 17.16→21.62 ms）、EMA 标签校正（灾难率由 0.38%→0.68%，Whisper 下由 1.71%→2.71%）与软 argmax 损失贡献最大。协议消融（Table 8）：分块推理大幅降低 MFA/Nyra 的长音频漂移但损害 Gentle/WhisperX；不做文本规范化使 MFA 平均误差上升 9.23 ms、WhisperX 上升 13.68 ms；仅对已对齐词打分低估 Gentle 的真实失败。

Conclusion: 文章证明：干净的朗读语音基准无法代表真实强制对齐部署条件；非对称误差、按词最差边界与全词打分能更直接反映编辑相关失败；ASR 转写错误主要影响对齐分布的尾部而非细粒度精度。FuseAlign 通过联合音频-文本上下文、1 ms 卷积上采样、存在检测头与 EMA 在线标签校正，在多样化长音频与含错转写条件下均取得最佳或与最佳统计持平的性能，且对模型规模不敏感。局限性：训练依赖伪对齐语料（需合适的引导对齐器），长音频推理仍需粗时间戳路由；未来工作可降低对引导对齐器的依赖并将长音频路由整合进对齐模型本身。

Abstract: Word-level forced alignment estimates when each transcript word occurs in an audio recording. It underpins text-based media editing, subtitling, speech-data curation, and phonetic analysis. Existing evaluations understate the difficulty of forced alignment by relying on short, clean speech, perfect transcripts, and metrics that obscure consequential alignment errors. In contrast, real-world media and data-processing pipelines operate on long and diverse recordings. Additionally, forced aligners often operate on error-prone automatic speech recognition (ASR) output. We address these gaps with improved evaluation metrics, a scoring protocol for real ASR transcripts, and AlignBench, a benchmark spanning diverse speaker, acoustic, and text conditions. We further introduce FuseAlign, a transformer-based aligner trained on large-scale pseudo-labeled speech with online label correction. FuseAlign performs joint contextualization of audio and text for the localization of coarse words. The model then refines boundaries at millisecond resolution and detects missing transcript words in the audio without lexicon-based or Viterbi decoding. On AlignBench, FuseAlign substantially outperforms all baselines and remains robust under real ASR transcripts. Ablations show that convolutional upsampling and EMA-snapshot label correction matter more than model properties such as parameter count.

</details>


### [1299] [Towards Eliminating Catastrophic Forgetting in the Curriculum Learning of Math Reasoning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33655)
*Zengyan Yang,Yangyang Wu,Kai Huang,Pengfei Lyu,Tianyi Zhang,Mengying Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究课程学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，理论证明了遗忘源于课程任务最优参数的差异（这种差异正是课程学习加速收敛所必需的），并提出IV-EWC方法，通过影响函数选择验证集来动态施加EWC正则化，在数学推理任务上显著减轻遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 课程学习在数学推理等领域广泛应用，但其训练分布的非平稳性导致灾难性遗忘：模型在后续困难任务训练后，在先前简单任务上的性能下降。现有方法多关注前向进度而忽视后向稳定性，缺乏对遗忘本质的理论理解及有效缓解手段。

Method: 1) 在光滑强凸损失设定下，通过梯度下降的参数更新动态理论分析课程学习的有效性与遗忘的不可避免性；2) 提出IV-EWC方法，利用影响函数（LiSSA算法）从课程训练数据中选取逐步扩展的代表性验证集，计算Fisher信息矩阵以施加动态EWC正则化（正则化权重λ=γ/t随任务递减）；3) 在相同理论框架下证明EWC正则化通过约束参数分布偏移来缓解遗忘；4) 在Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct和Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct三个模型上，于GSM8K、MATH和cn_k12三个数学推理基准上进行实验，与Random Replay、EWC、A-GEM、UPGD等基线对比。

Result: 在三个基座模型和三个数据集的实验中，IV-EWC在几乎所有配置下均优于基线方法，平均相对vanilla课程学习减少162%的遗忘，并在多数情况下实现负遗忘（正向后向迁移），即在困难任务训练后简单任务性能反而提升。小模型上增益更显著。消融实验验证了跨课程累积验证集和影响函数选择策略的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文从参数更新角度理论证明了课程学习中灾难性遗忘源于任务最优参数的差异，而这种差异是课程学习加速收敛的本质需求，因此遗忘无法完全消除。提出的IV-EWC方法通过影响函数引导的动态EWC正则化有效缓解遗忘，理论分析和实验结果均验证了其有效性，为课程学习中的后向稳定性提供了新视角。

Abstract: Curriculum learning has found broad application across numerous domains. Nevertheless, its effectiveness is intrinsically curtailed by catastrophic forgetting, driven by the shifts in model parameter distributions between curriculum tasks. In this paper, we investigate the phenomenon of catastrophic forgetting in this training paradigm, building on the established efficacy of curriculum learning. Our theoretical analyses of parameter update dynamics demonstrate that catastrophic forgetting in curriculum learning stems from the divergence of task optima, which is generally essential to the faster convergence of curriculum learning; therefore, forgetting cannot be completely eliminated. Based on this finding, we augment the training process and propose IV-EWC, which incorporates Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) into the curriculum learning objective to curb catastrophic forgetting in mathematical reasoning, a prototypical curriculum learning scenario. IV-EWC employs the influence function to construct a representative validation set from the curriculum's training data, which is used to drive dynamic regularization during training. We further present an extended theoretical analysis to show that EWC-based regularization methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting in curriculum learning, thereby providing theoretical support for IV-EWC. Empirical evaluations on three backbone models and three benchmarks indicate that curriculum learning exhibits catastrophic forgetting. IV-EWC alleviates this issue, reducing forgetting by 162% on average relative to vanilla curriculum learning and yielding positive backward transfer, as evidenced by improved performance on easier tasks after subsequent training on challenging tasks.

</details>


### [1300] [Scalable Attribution and Control of Model Behavior During Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33667)
*Sleem Abdelghafar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于互信息的训练中行为归因与控制框架，通过Batch-Space Ghost (BS-Ghost)算法高效计算每个训练样本对目标行为（如persona）的可区分贡献度(BGU)，并在训练中实时反馈调整样本权重以引导模型行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练中归因方法存在两个核心缺陷：(1) 批内样本产生相似的行为变化时难以区分个体贡献；(2) 多数方法（如Influence Functions、TRAK、MAGIC等）只能在训练后计算，无法用于训练中的反馈控制。这限制了模型对齐的可扩展监督能力。论文旨在解决"如何在训练循环内实时识别每个样本对目标行为的贡献并据此进行干预"这一核心问题。

Method: 1) **优化器感知响应(optimizer-aware response)**：对每个样本定义q_{t,j} = ∂b(F_t(e^s))/∂s_j|_{s=0}，描述该样本权重变化通过当前模型和优化器（如SGD/AdamW/带clipping）对行为的影响；2) **互信息公式化**：将批内干扰建模为高斯信道，通过互信息I(Z_{t,j};R_t)量化组合行为变化对每个样本贡献的揭示程度；3) **行为梯度唯一性(BGU)**：证明互信息=½log₂(1+BGU)，其中BGU = q_{t,j}^T Σ_{-j}^{-1} q_{t,j}，给出几何解释；4) **签名信息**：结合投影响应的方向，区分强化/弱化贡献；5) **BS-Ghost算法**：通过共享优化器计算（v_{t,r} = A_t^T u_r/B）、ghost contractions（避免存储模型大小的样本梯度）和batch-space求解（(K+λI)H=K）将开销降至8%；6) **反馈控制器**：基于签名信息最小化Σ m_{t,j}(ln w_j)²并满足行为预测约束，将样本权重用于训练。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，BS-Ghost对1000个样本增加27秒(8.02%)至5.5分钟训练，比训练后EK-FAC/Concept Influence快约44倍。在因果性测试中：GSM8K Mistakes移除10%最高BGU样本使mean judged evil从11.89降至2.38；Opinions/Medical 50%移除分别降低19.69/15.35点。339次重新加权干预中，预测与实测行为变化的平均余弦相似度0.84。反馈控制实验中，在第211步产生2/200有害回答（普通训练84/200），同时最终MMLU精度几乎不变（73.81% vs 73.79%）。BGU在批干扰恢复测试中Spearman相关系数0.78，优于所有基线方法（EK-FAC 0.575等）。

Conclusion: 论文建立了一个实用框架，通过信息论将训练数据与模型行为在训练过程中连接起来。BGU通过几何方式刻画批内可区分性，BS-Ghost使训练中归因具有可扩展性，签名信息既解释行为发展又支持反馈控制。该工作为大规模训练监督、对齐验证和实时干预提供了基础，附录中的误差界（有限重加权、目标导数复用）保证了方法的理论可靠性。

Abstract: Attributing and controlling model behavior during training requires identifying each example's contribution quickly enough to act before the next update. However, examples in the same training batch can produce similar behavioral changes, making their individual contributions difficult to distinguish. We address this ambiguity through mutual information, accounting for interference within the batch by quantifying how much the combined behavioral change reveals about each example's contribution. We show that this mutual information is a logarithmic function of Behavioral Gradient Uniqueness (BGU). BGU gives the information measure its geometric interpretation. Our Batch-Space Ghost (BS-Ghost) algorithm makes these scores practical inside the training loop through shared computation in batch space, without storing model-sized example gradients. On a complete 1,000-example Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct workload, our BS-Ghost implementation adds 27 seconds (8.0%) to 5.5 minutes of ordinary training. Removal and retraining demonstrate that BGU identifies data that causally shapes final behavior. At each training step, signed information identifies which examples strengthen or weaken the target behavior, explaining how behavior develops during training. Signed information also enables cheap intervention during training: it predicts how changing example weights will affect behavior in the next update. We then use these predictions to choose weights that steer behavior toward a desired target. This makes our framework a practical foundation for scalable oversight and verification of training pipelines and processes, helping evaluators assess model alignment, understand how it develops during training, and guide interventions that shape ongoing learning.

</details>


### [1301] [Reachability is not enough: Diagnosing long-range behavior in GNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33674)
*Filippo Maria Bianchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套诊断框架，通过测量"已实现的交互分布"来评估GNN是否真正使用了远距离信息，而非仅仅架构上可达。作者将长程能力分解为四个差距：支持限制、有限逼近差距、对齐差距和执行差距，理论分析了局部消息传递中远距离信息传播的二次代价，并通过受控实验和分子任务验证了架构相似但行为迥异的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN常被称为"长程"模型，因为其架构可以连接远距离节点，但这并不证明它们能正确利用远距离信息。整体预测指标可能掩盖远距离交互的失败。需要从架构属性转向诊断远距离信息实际使用情况。

Method: 1）定义已实现交互分布（realized interaction profile）和已实现范围（realized range）等度量指标；2）将长程能力分解为四个差距（支持限制、逼近差距、对齐差距、执行差距）；3）通过理论分析（T1-T5）解释有限更新对扩散范围的影响，以及等效滤波器的数值条件差异；4）在受控任务（Marked PathCopy、ResolventCopy、RingTransfer）和分子任务（ECHO-Charge、RemotePairs）上对比多种GNN家族。

Result: 1）理论证明：局部正扩散中，将已实现范围加倍需要约四倍的更新次数；Chebyshev多项式滤波器可避免此平方代价；2）架构相似的模型在远距离信息使用上差异显著（如GatedGCN在15跳处降至20%，GraphGPS保持100%）；3）低平均误差可隐藏远距离失败（tail error达1.0）；4）BF16精度复现会显著降低某些模型的预测准确率，但几乎不影响测得的范围；5）大多数GNN在ECHO-Charge远程上下文任务中表现优于局部裁剪版本。

Conclusion: 长程能力的关键不在于最大可达距离，而在于学习并保留任务所需距离上的信息。论文主张长程声明应报告四个层面：可能的交互、实际发生的交互、是否与任务匹配、执行是否保持该交互。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are often called long-range because their architecture can connect distant nodes, but this does not show whether they use distant information correctly. We introduce a framework that measures how strongly inputs at each graph distance affect predictions and separates limitations due to architecture, finite approximation, training, and numerical execution. Our analysis shows that local message-passing can spread influence slowly, so a finite implementation may rely mainly on nearby inputs even when the ideal computation uses the whole graph. We also explain why mathematically equivalent filters can differ in how easily they are learned and how reliably they run. Across controlled tasks, models with similar architectural reach use distant information very differently, while low average error can hide failures on distant interactions. Together, these results show that long-range capability depends on learning to use information at the distances required by the task and preserving that use during computation.

</details>


### [1302] [Benign Overfitting for General Norms and Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33675)
*Daniel Barzilai,Ohad Shamir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了一般范数（非仅ℓ₂）和一般亚高斯分布下的良性过拟合现象，证明了ℓ_p范数（p>1）在非高斯分布下仍可良性过拟合，但ℓ₁范数在非高斯分布下良性过拟合失败。核心方法是利用凸对偶、中心极限定量和一致浓度分析，证明对偶问题在高维下近似欧几里得几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代优化器（如Adam、Muon）使用非欧几里得更新规则，倾向于选择与ℓ₂以外的范数相关的解。然而，现有"良性过拟合"理论几乎仅限于ℓ₂范数（梯度下降的归纳偏置）和高斯输入（依赖高斯Minmax定理）。这造成了理论与实际之间的显著差距，亟需建立适用于一般范数和一般分布的分析框架。

Method: （1）将最小范数插值问题分解为信号块S和噪声拟合块N；（2）利用凸对偶分析内层最小化问题；（3）通过定量中心极限定理（CLT）和一致浓度论证，证明当λ"平坦"时，‖X_N^⊤λ‖_* ≈ κ_N‖λ‖₂，使对偶约束近似为ℓ₂球；（4）利用对偶截断引理（Lemma 3）证明可找到接近最优的平坦对偶解，平衡CLT精度与截断误差；（5）将此几何近似转化为对ℓ_p范数的风险界；（6）对ℓ₁，通过Rademacher输入构造反例，证明最小化ℓ_∞残差的几何结构本质上不稳定。

Result: （1）定理1（ℓ_p, p>1）：在亚高斯输入和噪声下，最小ℓ_p范数插值器在条件r_S≪n且s_N²|N|^{2/q}|S|^{max{2/p-1,0}}≪n≪|N|^{min{2/q,1}}下实现良性过拟合，匹配ℓ₂时Bartlett等人的充要条件；（2）定理2（ℓ₁反例）：对缩放Rademacher输入和特定亚高斯噪声，最小ℓ₁范数插值器以常数概率产生Ω(σ²log n)的过量风险，证明ℓ₁良性过拟合依赖高斯性；（3）定理3（一般范数）：给出满足假设3（平坦方向CLT）和假设4（一致浓度）的一般范数风险界，统一ℓ_p结果作为特例。

Conclusion: 本文建立了分析一般范数和一般分布下良性过拟合的统一框架，核心洞见是对偶问题在高维下近似具有欧几里得几何，从而恢复ℓ₂情形的良态行为。ℓ_p范数（p>1）的小波性过拟合在非高斯分布下仍成立，但ℓ₁范数是本质例外——其对偶几何在Rademacher输入下退化为ℓ_∞残差最小化，而非ℓ₂，导致高估误差发散。这一结果澄清了现代优化器归纳偏置的理论保证，并揭示了ℓ₁良性过拟合结果的分布依赖性。

Abstract: Understanding why predictors can generalize despite interpolating noisy training data is a central puzzle in machine learning. Most work on such "benign overfitting" studies minimum-2-norm linear regression, reflecting the inductive bias of gradient descent. However, modern optimizers such as Adam and Muon use non-Euclidean update geometries, favoring solutions associated with other norms. Analyzing regression for non-Euclidean norms is substantially more difficult, with known results essentially limited to Gaussians. In this paper, we develop a method to analyze benign overfitting in linear regression for general norms and general (sub-Gaussian) distributions. As a special case, we prove that minimum-p-norm interpolation with p>1 can benignly overfit even for non-Gaussian distributions, under suitable conditions. Perhaps surprisingly, for the 1-norm, benign overfitting does not hold in general for well-behaved (but non-Gaussian) distributions, showing that existing positive 1-norm results rely crucially on Gaussianity. Our proof analyzes the geometry of the dual optimization problem, using concentration and central limit tools to show it is approximately Euclidean in many high-dimensional cases.

</details>


### [1303] [T-MoXAI: A Hierarchical Explainability Framework for Temporal Multimodal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33685)
*Ali Inha,Mo Vali,Saaliha Vali,Pietro Liò,Meen-Yau Thum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍T-MoXAI框架，一个针对时序多模态数据的分层可解释AI系统，通过Transformer架构处理不规则时序和异构数据，并在医疗(IVF)和农业(小麦产量)两个领域进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前时序多模态XAI领域存在架构碎片化、缺乏统一基准的问题，且传统XAI方法难以处理随时间演化的多模态交互数据，限制了AI在高风险领域的可信部署。

Method: 方法核心是基于Transformer的分层架构：(1)使用ResNet-50编码图像、MLP编码表格数据；(2)采用4层8头Transformer编码器融合时序与跨模态信息；(3)三层解释机制——时序Shapley值(识别关键时间点)、注意力分析(识别关键模态)、梯度归因(Grad-CAM和Integrated Gradients定位特征/图像区域)。

Result: 在IVF结局预测任务(AUC=0.660，类别不平衡)和小麦产量预测(R²=0.265，环境噪声大)两个领域均验证有效。消融实验证明时序建模不可或缺(去除后性能降至随机水平)；时序ROAR实验验证了解释的忠实性(忠实性比率1.58-3.0)；解释生成在1秒内完成，支持交互决策。

Conclusion: T-MoXAI证明可解释性与预测性能可兼得，提供开源基线推动领域标准化。核心发现：时序建模至关重要，分层解释忠实反映模型推理过程。未来方向包括长序列扩展、不确定性量化、交互界面和基础模型。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) models for temporal multimodal data have potential in healthcare and agriculture, but their opacity can limit trust and adoption. We introduce T-MoXAI (Temporal Multimodal eXplainable AI), a hierarchical framework explaining (1) when timepoints influence predictions, using temporal Shapley values; (2) which modalities contribute at those moments, using attention analysis; and (3) what features or image regions drive decisions, using gradient based attribution. A transformer based architecture handles irregular temporal sequences and heterogeneous data, generating all three explanation levels in under one second for interactive decision support. We evaluate the framework on two real world tasks: predicting IVF treatment outcomes from ultrasound sequences and clinical measurements (AUC 0.660 despite significant class imbalance), and forecasting wheat yield from temporal RGB imagery and phenotypic traits ($R^2$ 0.265 amid substantial environmental variability). Ablation studies indicate that temporal modelling is critical in both domains: removing it reduces performance to the equivalent of random guessing. Temporal ROAR experiments provide evidence that the explanations reflect the model's reasoning process. With a unified, domain agnostic architecture and open source implementation, T-MoXAI provides a baseline for temporal multimodal XAI, addressing fragmentation in the field and supporting applications where understanding decisions is as important as predictive accuracy.

</details>


### [1304] [Geometric Inductive Biases for Semi-Supervised Equalization: The Constellation-Aware Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33695)
*Avi Caciularu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Constellation-Aware Transformer (CAT)，一种将星座几何先验和FIR滤波结构作为归纳偏置注入Transformer的半监督信道均衡器，在少导频场景下显著优于VAE-CNN和标准Transformer基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在未知信道条件下，现有深度学习均衡器（MLP/CNN/标准Transformer）需要从稀缺导频数据中隐式学习星座几何和信道物理特性，存在"与星座无关的估计间隙"（agnostic estimator gap），导致导频开销大、频谱效率低。通信理论中已知的结构（如最优线性接收机的匹配滤波器与块MMSE均衡器）未被有效利用。

Method: 提出CAT架构，由TransFIRmer块堆叠组成，包含两大核心设计：(1) 信号-星座联合注意力（"early interaction"范式），将接收信号与K个理想星座符号共同作为token输入，注意力机制可实现匹配滤波器组；(2) 双流FNN，信号流使用双向一维卷积实现FIR滤波以做反卷积，星座流使用标准MLP做几何精炼。理论上证明：(a) 引理1量化了星座无关估计器的额外贝叶斯风险上界（与KL散度相关）；(b) 定理1说明星座感知假设空间是标准空间的超集，MMSE不增；(c) 命题1证明CAT结构上与最优MIMO Wiener接收机对齐——注意力实现匹配滤波，双向FIR分支提供块MMSE所需的非因果滤波。

Result: 在3合1 ISI信道（h^(1), h^(2), h^(3)）和非线性无记忆信道上，CAT以约10k参数（远少于VAE-CNN的150k）显著降低SER：在h^(1)和h^(2)上，64导频的CAT优于128导频的基线；SNR从14到26 dB均保持最低SER；3GPP TDL-A/D上SER降低约1.8-2.0倍；5G NR LDPC编码下BLER增益2.5 dB且ECE校准改善7.4倍。消融实验验证双向FIR-FFN（ISI SER提升77%）和星座先验（SER降低2.2倍）的关键作用，旋转45°的星座先验使性能大幅恶化（0.1550 vs 0.0628），证明模型确实使用了正确的几何参考。

Conclusion: CAT通过将通信领域知识（星座几何与最优线性接收机结构）显式编码进Transformer归纳偏置，实现了半监督信道均衡中样本高效的导频利用，结构上与Wiener接收机对齐，实验上在多种信道和调制阶数下一致优于基线。主要局限在于：(1) 每块5000步的测试时训练计算成本高（可通过CAVIA元学习初始化降至50步）；(2) 注意力复杂度O((N+K)²d)随星座阶数增长，目前限于256-QAM；(3) 静态星座先验对CFO/相位噪声敏感，但通过PLL+学习的相位旋转可保持1.5 dB优势。未来工作包括I/Q因子化降复杂度、扩展至高移动性场景、以及与神经接收机管线的整合。

Abstract: Decoding signals over unknown channels with minimal pilot overhead is a critical challenge in next-generation communications. Existing deep learning approaches typically rely on generic encoders that struggle to model long-range temporal dependencies or efficiently capture the channel's physical properties from scarce data. We argue that standard architectures suffer from agnostic estimation gaps, as they must implicitly learn the constellation geometry that is already known. We introduce the Constellation-Aware Transformer (CAT), a novel architecture that explicitly injects geometric inductive biases into the equalization process. CAT is composed of a stack of custom TransFIRmer blocks, which use an "early interaction" paradigm to co-process received signals and ideal constellation symbols. Each block features a split Feed-Forward Network that applies a Finite Impulse Response (FIR)-inspired filter for deconvolution and a parallel MLP for geometric refinement. We show that this design is structurally aligned with the optimal linear (MIMO Wiener) receiver: its attention can implement a matched-filter bank, and its bidirectional FIR branch provides the non-causal filtering that block MMSE equalization requires. In the semi-supervised setting, CAT needs fewer pilots than VAE and standard Transformer baselines: on two of our three ISI channels, it reaches a lower SER with 64 pilots than they do with 128.

</details>


### [1305] [A Spectral Theory of Compositional Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33708)
*Hugo Rydel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个关于组合学习（compositional learning）的谱理论（spectral theory），通过数学分析深度线性网络在结构化合成环境中的学习动力学，建立了训练证据的统计结构与组合推理涌现之间的数学联系。该理论预测了组合推理何时出现、是否可从现有证据中识别，以及新关联证据如何快速解锁先前无法获得的推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类的组合推理能力并不均匀发展：相同的成分知识可能导致持续的组合失败、渐进的泛化或突然的推理涌现，具体取决于关系证据的组织方式。已有深度线性网络的谱分析仅解释被训练输出的学习时间，不直接适用于从未训练的组合推理。本文旨在建立一个数学框架，解释训练证据的统计结构如何决定组合推理的出现时机与可识别性。

Method: 1) 在加性关系世界（实体嵌入+关系位移）中，构造线性约束系统，将每个训练事实编码为矩阵A的一行，将锚点约束固定坐标系。2) 分析H=AᵀA/|D|的谱分解，导出命题4.1（通过正特征值子空间的投影判定组合律的可识别性）和命题4.2（浅层网络中可识别律的误差按谱模指数衰减的闭式轨迹）。3) 对深度网络通过链式法则导出分层梯度流（方程10），使用四阶Runge-Kutta数值积分。4) 在三个实验中验证：实验1检验16个具有不同证据支持的律的涌现时间；实验2检验一个关联事实如何解决欠定的律；实验3检验一个关联事实如何解锁跨结构推理。5) 使用200个独立生成的世界在网络深度N=1,2,3下进行系统比较，理论预测从相同初始权重出发，不拟合网络轨迹。

Result: 实验1：所有3200个律-世界对在三种深度下均达到涌现标准，预测与观测的log₁₀涌现时间R²分别为1.0000、0.9979、0.9793。实验2：关联事实将律的模糊度从0.2582降至≤1.4×10⁻¹⁵，2000个epoch后链接网络检索到77.4%、100.0%、100.0%的保留组合（对照组为10.9%、3.2%、2.6%），恢复时间R²为0.9986、0.9860、0.8735。实验3：链接后链接网络在30000个epoch后正确回答80个跨结构比较中的77.8、79.9、80.0个（对照组几乎为零），解锁时间R²为0.9996、0.9994、0.9996，但伴随短暂的前提事实检索中断（467/468受影响的案例最终恢复）。预测与观测的轨迹R²在多数设置下超过0.99。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了训练证据的统计结构与组合推理发展之间的数学联系。理论区分了组合检索失败的两种原因：可识别律因支撑模态仍在学习而检索缓慢，或欠定律因证据容许冲突解而无法唯一确定。该框架为人类认知中的若干现象（知道前提却组合失败、相似组合在不同时机涌现、单个关联事实突然启用大量新推理）提供了定性解释。局限在于理论在加性合成世界中发展并限于线性架构，未来工作应在异构/非线性关系以及知识图谱基准（如FB15k-237、WN18RR）上检验谱结构是否仍具解释力。

Abstract: How does compositional reasoning emerge during learning? We address this question by mathematically analyzing the learning dynamics of deep linear networks. We train these networks in structured synthetic environments and derive a theory linking the structure of experience to compositional learning. Our theory predicts when compositional inferences emerge, whether they are identifiable from the available evidence, and how new linking evidence can rapidly unlock previously unavailable inferences. These results provide a qualitative explanation for several phenomena observed in human cognition. They account for why a composition can fail despite knowing its premises, why similar compositions can emerge at different times, and how a single linking fact can suddenly enable many new inferences. Taken together, these findings establish a mathematical link between the statistical structure of experience and the development of compositional reasoning.

</details>


### [1306] [DuoOPD: Learning from Joint Teacher-Student Outcomes for Multi-Task On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33711)
*Ao Yu,Weibo Gao,Heng Zhou,Linan Yue,Rui Li,Suyi Liu,Yu Yan,Yizhong Zhang,Qi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出DuoOPD方法，通过联合师生输出结果来指导多任务在策略蒸馏，解决了传统OPD忽视师生各自成功率差异而错误抑制学生正确答案的问题，在Qwen3和Llama模型上均优于五个基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多任务在策略蒸馏（OPD）方法忽略了一个关键事实：教师和学生各自的正确率因任务而异。标准OPD会平均地抑制学生已经回答正确的响应（因为教师-学生对数比可能为负），而仅按学生正确性门控反馈（OPDVR）虽然修正了方向，但未考虑教师是否成功。这种忽视联合结果的方式无法充分利用教师的成功和学生已有的正确响应。

Method: DuoOPD采用"学生结果定方向，联合结果定支持"的统一规则处理四种师生结果组合：(1)仅教师成功时，将验证后的教师答案作为评分上下文来纠正学生错误响应；(2)仅学生成功时，通过任务内共享权重强化整个响应；(3)双方都成功或都失败时，使用Softplus函数设置正/负反馈强度。具体使用单元温度Softplus sp(x)=log(1+exp(x))保证权重方向正确且非零，通过对教师响应进行独立缓存和验证（仅教师读取参考）来实现。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B→Qwen3-0.6B和Llama-3.1-8B→Llama-3.2-3B两对模型上，DuoOPD在所有五种基线方法中取得最高的平均宏准确度，相比OPD分别提升2.58和5.98个百分点。同时在科学理解+计算、指令跟随、代码生成三种异构任务混合上也保持领先。消融实验表明：仅基于结果的方向控制接近门控基线，而联合结果设计（参考条件评分和任务内权重共享）贡献了大部分增益。训练开销增加约9-15%（缓存分摊后）。

Conclusion: DuoOPD通过一个跨任务的统一四结果规则实现了多任务在策略蒸馏，证明了学生结果定方向、联合结果定支持的原则有效性。该方法在两个模型家族和三种任务混合中均优于现有方法，验证了方向控制与教师使用方式设计的重要性。未来工作可探索分级验证器、压缩参考、迁移到未见任务以及利用结果统计指导任务调度。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own responses with token-level feedback from a stronger teacher, yet the teacher can fail on questions the student already answers correctly, and how often each model succeeds varies across tasks. OPD ignores these outcomes and, on average, pushes down even the student's correct responses; gating feedback by student correctness fixes the direction but uses the teacher in the same way whether or not it succeeded. We introduce DuoOPD, in which the student's outcome sets the direction of feedback and the joint teacher-student outcome decides how the teacher supports it: when only the teacher succeeds, its verified answer becomes context for scoring the student's failed response, and when only the student succeeds, a weight shared within the task reinforces the whole response. A single rule covers all four outcome combinations without task-specific settings. Across Qwen3 and Llama, DuoOPD outperforms all five baselines in mean macro accuracy, improving over OPD by 2.58 and 5.98 percentage points, and it also leads on two further task mixtures spanning scientific calculation, instruction following, and code generation. Ablations show that outcome-based direction alone stays near the gated baseline, while the joint-outcome designs supply most of the gain.

</details>


### [1307] [Theory Guided and Interpretable Neural Operator Design for Partial Differential Equation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33715)
*Zeyuan Song,Zheyu Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AFDONet，一种基于自适应傅里叶分解(AFD)理论的神经偏微分方程求解器，将AFD理论与变分自编码器(VAE)相结合，首次以严格的数学框架指导神经算子的架构设计，实现在任意黎曼流形上求解非线性PDE，并具有优秀的数学可解释性和收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的神经PDE求解器存在两个主要问题：一是难以推广到非欧几里得流形上的PDE求解；二是神经架构设计缺乏严谨的数学理论指导，更多依赖经验和试错。本文旨在通过自适应傅里叶分解(AFD)理论这一数学框架，自上而下地指导神经算子设计，弥合这一差距。

Method: AFDONet采用VAE作为骨干网络，包含三个核心组件：(1) 编码器，将输入参数或解映射到复数域的潜在空间；(2) 潜变量到RKHS网络，通过特征映射将潜变量投影到最近的再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)，利用FFT构造可学习的复数权重核；(3) AFD型动态卷积核网络(CKN)解码器，通过Gram-Schmidt正交化和极点自适应选择(对应AFD的最大选择原理)重建PDE解。训练损失函数包含重建损失、特征映射损失、KL散度正则化以及扩展到复数域的全纯训练损失(基于Sobolev训练)。理论上证明了三个定理：误差界、RKHS存在性以及动态CKN解码器的收敛性。

Result: 在三个基准PDE问题(二维Helmholtz方程、二维不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程在环面上、二维齐次Poisson方程在四分之一圆柱面上)上，AFDONet在所有PDE案例中均优于FNO、D-FNO、WNO和DeepONet等基线方法，MAE和相对L²误差降低达一到两个数量级。特别在Navier-Stokes方程(自回归任务)上，相对L²误差从FNO的6.288%降至0.170%。此外，AFDONet在含噪真实数据集(乳胶手套DIC数据集)和复杂流形(单位闭球上的薛定谔方程)上也表现出最优性能。计算时间随数据集大小近似线性增长，且由于仅使用单边(正频率)操作和紧凑潜在空间，比FNO更高效。消融实验验证了潜变量到RKHS网络、AFD型动态CKN解码器和VAE骨干的必要性。

Conclusion: AFDONet是首个完全由AFD数学理论指导架构设计的神经PDE求解器，实现了从"艺术"到"科学"的范式转变。它具有出色的数学可解释性、严格的收敛保证和泛化性能，在任意黎曼流形和含尖锐梯度的数据集上表现卓越。该工作为设计可解释的神经算子框架开辟了新范式。未来工作包括将AFDONet推广到去中心化框架以及信号处理、可再生能源预测等应用领域。

Abstract: Accurate numerical solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) are crucial in numerous science and engineering applications. In this work, we introduce a novel neural PDE solver named AFDONet, which incorporates neural operator learning and adaptive Fourier decomposition (AFD) theory for the first time into a specifically designed variational autoencoder (VAE) structure, to solve a general class of nonlinear PDEs on smooth manifolds. AFDONet is the first neural PDE solver whose architectural and component design is fully guided by an established mathematical framework (in this case, AFD theory), turning neural operator design from an art to a science. Thus, AFDONet also exhibits exceptional mathematical explainability and groundness, and enjoys several desired properties. Furthermore, AFDONet achieves outstanding solution accuracy and competitive computational efficiency in several benchmark problems. In particular, thanks to its deep connections with AFD theory, AFDONet shows superior performance in solving PDEs on i) arbitrary (Riemannian) manifolds, and ii) datasets with sharp gradients. Overall, this work presents a new paradigm for designing explainable neural operator frameworks.

</details>


### [1308] [ALDER: Discovering the Laws of a World by Acting in It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33728)
*Teng Cao,Yu Deng,Quentin Delfosse,Kristian Kersting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ALDER 是一种通过主动环境交互来发现、测试和修正基于方程的世界模型的方法。它通过结构化提议、系数拟合、独立验证和基于预测分歧的主动实验选择，实现方程结构的迭代修正，并能利用学到的模型进行目标导向控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于固定轨迹或预定义候选方程的方法无法区分在现有数据上表现相近但本质不同的竞争假设，也无法发现初始假设空间之外的方程。论文旨在通过主动实验设计，使智能体能够主动提出干预来区分竞争模型，并在必要时修正方程结构，从而获得更可靠、可检验、可解释的基于方程的世界模型。

Method: ALDER 由四个核心组件构成：(1) 法则修正代理（Law Revision Agent）在隔离沙箱中基于类型化文法提出或修改参数化方程结构；(2) 系数拟合器（Coefficient Fitter）仅拟合回归和预测数值系数，不改变结构；(3) 受保护的准入验证器（Protected Admission Verifier）在智能体不可见的保留数据上独立检验候选模型；(4) 主动执行选择器（Active Rollout Selector, ARS）选择候选模型预测差异最大的可行、安全且低成本实验。实验结果更新证据台账，引导下一轮结构修正。控制阶段将验证后的方程模型转化为逆问题，通过预测终态逼近目标来选择动作。

Result: 在 NovelLaw 基准（60 个案例）上，ALDER 将功能恢复率从一次性提议的 43.3% 提升至 85.0%，且分布偏移 NMSE 最低。在 PullCubeTool 与 PushT 机器人任务中，10 次运行中有 9 次通过验证，优于一次性/仅修正方法（3/10）。在 ODEBase（59 系统）上，中位重构 NMSE 为 2.32e-15，泛化 NMSE 为 2.28e-16，符号准确率达 90.7%，显著优于 SINDy、PySR、LLM-ACES 等基线。在 RoboCasa OpenDrawer/OpenDoor 任务中，分布偏移预测 RMSE 为 0.9×10⁻³，控制成功率达 100%，优于匹配的 MLP 基线。在 RQ2 中，ARS 在 182 个案例上以最低平均成本（1.16）识别目标模型。在 RQ4 中，验证器能可靠拒绝缺失结构项或关键状态的模型，且观测噪声增大时预测覆盖率下降。

Conclusion: ALDER 证明基于方程的世界模型能够通过环境交互进行主动测试和修正。预测分歧指导实验选择，交互反例驱动结构修正，独立验证决定模型准入。实验表明 ALDER 能构建超出初始集的方程、提早识别目标模型、改善分布偏移预测并拒绝无支持证据的模型。环境交互不仅是训练数据来源，更是识别、证伪和修正世界模型的工具。基于方程的显式模型天然支持通过求解逆问题实现目标导向控制。

Abstract: Reliable world models should not only predict future states but express how actions change the world in an explicit, transparent and testable form, such as equations. Yet methods that rely on a fixed set of trajectories cannot distinguish equally good competing hypotheses, while searches over a fixed set of predefined candidates cannot discover equations outside the initial hypothesis space. We introduce ALDER (Action-guided Law Discovery, Evaluation, and Revision), a method that actively proposes novel experiments to test and revise models. Specifically, ALDER proposes parametric equations; a numerical optimizer fits their coefficients; an independent verifier tests these candidates on held-out data. To distinguish between competing valid hypotheses, a cost- and safety-aware selector queries interventions, in the form of novel experiments. The resulting counterexamples update the evidence ledger and guide the next structural revision, while incompatible laws are discarded. Across an in-house benchmark, ODE equation discovery tasks, and robotic experiments, ALDER discovers laws beyond its initial formula set, repairs failed model proposals, distinguishes fixed candidate models with fewer interactions, and improves out-of-distribution prediction. Furthermore, given a current state and a target, ALDER selects control actions by solving the inverse problem defined by its validated world model. Together, these results show that explicit equation-based world models can be tested and revised through interaction, then naturally used to guide goal-directed control.

</details>


### [1309] [PQ-HSA: Reusing Product-Quantized Scores for Hybrid Sparse-Approximate Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33746)
*Kunming Shao,Jierun Chen,Yanli Wang,Ruoyu Wang,Haoli Bai,Kwang-Ting Cheng,Chi Ying Tsui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PQ-HSA提出了一种混合稀疏-近似注意力机制，在长上下文解码时复用IVF-PQ索引产生的评分，同时用于top-k选择和未被选中token（背景）的近似注意力计算，显著提升小预算下的准确性并加速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解码时注意力受内存带宽限制。现有稀疏注意力方法将未选中的token权重设为零（截断），在小预算（如1-2%）下对需要跨上下文聚合信息的任务准确率显著下降。需要一种方法既减少KV读取又保留被忽略token的贡献。
