Overall, ZeroCode addresses diverse code-design requirements within a unified framework, providing solutions with optimized decoding performance under given constraints.

</details>


### [1366] [Agentic High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization with Hypothesis- and Evidence-Guided Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34281)
*Zhixuan Gao,Ke Xue,Rongxi Tan,Ming Chen,Chao Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HERA（基于假设与证据引导的研究代理）和PRISM（可重构推理与搜索方法组合）框架，将LLM代理应用于高维贝叶斯优化（HDBO）。HERA在策略层级进行控制，维护可修订的结构假设并选择/配置HDBO方法及执行长度；PRISM作为数值执行引擎，在每个搜索块内顺序生成候选点。在四个无元数据合成函数和八个真实任务上的实验表明，HERA匹配强数值基线，优于现有LLM驱动与代理式BO方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM驱动和代理式贝叶斯优化方法主要在低至中等维度问题上验证，在高维场景下可靠性不足。高维BO的核心挑战不仅在于"在哪里评估"，更在于"使用何种建模假设和搜索几何"，因为目标函数的有用结构未知。现有方法要么让LLM直接生成高维候选点（覆盖差或逐坐标决策积累导致无效），要么固定单一数值后端（可能与目标不匹配）。因此需要重新思考LLM在HDBO中的控制层级。

Method: 提出HERA-PRISM架构：HERA（LLM代理）在策略层级运作，通过四个类型化工具（get_state、propose_initial_solution、set_search_strategy、run_search_block）与PRISM交互。HERA维护一个"工作假设"——对目标可搜索性的可修订解释，结合任务上下文、优化反馈和结构诊断（搜索几何如OTSD与观测熵、代理可信度、坐标稀疏性、低维子空间、加性交互）来选择、配置或重启HDBO策略（包括Vanilla BO、LassoBO、ALEBO启发的低秩策略、Add-GP-UCB、TuRBO），并决定执行块长度（1-50次评估）。PRISM在每个块内独立完成候选生成、采集优化与模型更新，控制权交还HERA后才重新评估假设。形成"观测-假设-干预-评估-反思"循环，HERA控制结构性搜索过程，PRISM保留高维候选生成的权威。

Result: 在四个无元数据合成函数（Hartmann-100D、Ackley-200D、Lévy-300D、Rosenbrock-300D）上，HERA与强数值HDBO基线相当，在Lévy上排名第一，超过LLAMBO、Centaur、Sara等代理基线。在八个真实任务（Rover 60D、HalfCheetah 102D、MOPTA 124D、Chip Design 128D、Mazda 148D、Ant 216D、Median Molecules 1&2 256D）上，HERA在大多数基准上取得最佳平均最终目标值，在八个任务中的七个优于LLM/代理基线。消融实验表明：结构诊断改变策略使用、元数据效应因任务而异、自适应搜索块降低推理成本、决策频率与模型选择均存在任务依赖性。

Conclusion: HERA-PRISM框架支持一种"代理式HDBO"观点：LLM管理演化的搜索策略而非直接求解高维候选生成。结构诊断应被视为测试搜索偏差的临时证据，而非恢复的真实结构。未来工作可扩展可用工具与策略空间、校准结构诊断可靠性、跨相关优化任务迁移策略经验。该框架的局限性在于其受限于PRISM暴露的诊断与数值策略。

Abstract: High-dimensional Bayesian optimization (HDBO) seeks sample-efficient optimization when the number of variables is large relative to the evaluation budget. Recent LLM-based and agentic BO methods incorporate task knowledge and adapt search decisions during a run, but have primarily been evaluated on low- and moderate-dimensional problems. We ask whether this paradigm can transfer to the higher-dimensional regime. Our experiments show that these methods do not remain reliable in the high-dimensional regime, where the challenge is not only where to evaluate, but also which modeling assumption and search geometry to use when the objective's useful structure is unknown. We therefore introduce HERA, a Hypothesis- and Evidence-guided Research Agent that uses task context, optimization feedback, and structural diagnostics to revise search hypotheses, select and configure HDBO strategies, and determine their execution length. PRISM, its numerical optimization engine, generates and evaluates candidates sequentially within each search block, updating numerical models after each observation. HERA remains competitive with strong numerical HDBO baselines and outperforms the evaluated LLM-based and agentic methods on four metadata-free synthetic functions. Across eight real-world tasks, HERA achieves the best mean final objective among all evaluated systems on most benchmarks. Further analyses show that structural diagnostics change strategy use, metadata effects vary across tasks, and adaptive search blocks reduce inference cost.

</details>


### [1367] [Epistemic Learning from Imprecise Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34285)
*Kaizheng Wang,Siu Lun Chau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了"认知不确定性学习"框架，通过credal集（凸集形式的标注分布集合）作为监督信号，使模型不仅输出预测分布，还输出一组预测分布集合。具体实例化为悲观-乐观credal分类器（POCC），采用共享主干网络加双头（悲观头最小化最坏损失、乐观头最小化最好损失）的结构。同时提出从概率标签松散构建credal标签的方法，并给出交叉熵下的闭式解。理论证明在条件覆盖假设下平均预测器的有限样本泛化界，明确包含监督不精确性惩罚项。实验在人类标注分歧、教师预测、标签平滑三种场景下验证，POCC在精度、校准、选择性分类上达到最佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将不精确标注（如标注者分歧、缺失信息）压缩为单一预测分布，丢失了标注证据未解决的不确定性信息。需要一种能显式表达"标注留下的不确定性"的学习框架。

Method: 1) 定义credal Markov核，将每个输入映射到一组可接受的标签分布；2) POCC采用共享骨干+两个分类头（悲观头/乐观头）结构，预测时返回两端点的凸包作为预测credal集，其跨度作为认知不确定性评分；3) 提出从参考分布q_L构造credal标签的方法（保留最高类别概率下界α，其余质量自由分配）；4) 交叉熵下推导闭式极值标签分布；5) 理论证明有限样本泛化界。

Result: 1) 理论：在条件覆盖和正则性假设下，POCC平均预测器满足泛化界，包含模型复杂度、有限样本误差、优化误差、以及由credal集直径刻画的监督不精确性惩罚项（2A·E[1-α(X)]）；2) 实验：在CIFAR-10H、MiceBone、TreeVersity（标注分歧），CIFAR-10/100（教师蒸馏），以及不同ε的标签平滑设置下，POCC在ACC、ECE、AUARC的综合指标BQS上统计显著优于EDL、LbBnn、Decali、DAPPr、MCDO、DE六种基线；闭式MMI不确定性度量优于熵差度量。

Conclusion: 论文成功建立了从credal监督学习预测分布集合的理论框架，POCC作为具体实现能够在精度、校准、不确定性量化三者间取得最佳平衡。核心贡献在于：显式建模标注不精确性、利用悲观-乐观双头互补学习、闭式高效优化、以及含明确不精确性惩罚项的泛化界。未来方向包括随机集形式的覆盖放宽、扩展到大模型、以及其他credal标签构造方式。

Abstract: Imprecise annotations may support several plausible labelling distributions, yet learning methods often resolve this ambiguity into a single predictive distribution. This can obscure what the annotation evidence leaves unresolved. We introduce epistemic learning from credal supervision, a framework that uses convex sets of plausible labelling distributions, called credal sets, as supervision and learns sets of predictive distributions. We instantiate the framework with the pessimistic--optimistic credal classifier (POCC), which combines a shared backbone with two classification heads trained to minimise worst-case and best-case losses over the supervision sets. Their outputs define a predictive credal set whose spread provides an uncertainty score. We also show how credal labels can be obtained through a simple relaxation of existing probabilistic labels, reducing commitment to their precise probability assignments. This construction admits closed-form inner optimisation under cross-entropy loss, enabling efficient training. Assuming the supervision sets contain the true conditional label distributions, and other regularity assumptions, we establish a finite-sample generalisation bound for the averaged predictor with an explicit penalty for supervision imprecision. We evaluate POCC using human annotator disagreement and teacher predictions, alongside label smoothing as a controlled proxy for annotation imprecision. Across these settings, POCC achieves a favourable balance of predictive accuracy, calibration, and uncertainty-based selective classification versus competitive baselines.

</details>


### [1368] [Riemannian Difference-of-Convex Optimization for K-Means Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34310)
*Meng Xu,Bo Jiang,Hanfu Zhang,Ya-Feng Liu,Anthony Man-Cho So*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于黎曼差凸（DC）优化的K-means聚类方法，通过在紧致嵌入子流形上建立基数约束的精确DC罚函数重构，并设计RADA-DC算法求解。理论证明罚函数模型与原始K-means问题在有限罚参数下全局等价，且算法具有O(ε⁻³)的迭代复杂度。实验表明在聚类数K较大时，该方法在解的质量上优于K-means++等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: K-means全局最优求解是NP-hard问题。现有黎曼优化方法（如基于ℓ₁正则化或二次罚函数的方法）无法保证与K-means的全局等价性。此外，现有黎曼DC算法要么依赖Hadamand流形假设，要么采用双循环结构导致计算开销大。因此，亟需一种具有全局等价性保证且高效的单循环算法。

Method: 1. 将K-means建模为紧致嵌入子流形上的基数约束优化问题；2. 用DC残差‖X‖₁‖‖X‖_[ₙ]作为罚函数替代ℓ₀基数约束；3. 建立全局误差界dist(X,X)≤8K√(nK)·r_DC(X)，证明当罚参数τ>8K²√n‖A‖₂²时罚函数问题与原问题共享全局最优解；4. 将非光滑黎曼DC问题转化为minimax形式；5. 提出RADA-DC算法：结合RADA框架的对偶正则化与DC线性化策略，每步执行T次黎曼梯度下降再更新对偶变量，采用Barzilai-Borwein初始化回溯线搜索。

Result: 1. 理论结果：建立了全局误差界（定理1）与精确罚函数结果（定理2）；2. 算法收敛性：在标准假设下，RADA-DC在O(ε⁻³)次迭代内找到ε-黎曼临界点（定理3）；3. 实验结果：在合成数据(K=40)上，RADA-DC目标函数值最低且运行时间远少于K-means++；在真实数据集ORL40和Faces94上，RADA-DC在目标值和聚类误差上均优于I-AManPG和K-means++，且在多数设置下运行时间最短。

Conclusion: 本文成功为K-means聚类开发了一种黎曼DC优化方法，建立了罚函数模型的精确性（有限罚参数下全局等价）以及RADA-DC算法的O(ε⁻³)迭代复杂度保证。数值实验表明该方法在大K设置下以具有竞争力的计算成本获得比基线方法（K-means++和I-AManPG）更低的目标函数值，是解决大规模K-means聚类问题的有效方法。

Abstract: K-means is a widely adopted clustering approach in signal processing and machine learning. In this paper, we study K-means clustering through a cardinality-constrained formulation on a compact embedded submanifold. We replace the cardinality constraint with a difference-of-convex (DC) penalty and establish a global error bound to prove that the penalized and constrained formulations share the same global minimizers whenever the penalty parameter exceeds a finite threshold. To solve the resulting nonsmooth Riemannian DC problem, we reformulate it as a minimax problem and propose RADA-DC, a Riemannian alternating descent ascent method combining dual regularization with DC linearization. Under standard assumptions and suitable parameter choices, RADA-DC finds an $\epsilon$-Riemannian critical point within $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ iterations. We conduct experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets to demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the tested baselines, including K-means++, in solution quality at competitive computational cost when the number of clusters is large.

</details>


### [1369] [One Rollout Is All You Get: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34321)
*Ziqiang Wang,Li Gu,Zhixiang Chi,Linlian Jiang,Zihuan Jiang,Linqiang Guo,Siobhan Reid,Zhi Liu,Yang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对GUI智能体在部署后冻结权重、无法从经验中学习的痛点,首次形式化定义了"完全测试时适配"(fully test-time adaptation)问题,并提出极简权重空间方法SOLO:利用一个判断器和一个提议-验证器对智能体自身产生的episode进行筛选与回顾性重新标注,采用top-K自蒸馏更新小型LoRA适配器。在WebArena、VisualWebArena和MobileWorld三个基准构建的循环任务流上,SOLO使UI-TARS-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B的成功率较冻结基线提升3-6个百分点,并在网页流上优于两种in-setting记忆方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI智能体以冻结权重部署后会丢弃所有在线经验,但部署流本身就是其被评判的分布,且很多部署场景下任务会重复出现。现有改进方法(SFT、RL、多rollout、重试、测试时训练等)均依赖于部署时不存在的资源(真值、额外rollout、训练阶段),而GUI动作不可逆,只能一次尝试,因此需要一个仅凭一次执行、从自身episode学习且无零条件信号的方法。

Method: SOLO的方法核心:(a) 三类辅助模型读取每个episode——判断器(J)判定整个任务是否完成,提议器(G)为判定失败的episode前缀命名一个已完成的子任务,验证器(V)独立检查该声明;(b) 接纳的episode进入容量为W的滑动窗口,每次接纳触发一次小步LoRA适配器的top-K自蒸馏更新,目标来自同一次前向传播的top-K概率分布,只在窗口含判定成功时才更新(锚定机制);(c) LoRA零初始化保证起点与冻结智能体一致,适配器规模约为骨干网络的0.2%。

Result: 在WebArena(324 episode)、VisualWebArena(411 episode)和MobileWorld(120 episode)三轮循环任务流上,SOLO使用UI-TARS-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B,在所有流上均超过冻结智能体3-6个百分点成功率;在网页流上优于两种in-setting记忆方法(AWM-online和DMS),在MobileWorld上与AWM-online相当。消融实验验证了top-K自蒸馏(避免one-hot模仿导致的episode过长)、滑动窗口和回顾性重标注三个组件的必要性。方法对辅助模型选择具有鲁棒性,使用GPT-5-mini、GPT-5、GPT-5-nano甚至智能体自身的8B模型均能保持增益。

Conclusion: 本文得出三个结论:(1) 形式化了GUI智能体完全测试时适配问题的三个约束(无真值、每次任务仅一次尝试、仅部署阶段),并定位了现有方法在该谱系中的位置;(2) SOLO作为权重空间的极简方法,通过top-K自蒸馏+小型LoRA适配器+判断器/提议-验证器,证明了在该严格约束下适配是可行的;(3) 限制包括:循环流由基准任务构造而非真实用户日志;依赖辅助模型带来成本与攻击面(对抗页面);长期部署下的漂移未测试。优点是它保留了将权重重置为零以恢复冻结智能体的安全阀。

Abstract: GUI agents are deployed with frozen weights and discard everything they experience on the job. Existing ways to update an agent's weights assume something deployment withholds: ground truth, rollouts beyond the single attempt (retries, samples, practice runs), or a learning phase other than deployment. Because GUI actions can be irreversible, a deployed agent gets one attempt per task occurrence, in arrival order, and every attempt counts. No ground truth is available at any point. We define fully test-time adaptation for GUI agents by these constraints and pair it with a minimal weight-space method, SOLO. Auxiliary models read each episode: a judge selects the episodes it deems successful, and a proposer-verifier pair relabels a failed episode's prefix with the subtask that prefix completed. Admitted episodes enter a short sliding window, and each admission updates a small adapter by top-K self-distillation on the agent's own predictions, provided the window holds a judged success. On recurring task streams built from WebArena, VisualWebArena and MobileWorld, SOLO improves on the frozen agent with both UI-TARS-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, by three to six points of success rate, and exceeds two in-setting memory methods on the web streams.

</details>


### [1370] [Routing Without Embeddings: Fast And Interpretable Routing With Regular Expressions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34326)
*Yifan Lu,Qiyue Zhang,Haotian Shan,Hanjie Chen,Jiarong Xing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RegexRoute 框架，利用稀疏自编码器(SAE)从无标注文本中自动发现可解释的正则表达式特征提取器，用于大语言模型路由决策。该方法无需在推理时运行神经编码器，仅用 128 个固定正则特征即可在四个基准测试上达到与最强神经编码器基线相当的路由准确率(76.43% vs 76.41%)，同时具备更低延迟和更强鲁棒性，并解释了为何扩大编码器规模对路由增益有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 路由器普遍依赖神经文本编码器，且直觉上认为更大编码器能更好地捕获查询意图与难度。但实验发现 Qwen2.5 从 0.5B 扩展到 72B 参数时路由准确率几乎没有提升，暗示路由所需的关键查询信息可能已被小编码器捕获，并且这些信息或许可以直接从文本表面提取，无需神经编码。

Method: 提出 RegexRoute 流水线：1) 使用 SAE 分解 LM 隐藏状态得到可解释潜变量；2) 通过文档级激活相关性将 16,384 个潜变量聚成 N=128 个潜变量族(采用谱聚类)；3) 由 LLM 根据潜变量族描述和相关 token 生成正则表达式特征提取器(每个含 regex 模式与聚合规则如 count/ratio/binary)；4) 在 fit 集上用 Kendall τb 对齐正则输出与 SAE 激活模式进行迭代精炼；5) 冻结 128 个提取器后，仅训练轻量路由头(如 Extra-Trees)用于推理，完全消除 LM/SAE 前向计算。

Result: 在 EmbedLLM、NineBy30k、R2Bench、CARROT 四个基准上，128 正则特征平均路由准确率 76.43%，与最强基线 Llama-3.1-8B 的 76.41% 相当；32 特征版本达到 76.06%，优于所有句嵌入和编码器 LM 基线。中位延迟 2.2ms(CPU)，比 Qwen2.5-0.5B GPU 路由器的 19.5ms 低约 90%。在拼写错误、词替换、句法重排、释义四种扰动及字符损坏下均保持最高扰动准确率。消融实验证明 SAE 引导和基于对齐的精炼均带来提升。特征恢复实验表明 0.5B 编码器已能恢复大部分正则特征(R²=0.820)，72B 仅提升至 0.848，解释了大编码器收益有限的原因。

Conclusion: RegexRoute 证明了紧凑的可解释表面文本特征足以支撑竞争性 LLM 路由，无需神经编码器。该工作既提供了部署上更轻量、更鲁棒的路由方案，又为理解"小编码器为何已足够用于路由"提供了机制性解释，开辟了通过显式可解释文本特征设计与理解 LLM 路由器的新方向。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) routers commonly rely on neural query embeddings, with larger encoders expected to better capture query intent and difficulty. Yet scaling Qwen2.5 encoders from 0.5B to 72B parameters brings little improvement in routing accuracy (Figure 1b), suggesting that small encoders may already capture the query properties needed for routing. We therefore investigate which properties matter and whether they can be extracted directly from text without a neural encoder. We introduce REGEXROUTE, a pipeline that uses sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to discover interpretable regular-expression (regex) features. Using unlabeled text, an LLM turns descriptions of grouped SAE latents into regex extractors and refines them to match latent activation patterns. These extractors supply numerical features to a lightweight routing head, eliminating neural encoding at inference (Figure 1a). Across four benchmarks, one fixed set of 128 features achieves 76.43% average routing accuracy, comparable to 76.41% for the strongest neural text encoder baseline, with much smaller latency and strong robustness. These findings establish explicit, interpretable text features as a practical basis for designing and understanding LLM routers.

</details>


### [1371] [The Composition Gap in Dataset Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34343)
*Guang Li,Takahiro Ogawa,Miki Haseyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了联邦/数据治理场景下独立数据集蒸馏的组合性问题。核心发现是：即使各源数据集分别被精确蒸馏、且总预算允许精确联合蒸馏，独立蒸馏集的并集仍可能无法复现真实数据并集的训练效果。理论分析表明，有限步压缩是非仿射变换，导致"先压缩后混合"与"先混合后压缩"不等价。二次目标下推导了精确的组合误差公式，其大小由源Hessian方差与仿射项决定。网络实验证实局部端点偏差可被二次预测捕捉，但学习合成集的源残差主导组合误差。联合蒸馏的精度优势在无源异质性时仍然存在，表明训练保真度与下游精度是不同要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集蒸馏通常逐个评估合成集，但在联邦学习和数据治理场景中，多方各自蒸馏数据，用户训练其并集。需要回答核心问题：独立蒸馏的数据集能否在不损失训练保真度的前提下组合？独立评估每个集合无法回答此问题。这一问题对医院联盟等分布式应用至关重要。

Method: 1. 二次目标精确分析：对固定步长梯度下降推导二对一压缩的精确矩阵恒等式，引入曲率方差V_H和仿射冲突w量化组合偏差。3. 提出的解析原理：通用可组合性要求压缩映射满足亲和性。2. 任意比例分解（定理E.2）：将任意压缩比p=T/K的误差分解为首项ηV_H与高阶余项。4. 网络局部近似：在小步长下冻结二次模型可预测局部端点偏差，标度η^4。5. 实验验证：二次模型、CIFAR-10/SVHN/CIFAR-100上的分布匹配、端点匹配以及多源场景。

Result: 1. 二次模型上，组合误差具有精确闭式解（定理4.2），缩放为η^4，由源Hessian方差V_H和均值仿射偏差决定。2. IID划分下额外端点误差接近零，标签偏斜下转正且随分级增大一致提升（CIFAR-10从0.06升至2.35×10^-3）。3. 网络实验：小步长下二次预测以余弦1.000和2-4%相对残差匹配局部偏差；学习合成集的源残差在端点匹配下超过结构项一个数量级以上。4. 联合精度优势在IID下+5.3点、Dir-0.1下+5.3点、无分裂控制下+6.6±0.4点（结构项恰为零时仍存在）。5. 类重加权仅缩小超额约15-25%，不改变精度。

Conclusion: 独立蒸馏数据集可在各自源上精确复制训练，组合后仍可能失败，即使总预算允许精确联合解。二次目标下失败具有精确形式（压缩源统计平均≠平均后压缩），学习二次蒸馏器重现该规律。网络平滑时二次预测在小步长下捕捉局部偏差；学习合成集的源残差主导组合误差。联合蒸馏的精度优势在同数据集两蒸馏集上也持久。训练保真度与下游精度是相互独立的要求，仅靠逐个评估合成集无法保证组合性能。实践建议：下游用户应将独立蒸馏集的并集作为整体对照并集参考进行验证。

Abstract: Dataset distillation compresses a training set into a small synthetic set, usually evaluated one at a time. In federated and data-governance settings, several parties distill their own data and a user trains on their union. We ask whether the union of separately distilled sets reproduces training on the union of the real data composability and show that it can fail even when every source is distilled exactly and the total budget admits an exact joint distillate. Compressing a training trajectory into fewer steps transforms the source statistics nonlinearly, so averaging compressed sources differs from compressing their average. For quadratic objectives we derive the exact composition error for two-to-one step compression in terms of the source-Hessian variance and the linear terms of the losses, and on a smooth network at small step sizes this prediction captures the local endpoint discrepancy in magnitude and direction. For learned synthetic sets, however, the composed error decomposes exactly into this local discrepancy and an aggregate source residual. Under endpoint matching the residual exceeds the structural term by more than an order of magnitude, and under distribution matching the two terms partly cancel. Joint distillation also retains an accuracy advantage when both sets are distilled from the same dataset, where the local discrepancy is exactly zero. Training fidelity and downstream accuracy are therefore distinct requirements, neither established by evaluating each set on its own.

</details>


### [1372] [FAST-Brain: A Flow-Aligned Spatio-Temporal Surrogate Brain Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34354)
*Shucheng Liu,Changchun Shi,Kai Zhang,Hongtu Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FAST-Brain，一种用于rs-fMRI生成的流对齐时空代理脑模型。其核心是直接预测干净BOLD信号（而非噪声或速度）的流匹配框架，结合图卷积网络（GCN）注入结构连通性、纤维长度和功能网络模块等解剖先验，以及Transformer捕获长程时序依赖。理论上证明在低维子空间假设下，贝叶斯最优去噪器仅通过内在低维投影依赖观测，逼近误差随内在维度d而非环境维度N缩放。实验在RNN、SDDEs合成数据和HCP真实数据上实现SOTA，HCP上FC相关性从0.726提升至0.938，MAE从0.199降至0.073。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有rs-fMRI代理脑模型存在三大局限：(1) 难以捕获长程时序依赖；(2) 未能充分整合多种解剖空间先验；(3) 扩散/流匹配模型在完整环境空间中参数化噪声或速度场，未能利用fMRI信号固有的低维子空间结构，导致样本效率低。

Method: 方法包含三大组件：(1) 流对齐直接数据预测框架——保留流匹配插值路径，但参数化网络直接预测干净BOLD信号Y_t而非速度V，速度通过 (Ŷ_t - Z_τ)/max(1-τ, τ₀) 解析恢复，由此得到FAST损失；(2) 时空网络架构——F_θ = D_temp + D_spat，D_temp为基于历史条件的Transformer（跨注意力+自注意力+旋转位置编码），D_spat为多图GCN，融合三种拉普拉斯（结构连通性、纤维长度倒数、功能网络模块），通过可学习多项式展开并采用零初始化的课程学习策略；(3) 理论保证——证明在低维子空间假设下，贝叶斯最优去噪器满足F*(Z,τ,h,g) = A·f(A⊤Z,τ,h,g)，并用ReLU网络逼近的误差为√(dP+1)·ε，与内在维度d而非环境维度N相关。

Result: 在三个数据集上均达到SOTA：FC恢复上，RNN相关性0.938、SDDEs相关性0.975、HCP相关性0.938（最强基线为0.726），MAE在HCP从0.199降至0.073；有效连接性恢复上，RNN数据集AUROC 0.999、AUPRC 0.995；条件生成在RNN上CRPS、QICE、ProbCorr、条件FID均最优；无条件生成在三个数据集上判别分数和相关性分数均最优。PCA/t-SNE可视化显示FAST-Brain最准确地恢复了SDDEs的环形流形和双峰分布。消融实验证实GCN空间先验和直接干净信号预测目标在高维SDDEs和HCP上贡献尤为显著，验证了理论预测。

Conclusion: FAST-Brain通过直接预测干净BOLD信号并整合图引导的结构先验，能够更忠实地恢复功能连接性、有效连接性和低维信号几何。理论结果严格证明了直接干净信号预测将有效学习维度从N降至d。论文指出该方法有望推广至交通、气候、气象、电网等其他结构约束时空系统。未来工作方向包括有限样本统计学习分析，推导统计估计误差的非渐近界。

Abstract: Modeling resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) data is crucial for understanding brain-wide neural activity. However, traditional methods struggle to capture complex temporal dynamics over long horizons, to account for the brain's anatomical spatial structure, and to model high-dimensional ambient signals that lie on a low-dimensional intrinsic subspace. We propose FAST-Brain, a unified flow-aligned spatio-temporal surrogate brain model that addresses all three challenges. At its core is a flow-aligned generative framework that directly predicts the clean blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) signal, paired with a graph convolutional network that captures spatial structural constraints and a Transformer that models long-range temporal dependencies. Theoretically, we show that under a low-dimensional subspace assumption, the approximation error of our model scales with the intrinsic dimension rather than the ambient dimension, which justifies our direct modeling of the BOLD signal. Extensive experiments on synthetic and Human Connectome Project datasets demonstrate that FAST-Brain achieves state-of-the-art performance in recovering functional connectivity, effective connectivity, and the implicit low-dimensional signal subspace.

</details>


### [1373] [FORGE: Form-Optimal Routing of Grounded Evidence for Frozen LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34358)
*Xi Xiao,Yunbei Zhang,Chen Liu,Lin Zhao,Jialin Chen,Tianchen Zhao,Xiang Xu,Youngeun Kim,Tianyang Wang,Min Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FORGE提出了一种针对冻结LLM智能体的统一路由框架，通过每查询联合路由"证据形式(Direct/Summary/Raw)"和"思考深度"两个轴，在不访问模型权重的前提下，以约269K参数的轻量路由器实现精度提升同时降低42-45%的token成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冻结的闭权重基础模型只能通过输入和推理流程进行下游适配。固定的支持形式和推理深度对约80%的查询是次优的，因为最优选择因查询而异，且证据质量与推理深度之间存在耦合关系——更好的证据减少所需推理，更深的推理减少所需证据。已有方法分别处理"自适应检索"和"自适应推理"两个轴，未能联合优化。

Method: 1) 将联合适配形式化为在动作空间A=M×Θ上的每查询路由，效用函数U(x,a)=F1(x,a)-λ_in·c̃_in(a)-λ_out·c̃_out(x,a)；2) 在熵正则化、代价感知的效用最大化下推导出闭式Boltzmann路由目标π*(a|x)∝exp(U(x,a)/τ)；3) 路由器为约269K参数的分解式MLP(π_μ·π_{θ|μ})；4) 三阶段训练：Stage 0离线枚举暖启动动作，Stage 1对Boltzmann目标做KL监督蒸馏，Stage 2用GRPO+KL锚点+熵奖励在全动作集上做策略精化。提出Full和Lite两个变体，Lite无需在线主机探针。

Result: 在5个知识密集型基准(HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue、PopQA、FEVER)和8个冻结骨干(7B-671B)上：Full FORGE在Qwen3-8B/Mistral-7B上宏F1比Always-Raw提升+2.4/+2.9，缓存token成本降低45%/42%；在思考型主机上12臂联合策略比最大思考预算+1.4至+1.9 F1，成本约减半；单一路由器零样本迁移到3个前沿API主机，在11/15任务-主机单元上匹配或超越Raw F1，token成本降低30%以上；FORGE的路由与六臂效用oracle在87%的查询上一致。

Conclusion: FORGE建立了在冻结主机周围联合控制证据形式和推理深度的实用范式，通过理论上由Boltzmann分布支撑的轻量路由器在质量-成本权衡上取得新Pareto前沿，跨主机迁移能力强，为冻结智能体适配提供了一个可迁移、有理论基础且实用的方向。

Abstract: In agentic AI systems, frozen foundation models are increasingly deployed as closed-weight API endpoints, making downstream adaptation possible only through the inputs and inference procedures surrounding the model. As a result, for each input query, two coupled decisions largely determine both answer quality and token cost: what evidence to provide and how much reasoning budget to allocate. Fixed defaults along these axes are often suboptimal, misallocating support form or reasoning depth on roughly 80% of queries in our analysis. To address this challenge, we propose FORGE, a unified framework for adapting frozen models through per-query routing over a joint action space that spans both support form and thinking depth. Under an entropy-regularized, cost-aware utility objective, we derive a closed-form Boltzmann routing target and instantiate the policy as a lightweight 269K-parameter factorized router. The routing policy is trained around the frozen host, without any weight access, through a three-stage pipeline: offline arm enumeration, supervised Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation from the Boltzmann target, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refinement with host feedback. Across 5 knowledge-intensive benchmarks and 8 frozen backbones ranging from 7B to 671B parameters, FORGE improves accuracy at 42-45% lower token cost on both main hosts, transfers zero-shot across hosts at lower token cost, and composes with intrinsic thinking budgets where available.

</details>


### [1374] [Emergence, Not Bandwidth: Physical Coupling and the Limits of Learned Multi-Agent Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34373)
*Mihir Chauhan,Aniket Bera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究速率受限多智能体团队中通信的价值，揭示物理耦合决定通信必要性，强化学习在协议发现上存在本质局限，且学习到的协议彼此不可互读。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有涌现通信文献几乎全在多智能体 MuJoCo（刚性耦合）上研究——本文证明这恰是通信价值为零的退化区域。同时缺乏速率匹配下工程发送者与学习发送者的受控比较，以及对学习失败根源（表征/维持/发现）的精确定位。

Method: 1. 三个 Dec-POMDP 定理（T1 优势充分性、T2 水平自由压缩损失、T3 轨道可识别性），刻画独立于学习者的最优边界；2. 三个 MuJoCo 连续控制场景解耦物理耦合（UAV-UGV 解耦、双臂盲部分耦合、双人形盲刚性耦合），每个条件精确按 2 比特计费；3. 通过 partner_blind 标志在同一场景内操纵物理侧信道；4. 25 种子×7 基线的种子配对检验、Holm 校正；5. 热启动实验分离表征/发现/维持失败；6. 600 有序种子对的交叉博弈测试。

Result: 1. 耦合决定通信价值：刚性耦合下所有信道与沉默无差（+0.001±0.001, p=0.982）；解耦下所有信道均成功；部分耦合下工程 2 比特发送者达 IQM 1.000，学习者仅 0.482（与沉默无差 p=0.400）；2. 匹配速率差距 +0.374±0.125（dz=1.23），带宽无法解释；3. 热启动将差距从 0.562 提升至 0.857（+0.295±0.131, p<0.001），定位失败为发现而非表征/维持；4. MAPPO 集中式评论家也不闭合差距（+0.447±0.206）；5. 交叉博弈：自博弈 0.980 跨种子崩溃至 0.144，最佳对齐最多恢复 23%，至少 77% 差距无法弥合；6. 涌现码同时编码目标扇区与所需转向方位，非纯命名也非纯控制信号。

Conclusion: 通信价值由物理耦合而非任务本身决定；场域主要工作在"答案已知为零"的退化区。在判别区域，匹配速率下工程与学习发送者的差距源自强化学习的协议发现能力，而非带宽限制；涌现协议虽个体有意义但彼此不可互读，无法实现零样本互操作。建议所有涌现通信工作明确报告其在耦合轴上的位置。

Abstract: Rate-limited multi-agent teams raise three questions the emergent-communication literature has answered only empirically: what an optimal message should encode, what compression costs over a horizon, and when a learned protocol is unique enough for a teammate to read. We answer them for rate-limited Dec-POMDPs, then measure how far reinforcement learning falls short of the optimum. Our theorems fix what is achievable independently of any learner, so a gap between an engineered and a learned sender at the same bit budget is an optimization fact, not an information-theoretic one. We instantiate this on three MuJoCo arenas spanning zero, partial and rigid physical coupling, charging every condition exactly 2 bits per decision, and create the discriminating regime by closing a physical side channel within one arena, holding bodies, task and reward fixed. Communication value is governed by coupling: under rigid coupling through a shared object, no channel beats silence (+0.001 +/- 0.001, p = 0.982, n = 25), since proprioception already carries that information; without coupling, every condition solves the task; under partial coupling, the engineered 2-bit sender reaches an interquartile mean of 1.000 but the learned one reaches 0.482, indistinguishable from silence (p = 0.400, n = 25). With a shared alphabet, bandwidth cannot explain the gap. Warm-starting from an engineered receiver localizes the failure: the same channel reaches 0.857 versus 0.562 cold-started (p < 0.001), so it is neither representational nor one of maintenance; reinforcement learning fails to discover the protocol. Cross-play shows learned protocols are individually meaningful but mutually unintelligible: self-play 0.980 collapses to 0.144 across seeds, and our best constructed alignment leaves at least 77% of that gap. All headline results use 25 seeds per arena and seven published baselines at matched rate.

</details>


### [1375] [GeoCFM: Positive-Only Conditional Flow Matching for Mineral Occurrence Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34398)
*Moshe Eliasof,Eldad Haber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GeoCFM 是一种基于条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）的生成式模型，用于在仅含正样本（无可靠负样本）的条件下，从多通道地球物理/地球化学图像中采样矿产可能出现的空间位置。它将矿产远景制图重新定义为学习条件空间密度 π(p|d)，避免了伪负样本，并通过多次采样表达由不可观测地下地质引起的多模态不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矿产勘探本质上是一个"仅正样本"问题：只能观测到稀疏的矿点位置，未标记区域并非可靠负样本；同时，地下地质状态不可直接观测，相同的地表地球物理信号可能对应多种地下状态（即一对多映射）。传统基于分数图（score map）并依赖伪负样本的方法存在系统性偏差与不确定性表达不足的缺陷。因此需要一种能够直接从正样本学习、可采样、并量化认知不确定性的概率方法。

Method: 1) 将矿点表示为二维坐标点集 p∈ℝ²，学习条件密度 π(p|d)，其中 d 为多通道地球科学图像。
2) 采用条件流匹配（CFM）：从二维高斯分布出发，学习时变速度场 v_θ(p,t|d) 将点传输至目标分布；使用线性插值轨迹 p_t = t·p + (1-t)·z，以 MSE 回归目标速度 p−z。
4) 条件注入方式：UNet 编码 geo-image 得到稠密特征图 Φ_ξ(d)，对当前点 p_t 通过双线性插值采样局部特征 ϕ_ξ，拼接坐标与正弦时间嵌入后由共享 MLP/残差头 h_ψ 预测速度。
6) 训练时使用 AdamW（lr=3e-4, wd=1e-4）、梯度裁剪、余弦衰减；推理时使用显式 Euler 积分（K=50 步）。
7) 数据集：合成磁性–地球化学基准（含隐变量激活机制）以及 USGS Earth MRI 实测数据（八层地球物理通道），后者采用空间不相交的瓦片切分避免空间泄露。

Result: 在合成基准（50 个样本）和 Earth MRI（200 个 patch，瓦片切分）上，使用对称 Chamfer 距离、Sinkhorn OT、F@5、KDE-NLL 和 top-5% 命中率五项指标进行评估（每图 20 次采样取平均）：
- 合成数据：GeoCFM CD=9.37±0.62，Sinkhorn=0.045±0.003，F@5=0.634±0.012，NLL=8.950±0.110，Top5=0.720±0.020，五项全部最优；
- Earth MRI：CD=12.30±0.54，Sinkhorn=0.085±0.004，F@5=0.151±0.008，NLL=10.500±0.150，Top5=0.250±0.012，同样五项全部最优。
最佳基线为 UNet-Seg（合成 CD=29.46，Earth MRI CD=46.81）。GeoCFM 在训练-测试差距上保持稳定（合成 8.81→9.37，Earth MRI 11.89→12.30），表明性能提升并非过拟合。消融实验显示：模型对正样本比例（50%–100%）稳健；仅 K=5 步 Euler 即可获得接近 K=50 的质量（CD≈9.30 vs 9.37）；采样预算 N 增大可改善密度稳定性与 KDE-NLL。

Conclusion: GeoCFM 将矿产远景制图重新定义为条件空间密度估计，避免了伪负样本并能通过多次采样显式表达由不可观测地下地质引起的认知不确定性。在合成与真实 USGS Earth MRI 数据集（含空间不相交切分）的五项指标上均显著优于基于分数图、单分类、检索式和非条件的基线方法，验证了基于条件流匹配的正样本采样框架的有效性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Critical mineral discovery is a positive-only problem: deposits are observed as sparse locations, while unlabeled regions are not reliable negatives, and similar geophysical signatures can arise from different subsurface states. We therefore model mineral targeting as learning a conditional spatial distribution over occurrence locations, $\pi(p\mid d)$, given geo-images $d$, rather than predicting a deterministic per-pixel score map. We introduce GeoCFM, a conditional flow-matching model that generates mineral occurrence point sets conditioned on multi-channel geo-images; GeoCFM learns a point-wise transport field in $\mathbb{R}^2$, using UNet features with point-conditioned velocity prediction to bridge dense rasters and sparse supervision without pseudo-negatives. On a synthetic magnetics--geochemistry benchmark with latent activation and on USGS Earth MRI data with a spatially disjoint tile split, GeoCFM improves geometric agreement with observed occurrences over score-map and non-conditional baselines, while representing epistemic uncertainty through conditional sampling.

</details>


### [1376] [Unlocking Few-Step Diffusion for Faithful Previews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34406)
*Jing Jia,Sifan Liu,Guanyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示冻结少步扩散采样器隐藏的重建能力，通过学习输入噪声修正和轨迹修正（LoRA适配器），实现与全步采样器输出的实例级对应。在CIFAR-10/LSUN/CelebA-HQ等无条件和SD1.5/SDXL/FLUX.1-dev等文本到图像模型上显著优于LD3等基线，支持"先预览后精修"工作流以加速候选筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型采样延迟高，用户在找到满意图像前需生成并丢弃大量候选，造成计算浪费。现有少步采样器输出质量差或与全步结果缺乏实例级对应，无法作为可靠的预览。

Method: 1) 揭示冻结3-4步采样器通过优化初始噪声即可高度重建全步输出（PSNR从~15dB提升至~37-40dB）；2) 输入修正：轻量网络预测噪声残差Δz，加到原始噪声后送入冻结采样器；3) 轨迹修正：每步独立LoRA适配器修改去噪更新；4) 通过α=(k/K)^p缩放实现跨采样步数迁移，无需重训练；5) CFG尺度作为额外输入通过Fourier特征调节修正。

Result: 无条件基准上MSE比LD3降低53-78%；SD1.5/SDXL在CFG=1/3/5下PSNR/LPIPS/SSIM全面优于LD3/DPM++/ConSolver；FLUX.1-dev 512 COCO提示词候选选择中ImageReward达1.1417（vs TDD-FLUX 1.0331，ConSolver 1.0085），NFE仅60；输入修正可迁移至更高分辨率和PartiPrompts，无需重训练；跨骨干迁移（Bedroom→CelebA）意外提升美学偏好分数（HPS从24.88提升至27.34）。

Conclusion: 冻结少步采样器具备被低估的重建能力，通过学习输入/轨迹修正可实现与全步采样的实例级对应；该方法支持"预览-选择-渲染"工作流，显著降低扩散模型交互成本；跨步数和跨骨干的迁移能力表明修正学习到了通用的语义方向，具有广泛的应用潜力。

Abstract: Sampling latency compounds in diffusion workflows, where users generate and discard many candidates before keeping one. Surprisingly, the poor outputs of standard few-step samplers do not reflect a lack of reconstruction capacity: by optimizing only the initial noise, frozen 3-4-step samplers can closely reproduce their corresponding full-step outputs. Building on this finding, we learn corrections to the initial noise and denoising updates using endpoint supervision, improving correspondence with full-step outputs generated from the same noise and prompt. The resulting previews allow users to screen candidates cheaply and reserve full-step generation for promising ones. Input correction also transfers across sampling budgets without retraining. Experiments show substantial improvements in reference fidelity, including 53-78% lower reconstruction MSE than retrained LD3 on unconditional benchmarks, alongside improved ranking preservation and candidate selection on SD1.5, SDXL, and FLUX.1-dev.

</details>


### [1377] [PROACT-Agent: Progressive Runtime Oversight and Active Circuit-breaking for Real-Time Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34415)
*Ding Jia,Wei Liu,Xianglong Du,Yingjie Li,Yingqing Yang,Huili Yu,Zhangsong Zhan,Chu Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PROACT-Agent 是一个用于 LLM 智能体运行时安全防护的框架，通过合成高保真轨迹数据并训练 guard 在每次推理前拦截不安全操作。其核心贡献包括：(1) 渐进式轨迹展开（PTU）将长程日志拆解为因果前缀；(2) 推理增强的因果校正（RACR）通过多模型投票与单调因果一致性（MCC）消除"safety drift"；(3) 文化感知的数据本地化（CADL）实现中英双语功能实体映射。配套发布了 PROACT-Bench（155,780 个前缀级标注状态）。在严格根分组与完整 source holdout 协议下分别达到 96.34% 与 91.46% 的 unsafe-class F1；在 AgentDojo 上将非 DoS 定向攻击成功率从 20.82% 降至 0.40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM从静态问答转向能执行工具调用的智能体，单次工具误用可能引发不可逆的数字或物理损害。现有防护措施（LlamaGuard、ShieldGemma等）主要为对话内容审核设计，无法在多步交互中准确判断何时阻断智能体运行；现有基准（如 R-Judge、ATBench、AgentAlign、TS-Bench）则存在粒度、规模与因果一致性之间的权衡，并普遍缺乏中文等非英语文化场景。作者认为：缺乏大规模、因果一致的数据是实时主动干预的关键瓶颈。

Method: 三阶段流水线：(1) PTU（Progressive Trajectory Unrolling）将静态轨迹 τ 通过算子 Γ 拆解为多个前缀状态 s_t = P_t，将风险重新定义为非马尔可夫前缀评估任务 R*(P_t)；(2) RACR 包含知识驱动的 Thought 增强（用 Qwen3-32B 推断辅助推理 ρ_t）、多智能体共识（DeepSeek-R1、Qwen2.5-72B、Qwen3-32B、MiniMax-M2.5 四模型委员会 + GLM-5.1 仲裁器 J 基于 Shannon 熵 H(Y_t) 触发）以及 Monotonic Causal Consistency（MCC）后向校正算子 T(Y) = {ŷ_t | ŷ_t = max_{0≤i≤t} y_i}_{t=0}^u，排除首次不安全边界之后的标签；(3) CADL 通过功能性实体映射（将 Instagram 映射为 RedNote 等）将状态从英文空间 S 映射至中文空间 S̃，配合 Tripartite Rigid Verification（TRV）进行结构/标签不变性、信息密度保留与上下文忠实度三重验证。训练阶段以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为基座，采用 LoRA (r=16, α=32) 在 155,780 个双语元组上做 3 epoch SFT，loss 为标准交叉熵，目标是输出 JSON 标签与拒绝理由。

Result: PROACT-Agent 在多个协议上取得领先：(1) 混合源对比中 Overall F1 达 97.01%，中英子集分别 97.31%/96.71%；(2) 严格根分组 F1 96.34%（vs Qwen3Guard 91.20%、TS-Guard 84.70%），完整 source holdout F1 91.46%（vs 71.38%/72.29%）；(3) 时序边界检测上，源 holdout 下首不安全召回 91.84%、精确边界检测 90.63%；(4) AgentDojo 非 DoS 定向攻击成功率从 20.82% 降至 0.40%（98.07% 相对降幅），Slack/Travel 套件直接归零；(5) 消融显示移除 CADL/RACR/PTU 任一组件都会导致 F1 显著下降；(6) 不同骨干（Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B、Qwen3.5-9B）均保持 96%+ F1，1.7B 仅占 4.69 GiB 显存。

Conclusion: PROACT-Agent 验证了"在 LLM 下一次推理前评估已更新上下文"这一主动防护范式的可行性：通过因果严格的单调校正、双语本地化与委员会仲裁，将回顾性日志转换为可用于流式干预的训练信号。论文将发布 PROACT-Bench 但采用受控访问协议以防止恶意滥用。局限包括：依赖静态文化知识库、本地化质量受底层模型能力制约、已执行工具的副作用无法回滚、缺乏系统性人工标注验证干预边界。

Abstract: The transition from Large Language Models (LLMs) to agents shifts safety stakes from toxic text to irreversible environmental harm. While current defenses remain largely retrospective, proactive runtime intervention is bottlenecked by the lack of large-scale, causally-consistent data. We propose PROACT-Agent, a framework for synthesizing high-fidelity trajectories to enable real-time guardrails. We identify a critical "safety drift" in prior benchmarks, where lenient annotation paradigms fail to enforce temporal consistency. PROACT-Agent addresses this through: (1) Progressive Trajectory Unrolling to reveal risks hidden in long-context interactions; (2) Reasoning-Augmented Causal Rectification to enforce monotonic causal consistency; and (3) Culturally-Aware Data Localization for cross-border robustness. We introduce PROACT-Bench, a bilingual safety benchmark with 155,780 states labeled through multi-model adjudication. Evaluating updated context before the next LLM inference, the trained guard achieves 91.46% unsafe-class F1 and 90.63% exact-boundary detection under complete source holdout. In AgentDojo, it reduces non-DoS targeted attack success from 20.82% to 0.40%.

</details>


### [1378] [MegaGraph: Towards Efficient Training of Large-Scale Graph Transformers with Automated Hybrid Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34420)
*Tong Qiao,Ao Zhou,Yingjie Qi,Chunming Hu,Jianlei Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MegaGraph是首个面向大规模图Transformer(GT)训练的自动化混合并行框架，通过三种专门的并行策略（图感知上下文并行、异构流水线并行、混合数据并行）解决GT训练中的注意力矩阵与拓扑偏置矩阵的内存瓶颈以及图嵌入层的负载不均衡问题，并利用Profile→Model→Search自动化搜索工作流在指数级配置空间中高效找到最优并行方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图Transformer相比传统GNN通过全局注意力克服了过度平滑问题，但扩展到大规模图时面临两大独特瓶颈：(1)注意力分数矩阵与拓扑感知偏置矩阵共同造成巨大的逐层内存开销；(2)图嵌入层导致严重的流水线负载不均衡。现有面向LLM的并行策略假设稠密规则负载，无法处理偏置矩阵在环形注意力旋转中的行列对齐丢失问题；面向GNN的分布式系统仅支持浅层消息传递架构，缺乏注意力分区与流水线调度能力。因此亟需一种专为GT设计的混合并行框架。

Method: 框架包含两大核心模块：
1. **并行后端**：
   - **图感知上下文并行(GA-CP)**：同时按节点维度分区注意力计算和偏置矩阵，KV块沿通信环旋转时动态切片对应的偏置列，保持拓扑一致性，偏置矩阵内存减少约P_cp倍；并修改在线softmax以正确处理随KV块变化的偏置项。
   - **异构流水线并行**：感知嵌入表的非均匀层分配，根据首阶段额外的嵌入查找和数据构建开销自动调整各阶段层数（如24层4阶段分配为[3,7,7,7]），采用GPipe微批次调度。
   - **混合数据并行**：沿图数据维度扩展吞吐量，通过All-Reduce同步梯度。
2. **自动化搜索引擎**（Profile→Model→Search）：
   - **Profiling**：使用PyTorch hook轻量级测量各CP度下的前向/反向时间、嵌入与投影时间，以及p2p和All-Reduce通信时间。
   - **Cost Model**：构建内存成本模型（四分量：权重、激活、特征与偏置、固定开销）和延迟成本模型（含L2缓存容量阈值l_break的分段线性计算模型与γ≈1.68的缓存抖动惩罚）。
   - **Search**：带内存剪枝的动态规划算法，在O(L²P_pp)时间内找到最优层分配，遍历(P_pp, P_cp, P_dp)组合选出全局最优。

Result: 在5个公开数据集（Products、Reddit、Reddit2、Citeseer、Computers、Arxiv）上与ANS-GT和TorchGT对比：
- **精度保持**：单机与双机MegaGraph结果差异<0.2pp，在Products上比TorchGT高出10pp以上精度。
- **内存**：在Products上峰值内存仅16.53GB，相对TorchGT（即使降至batch=6800的74.4GB）减少77.8%；双GPU进一步减少70.5%。
- **速度**：双GPU相对TorchGT获得4.51×（Products）和4.36×（Reddit）加速；扩展接近线性（Products 1.88×, Reddit 2.02×）。
- **成本模型精度**：216种配置下内存MAPE=3.37%(R²=0.994)，延迟R²=0.961。
- **消融实验**：GA-CP将内存从70.56GB降至13.50GB(5.2×)；异构PP在4.35s/epoch达到最佳吞吐；表明无单一策略在所有指标上最优，自动化搜索必要。
- **Pareto前沿**：4×RTX 4090上166种配置中，纯DP不在前沿上，混合CP+DP在低内存下匹配DP吞吐，搜索引擎在~3秒内找到24GB约束下的全局最优。

Conclusion: MegaGraph成功填补了大图+深模型交叉领域的系统空白，首次使GT模型能在大规模图上完成训练，同时显著降低峰值内存并提升训练速度。未来工作将扩展至动态图架构，并在更大规模的异构计算系统上探索弹性调度机制。

Abstract: Graph Transformers (GTs) offer superior representation capabilities by overcoming the depth limitations and over-smoothing issues of traditional Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). However, scaling GTs to large graphs poses critical bottlenecks. Specifically, the attention score matrix and its associated topology-aware bias matrix jointly incur significant per-layer memory overhead, and heavy graph embedding layers result in severe workload imbalances. These characteristics are unique to GT training and are not addressed by parallelism techniques designed for either conventional GNNs or Transformers, making a dedicated solution necessary. This paper introduces MegaGraph, the first automated hybrid parallelism framework designed for efficient GT training. MegaGraph designs three specialized strategies, namely graph-aware context parallelism, heterogeneous pipeline parallelism, and hybrid data parallelism, to support efficient training on large-scale graphs. However, coordinating these three parallelism strategies yields an exponentially large configuration space. To address this complexity, an automatic search engine leverages precise cost models via a Profile - Model - Search workflow to identify the optimal parallelism configuration. Evaluations demonstrate that MegaGraph enables training on large-scale graphs where state-of-the-art baselines fail due to out-of-memory (OOM) errors. The framework reduces per-device peak memory by up to 77.8\% and achieves up to 4.51$\times$ training speedup while maintaining model accuracy.

</details>


### [1379] [On the Relation Between Interval Regret and Dynamic Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34423)
*Yi-Han Wang,Peng Zhao,Zhi-Hua Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究非平稳在线学习中区间遗憾（interval regret）和动态遗憾（dynamic regret）之间的关系，否定了"最优区间遗憾蕴含最优动态遗憾"的长期猜想，并提出了一种通过域转换和替代损失实现最优动态遗憾的通用归约方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳在线学习中，静态遗憾不足以衡量算法在变化环境中的表现。区间遗憾和动态遗憾作为两种互补的强化度量被广泛研究，但二者的关系长期不明。先前工作普遍认为区间遗憾更强，并猜想具备最优区间遗憾的算法应自动获得最优动态遗憾。

Method: （一）负结果：通过构造单位ℓ₂球上的线性损失和单位ℓ₃/₂球上的二次损失（兼具1-强凸和1/9-指数凹）的硬实例，证明仅凭区间遗憾保证无法推出最优动态遗憾下界；引入均匀聚合（homogeneous aggregation）的线性规划对偶精确刻画仅利用OIR所能得到的最大动态遗憾。（二）正结果：提出包装算法（Algorithm 1），将OIR算法在替代损失上的区间遗憾最小化过程运行于扩大欧氏球上，利用域转换技术（梯度修正+投影）和替代损失（线性/二次）实现逐轮遗憾传递；借助Baby–Wang事后分区（hindsight partition）和区间外比较器控制逼近误差，分别对凸、指数凹和强凸损失给出完整归约。

Result: （1）负结果：在线性损失情形构造Ω(τ^(2/5)T^(3/5))的动态遗憾下界，在二次损失情形构造Ω(τ^(3/5)T^(2/5))的下界，均显著差于最优速率Ω(√(TP_T))。同时证明在多面体（及其充分小的欧氏平滑）上OIR可推出ODR，常数取决于多面体几何。（2）正结果：对凸损失获得Õ(√(T(1+P_T)))，对指数凹损失获得Õ(d+d^(2/3)P_T^(2/3)T^(1/3))，对强凸损失获得Õ(1+P_T^(2/3)T^(1/3))，均与已知下界匹配至对数因子。（3）副产物：首次给出在一般凸域上兼具proper、高效和最优dynamic regret保证的指数凹在线学习算法，分析显著简于此前基于KKT的方法。包装算法同时给出每个子区间上的区间动态遗憾保证。

Conclusion: OIR到ODR的度量级蕴含取决于域几何：在线性损失的多面体及其欧氏平滑上成立，但在光滑域上不成立。然而，通过域转换（projection + gradient correction + 闭合形式替代损失）与事后分区，仍可借助OIR算法的局部自适应能力实现最优动态遗憾。本文澄清了两条独立发展的研究线之间的本质联系，并为指数凹函数在一般凸域上的最优动态学习提供了首个兼具proper性和高效性的算法。未来方向包括二阶比较器变化量的适应和未知曲率情形。

Abstract: Non-stationary online learning has attracted much attention in recent years, as static regret is insufficient to guide algorithm design in changing environments. To address this limitation, interval regret and dynamic regret have been introduced as two representative performance metrics that strengthen static regret in complementary directions. Interval regret requires an online algorithm to achieve competitive static regret over every local time interval, whereas dynamic regret evaluates performance against an arbitrary sequence of time-varying comparators. Despite their importance, the relation between these metrics has long remained unclear. Prior work has often regarded interval regret as the stronger notion, based on the intuition that local guarantees should naturally induce global guarantees. Consequently, it is widely conjectured that an algorithm with optimal interval regret should automatically attain optimal dynamic regret. In this paper, we first establish a negative result that refutes this intuition of a metric-level implication. Specifically, for both convex and curved functions (including exp-concave and strongly convex functions), we show that there exist instances in which an algorithm with optimal interval regret nevertheless fails to achieve optimal dynamic regret. We then show how to leverage local adaptivity to obtain optimal dynamic regret. In particular, optimal dynamic regret can be attained by invoking an interval regret minimization process over an enlarged Euclidean ball containing the original convex feasible domain and using a suitable domain-converted surrogate loss. This reduction applies to both convex and curved functions. As a byproduct, we obtain the first proper and efficient algorithm with optimal dynamic regret for exp-concave functions, improving prior results while significantly simplifying the analysis.

</details>


### [1380] [Q-learning Penalized Transformer for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34426)
*Shengchao Hu,Peng Wang,Jifeng Hu,Qiyang Zhou,Anning Hu,Li Shen,Ya Zhang,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QPT（Q-learning Penalized Transformer）框架，将条件Transformer策略与约束感知价值估计相结合，用于安全离线强化学习。它通过Q学习惩罚同时优化奖励最大化与成本最小化，并在推理时复用Q函数进行安全动作选择，在DSRL基准38个任务上表现优异且支持零样本成本阈值适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全离线强化学习面临三重挑战：满足安全约束、最大化奖励以及保持离线数据集的行为正则化。现有方法（如拉格朗日方法）在离线场景下因价值估计偏差导致策略不稳定或过度保守，且训练时成本阈值固定，无法零样本适应不同约束阈值。

Method: 1) 条件Transformer策略：以return-to-go和cost-to-go为条件生成动作，保持行为正则化。2) Q学习惩罚：在序列建模训练目标中加入奖励Q函数（最大化）和成本Q函数（最小化）的惩罚项，实现可控的损失平衡。3) 数据增强：通过重新标记Pareto最优轨迹的回报-成本对，处理不可行的目标规格。4) 推理集成：并行生成多个候选动作，利用Q函数在满足成本阈值的前提下选择最高奖励动作，实现训练-推理一致性。

Result: 在DSRL基准38个任务（含SafetyGym、BulletGym、MetaDrive）上，QPT是唯一在所有任务中同时满足安全要求（归一化成本≤1）并获得最高回报的方法。消融实验验证了四个组件（Q^r、Q^c、数据增强、推理集成）的有效性。QPT还展示了对不同成本阈值的鲁棒零样本适应能力，优于同样支持零样本适应的基线CDT。理论分析在近似确定性CMDP设定下给出了Q惩罚改善安全性和性能的界限。

Conclusion: QPT通过统一条件序列建模与约束感知价值估计，有效平衡了安全离线强化学习中的三重目标，在理论分析和大规模实验上均验证了其有效性和优越性。

Abstract: This paper addresses the problem of safe offline reinforcement learning, which involves training a policy to satisfy safety constraints using an offline dataset. This problem is inherently challenging as it requires balancing three highly interconnected and competing objectives: satisfying safety constraints, maximizing rewards, and adhering to the behavior regularization imposed by the offline dataset. To tackle this trilogy challenge, we propose Q-learning Penalized Transformer policy (QPT), a \emph{training--inference consistent} framework that bridges conditional sequence modeling with constraint-aware value estimation. QPT trains a Transformer policy that generates actions conditioned on trajectory context and target return/cost, retaining strong behavior regularization. To inject explicit safety semantics during learning, we augment sequence-model training with a Q-shaped penalty using learned reward and cost Q-functions to favor high return under low constraint violation. At inference, the same Q-functions enforce the cost threshold and choose the highest-reward feasible action, closing the loop between training and deployment. We provide a principled analysis under stylized near-deterministic CMDPs, characterizing how Q-penalized conditional generation improve safety and performance. Empirically, QPT consistently outperforms strong safe offline RL baselines across 38 tasks on the DSRL benchmark, and exhibits robust zero-shot adaptation to different constraint thresholds.

</details>


### [1381] [LLMs as Adaptive Meta-Solvers: Strategy-Diverse RL for Industrial-Scale Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34427)
*Shihao Zhang,Weiting Liu,Siyu Shao,Yitian Chen,Jianfeng Feng,Dongdong Ge,Yinyu Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Strategy-Diverse Reinforcement Learning (SDRL)框架，训练开源LLM作为自适应优化元求解器，针对工业级优化任务。通过correctness-gated层次化多样性奖励，鼓励在solver-integrated reasoning、精确组合算法和启发式搜索三种策略间进行多样化探索，并采用混合格式训练方案同时支持自包含文本问题和文件驱动实例。SDRL在7个优化基准上超越现有微调方法和前沿模型，32B模型在Pass@1上超越DeepSeek-V4-Pro和GPT-5.5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的优化方法主要在小型自包含文本问题上评估，且通常固定于单一求解范式（求解器集成），无法应对工业级优化任务的规模与结构多样性。不同问题结构和规模需要互补的计算策略（精确建模、专业算法、启发式搜索），但现有系统缺乏自适应策略选择能力。此外，RLVR训练中常出现entropy collapse和策略坍缩问题，限制了Pass@k的提升。

Method: 1. 策略多样性强化学习（SDRL）：将优化建模为元求解问题，通过三阶段轨迹（问题分析→策略路由→解决方案实现）让LLM自适应选择三种范式（SIR/精确组合算法/启发式搜索）。2. Correctness-gated层次化多样性奖励：宏观层面奖励少数派策略（基于self-information），微观层面通过DBSCAN聚类log-runtime奖励策略内的不同运行时模式，仅对成功rollout施加。3. 混合格式训练：构建file-grounded训练数据（通过LLM将文本实例转换为参数化问题+外部CSV文件），联合训练文本和文件驱动实例。4. 基于GRPO的RLVR训练，使用DAPO非对称clipping（ε_low=0.20, ε_high=0.28），策略一致性规则检查防止reward hacking。

Result: 在7个基准（NL4Opt、MAMO-E/C、IndustryOR、OptMATH、OptiBench、MIPLIB-NL）上：SDRL-Qwen3-4B平均Pass@1达64.6%，超越所有现有微调基线（包括32B模型如SIRL-Qwen2.5-32B的58.6%）；SDRL-Qwen3-32B达69.7%，超越DeepSeek-V4-Pro（68.6%）和GPT-5.5（69.6%）。在文件驱动的MIPLIB-NL上，SDRL-32B达30.0% Pass@1（vs 基线Qwen3-32B的10.5%）。消融研究证实层次化多样性奖励各组件互补：宏观项提升Pass@8，微观项提升Pass@1。混合格式训练实现Pass@1最佳平衡。Pass@k曲线显示SDRL随k增长优势扩大，证实多样化策略路径带来更多可解实例。运行时分析表明微层奖励未导致程序变慢。

Conclusion: SDRL通过训练LLM作为自适应优化元求解器，有效解决了工业级优化任务中策略选择的难题。层次化多样性奖励成功防止了RL训练中的过早策略坍缩，同时保持实现可靠性。混合格式训练方案提升了数据效率和现实场景适应性。32B模型在Pass@1和Pass@8上均达到开源模型SOTA，超越多个前沿闭源模型。局限在于严格容差评估未能充分反映启发式方法在计算效率上的价值，未来工作应开发同时考虑解质量与计算成本的评估指标。

Abstract: Scaling LLM-based optimization from textbook-scale instances to real-world, industrial tasks remains a critical open challenge. Existing approaches are predominantly evaluated on small, self-contained textual problems and often commit to a solver-integrated paradigm, limiting their ability to handle the scale and structural diversity of practical optimization workloads. In this work, we propose a practical framework for training open-source LLMs to tackle real-world, industrial-scale optimization. We first show empirically that solver-integrated reasoning, exact combinatorial algorithm, and heuristic search exhibit complementary strengths across different problem structures and scales. Motivated by this, we introduce Strategy-Diverse Reinforcement Learning (SDRL), which trains LLMs as adaptive optimization meta-solvers. SDRL leverages this complementarity through a correctness-gated hierarchical diversity reward that promotes robust exploration across varying strategies and within each strategy, effectively preventing premature strategy collapse. We further introduce a mixed-format training scheme that jointly supports both self-contained textual problems and file-grounded instances. Across comprehensive evaluations, our framework outperforms existing fine-tuned methods and frontier models including DeepSeek-V4-Pro and GPT-5.5, both on average across benchmarks and on industrial-scale optimization tasks.

</details>


### [1382] [Harmonizing Spectral Evolution in Conditional Flow Matching for TTS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34431)
*Isha Pandey Varad Deshpande Abhijat Bharadwaj Ganesh Ramakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"频率选择性增强"(Frequency-Selective Boosting, FSB)的无需训练的推理策略，通过离散小波变换(DWT)对CFM-TTS模型在ODE积分过程中的mel频谱子带进行动态调整，以解决频谱演化不连贯的问题，在减少函数评估次数(NFE)的同时显著提升音频质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件流匹配(CFM)模型在TTS任务中存在频谱频率成分演化不连贯的问题：低频近似子带增长过快，而高频细节子带发展滞后。这种固有的频率偏差导致现有扩散模型领域的通用频谱修正方法无法直接迁移到CFM-TTS中。需要一种针对CFM声学动力学特性的频谱协调策略。

Method: 方法核心是FSB策略：在ODE积分的每一步，对中间mel频谱应用二维DWT分解得到LL(近似)、LH、HL、HH(细节)四个子带，根据观察到的子带能量轨迹计算再加权系数β_f(t)，抑制过度增长的子带、增强滞后发展的子带，然后通过逆DWT重建。F5-TTS采用指数衰减调度衰减LL和HL子带；Matcha-TTS采用线性调度微调LH和HL子带。调度参数通过一次性校准确定，无需重新训练模型。

Result: 在F5-TTS、Matcha-TTS和IndicF5三种架构上的实验表明：FSB将所需NFE从32降至26；在LibriTTS-clean上FAD降低48%，LibriTTS-other上降低52%，Matcha-TTS上降低61%；WER/CER、说话人相似度、主观MOS评分均不降低；平均运行时间减少16.4%。跨语言迁移验证(IndicF5复用F5-TTS调度)也取得FAD减半的效果。消融实验证实指数调度优于线性调度，多项式调度失效；轨迹稳定性分析显示FSB不会引入修正尖峰。

Conclusion: 本文识别了CFM-TTS中DWT子带演化不连贯这一共有局限性，提出的FSB是一种无需训练、步长相关的再加权策略，能有效协调ODE积分过程中的频谱发展。该方法在多种架构和语言上均能提升频谱收敛速度、音频质量和效率，且低维调度仅需一次性校准。未来方向包括自动调度估计和扩展到波形域流模型。

Abstract: Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) models for text-to-speech (TTS) suffer from incoherent frequency evolution during inference. While similar spectral imbalances are addressed in diffusion models for other domains, those generic solutions fail to generalize to the inherently uncoordinated acoustic dynamics of CFM. We demonstrate that this issue can be effectively mitigated by introducing a novel training-free frequency-selective boosting strategy. Using the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT), our method dynamically modulates mel-spectrogram sub-bands during ODE integration, synchronizing spectral development by penalizing aggressive low-frequency growth and boosting lagging high-frequency details. Validated across diverse architectures (Matcha-TTS, F5-TTS, IndicF5), our approach reduces the required Number of Function Evaluations (NFE) from 32 to 26 and improves Frechet Audio Distance (FAD) by up to 61%, all without compromising mean opinion scores, speaker similarity, and speech intelligibility.

</details>


### [1383] [Admissible Diffusion for Multimodal Interventional Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34433)
*Xing Han,Shravan Chaudhari,Jiarui Shao,Paul Pu Liang,Suchi Saria*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ADMIT是一个结合多模态不规则表征、治疗条件潜在扩散模型和显式生理约束的框架，用于生成临床干预轨迹。它通过序列g-计算构建因果干预目标，并在生成过程中通过状态投影或动作门控施加生理学先验约束。初步实验表明多模态输入改善了隐藏状态恢复，剂量时间效应可被学习，显式暴露约束能减少规则违反，但简化的GRU基线在平均预测上表现相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的临床轨迹模型要么无法处理多模态不规则观测，要么不能在生成过程中施加生理学先验约束。生成合理轨迹不等于能回答"如果采用不同治疗会怎样"的干预问题。物理限制可约束扩散模型，但合理轨迹仍需因果假设和充分的治疗支持才能回答干预问题。因此需要一个同时应对三大挑战的模拟器：从多模态历史中学习、在替代治疗方案下生成轨迹、以及在rollout过程中施加生理学知识。

Method: ADMIT框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 多模态不规则表征——使用时间注意力对齐观测到参考网格，门控局部核保留快速变化，四个专家的top-2混合融合，16维高斯变分潜状态；(2) 治疗条件潜在扩散——采用DDPM训练生成残差块U₀=Z_{t+1:t+B}-Zₜ，通过学习到的缩放和偏移参数将动作调制到去噪器特征中；(3) 可接纳性(admissibility)机制——通过浓度投影（梯度下降迭代）或动作门控施加生理学约束，在rollout过程中影响后续轨迹生成。干预目标通过序列g-计算公式化，将因果假设与约束满足区分开。

Result: 多模态输入将隐藏混杂因子的监督恢复MSE降低74.2%，治疗对比RMSE降低14.2%。在模拟化疗剂量调度实验中，正确清除率下ADMIT将front-loaded和break差异的RMSE分别降低78%和69%（相对于零效应参考）。暴露输入使break-difference RMSE降低21-25%（即使清除率错误），但缩小了预测的剂量效应大小。GRU基线在平均预测上匹配ADMIT。暴露投影将违反率从89.6%降至1.0%（保留率0.9时），但保留率为0时仅降至27.7%。在半合成eICU实验中，ADMIT对始终治疗和自适应策略的治疗效应RMSE分别为0.488和0.357，优于无效应参考(0.804/0.621)。

Conclusion: ADMIT提供了一个测试互补观测和生理限制是否能改善干预轨迹的框架。核心教训是恢复患者信息、预测治疗效应和执行生理规则是三个不同的要求——一项的进展必须对照其他项进行检查。未来工作应评估跨患者群体和治疗设置的泛化性、开发更丰富的生理约束、评估不确定性校准。确立临床价值需要使用每个治疗决策时点可获得的信息进行进一步验证。

Abstract: Generating a plausible clinical trajectory does not establish what would happen under a different treatment. We present ADMIT, a framework combining irregular multimodal representations, treatment-conditioned latent diffusion and explicit constraints on generated states or actions. We formulate its interventional target through sequential g-computation and distinguish causal assumptions from constraint satisfaction. Its admissibility mechanism translates physiological prior knowledge into explicit constraints on generated states and proposed actions. Treatment-exposure dynamics condition latent transitions, while state projection or action gating applies the constraints during rollout so that they influence subsequent trajectory generation. In our preliminary experiments, multimodal inputs improved supervised hidden-state recovery and reduced treatment-contrast error. In a simulated dosing-schedule experiment with leak-free history encoding, ADMIT predicted most of the tumor-volume change caused by redistributing a fixed total dose. An exposure input improved these predictions around a temporary dose reduction whether or not the assumed clearance rate was correct, but reduced the predicted size of a dose effect, and a deterministic recurrent baseline matched ADMIT's average predictions. Exposure projection reduced constraint violations, although enforcement remained incomplete. Semi-synthetic experiments using eICU context illustrated treatment-response generation under fixed and adaptive policies. Observational examples further characterize model treatment sensitivity. ADMIT provides a framework for testing whether complementary observations and physiological restrictions improve intervention trajectories, with representation recovery, effect accuracy and rule enforcement assessed separately.

</details>


### [1384] [Making LLMs Truly Forget: Deep Unlearning by Searching, Selecting, and Severing Knowledge Paths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34442)
*Jialu Wang,Peizhi Niu,Haoteng Yin,Hans Hao-Hsun Hsu,Pan Li,Rongzhe Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DUMIC框架，通过自适应树搜索（结合显式响应与中间层潜在实体解码）、置信度感知的支持子图构建和图最小割选择，实现LLM的深度遗忘，在有效切断多跳推理恢复路径的同时保持模型效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法仅针对孤立的事实，忽略了支撑知识——目标事实可通过相关知识的多跳推理被重构，导致"表层遗忘"无法实现真正的遗忘。

Method: 三阶段框架：1）Search阶段通过自适应树搜索，结合模型显式响应与Jacobian lens解码的中间层潜在实体来发现支持路径；2）Select阶段利用LLM验证路径有效性并通过置信度过滤构建置信度感知支持子图；3）Sever阶段对支持子图施加置信度加权的图最小割，以最小代价选择需遗忘的事实集合。配套提出基于模型特定知识的评估管道，通过校准置信度过滤参考知识图谱。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-27B和Gemma4-31B-Base上使用五种遗忘方法验证：DUMIC在遗忘效果（UES）上比表层遗忘提升12%-359%，同时局部效用（Loc）远优于完全删除支持子图（DeepUnlearn）的方法；Jacobian lens使发现路径数提升1.39-2.59倍，目标覆盖率从76-91%提升至93-96%；在LoRA设置下同样有效。

Conclusion: 真正的LLM遗忘需要打破能够重构目标事实的关系结构；DUMIC通过精准切断推理恢复路径实现了深层遗忘，在遗忘深度与模型效用间取得更好平衡，验证了针对支撑知识的遗忘策略的必要性。

Abstract: While an unlearned language model may no longer recall a fact directly, the fact often remains recoverable through multi-hop reasoning over related knowledge. Most existing unlearning techniques overlook this vulnerability, targeting facts in isolation while leaving their supporting knowledge intact. To achieve true forgetting, we propose a general deep unlearning framework compatible with existing unlearning algorithms. Our approach adaptively explores both explicit responses and latent internal representations to discover valid reasoning paths, compiles them into a confidence-aware supporting subgraph, and we apply a graph minimum cut to sever all recovery paths while preserving unrelated knowledge. To rigorously evaluate deep unlearning, we introduce a model-specific pipeline that extracts and completes knowledge graphs from raw text, filtering them by calibrated model confidence to reflect what the model genuinely retains. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that selectively unlearning supporting knowledge yields substantially deeper forgetting than superficial methods while preserving model utility, highlighting that genuine unlearning requires breaking the relational structures that enable factual reconstruction.

</details>


### [1385] [Livin' on a Prior: Likelihood Score Approximation for Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34446)
*Rostislav Makarov,Tal Peer,Danilo de Oliveira,Timo Gerkmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 LSA（Likelihood Score Approximation），一种用于求解逆问题的生成框架。LSA 保持预训练的无条件生成模型（先验）冻结，仅学习一个观测条件网络来逼近似然分数（likelihood score），从而将后验向量场分解为先验项与似然修正项之和。该框架基于随机插值（stochastic interpolant）形式化，可独立于先验的原生参数化在分数或速度坐标下训练，并支持确定性（ODE）与随机性（SDE）后验采样。训练时未知退化可从少量配对样本中学习；已知退化则可使用先验自生成的配对数据，无需真实配对数据。实验覆盖语音（增强、带宽扩展、STFT 相位恢复）和图像（ImageNet-256/512 多种退化）逆问题，在约 0.01% 数据量下仍有效；在 ImageNet-256 基准上以少几个数量级的网络函数评估次数（NFE）达到与强后验采样基线相当或更好的重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的逆问题求解方法存在两类局限：（1）依赖已知退化算子的后验采样方法对算子的可用性要求高；（2）基于配对数据的条件生成模型需要大量配对样本，训练成本高。本文希望填补两类方法之间的空白：既能利用少量配对数据或自生成数据学习未知退化，又能保持先验不变并支持高效推理。

Method: 1. 基于单边高斯随机插值 X_t = α_t X_0 + σ_t ε 构建概率路径；2. 利用贝叶斯分解将后验分数/速度场分解为冻结先验场 + 似然分数修正项；3. 保持预训练无条件模型 f_θ(x,t) 冻结，单独训练观测条件网络 ℓ̂_ψ^f(x,y,t) 逼近后验与先验场之差；4. 训练目标为 LSA 损失：仅优化 ψ，通过 stop-gradient 让 f_θ 不更新；5. 支持分数、速度、数据预测三种等价参数化，参数选择独立于先验原生形式；6. 支持概率流 ODE 与带可调扩散系数 ρ 的 SDE 后验采样；7. 引入 LSA 时间相关权重 ζ_t 与 restart-based refinement 推理增强；8. 先验可在训练后替换而不需重训 LSA（prior swapping）。

Result: 语音任务：1 分钟/10 分钟配对数据下，LSA 在增强、带宽扩展、STFT 相位恢复上均优于 ControlNet 和 direct posterior；在 EARS 全量数据下与全监督方法（StreamFlow、AnyEnhance 等）相当或更好；VoiceBank 域外评估通过先验替换（VB prior）得到改善。图像任务：ImageNet-256 DAPS 基准 7 种退化任务中，LSA 的 FID、LPIPS、SSIM 多项优于 DAPS、RePS、RED-diff、MAS 等 DPS 类基线，PSNR 相当，但 NFE 减少可达数个数量级（如超分 21 vs 1000，HDR 20 vs 4000）；128 对低数据设置下全面优于 ControlNet、LoRA、DEFT；ImageNet-512 8× 超分上仅用 100 对即可超过 DMAP+CSE 用 1000 对的 FID。先验替换实验表明训练好的 LSA 配合不同先验仍保持有效重建。

Conclusion: LSA 提出了一种简洁、统一的生成式逆问题求解框架：将后验分解为先验 + 似然分数修正，仅学习修正部分且与先验解耦。该方法兼容分数和速度两种生成模型参数化，支持 ODE/SDE 采样与先验替换，在少样本（语音分钟级、图像 25–128 对）和已知退化自生成场景下均显著有效，且推理成本远低于传统 DPS 类方法。结果表明该框架是稀疏配对数据和高效后验采样的实用统一方案。

Abstract: Generative models have found great success as data-driven methods of solving inverse problems. Two popular approaches work either by combining a pretrained generative prior with a known degradation model, or by training a conditional generative model directly from paired data. We target a setting that spans both regimes: unknown degradations can be learned from few paired examples, while known degradations can be learned from self-generated samples. We introduce Likelihood Score Approximation (LSA), a generative framework that keeps a pretrained unconditional model fixed and learns an observation-conditioned model that approximates the likelihood score from paired samples. Within a conditional stochastic-interpolant framework, LSA can be trained in either score or velocity coordinates, independently of the unconditional model's native parameterization, and supports both deterministic and stochastic sampling. We further show empirically that the prior model can be swapped post-training while keeping the same LSA model. Across speech and image inverse problems, LSA operates effectively even at roughly 0.01% of the full training dataset. On the ImageNet-256 benchmark it achieves competitive or better restoration quality than strong posterior-sampling baselines while requiring up to several orders of magnitude fewer network evaluations.

</details>


### [1386] [PhysioTRACE: Provenance-Aware Stress Tests for Physiological Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34466)
*Ayana Mussabayeva,Anuar Aimoldin,Olivier Oullier,Xue Liu,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PhysioTRACE提出一种四轴行为审计框架，用于检测冻结生理基础模型的任务头是否依赖采集来源（acquisition provenance）信息，并在依赖被检测时提供可验证的补救措施，最终输出三种判定之一：无依赖、依赖且补救已认证、或依赖但补救被拒绝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生理基础模型（PFM）的冻结编码器可能在嵌入中保留采集条件（如参考电极、设备、站点）的痕迹，当这些采集来源与诊断标签相关时，任务头可能利用这种"捷径"而非真实生理信号。现有评估通常使用迁移准确率或探针可解码性来推断这种风险，但两者都不能证明预测器实际使用了采集来源信息——可访问性不等于依赖性。

Method: PhysioTRACE通过四个连续步骤审计冻结编码器：(1) Recover用校准的多项Logistic探针衡量采集来源的线性可访问性（Linear Provenance Information, LPI）；(2) Stress在固定边际条件下，仅反转同一held-out记录上采集来源与目标的关联，比较在关联下训练的暴露头（exposed head）与独立权重训练的控制头（control head），定义"超额脆弱性"G；(3) Intervene通过配对视图对比或目标条件探针定位训练集中的低秩来源成分并进行白化投影抑制；(4) Verify要求抑制效果超过秩与能量匹配的随机Haar子空间（特异性），且任务效用损失在预设边界δ内（安全性），否则拒绝认证。算法最终返回三种判定。

Result: 在EEG和ECG数据、五个训练目标和五个冻结PFM上的实验表明：(1) LPI与分布外效用的关系在不同数据集间符号反转，提示两者都不能替代依赖性测试；(2) 在配对NMT EEG（已知构造的捷径）中，审计检测到依赖（暴露头损失约0.20–0.22 AUROC），并认证了秩2抑制方案，使暴露头恢复至控制水平而效用损失可忽略；(3) 在观测性ECG设备元数据上，审计返回全部三种判定——认证ECGFounder的秩1补救（消除91%超额脆弱性）、在弱关联设备对上判定无依赖、拒绝CLEF-Small的补救（其定位方向同时携带任务信号，会损失0.039 AUROC）。

Conclusion: 生理基础模型即使通过所有迁移基准测试，仍可能携带可部署的捷径；仅迁移指标和探针分数无法支持"对采集方式鲁棒"的声明。PhysioTRACE通过固定边际关联压力测试、训练局部化抑制以及对照头和随机子空间匹配，将该声明转化为可通过、可失败或可拒绝的行为测试，为PFM评估提供了一种可复现、可验证的审计协议。

Abstract: Physiological foundation models encode how a signal was recorded alongside the physiology it reflects. When recording conditions are associated with diagnosis, this acquisition provenance can become a shortcut, yet the usual evidence, shifted transfer and provenance decodability, does not show whether a predictor uses it. We introduce PhysioTRACE, a four-axis behavioral audit for frozen encoders that separates what a probe can decode from what a fixed task head relies on. Recover scores how decodable provenance is; Stress reverses only the provenance-target association on the same held-out records; Intervene removes a train-localized provenance component; and Verify certifies that removal only if it beats matched random projections within a declared utility margin. Each audit thus ends in one of three verdicts: no reliance, or reliance with the remedy certified or refused. Across EEG and ECG, five training objectives, and five frozen foundation models, the relation between Recover's calibrated score and out-of-distribution utility changes sign between datasets, so neither can stand in for a reliance test. On paired EEG views where the shortcut is known by construction, the audit detects it (the exposed head loses about 0.2 AUROC when the association is reversed, while a control head is unaffected) and certifies removal of a rank-two component that restores control-level behavior without measurable utility loss, for both encoder objectives tested. On real ECG device metadata it returns all three verdicts: it certifies a remedy that removes 91% of one model's excess vulnerability, finds no reliance where device and diagnosis are barely associated, and refuses the remedy for a second model whose localized direction also carries task signal. Robustness to how inputs were recorded therefore needs a behavioral test, and PhysioTRACE provides one that can pass, fail, or refuse a remedy.

</details>


### [1387] [Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34467)
*Shengchao Hu,Peng Wang,Qiyang Zhou,Guodong Zheng,Yuqi Huang,Li Shen,Ya Zhang,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AGFT提出了一种基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略学习框架，通过引入显式的三模态对比对齐损失，缓解视觉、语言和动作之间的表征错位问题，在保持高成功率的同时显著降低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型普遍存在视觉-语言-动作三模态错位（tri-modal misalignment）问题，导致动作语义基础（action grounding）薄弱、泛化能力差、微调效率低。同时主流基于扩散（diffusion）的动作头迭代去噪过程计算开销大，难以满足实时控制需求。

Method: 1) 基于Dita的DiT架构，使用冻结CLIP编码语言、可微调DINOv2提取视觉特征，经Q-Former+FiLM压缩后与动作噪声向量拼接，送入因果Transformer预测动作；2) 训练目标采用确定性流匹配损失替代扩散损失，加速推理；3) 额外引入三模态成对对比对齐损失（text-action、image-action、image-language），以欧氏距离+边界约束在共享嵌入空间内强制跨模态语义一致性；4) 理论证明：流匹配目标上下界均与三模态平均距离 d_avg 相关，收紧 d_avg 可缩小可行范围，提升优化紧度。

Result: 在LIBERO四个子集（Sp/Obj/Goal/Long）和CALVIN（ABC→D）基准上达到SOTA：LIBERO平均成功率88.9%（Long 75.2%），超越Dita基线7.9%；推理时间仅0.295s/样本（10步），远快于Dita的1.573s（100步）。消融验证：动作中心对齐损失贡献最大；仅微调CLIP反而损害性能；仅微调DINOv2+Transformer达到75.2%。α在[0.001,1]区间表现稳定。

Conclusion: AGFT证实三模态对齐是VLA可扩展性的关键瓶颈，而非单纯的建模容量；流匹配结合显式对比对齐可在保持竞争力的同时显著提升部署效率，为大规模具身策略学习提供了理论支撑（benchmark-agnostic的对齐-优化紧度联系）和实证基础。主要局限是验证仅在LIBERO和CALVIN仿真基准上进行。

Abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models point toward general-purpose robotic intelligence by unifying perception, instruction, and control. Despite impressive progress, existing VLA models often adapt poorly due to \emph{tri-modal misalignment} among vision, language, and action, which weakens action grounding and hurts generalization and fine-tuning efficiency. In this work, we present Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer (AGFT), a novel framework that explicitly enforces tri-modal alignment through a dedicated alignment loss, bridging the representational gap across modalities and enhancing task adaptation. While prior research has predominantly emphasized bi-modal vision--language alignment, we systematically formalize and study tri-modal alignment in VLA models, and provide both ablations and analysis to isolate its role in improving adaptation and robustness. To further accelerate deployment, we adopt a flow-matching objective, enabling substantially fewer inference steps than diffusion-based policies while maintaining accuracy. Theoretically, we establish a quantitative connection between the tri-modal alignment gap and the optimization tightness of flow matching; empirically, experiments on the extensive benchmark show that AGFT achieves superior success rates and lower inference latency compared to SOTA baselines, underscoring tri-modal alignment as a key ingredient for scaling robust VLA manipulation.

</details>


### [1388] [Deep kernel hedging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34474)
*Jean-Loup Dupret,Donatien Hainaut,Edouard Motte*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种深度核套保框架，将深度学习的灵活性与核方法的结构归纳偏置相结合，用于金融对冲问题。该框架通过对输入特征的神经网络嵌入来参数化核函数，并引入截断时间增广签名特征来捕捉路径依赖信息。最终通过广义表示定理将优化问题降维，并利用随机傅里叶特征近似实现可扩展计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融对冲任务中面临高维路径依赖、有限数据以及凸风险度量（如CVaR）等挑战。标准核方法虽具有结构归纳偏置但表达能力有限，而深度学习方法缺乏结构性偏置且在小样本下表现不稳定。本文旨在融合两者优势，在低数据场景下实现鲁棒且具有竞争力的对冲性能。

Method: 1. 将对冲函数限制在由神经网络嵌入参数化的再生核Hilbert空间内；
2. 引入截断时间增广签名特征处理路径依赖信息；
3. 推导广义联合表示定理，将经验优化降为有限维问题；
4. 采用随机傅里叶特征近似降低核矩阵计算成本，参数在训练前固定，深度核通过神经网络适应市场数据；
5. 在合成数据和真实数据上与标准核方法和经典深度套保架构进行比较。

Result: 数值实验表明，所提出的深度核方法在合成数据和真实数据上均展现出具有竞争力且鲁棒的对冲性能，特别是在低数据情形下表现突出，优于标准核方法和经典深度套保架构。

Conclusion: 将核方法的归纳偏置与神经网络的表达能力相结合，能够在低数据场景下显著提升对冲策略的鲁棒性与性能。随机傅里叶特征近似与广义表示定理使该框架兼具理论保证和计算可扩展性，为金融对冲提供了一种有效的新方法。

Abstract: We introduce a deep kernel hedging framework that combines the flexibility of deep learning with the structural inductive bias of kernel methods. The hedging functional is restricted to a reproducing kernel Hilbert space whose kernel is parameterized through a neural network embedding of the input features. The framework minimizes a regularized empirical risk under convex loss functions and can accommodate path-dependent information through truncated time-augmented signature features. We derive a generalized representer theorem for the joint hedging problem, reducing the empirical optimization to a finite-dimensional problem. To further reduce the computational cost associated with large kernel matrices, we develop a scalable random Fourier feature approximation and establish convergence guarantees. The random Fourier parameters are sampled once and remain fixed throughout training, while the deep kernel adapts to market data through the learned neural representation. We evaluate the performance of the proposed deep kernel approach on both synthetic and real data and compare it with standard kernel methods and classical deep hedging architectures. Numerical results indicate competitive and robust hedging performance, particularly in low-data regimes, which highlights the benefits of combining expressive neural representations with the inductive bias of kernel methods.

</details>


### [1389] [When Less Data Favors Smaller Teachers: Rethinking Teacher Capacity and Data Selection for Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34489)
*Minjae Park,Taesun Yeom,Jaeho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究知识蒸馏（KD）中数据剪枝场景下的教师容量选择问题，发现小教师在低数据预算下优于大教师，并将教师监督信号分解为关系排序（relational ordering）和分数几何（score geometry）两个组成部分。基于此提出了无需训练动力学信息的DVA方法，使用小教师作为代理进行预算感知难度过滤和类条件关系体积最大化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点认为教师容量越大蒸馏效果越好，但实证观察表明在数据剪枝的低数据预算场景下，小教师反而优于大教师。理解这一现象的根源对于教师选择和数据子集构建都至关重要。

Method: 将教师监督信号分解为关系排序（类别排名）和分数几何（概率幅值与间隔）两个维度，发现两者均贡献于小教师在低数据场景下的优势。在此基础上提出两个有效子集原则：样本难度应与预算匹配、关系信号应多样化。进而提出DVA方法：(1)使用小教师输出进行预算感知的难度过滤构建候选池；(2)对候选样本进行SVD关系投影；(3)通过log-determinant体积最大化目标贪心选择多样化的子集。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet和ImageNet上，使用ResNet和ViT架构进行了全面实验。DVA在所有剪枝率下均优于其他训练动力学无关基线，在低数据场景下优势尤为显著（如0.9剪枝率下比最强基线提升4.77pp），且与依赖训练动力学的方法具有竞争力。在ImageNet上选择成本降低25.4倍。可直接应用于现成预训练教师，无需额外训练。

Conclusion: 研究表明教师-学生容量差异并非决定KD性能的唯一因素，关系排序和分数几何共同驱动了低数据预算下的小教师优势。DVA通过预算感知难度过滤和关系体积最大化实现了有效的训练动力学无关数据选择，可在多种架构、数据集和蒸馏设置下直接使用预训练教师，具有良好的可扩展性和泛化性。

Abstract: Data pruning reduces the training cost of knowledge distillation (KD). However, the preferred teacher capacity changes with the data budget: smaller teachers can outperform larger ones when limited training data are available. Understanding what drives this shift is important not only for teacher choice but also for identifying which samples are useful for distillation. We analyze teacher supervision by decomposing it into relational ordering---the ranking of classes---and score geometry---the magnitudes and margins of class probabilities---and show that the small-teacher advantage in the low-data regime arises not only from score geometry but also from relational ordering. Beyond understanding teacher capacity, our analysis reveals two properties of effective subsets: samples should match the difficulty appropriate for the available budget, and their relational signals should be diverse rather than redundant. Based on these findings, we propose DVA (Difficulty- and Volume-Aware data selection for KD), a training-dynamics-free method, which uses a small teacher as a proxy for budget-aware difficulty filtering and class-conditional relational volume maximization. Despite requiring no training dynamics statistics, our method remains competitive with training-dynamics-based methods while consistently outperforming training-dynamics-free baselines.

</details>


### [1390] [M3OS: A Monte Carlo Graph Search-Orchestrated Multi-Agent LLM System for Evidence-Traced Molecular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34491)
*Junjie Wang,Yaowei Jin,Ruohui Tang,Guonan Cui,Haojie Wang,Penglei Wang,Dingyan Wang,Duo An,Shuangjia Zheng,Qian Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: M3OS是一个用于多目标小分子优化的多智能体LLM系统，通过蒙特卡洛图搜索(MCGS)将分子设计推理与优化状态管理解耦。系统通过持久化图存储候选分子、父子变换关系和评估证据，由两个互补的生成分支(工具驱动的创造性生成和知识驱动的合理药物化学编辑)协作产生候选分子，并在三个分子优化基准测试上取得了优于基线的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在迭代式多目标分子优化中，当LLM主要依靠对话上下文来管理优化历史时，需要反复从不断演变的文本记录中恢复候选分子身份、先前评估和任务约束，这容易导致证据遗漏、候选-结果关联错误或约束解释不一致。该研究的核心动机是将设计推理与状态管理解耦，以持久化的候选分子链接搜索状态，使每个智能体专注于其当前决策所需的信息，而无需重建整体优化历史。

Method: 该方法采用多智能体LLM系统架构，核心组件包括：(1) 持久化有向分子搜索图，以规范化SMILES标识节点，记录生成来源、评估证据和搜索统计量，边编码父子变换；(2) 蒙特卡洛图搜索(MCGS)利用累积奖励和访问统计量进行UCB排序，并由LLM从候选名单中选择扩展父节点；(3) 两个并行的生成分支——Creative Molecule Explorer使用REINVENT4等分子生成工具构建候选池，Rational Medicinal Designer使用药物化学知识和从专利中提取的优化案例进行有针对性的编辑；(4) MedChem Retrieval Agent提供简洁的来源链接指导；(5) 执行控制框架——Chief Architect将目标形式化为任务契约，Auditor仅从明确陈述的分子和证据中提取结构化记录，由分子验证和规范身份检查控制图的更新。

Result: 在三个分子优化基准测试上的实验结果表明：M3OS优于使用相同LLM骨干(Kimi-K3 Low)和分子工具访问的基线(Codex和Claude Code)。在MolOpt-120上，平均严格成功率从R1的约0.47提高到R3的0.70，高于Codex的0.60和Claude Code的0.61；在MuMOInstruct-100上，R3轮联合成功率约为0.85；在SMDD-Bench-93上，最终单解成功率为0.59，图中任意解成功率为0.61。消融研究表明，完整的Creative+Rational组合配置优于单一分支，且案例检索的影响大于药物化学检索的影响。DHFR_16案例研究显示，M3OS在三轮搜索中识别出19个满足完整任务契约的候选分子。

Conclusion: M3OS提出了一种将评估后的分子候选分子作为智能体间协调共享单元的架构，将"提出何种结构编辑"的局部决策与"继续何种优化轨迹"的长期决策联系起来。研究支持了持久化搜索状态、专门化智能体和受控执行三者集成的价值。生成器组合的比较表明联合属性改进是完整配置最明显的优势，而SMDD-Bench-93测试则验证了系统交付满足耦合设计约束的最终分子的能力。由于当前评估使用预测属性，前瞻性合成和实验测定对于建立选定候选分子的实验活性和ADMET特征是必要的。

Abstract: Small-molecule optimization integrates medicinal-chemistry reasoning and computational evidence through iterative, multi-objective decisions. When large language models (LLMs) reason over optimization histories stored primarily in conversational context, they must recover candidate identities, prior evaluations, and task constraints to guide subsequent decisions. We present M3OS, a multi-agent LLM system that decouples molecular-design reasoning from optimization-state management through Monte Carlo graph search. A persistent graph links evaluated candidates, parent-child transformations and evaluation evidence, while rewards and visit statistics guide LLM-assisted parent selection. Two branches combine tool-driven candidate generation with knowledge- and case-guided medicinal-chemistry editing. An execution harness controls graph updates through structured output extraction, molecular validation and task-bound evaluation. Agents receive role-specific contexts, while the graph preserves optimization trajectories beyond their active contexts. Across three molecular optimization benchmarks, M3OS achieves higher success rates than baselines, supporting the integration of persistent search state, specialized agents and controlled execution for multi-constraint optimization.

</details>


### [1391] [LLN: Learnable Lens Networks for Parameter-Efficient Long-Horizon Dynamical Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34493)
*Binbin Yong,Zhao Su,Lan Guo,Haoran Li,Jun Shen,Qingguo Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Learnable Lens Networks (LLN)，一种受物理光学启发的深度架构，在增广的位置-角度相空间中交替进行自由传播与可学习透镜场折射，取代传统的特征空间残差加法。在长时域动力学预测任务上以更少参数实现更低误差，且梯度传输接近中性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统残差连接 (x+f(x)) 主要为梯度传播提供代数捷径，但不约束特征几何在深度方向的演化；当无法依赖归一化等辅助机制时，反复的特征空间加法可能导致不可控的尺度与几何变化。需要一种从状态空间层面稳定深层变换的架构偏置。

Method: LLN 将隐藏状态表示为增广相空间中的位置 y 与角度 θ 耦合变量；每层先做自由传播 (y←y+Lθ)，再施加由坐标级高斯基展开参数化的可学习透镜场 (θ←θ+φ(y))。理论上证明每层映射对任意可微透镜场均全局可逆且体积保持（det(J)=1）；高斯实现进一步满足辛性，从而产生互倒奇异值配对。浅层 LLN 在嵌入与读出无约束条件下保持连续端到端映射的通用逼近性。

Result: 在 Lorenz 混沌流、弹簧链、Burgers、对流-扩散与反应-扩散五类十种动力学系统的 500 步自回归滚动中，D=40 时 LLN 在 9/10 系统上达到最低或并列最低 MSE，尤其在耗散型 PDE（Burgers/AdvecDiff/ReactionDiff）上误差降至对比基线的 14%–30%，参数仅用 5.5%–57.5%，匹配算术 FLOP 约为 29%–33%。初始化梯度传输审计显示 LLN 的 log10(g1/g40) 接近 0（≈0.000–0.008），显著优于 Plain MLP（≈−15.3）和无缩放 ResMLP（≈+3.1）。结构消融表明同时移除透镜、初始角度或传播任一组件均会显著退化。

Conclusion: LLN 以相空间几何偏置替代特征空间残差加法，在耗散型空间动力学上提供了参数高效、可解释且梯度稳定的深度替代方案；理论上的体积保持/辛性约束与嵌入-读出的灵活性兼容，并通过通用逼近定理保证表达能力。主要局限：受益程度因动力系统类型而异，确定律-level 几何结果不直接保证条件数或 Lyapunov 稳定性，实验限于固定深度 MLP 风格的一步模型。

Abstract: Explicit residual connections of the form (x+f(x)), often combined with normalization layers, have become a standard strategy for training very deep neural networks. However, residual addition primarily provides an algebraic shortcut for gradient propagation, while leaving the evolution of feature geometry across layers largely unconstrained. We introduce Learnable Lens Networks (LLN), a physics-inspired architecture that replaces direct feature-space residual accumulation with learnable optical transport in an augmented position-angle phase space. Each layer alternates between free propagation, which provides an implicit transport path, and a learnable lens field that performs nonlinear trajectory transformation and focusing. Theoretically, we establish that LLN transport is globally invertible and volume-preserving for any differentiable lens field, with the implemented coordinate-wise Gaussian transport further satisfying symplecticity. Importantly, these structural constraints do not limit expressivity: with unrestricted embeddings and readouts, LLN retain universal approximation of continuous end-to-end maps. Experiments across diverse dynamical systems demonstrate that LLN improves long-horizon prediction while using substantially fewer parameters than same-depth comparators. Further analysis reveals stable depth-wise gradient transport and interpretable learned dynamics under the coupled propagation and refraction design.

</details>


### [1392] [QAMM: Adjoint MeanFlow Matching for Few-Step Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34497)
*Yuehu Gong,Shutong Ding,Mokai Pan,Yimiao Zhou,Jiashu Hou,Ye Shi,Yanwei Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出QAMM（Adjoint MeanFlow Matching），将QAM中的瞬时速度critic梯度监督与MeanFlow的平均速度参数化结合，使离线流策略通过两次网络调用即可生成动作，无需对采样链求导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流策略能建模复杂动作分布，但迭代采样限制决策速度；QAM只提供瞬时速度监督，部署时仍需数值积分生成动作，需要一种能直接学习有限区间传输、几步即可采样的离线策略优化方法。

Method: 1) 沿参考速度场反向传播critic在终点处的动作梯度，得到"adjoint-corrected velocity"；2) 将该瞬时速度同时作为MeanFlow恒等式的基项与物质导数方向，构造平均速度监督目标；3) 采用端点加噪（endpoint-noised）反向Markov轨迹构造训练路径、对角及非对角时间对均参与监督；4) 部署时采用独立重噪声的两调用端点细化采样器。配套路径空间KL代理与残差自适应加权稳定训练。

Result: 在OGBench的5个HumanoidMaze-medium和5个HumanoidMaze-large任务上，QAMM两调用策略在Medium域与强流策略基线相当，在Large域五任务均值高于TRQAM；线上微调后Medium 98.7%、Large 87.2%；消融显示backup混合系数α与KL预算敏感于任务；Best-of-N可显著提升少调用性能。

Conclusion: 将基于critic梯度的adjoint监督与平均速度学习结合，可在不反传采样链的前提下学到有限区间流场并支持两步生成；理论只给出目标的条件相容性而非收敛保证，实际训练引入参考近似、有限步adjoint、端点加噪路径律等多项近似，需在更多任务和种子下进一步验证。

Abstract: Flow policies can model rich action distributions, but their iterative sampling limits decision speed. Adjoint matching uses the critic's action gradient to improve a flow policy without backpropagating through its sampling trajectory, yet its supervision is defined for instantaneous velocities. We propose QAMM, a method that turns the critic-derived adjoint signal into supervision for MeanFlow's average velocity. The resulting policy learns finite-interval transport directly and generates actions with few network evaluations. We derive the adjoint MeanFlow target, specify its gradient boundaries, and train it with an offline actor-critic. On ten HumanoidMaze tasks, QAMM produces effective two-call policies and achieves competitive performance against strong flow-policy baselines. These results show that adjoint-based Q optimization can be combined with average-velocity learning to obtain expressive offline policies with few-step action generation.

</details>


### [1393] [Distribution-Conditioned Task Routing for Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34503)
*Longhuan Xu,Zhipeng Zhou,Wei Ji,Chunyan Miao,Peilin Zhao,Lijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FDC（Feature Distribution Calibration），一种针对参数高效类增量学习中任务路由瓶颈的免训练后验校准框架，通过三个组件分别修正特征级、任务级和类别级的路由偏差，在八个CIL方法、五个基准上均取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于LoRA的类增量学习（CIL）中，每个任务拥有独立的分类头，推理时无任务标识。现有的参数高效方法主要缓解灾难性遗忘，但本文揭示任务路由（选择正确分类头）是另一关键瓶颈——实验显示提供任务ID可修正约80%的错误，而简单的logit标准化收益甚微，说明真正的错误来源于特征分布层面的跨任务竞争。

Method: FDC包含三个无训练的校准组件：(1) TSF（Task Subspace Filtering）通过任务PCA投影对分类器权重进行滤波，抑制主成分子空间外特征对logit的正贡献；(2) RLC（Residual Likelihood Calibration）通过比较输入在自身任务和外部任务参考分布下的子空间残差似然，提供任务级证据；(3) PAC（Prototype Affinity Calibration）通过输入与各类别原型的最近邻余弦亲和度（K=1），提供细粒度类别证据。FDC支持双视图（适配后E_T与冻结预训练E_0）加权融合，且无需梯度更新、回放缓冲或额外路由器。所有超参数（η=0.75, γ=0.5, α=β=w_T=w_0=1）跨方法共享。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-A/R、CUB-200、OmniBenchmark五个基准上：(1) Cumulative-LoRA基线+全FDC平均提升4.21pp（CUB-200上达10.88pp）；(2) 作为即插即用模块应用于EWC-LoRA、SD-LoRA、SplitLoRA、InfLoRA(+CA)、LoRA-Subtraction、LoDA、RSIAT八种方法，40组方法-数据集对全部取得正增益，平均+4.39pp；(3) 全部启用三组件时35/40对仍为正增益，平均+4.45pp；(4) 额外存储仅约8–12 MiB，单视图推理延迟增加<2%，双视图增加约88%。

Conclusion: FDC从特征分布视角系统性地解决了参数高效CIL中的任务路由瓶颈，证明了统计校准能够有效释放已学表征中保留的识别能力，且具备即插即用、轻量级、免训练等实用优势；但与给定任务ID的上界仍存在差距，未来可扩展至多专家/子网络结构。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient adaptation enables continual learners to acquire task-specific knowledge through compact model updates while maintaining strong within-task performance. However, class-incremental inference requires each input to be classified among all classes seen so far without access to its task identity. For learners equipped with task-specific parameter-efficient modules, this introduces a critical task-routing challenge beyond catastrophic forgetting. We study post-hoc task routing without retraining the learner or introducing a separately trained router. Such training-free inference-time calibration remains comparatively underexplored in parameter-efficient class-incremental learning. We identify three sources of routing error (feature-level, task-level, and class-level misalignment) and propose Feature Distribution Calibration (FDC). Its three components address these misalignments: Task Subspace Filtering (TSF) suppresses feature components outside each task's principal subspace, Residual Likelihood Calibration (RLC) evaluates the typicality of its subspace residual, and Prototype Affinity Calibration (PAC) measures compatibility with the task's class prototypes. Experiments demonstrate plug-and-play applicability to eight parameter-efficient class-incremental methods using a shared encoder. With one component configuration selected per method across all five benchmarks, FDC improves final accuracy in all 40 method-dataset pairs by 4.39 percentage points on average. Enabling all components improves 35 of the 40 pairs, with an average gain of 4.45 points. When applied to a simple baseline, FDC achieves strong overall performance.

</details>


### [1394] [KiT: A Foundation Model for Financial Time-Series Forecasting using DiffusionTransformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34507)
*Boyu Zhang,Haorui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KiT(K-line Diffusion Transformer)，首个针对金融K线数据的扩散基础模型，将未来路径预测重构为基于流匹配的条件路径生成任务，在三个市场、七种粒度上全面超越现有金融专用模型和通用时序基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: K线预测面临极低信噪比、市场异质性强、预测目标本质上是分布而非点值三大挑战。现有方法存在两方面不足：自回归生成导致误差累积；通用时序基础模型未针对K线结构优化，而Kronos等专用模型采用有损离散量化且自回归解码。

Method: 1) 五维对数比状态编码：(隔夜缺口、实体、上下影线、成交量)实现尺度无关且严格可逆的K线表示，保证几何合法性；2) 基于DiT架构与流匹配的扩散Transformer，one-shot生成整个预测区间；3) 双重条件注入：窗口恒定信号(市场/标的/粒度)经共享AdaLN主干调制每层，逐bar信号(时钟/日历/事件)直接加至token嵌入；4) 双重无分类器引导(身份+历史)；5) 三种参数规模(31M/101M/284M)在30亿根K线上预训练，涵盖美股、A股、加密货币。

Result: 在3个市场、7种粒度(1分钟到1天)测试中：平均收益RankIC 0.0571(全面领先)，平均波动率RankIC 0.6600(超Sundial 25%);A股长多头回测年化净收益+65.2%(5分钟，Sharpe 1.70)和+64.4%(2小时，Sharpe 2.46)。消融验证了对数比状态编码和双通道条件注入的必要性。模型规模与性能呈温和但持续提升的缩放关系。

Conclusion: KiT是首个将扩散基础模型成功应用于金融K线生成的工作，通过流匹配消除了自回归误差累积，五维对数比编码统一了跨市场跨粒度表示，双重条件注入与无分类器引导提供了灵活推理控制。未来工作将扩展至Level-3订单簿和高维因子数据，并探索下游任务微调。

Abstract: Financial candlestick forecasting is fundamental to quantitative investment, yet it remains exceptionally challenging due to extremely low signal-to-noise ratios and vast heterogeneity across markets and instruments.
