Existing approaches have largely attempted to introduce deep learning to capture hidden temporal features, but most adopt an auto-regressive formulation, which leads to error accumulation during inference. Meanwhile, general-purpose time-series foundation models are not tailored to the unique structure of k-line data and yield unsatisfactory performance on downstream candlestick forecasting tasks. To tackle these problems, we introduce KiT, a K-line Diffusion Transformer foundation model, and reformulate future prediction as conditional path generation via flow matching: given a historical context window, the model generates an ensemble of plausible future OHLCV trajectories. We pre-train KiT at multiple parameter scales on billions of candlestick bars spanning multiple markets and timescales. Across three markets and seven resolutions, KiT attains a mean return RankIC of 0.057 and a mean volatility RankIC of 0.66, leading at every timescale and outperforming both task-specific financial forecasters and general time-series foundation models. Code will be available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [1395] [Low-Confidence Remasking Traps Flexibility: Realizing Arbitrary-Order Potential for Diverse Rollouts in Diffusion LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34509)
*Moongyu Jeon,Dongjae Jeon,Bumjun Kim,Mingyu Kim,Albert No*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出掩码扩散语言模型(MDM)中广泛使用的低置信度重掩码(LCR)解码策略会指数级抑制低概率token，导致任意序生成的多样性丧失；提出使用top-probability position selection(TPP)替代LCR可恢复多样性，并进一步提出仅修改第一步的Entropy-Guided Initialization(EGI)以充分挖掘任意序灵活性，提升rollout多样性和下游策略优化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作(Ni et al., 2026)报告任意序解码的Pass@k低于自左向右解码，并将此归因于"灵活性陷阱"——延迟高不确定性token会减少探索路径。然而本文质疑这一解释，认为多样性损失主要源于LCR的token过滤机制，而非任意序生成本身。区分两种常被混淆的"置信度解码"策略(LCR与TPP)对理解rollout采样至关重要。

Method: 1) 区分两种解码规则：LCR(先采样所有位置proposal，只提交概率最高的)与TPP(先选最高top-token概率的位置，再从该位置采样)。2) 通过两个toy模型(独立token模型与非重叠序列模型)证明LCR中非top token/序列的提交概率呈指数衰减(1-c_T)^m。3) 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上验证：LCR即使提高温度仍几乎只提交top token。4) 提出Entropy-Guided Initialization(EGI)：第一步选择最高熵位置并以T=0.9采样，后续采用TPP。5) 在LLaDA-1.5上测试Pass@k。6) 将EGI rollouts集成到三种GRPO方法(SPG、JustGRPO、d2)中。

Result: LCR在GSM8K上即使温度升至1.2，非top token提交率仅0.7-1.1%，而TPP达36-38%。LCR的proposal与commitment差距显著：proposal概率可降至0.6-0.7，但commitment概率仍常超0.9。TPP的Pass@k接近AR，而LCR显著更弱。EGI在GSM8K和HumanEval上Pass@k优于AR和TPP；Div-Self-BLEU和Potential@k也更高。在SPG、JustGRPO、d2三种方法下，EGI rollouts在GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval、MBPP上均一致优于AR rollouts（训练计算预算匹配）。EGI维持更高的组内奖励方差，有利于group-relative学习。

Conclusion: 任意序生成的多样性损失主要源于LCR的proposal-rejection机制，而非置信度优先的位置排序本身。TPP在保持高置信度位置优先的同时直接遵循温度分布，可恢复与AR相当的Pass@k。仅在第一步利用任意序灵活性（EGI）即可超越AR，提升rollout多样性和下游策略优化表现，表明任意序生成为多样化rollout提供了有前景的设计空间。需要区分LCR与TPP以避免误导性结论。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models support arbitrary-order generation, suggesting a natural way to produce diverse outputs. However, recent work argues that this flexibility reduces diversity by delaying high-uncertainty tokens that can lead to different generation paths. We trace this diversity loss not to arbitrary-order generation itself, but largely to low-confidence remasking (LCR), a widely used decoding rule. At each step, LCR samples a token at every masked position but commits only the sampled token with the highest probability, filtering out the rest. We show that this mechanism can exponentially suppress lower-probability tokens as more positions compete, and observe the same suppression in LLaDA. In contrast, top-probability position selection (TPP), which has often been conflated with LCR under the shared label confidence-based decoding, avoids this diversity loss. TPP first selects the position whose most likely token has the highest probability, then samples directly from that position's distribution. Replacing LCR with TPP restores diversity and yields Pass@$k$ comparable to left-to-right decoding, suggesting that the reported diversity loss stems largely from LCR's filtering rather than from generating high-confidence positions first. To further exploit order flexibility, we introduce Entropy-Guided Initialization (EGI), which samples the first token at the highest-entropy position and then follows TPP. This simple modification further improves rollout diversity and solution coverage beyond left-to-right decoding, with gains extending to downstream policy optimization, highlighting the potential of arbitrary-order generation for diverse rollouts.

</details>


### [1396] [HALO: Enhancing Time Series Generation via Hyperspherical Latents and Masked AutoregRessive Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34511)
*Chunyi Hou,Xiangfei Qiu,Hanyin Cheng,Yutong Li,Bin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HALO提出在连续潜空间中进行时间序列生成。整体仍为两阶段结构：第一阶段引入超球面VAE（S-VAE），将潜变量约束在固定半径的超球面上，缓解连续潜表示的方差与尺度异质性；第二阶段采用掩码自回归建模，利用掩码上下文建模与条件扩散预测未知令牌，平衡并行解码与时序相关性学习，在减少推理步数的同时提升生成稳定性与质量。在12个数据集上达到SOTA，且推理效率显著优于现有自回归基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对现有两阶段时间序列生成范式的两个局限：①离散化连续信号导致细粒度时序信息丢失；②自回归生成过程中误差累积导致不稳定且低效。需要从离散潜空间转向连续潜空间，并设计更高效的自回归框架。

Method: 1) S-VAE：基于von Mises-Fisher分布，将潜变量约束在固定半径超球面上，消除连续潜表示的方差与尺度异质性，并缓解自回归生成中的尺度漂移。2) 掩码自回归模型：随机掩码策略生成预测目标，Transformer编码器-解码器构建上下文表示，轻量级条件扩散头在时序上下文条件下对掩码令牌进行并行预测，结合并行解码与时序相关性建模，显著减少推理步数。3) 训练目标包含ELBO与频域损失以保留周期性数据。

Result: 在能源、交通、自然、经济四大领域的12个真实数据集上进行实验，HALO在MMD、K-L、MDD指标上多数取得最优（168长度下14项MMD+K-L第一），跨域生成也优于微调与提示方法；推理速度（2.287ms/样本）显著优于TimeMAR（8.986ms/样本），峰值GPU内存1.406GB亦低于TimeMAR的2.311GB；消融实验验证S-VAE、掩码自回归骨架与条件扩散头各自的有效性；敏感度分析表明更多推理迭代轮次（K增大）能进一步提升生成质量。

Conclusion: HALO通过将连续潜表示几何化约束（超球面）与掩码自回归建模相结合，有效缓解了离散化信息损失与自回归误差累积问题，在生成质量与推理效率上均取得领先，为高质量高效率时间序列生成提供了新的建模范式，并展现了在构建大规模时间序列生成基础模型方面的潜力。

Abstract: Most existing time series generators rely on a two-stage modeling paradigm: the first stage learns discrete latent representations of time series; the second stage performs autoregressive modeling on these discrete latents through next token prediction. However, this paradigm suffers from two stage-specific limitations: the first stage can lead to information loss when discretizing continuous time series, while the second stage is prone to error accumulation during autoregressive generation. To address these limitations, our core idea is to perform generative modeling in a continuous latent space with a more efficient autoregressive framework. We propose HALO, which enhances time series generation via Hyperspherical Latents and Masked Autoregressive modeling to achieve this goal by tackling two key bottlenecks: (1) variance and scale heterogeneity of continuous latent representations; (2) the difficulty of balancing generation efficiency with temporal correlation modeling. HALO first introduces a hyperspherical VAE that constrains continuous latents to a fixed-radius hyperspherical shell, effectively stabilizing the numerical fluctuations of continuous latent representations. Secondly, we develop a masked autoregressive model that balances parallel decoding and temporal correlation learning, substantially reducing the number of inference steps required for generation and improving generation stability. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that HALO achieves state-of-the-art generation performance while offering significantly improved inference efficiency over existing advanced baselines.

</details>


### [1397] [On Parameter Symmetries and Conservation Laws in Gradient Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34549)
*Khang Nguyen,Guido Montúfar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了神经网络梯度流中参数对称性与守恒定律之间关系的统一几何框架，揭示了二者之间的精确联系与差距，并提出了多层网络中的继承原理和组合可辨识性概念，应用于多头注意力、多项式网络和深度线性网络等架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解深度学习模型的损失景观与隐式偏差是核心问题。参数对称性刻画了损失函数的冗余结构，守恒定律则约束了优化轨迹。受诺特定理启发，先前工作试图从对称性推导守恒定律，但二者关系的精确刻画及适用范围尚不清楚：并非所有连续对称性都对应守恒定律，反之守恒定律是否均源于已知对称性也是开放问题。

Method: 1. 基于微分几何的向量场框架：引入"梯度流分布"W和其正交补"对称分布"W⊥，通过Poincaré引理和Frobenius定理建立向量场闭性（closedness）与守恒定律/对称性的精确对应关系。2. 定义"组合可辨识性"（compositional identifiability），证明多层网络的继承原理（Theorem 17）：若大网络与子网络间满足函数等价性的双向蕴含，则大网络的完全对称/守恒律集可由子网络的完全集扩展得到。3. 应用到具体架构：利用矩阵分解恒等式、注意力头可辨识性定理和多项式网络的有限到一性质，分别给出GQA/MHSA、多项式神经网络、深度方阵线性网络的完整守恒律刻画。

Result: 1. 证明独立守恒律必诱导独立对称律（Corollary 10），但反之不然——对称-守恒差距为 s-c = r̄-r ≥ 0（Theorem 12），等号成立当且仅当梯度流分布W是对合的。2. 给出GQA（含MHSA特例）在秩满正则点附近的完整函数对称群（GL_{D_h}×GL_{D_h}）^{n_G}和完整守恒律集：H^j_QK = ΣQ_i^j⊤Q_i^j - K^j⊤K^j 与 H^j_VO = V^j⊤V^j - ΣO_i^j⊤O_i^j。3. 首次给出多项式神经网络完整守恒律的显式形式 h^j_i = ‖(W_j)_{i,:}‖² + (b_j)_i² - r_j‖(W_{j+1})_{:,i}‖²。4. 对L层D×D深度方阵线性网络给出独立守恒律上界 (L-1)D²。5. 语言模型（SGD训练）实验显示守恒律矩阵漂移远小于非守恒求和矩阵的漂移，但某些层块随训练时间推移守恒性可能退化。

Conclusion: 论文建立了梯度流中对称性与守恒律的完整几何理论，统一并推广了Kunin等、Głuch-Urbanke、Zhao等的Noether型框架。核心贡献是揭示了"闭向量场"这一精确的对应准则，量化了二者差距，并通过组合可辨识性概念实现了多层网络的系统化分析。该框架成功应用于现代注意力机制、多项式网络和深度线性网络，提供了可操作的初始化指导（如通过守恒律预测局部极小解的奇异值与条件数）。局限性：组合可辨识性不适用于矩阵乘法（深度线性网络的特殊情况），未来可探索弱化条件、扩展至非梯度流和数据相关动力学、以及利用守恒律指导初始化与训练。

Abstract: Parameter space symmetries and conservation laws play an important role in understanding the loss landscapes and implicit biases of neural networks. Inspired by Noether's theorem in physics, prior works have sought to derive conservation laws under gradient flow from parameter symmetries, but the scope and limitations of this connection remain unclear. We develop a unified geometric framework that clarifies the precise relationship between the two notions, including the conditions under which symmetries correspond to conservation laws. We introduce a notion of compositional identifiability and use it to establish a general inheritance principle for complete characterizations of symmetries and conservation laws in multilayer networks. We apply the framework to multi-head and grouped-query attention, polynomial neural networks, and square deep linear networks.

</details>


### [1398] [PulseInfer: I/O-Centric Sparse KV Cache Offloading for Efficient Long-Context LLM Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34555)
*Qiuyang Zhang,Kai Zhou,Kai Lu,Haocheng Lu,Jian Zhou,Yuanpeng Su,Kun Bao,Jiguang Wan,Fei Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PulseInfer提出了一种以I/O为中心的稀疏KV缓存卸载系统，通过可中断的层级调度（IRQ）、I/O自适应卸载准入策略（IOAA）以及SoloHead稀疏选择与gather-scatter传输引擎，解决长上下文LLM解码中recall I/O瓶颈问题。在SGLang上实现，相比SGLang最高提升4.7倍解码吞吐量，相比最优现有卸载基线提升2.6倍，TPOT降低最多76%，且保持近似无损精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM解码阶段受限于GPU显存容量导致batch size受限。稀疏KV缓存卸载虽可将历史KV块存储到CPU DRAM并按需recall，但引入了新的瓶颈——CPU-GPU的recall I/O。现有卸载系统面临两大问题：(1) recall I/O量在不同层、解码步、请求间高度动态变化且呈长尾分布，固定预取流水线无法有效隐藏；(2) 逐head的稀疏选择将recall I/O碎片化为大量小块PCIe传输（如8KB），有效带宽仅约6 GB/s，GPU利用率仅35-45%，导致吞吐量甚至低于非卸载基线。

Method: PulseInfer围绕"隐藏、控制、合并"三个目标设计三大机制：(1) IRQ可中断层级调度——将请求分为normal batch（KV驻留GPU）和offload batch（KV卸载至CPU），借鉴OS中断模型，在transformer层粒度上交错执行，offload batch发起recall后立即让出GPU切换至normal batch，通过semi-synchronous中断检测（仅同步attention kernel而非整层）在层边界检查I/O完成状态；(2) IOAA——建立以overlap depth m为参数的吞吐量模型（Throughput ∝ m/(m+1)·Bn + 1/(m+1)·Bo），通过离线profiling获取m(Bn,Bo)函数，在线采用带剪枝的二叉树搜索（GPU显存约束剪枝+长度单调性剪枝）选择最优normal/offload分配；(3) SoloHead + gather-scatter引擎——基于Middle Attention Mass (MAM)指标识别每层最强retrieval head，由其单独选择top-k块供所有KV head共享，将碎片化per-head传输合并为per-layer传输；gather-scatter引擎将分散KV块收集到pinned staging buffer后通过单次DMA传输，再由GPU scatter kernel放置到位。此外采用zero-sync I/O引擎，利用UVM共享buffer使CPU轮询线程异步处理recall任务，避免阻塞推理主线程。

Result: 在Qwen-3 14B、Qwen-3 30B-A3B (MoE)、MiniMax M2.5 (230B-A10B)三个模型上，基于合成负载（16K/32K/64K均值输入长度）和Mooncake、ServeGen真实工业trace评估（硬件：Intel Xeon Platinum 8470Q + 4×RTX PRO 6000，PCIe 5.0×16）：(1) 解码吞吐量相比Vanilla SGLang提升1.5-4.7×，相比最优现有卸载基线（InfiniGen/PQCache/ArkVale）提升1.1-2.6×，GPU利用率接近95%；(2) TPOT相比InfiniGen降低16.0%-76.4%；(3) 短请求（<8K）TPOT仅比Vanilla增加1.5×，长请求增加2.3×，而现有基线对两类请求均增加6.7-8.3×；(4) 消融实验表明IRQ、IOAA、SoloHead、gather-scatter各组件均贡献性能；(5) IOAA在ServeGen和Mooncake trace上均优于固定阈值策略；(6) 即使PCIe带宽降至0.4×仍优于Vanilla；(7) LongBench基准测试上保持近似无损精度（部分略超full attention），而reversed rank（选最低MAM head）配置精度显著下降，验证MAM有效性。

Conclusion: PulseInfer通过将recall I/O作为一等调度对象而非次要关注点，系统性地解决了稀疏KV缓存卸载的I/O瓶颈。其核心贡献在于：(1) 识别并表征了recall I/O的两大根本病理——动态recall量和碎片化传输；(2) 提出OS启发的可中断层级调度模型IRQ自适应隐藏可变recall延迟；(3) 提出基于吞吐量模型的IOAA动态分区normal/offload batch，以及SoloHead + gather-scatter合并碎片化recall传输。该系统实现了长上下文LLM解码的高吞吐量与低延迟权衡，且精度近似无损，为KV缓存卸载提供了完整的系统层解决方案。

Abstract: Long-context LLM serving is increasingly bottlenecked by decode, where large KV caches limit batch size and underutilize GPUs. Sparse KV cache offloading expands effective capacity by storing most historical KV blocks in CPU DRAM and recalling only selected blocks on demand. However, we find that existing offloading systems shift the bottleneck to CPU-GPU recall I/O: recall volume varies widely across layers, decode steps and requests, while headwise sparse selection fragments recalls into many small PCIe transfers. This paper presents PulseInfer, an I/O-centric sparse KV cache offloading system. PulseInfer hides variable recall latency with interruptible layer-wise scheduling, adapts offloading decisions with IO-Adaptive Offloading Admission, and coalesces fragmented transfers using SoloHead sparse selection and a gather-scatter I/O engine. Implemented on SGLang, PulseInfer improves decode throughput by up to 4.7x over SGLang and 2.6x over the best existing offloading baseline, while reducing TPOT by up to 76% and preserving near-lossless accuracy.

</details>


### [1399] [Brain-Conditioned Action Policies for Neural Motor Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34561)
*Luyao Jin,Running Zhao,Huan Zhao,Vincent C. K. Cheung,Wei-Hsin Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BrainVLA提出了一种基于预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的神经运动解码框架，通过神经-语言对齐使神经活动能够引导VLA策略生成可执行动作，缓解了神经-动作配对数据稀缺的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经运动解码需要学习从神经活动到运动学变量的任务特定映射，但受限于稀缺的配对神经-动作数据。现有VLA模型在大规模机器人数据上学习了丰富的动作先验，但如何将这些先验用于神经解码仍是开放问题，关键挑战在于建立神经活动与VLA策略之间有效的意图传达接口。

Method: 1) 构建VLA兼容数据集：在MuJoCo中重放记录的动作信号，渲染视觉观测并生成语言指令，构建包含神经活动、动作、语言和视觉的四元组RLDS数据集；2) 使用LoRA对OpenVLA-OFT进行任务特定适应，冻结主干，优化LoRA适配器、动作头和本体感受投影器；3) 训练POYO风格的神经编码器，通过对称多正样本对比学习将神经表征与对应语言表征对齐；4) 推理时神经表征直接替代语言条件，通过因果滚动解码协议在MuJoCo中执行预测动作以更新环境状态。

Result: 在两个人/非人灵长类动物神经运动数据集（7-DoF机械臂和2-DoF手指控制）上，BrainVLA在跨会话解码R²和任务成功率上均优于Wiener滤波、RNN、CycleGAN、POYO、NDT2、NDT3、NoMAD和SPINT等基线方法。D1上R²达到0.65±0.11，成功率0.77±0.10；D2上R²为0.46±0.05，成功率达到1.00±0.00。在低数据条件下也保持有效。消融实验验证了任务适应VLA、神经-语言对齐和视觉观测的贡献：视觉主要支持空间平移维度(x,y,z)，神经活动主要支持旋转和手指控制维度。

Conclusion: BrainVLA通过语言介导的对齐建立了神经活动与VLA策略之间的有效接口，使得神经运动解码能够利用大规模机器人动作先验。该框架在两个不同动作维度的数据集上展示了优越的解码性能和数据效率，为神经运动解码提供了利用预训练VLA模型的新策略，但仍需在实时闭环BCI场景中进一步验证。

Abstract: Motor brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) aim to decode motor intention, enabling people with paralysis to control external devices. Neural motor decoding typically learns task-specific mappings from neural activity to kinematics, yet remains constrained by scarce paired neural-action data. We propose BrainVLA, a framework that enables neural motor decoding by drawing on a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model through language-mediated alignment. BrainVLA mitigates reliance on scarce paired neural-action data by leveraging VLA policies. We first construct VLA-compatible datasets including paired neural activity, action signals, language instructions, and rendered visual observations. Then, we adapt the OpenVLA-OFT policy to the target action spaces through LoRA fine-tuning. To establish an effective interface through which neural activity can convey motor intention to adapted VLA policies and guide action generation, we train a neural encoder via neural-language alignment, using language representations as semantic targets to capture latent motor intent from neural activity. The resulting neural representations serve as an endogenous intention signal to guide VLA policies to generate executable actions, while visual observations provide complementary information about the evolving task state. BrainVLA is evaluated on two neural motor datasets with different action dimensionalities using causal rollout decoding. It outperforms the evaluated baselines in cross-session decoding $R^2$ and task success rate, while demonstrating high training data efficiency. These results establish a route for neural motor decoding to draw on large-scale robotic priors through brain-conditioned VLA policies.

</details>


### [1400] [Single-Layer MeMo as a Randomized Hamming-Kernel Classifier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34562)
*Alessandro Straziota*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论角度证明了单层 MeMo（一种基于关联矩阵存储器的语言模型架构）的理想检索规则本质上等价于一个基于位置汉明核（positional Hamming kernel）的多类分类器，并分析了其使用双重随机草图（输入与输出均采用高斯随机编码）实现该分类器时的近似误差，最终在合成数据与 WikiText-2 真实数据上验证了理论预测与实际性能权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeMo 是一种新的语言模型架构，将 token 上下文与下一 token 的关联存储在关联矩阵存储器中，但其原始描述仅将其行为近似为计数器，对"部分匹配"的理解较为模糊。论文试图回答：单层 MeMo 究竟求解的是什么样的学习问题？其部分匹配所诱导的几何结构是什么？随机表示的各个维度扮演什么角色？

Method: 1. 理论建模：将单层 MeMo 的理想检索规则形式化为基于位置汉明核的核投票规则/线性分类器，其中每个类别得分为查询上下文与所有属于该标签的训练上下文的汉明相似度之和。2. 误差分析：将 MeMo 的随机实现视为对理想分类器的双重随机草图，将得分误差分解为"上下文草图误差"（由输入高斯码本 U 和投影 W 引入）与"输出码干扰"（由输出高斯码本 Z 非正交引入），分别给出概率上界。3. 恢复保证：结合上述两个上界与理想分类器的边界 Δ(q)，给出 MeMo 精确恢复理想预测的充分条件及维数要求。4. 实证验证：在合成数据（控制上下文长度与标签合并）和 WikiText-2 受限子集上对比 MeMo 与多种经典基线。

Result: 1. 理论结果：证明单层 MeMo 的检索分数是理想汉明核分类器得分的无偏估计；在平方记忆设置下（d_h=d/h），上下文草图误差为 O(M_max·√(hL/d))，输出码干扰为 O(√(MM_max)·√(L/d))；精确恢复要求 d ≳ L(h·M_max² + M·M_max)/Δ(q)²。2. 合成实验：上下文草图误差随 d 呈 d_h^{-1/2} 衰减，输出误差随碰撞能量 C_H(q) 的增大而增大（标签合并使误差约增大 2 倍），端到端一致率随 d 增大趋向 1。3. 真实数据（WikiText-2 64 类）：h=8、d=1024 时 MeMo top-1 准确率 21.50%（与精确 sum 原型的 22.30% 仅差 0.8 个百分点），状态大小 20.50 MiB（比精确表的 65 MiB 减少约 68%），与理想分类器的一致率达 72.79%；融合实现下 GPU 吞吐量在 d=256 时达 4000 万次/秒，超过精确 sum 原型（3333 万次/秒），但在预测准确率上仍逊于线性 SVM（34.28%）。

Conclusion: 单层 MeMo 可被理解为位置汉明核分类器的随机化实现，其双重随机草图带来的误差可被有效界定，预测准确率、记忆效率与吞吐量三者之间存在可控的权衡；在 GPU 上尤为受益于矩阵运算的并行化，适合作为精确计数表的紧凑近似；但在预测准确率上不及判别训练的线性 SVM 等基线，并非通用最优方案。

Abstract: MeMo (Zanzotto et al., 2025) is a recent language-model architecture that stores associations between token contexts and next tokens in a correlation matrix memory. In this work, we study its single-layer form and show that its ideal retrieval rule is a multiclass classifier based on the positional Hamming kernel. The MeMo architecture represents both the sequence features and the output labels with Gaussian random codes. Its score is therefore a doubly randomized sketch of the ideal classifier. Under independent input and output codebooks, we bound the errors introduced by context sketching and output decoding, characterize their dependence on model and data parameters, and give a margin-based guarantee for recovering the ideal prediction. Controlled simulations support the trends predicted by the analysis. On a restricted WikiText-2 next-token task, we compare single-layer MeMo with classical baselines and show that it can offer a useful trade-off among predictive accuracy, memory, and throughput, particularly on a GPU, where its matrix operations can be parallelized.

</details>


### [1401] [Retracing Hodgkin and Huxley: State Recovery Does Not Certify Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34566)
*Peiyu Zang,Jiayi Hao,Yongqiang Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以 Hodgkin-Huxley (HH) 模型为受控环境，研究仅基于电流和电压观测训练的机器学习模型能否真正"重新发现"隐藏的门控机制（n, m, h）及其动力学。研究表明：尽管模型在响应预测和门态解码上表现出色，但状态恢复（state recovery）并不等价于机制恢复（mechanism recovery），高状态精度下输运场（transported field）可能仍与 HH 动力学严重不符。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Hodgkin-Huxley 模型是神经动力学的经典范式，其响应可观测而隐藏状态具有明确物理意义且控制方程已知，为研究"科学自发现"提供了理想测试床。核心问题是：预测观测动态是否足以证明模型已恢复底层物理机制？状态恢复与动力学恢复之间的差距如何评估？

Method: 1) 设计结构化潜在模型（GRU 编码器 + 电压依赖一阶松弛 + 类电导电流律），但不赋予门标识、门轨迹或 n^4/m^3h 等结构。2) 仅使用电流钳（CC）和电压钳（VC）下的电流、电压历史训练。3) 锁定模型后，用拟合的 chart r:(z,V)→(n̂,m̂,ĥ) 解码门态。4) 通过链式法则计算输运场，并与 HH 解析场比较。5) 使用恒等分解（等式7）将场误差分解为时间常数加权状态误差与 chart-field 残差。6) 比较 GRU、S4D、FNN、Latent ODE、DDAE 等基线架构。

Result: （1）响应预测误差及种子间散布在 K=3 维时骤降；OOD 门恢复在 K=5–6 时趋于平台。（2）在平滑电压钳支持上，使用潜在态与命令电压的 chart 达到 m 态 R²>0.99，但输运 m 场 R² 仅 0.27 左右，已知可逆 HH 坐标在同一审计下可达 0.995。（3）S4D 等强预测器同样存在显著状态-场差距。（4）方程7的分解显示时间尺度加权状态误差与 chart-field 残差可相互抵消或增强。（5）自治 DDAE 在电压钳下出现负速度 R²，揭示了干预输入缺失的影响。（6）该差距在不同 chart 类（线性/三次）、分支数、采样率等控制下稳健存在。

Conclusion: 状态恢复与机制恢复是可分离的两个诊断。仅依靠预测精度或高门态 R² 不足以证明模型已恢复 HH 动力学。对于科学自发现研究，应分别报告：响应预测、状态恢复（含 chart 输入选择）、协议转移下的输运场一致性。建议设计能区分隐藏状态、并在干预下检验输运场是否与目标生成器一致及门态连续性的协议。结论限定于被测试的模型与 chart，不声称生物学普适性。

Abstract: Predicting observed dynamics does not establish recovery of the underlying physical mechanism. Can machine learning retrace the hidden-state reasoning behind the Hodgkin-Huxley (HH) model? We train structured latent models on simulated current and voltage, withholding gate identities and trajectories from training and model selection. We then test response prediction, state recovery, protocol transfer, and agreement with HH dynamics. Prediction error and its cross-seed spread both drop sharply at three latent dimensions under the tested protocols, while gate recovery under new protocols improves through five to six coordinates. State recovery depends on which observations the chart uses. Observed voltage improves current-clamp decoding relative to freely predicted voltage. Under voltage clamp, adding latent state to command voltage raises m-state $R^2$ from 0.976 to above 0.99, yet the transported field disagrees with HH on identical smooth samples. Known invertible HH coordinates achieve high fast-m field agreement under the same audit procedure. An exact HH identity decomposes the discrepancy into time-scale-weighted state error and a residual in the transported field; these terms can cancel or reinforce. These findings concern the tested models and charts. They support evaluating state and dynamics recovery separately, including chart inputs and transported-field agreement across interventions.

</details>


### [1402] [Compute Time Scaling with Recursive Models for Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34585)
*Zhengxi Zhang,Paul Swoboda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TRM4CO（用于组合优化的微型递归模型），一种通用的神经组合优化方法。该方法基于权重共享的微型递归 Transformer（约 7M 参数），通过深度（递归步数 D）和宽度（并行采样数 K）两个维度扩展测试时计算，并采用自适应停止机制。在 MIS 和 TSP 两个基准测试上，TRM4CO 在 TSP-500/1000 上达到所有学习求解器中最低最优性差距（如 TSP-500 上 0.11%），并在 MIS 上超越大多数神经求解器。同时探索了自重标记（self-relabeling）作为自监督训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经组合优化面临参数多但每参数计算少的困境，而组合优化算法本质上是执行大量计算的短程序。设计能以较少参数提供深层计算图的架构是一个开放问题。现有方法要么是自回归（顺序慢），要么在热力图空间扩展（仍需搜索），缺乏在网络内部以递归方式扩展计算的方法。

Method: 1. 骨干网络：基于 TRM 的两模块 Transformer（约 7M 参数），通过权重共享实现深度递归，在潜变量 z 和答案变量 y 上迭代 L 次潜变量更新和 1 次答案更新，每步 H 个循环，仅最后循环携带梯度。\n2. 结构注入：MIS 通过邻接矩阵作为注意力偏置（每头可学习标量 γ_h）；TSP 通过坐标的正弦位置编码。\n3. 测试时扩展：深度 D（递归步数）+ 宽度 K（加噪并行采样）。\n4. 解码器：MIS 用顺序剥离（sequential peeling, k_p 节点/轮）+ 贪心选节点；TSP 用边插入 + 2-opt 修复。\n5. 训练：深度监督 + 任务特定的"solved"检查触发停止；可选自重标记（self-relabeling）周期性地用模型自身更优解替换标签。\n6. 前缀 token：P 个可学习全局寄存器，提供全局记忆。

Result: TSP-500：最优性差距 0.11%（2.1秒/实例），所有学习求解器中最低；TSP-1000：0.27%；TSP-10000：1.45%，匹配最佳扩散求解器。MIS ER-[700-800]：K=10 时差距 1.11%，K=200 时达 -0.38%（超越 KaMIS 参考）；SATLIB：与参考持平。自重标记将 ER 测试差距从 2.53% 降至 1.11%，且 16% 的训练标签超越 KaMIS。无标签训练下，42% 训练图标签匹配或超越 KaMIS。消融实验表明边偏置注意力优于 GNN 编码器（差距减半），顺序剥离使差距降低 2/3，前缀 token 是必要组件。

Conclusion: TRM4CO 证明了小型递归网络结合问题特定编解码可在 MIS 和 TSP 上与搜索密集型管线竞争或更优。其核心是在相同权重上沿深度和宽度扩展测试时计算，有效将算力转化为解的质量。自重标记可进一步提升模型，无论有无求解器标签。该方法从递归推理角度缩小了神经求解器与无学习搜索之间的差距。未来方向是减少对问题特定编码器和解码器的依赖。

Abstract: We propose Tiny Recursive Models for Combinatorial Optimization (\ours{}), a general neural method for combinatorial optimization that scales both depth (how often we recursively invoke our network) and width (how much we sample in parallel). Both are fundamental for combinatorial optimization: hard instances demand a large amount of compute, while a small network is essential to avoid overfitting and capture the algorithmic essence of optimization. In particular, our method consists of a graph-aware tiny recursive model that iterates on a latent state with adaptive halting and needs only a lightweight problem-specific decoder. Compared with previous heatmap-based general neural solvers, it achieves a better balance between solution quality and inference speed on both the Traveling Salesman Problem~(TSP) and the Maximum Independent Set~(MIS) problem, and remains competitive with hybrid methods that combine neural components with heuristics specific to each problem. With the same backbone architecture for both tasks, \ours{} outperforms every diffusion-based solver on TSP from 500 to 10,000 cities at a lower inference cost, and on the standard Erdős--Rényi-[700-800] MIS benchmark it surpasses all neural solvers except those that only work well on MIS. We then explore self-relabeling for self-supervised training. We periodically replace the current set of training labels with the model's own better solutions, as an alternative training signal. Self-relabeling can, while forgoing supervision from near-optimal solutions, still result in on-par quality.

</details>


### [1403] [Deep Weighted Bellman Residual Minimization for $Q^*$ Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34593)
*Lican Kang,Jerry Zhijian Yang,Cheng Yuan,Chen Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种加权 Bellman 残差最小化框架，通过密度比加权整合专家演示与行为数据，解决离线强化学习中分布偏移、Q 值过估计和样本利用效率低的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习中的离线策略评估面临分布偏移、Q 值过估计和样本利用效率低等挑战。传统方法依赖完全性假设，难以有效利用专家演示。

Method: 构建加权 Bellman 残差最小化框架，引入密度比加权策略整合专家演示与行为数据，放松传统的完全性假设，并建立密度比估计的收敛速率与深度 Q* 估计器超额风险的收敛速率。

Result: 在密度比估计上获得了尖锐收敛速率；推导了深度 Q* 估计器的超额风险收敛界；大量实验表明在数值性能和策略泛化性上相较现有方法有显著提升。

Conclusion: 所提出的加权框架为专家演示的合理利用提供了具体指导，能有效提升离线策略评估的准确性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Off-policy evaluation is a foundational component of offline reinforcement learning, aiming to assess and optimize policy performance using pre-collected datasets. However, such datasets often suffer from pronounced challenges, including distribution shift, $Q$-value overestimation, and low sample utilization efficiency. To address these issues, this paper introduces a weighted Bellman residual minimization framework that incorporates density ratio weighting by effectively integrating expert demonstrations with behavioral data. The proposed weighting scheme departs from the conventional completeness assumption commonly imposed in the theoretical analysis of deep reinforcement learning. We establish a sharp convergence rate for density ratio estimation and derive the convergence rate for the excess risk of resulting deep $Q^*$ estimator. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that, compared to existing methods, our method achieves significant improvements in numerical performance and policy generalization, providing specific guidance for the rational utilization of expert demonstrations.

</details>


### [1404] [The Low-Rank Structure of VLA Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34599)
*Minjae Oh,Yoonah Park,Jongwon Lim,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了强化学习(RL)如何从参数空间角度重塑基于flow-matching的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。研究发现RL诱导的参数更新具有显著的低秩特性，且高度集中于动作专家(action expert)中一个此前被忽视的小型模块——Timestep Modules(时间步模块)。这些模块仅占总参数的14.83%–27.58%，却承载了RL带来的大部分性能提升。其中，shift向量的更新方向与任务成功密切相关(ROC-AUC高达99.6%)，且其几何结构反映了任务间的迁移关系。基于这些发现，作者提出了一种无需额外RL训练即可在测试时通过沿shift更新方向进行自适应引导(steering)来进一步提升策略性能的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着强化学习被广泛用于VLA模型的后训练(post-training)，但与LLM领域不同，RL如何重塑VLA策略的参数空间结构仍缺乏系统理解。特别是在现代flow-based VLA中使用的flow-matching动作专家架构具有独特的时间步条件化结构，亟需在参数层面理解RL学习信号的位置与编码方式，以指导更高效、可解释的VLA后训练方法设计。

Method: 1. 在多种flow-based VLA(π0.5、GR00T N1.5/N1.6、SmolVLA)和多个基准(LIBERO、ManiSkill、MetaWorld、CALVIN)上对比BC与RL训练前后的参数更新；2. 定义update density(更新密度)与effective rank r95(有效秩)作为衡量指标；3. 通过module-replacement(模块替换)实验验证Timestep Modules的贡献；4. 对AdaRMS的scale/shift/gate输出进行消融分析；5. 使用ℓ2正则化logistic回归probe预测任务成败；6. 计算任务间shift向量的余弦相似度与迁移效果的相关性；8. 提出adaptive activation steering方法沿shift更新方向干预隐藏状态。

Result: 1. Timestep Modules在RL下被高度密集地更新(70%–95%)，且有效秩仅6–30，远低于BC的250–650；2. 仅使用Timestep Modules的RL更新即可恢复大部分RL性能提升(在π0.5上仅下降0.2%–1.6%)，而仅使用其他模块则下降高达39.7%；3. Shift向量的更新方向预测任务成功的ROC-AUC最高达99.6%；4. Shift更新方向的余弦相似度与跨任务迁移效果呈强正相关(Spearman ρ=0.794)；5. 测试时沿shift方向进行自适应steering可使成功率额外提升2.0%–4.0%。

Conclusion: RL对flow-based VLA的更新本质上是低秩、输入无关、且集中于Timestep Modules的时间步特定向量级调制。离散时间步训练是低秩结构形成的关键原因。Shift向量承载了大部分与任务相关的信息，并可作为有效的控制信号。这一发现为参数高效RL后训练、残差RL以及跨任务行为组合与迁移提供了新思路。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models, yet how RL reshapes these policies remains poorly understood. We find that RL across widely used flow-based VLA models, including $\pi_{0.5}$ and GR00T~N1.5/N1.6, on LIBERO, ManiSkill, MetaWorld, and CALVIN induces substantially lower-rank parameter updates that are highly concentrated in the action expert's Timestep Modules, a small and previously overlooked component. Through systematic module-replacement experiments, we further show that these modules capture a disproportionate share of the performance gains from RL. We then characterize what is encoded in these Timestep Modules. First, we show that RL specializes them to the discrete denoising timesteps used during rollouts, and that this discrete-timestep training underlies the low-rank updates. Second, we find that among their outputs, the shift vector changes most distinctly under RL, and through probing, we show that shift update directions strongly predict task success (ROC-AUC up to $99.6\%$). Third, we find that the geometry of shift updates reflects task relationships, as their pairwise similarity correlates with cross-task transfer patterns. Building on these findings, we show that steering along shift update directions further improves RL-trained policies without additional RL training. Overall, we provide a systematic understanding of how RL reshapes VLA policies by studying how learned signals are encoded in parameter space, offering insights into more efficient and interpretable VLA post-training.

</details>


### [1405] [When local gains fail to transfer: Frozen Earth-observation embeddings across wildfires](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34602)
*Philipp Stark,Alexandros Sopasakis,Ola Hall*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究针对当前地球观测基础模型（TESSERA、AlphaEarth）几乎仅依靠单一研究区内空间分块交叉验证进行评估的局限，以野火烧毁区识别为测试任务，提出包含跨区域留出测试、有限目标监督适应、跨火场权重向量比较的评估协议，揭示：尽管冻结嵌入在同一火场内大幅优于Sentinel-2指数基线（+0.05至+0.13 AUC），但其跨区域迁移能力基本丧失；嵌入的优势可在仅8个目标火场标注块下恢复，嵌入权重向量在不同火场间近乎正交；而在同区域内跨一年迁移（TESSERA: 0.772 AUC, 仅损失0.04）则明显优于跨区域迁移，提示"评估冻结嵌入时必须报告留出区域"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球观测基础模型（TESSERA、AlphaEarth）发布全球年度嵌入向量供下游任务复用，但现有评估实践几乎全部基于单一研究区内的空间分块交叉验证，无法反映跨区域与跨时间的泛化能力。该局限可能误导对模型实际可用性的判断。

Method: 选取希腊与西班牙2023年共四场野火（罗兹、埃夫罗斯、卡塞雷斯、特内里费）以及阿提卡省2023年Parnitha与2024年Varnavas一对相邻火场作为测试集。利用Copernicus CEMS烧毁图作为标签源（每个火场取5000烧毁+15000对照像素，总约12万标注像素）；描述符包括ESA WorldCover 2021、Sentinel-2指数年度统计（NDVI/NDMI/NBR中位数、IQR、P10/P90及观测计数，共15维）、TESSERA v1.0（128维反量化嵌入）和AlphaEarth（64维单位向量）。探测模型为L2正则化逻辑回归（主实验）与LightGBM（鲁棒性实验），并通过21种随机块折叠分配、500m/1km空间缓冲、块自助法以及有限k∈{0,2,4,8,16,32}目标标注块适应来系统评估泛化能力；进一步通过将各火场权重向量投影至共享坐标系进行正交分解以诊断规则可迁移性。

Result: 火场内结果：TESSERA较Sentinel-2指数提升+0.061至+0.132 AUC，AlphaEarth提升+0.053至+0.105 AUC，二者拼接在每场火中均最优（AUC 0.832–0.975），该优势在多次折叠分配、空间缓冲、梯度提升与去量化敏感性下保持稳健。跨区域迁移：TESSERA留出测试损失0.128–0.230 AUC（平均0.176），AlphaEarth损失0.105–0.177（平均0.148），Sentinel-2指数损失0.024–0.089（平均0.055）；三者留出AUC收敛至0.69/0.71/0.71，差距消失。有限监督适应：仅用目标火场8个标注块即可使TESSERA反超指数基线+0.04至+0.12 AUC，16块基本恢复全部优势；反之，加入其他火场59000个标注像素从k≥8起反而损害性能。规则诊断：TESSERA与AlphaEarth的火场内权重向量与跨火场权重向量余弦仅为0.12–0.22和0.03–0.41，91–99%系数范数集中于火场特异方向。时间迁移（Parnitha 2023→Varnavas 2024）：TESSERA达0.772 AUC（仅损失0.04），而来自其他区域的单火场仅0.628–0.721，拼接四场远火+0.765；AlphaEarth迁移效果较弱（Parnitha→Varnavas: 0.740）。

Conclusion: 冻结地球观测嵌入确实包含判别烧毁与非烧毁像素所需的有用信息，但其与野火发生的线性关系强烈依赖于具体区域，导致跨区域迁移性差且可能损害仅靠局部监督训练的模型；同区域内跨一年迁移保持大部分火场内性能，因此推荐的实际使用范式为：嵌入作为可复用特征，由轻量级局部模型在少量本地标注上完成适配，而非追求一个跨区域通用的分类器；评估冻结嵌入时必须报告留出区域结果以避免局部优势被高估。

Abstract: Frozen Earth-observation embeddings are judged almost entirely by spatially blocked cross-validation inside one study region. We show that this number does not predict accuracy in a new region; we show why; and we show the one setting in which such a model does keep working, using a protocol that needs only a linear probe and labels one already has. The testbed is wildfire, with Copernicus burned-area maps of six fires in Greece and Spain and descriptors from the year before each fire, comparing TESSERA and AlphaEarth with ESA WorldCover classes and annual Sentinel-2 index summaries. Inside a fire, the embeddings identify the burned land 0.05 to 0.13 ROC AUC better than the index summaries, and repeated fold allocations, spatial buffers, a block bootstrap, and gradient-boosted trees leave that margin unchanged. On a fire in another region, they lose 0.15 to 0.18 AUC, and the index summaries lose 0.06, so the three end within a few hundredths of each other. The representation is not the cause. Eight labelled blocks from the new region restore the embedding advantage and give a higher AUC than 59,000 labelled pixels from other regions, and the weight vector fitted in one region is nearly orthogonal to the vector fitted in the others, so the part that carries across regions is small and low-dimensional. Forecasting within a region is a different matter. Fitted on a fire that burned in 2023 and applied to a fire twelve kilometres away that burned in 2024, where nothing used postdates the target fire, TESSERA reaches 0.772 AUC and loses 0.04 against a classifier fitted inside the 2024 fire, while classifiers fitted in other regions lose 0.09 to 0.18. A region with one mapped fire can therefore forecast susceptibility for later fires there; a region without one cannot borrow a model from elsewhere, and every evaluation of a frozen embedding should report a held-out region.

</details>


### [1406] [Shaping Persistent Representations from Independent Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34604)
*Ji Dai,Quan Fang,Junyu Gao,Rongfeng Guo,Haoyan Rong,YipingHuang,Yongxi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SPRII，一种利用交互间关系作为持久上下文弱监督的训练原理，包含Align和Cross两个可组合组件。作者提出Formation-Use-Value三阶段分析框架，并在13个环境中验证了SPRII平均提升任务性能超10%、持久属性读出超15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准预测训练可仅依赖局部证据降低误差，但不会将持久信息组织为可复用的上下文。需要一种无需数值属性标签、仅利用交互间关系作为弱监督的方法来学习持久上下文，同时区分信息的形成、使用与价值。

Method: SPRII包含两个组件：(1) Align：使用VICReg正则化相关交互的上下文一致；(2) Cross：用另一个相关交互的上下文预测当前交互的未来。两者与学习器的原生目标联合训练。分析框架将持久信息生命周期分为三阶段：Formation（信息是否可访问）、Use（固定预测器是否依赖上下文）、Value（是否降低任务误差）。

Result: 在13个环境中（SpringWorld、PokeWorld、D-Clean、CoPhy、Burgers、FHN、Baxter触觉、RH20T机器人、Overcooked合作、Swimmer、Pendulum控制等）跨多种学习器家族验证。SpringWorld上SPRII相对Native JEPA降低22.3% MSE；D-Clean h32误差比CaDM低33.7%；持久属性读出平均提升超15%。研究发现：更可靠的关系改善表示组织，但增加共享属性可能降低仍共享属性的可访问性；上下文替换在固定权重下改变预测；历史收益随预测视野增大而提升。

Conclusion: SPRII通过交互间关系引导持久上下文的组织，其Align和Cross组件无需数值标签即可保留学习器原生目标。Formation-Use-Value框架揭示了准确预测本身不能同时保证三个阶段。关系设计和读出器设计互补：前者塑造上下文中的可用信息，后者决定其服务任务的有效性。未来工作可改进关系可靠性、扩展持久上下文到更长尺度变化的属性，并研究其在规划中的作用。

Abstract: World models learn environment dynamics from interaction experience. These dynamics depend on the current state and actions, as well as on properties that persist across interactions. Yet standard predictive training can reduce error using local evidence alone, without organizing persistent information into reusable context. We introduce SPRII, a training principle that uses relations between interactions as weak supervision for persistent context while retaining the learner's native objective. For example, different trajectories of the same system share persistent properties even when their states and actions differ. SPRII uses such relations to guide context learning without numerical property labels. Two composable components encourage contexts from related interactions to agree (Align) and use one interaction's context to predict another's future (Cross). Our analysis distinguishes three linked questions: what persistent information is accessible in the learned context (Formation), how that context influences a fixed predictor (Use), and whether it reduces task error (Value). Success at one stage does not guarantee success at the next. Controlled experiments show that more reliable relations improve representation organization, but adding a shared-property constraint can reduce access to a property that remains shared. Context substitutions change predictions at fixed model weights, while the benefit from history depends on prediction horizon and readout. Evaluations span thirteen settings, including controlled physical systems, public dynamics tasks, robotic and tactile data, and partner interaction, across multiple learner families. Relative to the corresponding baselines, SPRII yields average gains of over 10% in downstream task performance and over 15% in persistent-property readout. The project page is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1407] [PMOPD: Task Ordering, Cycling, and Parameter-Update Subspace Protection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34605)
*Youzhi Liu,Ruobing Zheng,Boyuan Tong,Tianqi Li,Pingqi Li,Hanbo Bi,Yi Yuan,Jingdong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PMOPD，一种基于参数更新子空间保护的多教师在策略蒸馏方法，通过几何感知的投影机制解决多能力集成中的"能力跷跷板"问题，并在 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多教师在策略蒸馏（MOPD）需要将多个领域专家的能力集成到单一学生模型中，但存在"能力跷跷板"现象——一个领域能力的提升会抑制另一领域。现有方法（任务混合、PCGrad 等）操作于瞬时梯度，未能捕捉 OPD 累积更新的几何结构，缺乏对干扰方向的直接识别与保护机制。

Method: 1) 发现不同任务的 OPD 累积参数位移迅速收敛到各自低维子空间，且任务间子空间重叠低（Math/Code/Reason 两两相似度仅 0.13-0.15），为干扰控制提供几何基础；2) PMOPD 对每个二维参数矩阵独立构建子空间记忆（Top-K=16 的右奇异向量），通过 QR 正交化扩展；3) 对梯度和 Adafactor 预条件更新进行双重投影（$G_\perp = G - GMM^\top$），去除与受保护任务方向对齐的分量；4) 设计轻量级冲突探针（基于 60 样本/折的 10 折估计）选择任务顺序 Code→Reason→Math；5) 通过同任务跨周期子空间相似度选择周期数（最优为 4 周期）。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B 上：Math 67.78、Reason 73.46、Code 59.67，平均 66.97，较 MOPD 提升 2.54 分；在 Llama-3.1-8B 上：Math 21.33、Reason 69.45、Code 32.33，平均 41.04，较 MOPD 提升 2.09 分。投影消融验证双重投影的互补性：仅梯度投影提升 2.37 分，再加优化器更新投影额外提升 0.75 分。四个周期在性能（66.97）和子空间一致性（0.525）上同时达到峰值，验证了几何机制。

Conclusion: 参数更新子空间保护是一种可迁移的多教师蒸馏策略。任务更新快速集中于低维子空间且任务间重叠度低的发现，使得双重投影成为控制跨任务干扰的有效手段；冲突引导的顺序与基于一致性的周期选择提供了实用的低成本调度方案。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) has emerged as a popular post-training paradigm for integrating specialized capabilities in frontier language models. Existing OPD research has primarily focused on optimizing single-task distillation through objective design, distillation scope, and teacher signal construction, whereas MOPD must aggregate multiple capabilities in shared parameters and address the resulting capability seesaw, in which improving one domain suppresses capabilities acquired from another. Inspired by the distinctive update geometry of OPD, we find that parameter updates from different tasks rapidly concentrate in their respective low-dimensional subspaces during MOPD, providing a direct geometric basis for identifying and controlling cross-task interference. We therefore propose PMOPD (Projection-based Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation), which constructs subspace memories from the cumulative parameter displacements of different tasks and projects both gradients and optimizer updates to remove components that interfere with protected task directions. We further develop a lightweight conflict probe to characterize task interactions and guide task ordering, together with a cycling strategy that balances subspace estimation and timely task revisitation. Experiments on representative Code, Reason, and Math tasks show that PMOPD improves every evaluated capability over MOPD, raising the average score across the three tasks by 2.54 points on Qwen2.5-7B and 2.09 points on Llama-3.1-8B. These consistent gains establish geometry-aware optimization as an effective and transferable approach to balanced multi-teacher distillation.

</details>


### [1408] [Beyond Site Agreement: Re-estimation for Brain Network Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34611)
*Yingxu Wang,Kunyu Zhang,Yanwu Yang3,Thomas Wolfers,Yujie Wu,Siyang Gao,Nan Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BRIO：利用同一扫描内FC重估计来指导跨站点对齐，提升脑网络OOD泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静息态fMRI的功能连接(FC)图是基于有限、时序相关的BOLD序列估计的。传统的跨站点对齐方法仅追求全扫描FC表示的站点间一致性，但这种一致性并不保证预测证据在FC重估计下仍然稳定。本文指出需要对FC重估计变异性进行刻画，以判断哪些预测模式真正适合跨站点对齐。

Method: 提出BRIO（Brain Network Re-estimation-Informed OOD Learning）框架，包含三个组件：(1)对应性保持的连接组因子分解——对同一BOLD序列进行联合循环移动块重采样生成K个FC重估计，通过共享的符号GNN和ROI分配映射到一致性索引的连接组因子；(2)任务校准的重估计资格评估——评估每个因子的预测相关性，并将其在FC重估计下的贡献变化与类内被试变异性和类间分离度进行校准，得到任务校准的重估计支持度；(3)资格引导的跨站点对齐——结合两站点的预测相关性和支持度形成逐对资格，确定因子权重和类别条件对齐强度。使用去偏Sinkhorn散度作为分布距离度量，并提出了两个理论命题（类别对比稳定性、资格变分形式）。

Result: 在ABIDE、REST-meta-MDD、SRPBS、ABCD四个真实数据集上的留一站点实验表明，BRIO在所有数据集上一致优于包括GCN、GAT、CORAL、IRM、GSAT、DisC、BrainNetTF、BrainOOD、CORE在内的竞争基线，准确率相对提升最高达3.8%。消融实验验证了重估计支持、任务相关性、对齐强度调制和因子加权四个组件的互补作用。在ABIDE上使用CC200替代AAL116的替代脑图谱划分下，增益依然存在。ID设置下也保持竞争力。案例研究证明跨站点一致性与预测重估计变异性之间存在不对应关系，而BRIO能有效识别可迁移因子。

Conclusion: BRIO通过在跨站点对齐之前评估FC重估计下的预测证据稳定性，解决了有限样本FC估计变异性问题。实验证明估计稳定性应作为"对齐什么"的标准，而非仅仅"对齐多少"的强度控制问题。该工作为多站点脑网络泛化提供了新视角，并启发了自适应重估计预算及动态/多模态连接组的未来研究。

Abstract: Cross-site out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization in resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) often relies on learning task-discriminative representations from full-scan functional connectivity (FC) graphs and promoting invariance across source sites. However, FC graphs are estimated from finite, temporally correlated blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) sequences. Cross-site agreement therefore does not necessarily imply that predictive evidence remains supported under FC re-estimation within the same scan. In this paper, we propose Brain Network Re-estimation-Informed OOD Learning (BRIO), a framework that uses within-scan FC re-estimation to guide cross-site alignment. BRIO maps fullscan graphs and their re-estimates into consistently indexed connectome factors, enabling comparisons of their predictive contributions. It assesses re-estimation support from changes in these contributions relative to within-class subject variability and class separation. For each source-site pair and class, this task-calibrated support from both sites is combined with predictive relevance to form pairwise qualifications, which determine relative factor weights and overall alignment strength. Leave-one-site-out experiments on four real-world datasets (ABIDE, REST-metaMDD, SRPBS, and ABCD) show that BRIO consistently outperforms competitive baselines, with relative improvements of up to 3.8% in accuracy. These gains also persist under an alternative brain parcellation on ABIDE.

</details>


### [1409] [Learning Regional Snow Water Equivalent and Snow Height Variations from Sentinel-1 InSAR Acquisitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34614)
*Luca Barco,Lorenzo Innocenti,Bianca Bartoli,Claudio Rossi,Edoardo Arnaudo,Paolo Garza*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较了三种机器学习架构（XGBoost、U-Net、SegFormer），利用Sentinel-1 InSAR数据联合估算意大利阿尔卑斯山的雪水当量（SWE）和雪深（HS）变化，以IT-SNOW再分析数据作为参考。SegFormer在两个目标上均取得最低误差（HS的MAE为10.391 cm，SWE的MAE为27.113 mm w.e.）和最低的初始化变异性。研究表明，特征选择具有模型和任务的特异性，空间相关性指标比平均误差更能区分三种架构的优劣。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 山区水资源管理依赖于可靠的雪水当量（SWE）和雪深（HS）数据，但这些变量在大尺度上的监测仍具挑战性。InSAR技术虽然有潜力，但最佳的特征组合、不同机器学习范式的比较以及多目标联合估算等问题尚未得到系统研究。

Method: 1. 研究区域：意大利阿尔卑斯山的Orobie Alps和Adamello山区。2. 数据源：Sentinel-1 InSAR数据（VV极化，12天重访周期）、Sentinel-3 SLSTR地表温度数据、IT-SNOW再分析数据（500m分辨率）。3. 特征提取：包括五个干涉特征（相干性、强度、相位、解缠相位、形变）和几何/热力/时间编码等共13个特征。4. 目标：预测两期SAR获取之间的ΔHS和ΔSWE变化。5. 模型：XGBoost（逐像素独立处理）、U-Net（ResNet-18骨干）、SegFormer（MiT-B0编码器），后两者采用联合多目标回归。6. 评估指标：MAE、RMSE、R²和Pearson相关系数r。7. 特征敏感性分析：逐个排除每个特征以评估其贡献。

Result: 1. SegFormer在两个目标上均取得最佳结果：HS的MAE为10.391 cm，SWE的MAE为27.113 mm w.e.，且初始化变异性最低。2. 特征敏感性分析显示，使用所有特征并不保证最低误差，最优特征子集具有模型和任务特异性。3. 空间指标（R²、Pearson's r）比平均误差（MAE、RMSE）更能区分三种架构。4. 误差分解显示，大部分归一化误差（58-73%）来自窗口均值变化的系统性偏差，而非空间模式错误。5. 联合多目标训练在所有对比中均优于此中中训练策略。6. 移除InSAR特征后，所有指标均退化，但绝对误差的改善有限（HS约6%，SWE约4%），说明高程和热力强迫已携带大部分可预测信号。

Conclusion: SegFormer在估算SWE和HS变化方面表现最佳，且变异性最低。空间相关性指标比平均误差更能区分不同机器学习架构的优劣。多目标联合训练优于单目标训练。当前模型的主要限制包括：C波段InSAR在湿雪条件下相干性低（0.26-0.33）、空间相关性在不同窗口间变化大、R²均为负值且反映系统性偏差、训练集和测试集的组成差异（全年vs仅积雪期）。未来工作应包括更长时序的交叉验证、扩展至意大利阿尔卑斯山以外的区域、利用L波段SAR（如NISAR）数据、多模态融合以及不确定性量化等。

Abstract: Managing water resources in mountainous regions depends heavily on reliable Snow Water Equivalent (SWE) and Snow Height (HS) data, yet these variables remain difficult to track at scale. This study evaluates three machine learning architectures (XGBoost, U-Net and SegFormer) for the joint estimation of SWE and HS variations from Sentinel-1 InSAR data over the Italian Alps, using the IT-SNOW reanalysis as reference. SegFormer achieves the best results on both targets, with an MAE of 10.391 cm for HS and 27.113 mm w.e. for SWE and the lowest variability across initializations. A feature sensitivity analysis shows that including all available features does not guarantee the lowest error, with model- and task-specific sensitivities. Spatial metrics (R2, Pearson's r) separate the three architectures far more clearly than mean error (MAE, RMSE) does, and decomposing the error per window attributes most of it to a systematic offset in the estimated mean variation rather than to the spatial pattern.

</details>


### [1410] [Evaluating Dynamical Fidelity through Predictive Structure in Physical Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34627)
*Oskar Bohn Lassen,Joao Paulo de Souza Boger,Simon Driscoll,Stephen I. Thomson,Sebastian Schemm,Filipe Rodrigues,Francisco C. Pereira*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个评估机器学习物理模型动态保真度的框架：在专家定义的物理表征空间中，从参考轨迹中发现预测性条件关系并将其冻结为评估测试，而非手动指定过程诊断。该框架应用于平流层波动-平均流相互作用和北极涛动（NAM）演化的预报评估，揭示了Pangu-Weather、GraphCast和FengWu在保持参考条件动态方面的差异，而这些差异无法被传统预报误差捕捉到。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前机器学习物理系统模型的评估主要依赖预测状态与参考状态之间的误差以及物理一致性检验，但这些方法无法揭示学习到的轨迹是否真正再现了底层动力学。过程导向的诊断虽然能提供动力学洞察，但通常与标准机器学习评估流程脱节。论文旨在弥合这一差距，将领域专家的物理表征系统化地转化为对学习物理动力学的评估测试。

Method: 框架将评估分为两个阶段：(1) 专家定义物理表征空间——包括行星波活动、垂直传播、波动强迫、背景环流和环流响应等表征；(2) 从参考轨迹（ERA5再分析）中自动发现具有预测性的条件关系并将其冻结。具体方法包括：分层阈值分割、冬级稳定性的自助法验证、置换FDR校准，用于在772个中性NAM初始条件下发现283个一级和672个二级条件关系。然后在相同的冻结子集上评估GraphCast、Pangu-Weather和FengWu的预报，通过条件均值误差、条件方差误差与传统预报误差的对比来衡量动态保真度。

Result: 三个模型在动态保真度方面表现出显著差异：Pangu-Weather在条件均值和方差误差上整体最低；FengWu虽然传统T、u、v预报MAE最低，但条件误差增长最快，第10天超过其他两个模型。更重要的是，传统预报技能无法预测模型在特定条件关系上的保真度：例如在强负NAM偏移子集中，GraphCast的条件均值误差低于FengWu（0.27 vs 0.33），但两者的传统NAM预报误差排序相反。ERA5的搜索发现预测性结构是稀疏且分层的——在7875个一级候选中只有283个通过统计验证，揭示了预测性集中在特定的物理-时间配置中。

Conclusion: 准确的态预测本身并不能保证参考预测结构的保持。该框架将领域专家的物理表征转化为学习物理动力学的系统化测试，无需预先规定关系。论文也指出局限：ERA5作为参考而非真值；某些前兆体总结的历史长于模型可直接获得的信息；稳定性和置换校准降低了偶然关系的影响但不保证对其他时期、再分析或物理系统的迁移。

Abstract: Machine-learning models for physical systems are currently evaluated primarily through errors between predicted and reference states and, increasingly, through tests of physical consistency. These metrics assess whether predictions are accurate and satisfy selected physical requirements, but provide limited insight into whether learned trajectories reproduce the underlying dynamics. Domain experts examine such relationships through physical representations that expose relevant processes, interactions, and responses, but these analyses are often separated from typical machine-learning evaluation. We introduce a practical framework for evaluating dynamical fidelity through predictive structure in physical representation spaces. Experts define the representations, while reference trajectories determine which relationships are predictive and retained as evaluation tests. We demonstrate the approach in atmospheric forecasting using ERA5 representations of planetary-wave activity and Northern Annular Mode evolution, and evaluate Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and FengWu. The models exhibit distinct departures from reference predictive structure that are not reflected by conventional forecast errors. The framework thereby turns domain-expert representations into systematic tests of learned physical dynamics without prescribing the relationships in advance.

</details>


### [1411] [DisKO: Deep Koopman Learning in Distribution Space from Unpaired Snapshots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34629)
*He Ma,Xiaochen Liu,Wanfeng Lu,Ying Wang,Wei Lin,Qunxi Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DisKO将深度Koopman学习从状态空间拓展到分布空间，提出一种直接从时间无配对的分布快照中学习群体动力学的方法，通过联合学习预测型分布观测函数、有限维Koopman表示以及生成式解码器，在七个基准上达到最优外推性能并能恢复解析Koopman谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多复杂系统（如单细胞测序、粒子群体、宇宙学模拟）只能通过时间无配对的分布快照观测，无法追踪个体轨迹对应关系。轨迹重建方法（如最优传输）需要额外假设且结果不唯一，而直接在无穷维分布空间学习动力学难以获得紧凑近似封闭的表示。Koopman理论虽提供线性化框架，但现有分布Koopman方法依赖预定义的观测字典，无法学习预测型分布观测函数。

Method: DisKO框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 置换不变的集合编码器（基于Deep Sets或Set Transformer），将经验分布快照映射为有限维潜在坐标；(2) 共享的仿射生成器 ż = Az + c，通过矩阵指数实现连续时间传播，支持不规则时间步长；(3) 基于条件流匹配（CFM）的生成式解码器，将潜在坐标映射回完整分布。训练采用三阶段策略：先预训练编解码器，再拟合仿射动力学，最后联合优化。四项损失包括预测CFM、重建CFM、潜在一致性和分布级损失（SW₁ + MMD² + 矩差异）。还提供离散闭式解版本（岭回归）。理论方面证明了多项式矩观测函数在紧致马氏半群下构成Koopman生成子的核心，并给出了观测充分性的充要条件。

Result: 在七个基准（OU、Duffing、Boids、Ocean、CAMELS、Pancreas、WOT iPSC）上，DisKO在全部数据集的W₁指标和六个数据集的SW₁指标上达到最优。相较最强基线，OU的W₁降低58.6%，Duffing降低53.9%，Ocean降低36.2%，单细胞数据Pancreas和WOT iPSC分别降低18.0%和18.7%。OU上50步外推误差近似平稳，Duffing上80步误差缓慢增长。在Circle和Torus上，离散和连续DisKO均能恢复前几个Fourier特征值（误差<0.006），并在wrapped Gaussian探针上以高复相关（>0.976）恢复特征函数。消融实验表明仿射Koopman生成器优于参数匹配的Neural ODE（未来W₁: 0.149±0.007 vs 0.201±0.026），且种子间方差更小。

Conclusion: DisKO成功将深度Koopman学习拓展到分布动力学，证明从无配对快照中学习的共享表示既能支撑精确的分布外推，也能恢复可解释的衰减与振荡模式。仿射潜在动力学作为有效的归纳偏置，比非线性Neural ODE提供了更好的外推稳定性与一致性。开放的理论问题包括：从无配对分布快照中Koopman动力学的可识别性条件，以及学习过程向该算子的收敛性与稳定性保证。

Abstract: Many complex systems are observed only through temporally unpaired distribution snapshots, making trajectory-based dynamical learning difficult without additional assumptions. We therefore formulate the problem directly in distribution space, treating the distribution itself as the dynamical state. The challenge is that distribution space is infinite-dimensional, making compact and approximately closed representations difficult to learn from finite snapshots. We introduce DisKO, which extends deep Koopman learning to distribution dynamics by jointly learning predictive distributional observables, a finite-dimensional Koopman representation, and a generative map back to the full distribution. Across seven diverse benchmarks, DisKO achieves state-of-the-art extrapolation performance, with substantially slower error accumulation on long-horizon prediction tasks. DisKO further recovers leading Koopman eigenvalues and eigenfunctions on systems with analytic spectra, revealing meaningful dynamical structure in the learned representation.

</details>


### [1412] [GenMem: Generative Symbolic Memory for Self-Evolving Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34633)
*Xinke Jiang,Tao Feng,Weixuan Xu,Zhixin Zhang,Zhibang Yang,Wentao Zhang,Runchuan Zhu,Xu Chu,Junfeng Zhao,Yasha Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GenMem提出了一种生成式符号记忆框架,通过Symbolic Identifier (SID)分层离散地址元组,将LLM智能体的记忆管理从判别式检索重构为生成式符号寻址,解决了记忆管理中的稀疏性挑战和地址变异性挑战,实现了无需重新分配地址即可在线更新记忆内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆管理方法受限于判别式检索范式,面临两大根本挑战:(1) 稀疏性挑战——可重用经验在记忆中高度冗余,而任务反馈稀疏、延迟、间接,难以分配到具体的记忆操作;(2) 地址变异性挑战——内容持续演化时,基于嵌入的检索地址随之漂移,破坏了学习到的检索策略的接口不变性。核心动机借鉴LoRA、MoE等结构化稀疏架构利用高维空间隐藏规律的思想,将可重用经验视为稀疏、层次结构化的区域。

Method: 核心机制是Symbolic Identifier (SID),由L层离散符号组成的元组,来自笛卡尔积地址空间,使用少于100个离散符号分解百万级稀疏记忆空间。框架包含三个组件:MemRetriever(生成查询对应的SID并改写检索经验为任务适配支持)、StackPlanner(执行器,使用记忆完成任务)、MemEvolver(从执行轨迹中提炼经验并生成更新SID)。训练流程包括:SID对齐预训练(5种文本-图谱双向映射)、记忆操作中训练(ReAct风格轨迹+拒采样+教师蒸馏)、GRPO后训练(过程奖励+结果奖励+双通道优化)、在线自进化(模型参数和码本冻结,仅通过插入/修改SID对应payload实现记忆演化)。SID通过RQ-KMeans离线构建,码本大小为(48,16,8,8),产生49152个可能地址。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、多跳QA、医学推理、深度研究等任务上的实验表明,GenMem显著优于强记忆增强基线:(1) 体验检索Top-5命中率13.15%,优于SkillRouter的10.28%和TF-IDF的12.52%;(2) ALFWorld全部成功率93.6%(RL版),优于最佳基线Skill0的89.8%;(3) 搜索增强QA平均F1为52.8%,优于SDAR的49.1%;(4) 在线自进化中,GenMem的候选命中率从t=0的20.25%稳步提升到t=9的25.25%,而嵌入型基线因漂移而退化;(5) GPQA上,完整SID使准确率从原始查询的48.32%提升到54.06-54.66%,展示神经符号组合性。

Conclusion: GenMem证明将记忆重构为生成式符号寻址而非判别式检索,可有效解决稀疏性和不变性-演化冲突:SID在分层地址空间上的生成使地址保持稳定,而内容可被精炼,从而实现长期自进化而不产生灾难性寻址漂移。SID还展现出涌现的神经符号特性:它们可与自然语言令牌交错并具有组合性——组合多个SID可合成其存储的经验以应对任何单个条目未涵盖的新情况。未来方向包括自适应码本分配和SID-文本-令牌交错,以将记忆库转变为复杂任务规划的可编程符号层。

Abstract: Long-term memory supports the self-evolution of LLM agents by retaining experience and skills across tasks and enabling their retrieval, reuse, and revision in subsequent long-horizon decision-making. Yet existing memory management approaches remain limited to discriminative retrieval and to address the sparse, hierarchical, and highly redundant structure of reusable experience: only a small, task-dependent subset of trajectories and memories warrants retention, retrieval, or revision. Learning these operations is further complicated by sparse, delayed, and indirect task-level feedback, with weak supervision across the memory lifecycle. Moreover, continual memory evolution introduces an architectural tension as addressing invariance: stored experience is perpetually revised, yet the addressing interface consumed by learned retrieval policies must remain stable. To address, we present GenMem, which reformulates memory management as generative symbolic addressing. Its core mechanism is the Symbolic Identifier (SID), a multi-level discrete token tuple drawn from a Cartesian-product address space that factorizes a million-scale sparse memory space using fewer than one hundred discrete symbols. Instead of generating ever-changing raw content, the memory agent learns to generate SIDs, while memory evolution rewrites the payload at a fixed address without shifting the address itself. Architecturally, GenMem couples a MemRetriever and a MemEvolver within a multi-agent harness, trained via GRPO with dense process and outcome rewards with two-channels optimization. Under offline memory evolution, experiments spanning ALFWorld, WebShop, multi-hop QA, medical reasoning, and deep research evaluate GenMem against strong memory-augmented baselines...

</details>


### [1413] [Correction-space Cross-variate Interaction for Test-time Adaptation in Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34638)
*Yuanyuan Deng,Mykola Pechenizkiy,Songgaojun Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoRe框架，将多变量时间序列预测测试时自适应（TSF-TTA）中的跨变量交互从传统的预测空间转移到修正空间，通过共享锚点修正精炼（SCR）和输入条件谱门控实现结构化跨变量自适应，避免了骨干网络误差在变量间的直接传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSF-TTA方法独立地适应每个变量，忽略了多变量时间序列中分布偏移的跨变量依赖结构。虽然利用这种结构具有潜力，但在延迟监督设置下，对预测直接进行交互会引入未修正骨干误差在变量间直接传播的路径。核心问题是：跨变量交互应该在哪里进行？

Method: 提出修正空间交互框架CoRe，包含两个核心组件：1）共享锚点修正精炼（SCR），通过参数高效瓶颈将每个变量的修正与跨变量共享锚点结合；2）输入条件谱门控，利用当前输入窗口的谱描述符自适应调节精炼贡献。理论分析（命题3.2）证明预测空间交互存在骨干误差的直接耦合传播路径，而修正空间交互避免了这种直接传播。

Result: 在7个骨干网络、6个数据集、4个预测范围的168个设置上，CoRe平均MSE比冻结骨干降低25.82%，比当前最优TSF-TTA方法COSA降低10.57%，在中长尺度（H=192, 336, 720）增益更显著。仅增加7.7%计算开销。在线自适应可靠性也全面优于基线（平均遗憾-0.117，负面比例23.2%）。

Conclusion: 修正空间交互是TSF-TTA中跨变量自适应的有效设计选择，能够在不直接混合未修正骨干误差的前提下实现变量间信息共享。结构化共享锚点设计结合输入条件谱门控，在广泛的实验设置中一致性地提升了预测精度和自适应可靠性，同时保持了适度的计算开销。修正矩阵表现出约73%能量集中于主导奇异模式的低维结构，验证了参数高效瓶颈设计的合理性。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) is a promising paradigm for handling distribution shift in time-series forecasting (TSF), where models adapt at inference time, often leveraging delayed observed data to refine predictions. In the multivariate setting, distribution shifts often exhibit cross-variate dependencies, yet existing TSF-TTA methods adapt each variate independently and ignore this cross-variate structure. Exploiting such structure motivates cross-variate interaction, but coupling variates through backbone predictions introduces direct pathways for mixing uncorrected errors across variates, a concern under the delayed supervision of TSF-TTA. We identify the \emph{interaction space} as a key design choice, and show that acting on adapter corrections that refine backbone outputs, the \emph{correction space}, rather than on the predictions themselves, avoids directly propagating backbone errors across variates. We build on this to propose \textsc{CoRe} (\textsc{Co}rrection-space Interaction \textsc{Re}finement), realizing correction-space interaction through (i) Shared-anchor Correction Refinement (SCR), which combines each variate's correction with a shared anchor through a parameter-efficient bottleneck, and (ii) input-conditioned spectral gating, which adaptively modulates the refinement from the current input window. Across seven backbones, six datasets, and four prediction horizons, \textsc{CoRe} reduces MSE by 25.82\% on average over backbones and 10.57\% over the state-of-the-art TSF-TTA method, with stronger gains at medium-to-long horizons and modest computational overhead. Data and code are available at: this https URL

</details>


### [1414] [Uniform Race: Parameter-Free Approximate Rejection Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34639)
*Seiyun Shin,Juhyeong Pang,Kwang-Sung Jun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为Uniform Race (UR)的无参数近似拒绝采样算法。该算法通过将每个观测重要性权重除以独立的均匀随机变量来构造评分，并返回评分最高的候选样本。UR无需阈值作为输入即可同时对所有固定阈值M达到RS的最优保证，且其总变差误差严格不高于预算校准的RS和SIR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的近似拒绝采样（RS）算法的最优阈值依赖于未知的目标-提议分布对（π,μ）的性质，通常无法从观测样本中获得。SIR等无阈值替代方法的误差收敛速度较慢（O(1/N)），而预算校准的RS通过估计归一化常数Z来选择阈值，存在固有的偏差权衡问题。这些都促使作者提出：能否设计一种无参数的采样算法，自动实现事后最优的RS保证？

Method: 1. 提出Uniform Race (UR)算法：对每个候选观测权重w_u(Y_i)除以独立均匀随机变量U_i~Unif(0,1)，构成评分S_i = w(Y_i)/U_i，返回最大评分对应的候选。由于Z对所有候选相同，排名中自然消去，无需知道归一化常数。2. 理论分析：证明UR的TV误差同时对所有阈值M满足上界（定理1），即D_TV(P_N^U, π) ≤ inf_{M>0}{ε_M + (1 - A_M/M)^N}。通过条件化最大评分S_(N)，刻画输出分布（命题1）。3. 对比分析：分别与预算校准的RS（Rohatgi等人2025算法5）和SIR进行对比，证明UR在TV距离及所有凸f-散度上均不超过两者（定理2和3）。在固定二元对上构造指数级分离实例（命题2和3）。4. 唯一性证明：证明满足通用RS保证的、对权重成比例缩放和排列对称的采样规则，其选择概率必须唯一等于UR（定理4）。5. 实验验证：在LLM数学推理任务（GSM8K和MATH500）上进行测试时扩展实验，比较TV误差和真实准确率。

Result: 1. 理论结果：UR同时对所有固定阈值M达到最优RS保证，无需阈值输入（定理1）；UR误差不超过预算校准RS和SIR，且在固定二元对上误差比为指数级增长（命题2：UR误差(3/4)·3^{-N} vs 校准RS的Ω(2^{-N/2})；命题3：UR误差指数衰减 vs SIR的O(1/N)）。2. 唯一性结果：在合理信息论假设下，达到通用RS保证的选择概率被唯一确定为UR（定理4）。3. 实验结果：在GSM8K和MATH500的LLM数学推理任务中，UR在TV误差和真实准确率上与已知最佳阈值RS相当，无需阈值选择，且优于预算校准RS和SIR，验证了理论预测。

Conclusion: UR是一种无需阈值输入即可自动实现最优RS事后保证的近似采样算法，它在理论上严格优于现有的预算校准RS和SIR，并在LLM推理时扩展（test-time scaling）实验中表现出与最佳阈值RS相当的性能，同时消除了阈值选择的工程负担。论文还证明了在自然信息论限制下，UR的选择概率是满足通用RS保证的唯一解。这一工作为推理时计算和LLM解码提供了理论完备且实用的采样方案。

Abstract: We study approximate sampling: given $N$ independent samples from a proposal distribution $\mu$, the goal is to select one whose distribution is close to a target $\pi$ specified only up to a normalizing constant. Block and Polyanskiy (2023) provide finite budget error bounds for approximate rejection sampling (RS) as a function of the acceptance threshold $M$. The threshold $M$ giving the smallest bound, however, depends on properties of $(\pi,\mu)$ that are typically unavailable from the observed sample. This raises a natural question: Can one attain the best RS guarantee without taking $M$ as input? We answer affirmatively by proposing a parameter-free sampling algorithm called uniform race (UR), based on importance weights, which are ratios of target to proposal probabilities (or densities). It divides each observed weight by an independent uniform random variable to form a score and returns the candidate with the largest score. For every budget $N$, its total variation error satisfies the RS upper bound for every fixed threshold $M$ simultaneously, thereby achieving the best such bound in hindsight. We also characterize its output distribution conditional on the largest score, identifying when it is exactly the target $\pi$. Uniform race has no larger total variation error than a natural budget-calibrated RS derived from Rohatgi et al. (2025) and sampling importance resampling (SIR). In particular, we exhibit instances where UR's error is exponentially smaller in $N$ than that of either baseline. Furthermore, we establish conditions under which attaining this RS guarantee for every $(\pi,\mu)$ uniquely determines the selection probabilities as those of UR. Finally, test-time scaling experiments on LLM math-reasoning tasks corroborate the theoretical comparisons and demonstrate that UR remains competitive in ground-truth accuracy without requiring threshold selection.

</details>


### [1415] [Tilted Schrödinger Bridge Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34642)
*Sergei Kholkin,Evgeny Burnaev,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Tilted Schrödinger Bridge Matching (TSBM)，一种基于 Adjoint Matching 的后训练微调方法，用于将预训练 Schrödinger Bridge 适配到奖励倾斜的目标分布 p₁ʳ∝p₁eʳ，同时保持源分布不变。该方法在 Colored MNIST 和 CelebA 无配对图像翻译任务上取得了优于 DPS 和 CondSMC 等基线的奖励-忠实度权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练 Schrödinger Bridge (SB) 需要根据人类偏好或物理约束进行调整，但现有的奖励微调方法主要针对无记忆的扩散模型。对于 SB 这类源-终点存在依赖关系的有记忆模型，简单的条件倾斜（如 q₁|₀∝p₁|₀eʳ）无法产生正确的终点边际分布 p₁ʳ，导致伪影或奖励黑客问题。因此需要一种能够精确保证终点边际奖励倾斜同时保持源边际的方法。

Method: TSBM 将倾斜 Schrödinger Bridge 问题（TiltedSBP）转化为相对于预训练桥 P 的随机最优控制（SOC）问题，通过 Proposition 1 证明 SB_P(p₀,p₁ʳ)=SB_R(p₀,p₁ʳ)，允许以 P 为参考进行增量控制学习。算法基于交替优化：Controller Matching（使用 Adjoint Matching，Eq. 19）和 Corrector Matching（Eq. 21）。其中，终端代价的梯度通过 Proposition 2 简化为 ∇fʳ_rel = hʳ - h_old - ∇r，其中 h 为对数 Schrödinger 势的梯度。理论证明（Theorem 1）该交替更新收敛到 TiltedSB 的精确解。

Result: 在 Colored MNIST 数字"2"到"3"的无配对翻译任务上，TSBM 在薄笔画、粗笔画、红色色度三个奖励上均改善了帕累托前沿；在 CelebA 128×128 男性到女性翻译任务上，针对自然露齿笑、浓妆、年长女性三个 ImageReward 提示，TSBM 在 PickScore 评估奖励（而非训练奖励）上取得最高分，表明其泛化能力优于 DPS（后者训练奖励高但评估奖励低，存在奖励黑客现象）。推理成本方面，TSBM 与预训练 DSBM 几乎相同（1.46s/图），而 DPS 需要 7.12s/图。在 2D 玩具实验中，TSBM 的 TV 距离为 0.117，显著优于 DPS 的 0.234 及 SNIS 的 0.298。

Conclusion: TSBM 是首个针对预训练 Schrödinger Bridge 进行奖励倾斜微调的实用算法，通过交替 Controller 和 Corrector Matching 实现精确的终点边际倾斜。在 Colored MNIST 和 CelebA 实验中，TSBM 在奖励优化和源忠实度之间取得了最佳权衡，且推理时无需奖励计算，效率接近预训练模型。局限在于假设精确优化和理论假设成立、需可微奖励和终点转移分数；未来工作包括非可微奖励扩展、物理约束适配、离散状态空间扩展及蒸馏降低微调成本。

Abstract: Schrödinger bridges provide an entropy-regularized framework and a principled solution for unpaired domain translation. In practice, a pretrained bridge may need to be adapted to human preferences or physical constraints through a reward a problem closely related to reward tilting in diffusion models but underexplored for Schrödinger bridges. We introduce Tilted Schrödinger Bridge Matching (TSBM), a post-training method for fine-tuning a learned bridge $P$ between source $p_0$ and target $p_1$ toward a reward-tilted target $p_1^r\propto p_1e^r$, while preserving source $p_0$. We formulate this adaptation as alternating optimization initialized from $P$, provide theoretical justification, and derive a practical algorithm based on Adjoint Matching. We evaluate TSBM on unpaired image-to-image translation targeting digit properties in MNIST and facial attributes in CelebA.

</details>


### [1416] [Universal Dynamic Portfolios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34643)
*Yu-Jie Zhang,Yu-Xiang Wang,Peng Zhao,Kevin Jamieson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了非平稳在线投资组合选择（OPS）的动态遗憾最小化问题，将Cover的通用投资组合推广到竞争任意时变比较器序列的场景。针对对数损失梯度无界导致现有方法失效的挑战，本文证明了基于标准L1路径长度的√(TP_T)下界是不可避免的，表明指数凹性带来的加速在动态设置中失效。为此引入了两种结构感知度量——Jensen-Shannon距离和JS^q-路径长度，并提出了Universal Dynamic Portfolio算法（结合Dirichlet Hedge与fixed-share更新），无需参数调优即可同时实现对两种度量的最优遗憾界。在有界梯度假设下，进一步开发了适用于一般在线指数凹优化的快速率proper算法，达到T^(1/3)P_T^(2/3)动态遗憾率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的OPS研究主要集中在静态遗憾（与最佳恒定再平衡投资组合竞争），但这一基准在动态市场中过于局限。将Cover的通用投资组合推广到时变比较器序列面临两大技术障碍：（1）对数损失梯度无界使现有动态遗憾方法失效；（2）尽管对数损失具有exp-concave曲率（静态设置下可获对数速率），其在动态设置下的优势是否保留尚不明确。本文旨在厘清OPS可实现的动态遗憾率，并阐明损失曲率在非平稳在线学习中的作用。

Method: 方法包含三部分：（1）通过将OPS归约为序贯概率赋值（SPA），构造分段平稳环境证明Ω(max{d log T, min{T, √(dTC)}})下界；（2）提出Universal Dynamic Portfolio算法（参数无关，μ_t=1/t），利用Dirichlet分布作为虚拟比较器进行基于mixability的分析，控制总变差距离以建立JS路径长度和JS^q-路径长度的遗憾界；（3）在有界梯度假设下设计FLH框架的proper算法，通过二层mixability分析处理组件级投影问题，使用高斯混合基学习器和二次代理损失，达到T^(1/3)P_T^(2/3)动态遗憾率，适用于一般紧凸域上的在线exp-concave优化。

Result: 主要结果包括：（1）标准L1路径长度下Ω(max{d log T, min{T, √(dTC)}})的极小极大下界，表明exp-concavity的加速在动态设置中消失；（2）Universal Dynamic Portfolio算法在无梯度界假设下达到Õ(d(1+T^(1/3)(P_T^JS)^(2/3)))动态遗憾，并通过JS^q-路径长度对所有q∈[0,1]同时实现Õ(dT^(q/(q+2))(P_{T,q}^JS)^(2/(q+2)))，涵盖切换数S_T的Õ(d(S_T+1)log(dT))保证；（3）在有界梯度下，对一般紧凸域上的exp-concave优化获得Õ((d/η)(ln(dT)+T^(1/3)P_T^(2/3)(ln(dT))^(2/3)))的proper且计算可行的动态遗憾率。

Conclusion: 本文建立了非平稳OPS动态遗憾的近乎匹配的上界和下界，揭示了标准路径长度的局限性，并提出了利用比较器序列空间-时间结构的新度量。Universal Dynamic Portfolio无需参数调优或梯度界假设即可实现多尺度自适应。提出的proper算法解决了Baby and Wang (2021)提出的关于强自适应方法能否在proper学习设置中实现最优动态遗憾的开放问题，适用于一般紧凸域上的在线exp-concave优化。未来工作包括开发计算更高效且保留精细OPS保证的算法，以及减少活跃基学习器的数量。

Abstract: Cover's Universal Portfolio (Cover, 1991) matches the performance of the best constant rebalanced portfolio in hindsight. We generalize this framework to compete with an arbitrary comparator sequence $\mathbf{u}_1,\ldots,\mathbf{u}_T$, leading to a dynamic regret minimization problem for the log loss where existing methods break down due to potentially unbounded gradients. The log loss is exp-concave, a curvature property that classically yields fast rates for static regret, yet we show that this advantage generally disappears in the dynamic setting. In particular, a linear-loss-type $\sqrt{TP_T}$ dependence is unavoidable, where $P_T=\sum_{t=2}^T\lVert\mathbf{u}_t-\mathbf{u}_{t-1}\rVert_1$ is the standard path length. This limitation stems from the coarse nature of $P_T$, which obscures finer spatial and temporal structure of the comparator sequence. We therefore introduce two structure-aware measures---the Jensen-Shannon distance for spatial structure and the JS$^q$-path length for temporal structure---under which faster rates are attainable when the comparator sequence has favorable structure. To achieve sharp bounds for both measures simultaneously, we develop Universal Dynamic Portfolio, a parameter-free method that combines a new Dirichlet Hedge algorithm with a fixed-share update, while retaining a near-optimal $P_T$ guarantee in the worst case. Finally, under an additional bounded-gradient assumption, we show that OPS admits the faster $T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3}$ dynamic regret rate over all comparator sequences. We attain this rate with a tractable proper algorithm that applies more broadly to general online exp-concave optimization over arbitrary compact convex domains.

</details>


### [1417] [When Can Attention Heads Be Statically Defined?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34650)
*Weixian Waylon Li,Yintao Tai,Marcio Fonseca,Shay B. Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出选择性注意力冻结（SAF），通过识别注意力模式低方差的注意力头并用训练中段拟合的固定后softmax均值替换其注意力权重，将存储从序列长度的二次降至线性，同时融合内核实现普通注意力与替换头的协同执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自注意力机制的输入依赖性带来了二次计算成本。部分注意力头的分数主要由查询和键的位置决定而非内容，因此这些头的注意力模式在不同输入间高度相似，重复计算这些几乎与内容无关的分数造成了不必要的开销。本文旨在探究哪些注意力头可以被固定模式替代，以及这种替代如何提高计算和内存效率。

Method: 1. SAF通过方差选择策略（attention variance）识别低注意力模式变化的头；2. 使用训练中段的校准数据测量注意力统计量，选取注意力方差最低的k个头；3. 为每个被选头拟合后softmax均值模式，用绝对位置偏好和相对距离偏好（长度为T的向量）表示，存储从O(T²)降至O(T)；4. 一次性中点替换方案：冻结被选头的注意力权重，保留V投影和输出投影的可训练性；5. 融合内核：将普通注意力（FlashAttention）与替换头在单次前向传播中执行，重构模式在寄存器中避免softmax计算；6. 选择器与模式的对比：比较了post-softmax均值、sharp均值、Gaussian/Dirichlet采样、结构化随机控制等模式，以及方差、forward KL、Q/K梯度等多种选择指标。

Result: 在124M参数、4K上下文、25%替换率下，SAF实现1.056×的训练更新加速，困惑度仅增加0.77%。在1B参数、8K上下文、四GPU设置下（含通信），更新速度提升1.068×，困惑度增加0.51%。50%替换率带来更大加速但困惑度代价更高（约2.5%）。SAF模型在长输入微调和因果预填充阶段也获得加速。在多查询关联回忆（MQAR）任务中，SAF模型在固定长度内对更多键值对的泛化能力优于普通注意力和两种剪枝基线（64对时准确率54.4% vs 26.2-29.0%）。Qwen3-4B零样本评估中，10%替换率下方差选择表现最佳，五个任务平均仅下降0.37个百分点。

Conclusion: SAF为语言模型训练提供了一种实用的输入依赖注意力计算减少方案。当约25%的注意力头被替换时，困惑度增幅低于1%，但获得了显著的训练加速和内存节省。该方法在长输入微调、因果预填充以及关联回忆泛化方面均表现出优势。核心发现是：后softmax均值提供了最佳固定模式，方差评分有效识别可替换头，固定拟合模式几乎不损失性能。这些结果在124M到4B不同规模的模型上均得到验证。

Abstract: Some attention heads learn similar patterns across inputs. Reusing these patterns could reduce training cost by avoiding repeated query-key score computation and softmax. Through controlled pretraining comparisons, we identify Selective Attention Freezing (SAF), which selects heads with low attention-pattern variance and replaces their attention weights with fitted post-softmax means halfway through training. We represent these fixed patterns with absolute-position and relative-distance preferences, reducing storage from quadratic to linear in sequence length. A fused kernel reconstructs the patterns and executes ordinary-attention and replaced heads together. At matched training-token budgets, replacing 25% of attention heads gives 1.056x faster post-replacement optimiser updates at 124M parameters and 4K context, with a 0.77% perplexity increase. At 1B and 8K context, post-replacement updates are 1.068x faster on four GPUs including communication, with a 0.51% perplexity increase. The resulting models also accelerate long-input finetuning and causal prefill. After associative-recall adaptation, the 124M model with 25% replacement generalises to more key-value pairs at a fixed length better than ordinary attention and two pruning controls.

</details>


### [1418] [Minimax Last-Iterate Convergence in Matrix Games with Observed Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34656)
*Yuheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对未知两人零和矩阵博弈，在带对手动作可观测的强盗式收益反馈下，提出了一个能以高概率同时在每轮实现 Õ(√(d/t)) 最后迭代对偶间隙的算法，将维度依赖从此前最佳的 d³ᐟ² 因子改进，同时匹配极小极大下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在自博弈、偏好学习、安全博弈等应用中，对手动作自然可观测。已有 Hait et al. (2026) 在观测对手动作下得到 Õ(d²/√t) 的最后迭代速率，但相比强盗下界 Ω(√(d/t)) 仍有 d 的差距。本文旨在填补这一差距，问：观测对手动作下能否在动作数和轮数上都达到极小极大最优？

Method: 算法采用分阶段（phase）方案，每阶段从基线策略对 (p,q) 出发，目标是将其对偶间隙缩减一半。核心是"自适应平均"（adaptive averaging）与"带比例修正的指数权重"（exponential weights with ratio correction）的联合设计：1）保持辅助策略 (u_t, v_t) 与采样策略 (x_t, y_t) 两套分布；2）选取 a_t = min{1, d/(S_{x,t}+S_{y,t})} 限制聚合重要比；3）对指数权重引入比值修正因子 x_{t,i}/x_{t+1,i}；4）采用隐式探索（implicit exploration）控制估计方差；5）通过势函数分析（potential argument）界定每阶段所需轮数。每阶段结束时以 max-conditional failure probability ρ_k = δ/2^{k+1} 运行，几何递减精度 e_k = 2^{1-k}。

Result: 主要定理（Theorem 1）：对任意 δ∈(0,1)，所提算法以至少 1−δ 的概率，对所有 t≥1 满足 Gap(x_t, y_t) ≤ C√(d/t) [log(dt/δ)]^{3/2}，其中 C 为通用常数。改进 Hait et al. (2026) 的 d² 维度依赖到 d，差距维度改善因子为 d^{3/2}。达到 ε 精度所需轮数从 Õ(d⁴/ε²) 降至 Õ(d/ε²)。计算复杂度为 O(d) 时间和内存每轮。这与 d-臂强盗的 Ω(d/ε²) 下界匹配（在 d 和 t 上均达极小极大最优，仅差对数因子）。

Conclusion: 本文解决了观测对手动作下矩阵博弈最后迭代收敛的开放问题：通过自适应平均与比值修正的指数权重的巧妙组合，在不增加 t 的依赖阶的前提下将 d 的依赖从 d² 改进到 √d，达到极小极大下界。算法无需知道时间范围，每轮 O(d) 计算，可行性强。未来方向包括：无观测对手动作下是否可达最优 d^{3/2} 速率（去耦博弈中的关键开放问题）、以及将方法推广到一般和博弈或连续动作空间。

Abstract: We study last-iterate convergence in unknown two-player zero-sum matrix games with bandit payoff feedback and observed opponent actions. For games with $d$ actions per player, we develop an algorithm achieving a duality gap of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{d/t})$ with high probability, simultaneously at every round $t$. This improves the dimension dependence of the best previously known guarantee by a factor of $d^{3/2}$. The rate matches a standard bandit lower bound, establishing minimax optimality in both the number of actions and the number of rounds, up to logarithmic factors. The algorithm is computationally efficient, requiring only $\mathcal{O}(d)$ time and memory per round. Our technical contribution is a joint design of adaptive averaging and corrected exponential weights that absorbs estimation variance, together with a potential argument that bounds phase durations.

</details>


### [1419] [FestDPO: Few-step Generator Alignment with Direct Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34673)
*Jaewoo Lee,Kyuil Sim,Hyeongyu Kang,Kanghoon Lee,Woocheol Shin,Jinkyoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FestDPO（Few-step DPO），一种将直接偏好优化（DPO）扩展到少步生成模型的方法。针对少步生成模型似然不可计算的问题，利用非参数核密度估计（KDE）从经验样本中近似似然，并利用少步模型的快速采样特性使基于样本的近似在计算上可行。方法与模型族和采样过程无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步生成模型虽然采样高效，但生成样本未必满足期望属性，且这些属性难以用显式奖励函数表达。DPO通过偏好对实现对齐，但依赖似然计算，而少步生成模型通常是隐式模型，似然难以求解，限制了其应用。

Method: 核心方法FestDPO用基于样本的核密度估计（KDE）替代DPO损失中的不可计算似然项；利用少量步数生成器的快速采样能力估计当前策略与参考策略的密度；在特征空间中进行KDE以适应图像语义和蛋白质旋转不变性。理论上证明FestDPO损失依概率收敛到DPO损失，且其最小化器一致。

Result: 在1D玩具实验中，FestDPO在Drifting、IMM、MeanFlow、sCM四种少步生成器上均能匹配奖励倾斜的目标分布（KL约3×10⁻³）。文生图任务中，在SDXL-Turbo和SDXL-DMD2上，FestDPO在Pick-a-Pic v2、Parti-Prompts、HPSv2三个基准上均获得最高胜率，并取得最佳人类评价分数。蛋白质骨架生成任务中，在β-折叠比例和结构可设计性（scRMSD）上均优于基线DrPO。对KDE样本数和特征编码器的消融实验表明方法具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: FestDPO为少步生成模型提供了一种模型无关、采样过程无关的偏好对齐方法。理论上与DPO渐近等价，实验上在文生图和蛋白质设计两个领域均优于现有偏好优化基线，且对实现选择鲁棒。

Abstract: Few-step generative models can generate high-fidelity samples within a few function evaluations. Despite this efficiency, generated samples may not exhibit desirable properties. When these properties are difficult to encode as an explicit reward function, direct preference optimization (DPO) can align generative models using pairwise preference feedback without training a separate reward model. However, extending DPO to few-step generative models is challenging because few-step generative models are generally implicit, making the likelihood evaluation required by DPO intractable. To address this challenge, we introduce Few-step DPO (FestDPO), an extension of DPO for few-step generative models that leverages nonparametric likelihood estimation from empirical samples. By exploiting the fast sampling capabilities of few-step generative models, our approach makes sample-based approximation of DPO loss computationally feasible. Furthermore, the sample-based formulation makes FestDPO agnostic to the model family and sampling procedure. Our toy experiment demonstrates that FestDPO matches the reward-tilted target distribution across four few-step generators. For real-world tasks, we evaluate FestDPO in two domains: text-to-image generation and protein backbone generation. In text-to-image generation, FestDPO outperforms preference optimization baselines in both win rates against the base models and human evaluation scores. In protein backbone generation, it achieves a higher $\beta$-sheet fraction and better structural designability than the baselines.

</details>


### [1420] [QuantForge: Discovering Residual Decompositions for MXFP4 Post-Training Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34680)
*Qiulin Shang,Zhoutong Wu,Jie Hu,Kun Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QuantForge 是一个面向 MXFP4 W4A4 训练后量化（PTQ）算法发现的系统，通过"渐进残差分解"将控制实验结论强制编译为后续代码修改。其发现的固定量化器 HiRes 在七款模型上达到最低 Robust Fit (0.09300)，并在 Qwen3-32B 上以更少的新程序评估（141 vs 240）实现了更好的迁移性能（6/8 命中目标 vs 3/8）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MXFP4 W4A4 量化中，坐标变换、离散编码与路径级纠错之间存在复杂耦合，传统 LLM 驱动的程序进化仅依赖性能分数，无法区分改进源于何处，导致搜索方向不清。需要一种能够将实验结论转化为代码变更指导的发现机制。

Method: QuantForge 维护两个前沿：可执行前沿（候选程序）和残差前沿（未解决的设计问题）。每个提案注册竞争性解释及其在不同控制条件下的预测，控制器按公式(2)选择最小成本的可区分控制集，冻结后执行。结果被"编译"为后续程序必须实现的代码变更，并通过执行探针验证。残差闭合并后，对修订程序重新测量，揭示下一阶段的残差——即"渐进残差分解"。该过程最终发现三阶段 HiRes 量化器：(I) 几何整形（参考坐标 + 编码误差交互修正 K + 权值-激活对角平衡 D）；(II) 离散实现（基于已安装 W4 权值的 GPTQ + 单码激活细化）；(III) 结构化恢复（先注意力值输出仿射修正，再以修正后状态重新测量 MLP 残差进行 SiLU 门控修正）。

Result: HiRes 在七款模型（Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen3-4B/8B/32B、Mistral-7B、Llama-3-8B、OLMo-2-13B）七项任务上的 Robust Fit 为 0.09300，低于 WUSH (0.09910) 和 BRQ (0.11152)；Qwen3-32B 量化 Fit-7 为 0.027369，低于 WUSH 的 0.036489。在匹配 240 次评估预算的对比中，QuantForge 以 141 个新程序（其余 99 次用于控制和合规探针）在 6/8 轮次中达到 Llama-3.1-8B 迁移目标，中位数 PPL 为 7.80，优于 ReflectMem (8.09, 3/8)、TextMem (9.20, 3/8) 和 Score-only (10.03, 1/8)。移除强制实现检查使验证残差闭合从 10.4 降至 3.9，中位数 PPL 从 7.80 升至 8.06。在 48 次重放实验中，强制按判决实现使改进后继比例从 31% 提升至 58%。

Conclusion: QuantForge 证明了通过控制实验将证据转化为后续代码变更可以显著提升可迁移 PTQ 算法的发现效率，同时减少对新候选程序的评估次数。HiRes 的三阶段层级结构——几何整形、离散实现、结构化恢复——通过逐步重新测量残差而相互适应，在严格 MXFP4 W4A4 约束下实现了跨模型的强健数值质量。主要局限在于未在原生 MXFP4 内核上测试实际延迟、吞吐和内存。

Abstract: Four-bit post-training quantization can reduce the memory demands of large language models, but preserving accuracy under strict MXFP4 W4A4 requires coordinating several design choices. Coordinate transforms change block-encoding errors, which in turn affect the residuals propagated through the network. The useful algorithmic decomposition is therefore not fully known before search. LLM-driven program evolution offers a way to explore these choices, but performance scores alone do not explain which design should change next. We introduce QuantForge, a PTQ discovery system that records competing explanations, selects controls that distinguish them, and checks that successor code implements the resulting conclusions. This residual compilation guides program revisions while retaining useful programs even when their original explanations are rejected. Remeasuring the revised program reveals the next error to address. This process discovers HiRes, a fixed MXFP4 quantizer that shapes coordinates, refines legal code assignments, and recovers errors along attention and MLP paths. Each stage acts on residuals measured after the preceding stage has executed. Across seven tasks, HiRes achieves the lowest seven-model Robust Fit (0.09300) and the lowest quantized Fit-7 at 32B. In matched-budget comparisons of LLM-driven program evolution, each with 240 evaluator calls, QuantForge reaches a held-out transfer target in six of eight runs, compared with three each for textual memory and reflection memory, and one for score-only evolution, despite evaluating fewer new programs. These results show that QuantForge improves the discovery of transferable PTQ algorithms by turning controlled evidence into subsequent program changes.

</details>


### [1421] [SOLAR: A State-Driven Online Learning Rate Scheduler for LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34681)
*Qiulin Shang,Binyu Wang,Yongqi Qiao,Songde Rao,Zhoutong Wu,Kun Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SOLAR 是一种用于大语言模型预训练的在线学习率调度框架，通过基于基础调度器的有界状态依赖残差修正（按参数组粒度）实现稳定在线 LR 适配。其核心设计包括：基础调度器锚定（每步重新锚定到基础 LR）、有界随机残差动作、轻量级状态表征、进度感知奖励以及安全熔断机制（Circuit-Breaker）。在 C4 数据集上对 60M–1B 的 Llama 2 密集模型（AdamW 和 Muon 优化器）以及 1B Qwen2-MoE 和 3B DeepSeek-V2 风格 MoE 模型的实验中，SOLAR 在最终困惑度上均优于调优后的静态调度器（Cosine、WSD 等）和自动 LR 调优器（AutoLRS、MECHANIC、Prodigy 等）。在 130M 对照实验中，基础锚定和动作边界将全局 PPL 控制器从 27.09 降至 23.74，而组级控制进一步达到 22.87。此外，在 60M 代理上训练的残差策略可冻结后直接迁移到更大密集模型，无需目标端 PPO 更新，且在四倍基础 LR 范围内保持有效。计算开销极低：1B AdamW 完整训练仅增加 1.23% 的 wall-clock 时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型预训练的学习率调度主要依赖手工设计的固定调度方案（如 Warmup-Cosine-Decay、WSD），这些方案在训练开始前就已确定，无法适应训练过程中动态变化的优化状态。虽然 Learning to Optimize（L2O）框架提供了在线学习调度的可能，但在 LLM 规模下，由于信号噪声大、反馈延迟以及灾难性发散的风险，在线调度仍然非常脆弱。因此，需要一种既能动态适应又能稳定可靠的在线 LR 调度方法。

Method: SOLAR 采用基于 PPO 的强化学习框架，其核心设计包括：(1) 基础调度器锚定——保留外部基础调度器（如 Cosine）提供预热-衰减轮廓，策略仅学习有界的状态依赖残差修正 η_{t,g} = η^base_{t,g} · exp(α_t · a_{t,g})，每步重新锚定以避免探索错误累积；(2) 有界随机组级动作——采用 tanh-squashed Gaussian 策略，为每个参数组输出一个有界残差动作，共享一个可学习的标量标准差 σ；(3) 轻量级状态表征——结合全局特征（训练进度、损失、EMA 差异等 4 维）和局部特征（基础 LR 对数、梯度范数、前一步动作、深度索引、参数范数等 6 维），共 10 维；(4) 进度感知奖励——结合即时损失改善 r^perf、长期 EMA 趋势 r^trend 和组级稳定性塑形项 p^stab；(5) Circuit-Breaker 安全机制——当损失突增超过阈值 κ_L=1.5 时触发，回滚至最近安全检查点并执行强制 PPO 更新。架构采用两层 MLP 编码器（隐藏维度 256），Tanh 激活。动作尺度 α 在前 10% 步内线性从 0 预热至 α=1.3。

Result: 在 C4 数据集上对 60M–1B Llama 2 模型的实验中，SOLAR-online 在所有规模和优化器下均取得最低验证困惑度：1B AdamW 从 16.52（Cosine）降至 14.83，1B Muon 从 14.36 降至 13.79。SOLAR-frozen（60M 代理训练的冻结策略直接迁移）在 130M/350M/1B 上均优于对应调优的 Cosine/WSD，且在五组对照中的六组 seed-52 对比中获得更低 PPL。Qwen2-MoE 1B 上从 9.61 降至 9.34，3B DeepSeek-V2 风格 MoE 从 10.73 降至 10.38。消融实验表明：基础锚定和动作边界将全局 PPO 控制器从 27.09 改善至 23.74 PPL；组级控制进一步降至 22.87。在四倍基础 LR（0.5×–2×）的迁移测试中，冻结策略在所有六个设置上均优于匹配 Cosine，且在 Cosine 发散的两个 2× 设置中成功完成训练。控制流时间开销极低：1B AdamW 完整训练仅增加 1.23% wall-clock 时间。

Conclusion: SOLAR 建立了 LLM 预训练中实用在线 LR 调度的可行路径。通过将基础 LR 轮廓保留在控制器外部并学习有界状态依赖的组级残差修正，结合 Circuit-Breaker 安全机制和轻量级状态表征，SOLAR 在密集模型（60M–1B，AdamW 和 Muon）以及 MoE 设置（1B Qwen2-MoE 和 3B DeepSeek-V2 风格）上一致改善最终困惑度。其核心贡献包括：(1) 方法论设计——有界、状态依赖、每步重新锚定的组级残差修正框架；(2) 实验验证——在密集和 MoE 模型、多种优化器上的一致性改善；(3) 实际可扩展性——60M 训练的策略可冻结迁移至更大模型，无需目标端 PPO 更新。主要局限在于验证规模仍限于 1B 密集模型和 3B MoE，更大规模的行为有待未来工作验证。

Abstract: Learning-rate (LR) scheduling plays a central role in large language model (LLM) pretraining, yet current practice still relies heavily on hand-crafted heuristics such as Warmup-Cosine-Decay and Warmup-Stable-Decay. Because these schedules are fixed in advance, they cannot adapt to evolving optimization dynamics. Online learned scheduling within the Learning to Optimize (L2O) framework offers a dynamic alternative, but remains brittle at LLM scale due to noisy signals, delayed feedback, and the risk of catastrophic divergence. We propose SOLAR (State-driven Online Learning rAte scheduleR), a stabilized framework for reliable online LR adaptation. SOLAR uses a base schedule as a reference and learns bounded, state-dependent residual corrections for individual parameter groups. Each correction re-anchors to the base at every step, allowing the policy to adapt the LR without relearning the warmup-decay profile. A lightweight state representation and progress-aware reward guide online learning, while a Circuit-Breaker restores training after rare unsafe actions. Across autoregressive language-model pretraining, SOLAR improves final perplexity over tuned static schedules and automatic LR tuners for dense models from 60M to 1B, AdamW and Muon, and two MoE settings up to 3B. Matched 130M controls show that adding base anchoring and action bounds improves a global PPO controller from 27.09 to 23.74 final PPL, while group-wise control reaches 22.87 on the same two seeds.
