TL;DR: 本文提出SpikeCredit框架,将脉冲神经网络(SNN)的膜电位迹与脉冲事件视为"时序信用载体"(Temporal Credit Carriers, TCC),通过任务自适应的载体选择与"快读-慢写"闭环机制(自运动反馈约束SMF读、信用目标迹对齐CTT写)解决稀疏奖励强化学习中的时序信用分配难题,在四个MuJoCo任务上大幅超越稀疏奖励SNN基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏奖励RL中,延迟的轨迹级回报无法区分哪些中间转移对最终成败真正负责,使得信用分配极度模糊。已有方法(事后经验回放、奖励重分配、奖励塑形等)聚焦于"如何重新分配延迟回报",但忽视了一个前提问题:信用相关的时序信息是否被保留在策略内部动态中。本文认为可靠信用分配的前提是策略动态能够保存并暴露信用相关信息,并提出SNN的膜电位迹与脉冲事件天然具备此特性。

Method: 核心方法包含三部分:(1)任务自适应TCC选择:通过随机rollout统计动作的节律性与突发性分数,选择膜电位载体(c_mem)或脉冲载体(c_spk);(2)快通路SMF(自运动反馈约束):冻结actor,利用状态、状态变化量、动作能量构成的线性代理读出器与TCC评分器,通过return-consistency损失、KL对齐损失与L1稀疏约束,将终端回报转化为逐转移的信用分布与对数信用目标;(3)慢通路CTT(信用目标迹对齐):在延迟的actor更新步,通过冻结的TCC评分器,用Huber损失将replay样本的TCC动力学对齐到SMF恢复的信用目标,使未来动力学更具"信用可读性"。该read-write循环在episode级别反复执行。

Result: 在Ant、Hopper、Swimmer、Walker2d四个MuJoCo稀疏奖励任务上,SpikeCredit的Last10回报相对稀疏SNN基线分别提升+1169%、+953%、+723%、+1781%,并在Swimmer上超过密集奖励基线约+113%;在Ant上恢复的信用信号与密集奖励的逐转移Pearson/Spearman相关达0.63/0.64;消融实验证明SMF的三种输入互补且不可或缺,移除SMF后回报骤降至192.7,CTT的移除使Last10从1669.9降至1403.8;载体选择机制在不同任务上自动选中更优载体;对λ_align、λ_sparse、λ_CTT等关键超参数在合理范围内鲁棒。

Conclusion: 本文将SNN动力学重新定位为稀疏奖励信用分配的"信用保留基底",通过形式化TCC概念与快读-慢写闭环框架,证明脉冲时序动态能有效保存并暴露信用相关信息,既显著超越稀疏奖励SNN/ANN基线,又在部分任务上达到甚至超过密集奖励性能,为稀疏奖励脉冲强化学习提供了新的表示学习视角。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse rewards is challenging because delayed outcomes provide little guidance about which intermediate computations caused success or failure. We argue that reliable credit assignment requires policy dynamics that preserve and expose credit-relevant information over time, a role we formalize as Temporal Credit Carriers (TCCs) and that spiking neural networks (SNNs) naturally fulfill through graded membrane traces and event-driven spikes. Based on this hypothesis, we propose SpikeCredit, an SNN-based framework for RL with sparse rewards that first performs task-adaptive TCC selection and then closes the loop between a fast TCC-reading pathway, where self-motion feedback constraint uses local behavior-grounded cues to constrain transition-level credit recovery, and a slow TCC-writing pathway, where credit-targeted trace alignment feeds recovered credit back into the actor to make future TCC dynamics more credit-readable. Across sparse-reward MuJoCo tasks, SpikeCredit improves Last10 return over sparse SNN baselines by +1169% on Ant, +953% on Hopper, +723% on Swimmer, and +1781% on Walker2d, and exceeds the dense-reward baseline on Swimmer by +113%. Mechanistic analyses further show substantially stronger alignment with dense rewards than the sparse SNN baseline. These results position spiking dynamics as credit-preserving substrates for sparse-reward RL.

</details>


### [1478] [$λ$-JEPA Spectral Anti-Collapse Regularization for Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35288)
*Berker Demirel,Clémentine Dominé,Valentino Maiorca,Marco Fumero,Marco Mondelli,Francesco Locatello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SACReg（谱反坍缩正则化器），通过λ-平衡分析推导而来，旨在解决联合嵌入自监督学习（JESSL）中骨干网络表征维度坍缩的问题。作者将该方法应用于JEPA，提出λ-JEPA，在图像和视频自监督学习基准上取得了显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的显式正则化JESSL方法（如LeJEPA、VICReg、VISReg）将反坍缩约束施加于投影头之后的表征空间，但在下游任务中实际使用的是投影头之前的骨干表征。研究发现，即使投影空间较高表示高秩，骨干表征仍可能维度坍缩（rank低），这会减少下游任务可用的特征方向，限制迁移性能。

Method: 从两层线性网络的λ-平衡（捕获相邻层权重矩阵的相对尺度）分析出发，证明负λ-平衡能防止表征坍缩。推导线性SACReg（结合L2权重衰减与对数行列式项），通过约束优化确保编码器Gram矩阵的下界。扩展到非线性编码器：直接对表示协方差进行正则化（均值惩罚+迹惩罚+负对数行列式惩罚），该正则器具有反坍缩性质（最优均值为零，最优协方差为各向同性满秩）。提出λ-JEPA，将SACReg应用于骨干表征和投影表征的视图中心，对抗坍缩并促进图像间的变化。

Result: 1）ImageNet-1k 100轮训练中，λ-JEPA ViT-S/16线性探测达69.7%，迁移达77.6%（优于LeJEPA的62.5%/68.7%）；ViT-B/16达74.2%/80.9%（优于VISReg的70.3%/76.4%）。2）400轮训练后ViT-B/16平均迁移达82.0%，优于VISReg 2.9点。3）视频SSL上，λ-JEPA ViT-B在Something-Something-v2上达43.9%（240轮）和48.3%（1085轮），显著优于LeVJEPA和V-JEPA 2。4）控制实验表明，SACReg在不同SSL方法上均提高骨干RankMe和下游性能（kNN和线性探测），且改进主要来自类中心可分性增强，而非增强不变性。

Conclusion: SACReg是首个直接针对骨干表征进行反坍缩正则化的方法，成功弥合了显式正则化JESSL方法与基于负样本/不对称方法（如DINO、iBOT）之间的差距。它在图像和视频SSL基准上均获得显著改进，特别是在视频时间推理任务上。未来的工作方向包括扩展到patch级特征和局部裁剪的稀疏预测任务，以及探索该正则化器在世界模型可识别性中的作用。

Abstract: Joint-embedding self-supervised learning typically combines an invariance objective across augmented views with additional mechanisms to prevent representational collapse. These objectives are often applied after a projection head, while downstream tasks use the backbone representation before the projector. We find that this mismatch does not necessarily prevent dimensional collapse in the backbone, which can retain low effective rank and potentially limit downstream transfer. To address this, we introduce SACReg, a spectral anti-collapse regularizer motivated by an analysis of $\lambda$-balance, which captures the relative scale of weight matrices across layers. In a two-layer linear network, we show that (i) $\lambda$-balance prevents collapse, and (ii) our regularizer applied to the backbone induces $\lambda$-balance. In the nonlinear case, this regularizer leads to anti-collapse as well and, in realistic architectures on ImageNet100, it empirically increases the representations' ranks. We apply SACReg to JEPA and propose $\lambda$-JEPA, which improves over LeJEPA and VISReg on ImageNet-1k classification and in average linear-probe transfer performance across eight downstream image datasets. On video self-supervised learning, $\lambda$-JEPA improves over LeVJEPA and V-JEPA 2 on the Something-Something-v2 and Kinetics-400 benchmarks. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1479] [Narrow Multimodal Fine-Tuning Can Induce Emergent Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35291)
*Shunchang Liu,Lukas Fluri,Xin Chen,Francesco Croce*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Modern AI models are aligned through post-training to adapt them to downstream tasks. Recent work shows that fine-tuning language models on narrow tasks can induce emergent misalignment (EM), causing broadly harmful behaviors beyond the training task. However, EM has been studied almost entirely in text-only tasks, leaving its manifestation in multimodal models unclear. In this paper, we define and analyze EM in the context of vision-language models. We first induce EM via fine-tuning on narrow multimodal tasks targeting vulnerable code, careless household-object use, and conspiratorial interpretations of ordinary scenes. Across fifteen commercial and open-source models with different scales, we find that narrow multimodal fine-tuning can induce coherent and broadly misaligned behavior that transfers to unrelated tasks, including misaligned opinions, visual factual dishonesty, unsafe image generation, vulnerability to visual jailbreaks, and risky agentic actions. We further find that multimodal EM does not depend on the apparent harmfulness of training data but is sensitive to training-evaluation modality alignment. EM can arise under both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization and can propagate through intermediate reasoning. Finally, we explore several mitigation strategies, including prompt inoculation, benign continued training, and activation-level steering, which can partially reduce EM. Overall, our findings suggest that multimodal EM reflects a behavioral shift rather than a general loss of capability, extending beyond text to the visual modality.

### [1480] [LionMuon: Alternating Spectral and Sign Descent for Efficient Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35297)
*Arman Bolatov,Artem Riabinin,Nikita Kornilov,Andrey Veprikov,Samuel Horváth,Martin Takáč,Aleksandr Beznosikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LionMuon优化器，通过每P步执行一次Muon（谱）步、其余执行Lion（符号）步的交替策略，结合双EMA动量，在保持Muon更新质量的同时显著降低计算和通信成本（状态仅为AdamW的一半）。理论证明在重尾噪声下存在内部最优周期P*，实验在124M/355M参数模型上验证其损失低于各基线，并在4-GPU数据并行训练中以比Muon少1/3的墙钟时间达到同等损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon的谱方向虽强但代价昂贵——每步需Newton-Schulz迭代和额外的all-reduce通信；Lion等符号方法虽廉价却更新质量不足。核心问题是：能否既保留Muon的更新质量，又仅每隔P步才付出其计算与通信成本？

Method: 设计LionMuon算法：单一双EMA动量缓冲，每P步执行一次Muon（矩阵符号）步，其余P-1步执行Lion（元素符号）步，并采用解耦权重衰减。SignMuon为单EMA变体。理论基于Frank-Wolfe/LMO框架，在重尾噪声假设下推导收敛界，证明周期P在Muon与Lion的光滑度和噪声常数之间插值，并给出最优参数和学习率比α=η_M/η_L的选择依据。

Result: 在FineWeb上训练124M和355M模型时，LionMuon（P=2或5）在相同token数下达到比Muon、AdamW、Lion和Signum更低的损失；在4-GPU数据并行训练中以比Muon少约1/3的PCIe墙钟时间达到Muon的最终损失，且在暴露通信量不增多的前提下优于Dion和MuonBP两个通信高效Muon变体。测得的常数与理论预测一致——FineWeb上存在内部最优周期P*∈{2,5}。

Conclusion: LionMuon通过迭代轴上的周期性交替，将Muon的强方向性与Lion的低成本相结合，以仅增加整数P为代价换取显著的计算和通信节省，同时保持AdamW一半的优化器状态。复杂度界揭示了最优周期由光滑度比L∞/L2和噪声比ρ1/ρ_nuc共同决定。未来工作方向包括更大模型、多节点训练、自适应周期以及考虑Newton-Schulz误差的分析。

Abstract: Pretraining a language model takes enormous compute, and the right optimizer can save a good part of it. Muon's spectral step gives a stronger direction than a sign step, but it is expensive. Every step runs Newton-Schulz iterations on the full matrix and, in distributed training, an extra all-reduce. Sign steps, as in Lion and Signum, are cheap and stay local to each device. We propose LionMuon, which takes one Muon step every $P$ iterations and Lion steps in between, with a single dual-EMA momentum buffer shared by both. Muon's compute and communication are paid once per $P$ steps, and the optimizer state is half of AdamW's. A single-EMA variant, SignMuon, already improves on Muon. We prove complexity bounds under heavy-tailed noise in which the period sets an interpolation between Muon's and Lion's smoothness and noise constants, and which say when LionMuon is faster than both. On 124M and 355M models trained on FineWeb, LionMuon with $P=2$ and $P=5$ reaches a lower loss than Muon, AdamW, Lion and Signum at the same number of tokens. Under 4-GPU data-parallel training it reaches Muon's final loss with a third less wall-clock on PCIe, and it beats the communication-efficient Muon variants Dion and MuonBP on loss at no more exposed communication, while keeping the exact gradient. Code: this https URL

</details>


### [1481] [When Should a Satellite Estimate Be Changed? Stress-Testing Neural Corrections for Evapotranspiration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35314)
*Marco Trotta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对卫星蒸散发(ET)产品中神经残差校正方法的选择性问题,系统性地测试了"何时应改变卫星估计值"这一核心问题。通过对16,366个通量塔观测值(151个站点,九年滚动评估,五种空间折叠)的评估,发现基于输入支持度的筛选(SupportGain)在干净数据上优势不显著,但在受控天气扰动下显著降低误差,并揭示了一个站点级的严重失败案例。此外,仅使用农田数据训练可降低已测试农田队列的误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星ET产品在边界层和水文应用中至关重要,但机器学习校正可能引入错误——特别是当输入超出训练分布时。研究动机在于验证一个关键问题:选择器(selector)能否可靠判断神经校正是否优于现有OpenET卫星估计,以及在输入失效(如传感器故障、单位错误)时是否能避免灾难性错误。核心挑战在于"预测神经误差"与"预测对OpenET的实际改善"是两件不同的事。

Method: 方法包括:(1)十网络残差集成(每网络1345参数,两层32单元ReLU,预测OpenET到实测ET的残差);(2)七种选择器:Full、Gain(基于梯度提升树预测收益)、Support95(基于k近邻距离)、Spread95(基于集成离散度)、SupportGain(Gain+支持度筛选)、MonoGain(单调约束)、AugmentedGain(加入随机天气故障训练);(3)滚动时序评估(2012-2020年)和空间留出验证;(4)受控天气变换(风速乘数0.447-10、VPD乘10、华氏误读摄氏、温度偏移0-32°C)作为故障注入;(5)物理规则筛选剔除温度、VPD和无效天气值;(6)组自助法(2000次抽样)构建不确定性区间,Holm校正用于多重比较;(7)农田专训对比实验。

Result: 关键结果:(1)站点级失败案例:在manilacotton站,Gain接受了32条物理无效记录,预测平均收益0.83 mm/day,但实际MAE从1.095增至22.681 mm/day(增加21.586),而SupportGain拒绝全部32条,回退OpenET;(2)干净数据上,40项预计划比较均未通过Holm校正(最小p=0.126),SupportGain对Gain的改善仅0.0059 mm/day(95%CI [-0.0069, 0.0186],包含零);(3)受控扰动下显著:风速×3.6时SupportGain降低MAE 0.1478 mm/day(CI [0.0697, 0.2260]),覆盖率仅9.3% vs Gain的51.8%;VPD×10时改善达1.3698 mm/day;华氏误读时0.4899 mm/day;(4)农田专训:在3234条农田测试记录上,农田专训SupportGain MAE 0.788 vs 全站训练0.829 mm/day,改善0.0414 mm/day(CI [0.0085, 0.0788]),九年中有八年支持农田专训。

Conclusion: 研究得出三个主要结论:(1)未能在干净输入上建立支持度筛选相对于学习收益预测的可靠优势——两者差异小且不确定;(2)支持度筛选通过拒绝更多校正在受控天气变换下表现更佳,但不能泛化为自然故障率估计,一个站点的严重失败案例揭示了自信校正可能错失的程度;(3)农田专训在测试农田队列上降低误差,但存在方法选择不确定性(SupportGain的选择基于同一数据集结果)。所有发现的稳健性受限于:滚动年测试重复使用站点、未测试未见站点迁移、土地覆盖标签无法识别灌溉状态、360次神经网络拟合均达到120次迭代限制并报告收敛警告。研究结果不支持关于灌溉响应或预测技能的广泛声明。

Abstract: Neural residuals can improve satellite evapotranspiration (ET) estimates, but selectors must predict when a correction helps and reject unsupported inputs. We evaluate ten-member models on 16,366 flux-tower observations from 151 stations paired with OpenET, across nine rolling years and five spatial folds. At one held-out station, Gain accepted corrections on all 32 physically invalid records: it predicted a mean benefit of 0.83 mm/day, but the corrections increased mean absolute error by 21.6 mm/day versus OpenET. On spatially held-out unit errors, SupportGain reduced station-macro MAE versus Gain by 0.148 mm/day under wind x3.6 (simultaneous 95% interval, 0.070 to 0.226), with 9.3% acceptance versus Gain's 51.8%; on clean inputs, its 0.006 mm/day advantage had an interval that includes zero. These fault analyses are exploratory; none of 40 preplanned temporal comparisons passed Holm correction, while a separate predeclared cropland contrast found 0.041 mm/day lower station-macro MAE with crop-only training (95% interval, 0.009 to 0.079).

</details>


### [1482] [Collaborative Principle Evolution via Evidence Transfer for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35315)
*Yingming Pu,Hongyu Chen,Tao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoEvolve框架，将协作式科学发现建模为并行原则演化分支间的证据传输问题，通过价值门控路由和上下文折扣似然注入实现分支协作，在六个科学发现任务和五个自动研究任务上均显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的科学发现agent在探索庞大假设空间时效率低下，原则演化方法虽加速了探索循环，但顺序执行限制了探索广度并浪费了计算时间。需要一种机制让多个并行分支协作，共享有效证据而不引入冗余或负迁移。

Method: CoEvolve框架通过协调核心(coordination core)实现并行分支间的证据传输：1) Collect-Merge-Score-Route-Inject循环；2) 基于价值信息(VoI)的门控路由机制，校准置信半径控制有害导入；3) 上下文折扣似然注入，权重α由源可信度ρ、上下文匹配度s和复制验证v三因子决定；4) 理论保证包括并行覆盖定理、折扣导入下的集中定理和负迁移控制定理。

Result: 在六个科学发现任务（MBO、NHO、SPO、TMC、AMP、Promoter）上，CoEvolve平均解质量达66.5%，相比单分支PiEvo的57.0%提升显著；在GPT-5.6-Terra骨干上实现1.80倍壁钟加速，0.97倍每token转换率；在五个自动研究任务上成为唯一在所有任务上均超过已发布SOTA锚点的方法，平均改进+16.7% vs PiEvo的+5.8%；消融实验表明折扣机制是核心保护组件（移除导致-19.0 SQ），门控机制控制尾部风险。

Conclusion: CoEvolve将原则演化agent转化为并行科学发现范式，通过严格的证据传输协议（包括价值门控、折扣注入和冗余控制）实现多AI科学家在同问题上的高效协作，确立了证据共享加速并行发现的条件及传输安全保障的必要性，为多智能体科学发现提供了实用框架。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents promise to automate scientific discovery, yet exploring the vast hypothesis space remains costly. Existing principle-evolution methods accelerate this loop, but operate sequentially, which caps exploration breadth and wastes wall-clock time on challenging problems. To address this, we formulate collaborative scientific discovery as evidence transfer between parallel principle-evolution branches. We present COEVOLVE, which realizes this transfer through a coordination core over parallel branches. By integrating value-of-information-gated routing and context-discounted likelihood injection, COEVOLVE enables branches to collaborate through shared measurements while keeping their principle posteriors separate. Across six scientific-discovery tasks under a matched evaluation budget, COEVOLVE attains a mean solution quality of 66.5% versus 57.0% for single-branch principle evolution, with a 1.80x mean wall-clock speedup on the GPT-5.6-Terra backbone; on five auto-research tasks delegated to an autonomous research harness, it is the only arm whose mean stays above the published SOTA anchor on every task. These results establish when evidence sharing accelerates parallel discovery and when transfer safeguards are necessary to limit negative or inert transfers

</details>


### [1483] [Weighting Schedules Govern What and When Score-Based Generative Models Learn from Multimodal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35322)
*Jérémie Klinger,Raphaël Urfin,Giulio Biroli,Marylou Gabrié*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究分数生成模型在多模态数据上训练时，加权调度（weighting schedule）如何决定模型学习数据特征（模态方向、相对权重、模态幅度）的顺序与速率。通过对非平衡和层级高斯混合模型的高维精确分析，作者证明在训练中只有信噪比（SNR）处于"种化时间"（speciation time）尺度附近的噪声水平才能使所有特征被学到，并由此推导出对加权调度设计的指导原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型和流匹配等分数生成模型在采样阶段已有"种化时间"理论刻画模式承诺机制，但训练阶段中加权调度如何决定特征获取的顺序与速率尚缺乏理论解释。本文填补这一空白，旨在建立加权调度与训练动力学之间的精确联系。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 在高维极限下对两类受控高斯混合分布（非平衡双模态𝒟₁和层级四模态𝒟₂）进行分数匹配训练的精确分析；(2) 将积分损失按信噪比Λ(t)分解，分析固定SNR下的梯度流闭合ODE；(3) 引入有效SNR加权w_eff(Λ)统一不同SI框架；(4) 在MNIST、染色MNIST和人类基因组单体型数据上进行实证验证。

Result: 核心结果包括：(1) 在Regime II（高SNR）训练时，所有模态方向以单一、对振幅不敏感的时间尺度同时学到，但相对权重无法学到；(2) 在种化时间（Λ=O(1)）附近训练时，权重与方向联合学习，不同方向以各自的振幅决定的速率层级式获得；(3) 扩散模型的有效加权呈标度自由性，而流匹配则向低SNR倾斜√(d/Λ)倍；(4) 在MNIST染色数据和HGD基因组数据上实证验证了层级特征出现的预测。

Conclusion: 结论指出，将训练目标通过有效SNR加权来解读，可将任意加权调度转化为预测性的设计选择：模型解析哪些特征以及何时解析，取决于该加权相对于种化尺度的质量分布。基于此可设计定制化的加权调度以优先获取目标特征或优化计算预算分配。

Abstract: Score-based generative models generate new samples by integrating a time-dependent drift that carries Gaussian noise onto the target distribution. In practice this drift is modeled by a neural network, trained on a loss integrated over time $t$ with a weighting schedule $w(t)$. Along the backward dynamics, and for multi-modal distributions, trajectories commit to modes of the target within a narrow time window, the \textit{speciation time}. In this work, focusing on high-dimensional data, we decompose the integrated loss into its single-time contributions and analyze each at fixed signal-to-noise ratio $\Lambda(t)$: we show that $\Lambda(t)$ sets the rate at which each feature of a multimodal target - the mode directions and their relative weights - is acquired during training. Crucially, at high $\Lambda(t)$ all mode directions are acquired together, on a single timescale insensitive to their amplitudes, while the relative weights are not learned at all. Only near the speciation time, where $\Lambda(t)$ becomes of order one, do all features become learnable, each on its own timescale: the weights are acquired jointly with the directions, and the directions at rates set by their relative amplitudes. For models trained on time-integrated objectives, the learning dynamics is then governed by how much of the weighting effectively sits near the speciation time, which provides insights on $w(t)$ design choices. These results follow from an exact high-dimensional analysis of the training dynamics of unbalanced and hierarchical Gaussian mixtures. Numerical experiments on image and human genome haplotype generation recover the predicted hierarchy of learning timescales in more complex settings.

</details>


### [1484] [Scalable In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Recurrent Algorithm Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35333)
*Yuanqing Ma,Zhenrui Zheng,Chenjun Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出循环算法蒸馏（RAD），通过双 Transformer 架构将扩展交互历史压缩为固定大小的潜在记忆，从而以较小的上下文窗口实现与标准算法蒸馏（AD）相当的长视域上下文强化学习（ICRL）性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准算法蒸馏（AD）需要在 Transformer 的上下文窗口中容纳足够多的跨回合学习历史才能内化"改进算子"，但 Transformer 的二次复杂度导致长上下文带来难以承受的内存和计算开销，而简单地截断历史又会丢失对长视域任务至关重要的远端信息。

Method: RAD 采用双 Transformer 架构：(1) 压缩 Transformer 基于 C3 上下文级联压缩机制，将工作记忆和已有长期潜在记忆压缩为固定数量的潜在令牌；(2) AD Transformer 以自回归方式基于长期记忆 z 与最近工作记忆 x 的混合上下文生成动作。当工作记忆填满时，循环地用压缩 Transformer 生成候选潜在令牌，并通过 GRU 风格的门控更新（更新门 U_φ）将其与旧潜在记忆融合，形成新的长期记忆。该过程将有效历史长度与计算复杂度解耦。训练分两阶段：先对压缩 Transformer 进行重建预训练，再联合优化策略、压缩器和门控以进行动作蒸馏；采用课程学习逐步增加压缩次数，并对反向传播的压缩轮数加以截断。

Result: 在 Delayed-Bandit、Darkroom、Dark Key-to-Door 与 Meta-World 等离散与连续环境上的实验表明，RAD 以显著更短的上下文窗口达到了与 AD 相当或更优的渐近性能，并且推理 FLOPs 在多数环境下减少 80% 以上。在 Delayed-Bandit 上 RAD 还能泛化到训练时未见的更长延迟，而 AD-long 出现明显退化。消融实验表明 GRU 门控优于替换、残差和乘性更新，确定性自编码器压缩器优于 VAE 与 VQ-VAE。

Conclusion: RAD 通过递归压缩将长交互历史整合到固定大小的潜在记忆中，为长视域上下文强化学习提供了一种可扩展的解决方案；主要局限在于训练稳定性——跨时间的反向传播增加了优化难度，未来可探索更稳定的训练目标和替代的记忆更新机制。

Abstract: Algorithm Distillation (AD) has demonstrated the remarkable ability of Transformers to perform in-context reinforcement learning without explicit weight updates. However, capturing long-term learning progress necessitates expansive context windows, which incur prohibitive memory costs and limit scalability in complex, long-horizon tasks. To address this bottleneck, we propose Recurrent Algorithm Distillation (RAD). RAD employs a dual-component architecture: a Compression Transformer that distills extended interaction histories into compact latent tokens, and an AD Transformer that auto-regressively generates actions using a hybrid context of these compressed memories and recent transitions. By maintaining a fixed-size latent buffer, RAD decouples the effective history length from computational complexity, functionally providing the model with a long-horizon memory. Empirical evaluations across diverse environments demonstrate that RAD matches the asymptotic performance of standard AD with significantly reduced context window sizes, offering a scalable solution for efficient in-context decision-making.

</details>


### [1485] [NeuronDiscover: Agent-in-Twin for Mechanistic Discovery in Neuronal Microenvironments with World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35338)
*Haowei Xu,Wanyi Fu,Hongbin Han,Zhaoheng Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuronDiscover 提出了一种 Agent-in-Twin 框架，通过机制驱动的世界动作模型（WAM）和 MIOY 图修订机制，在神经微环境中实现区分物理机制与孪生模型误差（Twin confounding）的机械发现。在 32 个独立源单元、16 次实验预算下，每分配世界解析 4.0 个关系（强基线 3.4，固定图 3.2），假支持 5%，范围准确率 82%，并将接受程序失败率从 15% 降至 9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经微环境中的溶质传输机制（扩散、流、边界交换）产生相似观测签名，且预测准确性无法区分真实机制变化与计算孪生误差。作者形式化这一"孪生混淆"问题，指出物理机制改变与孪生模型误差在稀疏观测中留下相同痕迹，需要通过联合机制-差异信念设计实验来分离二者。

Method: 框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 机制驱动的世界动作模型（WAM），通过耦合物理动力学与类型化掩码扩散，统一前向、反向和传感查询；(2) Agent 维护联合机制-差异-状态-干扰信念，通过 MIOY 图（机制-干预-观测-结果）扩展关系词汇，冻结选择后释放结果修订图；(3) 基于协方差缩放局部灵敏度等理论指导的自适应实验设计。理论保证包括命题 1（局部机制-WAM 可识别性）、命题 2（采集稳定性）、命题 6（冻结后有效性）、定理 1（同步差异调整可达性）和推论 1（端到端可问责性），其中事件校准半径 δ_a 由两采样 Hoeffding 界控制。算法 1 形式化了完整闭环。

Result: 在 32 个独立源单元（运输环境）和 32 个供体不相交 Allen 神经元记录上评估，匹配 16 次实验预算：Agent-in-Twin 解析 4.0 关系/世界（强基线 3.4，固定图 3.2；+0.80，95% CI [+0.57, +1.03]，p<0.001），假支持 5%，范围准确率 82%；联合机制-差异EIG 在非线性差异条件下解析 3.8 关系（vs 插件 EIG 2.9，+0.90，p<0.001）；差异调整验证将接受程序失败率从 15% 降至 9%（60% 接受覆盖）；神经元迁移 1.94 vs 固定图 1.53 关系/世界。删除 MIOY 图任一组件（类型化、范围、原样保留）均显著增加假支持（5.0%→13.5%、9.5%、7.5%）。FNO 虽达到最佳确定性前向误差，但在状态宏 F1 上仍落后机制驱动混合 WAM 0.10。

Conclusion: 神经微环境中的机械发现应被视为针对不确定孪生模型的序列实验设计：联合机制-差异信念和可修订的 MIOY 图是恢复遗漏关系的关键，而非更强的前向预测器。类型化、可修订的假设使 Agent 能区分物理机制与读出差异，避免将传感器误差错误归因于机制。正确性在声明的模型世界和档案记录内裁定，与仪器配对是下一步工作。

Abstract: Mechanistic discovery in neuronal microenvironments requires interventions and measurements that separate competing explanations of solute transport and neuronal response. Predictive accuracy cannot settle the question: a real mechanistic change and an error in the computational twin leave the same signature in sparse observations. We formalize this twin confounding and reason over a joint mechanism--discrepancy belief, designing experiments that separate the two. NeuronDiscover is an Agent-in-Twin framework whose shared, mechanism-grounded World Action Model (WAM) couples prediction, intervention proposals, and observation design; independently adjudicated outcomes revise a scoped Mechanism--Intervention--Observation--Outcome (MIOY) graph, whose supported relations compile into executable programs carrying discrepancy-adjusted acceptance bounds. We evaluate on simulated brain-fluid tracer-transport worlds adjudicated by an independently frozen finer-mesh reference solver, and on donor-disjoint public current-clamp recordings of cortical neurons. Counting only relations that reach a certified terminal status, and scoring abstentions as unresolved for every method, at a matched budget of 16 experiments over 32 source units NeuronDiscover resolves 4.0 relations per assigned world against 3.4 for the strongest baseline and 3.2 without graph revision, at 5% false support and 82% scope accuracy. Joint mechanism--discrepancy acquisition resolves 3.8 relations versus 2.9 for plug-in expected information gain; discrepancy-adjusted verification lowers accepted-program failure from 15% to 9% at 60% acceptance coverage; and transfer to the recordings yields 1.94 versus 1.53 relations per assigned world. Correctness is adjudicated within declared model worlds and archival recordings.

</details>


### [1486] [Beyond Teacher Assignment: Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35347)
*Xin Li,Hao Jiang,Xin Gao,Annan Wang,Yuchen Xie,Jinghao Guo,Xingwei Qu,Yichi Zhang,Chau Yuen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 DN-MOPD（Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation），在多教师在线策略蒸馏中按域反馈的离散度对各域优势进行缩放，解决指令跟随域反馈因方差过大而压制数学能力传递的问题，在 Qwen3.5 三种规模上一致超越标签路由 MOPD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）通过路由让领域专家监督对应域的提示，但路由仅决定"由谁教"，无法控制"教得多强"。经验上发现 MOPD 学生无法超越最优单教师学生，且数学专家的能力几乎未被传递，原因是各域教师-学生对数比的离散度严重不平衡——指令跟随（IF）反馈的离散度是数学的数倍，导致 IF 梯度在初始 4B 学生中占据 94% 的组合梯度。

Method: DN-MOPD 保留 MOPD 的标签路由机制，仅在每次更新时增加一步操作：计算每个域内教师-学生对数比的总体标准差 σ_d，以及跨域池化的 σ_all，然后为每个域计算有界缩放因子 w_d = clip(σ_all/σ_d, 0.25, 4)，对各域蒸馏优势进行缩放。该因子保持优势符号不变，IF 因离散度过大而被衰减，数学因离散度过小而被放大，代码大致保持不变。不引入额外的教师调用、学习路由器或损失改动。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-9B/4B/2B 三种规模、6 个公开基准（AIME25/26、LiveCodeBench v5/v6、IFEval、IFBench）上，DN-MOPD 在所有规模和两种评估预算（8K、16K token）下均优于标签路由 MOPD，六任务平均提升 1.17–3.08 个百分点，三个随机种子的配对区间均大于零。数学域提升最显著，在 8K 评估下恢复了 Label 丢失的 61–90% 的数学专家增益。控制实验表明增益主要来自降低 IF 反馈而非单纯放大数学反馈；在 9B 和 4B 上，使用训练前一次性测量的固定权重即可复现增益，2B 上则需每批次重估。

Conclusion: 整合 RL 训练的领域专家不仅需要决定"由哪个教师教"，还需校准"其反馈占比多少"。DN-MOPD 通过按反馈离散度缩放各域优势，仅以极小的实现改动一致地改进了多教师在线策略蒸馏，但该方法的收益依赖于具体的教师-学生配置，在某些早期 Qwen3-4B 配置中未观察到明显增益。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning can turn one language model into several specialists, each excellent at a single skill such as mathematics, coding or following instructions, but users need one model with all of these skills. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) merges them by letting the specialists teach one student: the student answers each prompt, and the specialist for that prompt's domain gives feedback on every token. This routing decides which specialist teaches, but not how strongly its feedback moves the shared student. In Qwen3.5 models at three sizes, we find that MOPD's student does not beat one taught by the best single specialist and gains little of the mathematics specialist's advantage. The feedback is unbalanced: instruction-following feedback is several times more spread out than mathematics feedback and dominates the student's updates. We propose Domain-Normalized MOPD (DN-MOPD), which keeps the routing and rescales each domain's feedback by its measured spread. On six public benchmarks, DN-MOPD improves the average score over MOPD at every size, across three random seeds and under two answer-length limits, and recovers most of the lost mathematics gain. Controls with fixed domain weights show that the gain comes mainly from turning down instruction-following feedback rather than turning up mathematics alone, and that fixed weights close to those DN-MOPD measures perform comparably. Combining specialists therefore requires deciding not only which one teaches, but also how strongly its feedback counts.

</details>


### [1487] [Quasi Linear Kernel Attention with Infinite Capacity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35349)
*Nicolaj Rux,Johannes Hertrich,Sebastian Neumayer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对Transformer中softmax注意力的二次复杂度瓶颈，提出了一种新型核注意力框架。核心贡献是定义"容量"（capacity）作为核表达力的严格度量指标，证明softmax、Gauss、Laplace等平稳$\mathcal{C}_0$核具有无限容量，而有限特征映射（FFM）核的容量受限于特征维度$L$。为实现准线性注意力下的无限容量，作者提出由单变量spline核和多项式指数核构造的加性核（additive kernels），并证明加性bump核和加性Laplace核同时具备无限容量和通过排序算法实现的准线性计算复杂度。文章提供了高效的CUDA实现，在序列长度$N \geq 2048$时性能优于PyTorch fp32 softmax注意力，在$N \geq 20000$时接近FlashAttention，并在文本嵌入和视觉Transformer蒸馏实验中验证了所提方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer的softmax注意力机制计算复杂度为$\mathcal{O}(N^2)$，已成为处理长序列的主要瓶颈。现有线性注意力方法（基于有限特征映射FFM）虽能实现线性复杂度，但表达能力有限。准线性核（如Laplace核）虽具有更好的表达能力，但要么局限于低维（如$D \leq 6$），要么缺乏严格的表达能力度量。因此，需要一个严格的可计算性vs表达力trade-off分析框架，以及同时满足高表达力和准线性计算两个要求的核构造方法。

Method: 1. **容量定义**：为每个核$\Phi$定义capacity，测量注意力矩阵能近似单位矩阵的最大序列长度$N$。等价于衡量注意力机制能区分的token数量上限。2. **理论分析**：证明平稳$\mathcal{C}_0$核（Gauss、Laplace等）具有无限容量；基于FFM的核容量上界为$\dim(\mathcal{H}_\Phi) \leq L$；Riesz核虽有无限维RKHS但capacity仅为2。3. **加性核构造**：提出形如$\Phi(q,k) = \sum_{d=1}^D \phi(q_d, k_d)$的核，将高维问题分解为单变量子问题。4. **排序算法**：对单变量Laplace核$\exp(-|s-t|)$和bump核$\max(0, 1-|s-t|)$，利用prefix sum和排序在$\mathcal{O}((N+M)(\log N + C))$时间内计算kernel sum。5. **CUDA实现**：通过单次扫描排序后的键、在线计算prefix sums，避免物化大型中间张量，实现高并行和低内存占用。

Result: 1. **容量验证**：关联召回实验证实FFM核在$N > L$时失败（如relu在N=6失败），而加性bump和Laplace核在测试范围内（$N \leq 600$）成功。2. **速度基准**（RTX 5090，fp32）：$N = 2048$时FUSED实现超过PyTorch MEM_EFF32；$N = 131072$时GLOBAL比MEM_EFF32快约31×；前向+反向在$N = 16384$时即超过FlashAttention。3. **文本嵌入蒸馏**：在nomic-embed-text-v1上的MTEB和LoCo评估中，add_laplace和add_bump核保留了教师模型大部分性能，在长序列（$N = 8192$）下显著优于FFM核。4. **视觉Transformer**（CIFAR-10）：所有核经过蒸馏后都能达到softmax 96.57%的96%以上准确率。

Conclusion: 本文建立了核注意力表达力的严格理论框架，通过"容量"指标明确了FFM核的固有局限性，并证明了加性核能够同时实现无限容量和准线性计算复杂度。所提出的add_laplace和add_bump核配合CUDA实现在长序列场景下显著优于现有softmax后端，是替代二次复杂度注意力的有效方案。未来工作包括fp16实现、因果注意力扩展，以及在大规模基准上的进一步验证。

Abstract: The evaluation cost of transformers with softmax attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Kernel attention addresses this by replacing softmax with a more general kernel function. In this paper, we aim to identify kernels that retain the expressivity of attention while enabling quasi linear computation. To quantify expressivity, we introduce a capacity for each kernel, measuring the maximum sequence length for which the attention matrix can approximate the identity. A higher capacity thus indicates greater expressivity. We show that expressive kernels like softmax, Gauss, and Laplace have infinite capacity. In contrast, common quasi linear kernels, such as those derived from finite dimensional feature maps, exhibit finite capacity. As a solution, we propose additive kernels constructed from univariate spline and polynomial exponential kernels. We prove that these maintain infinite capacity while allowing quasi linear computation via sorting. Finally, we implement additive sorting kernels efficiently and benchmark them against modern softmax backends, demonstrating advantages for long sequences.

</details>


### [1488] [Interference Beyond Geometry in Concept Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35351)
*Valérie Costa,Bahareh Tolooshams*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了将"干扰"仅视为学习特征间几何重叠的通行观点，提出"有效干扰"概念，将其定义为特征几何与编码统计的联合属性，并通过理论分析与稀疏自编码器实验揭示架构约束如何通过四种机制塑造干扰结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献普遍将叠加假设下的干扰度量视为纯几何量（如余弦相似度、互相关性），但这无法解释稀疏或弱相关编码的特征之间干扰很小、相关概念可建设性利用重叠等现象。需要一个同时考虑特征几何与编码使用方式（即编码统计）的干扰度量框架。

Method: 1. 定义有效干扰 I_ij = (d_i^T d_j) E[z_i z_j]，并将其分解为 I_ij = ρ_ij · π_ij · M_ij（取向、共激活频率、条件幅度）。2. 在固定支持条件下推导出编码器一致性恒等式（自响应失配、传入串扰、偏置补偿、残差耦合四项平衡）。3. 推导出局部正交化命题（Proposition 4.3）。4. 识别四种架构调节机制：约束性局部正交化、条件偏置补偿、编码器增益适应、编码器-解码器对偶分离。5. 使用 TopK、BatchTopK、JumpReLU、Matryoshka 四种 SAE 在 Pythia-160M 第 8 层激活上进行控制实验，并在 MNIST 和 SAEBench 预训练 SAE 上验证泛化性。

Result: 1. 全局几何重叠在训练中上升，但有效干扰从峰值下降，说明稀疏自编码器选择性正交化共激活特征对，而非全局正交化。2. 偏置预测 b̂_i 与学到的 b_i 高度吻合（Pearson 相关显著），证实偏置补偿机制。3. 编码器增益预测 α̂_i 与学到的 α_i 吻合，正均值传入串扰预测 α_i < 1。4. 解绑设置下，高 π_ij·M_ij 的特征对偏向正 ρ_ij（建设性解码器交互），同时编码器-解码器交叉增益 α_iγ_ij 集中在零附近，实现重建与推理分离。5. 建设性 I_+ 和破坏性 I_- 可相互抵消，小净干扰值并不意味着弱交互；解绑设置产生最大建设性贡献，约占重建能量的 40-50%。6. MNIST 和 SAEBench 独立训练 SAE 上均观察到相同模式。

Conclusion: 干扰不是特征几何的独立属性，而是几何与编码共激活方式的联合属性。SAE 架构通过四种非互斥机制调节干扰结构：受约束编码器倾向于正交化共激活特征，而偏置、增益和编码器自由度允许建设性跨特征贡献保留。这些结果为理解架构选择如何影响学习表示中实现的交互提供了框架，无需预设单一干扰方案为普遍最优。局限：理论局部于固定支持；有效干扰衡量能量分配而非表示质量；正交化命题限于双激活特征和支持保持的小梯度步长。

Abstract: Interference is commonly treated as geometric overlap between learned features. We introduce effective interference, which combines feature geometry and code statistics to capture realized interactions, distinguishing constructive from destructive interference and frequent weak interactions from rare strong ones. Under local fixed-support assumptions, we characterize how architectural constraints shape interference through four mechanisms: feature orthogonalization, bias compensation, gain adaptation, and encoder-decoder separation. Experiments with sparse autoencoders show that constrained architectures selectively reduce overlap among co-active features, while bias, gain, and encoder freedom allow constructive cross-contributions to remain. Together, these results show that interference in learned representations depends not only on feature geometry, but also on how features are used and on the architecture that produces their codes.

</details>


### [1489] [Fiona: Accelerating FHE Inference with Packing-Aware Ternary Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35352)
*Yiteng Peng,Zhibo Liu,Dongwei Xiao,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FIONA，一个离线优化器，通过打包感知的混合权重三值化（ternarization）在不修改现有FHE打包布局的前提下减少FHE推理中的明文-密文乘法（PMult）数量，并结合低阶多项式优化，在保持精度的同时显著加速加密神经网络推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全同态加密（FHE）推理比明文推理慢数个数量级，其中服务器将明文权重应用于加密激活所涉及的明文-密文乘法（PMult）占据了近期系统中超过一半的推理时间。虽然三值量化（ternary quantization）可将PMult替换为加法和减法，但在打包执行下收益难以实现——单个PMult作用于打包布局固定的权重组，只有当组内所有权重共享相同三值时才能避免乘法。而将所有组全部三值化会大幅降低模型精度。因此需要在给定打包布局下，选择性地对部分权重组进行三值化以平衡效率与精度。

Method: FIONA是一个离线优化器，包含四个阶段：(1) 打包感知的混合权重路由（Hybrid Weight Routing）：基于任务敏感性（task sensitivity，用经验Fisher对角线估计损失曲率）评估每个执行组三值化对任务损失的影响，训练时通过敏感度加权的一致性损失（homogeneity loss）推动每个组趋向共享三值，并保留敏感组的全精度权重；(2) 精确编译（Exact Compilation）：对混合线性算子进行三种代数等价改写——将重建因子（reconstruction factors）一次性应用于累积的符号和、跨输出共享相同符号和、在rescaling前合并符号与原始路径结果；(3) 路由后多项式优化：在累积精度预算约束下，拟合和替换下游多项式为更低阶版本，减少乘法深度和自举（bootstrapping）次数；(4) 公共常量折叠与计划导出。

Result: 在VGG11（CIFAR-10）、ViT-S/16（Tiny-ImageNet）和BERT-base（SST-2）上的实验表明：FIONA将PMult操作减少53.4%-79.5%，自举操作减少37.0%-57.1%，端到端加密推理分别加速2.38×、1.68×和1.84×，且所有三个模型的精度损失均小于1%。权重三值化还使多项式输入范围收窄，使多项式总CMult深度在ViT和BERT上分别降低54.07%和49.80%。精确编译为各模型线性层贡献1.44×-1.60×的额外加速。

Conclusion: FIONA通过在固定打包布局下进行敏感性感知的混合权重三值化与精确编译，显著降低了FHE推理的计算开销，同时利用权重变化带来的多项式输入范围收窄机会进一步降低乘法深度。该方法与现有打包方案正交，可直接嵌入现有FHE-DL系统，在保持精度的同时获得显著加速。

Abstract: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables neural network inference directly on encrypted inputs, but it remains orders of magnitude slower than plaintext in- ference. Applying the server's plaintext weights to encrypted activations involves plaintext-ciphertext multiplications (PMult) and accounts for more than half of inference time in recent systems. Ternary quantization can replace these multipli- cations with additions and subtractions, but the savings rarely materialize under packed execution. A single PMult applies a weight group fixed by the packing layout and can be avoided only when all its weights share the same ternary value. Ternarizing all groups, however, largely degrades accuracy. We present FIONA, an offline optimizer that selectively ternarizes weights within a given packing layout based on the estimated effect of ternary conversion on the model's performance. FIONA encourages a shared ternary value within each weight group and retains full-precision weights for sensitive groups, so ternar- ized and full-precision paths coexist within a layer. It then compiles these hybrid operators exactly, applying common scaling factors once to accumulated inputs and reusing sums across outputs. Weight ternarization can also narrow the input ranges of downstream polynomials. FIONA fits lower-degree replacements under a cumulative accuracy budget, reducing multiplicative depth and bootstrapping. On VGG11, ViT, and BERT, FIONA reduces PMult operations by 53.4-79.5% and accelerates end-to-end encrypted inference by 2.38x, 1.68x, and 1.84x, re- spectively, with less than 1% accuracy loss across all three models.

</details>


### [1490] [First Learn, Then Memorize: The Spectral Bias of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35377)
*Raphaël Urfin,Tony Bonnaire,Giulio Biroli,Marc Mézard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示扩散模型训练中"先泛化、后记忆"两阶段分离的机制：神经正切核(NTK)Gram矩阵的谱分裂为一个大特征值的"泛化块"和一个小特征值的"记忆块"(由同一干净样本的m次重复加噪产生),两者间存在随训练集大小n增长的谱隙,从而在训练时间上产生 τ_mem/τ_gen ∼ n/d 的分离。在懒学习(lazy regime)高维极限下,通过复制方法严格求解谱分布,获得偏差-方差分解的闭式方程,并在CelebA上用卷积NTK和有限宽度U-Net实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在有限数据集上训练时,先学习泛化能力生成新样本,随后才记忆训练集,这一时间尺度分离现象缺乏机制性解释。本文旨在找到支配这一分离的核心数学对象——谱。

Method: 在懒学习高维极限下(n,d→∞),对内积核Gram矩阵G^να,μβ = f(Y^να⊤Y^μβ/d)进行线性等价化简为G_lin = μ_I I_N + μ_B B_m + μ_0 1_N1_N⊤ + μ_1 Y⊤Y/d;用复制方法(replica method)求Stieltjes变换q(z)的自洽方程;分别在m=1和m=O(1)下求解两段谱结构;推导核岭回归的偏差-方差闭式方程;在CelebA上用闭式卷积NTK和有限宽度U-Net实验验证,包括截断秩与L2正则化两个因果干预。

Result: 理论上证明Gram矩阵谱分为四个部分:两个原子(权重1/m和(m-1-1/ψn)/m)、Θ(nm/d)的"泛化"块(特征向量u_1^να ∝ v_λ⊤Y^να)、Θ(m)的"记忆"块(特征向量u_2^να涉及样本特异性噪声方向,仅在m>1时出现),谱隙导致τ_mem/τ_gen ∼ ψn;偏差-方差方程显示记忆块导致Θ(1)的不可约偏差,最优正则下消失;CelebA卷积NTK与U-Net均呈现两段结构,截断秩r控制泛化-记忆过渡,针对记忆块的L2正则完全抑制f_mem=0且不损测试损失。

Conclusion: Gram矩阵谱的两段结构是扩散模型"先泛化、后记忆"的精确机制,记忆块由DSM损失中每样本m次加噪产生,在一般梯度下降(超出懒学习)下依然存在并可通过谱操作因果控制。

Abstract: Diffusion models trained on a finite dataset first learn to generate novel, high-quality samples and only much later collapse onto their training set. We identify the mechanism behind this separation of timescales and the object that probes it. The training dynamics of the score function are governed---exactly, and at any width---by the Gram matrix of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evaluated on the noisy training data, so the timescales of generalization and of memorization must be encoded in its spectrum. We show that they are, and that the structure responsible has no analogue in standard kernel settings. The use of multiple noise realizations per sample ($m$ noised copies at a fixed noise level) in the score-matching loss is what restructures the Gram matrix spectrum into two distinct parts. The first, of large eigenvalues, carries the global features of the target distribution and is present already for $m=1$. The second, which the repeated noising creates, consists of the smallest eigenvalues and is supported on eigenvectors aligned with the sample-specific noise directions; it sets a memorization timescale parametrically larger in the training set size $n$. We establish this picture on two fronts. Analytically, we solve the spectrum in the lazy high-dimensional limit for both linear ($n \asymp d$) and polynomial ($n \asymp d^k$) sample complexities, and prove through a bias--variance decomposition that the first bulk minimizes the approximation error while the second drives the error associated with memorization. Empirically, we show the same two-bulk structure in Convolutional NTKs on CelebA and in finite-width U-Nets trained well beyond the lazy regime, and we make the link causal: truncating the Gram matrix at rank $r$ tunes the generalization--memorization transition, and an $L_2$ penalty targeting the second bulk suppresses memorization in feature-learning U-Nets.

</details>


### [1491] [Identifying Neural Source Dynamics from Unknown Local Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35379)
*Ayana Mussabayeva,Jiaqi Sun,Anuar Aimoldin,Olivier Oullier,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种从EEG记录中识别大脑源动力学的理论框架，利用未知的局部机制变化（干预）来补充基线实验中缺失的信息，突破了传统系统实现理论对完全可达性的要求。论文建立了构造性识别定理、直接对比度重建估计器，并在MRI衍生的解剖结构模拟EEG上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG记录的是脑源活动的混合信号，即使已知前向模型（导联场），当实验仅激发部分源状态空间时，动力学仍然存在不可辨识性——因为更多重复无法解决这一模糊性。扰动神经科学虽然表明局部干预可以改变回路响应从而暴露新方向，但在EEG中干预效果在传感器间混合，且干预本身（目标源和强度）通常未知。论文旨在回答：未知的局部机制变化能否在基线均值响应无法触及的方向上揭示源动力学，并在解剖坐标中识别它们，即使干预目标和系数未知？

Method: 方法包括三个核心组成部分：(1) 构造性识别定理（定理1/定理4）：对于固定解剖源上的线性动力学z_{τ+1}=(F+D_e)z_τ，已知初始化模式K和导联场L，未知的单次转换接收行变化D_e=e_{j_e}v_e^⊤产生秩一、源特定的签名ΔH_e=H^[e]-H_+=O_T e_{j_e}(v_e^⊤R_s)，通过减去匹配基线响应可分离该签名，导联场识别源并校准响应；(3) 锚定矩阵Ω=[K, E_J]结合校准历史和初始化响应，在秩条件rank(Ω)=q（源覆盖）和rank(O_-)=q（时间可观测性）下恢复完整观测矩阵O_T和转移矩阵F=O_-^†O_+。直接估计器（算法1）使用SVD提取主导左奇异向量，通过第一传感器块与导联场列匹配识别源标签并校准历史。条件稳定性界（命题2）分离了覆盖条件σ_min(Ω)和最弱时间可观测响应β=σ_min(O_-)。

Result: 主要实验结果包括：(1) 不可达基线恢复中，4/12 个MRFI源坐标可达基线，8个未知变化在18,332个试次等价上以32/32恢复全部12源动力学（e_f=3.24%，e_z=3.97%），而基线实现（Spectral-local）失败（0/32），具有逆导联场的基线回归（OLS/ridge-gcv）也失败（0/32），显式构造的替代动力学复制了每个基线均值；(2) 匹配信息恢复中，直接重建在155/160案例中成功，Spectral-local为141/160，p95估计区间增量为+8.75百分点（95% CI [3.125, 15.0]）；(3) 直接重建作为EM初始化的期望最大化能在所有32个拟合中收敛并优于非直接启动；(5) 局限包括：非局部变化在0.1系数比下将成功率降至65-69/80，前向模型误标（颅骨电导率从0.003到0.012 S/m）即使源标签完全正确仍产生11-27%的动力学误差。

Conclusion: 论文证明了未知局部机制变化可揭示受控基线均值采集无法触及的源动力学，其核心洞见在于识别解剖校准的源响应历史而非干预的每个系数，结合已知初始化响应后可在解剖定义的源之间恢复有向交互，超越基线可达性。实验将这种信息增益与估计器分离：部分激发系统可在基线实现、可逆读出和未暴露变化都失败的情况下被识别；当代信息充分时，直接重建是更可靠的路线并能初始化似然拟合。压力测试说明了保证的代价：噪声、非局部变化和前向模型误差都会降低恢复精度，即使源标签正确，因此标签和历史必须分开验证。这些发现推动了控制神经回路实验中映射交互的研究，但生物转化需要校准的观测和初始化模型以及对单行、单转换机制的修改协议的验证。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) records mixtures of brain-source activity. Even with a known anatomical forward model, experiments that excite only part of the source-state space leave the dynamics unidentified, and repetition cannot resolve the ambiguity. We show that unknown local mechanism changes can supply the missing information. We consider linear dynamics among fixed anatomical sources with known source-state initialization patterns. Changing one source's update rule for one transition leaves a rank-one, source-specific signature in subsequent EEG: subtracting matched baseline responses isolates it, and the forward model identifies the source and calibrates its response history. Combining these histories with initialization responses recovers source interactions without baseline reachability and without first identifying the intervention coefficients. We establish sufficient recovery conditions, a direct estimator, and a noise-sensitivity bound conditional on correct source labels. Simulated EEG on anatomy derived from magnetic resonance imaging confirms the information gain: with baseline excitation confined to four of twelve source coordinates, eight unknown changes recover all dynamics in 32/32 systems, whereas baseline realization, baseline regression through an invertible forward model, and changes that leave the tested states unexposed all fail, and explicitly constructed alternative dynamics reproduce every baseline mean. Where baseline information suffices, direct reconstruction is also more reliable than a matched-information spectral estimator. Nonlocal changes and forward-model error limit accuracy even when source labels are correct.

</details>


### [1492] [Inductive Feedback for Mixed-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35390)
*Amir Moeini,Huaijiang Zhu,Daniel Havir,Shangtong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于归纳反馈的混合策略蒸馏方法，用于语言模型的后训练。该方法通过概率确认框架隔离反馈信息，并使用共享rollout估计器学习未被学生rollout利用的指导内容，在多个知识型和代理型基准测试中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在缺乏可靠程序化验证器时，基于语言模型评判器的语言反馈可提供丰富的监督信号。现有的在策略蒸馏（OPD）方法存在两个问题：会传递反馈未涉及的教师偏好，且未充分利用反馈中的指导信息。这源于标准OPD目标使用的散度和目标分布。

Method: 方法包含两个核心组件：1）使用概率确认框架（Crupi and Tentori, 2013）将语言反馈视为关于下一个token假设的证据，基于教师反馈前后的预测计算确认分数（相对距离），在学生分布的信任域内构建修正目标；2）推导共享rollout估计器，估计学生与目标之间的对称Jeffreys散度，通过重要性加权在两个方向上重用学生和教师rollout，提供有界的重要性权重和方差保证。

Result: 在Trivia Fantasy、EmbodiedEval、SciKnowEval（L3）和ToolAlpaca四个基准测试上，所提方法在所有任务上均取得了最高平均得分。在Trivia Fantasy上准确率从基础模型的2.8%提升至98.3%，显著优于SDPO（61.0%）和W2S-OPD（41.7%）。在EmbodiedEval上将平均任务失败率降低了约三分之一。在SciKnowEval化学和物理上分别超过强基线14.3和12.0个百分点。消融实验验证了rollout分配（λ=3/4）和重加权强度（β=10）的有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法通过将语言反馈解释为证据并构建确认分数排序的修正目标，成功隔离了反馈传达的信息；同时通过共享rollout估计器充分利用了反馈的规范性内容。理论分析提供了重要性权重的有界性和梯度方差的上界，实验结果验证了在知识获取、具身规划和工具使用等多种任务上的有效性。

Abstract: Verbal feedback can identify errors and prescribe corrections, providing rich supervision for language-model post-training even when reliable programmatic verifiers are unavailable. Such feedback, often generated by a capable model, can be used to condition the teacher in on-policy distillation, which trains the student to match the teacher's predictions on student-generated rollouts. However, this approach can transfer teacher preferences that the feedback did not motivate, while leaving much of the feedback's guidance unused. We find that both problems come from the standard on-policy distillation objective, specifically the divergence it minimizes and the distribution it uses as its target. Our proposed method addresses both limitations. First, to isolate the information conveyed by the feedback from the teacher's inherent preferences, we treat verbal feedback as evidence for or against the hypothesis that a particular token comes next at a given prefix. We then adopt a probabilistic confirmation framework which uniquely determines an ordering over the vocabulary based on the teacher's predictions before and after it receives feedback. Using a confirmation score consistent with this ordering, we construct a target distribution within a trust region of the student. Second, to learn from guidance that student rollouts can leave unused, we derive a simple shared-rollout estimator of a symmetric divergence between the student and target distributions over rollouts, reusing student and feedback-conditioned teacher rollouts in both directions through importance weighting. Empirical evaluations show that our method outperforms the common on-policy distillation recipe and a recent contrastive variant on knowledge-based and agentic benchmarks.

</details>


### [1493] [Persistent Partners Raise Prices Among Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35402)
*Paul-Peter Arslan,Yubin Kim,Xiao Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一项预注册的随机实验研究，在Calvano等人的Bertrand双寡头模型中检验"平台决定的交易对手匹配"是否影响算法定价代理的学习价格水平与执行机制。核心发现是：保持固定交易对手使利润水平提高0.27（占竞争利润到垄断利润差距的比例，95% CI [0.20, 0.35]），但未发现可靠的"学习到的惩罚"证据。在竞争对手价格不可观察（无法实施报复）的条件下，价格仍会上涨，这对依赖惩罚模式的反垄断审计方法构成挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着算法定价（含LLM代理）的普及，平台控制交易对手匹配的机制可能影响价格水平和协调证据的存在形式。当前文献固定"谁与谁交易"这一变量，但未对其进行因果检验，且传统"强制偏离探测"将静态最优反应误读为报复行为。

Method: 采用Calvano等人的校准Bertrand差异化产品双寡头模型，混合代理（Qwen2.5-0.5B语言骨架+4×4表格Q学习价值模块）通过策略梯度训练。三因素随机设计：(1)固定vs.随机重配对手，(2)对手价格可见vs.隐藏，(3)有无自由文本通信通道。8条件×5种子块=40次运行。注册主要假设H1检验利润水平，H6检验"净强制偏离响应"（扣除静态最优反应后的报复度量），使用随机推断检验。在25个额外块上用纯表格学习器复制，并探索性扩展至Qwen2.5 7B/14B、Mistral、OLMo等无训练提示模型。

Result: 注册结果：H1（水平）被拒绝且"实质显著"，C_Δ=+0.274 [0.195, 0.350]，20个配对运行全部为正，纯表格学习器在25个复制块全部复制；H6（执行/报复）不具结论性，注册效力约0.5。事后分析中，隐藏对手条件下水平差异+0.295且持续到训练结束（+0.52），但静态最优反应解释了强制偏离探测读数的1/3至1/2。探索性扩展：Qwen2.5 7B/14B在隐藏对手条件下显示效应，Mistral和OLMo显示精确零效应。机制证据部分与"自发耦合"假设一致（两个保持相遇的学习者的价值估计同步漂移）。

Conclusion: 平台层面的交易对手持久性是这些学习代理价格水平的杠杆，且在对手不可观察（从而无法报复）时影响最持久。仅寻找惩罚证据的审计将错过此类价格上涨，而检查有利偏离的审计方法可标记大部分此类静止点。强制偏离探测的"报复"读数应扣除静态最优反应。局限：条件限于M=4、8000轮、0.5B训练模型和一个提示；不能推断训练型LLM、更多企业市场或部署定价工具的行为；随机重配作为补救措施的有效性未建模。

Abstract: When pricing agents meet repeatedly on a platform, the platform decides who faces whom. We ask whether that choice moves the prices the agents learn, and whether a rise comes with learned punishment. In a pre-registered randomised experiment in the Bertrand duopoly of Calvano et al., each agent's price is set by a tabular Q-learning module, not by the small language model attached to it, and we randomise whether each agent keeps its partner, sees its rival's prices and can send messages. Keeping the same partner raises the level of profits, averaged over training, by 0.27 of the gap between competitive and monopoly profit (95% CI 0.20 to 0.35, all twenty paired runs positive), our registered primary result, and the resting price by 0.17 of the Nash-to-monopoly range (post hoc). A plain tabular learner reproduces the effect in all 25 further blocks, and there one permanent partner raises the level more than about three do (+0.23 against +0.05, exploratory). Where rival prices are hidden, the price-setting module cannot see a cut, so cannot punish it, yet the resting price rises as much and the rise lasts to the end of training, while with visible rivals it shrinks with longer training (post hoc). Where the rival is visible, a static best responder accounts for a third to a half of what a forced-deviation probe reads as punishment, on the starts where the rival can see the cut, and net of it the registered test of learned punishment is inconclusive. A test that looks only for punishment would thus miss the rise where the rival is hidden, while a check for profitable deviations flags most of those prices (post hoc). In an exploratory extension, untrained Qwen2.5 7B and 14B models under one prompt show the effect when the rival's price is left out of the prompt and inconsistently when it is shown, the 7B result replicating on fresh blocks, while two other model families show none.

</details>


### [1494] [LLMs are General Asynchronous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35427)
*George Yakushev,Denis Mazur,Vladimir Bartenev,Vyacheslav Zhdanovskiy,Timofey Byzov,Vladimir Kaurkin,Vadim Pastushenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AsyncLLM框架，将LLM智能体从"串行思考-行动"循环扩展为通用异步智能体，支持在推理过程中并发处理多模态输入（文本、图像、视频、音频），无需任务特定训练。基于async/await编程模型，通过共享CacheBlock和注意力视图实现多协程并发推理，在流式视频理解、视频游戏交互、系统监控等任务上验证了Qwen 3.x模型即具备通用异步能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM智能体遵循串行的"读-思考-回复"循环，但真实场景（语音助手、具身机器人、监控系统）需要异步并发处理。现有方案针对每个异步任务单独设计专用架构（语音用full-duplex、机器人用VLA actor-thinker等），缺乏统一框架。本文旨在探索LLM能否像通用工具使用者一样成为"通用异步智能体"，将异步性视为一种通用能力而非领域特定技能。

Method: 1. 编程模型：基于Python asyncio的async/await范式，将异步智能体定义为并发协程（coroutines），通过CacheBlock（封装attention KV缓存和Gated Delta Network循环状态）和cache view（协程间共享内存视图）实现协程间实时信息共享。2. 多缓存块推理算法：扩展Rodionov et al. (2025)的工作——对full attention层，通过旋转query而非key来支持RoPE位置重排；对线性注意力/GDN层，利用离线编程的级联变换总结每个块的(A,B)仿射转移，块组合只需O(N_blocks)矩阵运算而非O(N_tokens)；对多模态MRoPE，维护逐块位置跨度信息。3. 调度引擎：基于mini-SGLang实现平衡批处理调度，采用chunked prefilling防止快速反应协程被大型prefill请求阻塞。4. 五种架构无关的并发模式：探测与监控、并行推理流、子程序委托、中断与增量输入、共享演化上下文。

Result: 1. 单异步输入实验：Qwen 3.x模型能响应推理过程中到达的文本澄清（MATH-500-Sharded）和图像变化（自构ShardedVQA 513对）。2. 流式视频理解：在SoccerNet-Caption和ProactiveVideoQA上，无需训练探测器的AsyncLLM Qwen 3.x模型超越专门训练的Mage-VL。3. 视频游戏交互（ViZDoom）：异步智能体在保持推理质量的同时，反应速度显著优于串行基线。4. 系统监控（DevOps-Gym）：异步监控智能体在精度可比的前提下，前向传播次数远少于串行基线。5. 吞吐量方面，9B模型在8协程下达552 tokens/s解码速度，在1×H200上ProactiveVideoQA视频流达4.4秒/秒实时率。6. 实验还展示LLM可通过工具调用修改自身推理协程定义，呈现初步自修改能力。

Conclusion: 现代LLM可作为通用异步智能体运行，无需任务特定异步训练。AsyncLLM框架通过async/await编程模型和共享内存视图统一了语音助手、流式视频、监控、交互游戏等多领域异步模式。核心贡献在于：证明异步性是可被框架化的通用能力、提出支持混合与多模态LLM的多缓存块高效推理算法、验证Qwen 3.x模型在该范式下具有跨任务泛化能力。未来工作方向：(i)训练更好的通用异步智能体；(iii)进一步研究智能体自修改协程的能力。同时需注意并发执行带来的安全风险（错误动作抢先发出、双重用途风险）。

Abstract: Modern LLMs are increasingly capable as autonomous agents, but they follow sequential interaction cycles: read, think, reply or call tools, repeat. Many real-world use cases are not sequential: voice assistants, embodied agents, and monitoring systems receive new inputs while they think or perform another task. Modern LLMs address this with specialized architectures for voice interaction and video streams, VLAs for robot control, asynchronous tool calling for API usage, and others. In this work, we generalize from different asynchronous tasks to general asynchronous agents that can adapt to different types of concurrency. To achieve this, we develop an asynchronous LLM framework that lets users (or the agents themselves) define inference coroutines with overlapping memory states. We showcase that Qwen 3.x models are capable of asynchronous operation for streaming video understanding, videogames, and monitoring, without task-specific training.

</details>


### [1495] [NeuronSifter: Intervention Planning in CNS Microenvironments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35445)
*Haowei Xu,Wanyi Fu,Hongbin Han,Zhaoheng Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuronSifter提出了一种中枢神经系统(CNS)干预规划框架，将干预方案编译为状态条件性的靶点占据场(state-conditional target-occupancy fields)，通过占据条件扩散算子(occupancy-conditioned diffusion operator)传播微环境动力学，并基于干预损失的预期减少来选择测量。其核心主张是：在动态、损失、信息和规划能力匹配的前提下，决策质量取决于后验保留的干预接口，而非控制器是内置还是外置。在合成阿尔茨海默病(AD)评估中，占据条件化将轨迹CRPS从0.165降至0.110，干预排序准确率从0.760提升至0.880；决策导向的证据获取以匹配数值贝叶斯实验设计(BED)规划器96.3%的成本达到目标风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的动作条件预测器将干预方案简化为身份标记或标量暴露，丢弃了靶点在何处、何时被接合的空间时间信息；而将点估计交给独立规划器则丢弃了使测量值得执行的联合不确定性。因此需要一种保留后验的干预接口，使决策质量成为接口属性而非控制器位置属性。

Method: 1. **结构化干预编译器**：将剂量、途径、方案编译为带支持掩码的状态条件性占据场，通过PK/PD模型传播暴露并计算占据；2. **占据条件化扩散算子**：使用有序机制专家(ordered mechanism experts)的掩码扩散模型，在共享残差上学习轨迹残差，以占据和支持掩码为条件；3. **共享后验**：使用分类变分分布（加权联合粒子）保留暴露、机制、参数和响应的联合不确定性；4. **决策导向证据获取**：通过净效用最大化选择测量，考虑信息价值(VOI)、成本、失败惩罚等；5. **TRI选择性干预**：通过Twin Reliability Index门控接受/拒绝决策，并使用分裂保形风险控制提供选择性覆盖保证。形式上提出了后验保留接口原则(Proposition 1)。

Result: 在64个配对场景块的合成AD评估中：(1) 占据条件化使CRPS从0.165降至0.110，排序准确率从0.760升至0.880，所有Holm校正后的对比均显著；(2) 决策导向获取终端风险0.160 vs 匹配BED 0.166，成本比为0.963 [0.907,1.025]（不可分离），对比早期控制为0.796 [0.732,0.873]（可分离）；(3) 点状态和依赖消融接口分别将风险提升至0.220和0.199；(4) TRI规则AURC为0.124，假接受率0.018，分布偏移下覆盖率为61/64（无逐层重新调优）。

Conclusion: NeuronSifter通过结构化干预编译器、共享生物后验和决策导向证据获取，在CNS微环境孪生中连接了反事实轨迹、选择性优先级排序和选择性干预。接口原则预测匹配全后验控制器具有相同价值；信息丢失控制隔离了生物依赖性；获取协议分离了信息目标、数值规划和摊销。合成对比定义了执行评估、独立规划器对比和冻结回放仍需提供的内容。当前模型比较使用合成输入，AD试验数据仅作为独立的回顾性端点桥梁。

Abstract: Prioritizing central nervous system (CNS) interventions requires predicting how a dose, route, and schedule act on a partially observed microenvironment, then choosing the measurement that would change the decision. Action-conditioned predictors reduce a regimen to an identity token or a scalar exposure, discarding where and when the target is engaged; handing a point estimate to a separate planner then discards the joint uncertainty that makes a measurement worth running. We therefore treat decision quality as a property of the intervention interface, not of controller placement. NeuronSifter compiles regimens into state-conditional target-occupancy fields with support masks, propagates them through microenvironment dynamics with an occupancy-conditioned diffusion operator, and selects measurements by their expected reduction in intervention loss, assimilating typed outcomes into the same posterior. In a declared synthetic Alzheimer's disease (AD) evaluation over 64 paired scenario blocks, occupancy conditioning lowers trajectory continuous ranked probability score from 0.165 to 0.110 and raises intervention ordering accuracy from 0.760 to 0.880, and every paired benchmark contrast remains separated after Holm correction. Decision-directed acquisition attains terminal risk 0.160 against 0.166 for a matched numerical Bayesian experimental design planner, and reaches the target risk at 0.796 $[0.732,0.873]$ of an earlier design control's cost, while the corresponding ratio against the matched planner, 0.963 $[0.907,1.025]$, is not separated from equality; point-state and dependence-ablated interfaces instead raise risk to 0.220 and 0.199, and a full-posterior external controller ties exactly. Published AD trials supply a separate retrospective endpoint bridge.

</details>


### [1496] [Manifold-Stable Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35454)
*Amirhossein Nazerian,Ali Pezeshki,Jianguo Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的生成模型框架——流形稳定流匹配（MSFM），通过将学习的切向传输与规定的法向收缩相结合，保证生成的样本从任意环境先验出发，在有限时间窗口内收敛到数据流形附近，显著提升了几何一致性和任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的流匹配（FM）方法通过速度回归学习生成动力学，但仅控制期望速度误差，即使回归误差很低也不能保证生成的样本贴合数据流形。当目标分布集中在低维流形上时（如机器人姿态、专家动作等），偏离流形的样本可能无效，且会降低闭环控制中的任务性能。现有几何FM方法需要已知流形和流形上的先验，限制了实际应用。

Method: MSFM的核心是将速度场分解为两个部分：（1）学习的切向传输分量 $P_y w_\theta(t,x)$，由神经网络仅在切向空间学习；（2）规定的法向收缩分量 $-\alpha(t)r(x)$，通过收缩理论从非线性动力学中引入，保证法向距离指数衰减。对于已知流形，使用解析投影算子（切向和法向）；对于未知流形，使用局部PCA仿射近似作为代理。收缩调度采用 $\alpha(t)=\alpha_0 + \beta/(1-t)$，保证积分发散从而实现有限时间窗口内的法向收敛。训练损失被正交分解为学习的切向项和参数无关的法向残差。同时推导了兼容的切向-法向概率路径族。

Result: 在椭圆实验中，700个样本的平均终端偏离代理误差达到 $1.10 \times 10^{-6}$ 阶。在Push-T机器人任务中（施加块位置扰动），成功率从74%提升到82%，平均最大奖励从0.86提升到0.92。在Robomimic Square任务中，成功率从60%提升到72%，旋转流形偏差从 $10^{-2}$ 阶降低到 $10^{-7}$ 阶。终端几何误差由数值容差 $\delta$ 控制。这些结果表明MSFM在几何一致性和任务性能上均优于标准FM。

Conclusion: MSFM通过将学习的切向传输与规定的法向收缩解耦，提供了一个流匹配框架，能够从任意环境先验出发，在有限时间窗口内保证对数据流形（或其局部仿射近似）的收敛。该框架适用于已知几何（通过解析投影）和未知几何（通过PCA代理）两种情形，具有理论收敛保证。实验验证了其在几何一致性和任务性能上的优势，支持将法向收缩作为学习生成传输的有益补充。该方法与骨干网络无关，可与更大架构结合使用。

Abstract: Flow matching (FM) learns generative dynamics through velocity regression. Geometric FM variants commonly assume a prior supported on the data manifold, requiring geometric knowledge that is often unavailable. Without such knowledge, low regression error alone does not guarantee manifold adherence. Adherence keeps generated samples within valid configurations and is empirically associated with better task performance. We introduce manifold-stable flow matching (MSFM), which can start from an arbitrary ambient prior, not necessarily supported on the manifold. Using tools from nonlinear dynamics, namely contraction theory, MSFM combines learned tangential transport with prescribed normal contraction. The construction uses analytical projectors for known manifolds and local affine proxies estimated by principal component analysis for unknown data geometry. By implementing contraction theory in both cases of known and unknown manifolds, we guarantee manifold invariance and transverse convergence to the manifold within a desired time window (e.g., one second). We derive a family of compatible probability paths and decompose the training loss into a learnable tangential term and a normal residual. An ellipse experiment attains a mean terminal off-manifold error of order $10^{-6}$. In Push-T robotic experiments, MSFM raises success from $74\%$ to $82\%$. In the Robomimic Square task, success increases from $60\%$ to $72\%$, while rotation-manifold deviation decreases from order $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-7}$. The MSFM terminal geometric errors are controlled by the chosen numerical tolerance. These results demonstrate stronger geometric adherence and higher observed task performance, supporting prescribed normal contraction as a complement to learned generative transport.

</details>


### [1497] [Tetra: Serving Leech-Lattice Quantized LLMs at 2.7 Bits per Parameter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35465)
*Pier-Jean Malandrino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tetra 是一种基于 Leech 格（Leech lattice）的新型码本与融合解码内核，可让 Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 大模型以约 2.7 bits/参数（约 2.7 bpp）的极低比特率在单张 L40S GPU 上部署，相比此前最优格式 Planes14 将每权重 VRAM 读取量从 4.804 bit 降至 2.148 bit（约减半），同时在 MMLU 与 GSM8K 上保持可用质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Leech 格量化能以 2 bit/权重提供高质量，但码本规模超过 10^14 点，无法用查找表实现；此前 Planes14 方案需在加载时展开码字，导致 VRAM 读取达 4.804 bit/权重，反而高于 4-bit AWQ (4.179 bit/权重)，压缩优势被抵消。本文目标是消除这一开销，实现真正低于 4-bit 的存储与带宽。

Method: 核心方法是：① 利用 Golay 码的 8-bit 八重组（octad）结构，把 24 维块切成三段 8 维，构建 64 状态格形（trellis）作为码本索引；② 设计 48-bit 字（8 比特状态 + 11-bit 表索引 ×3 + 增益位）配合共享 16 KiB 排名向量表，通过 6 次表加载和 2 次小查找在矩阵-向量乘内完成解码；③ 三项"封装"步骤（行尺度重训练、对最敏感投影改用 int4、4-bit 嵌入表）将完整模型压缩到约 2.7 bpp，且不改动任何格码。

Result: 在 Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 上分别实现 2.73/2.70/2.73 bpp，MMLU 得分为 63.37/69.58/75.66（比 4-bit AWQ 低 4.76/4.21/2.46 点），单 L40S 生成速度 113.8/95.0/57.2 tok/s；GSM8K 经推理内核分别落后 FP16 9.63/4.62/3.26 点；4B 文件比 llama.cpp IQ2_XXS（2.48 bpp）高 23.6 MMLU 点；8B 与 14B 文件在 MMLU 上分别以相近内存反超 AWQ 4B/8B。

Conclusion: GPU 可直接读取未展开的 Leech 格码：Tetra 把 bpp 从 4.804 降至 2.148（约 AWQ 一半），在 Qwen3 全系列上以约 2.7 bpp 提供可用质量，内存约为 4-bit AWQ 的 45–52%（若 AWQ 也用 4-bit 嵌入表则约 65%），证明 2-bit 级别的大模型本地部署在带宽与质量间达成新帕累托前沿；同时也指出局限：单卡验证、GSM8K 错误率代价、MMLU 经密集重建而非内核打分、int4 投影选择在测试集上完成等。

Abstract: Leech-lattice quantization gives good quality at two bits per weight, but its codebooks hold more than 10^14 points, too many for a lookup table. Our earlier kernel expanded the codes at load time and read 4.804 bits per weight from GPU memory for 2 bits of code. We present Tetra, a new codebook on the same lattice. A 24-weight block still takes 48 bits, most of which index a 64-state trellis of the Golay code and one shared 16 KiB table. The kernel decodes a block with six table loads and two small lookups inside the matrix-vector product, and reads 2.148 bits per weight. For full models, we retrain one scale per matrix row, store the matrices that lose the most as 4-bit integers, and pay for them with 4-bit embedding tables. Our Qwen3-4B, 8B and 14B files hold 2.73, 2.70 and 2.73 bits per parameter over the whole model. They score 63.37, 69.58 and 75.66 on the full MMLU test set, 4.76, 4.21 and 2.46 points below 4-bit AWQ at 5.3 to 6.0 bits per parameter. They generate 113.8, 95.0 and 57.2 tokens per second in our engine. On GSM8K, through the served kernel, they lose 9.63, 4.62 and 3.26 points to FP16. At 4B our file scores 23.6 points above this http URL 's IQ2_XXS (2.48 bits per parameter). Every number we measured for a table or figure comes from one NVIDIA L40S GPU. We preregistered the main experiments.

</details>


### [1498] [An analysis of Mirror-Descent Soft Actor-Critic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35466)
*Denis Zorba,Michal Valko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）算法进行了理论分析，特别研究了使用策略镜像下降（policy mirror descent）目标替代传统Gibbs测度目标的SAC变体。作者在population层面（固定协方差挤压高斯actor、线性均值、critic oracle）证明了有限时间收敛保证，推导了actor目标强凸性和光滑性的充分条件（通过Legendre微分算子量化critic曲率），并建立了最佳迭代的$\mathcal{O}(N^{-1/5})$收敛率。研究的关键发现是镜像下降步长$\lambda$可直接控制目标漂移和actor跟踪误差，而Gibbs目标对应界中包含不可消去的跟踪项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAC虽在实践中非常成功，但其理论分析仍很稀缺且具有挑战性。现有策略空间收敛结果无法直接覆盖实践中常见的挤压高斯参数化（其对数密度在动作空间边界附近无界）。此外，实际实现中只对演化目标执行少量梯度步，而非完全求解，这引入了额外的actor跟踪误差，但传统Gibbs目标在处理该误差时存在不可消去的跟踪项。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 在population层面研究SAC形式化框架，使用挤压高斯（tanh变换下的固定协方差高斯）作为actor策略类，线性均值参数化，并假设critic oracle提供$\varepsilon_{\text{crit}}$-最优Q函数估计。主要技术工具包括：(1)通过Legendre微分算子$\mathcal{T}$量化critic曲率$R_{\widehat{Q}}$，并推导强凸性条件$R_{\widehat{Q}}/2 < \tau$；(2)使用三引理和Pinsker不等式将actor跟踪误差与目标漂移联系起来；(3)通过仔细调整镜像下降步长$\lambda$和actor步长$h$来平衡策略改进与跟踪能力。比较了两种目标：传统Gibbs测度$\pi_{\mathrm{G}}$和镜像下降目标$\pi^{n+1}$。

Result: 主要结果包括：定理1给出最优性间隙的有限时间界，包含$1/(\lambda n) + \lambda$项加上actor跟踪误差和近似误差；定理2建立了actor目标在$\mathfrak{B}(R)$上的强凸性$(1-\gamma)(2-R_{\widehat{Q}}/\tau)c_{\Sigma,\mathrm{R}}\lambda_P$和光滑性$2+R_{\widehat{Q}}/\tau$；引理2显示镜像下降目标的跟踪误差以$\mathcal{O}((1/(hn) + \lambda/h^2)^{1/4})$为界，其中$\lambda$直接控制漂移；推论1表明Gibbs目标的相应界包含不可消去的$1/\tau$项；定理3通过选择$\lambda = \vartheta/(2N^{4/5})$建立最佳迭代的$\mathcal{O}(N^{-1/5})$收敛率。实验验证了曲率条件对训练动态的影响以及$\lambda$对跟踪误差的控制作用。

Conclusion: 本文为SAC的population级形式化提供了首个收敛保证，证明了使用策略镜像下降目标相对于传统Gibbs目标具有理论优势。镜像下降步长$\lambda$提供了控制actor跟踪误差的显式机制，平衡了策略改进的激进程度与actor跟踪能力。局限性包括分析在population层面进行，未考虑采样效应，且未显式纳入critic动力学；进一步研究方向包括联合分析critic动力学以获得更快收敛率。

Abstract: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is widely used for entropy-regularised reinforcement learning with continuous action spaces, and practical implementations perform only a few actor steps towards an evolving target. In this work, we prove convergence guarantees when the target policy arises from policy mirror descent and compare it with the classical Gibbs target. We derive sufficient conditions for the strong convexity and smoothness of the actor objective, characterised by the curvature of the $Q$-function estimate through the Legendre differential operator, and establish an $\mathcal{O}\!\left(N^{-\frac{1}{5}}\right)$ best-iterate finite-time convergence rate up to actor and critic approximation errors. Moreover, the mirror-descent step size $\lambda$ directly controls the target drift and hence actor tracking error, whereas the analogous Gibbs bound contains a non-vanishing tracking term.

</details>


### [1499] [Universal Approximation of Measure-to-Measure Operators by Pushforwards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35483)
*Takashi Furuya,Nicholas H. Nelsen,Frank Cole*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了由推前模型（pushforward models，即形式为 G(μ,·)#μ 的映射）逼近概率测度之间连续算子的普适逼近问题。论文证明了在包含原子测度的紧集上普适逼近会失败（因推前模型无法分裂或重新分配原子质量），并引入了"均匀水平集条件"作为充分条件——该条件被一维非原子测度紧族、共享同一非原子参考测度的紧族以及支集在连续变化低维结构上的奇异性测度紧族所满足。在该条件下，任何有限 p 阶矩的连续测度-测度算子可在 p-Wasserstein 距离下被连续推前模型一致逼近。论文还给出了定量误差界，并将结果应用于测度论 Transformer 架构以及连续变化源测度场景（与交叉注意力相关）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多学习任务将输入分布映射到输出分布（如贝叶斯推断中的先验-后验映射、Wasserstein 空间上的近端映射等）。Transformer 的测度论公式自然产生"推前模型"。本文的动机是确定在何种条件下，任意连续算子可以被此类推前模型一致逼近——这是理解 Transformer 表达能力的基础性问题。

Method: 论文采用六步法证明辅助定理3.6（主普适逼近定理）：(1) 用投影截断输出空间以控制尾部分布；(2) 用 h-网和单位分解离散化截断输出；(3) 利用均匀水平集条件构造连续精确"均匀化映射" H₀ 将每个输入测度推前到 Unif[0,1]；(4) 用磨光核正则化间断的区间映射以获得连续 Q_δ；(5) 估计正则化产生的 Wasserstein 误差；(6) 通过三角不等式组合各步骤的误差界。对 Transformer 应用则结合已有测度论 in-context 映射普适逼近结果（先合成）、Dugundji 扩展定理将紧集上的逼近扩展到全空间，并利用 ReLU MLP 逼近紧集上的同胚。最后通过高斯卷积消除均匀水平集条件的要求。

Result: 论文取得三项主要成果：(C1) 证明在允许原子测度的紧族上，原子分裂（如 δ₀ → ½δ₋₁ + ½δ₁）或原子权重修改（如 (½δ₋₁ + ½δ₁) → (⅓δ₋₁ + ⅔δ₁)）均不能被确定性推前模型任意好地逼近；(C2) 引入均匀水平集条件（存在连续标量化函数 φ 使其水平集邻域在输入测度族上一致地具有消失质量），在该条件下证明任何具有有限 p 阶矩的连续测度-测度算子可在 W_p 距离下被一致逼近，并给出显式误差界 sup_μ W_p ≤ E_tail,p(R) + h + 2R[2C_{d'}(1+R/h)^{d'}δ]^{1/p}；(C3) 结合测度论 in-context 映射普适逼近结果建立 Transformer 的测度-测度算子普适逼近定理（定理4.4），并将推前框架扩展到连续变化源测度情形（推论4.6），与交叉注意力架构相联系。此外，推论A.6通过高斯卷积消除均匀水平集条件，允许包含原子测度的紧集。

Conclusion: 本文确立了连续推前模型普适逼近测度-测度算子的精确条件。原子测度构成本质性障碍，而均匀水平集条件提供充分保证——这一条件比 Lebesgue 绝对连续更灵活，允许支集在低维流形上或连续变化曲线上的奇异测度。该工作将推前模型与测度论 Transformer 架构联系起来，并推广到交叉注意力场景。未来仍有若干开放问题：识别最小必要条件、逼近可能不连续的算子（如贝叶斯条件映射）、以及获得参数数量可控的 Transformer 定量逼近率。

Abstract: Many learning tasks map an input distribution to an output distribution. A natural way to model such an operator is to transform each input sample using a continuous function that may depend on the entire input distribution, and then take the distribution of the transformed samples. This defines a measure-dependent pushforward model and includes measure-theoretic formulations of transformers. We ask when such models can approximate arbitrary continuous operators between spaces of probability measures. We first show that universal approximation fails when atomic inputs are allowed: some continuous measure-to-measure operators that split or redistribute atomic mass cannot be approximated arbitrarily well by deterministic pushforward models. We then introduce the uniform level set condition, which requires a continuous measure-dependent scalarization whose shrinking level set neighborhoods carry uniformly vanishing mass over the input family. This condition is satisfied, in particular, by compact families of absolutely continuous measures. On every compact family satisfying this condition, we prove that any continuous measure-to-measure operator with outputs of finite $p$-th moment can be uniformly approximated, in the $p$-Wasserstein distance, by continuous measure-dependent pushforwards. Combining our theorem with existing approximation results for measure-dependent in-context maps yields universal approximation by measure-theoretic transformers. We also extend the framework to continuously-varying source measures, yielding a corresponding universality result for a class of pushforward models that are closely aligned with cross-attention architectures.

</details>


### [1500] [Physics-Guided Conditional Diffusion Model for Rare Event Synthesis and Diagnosis for the Water-Gas Shift Reaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35499)
*Md Abrar Rafid Siddique,Bibek Aryal,Qiugang Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种物理引导的条件去噪扩散概率模型（Pg-CDDPM），用于水煤气变换（WGS）反应中罕见事件轨迹的合成与故障诊断。通过将反应器的控制方程（物质平衡、能量平衡、Eley-Rideal动力学）作为物理损失嵌入扩散模型的训练过程，并结合传热效率因子与活化能因子作为条件特征，模型能够在训练数据分布外的极端工况（外推区域）生成物理一致的操作轨迹。同时，作者定义了一个综合危险评分指数来量化反应健康状态，将工况分为正常、轻度异常、极端和灾难四类，并利用门控循环单元（GRU）进行分类。仿真结果表明，Pg-CDDPM在插值和外推区域的合成质量均优于纯数据驱动的CDDPM，且通过合成数据进行数据增强后，GRU分类器对灾难类工况的诊断准确率从0%提升至92%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水煤气变换反应在实际运行中可能因严重结垢、催化剂失活和热失控等罕见事件导致安全隐患和氢气产量下降。由于事故工况下运行数据极其稀少，传统数据驱动的故障诊断模型难以可靠识别罕见异常工况。同时，现有的物理建模方法需要完整的过程机理知识，而纯数据驱动的生成模型（如GAN）存在训练不稳定和模式崩溃问题，且难以保证生成数据的物理一致性。扩散模型虽避免了对抗训练，但其在化学反应过程的应用尚未结合控制方程，无法外推到训练分布外的罕见危险工况。

Method: 1. 基于连续搅拌釜式反应器（CSTR）和Eley-Rideal机理构建WGS反应动态仿真器，生成7个过程变量（CO、H2O、CO2、H2浓度、反应器温度、冷却剂温度、进料流率）的轨迹数据；2. 提出物理引导条件扩散模型（Pg-CDDPM），采用1D U-Net架构（含ResBlock、SiLU激活函数），条件特征为传热效率因子f和活化能因子fEa；3. 损失函数由噪声预测损失（L_noise）和物理损失（L_physics）加权组成，其中物理损失通过将扩散模型生成的控制输入传入CSTR仿真器，计算仿真输出与扩散模型预测输出之间的差异；4. 定义综合危险评分指数，综合考虑反应器温度、氢气浓度、传热效率和催化剂退化程度，将轨迹分为正常、轻度异常、极端和灾难四类；5. 使用门控循环单元（GRU）作为分类器，基于增强后的数据集进行四类故障诊断。

Result: 在插值工况（f=0.72，fEa=1.30）下，Pg-CDDPM与CDDPM表现相近，温度RMSE分别为4.0 K和5.0 K；在外推工况（f=0.55，fEa=1.55）下，Pg-CDDPM显著优于CDDPM，温度RMSE分别为3.67 K和26.6 K，物种浓度RMSE也大幅降低。在故障诊断任务中，仅使用仿真数据的Case 1无法识别灾难类（全部误判）；基于Pg-CDDPM增强的Case 2中灾难类召回率从0%提升至92%，F1分数达到0.93；而基于CDDPM增强的Case 3中灾难类召回率仅为21%。证明物理引导的扩散模型能有效生成外推区域的物理一致轨迹，并显著提升罕见事件的诊断能力。

Conclusion: 本文提出的Pg-CDDPM框架成功将反应器控制方程嵌入扩散模型的训练过程，通过物理损失确保生成轨迹的物理一致性，使模型能够外推到训练数据分布外的罕见危险工况。综合危险评分指数为反应健康状态的量化评估提供了有效工具。数据增强策略显著提升了GRU分类器对灾难类工况的识别能力，验证了物理引导扩散模型在化工过程异常诊断中的实用价值。该方法为解决数据稀缺场景下的过程监测与安全保障问题提供了新途径。

Abstract: As the world moves towards sustainable energy sources, hydrogen (H2) can be treated as an eco-friendly alternative to fossil fuels due to its high energy density and zero carbon emissions. The water-gas shift (WGS) reaction is a widely used industrial process for hydrogen production by converting carbon monoxide and steam into hydrogen and carbon dioxide. However, occurrences like severe fouling, catalyst deterioration, and thermal runaway can hamper the reaction kinetics/process safety and decrease the yield of H2. These incidents are rare, and gathering process data under such abnormal conditions is challenging. In this work, we propose a physics-guided conditional diffusion model to generate realistic rare-event trajectories for the WGS reaction. The proposed model integrates a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (CDDPM) with governing laws of the reaction to generate physically consistent process trajectories. The conditioning features allow the model to produce high-quality synthetic profiles for rare-event domains that are typically beyond the training regimes. The generated rare-event trajectories then augment the raw dataset for a balanced distribution between normal and abnormal conditions. We further propose a hazard score to assess the risk severity of the operating condition based on the operating trajectory. Deep learning models are trained with the augmented dataset to diagnose the health status of the reaction. Simulation results show that the proposed physics-guided diffusion model outperforms data-driven models in terms of the quality of synthetic data and diagnosis performance for rare events.

</details>


### [1501] [Structured Latent Modeling for Supervised Multimodal Information Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35502)
*Wanting Huang,Sanvesh Srivastava,Weiran Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了S2MLVM（监督结构化多模态潜变量模型），通过在中间层应用对比或掩码目标，结合逐源可逆归一化流和监督低秩潜变量模型，将多模态联合分布显式分解为共享任务相关变化、模态特定预测变化和任务无关依赖，从而缓解单模态偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态融合中普遍存在单模态偏置（模态竞争/不平衡），现有方法缺乏原则性的方式来分离连续表征中与目标相关的贡献，无法有效隔离共享预测信息、模态特定预测信息及任务无关的跨模态依赖。

Method: 提出S2MLVM框架：(1)结构化潜变量模型将每个模态的潜空间分解为共享预测因子z^12、模态特定预测因子z^m和共享干扰因子z^c；(2)逐源可逆归一化流将非线性神经表征映射到高斯空间；(3)辅助表示学习（掩码重建S2MLVM-Mask或对比学习S2MLVM-Contrast）防止表征退化；(4)联合优化任务损失、密度似然损失和辅助表示损失；(5)理论分析通过偏信息分解(PID)框架揭示协同信息的产生机制。

Result: 在合成数据上能准确恢复任务相关子空间（典型相关系数>0.93）；在TriFeature诊断任务上S2MLVM-Contrast在冗余、唯一和协同任务上分别达到99.9%、95.2%、92.3%的准确率；在多个真实多模态基准（V&T EE、MIMIC、CREMA-D、UCF101、MOSEI、MOSI、UR-FUNNY、MUSTARD等）上均优于现有无监督和监督方法，并可扩展至三模态场景；消融实验验证了流变换和干扰因子的必要性。

Conclusion: S2MLVM提供了一个统一的潜变量视角来刻画连续多模态交互，通过显式分离共享预测、模态特定预测和任务无关因子，有效缓解单模态偏置，在多种多模态基准上实现稳健的预测性能提升，并能无缝扩展到多于两个模态的场景；未来工作将探索处理部分缺失模态的扩展。

Abstract: Multimodal prediction relies on diverse forms of evidence: information repeated across modalities, cues specific to a single source, and complex cross-modal dependencies that emerge only when inputs are considered together. While recent methods promote richer interactions, they lack a principled way to isolate these target-relative contributions within learned continuous representations. We introduce a framework that applies contrastive or masked objectives at intermediate layers, coupled with source-wise invertible normalizing flows and a supervised, low-rank latent variable model. This architecture explicitly factorizes the joint distribution into shared task-relevant variation, modality-specific predictive variation, and task-irrelevant dependence. Drawing connections to prior multimodal learning assumptions, our approach evaluates how modalities independently and jointly contribute to the target. Ultimately, this framework unites intermediate representation learning with structured likelihood-based guidance, offering a practical latent-variable lens for characterizing continuous multimodal interactions. Empirically, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach across diverse multimodal benchmarks, showing robust improvements in predictive performance.

</details>


### [1502] [An RL View of OPD: Least Square Policy Distillation for Sample-Efficient LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35505)
*Shangzhe Li,Yuxiao Yang,Tianrun Yu,Kaixiang Zhao,Xiaoyun Wang,Taylor W. Killian,Weitong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LSPD框架，通过强化学习视角重新解释on-policy distillation，引入最小二乘策略蒸馏方法，实现乐观探索和off-policy数据复用，在数学推理任务上显著提升性能和样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy distillation (OPD)虽被解释为强化学习方法，但其在探索和数据效率方面的算法潜力尚未充分挖掘。policy-based框架（如PPO、GRPO）需要频繁rollout且难以复用历史数据，而value-based KL正则化RL方法提供了原则性的off-policy更新和探索机制。本文旨在将value-based RL的探索与数据复用优势引入policy distillation。

Method: 1. 将OPD的reverse-KL目标重新解释为KL正则化策略优化问题，通过教师诱导的log-ratio奖励建立连接。2. 基于乐观KL正则化value-based RL，提出Least Square Policy Distillation (LSPD)：通过累积学生轨迹估计奖励，构建最小二乘置信集，取逐点乐观奖励进行KL正则化策略更新。3. 通过Lagrangian松弛导出quadratic matching目标（学生与教师log-probability的平方匹配）。4. 实际实现中结合Huber-type鲁棒惩罚和显式熵正则化。5. 提出LSPD-RB变体，使用replay buffer实现完全off-policy训练，支持多次更新复用历史轨迹。

Result: 1. 在6个数学推理基准（MATH-500、Minerva、Olympiad-Bench、AMC23、AIME24、AIME25）和3组Qwen3教师-学生配置上，LSPD平均提升Avg@16 +1.59分，超过最强基线EOPD +0.91分、OPD +1.99分。2. Pass@k评估（k∈{1,...,64}）显示LSPD在更大采样预算下表现更强，体现更好的策略多样性保持。3. LSPD-RB仅用10个训练步骤（仅25% rollout batches）即达到与vanilla OPD相当的性能，大幅提升样本效率。4. Pass@16和Pass@32/64一致优于基线，表明更好的解决方案覆盖。5. 理论保证：理想化算法达到Õ(log K)后悔界。6. 域外泛化（GPQA、MMLU、WinoGrande、HumanEval）同样有效提升。

Conclusion: LSPD为on-policy distillation提供了基于强化学习的原则性解释和实用方法，通过引入乐观探索和off-policy数据复用，在数学推理任务上实现了更好的性能、多样性保持和rollout效率。理论分析建立了Õ(log K)后悔界，证明了value-based RL原理可以有效改善policy distillation，为更高效的大语言模型蒸馏提供了新路径。

Abstract: We study on-policy distillation (OPD) through the lens of reinforcement learning, establishing a connection between the reverse-KL objective in OPD and KL-regularized policy optimization. Building on this connection, we introduce Least-Square Policy Distillation (LSPD), an RL-inspired framework that brings optimistic exploration and off-policy data reuse from value-based RL into policy distillation. LSPD preserves policy diversity through exploration while improving rollout efficiency by repeatedly learning from previously collected trajectories. Our theoretical analysis connects LSPD to optimistic value-based learning and shows that its idealized formulation achieves a sharp $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\log K)$ regret bound under online exploration. Empirically, LSPD consistently outperforms existing distillation baselines across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and diverse teacher-student settings, with average gains of +1.59 points in Avg@16. Remarkably, through Pass@k evaluations up to k=64, we found that LSPD better preserves policy diversity by achieving stronger performance as k grows. Its fully off-policy variant achieves comparable performance to vanilla OPD using only the first 25% of rollout batches. Together, these results provide an RL perspective on OPD that offers both a principled interpretation and a practical route toward more effective and rollout-efficient language model distillation.

</details>


### [1503] [One Proposal for Every Margin: Zero-Shot Amortized Sequential Importance Sampling for Binary Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35514)
*Ruishuo Chen,Weijia Li,Xun Wang,Yu Chen,Leheng Cai,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MarginFlow框架，将GFlowNet与序贯重要性采样（SIS）相结合，用于在固定行列和条件下对二元矩阵进行零样本摊销计数与均匀采样。该方法将SIS提议分布的设计问题转化为学习问题，利用问题的自相似性训练一个集合Transformer，在1904个边际上训练后，可零样本泛化至1190个未见过的边际（大小从3×3到870×6）。在99.2%的测试边际上匹配或优于31种解析设计的提议配置，在最困难的边际上将中位有效样本分数从10.3%提升至94.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在生态学、心理测量学以及社会和金融网络分析中，经常需要在固定观测到的行和列和条件下分析二元矩阵。两个基本计算问题是计算满足约束的矩阵空间基数|Z|以及从中均匀采样。序贯重要性采样（SIS）通过独立加权样本同时解决这两个问题，但其效率关键依赖于提议分布。现有的解析设计提议在不同边际上表现差异巨大，某些边际上甚至需要指数级数量的样本来避免严重低估计数。作者旨在通过学习而非解析设计来构建更好的提议分布。

Method: 1. 理论等价性证明：证明了零方差SIS提议恰好是单位奖励下GFlowNet的前向策略——在所有满足边际的矩阵上奖励为1时，任意部分矩阵的流等于其补全数量，初始状态的流等于总数Z。由此提议设计问题转化为GFlowNet策略学习问题。2. 边际间的摊销：利用自相似性——每个部分矩阵本身就是一个减少边际的实例，因此一个读取剩余边际的集合Transformer可作为通用提议。采用4层256宽度的预归一化注意力集合Transformer，以类型（按约简列和分组的可行行）作为动作空间，结合解析设计的对数权重作为先验。3. 训练：使用对数方差损失（VarGrad目标）进行训练，不依赖计数Z。训练池包含1904个边际（1688个合成+216个真实），覆盖19种数据族。4. 零样本评估：在1190个未见过的边际上评估，对比31种解析设计配置的后验最佳选择。

Result: 在1190个保留边际上：MarginFlow在1187个上匹配或优于31种解析设计配置的后验最佳选择（415胜/772平/3负），中位有效样本分数为99.8%。在最困难的56个边际（后验最佳保留样本不足37%）上，MarginFlow全部获胜，将中位有效样本分数从10.3%提升至94.1%。在Bezáková等人（2012）证明经典SIS指数级失败的边际族上，模型外推至训练规模5倍时，每个有效样本仅需1.2次抽样（而经典CDHL需2.3×10^27次）。作为计数器，MarginFlow对数计数的标准差比CDHL小约15倍，比60分钟Curveball链小约20倍。

Conclusion: MarginFlow建立了SIS提议分布与GFlowNet策略之间的精确等价性，将长期依赖人工设计的提议构造问题转化为可学习问题。通过在边际池上摊销学习，一次训练、零样本部署即可在各种大小的未见边际上获得优异表现。该方法在解析设计失效的困难边际上优势最为明显。该框架可扩展到列带有结构零的列联表、度约束图以及其他通过逐行/逐片构建的组合对象，每一步的剩余部分仍构成同一问题的实例。

Abstract: In ecology, psychometrics, and the analysis of social and financial networks, binary matrices are often analyzed conditional on their observed row and column sums, which restricts the problem to a finite sample space of matrices with the same margins. Two fundamental problems are to count this space and to sample uniformly from it. Sequential importance sampling (SIS) addresses both with independent weighted samples and an unbiased count estimator, but its efficiency depends critically on the proposal distribution. Existing proposals are analytically designed, and their accuracy can vary substantially with the margins. We show that the ideal SIS proposal, under which every weight equals the count and the variance vanishes, is exactly the policy of a generative flow network (GFlowNet) with unit reward on every matrix that has the given margins. We therefore propose MarginFlow, a framework that turns the design of the proposal into a learning problem and amortizes it across margins by exploiting their self-similarity. Every partial matrix is itself an instance with reduced margins, so one set transformer that reads the remaining margins serves every margin. We train MarginFlow on a pool of 1904 margins and evaluate it zero-shot on 1190 held-out margins, synthetic and real, from $3\times3$ to $870\times6$. On 1187 of the 1190 margins it matches or beats the best of 31 analytically designed configurations, chosen post hoc for each margin, and its median effective sample fraction is 99.8%. On the 56 margins where that best loses more than one nat of effective sample size, MarginFlow wins every one and raises the median effective sample fraction from 10.3% to 94.1%.

</details>


### [1504] [Reward-Aligned Reweighting for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35517)
*Haofeng Xu,Junwei Su,Lansong Diao,Wenchao Zhou,Chuan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出R²-OPD，一种针对在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的奖励对齐重加权方法，通过结合轨迹结果一致性（outcome agreement）与师生分歧幅度（disagreement magnitude）来连续重新分配教师监督信号，解决标准OPD中统一加权token级蒸馏项导致的"过度纠错"和"过度信任"问题。在7个数学推理基准和代码生成任务上均优于标准OPD及其他基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准在线策略蒸馏（OPD）对token级蒸馏损失采用均匀加权，隐含假设"局部教师偏好"等同于"纠错效用"。然而，一个决策的任务价值取决于学生如何完成后续推理。这种不匹配会导致：(1) 过纠错（over-correction）：在成功轨迹上抑制教师不偏好的决策，侵蚀有效的学生策略；(2) 过度信任（over-trust）：在失败轨迹上强化教师偏好的决策，鼓励学生无法可靠完成的推理路径。验证轨迹结果（verifiable outcomes）虽提供补充证据，但不直接识别单个决策的效用。因此，动机在于利用结果反馈来引导教师纠错的相对强度，而非作为确定性的token价值标签或简单硬过滤。

Method: 核心方法R²-OPD包含两个关键组件：<br><br>1. **奖励对齐门控（Reward-Aligned Gate）**：对每个完整响应，计算蒸馏优势 A_t = log(π_T/π_θ̄) 和二值结果 z ∈ {-1, +1}。通过响应局部尺度 ν_o（median(|A_j|)的下界）和sigmoid门 g_t = σ(β·z·A_t/ν_o) 进行连续加权。参数β控制锐度。对齐修正（z·A_t > 0）获得 g_t > 1/2，不一致修正（z·A_t < 0）获得 g_t < 1/2。<br><br>2. **质量保持归一化（Mass-Preserving Normalization）**：为补偿门控导致的绝对系数质量减少，对每个响应进行归一化 Z_o = M_o / Σ(g_j·|A_j|)，使得重加权后 Σ|A_t^R2| = M_o 保持不变，但相对权重按门控值重新分配。<br><br>理论上，文章形式化了"偏好-价值不匹配"（preference-value mismatch），证明局部降低反向KL可能同时降低一阶任务奖励（Proposition 1），并建立了重加权改善一阶任务进展的充分条件（Proposition 4）：协方差 Cov_p(g, u) > 0，即更大的门权重必须与更高的任务投影效用相关联。

Result: **数学推理基准（7个：AIME24/25, AMC23/24, MATH500, Minerva, OlympiadBench）**：<br>- 跨规模蒸馏（Qwen3-4B-GRPO → Qwen3-1.7B-Base）：R²-OPD平均准确率46.2%，优于标准OPD +3.5pp，超OPDVR +1.2pp，超ExOPD +0.9pp。在AIME25上+4.4pp，AMC24上+5.2pp。<br>- 同规模蒸馏（Qwen3-4B-GRPO → Qwen3-4B-Base）：R²-OPD平均50.8%，优于标准OPD +2.4pp。<br><br>**代码生成扩展**：<br>- HumanEval+和LiveCodeBench上平均61.2%，优于标准OPD +1.6pp，优于OPDVR +1.0pp。<br><br>**消融实验**：<br>- 反转对齐导致-3.8pp最大下降<br>- 仅符号门控：-1.6pp<br>- 仅幅度门控：-2.4pp<br>- 无质量归一化：-0.9pp<br>- 组合GRPO：+0.8pp<br><br>**训练动态**：保持更高训练奖励轨迹和更高策略熵，表明性能提升不是通过熵过度压缩实现。响应长度与标准OPD相当，排除更长rollout为主要解释。

Conclusion: R²-OPD通过结果引导的监督分配，有效地将密集教师反馈转化为更强的学生性能。核心贡献包括：<br>(1) 形式化分析：阐明了局部教师偏好与学生连续价值之间的不匹配，揭示了过纠错和过度信任两个失败模式的统一解释；<br>(2) 方法创新：提出连续、幅度敏感的重加权方法，保持非零教师反馈、修正符号和每响应系数质量；<br>(3) 充分条件：建立了重加权改善一阶任务进展的奖励-效用一致性条件；<br>(4) 实证验证：在数学推理和代码生成任务、不同模型规模（1.7B和4B）上一致优于标准OPD和现有基线。<br><br>研究强调了有效OPD不仅取决于"在哪里"收集教师反馈，还取决于"如何分配"其影响力——利用学生任务成功的证据进行结果引导的监督分配。方法无需额外的强化学习目标或学习的价值估计器，计算开销仅增加O(N)级别的中位数计算。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model with dense feedback from a stronger teacher on student-generated trajectories. Yet standard OPD weights token-level distillation terms uniformly, implicitly treating local teacher preference as a proxy for correction utility. A decision's task value, however, depends on how the student completes the subsequent reasoning.
