This mismatch can cause imitation to suppress viable student strategies or reinforce paths the student cannot reliably execute. Verified trajectory outcomes provide complementary evidence about continuation quality, but do not directly identify the utility of individual decisions. We introduce Reward-Aligned Reweighting for On-Policy Distillation (R$^{2}$-OPD), which uses outcome agreement and the magnitude of teacher--student disagreement to continuously reallocate teacher supervision. It gives reward-aligned corrections greater relative influence while retaining dense feedback, moving beyond uniform imitation and hard filtering. Our analysis formalizes the mismatch between local teacher preference and student continuation value and establishes sufficient conditions for reallocation to improve first-order task progress over uniform OPD. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, R$^{2}$-OPD achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared training methods in both cross-size and same-size distillation. It outperforms standard OPD on all seven benchmarks, with average gains of 3.5 and 2.4 percentage points for 1.7B and 4B students, respectively. An extension to code generation yields an average gain of 1.6 percentage points over standard OPD. These results highlight outcome-guided supervision allocation as an effective way to translate dense teacher feedback into stronger student performance across model scales and task domains.

</details>


### [1505] [Deep Epistemic Value Functions for Optimistic Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35525)
*Leander Diaz-Bone,Marco Bagatella,Jonas Hübotter,Andreas Krause*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DEVOTE，一种基于深度认知价值函数的无模型强化学习探索算法，通过三个核心改进——随机傅里叶网络(RFN)函数空间先验、时序认知差分(TUD)学习、软重置机制——解决了深度认知价值函数中认知不确定性在表示、传播和优化三个维度的失效问题，在纯探索和高维连续控制任务上均优于强基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度强化学习因探索策略缺乏长视野一致性而样本效率低下。基于价值函数的乐观探索虽有理论保证，但深度近似实现脆弱、不稳定，核心挑战是如何在深度函数逼近下鲁棒地扩展这些原理。具体需要解决认知不确定性在表示(数据外如何泛化)、传播(TD学习中如何稳定)和优化(非平稳目标下如何保持可塑性)三个轴上的失败问题。

Method: DEVOTE基于认知神经网络(ENN)框架，包含三大技术创新：1) 随机傅里叶网络(RFN)函数空间先验：通过RFF构造在函数空间直接定义先验，核长度尺度控制数据外不确定性的泛化方式，相比MLP权重空间先验产生更校准的不确定性；2) 时序认知差分(TUD)学习：将价值函数分解为基网络(标准TD学习奖励)、校正器(回归抵消先验)、残差自举网络(自举传播未来残差)，通过丢弃TD损失中的交叉项来防止先验泄漏到奖励信号中，额外提出TUD-OPT传播绝对残差以提供更强的乐观信号；3) 软重置：定期将残差自举网络和探索演员参数向随机初始化插值，以维持对持续变化探索目标的适应性。同时维护利用演员(最大化基价值)和探索演员(最大化UCB式乐观价值)。

Result: 在DeepSea、Spiral PointMaze、DMC Cheetah的纯探索任务和AntMaze、PickAndPlace的高维控制任务上，DEVOTE在状态覆盖率和任务回报方面均优于SAC、RND、Thompson Sampling和基于模型的SOMBRL等强基线。消融实验证实三个组件各有互补贡献：RFN先验决定局部不确定性信号质量，TUD学习决定信号学习可靠性，TUD-OPT决定时序传播，软重置决定探索策略适应性。在U型PointMaze上的分析表明无重置时休眠神经元比例上升且探索停滞。UCI回归基准测试中RFN先验在OOD检测AUROC上优于MLP先验(0.844 vs 0.749)。

Conclusion: 深度认知价值函数是可扩展、原则化探索的有前景路径，但需要同时解决不确定性表示、传播和优化三个维度的挑战。DEVOTE通过结构化函数空间先验、TUD学习和可塑性正则化的组合，在奖励自由探索和具有挑战性的连续控制任务上实现了更可靠的探索和更强的任务性能。未来方向包括扩展到学习表示和视觉观测，以及建立理论保证。研究表明扩展原则化探索不仅需要正确的算法目标，还需要深入理解该目标与神经函数逼近的交互。

Abstract: Principled exploration in reinforcement learning requires an agent to quantify its epistemic uncertainty and act to resolve it. Uncertainty over the value function provides a natural signal for exploration, yet existing deep approximations remain brittle and perform inconsistently. The central challenge is therefore to scale these ideas robustly. We conduct a systematic empirical study of how epistemic uncertainty is represented, propagated, and optimized in deep epistemic value functions, and uncover distinct failure modes along each of these axes. These findings motivate DEVOTE, a model-free reinforcement learning algorithm that controls how uncertainty generalizes beyond observed data, stabilizes its temporal propagation, and preserves adaptation to the resulting non-stationary exploration objective. Across reward-free exploration and challenging continuous-control tasks, DEVOTE reaches novel states more effectively and achieves higher task return than strong model-free and model-based exploration baselines. These results provide evidence that deep epistemic value functions are a promising path toward scalable, principled exploration.

</details>


### [1506] [GeoGAE: Scalable Graph-Level Autoencoding via Hyperball Cloud Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35527)
*Radosław Nowak,Anna Bielawska,Bogusz Stefańczyk,Maciej Sanocki,Paweł Wawrzyński*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GeoGAE提出了一种基于"超球云"(hyperball cloud)的图表示方法，将离散图映射为欧氏空间中可确定排序的超球集合，从而绕开节点匹配问题。基于此设计了一个Transformer自编码器，将变长超球云压缩为定长图嵌入 z∈ℝᵐ，再解码重建。核心创新在于：(1) 超球云连续表示+确定性节点排序消除置换模糊性；(2) 多层教师强迫解码器缓解曝光偏差；(3) 节点捆绑(bundling)机制提升大图可扩展性。在7个基准数据集(MUTAG、AIDS、IMDB-BIN、QM9、SYNTHETIC NEW、COLLAB、REDDIT-BIN)上的拓扑重建F1均达到或超过SOTA(GraphVAE类基线)，并在REDDIT-BIN和COLLAB等大图上显著优于PIGVAE/ReGAE/GRALE(后者常出现OOM或崩溃)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图级自编码器存在两大瓶颈：(1) 依赖节点排序的方案(如ReGAE)不具有置换等变性，影响精度；(2) 置换等变方案(如PIGVAE、GRALE)需复杂的最优传输/Sinkhorn匹配机制输出节点到输入节点，且对大图扩展性差(常OOM或退化为平凡预测)。图级固定维嵌入对下游生成、转换、优化任务至关重要，因此亟需一种可逆、无需匹配、可扩展的图↔向量变换方法。

Method: 核心方法分四步：
1. **超球云编码**：通过空间优化将图节点映射为d维欧氏空间中的变半径超球，邻接关系由球面相交规则(m_{i,j}>0判定边)确定；使用SVD+偏度归一化消除旋转/反射歧义，使表示(几乎)唯一。
2. **确定性节点排序**：从全局几何中心最近节点出发，贪心选取——距离+log₂到全局中心距离惩罚——得到唯一序列。
3. **编码器**：序列经可选捆绑(Bundle→Token MLP)后，输入Transformer编码器；用C个[CLS]标记(彼此禁止互注意力)拼接得到z∈ℝᵐ；可选VAE重参数化。
4. **解码器**：通过交叉注意力将z解码为超球序列；K次权重共享堆叠+右移实现多层教师强迫，缓解曝光偏差；每token含b个超球+b个停止logit精确控制图大小。
5. **静态球面相交规则**将重建超球云映射回离散图。
总损失包括几何重建(Huber)、拓扑(focal loss on margins)、停止(focal loss)、可选KL与节点/边特征损失。

Result: **拓扑重建F1(节点加权)**：MUTAG 61.3%、AIDS 84.1%、IMDB-BIN 94.0%、QM9 99.4%、SYNTHETIC NEW 50.1%、COLLAB 90.9%、REDDIT-BIN 56.5%。在所有数据集上均匹配或超越PIGVAE/ReGAE/GRALE，其中大图(COLLAB/REDDIT-BIN)上基线方法出现OOM或退化为全0/全1预测。**图大小预测误差极小**（QM9仅0.01，REDDIT-BIN 16.25为最差）。**特征重建**：AIDS上节点RMSE 0.8、边F1 85.0%；QM9上节点RMSE 0.5、边RMSE 0.3。**消融**：(1) K=1解码层导致性能崩溃(AIDS F1从84.1→72.6，平均大小差从0.23→4.67)；(2) VAE正则化略损重建精度(QM9 99.4→95.9)；(3) 引入节点/边属性作为辅助信号可提升拓扑重建(MUTAG 61.3→63.6, AIDS 84.1→86.0)；(4) 捆绑大小b越大F1越低(b=1:84.1%, b=8:79.5%)，但b=2时大小预测最优(0.09 vs 0.23)。

Conclusion: GeoGAE通过"超球云"连续表示+确定性节点排序，成功解决了图自编码器的节点匹配瓶颈和大小限制。Transformer编码器-解码器框架在7个跨领域基准上达到或超过SOTA，特别是首次在REDDIT-BIN/COLLAB等大图上实现稳定训练和高保真重建，为隐空间图生成、转换和优化奠定了可扩展基础。局限性：(1) 超球云映射需逐图求解连续优化问题，增加预处理开销(虽每数据集仅一次)；(2) 高对称图对SVD归一化和贪心排序的扰动仍敏感；(3) 大图精确大小预测与捆绑下拓扑保持仍有挑战。未来方向包括端到端可微的超球初始化和对称感知排序。

Abstract: Embedding structured objects into Euclidean spaces has enabled a wide range of successful machine learning applications. Such objects include words, documents, image patches, time series, and graph nodes. In contrast, embedding entire graphs remains a challenging problem. Existing methods either sustain the original order of the graph nodes or match the output nodes to the input ones, both of which create scalability issues. In this work, we propose a graph representation as a cloud of hyperballs, which allows us to define a specific, typically unique, node ordering. Based on this representation, we propose GeoGAE, an autoencoder, in which the Transformer encoder translates a hyperball cloud into a graph-level embedding, and the Transformer decoder translates the graph-level embedding back into the graph. This formulation enables the model to capture both the global graph structure and local relational patterns. We evaluate our method on multiple graph datasets, spanning various domains. The results demonstrate effectiveness of our method in encoding and reconstructing graphs from their embeddings.

</details>


### [1507] [Optimal Networks for Agentic Information Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35537)
*MohammadHossein Bateni,Zahra Hadizadeh,MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi,Mahdi JafariRaviz,Shayan Taherijam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了网络化分布式学习中的信息聚合问题。核心问题是：在有向无环图上，智能体按拓扑顺序学习，每个智能体观察部分特征并接收父节点的预测，最终输出智能体的预测能否匹配全局最优预测器。作者在两种设计者设定下分析了实现精确聚合所需的深度和智能体数量，证明了深度和智能体数量的最优上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的多智能体AI系统（如大型语言模型的链式调用）中，每个模型只接收部分信息并基于前序模型的输出进行预测。理解这种网络化学习的信息聚合极限，对于设计高效的分布式AI系统至关重要。已有工作主要分析给定图和特征分配下的误差界，但缺乏对网络设计自由度（智能体数量、深度、每个智能体的父节点数量）的系统性研究。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 在自适应设计者（已知分布）和盲设计者（不知分布）两种设定下，分别求解网络最优充分的最差余误差R_b(d,D)和R̄_b(d,D)。(2) b=1情形：构造高斯混合分布给出Ω(1/D)下界，贪心特征分配给出O(1/D)上界。(3) b≥3情形：设计分层图结构（轮次+二叉树+gadget），在盲设计者设定下实现O(d log d)深度精确聚合，在自适应设定下实现O(d)深度。(5) 通过Lemma 6.1将三父节点智能体替换为常数量级的两父节点智能体。(6) 智能体数量下界：通过构造代数独立的协方差矩阵，利用行列式多项式分布的不可约性证明精确聚合需要Ω(d²)个智能体。

Result: 主要结果总结为表格：(1) b=1时R₁(d,D)=Θ(1/D)，无有限深度可保证精确聚合；(2) b≥3时盲设计者设定需O(d log d)深度，自适应设定需O(d)深度，两者均紧；(4) b=2时通过常数因子替换达到与b=3相同的渐近界；(5) 所有b≥2情形下智能体数量的Ω(d²)下界。所有深度和智能体数量界的上界都匹配相应下界至常数因子。

Conclusion: 本文建立了网络化信息聚合模型的完整最优界。在分布式多智能体AI系统的设计中，关键权衡为：每个智能体接收的父节点预测数量(b)与实现全局最优预测所需的深度和智能体数量之间的关系。b=1本质上不足以实现精确聚合；b=2是充分条件，深度O(d log d)和O(d²)智能体为最优。文章结果为设计高效的多模型AI系统提供了理论指导。

Abstract: We study information aggregation in the networked learning model introduced by Kearns, Roth, and Ryu (SODA 2026). There is a fixed distribution over $d$ features and a common label. Agents learn in topological order on a directed acyclic graph. Each observes a subset of the features and its parents' predictions, fits a linear predictor to minimize mean squared error, and passes only its prediction forward. The global predictor is the best linear predictor using all features. Kearns, Roth, and Ryu show that the output agent's error approaches the global predictor's error along sufficiently deep paths with suitable feature coverage, while insufficient depth can prevent aggregation even in large networks. In contrast to their main focus on a given graph and feature allocation, we consider the limits of the model under two settings. In the adaptive designer setting, a designer chooses the graph, feature allocation, and output agent knowing the distribution. In the oblivious designer setting, the designer fixes all three before an adversary chooses the distribution. Each agent observes one feature and receives predictions from a limited number of parents. We call the aggregation exact when the output agent matches the global predictor exactly. For $d\ge3$, we show that no finite depth guarantees exact aggregation for every distribution with one parent per agent, even when the designer knows the distribution. In contrast, two parents per agent suffice for exact aggregation even in the oblivious designer setting. A fixed graph, feature allocation, and output agent achieve this for every distribution at depth $O(d\log d)$. Knowing the distribution reduces the depth to $O(d)$. Both constructions use $O(d^2)$ agents, with a very large constant for two parents. We show the bounds on the depth and number of agents are all optimal up to constant factors.

</details>


### [1508] [Learning the Robustness Mechanism with Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35541)
*Yiyang Shen,Qihang Lin,Weiran Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种分布鲁棒学习框架，通过双层优化（bilevel optimization）将鲁棒性机制中的参数从手动调优改为从验证数据中自动学习。该框架包含两种实例化（Bi-HDRO和Bi-PG-DRO），分别处理有/无分组标签的训练场景，并提供了样本复杂度分析保证其与穷举网格搜索相比具有可比泛化性能，同时在同时存在组内和组间分布偏移的实验设置中展现了显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的分布鲁棒优化方法（如GDRO和HDRO）需要手动指定和大量调优鲁棒性参数（如鲁棒性惩罚η和组内扰动半径ε），这不仅计算成本高昂，而且不同数据集需要不同的调优设置。此外，当分组标签不可用时，最坏组预测器的准确性也需要调优。核心问题是：能否将鲁棒性机制本身作为可学习的组件，在训练过程中自动优化？

Method: 方法采用双层优化框架：上层最小化验证集上的最坏组损失以调优鲁棒性参数（η、ε_g等），下层使用这些参数进行鲁棒训练（求解minimax问题）。提出了两种实例化：(1) Bi-HDRO（双层分层DRO）处理有分组标签场景，通过平滑化技术将HDRO的下层问题转化为可精确求梯度的凸优化；(2) Bi-PG-DRO（双层概率分组DRO）处理分组标签缺失场景，联合学习属性预测器和鲁棒模型，使用KL散度正则化。求解算法基于Shen et al. (2026)的一阶方法，通过proximal-point方法将非凸-凹minimax问题转化为强凸-强凹子问题序列求解。

Result: 在同时存在组内和组间分布偏移的Shifted CMNIST、Shifted CelebA和Shifted CivilComments三个数据集上的实验表明：(1) Bi-HDRO在Worst-group准确率上优于GDRO、DFR、PDE和HDRO等基线方法（例如CelebA上从GDRO的59.2提升至82.8）；(2) Bi-PG-DRO在分组标签缺失时也优于ERM、GIC、XRM、AGRO、SSA和PG-DRO等基线；(3) 方法在计算上比穷举网格搜索更高效（HDRO需要16种参数组合的网格搜索，Bi-HDRO仅需单次运行）；(4) 理论分析证明了连续oracle不等式，显示样本复杂度与网格搜索相当但避免了离散化误差。

Conclusion: 本文成功证明了可以将鲁棒性机制作为可学习组件集成到训练过程中，通过双层优化框架自动调优多个连续超参数。理论上的连续oracle不等式表明该方法在保持泛化性能的同时避免了离散化误差和网格搜索的指数计算复杂度。实验验证了该方法在双重视分布偏移下的有效性和可扩展性。未来工作可扩展到非凸-凹下层问题（通过KL条件）和机器遗忘、大语言模型对齐等应用。

Abstract: We propose a distributionally robust learning framework where parameters defining the robustness mechanism are learned from held-out data instead of extensively tuned. Using bilevel optimization with both upper and lower level minimax problems, we create two instances of our framework to tackle setups with and without group labels in the training set. Theoretically, we provide sample complexity analysis for our robustness mechanism learning paradigm, showing that it achieves generalization guarantees comparable to exhaustive grid search while being more computationally efficient. Empirically, we evaluate our framework under a challenging setup when both intra-group and inter-group test distribution shifts occur at the same time, thereby demonstrating the efficacy and scalability of our method.

</details>


### [1509] [Simplex Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35553)
*Justin Deschenaux,Alexandre Galashov,Andrew Campbell,Li Kevin Wenliang,James Thornton,Arnaud Doucet,Valentin De Bortoli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Simplex Diffusion Models (SDMs)，将离散扩散过程提升到概率单纯形上，通过Dirichlet前向过程和具有可调随机性的DDIM式采样器，在保持信念状态不确定性的同时实现高效离散数据生成，在代码生成等任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散扩散模型在中间采样步骤通过类别采样丢弃不确定性（信息坍缩），需要依赖Self-Conditioning等机制传递信念。Dirichlet Flow Matching需要ODE数值积分，难以扩展到大词汇表。需要在保持离散数据建模能力的同时，实现不确定性在去噪步骤间的有效传递。

Method: SDMs在概率单纯形$\Delta_N$上构建Dirichlet前向过程$p_t|P_0=\text{Dir}(P_t; c_t(\alpha_t P_0+(1-\alpha_t)\pi))$，其中均值与浓度独立参数化。利用Dirichlet分布的stick-breaking和thinning性质，导出具有闭式反向转移的桥接过程$p_{s|0,t}$，并引入churn参数$\kappa$控制采样随机性。当$\kappa=1$时为独立桥，$\kappa=0$时信任当前状态。训练使用简单的交叉熵损失，对应ELBO下界。理论分析表明：高温极限恢复离散扩散，低温极限收敛到均值插值（高斯涨落）。还提出了Simplex DMD蒸馏方法，仅需单一梯度路径即可实现。

Result: 在TinyGSM代码生成上，SDM（512步，$\kappa=1$）达49.0%（T=0.1）和45.8%（T=1），无需SC即优于带SC或PC的MDM/UDM基线。蒸馏到8步后解决32.1%的GSM8K问题，超过128步的IDLM（21.4%）。在数独上SDM+SC达99.1%，匹配最佳离散扩散模型。在OpenWebText上，GenPPL/熵前沿与离散扩散方法竞争。分子生成上SDM达到87.23% Quality（confidence-based采样），证明其在不同离散数据模态上的竞争力。

Conclusion: SDMs统一了离散与连续扩散框架，通过在单纯形上操作避免了信息坍缩，无需数值ODE积分。其DDIM式采样器提供可调的随机性-确定性权衡。蒸馏后的SDMs在少步采样下显著优于现有离散扩散蒸馏方法。结论在大规模模型上是否成立仍需进一步验证，但展示了离散与连续扩散语言模型之间并非真正对立。

Abstract: Diffusion models have revolutionized generative modeling for continuous data through the gradual refinement of a belief state. This iterative refinement has not yet carried over to discrete diffusion models, which discard uncertainty at intermediate steps through categorical sampling (information collapse). We propose Simplex Diffusion Models (SDMs), a framework that lifts the diffusion process to the probability simplex to represent beliefs over categories. SDMs admit probability paths with closed-form reverse transitions and can be trained with a simple cross-entropy loss. Contrary to earlier proposals such as Dirichlet Flow Matching which requires integrating an ordinary differential equation, we introduce a DDIM-like sampler with a tunable level of stochasticity. Because SDMs operate on samples on the simplex, they can carry uncertainty across denoising steps, which mitigates information collapse. On OpenWebText, SDMs are competitive with strong Discrete Diffusion baselines, achieving $17.0$ GenPPL at $5.46$ unigram entropy in 64 sampling steps, close to real validation data. Even without Self-Conditioning (SC), SDMs outperform masked and uniform diffusion (with SC or predictor-corrector sampling) on code generation (TinyGSM, $T=0.1$; $49.0\%$ vs. $45.8\%$). Distilled down to 8 steps, SDMs solve $32.1\%$ of GSM8K problems, more than distilled Discrete Diffusion models with 128 steps ($21.4\%$).

</details>


### [1510] [From Experience to Expertise: Adoption-Aware Memory Learning for Data-Scarce NPU Kernel Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35568)
*Longxiao Fan,Tao Zhang,Han Yan,Jiajun Li,Mingcong Song,Guoping Long,Hongjie Si,Weiwei Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAGE是一个面向数据稀缺NPU内核合成的持久化自我改进智能体，通过"采用感知信用分配（ATU）"和"效用门控固化（UGC）"两大机制，让冻结参数的LLM能够积累并重用硬件特定知识。在NPUKernelBench上，SAGE的执行率达到95.5%（对比最强基线84.1%），其中86.9%的已解决算子优于torch_npu；在稀疏Flash Attention上实现43.99倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM编码智能体在CUDA等成熟GPU生态中表现优异，但难以迁移到数据稀缺、内存层次与执行模型迥异的NPU DSA架构。现有方法存在两大局限：(1) 后训练方法（SFT/RL）依赖稀缺专家数据与高昂算力；(2) 现有记忆学习智能体采用统一信用分配，被检索但未被采用的经验与被采用的经验获得同等奖励，会偏置后续检索排序；高价值经验只能反复检索而非驻留上下文，增加检索开销并削弱跨任务指导。

Method: SAGE构建冷-热分层记忆：(1) ATU通过"采用追踪"机制记录每个检索经验是否实际指导了代码修订，结合终端验证分数做采用感知信用分配——采用项均分episode级信用，未采用项获得固定负信用，并采用衰减步长的bandit式规则在线更新经验效用；插入trace-completeness hook保证采用记录完整。(2) UGC基于正效用、跨算子多次采用（K_ado≥3, K_op≥3）的证据将冷记忆经验抽象为可重用规则并固化进有限token预算（B=10K）的热记忆，通过效用密度 U(m)=u_m·p̂_m/L_m 排序，持久未使用的规则按指数衰减被降级。形式化分析证明信用有界、效用稳定、重排序可控、驻留优先级可衰减。

Result: 在88算子NPUKernelBench子集（覆盖L1/L2/L3）上，SAGE在三个骨干（Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B、GLM-5.2 744B）上一致优于Refinement、Static RAG、Value Memory三个受控基线。GLM-5.2下SAGE达95.5% ER（对比Value Memory 84.1%），Fast_1.0从75.7%提升至86.9%，L3 ER从61.1%提升至88.9%。在16个xCCL算子迁移测试中达68.8% ER，81.8%优于torch_npu；GLM-5.3下sparse_flash_attention达43.99×加速。消融：均匀信用使L3 ER从88.9%跌至66.7%；去除UGC与随机UGC均明显下降。跨骨干迁移中，GLM-5.2演化的记忆可提升DeepSeek-V4-Flash ER至72.7%。任务顺序实验表明L2→L3顺序效果最佳。

Conclusion: SAGE证明采用感知信用分配与选择性固化使智能体能够跨任务积累并重用硬件特定知识；采纳追踪提供了比统一信用更精确的归因信号，跨算子固化提供了比单纯检索更高效的复用通道。局限性：30轮预算未覆盖长视距融合内核/巨核合成；多智能体共享记忆存在专业化、来源、迁移与冲突解决问题。未来工作将探索该原理在其他新兴硬件架构与DSL上的应用。

Abstract: High-performance kernels underpin efficient accelerator execution but require expert tuning and lengthy manual optimization cycles. LLM coding agents promise automation, yet their CUDA knowledge transfers poorly to data-scarce domain-specific architectures (DSAs) such as NPUs, whose execution models and memory hierarchies differ substantially from those of GPUs. To address this transfer gap, post-training methods adapt LLMs to NPU programming but depend on scarce expert data and substantial training compute. Memory-learning agents instead adapt through external memory, but their uniform credit assignment gives adopted and unused experiences the same reward target, potentially biasing subsequent retrieval rankings. Moreover, when learned values guide only retrieval, high-value experiences that generalize across operators must be retrieved repeatedly rather than retained in context, thereby increasing retrieval overhead and weakening cross-task guidance. We therefore present SAGE, a persistent self-improving agent for NPU kernel synthesis. Adoption-Traced Utility estimation (ATU) combines explicit adoption records with kernel evaluation outcomes for adoption-aware credit assignment. Utility-Gated Consolidation (UGC) uses positive utility and repeated adoption across operators to select and abstract reusable rules into a bounded resident context. On NPUKernelBench, SAGE achieves a 95.5% execution rate versus 84.1% for the strongest controlled baseline, with 86.9% of solved operators outperforming torch_npu. With GLM-5.3, SAGE achieves a 43.99x speedup over the torch_npu reference on sparse flash attention. These results show that adoption-aware credit assignment and selective consolidation enable agents to accumulate and reuse hardware-specific knowledge across tasks.

</details>


### [1511] [Output-aware Residual Stream Pruning for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35579)
*Chayne Thrash,Kevin Chen,Soheil Kolouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向大语言模型的"输出感知"残差流剪枝方法。该方法在选择需剪枝维度时，不仅考虑激活重建误差，还结合了下游层对各方向的敏感性。通过对输出KL散度进行二阶近似，将子空间选择问题转化为对灵敏度加权协方差矩阵的特征分解，从而在多个指令微调的LLM系列上，相较于SliceGPT等仅依赖激活的方法，在困惑度、下游任务表现及校准KL散度上均取得一致改进，尤其在高压缩率下优势更显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有残差流剪枝方法（如SliceGPT）通过最小化激活重建误差来选择需剪枝的维度方向，将所有扰动方向视为同等重要，忽略了模型输出对不同方向扰动的下游敏感性差异。这导致在相同激活重建误差下，不同方向的扰动对模型输出分布的影响可能截然不同，从而影响剪枝后模型的性能保留。

Method: 方法核心是将残差流子空间选择目标从单纯的激活能量最小化转变为考虑输出敏感性的优化问题。具体步骤包括：(1) 通过对输出KL散度进行二阶近似（基于Fisher信息矩阵），推导出包含激活协方差矩阵C和输出敏感性矩阵H的复合目标函数L(U)=Tr(UᵀCU·UᵀHU)；(2) 引入共享的层级别曲率矩阵H以避免逐token计算的高昂成本；(3) 推导该目标的光谱上界，将其转化为对加权矩阵M_τ=τC+τ⁻¹H的特征分解问题；(4) 通过在网格τ值上选择候选子空间U并依据原目标函数L(U)进行筛选，实现高效的剪枝基构建。

Result: 在Llama-3.2 3B、Llama-3.1 8B、Mistral 7B v0.3、Mistral Nemo、Phi-3 Medium等五个指令微调LLM上，以10%-30%的稀疏率进行评估。结果显示：(1) 校准KL散度在所有模型和压缩率下均显著低于SliceGPT；(2) 困惑度改进幅度随压缩率增加而增大，例如Llama-3.2 3B在30%稀疏率下PPL从57.17降至30.14；(3) 常识推理、数学推理(GSM8K)及指令跟随(IFEval)任务性能普遍优于SliceGPT；(4) 在非指令微调模型和不同校准数据集(RedPajama)上同样有效；(5) 额外优化带来的增益有限，表明光谱候选选择已接近最优；(6) 校准时间仅小幅增加（Llama-3.1 8B增加约11分钟）。

Conclusion: 仅保留激活能量不足以实现高效的残差流剪枝。显式建模扰动向模型输出传播的方式可提供更有效的剪枝维度选择标准。本文提出的灵敏度感知方法通过二阶近似和光谱上界，在保持旋转剪枝方法效率和结构简洁性的同时，显著提升了剪枝后模型对原始输出分布及下游能力的保留度。未来方向包括跨块共享变换和参数高效化以降低旋转带来的额外开销。

Abstract: Residual stream pruning methods reduce inference cost by shrinking the model's hidden dimension, but existing approaches typically choose these dimensions by minimizing activation reconstruction error. This criterion implicitly treats all perturbation directions as equally important, ignoring the sensitivity of downstream layers. We introduce a sensitivity-aware approach to residual-stream pruning that directly accounts for this direction-dependent sensitivity. Using a second-order approximation to the output KL divergence, we characterize the effect of a residual-stream perturbation through both its activation covariance and the local sensitivity of the model output. The resulting subspace selection objective couples these two quantities, but is difficult to optimize directly. We derive a tractable spectral upper bound that reduces subspace selection to an eigendecomposition of a sensitivity-weighted covariance matrix, retaining the efficiency and structural simplicity of rotation-based pruning methods. Across several instruction-tuned language model families, our method consistently reduces calibration KL divergence relative to activation-only pruning and improves perplexity and downstream task performance over a range of compression levels. Our results show that preserving activation energy alone is insufficient for residual-stream pruning, and that explicitly accounting for how perturbations propagate to the model output provides a more effective criterion for selecting dimensions to remove.

</details>


### [1512] [Hardware-Aware Features for CUTLASS Kernel Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35587)
*Shriram Chandran,Dominic Rinderer,Yakup Budanaz,Alexandru Calotoiu,Marcin Copik,Torsten Hoefler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向CUTLASS核函数选择的硬件感知特征表示方法。该方法将候选配置与其静态可计算的硬件行为估计相结合，通过梯度提升和神经学习排序模型，在490万个核函数数据集上训练选择器，在保持排他性评估问题上将选择遗憾降低40%（相对于结构基线）和64.2%（相对于NVIDIA的矩阵乘法启发式），并展示了跨精度和融合副操作的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代GPU库（如CUTLASS）为单个操作暴露了数万个语义等效的核函数，使得穷举自动调优成本高昂，无执行选择困难。现有分析方法需要手工设计的性能规则，而学习方法仅使用原始配置参数，需要从数据中推断硬件后果。该论文旨在通过引入硬件感知特征表示来弥合这一差距，将候选配置与其静态可计算的硬件行为估计相结合，从而提供有用的归纳偏置用于学习核函数选择。

Method: 本文方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于Nsight Compute剖析的硬件感知特征工程，通过组内Spearman相关性分析识别出有意义的执行效果（如tensor_active_pct和dram_throughput_pct），并将其转化为静态代理特征，包括工作分解与波量化、内存行为、资源压力与占用率、流水线平衡等特征组；(2) 数据收集与采样策略，构建包含593个GEMM形状（×4布局=2372个唯一组）的训练语料库，采用偏置多样采样策略（3/4预算从启发式高分区域采样，1/4从其余区域采样），收集约490万个测量核函数；(3) 学习排序模型训练，包括基于XGBoost的梯度提升排序模型（Model A）和基于LambdaRank/RankNet的前馈神经网络排序模型（Model B），采用组内排序目标进行训练，通过形状分组交叉验证和Optuna TPE贝叶斯优化进行超参数搜索，以选择遗憾（selection regret）作为最终评估指标。

Result: 在17个形状（68个布局组）的穷举评估数据集上，硬件感知MLP将平均选择遗憾降至6.2%，XGBoost为6.4%，相比之下NVIDIA矩阵乘法启发式（nvMMH）top-1为17.3%，随机选择为71.5%。硬件感知特征将最佳MLP的遗憾从7.4%降至6.2%（相对减少约16%），将XGBoost的遗憾从10.7%降至6.4%（相对减少40%）。在8000个未见BF16 GEMM的广义评估中，硬件感知MLP达到42.9 Tflop/s几何平均吞吐量，是nvMMH（37.6 Tflop/s）的1.14倍。在跨精度迁移实验中，FP32上实现1.24倍加速，FP8上实现1.19倍加速；在副操作融合迁移中以最低剂量匹配 nvMMH。在151个内部用例上实现1.14×–1.29×加速。

Conclusion: 本文证明硬件感知特征表示为CUTLASS核函数选择提供了有效的归纳偏置。核心发现是：学习性能模型的改进可能更多来自与硬件执行对齐的更好表示，而非更大的模型。原始参数往往隐藏其含义随工作负载和执行机制变化的效果，而完全分析模型需要脆弱的架构特定规则。硬件感知表示提供了中间抽象：架构知识暴露相关机制，数据学习其交互。该方法在精度、算子和架构迁移方面表现出色，为现代加速器上学习性能建模提供了实用基础。

Abstract: GPU libraries such as CUTLASS expose tens of thousands of semantically equivalent kernels for a single operation, making exhaustive autotuning expensive and execution-free selection difficult. Existing analytical selectors require hand-designed performance rules, while learned selectors operate on raw configuration parameters and must infer hardware consequences from data. We introduce a hardware-aware representation for CUTLASS kernel selection that augments candidate configurations with statically computable estimates of induced hardware behavior. We construct a dataset of 4.9 million CUTLASS kernels and train gradient-boosted and neural learning-to-rank models to rank candidates within each problem. On held-out exhaustive evaluation problems, hardware-aware representations reduce selection regret by up to 40\% relative to structural baselines and 64.2\% relative to NVIDIA's matrix-multiply heuristics. We further evaluate data-efficient cross-precision and epilogue-fusion transfer within CUTLASS GEMM, showing that explicitly representing candidate-induced hardware behavior provides a useful inductive bias for learned kernel selection.

</details>


### [1513] [Control-Geometry Straightening for Sampling-Based Latent Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35603)
*Ziang Fu,Ning Ning*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出控制几何直线化（CGS），通过在像素-动作对的局部转移上匹配动作与潜在差异的余弦相似度，学习一种利于采样式规划的世界模型表示。在线性动力学的理论分析下，CGS可增强规划Hessian的平衡性，并为MPPI、CEM和梯度下降带来有限预算/收敛保证；在PushT、Cube、TwoRooms、Reacher四个环境上以K=128的MPPI、CEM、PG-MPPI/PG-CEM和GD规划器均一致提升，相对LeWM最高+20个百分点、相对LeWM+TS最高+12.6个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）通过预测学习表征，但仅有准确的转移预测并不能保证规划目标易于优化；时序直线化（TS）约束相邻潜在差异，并未直接刻画动作如何塑造潜在转移。作者希望寻找一种表征几何，使在有限采样预算与有限精炼步数下，良好的动作序列更容易被找到。

Method: 提出控制几何直线化（CGS）：对每个转移t，将动作向量a_t与编码器得到的潜在差Δz_t标准化后构造余弦Gram矩阵K_A、K_Z，最小化‖K_Z-K_A‖_F^2（等价于逐对余弦相似度的匹配）。完整训练损失为L_LeWM + λ_CGS·L_CGS，λ_CGS在前5%步由0线性升至目标值，可与LeWM的预测损失和SIGReg共同训练。在线性动力学z_{t+1}=Az_t+Ba_t下，推导出CGS促使A≈I_d、B^TB≈cI、漂移-控制耦合D^TB≈0；进而控制规划Hessian G_H=Γ_H^⊤Γ_H相对理想投影cH·P_H的谱偏差ξ_H(ε)，并给出MPPI有限预算收敛率、CEM局部收缩结果和梯度下降收敛界。该方法可推广至DINO-WM的CLS与Patch表示。

Result: 在PushT、Cube、TwoRooms、Reacher四个环境中，LeWM+CGS在K=128的MPPI/CEM/PG-MPPI/PG-CEM/GD规划器上普遍优于LeWM和LeWM+TS：在PushT和Cube的MPPI上分别提升13.3和20.0个百分点；在Cube的GD上提升12.0个百分点；在TwoRooms的GD上提升29.3个百分点；最高相对LeWM+TS提升12.6个百分点。CGS还改善了规划预算效率（更少候选数与精炼步即可达到高成功率）并改善行为克隆先验质量；在Cube的XYZ翻译二次探针中降低MPPI种群收缩因子q_∞从0.841至0.685，并将单步进展概率在K=32时由75.1%提升至91.3%；计算开销远低于DINO-WM Patch。

Conclusion: CGS通过匹配动作与潜在差异的成对余弦相似度这一简单辅助损失，学习规划器友好的表示；理论分析表明该损失使规划Hessian在可控方向上更平衡，从而为MPPI、CEM和梯度下降规划器提供更紧的有限预算/收敛保证。实验验证CGS在多种环境与多种规划器上提高了成功率、采样与精炼效率以及先验质量，且与LeWM及TS互补；为利用像素-动作数据进一步扩展至状态依赖控制效应与更丰富动力学背景提供了自然方向。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures enable planning with latent world models, but accurate transition prediction alone does not ensure that the planning objective is easy to optimize. We introduce Control-Geometry Straightening (CGS), a single auxiliary loss that learns planner-friendly representations by directly straightening control geometry for sampling-efficient planning. CGS matches pairwise cosine similarities among actions to those among corresponding latent differences only using local transitions from pixel-action pairs. The loss can be applied across world-model architectures using end-to-end learned or pretrained representations. Under linear-dynamics, our theoretical analysis connects this objective to temporal straightening and more balanced terminal-cost curvature across the full planning horizon, yielding finite-budget guarantees for MPPI, local contraction results for CEM, and convergence bounds for gradient descent. Across four control environments and multiple planners, CGS improves planning with fewer sampled candidates and refinement steps, achieving success-rate gains up to 20 and 12.6 percentage points over LeWorldModel (LeWM) and its temporal-straightening variant (LeWM+TS), respectively, with sampling-based planners using 128 candidates per update. Probes, comparisons with DINO-WM architecture, and planner-side ablations clarify how latent motion organization, state dependence, and dynamical context shape planning behavior. Straightening control geometry thus makes good action sequences easier to find under limited planning budgets.

</details>


### [1514] [EvE: An Alternate Optimizer to Adam](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35614)
*Shashank Raj,Kalyanmoy Deb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了EvE（Evolutionary Explorer），一种结合差分进化（DE）与Adam梯度下降回退的混合优化器。EvE采用规模为4的稳定状态种群，每轮通过DE生成候选解，仅当候选解未能改进时触发短时Adam梯度下降作为"针对性回退"。在固定评估代价预算下，EvE在70个（问题，维度）单元中的76%上胜出或追平Adam；在真实神经网络任务上以1.7-3.9倍的速度完成相同预算，但最终精度略低；在UCI Adult上的超参数/架构搜索中速度快3.1-3.5倍，配置排序与Adam的一致性接近Adam自身跨种子的一致性。EvE并非Adam的全面替代品，而是面向搜索密集型、预算受限场景的快速梯度感知代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam及其变体主导着神经网络训练，但单次训练需耗费大量预算才能判断配置优劣，难以满足超参数搜索和架构搜索中"廉价排序、早期剪枝"的需求。进化算法虽能并行探索但在高维下采样效率差；纯梯度方法在多峰景观上易陷入局部最优。本文旨在通过差分进化与梯度下降的紧耦合，构造一种在固定评估预算下既快速又具备梯度感知能力的优化器，填补搜索阶段的效率空白。

Method: EvE采用规模为4的稳定状态差分进化种群，初始化采用"邻近初始化"（神经网络）或拉丁超立方（合成基准）。每轮通过rand-to-pbest/1 DE算子（含pbest牵引项）生成一个候选子代；若候选子代未能改善目标槽位，则触发n_adam步Adam梯度下降作为回退（每槽位保持持久动量状态）。选择采用贪心策略，使用共同随机数（同一minibatch评估所有比较）。多项式变异（PM）仅用于合成基准，通过接受/拒绝门控确保只可能改善候选。在判定目标上，best-so-far值具有单调非增的理论保证；每轮成本与单步Adam处于常数因子关系，与维度无关。

Result: 1) 合成基准（7个问题×10个维度，最高n=10^6，21个种子）：EvE在70个单元中显著优于33个，与Adam相当20个，劣于17个；在多模态问题（Ackley、Griewank、Rastrigin）上全面领先，在凸问题Sphere和Schwefel上Adam更强。2) MLP/MNIST（1.86M参数）：EvE以49s完成预算（vs Adam族182-192s），速度快3.7-3.9×，但精度低约1个百分点（97.0% vs 98.0-98.2%）。3) LoRA微调Qwen2.5-1.5B（Alpaca）：速度快1.7-2.0×，测试损失高约11%。4) LoRA微调Qwen2.5-1.5B（GSM8K）：速度快1.9-2.0×，下游精度低约5个百分点。6) UCI Adult连续举搜超参/架构搜索：速度快3.1-3.5×，Kendall's τ为0.66-0.69（与Adam跨种子自身一致性0.67-0.69相当）。

Conclusion: EvE是一种有实用价值的快速优化器，但并非Adam作为最终阶段训练器的全面替代品。其核心定位是面向超参数搜索、架构搜索及预算受限场景下的"快速梯度感知代理"——以较小的最终精度损失换取显著的速度提升。EvE的配置排序能力接近Adam，使其适合作为搜索回路中的内部优化器。未来工作方向包括自适应种群/变异/初始化策略，以及在更多数据集上扩展搜索回路证据。

Abstract: Adam and its variants dominate neural network training, but a single run only reveals whether a configuration works well after most of its budget is spent, a poor fit for hyperparameter or architecture search, where configurations must be ranked cheaply and pruned early. We introduce EvE (Evolutionary Explorer), a steady-state, population-of-four differential evolution (DE) optimizer with a targeted Adam fallback: each iteration proposes one candidate via DE, running a short burst of gradient descent only if the DE step fails to improve on the incumbent. Selection is greedy, so on a deterministic objective the best-so-far value is provably monotone non-increasing, and since gradients are used only as a targeted rescue, per-iteration cost stays within a constant factor of a single Adam step regardless of dimension. Under a fixed, evaluation-cost-matched budget, EvE wins or ties Adam on 76% of 70 (problem, dimension) cells across seven scalable benchmarks up to one million variables. On three real neural-network tasks (an MLP on MNIST, and LoRA fine-tuning of a 1.5B-parameter language model on two datasets) EvE finishes the same charged budget 1.7-3.9x faster, at a modest cost in final quality (about one accuracy point on MNIST, 9-11% higher relative test loss on the two fine-tuning tasks; on GSM8K, Adam is about 5 accuracy points more accurate, and fine-tuning lowers accuracy below the base model for both). Inside successive halving on UCI Adult, EvE completes hyperparameter and architecture searches 3.1-3.5x faster, ranking configurations about as consistently with Adam as Adam does with itself across seeds (Kendall's tau 0.66-0.69). EvE is not a total replacement for Adam as a final-stage trainer, but a fast, gradient-aware proxy for the search-heavy, budget-constrained regime one level up.

</details>


### [1515] [Attention Graphons: A Graph Limit Perspective on Graph Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35620)
*Caio F. Deberaldini Netto,Moshe Eliasof,Luana Ruiz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"注意力图论"框架，将图Transformer的注意力矩阵视为稠密加权图，并利用密集图极限理论（graphons）分析其是否随图规模n增长而收敛到稳定的数据集级别核。通过推导截距/截范数方差界，提出canonicalize-then-block-average估计流程，并在多个基准上验证注意力稳定性和跨尺度可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图Transformer每个注意力头产生n×n的稠密交互矩阵，但这些注意力图是否会随n增长收敛到稳定的极限对象（即与大小无关的核），或是保持无结构且依赖于尺寸——这一问题尚无理论刻画。若存在稳定极限，则可压缩交互模式、支持跨图大小的可迁移性，并为规模泛化提供理论基础。

Method: 核心方法包含三部分：(1) 理论层面——将对称化后的pre-softmax注意力矩阵通过sigmoid映射到(0,1)作为注意力图，利用密集图极限理论推导截距方差的最坏情况界（O(1/log n)，基于第二采样引理）和基于Hölder正则性的更紧的截范数方差界（多项式速率n^{-2min(α,1)/(min(α,1)+1)}，基于非参数graphon估计理论）；(2) 估计流程——canonicalize-then-block-average：尺寸归一化→度排序规范化→分块平均，并基于估计graphon设计单侧假设检验诊断注意力是否具有稳定连续描述；(3) 实验验证——在8个真实图基准和3个合成数据集上，测试cut-norm方差是否随n衰减、估计图论是否稳定、以及小图训练的GT能否通过估计graphon迁移到大图。

Result: 实验结果表明：(1) 在多数数据集上（除REDDIT-MULTI-5K外），cut-norm的经验方差随n增长而下降，低于正则性感知的理论代理𝒪(n^{-1})，支持注意力集中于稳定核的假设；(2) 估计的注意力graphon随目标尺寸N增长而稳定，且不同数据集呈现不同的kernel结构；(3) 基于小图估计的graphon可迁移至大图，准确率差距随训练尺寸增大而缩小（特别在SmoothW上），相比O(n²d)的query-key乘积，因式分解注意力计算复杂度为O(nd_v + K²d_v)；(4) 图论正则性（以Lipschitz常数衡量）与任务难度在合成数据上相关，SharpW比SmoothW训练损失更高、谱扩散更大；(5) 多架构（GPS、Graphormer-GD、GRIT）和多数据集上一致观察到此现象，bootstrap和permutation检验支持结论稳健性。

Conclusion: 本文确立了图Transformer注意力矩阵的graphon视角：对于固定训练的GT，每头注意力在大n极限下常可由数据集相关的graphon描述，cut-norm方差随尺寸减小。该视角为注意力模式的跨数据集/跨尺度总结与比较提供了原则性方法，并支持通过采样graphon实现高效的跨尺度迁移。框架在稀疏/有向/尺寸依赖注意力等情形下存在失效可能，需要进一步发展resolution-free神经估计器和有向核扩展。

Abstract: Graph Transformers produce, for each attention head, a dense $n\times n$ matrix of learned pairwise interactions. We ask a fundamental question: do these attention-induced graphs converge to a stable limit object as $n$ grows, or does the learned interaction pattern remain unstructured and size-dependent? We answer this using dense graph limit theory, treating each attention matrix as a finite sample from an underlying kernel---an \emph{attention graphon}---and studying concentration around this limit under the cut-distance. We derive a worst-case variance bound requiring no assumptions on the graphon, and a sharper regularity-aware bound based on nonparametric estimation theory. To operationalize the theory, we propose a canonicalize-then-block-average pipeline for estimating dataset-level attention graphons, and a variance-based diagnostic for testing whether attention admits a stable continuum description. Experiments across multiple graph benchmarks show that learned attention stabilizes to dataset-specific graphon structure on several datasets; that empirical cut-distance and cut-norm variance decreases with $n$ consistent with our bounds; and that attention graphons transfer to larger graph sizes with error decreasing in $n$.

</details>


### [1516] [Cartridges++: KV Cache Compression without Off-Context Derailment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35621)
*Sonia Laguna,Joao Monteiro,Marco Cuturi,Pierre Ablin,Eleonora Gualdoni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Serving long documents to a Large Language Model (LLM) repeatedly is expensive: computations grow with context length, and the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache balloons. Compressed KV (CKV) representations aim to mimic the cache of a document and are typically computed once and for all, ahead of inference time. Methods to obtain CKVs range from drop mechanisms that reduce their number of columns, to learned approaches. Among the latter, Cartridges have emerged as a leading compression method, learning compact KV representations through distillation on relevant Q/A pairs. While existing evaluations focus primarily on whether Cartridges and other CKVs yield approximately similar responses to document-related, on-context queries, we investigate the crucial deployment question of whether they can handle off-context queries, something the native KV representation is particularly good at, thanks to the mechanics of attention. We observe a fundamental trade-off: while Cartridges perform better for on-context queries, heuristic-variants preserve better the original LLM's ability to operate off-context. We measure this through their capability to avoid context contamination in their response, retain general knowledge, and follow instructions. We propose Cartridges++, simple modifications to cartridges that retain off-context abilities at small or negligible cost. The router variant decides at inference time whether the query should use the learned long-context memory, while the data-mixing variant allocates a small fraction of training Q/As to queries outside the reference long document. Our study shows that assessing CKVs on document utility alone can mask substantial degradation in broader model capabilities, yet those issues can be fixed with benign changes to CKV inference or training.

The router variant decides at inference time whether the query should use the learned long-context memory, while the data-mixing variant allocates a small fraction of training Q/As to queries outside the reference long document. Our study shows that assessing CKVs on document utility alone can mask substantial degradation in broader model capabilities, yet those issues can be fixed with benign changes to CKV inference or training.

</details>


### [1517] [Arbitrary-Accuracy Neural Approximation with Optimal Neuron Count and Near-Optimal Bit Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35628)
*Zilan Cheng,Li-Lian Wang,Zhongjian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We study the minimum number of hidden neurons required for arbitrary-accuracy approximation of multivariate Hölder-continuous functions on $[0,1]^d$ and the associated encoding complexity. For $d\geq 2$, we construct a fixed, explicitly defined activation function for which a closed-form network with two hidden layers of widths $d$ and $1$ achieves arbitrary accuracy in the uniform norm. We prove that $d+1$ is the exact minimum total number of hidden neurons among standard feedforward networks with locally integrable activations and affine outputs. We further give a simpler construction using a single elementary activation that combines the floor and exponential functions. This construction requires three hidden layers of widths $d$, $1$, and $2$, only two neurons above the minimum. If a skip connection is allowed, widths $d$, $1$, and $1$ suffice. These constructions use explicit grid addressing and integer encoding of quantized function values. For a bounded $\alpha$-Hölder class, they require $O(\varepsilon^{-d/\alpha}\log(1/\varepsilon))$ bits, matching the metric-entropy lower bound up to a logarithmic factor.

### [1518] [SANTA++: Sampling Attention through Representative Keys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35629)
*Kyle Lee,Christian Z. Pratt,Ruoyu Fang,Heekyung Lee,Avinash Lohitsa,Ryan Modafe,Kerem Y. Camsari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Attention often concentrates on a small subset of tokens in the context, but which subset matters changes from one query to the next. To exploit this changing structure, we introduce SANTA++, a training-free stochastic attention method that uses representative keys for memory-efficient selection without scanning the entire key-value (KV) cache. Cached keys are organized into teams, and the query scores one representative from each team to decide which teams to sample. We compute exact attention scores within the sampled teams and reweight each team's contribution by the inverse of its inclusion probability. This importance sampling correction estimates attention over the full cache, with a sampling budget that lets us trade memory reads for accuracy. Remarkably, with 32 or 64 sampled teams, SANTA++ uses 16% to 22% of dense attention's KV reads and retains 94% to 99% of the dense-attention baseline's scores on LongBench v2 and HELMET's retrieval-augmented generation subset, and 85% to 91% on RULER, with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at 32K context. With 31 sampled teams, our GPU implementation delivers a $1.69\times$ attention speedup over the dense FlashAttention baseline at 32K context. By reducing the number of cache entries read, SANTA++ in principle complements architectures with compressed KV representations, such as multi-head latent attention. Our kernels are available at: this https URL .

### [1519] [Bounding Retraining Equivalence and the Deletion Floor in Materials Machine Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35635)
*Can Polat,Mustafa Kurban,Erchin Serpedin,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: In materials machine learning, closely related retained structures can sustain accurate property predictions even after removing a specific record, rendering post-deletion prediction error an ambiguous metric for machine unlearning. To resolve this ambiguity, we define the deletion floor as the expected target loss under a specified retraining procedure at the deleted request. Standard indistinguishability constraints yield a sharp interval bounding an update's target loss around this baseline reference. Theoretically, a conditional neighbor bound links a low deletion floor directly to retained fit, prediction regularity, and local label agreement, while an exact ridge identity isolates residual fit from the prediction change induced by record deletion. Empirically, controlled redundancy sweeps show an $\approx 8\times$ drop in median normalized retraining loss when one retained relative remains after deletion. Across two distinct fitting regimes in a paired Materials Project study, the lower-floor regime also exhibits a larger prediction change on more than 50% of the shared requests. Systematic comparisons against approximate updates and the original model decouple deliberate target suppression from preserved overall model utility. Consequently, request-level unlearning evaluations should report reference loss, prediction change, and retained utility together, interpreting post-deletion accuracy against what retraining itself leaves behind.

### [1520] [Transferable Mass Spectrum Prediction via Reference-Guided Test-time Specialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35649)
*Yunhua Zhong,Runting Li,Yifan Li,Pan Liu,Zhiwen Yang,Zikun Wang,Yixuan Tang,Jun Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tandem mass spectrum prediction supports compound identification across metabolomics, natural-product discovery, and environmental analysis. However, pretrained predictors often degrade under shifts in chemical space and acquisition conditions, while retraining domain-specific models from scratch is costly. We introduce SPARC, a retrieval-guided test-time specialization framework that adapts a pretrained predictor using a spectral reference library without accessing test-query spectra. For each target query, SPARC retrieves chemically related reference spectra to recalibrate fragment intensities within the learned fragmentation space. During Transfer, SPARC combines reference-guided spectral adaptation with reliability-aware consistency, using reconstruction behavior on retrieved spectra to selectively preserve trustworthy predictions during continual specialization. Across MassSpecGym, NPLIB1 and application-specific GNPS libraries, SPARC improves spectral prediction under multiple transfer settings. These results establish retrieval-guided test-time specialization as a practical strategy for extending pretrained MS/MS predictors to specific chemical and acquisition domains, with continual test-time training providing further refinement during deployment.

### [1521] [Rethinking Personalized Generation: Test-Time Alignment via Factorized Ranking Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35695)
*Qiyao Ma,Junshan Zhang,Zhe Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to diverse user preferences is fundamentally hindered by standard alignment paradigms that optimize for monolithic users. In this work, empirical studies are first used to reveal the existence of a massive, untapped performance headroom for personalized generation through test-time alignment. We demonstrate that personalized generation is uniquely suited for test-time scaling methods like Best-of-N (BoN) because it can be viewed primarily as a candidate matching problem rather than a generator capability bottleneck. While reward models could in principle exploit this headroom, they are poorly calibrated for personalization, and their billion-parameter scale makes scoring large candidate pools prohibitively expensive. To overcome this limitation, we propose a parameter-efficient framework utilizing million-parameter scale multi-layer perceptron (MLP) ranking models. Our personalized ranking model directly reuses the internal embeddings of the base generator with minimal overhead. By scaling train-time data to provide fine-grained personalized preferences, this million-parameter ranking model accurately scores large candidate pools and can seamlessly guide generation to reduce the cost of materializing N candidates. Extensive experiments on nine datasets spanning three personalized generation settings show that our personalized ranking model effectively exploits the discovered headroom, outperforming billion-parameter generalist reward models on every dataset, with under 0.4% of their parameters and four orders of magnitude lower scoring latency.

### [1522] [Provable Benefits of Regularization: Fast Rates for Adversarial Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35698)
*Hanbin Zhou,Shangzhe Li,Alexander Braverman,Weitong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We study adversarial imitation learning (AIL), in which an agent learns to imitate expert demonstrations by optimizing a policy against an adversarial reward that distinguishes expert and learner behavior. Historically, reward regularization and entropy-based policy regularization are key components of empirically successful methods such as GAIL and LS-IQ, yet their finite-sample benefits remain underexplored. We establish fast rates for jointly regularized AIL in finite-horizon Markov decision processes with general function approximation. Our model-free algorithm, Dually Regularized AIL, combines KL policy regularization with a quadratic reward penalty weighted by expert and learner occupancies. With K online episodes and N expert trajectories, we prove a $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{K}+\frac{1}{N}\right)$ bound on the regularized imitation gap for fixed regularization parameters. Our analysis combines an online mirror descent construction for general convex reward classes to control estimation error from finite expert data and stochastic learner feedback, with a sharp analysis of optimistic KL-regularized policy learning. To the best of our knowledge, Dually Regularized AIL is the first algorithm to simultaneously achieve $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\epsilon}\right)$ sample complexity in both expert demonstrations and online interactions for this regularized AIL objective, even with stochastic experts. These results provide a rigorous characterization of the complementary statistical benefits of reward and policy regularization in AIL.

### [1523] [MeqMuon: Matrix-Equilibrating Muon for LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35701)
*Chang-Wei Shi,Xu Wang,Wu-Jun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: The success of large language models (LLMs) has been accompanied by continued growth in model size and pretraining costs. Muon offers high accuracy and training efficiency in LLM pretraining. Recent work introduces row-wise normalization into Muon to balance update magnitudes and improve pretraining performance. However, row-wise normalization alone cannot accommodate different imbalance patterns in update matrices. In this paper, we propose an improved Muon optimizer, called \underline{m}atrix-\underline{eq}uilibrating Muon~(MeqMuon), for LLM pretraining. MeqMuon balances both row and column magnitudes through normalization that can be automatically tailored to different imbalance patterns without manual intervention. Moreover, MeqMuon eliminates the need to store AdamW's second-moment estimates, reducing optimizer-state memory usage. Empirical results demonstrate that MeqMuon achieves better convergence performance than AdamW, Muon, and other baselines in LLM pretraining.

### [1524] [ScAn-Bench: Evaluating Scaling Analysis Methodology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35707)
*Artin Sermaxhaj,Nastaran Alipour,Donat Sinani,Johannes Hog,Neeratyoy Mallik,Jenia Jitsev,Danny Stoll*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Recent progress in machine learning is driven by large-scale foundation models, where scaling laws and finding optimal scaling prescriptions for architecture, data, and hyperparameters are key in advancing the state-of-the-art. Therefore, it is surprising that no systematic study evaluates the methodology to obtain scaling laws and prescriptions across different model types. To shed light on this crucial blind spot and facilitate future research, we introduce the surrogate benchmarks ScAn-Bench-LLM and ScAn-Bench-VLM based on 4524 and 8024 checkpoints of language and vision-language model pipelines. On our benchmarks, we perform the first systematic evaluation of both data acquisition and extrapolation methodology for scaling analysis across different data modalities.

### [1525] [Neural Harmonic Measure Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35752)
*Jinjin He,Sinan Wang,Yuchen Sun,Bo Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We introduce Neural Harmonic Measure Operator (NHMO), a neural solver for elliptic PDE problems on variable-shape domains. The harmonic measure of a domain is the boundary probability distribution that, integrated against any boundary data, returns the Dirichlet Laplace solution. It depends only on the geometry, not on the boundary data. NHMO parameterizes the density of this measure as a transformer-based boundary kernel supervised by Walk-on-Spheres exit samples, so one trained kernel handles different boundary values on a shape with no retraining. We extend it to Poisson via a classical decomposition, with an auxiliary network amortizing the source-induced correction and avoiding the singular volume quadrature that breaks direct evaluation. At inference, new boundary values and new sources both yield PDE solutions by re-integration against the fitted kernel and lift, with no retraining. NHMO improves over four prior baselines on the MCB-B 3D variable-shape Poisson benchmark across all five categories, and is competitive with major neural-operator baselines on a controlled 2D testbed.

### [1526] [Unifying Distributional Training for One-Step Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35763)
*Chi Zhang,Haoyang Shi,Yueyi Liu,Ruichuan An,Junkang Zhou,Chang Li,Xiuyuan Lu,Yichi Zhang,Bo Wang,Yuhang Wu,Sen Cui,Miao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: \emph{Distributional training} provides collective supervision for one-step visual generation by matching real and generated features in frozen representation spaces. We introduce \emph{a unified theoretical framework} that separates distribution modeling from matching discrepancy and connects global objectives to pointwise feature updates through Wasserstein gradient flow. Under this framework, FD-Loss and Gaussian-kernel Drifting are recovered through Gaussian optimal transport and kernel-density-based KL matching, respectively. The framework motivates \textbf{MGFlow}, which models feature distributions with Gaussian mixtures at an adjustable granularity between global moments and sample-based representations. MGFlow supports both optimal transport and score-based matching, and couples mass-constrained sample assignment with paired component updates to address mode collapse that mixture expressivity alone does not resolve. On ImageNet $256\times256$, MGFlow substantially surpasses the FD-Loss baseline, achieving state-of-the-art results with \textbf{1.45} $\mathrm{FDr}^6$ on pMF-H and \textbf{1.64} on JiT-H. For text-to-image generation, MGFlow post-trains FLUX.2 [klein] 4B into a one-step generator that outperforms the original four-step model on both GenEval and PickScore.
